	internal class ListParser
	{
		[Flags]
		private enum State
		{
			Initial = 1,
			Escape = 2,
			QuoteOpened = 4,
			QuoteClosed = 8
		}

		private char[] _openQuoteChars;

		private char[] _closeQuoteChars;

		private char _escapeCharacter;

		private char _itemsSeparatorChar;

		private long _mask_allSpecialChars;

		private long _mask_openQuoteChars;

		private long _mask_closeQuoteChars;

		private long _mask_specialCharsWithinQuotes;

		private char[] _allSpecialChars;

		private char[] _specialCharsWithinQuotes;

		public ListParser(char openQuoteChar, char closeQuoteChar, char escapeCharacter, char itemsSeparatorChar)
			: this(new char[1] { openQuoteChar }, new char[1] { closeQuoteChar }, escapeCharacter, itemsSeparatorChar)
		{
		}

		public ListParser(char[] openQuoteChars, char[] closeQuoteChars, char escapeCharacter, char itemsSeparatorChar)
		{
			if (openQuoteChars.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Open quote chars not specified.");
			}
			if (openQuoteChars.Length != closeQuoteChars.Length)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Open and close quote chars must match.");
			}
			_openQuoteChars = openQuoteChars;
			_closeQuoteChars = closeQuoteChars;
			_escapeCharacter = escapeCharacter;
			_itemsSeparatorChar = itemsSeparatorChar;
			_allSpecialChars = Aggregate<char>(openQuoteChars, closeQuoteChars, new char[2] { escapeCharacter, itemsSeparatorChar });
			_specialCharsWithinQuotes = Aggregate<char>(openQuoteChars, closeQuoteChars, new char[1] { escapeCharacter });
			_mask_allSpecialChars = CalcMask(_allSpecialChars);
			_mask_specialCharsWithinQuotes = CalcMask(_specialCharsWithinQuotes);
			_mask_openQuoteChars = CalcMask(_openQuoteChars);
			_mask_closeQuoteChars = CalcMask(_closeQuoteChars);
		}

		private void AddItemHelper(IList<string> itemList, StringBuilder sb, ref int lastEscapedIndexInSB, bool trimTrailingSpaces, bool skipEmptyItems)
		{
			if (trimTrailingSpaces)
			{
				TrimTrailingSpaces(sb, lastEscapedIndexInSB);
			}
			if (sb.Length > 0 || !skipEmptyItems)
			{
				itemList.Add(sb.ToString());
			}
			sb.Remove(0, sb.Length);
			lastEscapedIndexInSB = -1;
		}

		private static T[] Aggregate<T>(params IEnumerable<T>[] collections)
		{
			List<T> list = new List<T>();
			foreach (IEnumerable<T> collection in collections)
			{
				list.AddRange(collection);
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void Append_EncloseInQuotes(StringBuilder sb, string item)
		{
			sb.Append(_openQuoteChars[0]);
			string value = EscapeString(item, withinQuotes: true, escapeLeadingAndTrailingWhiteSpace: false);
			sb.Append(value);
			sb.Append(_closeQuoteChars[0]);
		}

		private static long CalcMask(char[] arr)
		{
			long num = 1L;
			for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length; i++)
			{
				long num2 = num * (int)arr[i];
				if (num2 > num)
				{
					num = num2;
					continue;
				}
				num = 0L;
				break;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private static bool ContainsCharHelper(char[] arr, char c, long mask)
		{
			if (mask % (int)c == 0L)
			{
				return Array.IndexOf(arr, c) >= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool DoesCharNeedEscaping(char c, bool withinQuotes)
		{
			if (!withinQuotes)
			{
				return DoesCharNeedEscaping(c);
			}
			return DoesCharNeedEscapingWithinQuotes(c);
		}

		private bool DoesCharNeedEscaping(char c)
		{
			return ContainsCharHelper(_allSpecialChars, c, _mask_allSpecialChars);
		}

		private bool DoesCharNeedEscapingWithinQuotes(char c)
		{
			return ContainsCharHelper(_specialCharsWithinQuotes, c, _mask_specialCharsWithinQuotes);
		}

		private char GetCorrespondingCloseQuoteChar(char openQuote)
		{
			char[] openQuoteChars = _openQuoteChars;
			for (int i = 0; i < openQuoteChars.Length; i++)
			{
				if (openQuote == openQuoteChars[i])
				{
					return _closeQuoteChars[i];
				}
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("Specified character is not an open quote character.");
		}

		private bool IsCloseQuoteChar(char c)
		{
			return ContainsCharHelper(_closeQuoteChars, c, _mask_closeQuoteChars);
		}

		private bool IsOpenQuoteChar(char c)
		{
			return ContainsCharHelper(_openQuoteChars, c, _mask_openQuoteChars);
		}

		private static void TrimTrailingSpaces(StringBuilder sb, int lastEscapedCharIndex)
		{
			int num = sb.Length - 1;
			while (num >= 0 && num > lastEscapedCharIndex && char.IsWhiteSpace(sb[num]))
			{
				sb.Remove(num, 1);
				num--;
			}
		}

		internal static ListParser CreateDefault(char separatorChar = ',')
		{
			char[] array = new char[2] { '\'', '"' };
			return new ListParser(array, array, '\\', separatorChar);
		}

		public void ConstructList(IEnumerable<string> items, bool separateEachItemBySpace, StringBuilder dest)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (items == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (string item in items)
			{
				if (num > 0)
				{
					dest.Append(_itemsSeparatorChar);
					if (separateEachItemBySpace)
					{
						dest.Append(' ');
					}
				}
				dest.Append(EscapeString(item, withinQuotes: false, escapeLeadingAndTrailingWhiteSpace: true));
				num++;
			}
		}

		public string ConstructList(IEnumerable<string> items, bool separateEachItemBySpace)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			ConstructList(items, separateEachItemBySpace, stringBuilder);
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public string EscapeString(string text, bool withinQuotes, bool escapeLeadingAndTrailingWhiteSpace)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = null;
			int i = 0;
			for (int num = text?.Length ?? 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (DoesCharNeedEscaping(c, withinQuotes) || (escapeLeadingAndTrailingWhiteSpace && (i == 0 || 1 + i == text.Length) && !withinQuotes && char.IsWhiteSpace(c)))
				{
					if (stringBuilder == null)
					{
						stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(text, 0, i, 2 * text.Length - i);
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(_escapeCharacter).Append(c);
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder?.Append(c);
				}
			}
			if (stringBuilder != null)
			{
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal int GetNextSeparator(string text, int startIndex)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			int i = startIndex;
			for (int length = text.Length; i < length; i++)
			{
				if (!flag && _itemsSeparatorChar == text[i])
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		public string NormalizeEscapement(string text, bool withinQuotes)
		{
			return EscapeString(UnEscapeString(text), withinQuotes, escapeLeadingAndTrailingWhiteSpace: true);
		}

		public void ParseList(string text, bool skipEmptyItems, IList<string> dest)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			State state = State.Initial;
			char c = '\0';
			int lastEscapedIndexInSB = -1;
			int i = 0;
			for (int length = text.Length; i < length; i++)
			{
				char c2 = text[i];
				if (State.Escape == (State.Escape & state))
				{
					lastEscapedIndexInSB = stringBuilder.Length;
					stringBuilder.Append(c2);
					state ^= State.Escape;
				}
				else if (_escapeCharacter == c2)
				{
					state |= State.Escape;
				}
				else if (State.QuoteOpened == (State.QuoteOpened & state) && c2 == c)
				{
					AddItemHelper(dest, stringBuilder, ref lastEscapedIndexInSB, trimTrailingSpaces: false, skipEmptyItems);
					state ^= State.QuoteOpened;
					state |= State.QuoteClosed;
				}
				else if (State.QuoteOpened != (State.QuoteOpened & state) && IsOpenQuoteChar(c2))
				{
					c = GetCorrespondingCloseQuoteChar(c2);
					state |= State.QuoteOpened;
					state &= ~State.QuoteClosed;
				}
				else if (State.QuoteClosed == (State.QuoteClosed & state) && _itemsSeparatorChar == c2)
				{
					state ^= State.QuoteClosed;
				}
				else if (State.QuoteClosed == (State.QuoteClosed & state))
				{
					state ^= State.QuoteClosed;
				}
				else if (State.Initial != state || !char.IsWhiteSpace(c2) || stringBuilder.Length != 0)
				{
					if (State.Initial == state && _itemsSeparatorChar == c2)
					{
						AddItemHelper(dest, stringBuilder, ref lastEscapedIndexInSB, trimTrailingSpaces: true, skipEmptyItems);
						state &= ~State.QuoteClosed;
					}
					else
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(c2);
					}
				}
			}
			if (State.Initial != state && State.Escape != state)
			{
				_ = 4;
			}
			if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
			{
				AddItemHelper(dest, stringBuilder, ref lastEscapedIndexInSB, trimTrailingSpaces: true, skipEmptyItems);
			}
		}

		public IList<string> ParseList(string text, bool skipEmptyItems)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			ParseList(text, skipEmptyItems, list);
			return list;
		}

		public string UnEscapeString(string text)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = null;
			int i = 0;
			for (int num = text?.Length ?? 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				char c = text[i];
				if (_escapeCharacter == c)
				{
					if (stringBuilder == null)
					{
						stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(text, 0, i, text.Length - 1);
					}
					i++;
					if (i < text.Length)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(text[i]);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder?.Append(c);
				}
			}
			if (stringBuilder != null)
			{
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}
	}
}
namespace Infragistics.Win
{
	internal static class ScaledDrawingUtils
	{
		internal const double RADIANS_PER_DEGREE = Math.PI / 180.0;

		internal static double CalculateDistanceBetweenTwoPoints(Point p1, Point p2)
		{
			return Math.Sqrt(Math.Pow(p1.X - p2.X, 2.0) + Math.Pow(p1.Y - p2.Y, 2.0));
		}

		internal static float CalculateLineYFromX(PointF point1, PointF point2, int x)
		{
			float num = CalculateSlope(point1, point2);
			return ((float)x - point1.X) * num + point1.Y;
		}

		internal static float CalculateLineXFromY(PointF point1, PointF point2, int y)
		{
			float num = CalculateSlope(point1, point2);
			return ((float)y - point1.Y) / num + point1.X;
		}

		internal static PointF CalculatePointOnLine(PointF point1, PointF point2, float percentage)
		{
			return new PointF(point1.X + (point2.X - point1.X) * percentage, point1.Y + (point2.Y - point1.Y) * percentage);
		}

		internal static PointF CalculatePointOnLine(PointF startingPoint, double angle, float length)
		{
			return new PointF(startingPoint.X + (float)Math.Cos(angle) * length, startingPoint.Y + (float)Math.Sin(angle) * length);
		}

		internal static float CalculateSlope(PointF p1, PointF p2)
		{
			return (p2.Y - p1.Y) / (p2.X - p1.X);
		}

		internal static void CenterPoint(ref PointF point, float imageWidth, float imageHeight, SizeF availableSize)
		{
			float num = availableSize.Width / 2f;
			float num2 = availableSize.Height / 2f;
			float num3 = imageWidth / 2f;
			float num4 = imageHeight / 2f;
			float num5 = num - num3;
			float num6 = num2 - num4;
			point.X += num5;
			point.Y += num6;
		}

		internal static void CenterPoints(ref PointF[] points, float imageWidth, float imageHeight, SizeF availableSize)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				CenterPoint(ref points[i], imageWidth, imageHeight, availableSize);
			}
		}

		internal static void CenterRect(ref RectangleF rect, SizeF availableSize)
		{
			CenterRect(ref rect, rect.Width, rect.Height, availableSize);
		}

		internal static void CenterRect(ref RectangleF rect, float imageWidth, float imageHeight, SizeF availableSize)
		{
			float num = availableSize.Width / 2f;
			float num2 = availableSize.Height / 2f;
			float num3 = imageWidth / 2f;
			float num4 = imageHeight / 2f;
			float num5 = num - num3;
			float num6 = num2 - num4;
			rect.X += num5;
			rect.Y += num6;
		}

		internal static void DrawDot(Graphics g, Brush brush, Point p)
		{
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(p.X, p.Y, 1, 1);
			g.FillRectangle(brush, rect);
		}

		internal static float GetFontSizeInPointsToFitHeightInPixels(int fontHeightInPixels)
		{
			float num = DpiUtilities.GetSystemDpi();
			return (float)fontHeightInPixels * (72f / num);
		}

		internal static PointF GetPointOnEllipse(RectangleF rect, double angleInRadians)
		{
			if (rect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return rect.Location;
			}
			float num = rect.Width / 2f;
			float num2 = rect.Height / 2f;
			double num3 = Math.Cos(angleInRadians);
			double num4 = Math.Sin(angleInRadians);
			double num5 = num4 / num3;
			double num6 = num5 * (double)num / (double)num2;
			double num7 = 1.0 / Math.Sqrt(1.0 + num6 * num6);
			PointF pt = new PointF(rect.Left + num, rect.Top + num2);
			double num8 = (double)num * num7 * (double)Math.Sign(num3);
			double num9 = (double)num2 * num7 * num6 * (double)Math.Sign(num3);
			return PointF.Add(pt, new SizeF((float)num8, (float)num9));
		}

		internal static void OffsetPoints(Point[] points, ref Point offSet)
		{
			if (!offSet.IsEmpty)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
				{
					points[i].Offset(offSet);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static double RadiansFromDegrees(float degrees)
		{
			return (double)degrees * (Math.PI / 180.0);
		}

		internal static void RotateRect90DegreesRight(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Rectangle rect)
		{
			int num = referenceRect.Bottom - rect.Bottom;
			int num2 = rect.Left - referenceRect.Left;
			rect = new Rectangle(referenceRect.Left + num, referenceRect.Top + num2, rect.Height, rect.Width);
		}

		internal static void RotatePoints180Degrees(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				RotatePoint180Degrees(referenceRect, ref points[i]);
			}
		}

		internal static void RotatePoint180Degrees(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point point)
		{
			RotatePoint90DegreesRight(referenceRect, ref point);
			RotatePoint90DegreesRight(referenceRect, ref point);
		}

		internal static void RotatePoints90DegreesRight(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				RotatePoint90DegreesRight(referenceRect, ref points[i]);
			}
		}

		internal static void RotatePoint90DegreesRight(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point point)
		{
			int num = referenceRect.Bottom - point.Y - 1;
			int num2 = point.X - referenceRect.Left;
			point = new Point(referenceRect.Left + num, referenceRect.Top + num2);
		}

		internal static void RotatePoints90DegreesLeft(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				RotatePoint90DegreesLeft(referenceRect, ref points[i]);
			}
		}

		internal static void RotatePoint90DegreesLeft(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point point)
		{
			int num = referenceRect.Right - point.X - 1;
			int y = point.Y;
			point = new Point(referenceRect.Left + y, referenceRect.Top + num);
		}

		internal static void FlipPointsHorizontally(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				FlipPointHorizontally(referenceRect, ref points[i]);
			}
		}

		internal static void FlipPointHorizontally(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point point)
		{
			point = new Point(referenceRect.Right - point.X - 1, point.Y);
		}

		internal static void FlipPointsVertically(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point[] points)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < points.Length; i++)
			{
				FlipPointVertically(referenceRect, ref points[i]);
			}
		}

		internal static void FlipPointVertically(Rectangle referenceRect, ref Point point)
		{
			point = new Point(point.X, referenceRect.Bottom - point.Y - 1);
		}

		internal static Bitmap TrimImage(Bitmap originalImage, Color backColor)
		{
			int width = originalImage.Width;
			int height = originalImage.Height;
			int num = width - 1;
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = height - 1;
			int num4 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < width; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < height; j++)
				{
					Color pixel = originalImage.GetPixel(i, j);
					if (!ColorSelector.IsSameColor(backColor, pixel))
					{
						num = Math.Min(num, i);
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, i);
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, j);
						num4 = Math.Max(num4, j);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int width2 = num2 - num + 1;
			int height2 = num4 - num3 + 1;
			Rectangle srcRect = new Rectangle(num, num3, width2, height2);
			Rectangle destRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, width2, height2);
			if (originalImage.Size != destRect.Size)
			{
				Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(width2, height2);
				using Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(bitmap);
				graphics.DrawImage(originalImage, destRect, srcRect, GraphicsUnit.Pixel);
				return bitmap;
			}
			return originalImage;
		}
	}

			{
				num3--;
				num++;
			}
			int x2 = num + num3 / 2;
			int num4 = height / 2;
			int num5 = height - num4;
			int num6 = top + num5 / 2;
			int y = num6 + num4;
			Point[] points = new Point[3]
			{
				new Point(num, num6),
				new Point(x, num6),
				new Point(x2, y)
			};
			using Brush brush = new SolidBrush(color);
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillPolygon(brush, points);
		}

		internal static Rectangle GetImageRectForElement(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, UltraGridLayout layout, bool useButtonPadding = true)
		{
			Rectangle elementDrawingRect = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).ElementDrawingRect;
			int num = Math.Min(elementDrawingRect.Width, elementDrawingRect.Height);
			if (useButtonPadding)
			{
				int borderThickness = layout.GetBorderThickness((UIElementBorderStyle)8);
				num -= layout.HEADER_BUTTON_PADDING + borderThickness * 2;
			}
			Rectangle result = new Rectangle(0, 0, num, num);
			DrawUtility.AdjustHAlign((HAlign)2, ref result, elementDrawingRect);
			DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign((VAlign)2, ref result, elementDrawingRect);
			return result;
		}
	}

namespace Infragistics.Win.UltraWinGrid
{
	internal class ActionHistory
	{
		internal abstract class ActionBase
		{
			private ActionHistory actionHistory;

			private bool checkForReadOnlyCells = true;

			internal ActionHistory ActionHistory => actionHistory;

			internal UltraGridLayout Layout => ActionHistory.Layout;

			internal bool CheckForReadOnlyCells
			{
				get
				{
					return checkForReadOnlyCells;
				}
				set
				{
					checkForReadOnlyCells = value;
				}
			}

			internal ActionBase(ActionHistory actionHistory)
			{
				GridUtils.ValidateNull(actionHistory);
				this.actionHistory = actionHistory;
			}

			internal abstract bool CanPerform(object context);

			internal abstract bool Perform(object context, out ActionBase undoAction);
		}

		private class ActionsCollection
		{
			private const int MAX_ITEMS = 100;

			private List<ActionBase> stack;

			internal int Count => stack.Count;

			internal ActionsCollection()
			{
				stack = new List<ActionBase>();
			}

			internal void Push(ActionBase action)
			{
				stack.Add(action);
				if (Count > 100)
				{
					stack.RemoveAt(0);
				}
			}

			internal ActionBase Peek()
			{
				return stack[Count - 1];
			}

			internal ActionBase Pop()
			{
				ActionBase result = Peek();
				stack.RemoveAt(Count - 1);
				return result;
			}

			internal void Clear()
			{
				stack.Clear();
			}
		}

		private MultiCellOperationInfo multiCellOperationInfo;

		private ActionsCollection undoActions;

		private ActionsCollection redoActions;

		private bool isPerformingAction;

		internal MultiCellOperationInfo MultiCellOperationInfo => multiCellOperationInfo;

		internal UltraGridLayout Layout => MultiCellOperationInfo.Layout;

		private ActionsCollection UndoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (undoActions == null)
				{
					undoActions = new ActionsCollection();
				}
				return undoActions;
			}
		}

		private bool HasUndoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (undoActions != null)
				{
					return undoActions.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private ActionsCollection RedoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (redoActions == null)
				{
					redoActions = new ActionsCollection();
				}
				return redoActions;
			}
		}

		private bool HasRedoActions
		{
			get
			{
				if (redoActions != null)
				{
					return redoActions.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private ActionBase UndoActionOnQueue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasUndoActions)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return UndoActions.Peek();
			}
		}

		private ActionBase RedoActionOnQueue
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasRedoActions)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return RedoActions.Peek();
			}
		}

		internal bool IsPerformingAction => isPerformingAction;

		internal ActionHistory(MultiCellOperationInfo multiCellOperationInfo)
		{
			this.multiCellOperationInfo = multiCellOperationInfo;
		}

		internal bool CanUndo()
		{
			return UndoActionOnQueue?.CanPerform(new MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext(MultiCellOperation.Undo)) ?? false;
		}

		internal bool CanRedo()
		{
			return RedoActionOnQueue?.CanPerform(new MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext(MultiCellOperation.Redo)) ?? false;
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			if (HasUndoActions)
			{
				UndoActions.Clear();
				undoActions = null;
			}
			if (HasRedoActions)
			{
				RedoActions.Clear();
				redoActions = null;
			}
		}

		internal bool Undo()
		{
			if (HasUndoActions)
			{
				return UndoRedoHelper(new MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext(MultiCellOperation.Undo), UndoActions, RedoActions);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool Redo()
		{
			if (HasRedoActions)
			{
				return UndoRedoHelper(new MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext(MultiCellOperation.Redo), RedoActions, UndoActions);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool UndoRedoHelper(object actionContext, ActionsCollection xxStack, ActionsCollection yyStack)
		{
			ActionBase actionBase = xxStack.Pop();
			while (!actionBase.CanPerform(actionContext) && xxStack.Count > 0)
			{
				actionBase = xxStack.Pop();
			}
			return PerformActionHelper(actionContext, actionBase, yyStack);
		}

		private bool PerformActionHelper(object actionContext, ActionBase action, ActionsCollection undoList)
		{
			bool flag = isPerformingAction;
			isPerformingAction = true;
			try
			{
				ActionBase undoAction;
				bool flag2 = action.Perform(actionContext, out undoAction);
				if (flag2)
				{
					if (undoAction != null)
					{
						undoList.Push(undoAction);
					}
					else
					{
						Clear();
					}
				}
				return flag2;
			}
			finally
			{
				isPerformingAction = flag;
			}
		}

		internal bool PerformAction(object actionContext, ActionBase action)
		{
			return PerformActionHelper(actionContext, action, UndoActions);
		}
	}
	internal class ActionFactory
	{
		internal class SingleCellValueAction : ActionHistory.ActionBase
		{
			private UltraGridCell cell;

			private object value;

			private bool dontExitEditMode;

			internal bool DontExitEditMode
			{
				get
				{
					return dontExitEditMode;
				}
				set
				{
					dontExitEditMode = value;
				}
			}

			internal SingleCellValueAction(ActionHistory actionHistory, UltraGridCell cell, object newVal)
				: base(actionHistory)
			{
				GridUtils.ValidateNull(cell);
				this.cell = cell;
				value = newVal;
			}

			private MultiCellValuesAction CreateMultiCellValueAction()
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = cell;
				object obj = value;
				MultiCellOperationInfo.CellsCollection cells = new MultiCellOperationInfo.CellsCollection(base.Layout, new UltraGridCell[1] { ultraGridCell }, 1, 1);
				MultiCellOperationInfo.CellValuesCollection cellValuesCollection = new MultiCellOperationInfo.CellValuesCollection(cells);
				MultiCellOperationInfo.CellValueHolder cellValueHolder = cellValuesCollection[ultraGridCell];
				cellValueHolder.Value = obj;
				cellValueHolder.IsValueDisplayText = false;
				return new MultiCellValuesAction(base.ActionHistory, cellValuesCollection);
			}

			internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
			{
				return MultiCellValuesAction.CanPerform(context, cell);
			}

			internal override bool Perform(object context, out ActionHistory.ActionBase undoAction)
			{
				undoAction = null;
				bool result = false;
				if (CanPerform(context))
				{
					undoAction = new SingleCellValueAction(base.ActionHistory, cell, cell.Value);
					undoAction.CheckForReadOnlyCells = base.CheckForReadOnlyCells;
					if (context is MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext)
					{
						MultiCellValuesAction multiCellValuesAction = CreateMultiCellValueAction();
						multiCellValuesAction.CheckForReadOnlyCells = base.CheckForReadOnlyCells;
						result = multiCellValuesAction.Perform(context, out var _);
					}
					else
					{
						result = cell.SetValueInternal(value, suppressErrorMessagePrompt: false, fireInitializeRow: false);
					}
					if (cell != null && cell.IsFilterRowCell)
					{
						UltraGridFilterCell ultraGridFilterCell = (UltraGridFilterCell)cell;
						if (!ultraGridFilterCell.IsInEditMode)
						{
							ultraGridFilterCell.ApplyFilters();
						}
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal class MultiCellValuesAction : ActionHistory.ActionBase
		{
			private MultiCellOperationInfo.CellValuesCollection cellValues;

			private UltraGridRow lastRow_InitializeRowSuspended;

			internal MultiCellValuesAction(ActionHistory actionHistory, MultiCellOperationInfo.CellValuesCollection cellValues)
				: base(actionHistory)
			{
				this.cellValues = cellValues;
			}

			internal static bool IsCellDeleted(UltraGridCell cell)
			{
				if (!cell.Disposed)
				{
					return cell.Row.Disposed;
				}
				return true;
			}

			internal static bool CanPerform(object context, UltraGridCell cell)
			{
				if (IsCellDeleted(cell))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (context is MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext)
				{
					MultiCellOperation operationBeingPerformed = ((MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext)context).operationBeingPerformed;
					if (operationBeingPerformed == MultiCellOperation.Undo || operationBeingPerformed == MultiCellOperation.Redo)
					{
						return cell.Band.IsMultiCellOperationAllowed(operationBeingPerformed);
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			internal override bool CanPerform(object context)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridCell item in (IEnumerable)cellValues.Cells)
				{
					if (CanPerform(context, item))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}

			private void FireError(MultiCellOperationErrorInfo errorInfo)
			{
				if (base.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
				{
					ultraGrid.InternalHandleMultiCellOperationError(errorInfo, defaultCancelValue: false);
				}
			}

			private bool SetCellValueHelper(MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext context, UltraGridCell cell, object value, out MultiCellOperationErrorInfo errorInfo)
			{
				errorInfo = null;
				try
				{
					bool flag = cell.SetValueInternal(value, suppressErrorMessagePrompt: true, fireInitializeRow: false, throwExceptionOnError: true);
					if (flag && cell.Row != null && cell.Row.ParentCollection != null)
					{
						cell.Row.ParentCollection.OnUserModifiedCellValue(cell);
					}
					return flag;
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					errorInfo = new MultiCellOperationErrorInfo(context.operationBeingPerformed, cell, exception, null, !IsLastCell(cell));
					FireError(errorInfo);
					return false;
				}
			}

			private bool IsLastCell(UltraGridCell cell)
			{
				if (cell != null)
				{
					return cell == cellValues.Cells.LastCell;
				}
				return false;
			}

			private bool UpdateRowHelper(MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext context, UltraGridCell lastCell, UltraGridCell currCell, UpdateMode updateMode, out MultiCellOperationErrorInfo errorInfo)
			{
				bool result = true;
				errorInfo = null;
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = lastCell?.Row;
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = currCell?.Row;
				DataErrorInfo error = null;
				UltraGridCell errorCell = null;
				if (updateMode == UpdateMode.OnCellChangeOrLostFocus || updateMode == UpdateMode.OnCellChange)
				{
					if (ultraGridRow2 != null)
					{
						result = ultraGridRow2.Update(out error);
						if (error != null)
						{
							errorCell = currCell;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (ultraGridRow != ultraGridRow2 && ultraGridRow != null && (ultraGridRow2 != null || cellValues.Cells.RowCount >= 2 || !ultraGridRow.IsActiveRow) && (UpdateMode.OnRowChange == updateMode || updateMode == UpdateMode.OnRowChangeOrLostFocus))
					{
						result = ultraGridRow.Update(out error);
						if (error != null)
						{
							errorCell = lastCell;
						}
					}
					if (lastRow_InitializeRowSuspended != ultraGridRow2)
					{
						if (lastRow_InitializeRowSuspended != null)
						{
							UltraGridRow ultraGridRow3 = lastRow_InitializeRowSuspended;
							lastRow_InitializeRowSuspended = null;
							ultraGridRow3.Layout.ResumeInitializeRowFor(ultraGridRow3);
							ultraGridRow3.FireInitializeRow();
						}
						if (ultraGridRow2 != null && !ultraGridRow2.Layout.SuspendInitializeRowFor(ultraGridRow2))
						{
							lastRow_InitializeRowSuspended = ultraGridRow2;
						}
					}
				}
				if (error != null)
				{
					errorInfo = new MultiCellOperationErrorInfo(context.operationBeingPerformed, errorCell, null, error, currCell != null && !IsLastCell(currCell));
					FireError(errorInfo);
				}
				return result;
			}

			internal override bool Perform(object contextParam, out ActionHistory.ActionBase undoActionParam)
			{
				undoActionParam = null;
				MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext multiCellOperationContext = (MultiCellOperationInfo.MultiCellOperationContext)contextParam;
				if (!(base.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid) || !CanPerform(multiCellOperationContext))
				{
					return false;
				}
				BeforeMultiCellOperationEventArgs e = new BeforeMultiCellOperationEventArgs(multiCellOperationContext.operationBeingPerformed, cellValues);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeMultiCellOperation, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return false;
				}
				MultiCellOperationInfo.CellValuesCollection cellValuesCollection = MultiCellOperationInfo.GetCellValues(cellValues.Cells);
				MultiCellValuesAction multiCellValuesAction = (MultiCellValuesAction)(undoActionParam = new MultiCellValuesAction(base.ActionHistory, cellValuesCollection));
				if (!cellValues.ConvertToDataValue(multiCellOperationContext, out var stopCellExclusive, base.CheckForReadOnlyCells))
				{
					return false;
				}
				List<UltraGridCell> list = new List<UltraGridCell>();
				MultiCellOperationErrorInfo errorInfo = null;
				UpdateMode updateMode = ultraGrid.UpdateMode;
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = null;
				bool flag = false;
				if (MultiCellOperation.Paste == multiCellOperationContext.operationBeingPerformed || MultiCellOperation.Redo == multiCellOperationContext.operationBeingPerformed || MultiCellOperation.Undo == multiCellOperationContext.operationBeingPerformed)
				{
					UltraGridCell activeCell = ultraGrid.ActiveCell;
					if (activeCell == null || !cellValues.Exists(activeCell))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				foreach (UltraGridCell item in (IEnumerable)cellValues.Cells)
				{
					if (item == stopCellExclusive)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (IsCellDeleted(item))
					{
						continue;
					}
					MultiCellOperationInfo.CellValueHolder cellValueHolder = cellValues[item];
					if (cellValueHolder.Ignore || cellValueHolder.HasConversionError || item.Column.IgnoreMultiCellOperationResolved)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (cellValueHolder.HasSameValue || SetCellValueHelper(multiCellOperationContext, item, cellValueHolder.Value, out errorInfo))
					{
						list.Add(item);
						if (ultraGridCell == null && flag)
						{
							item.Activate();
						}
						UpdateRowHelper(multiCellOperationContext, ultraGridCell, item, updateMode, out errorInfo);
						ultraGridCell = item;
					}
					if (errorInfo == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.ClearCellAndContinue == errorInfo.Action)
					{
						object columnDefaultValue = MultiCellOperationInfo.CellValuesCollection.GetColumnDefaultValue(item);
						if (columnDefaultValue != cellValueHolder.Value)
						{
							SetCellValueHelper(multiCellOperationContext, item, columnDefaultValue, out var errorInfo2);
							if (errorInfo2 != null)
							{
								errorInfo = errorInfo2;
							}
						}
					}
					if (MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Revert == errorInfo.Action || MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Stop == errorInfo.Action)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if (list.Count <= 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ultraGridCell != null && (errorInfo == null || MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Revert != errorInfo.Action))
				{
					UpdateRowHelper(multiCellOperationContext, ultraGridCell, null, updateMode, out errorInfo);
				}
				if (errorInfo != null && MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Revert == errorInfo.Action)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridCell item2 in list)
					{
						MultiCellOperationInfo.CellValueHolder cellValueHolder2 = multiCellValuesAction.cellValues[item2];
						item2.SetValueInternal(cellValueHolder2.Value, suppressErrorMessagePrompt: true, fireInitializeRow: true);
					}
					return false;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridCell item3 in (IEnumerable)multiCellValuesAction.cellValues.Cells)
				{
					multiCellValuesAction.cellValues[item3].Ignore = true;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridCell item4 in list)
				{
					multiCellValuesAction.cellValues[item4].Ignore = false;
				}
				if (MultiCellOperation.Paste == multiCellOperationContext.operationBeingPerformed || MultiCellOperation.Redo == multiCellOperationContext.operationBeingPerformed || MultiCellOperation.Undo == multiCellOperationContext.operationBeingPerformed)
				{
					base.ActionHistory.MultiCellOperationInfo.ScrollAndSelect(list, scrollIntoView: true, 1 == list.Count);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private ActionFactory()
		{
		}
	}

		internal static bool UseControlInfo(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = GetResolutionOrder(layout);
			return ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo;
		}

		internal static ResolutionOrder GetResolutionOrderEnum(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ComponentRole componentRole = GetComponentRole(layout);
			if (componentRole == null)
			{
				return (ResolutionOrder)0;
			}
			return componentRole.ResolutionOrder;
		}

		internal static ResolutionOrderInfo GetResolutionOrder(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			return ComponentRole.GetResolutionOrderInfo(GetComponentRole(layout));
		}

			return GetRole(band, role, out resOrder);

		}

		internal static UIRole GetRole(UltraGridLayout layout, Role role, out ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (layout == null || layout.Grid == null)
			{
				resOrder = new ResolutionOrderInfo((ResolutionOrder)0);
				return null;
			}
			ComponentRole componentRole = ((UltraControlBase)layout.Grid).ComponentRole;
			resOrder = componentRole.GetResolutionOrderInfo();
			return componentRole.GetRole((int)role);
		}

		}

		internal static bool GetCachedPropertyVal(UltraGridLayout layout, CustomProperty prop, out object val)
		{
			return GetCachedPropertyVal(layout, (int)prop, out val);
		}

		internal static bool GetCachedPropertyVal(UltraGridLayout layout, CachedProperty prop, out object val)
		{
			return GetCachedPropertyVal(layout, (int)prop, out val);
		}

		private static bool GetCachedPropertyVal(UltraGridLayout layout, int prop, out object val)
		{
			if (layout != null)
			{
				return layout.propertyCache.GetCachedProperty(prop, ref val);
			}
			val = null;
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool GetCachedPropertyVal(UltraGridBand band, CustomProperty prop, out object val)
		{
			return GetCachedPropertyVal(band, (int)prop, out val);
		}

		internal static bool GetCachedPropertyVal(UltraGridBand band, CachedProperty prop, out object val)
		{
			return GetCachedPropertyVal(band, (int)prop, out val);
		}

		}

		private static object ResolveValueHelper(object val, object defVal, object resolveVal)
		{
			if (defVal != resolveVal && (val == null || object.Equals(val, defVal)))
			{
				return resolveVal;
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal static object CachePropertyValue(UltraGridLayout layout, CustomProperty prop, object controlVal, object defVal, object resolveVal)
		{
			if (layout != null)
			{
				object stylePropertyValue = GetStylePropertyValue(layout, prop);
				return CachePropertyValue(layout, layout.propertyCache, (int)prop, stylePropertyValue, controlVal, defVal, resolveVal);
			}
			return ResolveValueHelper(controlVal, defVal, resolveVal);
		}

		internal static object GetStylePropertyValue(UltraGridLayout layout, CustomProperty prop)
		{
			ComponentRole componentRole = GetComponentRole(layout);
			string customPropertyName = GetCustomPropertyName(prop);
			if (componentRole == null || !componentRole.HasProperty(customPropertyName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return componentRole.GetProperty(customPropertyName);
		}

		internal static object CachePropertyValue(UltraGridBand band, CustomProperty prop, object controlVal, object defVal, object resolveVal)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridLayout layout = band.Layout;
			ComponentRole componentRole = GetComponentRole(layout);
			if (componentRole != null)
			{
				object stylePropertyValue = GetStylePropertyValue(layout, prop);
				object obj = StyleUtilities.CalculateResolvedValue(GetResolutionOrderEnum(layout), stylePropertyValue, controlVal, defVal, resolveVal);
				band.propertyCache.CachePropertyValue((int)prop, obj);
				return obj;
			}
			return ResolveValueHelper(controlVal, defVal, resolveVal);
		}

		internal static void DirtyCachedPropertyVals(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			ComponentRole componentRole = GetComponentRole(layout);
			if (componentRole != null)
			{
				componentRole.ClearCachedPropertyValues();
			}
			if (layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (layout.propertyCache != null)
			{
				layout.propertyCache.ClearCachedPropertyValues();
			}
			if (layout.Bands == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand band in layout.Bands)
			{
				if (band.propertyCache != null)
				{
					band.propertyCache.ClearCachedPropertyValues();
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void DirtyCachedPropertyVals(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (band != null && band.propertyCache != null)
			{
				band.propertyCache.ClearCachedPropertyValues();
			}
		}

		private static string[] GetCustomPropertyNames()
		{
			if (cachedCustomPropertyNames != null)
			{
				return cachedCustomPropertyNames;
			}
			object[] customPropertiesInfo = GetCustomPropertiesInfo();
			string[] array = new string[customPropertiesInfo.Length / 7];
			for (int i = 0; i < customPropertiesInfo.Length; i += 7)
			{
				array[i / 7] = (string)customPropertiesInfo[i];
			}
			return cachedCustomPropertyNames = array;
		}

		internal static string GetCustomPropertyName(CustomProperty prop)
		{
			string[] customPropertyNames = GetCustomPropertyNames();
			return customPropertyNames[(int)prop];
		}

		internal static AppStyleProperty[] GetCustomProperties(ComponentType component)
		{
			//IL_0048: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Expected O, but got Unknown
			object[] customPropertiesInfo = GetCustomPropertiesInfo();
			List<AppStyleProperty> list = new List<AppStyleProperty>();
			for (int i = 0; i < customPropertiesInfo.Length; i += 7)
			{
				ComponentType componentType = (ComponentType)customPropertiesInfo[5 + i];
				if ((component & componentType) != 0)
				{
					string text = (string)customPropertiesInfo[i];
					Type type = (Type)customPropertiesInfo[1 + i];
					object defaultValue = customPropertiesInfo[2 + i];
					AppStylePropertyConverter val = (AppStylePropertyConverter)customPropertiesInfo[3 + i];
					ValueConstraint constraint = (ValueConstraint)customPropertiesInfo[4 + i];
					AppStyleProperty val2 = new AppStyleProperty(text, type, val);
					val2.DefaultValue = defaultValue;
					val2.Constraint = constraint;
					string text2 = (string)customPropertiesInfo[6 + i];
					if (text2 != null && text2.Length > 0)
					{
						val2.Description = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(text2);
					}
					list.Add(val2);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal static bool HasAppearance(UIRole role, RoleState state)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (role != null)
			{
				return role.HasAppearance(state);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static ComponentRole GetComponentRole(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			if (layout != null)
			{
				UltraGridBase grid = layout.Grid;
				if (grid != null)
				{
					return ((UltraControlBase)grid).ComponentRole;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		{

			return roleDefs;
		}

		internal static string[] GetRoleNames(ComponentType matchComponent)
		{
			GetRolesHelper(out var roleNames, out var _, matchComponent, getRoleNames: true, getRoleDefs: false);
			return roleNames;
		}

		private static string TranslateTableRoleName(string role)
		{
			role = ((!role.StartsWith("g-")) ? ("Grid" + role) : role.Remove(0, "g-".Length));
			return role;
		}

		}

			object[] array = componentType switch
			{
				ComponentType.RowEditTemplate => TEMPLATE_ROLES, 
				ComponentType.CellProxy => CELLPROXY_ROLES, 
				_ => ROLES, 
			};
			string[] array2 = new string[array.Length / 6];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i += 6)
			{
				Role role = (Role)array[i];
				string text = TranslateTableRoleName((string)array[i + 1]);
				int num = (int)role;
				if (num >= 0 && num < array2.Length && array2[num] == null)
				{
					array2[num] = text;
				}
			}
			return array2;
		}

				GetRolesHelperHelper(matchComponent, list, list2, TEMPLATE_ROLES);
			}
			roleDefs = list?.ToArray();
			roleNames = list2?.ToArray();
		}
