	public static class AsynchronousExportManager
	{
		[ThreadStatic]
		private static readonly int DEFAULT_AsynchronousExportInterval = 50;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static readonly int DEFAULT_AsynchronousExportDuration = 30;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static int asynchronousExportDuration = DEFAULT_AsynchronousExportDuration;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static int asynchronousExportInterval = DEFAULT_AsynchronousExportInterval;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static Queue<AsyncExportOperation> exportOperations;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static System.Windows.Forms.Timer exportIntervalTimer;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static DateTime lastAsyncOperationStarted;

		[ThreadStatic]
		private static WeakList<AsyncExportStatusDisplay> exportStatusControlList = null;

		public static int AsynchronousExportDuration
		{
			get
			{
				return asynchronousExportDuration;
			}
			set
			{
				asynchronousExportDuration = value;
			}
		}

		public static int AsynchronousExportInterval
		{
			get
			{
				return asynchronousExportInterval;
			}
			set
			{
				asynchronousExportInterval = value;
				if (exportIntervalTimer != null)
				{
					exportIntervalTimer.Interval = asynchronousExportInterval;
				}
			}
		}

		private static System.Windows.Forms.Timer ExportIntervalTimer
		{
			get
			{
				if (exportIntervalTimer == null)
				{
					exportIntervalTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
					exportIntervalTimer.Interval = AsynchronousExportInterval;
					exportIntervalTimer.Tick += exportIntervalTimer_Tick;
				}
				return exportIntervalTimer;
			}
		}

		private static Queue<AsyncExportOperation> ExportOperations
		{
			get
			{
				if (exportOperations == null)
				{
					exportOperations = new Queue<AsyncExportOperation>();
				}
				return exportOperations;
			}
		}

		internal static void AddExportStatusControl(AsyncExportStatusDisplay asyncExportStatus)
		{
			if (exportStatusControlList == null)
			{
				exportStatusControlList = new WeakList<AsyncExportStatusDisplay>();
			}
			exportStatusControlList.Add(asyncExportStatus);
		}

		internal static void AddExportOperation(UltraGrid grid, IUltraGridExporterAsynch exporter)
		{
			AsyncExportOperation asyncExportOperation = new AsyncExportOperation(grid, exporter);
			ExportOperations.Enqueue(asyncExportOperation);
			if (ExportOperations.Count == 1)
			{
				ProcessExport();
			}
			else
			{
				asyncExportOperation.UpdateExportStatusControls();
			}
		}

		internal static List<AsyncExportStatusDisplay> FindStatusControls(UltraGrid grid)
		{
			List<AsyncExportStatusDisplay> list = null;
			if (exportStatusControlList == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (AsyncExportStatusDisplay exportStatusControl in exportStatusControlList)
			{
				if (grid == exportStatusControl.Grid)
				{
					if (list == null)
					{
						list = new List<AsyncExportStatusDisplay>();
					}
					list.Add(exportStatusControl);
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal static AsyncExportOperation FindExportOperation(UltraGrid grid)
		{
			if (exportOperations == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (AsyncExportOperation exportOperation in ExportOperations)
			{
				if (exportOperation.Grid == grid)
				{
					return exportOperation;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static AsyncExportOperation FindExportOperation(IUltraGridExporter exporter)
		{
			if (exportOperations == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (AsyncExportOperation exportOperation in ExportOperations)
			{
				if (exportOperation.Exporter == exporter)
				{
					return exportOperation;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static AsyncExportOperation GetTopItem()
		{
			if (exportOperations == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ExportOperations.Count > 0)
			{
				return ExportOperations.Peek();
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool HasAsynchronousDurationExpired()
		{
			DateTime now = DateTime.Now;
			return (now - lastAsyncOperationStarted).TotalMilliseconds > (double)AsynchronousExportDuration;
		}

		private static void ProcessExport()
		{
			lastAsyncOperationStarted = DateTime.Now;
			List<AsyncExportOperation> list = new List<AsyncExportOperation>();
			do
			{
				AsyncExportOperation topItem = GetTopItem();
				if (topItem != null)
				{
					if (!list.Contains(topItem))
					{
						list.Add(topItem);
					}
					if (topItem.CurrentAsyncExportPhase == AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Completed || topItem.CurrentAsyncExportPhase == AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Cancelled)
					{
						AsyncExportOperation asyncExportOperation = ExportOperations.Dequeue();
						asyncExportOperation.UpdateExportStatusControls();
					}
					topItem.ProcessCurrentPhase();
					continue;
				}
				return;
			}
			while (!HasAsynchronousDurationExpired());
			foreach (AsyncExportOperation item in list)
			{
				item.UpdateExportStatusControls();
			}
			ExportIntervalTimer.Start();
		}

		internal static void RemoveExportStatusControl(AsyncExportStatusDisplay asyncExportStatus)
		{
			if (exportStatusControlList != null)
			{
				exportStatusControlList.Remove(asyncExportStatus);
			}
		}

		private static void exportIntervalTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			exportIntervalTimer.Stop();
			ProcessExport();
		}
	}
	internal class AsyncExportOperation
	{
		internal enum AsyncExportPhase
		{
			Pending,
			PrepareForExport,
			AutoSizeColumns,
			BeginExport,
			ProcessRows,
			EndExport,
			Completed,
			Cancelled
		}

		private UltraGrid grid;

		private IUltraGridExporterAsynch exporter;

		private AsyncExportPhase currentAsyncExportPhase;

		private UltraGridLayout exportLayout;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer exportTimer;

		private Stack<RowContext> asynchronousExportContextStack;

		private bool cancelled;

		private int rowCount;

		private AutoSizeAllColumnsContext autoSizeAllColumnsContext;

		public bool Cancelled => cancelled;

		internal AsyncExportPhase CurrentAsyncExportPhase
		{
			get
			{
				return currentAsyncExportPhase;
			}
			set
			{
				if (currentAsyncExportPhase != value)
				{
					currentAsyncExportPhase = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal int RowCount => rowCount;

		public UltraGrid Grid
		{
			get
			{
				return grid;
			}
			set
			{
				grid = value;
			}
		}

		public IUltraGridExporterAsynch Exporter
		{
			get
			{
				return exporter;
			}
			set
			{
				exporter = value;
			}
		}

		internal AsyncExportOperation(UltraGrid grid, IUltraGridExporterAsynch exporter)
		{
			this.grid = grid;
			this.exporter = exporter;
		}

		private void AdvanceToNextPhase()
		{
			switch (CurrentAsyncExportPhase)
			{
			case AsyncExportPhase.Pending:
				CurrentAsyncExportPhase = AsyncExportPhase.PrepareForExport;
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.PrepareForExport:
				CurrentAsyncExportPhase = AsyncExportPhase.AutoSizeColumns;
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.AutoSizeColumns:
				CurrentAsyncExportPhase = AsyncExportPhase.BeginExport;
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.BeginExport:
				CurrentAsyncExportPhase = AsyncExportPhase.ProcessRows;
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.ProcessRows:
				CurrentAsyncExportPhase = AsyncExportPhase.EndExport;
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.EndExport:
				if (cancelled)
				{
					CurrentAsyncExportPhase = AsyncExportPhase.Cancelled;
				}
				else
				{
					CurrentAsyncExportPhase = AsyncExportPhase.Completed;
				}
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.Completed:
			case AsyncExportPhase.Cancelled:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessCurrentPhase()
		{
			switch (CurrentAsyncExportPhase)
			{
			case AsyncExportPhase.Pending:
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.PrepareForExport:
				ProcessPhasePrepareForExport();
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.AutoSizeColumns:
				ProcessPhaseAutoSizeColumns();
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.BeginExport:
				ProcessPhaseBeginExport();
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.ProcessRows:
				ProcessPhaseExportRows();
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.EndExport:
				ProcessPhaseEndExport();
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessPhasePrepareForExport()
		{
			rowCount = 0;
			exportLayout = new UltraGridLayout();
			grid.PrepareForExport(exportLayout, async: true);
			exporter.InitializeExportLayout(exportLayout);
			if (exporter.ShouldAutoSizeColumns)
			{
				autoSizeAllColumnsContext = new AutoSizeAllColumnsContext(exportLayout, AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.All);
			}
			else
			{
				autoSizeAllColumnsContext = null;
			}
			AdvanceToNextPhase();
		}

		private void ProcessPhaseAutoSizeColumns()
		{
			if (autoSizeAllColumnsContext == null)
			{
				cancelled = false;
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
			}
			else if (!autoSizeAllColumnsContext.Continue(cancelled))
			{
				if (autoSizeAllColumnsContext != null)
				{
					autoSizeAllColumnsContext = null;
				}
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessPhaseBeginExport()
		{
			exporter.BeginExport(exportLayout, exportLayout.Rows);
			RowContext item = new RowContext(exportLayout.Rows, 0);
			asynchronousExportContextStack = new Stack<RowContext>();
			asynchronousExportContextStack.Push(item);
			AdvanceToNextPhase();
		}

		private void ProcessPhaseExportRows()
		{
			if (asynchronousExportContextStack.Count == 0)
			{
				cancelled = false;
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
			}
			else
			{
				RowContext asynchronousExportContext = asynchronousExportContextStack.Pop();
				ProcessRowAsync(asynchronousExportContext);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessPhaseEndExport()
		{
			if (exportTimer != null)
			{
				exportTimer.Stop();
				exportTimer.Dispose();
				exportTimer = null;
			}
			if (exporter != null)
			{
				exporter.EndExport(cancelled);
				exporter = null;
			}
			if (exportLayout != null)
			{
				exportLayout.Dispose();
				exportLayout = null;
			}
			AdvanceToNextPhase();
		}

		internal void ProcessRowAsync(RowContext asynchronousExportContext)
		{
			IUltraGridExporter ultraGridExporter = exporter;
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = exportLayout;
			RowsCollection rows = asynchronousExportContext.Rows;
			UltraGridBand band = rows.Band;
			int index = asynchronousExportContext.Index;
			if (band.HiddenResolved || index >= rows.CountIncludingSpecialRows)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridRow rowAtIndex = rows.GetRowAtIndex(index, includeSpecialRows: true);
			if (rowAtIndex == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ProcessRowParams processRowParams = new ProcessRowParams();
			if (cancelled)
			{
				processRowParams.TerminateExport = true;
			}
			ultraGridExporter.ProcessRow(rowAtIndex, processRowParams);
			if (!processRowParams.SkipRow)
			{
				rowCount++;
			}
			if (processRowParams.TerminateExport)
			{
				cancelled = true;
				CurrentAsyncExportPhase = AsyncExportPhase.EndExport;
				return;
			}
			if (!processRowParams.SkipSiblings)
			{
				asynchronousExportContext.Index = index + 1;
				asynchronousExportContextStack.Push(asynchronousExportContext);
			}
			if (processRowParams.SkipDescendants || rowAtIndex.ChildBands == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int num = rowAtIndex.ChildBands.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = rowAtIndex.ChildBands[num];
				if (!ultraGridChildBand.Band.HiddenResolved)
				{
					asynchronousExportContextStack.Push(new RowContext(ultraGridChildBand.Rows, 0));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateExportStatusControls()
		{
			List<AsyncExportStatusDisplay> list = AsynchronousExportManager.FindStatusControls(Grid);
			foreach (AsyncExportStatusDisplay item in list)
			{
				item.UpdateStatus(this);
			}
		}

		public void Cancel()
		{
			switch (CurrentAsyncExportPhase)
			{
			case AsyncExportPhase.Pending:
			case AsyncExportPhase.PrepareForExport:
			case AsyncExportPhase.AutoSizeColumns:
				cancelled = true;
				if (autoSizeAllColumnsContext != null)
				{
					autoSizeAllColumnsContext.Cancel();
				}
				CurrentAsyncExportPhase = AsyncExportPhase.EndExport;
				ProcessCurrentPhase();
				UpdateExportStatusControls();
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.BeginExport:
			case AsyncExportPhase.ProcessRows:
				cancelled = true;
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.EndExport:
				cancelled = true;
				break;
			case AsyncExportPhase.Completed:
			case AsyncExportPhase.Cancelled:
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RowContext
	{
		private RowsCollection rows;

		private int index;

		public RowsCollection Rows => rows;

		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				return index;
			}
			set
			{
				index = value;
			}
		}

		internal RowContext(RowsCollection rows, int index)
		{
			this.rows = rows;
			this.index = index;
		}
	}
	internal class AutoSizeAllColumnsContext
	{
		private UltraGridLayout exportLayout;

		private BandEnumerator currentBandEnumerator;

		private ColumnEnumerator currentColumnEnumerator;

		private AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions autoResizeColumnWidthOptions;

		private bool skipMultilineColumns;

		private AutoSizeColumnContext autoSizeColumnContext;

		private UltraGridColumn CurrentColumn => currentColumnEnumerator.Current;

		internal AutoSizeAllColumnsContext(UltraGridLayout exportLayout, AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions autoResizeColumnWidthOptions)
			: this(exportLayout, autoResizeColumnWidthOptions, skipMultilineColumns: true)
		{
		}

		internal AutoSizeAllColumnsContext(UltraGridLayout exportLayout, AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions autoResizeColumnWidthOptions, bool skipMultilineColumns)
		{
			this.exportLayout = exportLayout;
			this.autoResizeColumnWidthOptions = autoResizeColumnWidthOptions;
			this.skipMultilineColumns = skipMultilineColumns;
			currentBandEnumerator = this.exportLayout.SortedBands.GetEnumerator();
			if (currentBandEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				UltraGridBand current = currentBandEnumerator.Current;
				currentColumnEnumerator = current.columns.GetEnumerator();
			}
		}

		internal void Cancel()
		{
			if (autoSizeColumnContext != null)
			{
				autoSizeColumnContext.Cancel();
			}
		}

		internal bool Continue(bool cancelled)
		{
			if (cancelled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (autoSizeColumnContext == null && !MoveNext())
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (autoSizeColumnContext.CurrentAutoSizePhase)
			{
			case AutoSizeColumnContext.AutoSizePhase.Initial:
			case AutoSizeColumnContext.AutoSizePhase.Header:
			case AutoSizeColumnContext.AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_Initial:
			case AutoSizeColumnContext.AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_ProcessRows:
			case AutoSizeColumnContext.AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_CleanUp:
			case AutoSizeColumnContext.AutoSizePhase.Miscellaneous:
				autoSizeColumnContext.ProcessCurrentPhase();
				return true;
			case AutoSizeColumnContext.AutoSizePhase.Complete:
				return MoveNext();
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool CreateAutoSizeColumnContext()
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			UltraGridColumn currentColumn = CurrentColumn;
			if (currentColumn == null || currentColumn.IsChaptered || (skipMultilineColumns && 1 == (int)currentColumn.CellMultiLineResolved))
			{
				return false;
			}
			autoSizeColumnContext = new AutoSizeColumnContext(currentColumn, null, 0, applyWidth: true, autoResizeColumnWidthOptions, 0);
			return true;
		}

		private bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (currentColumnEnumerator == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (currentColumnEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				if (CreateAutoSizeColumnContext())
				{
					return true;
				}
				return MoveNext();
			}
			if (!currentBandEnumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return MoveNext();
		}
	}
	internal class AutoSizeColumnContext
	{
		internal enum AutoSizePhase
		{
			Initial,
			Header,
			CellsAndSummaries_Initial,
			CellsAndSummaries_ProcessRows,
			CellsAndSummaries_CleanUp,
			Miscellaneous,
			Complete
		}

		private UltraGridColumn column;

		private RowsCollection rows;

		private int nRows;

		private bool applyWidth;

		private AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions autoResizeColumnWidthOptions;

		private int maxRowsCollections;

		private int width;

		private AutoSizePhase currentAutoSizePhase;

		private bool includeHeader;

		private bool includeCells;

		private bool includeSummary;

		private int maxColWidth;

		private int headerWidth;

		private int maxWidth;

		private UltraGridBand band;

		private UltraGridLayout layout;

		private int maxCellTextWidth;

		private Graphics gr;

		private StringFormat stringformat;

		private int cellSpacing;

		private int borderThickness;

		private int maxAvailableCellTextWidth;

		private int rowScrollRegionIndex;

		private int visibleRowIndex;

		private UltraGridColumn.TraverseRowsCallback columnAutoSizeTraverseRowsCallback;

		private Stack<RowContext> autoSizeRowsStack;

		internal AutoSizePhase CurrentAutoSizePhase => currentAutoSizePhase;

		internal AutoSizeColumnContext(UltraGridColumn column, RowsCollection rows, int nRows, bool applyWidth, AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions autoResizeColumnWidthOptions, int maxRowsCollections)
		{
			this.column = column;
			this.rows = rows;
			this.nRows = nRows;
			this.applyWidth = applyWidth;
			this.autoResizeColumnWidthOptions = autoResizeColumnWidthOptions;
			this.maxRowsCollections = maxRowsCollections;
			band = this.column.Band;
			layout = this.column.Layout;
		}

		private void AdvanceToNextPhase()
		{
			switch (CurrentAutoSizePhase)
			{
			case AutoSizePhase.Initial:
				currentAutoSizePhase = AutoSizePhase.Header;
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.Header:
				currentAutoSizePhase = AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_Initial;
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_Initial:
				currentAutoSizePhase = AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_ProcessRows;
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_ProcessRows:
				currentAutoSizePhase = AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_CleanUp;
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_CleanUp:
				currentAutoSizePhase = AutoSizePhase.Miscellaneous;
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.Miscellaneous:
				currentAutoSizePhase = AutoSizePhase.Complete;
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.Complete:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void Cancel()
		{
			switch (currentAutoSizePhase)
			{
			case AutoSizePhase.Initial:
			case AutoSizePhase.Header:
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_Initial:
			case AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_ProcessRows:
				ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_CleanUp();
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_CleanUp:
			case AutoSizePhase.Miscellaneous:
			case AutoSizePhase.Complete:
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void InternalTraverseRowsHelper(RowContext rowContext, IRowCallback rowCallback, IRowsCollectionCallback rowsCollectionCallback, bool recursive, bool includeTemplateAddRows)
		{
			if (rowsCollectionCallback != null && !rowsCollectionCallback.ProcessRowsCollection(rowContext.Rows))
			{
				autoSizeRowsStack.Clear();
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
			}
			else
			{
				if (rowContext.Index >= rowContext.Rows.Count)
				{
					return;
				}
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = rowContext.Rows[rowContext.Index];
				if (rowCallback.ProcessRow(ultraGridRow))
				{
					rowContext.Index++;
					autoSizeRowsStack.Push(rowContext);
				}
				if (!recursive || (!band.IsDescendantOfBand(ultraGridRow.Band) && (!(ultraGridRow is UltraGridGroupByRow) || band != ultraGridRow.Band)) || ultraGridRow.ChildBands == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = ultraGridRow.childBands.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = ultraGridRow.ChildBands[i];
					if (band == ultraGridChildBand.Band || band.IsDescendantOfBand(ultraGridChildBand.Band))
					{
						RowContext item = new RowContext(ultraGridChildBand.Rows, 0);
						autoSizeRowsStack.Push(item);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ProcessCurrentPhase()
		{
			switch (currentAutoSizePhase)
			{
			case AutoSizePhase.Initial:
				ProcessIntitialPhase();
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.Header:
				ProcessHeaderPhase();
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_Initial:
				ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_Initial();
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_ProcessRows:
				ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_ProcessRows();
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.CellsAndSummaries_CleanUp:
				ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_CleanUp();
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.Miscellaneous:
				ProcessMiscellaneousPhase();
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
				break;
			case AutoSizePhase.Complete:
				break;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessIntitialPhase()
		{
			if (!column.IsStillValid)
			{
				width = 0;
				currentAutoSizePhase = AutoSizePhase.Complete;
				return;
			}
			includeHeader = (((autoResizeColumnWidthOptions & AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.IncludeHeader) != AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.Default) ? true : false);
			includeCells = (((autoResizeColumnWidthOptions & AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.IncludeCells) != AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.Default) ? true : false);
			includeSummary = (((autoResizeColumnWidthOptions & AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.IncludeSummaryRows) != AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.Default) ? true : false);
			maxColWidth = Math.Max(10000, column.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion.ClippedExtent);
		}

		private void ProcessHeaderPhase()
		{
			headerWidth = 0;
			if (includeHeader && !column.Header.HiddenResolved)
			{
				headerWidth = column.CalculateHeaderTextWidth(maxColWidth);
			}
		}

		private void ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_Initial()
		{
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DrawUtility.BeginGraphicsCaching();
			gr = null;
			maxCellTextWidth = 0;
			gr = layout.GetCachedGraphics();
			StringFormatFlags options = (StringFormatFlags)0;
			if (!column.IsCellMultiLine)
			{
				options = StringFormatFlags.NoWrap;
			}
			stringformat = new StringFormat(options);
			cellSpacing = 2 * band.CellSpacingResolved;
			borderThickness = layout.GetBorderThickness(band.BorderStyleCellResolved);
			maxAvailableCellTextWidth = maxColWidth - cellSpacing + 2 * borderThickness;
			column.Editor.BeginGdiTextMeasurementCaching();
			if (nRows < 0)
			{
				rowScrollRegionIndex = 0;
				visibleRowIndex = 0;
				return;
			}
			if (nRows == 0)
			{
				columnAutoSizeTraverseRowsCallback = new UltraGridColumn.TraverseRowsCallback(column, gr, stringformat, nRows, maxAvailableCellTextWidth, maxRowsCollections, autoResizeColumnWidthOptions);
				RowsCollection rowsCollection = ((rows != null) ? rows : layout.Rows);
				RowContext item = new RowContext(rowsCollection, 0);
				autoSizeRowsStack = new Stack<RowContext>();
				autoSizeRowsStack.Push(item);
				return;
			}
			throw new NotImplementedException("nRows > 0 case is not implemented, because it was not needed for asynchronous exporting");
		}

		private void ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_ProcessRows()
		{
			if (nRows == 0)
			{
				if (autoSizeRowsStack.Count == 0)
				{
					AdvanceToNextPhase();
					return;
				}
				RowContext rowContext = autoSizeRowsStack.Pop();
				InternalTraverseRowsHelper(rowContext, columnAutoSizeTraverseRowsCallback, columnAutoSizeTraverseRowsCallback, recursive: true, includeTemplateAddRows: true);
			}
			else if (nRows < 0)
			{
				if (rowScrollRegionIndex >= layout.RowScrollRegions.Count)
				{
					maxCellTextWidth = Math.Min(maxColWidth, maxCellTextWidth + cellSpacing + 2 * borderThickness);
					AdvanceToNextPhase();
				}
				else
				{
					ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_ProcessRows_VisibleRows();
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_ProcessRows_VisibleRows()
		{
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = layout.RowScrollRegions[rowScrollRegionIndex];
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = rowScrollRegion.VisibleRows;
			UltraGridRow row = visibleRows[visibleRowIndex].Row;
			ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_ProcessRows_VisibleRow(row);
			visibleRowIndex++;
			if (visibleRowIndex >= rowScrollRegion.VisibleRows.Count)
			{
				visibleRowIndex = 0;
				rowScrollRegionIndex++;
			}
			if (maxCellTextWidth > maxAvailableCellTextWidth)
			{
				maxCellTextWidth = maxAvailableCellTextWidth;
				AdvanceToNextPhase();
			}
		}

		private void ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_ProcessRows_VisibleRow(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row.IsSummaryRow && (autoResizeColumnWidthOptions & AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.IncludeSummaryRows) != AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.Default)
			{
				maxCellTextWidth = Math.Max(maxCellTextWidth, column.CalculateMaxSummaryTextWidth(maxAvailableCellTextWidth, row));
			}
			else if (!row.IsSummaryRow)
			{
				maxCellTextWidth = Math.Max(maxCellTextWidth, column.CalculateCellTextWidth(row, gr, stringformat, maxAvailableCellTextWidth));
			}
			if (row.IsFilterRow)
			{
				FilterOperatorLocation filterOperatorLocationResolved = column.FilterOperatorLocationResolved;
				if (filterOperatorLocationResolved == FilterOperatorLocation.WithOperand)
				{
					maxCellTextWidth += layout.GetIdealOperatorButtonSize().Width;
				}
				if (column.FilterClearButtonVisibleResolved)
				{
					maxCellTextWidth += layout.GetIdealClearButtonSize().Width;
				}
			}
		}

		private void ProcessCellsAndSummariesPhase_CleanUp()
		{
			column.Editor.EndGdiTextMeasurementCaching();
			if (nRows == 0)
			{
				maxCellTextWidth = Math.Min(maxColWidth, columnAutoSizeTraverseRowsCallback.width + cellSpacing + 2 * borderThickness);
			}
			if (stringformat != null)
			{
				stringformat.Dispose();
				stringformat = null;
			}
			if (gr != null)
			{
				layout.ReleaseCachedGraphics(gr);
				gr = null;
			}
			DrawUtility.EndGraphicsCaching();
		}

		private void ProcessMiscellaneousPhase()
		{
			//IL_00a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ((layout != null) ? layout.Grid : null);
			if (ColumnStyle.EditButton == column.Style)
			{
				maxCellTextWidth += ((layout != null) ? layout.EditButtonWidth : ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)(object)ultraGridBase));
			}
			maxWidth = Math.Max(headerWidth, maxCellTextWidth);
			if (!column.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved && column.Band.Layout != null)
			{
				int num = column.Band.Layout.GetBorderThickness(column.Band.BorderStyleRowResolved);
				bool flag = column.FirstItem || column.Band.CardView;
				bool flag2 = column.LastItem || column.Band.CardView;
				maxWidth += (flag ? num : 0);
				maxWidth += (flag2 ? num : 0);
			}
			if (!applyWidth)
			{
				width = maxWidth;
				return;
			}
			column.Width = maxWidth;
			if (column.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				int num2 = column.Width;
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = column.RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				if (includeCells)
				{
					rowLayoutColumnInfo.PreferredCellSize = new Size(num2, rowLayoutColumnInfo.PreferredCellSize.Height);
				}
				if (includeHeader)
				{
					rowLayoutColumnInfo.PreferredLabelSize = new Size(num2, rowLayoutColumnInfo.PreferredLabelSize.Height);
				}
			}
			width = maxWidth;
		}
	}
	internal class AsyncExportStatusDisplay : Control
	{
		private enum DisplayMode
		{
			Uninitialized,
			Normal,
			Complete
		}

		private UltraGrid grid;

		private int rowCount;

		private AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase? status;

		private bool needsUpdate = true;

		private Image exportCompleteImage;

		private Image exportCompleteImageResolved;

		private Color lastResolvedCompleteImageForeColor = Color.Empty;

		private Image asyncExportCompleteImage;

		private DisplayMode currentDisplayMode;

		private string exportDocumentType;

		private IContainer components;

		private UltraActivityIndicator ultraActivityIndicator1;

		private UltraButton btnCancel;

		private UltraLabel lblStatus;

		private UltraPanel upProgress;

		private UltraPanel upProgressComplete;

		private UltraLabel lblStatusComplete;

		private Image DefaultExportCompleteImage
		{
			get
			{
				if (exportCompleteImage == null)
				{
					exportCompleteImage = UltraGridLayout.GetImageFromResourse("Images.AsyncExportCompletedCheckMark.png");
				}
				return exportCompleteImage;
			}
		}

		private DisplayMode CurrentDisplayMode
		{
			get
			{
				return currentDisplayMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (currentDisplayMode != value)
				{
					currentDisplayMode = value;
					switch (currentDisplayMode)
					{
					case DisplayMode.Normal:
						((Control)(object)upProgress).Visible = true;
						((Control)(object)upProgressComplete).Visible = false;
						ultraActivityIndicator1.AnimationEnabled = true;
						break;
					case DisplayMode.Complete:
						ultraActivityIndicator1.AnimationEnabled = false;
						((Control)(object)upProgressComplete).SetBounds(((Control)(object)upProgress).Left, ((Control)(object)upProgress).Top, ((Control)(object)upProgress).Width, ((Control)(object)upProgress).Height);
						((Control)(object)upProgressComplete).Visible = true;
						((Control)(object)upProgress).Visible = false;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private Image ExportCompleteImageResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (asyncExportCompleteImage != null)
				{
					return asyncExportCompleteImage;
				}
				Color resolvedCompleteImageForeColor = GetResolvedCompleteImageForeColor();
				if (!IsSameColor(resolvedCompleteImageForeColor, lastResolvedCompleteImageForeColor))
				{
					exportCompleteImageResolved = null;
					lastResolvedCompleteImageForeColor = resolvedCompleteImageForeColor;
				}
				if (exportCompleteImageResolved == null)
				{
					Image defaultExportCompleteImage = DefaultExportCompleteImage;
					Bitmap image = new Bitmap(defaultExportCompleteImage);
					using (Graphics graphics = Graphics.FromImage(image))
					{
						using ImageAttributes imageAttributes = new ImageAttributes();
						ColorMap[] array = new ColorMap[1]
						{
							new ColorMap()
						};
						array[0].OldColor = Color.Black;
						array[0].NewColor = resolvedCompleteImageForeColor;
						imageAttributes.SetRemapTable(array);
						Rectangle destRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, defaultExportCompleteImage.Width, defaultExportCompleteImage.Height);
						graphics.DrawImage(defaultExportCompleteImage, destRect, 0, 0, defaultExportCompleteImage.Width, defaultExportCompleteImage.Height, GraphicsUnit.Pixel, imageAttributes);
					}
					exportCompleteImageResolved = image;
				}
				return exportCompleteImageResolved;
			}
		}

		internal string ExportDocumentType
		{
			get
			{
				return exportDocumentType;
			}
			set
			{
				exportDocumentType = value;
			}
		}

		internal int RowCount
		{
			get
			{
				return rowCount;
			}
			set
			{
				if (rowCount != value)
				{
					rowCount = value;
					needsUpdate = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase? Status
		{
			get
			{
				return status;
			}
			set
			{
				if (status != value)
				{
					status = value;
					needsUpdate = true;
					OnStatusChanged(EventArgs.Empty);
				}
			}
		}

		public Image AsyncExportCompleteImage
		{
			get
			{
				return asyncExportCompleteImage;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != asyncExportCompleteImage && asyncExportCompleteImage != value)
				{
					asyncExportCompleteImage = value;
					UpdateCompletedImage();
				}
			}
		}

		public UltraGrid Grid
		{
			get
			{
				return grid;
			}
			set
			{
				if (grid != value)
				{
					UltraGrid ultraGrid = grid;
					grid = value;
					if (grid == null)
					{
						AsynchronousExportManager.RemoveExportStatusControl(this);
					}
					else if (ultraGrid == null)
					{
						AsynchronousExportManager.AddExportStatusControl(this);
					}
					if (grid != null)
					{
						AsyncExportCompleteImage = grid.DisplayLayout.AsyncExportCompleteImage;
						ShowCancelButton = grid.DisplayLayout.AllowCancelAsyncExport;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShowCancelButton
		{
			get
			{
				return ((Control)(object)btnCancel).Visible;
			}
			set
			{
				((Control)(object)btnCancel).Visible = value;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler StatusChanged;

		internal AsyncExportStatusDisplay()
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			SetStyle(ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor, value: true);
			BackColor = Color.FromArgb(128, 0, 0, 0);
		}

		private Color GetResolvedCompleteImageForeColor()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Invalid comparison between I8 and Unknown
			AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)2;
			lblStatusComplete.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			Color color = ((2 == (long)(2 & requestedProps)) ? SystemColors.ControlText : ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor);
			return Utilities.GetNonSystemColor(color);
		}

		private static bool IsSameColor(Color color1, Color color2)
		{
			color1 = Utilities.GetNonSystemColor(color1);
			color2 = Utilities.GetNonSystemColor(color2);
			return color1.ToArgb() == color2.ToArgb();
		}

		private void LayoutChildControls()
		{
			Size size = DpiUtilities.ConvertToScaledDpi((Control)(object)grid, new Size(12, 14));
			int num = DpiUtilities.ConvertToScaledDpi((Control)(object)grid, 6);
			int num2 = DpiUtilities.ConvertToScaledDpi((Control)(object)grid, 50);
			int num3 = DpiUtilities.ConvertToScaledDpi((Control)(object)grid, 17);
			int num4 = base.Width - num2 * 2;
			int num5 = size.Height + num3 + num + ((Control)(object)lblStatus).PreferredSize.Height + num + ((Control)(object)btnCancel).PreferredSize.Height + size.Height;
			((Control)(object)upProgress).SetBounds(num2, (base.Height - num5) / 2, num4, num5);
			int num6 = num4 - size.Width * 2;
			AnchorStyles anchorStyles = StoreAnchor((Control)(object)ultraActivityIndicator1);
			((Control)(object)ultraActivityIndicator1).SetBounds(size.Width, size.Height, num6, num3, BoundsSpecified.All);
			RestoreAnchor((Control)(object)ultraActivityIndicator1, anchorStyles);
			anchorStyles = StoreAnchor((Control)(object)lblStatus);
			((Control)(object)lblStatus).SetBounds(size.Width, ((Control)(object)ultraActivityIndicator1).Bounds.Bottom + num, num6, ((Control)(object)lblStatus).PreferredSize.Height);
			RestoreAnchor((Control)(object)lblStatus, anchorStyles);
			anchorStyles = StoreAnchor((Control)(object)btnCancel);
			((Control)(object)btnCancel).SetBounds(num4 - (((Control)(object)btnCancel).PreferredSize.Width + size.Width), num5 - (((Control)(object)btnCancel).PreferredSize.Height + size.Height), ((Control)(object)btnCancel).PreferredSize.Width, ((Control)(object)btnCancel).PreferredSize.Height);
			RestoreAnchor((Control)(object)btnCancel, anchorStyles);
		}

		private void LocalizeStrings()
		{
			((Control)(object)btnCancel).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Async_Export_Status_Cancel_Button");
		}

		private AnchorStyles StoreAnchor(Control control)
		{
			AnchorStyles anchor = control.Anchor;
			control.Anchor = AnchorStyles.Top | AnchorStyles.Left;
			return anchor;
		}

		private void RestoreAnchor(Control control, AnchorStyles anchorStyles)
		{
			control.Anchor = anchorStyles;
		}

		private void UpdateCompletedImage()
		{
			Image image = ExportCompleteImageResolved;
			lblStatusComplete.Appearance.Image = image;
			lblStatusComplete.ImageSize = image.Size;
		}

		internal void UpdateStatus(AsyncExportOperation asyncExportOperation)
		{
			Status = asyncExportOperation.CurrentAsyncExportPhase;
			RowCount = asyncExportOperation.RowCount;
			VerifyUI();
		}

		private void UpdateUI()
		{
			AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase? asyncExportPhase = Status;
			if (!asyncExportPhase.HasValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (asyncExportPhase.GetValueOrDefault())
			{
			case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Pending:
				((Control)(object)lblStatus).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Async_Export_Status_Waiting");
				CurrentDisplayMode = DisplayMode.Normal;
				break;
			case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.PrepareForExport:
			case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.AutoSizeColumns:
				((Control)(object)lblStatus).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Async_Export_Status_Preparing", ExportDocumentType);
				CurrentDisplayMode = DisplayMode.Normal;
				break;
			case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.BeginExport:
			case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.ProcessRows:
			case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.EndExport:
				if (RowCount != 1)
				{
					((Control)(object)lblStatus).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Async_Export_Status_InProgress_Plural", ExportDocumentType, RowCount);
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)lblStatus).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Async_Export_Status_InProgress_Singular", ExportDocumentType, RowCount);
				}
				CurrentDisplayMode = DisplayMode.Normal;
				break;
			case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Completed:
			case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Cancelled:
				if (RowCount != 1)
				{
					((Control)(object)lblStatusComplete).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Async_Export_Status_Complete_Plural", RowCount);
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)lblStatusComplete).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Async_Export_Status_Complete_Singular", RowCount);
				}
				CurrentDisplayMode = DisplayMode.Complete;
				break;
			}
		}

		private void VerifyUI()
		{
			if (needsUpdate)
			{
				UpdateUI();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnParentChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnParentChanged(e);
			if (base.Parent != null)
			{
				LayoutChildControls();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisibleChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCompletedImage();
			base.OnVisibleChanged(e);
			LocalizeStrings();
		}

		protected virtual void OnStatusChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (this.StatusChanged != null)
			{
				this.StatusChanged(this, e);
			}
		}

		private void btnCancel_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			AsynchronousExportManager.FindExportOperation(Grid)?.Cancel();
		}

		private void lblStatusComplete_SizeChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)lblStatusComplete).Location = new Point((((Control)(object)upProgressComplete).Width - ((Control)(object)lblStatusComplete).Width) / 2, (((Control)(object)upProgressComplete).Height - ((Control)(object)lblStatusComplete).Height) / 2);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{

					if (val != null && ((LayoutManagerBase)val).LayoutItems.IndexOf((ILayoutItem)(object)group1.Header) != -1 && ((LayoutManagerBase)val).LayoutItems.IndexOf((ILayoutItem)(object)group2.Header) != -1)
					{
						object constraint = ((LayoutManagerBase)val).LayoutItems.GetConstraint((ILayoutItem)(object)group1.Header);
						IGridBagConstraint val2 = (IGridBagConstraint)((constraint is IGridBagConstraint) ? constraint : null);
						object constraint2 = ((LayoutManagerBase)val).LayoutItems.GetConstraint((ILayoutItem)(object)group2.Header);
						IGridBagConstraint val3 = (IGridBagConstraint)((constraint2 is IGridBagConstraint) ? constraint2 : null);
						if (val2 != null && val3 != null)
						{
							int num = val2.OriginX.CompareTo(val3.OriginX);
							int num2 = val2.OriginY.CompareTo(val3.OriginY);
							if (yWise)
							{
								if (num2 != 0)
								{
									return num2;
								}
								return num;
							}
							if (num != 0)
							{
								return num;
							}
							return num2;
						}
					}
				}
				if (yWise)
				{
					int num3 = group1.RowLayoutGroupInfo.OriginYResolved.CompareTo(group2.RowLayoutGroupInfo.OriginYResolved);
					if (num3 != 0)
					{
						return num3;
					}
					return group1.RowLayoutGroupInfo.OriginXResolved.CompareTo(group2.RowLayoutGroupInfo.OriginXResolved);
				}
				int num4 = group1.RowLayoutGroupInfo.OriginXResolved.CompareTo(group2.RowLayoutGroupInfo.OriginXResolved);
				if (num4 != 0)
				{
					return num4;
				}
				return group1.RowLayoutGroupInfo.OriginYResolved.CompareTo(group2.RowLayoutGroupInfo.OriginYResolved);
			}
		}

		internal int PreRowAreaExtent
		{
			get
			{
				if (CardView)
				{
					int num = 0;
					if (-1 != indentation)
					{
						return indentation;
					}
					if (parentBand != null)
					{
						num = 8;
						for (int i = 1; i < Layout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
						{
							UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Layout.SortedBands[i];
							if (ultraGridBand.ParentBand == parentBand && !ultraGridBand.CardView)
							{
								num = Math.Max(num, ultraGridBand.PreRowAreaExtent);
							}
						}
					}
					return num;
				}
				if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid))
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int result = 0;
				ShowExpansionIndicator expansionIndicatorResolved = ExpansionIndicatorResolved;
				if (expansionIndicatorResolved == ShowExpansionIndicator.Always || ShowExpansionIndicator.CheckOnDisplay == expansionIndicatorResolved || ShowExpansionIndicator.CheckOnExpand == expansionIndicatorResolved)
				{
					result = PreRowSelectorWidth;
				}
				else if (layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay)
				{
					if (ParentBand != null && !HasGroupBySortColumns)
					{
						result = PreRowSelectorWidth;
					}
					else if (GetChildBandCount(excludeHidden: true) > 0)
					{
						result = PreRowSelectorWidth;
					}
				}
				int num2 = indentation;
				if (num2 == -1)
				{
					return result;
				}
				return num2;
			}
		}

		internal int CardCaptionHeight
		{
			get
			{
				if (!CardSettings.ShowCaption)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (!isCardCaptionFontHeightCached)
				{
					int num = 0;
					UltraGridOverride lowestLevelOverride = LowestLevelOverride;
					if (lowestLevelOverride != null)
					{
						num = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.CardCaption, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.CardCaption, (RoleState)1);
						int bLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.SelectedCardCaption, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.CardCaption, (RoleState)2);
						num = Math.Max(bLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight, num);
						int bLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight2 = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.ActiveCardCaption, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.CardCaption, (RoleState)16);
						num = Math.Max(bLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight2, num);
					}
					if (num == 0)
					{
						num = layout.DefaultFontHeight;
					}
					num = Math.Max(num, 4 + GetIdealCompressedCardViewButtonSize().Height);
					cachedCardCaptionFontHeight = num;
					isCardCaptionFontHeightCached = true;
				}
				return cachedCardCaptionFontHeight * CardSettings.CaptionLines;
			}
		}

		internal int CardHeightCompressed
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				int borderThickness = Layout.GetBorderThickness(BorderStyleRowResolved);
				return CardCaptionHeight + 2 * borderThickness;
			}
		}

		internal int CardHeight
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0111: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					if (AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
					{
						cachedCardHeight = Math.Max(PreferredHeaderLayoutSize.Height, PreferredRowLayoutSize.Height);
					}
					else
					{
						cachedCardHeight = PreferredRowLayoutSize.Height;
					}
				}
				if (cachedCardHeight < 1)
				{
					int num = 0;
					for (int i = 0; i < OrderedHeaders.Count; i++)
					{
						HeaderBase headerBase = OrderedHeaders[i];
						if (headerBase.Hidden)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (headerBase is GroupHeader { Group: var ultraGridGroup })
						{
							foreach (UltraGridColumn item in ultraGridGroup.ColumnsResolved)
							{
								if (!item.HiddenResolved)
								{
									num += item.CardCellHeight;
								}
							}
						}
						else if (headerBase is ColumnHeader columnHeader)
						{
							num += columnHeader.Column.CardCellHeight;
						}
					}
					cachedCardHeight = num;
				}
				int borderThickness = Layout.GetBorderThickness(BorderStyleRowResolved);
				return cachedCardHeight + CardCaptionHeight + 2 * borderThickness;
			}
		}

		private int CardCellAreaWidth
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_009f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					return PreferredRowLayoutSize.Width;
				}
				if (cachedCardCellAreaWidth < 1)
				{
					int num = 0;
					int num2 = 0;
					if (Layout.Grid != null && Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay != null && Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.Created && Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.IsHandleCreated)
					{
						num2 = Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplayClientAreaRectangle.Width - 2 * Layout.GetBorderThickness(Layout.BorderStyleResolved);
						if (layout.AutoFitAllColumns)
						{
							num2 -= GetOrigin(BandOrigin.RowSelector);
						}
						num2 -= CardLabelWidthResolved;
						if (num2 < 10)
						{
							return 10;
						}
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < OrderedHeaders.Count; i++)
					{
						HeaderBase headerBase = OrderedHeaders[i];
						if (headerBase.Hidden)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (headerBase is GroupHeader { Group: var ultraGridGroup })
						{
							foreach (UltraGridColumn item in ultraGridGroup.ColumnsResolved)
							{
								if (!item.HiddenResolved)
								{
									num = Math.Max(num, item.CellWidthDefault);
								}
							}
						}
						else if (headerBase is ColumnHeader columnHeader)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, columnHeader.Column.CellWidthDefault);
						}
					}
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						num = Math.Min(num, num2);
					}
					cachedCardCellAreaWidth = Math.Max(1, num);
				}
				return cachedCardCellAreaWidth;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFilterUIEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_005a: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				if (Layout != null)
				{
					if (Layout.GrandVerifyVersion == verifiedIsFilterUIEnabledVersionNumber)
					{
						return cachedIsFilterUIEnabled;
					}
					verifiedIsFilterUIEnabledVersionNumber = Layout.GrandVerifyVersion;
				}
				cachedIsFilterUIEnabled = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Columns[i];
					if (!ultraGridColumn.HiddenResolved && 1 == (int)ultraGridColumn.AllowRowFilteringResolved)
					{
						cachedIsFilterUIEnabled = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				return cachedIsFilterUIEnabled;
			}
		}

		internal bool AddNewBoxButtonEnabledResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (AllowAddNew.No == AllowAddNewResolved)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (HasGroupBySortColumns)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Layout == null || Layout.Grid == null || Layout.Grid.DesignMode)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ParentBand == null)
				{
					if (HasGroupBySortColumns)
					{
						UltraGridRow activeRow = Layout.ActiveRow;
						if (activeRow == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (this == activeRow.Band && activeRow is UltraGridGroupByRow)
						{
							UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = (UltraGridGroupByRow)activeRow;
							if (SortedColumns.LastGroupByColIndex != SortedColumns.IndexOf(ultraGridGroupByRow.Column.Key))
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					UltraGridRow activeRow2 = Layout.ActiveRow;
					if (activeRow2 == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!activeRow2.Band.IsDescendantOfBand(this) && ParentBand != activeRow2.Band && this != activeRow2.Band && ParentBand != activeRow2.Band.ParentBand)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (ParentBand == activeRow2.Band && ParentBand.HasGroupBySortColumns && activeRow2 is UltraGridGroupByRow)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (HasSortedColumns && activeRow2 is UltraGridGroupByRow)
					{
						UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow2 = (UltraGridGroupByRow)activeRow2;
						if (SortedColumns.LastGroupByColIndex != SortedColumns.IndexOf(ultraGridGroupByRow2.Column.Key))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				RowsCollection currentParentRowsForAddNew = GetCurrentParentRowsForAddNew();
				if (currentParentRowsForAddNew != null && !currentParentRowsForAddNew.ContainsLessThanMaxRows)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridBand_P_CardView")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Appearance")]
		public bool CardView
		{
			get
			{
				if (!cardView)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (layout == null)
				{
					return cardView;
				}
				if (Layout.IsExportLayout)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Layout.IsPrintLayout)
				{
					switch (Layout.AllowCardPrinting)
					{
					case AllowCardPrinting.Never:
						return false;
					case AllowCardPrinting.RootBandOnly:
						if (!IsRootBand)
						{
							return false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (layout.Grid != null && !(layout.Grid is UltraGrid))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return cardView;
			}
			set
			{
				if (cardView != value)
				{
					cardView = value;
					DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
					if (layout != null)
					{
						layout.BumpBandCardViewVersion();
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CardView);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public string AutoPreviewField
		{
			get
			{
				return autoPreviewField;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(autoPreviewField != value))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (layout == null)
				{
					autoPreviewField = value;
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					if (value == null || value.Length < 1 || Columns.Exists(value))
					{
						autoPreviewField = value;
						NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AutoPreviewField);
						return;
					}
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_315", value));
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_315", value));
				}
			}
		}

				if (hidden != value)
				{
					hidden = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Hidden, null);
				}
			}
		}

		private bool HiddenResolvedInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (Hidden)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay)
				{
					return layout.SortedBands[0] != this;
				}
				if (parentBand != null)
				{
					if (parentBand.CardView)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return parentBand.HiddenResolved;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool HiddenResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (layout.IsCachingBandInfo)
				{
					Dictionary<UltraGridBand, UltraGridLayout.CachedBandInfo> cachedBandData = layout.CachedBandData;
					UltraGridLayout.CachedBandInfo value = null;
					if (cachedBandData.TryGetValue(this, out value) && value.Hidden.HasValue)
					{
						return value.Hidden.Value;
					}
					value = new UltraGridLayout.CachedBandInfo();
					value.Hidden = HiddenResolvedInternal;
					if (!cachedBandData.TryGetValue(this, out var value2))
					{
						cachedBandData[this] = value;
					}
					else
					{
						value2.Hidden = value.Hidden;
					}
					return value.Hidden.Value;
				}
				return HiddenResolvedInternal;
			}
		}

		internal int HierarchicalLevel
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridLayout.CachedBandInfo value = null;
				Dictionary<UltraGridBand, UltraGridLayout.CachedBandInfo> dictionary = null;
				if (layout.IsCachingBandInfo)
				{
					dictionary = layout.CachedBandData;
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(this, out value) && value.HierarchicalLevel > -1)
					{
						return value.HierarchicalLevel;
					}
				}
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = parentBand;
				int num = 0;
				while (ultraGridBand != null)
				{
					num++;
					ultraGridBand = ultraGridBand.ParentBand;
				}
				if (dictionary != null)
				{
					if (value != null)
					{
						value.HierarchicalLevel = num;
					}
					else
					{
						value = new UltraGridLayout.CachedBandInfo();
						value.HierarchicalLevel = num;
						dictionary[this] = value;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn ScrollTipCol
		{
			get
			{
				if (columns == null || columns.Count < 1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ((ScrollTipField != null && ScrollTipField.Length > 0) ? Columns[ScrollTipField] : null);
				if (ultraGridColumn == null)
				{
					if (layout.Grid is UltraDropDownBase ultraDropDownBase)
					{
						ultraGridColumn = Columns[ultraDropDownBase.DisplayMemberResolved];
					}
					else
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
						{
							UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = Columns[i];
							if (!ultraGridColumn2.HiddenResolved)
							{
								ultraGridColumn = ultraGridColumn2;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return ultraGridColumn;
			}
		}

		internal RowLayoutSizing AllowRowLayoutCellSizingResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasOverride && overrideObj.ShouldSerializeAllowRowLayoutCellSizing())
				{
					return overrideObj.AllowRowLayoutCellSizing;
				}
				if (Layout.HasOverride && Layout.Override.ShouldSerializeAllowRowLayoutCellSizing())
				{
					return Layout.Override.AllowRowLayoutCellSizing;
				}
				if (AllowColSizing.None == AllowColSizingResolved)
				{
					return RowLayoutSizing.None;
				}
				RowSizing rowSizingResolved = RowSizingResolved;
				if (ColumnSizingArea.HeadersOnly == ColumnSizingAreaResolvedDefault)
				{
					if (RowSizing.Fixed == rowSizingResolved || RowSizing.AutoFixed == rowSizingResolved)
					{
						return RowLayoutSizing.None;
					}
					return RowLayoutSizing.Vertical;
				}
				if (RowSizing.Fixed == rowSizingResolved || RowSizing.AutoFixed == rowSizingResolved)
				{
					return RowLayoutSizing.Horizontal;
				}
				return RowLayoutSizing.Both;
			}
		}

		internal RowLayoutSizing AllowRowLayoutLabelSizingResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (HasOverride && overrideObj.ShouldSerializeAllowRowLayoutLabelSizing())

				}
				if (Layout.HasOverride && Layout.Override.ShouldSerializeAllowRowLayoutLabelSizing())
				{
					return Layout.Override.AllowRowLayoutLabelSizing;
				}
				if (AllowColSizing.None == AllowColSizingResolved)
				{
					return RowLayoutSizing.None;
				}
				if (ColumnSizingArea.CellsOnly == ColumnSizingAreaResolvedDefault)
				{
					return RowLayoutSizing.Vertical;
				}
				return RowLayoutSizing.Both;
			}
		}

		internal AccessibleObject ColHeadersAccessibilityObject
		{
			get
			{
				if (HiddenResolved)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (CardView)
				{
					if (Index != 0 || CardSettings.StyleResolved != CardStyle.MergedLabels)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				else if (!ColHeadersVisible)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (colHeadersAccessibilityObject == null)
				{
					colHeadersAccessibilityObject = Layout.Grid.CreateAccessibilityInstance(new HeadersCollection.HeadersAccessibleObject(this));
				}
				return colHeadersAccessibilityObject;
			}
		}

		internal AccessibleObject CardScrollbarAccessibilityObject
		{
			get
			{
				if (HiddenResolved)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (!CardView || Index != 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (Layout.UIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement), new object[2] { Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion, Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion }) is RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)
				{
					UIElementEnumerator enumerator = ((UIElement)rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement).ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
							if (current is CardAreaUIElement cardAreaUIElement && cardAreaUIElement.Band == this)
							{
								return cardAreaUIElement.ScrollbarAccessibilityObject;
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

					return null;
				}
				if (!CardView)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (Layout.UIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement), new object[2] { Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion, Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion }) is RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)
				{

					try
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
							if (current is CardAreaUIElement cardAreaUIElement && cardAreaUIElement.Band == this)
							{
								return cardAreaUIElement;
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal void FitColumnsToWidth(int right)
		{
			int num = right - GetOrigin(BandOrigin.RowSelector);
			if (num < 1 || extent < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int adjustment = num + PreRowAreaExtent - extent;
			if (adjustment == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = 0;
			if (Layout.AutoFitExtendLastColumn)
			{
				bool useRowLayoutResolved = UseRowLayoutResolved;
				bool flag = true;
				PrintManager printManager = ((layout.Grid is UltraGrid) ? ((UltraGrid)layout.Grid).PrintManager : null);
				if (printManager != null && printManager.LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.FitWidthToPages == 0)
				{
					flag = false;
					if (useRowLayoutResolved)
					{
						RecalcCachedLayoutItemRects();
					}
				}
				HeaderBase lastVisibleHeader = OrderedHeaders.LastVisibleHeader;
				if (lastVisibleHeader != null && flag)
				{
					if (adjustment > 0)
					{
						if (!useRowLayoutResolved)
						{
							num2 = 0;
							num3 = 0;
							lastVisibleHeader.GetResizeRange(ref num2, ref num3);
							if (num3 > 0)
							{
								int num4 = lastVisibleHeader.Extent - lastVisibleHeader.RowSelectorExtent;
								if (num4 + adjustment > num3)
								{
									adjustment = Math.Max(0, num3 - num4);
								}
							}
							extent += adjustment;
						}
						else
						{
							extent += adjustment;
							RecalcCachedLayoutItemRects();
						}
					}
					else if (useRowLayoutResolved)
					{
						RecalcCachedLayoutItemRects();
					}
				}
				BumpMajorRowHeightVersion();
				return;
			}
			if (UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				extent += adjustment;
				extent = Math.Max(extent, GetExtentLayout(minimum: true, BandOrigin.PreRowArea));
				RecalcCachedLayoutItemRects();
				return;
			}
			num2 = 0;
			num3 = 0;
			int num5 = adjustment;
			int num6 = 0;
			int num7 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < OrderedHeaders.Count; i++)
			{
				if (OrderedHeaders[i].Hidden)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (OrderedHeaders[i] is GroupHeader)
				{
					UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = OrderedHeaders[i].Group;
					if (ultraGridGroup != null && !ultraGridGroup.ProportionalResizeResolved)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (OrderedHeaders[i] is ColumnHeader)
				{
					UltraGridColumn column = OrderedHeaders[i].Column;
					if (column != null && !column.ProportionalResizeResolved)
					{

					}
				}

				if (adjustment < 0)
				{
					if (num8 <= num2)
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				else if (num3 > 0 && num8 >= num3)
				{
					continue;
				}
				num6++;
				num7 += num8 - OrderedHeaders[i].RowSelectorExtent;
			}
			if (num6 >= 1)
			{
				double factor = (double)(adjustment + num7) / (double)num7;
				ApplyAdjustmentToColumns(ref adjustment, factor);
				if (adjustment != 0)
				{
					ApplyAdjustmentToColumns(ref adjustment, 0.0);
				}

		}

		internal void ResetAutoFit_ColumnLastAdjustmentFullyAppliedToIndex()
		{
			autoFit_columnLastAdjustmentFullyAppliedToIndex = -1;
		}

		private void ApplyAdjustmentToColumns(ref int adjustment, double factor)
		{
			int minWidth = 0;
			int maxWidth = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((0.0 != factor) ? 1 : 2); i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < OrderedHeaders.Count; j++)
				{
					if (adjustment == 0)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (OrderedHeaders[j].Hidden)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (OrderedHeaders[j] is GroupHeader)
					{
						UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = OrderedHeaders[j].Group;
						if (ultraGridGroup != null && !ultraGridGroup.ProportionalResizeResolved)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					if (OrderedHeaders[j] is ColumnHeader)
					{
						UltraGridColumn column = OrderedHeaders[j].Column;
						if (column != null && !column.ProportionalResizeResolved)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					OrderedHeaders[j].GetResizeRange(ref minWidth, ref maxWidth);
					int num = OrderedHeaders[j].Extent;
					int num2;
					if (factor == 0.0)
					{
						if (i == 0 && j <= autoFit_columnLastAdjustmentFullyAppliedToIndex)
						{
							continue;
						}
						autoFit_columnLastAdjustmentFullyAppliedToIndex = j;
						num2 = adjustment;
					}
					else
					{
						int rowSelectorExtent = OrderedHeaders[j].RowSelectorExtent;
						int num3 = num - rowSelectorExtent;
						num2 = (int)(factor * (double)num3 - (double)num3);
						num2 = ((adjustment >= 0) ? Math.Min(num2, adjustment) : Math.Max(num2, adjustment));
					}
					int val = num + num2;
					if (maxWidth > 0)
					{
						val = Math.Min(maxWidth, val);
					}
					val = Math.Max(minWidth, val);
					if (val == num)
					{
						continue;
					}
					OrderedHeaders[j].InternalSetWidth(val, autofit: true);
					num2 = OrderedHeaders[j].Extent - num;
					for (int k = j + 1; k < OrderedHeaders.Count; k++)
					{
						if (!OrderedHeaders[k].Hidden)
						{
							OrderedHeaders[k].SetOrigin(OrderedHeaders[k].Origin + num2);
						}
					}
					adjustment -= num2;
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn GetColumnAtOverallPosition(int position)
		{
			if (position < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (GroupsDisplayed && RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < OrderedGroupHeaders.Count; i++)
				{
					GroupColumnsCollection groupColumnsCollection = OrderedGroupHeaders[i].Group.Columns;
					if (position < groupColumnsCollection.Count)
					{
						return groupColumnsCollection[position];
					}
					position -= groupColumnsCollection.Count;
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (position < OrderedColumnHeaders.Count)
			{
				return OrderedColumnHeaders[position].Column;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (Key == null || Key.Length == 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("Band[");
				stringBuilder.Append(Index);
				stringBuilder.Append("]");
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Key);
			}
			if (Hidden)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" [hidden]");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			UnWireDataSource();
			if (header != null)
			{
				header.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				header.Dispose();
				header = null;
			}
			if (overrideObj != null)
			{
				overrideObj.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				overrideObj.Dispose();
				overrideObj = null;
			}
			if (columns != null)
			{
				columns.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				columns.Dispose();
				columns = null;
			}
			if (groups != null)
			{
				groups.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				groups.Dispose();
				groups = null;
			}
			if (rowLayouts != null)
			{
				rowLayouts.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				rowLayouts.Dispose();
				rowLayouts = null;
			}
			orderedColumns = null;
			orderedGroups = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		private void EnsureProperlyHookedIntoBindingListListChanged()
		{
			IBindingList bindingList = BindingList;
			if (lastBindingList != bindingList)
			{
				if (lastBindingList != null)
				{
					lastBindingList.ListChanged -= listChangedHandler;
				}
				if (bindingList != null)
				{
					bindingList.ListChanged += listChangedHandler;
				}
			}
			lastBindingList = bindingList;
		}

		private void UnHookFromBindingList()
		{
			if (lastBindingList != null)
			{
				lastBindingList.ListChanged -= listChangedHandler;
			}
			lastBindingList = null;
		}

		private void DataSource_ItemChanged(object sender, ItemChangedEventArgs ea)
		{
			EnsureProperlyHookedIntoBindingListListChanged();
			if (binding_debug)
			{
				_ = ParentBand;
			}
			if (!IsCurrentRowRowsCollectionCreated())
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsBoundToIBindingList)
			{
				InternalRefreshSummaries();
			}
			if ((parentBand != null && !layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay) || HiddenResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			RowsCollection currentParentRows = GetCurrentParentRows(initializeIfNeeded: false, dontSyncRows: true);
			if (List != lastBoundList)
			{
				lastBoundList = List;
				if (ParentBand == null)
				{
					if (currentParentRows != null && Layout != null)
					{
						currentParentRows.DirtyRows();
						if (Layout != null)
						{
							Layout.DirtyGridElement();
							Layout.DirtyComboArea();
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					currentParentRows?.DirtyDataList();
				}
			}
			if (BindingManager != null && currentParentRows != null && !currentParentRows.IsRowsDirty && (BindingManager.Count != currentParentRows.ActualRowsCount || (ea.Index < 0 && BindingManager.Position < 0)))
			{
				if (!HookIntoList || BindingManager.Count == 0 || currentParentRows.ActualRowsCount == 0)
				{
					if (currentParentRows.ParentRow == null || currentParentRows.ParentRow.Expanded)
					{
						currentParentRows.DirtyRows();
					}
					else
					{
						currentParentRows.DirtyRows();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (currentParentRows != null && ea.Index >= 0 && !Layout.Grid.RowSynchronizationSuspended && !currentParentRows.IsRowsDirty && ea.Index < currentParentRows.ActualRowsCount)
			{
				UltraGridRow rowWithListIndex = currentParentRows.GetRowWithListIndex(ea.Index);
				if (rowWithListIndex != null)
				{
					rowWithListIndex.InternalDecrementVerifiedVersion();
					rowWithListIndex.ParentCollection.NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged(rowWithListIndex);
					rowWithListIndex.FireInitializeRow();
				}
			}
			if (layout != null && layout.Grid is UltraCombo ultraCombo)
			{
				((UIElement)ultraCombo.UIElement).DirtyChildElements();
			}
		}

		private bool IsCurrentRowRowsCollectionCreated()
		{
			if (ParentBand != null)
			{
				if (!ParentBand.IsCurrentRowRowsCollectionCreated())
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraGridRow currentRow = ParentBand.GetCurrentRow(ensureExpanded: false, dontSyncRows: true);
				if (currentRow != null && currentRow.HaveChildRowsBeenCreated(this))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void DataSource_CurrentChanged(object sender, EventArgs ea)
		{
			_ = binding_debug;
			if (!(lastBoundList is IUltraDataRowsCollection) && IsCurrentRowRowsCollectionCreated() && !Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange && (parentBand == null || layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay) && !HiddenResolved)
			{
				RowsCollection currentParentRows = GetCurrentParentRows(initializeIfNeeded: false, dontSyncRows: true);
				if (currentParentRows == null || currentParentRows.ParentRow == null || currentParentRows.ParentRow.Expanded)
				{
					GetCurrentRow(ensureExpanded: false, dontSyncRows: true)?.InvalidateItemAllRegions();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DataSource_PositionChanged(object sender, EventArgs ea)
		{
			if (binding_debug)
			{
				_ = ParentBand;
			}
			if (lastAddedRow != null && !inAddNew && lastAddedRow.ListIndex != BindingManager.Position)
			{
				lastAddedRow.InternalSetIsAddRow(val: false);
				lastAddedRow = null;
			}
			EnsureChildBandsLoaded();
			if (!IsCurrentRowRowsCollectionCreated() || Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange || (parentBand != null && !layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay) || HiddenResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			RowsCollection currentParentRows = GetCurrentParentRows(initializeIfNeeded: false, dontSyncRows: true);
			if (BindingManager != null && currentParentRows != null && !currentParentRows.IsRowsDirty && BindingManager.Count != currentParentRows.ActualRowsCount)
			{
				if (!HookIntoList)
				{
					if (currentParentRows.ParentRow == null || currentParentRows.ParentRow.Expanded)
					{
						currentParentRows.DirtyRows();
					}
					else
					{
						currentParentRows.DirtyRows();
					}
				}
				((UltraControlBase)layout.Grid).Invalidate();
			}
			if (Layout.Grid is UltraGrid { SyncWithCurrencyManager: not false } && BindingManager != null && BindingManager.Position >= 0 && (currentParentRows == null || !currentParentRows.IsRowsDirty))
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = ((!Layout.Grid.RowSynchronizationSuspended) ? GetCurrentRow(ensureExpanded: false) : GetCurrentRow(ensureExpanded: false, dontSyncRows: true));
				if (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					if (Layout.Grid.ActiveRow != null)
					{
						Layout.Grid.ActiveRow.forceTemplateCloseOnActionRowChanged = true;
					}
					Layout.Grid.TempActiveRow = ultraGridRow;
				}
			}
			if (Layout.Grid is UltraCombo)
			{
				((UltraCombo)Layout.Grid).SyncSelectedRowWithCurrencyManager(targetSelectedRow: true);
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetCurrentRow(bool ensureExpanded)
		{
			return GetCurrentRow(ensureExpanded, dontSyncRows: false);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetCurrentRow(bool ensureExpanded, bool dontSyncRows)
		{
			if (bindingManager == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (parentBand == null)
			{
				int num = ((!dontSyncRows) ? layout.Rows.ActualRowsCount : layout.Rows.ActualRowsCount_NoSync);
				if (bindingManager.Position < num)
				{
					return layout.Rows.GetRowWithListIndexHelper(bindingManager.Position, dontSyncRows);
				}
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRow currentRow = parentBand.GetCurrentRow(ensureExpanded, dontSyncRows);
			if (currentRow != null)
			{
				if (ensureExpanded && !currentRow.Expanded)
				{
					currentRow.Expanded = true;
					if (!currentRow.Expanded)
					{
						return null;
					}
				}
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = currentRow.ChildBands[this];
				if (ultraGridChildBand != null && bindingManager.Position >= 0)
				{
					RowsCollection topLevelRows = ultraGridChildBand.TopLevelRows;
					int num2 = ((!dontSyncRows) ? topLevelRows.ActualRowsCount : topLevelRows.ActualRowsCount_NoSync);
					if (bindingManager.Position < num2)
					{
						return topLevelRows.GetRowWithListIndexHelper(bindingManager.Position, dontSyncRows);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void UnWireDataSource()
		{
			if (bindingManager != null)
			{
				_ = binding_debug;
				if (BindingManager is CurrencyManager currencyManager)
				{
					currencyManager.CurrentChanged -= currentChangedHandler;
					currencyManager.PositionChanged -= positionChangedHandler;
					currencyManager.ItemChanged -= itemChangedHandler;
				}
				bindingManager.Bindings.CollectionChanged -= bindingsChangedHandler;
				UnHookFromBindingList();
				bindingManager = null;
				lastBoundList = null;
				if (rowEditTemplate != null)
				{
					rowEditTemplate.Initialize(null);
					rowEditTemplate = null;
				}
			}
			cachedList = null;
		}

		private void WireDataSource()
		{
			if (bindingManager != null && (Layout == null || !Layout.ExtractDataStructureOnly))
			{
				_ = binding_debug;
				if (BindingManager is CurrencyManager currencyManager)
				{
					currencyManager.CurrentChanged += currentChangedHandler;
					currencyManager.PositionChanged += positionChangedHandler;
					currencyManager.ItemChanged += itemChangedHandler;
				}
				bindingManager.Bindings.CollectionChanged += bindingsChangedHandler;
				EnsureProperlyHookedIntoBindingListListChanged();
				lastBoundList = List;
				if (rowEditTemplate != null)
				{
					rowEditTemplate.Initialize(this);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CalculateBandMetrics(UltraGridBand priorBand)
		{
			int num = 0;
			bool firstItem = true;
			bandExtent_BeforeAutoFitExtendLastColumn = 0;
			int num2 = extent;
			Layout.ValidateSynchronizedColLists();
			synchronizationAdjustment = 0;
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = null;
			HeaderBase headerBase = null;
			List<HeaderBase> allOrderedHeaders = GetAllOrderedHeaders();
			ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = Layout.ViewStyleImpl;
			foreach (HeaderBase item in allOrderedHeaders)
			{
				item.InitSynchronization();
				if (item.Hidden)
				{
					item.SetOrigin(0);
					continue;
				}
				if (UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					item.SetOrigin(((IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo)item).RowLayoutColumnInfo.CachedHeaderRect.Left);
					if (item is GroupHeader groupHeader)
					{
						groupHeader.Group.SetWidth(((IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo)item).RowLayoutColumnInfo.CachedHeaderRect.Width, byMouse: false, fireEvents: false, fAdjustAllColsInGroup: false, fNotify: false);
					}
					continue;
				}
				colScrollRegion = item.ExclusiveColScrollRegion;
				if (colScrollRegion != null)
				{
					colScrollRegion.AdjustExclusiveWidth(item, viewStyleImpl);
					continue;
				}
				int num3 = item.Extent;
				item.FirstItem = firstItem;
				item.SetOrigin(num);
				item.LastItem = false;
				if (num3 > 0)
				{
					num += item.Extent;
					firstItem = false;
					headerBase = item;
				}
			}
			if (headerBase != null)
			{
				headerBase.LastItem = true;
			}
			if (CardView)
			{
				extent = 1;
			}
			else if (UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				extent = GetExtentLayout();
			}
			else
			{
				extent = num;
			}
			if (extent < 1)
			{
				extent += RowSelectorExtent + PreRowAreaExtent;
			}
			else
			{
				extent += PreRowAreaExtent;
			}
			if (!HiddenResolved || !UseRowLayoutResolved || Layout.Grid == null || !Layout.Grid.DesignMode)
			{
				viewStyleImpl.AdjustBandOrigin(this, priorBand, ref origin);
				if (Layout.Grid is UltraDropDownBase ultraDropDownBase && extent != num2 && !Layout.ColScrollRegions.InitializingMetrics)
				{
					ultraDropDownBase.ReCalculateDropDownSize(resizeDropDownForm: true, dirtyMetrics: false);
				}
				bandExtent_BeforeAutoFitExtendLastColumn = extent;
			}
		}

		internal void ResetBandOrigins(bool adjustChildBandsAlso)
		{
			layout.ViewStyleImpl.AdjustBandOrigin(this, parentBand, ref origin);
			if (!adjustChildBandsAlso)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = Index + 1; i < Layout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Layout.SortedBands[i];
				if (this == ultraGridBand.ParentBand)
				{
					ultraGridBand.ResetBandOrigins(adjustChildBandsAlso);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SynchronizeColWidths()
		{
			HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = OrderedHeaders;
			ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = Layout.ViewStyleImpl;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = orderedHeaders.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = orderedHeaders[i];
				headerBase.Synchronize();
			}
			if (synchronizationAdjustment != 0)
			{
				extent += synchronizationAdjustment;
				bandExtent_BeforeAutoFitExtendLastColumn = extent;
				viewStyleImpl?.AdjustDescendantBandOrigins(this, synchronizationAdjustment);
				synchronizationAdjustment = 0;
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateExclusizeColRegionWidths()

				}
				return;
			}
			HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = OrderedHeaders;
			for (int i = 0; i < orderedHeaders.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = orderedHeaders[i];
				if (!headerBase.Hidden)
				{
					headerBase.ExclusiveColScrollRegion?.UpdateExclusiveWidth(headerBase);
				}
			}
		}
