		private int CalcRowConnectorLineOffsetHelper()
		{
			int preRowSelectorWidth = PreRowSelectorWidth;
			if (indentation != -1 && indentation < preRowSelectorWidth)
			{
				preRowSelectorWidth = indentation;
			}
			return preRowSelectorWidth / 2;
		}

		private int CalcRowConnectorLineOffset()
		{
			int num = CalcRowConnectorLineOffsetHelper();
			if (!HasIndependentRowConnectorsFromSiblingBands)
			{
				BandsCollection bandsCollection = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.SortedBands : null);
				int index = Index;
				if (index > 0 && bandsCollection != null)
				{
					for (int num2 = index - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = bandsCollection[num2];
						if (ultraGridBand.parentBand == parentBand)
						{
							if (ultraGridBand.HasIndependentRowConnectorsFromSiblingBands)
							{
								break;
							}
							num = Math.Min(num, ultraGridBand.CalcRowConnectorLineOffsetHelper());
						}
					}
					int i = index + 1;
					for (int count = bandsCollection.Count; i < count; i++)
					{
						UltraGridBand ultraGridBand2 = bandsCollection[i];
						if (ultraGridBand2.parentBand == parentBand)
						{
							if (ultraGridBand2.HasIndependentRowConnectorsFromSiblingBands)
							{
								break;
							}
							num = Math.Min(num, ultraGridBand2.CalcRowConnectorLineOffsetHelper());
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal Size GetIdealCompressedCardViewButtonSize(bool imageOnly = false)
		{
			bool themesBeingUsed = Layout.ThemesBeingUsed;
			Control grid = (Control)(object)Layout.Grid;
			Size size;
			if (themesBeingUsed)
			{
				Graphics cachedGraphics = Layout.GetCachedGraphics();
				if (cachedGraphics != null)
				{
					Size buttonSize = XPThemes.Explorer.GetButtonSize(grid, (ExplorerButtonType)1, (ExplorerButtonState)0, cachedGraphics);
					Size buttonSize2 = XPThemes.Explorer.GetButtonSize(grid, (ExplorerButtonType)2, (ExplorerButtonState)0, cachedGraphics);
					Layout.ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);
					cachedGraphics = null;
					size = new Size(Math.Max(buttonSize.Width, buttonSize2.Width), Math.Max(buttonSize.Height, buttonSize2.Height));
				}
				else
				{
					size = DpiUtilities.ConvertToScaledDpi(grid, new Size(18, 18));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				size = DpiUtilities.ConvertToScaledDpi(grid, new Size(12, 12));
			}
			if (!imageOnly)
			{
				size = AdjustForTouchMode(size);
			}
			return size;
		}

		internal int CardLabelWidthResolvedHelper(bool forWrapHeaderTextCalculations)
		{
			//IL_00d5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!ColHeadersVisible && (RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout || !GroupHeadersVisible))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (CardSettings.LabelWidth > 0)
			{
				return CardSettings.LabelWidth;
			}
			if (UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				return PreferredHeaderLayoutSize.Width;
			}
			int num = cachedCardLabelAreaWidth;
			if (num < 1 || forWrapHeaderTextCalculations)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				if (Layout.Grid != null && Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay != null && Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.Created && Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.IsHandleCreated)
				{
					num2 = Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplayClientAreaRectangle.Width - 2 * Layout.GetBorderThickness(Layout.BorderStyleResolved);
					if (layout.AutoFitAllColumns)
					{
						num2 -= GetOrigin(BandOrigin.RowSelector);
					}
					if (num2 < 10)
					{
						return 10;
					}
				}
				if (!forWrapHeaderTextCalculations)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < OrderedHeaders.Count; i++)
					{
						HeaderBase headerBase = OrderedHeaders[i];
						if (headerBase.Hidden)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (headerBase is GroupHeader { Group: var ultraGridGroup })
						{
							foreach (UltraGridColumn item in ultraGridGroup.ColumnsResolved)
							{
								if (!item.HiddenResolved)
								{
									num = Math.Max(num, item.CardLabelSize.Width);
								}
							}
						}
						else if (headerBase is ColumnHeader columnHeader)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, columnHeader.Column.CardLabelSize.Width);
						}
					}
				}
				if (num2 > 0)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num, num2 * 3 / 4);
				}
				if (!forWrapHeaderTextCalculations)
				{
					cachedCardLabelAreaWidth = num;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		}

		internal int GetTotalRowsInCardArea(int totalCardAreaHeight)
		{
			int cardHeight = CardHeight;
			int num = GetHeightAvailableForCards(totalCardAreaHeight) - cardHeight;
			int num2 = 1;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				num2 += num / Math.Max(1, cardHeight + CardSpacingVertical);
			}
			if (CardSettings.MaxCardAreaRows > 0)
			{
				num2 = Math.Min(CardSettings.MaxCardAreaRows, num2);
			}
			return num2;
		}

		internal int GetTotalColsInCardArea(int totalCardAreaWidth)
		{
			int cardWidthResolved = CardWidthResolved;
			int num = GetWidthAvailableForCards(totalCardAreaWidth) - cardWidthResolved;
			int num2 = 1;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				num2 += num / (cardWidthResolved + CardSpacingHorizontal);
			}
			if (CardSettings.MaxCardAreaCols > 0)
			{
				num2 = Math.Min(CardSettings.MaxCardAreaCols, num2);
			}
			return num2;
		}

		internal int CalculateRequiredCardAreaWidth(int cardColumns)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			cardColumns = Math.Max(cardColumns, 1);
			int cardWidthResolved = CardWidthResolved;
			int cardSpacingHorizontal = CardSpacingHorizontal;
			int borderThickness = Layout.GetBorderThickness(BorderStyleCardAreaResolved);
			int num = 2 * (CardAreaMarginsResolved + borderThickness);
			num += CardMergedLabelAreaWidth;
			num += cardSpacingHorizontal;
			num += cardColumns * cardWidthResolved;
			return num + (cardColumns - 1) * cardSpacingHorizontal;
		}

		internal int CalculateRequiredCardAreaHeight(int cardRows)
		{
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			cardRows = Math.Max(cardRows, 1);
			int cardHeight = CardHeight;
			int cardSpacingVertical = CardSpacingVertical;
			int borderThickness = Layout.GetBorderThickness(BorderStyleCardAreaResolved);
			int num = 2 * (CardAreaMarginsResolved + borderThickness);
			num += CardAreaHorizontalScrollbarHeightResolved;
			num += cardRows * cardHeight;
			return num + (cardRows - 1) * cardSpacingVertical;
		}

		public int GetOrigin(BandOrigin area)
		{
			int num = origin;
			switch (area)
			{
			case BandOrigin.RowSelector:
				num += PreRowAreaExtent;
				break;
			case BandOrigin.RowCellArea:
				num += PreRowAreaExtent + RowSelectorExtent;
				break;
			}
			return num;
		}

		public int GetOrigin()
		{
			return GetOrigin(BandOrigin.PreRowArea);
		}

		public int GetExtent(BandOrigin area)
		{
			int num = extent;
			switch (area)
			{
			case BandOrigin.RowSelector:
				num -= PreRowAreaExtent;
				break;
			case BandOrigin.RowCellArea:
				num -= PreRowAreaExtent + RowSelectorExtent;
				break;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal int GetActualWidth(bool ignoreDraggingWidth)
		{
			return GetExtent();
		}

		public int GetExtent()
		{
			return GetExtent(BandOrigin.PreRowArea);
		}

		internal static object GetValueForFilterComparisionHelper(object val, UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column, ref bool forceGetDisplayValue)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase editor = column.GetEditor(row);
			if (editor != null)
			{
				object cellVal = val;
				val = editor.GetDataFilteredDestinationValue(val, (ConversionDirection)2, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)column.EditorOwnerInfo, (object)row);
				if (forceGetDisplayValue || !editor.ComparesByValue((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)column.EditorOwnerInfo, (object)row))
				{
					val = ((row == null) ? editor.DataValueToText(val, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)column.EditorOwnerInfo, (object)row) : column.GetCellText(row, cellVal));
					forceGetDisplayValue = true;
				}
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = DBNull.Value;
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal bool LoadFilterValueListHelper(ValueList valueList, RowsCollection rows, UltraGridColumn column, bool includeFilteredOutRows, FilterValueListOptions options)
		{
			return LoadFilterValueListHelper(valueList, rows, column, includeFilteredOutRows, options, fireRowFilterDropDownPopulateEvents: true);
		}

		internal bool LoadFilterValueListHelper(ValueList valueList, RowsCollection rows, UltraGridColumn column, bool includeFilteredOutRows, FilterValueListOptions options, bool fireRowFilterDropDownPopulateEvents)
		{
			valueList.ValueListItems.Clear();
			FilterOperandDropDownItems filterOperandDropDownItems = column?.FilterOperandDropDownItemsResolved ?? (FilterOperandDropDownItems.Blanks | FilterOperandDropDownItems.NonBlanks | FilterOperandDropDownItems.Custom | FilterOperandDropDownItems.CellValues | FilterOperandDropDownItems.All);
			switch (options)
			{
			case FilterValueListOptions.None:
				if (FilterUIType.HeaderIcons == FilterUITypeResolved && (filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.All) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.All)
				{
					valueList.ValueListItems.Add((ValueListItem)(object)new FilterValueListItem(FilterAllText, FilterAllText));
				}
				if ((filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.Custom) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.Custom)
				{
					if (FilterUIType.FilterRow == FilterUITypeResolved)
					{
						valueList.ValueListItems.Add((ValueListItem)(object)new FilterValueListItem(new object(), FilterCustomText));
					}
					else
					{
						valueList.ValueListItems.Add((ValueListItem)(object)new FilterValueListItem(FilterCustomText, FilterCustomText));
					}
				}
				if ((filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.Blanks) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.Blanks)
				{
					valueList.ValueListItems.Add((ValueListItem)(object)new FilterValueListItem(FilterBlanks, FilterBlanks));
				}
				if ((filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.NonBlanks) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.NonBlanks)
				{
					valueList.ValueListItems.Add((ValueListItem)(object)new FilterValueListItem(FilterNonBlanks, FilterNonBlanks));
				}
				break;
			case FilterValueListOptions.FilterUIProvider:
				if ((filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.All) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.All)
				{
					valueList.ValueListItems.Add((ValueListItem)(object)new FilterValueListItem(FilterAllText, FilterAllText));
				}
				if ((filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.Blanks) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.Blanks)
				{
					valueList.ValueListItems.Add((ValueListItem)(object)new FilterValueListItem(FilterBlanks, FilterBlanks));
				}
				break;
			}
			if (options != FilterValueListOptions.CellValuesOnly && SupportsDataErrorInfoOnCellsResolved)
			{
				if ((filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.Errors) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.Errors)
				{
					valueList.ValueListItems.Add((ValueListItem)(object)new FilterValueListItem(FilterErrors, FilterErrors));
				}
				if ((filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.NonErrors) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.NonErrors)
				{
					valueList.ValueListItems.Add((ValueListItem)(object)new FilterValueListItem(FilterNonErrors, FilterNonErrors));
				}
			}
			if ((filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.CellValues) != FilterOperandDropDownItems.CellValues)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (fireRowFilterDropDownPopulateEvents)
			{
				UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
				if (ultraGridBase != null)
				{
					BeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulateEventArgs e = new BeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulateEventArgs(column, rows, valueList);
					ultraGridBase.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulate, e);
					if (e.Handled)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			if (RowFilterActionResolved != RowFilterAction.None)
			{
				if (column.HasFormulaHolder && column.FormulaHolder.HasActiveFormula)
				{
					UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = column.Band?.Layout;
					IUltraCalcManager ultraCalcManager = (ultraGridLayout?.Grid)?.CalcManager;
					if (ultraCalcManager != null)
					{
						ultraCalcManager.ProcessEventQueue();
						ColumnReference columnReference = column.CalcReference;
						try
						{
							columnReference.disableRecalcDeferredOverride = true;
							ultraGridLayout.AddRecalcDeferredFormulasToRecalcChain_Helper(columnReference);
							ultraCalcManager.EnsureCalculated(columnReference, wait: true);
						}
						finally
						{
							columnReference.disableRecalcDeferredOverride = false;
						}
					}
				}
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				TraverseRowsCallback traverseRowsCallback;
				if (rows != null)
				{
					rows.TopLevelRowsCollection.InternalTraverseRowsHelper(this, traverseRowsCallback = new TraverseRowsCallback(this, column, hashtable, includeFilteredOutRows, rows), recursive: true);
				}
				else
				{
					Layout.Rows.InternalTraverseRowsHelper(this, traverseRowsCallback = new TraverseRowsCallback(this, column, hashtable, includeFilteredOutRows, rows), recursive: true);
				}
				DictionaryEntry[] array = new DictionaryEntry[hashtable.Count];
				hashtable.CopyTo(array, 0);
				if (!traverseRowsCallback.hasImagesInTable)
				{
					Array.Sort(array, new FilterDropDownItemComparer(sortByDisplayText: true, column));
					DictionaryEntry[] array2 = array.Clone() as DictionaryEntry[];
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						if (i > 0 && array2[i].Value.ToString() == array2[i - 1].Value.ToString())
						{
							ref DictionaryEntry reference = ref array[i];
							reference.Value = string.Concat(reference.Value, " (", array[i].Key, ")");
						}
						else if (i < array.Length - 1 && array2[i].Value.ToString() == array2[i + 1].Value.ToString())
						{
							ref DictionaryEntry reference = ref array[i];
							reference.Value = string.Concat(reference.Value, " (", array[i].Key, ")");
						}
					}
				}
				bool sortByDisplayText = column == null || !column.Editor.ComparesByValue((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)column.EditorOwnerInfo, (object)null);
				if (traverseRowsCallback.hasImagesInTable)
				{
					sortByDisplayText = false;
				}
				valueList.DisplayStyle = (ValueListDisplayStyle)(traverseRowsCallback.hasImagesInTable ? 4 : 0);
				Array.Sort(array, new FilterDropDownItemComparer(sortByDisplayText, column));
				ValueListItemsCollection valueListItems = valueList.ValueListItems;
				for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
				{
					object value = array[j].Value;
					TraverseRowsCallback.ImageAndDisplayText imageAndDisplayText = value as TraverseRowsCallback.ImageAndDisplayText;
					ValueListItem val = valueListItems.Add(array[j].Key, (imageAndDisplayText == null) ? value.ToString() : imageAndDisplayText.displayText);
					if (imageAndDisplayText != null && imageAndDisplayText.image != null)
					{
						val.Appearance.Image = imageAndDisplayText.image;
					}
				}
				valueList.BumpContentsVersion();
			}
			if (fireRowFilterDropDownPopulateEvents)
			{
				UltraGridBase ultraGridBase2 = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
				if (ultraGridBase2 != null)
				{
					AfterRowFilterDropDownPopulateEventArgs e2 = new AfterRowFilterDropDownPopulateEventArgs(column, rows, valueList);
					ultraGridBase2.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.AfterRowFilterDropDownPopulate, e2);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool LoadFilterValueList(ValueList valueList, HeaderUIElement headerElement, bool includeFilteredOutRows, FilterValueListOptions options)
		{
			valueList.ValueListItems.Clear();
			RowFilterMode rowFilterModeResolved = RowFilterModeResolved;
			ColumnHeader columnHeader = (ColumnHeader)((UIElement)headerElement).GetContext(typeof(ColumnHeader), true);
			if (columnHeader == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridColumn column = columnHeader.Column;
			if (column == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (RowFilterMode.AllRowsInBand == rowFilterModeResolved)
			{
				return LoadFilterValueListHelper(valueList, null, column, includeFilteredOutRows, options);
			}
			if (RowFilterMode.SiblingRowsOnly == rowFilterModeResolved)
			{
				RowsCollection rowsCollection = (RowsCollection)((UIElement)headerElement).GetContext(typeof(RowsCollection), true);
				if (rowsCollection != null)
				{
					return LoadFilterValueListHelper(valueList, rowsCollection, column, includeFilteredOutRows, options);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InternalRefreshSummaries()
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = this;
			bool flag = false;
			while (ultraGridBand != null)
			{
				if (ultraGridBand.HasSummaries)
				{
					flag = ultraGridBand.Summaries.DirtySummarySettings(this) || flag;
				}
				ultraGridBand = ultraGridBand.ParentBand;
			}
			if (flag && Layout != null)
			{
				Layout.DirtyGridElement();
			}
		}

		private void InitializeOrderedColumns()
		{
			orderedColumnsDirty = false;
			int num = Columns.Count;
			if (num < 10)
			{
				num = 10;
			}
			if (orderedColumns == null)
			{
				orderedColumns = new HeadersCollection(num);
			}
			else
			{
				orderedColumns.InternalClear();
				orderedColumns.Capacity = num;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				orderedColumns.InternalAdd(Columns[i].Header);
			}
			if (orderedColumns.Count > 1)
			{
				orderedColumns.Sort(new HeaderComparer());
			}
			SetVisiblePositionsToActual(orderedColumns);
			orderedColumns.SetReadOnly(readOnly: true);
			DirtyTabOrderedColumns();
		}

		private void InitializeOrderedGroups()
		{
			orderedGroupsDirty = false;
			int num = Groups.Count;
			if (num < 10)
			{
				num = 10;
			}
			if (orderedGroups == null)
			{
				orderedGroups = new HeadersCollection(num);
			}
			else
			{
				orderedGroups.InternalClear();
				orderedGroups.Capacity = num;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Groups.Count; i++)
			{
				orderedGroups.InternalAdd(Groups[i].Header);
			}
			if (orderedGroups.Count > 1)
			{
				orderedGroups.Sort(new HeaderComparer());
			}
			SetVisiblePositionsToActual(orderedGroups);
			orderedGroups.SetReadOnly(readOnly: true);
			DirtyTabOrderedColumns();
		}

		internal int GetChildBandCount()
		{
			return GetChildBandCount(excludeHidden: false);
		}

		internal int GetChildBandCount(bool excludeHidden)
		{
			if (excludeHidden && (hidden || !layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			BandsCollection sortedBands = layout.SortedBands;
			int count = sortedBands.Count;
			if (count > 1)
			{
				int num2 = sortedBands.IndexOf(this);
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					for (int i = 1 + num2; i < count; i++)
					{
						UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = sortedBands[i];
						if (ultraGridBand.ParentBand == this && (!excludeHidden || !ultraGridBand.HiddenResolved))
						{
							num++;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal RowsCollection GetCurrentParentRows(bool initializeIfNeeded)
		{
			return GetCurrentParentRows(initializeIfNeeded, dontSyncRows: false);
		}

		internal RowsCollection GetCurrentParentRows(bool initializeIfNeeded, bool dontSyncRows)
		{
			if (parentBand == null)
			{
				return layout.Rows;
			}
			UltraGridRow currentRow = parentBand.GetCurrentRow(ensureExpanded: false, dontSyncRows);
			if (currentRow == null || currentRow.ChildBands == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!initializeIfNeeded && !currentRow.ChildBands[this].HaveRowsBeenInitialized)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return currentRow.ChildBands[this].TopLevelRows;
		}

		internal RowsCollection GetCurrentParentRowsForAddNew()
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = ((Layout != null) ? (Layout.Grid as UltraGrid) : null);
			if (ultraGrid == null || IsRootBand)
			{
				return GetCurrentParentRows(initializeIfNeeded: true);
			}
			UltraGridRow activeRow = Layout.ActiveRow;
			if (activeRow == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridBand band = activeRow.Band;
			if (band != null)
			{
				if (band.IsTrivialDescendantOf(this))
				{
					return activeRow.GetAncestorRow(this)?.ParentCollection;
				}
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = ParentBand;
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = activeRow;
				do
				{
					if (ultraGridRow.Band == ultraGridBand)
					{
						ChildBandsCollection childBands = ultraGridRow.ChildBands;
						if (childBands != null && childBands.Exists(this))
						{
							return childBands[this].Rows;
						}
					}
					ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
				}
				while (ultraGridRow != null);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void OnListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (binding_debug)
			{
				_ = ParentBand;
			}
			BumpHeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion();
			ListChangedType listChangedType = e.ListChangedType;
			if ((listChangedType == ListChangedType.ItemAdded || listChangedType == ListChangedType.ItemDeleted) && IsCurrentRowRowsCollectionCreated())
			{
				GetCurrentParentRows(initializeIfNeeded: false)?.OnListChangedHelper(e, calledFromBandListChanged: true);
			}
			switch (e.ListChangedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorAdded:
			case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorDeleted:
			case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged:
				if (ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged == e.ListChangedType && parentColumn != null && e.PropertyDescriptor == null && parentBand != null)
				{
					parentBand.OnListChanged(sender, e);
					break;
				}
				if (ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged == e.ListChangedType)
				{
					int oldIndex = e.OldIndex;
					if (oldIndex >= 0 && oldIndex < Columns.Count)
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Columns[oldIndex];
						if (ultraGridColumn.FormulaHolder.CalcReference.ElementName != ultraGridColumn.Key)
						{
							Columns[oldIndex].FormulaHolder.RemoveReferenceFromCalcNetwork();
							Columns[oldIndex].FormulaHolder.AddReferenceToCalcNetwork();
						}
					}
				}
				ColumnAddedRemovedChangedHandler(e);
				break;
			}
		}

		internal bool AllowAdd(IList dataList)
		{
			if (AllowAddNewResolved == AllowAddNew.No)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (dataList is IBindingList bindingList)
			{
				return bindingList.AllowNew;
			}
			if (dataList != null)
			{
				return !dataList.IsFixedSize;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool AllowDelete(out bool canDelete)
		{
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			canDelete = false;
			if ((int)AllowDeleteResolved == 2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (BindingList != null)
			{
				canDelete = BindingList.AllowRemove;
				return true;
			}
			if (List == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			canDelete = !List.IsFixedSize;
			return true;
		}

		internal bool AllowDelete(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RowsCollection parentCollection = row.ParentCollection;
			if (parentCollection != null)
			{
				if (parentCollection.BindingList != null)
				{
					return parentCollection.BindingList.AllowRemove;
				}
				if (parentCollection.Data_List != null)
				{
					return !parentCollection.Data_List.IsFixedSize;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void SetGroupByValues(UltraGridGroupByRow parentGroupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			object value = parentGroupByRow.Value;
			row.SetCellValue(parentGroupByRow.Column, value);
			if (parentGroupByRow.ParentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow parentGroupByRow2)
			{
				SetGroupByValues(parentGroupByRow2, row);
			}
		}

		private bool GetAddNewContext(out UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow)
		{
			groupByRow = null;
			if (Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
			{
				ultraGrid.EnsureTempActiveRowAssigned();
			}
			UltraGridRow activeRow = Layout.ActiveRow;
			if (activeRow == null && HasGroupBySortColumns)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (activeRow == null && ParentBand == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (activeRow == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!HasGroupBySortColumns && (activeRow.Band == this || activeRow.Band == ParentBand || activeRow.Band.ParentBand == ParentBand))
			{
				return true;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = activeRow;
			while (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.Band != this)
			{
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
			}
			if (ultraGridRow == null || ultraGridRow.Band != this)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (HasGroupBySortColumns)
			{
				if (!(ultraGridRow is UltraGridGroupByRow))
				{
					groupByRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow as UltraGridGroupByRow;
				}
				else
				{
					UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = (UltraGridGroupByRow)ultraGridRow;
					if (SortedColumns.IndexOf(ultraGridGroupByRow.Column.Key) != SortedColumns.LastGroupByColIndex)
					{
						return false;
					}
					groupByRow = ultraGridGroupByRow;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow InternalAddNew()
		{
			if (!(layout.Grid is UltraGrid { ActiveRow: var activeRow } ultraGrid))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (activeRow != null && activeRow.IsUnModifiedAddRowFromTemplate && this == activeRow.Band)
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ultraGrid.ActiveCell;
				if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.Row != activeRow)
				{
					ultraGridCell = null;
				}
				if (ultraGridCell == null || !ultraGridCell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.CanEnterEditMode && ultraGridCell.CanBeModified)
					{
						ultraGridCell.EnterEditMode(byMouse: false);
					}
					else
					{
						activeRow.EnterFirstCellInEditMode();
					}
				}
				return activeRow;
			}
			try
			{
				UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = Layout;
				if (ultraGridLayout != null && !ultraGridLayout.ExitEditModeHelper())
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_4"));
				}
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = AddNew(calledFromAddNew: false);
				if (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGrid.ActiveCell == null && Layout.ActiveRow == ultraGridRow)
				{
					ultraGridRow.EnterFirstCellInEditMode();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				DataErrorInfo dataErrorInfo = new DataErrorInfo(ex, null, null, null, DataErrorSource.RowAdd, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorRowAddMessage", ex.Message));
				ultraGrid.InternalHandleDataError(dataErrorInfo);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public UltraGridRow AddNew()
		{
			return AddNew(calledFromAddNew: true);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow AddNew(bool calledFromAddNew)
		{
			UltraGridRow activeRow = Layout.ActiveRow;
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			if (activeRow != null && (ultraGrid == null || UpdateMode.OnUpdate != ultraGrid.UpdateMode) && !activeRow.Update() && !calledFromAddNew)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow = null;
			if (!GetAddNewContext(out groupByRow))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_328"));
			}
			if (HasGroupBySortColumns && groupByRow == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_329"));
			}
			RowsCollection currentParentRowsForAddNew = GetCurrentParentRowsForAddNew();
			UltraGridRow result = null;
			if (currentParentRowsForAddNew != null && currentParentRowsForAddNew.TemplateRowLocationDefault != TemplateAddRowLocation.None)
			{
				currentParentRowsForAddNew.AddTemplateAddRowToDataListHelper(activateFirstCellInNewRow: true, out result);
			}
			else
			{
				result = AddNewHelper(currentParentRowsForAddNew);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow AddNewHelper(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = layout;
			if (!(ultraGridLayout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_EXCEPTION_314"));
			}
			if (rows != null && rows.IsGroupByRows)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("Can't add a row to group-by rows collection.");
			}
			if (rows == null)
			{
				rows = GetCurrentParentRowsForAddNew();
				rows = (rows?.GetRowWithListIndex(BindingManager.Position))?.ParentCollection;
			}
			UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = null;
			bool flag = false;
			IList list = null;
			if (rows != null)
			{
				ultraGridGroupByRow = rows.ParentRow as UltraGridGroupByRow;
				list = rows.ResolvedDataList;
				flag = list != null;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_328"));
			}
			if (!AllowAdd(list))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_6"));
			}
			if (HasGroupBySortColumns && ultraGridGroupByRow == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_329"));
			}
			if (rows != null && !rows.ContainsLessThanMaxRows)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (rows.ParentRow != null)
			{
				if (!rows.ParentRow.ExpandAncestors())
				{
					return null;
				}
				rows.ParentRow.Expanded = true;
				if (!rows.ParentRow.Expanded)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			BeforeRowInsertEventArgs e = new BeforeRowInsertEventArgs(this, rows.ParentRow);
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowInsert, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			try
			{
				inAddNew = true;
				addedRow = null;
				if (list is IBindingList)
				{
					bool inAddingTemplateAddRow = rows.inAddingTemplateAddRow;
					rows.inAddingTemplateAddRow = false;
					try
					{
						RowsCollection topLevelRowsCollection = rows.TopLevelRowsCollection;
						if (topLevelRowsCollection != null && topLevelRowsCollection.ParentRow != null)
						{
							topLevelRowsCollection.ParentRow.EndEdit();
						}
						BindingManagerBase bindingManagerBase = ParentBand?.BindingManager;
						bindingManagerBase?.EndCurrentEdit();
						if (bindingManagerBase != null)
						{
							UltraGridRow parentRow = rows.TopLevelRowsCollection.ParentRow;
							if (parentRow != null && parentRow.InternalIsAddRow && parentRow.AreAllAncestorsCurrentRows && parentRow.ParentCollection != null && parentRow.ParentCollection.Count > 1)
							{
								int num = parentRow.ListIndex - 1;
								if (num < 0)
								{
									num = parentRow.ListIndex + 1;
								}
								int position = bindingManagerBase.Position;
								bool ignoreDataSourePositionChange = ultraGridLayout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange;
								ultraGridLayout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange = true;
								try
								{
									bindingManagerBase.Position = num;
								}
								catch (Exception)
								{
								}
								finally
								{
									try
									{
										bindingManagerBase.Position = position;
									}
									finally
									{
										ultraGridLayout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange = ignoreDataSourePositionChange;
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex2)
					{
						throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_330", ex2.Message));
					}
					finally
					{
						int count = rows.Count;
						rows.inAddingTemplateAddRow = inAddingTemplateAddRow;
					}
					if (BindingManager != null && (rows.ParentRow == null || rows.ParentRow.AreAllAncestorsCurrentRows))
					{
						BindingManager.AddNew();
						try
						{
							if (addedRow != null && BindingManager != null && BindingManager.Position != addedRow.ListIndex)
							{
								BindingManager.Position = addedRow.ListIndex;
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
					}
					else
					{
						rows.DirtyDataList();
						list = rows.ResolvedDataList;
						if (!(list is IBindingList))
						{
							return null;
						}
						((IBindingList)list).AddNew();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (1 == Columns.BoundColumnsCount)
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Columns[0];
						if (ultraGridColumn.PropertyDescriptor is ValuePropertyDescriptor && DataBindingUtils.IsKnownType(ultraGridColumn.PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType))
						{
							object value = CreateObjectOfKnownType(ultraGridColumn.PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType);
							list.Add(value);
							rows.DirtyRows();
							flag2 = true;
							try
							{
								if (BindingManager != null && BindingManager.Position != list.Count - 1)
								{
									BindingManager.Position = list.Count - 1;
								}
							}
							catch (Exception)
							{
							}
						}
					}
					if (!flag2)
					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_7"));
					}
				}
				if (rows.IsRowsDirty)
				{
					rows.SyncRows();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ultraGridRow = addedRow;
				inAddNew = false;
				addedRow = null;
			}
			if (ultraGridRow == null)
			{
				ultraGridRow = rows.GetRowWithListIndex(rows.Count - 1);
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null)
			{
				if (ultraGrid != null && (!ultraGrid.SyncWithCurrencyManager || BindingManager == null))
				{
					ultraGrid.SetTempActiveRow(ultraGridRow, scrollIntoView: false);
				}
				ultraGridRow.SetDataChanged(newValue: true);
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = ultraGridLayout.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
				if (rowScrollRegion == null && ultraGridLayout.RowScrollRegions.Count > 0)
				{
					rowScrollRegion = ultraGridLayout.RowScrollRegions[0];
				}
				if (rowScrollRegion != null)
				{
					ultraGrid?.EnsureTempActiveRowAssigned();
					rowScrollRegion.RegenerateVisibleRows();
					rowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(ultraGridRow);
				}
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null)
			{
				RowEventArgs e2 = new RowEventArgs(ultraGridRow);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowInsert, e2);
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		private void InitBandKey()
		{
			string text = null;
			if (parentColumn != null)
			{
				text = parentColumn.PropertyDescriptor.Name;
			}
			else if (bindingManager is CurrencyManager && ((CurrencyManager)bindingManager).List != null)
			{
				CurrencyManager currencyManager = (CurrencyManager)bindingManager;
				if (currencyManager.List is ITypedList)
				{
					if (currencyManager.List is BindingSource bindingSource)
					{
						text = bindingSource.DataMember;
					}
					if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
					{
						text = ((ITypedList)currencyManager.List).GetListName(null);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					text = currencyManager.List.GetType().Name;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				text = dataMember;
			}
			RemoveCalcReferences();
			base.Key = text;
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in Columns)
			{
				column.BumpCalcReferenceParserInstanceVersion();
			}
			AddCalcReferences();
		}

		internal void InitListManager(BindingManagerBase bindingManager, string dataMember, UltraGridBand[] oldBands)
		{
			UnWireDataSource();
			this.dataMember = dataMember;
			this.bindingManager = bindingManager;
			InitBandKey();
			InitColumns(oldBands);
			hookIntoList = true;
			if (this == Layout.Bands[0])
			{
				Layout.Rows.BindToList();
			}
			if (Layout != null && Layout.ExtractDataStructureOnly)
			{
				this.bindingManager = null;
			}
			else
			{
				WireDataSource();
			}
		}

		private void EnsureChildBandsLoaded()
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = Layout;
			if (GetChildBandCount() < Columns.ChapteredColumnsCount && ultraGridLayout != null && HierarchicalLevel < ultraGridLayout.MaxBandDepthEnforced - 1)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = Columns.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = columns[i];
					if (ultraGridColumn.IsChaptered)
					{

						{
							EnsureBindingManagerLoaded(ultraGridColumn, bandAssociatedWithChapteredColumn);
						}
					}
				}
			}

				{
					return;
				}

				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = sortedBands[i];
					if (ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridBand.BindingManager == null)
					{
						EnsureBindingManagerLoaded(ultraGridBand.ParentColumn, ultraGridBand);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ColumnAddedRemovedChangedHandler(ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection itemPropertiesHelper = GetItemPropertiesHelper();
			InitBandKey();
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				Columns[i].InternalResetInternedKey();
			}
			if (itemPropertiesHelper != null)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < itemPropertiesHelper.Count; j++)
				{
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = itemPropertiesHelper[j];
					bool tryMatchingByPropertyDescriptor = e.ListChangedType == ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged;
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Columns.FindMatchingColumn(propertyDescriptor, tryMatchingByPropertyDescriptor);
					if (ultraGridColumn == null)
					{
						ultraGridColumn = new UltraGridColumn(this);
						if (Layout != null && NewColumnLoadStyle.Hide == Layout.NewColumnLoadStyleInEffect)
						{
							ultraGridColumn.Hidden = true;
						}
						ultraGridColumn.InitPropertyDescriptor(propertyDescriptor, null);
						Columns.InternalInsert(Math.Min(j, columns.BoundColumnsCount), ultraGridColumn);
						flag = true;
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGridColumn.InitPropertyDescriptor(propertyDescriptor, null);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < Columns.Count; k++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = Columns[k];
				if (!ultraGridColumn2.IsBound)
				{
					continue;
				}
				PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor2 = itemPropertiesHelper?.Find(ultraGridColumn2.Key, ignoreCase: true);
				if (propertyDescriptor2 != null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (ultraGridColumn2.IsChaptered)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = ((Layout != null && Layout.Bands != null) ? Layout.Bands.FindBand(ultraGridColumn2) : null);
					if (ultraGridBand != null)
					{
						Layout.Bands.InternalRemove(ultraGridBand);
						Layout.BumpScrollableRowCountVersion();
					}
				}
				Columns.InternalRemoveColumn(ultraGridColumn2);
				k--;
				flag = true;
			}
			orderedColumnsDirty = true;
			BumpColumnsVersion();
			if (flag)
			{
				if (HasSortedColumns)
				{
					SortedColumns.VerifyColumns();
				}
				if (RowEditTemplate != null)
				{
					RowEditTemplate.OnBandColumnsChanged();
				}
			}
			layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
			layout.RowScrollRegions.DirtyAllVisibleRows();
			layout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
			DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
		}

		internal void BumpColumnsVersion()
		{
			columnsVersion++;
			orderedColumnsDirty = true;
			DirtyTabOrderedColumns();
			ClearDrawCache();
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeColumns()
		{
			if (columns != null)
			{
				if (columns.Count > 0 && Layout != null && Layout.AlwaysSerializeBandsAndColumns)
				{
					return true;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in columns)
				{
					if (column.ShouldSerialize())
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetColumns()
		{
			if (columns == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			columns.ClearUnbound();
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in columns)
			{
				column.Reset();
				if (column.IsHeaderAllocated)
				{
					column.Header.InternalResetVisiblePos();
					orderedColumnsDirty = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeGroups()
		{
			if (groups != null)
			{
				return groups.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSortedColumns()
		{
			if (sortedColumns != null)
			{
				if (sortedColumns.Count <= 0)
				{
					return sortedColumns.HasSerializedColumnIDs;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetGroups()

			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeOverride()

		}

		internal int CalcGroupByRowIndent(RowsCollection groupByRowsCollection)
		{
			if (groupByRowsCollection == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (this != groupByRowsCollection.Band)
			{
				if (groupByRowsCollection.Band != null)
				{
					return groupByRowsCollection.Band.CalcGroupByRowIndent(groupByRowsCollection);
				}
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 1 + SortedColumns.LastGroupByColIndex;
			num = IndentationGroupByRowResolved * (num2 - groupByRowsCollection.GroupByRowLevel);
			if (Layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsOutlookGroupBy && PreRowAreaExtent > 0)
			{
				num -= Math.Max(0, (PreRowSelectorWidth - ExpansionIndicatorWidth) / 2);
			}
			return -num;
		}

		internal int CalcGroupByRowIndent(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow)
		{
			return CalcGroupByRowIndent(groupByRow?.ParentCollection);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public int CalcGroupBySummariesIndent(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			if (rows != null && rows.IsGroupByRows)
			{
				return -CalcGroupByRowIndent(rows) + PreRowAreaExtent;
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal int CalcGroupBySummariesIndent(UltraGridGroupByRow row)
		{

		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public int CalcGroupByConnectorsExtent()
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = Layout;
			if (ultraGridLayout == null || ultraGridLayout.ViewStyleImpl == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (HeaderPlacement.OncePerGroupedRowIsland == HeaderPlacementResolved || (ultraGridLayout.ViewStyleImpl.IsOutlookGroupBy && ultraGridLayout.ViewStyleImpl.BandHasFixedHeaders(this)))
			{
				return Layout.ViewStyleImpl.CalcGroupByConnectorsExtent(this);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal HeaderClickAction GetHeaderClickActionResolved(bool changeExternalSortTypesToRegular)
		{
			HeaderClickAction headerClickAction = HeaderClickAction.Default;
			headerClickAction = ((HasOverride && overrideObj.ShouldSerializeHeaderClickAction()) ? overrideObj.HeaderClickAction : ((!Layout.HasOverride || !Layout.Override.ShouldSerializeHeaderClickAction()) ? (HasSortedColumns ? HeaderClickAction.SortMulti : layout.HeaderClickActionDefault) : layout.HeaderClickActionDefault));
			if (changeExternalSortTypesToRegular)
			{
				if (HeaderClickAction.ExternalSortSingle == headerClickAction)
				{
					headerClickAction = HeaderClickAction.SortSingle;
				}
				else if (HeaderClickAction.ExternalSortMulti == headerClickAction)
				{
					headerClickAction = HeaderClickAction.SortMulti;
				}
			}
			return headerClickAction;
		}

		internal TipStyle TipStyleCellResolved(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn col)
		{
			return TipStyleCellResolved(row.GetCellIfAllocated(col));
		}

		internal TipStyle TipStyleCellResolved(UltraGridCell cell)
		{
			TipStyle tipStyle = TipStyleCellUnResolved;
			if (tipStyle == TipStyle.Default)
			{
				tipStyle = ((layout.Grid is UltraGrid || (cell != null && cell.ToolTipText != null && cell.ToolTipText.Length > 0)) ? TipStyle.Show : TipStyle.Hide);
			}
			return tipStyle;
		}

		internal TipStyle TipStyleScrollResolved(bool forRowConnectorTooltip)
		{
			if (HasOverride && overrideObj.ShouldSerializeTipStyleScroll())
			{
				return overrideObj.TipStyleScroll;
			}
			if (layout.HasOverride && layout.Override.ShouldSerializeTipStyleScroll())
			{
				return layout.Override.TipStyleScroll;
			}
			if (!forRowConnectorTooltip && ScrollStyle.Immediate == layout.ScrollStyle)
			{
				return TipStyle.Hide;
			}
			return TipStyle.Show;
		}

			}
		}

		internal int GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex index, bool resolveToDefaultFontHeight, StyleUtils.Role eRole, RoleState roleState)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = Layout;
			if (HasOverride || ultraGridLayout.HasOverride)
			{
				AppearancePropFlags flags = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
				AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
				MergeBLOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref flags, index, eRole, roleState);
				if (((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).HasFontData)
				{
					ultraGridLayout.MergeLayoutAppearances(ref appData, ref flags, UltraGridLayout.LayoutAppearanceIndex.Default);
					return ultraGridLayout.CalculateFontHeight(ref appData);
				}
			}
			if (!resolveToDefaultFontHeight)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return ultraGridLayout.DefaultFontHeight;
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref ResolveAppearanceContext context)
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_03e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_03e4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_03f6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_040b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_040c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = context.ResolutionOrder;
			((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref context.ResolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter = false;
			if (context.IsRowSelector)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.RowSelector, (RoleState)1);
			}
			else if (context.IsRowPreview)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.RowPreview, (RoleState)1);
			}
			else if (context.IsInEdit)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.EditCell, (RoleState)32);
			}
			else if (context.IsActiveCell)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.ActiveCell, (RoleState)16);
				if (context.IsActiveRow)
				{
					MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.ActiveRowCellAppearance);
					UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(this, StyleUtils.Role.Row);
					MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.ActiveRow, role, (RoleState)16);
				}
			}
			else if (context.IsActiveRow)
			{
				if (typeof(CardCaptionUIElement) == context.ObjectType)
				{
					MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.ActiveCardCaption, (RoleState)16);
				}
				else
				{
					if (typeof(UltraGridCell) == context.ObjectType)
					{
						MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.ActiveRowCellAppearance);
					}
					MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.ActiveRow, StyleUtils.GetRole(this, StyleUtils.Role.Row), (RoleState)16);
				}
			}
			else if (context.IsSelected)
			{
				if (typeof(CardCaptionUIElement) == context.ObjectType)
				{
					MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.SelectedCardCaption, (RoleState)2);
				}
				else
				{
					if (typeof(UltraGridCell) == context.ObjectType)
					{
						MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.SelectedCell, (RoleState)2);
					}
					UIRole role2 = ((typeof(UltraGridGroupByRow) == context.ObjectType) ? context.Role : StyleUtils.GetRole(this, StyleUtils.Role.Row));
					MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.SelectedRow, role2, (RoleState)2);
				}
			}
			else if (context.IsGroupByColumn)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.GroupByColumn, (RoleState)32768);
			}
			else if (context.IsGroupByColumnHeader)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.GroupByColumnHeader, (RoleState)32768);
			}
			else if (context.IsFixedHeader)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.FixedHeaderAppearance, (RoleState)8192);
			}
			else if (context.IsFixedColumn)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.FixedCellAppearance, (RoleState)8192);
			}
			else if (context.IsFormulaError)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.FormulaErrorAppearance, (RoleState)128);
			}
			else if (context.IsNoRowsInDataSourceMessageText)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.NoRowsInDataSourceMessageAppearance, (RoleState)1);
			}
			else if (context.IsNoVisibleRowsMessageText)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.NoVisibleRowsMessageAppearance, (RoleState)1);
			}
			else if (typeof(HeaderBase) == context.ObjectType)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Header, (RoleState)1);
			}
			else if (typeof(UltraGridCell) == context.ObjectType)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Cell, (RoleState)1);
				if (!context.IsCellOnly)
				{
					UIRole role3 = StyleUtils.GetRole(this, StyleUtils.Role.Row);
					if (context.IsAlternate)
					{
						MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.RowAlternate, role3, (RoleState)262144);
					}
					else
					{
						MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Row, role3, (RoleState)1);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (typeof(UltraGridRow) == context.ObjectType)
			{
				if (context.IsAlternate)
				{
					MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.RowAlternate, (RoleState)262144);
				}
				else
				{
					MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Row, (RoleState)1);
				}
			}
			else if (typeof(CardAreaUIElement) == context.ObjectType)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.CardArea, (RoleState)1);
			}
			else if (typeof(CardCaptionUIElement) == context.ObjectType)
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.CardCaption, (RoleState)1);
			}
			else if (context.ObjectType == typeof(SummaryFooterUIElement))
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.SummaryFooterAppearance, (RoleState)1);
			}
			else if (context.ObjectType == typeof(SummaryFooterCaptionUIElement))
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.SummaryFooterCaptionAppearance, (RoleState)1);
			}
			else if (context.ObjectType == typeof(SummaryValueUIElement))
			{
				MergeOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.SummaryValueAppearance, (RoleState)1);
			}
			context.ResolutionOrder = resolutionOrder;
			((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref context.ResolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore = false;
			if ((int)context.UnresolvedProps != 0)
			{
				layout.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
			}
			context.ResolutionOrder = resolutionOrder;
		}

		internal void ResolveRowSelectorHeaderAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags, bool defaultToHeaderAppearance, bool resolveDefaultColors)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Expected I8, but got Unknown
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(this, StyleUtils.Role.RowSelectorHeader, out resOrder);
			MergeBLOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref flags, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.RowSelectorHeaderAppearance, role, resOrder, (RoleState)1);
			if (defaultToHeaderAppearance)
			{
				ResolveAppearanceContext context = new ResolveAppearanceContext(typeof(HeaderBase), flags);
				context.Role = role;
				context.ResolutionOrder = resOrder;
				context.ResolveDefaultColors = resolveDefaultColors;
				ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
				flags = (AppearancePropFlags)(long)context.UnresolvedProps;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
			if (propChange.Source == overrideObj)
			{
				if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
				{
					switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId)
					{
					case PropertyIds.HeaderAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.GroupByColumnHeaderAppearance:
						isColHdrFontHeightCached = false;
						isGroupHdrFontHeightCached = false;
						isCardLabelFontHeightCached = false;
						isColumnCardFontCacheDirty = true;
						break;
					case PropertyIds.CardCaptionAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.ActiveCardCaptionAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.SelectedCardCaptionAppearance:
						isCardCaptionFontHeightCached = false;
						break;
					case PropertyIds.CellPadding:
					case PropertyIds.CellSpacing:
						isMinRowHeightCached = false;
						break;
					case PropertyIds.HeaderCheckBoxAlignment:
						StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
						DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
						DirtyCachedContainsCheckboxOnTopOrBottom();
						break;
					case PropertyIds.HeaderCheckBoxVisibility:
						DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
						DirtyCachedContainsCheckboxOnTopOrBottom();
						break;
					}
				}
				layout.OnOverrideChanged(propChange, this);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Override, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == columns)
			{
				if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
				{
					PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
					if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.Add || propertyIds == PropertyIds.ClearUnbound || propertyIds == PropertyIds.Remove)
					{
						if (!layout.InitializingAllSubItems)
						{
							OnColumnsChanged();

			}
			else if (rowLayouts != null && propChange.Source == RowLayouts)
			{

			}
		}

		private void OnColumnsChanged()
		{
			orderedColumnsDirty = true;
			DirtyTabOrderedColumns();
			if ((!Layout.IsDisplayLayout && !Layout.IsPrintLayout && !Layout.IsExportLayout) || Layout.Grid.InInitializeLayout)
			{
				if (Layout.IsRowsCollectionAllocated)
				{
					Layout.Rows.fireInitializeRowsOnAllRow = true;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (sortedColumns != null)
			{
				sortedColumns.VerifyColumns();
			}
			foreach (UltraGridRow nonNullItem in Layout.Rows.NonNullItems)
			{
				nonNullItem.OnColumnsChanged();
			}
		}

		internal int GetTotalHeaderHeight(bool includeOverlappedBorders)
		{
			//IL_008c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0092: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0095: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = layout;
			ViewStyleBase viewStyleBase = ultraGridLayout?.ViewStyleImpl;
			if (viewStyleBase != null && viewStyleBase.FixedHeaderHeightCachingEnabled && viewStyleBase.TotalHeaderHeightCache.TryGetValue(this, out var value))
			{
				return value;
			}
			int num = Header.GetBandHeaderHeight();
			if (!UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				num += GetColumnHeaderHeight(includeOverlappedBorders);
			}
			else if (ColHeadersVisibleInSeparateAreaResolved || GroupHeadersVisibleInSeparateAreaResolved)
			{
				if (PreferredHeaderLayoutSize.Height != 0)
				{
					num += PreferredHeaderLayoutSize.Height;
				}
				else if ((int)RowSelectorHeaderStyleResolved == 5 || (int)RowSelectorHeaderStyleResolved == 4)
				{
					num += GetColumnHeaderHeightHelper(1);
					num += 4;
				}
			}
			if (!CardView)
			{
				switch (RowLayoutStyle)
				{
				default:
					num += GroupHeaderHeight;
					break;
				case RowLayoutStyle.ColumnLayout:
				case RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout:
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num > 0 && HasSpecialRowSeparatorAfterHeaders)
			{
				num += SpecialRowSeparatorHeightResolved;
			}
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ultraGridLayout?.Grid;
			if (ultraGridBase != null)
			{
				int? minimumBandHeadersHeight = ultraGridBase.GetMinimumBandHeadersHeight(this);
				if (minimumBandHeadersHeight.HasValue)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, minimumBandHeadersHeight.Value);
				}
			}
			if (viewStyleBase != null && viewStyleBase.FixedHeaderHeightCachingEnabled)
			{
				viewStyleBase.TotalHeaderHeightCache[this] = num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal int GetGroupHeaderHeight(bool ignoreHidden)
		{
			//IL_00f7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<UltraGridGroup> visibleGroupsList = GetVisibleGroupsList();
			if (visibleGroupsList == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if ((!ignoreHidden && !groupHeadersVisible) || visibleGroupsList.Count == 0)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (!isGroupHdrFontHeightCached)
			{
				int val = 0;
				if (groups != null)
				{
					val = groups.MaxHeaderFontHeight;
				}
				int bLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Header, StyleUtils.Role.GroupHeader, (RoleState)1);
				cachedGroupHdrFontHeight = Math.Max(bLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight, val);
				isGroupHdrFontHeightCached = true;
			}
			int num = cachedGroupHdrFontHeight * GroupHeaderLines;
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (UltraGridGroup item in visibleGroupsList)
			{
				if (item.HiddenResolved || item.Header.Hidden)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (FixedHeaderIndicator.Button == item.Header.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved && UseFixedHeaders)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				TextOrientationInfo textOrientationResolved = item.Header.TextOrientationResolved;
				bool flag2 = textOrientationResolved != null && !object.Equals(textOrientationResolved, TextOrientationInfo.Horizontal);
				bool wrapHeaderTextResolved = WrapHeaderTextResolved;
				if (wrapHeaderTextResolved || flag2)
				{
					AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
					item.Header.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, (AppearancePropFlags)65011720);
					if (flag2)
					{
						int height = layout.CalculateFontSize(ref appData, item.Header.Caption, -1, textOrientationResolved).Height;
						num = Math.Max(num, height);
					}
					else if (wrapHeaderTextResolved)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, item.CardLabelSize.Height);
					}
				}
			}
			num += 2 * HeaderBorderThickness;
			num += 4;
			if (flag)
			{
				num = layout.AdjustForTouchMode(num, adjustByWidth: false);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal int GetColumnHeaderHeight(bool includeOverlappedBorders, bool singleHeaderHeight, bool ignoreHidden)
		{
			//IL_008a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0099: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0113: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!ignoreHidden && !singleHeaderHeight && !ColHeadersVisibleInSeparateAreaResolved)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			CacheColumnHeaderFontHeight();
			int num = 0;
			if (WrapHeaderTextResolved)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in Columns)
				{
					if (!column.Hidden && !column.Header.HiddenResolved)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, column.CardLabelSize.Height);
					}
				}
				if ((int)RowSelectorHeaderStyleResolved == 5 || (int)RowSelectorHeaderStyleResolved == 4)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, GetColumnHeaderHeightHelper(1));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num = cachedColHdrFontHeight * colHeaderLines;
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column2 in Columns)
				{
					if (!column2.Hidden && !column2.Header.HiddenResolved)
					{
						TextOrientationInfo textOrientationResolved = column2.Header.TextOrientationResolved;
						if (textOrientationResolved != null && !object.Equals(textOrientationResolved, TextOrientationInfo.Horizontal))
						{
							AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
							column2.Header.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, (AppearancePropFlags)65011720);
							int height = layout.CalculateFontSize(ref appData, column2.Header.Caption, -1, textOrientationResolved).Height;
							num = Math.Max(num, height);
						}
					}
				}
				num += 2 * HeaderBorderThickness;
			}
			if (ContainsColumnWithVisibleHeaderCheckBoxOnTopOrBottom)
			{
				num += GetHeaderCheckBoxSize((GlyphType)0, Layout.UIElementInternal).Height;
			}
			num += 4;
			num = AdjustForTouchMode(num, adjustByWidth: false);
			if (singleHeaderHeight)
			{
				return num;
			}
			if (UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				return PreferredHeaderLayoutSize.Height;
			}
			num *= ActualColDisplayLevels;
			if (!includeOverlappedBorders && ShareRowBorders)
			{
				num--;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetColumnHeaderHeightHelper(int colHeaderLines)
		{
			CacheColumnHeaderFontHeight();
			int num = cachedColHdrFontHeight * colHeaderLines;
			return num + 2 * HeaderBorderThickness;
		}

		private void CacheColumnHeaderFontHeight()
		{
			if (!isColHdrFontHeightCached)
			{
				int val = 0;
				if (columns != null)
				{
					val = columns.MaxHeaderFontHeight;
				}
				int bLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Header, StyleUtils.Role.ColumnHeader, (RoleState)1);
				cachedColHdrFontHeight = Math.Max(bLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight, val);
				isColHdrFontHeightCached = true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDescendantOfBand(UltraGridBand ancestorBand)
		{
			if (ancestorBand == parentBand)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (parentBand == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return parentBand.IsDescendantOfBand(ancestorBand);
		}

		internal bool IsTrivialDescendantOf(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (this != band)
			{
				return IsDescendantOfBand(band);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void AdjustOrigin(int adjustment)
		{
			origin += adjustment;
		}

		internal void ResizeRow(UltraGridRow row, int newHeight, bool fireEvents)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			if (fireEvents && ultraGrid != null)
			{
				BeforeRowResizeEventArgs e = new BeforeRowResizeEventArgs(row, newHeight);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowResize, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!isSynchronizingRowHeights && RowSizingResolved == RowSizing.Sychronized)
			{
				synchronizedRowHeight = newHeight - (row?.AutoPreviewHeight ?? 0);
				synchronizedRowHeightVersion++;
				isSynchronizingRowHeights = true;
				try
				{
					if (Layout.RowScrollRegions != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < Layout.RowScrollRegions.Count; i++)
						{
							RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = Layout.RowScrollRegions[i];
							if (rowScrollRegion == null)
							{
								continue;
							}
							bool flag = true;
							for (int j = 0; j < rowScrollRegion.VisibleRows.Count; j++)
							{
								VisibleRow visibleRow = rowScrollRegion.VisibleRows[j];
								if (visibleRow == null || visibleRow.Row == null || this != visibleRow.Band)
								{
									continue;
								}
								visibleRow.Row.SetHeight(newHeight);
								if (flag)
								{
									UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = row;
									while (ultraGridRow != null)
									{
										ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
										ultraGridRow?.SynchSameTierParentRows(newHeight);
									}
									flag = false;
								}
							}
						}
						synchronizedRowHeightVersion++;
						Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
						Layout.RowScrollRegions.DirtyAllVisibleRows(setScrollToBeginning: false);
						Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				isSynchronizingRowHeights = false;
			}
			else
			{
				row.SetHeight(newHeight);
			}
			if (fireEvents)
			{
				ultraGrid?.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowResize, new RowEventArgs(row));
			}
		}

		private int CalcMinRowHeight()
		{
			int val = 0;
			int val2 = 0;
			int val3 = 0;
			int val4 = 0;
			int val5 = 0;
			int val6 = 0;
			int num = 0;
			int val7 = 0;
			int minHeightRequiredByColumns = MinHeightRequiredByColumns;
			UltraGridOverride lowestLevelOverride = LowestLevelOverride;
			if (lowestLevelOverride != null)
			{
				val = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.SelectedRow, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.Row, (RoleState)2);
				val2 = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.SelectedCell, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.Cell, (RoleState)2);
				val3 = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.EditCell, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.Cell, (RoleState)32);
				val4 = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.ActiveRow, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.Row, (RoleState)16);
				val5 = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.ActiveCell, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.Cell, (RoleState)16);
				val6 = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Cell, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.Cell, (RoleState)1);
				num = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Row, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.Row, (RoleState)1);
				val7 = GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.RowAlternate, resolveToDefaultFontHeight: false, StyleUtils.Role.Row, (RoleState)262144);
			}
			if (num == 0)
			{
				num = layout.DefaultFontHeight;
			}
			int val8 = 0;
			val8 = Math.Max(val8, val);
			val8 = Math.Max(val8, val2);
			val8 = Math.Max(val8, val3);
			val8 = Math.Max(val8, val4);
			val8 = Math.Max(val8, val5);
			val8 = Math.Max(val8, val6);
			val8 = Math.Max(val8, num);
			val8 = Math.Max(val8, val7);
			return Math.Max(val8, minHeightRequiredByColumns);
		}

		private int GetMinRowHeightHelper(bool synchronized)
		{
			//IL_0055: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0090: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00dc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (synchronized)
			{
				isRowHeightDirty = true;
			}
			if (!isRowFontHeightCached)
			{
				cachedRowFontHeight = CalcMinRowHeight();
				isRowFontHeightCached = true;
			}
			if (!isMinRowHeightCached)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					num = GetLayoutRowHeight(minimum: true);
				}
				else
				{
					int cellSpacingResolved = CellSpacingResolved;
					int borderThickness = Layout.GetBorderThickness(BorderStyleCellResolved);
					int num2 = 0;
					int num3 = 0;
					if (cellSpacingResolved > 0 || !Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(BorderStyleCellResolved))
					{
						num2 = 2 * borderThickness;
						num3 = 2 * borderThickness;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = borderThickness;
						if (!Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(BorderStyleRowResolved))
						{
							num3 = 2 * borderThickness;
						}
					}
					num = 2 + (cachedRowFontHeight + CellPaddingResolved * 2 + cellSpacingResolved * 2);
					int actualColDisplayLevels = ActualColDisplayLevels;
					if (actualColDisplayLevels > 1)
					{
						num *= actualColDisplayLevels;
						num += num2 * (actualColDisplayLevels - 1);
					}
					num += num3 + Layout.GetBorderThickness(BorderStyleRowResolved) * 2;
				}
				if (synchronized)
				{
					ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = Layout.ViewStyleImpl;
					if (viewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < layout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
						{
							UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = layout.SortedBands[i];
							if (ultraGridBand != this && !ultraGridBand.HiddenResolved)
							{
								num = Math.Max(num, ultraGridBand.GetMinRowHeightHelper(synchronized: false));
							}
						}
					}
				}
				num = (cachedRowFontHeight = AdjustForTouchMode(num));
				isMinRowHeightCached = true;
				return num;
			}
			return cachedRowFontHeight;
		}

		internal void BumpMajorRowHeightVersion()

			majorRowHeightVersion = synchronizedRowHeightVersion;
			if (Layout != null)
			{
				Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
				Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
			}
		}

		internal int GetSyncPosition(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column.Band != this)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			ColScrollRegion exclusiveColScrollRegion = column.Header.ExclusiveColScrollRegion;
			HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = OrderedHeaders;
			for (int i = 0; i < orderedHeaders.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = orderedHeaders[i];
				if (headerBase.Hidden || headerBase.ExclusiveColScrollRegion != exclusiveColScrollRegion)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (headerBase.IsGroup)
				{
					if (column.GroupResolved == headerBase.Group)
					{
						int relativeColSyncPosition = headerBase.GetRelativeColSyncPosition(column);
						if (relativeColSyncPosition >= 0)
						{
							return num + relativeColSyncPosition;
						}
						return -1;
					}
				}
				else if (column.Header == headerBase)
				{
					int relativeColSyncPosition2 = headerBase.GetRelativeColSyncPosition(column);
					if (relativeColSyncPosition2 >= 0)
					{
						return num + relativeColSyncPosition2;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				num += headerBase.GetTotalColSyncPositions(exclusiveColScrollRegion);
			}
			return -1;
		}

			synchronizationAdjustment += adjustment;

		internal void SetVisiblePosition(UltraGridColumn column, int newPos, ref bool changed)
		{
			changed = false;
			int num = GetVisiblePosition(column);
			if (newPos != num)
			{
				int count = OrderedColumnHeaders.Count;
				if (newPos < 0 || newPos >= count)
				{
					newPos = count - 1;
				}
				orderedColumns.InternalRemove(column.Header);
				int index = newPos;
				try
				{
					orderedColumns.InternalInsert(index, column.Header);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_325", ex.Message));
				}
				EnsureFixedHeadersBeforeNonFixed();
				SetVisiblePositionsToActual();
				changed = true;
			}
		}

		internal static NavigateType MapToNavigateType(VisibleRelation relation)
		{
			return relation switch
			{
				VisibleRelation.First => NavigateType.First, 
				VisibleRelation.Last => NavigateType.Last, 
				VisibleRelation.Previous => NavigateType.Prev, 
				_ => NavigateType.Next, 
			};
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn GetRelatedVisibleCol(UltraGridColumn column, NavigateType navType, bool includeNonActivateable, bool byTabKey)
		{
			HeadersCollection headersCollection = (UseRowLayoutResolved ? LayoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders : OrderedHeaders);
			bool flag = byTabKey;
			if (flag)
			{
				headersCollection = TabOrderedColumns;
			}
			if (headersCollection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag2 = GroupsDisplayed && RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout;
			UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = ((column != null && flag2) ? column.Group : null);
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = column?.Header.ExclusiveColScrollRegionResolved;
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (NavigateType.Above == navType || NavigateType.Below == navType || NavigateType.Topmost == navType || NavigateType.Bottommost == navType)
			{
				if (column == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_149"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_304"));
				}
				if (ultraGridGroup != null)
				{
					return ultraGridGroup.Header.GetRelatedVisibleCol(column, navType, includeNonActivateable);
				}
				if (UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					headersCollection = LayoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical;
					if (headersCollection == null || headersCollection.Count <= 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					int i = headersCollection.IndexOf(column.Header);
					if (i < 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					switch (navType)
					{
					case NavigateType.Above:
						if (i <= 0)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return headersCollection[i - 1].Column;
					case NavigateType.Below:
						if (1 + i >= headersCollection.Count)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return headersCollection[1 + i].Column;
					case NavigateType.Topmost:
						while (i > 0 && headersCollection[i].Column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginYResolved < column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginYResolved)
						{
							i--;
						}
						return headersCollection[i].Column;
					case NavigateType.Bottommost:
						for (; i < headersCollection.Count && headersCollection[i].Column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginYResolved > column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginYResolved; i++)
						{
						}
						return headersCollection[i].Column;
					}
				}
				return column.Header.GetRelatedVisibleCol(column, navType, includeNonActivateable);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < headersCollection.Count; j++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = headersCollection[j];
				if (headerBase.Hidden || headerBase.ExclusiveColScrollRegionResolved != colScrollRegion)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (navType == NavigateType.First)
				{
					ultraGridColumn = headerBase.GetFirstVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable);
					if (ultraGridColumn != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (NavigateType.Next == navType && flag3)
				{
					ultraGridColumn = headerBase.GetFirstVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable);
					if (ultraGridColumn != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if ((!flag && flag2 && ultraGridGroup != null && ultraGridGroup == headerBase.Group) || column == headerBase.Column)
				{
					flag3 = true;
					if (NavigateType.Next == navType)
					{
						ultraGridColumn = headerBase.GetNextVisibleCol(column, includeNonActivateable);
						if (ultraGridColumn != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (NavigateType.Prev == navType)
					{
						UltraGridColumn prevVisibleCol = headerBase.GetPrevVisibleCol(column, includeNonActivateable);
						if (prevVisibleCol != null)
						{
							ultraGridColumn = prevVisibleCol;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (NavigateType.Last == navType || NavigateType.Prev == navType)
				{
					UltraGridColumn lastVisibleCol = headerBase.GetLastVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable);
					if (lastVisibleCol != null)
					{
						ultraGridColumn = lastVisibleCol;
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraGridColumn;
		}

		internal HeaderBase GetLastDisplayableCardLabel(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			HeaderBase headerBase = null;
			for (int num = OrderedHeaders.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)

				headerBase = OrderedHeaders[num];

					{
						IEnumerable<UltraGridColumn> columnsResolved = headerBase.Group.ColumnsResolved;
						if (columnsResolved != null)
						{
							UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
							foreach (UltraGridColumn item in columnsResolved)
							{
								if (!item.Header.Hidden && item.ShouldCellValueBeDisplayedInCard(row))
								{
									ultraGridColumn = item;
								}
							}
							if (ultraGridColumn != null)

								return ultraGridColumn.Header;
							}
						}
					}
					else if (headerBase.Column.ShouldCellValueBeDisplayedInCard(row))

					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
