		internal void BuildSynchronizedColLists(SynchedBandAbove pSynchedBandAbove)
		{
			if (CardView)
			{
				return;
			}
			BandsCollection sortedBands = Layout.SortedBands;
			if (sortedBands == null || sortedBands.Count <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = layout.ViewStyleImpl;
			bool flag = AllowColSizingResolved == AllowColSizing.Synchronized && !GroupsDisplayed;
			bool flag2 = flag;
			HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = OrderedHeaders;
			if (orderedHeaders != null && flag)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = orderedHeaders.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					HeaderBase headerBase = orderedHeaders[i];
					if (!headerBase.Hidden)
					{
						headerBase.AddColsToSyncColsList(pSynchedBandAbove);
					}
				}
			}
			List<UltraGridBand> list = new List<UltraGridBand>(Layout.SortedBands.Count);
			for (int j = 0; j < sortedBands.Count; j++)
			{
				if (sortedBands[j].CardView)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (viewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers)
				{
					int hierarchicalLevel = sortedBands[j].HierarchicalLevel;
					int num = 0;
					for (num = 0; num < list.Count; num++)
					{
						UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = list[num];
						if (ultraGridBand.HierarchicalLevel > hierarchicalLevel || (ultraGridBand.HierarchicalLevel == hierarchicalLevel && ultraGridBand.Index > j))
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					list.Insert(num, sortedBands[j]);
				}
				else
				{
					list.Add(sortedBands[j]);
				}
			}
			if (!viewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay || sortedBands == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag3 = false;
			SynchedBandAbove synchedBandAbove = new SynchedBandAbove(this, pSynchedBandAbove);
			for (int k = 0; k < list.Count; k++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand2 = list[k];
				if (ultraGridBand2.HiddenResolved)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (!flag3)
				{
					flag3 = this == ultraGridBand2;
					continue;
				}
				if (viewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers)
				{
					if (ultraGridBand2.ParentBand == ParentBand)
					{
						ultraGridBand2.BuildSynchronizedColLists(flag2 ? synchedBandAbove : pSynchedBandAbove);
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGridBand2.BuildSynchronizedColLists(null);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ultraGridBand2.BuildSynchronizedColLists(flag2 ? synchedBandAbove : pSynchedBandAbove);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn GetColAtSyncPosition(int nSyncPosition, int nLevel, ColScrollRegion exclusiveRegion)
		{
			UltraGridColumn result = null;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < OrderedHeaders.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = OrderedHeaders[i];
				if (!headerBase.Hidden && headerBase.ExclusiveColScrollRegion == exclusiveRegion)
				{
					num2 = headerBase.GetTotalColSyncPositions(exclusiveRegion);
					if (num2 > 0 && num2 + num > nSyncPosition)
					{
						return headerBase.GetColAtRelativeSyncPosition(nSyncPosition - num, nLevel, num2, exclusiveRegion);
					}
					num += num2;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

				column.NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.VisiblePosition);

				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "IndentationGroupByRowExpansionIndicator", IndentationGroupByRowExpansionIndicator);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeExcludeFromColumnChooser())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ExcludeFromColumnChooser", excludeFromColumnChooser);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSpecialRowPromptField())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SpecialRowPromptField", specialRowPromptField);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRowEditTemplate())
			{
				string value = ((rowEditTemplate != null) ? ((Control)(object)rowEditTemplate).Name : rowEditTemplateControlName);
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RowEditTemplateControlName", value);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeVisiblePosition())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "VisiblePosition", VisiblePosition);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRowLayoutStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RowLayoutStyle", RowLayoutStyle);
			}
		}

		private void InitSortedColumnsOnDeserialization()
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (columns != null)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in columns)
				{
					if (column.SortIndex >= 0)
					{
						num++;
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, column.SortIndex);
					}
				}
			}
			if (num < 1 || num2 != num - 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridColumn[] array = new UltraGridColumn[num];
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column2 in columns)
			{
				if (column2.SortIndex >= 0)
				{
					if (array[column2.SortIndex] != null)
					{
						return;
					}
					array[column2.SortIndex] = column2;
				}
			}
			if (sortedColumns == null)
			{
				sortedColumns = new SortedColumnsCollection(this);
			}
			sortedColumns.InitDuringDeserialization(array);
		}

		internal void InitLayout(UltraGridLayout layout, bool calledFromEndInit)
		{
			this.layout = layout;
			if (columns != null)
			{
				columns.InitBand(this, calledFromEndInit);
			}
			if (groups != null)
			{
				groups.InitBand(this, calledFromEndInit);
			}
			InitRowLayoutColumnInfo();
			if (calledFromEndInit)
			{
				InitSortedColumnsOnDeserialization();
				if (rowEditTemplate != null)
				{
					rowEditTemplate.SetGrid(this, layout.Grid as UltraGrid);
				}
				return;
			}
			if (sortedColumns != null)
			{
				sortedColumns.InitBand(this);
			}
			if (overrideObj != null)
			{
				overrideObj.InitLayout(this.layout);
			}
			if (header != null)
			{
				header.InitBand(this);
			}
			if (cardSettings != null)
			{
				cardSettings.InitBand(this);
			}
			if (summaries != null)
			{
				summaries.OnDeserializationComplete(this);
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(UltraGridBand source, PropertyCategories propCat)
		{
			if ((propCat & PropertyCategories.Bands) == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (layout == null || (!layout.IsDisplayLayout && !layout.IsPrintLayout && !layout.IsExportLayout))
			{
				Key = source.Key;
			}
			addButtonCaption = source.addButtonCaption;
			addButtonToolTipText = source.addButtonToolTipText;
			autoPreviewMaxLines = source.autoPreviewMaxLines;
			autoPreviewEnabled = source.autoPreviewEnabled;
			autoPreviewField = source.AutoPreviewField;
			ScrollTipField = source.ScrollTipField;
			summaryFooterCaption = source.summaryFooterCaption;
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.Tag;
			}
			LevelCount = source.LevelCount;
			cardView = source.cardView;
			colHeaderLines = source.colHeaderLines;
			groupHeaderLines = source.groupHeaderLines;
			indentation = source.indentation;
			HeaderVisible = source.headerVisible;
			groupHeadersVisible = source.groupHeadersVisible;
			colHeadersVisible = source.colHeadersVisible;
			expandable = source.expandable;
			autoPreviewIndentation = source.autoPreviewIndentation;
			rowLayoutLabelPosition = source.rowLayoutLabelPosition;
			rowLayoutLabelStyle = source.rowLayoutLabelStyle;
			rowLayoutStyle = source.rowLayoutStyle;
			excludeFromColumnChooser = source.excludeFromColumnChooser;
			specialRowPromptField = source.specialRowPromptField;
			if (source.HasOverride)
			{
				_ = Override;
				Override.InitializeFrom(source.Override, propCat);
			}
			else
			{
				Override.Reset();
			}
			if (source.HasCardSettings)
			{
				_ = CardSettings;
				CardSettings.InitializeFrom(source.CardSettings, propCat);
			}
			else
			{
				CardSettings.Reset();
			}
			Columns.InitializeFrom(source.Columns, propCat);
			if (PropertyCategories.SortedColumns == (propCat & PropertyCategories.SortedColumns))
			{
				if (source.sortedColumns != null && source.HasSortedColumns)
				{
					SortedColumns.InitializeFrom(source.SortedColumns, propCat);
				}
				else if (source.sortedColumns != null && source.sortedColumns.HasSerializedColumnIDs)
				{
					SortedColumns.InitializeFrom(source.SortedColumns, propCat);
				}
				else if (sortedColumns != null)
				{
					sortedColumns.Clear();
				}
				Layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
				Layout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
			}
			if ((propCat & PropertyCategories.Bands) != 0 && !GroupsDisplayed)
			{
				if (source.OrderedColumnHeaders.Count < 1)
				{
					InitializeOrderedColumns();
				}
				else
				{
					orderedColumnsDirty = true;
				}
			}
			if (PropertyCategories.Groups == (propCat & PropertyCategories.Groups))
			{
				if (source.HasGroups)
				{
					if (Groups != null)
					{
						Dictionary<UltraGridColumn, string> dictionary = new Dictionary<UltraGridColumn, string>(Columns.Count);
						foreach (UltraGridColumn column in Columns)
						{
							if (column.HasRowLayoutColumnInfo)
							{
								UltraGridGroup parentGroup = column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup;
								if (parentGroup != null)
								{
									dictionary[column] = parentGroup.Key;
								}
							}
						}
						Groups.InitializeFrom(source.Groups, propCat);
						foreach (UltraGridColumn key in dictionary.Keys)
						{
							string text = dictionary[key];
							if (Groups.Exists(text))
							{
								UltraGridGroup parentGroup2 = Groups[text];
								key.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup = parentGroup2;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else if (HasGroups)
				{
					Groups.Clear();
				}
				InitRowLayoutColumnInfo();
				orderedGroups = null;
			}
			if (source.rowLayouts != null && source.rowLayouts.Count > 0)
			{
				RowLayouts.InitializeFrom(source.rowLayouts);
			}
			else if (rowLayouts != null)
			{
				rowLayouts.Clear();
			}
			Header.InitializeFrom(source.Header, propCat);
			InitializeOrderedColumns();
			InitializeOrderedGroups();
			Hidden = source.hidden;
			if ((PropertyCategories.Summaries & propCat) == PropertyCategories.Summaries && (summaries != null || source.summaries != null))
			{
				Summaries.InitializeFrom(source.Summaries, propCat);
			}
			if (PropertyCategories.ColumnFilters == (PropertyCategories.ColumnFilters & propCat) && (columnFilters != null || source.columnFilters != null))
			{
				ColumnFilters.InitializeFrom(source.ColumnFilters, propCat);
			}
			ClearCachedHeaderFontHeights();
			ClearCachedHeightValues();
			DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
			BumpFixedHeadersVerifyVersion();
			minRows = source.minRows;
			maxRows = source.maxRows;
			xsdSuppliedConstraints = source.xsdSuppliedConstraints;
			indentationGroupByRow = source.indentationGroupByRow;
			indentationGroupByRowExpansionIndicator = source.indentationGroupByRowExpansionIndicator;
			rowEditTemplate = source.rowEditTemplate;
			if (rowEditTemplate != null && rowEditTemplate.BandHierarchyLevel == -1)
			{
				rowEditTemplate.BandHierarchyLevel = HierarchicalLevel;
			}
			rowEditTemplateControlName = source.rowEditTemplateControlName;
			VisiblePosition = source.visiblePosition;
		}

		internal void SetVisiblePosition(UltraGridGroup group, int newPos, ref bool changed)
		{
			changed = false;
			int num = GetVisiblePosition(group);
			if (newPos != num)
			{
				if (newPos >= 0)
				{
					_ = OrderedGroupHeaders.Count;
				}
				orderedGroups.InternalRemove(group.Header);
				orderedGroups.InternalInsert(newPos, group.Header);
				EnsureFixedHeadersBeforeNonFixed();
				SetVisiblePositionsToActual();
				changed = true;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanInitializeFrom(UltraGridBand Source)
		{
			CaseInsensitiveComparer caseInsensitiveComparer = new CaseInsensitiveComparer();
			if (caseInsensitiveComparer.Compare(Key, Source.Key) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Source.ParentBand == null && parentBand == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal int GetVisiblePosition(UltraGridGroup group)
		{
			if (group.Band != this)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < OrderedGroupHeaders.Count; i++)
			{
				if (orderedGroups[i] == group.Header)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		internal SerializedColumnID GetSerializedColumnId(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (this != column.Band)
			{
				return column.Band.GetSerializedColumnId(column);
			}
			int num = column.Index;
			if (!column.IsBound)
			{
				num -= Columns.BoundColumnsCount;
			}
			return new SerializedColumnID(num, column.IsBound, column.SortIndicator, column.IsGroupByColumn, column.Key);
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn GetMatchingColumn(SerializedColumnID serializedColumnId)
		{
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
			try
			{
				if (serializedColumnId.Key.Length > 0 && Columns.Exists(serializedColumnId.Key))
				{
					ultraGridColumn = Columns[serializedColumnId.Key];
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			if (ultraGridColumn == null)
			{
				int num = serializedColumnId.RelativeIndex;
				if (!serializedColumnId.Bound)
				{
					num += Columns.BoundColumnsCount;
				}
				try
				{
					ultraGridColumn = Columns[num];
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return ultraGridColumn;
		}

		public void UnfixAllHeaders()
		{
			GroupsCollection groupsCollection = groups;
			if (groupsCollection != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < groupsCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					groupsCollection[i].Header.Fixed = false;
				}
			}
			ColumnsCollection columnsCollection = columns;
			if (columnsCollection != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < columnsCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					columnsCollection[i].Header.Fixed = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void BumpFixedHeadersVerifyVersion()
		{
			BumpFixedHeadersVerifyVersion(dirtyOrderedHeaders: false);
		}

		internal void BumpFixedHeadersVerifyVersion(bool dirtyOrderedHeaders)
		{
			fixedHeadersVerifyVersion++;
			if (dirtyOrderedHeaders && UseFixedHeaders)
			{
				orderedColumnsDirty = (orderedGroupsDirty = true);
			}
			if (Layout != null)
			{
				Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
				Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
				if (Layout.ColScrollRegions != null)
				{
					Layout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
				}
				Layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
				Layout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
			}
			DirtyTabOrderedColumns();
		}

		internal void VerifyFixedHeadersVersion()
		{
			if (verifiedFixedHeadersVersion == FixedHeadersVerifyVersion && leftFixedHeadersCached != null && rightFixedHeadersCached != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			verifiedFixedHeadersVersion = FixedHeadersVerifyVersion;
			HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = OrderedHeaders;
			List<HeaderBase> list = new List<HeaderBase>(orderedHeaders.Count);
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < orderedHeaders.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = orderedHeaders[i];
				if (!headerBase.Hidden)
				{
					if (!headerBase.FixedResolved || headerBase.FixOnRightResolved)
					{
						break;
					}
					list.Add(headerBase);
				}
			}
			for (; i < orderedHeaders.Count && (!orderedHeaders[i].FixedResolved || !orderedHeaders[i].FixOnRightResolved); i++)
			{
			}
			List<HeaderBase> list2 = new List<HeaderBase>(orderedHeaders.Count);
			for (; i < orderedHeaders.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase2 = orderedHeaders[i];
				if (!headerBase2.Hidden)
				{
					list2.Add(headerBase2);
				}
			}
			leftFixedHeadersCached = list.ToArray();
			rightFixedHeadersCached = list2.ToArray();
		}

		internal void OnHeadersDropped(HeaderBase[] cloneHeaders)
		{
			if (!UseFixedHeaders)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = OrderedHeaders;
			List<HeaderBase> list = new List<HeaderBase>();
			List<HeaderBase> list2 = new List<HeaderBase>();
			List<HeaderBase> list3 = new List<HeaderBase>();
			for (int i = 0; i < orderedHeaders.Count; i++)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				bool flag3 = false;
				UltraGridColumn column = orderedHeaders[i].Column;
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = orderedHeaders[i].Group;
				for (int j = 0; j < cloneHeaders.Length; j++)
				{
					UltraGridColumn column2 = cloneHeaders[j].Column;
					if (column2 != null && (column2 == column || column2.Header == orderedHeaders[i] || column2.ClonedFromColumn == column))
					{
						flag2 = true;
						flag = cloneHeaders[j].Fixed;
						flag3 = cloneHeaders[j].FixOnRightResolved;
						break;
					}
					UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup2 = cloneHeaders[j].Group;
					if (ultraGridGroup2 != null && (ultraGridGroup2 == ultraGridGroup || ultraGridGroup2.Header == orderedHeaders[i] || ultraGridGroup2.GetClonedFromGroup() == ultraGridGroup))
					{
						flag2 = true;
						flag = cloneHeaders[j].Fixed;
						flag3 = cloneHeaders[j].FixOnRightResolved;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag2)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					bool flag4 = orderedHeaders[i].Fixed;
					if (flag3)
					{
						if (!flag4 || !orderedHeaders[i].FixOnRightResolved)
						{
							list.Add(orderedHeaders[i]);
						}
					}
					else if (!flag4 || orderedHeaders[i].FixOnRightResolved)
					{
						list2.Add(orderedHeaders[i]);
					}
				}
				else if (orderedHeaders[i].Fixed)
				{
					list3.Add(orderedHeaders[i]);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
			{
				list2[i].Fixed = true;
				list2[i].FixOnRight = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list3.Count; i++)
			{
				list3[i].Fixed = false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				list[i].Fixed = true;
				list[i].FixOnRight = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
			}
			EnsureFixedHeadersBeforeNonFixed(orderedHeaders);
			SetVisiblePositionsToActual(orderedHeaders);
		}

		internal void EnsureFixedHeadersBeforeNonFixed()
		{
			if (UseFixedHeaders)
			{
				HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = OrderedHeaders;
				if (orderedHeaders != null)
				{
					EnsureFixedHeadersBeforeNonFixed(orderedHeaders);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void EnsureFixedHeadersBeforeNonFixed(HeadersCollection headers)
		{
			if (headers == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < headers.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = headers[i];
				if (headerBase.FixedResolved)
				{
					if (headerBase.FixOnRightResolved)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
					else if (flag2 || flag3)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (flag3)
				{
					if (headerBase.Column == null || !headerBase.Column.IsChaptered)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<HeaderBase> list = new List<HeaderBase>(headers.Count);
			List<HeaderBase> list2 = new List<HeaderBase>(headers.Count);
			List<HeaderBase> list3 = new List<HeaderBase>(headers.Count);
			List<HeaderBase> list4 = new List<HeaderBase>(headers.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < headers.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase2 = headers[i];
				if (headerBase2.Column != null && headerBase2.Column.IsChaptered)
				{
					list4.Add(headerBase2);
				}
				else if (headerBase2.FixedResolved)
				{
					if (headerBase2.FixOnRightResolved)
					{
						list2.Add(headerBase2);
					}
					else
					{
						list.Add(headerBase2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list3.Add(headerBase2);
				}
			}
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				headers[num++] = list[i];
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list3.Count; i++)
			{
				headers[num++] = list3[i];
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
			{
				headers[num++] = list2[i];
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list4.Count; i++)
			{
				headers[num++] = list4[i];
			}
		}

		internal int GetFixedHeaders_ExtentDelta(ColScrollRegion csr)
		{
			if (!UseFixedHeadersResolved(csr) || !layout.IsDisplayLayout)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (Layout.ViewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers)
			{
				if (ParentBand == null)
				{
					return Math.Min(csr.Position, GetExtent(BandOrigin.RowCellArea) - GetFixedHeadersExtent(csr));
				}
				int scrollDelta = csr.Position;
				GetBandOriginExtent_HorizontalViewStyle(ParentBand, csr, ref scrollDelta, out var _, out var _);
				return Math.Min(scrollDelta, GetExtent(BandOrigin.RowCellArea) - GetFixedHeadersExtent(csr));
			}
			return Math.Min(csr.Position, GetExtent(BandOrigin.RowCellArea) - GetFixedHeadersExtent(csr));
		}

		internal int GetFixedHeaders_BandHeader_SummaryFooter_RightDelta(ColScrollRegion csr)

					int scrollDelta = csr.Position;

					num = scrollDelta;
				}
				int num4 = GetFixedHeaders_ExtentDelta(csr) - num;
				if (num4 < 0)
				{
					return num4;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal static void GetBandOriginExtent_HorizontalViewStyle(UltraGridBand band, ColScrollRegion csr, ref int scrollDelta, out int origin, out int extent)
		{
			origin = 0;
			extent = 0;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (band.ParentBand != null)
			{
				GetBandOriginExtent_HorizontalViewStyle(band.ParentBand, csr, ref scrollDelta, out num, out num2);
			}
			int val = band.PreRowAreaExtent + band.RowSelectorExtent + band.GetFixedHeadersExtent(csr);
			int bandExtent = csr.GetBandExtent(band);
			origin = csr.GetBandOrigin(band);
			extent = Math.Max(val, bandExtent - scrollDelta);
			origin -= csr.Position - scrollDelta;
			scrollDelta -= bandExtent - extent;
		}

		internal HeaderBase GetFirstNonFixedHeader(ColScrollRegion csr)
		{
			if (!UseFixedHeadersResolved(csr))
			{
				return null;
			}

			for (int i = 0; i < orderedHeaders.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = orderedHeaders[i];
				if (!headerBase.Hidden && !headerBase.FixedResolved)
				{
					return headerBase;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int GetFixedHeadersExtent(ColScrollRegion csr, bool getRightExtent)
		{
			HeaderBase[] fixedHeaders = GetFixedHeaders(csr, getRightExtent);
			if (fixedHeaders == null)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (HeaderBase headerBase in fixedHeaders)
			{
				num += headerBase.Extent - headerBase.RowSelectorExtent;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool IsHeaderFixed(ColScrollRegion csr, HeaderBase testHeader, bool checkRightColumns)
		{
			HeaderBase[] fixedHeaders = GetFixedHeaders(csr, checkRightColumns);
			if (fixedHeaders != null)
			{
				foreach (HeaderBase headerBase in fixedHeaders)
				{
					if (headerBase == testHeader)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (headerBase is GroupHeader && testHeader is ColumnHeader && headerBase.Group == testHeader.Column.GroupResolved)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsHeaderScrolledUnderFixedHeaders(ColScrollRegion csr, HeaderBase header, bool considerLeftFixedHeaders = true, bool considerRightFixedHeaders = true)
		{
			if (IsHeaderFixed(csr, header))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			header.GetDimensions(PositionDimensions.InsideRowSelectors, DimOriginBase.Relative, ref num, ref num2, csr);
			if (considerLeftFixedHeaders)
			{
				int leftFixedHeadersAreaRight = GetLeftFixedHeadersAreaRight(csr);
				if (num < leftFixedHeadersAreaRight)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (considerRightFixedHeaders)
			{
				int rightFixedHeadersAreaLeft = header.Band.GetRightFixedHeadersAreaLeft(csr);
				if (num + num2 > rightFixedHeadersAreaLeft)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool AreNonFixedHeadersScrolledUnderneathFixedHeaders(ColScrollRegion csr, bool considerLeftFixedHeaders = true, bool considerRightFixedHeaders = true)
		{
			if (UseFixedHeadersResolved(csr))
			{
				if (considerLeftFixedHeaders && GetFixedHeaders_ExtentDelta(csr) != 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (considerRightFixedHeaders)
				{
					if (GetExtent(BandOrigin.RowCellArea) <= csr.SafeExtent)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return csr.Position < csr.Range;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		internal LabelPosition GetRowLayoutLabelPositionResolved(RowLayoutColumnInfoContext contextType)
		{
			if (RowLayoutLabelPosition != LabelPosition.Default)
			{
				return RowLayoutLabelPosition;
			}
			switch (contextType)
			{
			case RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Column:
				if (!ColHeadersVisible)
				{
					return LabelPosition.None;
				}
				break;
			case RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Group:
				if (!GroupHeadersVisible)
				{
					return LabelPosition.None;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (!CardView)
			{
				return LabelPosition.Top;
			}
			return LabelPosition.Left;
		}

		}

		private UltraGridColumn[] GetLayoutVisibleColumns(bool getRootColumnsOnly)
		{
			ColumnsCollection columnsCollection = Columns;
			List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>(columnsCollection.Count);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = columnsCollection.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = columnsCollection[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.IsVisibleInLayout && ShouldIncludeInLayout(ultraGridColumn, getRootColumnsOnly))
				{
					list.Add(ultraGridColumn);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal int GetExtentLayout(bool minimum, BandOrigin bandOrigin)
		{
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = ((!minimum) ? PreferredRowLayoutSize.Width : Math.Max(MinimumRowLayoutSize.Width, MinimumHeaderLayoutSize.Width));
			if (BandOrigin.RowCellArea == bandOrigin)
			{
				return num;
			}
			int rowSelectorExtent = RowSelectorExtent;
			bool flag = Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(BorderStyleRowResolved);
			bool flag2 = Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(BorderStyleCellResolved);
			if (rowSelectorExtent > 0 && flag)
			{
				num--;
			}
			if (!flag || !flag2 || CellSpacingResolved > 0)
			{
				num += 2 * Layout.GetBorderThickness(BorderStyleRowResolved);
			}
			num += rowSelectorExtent;
			if (BandOrigin.RowSelector == bandOrigin)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return num + PreRowAreaExtent;
		}

		private void CalcLayoutHelper(int bandExtent)
		{
			layoutItemDimensionsCellArea = null;

			}
			else
			{

				{

					cachedLayoutContainerCardLabelArea.Initialize(this, cardLabelAreaRect);

					layoutItemDimensionsHeaderArea = gridBagHeaderLayoutManager.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCardLabelArea, (object)null);
				}
				Rectangle rowCellAreaRect2 = new Rectangle(0, 0, CardWidthResolved, PreferredRowLayoutSize.Height);
				LayoutContainerCardCellArea cachedLayoutContainerCardCellArea = GetCachedLayoutContainerCardCellArea();
				cachedLayoutContainerCardCellArea.Initialize(this, rowCellAreaRect2);
				RowLayoutManager.LayoutContainer((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCardCellArea, (object)null);
				layoutItemDimensionsCellArea = gridBagRowLayoutManager.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCardCellArea, (object)null);
			}
			UltraGridColumn[] layoutVisibleColumns = GetLayoutVisibleColumns(getRootColumnsOnly: false);
			if (layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders == null)
			{
				layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders = new HeadersCollection(layoutVisibleColumns.Length);
			}
			if (layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical == null)
			{
				layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical = new HeadersCollection(layoutVisibleColumns.Length);
			}
			layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders.InternalClear();
			layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical.InternalClear();
			Utilities.SortMerge((object[])layoutVisibleColumns, (IComparer)new LayoutColumnPositionComparer(yWise: true));
			for (int i = 0; i < layoutVisibleColumns.Length; i++)
			{
				layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders.InternalAdd(layoutVisibleColumns[i].Header);
			}
			Utilities.SortMerge((object[])layoutVisibleColumns, (IComparer)new LayoutColumnPositionComparer(yWise: false));
			for (int i = 0; i < layoutVisibleColumns.Length; i++)
			{
				layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical.InternalAdd(layoutVisibleColumns[i].Header);

			if (layoutOrderedVisibleGroupHeaders == null)

			Utilities.SortMerge((object[])layoutVisibleGroups, (IComparer)new LayoutGroupPositionComparer(yWise: true));
			for (int i = 0; i < layoutVisibleGroups.Length; i++)
			{
				layoutOrderedVisibleGroupHeaders.InternalAdd(layoutVisibleGroups[i].Header);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Columns[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn.HasRowLayoutColumnInfo)
				{
					ultraGridColumn.RowLayoutColumnInfo.InternalSetSpansEntireLayoutHeight(val: false);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Groups.Count; i++)
			{

			}
			for (int i = 0; i < layoutVisibleColumns.Length; i++)
			{
				Size cardLabelSize = layoutVisibleColumns[i].CardLabelSize;
			}
			BumpMajorRowHeightVersion();
			rowLayoutAutoSizeAutoHeightCacheVersion++;
		}

		internal int GetLayoutRowHeight(bool minimum)
		{
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0057: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			VerifyRowLayoutCache();
			int num = (minimum ? MinimumRowLayoutSize.Height : PreferredRowLayoutSize.Height);
			if (num == 0)
			{
				int overrideMinRowHeight = OverrideMinRowHeight;
				num = ((overrideMinRowHeight <= 0) ? CalcMinRowHeight() : overrideMinRowHeight);
			}
			if (CellSpacingResolved > 0 || !Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(BorderStyleRowResolved, BorderStyleCellResolved))
			{
				num += 2 * Layout.GetBorderThickness(BorderStyleRowResolved);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static double ArrSum(double[] arr, int startIndex, int len)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			int num2 = startIndex;
			while (arr != null && num2 < arr.Length && num2 < startIndex + len)
			{
				num += arr[num2];
				num2++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static int ArrSum(int[] arr)
		{
			return ArrSum(arr, 0, arr.Length);
		}

		internal static int ArrSum(int[] arr, int startIndex, int len)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = startIndex;
			while (arr != null && num2 < arr.Length && num2 < startIndex + len)
			{
				num += arr[num2];
				num2++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void GetLayoutResizeItems(UIElement elem, ref ILayoutItem resizeItem, Size containerSize, out GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLM, out Size preferredLayoutSize, out GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection preferredItemDims, out GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection actualItemDims, bool recalcPreferredItemDims)
		{
			preferredLayoutSize = Size.Empty;
			gridBagLM = null;
			preferredItemDims = null;
			actualItemDims = null;
			if (resizeItem is HeaderBase || resizeItem is UltraGridColumn || resizeItem is RowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder.CellLayoutItem || resizeItem is GroupLayoutItemBase)
			{
				ILayoutItem val = ((elem != null) ? GetLayoutItemFromElem(elem, out gridBagLM, resizeItem) : null);
				if (val != null && gridBagLM != null)
				{
					resizeItem = val;
					preferredLayoutSize = ((LayoutManagerBase)gridBagLM).CalculatePreferredSize((ILayoutContainer)(object)GetCachedLayoutContainerCalcSize(), (object)null);
					preferredItemDims = gridBagLM.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)new LayoutContainerCalcSize(preferredLayoutSize), (object)null);
				}
				else if (resizeItem is HeaderBase && AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
				{
					gridBagLM = gridBagHeaderLayoutManager;
					actualItemDims = (preferredItemDims = LayoutItemDimensionsHeaderArea);
					preferredLayoutSize = PreferredHeaderLayoutSize;
				}
				else
				{
					gridBagLM = gridBagRowLayoutManager;
					actualItemDims = (preferredItemDims = LayoutItemDimensionsCellArea);
					preferredLayoutSize = PreferredRowLayoutSize;
				}
				if (recalcPreferredItemDims && gridBagLM != null)
				{
					preferredLayoutSize = ((LayoutManagerBase)gridBagLM).CalculatePreferredSize((ILayoutContainer)(object)GetCachedLayoutContainerCalcSize(), (object)null);
					preferredItemDims = gridBagLM.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)new LayoutContainerCalcSize(preferredLayoutSize), (object)null);
					actualItemDims = null;
				}
				if (containerSize.Width == 0)
				{
					containerSize.Width = preferredLayoutSize.Width;
				}
				if (containerSize.Height == 0)
				{
					containerSize.Height = preferredLayoutSize.Height;
				}
				if (Math.Abs(containerSize.Width - preferredLayoutSize.Width) > 10 || Math.Abs(containerSize.Height - preferredLayoutSize.Height) > 10 || actualItemDims == null)
				{
					actualItemDims = gridBagLM.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)new LayoutContainerCalcSize(containerSize), (object)null);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		internal void GetLayoutItemResizeRange(UIElement elem, ILayoutItem resizeItem, Size containerSize, ref int minWidth, ref int maxWidth, ref int minHeight, ref int maxHeight, out Size currSize)
		{
			currSize = Size.Empty;
			minWidth = 0;
			maxWidth = 0;
			minHeight = 0;
			maxHeight = 0;
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection preferredItemDims = null;
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection actualItemDims = null;
			GridBagLayoutManager gridBagLM = null;
			Size preferredLayoutSize = Size.Empty;
			GetLayoutResizeItems(elem, ref resizeItem, containerSize, out gridBagLM, out preferredLayoutSize, out preferredItemDims, out actualItemDims, recalcPreferredItemDims: false);
			if (gridBagLM == null || preferredItemDims == null || actualItemDims == null || resizeItem == null || !actualItemDims.Exists(resizeItem))
			{
				return;
			}
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection val = actualItemDims;
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensions val2 = val[resizeItem];
			int originX = val2.OriginX;
			int spanX = val2.SpanX;
			int originY = val2.OriginY;
			int spanY = val2.SpanY;
			int num = val2.Bounds.Left + resizeItem.MinimumSize.Width;
			int num2 = val2.Bounds.Top + resizeItem.MinimumSize.Height;
			currSize = val2.Bounds.Size;
			minWidth = resizeItem.MinimumSize.Width;
			minHeight = resizeItem.MinimumSize.Height;
			Size layoutItemMaxSize = GetLayoutItemMaxSize(resizeItem);
			int num3 = ((layoutItemMaxSize.Width > 0) ? (val2.Bounds.Left + layoutItemMaxSize.Width) : int.MaxValue);
			int num4 = ((layoutItemMaxSize.Height > 0) ? (val2.Bounds.Top + layoutItemMaxSize.Height) : int.MaxValue);
			for (int i = 0; i < ((LayoutManagerBase)gridBagLM).LayoutItems.Count; i++)
			{
				ILayoutItem val3 = ((LayoutManagerBase)gridBagLM).LayoutItems[i];
				GridBagLayoutItemDimensions val4 = (val.Exists(val3) ? val[val3] : null);
				if (val4 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int originX2 = val4.OriginX;
				int spanX2 = val4.SpanX;
				int originY2 = val4.OriginY;

		internal void AutoResizeLayoutItem(ILayoutItem autoResizeItem, RowsCollection rowsContext, Size containerSize, UIElement elem)
		{

			}

						if (val5.OriginX + val5.SpanX != val7.OriginX + val7.SpanX)
						{
							continue;
						}
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = ((val6 is UltraGridColumn) ? ((UltraGridColumn)(object)val6) : ((val6 is ColumnHeader) ? ((ColumnHeader)(object)val6).Column : null));

						{

		internal bool IsMultiCellOperationAllowed(MultiCellOperation operation)
		{
			AllowMultiCellOperation allowMultiCellOperationsResolved = AllowMultiCellOperationsResolved;
			bool result = false;
			switch (operation)
			{
			case MultiCellOperation.Copy:
				result = ((AllowMultiCellOperation.Copy | AllowMultiCellOperation.CopyWithHeaders) & allowMultiCellOperationsResolved) != 0;
				break;
			case MultiCellOperation.Cut:
				result = (AllowMultiCellOperation.Cut & allowMultiCellOperationsResolved) != 0;
				break;
			case MultiCellOperation.Delete:
				result = (AllowMultiCellOperation.Delete & allowMultiCellOperationsResolved) != 0;
				break;
			case MultiCellOperation.Paste:
				result = (AllowMultiCellOperation.Paste & allowMultiCellOperationsResolved) != 0;
				break;
			case MultiCellOperation.Redo:
				result = (AllowMultiCellOperation.Redo & allowMultiCellOperationsResolved) != 0;
				break;
			case MultiCellOperation.Undo:
				result = (AllowMultiCellOperation.Undo & allowMultiCellOperationsResolved) != 0;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private UltraGridRowEditTemplate SearchForTemplateWithName(string ctrlName)
		{
			UltraGridRowEditTemplate ultraGridRowEditTemplate = null;
			try
			{
				UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
				if (ultraGridBase != null)
				{
					for (Control parent = ((Control)(object)ultraGridBase).Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
					{
						if (parent.Controls != null)
						{
							ultraGridRowEditTemplate = SearchForTemplateWithName(parent.Controls, ctrlName, recursive: false);
						}
						if (ultraGridRowEditTemplate != null)
						{
							return ultraGridRowEditTemplate;
						}
					}
				}
				Control rootControlForSearching = GridUtils.GetRootControlForSearching((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
				if (rootControlForSearching != null)
				{
					ultraGridRowEditTemplate = SearchForTemplateWithName(rootControlForSearching.Controls, ctrlName, recursive: true);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return ultraGridRowEditTemplate;
		}

		private UltraGridRowEditTemplate SearchForTemplateWithName(Control.ControlCollection controls, string name, bool recursive)
		{
			if (controls == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRowEditTemplate ultraGridRowEditTemplate = null;
			foreach (Control control in controls)
			{
				if (control is UltraGridRowEditTemplate && control.Name.Equals(name))
				{
					return (UltraGridRowEditTemplate)(object)control;
				}
				if (control.Controls.Count > 0 && recursive)
				{
					ultraGridRowEditTemplate = SearchForTemplateWithName(control.Controls, name, recursive: true);
					if (ultraGridRowEditTemplate != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraGridRowEditTemplate;
		}

		private void PerformAutoResizeHelper(bool sizeHiddenColumns, PerformAutoSizeType autoSizeType, bool includeHeader)
		{
			if (CardView || (HiddenResolved && !sizeHiddenColumns))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in Columns)
			{
				if (!column.IsChaptered && (sizeHiddenColumns || !column.HiddenResolved))
				{
					column.PerformAutoResize(autoSizeType, includeHeader);
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		public void PerformAutoResizeCards(bool includeHiddenColumns)
		{
			if (!CardView || (HiddenResolved && !includeHiddenColumns))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			if (includeHiddenColumns || !HiddenResolved)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in Columns)

					{
						int val = column.CalculateAutoResizeWidth(PerformAutoSizeType.AllRowsInBand, includeHeader: false);

			{
				num += CardLabelWidthResolvedHelper(forWrapHeaderTextCalculations: false);
			}
			CardSettings.Width = num;
		}

		internal CheckState GetHeaderCheckState(UltraGridColumn column)

		private bool IsCachedCheckStateValid(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column.Band != null && column.Band.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion != currentHeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion && column.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved != HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.None)
			{
				currentHeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion = column.Band.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion;
				DirtyCheckStateCacheValidEntry(null);
				return false;
			}
			if (!checkStateCacheValidHashTable.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return checkStateCacheValidHashTable[column];
		}

		internal void DirtyCheckStateCacheValidEntry(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				checkStateCacheValidHashTable.Clear();
			}
			else
			{
				checkStateCacheValidHashTable[column] = false;
			}
		}

		internal void SetCheckStateCache(UltraGridColumn column, CheckState state, bool isCancelable, bool synchronize)
		{
			if (synchronize && Layout.Grid is UltraGrid { ActiveCell: not null } ultraGrid && ultraGrid.ActiveCell.IsInEditMode && ultraGrid.ActiveCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: false))
			{
				return;
			}
			CheckState checkState = state;
			bool flag = checkStateCache.ContainsKey(column);
			if (!flag || checkStateCache[column] != checkState)
			{
				UltraGridBase grid = Layout.Grid;
				BeforeHeaderCheckStateChangedEventArgs e = new BeforeHeaderCheckStateChangedEventArgs(column, null, state, flag ? checkStateCache[column] : CheckState.Indeterminate, isCancelable);
				grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeHeaderCheckStateChanged, e);
				if (e.Cancel && isCancelable)
				{
					return;
				}
				checkState = e.NewCheckState;
				checkStateCache[column] = checkState;
				column.DirtyHeaderUIElements(null);
				if (synchronize && column.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved == HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.Band && checkState != CheckState.Indeterminate)
				{
					column.SetCellValuesBasedOnCheckState(null, checkState);
				}
				grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.AfterHeaderCheckStateChanged, new AfterHeaderCheckStateChangedEventArgs(column, null));
			}
			checkStateCacheValidHashTable[column] = true;
		}

		internal static List<IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo> GetGroupsAndColumns(UltraGridBand band)

		internal UltraGridGroup[] GetLayoutVisibleGroups(bool getRootGroupsOnly)
		{
			if (RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout)
			{
				return new UltraGridGroup[0];
			}
			GroupsCollection groupsCollection = Groups;
			List<UltraGridGroup> list = new List<UltraGridGroup>(groupsCollection.Count);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = groupsCollection.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = groupsCollection[i];
				if (ultraGridGroup != null && ultraGridGroup.IsVisibleInLayout && ShouldIncludeInLayout(ultraGridGroup, getRootGroupsOnly))
				{
					list.Add(ultraGridGroup);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal UltraGridGroup GetMatchingGroup(SerializedGroupID serializedGroupId)
		{
			UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = null;
			try
			{
				if (serializedGroupId.Key.Length > 0 && Groups.Exists(serializedGroupId.Key))
				{
					ultraGridGroup = Groups[serializedGroupId.Key];
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			if (ultraGridGroup == null)
			{
				int relativeIndex = serializedGroupId.RelativeIndex;
				try
				{
					ultraGridGroup = Groups[relativeIndex];
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return ultraGridGroup;
		}

		internal static RowLayoutColumnInfo GetRowLayoutColumnInfo(ILayoutItem layoutItem)

			if (provideRowLayoutColumnInfo != null)
			{
				return provideRowLayoutColumnInfo.RowLayoutColumnInfo;
			}
			if (layoutItem is HeaderBase headerBase)

				return headerBase.RowLayoutColumnInfo;
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		internal static void InitRowLayoutColumnInfo(RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo, UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroupKey != null && band.Groups.Exists(rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroupKey))
			{
				rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup = band.Groups[rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroupKey];
			}
			else if (rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroupIndex >= 0 && rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroupIndex < band.Groups.Count)
			{
				rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup = band.Groups[rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroupIndex];
			}
			else
			{
				rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup = null;
			}
		}

		internal static bool ShouldAddGroupHeaderToCellArea(UltraGridGroup group)
		{
			if (!group.Band.CardView)
			{
				if (group.RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelPositionResolved == LabelPosition.Left || group.RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelPositionResolved == LabelPosition.Right)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (group.RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelPositionResolved == LabelPosition.Top || group.RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelPositionResolved == LabelPosition.Bottom)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool ShouldIncludeInLayout(IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo, bool getRootItemsOnly)
		{
			switch (RowLayoutStyle)
			{
			case RowLayoutStyle.None:
				return false;
			case RowLayoutStyle.ColumnLayout:
				return iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo is UltraGridColumn;
			case RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout:
				if (!getRootItemsOnly)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup == null;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal void AddCalcReferences()
		{
			AddCalcReferencesHelper(shouldAdd: true);
		}

		internal void RemoveCalcReferences()
		{
			AddCalcReferencesHelper(shouldAdd: false);
		}

		private void AddCalcReferencesHelper(bool shouldAdd)
		{
			if (Layout == null || !Layout.IsDisplayLayout || Layout.IsApplyingLayout)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridBase grid = Layout.Grid;
			if (grid == null || grid.CalcManager == null || grid.Initializing || grid.inSet_ListManager)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand item in Layout.BandsInternal)
			{
				if (!item.IsTrivialDescendantOf(this))
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in item.Columns)
				{
					if (column.HasFormulaHolder)
					{
						if (shouldAdd)
						{
							column.CalcReference.ParsedReference = null;
							column.FormulaHolder.AddReferenceToCalcNetwork();
						}
						else
						{
							column.FormulaHolder.RemoveReferenceFromCalcNetwork();
							column.CalcReference.ParsedReference = null;
						}
					}
				}
				foreach (SummarySettings item2 in (IEnumerable)item.Summaries)
				{
					if (item2.HasFormulaHolder)
					{
						if (shouldAdd)
						{
							item2.CalcReference.ParsedReference = null;
							item2.FormulaHolder.AddReferenceToCalcNetwork();
						}
						else
						{
							item2.FormulaHolder.RemoveReferenceFromCalcNetwork();
							item2.CalcReference.ParsedReference = null;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			grid.CalcManager.ProcessEventQueue();
		}

		internal AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions GetAutoResizeColumnWidthOptionsDefault(PerformAutoSizeType autoSizeType)
		{
			bool includeHeader = true;
			bool includeCells = autoSizeType != PerformAutoSizeType.None;
			int nRows = ((autoSizeType != PerformAutoSizeType.AllRowsInBand) ? (-1) : 0);
			return GetAutoResizeColumnWidthOptionsDefault(nRows, includeHeader, includeCells);
		}

		internal AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions GetAutoResizeColumnWidthOptionsDefault(int nRows)
		{
			return GetAutoResizeColumnWidthOptionsDefault(nRows, includeHeader: true, includeCells: true);
		}

		internal AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions GetAutoResizeColumnWidthOptionsDefault(int nRows, bool includeHeader, bool includeCells)
		{
			AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions autoResizeColumnWidthOptions = AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.Default;
			if (includeCells)
			{
				autoResizeColumnWidthOptions |= AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.IncludeCells;
				if (nRows == 0)
				{
					autoResizeColumnWidthOptions |= AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.IncludeSummaryRows;
				}
			}
			if (includeHeader)
			{
				autoResizeColumnWidthOptions |= AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.IncludeHeader;
			}
			return autoResizeColumnWidthOptions;
		}

		private void MergeExternalAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = Layout;
			if (ultraGridLayout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridBase grid = ultraGridLayout.Grid;
			if (grid != null)
			{
				AppearanceBase appearance = null;
				bool flag = false;
				switch (index)
				{
				case UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Cell:
					flag = grid.GetExternalOverrideCellAppearance(this, out appearance);
					break;
				case UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Header:
					flag = grid.GetExternalOverrideHeaderAppearance(this, out appearance);
					break;
				case UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Row:
					flag = grid.GetExternalOverrideRowAppearance(this, out appearance);
					break;
				case UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.RowSelector:
					flag = grid.GetExternalOverrideRowSelectorAppearance(this, out appearance);
					break;
				case UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.RowSelectorHeaderAppearance:
					flag = grid.GetExternalOverrideRowSelectorHeaderAppearance(this, out appearance);
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldAddPlaceholderChildRow(ViewStyleBase viewStyle, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			if (rows.ParentChildBand != null && rows.ParentChildBand.CollapsedResolved)
			{
				return (rows.Count > 0) | rows.IsTemplateAddRowVisible;
			}
			UltraGridBand band = rows.Band;
			if (viewStyle.ShouldApplySpecialRowFiltersCode() && IsFilterUIEnabled && band.FilterUITypeResolved != FilterUIType.FilterRow && RowFilterAction.HideFilteredOutRows == RowFilterActionResolved && Layout.IsDisplayLayout && !band.CardView)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				switch (HeaderPlacementResolved)
				{
				case HeaderPlacement.RepeatOnBreak:
				case HeaderPlacement.OncePerRowIsland:
					flag = true;
					break;
				case HeaderPlacement.OncePerGroupedRowIsland:
					if (rows.IsTopLevel)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (flag && rows.GetVisibleRowCount(includeSpecialRows: false) == 0)
				{
					return rows.Count > 0;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldAddFilteredOutCard(ViewStyleBase viewStyle, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (!CardView)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridRow childRowToAdd = null;
			if (ShouldAddFilteredOutFirstCard(viewStyle, row.ParentCollection, out childRowToAdd) && childRowToAdd == row)

		internal override UltraGridColumn GetRelatedVisibleCol(UltraGridColumn column, NavigateType navType, bool includeNonActivateable)
		{
			HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = Band.OrderedHeaders;
			if (orderedHeaders == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridGroup groupResolved = column.GroupResolved;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = column.Header.ExclusiveColScrollRegion;
			bool flag = false;
			if (NavigateType.Above == navType || NavigateType.Below == navType || NavigateType.Topmost == navType || NavigateType.Bottommost == navType)
			{
				if (groupResolved != null)
				{
					return groupResolved.Header.GetRelatedVisibleCol(column, navType, includeNonActivateable);
				}
				return column.Header.GetRelatedVisibleCol(column, navType, includeNonActivateable);
			}
			foreach (HeaderBase item in orderedHeaders)
			{
				if (item.Hidden || item.ExclusiveColScrollRegion != colScrollRegion)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (navType == NavigateType.First)
				{
					ultraGridColumn = item.GetFirstVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable);
					if (ultraGridColumn != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (NavigateType.Next == navType && flag)
				{
					ultraGridColumn = item.GetFirstVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable);
					if (ultraGridColumn != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				if ((groupResolved != null && groupResolved.Header == item) || column.Header == item)
				{
					flag = true;
					if (NavigateType.Next == navType)
					{
						ultraGridColumn = item.GetNextVisibleCol(column, includeNonActivateable);
						if (ultraGridColumn != null)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (NavigateType.Prev == navType)
					{
						UltraGridColumn prevVisibleCol = item.GetPrevVisibleCol(column, includeNonActivateable);
						if (prevVisibleCol != null)
						{
							ultraGridColumn = prevVisibleCol;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (NavigateType.Last == navType || NavigateType.Prev == navType)
				{
					UltraGridColumn lastVisibleCol = item.GetLastVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable);
					if (lastVisibleCol != null)
					{
						ultraGridColumn = lastVisibleCol;
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraGridColumn;
		}

		private class BandSortComparer : IComparer
		{
			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				return Compare((UltraGridBand)x, (UltraGridBand)y);
			}

			private int Compare(UltraGridBand bandX, UltraGridBand bandY)
			{
				if (bandX == bandY)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (bandX == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (bandY == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (bandX.IsRootBand)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (bandY.IsRootBand)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				int hierarchicalLevel = bandX.HierarchicalLevel;
				int hierarchicalLevel2 = bandY.HierarchicalLevel;
				int num;
				if (hierarchicalLevel < hierarchicalLevel2)
				{
					num = Compare(bandX, bandY.ParentBand);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						return num;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				if (hierarchicalLevel > hierarchicalLevel2)
				{
					num = Compare(bandX.ParentBand, bandY);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						return num;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				num = Compare(bandX.ParentBand, bandY.ParentBand);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				num = bandX.VisiblePosition.CompareTo(bandY.VisiblePosition);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return bandX.Index.CompareTo(bandY.Index);
			}
		}

		private int CalculateBandMetrics(int pass)
		{
			int num = 0;
			UltraGridBand priorBand = null;
			bool flag = layout != null && layout.Grid != null && layout.Grid.DesignMode;
			int num2 = ((Count > 0) ? this[0].GetExtent() : 0);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = this[i];
				if (!ultraGridBand.HiddenResolved || (flag && ultraGridBand.UseRowLayoutResolved))
				{
					if (1 != pass || AllowColSizing.Synchronized == ultraGridBand.AllowColSizingResolved)
					{
						ultraGridBand.CalculateBandMetrics(priorBand);
					}
					priorBand = ultraGridBand;
				}
			}
			if (pass == 0)
			{
				if (Layout != null)
				{
					Layout.ClearSynchronizedColLists();
				}
			}
			else if (Count > 1)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < Count; j++)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand2 = this[j];
					if (!ultraGridBand2.HiddenResolved && !ultraGridBand2.CardView)
					{
						ultraGridBand2.SynchronizeColWidths();
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < Count; k++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand3 = this[k];
				if (!ultraGridBand3.HiddenResolved)
				{
					ultraGridBand3.UpdateExclusizeColRegionWidths();
				}
			}
			if (-2 == pass)
			{
				Layout.ViewStyleImpl.FitColumnsToWidth();
				pass = -1;
			}
			if (-1 == pass)
			{
				Layout.ViewStyleImpl.FitColumnsToWidth();
			}
			else if (pass == 0)
			{
				Layout.ViewStyleImpl.FitColumnsToWidth();
				Layout.synchronizedColListsDirty = true;
				CalculateBandMetrics(1);
			}
			for (int l = 0; l < Count; l++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand4 = this[l];
				if (!ultraGridBand4.HiddenResolved)
				{
					int num3 = ultraGridBand4.GetOrigin() + ultraGridBand4.GetExtent();
					if (num3 > num)
					{
						num = num3;
					}
					if (!Layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			int num4 = ((Count > 0) ? this[0].GetExtent() : 0);
			if (num2 != num4 && Layout.Grid is UltraDropDownBase ultraDropDownBase && pass != 0)
			{
				ultraDropDownBase.ReCalculateDropDownSize(resizeDropDownForm: true, dirtyMetrics: false);
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (Layout != null)
			{
				Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
			}
			if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.Indentation:
				case PropertyIds.IndentationGroupByRow:
				case PropertyIds.IndentationGroupByRowExpansionIndicator:
					layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
					if (layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false) != null)
					{
						layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics();
					}
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Groups:
				case PropertyIds.Hidden:
				case PropertyIds.CardView:
					layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
					layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
					if (layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false) != null)
					{
						layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics();
					}
					layout.BumpScrollableRowCountVersion();
					layout.BumpFixedRowsCollectionsVersion();
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(layout);
					break;
				case PropertyIds.RowLayoutStyle:
					if (layout != null)
					{
						layout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
						layout.ClearBandRowHeightMetrics(null);
						layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
						layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
						if (layout.ColScrollRegions != null)
						{
							layout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
						}
					}
					break;
				case PropertyIds.LevelCount:
					layout.ClearBandRowHeightMetrics(null);
					layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
					layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
					if (layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false) != null)
					{
						layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics();
					}
					break;
				case PropertyIds.AutoPreviewEnabled:
				case PropertyIds.AutoPreviewField:
				case PropertyIds.AutoPreviewMaxLines:
				case PropertyIds.ColHeaderLines:
				case PropertyIds.ColHeadersVisible:
				case PropertyIds.Expandable:
				case PropertyIds.GroupHeaderLines:
				case PropertyIds.GroupHeadersVisible:
				case PropertyIds.HeaderVisible:
				case PropertyIds.SummaryFooterCaption:
				case PropertyIds.SpecialRowPromptField:
					layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
					layout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
					layout.RowScrollRegions.DirtyAllVisibleRows();
					layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
					break;
				case PropertyIds.AddButtonCaption:
					layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false);
					break;
				case PropertyIds.RowEditTemplate:
					layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics();
					break;
				case PropertyIds.VisiblePosition:
					BumpSortedBandsVersion();
					layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
					layout.Grid.RefreshColumnChoosers();
					break;
				default:
					layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false);
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Columns:
					break;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Band, propChange);
		}

		public void DirtyOrigins()
		{
			originsDirty = true;
		}

		internal UltraGridBand InternalAdd(UltraGridBand parentBand, UltraGridColumn parentColumn, UltraGridBand[] oldBands)
		{
			bool newBandCreated;
			return InternalAdd(parentBand, parentColumn, oldBands, out newBandCreated);
		}

		internal UltraGridBand InternalAdd(UltraGridBand parentBand, UltraGridColumn parentColumn, UltraGridBand[] oldBands, out bool newBandCreated)
		{
			newBandCreated = false;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = null;
			if (oldBands != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < oldBands.Length; i++)
				{
					if (oldBands[i] != null && oldBands[i].ParentColumn == parentColumn)
					{
						ultraGridBand = oldBands[i];
						oldBands[i] = null;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ultraGridBand == null)
			{
				ultraGridBand = new UltraGridBand(layout, parentBand, parentColumn);
				newBandCreated = true;
			}
			ultraGridBand.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			int num = ((parentBand != null) ? IndexOf(parentBand) : (-1));
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				for (num++; num < Count && this[num].IsDescendantOfBand(parentBand); num++)
				{
				}
				InternalInsert(num, ultraGridBand);
			}
			else
			{
				InternalAdd(ultraGridBand);
			}
			parentBand?.BumpColumnsVersion();
			BumpSortedBandsVersion();
			return ultraGridBand;
		}

		internal UltraGridBand FindBand(UltraGridColumn chapteredColumn)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].ParentColumn == chapteredColumn)
				{
					return this[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			band.UnWireDataSource();
			band.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			int num = IndexOf(band);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				InternalRemoveAt(num);
			}
			if (band != null && band.ParentBand != null)
			{
				band.ParentBand.BumpColumnsVersion();
			}
			if (Layout != null)
			{
				Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
				Layout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
				Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
				Layout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
			}
			BumpSortedBandsVersion();
		}

		internal UltraGridBand[] ClearAllButBandZero()
		{
			UltraGridBand[] array = null;
			if (Count > 1)
			{
				array = new UltraGridBand[Count - 1];
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					array[i] = this[i + 1];
					array[i].UnWireDataSource();
					array[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				List.RemoveRange(1, Count - 1);
			}
			BumpSortedBandsVersion();
			return array;
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			if (Layout == null || this != Layout.LoadedBandsInternal)
			{
				{
					BandEnumerator bandEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (bandEnumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							UltraGridBand current = bandEnumerator.Current;
							current.UnWireDataSource();
							current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = bandEnumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			BumpSortedBandsVersion();
		}

		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			PropertyCategories propertyCategories = ((context.Context is PropertyCategories) ? ((PropertyCategories)context.Context) : PropertyCategories.All);
			if ((propertyCategories & PropertyCategories.Bands) != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
				}
				SerializeTag(info);
			}
		}

		protected BandsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if ((((context.Context is PropertyCategories) ? ((PropertyCategories)context.Context) : PropertyCategories.All) & PropertyCategories.Bands) == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			layout = null;
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(UltraGridBand))
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = (UltraGridBand)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraGridBand), null);
					if (ultraGridBand != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(ultraGridBand);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		{
			InitLayout(layout, calledFromEndInit: false);
		}

		internal void InitLayout(UltraGridLayout layout, bool calledFromEndInit)
		{
			this.layout = layout;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i].InitLayout(this.layout, calledFromEndInit);
				if (!calledFromEndInit)
				{
					this[i].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void InitializeParentBandPointers(BandsCollection source)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < source.Count; i++)
			{
				int parentIndex = source[i].ParentIndex;
				if (source[i].ParentBand == null && parentIndex != -1)
				{
					source[i].SetParentBand(source[parentIndex]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(BandsCollection source, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.Tag;
			}
			InitializeParentBandPointers(source);
			if (Layout.IsDisplayLayout || Layout.IsPrintLayout || Layout.IsExportLayout)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = ((Count > 0) ? this[0] : null);
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand2 = ((source.Count > 0) ? source[0] : null);
				if (ultraGridBand == null || ultraGridBand2 == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ultraGridBand.CanInitializeFrom(ultraGridBand2))
				{
					InitBandWithChildren(source, ultraGridBand2, ultraGridBand, categories);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!Layout.IsApplyingLayout || (Layout.NewColumnLoadStyleInEffect == NewColumnLoadStyle.Show && Layout.NewBandLoadStyleInEffect == NewBandLoadStyle.Show) || !ultraGridBand.HasColumnsBeenAllocated)
					{
						return;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < ultraGridBand.Columns.Count; i++)
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ultraGridBand.Columns[i];
						if (ultraGridColumn != null && NewColumnLoadStyle.Hide == Layout.NewColumnLoadStyleInEffect)
						{
							ultraGridColumn.Hidden = true;
						}
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < Count; j++)
					{
						UltraGridBand ultraGridBand3 = this[j];
						if (ultraGridBand3 != null && ultraGridBand3 != ultraGridBand && NewBandLoadStyle.Hide == Layout.NewBandLoadStyleInEffect)
						{
							ultraGridBand3.Hidden = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Clear();
				if (source.Count >= 1)
				{
					CopyBandWithChildren(source, source[0], null, categories);
				}
			}
		}

		internal object Clone()
		{
			BandsCollection bandsCollection = new BandsCollection(layout);
			bandsCollection.InitializeFrom(this, PropertyCategories.All);
			return bandsCollection;
		}

		internal void CopyBandWithChildren(BandsCollection sourceBands, UltraGridBand source, UltraGridBand parentBand, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			UltraGridColumn parentColumn = null;
			if (parentBand != null && source.ParentColumn != null)
			{
				int index = source.ParentColumn.Index;
				index--;
				if (index >= 0)
				{
					parentColumn = parentBand.Columns[index];
				}
			}
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = new UltraGridBand(layout, parentBand, parentColumn);
			InternalAdd(ultraGridBand);
			ultraGridBand.InitializeFrom(source, categories);
			for (int i = 0; i < sourceBands.Count; i++)
			{
				if (sourceBands[i].ParentBand == source)
				{
					CopyBandWithChildren(sourceBands, sourceBands[i], ultraGridBand, categories);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitBandWithChildren(BandsCollection sourceBands, UltraGridBand source, UltraGridBand target, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			target.InitializeFrom(source, categories);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].ParentBand != target)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < sourceBands.Count; j++)
				{
					if (sourceBands[j].ParentBand == source && this[i].CanInitializeFrom(sourceBands[j]))
					{
						InitBandWithChildren(sourceBands, sourceBands[j], this[i], categories);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalCopyFromBandsSerializer(BandsSerializer source, bool clearSource)
		{
			InternalCopyFromBandsSerializer(source, clearSource, calledFromEndInit: false);
		}

		internal void InternalCopyFromBandsSerializer(BandsSerializer source, bool clearSource, bool calledFromEndInit)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			int num = 0;
			while (flag && num < source.Count)
			{
				flag = source[num].addedInBandsSerializer;
				num++;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			Clear();
			while (source.Count > 0 && source[0].addedInBandsSerializer)
			{
				source.InternalRemoveAt(0);
			}
			for (num = 0; num < source.Count; num++)
			{
				if (source[num] != null)
				{
					InternalAdd(source[num]);
					source[num].InitLayout(layout, calledFromEndInit);
					source[num].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					source[num].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			if (clearSource)
			{
				source.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridBand GetChildBand(UltraGridColumn chapteredColumn)
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = null;
			int num = 0;
			while (ultraGridBand == null && num < Count)
			{
				if (chapteredColumn == this[num].ParentColumn)
				{
					ultraGridBand = this[num];
				}
				num++;
			}
			return ultraGridBand;
		}

		private void BumpSortedBandsVersion()
		{
			if (layout != null)
			{
				layout.BumpSortedBandsVersion();
			}
		}

		private void VerifySortedBands()
		{
			if (isInVerifySortedBands || !sort || layout == null || lastGoodSortedBandsVersion == layout.sortedBandsVersion)
			{
				return;
			}
			BandsCollection bands = layout.Bands;
			isInVerifySortedBands = true;
			try
			{
				List.Clear();
				foreach (UltraGridBand item in bands)
				{
					List.Add(item);
				}
				Utilities.SortMerge(List, (IComparer)new BandSortComparer());
				lastGoodSortedBandsVersion = layout.sortedBandsVersion;
			}
			finally
			{
				isInVerifySortedBands = false;
			}
		}

		internal void DirtyCachedContainsCheckboxOnTopOrBottom()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i].DirtyCachedContainsCheckboxOnTopOrBottom();
			}
		}

		internal void BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion()
		{
			BandEnumerator bandEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (bandEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraGridBand current = bandEnumerator.Current;
					current.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = bandEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}

						rect.X--;
						rectInsideBorders.Width -= rect.Width + 1;
						break;
					default:
						rect.X++;
						rectInsideBorders.Width -= rect.Width + 1;
						rectInsideBorders.X += rect.Width + 1;
						break;
					case 1:
						break;
					}
					((UIElement)val2).Rect = rect;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)val2);
				}
			}
			((UIElement)val).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)val);
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolveAppearanceContext context = new ResolveAppearanceContext(typeof(UltraGridLayout), requestedProps);
			context.IsCaption = true;
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = ((UltraGridBase)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).DisplayLayout;
			context.Role = StyleUtils.GetRole(displayLayout, StyleUtils.Role.GridCaption, out context.ResolutionOrder);
			displayLayout.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref context);
		}
	}

					return;
				}

				lastProcessedResizeDelta = newDeltaY;
			}
			int cardAreaHeight = heightAtStartOfResize + newDeltaY;
			int cardAreaHeight2 = Rows.CardAreaHeight;
			Rows.CardAreaHeight = cardAreaHeight;
			if (Rows.CardAreaHeight != cardAreaHeight2)
			{
				InvalidateAfterCardAreaResize();
			}
		}

			int num = Math.Abs(delta);
			ScrollBarAction val = (ScrollBarAction)0;
			val = ((delta >= 0) ? ((ScrollBarAction)((num > 100) ? 4 : 2)) : ((ScrollBarAction)((num > 100) ? 5 : 3)));
			HScrollBarInfo.PerformAction(val);
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			//IL_0112: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0119: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01bc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01c3: Expected O, but got Unknown
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			Rectangle rect = rectInsideBorders;
			hScrollbarElement = null;
			vScrollbarElement = null;
			int verticalScrollBarWidth = VerticalScrollBarWidth;
			int horizontalScrollBarHeight = HorizontalScrollBarHeight;
			if (!RowLayoutDesignerElement)
			{
				int cardAreaHorizontalScrollbarHeightResolved = Band.CardAreaHorizontalScrollbarHeightResolved;
				int cardAreaHeight = rectInsideBorders.Height - cardAreaHorizontalScrollbarHeightResolved;
				int heightRequired = 0;
				bool flag = (hasVerticalScrollbar = NeedsVerticalScrollbar(cardAreaHeight, out heightRequired));
				if (Band.Index != 0 && flag && !AutoFit)
				{
					int num = CalculateRequiredCardAreaWidth(rectInsideBorders.Width + verticalScrollBarWidth);
					if (num > rectInsideBorders.Width)
					{
						Rectangle rect2 = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
						rect2.Width += verticalScrollBarWidth;
						((UIElement)this).Rect = rect2;
						rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
						rect = rectInsideBorders;
					}
				}
				ResetHorizontalScrollBarMetricsAndValue();
				if (Rows != null && Rows.IsCardAreaHorizontalScrollbarVisible)
				{
					object obj = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(ScrollBarUIElement), true);
					ScrollBarUIElement val = (ScrollBarUIElement)((obj is ScrollBarUIElement) ? obj : null);
					if (val == null)
					{
						val = new ScrollBarUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, HScrollBarInfo);
					}
					hScrollbarElement = val;
					Rectangle rect3 = rectInsideBorders;
					rect3.Y = rect3.Bottom - horizontalScrollBarHeight;
					rect3.Height = horizontalScrollBarHeight;
					if (flag)
					{
						rect3.Width -= verticalScrollBarWidth;
					}
					((UIElement)val).Rect = rect3;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)val);
					rect.Height -= rect3.Height;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					ResetVerticalScrollBarMetricsAndValue(cardAreaHeight, heightRequired);
					if (!IsPrinting)
					{
						object obj2 = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(ScrollBarUIElement), true);
						ScrollBarUIElement val2 = (ScrollBarUIElement)((obj2 is ScrollBarUIElement) ? obj2 : null);
						if (val2 == null)
						{
							val2 = new ScrollBarUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, VScrollBarInfo);
						}
						vScrollbarElement = val2;
						Rectangle rect4 = rectInsideBorders;
						rect4.X = rectInsideBorders.Right - verticalScrollBarWidth;
						rect4.Width = verticalScrollBarWidth;
						rect4.Height -= cardAreaHorizontalScrollbarHeightResolved;
						((UIElement)val2).Rect = rect4;
						((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)val2);
						rect.Width -= rect4.Width;
					}
				}
				else if (vScrollBarInfo != null)
				{
					vScrollBarInfo.Scroll -= ScrollHandler;
					vScrollBarInfo.ValueChanged -= ScrollValueChangedHandler;
					((DisposableObject)(object)vScrollBarInfo).Dispose();
					vScrollBarInfo = null;
				}
			}
			CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement = UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement), true) as CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement;
			if (cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement == null)
			{
				cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement = new CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
			}
			((UIElement)cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement).Rect = rect;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement);
			NotifyCalcManagerHelper(onlyIfFirstCardChanged: true);

		internal void MaintainScrollPositionHelper()
		{
			if (hScrollBarInfo != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)hScrollBarInfo).Disposed)

				scrollBarPositionToMaintain = hScrollBarInfo.Value;
