		private int GetTotalColsInCardArea(int cardAreaWidth)
		{
			if (FixedHeight)
			{
				int num = Rows.VisibleRowCount / TotalRowsInCardArea;
				if (Rows.VisibleRowCount % TotalRowsInCardArea != 0)
				{
					num++;
				}
				int totalColsInCardArea = Band.GetTotalColsInCardArea(cardAreaWidth);
				return Math.Min(totalColsInCardArea, num);
			}
			return GetTotalColumnsNeededWithAdjustment(FirstVisibleRow, Band.GetTotalColsInCardArea(cardAreaWidth));
		}

		private int GetTotalVisibleCards(int totalColsInCardArea)
		{
			if (FixedHeight)
			{
				return Math.Min(Rows.VisibleRowCount - FirstVisibleRowIndex, TotalRowsInCardArea * totalColsInCardArea);
			}
			return NumberOfVariableHeightCardsDisplayableInColumns(totalColsInCardArea);
		}

		internal int CalculateRequiredCardAreaWidth(int availableWidth)
		{
			if (AutoFit)
			{
				return availableWidth;
			}
			int num = (availableWidth - Band.CardMergedLabelAreaWidth - 2 * Band.CardAreaMarginsResolved) / Band.CardWidthResolved;
			if (Band.CardSettings.MaxCardAreaCols > 0)
			{
				num = Math.Min(Band.CardSettings.MaxCardAreaCols, num);
			}
			int totalColumnsNeededWithAdjustment = GetTotalColumnsNeededWithAdjustment(FirstVisibleRow, num);
			totalColumnsNeededWithAdjustment = Math.Max(totalColumnsNeededWithAdjustment, 1);
			int num2 = Band.CalculateRequiredCardAreaWidth(totalColumnsNeededWithAdjustment);
			while (num2 > availableWidth && totalColumnsNeededWithAdjustment > 1)
			{
				totalColumnsNeededWithAdjustment--;
				num2 = Band.CalculateRequiredCardAreaWidth(totalColumnsNeededWithAdjustment);
			}
			int cardAreaHeight = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders.Height - Band.CardAreaHorizontalScrollbarHeightResolved;
			if (NeedsVerticalScrollbar(cardAreaHeight))
			{
				num2 += VerticalScrollBarWidth;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		internal bool DoesDragNeedScrollHorizontal(Point mouseLoc, ref int timerInterval)
		{
			DoesDragNeedScroll(mouseLoc, ref timerInterval, out var needsToScrollHorizontally, out var _);
			return needsToScrollHorizontally;
		}

		internal bool DoesDragNeedScrollVertical(Point mouseLoc, ref int timerInterval)
		{
			DoesDragNeedScroll(mouseLoc, ref timerInterval, out var _, out var needsToScrollVertically);
			return needsToScrollVertically;
		}

		internal void ScrollCardVertically(Point mouseLoc)
		{
			if (!HasVerticalScrollbar || VScrollBarInfo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			ScrollBarInfo val = VScrollBarInfo;
			int minimum = val.Minimum;
			int num = val.Maximum;
			if (val.LargeChange > 0)
			{
				num -= val.LargeChange - 1;
			}
			if (minimum < num)
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				if (mouseLoc.Y < rectInsideBorders.Y)
				{
					num2 = -10;
				}
				else if (mouseLoc.Y > rectInsideBorders.Bottom)
				{
					num2 = 10;
				}
				int cardAreaScrollRegionVerticalOffset = Math.Min(num, Math.Max(minimum, CardAreaScrollRegionVerticalOffset + num2));
				CardAreaScrollRegionVerticalOffset = cardAreaScrollRegionVerticalOffset;
			}
		}

		private void DoesDragNeedScroll(Point mouseLoc, ref int timerInterval, out bool needsToScrollHorizontally, out bool needsToScrollVertically)
		{
			needsToScrollHorizontally = false;
			needsToScrollVertically = false;
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			UltraGridBase grid = ultraGridBand.Layout.Grid;

		internal UltraGridRow GetLastCardInColumnContainingRow(UltraGridRow targetRow)

		internal UltraGridRow GetRelatedVisibleCard(UltraGridRow row, NavigateType navType, bool includeNonActivateable)
		{
			switch (navType)
			{
			case NavigateType.Above:
				if (GetFirstCardInColumnContainingRow(row) == row)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(row, -1);
			case NavigateType.Below:
				if (GetLastCardInColumnContainingRow(row) == row)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(row, 1);
			case NavigateType.Bottommost:
				return GetLastCardInColumnContainingRow(row);
			case NavigateType.First:
				return Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow();
			case NavigateType.Last:
				return Rows.GetLastVisibleRow();
			case NavigateType.Next:
				return Rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(row, 1);
			case NavigateType.Prev:
				return Rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(row, -1);
			case NavigateType.Topmost:
				return GetFirstCardInColumnContainingRow(row);
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal int GetTotalColumnsNeeded(UltraGridRow firstVisibleRow, int maxAvailableColumns)
		{

					num3 -= ultraGridRow.CardHeight + Band.CardSpacingVertical;

					{
						flag = false;
					}

				}

		}

		internal int GetTotalColumnsNeededWithAdjustment(UltraGridRow firstVisibleRow, int maxAvailableColumns)
		{
			int num = 0;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = FirstVisibleRow;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = FirstVisibleRow;
			while (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.VisibleIndex >= 0 && num <= maxAvailableColumns)

				}

		private bool CanFitAllVisibleRows()

		private bool CanFitAllVisibleRows(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			if (rows != null)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = rows.Band;
				int totalColsInCardArea = ultraGridBand.GetTotalColsInCardArea(((UIElement)this).Rect.Width);
				int totalRowsInCardArea = ultraGridBand.GetTotalRowsInCardArea(((UIElement)this).Rect.Height);
				if (totalColsInCardArea * totalRowsInCardArea >= rows.VisibleRowCount)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal void InitializeRow(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext != null)
			{
				RowsCollection rowsCollection = (RowsCollection)((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext;
				if (rowsCollection != row.ParentCollection)
				{

					((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = null;
				}
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = row?.ParentCollection.InternalFirstVisibleCard;
			if (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.VisibleIndex < 0)
			{
				if (CanFitAllVisibleRows(row.ParentCollection))
				{
					row.ParentCollection.FirstVisibleCard = row.ParentCollection.GetFirstVisibleRow();
				}
				firstVisibleRow = row.ParentCollection.FirstVisibleCard;
			}
			else if (row != null && CanFitAllVisibleRows(row.ParentCollection))
			{
				if (CanFitAllVisibleRows(row.ParentCollection))
				{
					row.ParentCollection.FirstVisibleCard = row.ParentCollection.GetFirstVisibleRow();
				}
				firstVisibleRow = row.ParentCollection.FirstVisibleCard;
			}
			if (((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext == null)
			{
				((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = row.ParentCollection;
				firstVisibleRow = row.ParentCollection.FirstVisibleCard;
				band = row.Band;
				row.ParentCollection.SubObjectPropChanged += SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			else if (row != null && row.ParentCollection != null)
			{
				firstVisibleRow = row.ParentCollection.FirstVisibleCard;
			}
			if (RowLayoutDesignerElement && row != null && row.ParentCollection != null && row.ParentCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				firstVisibleRow = row.ParentCollection[0];
			}
		}

		internal void ResetHorizontalScrollBarMetricsAndValue()
		{
			if (RowLayoutDesignerElement)

				return;
			}
			HScrollBarInfo.ScrollBarLook = ((Band != null) ? Band.Layout.ScrollBarLook : null);
			if (CardStyle.Compressed == Band.CardSettings.StyleResolved)
			{
				if (!currentlyScrolling)

					int val = Rows.CalculateCardAreaScrollRange(HeightAvailableForCards, FirstVisibleRowIndex, out scrollBarValue);
					HScrollBarInfo.Minimum = 0;
					HScrollBarInfo.SmallChange = 1;
					HScrollBarInfo.LargeChange = Math.Max(1, TotalColsInCardArea);
					HScrollBarInfo.Maximum = Math.Max(HScrollBarInfo.Minimum, Math.Min(val, visibleRowCount - 1));
					bool flag = false;
					bool flag2 = false;
					int num = ((FirstVisibleRow != null) ? FirstVisibleRow.VisibleIndex : (-1));
					if (num < 0)
					{
						flag2 = (flag = true);
					}
					else
					{
						if (num == 0)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
						if (num + totalVisibleCards >= visibleRowCount)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					if (flag && flag2)
					{
						HScrollBarInfo.Enabled = false;
					}
					else
					{
						HScrollBarInfo.Enabled = true;
						if (flag2)
						{
							HScrollBarInfo.Value = 0;
						}
						else if (flag)
						{
							HScrollBarInfo.Value = HScrollBarInfo.Maximum - HScrollBarInfo.LargeChange + 1;
						}
						else
						{
							if (scrollBarValue <= HScrollBarInfo.Minimum)
							{
								scrollBarValue = 1 + HScrollBarInfo.Minimum;
							}
							if (scrollBarValue > HScrollBarInfo.Maximum)
							{
								scrollBarValue = HScrollBarInfo.Maximum;
							}
							HScrollBarInfo.Value = scrollBarValue;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				HScrollBarInfo.SmallChange = 1;
				HScrollBarInfo.LargeChange = Math.Max(1, TotalColsInCardArea);
				HScrollBarInfo.Minimum = 0;
				if (Rows.VisibleRowCount < 1 || FirstVisibleRowIndex < 0)
				{
					HScrollBarInfo.Maximum = 0;
					HScrollBarInfo.Value = 0;
					HScrollBarInfo.Enabled = false;
					return;
				}
				if (FixedHeight)
				{
					HScrollBarInfo.Maximum = (Rows.VisibleRowCount + TotalRowsInCardArea - 1) / TotalRowsInCardArea - 1;
					int num2 = FirstVisibleRowIndex;
					if (!IsPrinting)
					{
						while (num2 > 0 && num2 / TotalRowsInCardArea > HScrollBarInfo.Maximum + 1 - HScrollBarInfo.LargeChange)
						{
							num2 = Math.Max(0, num2 - TotalRowsInCardArea);
							firstVisibleRow = Rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndex(num2);
						}
					}
					int totalRowsInCardArea = TotalRowsInCardArea;
					HScrollBarInfo.Value = num2 / totalRowsInCardArea;
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						if (HScrollBarInfo.Value <= HScrollBarInfo.Minimum)
						{
							int num3 = 1 + HScrollBarInfo.Minimum;
							HScrollBarInfo.Maximum = Math.Max(1 + num3, HScrollBarInfo.Maximum);
							HScrollBarInfo.Value = num3;
						}
						HScrollBarInfo.Enabled = true;
					}
					else if (HScrollBarInfo.Minimum == HScrollBarInfo.Maximum + 1 - HScrollBarInfo.LargeChange)
					{
						HScrollBarInfo.Enabled = false;
					}
					else
					{
						HScrollBarInfo.Enabled = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int totalVisibleCards2 = TotalVisibleCards;
					if (FirstVisibleRowIndex == 0 && totalVisibleCards2 == Rows.VisibleRowCount)
					{
						HScrollBarInfo.Enabled = false;
					}
					else
					{
						HScrollBarInfo.Enabled = true;
						int num4 = Math.Max(1, TotalVisibleCards / TotalColsInCardArea);
						HScrollBarInfo.Maximum = (Rows.VisibleRowCount + num4 - 1) / num4 - 1;
						bool flag3 = false;
						if (FirstVisibleRow.VisibleIndex + TotalVisibleCards >= Rows.VisibleRowCount)
						{
							flag3 = true;
						}
						if (flag3)
						{
							HScrollBarInfo.Value = HScrollBarInfo.Maximum - HScrollBarInfo.LargeChange + 1;
						}

		}

		internal void ScrollCardIntoView(UltraGridRow rowToScroll, bool exitEditMode)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = firstVisibleRow;
			RowUIElementBase rowUIElementBase = null;
			int num = 0;

			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement).ChildElements).Count; i++)
			{
				if (((UIElement)cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement).ChildElements[i] is RowUIElementBase)
				{
					rowUIElementBase = ((UIElement)cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement).ChildElements[i] as RowUIElementBase;
					if (rowUIElementBase.Row == rowToScroll && !((UIElement)rowUIElementBase).ClipRect.IsEmpty)
					{
						return;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (exitEditMode && Band.Layout.ActiveCell != null)
			{
				Band.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper();
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = GetFirstCardInColumnContainingRow(rowToScroll);
			if (ultraGridRow2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (num > 1 && ultraGridRow.Index < ultraGridRow2.Index)
			{
				UltraGridRow columnRelativeToColumn = GetColumnRelativeToColumn(ultraGridRow2, -1 * (TotalColsInCardArea - 1));
				if (columnRelativeToColumn != null)
				{
					ultraGridRow2 = columnRelativeToColumn;
				}
			}
			Rows.FirstVisibleCard = ultraGridRow2;
			RefreshFirstVisibleCard();
		}

		private bool NeedsVerticalScrollbar(int cardAreaHeight)
		{
			int heightRequired = 0;
			return NeedsVerticalScrollbar(cardAreaHeight, out heightRequired);
		}

		private bool NeedsVerticalScrollbar(int cardAreaHeight, out int heightRequired)
		{
			heightRequired = 0;
			int totalRowsInCardArea = TotalRowsInCardArea;
			if (totalRowsInCardArea != 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if (VariableHeight)
			{
				int firstVisibleRowIndex = FirstVisibleRowIndex;
				int totalColsInCardArea = TotalColsInCardArea;
				for (int i = firstVisibleRowIndex; i < firstVisibleRowIndex + totalColsInCardArea; i++)
				{
					UltraGridRow rowAtVisibleIndex = Rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndex(i);
					if (rowAtVisibleIndex != null)
					{
						heightRequired = Math.Max(heightRequired, rowAtVisibleIndex.CardHeight);
					}
				}
				heightRequired += ultraGridBand.CardAreaMarginsResolved;
			}
			else if (Compressed)
			{
				int firstVisibleRowIndex2 = FirstVisibleRowIndex;
				int totalVisibleCards = TotalVisibleCards;
				for (int j = firstVisibleRowIndex2; j < firstVisibleRowIndex2 + totalVisibleCards; j++)
				{
					UltraGridRow rowAtVisibleIndex2 = Rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndex(j);
					if (rowAtVisibleIndex2 != null)
					{
						heightRequired = Math.Max(heightRequired, rowAtVisibleIndex2.CardHeight);
					}
				}
				heightRequired += ultraGridBand.CardAreaMarginsResolved;
			}
			else
			{
				heightRequired = ultraGridBand.CardHeight + ultraGridBand.CardAreaMarginsResolved;
			}
			return heightRequired > cardAreaHeight;
		}

		}

		internal bool OnMouseWheel(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ScrollBarAction val = (ScrollBarAction)((e.Delta > 0) ? 3 : 2);

				{
					autoFit = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AutoFit);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridCardSettings_P_Style")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public CardStyle Style
		{
			get
			{
				return style;
			}
			set
			{
				if (style == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CardStyle), value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_86"));
				}
				if (band != null && band.Layout != null && width != 0 && (band == null || !band.UseRowLayoutResolved))
				{
					if (style == CardStyle.MergedLabels)
					{
						Width = band.CardWidthResolved + band.CardLabelWidthResolved;
					}
					else if (value == CardStyle.MergedLabels)
					{
						Width = band.CardWidthResolved - band.CardLabelWidthResolved;
					}
				}
				style = value;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CardStyle, null);
			}
		}

		internal CardStyle StyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (CardStyle.VariableHeight == Style && band != null && band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					return CardStyle.StandardLabels;
				}
				return Style;
			}
		}

		public CardScrollbars CardScrollbars
		{
			get
			{
				return cardScrollbars;
			}
			set
			{
				if (cardScrollbars != value)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(CardScrollbars), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("CardScrollbars", (int)value, typeof(CardScrollbars));
					}
					cardScrollbars = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CardScrollbars);
				}
			}
		}

		public UltraGridCardSettings(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			this.band = band;
			Reset();
		}

		protected UltraGridCardSettings(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Reset();
			band = null;
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "AllowLabelSizing":
					AllowLabelSizing = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), AllowLabelSizing);
					break;
				case "AllowSizing":
					AllowSizing = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), AllowSizing);
					break;
				case "AutoFit":
					AutoFit = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), AutoFit);
					break;
				case "CaptionField":
					CaptionField = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), CaptionField);
					break;
				case "CaptionLines":
					CaptionLines = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), CaptionLines);
					break;
				case "LabelWidth":
					LabelWidth = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), LabelWidth);
					break;
				case "MaxCardAreaCols":
					MaxCardAreaCols = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), MaxCardAreaCols);
					break;
				case "MaxCardAreaRows":
					MaxCardAreaRows = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), MaxCardAreaRows);
					break;
				case "ShowCaption":
					ShowCaption = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), ShowCaption);
					break;
				case "Style":
					Style = (CardStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(CardStyle), Style);
					break;
				case "Width":
					Width = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), Width);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "CardScrollbars":
					CardScrollbars = (CardScrollbars)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(CardScrollbars), cardScrollbars);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowLabelSizing())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowLabelSizing", allowLabelSizing);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAllowSizing())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowSizing", allowSizing);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAutoFit())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AutoFit", autoFit);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCaptionField())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CaptionField", captionField);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCaptionLines())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CaptionLines", captionLines);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLabelWidth())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LabelWidth", labelWidth);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMaxCardAreaCols())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaxCardAreaCols", maxCardAreaCols);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeMaxCardAreaRows())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "MaxCardAreaRows", maxCardAreaRows);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeShowCaption())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ShowCaption", showCaption);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Style", style);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeWidth())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Width", width);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCardScrollbars())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CardScrollbars", CardScrollbars);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetAllowLabelSizing();
			ResetAllowSizing();
			ResetAutoFit();
			ResetCaptionField();
			ResetCaptionLines();
			ResetLabelWidth();
			ResetMaxCardAreaCols();
			ResetMaxCardAreaRows();
			ResetShowCaption();
			ResetStyle();
			ResetWidth();
			ResetCardScrollbars();
		}

		public void ResetCardScrollbars()
		{
			CardScrollbars = CardScrollbars.Horizontal;
		}

		public void ResetWidth()
		{
			Width = 0;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public void ResetStyle()
		{
			Style = CardStyle.MergedLabels;
		}

		public void ResetShowCaption()
		{
			ShowCaption = true;
		}

		public void ResetMaxCardAreaRows()
		{
			MaxCardAreaRows = 0;
		}

		public void ResetMaxCardAreaCols()
		{
			MaxCardAreaCols = 0;
		}

		public void ResetLabelWidth()
		{
			LabelWidth = 0;
		}

		public void ResetCaptionLines()
		{
			CaptionLines = 1;
		}

		public void ResetCaptionField()
		{
			CaptionField = null;
		}

		public void ResetAutoFit()
		{
			AutoFit = false;
		}

		public void ResetAllowSizing()
		{
			AllowSizing = true;
		}

		public void ResetAllowLabelSizing()
		{
			AllowLabelSizing = true;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAllowLabelSizing() && !ShouldSerializeAllowSizing() && !ShouldSerializeAutoFit() && !ShouldSerializeCaptionField() && !ShouldSerializeCaptionLines() && !ShouldSerializeLabelWidth() && !ShouldSerializeMaxCardAreaCols() && !ShouldSerializeMaxCardAreaRows() && !ShouldSerializeShowCaption() && !ShouldSerializeStyle() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeWidth())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeCardScrollbars();
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeCardScrollbars()
		{
			return CardScrollbars.Horizontal != cardScrollbars;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeWidth()
		{
			return width != 0;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeStyle()
		{
			return style != CardStyle.MergedLabels;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeShowCaption()
		{
			return !showCaption;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeMaxCardAreaRows()
		{
			return maxCardAreaRows > 0;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeMaxCardAreaCols()
		{
			return maxCardAreaCols > 0;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeLabelWidth()
		{
			return labelWidth != 0;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeCaptionLines()
		{
			return captionLines > 1;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAutoFit()
		{
			return autoFit;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAllowSizing()
		{
			return !allowSizing;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAllowLabelSizing()
		{
			return !allowLabelSizing;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeCaptionField()
		{
			if (captionField != null)
			{
				return captionField.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InitBand(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			this.band = band;
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(UltraGridCardSettings source, PropertyCategories propertyCategories)
		{
			allowLabelSizing = source.allowLabelSizing;
			allowSizing = source.allowSizing;
			autoFit = source.autoFit;
			captionField = source.captionField;
			captionLines = source.captionLines;
			labelWidth = source.labelWidth;
			maxCardAreaCols = source.maxCardAreaCols;
			maxCardAreaRows = source.maxCardAreaRows;
			showCaption = source.showCaption;
			style = source.style;
			width = source.width;
			cardScrollbars = source.cardScrollbars;
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.Tag;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	public class UltraGridCell : ActivateableGridItemBase, IKeyedSubObjectEx, IKeyedSubObject
	{
		public class CellAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private UltraGridCell cell;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = cell.GetUIElement(cell.Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion, cell.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion, verifyElements: true);
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return uIElement.Control?.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.ClipRect) ?? Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction
			{
				get
				{
					if (!cell.Column.HiddenResolved && cell.ActivationResolvedInternal != Activation.Disabled)
					{
						if (cell.CanEnterEditMode)
						{
							return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Cell_Editable");
						}
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Cell");
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public override string Description => null;

			public override string Help => null;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return cell.Column.Header.Caption;
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent => cell.Row.AccessibilityObject;

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.Cell;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					if (cell.InternalHidden || cell.Column.IsChaptered)
					{
						return AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					if (cell.ActivationResolvedInternal == Activation.Disabled)
					{
						return AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.Selectable;
					accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focusable;
					if (cell.Selected)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Selected;
					}
					if (cell.IsActiveCell && ((Control)(object)cell.Layout.Grid).Focused)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public override string Value
			{
				get
				{
					return cell.Text;
				}
				set
				{
					if (cell.ActivationResolvedInternal != Activation.AllowEdit || ((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)cell.EditorOwnerInfo).IsReadOnly((object)cell.Row) || !cell.CanEnterEditMode)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!cell.IsActiveCell)
					{
						cell.Activate();
					}
					if (!cell.IsActiveCell)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (!cell.IsInEditMode)
					{
						cell.EnterEditMode(byMouse: false);
					}
					if (!cell.IsInEditMode)
					{
						return;
					}
					EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = cell.EditorResolved;
					if (editorResolved == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					try
					{
						if (editorResolved.SupportsSelectableText)
						{
							editorResolved.SelectionStart = 0;
							editorResolved.SelectionLength = editorResolved.TextLength;
							editorResolved.SelectedText = value;
						}
						else
						{
							editorResolved.Value = value;
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
			}

			public UltraGridCell Cell => cell;

			public CellAccessibleObject(UltraGridCell cell)
			{
				if (cell == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("cell");
				}
				this.cell = cell;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				if (!cell.Column.HiddenResolved && cell.ActivationResolvedInternal != Activation.Disabled)
				{
					cell.Activate();
					if (cell.IsActiveCell && cell.CanEnterEditMode)
					{
						cell.EnterEditMode(byMouse: false, showingDropDown: false);
					}
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index == 0 && cell.IsActiveCell && cell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return cell.EditorAccessibilityObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				if (!cell.IsActiveCell || !cell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return 1;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				if ((((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).State & AccessibleStates.Focused) != AccessibleStates.Focused)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (cell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					AccessibleObject accessibleObject = cell.EditorAccessibilityObject?.GetFocused();
					if (accessibleObject != null)
					{
						return accessibleObject;
					}
				}
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return (Control)(object)cell.Layout.Grid;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				if (cell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					AccessibleObject accessibleObject = cell.EditorAccessibilityObject?.GetSelected();
					if (accessibleObject != null)
					{
						return accessibleObject;
					}
				}
				if ((((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).State & AccessibleStates.Selected) != AccessibleStates.Selected)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).AccessibleObject;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = null;
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Navigate(navdir);
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					ultraGridCell = cell.Layout.GetAboveBelowCell(down: true, cell.Row, cell, shiftKeyDown: false, ctlKeyDown: false, spanBands: false, spanRows: true, spanParents: true, select: false);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					ultraGridCell = cell.Layout.GetAboveBelowCell(down: false, cell.Row, cell, shiftKeyDown: false, ctlKeyDown: false, spanBands: false, spanRows: true, spanParents: true, select: false);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
					ultraGridCell = cell.Layout.GetNextCell(next: true, cell.Row, cell, shiftKeyDown: false, ctlKeyDown: false, spanBands: true, spanRows: true, spanParents: true, select: false);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					ultraGridCell = cell.Layout.GetNextCell(next: false, cell.Row, cell, shiftKeyDown: false, ctlKeyDown: false, spanBands: true, spanRows: true, spanParents: true, select: false);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
					ultraGridCell = cell.Layout.GetNextCell(next: true, cell.Row, cell, shiftKeyDown: false, ctlKeyDown: false, spanBands: true, spanRows: true, spanParents: true, select: false);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
					ultraGridCell = cell.Layout.GetNextCell(next: false, cell.Row, cell, shiftKeyDown: false, ctlKeyDown: false, spanBands: true, spanRows: true, spanParents: true, select: false);
					break;
				}
				if (ultraGridCell != null)
				{
					return ultraGridCell.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				UIElement uIElement = cell.GetUIElement(cell.Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion, cell.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion, verifyElements: false);
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					return uIElement.Navigate(navdir);
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
				//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = cell;
				UltraGridBase grid = ultraGridCell.Layout.Grid;
				ISelectionManager val = (ISelectionManager)(object)((grid is ISelectionManager) ? grid : null);
				ISelectionStrategy val2 = ((val != null) ? val.GetSelectionStrategy((ISelectableItem)ultraGridCell) : null);
				if (val == null || val2 == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool clearExistingSelection = val2 is SelectionStrategyExtended && !((SelectionStrategyExtended)val2).IsDiscontiguousAllowed;
				if (grid is UltraGrid)
				{
					UltraGrid ultraGrid = (UltraGrid)grid;
					if ((AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection == (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection & flags) || AccessibleSelection.AddSelection == (AccessibleSelection.AddSelection & flags)) && ultraGridCell.Selectable)
					{
						if (val2.IsSingleSelect)
						{
							ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(ultraGridCell, clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
						}
						else if (val.IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection((ISelectableItem)ultraGridCell) && !val.IsMaxSelectedItemsExceeded((ISelectableItem)ultraGridCell))
						{
							if (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection == (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection & flags))
							{
								ultraGrid.InternalSelectRange(ultraGridCell, clearExistingSelection: false, select: true);
							}
							else
							{
								ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(ultraGridCell, clearExistingSelection, select: true);
							}
						}
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus == (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus & flags))
					{
						ultraGridCell.Activate();
						if (ultraGridCell.IsActiveCell)
						{
							val.SetPivotItem((ISelectableItem)ultraGridCell, false);
						}
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection == (AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection & flags))
					{
						ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(ultraGridCell, clearExistingSelection, select: false);
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection == (AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection & flags) && ultraGridCell.Selectable)
					{
						ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(ultraGridCell, clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_ = grid is UltraDropDownBase;
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public Appearance Appearance
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (appearance == null)
				{
					appearance = new Appearance();
					((SubObjectBase)(object)appearance).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				return appearance;
			}
			set
			{
				if (appearance != value)
				{
					UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
					if (appearance != null)
					{
						((SubObjectBase)(object)appearance).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
						layout?.RemoveMulticastAppearance((AppearanceBase)(object)appearance, this);
					}
					appearance = value;
					if (appearance != null)
					{
						layout?.SetMulticastAppearance((AppearanceBase)(object)appearance, this);
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Appearance, null);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool DroppedDown
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsInEditMode)
				{
					EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
					if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.SupportsDropDown && editorResolved.IsInEditMode)
					{
						return editorResolved.IsDroppedDown;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == DroppedDown)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (this != Layout.ActiveCell || !IsInEditMode)
				{
					SetFocusAndActivate(byMouse: false, enterEditMode: true);
					if (this != Layout.ActiveCell || !IsInEditMode)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				if (value)
				{
					ShowDropDown();
				}
				else
				{
					HideDropDown();
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool CanBeModified
		{
			get
			{
				if (ActivationResolvedInternal != Activation.AllowEdit)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Column.IsReadOnly)
				{
					if (Row.IsAddRow)
					{
						return !Column.DataColumnHasExpression;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal override Activation ActivationResolvedInternal
		{
			get
			{
				if (Hidden)
				{
					return Activation.Disabled;
				}
				UltraGridRow row = Row;
				if (row.IsFilteredOut && RowFilterAction.DisableFilteredOutRows == Band.RowFilterActionResolved)
				{
					return Activation.Disabled;
				}
				UltraGridBase grid = GetGrid();
				if (grid != null)
				{
					Activation? cellActivationResolved = grid.GetCellActivationResolved(Row, column);
					if (cellActivationResolved.HasValue)
					{
						return cellActivationResolved.Value;
					}
				}
				if (IgnoreRowColActivation)
				{
					return Activation;
				}
				Activation resolvedCellActivation = row.GetResolvedCellActivation(column);
				return GridUtils.MaxActivation(activation, resolvedCellActivation);
			}
		}

					result = column.MaxLength;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		public EmbeddableEditorBase Editor
		{
			get
			{
				return editor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (editor != value)
				{
					if (value != null && !Column.IsEditorAppropriate(value))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_336", ((object)value).GetType().Name), "Editor");
					}
					if (IsInEditMode)
					{
						ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: true);
					}
					editor = value;
					DirtyCachedEditor();
					InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public EmbeddableEditorBase EditorResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (lastEmbeddableEditor != null && (verifiedCachedEditorVersion == Column.verifyEditorVersionNumber || IsInEditMode))
				{
					return lastEmbeddableEditor;
				}
				EmbeddableEditorBase val = editor;
				if (val == null && EditorComponent != null)
				{
					Component component = EditorComponent;
					IProvidesEmbeddableEditor val2 = (IProvidesEmbeddableEditor)(object)((component is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor) ? component : null);
					if (val2 != null && Column.IsEditorAppropriate(val2.Editor))
					{
						val = val2.Editor;
					}
				}
				if (val == null && IsFilterRowCell)
				{
					val = Column.FilterOperandEditor;
				}
				if (val == null && Style != ColumnStyle.Default)
				{
					val = Column.GetDefaultEditor(Row);
				}
				if (val == null)
				{
					val = Column.InternalEditor;
				}
				if (val == null)
				{
					Component editorComponentResolved = Column.EditorComponentResolved;
					IProvidesEmbeddableEditor val3 = (IProvidesEmbeddableEditor)(object)((editorComponentResolved is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor) ? editorComponentResolved : null);
					val = ((val3 == null || !Column.IsEditorAppropriate(val3.Editor)) ? Column.GetDefaultEditor(Row) : val3.Editor);
				}
				verifiedCachedEditorVersion = Column.verifyEditorVersionNumber;
				if (lastEmbeddableEditor != val)
				{
					editorAccessibilityObject = null;
				}
				return lastEmbeddableEditor = val;
			}
		}

				layout?.RemoveMulticastAppearance((AppearanceBase)(object)appearance, this);
				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearance).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearance = null;
			}
			if (layout != null && buttonAppearance != null)

				layout.RemoveMulticastAppearance(buttonAppearance, this);
			}

				val.ReleaseResources();
			}
			unBoundData = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal void ShowDropDownHelper(bool hide)
		{
			if (!(Column.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid) || !CanBeModified)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridCell cellInEditMode = Layout.CellInEditMode;
			if (cellInEditMode == null || this != cellInEditMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			CellUIElementBase cellUIElementBase = (CellUIElementBase)(object)GetUIElement();
			if (cellUIElementBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			EmbeddableUIElementBase val = cellUIElementBase.FindEmbeddableUIElement();
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.IsInEditMode && editorResolved == val.Editor && editorResolved.ElementBeingEdited == val && editorResolved.SupportsDropDown)
			{
				if (!hide)
				{
					editorResolved.DropDown();
				}
				else
				{
					editorResolved.CloseUp();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ShowDropDown()
		{

			}
		}

		internal void HideDropDown()

		internal bool SetValueInternal(object value, bool suppressErrorMessagePrompt, bool fireInitializeRow, bool throwExceptionOnError)
		{
			bool fireDataChanged = true;
			return SetValueInternal(value, suppressErrorMessagePrompt, fireInitializeRow, throwExceptionOnError, fireDataChanged);
		}

		internal bool SetValueInternal(object value, bool suppressErrorMessagePrompt, bool fireInitializeRow, bool throwExceptionOnError, bool fireDataChanged)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			UltraGridRow row = Row;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Column;
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			if (ultraGridColumn == null || layout == null || layout.Grid == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ultraGridColumn.IsChaptered)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row.IsTemplateAddRow)
			{
				return row.SetCellValue(ultraGridColumn, value, suppressErrorMessagePrompt, throwExceptionOnError);
			}
			if (ultraGrid != null && ultraGrid.EventManager.InProgress(GridEventIds.BeforeCellUpdate))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_35"));
			}
			object cellValue = row.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn);
			if (!IsInEditMode)
			{
				if (cellValue == null && value == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (cellValue != null && value != null && cellValue.Equals(value))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (ultraGrid != null && !Layout.IsPrintLayout && !Layout.IsExportLayout)
			{
				BeforeCellUpdateEventArgs e = new BeforeCellUpdateEventArgs(this, value);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeCellUpdate, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			bool flag = layout.SuspendInitializeRowFor(row);
			try
			{
				if (ultraGridColumn.IsBound || row.IsFilterRow)
				{
					originalValue = cellValue;
					row.SetCellValue(ultraGridColumn, value, suppressErrorMessagePrompt, throwExceptionOnError);
					if (ultraGrid != null && ultraGrid.EventManager != null)
					{
						if (!ultraGrid.EventManager.InProgress(GridEventIds.InitializeRow))
						{
							SetDataChanged(newValue: true);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						SetDataChanged(newValue: true);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					UnBoundData unboundData = UnboundData;
					if (unboundData != null)
					{
						if (value == null || value is DBNull || ultraGridColumn.DataType.IsAssignableFrom(value.GetType()))
						{
							unboundData.Current = value;
						}
						else
						{
							unboundData.Current = Convert.ChangeType(value, column.DataType);
						}
						if (ultraGrid != null && ultraGrid.EventManager != null)
						{
							if (!ultraGrid.EventManager.InProgress(GridEventIds.InitializeRow))
							{
								SetDataChanged(newValue: true);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							SetDataChanged(newValue: true);
						}
						Row.ParentCollection.NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged(this);
						Row.ParentCollection.DataChanged_DirtySummaries();
						if (fireDataChanged)
						{
							RowsCollection parentCollection = Row.ParentCollection;
							string columnKey = ((ultraGridColumn != null) ? ultraGridColumn.Key : string.Empty);
							CheckedListSettings.DataChangedEventArgs args = new CheckedListSettings.DataChangedEventArgs(Row, columnKey, null);
							parentCollection.FireDataChanged(args);
						}
					}
				}
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = row.RowEditTemplateResolved;
				if (rowEditTemplateResolved != null && (rowEditTemplateResolved.IsShown || rowEditTemplateResolved.Row != null))
				{
					rowEditTemplateResolved.RefreshBindings(Band);
					if (rowEditTemplateResolved.ColumnProxyMap.ContainsKey(Column.Key))
					{
						((UltraControlBase)rowEditTemplateResolved.ColumnProxyMap[Column.Key]).Invalidate(true);
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Value, null);
				if (row.IsCardStyleVariableHeight && row.IsPotentiallyVisibleOnScreen)
				{
					layout.DirtyDataAreaElement();
				}
				InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
				if (ultraGrid != null)
				{
					if (this == layout.ActiveCell && IsInEditMode && (!IsFilterRowCell || !InCommitEditValue))
					{
						EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
						if (editorResolved.IsInEditMode)
						{
							bool dontFireCellChangeEvent = Layout.DontFireCellChangeEvent;
							Layout.DontFireCellChangeEvent = true;
							try
							{
								editorResolved.Value = Value;
							}
							finally
							{
								Layout.DontFireCellChangeEvent = dontFireCellChangeEvent;
							}
						}
					}
					if (!Layout.IsPrintLayout && !Layout.IsExportLayout)
					{
						CellEventArgs e2 = new CellEventArgs(this);
						ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterCellUpdate, e2);
					}
				}
				RowsCollection parentCollection2 = row.ParentCollection;
				if (ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved != HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.None && parentCollection2 != null)
				{
					parentCollection2.DirtyCheckStateCacheValidEntry(ultraGridColumn);
					if (row.Band != null)
					{
						row.Band.DirtyCheckStateCacheValidEntry(ultraGridColumn);
					}
					ultraGridColumn.DirtyHeaderUIElements(parentCollection2);
				}
				if (ultraGridColumn != null && row != null)
				{
					ultraGridColumn.SynchronizeRadioButtons(row);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					layout.ResumeInitializeRowFor(row);
				}
			}
			if (fireInitializeRow && !flag)
			{
				row.FireInitializeRow();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void CancelUpdate()
		{
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_39"));
			}
			CancelableCellEventArgs e = new CancelableCellEventArgs(this);
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeCellCancelUpdate, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (isExitingEditMode && Layout != null)
			{
				Layout.CancellingEditOperationFlag = true;
			}
			else
			{
				ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: true);
			}
			if (ColumnStyle.DropDownList == StyleResolved)
			{
				try
				{
					Control controlForGridDisplay = Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay;
					if (DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(controlForGridDisplay.GetType()))
					{
						GridUtils.FocusControl(controlForGridDisplay);
					}
					else
					{
						controlForGridDisplay.Focus();
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (Column != null && Row != null)
			{
				Column.UpdateHeaderCheckBox(Row.ParentCollection);
			}
			CellEventArgs e2 = new CellEventArgs(this);
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterCellCancelUpdate, e2);
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			UltraGridRow row = Row;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			if (propChange.Source == appearance)
			{
				InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true, dirtyMergedCell: true);
				if (row.InInitializeRowEvent)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (GetGrid() is UltraDropDownBase ultraDropDownBase)
				{
					ultraDropDownBase.BumpItemImageSizeVersion();
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Appearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasButtonAppearance && propChange.Source == ButtonAppearance)
			{
				if (row == null || row.InInitializeRowEvent)
				{
					return;
				}
				flag2 = true;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ButtonAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == selectedAppearance)
			{
				if (row != null && !row.InInitializeRowEvent)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SelectecCellAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == activeAppearance)
			{
				if (row != null && !row.InInitializeRowEvent)
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ActiveCellAppearance, propChange);
			}
			if (flag2 || flag)
			{
				InvalidateItemAllRegions(flag2, dirtyMergedCell: false);
			}
		}

		private CheckState ToggleCheckBoxState(CheckState state)
		{
			switch (state)
			{
			case CheckState.Unchecked:
				return CheckState.Checked;
			case CheckState.Checked:
				if (ColumnStyle.TriStateCheckBox == StyleResolved)
				{
					return CheckState.Indeterminate;
				}
				return CheckState.Unchecked;
			case CheckState.Indeterminate:
				return CheckState.Unchecked;
			default:
				return CheckState.Unchecked;
			}
		}

		internal void ToggleCheckBox()
		{
			//IL_009a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a0: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid))
			{
				return;
			}
			CellUIElementBase cellUIElementBase = (CellUIElementBase)(object)GetUIElement(Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion, Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion, verifyElements: false);
			if (cellUIElementBase == null || Column == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved == null || !(editorResolved is CheckEditor))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (this != Layout.ActiveCell || !IsInEditMode)
			{
				SetFocusAndActivate(byMouse: false, enterEditMode: true);
				if (this != Layout.ActiveCell || !IsInEditMode)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			CheckEditor val = (CheckEditor)editorResolved;
			((ToggleEditorBase)val).CheckState = ToggleCheckBoxState(((ToggleEditorBase)val).CheckState);
		}

		public override UIElement GetUIElement(RowScrollRegion rsr, ColScrollRegion csr, bool verifyElements)
		{
			if (!Row.IsPotentiallyVisibleOnScreen)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = Row.Band.Layout.GetUIElement(verifyElements);
			uIElement = (UIElement)(object)Row.Band.Layout.DataAreaElement;
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(CellUIElementBase), new object[4] { Row, column, rsr, csr });
		}

		internal void HookValueChangedIntoEditor(EmbeddableEditorBase editor)
		{
			UnhookValueChangedFromEditor();
			lastHookedEditor = editor;
			lastHookedEditor.ValueChanged += CellChangeHelper;
		}

		internal void UnhookValueChangedFromEditor()
		{
			if (lastHookedEditor != null)
			{
				lastHookedEditor.ValueChanged -= CellChangeHelper;
				lastHookedEditor = null;
			}
		}

		}

		internal bool CommitEditValue(ref bool stayInEdit, bool fireDataError, bool forceDontThrowException, bool dontStoreInUndoHistory)
		{
			bool flag = inCommitEditValue;
			inCommitEditValue = true;
			try
			{
				UltraGrid ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
				EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
				if (editorResolved == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (HasActiveFormula && !Column.CanBeModified(Row))
				{
					return true;
				}
				string message = null;
				bool flag2 = true;
				object value = Value;
				object obj = null;
				Exception ex = null;
				try
				{
					if (editorResolved.IsValidValue(ref message))
					{
						obj = editorResolved.Value;
						flag2 = true;
					}
					else
					{
						obj = editorResolved.CurrentEditText;
						flag2 = false;
					}
					if (obj == null)
					{
						obj = DBNull.Value;
					}
				}
				catch (DataFilterException)
				{
					throw;
				}
				catch (Exception ex3)
				{
					ex = ex3;
					flag2 = false;
					message = "Value in editor is not valid.\n" + ex3.Message;
					obj = editorResolved.CurrentEditText;
				}
				bool flag3 = true;
				if (IsFilterRowCell && editValueChanged)
				{
					flag3 = false;
				}
				if (flag3)
				{
					if (obj == ((value != null) ? value : DBNull.Value))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (obj != null && value != null)
					{
						if (obj.Equals(Column.NullTextResolved) && value is DBNull)
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (obj.GetType() == value.GetType())
						{
							if (obj.Equals(value))
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							object obj2 = Column.ConvertValueToDataType(obj);
							if (obj2 != null && obj2.Equals(value))
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (!editValueChanged)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!flag2 || !editorResolved.IsValid)
				{
					flag2 = false;
					if (message == null || message.Length == 0)
					{
						message = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ErrMSgEditorValNotValid");
					}
				}
				if (flag2 && IsFilterRowCell)
				{
					UltraGridFilterRow ultraGridFilterRow = (UltraGridFilterRow)Row;
					if (!ultraGridFilterRow.IsFilterCellInputValid(Column, obj, out var errorMessage))
					{
						flag2 = false;
						message = errorMessage;
					}
				}
				if (flag2 && column.DataType == typeof(DateTime) && !IsFilterRowCell && !(obj is DateTime))
				{
					if (obj is string && ((string)obj).Length == 0)
					{
						obj = DBNull.Value;
					}
					object obj3 = Column.ConvertValueToDataType(obj);
					if (obj3 is DateTime)
					{
						obj = obj3;
					}
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					bool flag4 = false;
					try
					{
						if (obj == null || (obj is string && ((string)obj).Length == 0) || obj is DBNull)
						{
							obj = GetNullValue(out message, ref flag2);
						}
						if (flag2)
						{
							if (Row.IsDataRow && Layout.CalcManager != null)
							{
								Layout.StoreCellValues(Row);
							}
							if (!dontStoreInUndoHistory && Band.IsMultiCellOperationAllowed(MultiCellOperation.Undo))
							{
								ActionFactory.SingleCellValueAction singleCellValueAction = new ActionFactory.SingleCellValueAction(Layout.ActionHistory, this, obj);
								if (stayInEdit)
								{
									singleCellValueAction.DontExitEditMode = true;
								}
								Layout.ActionHistory.PerformAction(null, singleCellValueAction);
							}
							else
							{
								SetValueInternal(obj, suppressErrorMessagePrompt: false, fireInitializeRow: false);
							}
							flag4 = true;
						}
					}
					catch (Exception ex4)
					{
						flag4 = false;
						ex = ex4;
						flag2 = false;
					}
					if (flag4)
					{
						editValueChanged = false;
						bool flag5 = false;
						if (ultraGrid != null && (ultraGrid.UpdateMode == UpdateMode.OnCellChange || ultraGrid.UpdateMode == UpdateMode.OnCellChangeOrLostFocus) && Row != null && !Row.IsAddRow)
						{
							Row.Update();
						}
						else
						{
							Row.FireInitializeRow();
							flag5 = true;
						}
						if (!Column.IsBound && !flag5)
						{
							Row.FireInitializeRow();
						}
						if (Row.IsCardStyleVariableHeight && Layout != null)
						{
							Layout.DirtyDataAreaElement();
						}
						InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (ultraGrid != null)
				{
					if (!fireDataError)
					{
						if (forceDontThrowException)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (ex != null)
						{
							throw ex;
						}
						throw new Exception(message);
					}
					CellDataErrorEventArgs e = new CellDataErrorEventArgs(Layout.ForceExitEditOperationFlag);
					switch (Column.InvalidValueBehaviorResolved)
					{
					case InvalidValueBehavior.RetainValueAndFocus:
						e.RestoreOriginalValue = false;
						e.StayInEditMode = true;
						break;
					case InvalidValueBehavior.RevertValue:
						e.RestoreOriginalValue = true;
						e.StayInEditMode = false;
						break;
					case InvalidValueBehavior.RevertValueAndRetainFocus:
						e.RestoreOriginalValue = true;
						e.StayInEditMode = true;
						break;
					}
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.CellDataError, e);
					if (e.RaiseErrorEvent)
					{
						DataErrorInfo dataErrorInfo = new DataErrorInfo(ex, obj, Row, this, DataErrorSource.CellUpdate, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCellUpdateUnableToUpdateValue", (message != null && message.Length > 0) ? message : ((ex != null) ? ex.Message : "")));
						ultraGrid.InternalHandleDataError(dataErrorInfo);
					}
					if (e.RestoreOriginalValue)
					{
						editorResolved.Value = Value;
						SetDataChanged(newValue: false);
					}
					stayInEdit = e.StayInEditMode;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inCommitEditValue = flag;
				if (Layout != null)
				{
					Layout.NotifyCalcEngineOfChangedCellsInStoredRow();
				}
				Row.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private object GetNullValue(out string message, ref bool valueValid)
		{
			return Column.GetNullValue(out message, ref valueValid, NullableResolved);
		}

		internal object GetNullValueForMultiCellOperation()
		{
			bool valueValid = true;
			string message;
			object nullValue = GetNullValue(out message, ref valueValid);
			if (valueValid)
			{
				return nullValue;
			}
			return Column.DefaultCellValue;
		}

		internal bool ExitEditMode(bool cancellingEditOperation, bool forceExit)
		{
			if (isExitingEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsInEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return false;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved == null)
			{
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited = null;
				IsInEditMode = false;
				return false;
			}
			Layout.ForceExitEditOperationFlag = forceExit;
			Layout.CancellingEditOperationFlag = cancellingEditOperation;
			bool flag = false;
			bool focused = editorResolved.Focused;
			try
			{
				isExitingEditMode = true;
				flag = editorResolved.ExitEditMode(forceExit, !cancellingEditOperation);
			}
			finally
			{
				isExitingEditMode = false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited = null;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate ultraGridRowEditTemplate = Band?.RowEditTemplate;
				if (ultraGridRowEditTemplate != null && ultraGridRowEditTemplate.IsShown)
				{
					Row.ShowEditTemplate(preventForHiddenOrDisabledRow: true, TemplateDisplaySource.OnEnterEditMode);
				}
				else if (editorResolved.CanFocus)
				{
					try
					{
						editorResolved.Focus();
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				else
				{
					try
					{
						if (Layout != null && Layout.Grid != null && ((Control)(object)Layout.Grid).CanFocus)
						{
							((Control)(object)Layout.Grid).Focus();
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			IsInEditMode = false;
			if (!ultraGrid.inOnLeave && focused)
			{
				try
				{
					GridUtils.FocusControlWithoutScrollingIntoView((Control)(object)Layout.Grid);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
			return false;
		}

		public bool Activate()
		{
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_37"));
			}
			if (!Layout.IsDisplayLayout)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Layout.ActiveCell == this)
			{
				Layout.ExitEditModeHelper(cell: false);
				return false;
			}
			if (IsDisabled)
			{
				return true;
			}
			UltraGridRow activeRow = Layout.ActiveRow;
			UltraGridCell activeCellInternal = Layout.ActiveCellInternal;
			if (Row != Layout.Grid.ActiveRow)
			{
				Layout.Grid.SetActiveRow(Row, scrollIntoView: false);
				if (Layout.Grid.ActiveRow != Row)
				{
					return true;
				}
				ultraGrid.ActiveCell = null;
			}
			if (!Layout.ExitEditModeHelper())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsDisabled)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ultraGrid.ActiveCell = null;
			if (Layout.Grid == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Layout.ActiveCell != null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Layout.Grid == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (UpdateMode.OnCellChange == ultraGrid.UpdateMode && activeRow != null && !activeRow.IsAddRow)
			{
				activeRow.Update();
			}
			ultraGrid.ActiveCell = this;
			if (ultraGrid.ActiveCell != this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(Row);
			ColScrollRegion exclusiveColScrollRegionResolved = column.Header.ExclusiveColScrollRegionResolved;
			ColScrollRegion activeColScrollRegion = Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion;
			if (exclusiveColScrollRegionResolved != null)
			{
				Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion = exclusiveColScrollRegionResolved;
			}
			Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion.ScrollColIntoView(column);
			activeCellInternal?.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: false);
			InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: false);
			return false;
		}

		internal override bool SetFocusAndActivate(bool byMouse, bool enterEditMode, bool byTabKey)

			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_37"));
			}
			if (Activate())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (IsInEditMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (enterEditMode || byTabKey)
			{
				EnterEditMode(byMouse);
				ultraGrid.SetPivotItem(this, shiftKeyDown: false);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void OnAfterCellEnterEditMode()
		{
			isInEditMode = true;
			if (Layout.ActiveProxy == null)
			{
				EmbeddableUIElementBase embeddableElementBeingEdited = ((CellUIElementBase)(object)GetUIElement(Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion, Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion, verifyElements: false))?.FindEmbeddableUIElement(extract: false);
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited = embeddableElementBeingEdited;
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited_ColScrollRegion = Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion;
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited_RowScrollRegion = Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			}
			editValueChanged = false;
			RowsCollection.MergedCell_CellStateChanged(this, MergedCell.State.EnterEditMode);
			HookValueChangedIntoEditor(EditorResolved);
			if (Layout.ActiveProxy == null)
			{
				Row.BeginEdit();
				Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(Row, exitEditMode: false);
				Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion.ScrollColIntoView(Column);
			}
			bool flag = !Layout.goingIntoEditModeByMouse;
			if (Layout.goingIntoEditModeByMouse && Layout.HasOverride && CellClickActionResolved == CellClickAction.EditAndSelectText)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag && IsInEditMode)
			{
				SelectAll();
			}
			Layout.InvalidateHotTrackedElement();
		}

		public void SelectAll()
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.SupportsSelectableText)
			{
				if (editorResolved is EditorWithMask)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)(EditorWithMask)editorResolved).SelectAll();
					return;
				}
				editorResolved.SelectionStart = 0;
				editorResolved.SelectionLength = editorResolved.TextLength;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnAfterCellExitEditMode()
		{
			IsInEditMode = false;
			Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited = null;
			if (editValueChanged)
			{
				editValueChanged = false;
				if (!DataChanged && !Row.DataChanged)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DataChanged);
					Row.NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DataChanged);
				}
			}
			Layout.CellGoingIntoEditMode = null;
			Layout.UnHookFromEditor();
			UnhookValueChangedFromEditor();
			InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
			RowsCollection.MergedCell_CellStateChanged(this, MergedCell.State.ExitEditMode);
			Layout.InvalidateHotTrackedElement();
		}

		}

		internal bool EnterEditorIntoEditMode(bool byMouse)
		{
			//IL_011b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0120: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			InvalidateItem(Band.Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion, Band.Layout.GetActiveColScrollRegion(initializeMetrics: false), recalcRects: true);
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return false;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Layout.EnsureUIElementRectInitialized();
			UIElement uIElement = Layout.GetUIElement(verify: true);
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CellUIElementBase cellUIElementBase = (CellUIElementBase)(object)uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(CellUIElementBase), new object[4]
			{
				Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion,
				Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion,
				Row,
				this
			});
			if (cellUIElementBase == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CellDisplayStyle cellDisplayStyleResolved = Column.GetCellDisplayStyleResolved(Row);
			Layout.CellGoingIntoEditMode = this;
			if (CellDisplayStyle.FullEditorDisplay != cellDisplayStyleResolved)
			{
				((UIElement)cellUIElementBase).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UIElement)cellUIElementBase).VerifyChildElements(true);
			}
			EmbeddableUIElementBase val = cellUIElementBase.FindEmbeddableUIElement(extract: false);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (editorResolved != val.Editor)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Layout.HookIntoEditor(editorResolved);
			if (1 == (int)column.CellMultiLineResolved)
			{
				EditorWithText val2 = (EditorWithText)(object)((editorResolved is EditorWithText) ? editorResolved : null);
				if (val2 != null)
				{
					val2.AcceptsReturn = true;
				}
			}
			if (!editorResolved.IsInEditMode)
			{
				Layout.LastAutoSizeEditEventArgs = null;
			}
			EditorOwnerInfo.dontHandleOnBeforeEnterEditMode = true;
			bool flag = false;
			bool goingIntoEditModeByMouse = Layout.goingIntoEditModeByMouse;
			try
			{
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited = val;
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited_ColScrollRegion = Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion;
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited_RowScrollRegion = Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
				Layout.goingIntoEditModeByMouse = byMouse;
				flag = editorResolved.EnterEditMode(val);
			}
			finally
			{
				Layout.goingIntoEditModeByMouse = goingIntoEditModeByMouse;
				EditorOwnerInfo.dontHandleOnBeforeEnterEditMode = false;
				if (!flag)
				{
					Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited = null;
					Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited_ColScrollRegion = null;
					Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited_RowScrollRegion = null;
					Layout.CellGoingIntoEditMode = null;
				}
			}
			if (flag && editorResolved.IsInEditMode)
			{
				InvalidateItem();
				if (editorResolved.CanFocus)
				{
					try
					{
						editorResolved.Focus();
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				((UltraControlBase)ultraGrid).Update();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool EnterEditMode(bool byMouse, bool showingDropDown)
		{
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_V2_NotSupportedException_309"));
			}
			if (ultraGrid.DesignMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ColumnStyle.Button == StyleResolved)
			{
				return true;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsInEditMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!CanEnterEditMode)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Control controlForGridDisplay = Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay;
			if (!controlForGridDisplay.ContainsFocus)
			{
				try
				{
					if (DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(controlForGridDisplay.GetType()))
					{
						GridUtils.FocusControl(controlForGridDisplay);
					}
					else
					{
						controlForGridDisplay.Focus();
					}
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			if (!controlForGridDisplay.Focused)
			{
				if (!controlForGridDisplay.ContainsFocus)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (editorResolved.IsEnteringEditMode && editorResolved.ElementBeingEdited != null && ((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)EditorOwnerInfo).GetExternalContext(editorResolved.ElementBeingEdited.OwnerContext) == this)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (StyleResolved == ColumnStyle.EditButton && byMouse && IsCursorOverEditButton)
			{
				return true;
			}
			RowScrollRegion activeRowScrollRegion = ultraGrid.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			if (ultraGrid.ClearAllSelected(this == activeRowScrollRegion.PivotItemInternal))
			{
				return true;
			}
			Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(Row, exitEditMode: false);
			Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion.ScrollColIntoView(column);
			if ((Band.RowEditTemplateUITypeResolved & RowEditTemplateUIType.OnEnterEditMode) != RowEditTemplateUIType.None)
			{
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = Row.RowEditTemplateResolved;
				if (rowEditTemplateResolved != null)
				{
					Row.ShowEditTemplate(preventForHiddenOrDisabledRow: true, TemplateDisplaySource.OnEnterEditMode);
					return false;
				}
			}
			EnterEditorIntoEditMode(byMouse);
			if (!editorResolved.IsInEditMode)
			{
				isInEditMode = false;
				return true;
			}
			isInEditMode = true;
			InvalidateItem(Band.Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion, Band.Layout.GetActiveColScrollRegion(initializeMetrics: false), recalcRects: true);
			Row.InvalidateItem();
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsPointOverEditButton(Point point)
		{
			UIElement uIElement = Layout.GetUIElement(verify: false);
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				UIElement val = uIElement.ElementFromPoint(point);
				if (val != null && this == val.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridCell)) && ((object)val).GetType() == typeof(ButtonUIElement) && val.ClipRect.Contains(point))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void CellChangeHelper(object sender, EventArgs ev)
		{
			if (!editValueChanged)
			{
				if (HasActiveFormula)
				{
					return;
				}
				editValueChanged = true;
				if (Row != null && Row.ParentCollection != null)
				{
					Row.ParentCollection.OnUserModifiedCellValue(this);
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DataChanged);

		internal override void InvalidateElem(UIElement element, bool recalcRects)
		{
			if (element != null && element.GetAncestor(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)) is RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement { LastActiveCellBorderThickness: var lastActiveCellBorderThickness })
			{
				int activeCellBorderThicknessResolved = Band.ActiveCellBorderThicknessResolved;
				int num = Math.Max(lastActiveCellBorderThickness, activeCellBorderThicknessResolved);
				if (Layout.SelectionOverlayBorderColorResolved != Color.Empty)
				{
					num = Math.Max(num, Layout.SelectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved);
				}
				if (num > 0 && GetGrid() is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
				{
					num += Band.CellSpacingResolved;
					Rectangle rectangle = CalculateCellOverlayRect(element, num, calculateInvalidRect: true);
					((UltraControlBase)ultraGrid).Invalidate(rectangle);
					if (!recalcRects)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			base.InvalidateElem(element, recalcRects);
		}

		internal static Rectangle CalculateCellOverlayRect(UIElement element, int borderWidth, bool calculateInvalidRect)
		{
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rectangle drawingRect = element.DrawingRect;
			if (!(element is CellUIElementBase cellUIElementBase))
			{
				return drawingRect;
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
			UIElement ancestor = ((UIElement)cellUIElementBase).GetAncestor(typeof(RowCellAreaUIElement));
			if (ancestor != null)
			{
				Rectangle drawingRect2 = ancestor.DrawingRect;
				ultraGridColumn = cellUIElementBase.Column;
				bool flag = false;
				if (ultraGridColumn.Band.CellSpacingResolved == 0)
				{
					UIElementBorderStyle borderStyleCellResolved = ultraGridColumn.Band.BorderStyleCellResolved;
					if (ultraGridColumn.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(borderStyleCellResolved))
					{
						if ((((UIElement)cellUIElementBase).BorderSides & Border3DSide.Top) == 0)
						{
							drawingRect.Y--;
							drawingRect.Height++;
						}
						if ((((UIElement)cellUIElementBase).BorderSides & Border3DSide.Right) != 0)
						{
							drawingRect.Width--;
						}
						if (borderWidth % 2 == 0)
						{
							if ((((UIElement)cellUIElementBase).BorderSides & Border3DSide.Left) != 0)
							{
								drawingRect.Width--;
								drawingRect.X++;
							}
						}
						else if (ultraGridColumn.Band.RowLayoutStyle == RowLayoutStyle.None && ultraGridColumn.IsFirstVisibleColumnOnLevel)
						{
							int num = drawingRect.Left - drawingRect2.Left;
							if (num > 0)
							{
								drawingRect.X -= num;
								drawingRect.Width += num;
							}
						}
						if (!flag && (((UIElement)cellUIElementBase).BorderSides & Border3DSide.Bottom) != 0)
						{
							drawingRect.Height--;
						}
					}
					if (borderWidth != 0 && borderWidth % 2 == 0)
					{
						drawingRect.Y++;
						drawingRect.Height--;
					}
				}
				else if (borderWidth % 2 != 0)
				{
					drawingRect.Width--;
					drawingRect.Height--;
				}
			}
			int num2 = (calculateInvalidRect ? borderWidth : ((int)((double)borderWidth / 2.0)));
			drawingRect.Inflate(num2, num2);
			return drawingRect;
		}
	}

	public class CellsCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase
	{
		private UltraGridRow row;

		private int columnsCollectionVersion;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

		internal UltraGridRow Row => row;

		public UltraGridCell this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
				return (UltraGridCell)GetItem(index);
			}
		}

		public UltraGridCell this[string key]
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
				return (UltraGridCell)GetItem(key);
			}
		}

		public UltraGridCell this[UltraGridColumn column]
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
				return (UltraGridCell)GetItem(column.Index);
			}
		}

		protected override int InitialCapacity => Row.Band.Columns.Count;

		public override object[] All
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
				object[] array = new object[Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = GetItem(i);
				}
				return array;
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public override int Count
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
				return base.Count;
			}
		}

		public CellsCollection(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			this.row = row;
			columnsCollectionVersion = -1;
		}

		public bool HasCell(int index)
		{
			SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
			return List[index] != null;
		}

		public bool HasCell(string key)
		{
			return HasCell(Row.Band.Columns.IndexOf(key));
		}

		public bool HasCell(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			int index = column.Index;
			return HasCell(index);
		}

		public override int IndexOf(string key)
		{
			return Row.Band.Columns.IndexOf(key);
		}

		protected override IKeyedSubObject GetItem(string key)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = Row.BandInternal.Columns[key];
			return this[column];
		}

		public override object GetItem(int index)
		{
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = (UltraGridCell)List[index];
			if (ultraGridCell == null)
			{
				ultraGridCell = Row.CreateCell(Row.BandInternal.Columns[index]);
				ultraGridCell.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				List[index] = ultraGridCell;
			}
			return ultraGridCell;
		}

		private new void InternalRemove(int index)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			((IKeyedSubObject)(UltraGridCell)arrayList[index])?.OnRemovedFromCollection((KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase)this);
			arrayList.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		private new void InternalClear()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
			{
				((IKeyedSubObject)(UltraGridCell)arrayList[i])?.OnRemovedFromCollection((KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase)this);
			}
			arrayList.Clear();
		}

		private void SynchronizeWithColumnsColection()
		{
			if (row.BandInternal.ColumnsVersion == columnsCollectionVersion)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridBand bandInternal = Row.BandInternal;
			ColumnsCollection columns = bandInternal.Columns;
			int count = columns.Count;
			if (count == 0)
			{
				columnsCollectionVersion = bandInternal.ColumnsVersion;
				InternalClear();
				return;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			if (arrayList.Count < count)
			{
				arrayList.Capacity = count;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (arrayList[i] != null)
				{
					int index = ((UltraGridCell)arrayList[i]).Column.Index;
					if (index < 0)
					{
						InternalRemove(i);
						i--;
					}
					else if (index < i)
					{
						InternalRemove(i - 1);
						i -= 2;
					}
					else if (index > i)
					{
						arrayList.Insert(i, null);
					}
				}
			}
			if (count < arrayList.Count)
			{
				arrayList.RemoveRange(count, arrayList.Count - count);
			}
			else
			{
				while (count > arrayList.Count)
				{
					arrayList.Add(null);
				}
			}
			columnsCollectionVersion = bandInternal.ColumnsVersion;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			PropChangeInfo trigger = new PropChangeInfo(this, PropertyIds.Cell, propChange);
			NotifyPropChange(trigger);
			if (row != null)
			{
				row.NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Cells, trigger);
			}
		}

		public CellEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
			return new CellEnumerator(this);
		}

		internal UltraGridCell GetCellIfAllocated(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
			int index = column.Index;
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (UltraGridCell)List[index];
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (arrayList[i] is UltraGridCell ultraGridCell)
				{
					ultraGridCell.Dispose();
				}
			}
			List.Clear();
			columnsCollectionVersion--;
		}

		internal void RemoveCellsFromSelected(SelectedCellsCollection selectedCells)
		{
			if (selectedCells == null || selectedCells.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
			{
				if (List[i] is UltraGridCell selectedCell)
				{
					selectedCells.Remove(selectedCell);
				}
			}
		}

		public override void CopyTo(IKeyedSubObject[] array, int index)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				array[index + i] = this[i];
			}
		}

		internal bool DeallocateCellsHelper(UltraGridCell activeCell, bool retainUnboundCellData)
		{
			bool result = true;
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (arrayList[i] is UltraGridCell ultraGridCell)
				{
					if (!ultraGridCell.Selected && ultraGridCell != activeCell && (!retainUnboundCellData || !ultraGridCell.HasUnboundData || ultraGridCell.Column.IsBound))
					{
						arrayList[i] = null;
						ultraGridCell.Dispose();
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGridCell.ClearSettings(retainUnboundCellData);
						result = false;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
