		protected override bool ContinueDescendantSearch(Type type, object[] contexts)
		{
			if (contexts != null)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = Row;
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Column;
				foreach (object obj in contexts)
				{
					if (obj == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (obj is UltraGridCell ultraGridCell)
					{
						if (ultraGridCell.Row == ultraGridRow)
						{
							return ultraGridCell.Column == ultraGridColumn;
						}
						return false;
					}
					if (obj is UltraGridColumn)
					{
						return ultraGridColumn == obj;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal UltraGridCell[] GetAllCellsFromPosition(bool right)
		{
			UIElement parentElement = ((UIElement)this).parentElement;
			if (((UIElement)this).parentElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}

			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					if ((object)current == this)
					{
						continue;
					}

					if (current == null)
					{
						continue;
					}

					if (right ? (rect.X > ((UIElement)this).Rect.X) : (rect.Right < ((UIElement)this).Rect.Right))
					{
						bool flag = false;
						if (rect.Y < ((UIElement)this).Rect.Y)
						{
							flag = rect.Bottom >= ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top;
						}
						else if (rect.Y < ((UIElement)this).Rect.Bottom)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						if (flag && current.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridCell)) is UltraGridCell item)
						{
							list.Add(item);

			finally

				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal static CheckState ToCheckState(UltraGridColumn checkStateColumn, object cellValue)
		{
			if (checkStateColumn == null)
			{
				return CheckState.Indeterminate;
			}

				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text))

				}

				string b2 = false.ToString(checkStateColumn.FormatInfo);
				if (string.Equals(text, b, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase) || string.Equals(text, b2, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					if (!string.Equals(text, b))
					{
						return CheckState.Unchecked;
					}
					return CheckState.Checked;
				}
				string b3 = CheckState.Checked.ToString();
				string b4 = CheckState.Unchecked.ToString();
				string b5 = CheckState.Indeterminate.ToString();
				bool flag = string.Equals(text, b3, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				bool flag2 = string.Equals(text, b4, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				bool flag3 = string.Equals(text, b5, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase);
				if (flag || flag2 || flag3)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						if (!flag2)
						{
							return CheckState.Indeterminate;
						}
						return CheckState.Unchecked;
					}
					return CheckState.Checked;
				}
			}
			object obj = checkStateColumn.ConvertValueToDataType(cellValue);
			return IsNull(obj) ? CheckState.Indeterminate : ((obj is CheckState) ? ((CheckState)obj) : ((obj is bool && (bool)obj) ? CheckState.Checked : CheckState.Unchecked));
		}

			}
			Type dataType = checkStateColumn.DataType;
			if (dataType == typeof(CheckState))
			{
				return checkState;
			}
			if (dataType == typeof(string))
			{
				string text = true.ToString(checkStateColumn.FormatInfo);
				string text2 = false.ToString(checkStateColumn.FormatInfo);
				return checkState switch
				{
					CheckState.Unchecked => text2, 
					CheckState.Checked => text, 
					_ => null, 
				};
			}
			return checkStateColumn.ConvertValueToDataType(checkState);
		}

		internal static bool IsNull(object value)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				return value == DBNull.Value;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void VerifyCheckStateColumn(PropertyIds? propId, string valueMemberResolved)
		{
			VerifyCheckStateColumn(propId, valueMemberResolved, checkStateMember);
		}

		internal void VerifyCheckStateColumn(PropertyIds? propId, string valueMemberResolved, string checkStateMember)
		{
			if ((propId.HasValue && ultraCombo.Initializing) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(valueMemberResolved) || string.IsNullOrEmpty(checkStateMember) || !string.Equals(valueMemberResolved, checkStateMember, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
			{
				return;
			}
			string message = ((propId.HasValue && propId.Value == PropertyIds.ValueMember) ? Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraCombo_E_ValueMemberCannotEqualCheckStateMember", valueMemberResolved) : ((propId.HasValue && propId.Value == PropertyIds.CheckStateMember) ? Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("CheckedListSettings_E_CheckStateMemberCannotEqualValueMember", valueMemberResolved) : Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("UltraCombo_E_ValueMemberAndCheckStateMemberAreSame", valueMemberResolved)));
			throw new Exception(message);
		}

		private void OnInitializeRowsCollection(object sender, InitializeRowsCollectionEventArgs e)
		{
			UltraCombo ultraCombo = sender as UltraCombo;
			if (ultraCombo == this.ultraCombo)
			{
				RowsCollection rows = e.Rows;
				if (rows != null)
				{
					DataChangedHandler value = OnRowsCollectionDataChanged;
					rows.DataChanged -= value;
					rows.DataChanged += value;
					SubObjectDisposedEventHandler value2 = OnRowsCollectionDisposed;
					rows.SubObjectDisposed -= value2;
					rows.SubObjectDisposed += value2;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnRowsCollectionDisposed(SubObjectBase notifier)
		{
			if (notifier is RowsCollection rowsCollection)
			{
				rowsCollection.DataChanged -= OnRowsCollectionDataChanged;
				rowsCollection.SubObjectDisposed -= OnRowsCollectionDisposed;
				ultraCombo.DirtyCheckedRowsCollection(dirtyAll: true);
			}
		}

		internal void OnHeaderCheckStateChangeComplete(CheckState newValue)
		{
			if (IsValueProvidedByCheckedItemList && HeaderCheckBoxEventFiring == HeaderCheckBoxEventFiring.OnHeaderCheckboxValueChange)
			{
				CheckedRowsCollection checkedRows = ultraCombo.CheckedRows;
				checkedRows.DirtyCheckedRows();
				ultraCombo.FireCheckStateChanged(null);
				ultraCombo.FireEvent(ComboEventIds.ValueChanged, EventArgs.Empty);
				ultraCombo.RaiseTextChangedEvent();
			}
		}

		protected CheckedListSettings(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (name == "CheckStateMember")
				{
					checkStateMember = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), checkStateMember);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{

			}

		}

	public class CheckedRowsCollection : SubObjectsCollectionBase, IEnumerable<UltraGridRow>, IEnumerable
	{
		private Dictionary<object, UltraGridRow> allRows;

		private Dictionary<object, UltraGridRow> checkedRows;

		private UltraCombo ultraCombo;

		private bool allDirty = true;

		private bool checkedRowsDirty = true;

		private List<object> values;

		private int rowFiltersVersion = int.MinValue;

		private Dictionary<object, UltraGridRow> AllRows
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				return allRows;
			}
		}

		private Dictionary<object, UltraGridRow> CheckedRows
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				return checkedRows;
			}
		}

		public UltraGridRow this[int index] => List[index] as UltraGridRow;

		public UltraGridRow this[object value]
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				UltraGridRow value2 = null;
				CheckedRows.TryGetValue(value, out value2);
				return value2;
			}
		}

		public override int Count
		{
			get

				VerifyCollection();
				return CheckedRows.Count;
			}
		}

		internal List<object> Values
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyCollection();
				if (values == null)
				{

					values = new List<object>(dictionary.Count);
					foreach (KeyValuePair<object, UltraGridRow> item in dictionary)

		internal CheckedRowsCollection(UltraCombo ultraCombo)
		{
			if (ultraCombo == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ultraCombo");
			}
			this.ultraCombo = ultraCombo;
			rowFiltersVersion = this.ultraCombo.DisplayLayout.BandZero?.RowFiltersVersion ?? int.MinValue;
		}

		private void VerifyCollection()
		{
			allDirty = allDirty || VerifyRowFiltersVersion();
			if (!allDirty && !checkedRowsDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			values = null;
			bool flag = allDirty;
			bool flag2 = flag || checkedRowsDirty;
			if (allRows == null)
			{
				allRows = new Dictionary<object, UltraGridRow>(ultraCombo.Rows.Count);
			}
			if (checkedRows == null)
			{
				checkedRows = new Dictionary<object, UltraGridRow>();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				allRows.Clear();
				allDirty = false;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				ClearCheckedRows();
				checkedRowsDirty = false;
			}
			UltraGridBand bandZero = ultraCombo.DisplayLayout.BandZero;
			if (bandZero == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string valueMemberResolved = ultraCombo.ValueMemberResolved;
			string checkStateMember = ultraCombo.CheckedListSettings.CheckStateMember;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ((bandZero != null && bandZero.Columns.Exists(valueMemberResolved)) ? bandZero.Columns[valueMemberResolved] : null);
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = ((bandZero != null && bandZero.Columns.Exists(checkStateMember)) ? bandZero.Columns[checkStateMember] : null);
			if (ultraGridColumn == null || ultraGridColumn2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RowsCollection rows = ultraCombo.Rows;
			foreach (UltraGridRow item in rows)
			{
				object cellValue = (ultraGridColumn2.IsBound ? item.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn2) : item.Cells[ultraGridColumn2].Value);
				object obj = (ultraGridColumn.IsBound ? item.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn) : item.Cells[ultraGridColumn].Value);
				if (obj == null || obj == DBNull.Value)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (flag && !allRows.ContainsKey(obj))
				{
					allRows.Add(obj, item);
				}
				if (flag2)
				{
					CheckState checkState = CheckedListSettings.ToCheckState(ultraGridColumn2, cellValue);
					if (checkState == CheckState.Checked && !checkedRows.ContainsKey(obj))
					{
						AddCheckedRow(obj, item);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private bool VerifyRowFiltersVersion()
		{
			UltraGridBand bandZero = ultraCombo.DisplayLayout.BandZero;
			if (bandZero == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = bandZero.RowFiltersVersion;
			bool result = num != rowFiltersVersion;
			rowFiltersVersion = num;
			return result;
		}

		private void AddCheckedRow(object dataValue, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			List.Add(row);
			checkedRows.Add(dataValue, row);
		}

		private void ClearCheckedRows()
		{
			List.Clear();
			if (checkedRows != null)
			{
				checkedRows.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal void DirtyAll()
		{
			allDirty = true;
			checkedRowsDirty = true;
		}

		internal void DirtyCheckedRows()
		{
			checkedRowsDirty = true;
		}

		internal bool Equals(List<object> values)
		{
			VerifyCollection();
			if (values == null || values.Count == 0)
			{
				return checkedRows.Count == 0;
			}
			if (checkedRows.Count != values.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (object value in values)
			{
				if (this[value] == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = (ultraCombo.HasCheckedListSettings ? ((EditorCheckedListSettings)ultraCombo.CheckedListSettings).ListSeparatorResolved : CultureInfo.CurrentCulture.TextInfo.ListSeparator);
			return ToString(text);
		}

		public string ToString(string listSeparator)
		{
			VerifyCollection();
			Dictionary<object, UltraGridRow> dictionary = CheckedRows;
			if (dictionary.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			List<object> list = new List<object>(dictionary.Count);
			foreach (KeyValuePair<object, UltraGridRow> item in dictionary)
			{
				list.Add(item.Key);
			}
			return ToString(list, listSeparator);
		}

		internal string ToString(IList values, string listSeparator)
		{
			if (values == null || values.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			UltraGridBand bandZero = ultraCombo.DisplayLayout.BandZero;
			string displayMemberResolved = ultraCombo.DisplayMemberResolved;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ((bandZero != null && bandZero.Columns.Exists(displayMemberResolved)) ? bandZero.Columns[displayMemberResolved] : null);
			if (ultraGridColumn == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			VerifyCollection();
			Dictionary<object, UltraGridRow> dictionary = AllRows;
			if (dictionary.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			List<string> list = new List<string>(values.Count);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = values.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridRow value = null;
				object key = values[i];
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out value))
				{
					string cellText = value.GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(cellText))
					{
						list.Add(cellText);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			int j = 0;
			for (int count2 = list.Count; j < count2; j++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(list[j]);
				if (j < count2 - 1)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(listSeparator);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public override void Dispose()
		{
			if (allRows != null)
			{
				allRows = null;
			}
			if (checkedRows != null)
			{
				checkedRows = null;
			}
			base.Dispose();
		}

		IEnumerator<UltraGridRow> IEnumerable<UltraGridRow>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			VerifyCollection();
			Dictionary<object, UltraGridRow>.ValueCollection valueCollection = CheckedRows.Values;
			foreach (UltraGridRow item in valueCollection)
			{
				yield return item;
			}
		}
	}

						UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = (UltraGridGroupByRow)ParentRow;
						int num = ultraGridGroupByRow.Band.SortedColumns.IndexOf(ultraGridGroupByRow.Column);
						if (num >= 0)

								ultraGridColumn = ultraGridGroupByRow.Band.SortedColumns[1 + num];
							}
							if (ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn)

					finally

				else
				{
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeChildBandCollapsed, e);

		internal AccessibleObject GetAccessibleChild(int index)
		{
			if (!ParentRow.IsExpanded)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (CardLabelsAccessibilityObject != null)
			{
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return CardLabelsAccessibilityObject;
				}
				index--;
			}
			if (RowsCollectionAccessibilityObject != null)
			{
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return RowsCollectionAccessibilityObject;
				}
				index--;
			}
			AccessibleObject cardScrollbarAccessibilityObject = CardScrollbarAccessibilityObject;
			if (cardScrollbarAccessibilityObject != null)
			{
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return cardScrollbarAccessibilityObject;
				}
				index--;
			}
			return null;
		}

				return 0;
			}

			if (CardLabelsAccessibilityObject != null)
			{
				num++;
			}
			if (CardScrollbarAccessibilityObject != null)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return num;
		}

			if (ultraGridLayout != null)
			{
				ultraGridLayout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
				ultraGridLayout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
			}
		}

		{

			}
			return band.Layout?.Grid;
		}

		{

		}

		internal class TraverseRowsCallback : IRowCallback, IRowsCollectionCallback
		{
			private UltraGridBand band;

			private UltraGridColumn column;

			private int nRows;

			private int calculatedRowCount;

			internal int width;

			private int maxWidth;

			private Graphics gr;

			private StringFormat stringFormat;

			private int maxRowsCollections;

			private int traversedRowsCollections;

			private RowsCollection lastRowsCollection;

			private AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions autoResizeColumnOptions;

			internal TraverseRowsCallback(UltraGridColumn column, Graphics gr, StringFormat stringFormat, int nRows, int maxWidth, int maxRowsCollections, AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions autoResizeColumnOptions)
			{
				this.nRows = nRows;
				calculatedRowCount = 0;
				band = column.Band;
				this.column = column;
				width = 0;
				this.maxWidth = maxWidth;
				this.gr = gr;
				this.stringFormat = stringFormat;
				this.maxRowsCollections = maxRowsCollections;
				this.autoResizeColumnOptions = autoResizeColumnOptions;
			}

			bool IRowsCollectionCallback.ProcessRowsCollection(RowsCollection rows)
			{
				if (lastRowsCollection == null || !rows.IsTrivialDescendantOf(lastRowsCollection))
				{
					traversedRowsCollections++;
				}
				lastRowsCollection = rows;
				if ((autoResizeColumnOptions & AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.IncludeSummaryRows) != AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.Default)
				{
					width = Math.Max(width, column.CalculateMaxSummaryTextWidth(maxWidth, rows));
				}
				if (maxRowsCollections != 0 && traversedRowsCollections > maxRowsCollections)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			bool IRowCallback.ProcessRow(UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (row is UltraGridGroupByRow)
				{
					return true;
				}
				calculatedRowCount++;
				if ((autoResizeColumnOptions & AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.IncludeCells) != AutoResizeColumnWidthOptions.Default)
				{
					width = Math.Max(width, column.CalculateCellTextWidth(row, gr, stringFormat, maxWidth));
				}
				if (maxWidth > 0 && width > maxWidth)
				{
					width = maxWidth;
					return false;
				}
				if (nRows != 0 && calculatedRowCount >= nRows)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

					ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
					string text = null;
					text = ((DataType == typeof(string)) ? "One sample string" : ((DataType == typeof(DateTime)) ? "23_23_2002" : ((DataType == typeof(bool)) ? "false" : ((!(DataType == typeof(int)) && !(DataType == typeof(float)) && !(DataType == typeof(uint))) ? ((!(DataType == typeof(long)) && !(DataType == typeof(ulong)) && !(DataType == typeof(double)) && !(DataType == typeof(decimal))) ? ((!(DataType == typeof(short)) && !(DataType == typeof(ushort))) ? ((DataType == typeof(byte) || DataType == typeof(sbyte) || DataType == typeof(char)) ? "W" : ((DataType == typeof(Guid)) ? "{C0E65F47-F307-41d7-ADB3-04CA00C01F10}" : ((!(typeof(Color) == DataType)) ? "WWWg" : "(255, 255, 255)"))) : "-13,456") : "1,123,456,789") : "3,456,789"))));
					int borderThickness = Layout.GetBorderThickness(band.BorderStyleCellResolved);
					result = Layout.CalculateFontSize(ref appData, text);
					int num = 2 * (borderThickness + band.CellPaddingResolved + band.CellSpacingResolved);
					result.Width += num;
					result.Height += num;
					switch (GetStyleResolved(null))
					{
					case ColumnStyle.EditButton:
					case ColumnStyle.DropDown:
					case ColumnStyle.DropDownList:
					case ColumnStyle.DropDownValidate:
					case ColumnStyle.DropDownCalendar:
					{
						int num2 = Layout?.EditButtonWidth ?? ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)(object)grid);
						result.Width += num2 + 3;
						break;
					}
					}
					if (Layout.Grid != null && Layout.Grid is UltraGrid && Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay != null && Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.Created && Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.IsHandleCreated)
					{
						result.Width = Math.Min(result.Width, Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplayClientAreaRectangle.Width - 2 * Layout.GetBorderThickness(Layout.BorderStyleResolved));
					}
					cachedCellSizeDefault = result;
				}
				if (maxWidth > 0 && result.Width > MaxWidthActual)
				{
					result.Width = MaxWidthActual;
				}
				if (minWidth > 0 && result.Width < minWidth)
				{
					result.Width = minWidth;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

			}

		internal bool IsNullable
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				bool result = true;
				if (Nullable.Disallow == Nullable)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (PropertyDescriptor is IUltraDataColumn)
				{
					return ((IUltraDataColumn)PropertyDescriptor).AllowDBNull;
				}
				DataColumn dataColumn = GetDataColumn();
				if (dataColumn != null)
				{
					result = dataColumn.AllowDBNull;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal bool ProportionalResizeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				if (header != null && (int)header.proportionalResizeOverride != 0)
				{
					return 1 == (int)header.proportionalResizeOverride;
				}
				if (Layout != null && Layout.AutoFitAllColumns && !ProportionalResize)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < Band.Columns.Count; i++)
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Band.Columns[i];
						if (!ultraGridColumn.HiddenResolved && ultraGridColumn.ProportionalResize)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				return ProportionalResize;
			}
		}

		{

			{

				{
					return nullText;
				}
				if (band == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (band.HasOverride && band.Override.NullText != null)
				{
					return band.Override.NullText;
				}
				if (Layout == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (Layout.HasOverride && Layout.Override.NullText != null)
				{
					return Layout.Override.NullText;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
		}

			{
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SortIndicator), value))
				{
					throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("SortIndicator", (int)value, typeof(SortIndicator));
				}
				if (Layout != null)
				{
					Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
				}
				if (Band != null)
				{
					if (IsGroupByColumn && (SortIndicator.Ascending == value || SortIndicator.Descending == value))
					{
						if (sortIndicator != value)
						{
							ClickGroupByButton();
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Band.SetSortedColumn(this, value, isGroupBy: false, HeaderClickAction.SortSingle == Band.HeaderClickActionResolved);
					}
				}
				else if (sortIndicator != value && SortIndicator.Disabled == value)
				{
					sortIndicator = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_AppearanceCache_P_Style")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public ColumnStyle Style
		{
			get
			{
				return style;
			}
			set
			{
				if (style == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ColumnStyle), value))
				{
					throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("Style", (int)value, typeof(ColumnStyle));
				}
				if (ColumnStyle.CheckBox == value || ColumnStyle.TriStateCheckBox == value)
				{
					if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)Band.Layout.CheckEditor).CanRenderType(DataType))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_10"));
					}
				}
				else if (ColumnStyle.TrackBar == value)
				{
					if (Band != null)
					{
						DefaultEditorOwnerSettings defOwnerSettings;
						EmbeddableEditorBase cachedEditor = GetCachedEditor(typeof(TrackBarEditor), ColumnStyle.TrackBar, out defOwnerSettings);
						TrackBarEditor val = (TrackBarEditor)(object)((cachedEditor is TrackBarEditor) ? cachedEditor : null);
						if (val != null && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)val).CanRenderType(DataType))
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_17"));
						}
					}
				}
				else if ((ColumnStyle.RadioButtonByBand == value || ColumnStyle.RadioButtonByRowsCollection == value) && Band != null)
				{
					DefaultEditorOwnerSettings defOwnerSettings2;
					EmbeddableEditorBase cachedEditor2 = GetCachedEditor(typeof(RadioButtonEditor), style, out defOwnerSettings2);
					RadioButtonEditor val2 = (RadioButtonEditor)(object)((cachedEditor2 is RadioButtonEditor) ? cachedEditor2 : null);
					if (val2 != null && !((EmbeddableEditorBase)val2).CanRenderType(DataType))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_17"));
					}
				}
				style = value;
				DirtyDefaultEditor();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Style, null);
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_AppearanceCache_P_MinWidth")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public int MinWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return GetMinWidth();
			}
			set
			{
				if (minWidth == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value > MaxWidth && MaxWidth != 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_86"));
				}
				if (Width < value)
				{
					minWidth = value;
					if (width > 0 && width < minWidth)
					{
						Width = minWidth;
					}
					else
					{
						GroupResolved?.AdjustAllColumnWidths(byMouse: true, groupResize: false, duringDrag: false, fireGroupResizeEvent: false, columnAdded: false, this);
					}
					if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null)
					{
						Band.Layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
						Band.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
					}
				}
				minWidth = value;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MinWidth, null);
			}
		}

				if (Width > value && value > 0)

					maxWidth = value;

					{
						Width = maxWidth;
					}
					else
					{
						GroupResolved?.AdjustAllColumnWidths(byMouse: true, groupResize: false, duringDrag: false, fireGroupResizeEvent: false, columnAdded: false, this);
					}
					if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null)
					{
						Band.Layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
						Band.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
					}
				}
				maxWidth = value;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MaxWidth, null);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsColumnNumeric
		{
			get
			{
				Type type = DataType;
				Type underlyingType = System.Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(type);
				if (null != underlyingType)
				{
					type = underlyingType;
				}
				if (!(typeof(int) == type) && !(typeof(uint) == type) && !(typeof(short) == type) && !(typeof(ushort) == type) && !(typeof(long) == type) && !(typeof(ulong) == type) && !(typeof(float) == type) && !(typeof(double) == type) && !(typeof(decimal) == type) && !(typeof(byte) == type))
				{
					return typeof(sbyte) == type;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool SingleSummariesOnly
		{
			get
			{
				AllowRowSummaries allowRowSummariesResolved = AllowRowSummaries;
				if (allowRowSummariesResolved == AllowRowSummaries.Default)
				{
					allowRowSummariesResolved = Band.AllowRowSummariesResolved;
				}
				if (AllowRowSummaries.SingleSummary != allowRowSummariesResolved)
				{
					return AllowRowSummaries.SingleSummaryBasedOnDataType == allowRowSummariesResolved;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool AllowRowSummariesResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (Layout == null || !(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid))
				{
					return false;
				}
				AllowRowSummaries allowRowSummariesResolved = AllowRowSummaries;
				if (allowRowSummariesResolved == AllowRowSummaries.Default)
				{
					allowRowSummariesResolved = Band.AllowRowSummariesResolved;
				}
				return allowRowSummariesResolved switch
				{
					AllowRowSummaries.True => true, 
					AllowRowSummaries.False => false, 
					AllowRowSummaries.BasedOnDataType => IsColumnNumeric, 
					AllowRowSummaries.SingleSummary => true, 
					AllowRowSummaries.SingleSummaryBasedOnDataType => IsColumnNumeric, 
					_ => false, 
				};
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public EmbeddableEditorBase Editor
		{
			get
			{
				if (embeddableEditor != null)
				{
					return embeddableEditor;
				}
				if (lastEmbeddableEditor == null || defaultEditorDirtyFlag)
				{
					Component editorComponentResolved = EditorComponentResolved;
					IProvidesEmbeddableEditor val = (IProvidesEmbeddableEditor)(object)((editorComponentResolved is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor) ? editorComponentResolved : null);
					if (val != null && IsEditorAppropriate(val.Editor))
					{
						lastEmbeddableEditor = val.Editor;
					}
					else
					{
						lastEmbeddableEditor = GetDefaultEditor(null);
					}
					defaultEditorDirtyFlag = false;
				}
				return lastEmbeddableEditor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (embeddableEditor == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value != null && !IsEditorAppropriate(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_336", ((object)value).GetType().Name), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_337"));
				}
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = Editor;
				bool flag = true;
				if (value != null && editor == value)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (value == null && editor == GetDefaultEditor(null))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				UltraGrid ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
				if (flag && ultraGrid != null)
				{
					UltraGridCell activeCell = ultraGrid.ActiveCell;
					if (activeCell != null && activeCell.IsInEditMode && activeCell.Column == this)
					{
						activeCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: true);
					}
				}
				embeddableEditor = value;
				DirtyDefaultEditor();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Editor);
			}
		}

		internal Size MinimumSize
		{
			get
			{
				Size minimumCellSize = RowLayoutColumnInfo.MinimumCellSize;
				if (minimumCellSize.Width <= 0)
				{
					minimumCellSize.Width = MinWidthActual;
				}
				if (minimumCellSize.Height <= 0)
				{
					minimumCellSize.Height = CardCellHeight;
					if (Band.CardView && Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
					{
						minimumCellSize.Height = Math.Max(minimumCellSize.Height, CardLabelSize.Height);
					}
				}
				return minimumCellSize;
			}
		}

		internal Size PreferredSize
		{
			get
			{
				Size preferredCellSize = RowLayoutColumnInfo.PreferredCellSize;
				if (preferredCellSize.Width <= 0)
				{
					preferredCellSize.Width = Width;
				}
				if (preferredCellSize.Height <= 0)
				{
					preferredCellSize.Height = CardCellHeight;
					if (Band.CardView && Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
					{
						preferredCellSize.Height = Math.Max(preferredCellSize.Height, CardLabelSize.Height);
					}
				}
				Size minimumCellSize = RowLayoutColumnInfo.MinimumCellSize;
				preferredCellSize.Width = Math.Max(preferredCellSize.Width, minimumCellSize.Width);
				preferredCellSize.Height = Math.Max(preferredCellSize.Height, minimumCellSize.Height);
				return preferredCellSize;
			}
		}

		Size ILayoutItem.MinimumSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (LabelPosition.LabelOnly == RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
				{
					return LayoutUtility.AccountForLabelPosition(Band, ((ILayoutItem)Header).MinimumSize);
				}
				return MinimumSize;
			}
		}

		Size ILayoutItem.PreferredSize
		{
			get
			{
				if (LabelPosition.LabelOnly == RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
				{
					return LayoutUtility.AccountForLabelPosition(Band, ((ILayoutItem)Header).PreferredSize);
				}
				return PreferredSize;
			}
		}

		bool ILayoutItem.IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsVisibleInLayout)
				{
					return false;
				}
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				if (!Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea && rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelSpanResolved > 0)
				{
					LabelPosition labelPositionResolved = rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved;
					if (LabelPosition.Left == labelPositionResolved || LabelPosition.Right == labelPositionResolved)
					{
						if (rowLayoutColumnInfo.SpanXResolved - rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelSpanResolved <= 0)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					else if ((LabelPosition.Top == labelPositionResolved || LabelPosition.Bottom == labelPositionResolved) && rowLayoutColumnInfo.SpanYResolved - rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelSpanResolved <= 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public Size CellSizeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
				if (ultraGridBand == null)
				{
					return Size.Empty;
				}
				Size size;
				if (ultraGridBand.UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					size = RowLayoutColumnInfo.CachedItemRectCell.Size;
				}
				else
				{
					int rowHeightResolved = ultraGridBand.RowHeightResolved;
					int num = Width;
					num += AutoFitExtendLastColumn_WidthDelta;
					size = new Size(num, rowHeightResolved);
				}
				int delta = 2 * ultraGridBand.CellSpacingResolved;
				GridUtils.Deflate(ref size, delta);
				return size;
			}
		}

		internal int AutoFitExtendLastColumn_WidthDelta
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
				if (ultraGridBand.Layout.AutoFitExtendLastColumn)
				{
					bool flag;
					if (ultraGridBand.GroupsDisplayed)
					{
						UltraGridGroup groupResolved = GroupResolved;
						flag = ((groupResolved != null) ? (groupResolved.LastItem && LastItemInLevel) : (band.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.None && LastItem));
					}
					else
					{
						flag = LastItem;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						int extent = ultraGridBand.GetExtent();
						if (ultraGridBand.bandExtent_BeforeAutoFitExtendLastColumn < extent)
						{
							return extent - ultraGridBand.bandExtent_BeforeAutoFitExtendLastColumn;
						}
					}
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		[Editor(typeof(PrimitiveTypeUITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(PrimitiveTypeConverter))]
		public object DefaultCellValue
		{
			get
			{
				return defaultAddRowCellValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (defaultAddRowCellValue == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value != null && DBNull.Value != value && !DataType.IsAssignableFrom(value.GetType()))
				{
					object obj = ConvertValueToDataType(value);
					if (obj == null || !DataType.IsAssignableFrom(obj.GetType()))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_16"), "DefaultCellValue");
					}
					value = obj;
				}
				defaultAddRowCellValue = value;
				if ((XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.DefaultValue) != 0)
				{
					XsdSuppliedConstraints &= ~XsdConstraintFlags.DefaultValue;
				}
				if ((XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.FixedValue) != 0)
				{
					XsdSuppliedConstraints &= ~XsdConstraintFlags.FixedValue;
				}
				if (value == null)
				{
					Constraint.ResetFixedValue();
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DefaultCellValue);
			}
		}

		internal bool MergedCellEnabledResolved
		{
			get
			{
				MergedCellStyle mergedCellStyleResolved = MergedCellStyleResolved;
				if (MergedCellStyle.Never != mergedCellStyleResolved)
				{
					if ((MergedCellStyle.OnlyWhenSorted != mergedCellStyleResolved || IsSorted) && Band.ActualColDisplayLevels <= 1 && !HiddenResolved && !Band.CardView)
					{
						if (Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
						{
							return RowLayoutColumnInfo.SpansEntireLayoutHeight;
						}
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal MergedCellStyle MergedCellStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				MergedCellStyle mergedCellStyle = this.mergedCellStyle;
				if (mergedCellStyle == MergedCellStyle.Default)
				{
					if (Band.HasOverride)
					{
						mergedCellStyle = Band.Override.MergedCellStyle;
					}
					if (mergedCellStyle == MergedCellStyle.Default)
					{
						if (Layout.HasOverride)
						{
							mergedCellStyle = Layout.Override.MergedCellStyle;
						}
						if (mergedCellStyle == MergedCellStyle.Default)
						{
							mergedCellStyle = MergedCellStyle.Never;
						}
					}
				}
				return mergedCellStyle;
			}
		}

		internal MergedCellEvaluationType MergedCellEvaluationTypeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (mergedCellEvaluationType != MergedCellEvaluationType.Default)
				{
					return mergedCellEvaluationType;
				}
				if (!(typeof(DateTime) == DataType))
				{
					return MergedCellEvaluationType.MergeSameValue;
				}
				return MergedCellEvaluationType.MergeSameText;
			}
		}

		internal MergedCellContentArea MergedCellContentAreaResolved
		{
			get
			{
				MergedCellContentArea mergedCellContentArea = this.mergedCellContentArea;
				if (mergedCellContentArea == MergedCellContentArea.Default)
				{
					if (Band.HasOverride)
					{
						mergedCellContentArea = Band.Override.MergedCellContentArea;
					}
					if (mergedCellContentArea == MergedCellContentArea.Default)
					{
						if (Layout.HasOverride)
						{
							mergedCellContentArea = Layout.Override.MergedCellContentArea;
						}
						if (mergedCellContentArea == MergedCellContentArea.Default)
						{
							mergedCellContentArea = ((!Layout.IsPrintLayout) ? MergedCellContentArea.VirtualRect : MergedCellContentArea.VisibleRect);
						}
					}
				}
				return mergedCellContentArea;
			}
		}

		internal FilterOperandStyle FilterOperandStyleResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				if (2 == (int)AllowRowFilteringResolved)
				{
					return FilterOperandStyle.Disabled;
				}
				bool flag = false;
				FilterOperandStyle filterOperandStyle = FilterOperandStyle.Default;
				if (ShouldSerializeFilterOperandStyle())
				{
					filterOperandStyle = FilterOperandStyle;
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (Band.HasOverride && Band.Override.ShouldSerializeFilterOperandStyle())
				{
					filterOperandStyle = Band.Override.FilterOperandStyle;
					flag = true;
				}
				else if (Layout.HasOverride && Layout.Override.ShouldSerializeFilterOperandStyle())
				{
					filterOperandStyle = Layout.Override.FilterOperandStyle;
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag && (filterOperandStyle != FilterOperandStyle.FilterUIProvider || (Band.FilterUIProviderResolved != null && Band.FilterUIProviderResolved.GetFilterCellEditor(this) != null)))
				{
					return filterOperandStyle;
				}
				VerifyFilterRowRelatedCache();
				return cachedDefaultFilterOperandStyle;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				FilterComparisonType filterComparisonType = FilterComparisonType;
				if (filterComparisonType == FilterComparisonType.Default)
				{
					if (band.HasOverride)
					{
						filterComparisonType = band.Override.FilterComparisonType;
					}
					if (filterComparisonType == FilterComparisonType.Default && band.Layout.HasOverride)
					{
						filterComparisonType = band.Layout.Override.FilterComparisonType;
					}
				}
				if (filterComparisonType == FilterComparisonType.Default)
				{
					return FilterComparisonType.CaseInsensitive;
				}
				return filterComparisonType;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridColumn_P_MaxLength")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public int MaxLength
		{
			get
			{
				if (!bound)
				{
					return Constraint.MaxLength;
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeMaxLength())
				{
					return Constraint.MaxLength;
				}
				DataColumn dataColumn = GetDataColumn();
				if (dataColumn != null && dataColumn.MaxLength > 0)
				{
					return dataColumn.MaxLength;
				}
				return 0;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value < 0)
				{
					throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("MaxLength", value, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_15"));
				}
				if (Constraint.MaxLength != value)
				{
					Constraint.MaxLength = value;
					if ((XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.MaxLength) != 0)
					{
						XsdSuppliedConstraints &= ~XsdConstraintFlags.MaxLength;
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MaxLengthColumn);
				}
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{

					IGridDesignInfo grid = Band.Layout.Grid;

		internal SortComparisonType SortComparisonTypeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (SortComparisonType != SortComparisonType.Default)
				{
					return SortComparisonType;
				}
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
				if (ultraGridBand != null)
				{
					if (ultraGridBand.HasOverride && ultraGridBand.Override.SortComparisonType != SortComparisonType.Default)
					{
						return Band.Override.SortComparisonType;
					}
					UltraGridLayout layout = Band.Layout;
					if (layout != null && layout.HasOverride)
					{
						UltraGridOverride ultraGridOverride = layout.Override;
						if (ultraGridOverride.SortComparisonType != SortComparisonType.Default)
						{
							return ultraGridOverride.SortComparisonType;
						}
					}
				}
				return SortComparisonType.CaseSensitive;
			}
		}

		internal bool ColumnChooserEnabledResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0021: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002f: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				//IL_004e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0053: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0061: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				if (ExcludeFromColumnChooser.False == ExcludeFromColumnChooserResolved)
				{
					UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
					UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = layout?.Grid;
					if (layout != null && (int)layout.ColumnChooserEnabled != 0)
					{
						return 1 == (int)layout.ColumnChooserEnabled;
					}
					if (ultraGridBase != null && ultraGridBase.columnChooserHasBeenDispalyedAtLeastOnce)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (Band != null && (4 == (int)Band.RowSelectorHeaderStyleResolved || 5 == (int)Band.RowSelectorHeaderStyleResolved) && Band.RowSelectorExtent > 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsColumnBorderMerged
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_004f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0055: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
				if (ultraGridBand == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
				if (Layout == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!ultraGridBand.UseRowLayoutResolved && layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(ultraGridBand.BorderStyleCellResolved))
				{
					ColumnHeader columnHeader = Header;
					if (columnHeader == null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					bool firstItem = columnHeader.FirstItem;
					bool lastItem = columnHeader.LastItem;
					bool flag = (int)ultraGridBand.RowSelectorsResolved == 1;
					bool flag2 = layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(Band.BorderStyleRowResolved);
					if (firstItem)
					{
						if (flag && flag2)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (!lastItem)
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (flag2)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool HiddenResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (band == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (band.GroupsDisplayed)
				{
					UltraGridGroup groupResolved = GroupResolved;
					if (groupResolved == null)
					{
						if (band.RowLayoutStyle == RowLayoutStyle.None)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (groupResolved.HiddenResolved)
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (!Hidden && !groupResolved.Expanded)
						{
							return HiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed;
						}
					}
				}
				return Hidden;
			}
		}

					ultraGridLayout.Grid.InternalHandleDataError(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataError_CurrencyManagerRetrievalFailure"), exception, defaultCancelValue: true);
				}
			}
			return bindingManagerBase;
		}

		internal void InitPropertyDescriptor(PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor, UltraGridBand[] oldBands)
		{
			this.propertyDescriptor = propertyDescriptor;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = ultraGridBand?.Layout;
			if (this.propertyDescriptor != null && this.propertyDescriptor.Attributes != null && this.propertyDescriptor.Attributes.Contains(BrowsableAttribute.No))
			{
				hidden = true;
			}
			if (!hidden && this.propertyDescriptor != null && !this.propertyDescriptor.IsBrowsable)
			{
				hidden = true;
			}
			if (this.propertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				Type propertyType = this.propertyDescriptor.PropertyType;
				bool flag = DataBindingUtils.ImplementsGenericIEnumerable(propertyType);
				cachedIsChaptered = (typeof(IList).IsAssignableFrom(propertyType) || flag) && !typeof(Array).IsAssignableFrom(propertyType);
			}
			else
			{
				cachedIsChaptered = false;
			}
			shouldCheckForImageCellValue = true;
			if (this.propertyDescriptor != null && !(this.propertyDescriptor is ValuePropertyDescriptor))
			{
				Type propertyType2 = this.propertyDescriptor.PropertyType;
				if (typeof(object) != propertyType2 && typeof(Image) != propertyType2 && !typeof(Image).IsAssignableFrom(propertyType2))
				{
					shouldCheckForImageCellValue = false;
				}
			}
			bound = true;
			if (IsChaptered)
			{
				dataType = typeof(ChapteredColumnType);
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand2 = ultraGridLayout?.Bands.GetChildBand(this);
				int num = ultraGridLayout?.MaxBandDepthEnforced ?? 100;
				if (ultraGridBand.HierarchicalLevel >= num - 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					string newDataMember;
					BindingManagerBase bindingManager = CreateChildBandBindingManagerHelper(out newDataMember);
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand3 = ultraGridBand2;
					if (ultraGridBand3 == null)
					{
						ultraGridBand3 = ultraGridLayout.Bands.InternalAdd(Band, this, oldBands, out var newBandCreated);
						if (ultraGridLayout != null && NewBandLoadStyle.Hide == ultraGridLayout.NewBandLoadStyleInEffect && newBandCreated)
						{
							ultraGridBand3.Hidden = true;
						}
					}
					ultraGridBand3.InitListManager(bindingManager, newDataMember, oldBands);
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception exception)
				{
					if (ultraGridLayout != null && ultraGridLayout.Grid != null)
					{
						ultraGridLayout.Grid.InternalHandleDataError(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataError_CurrencyManagerRetrievalFailure"), exception, defaultCancelValue: true);
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			dataType = this.propertyDescriptor.PropertyType;
			ClearFontCache();
			ultraGridBand?.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
			DirtyDefaultEditor();
			cachedDataColumn_lastPropDesc = null;
			cachedDataColumn = null;
		}

		internal DataColumn GetDataColumn()
		{
			if (cachedDataColumn_lastPropDesc == propertyDescriptor)
			{
				return cachedDataColumn;
			}
			if (Band != null && propertyDescriptor != null)
			{
				try
				{
					DataView dataView = Band.BindingList as DataView;
					if (dataView == null && Band.BindingList is BindingSource bindingSource)
					{
						dataView = bindingSource.List as DataView;
					}
					if (dataView != null)
					{
						DataTable table = dataView.Table;
						if (table != null && table.Columns != null && table.Columns.Contains(propertyDescriptor.Name))
						{
							DataColumn result = table.Columns[propertyDescriptor.Name];
							cachedDataColumn_lastPropDesc = propertyDescriptor;
							cachedDataColumn = result;
							return result;
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal object ConvertValueToDataType(object valueToConvert)
		{
			object convertedValue = null;
			ConvertValueToDataType(valueToConvert, out convertedValue);
			return convertedValue;
		}

		internal bool ConvertValueToDataType(object valueToConvert, out object convertedValue)
		{
			convertedValue = null;
			Type underlyingType = Utilities.GetUnderlyingType(DataType);
			if (valueToConvert is DBNull)
			{
				convertedValue = valueToConvert;
			}
			else if (PropertyDescriptor == null)
			{
				if (valueToConvert != null && valueToConvert.GetType() == underlyingType)
				{
					convertedValue = valueToConvert;
				}
				if (convertedValue == null)
				{
					try
					{
						convertedValue = Convert.ChangeType(valueToConvert, underlyingType, FormatInfo);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (convertedValue == null)
				{
					try
					{
						convertedValue = Convert.ChangeType(valueToConvert, underlyingType);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (valueToConvert != null && valueToConvert.GetType() == PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType)
				{
					convertedValue = valueToConvert;
				}
				else if (valueToConvert != null && null != PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType && PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType.IsInstanceOfType(valueToConvert))
				{
					convertedValue = valueToConvert;
				}
				else if (valueToConvert is string || underlyingType == typeof(string) || (valueToConvert != null && PropertyDescriptor.Converter.CanConvertFrom(valueToConvert.GetType())))
				{
					try
					{
						convertedValue = PropertyDescriptor.Converter.ConvertFrom(null, FormatInfo as CultureInfo, valueToConvert);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				else if (valueToConvert == null && Nullable == Nullable.Automatic && Utilities.IsNullableType(PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType))
				{
					convertedValue = valueToConvert;
					return true;
				}
				if (convertedValue == null)
				{
					try
					{
						convertedValue = Convert.ChangeType(valueToConvert, underlyingType, FormatInfo);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (convertedValue == null)
				{
					try
					{
						convertedValue = PropertyDescriptor.Converter.ConvertFrom(valueToConvert);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (convertedValue == null)
				{
					try
					{
						convertedValue = Convert.ChangeType(valueToConvert, underlyingType);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return convertedValue != null;
		}

		internal void InternalSetSortIndicator(SortIndicator sortIdicator)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SortIndicator), sortIdicator))
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_85"));
			}
			if (sortIndicator == sortIdicator)
			{
				return;
			}
			sortIndicator = sortIdicator;
			if (!isCloneForEvents)
			{
				if (Band.HasSortedColumns)
				{
					Band.SortedColumns.BumpSortVersion();
				}
				else if (Layout != null)
				{
					Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
				}
				if (Layout != null)
				{
					Layout.BumpColumnHeaderHeightVersionNumber();
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SortIndicator);
			}
		}

		}

		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (Layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (propChange.Source == Header)
			{
				if (propChange.FindPropId((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropIds)4) != null)
				{
					band.ClearCachedHeaderFontHeights();
					ClearFontCache();
				}
				else if (propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Activation) != null)
				{
					if (Layout != null && Layout.Grid != null)
					{
						UltraGrid.VerifyRowEditTemplateProxyEnabledStates(Layout.Grid.ActiveRow);
					}
				}
				else if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
				{
					switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId)
					{
					case PropertyIds.Caption:
					{
						ClearFontCache();
						TextOrientationInfo textOrientationResolved = Header.TextOrientationResolved;
						if (textOrientationResolved != null && !object.Equals(textOrientationResolved, TextOrientationInfo.Horizontal))
						{
							Layout.BumpRowLayoutVersion();
						}
						break;
					}
					case PropertyIds.ExclusiveColScrollRegion:
					case PropertyIds.Fixed:
					case PropertyIds.FixedHeaderIndicator:
						if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null)
						{
							Band.Layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
							band.Layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics();
						}
						break;
					case PropertyIds.HeaderCheckBoxVisibility:
					case PropertyIds.HeaderCheckBoxAlignment:
						ClearFontCache();
						break;
					case PropertyIds.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization:
						if (Band != null)
						{
							Band.BumpHeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion();
						}
						DirtyHeaderUIElements(null);
						break;
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Header, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == ValueList)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ValueList, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasCellAppearance && propChange.Source == cellAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				Layout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
				band.ClearCachedHeaderFontHeights();
				ClearFontCache();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CellAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasCellButtonAppearance && propChange.Source == cellButtonAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				Layout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CellButtonAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasMaskLiteralsAppearance && propChange.Source == maskLiteralsAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MaskLiteralsAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasRowLayoutColumnInfo && propChange.Source == RowLayoutColumnInfo)
			{
				if (Band != null)
				{
					Band.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RowLayoutColumnInfo, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasMergedCellAppearance && propChange.Source == mergedCellAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				Layout.DirtyDataAreaElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, invalidate: true, bumpCellElemsVersion: true);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.MergedCellAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasFormulaErrorAppearance && propChange.Source == formulaErrorAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				Layout.DirtyDataAreaElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, invalidate: true, bumpCellElemsVersion: true);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.FormulaErrorAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasFilterCellAppearance && propChange.Source == filterCellAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				Layout.DirtyDataAreaElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, invalidate: true, bumpCellElemsVersion: true);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.FilterCellAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasFilterOperatorAppearance && propChange.Source == filterOperatorAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				Layout.DirtyDataAreaElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, invalidate: true, bumpCellElemsVersion: true);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.FilterOperatorAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasGroupByRowConnectorAppearance && propChange.Source == groupByRowConnectorAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				Layout.DirtyDataAreaElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, invalidate: true, bumpCellElemsVersion: true);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupByRowConnectorAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasGroupByRowAppearance && propChange.Source == groupByRowAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				Layout.DirtyDataAreaElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, invalidate: true, bumpCellElemsVersion: true);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupByRowAppearance, propChange);
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref ResolveAppearanceContext context)
		{
			//IL_00f2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_016c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (context.ObjectType == typeof(HeaderBase))
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = Header;
				if (headerBase != null && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref context.ResolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
					if (ultraGridBase != null)
					{
						AppearanceBase appearance = null;
						if (ultraGridBase.GetExternalColumnHeaderAppearance(this, out appearance))
						{
							appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref context.UnresolvedProps);
						}
					}
					if (headerBase.HasAppearance)
					{
						headerBase.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref context.UnresolvedProps);
					}
				}
			}
			else if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref context.ResolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				UltraGridBase ultraGridBase2 = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
				if (ultraGridBase2 != null)
				{
					AppearanceBase appearance2 = null;
					if (ultraGridBase2.GetExternalColumnCellAppearance(this, out appearance2))
					{
						appearance2.MergeData(ref appData, ref context.UnresolvedProps);
					}
				}
				if (HasCellAppearance)
				{
					cellAppearanceHolder.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref context.UnresolvedProps);
				}
			}
			if ((int)context.UnresolvedProps == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (context.ObjectType == typeof(HeaderBase))
			{
				Band.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
				Band.Layout.ResolveColors(ref appData, ref context, SystemColors.Control, SystemColors.WindowFrame, SystemColors.WindowText, selectedPass: false);
				return;
			}
			UltraGridGroup groupResolved = GroupResolved;
			if (groupResolved != null)
			{
				groupResolved.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
			}
			else if (context.ObjectType == typeof(UltraGridCell) && (int)context.UnresolvedProps != 0 && context.IsCellOnly)
			{
				Band.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
			}
		}

		internal ColumnStyle GetStyleResolved(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			//IL_00a7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ac: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			if (row != null)
			{
				UltraGridCell cellIfAllocated = row.GetCellIfAllocated(this);
				if (cellIfAllocated != null)
				{
					if (cellIfAllocated.Style != ColumnStyle.Default)
					{
						return cellIfAllocated.Style;
					}
					if (cellIfAllocated.Editor != null || cellIfAllocated.EditorComponent != null)
					{
						bool flag = cellIfAllocated.ValueList != null || (cellIfAllocated.EditorResolved != null && cellIfAllocated.EditorResolved.SupportsDropDown);
						ColumnStyle result = ColumnStyle.Edit;
						if (flag)
						{
							result = ((ColumnStyle.DropDownList == style || ColumnStyle.DropDownValidate == style) ? style : ColumnStyle.DropDown);
						}
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			if (style > ColumnStyle.Default && (row == null || !row.IsFilterRow))
			{
				return style;
			}
			IValueList valueList = GetValueList(row);
			if (valueList != null)
			{
				ValueList val = (ValueList)(object)((valueList is ValueList) ? valueList : null);
				if (val != null && 5 == (int)val.DisplayStyle)
				{
					return ColumnStyle.DropDownList;
				}
				return ColumnStyle.DropDown;
			}
			if (!HasActiveFormula)
			{
				if (typeof(DateTime) == DataType)
				{
					return ColumnStyle.DropDownCalendar;
				}
				if (typeof(bool) == DataType)
				{
					return ColumnStyle.CheckBox;
				}
			}
			return ColumnStyle.Edit;
		}

		}

		internal int GetActualWidth(bool bIgnoreDraggingWidth)
		{

			}
			UltraGridGroup groupResolved = GroupResolved;
			if (groupResolved != null && !groupResolved.Expanded && HiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (widthDuringDrag > 0 && !bIgnoreDraggingWidth)
			{
				return widthDuringDrag;
			}
			return Width;
		}

		internal bool CanInitializeFrom(UltraGridColumn source)
		{
			if (source == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsBound && (Key == null || Key.Length == 0) && (source.Key == null || source.Key.Length == 0))
			{
				return source.UnboundRelativePosition == UnboundRelativePosition;
			}
			if (string.Compare(Key, source.Key, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn Clone()
		{
			if (cloneData != null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_89"));
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = (UltraGridColumn)MemberwiseClone();
			ultraGridColumn.editorOwnerInfo = null;
			ultraGridColumn.filterOperandEditorOwnerInfo = null;
			ultraGridColumn.filterOperatorEditorOwnerInfo = null;
			ultraGridColumn.header = Header.Clone();
			ultraGridColumn.header.InitColumn(ultraGridColumn);
			ultraGridColumn.cloneData = new ColumnCloneData();
			ultraGridColumn.CloneData.clonedFromCol = this;
			ultraGridColumn.CloneData.width = Width;
			ultraGridColumn.CloneData.visiblePosition = Header.VisiblePosition;
			if (rowLayoutColumnInfo != null)
			{
				ultraGridColumn.rowLayoutColumnInfo = rowLayoutColumnInfo.Clone();
			}
			return ultraGridColumn;
		}

		internal void CalculateHeaderRect(ref Rectangle rcHeader, ref Rectangle prcFixedHeaders, BandHeadersUIElement.BandHeaderMetricsCache bandHeaderMetricsCache = null)
		{
			rcHeader.X = 0;
			rcHeader.Y = 0;
			int height = bandHeaderMetricsCache?.ColumnHeaderHeight ?? Band.GetColumnHeaderHeight();
			rcHeader.Height = height;
			int num = bandHeaderMetricsCache?.GroupHeaderHeight ?? Band.GroupHeaderHeight;
			UltraGridGroup groupResolved = GroupResolved;
			if (groupResolved != null && LastItemInLevel)
			{
				Rectangle headerRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
				groupResolved.CalculateHeaderRect(ref headerRect, ref prcFixedHeaders, bandHeaderMetricsCache);
				int num2 = RelativeOrigin;
				rcHeader.Width = headerRect.Width - num2;
			}
			else
			{
				rcHeader.Width = OverallWidth;
			}
			short num3 = (short)Band.ActualColDisplayLevels;
			if (num3 > 1 && Band.ColHeadersVisibleInSeparateAreaResolved)
			{
				int levelResolved = LevelResolved;
				int num4 = rcHeader.Bottom / num3;
				rcHeader.Y = num4 * levelResolved;
				rcHeader.Height -= num4 * levelResolved;
				if (levelResolved < num3 - 1)
				{
					rcHeader.Height = num4;
				}
			}
			AlignHeaderInFixedHeaderArea(ref rcHeader, ref prcFixedHeaders, bandHeaderMetricsCache);
		}

		private void AlignHeaderInFixedHeaderArea(ref Rectangle headerRect, ref Rectangle fixedHeaders, BandHeadersUIElement.BandHeaderMetricsCache bandHeaderMetricsCache)
		{
			int num = bandHeaderMetricsCache?.TotalHeaderHeight ?? Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight();
			if (fixedHeaders.Height > num)
			{
				headerRect.Offset(0, fixedHeaders.Height - num);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsWidthFixed(bool byMouse, bool duringGroupResize, UltraGridColumn fixedColumn)
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if (ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridBand.GroupsDisplayed)
			{
				UltraGridGroup groupResolved = GroupResolved;
				if (groupResolved != null && !groupResolved.Expanded)
				{
					return HiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed;
				}
			}
			if (Band.Layout.Grid != null && Band.Layout.Grid.DesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Hidden)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (this == fixedColumn)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (byMouse && Band.AllowColSizingResolved == AllowColSizing.None)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (byMouse)
			{
				if (!LockedWidth)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void GetColumnWidthRange(bool byMouse, bool adjustGroupWidthAlso, ref int minWidth, ref int maxWidth)
		{
			if (IsWidthFixed(byMouse, duringGroupResize: false, null))
			{
				minWidth = (maxWidth = GetActualWidth());
				return;
			}
			UltraGridGroup groupResolved = GroupResolved;
			if (groupResolved != null && Band != null && Band.RowLayoutStyle == RowLayoutStyle.None)
			{
				int num = minWidth;
				int num2 = maxWidth;
				groupResolved.GetColumnWidthRange(byMouse, adjustGroupWidthAlso, this, ref num, ref num2);
				minWidth = num;
				maxWidth = num2;
			}
			else
			{
				minWidth = MinWidthActual;
				maxWidth = MaxWidthActual;
			}
		}

		internal void SynchColsOnWidthChange(int deltaWidth, bool includeSameBandColumns)
		{
			if (deltaWidth == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridColumn synchronizedCol = GetSynchronizedCol(NavigateType.First);
			for (UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = synchronizedCol; ultraGridColumn != null; ultraGridColumn = ultraGridColumn.GetSynchronizedCol(NavigateType.Next))
			{
				if (this != ultraGridColumn && (includeSameBandColumns || Band != ultraGridColumn.Band))
				{
					ultraGridColumn.width = ultraGridColumn.GetActualWidth() + deltaWidth;
					ultraGridColumn.width = Math.Max(ultraGridColumn.width, ultraGridColumn.MinWidthActual);
					ultraGridColumn.hasWidthSet = true;
					if (ultraGridColumn.synchronizedWidth != 0)
					{
						ultraGridColumn.synchronizedWidth = ultraGridColumn.width;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Synchronize()
		{
			if (isSynchronized || HiddenResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			AdjustOriginDuringColSynch();
			if (NextLinkedListItem != null || PrevLinkedListItem != null)
			{
				int rightMostCurr = 0;
				int rightMostMin = 0;
				int leftMostMax = 0;
				GetSynchedColsRightCoordRange(ref rightMostCurr, ref rightMostMin, ref leftMostMax);
				UltraGridColumn synchronizedCol = GetSynchronizedCol(NavigateType.First);
				int val = rightMostCurr;
				if (leftMostMax > 0)
				{
					val = Math.Min(val, leftMostMax);
				}
				val = Math.Max(val, rightMostMin);
				for (UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = synchronizedCol; ultraGridColumn != null; ultraGridColumn = ultraGridColumn.GetSynchronizedCol(NavigateType.Next))
				{
					int num = ultraGridColumn.Header.OverallOrigin + ultraGridColumn.Header.Extent;
					ultraGridColumn.AdjustWidthDuringColSynch(val - num);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AdjustOriginDuringColSynch()
		{
			isSynchronized = true;
			ColumnHeader columnHeader = Header;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if (ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridBand.AllowColSizingResolved == AllowColSizing.Synchronized)
			{
				UltraGridLayout layout = ultraGridBand.Layout;
				if (layout != null && layout.HasColSpan)
				{
					HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = ultraGridBand.OrderedHeaders;
					if (orderedHeaders != null)
					{
						UltraGridGroup groupResolved = GroupResolved;
						int i = 0;
						for (int count = orderedHeaders.Count; i < count; i++)
						{
							HeaderBase headerBase = orderedHeaders[i];
							if (headerBase.Hidden)
							{
								continue;
							}
							if (headerBase.IsGroup)
							{
								if (headerBase == groupResolved.Header)
								{
									break;
								}
							}
							else if (headerBase == columnHeader)
							{
								break;
							}
							headerBase.Synchronize();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (GroupResolved == null && columnHeader.ExclusiveColScrollRegion == null)
			{
				columnHeader.SetOrigin(relativeOrigin + Band.OriginAdjustmentDuringColSynch);
			}
		}

		internal void GetResizeRange(ref int minWidth, ref int maxWidth)
		{
			minWidth = MinWidthActual;
			maxWidth = MaxWidthActual;
			if (NextLinkedListItem != null || PrevLinkedListItem != null)
			{
				int rightMostCurr = 0;
				int rightMostMin = 0;
				int leftMostMax = 0;
				GetSynchedColsRightCoordRange(ref rightMostCurr, ref rightMostMin, ref leftMostMax);
				int num = Header.OverallExtent;
				int num2 = Header.OverallOrigin + num;
				if (FirstItem && GroupResolved == null)
				{
					num -= Band.PreRowAreaExtent;
				}
				minWidth = num - (num2 - rightMostMin);
				if (leftMostMax > 0)
				{
					maxWidth = num + leftMostMax - num2;
					maxWidth = Math.Max(num, maxWidth);
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetSynchedColsRightCoordRange(ref int rightMostCurr, ref int rightMostMin, ref int leftMostMax)
		{
			UltraGridColumn synchronizedCol = GetSynchronizedCol(NavigateType.First);
			int syncPosition = Band.GetSyncPosition(this);
			int overallOrigin = Header.OverallOrigin;
			int rowSelectorExtent = Header.RowSelectorExtent;
			overallOrigin += rowSelectorExtent;
			rightMostCurr = overallOrigin + Extent;
			bool flag;
			if (LockedWidth && !Layout.Grid.DesignMode)
			{
				rightMostMin = rightMostCurr;
				leftMostMax = rightMostCurr;
				flag = true;
			}
			else
			{
				rightMostMin = overallOrigin + MinWidthActual;
				leftMostMax = overallOrigin + MaxWidthActual;
				flag = MaxWidthActual != 0;
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = synchronizedCol;
			bool flag2 = Layout != null && Layout.AutoFitAllColumns;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			int num = rightMostCurr;
			while (ultraGridColumn != null)
			{
				if (this != ultraGridColumn)
				{
					ultraGridColumn.AdjustOriginDuringColSynch();
					overallOrigin = ultraGridColumn.Header.OverallOrigin;
					overallOrigin += ultraGridColumn.Header.RowSelectorExtent;
					int val = overallOrigin + ultraGridColumn.MinWidthActual;
					int num2 = overallOrigin + ultraGridColumn.Extent;
					if (ultraGridColumn.LockedWidth)
					{
						val = num2;
						if (flag)
						{
							leftMostMax = Math.Min(leftMostMax, num2);
						}
						else
						{
							leftMostMax = num2;
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else if (ultraGridColumn.MaxWidthActual != 0)
					{
						int num3 = overallOrigin + ultraGridColumn.MaxWidthActual;
						if (flag)
						{
							leftMostMax = Math.Min(leftMostMax, num3);
						}
						else
						{
							leftMostMax = num3;
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					rightMostMin = Math.Max(rightMostMin, val);
					rightMostCurr = Math.Max(rightMostCurr, num2);
					if (flag2 && ultraGridColumn.Band.GetTotalColSyncPositions(null) > ultraGridBand.GetTotalColSyncPositions(null))
					{
						ultraGridBand = ultraGridColumn.Band;
						num = num2;
					}
				}
				ultraGridColumn = ultraGridColumn.GetSynchronizedCol(NavigateType.Next);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				leftMostMax = 0;
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				rightMostCurr = num;
			}
		}

		internal void InsertAfterLinkedList(UltraGridColumn existing)
		{
			RemoveFromLinkedList();
			prevLinkedColumn = existing;
			nextLinkedColumn = existing.nextLinkedColumn;
			existing.nextLinkedColumn = this;
			if (nextLinkedColumn != null)
			{
				nextLinkedColumn.prevLinkedColumn = this;
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveFromSynchronizedColList()
		{
			RemoveFromLinkedList();
			synchronizedWidth = 0;
		}

		private void RemoveFromLinkedList()
		{
			if (nextLinkedColumn != null)
			{
				nextLinkedColumn.prevLinkedColumn = prevLinkedColumn;
			}
			if (prevLinkedColumn != null)
			{
				prevLinkedColumn.nextLinkedColumn = nextLinkedColumn;
			}
			nextLinkedColumn = null;
			prevLinkedColumn = null;
		}

		internal void AdjustWidthDuringColSynch(int adjustment)
		{
			if (adjustment != 0)
			{
				synchronizedWidth = GetActualWidth() + adjustment;
			}
			if (GroupResolved == null)
			{
				ColScrollRegion exclusiveColScrollRegion = Header.ExclusiveColScrollRegion;
				if (exclusiveColScrollRegion != null)
				{
					exclusiveColScrollRegion.AdjustWidthDuringColSynch(Header, adjustment);
				}
				else
				{
					Band.AdjustWidthDuringColSynch(adjustment);
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn GetSynchronizedCol()
		{
			return GetSynchronizedCol(NavigateType.Next);
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn GetSynchronizedCol(NavigateType navType)
		{
			if (!Layout.IsDisplayLayout && !Layout.IsPrintLayout && !Layout.IsExportLayout)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Layout.ValidateSynchronizedColLists();
			UltraGridColumn result = null;
			switch (navType)
			{
			case NavigateType.First:
			case NavigateType.Topmost:
				result = PrevLinkedListItem;
				result = ((result == null) ? this : result.GetSynchronizedCol(navType));
				break;
			case NavigateType.Last:
			case NavigateType.Bottommost:
				result = NextLinkedListItem;
				result = ((result == null) ? this : result.GetSynchronizedCol(navType));
				break;
			case NavigateType.Next:
			case NavigateType.Below:
				result = NextLinkedListItem;
				break;
			case NavigateType.Prev:
			case NavigateType.Above:
				result = PrevLinkedListItem;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void SetWidth(int newWidth, bool byMouse, bool fireEvents, bool adjustAllColsInGroup, bool adjustGroupWidthAlso, bool syncOtherColumns, bool enforceColumnMinWidthMaxWidth, bool autoFit)
		{
			int val = 0;
			int num = 0;
			if (enforceColumnMinWidthMaxWidth)
			{
				val = MinWidthActual;
				num = MaxWidthActual;
			}
			else
			{
				GetColumnWidthRange(byMouse, adjustGroupWidthAlso, ref val, ref num);
			}
			newWidth = Math.Max(newWidth, val);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				newWidth = Math.Min(newWidth, num);
			}
			if (newWidth == Width)
			{
				return;
			}
			int actualWidth = GetActualWidth();
			UltraGridBase grid = Band.Layout.Grid;
			if (fireEvents && grid != null)
			{
				ColumnHeader[] array = new ColumnHeader[1];
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
				if (array == null)
				{
					throw new OutOfMemoryException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_Exception_90"));
				}
				ultraGridColumn = Clone();
				if (ultraGridColumn == null)
				{
					throw new OutOfMemoryException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_Exception_91"));
				}
				if (ultraGridColumn.CloneData == null)
				{
					throw new OutOfMemoryException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_Exception_92"));
				}
				ultraGridColumn.CloneData.width = newWidth;
				ultraGridColumn.width = newWidth;
				array[0] = ultraGridColumn.Header;
				BeforeColPosChangedEventArgs e = new BeforeColPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.Sized, array, PosChangedType.Sized);
				grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeColPosChanged, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				width = ultraGridColumn.CloneData.width;
				hasWidthSet = true;
				if (syncOtherColumns)
				{
					if (NextLinkedListItem != null || PrevLinkedListItem != null)
					{
						SynchColsOnWidthChange(width - actualWidth, includeSameBandColumns: true);
						if (synchronizedWidth != 0)
						{
							synchronizedWidth = width;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						UltraGridGroup groupResolved = GroupResolved;
						if (groupResolved != null && adjustAllColsInGroup)
						{
							groupResolved.AdjustAllColumnWidths(byMouse: true, groupResize: false, duringDrag: false, fireGroupResizeEvent: false, columnAdded: false, this);
						}
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Width);
				array[0] = Header;
				grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.AfterColPosChanged, new AfterColPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.Sized, array, PosChangedType.Sized));
				return;
			}
			width = newWidth;
			hasWidthSet = true;
			if (synchronizedWidth != 0)
			{
				synchronizedWidth = width;
			}
			if (syncOtherColumns && (NextLinkedListItem != null || PrevLinkedListItem != null))
			{
				SynchColsOnWidthChange(width - actualWidth, includeSameBandColumns: false);
			}
			else
			{
				UltraGridGroup groupResolved2 = GroupResolved;
				if (groupResolved2 != null && adjustAllColsInGroup)
				{
					groupResolved2.AdjustAllColumnWidths(byMouse: true, groupResize: false, duringDrag: false, fireGroupResizeEvent: false, columnAdded: false, this);
				}
			}
			if (!autoFit || grid == null || !grid.DesignMode)

			}
		}

		internal void SetGroup(UltraGridGroup group, int visiblePosition, int level)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (group != null && group.Band != Band)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_Exception_93"));
			}
			if (level < 0 || level >= Band.LevelCount)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_Exception_94"));
				}
				level = Band.LevelCount - 1;
			}
			if (Group == group)
			{
				return;
			}
			GroupColumnsCollection groupColumnsCollection = ((group != null) ? group.Columns : Group.Columns);
			if (group != null)
			{
				if (this.group != null)
				{
					this.group.Columns.InternalRemove(this);
				}
				this.group = group;
				groupColumnsCollection.InternalAdd(this, visiblePosition, level);
			}
			else
			{
				groupColumnsCollection.InternalRemove(this);
				this.level = 0;
				this.group = null;
			}
			this.level = level;
			DirtyHasColSpan();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Group);
		}

		internal void InternalSwapPosition(UltraGridColumn swapColumn, PositionInfo thisColInfo, PositionInfo swapColInfo)
		{
			if (Band != null && Band.RowLayoutStyle == RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout)
			{
				InternalSetVisiblePosition(swapColInfo.VisiblePos);
				swapColumn.InternalSetVisiblePosition(thisColInfo.VisiblePos);
				return;
			}
			if (thisColInfo.Group != swapColInfo.Group)
			{
				swapColumn.SetGroup(thisColInfo.Group, thisColInfo.VisiblePos, thisColInfo.Level);
				SetGroup(swapColInfo.Group, swapColInfo.VisiblePos, swapColInfo.Level);
				return;
			}
			if (thisColInfo.Group != null || swapColInfo.Group != null)
			{
				Group.Columns?.Swap(this, swapColumn);
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				InternalSetVisiblePosition(swapColInfo.VisiblePos);
				InternalSetLevel(swapColInfo.Level, notify: true);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			try
			{
				swapColumn.InternalSetVisiblePosition(thisColInfo.VisiblePos);
				swapColumn.InternalSetLevel(thisColInfo.Level, notify: true);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

			}
