		}

		public void Swap(UltraGridColumn swapColumn)
		{
			if (!(Band.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_96"));
			}
			if (swapColumn == null || ultraGrid == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>(2);
			if (list == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Clone();
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = swapColumn.Clone();
			if (ultraGridColumn == null || ultraGridColumn2 == null || ultraGridColumn.CloneData == null || ultraGridColumn2.CloneData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = ((Band != null && Band.Layout != null) ? Band.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion : null);
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			int visiblePosition = Header.VisiblePosition;
			int visiblePosition2 = swapColumn.Header.VisiblePosition;
			if (colScrollRegion != null && Band.AreFixedHeadersAllowed(colScrollRegion) && !Band.HasGroups)
			{
				flag2 = ultraGridColumn.Header.FixedResolved;
				flag3 = ultraGridColumn2.Header.FixedResolved;
				if (flag2 != flag3)
				{
					ultraGridColumn.Header.InternalSetFixed(flag3);
					ultraGridColumn2.Header.InternalSetFixed(flag2);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			PositionInfo positionInfo = PositionInfo;
			PositionInfo positionInfo2 = swapColumn.PositionInfo;
			ultraGridColumn.SetPositionInfo(positionInfo2);
			ultraGridColumn2.SetPositionInfo(positionInfo);
			list.Insert(0, ultraGridColumn);
			list.Insert(0, ultraGridColumn2);
			if (Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				ultraGridColumn.RowLayoutColumnInfo.InitializeFrom(ultraGridColumn2.RowLayoutColumnInfo);
				ultraGridColumn2.RowLayoutColumnInfo.InitializeFrom(RowLayoutColumnInfo);
			}
			BeforeColPosChangedEventArgs e = new BeforeColPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.Swapped, DragStrategy.ToColumnHeaderArray(list.ToArray()), PosChangedType.Swapped);
			ultraGrid.FireBeforeColPosChanged(e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					Header.InternalSetFixed(flag3);
					swapColumn.Header.InternalSetFixed(flag2);
					Header.InternalSetVisiblePosValue(visiblePosition2);
					swapColumn.Header.InternalSetVisiblePosValue(visiblePosition);
					Band.BumpFixedHeadersVerifyVersion(dirtyOrderedHeaders: true);
					swapColumn.Header.NotifyFixedChanged();
					Header.NotifyFixedChanged();
				}
				else
				{
					InternalSwapPosition(swapColumn, positionInfo, positionInfo2);
				}
				if (Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					RowLayoutColumnInfo.InitializeFrom(ultraGridColumn.RowLayoutColumnInfo);
					swapColumn.RowLayoutColumnInfo.InitializeFrom(ultraGridColumn2.RowLayoutColumnInfo);
				}
				list.Clear();
				list.Insert(0, this);
				list.Insert(0, swapColumn);
				ultraGrid.FireAfterColPosChanged(new AfterColPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.Swapped, DragStrategy.ToColumnHeaderArray(list.ToArray()), PosChangedType.Swapped));
				list.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal void SetGroupByColumnStatus(bool groupedBy)
		{
			//IL_00a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (groupedBy == isGroupByColumn)
			{
				return;
			}

			if (SortIndicator != SortIndicator.None && SortIndicator.Disabled != SortIndicator)
			{

			}
			if (SortIndicator.Disabled == this.sortIndicator)
			{
				this.sortIndicator = SortIndicator.None;
			}
			if (groupedBy)
			{
				Band.SetSortedColumn(this, sortIndicator, isGroupBy: true, clearExisting: false);
			}

			{

				catch (Exception)

				}
			}
			if (!IsGroupByColumn)
			{
				hiddenWhenGroupByOverride = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.IsGroupByColumn, null);
		}

		internal void ClickGroupByButton()
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = Band.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			ProcessMode processMode = ProcessMode.Lazy;
			if (ultraGrid != null)
			{
				SortIndicator sortIndicator = this.sortIndicator;
				if (SortIndicator.Ascending == SortIndicator)
				{
					this.sortIndicator = SortIndicator.Descending;
				}
				else
				{
					this.sortIndicator = SortIndicator.Ascending;
				}
				BeforeSortChangeEventArgs e = new BeforeSortChangeEventArgs(Band, Band.SortedColumns);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeSortChange, e);
				this.sortIndicator = sortIndicator;
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				processMode = e.ProcessMode;
			}
			if (SortIndicator.Ascending == SortIndicator)
			{
				InternalSetSortIndicator(SortIndicator.Descending);
			}
			else
			{
				InternalSetSortIndicator(SortIndicator.Ascending);
			}
			Band.SortedColumns.OnSortChanged();
			band.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
			if (ultraGrid != null)
			{
				ultraGrid.Rows.EnsureSortedAndFilteredHelper(processMode, Band);
				BandEventArgs e2 = new BandEventArgs(Band);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterSortChange, e2);
			}
		}

		internal void CreateSwapList(ValueList swapDropDown)
		{
			ColumnsCollection columns = Band.Columns;
			if (columns == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = ((Band != null && Band.Layout != null) ? Band.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion : null);
			Band.AddSwapDropdownFixUnfixItem(swapDropDown, Header);
			UltraGridGroup groupResolved = GroupResolved;
			for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = columns[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn == this || ultraGridColumn.IsChaptered || ultraGridColumn.HiddenResolved)
				{
					continue;
				}
				UltraGridGroup groupResolved2 = ultraGridColumn.GroupResolved;
				AllowColSwapping allowColSwappingResolved = Band.AllowColSwappingResolved;
				if (colScrollRegion != null && Band.AreFixedHeadersAllowed(colScrollRegion))
				{
					if (groupResolved != null || groupResolved2 != null)
					{
						if (groupResolved == null || groupResolved2 == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, Header) != Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, ultraGridColumn.Header))
						{
							if (FixedHeaderIndicator.None == groupResolved.Header.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved || FixedHeaderIndicator.None == groupResolved2.Header.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved)
							{
								continue;
							}
						}
						else if (FixedHeaderIndicator.None == groupResolved.Header.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved != (FixedHeaderIndicator.None == groupResolved2.Header.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved))
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					else if (Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, Header) != Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, ultraGridColumn.Header) && (FixedHeaderIndicator.None == Header.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved || FixedHeaderIndicator.None == ultraGridColumn.Header.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved))
					{
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (allowColSwappingResolved == AllowColSwapping.WithinGroup)
				{
					if (groupResolved == groupResolved2)
					{
						swapDropDown.ValueListItems.Add((object)ultraGridColumn, ultraGridColumn.Header.Caption);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					swapDropDown.ValueListItems.Add((object)ultraGridColumn, ultraGridColumn.Header.Caption);
				}
			}
		}

		protected int GetMinWidth()
		{

		internal bool ShouldCellValueBeDisplayedInCard(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row != null && row.IsCardStyleCompressed)
			{
				return !row.IsCardCompressed;
			}
			if (Band.CardSettings.StyleResolved != CardStyle.VariableHeight)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (row == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row.IsAddRow || row.IsAddRowFromTemplate || row.IsTemplateAddRow)
			{
				return true;
			}
			object cellValue = row.GetCellValue(this);
			if (cellValue == null || cellValue is DBNull)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (cellValue is string text)
			{
				return text.Trim().Length > 0;
			}
			if (cellValue is int)
			{
				return (int)cellValue != 0;
			}
			if (cellValue is uint)
			{
				return (uint)cellValue != 0;
			}
			if (cellValue is short)
			{
				return (short)cellValue != 0;
			}
			if (cellValue is ushort)
			{
				return (ushort)cellValue != 0;
			}
			if (cellValue is long)
			{
				return (long)cellValue != 0;
			}
			if (cellValue is ulong)
			{
				return (ulong)cellValue != 0;
			}
			if (cellValue is decimal)
			{
				return (decimal)cellValue != 0.0m;
			}
			if (cellValue is float)
			{
				return (float)cellValue != 0f;
			}
			if (cellValue is double)
			{
				return (double)cellValue != 0.0;
			}
			if (cellValue is byte)
			{
				return (byte)cellValue != 0;
			}
			if (cellValue is sbyte)
			{
				return (sbyte)cellValue != 0;
			}
			if (cellValue is char)
			{
				return (char)cellValue != '\0';
			}
			try
			{
				return cellValue.ToString().Trim().Length > 0;
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal object ApplyDataFilter(UltraGridRow row, object value, ConversionDirection direction, out string error)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			error = null;
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = row.GetEditorResolved(this);
			EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase owner = (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)row.GetEditorOwnerInfo(this);
			if (editorResolved == null)
			{
				return value;
			}
			return ApplyDataFilter(editorResolved, owner, row, value, direction, out error);
		}

		internal object ApplyDataFilter(EmbeddableEditorBase editor, EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase owner, object ownerContext, object value, ConversionDirection direction, out string error)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			error = null;
			bool flag = default(bool);
			object result = editor.GetDataFilteredDestinationValue(value, direction, ref flag, owner, ownerContext, ref error);
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (error == null || error.Length == 0)
				{
					error = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCellUpdateUnableToConvert", (value != null) ? value.GetType().Name : "null", DataType);
				}
				if (error == null)
				{
					error = "Error converting.";
				}
				result = null;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal object ConvertDisplayTextToDataValue(UltraGridRow row, string displayText, out string error)
		{
			object obj = ApplyDataFilter(row, displayText, (ConversionDirection)0, out error);
			if (GridUtils.IsEmpty(error))
			{
				obj = ApplyDataFilter(row, obj, (ConversionDirection)3, out error);
			}
			if (obj != null && GridUtils.IsEmpty(error))
			{
				obj = ConvertValueToDataType(obj);
				if (obj == null)
				{
					error = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCellUpdateUnableToConvert", "String", DataType);
				}
			}
			if (GridUtils.IsEmpty(error))
			{
				error = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			return obj;
		}

					}
				}
				text = editor.DataValueToText(dataFilteredDestinationValue, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)gridEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase, (object)row);
				if (!EditorWithText.ApplyPasswordChar((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)gridEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase, (object)row, ref text))
				{
					EditorWithText.ApplyCharacterCasing((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)gridEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase, (object)row, ref text);
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = ((cellVal != null) ? FormatDisplayText(cellVal) : null);
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				return NullTextResolved;
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal string GetCellText(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (HasActiveFormula && row.IsDataRow)
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = row.Cells[this];
				bool isError;
				object formulaCalcValue = RefUtils.GetFormulaCalcValue(ultraGridCell.CalcReference, out isError, FormatInfo);
				if (!isError)
				{
					return GetCellText(row, formulaCalcValue);
				}
				if (formulaCalcValue != null && DBNull.Value != formulaCalcValue)
				{
					return formulaCalcValue.ToString();
				}
				return NullTextResolved;
			}
			object cellValue = row.GetCellValue(this);
			return GetCellText(row, cellValue);
		}

		private string FormatDisplayText(object dataValue)
		{
			try
			{
				if ((format == null || format.Length < 1) && formatInfo == null && (object)dataValue.GetType() != typeof(DateTime))
				{
					return dataValue.ToString();
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(string))
				{
					if (formatInfo != null)
					{
						return ((string)dataValue).ToString(formatInfo);
					}
					return dataValue as string;
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(int))
				{
					return ((int)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(DateTime))
				{
					if (format == null || format.Length < 1)
					{
						CultureInfo cultureInfo = formatInfo as CultureInfo;
						if (cultureInfo == null)
						{
							cultureInfo = CultureInfo.CurrentCulture;
						}
						return ((DateTime)dataValue).ToString(cultureInfo.DateTimeFormat.ShortDatePattern, formatInfo);
					}
					return ((DateTime)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(DayOfWeek))
				{
					return ((DayOfWeek)dataValue).ToString(format);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(uint))
				{
					return ((uint)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(long))
				{
					return ((long)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(ulong))
				{
					return ((ulong)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(short))
				{
					return ((short)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(ushort))
				{
					return ((ushort)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(double))
				{
					return ((double)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(float))
				{
					return ((float)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(decimal))
				{
					return ((decimal)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(byte))
				{
					return ((byte)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(sbyte))
				{
					return ((sbyte)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if ((object)dataValue.GetType() == typeof(Guid))
				{
					return ((Guid)dataValue).ToString(format, formatInfo);
				}
				if (typeof(Color) == dataValue.GetType())
				{
					return ((Color)dataValue/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString();
				}
				if (typeof(bool) == dataValue.GetType())
				{
					return ((bool)dataValue).ToString(formatInfo);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return dataValue.ToString();
		}

		internal HAlign GetDefaultHorizontalTextAlignment(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			IValueList valueList = GetValueList(row);
			if (valueList == null && (typeof(decimal) == DataType || typeof(double) == DataType || typeof(short) == DataType || typeof(int) == DataType || typeof(long) == DataType || typeof(float) == DataType || typeof(float) == DataType || typeof(sbyte) == DataType))
			{
				return (HAlign)3;
			}
			return (HAlign)1;
		}

		internal bool ShouldBtnElementSpaceBeReserved(UltraGridRow row, ref AppearanceData appResolved, RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion, ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0025: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0031: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!IsColumnStyleEditButton(row))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ShouldBtnElementBeCreated(row, rowScrollRegion, colScrollRegion))
			{
				return true;
			}
			HAlign val = ((AppearanceData)(ref appResolved)).TextHAlign;
			if ((int)val == 0)
			{
				val = GetDefaultHorizontalTextAlignment(row);
			}
			if ((int)val == 2 || (int)val == 3)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return IsCellMultiLine;
		}

		internal bool IsCursorOverCell(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			return IsCursorOverCell(row, null, null);
		}

		internal bool IsCursorOverCell(UltraGridRow row, RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion, ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion)
		{
			Point position = Cursor.Position;
			position = Layout.Grid.EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(position);
			if (rowScrollRegion == null)
			{
				rowScrollRegion = Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			}
			if (colScrollRegion == null)
			{
				colScrollRegion = Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = Layout.GetUIElement(verify: false, forceInitializeRect: false);
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				UIElement val = uIElement.ElementFromPoint(position);
				if (val != null && !(val is CellUIElementBase))
				{
					val = val.GetAncestor(typeof(CellUIElementBase));
				}
				if (val is CellUIElementBase cellUIElementBase && this == cellUIElementBase.Column && row == cellUIElementBase.Row && ((UIElement)cellUIElementBase).Contains(position, false))
				{
					RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement = (RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)(object)((UIElement)cellUIElementBase).GetAncestor(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement));
					if (rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement != null && colScrollRegion == rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement.ColScrollRegion && rowScrollRegion == rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement.RowScrollRegion)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldBtnElementBeCreated(UltraGridRow row, RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion, ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion)
		{
			if (!IsColumnStyleButton(row) && !IsColumnStyleEditButton(row))
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = rowScrollRegion == Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion && colScrollRegion == Layout.GetActiveColScrollRegion(initializeMetrics: false);
			if (flag && row.Cells.HasCell(this) && row.Cells[this] == Layout.ActiveCell)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool result = false;
			switch (ButtonDisplayStyle)
			{
			case ButtonDisplayStyle.OnMouseEnter:
				if (IsCursorOverCell(row, rowScrollRegion, colScrollRegion) && Activation.Disabled != row.GetCellActivationResolved(this))
				{
					result = true;
				}
				break;
			case ButtonDisplayStyle.Always:
				result = true;
				break;
			case ButtonDisplayStyle.OnRowActivate:
				result = flag && row == Layout.ActiveRow && Activation.Disabled != row.GetCellActivationResolved(this);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool CanCellEnterEditMode(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			return CanCellEnterEditMode(row, isEnteringFromTemplate: false);
		}

		internal bool CanCellEnterEditMode(UltraGridRow row, bool isEnteringFromTemplate)
		{
			if (!isEnteringFromTemplate)
			{
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = row.RowEditTemplateResolved;
				if (rowEditTemplateResolved != null && rowEditTemplateResolved.DisplayMode == RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Modeless && rowEditTemplateResolved.IsShown)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (!row.IsFilterRow)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = GetEditor(row);
				Type type = ((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)EditorOwnerInfo).GetDataType((object)row);
				if (editor != null && !editor.CanEditType(type))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor2 = GetEditor(row);
				if (editor2 is EmbeddableImageRenderer)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			Activation cellActivationResolved = row.GetCellActivationResolved(this);
			if (Activation.Disabled == cellActivationResolved || Activation.NoEdit == cellActivationResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool CanBeModified(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (HasActiveFormula)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row.HasCell(this))
			{
				return row.Cells[this].CanBeModified;
			}
			if (row.GetCellActivationResolved(this) != Activation.AllowEdit)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (IsReadOnly)
			{
				if (row.IsAddRow || row.IsTemplateAddRow)
				{
					return !DataColumnHasExpression;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (Key == null || Key.Length == 0)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("Column#");
				stringBuilder.Append(Index);
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Key);
			}
			if (Header.Hidden)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" [hidden]");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal bool ClickSortIndicator()
		{
			if (this.sortIndicator != SortIndicator.None && IsGroupByColumn)
			{
				ClickGroupByButton();
				return true;
			}
			bool clearExisting = true;
			switch (band.HeaderClickActionResolved)
			{
			case HeaderClickAction.SortMulti:
				if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) != Keys.None)
				{
					clearExisting = false;
				}
				if (Header.SortIndicator == SortIndicator.Disabled)
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case HeaderClickAction.SortSingle:
				if (Header.SortIndicator == SortIndicator.Disabled)
				{
					return true;
				}
				break;
			default:
				return false;
			}
			SortIndicator sortIndicator = SortIndicator.None;
			switch (header.SortIndicator)
			{
			case SortIndicator.Ascending:
				sortIndicator = SortIndicator.Descending;
				break;
			case SortIndicator.None:
				sortIndicator = GetResolvedSortIndicatorBasedOnInitSortDirection();
				break;
			case SortIndicator.Descending:
				sortIndicator = ((!Layout.Grid.DesignMode) ? SortIndicator.Ascending : SortIndicator.None);
				break;
			}
			band.SetSortedColumn(this, sortIndicator, clearExisting);
			return true;
		}

		private SortIndicator GetResolvedSortIndicatorBasedOnInitSortDirection()
		{
			SortDirection sortDirection = ((InitialSortDirection != SortDirection.Default) ? InitialSortDirection : ((Band.Override.InitialSortDirection == SortDirection.Default) ? GetGrid().DisplayLayout.Override.InitialSortDirection : Band.Override.InitialSortDirection));
			if (sortDirection == SortDirection.Default || sortDirection == SortDirection.Ascending)
			{
				return SortIndicator.Ascending;
			}
			return SortIndicator.Descending;
		}

		private UltraDropDown FindDropDownFromName(string ctrlName)
		{
			UltraDropDown ultraDropDown = null;
			try
			{
				UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
				if (ultraGridBase != null)
				{
					for (Control parent = ((Control)(object)ultraGridBase).Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
					{
						if (parent.Controls != null)
						{
							ultraDropDown = SearchForDropDownWithName(parent.Controls, ctrlName, recursive: false);
						}
						if (ultraDropDown != null)
						{
							return ultraDropDown;
						}
					}
				}
				Control rootControlForSearching = GridUtils.GetRootControlForSearching((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
				if (rootControlForSearching != null)
				{
					ultraDropDown = SearchForDropDownWithName(rootControlForSearching.Controls, ctrlName, recursive: true);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return ultraDropDown;
		}

		private UltraDropDown SearchForDropDownWithName(Control.ControlCollection controls, string name, bool recursive)
		{
			if (controls == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraDropDown ultraDropDown = null;
			foreach (Control control in controls)
			{
				if (control is UltraDropDown && control.Name.Equals(name))
				{
					return (UltraDropDown)(object)control;
				}
				if (control.Controls.Count > 0 && recursive)
				{
					ultraDropDown = SearchForDropDownWithName(control.Controls, name, recursive: true);
					if (ultraDropDown != null)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraDropDown;
		}

		internal bool IsEditorAppropriate(EmbeddableEditorBase editor)
		{
			if (Band == null || Band.Layout == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (editor != null)
			{
				Type type = DataType;
				return IsEditorAppropriate(editor, type);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsEditorAppropriate(EmbeddableEditorBase editor, Type dataType)
		{
			if (typeof(object) == dataType && editor.DefaultOwner != null)
			{
				Type type = editor.DefaultOwner.GetDataType((object)null);
				if (null != type)
				{
					dataType = type;
				}
			}
			if (editor.CanRenderType(dataType))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Control FindEditorControlOnForm(string name, Control.ControlCollection controls)
		{
			try
			{
				if (controls == null)
				{
					Control rootControlForSearching = GridUtils.GetRootControlForSearching((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
					if (rootControlForSearching != null)
					{
						controls = rootControlForSearching.Controls;
					}
				}
				if (controls != null)
				{
					foreach (Control control3 in controls)
					{
						if (control3 is IProvidesEmbeddableEditor && control3.Name.Equals(name))
						{
							return control3;
						}
						Control.ControlCollection controls2 = control3.Controls;
						if (controls2 != null)
						{
							Control control2 = FindEditorControlOnForm(name, controls2);
							if (control2 != null)
							{
								return control2;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void VerifyFilterRowRelatedCache()
		{
			if (verifiedFilterRowCacheVersion == verifyEditorVersionNumber)
			{
				return;
			}
			verifiedFilterRowCacheVersion = verifyEditorVersionNumber;
			cachedDefaultFilterOperatorLocation = FilterOperatorLocation.WithOperand;
			bool flag = Band != null && Band.FilterUIProviderResolved != null && Band.FilterUIProviderResolved.GetFilterCellEditor(this) != null;
			Type underlyingType = Utilities.GetUnderlyingType(DataType);
			if ((IsColumnNumeric || typeof(DateTime) == underlyingType) && !GridUtils.DisplaysTextValues(this))
			{
				cachedDefaultFilterOperatorDefaultValue = FilterOperatorDefaultValue.Equals;
				if (flag)
				{
					cachedDefaultFilterOperandStyle = FilterOperandStyle.FilterUIProvider;
				}
				else
				{
					cachedDefaultFilterOperandStyle = ((typeof(DateTime) == underlyingType) ? FilterOperandStyle.UseColumnEditor : FilterOperandStyle.Combo);
				}
				cachedDefaultFilterOperatorDropDownItems = FilterOperatorDropDownItems.Equals | FilterOperatorDropDownItems.NotEquals | FilterOperatorDropDownItems.LessThan | FilterOperatorDropDownItems.LessThanOrEqualTo | FilterOperatorDropDownItems.GreaterThan | FilterOperatorDropDownItems.GreaterThanOrEqualTo | FilterOperatorDropDownItems.In | FilterOperatorDropDownItems.NotIn;
			}
			else if (typeof(bool) == underlyingType)
			{
				cachedDefaultFilterOperatorDefaultValue = FilterOperatorDefaultValue.Equals;
				cachedDefaultFilterOperandStyle = (flag ? FilterOperandStyle.FilterUIProvider : FilterOperandStyle.UseColumnEditor);
				cachedDefaultFilterOperatorDropDownItems = FilterOperatorDropDownItems.Equals;
			}
			else
			{
				cachedDefaultFilterOperatorDefaultValue = FilterOperatorDefaultValue.StartsWith;
				cachedDefaultFilterOperandStyle = (flag ? FilterOperandStyle.FilterUIProvider : FilterOperandStyle.Combo);
				cachedDefaultFilterOperatorDropDownItems = FilterOperatorDropDownItems.All;
			}
			FilterOperatorDropDownItems associatedFilterDropDownItem = Layout.GetAssociatedFilterDropDownItem(FilterOperatorDefaultValueResolved);
			cachedDefaultFilterOperatorDropDownItems |= associatedFilterDropDownItem;
			if (flag)
			{
				cachedDefaultFilterOperatorLocation = FilterOperatorLocation.Hidden;
				return;
			}
			int num = (int)FilterOperatorDropDownItemsResolved;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num != 0)
			{
				num >>= 1;
				if ((1 & num) != 0)
				{
					num2++;
				}
			}
			if (num2 <= 1)
			{
				cachedDefaultFilterOperatorLocation = FilterOperatorLocation.Hidden;
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveFilterOperatorAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags)
		{
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(this, StyleUtils.Role.FilterOperator, out resOrder);
			if (HasFilterOperatorAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				FilterOperatorAppearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
			}
			Band.MergeBLOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref flags, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.FilterOperatorAppearance, role, resOrder, (RoleState)1);
			if ((4uL & (ulong)flags) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BorderColor = SystemColors.ControlDark;
				flags = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)flags ^ 4uL);
			}
			if ((0x80uL & (ulong)flags) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageVAlign = (VAlign)2;
				flags = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)flags ^ 0x80uL);
			}
			if ((0x40uL & (ulong)flags) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageHAlign = (HAlign)1;
				flags = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)flags ^ 0x40uL);
			}
		}

		public CheckState GetHeaderCheckedState(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			switch (HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved)
			{
			case HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.Band:
				if (Band == null)
				{
					return CheckState.Unchecked;
				}
				return Band.GetHeaderCheckState(this);
			default:
				if (rows == null)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_UltraGridColumn_GetHeaderCheckStateWithNullParameter"));
				}
				return rows.GetHeaderCheckState(this);
			}
		}

		public void SetHeaderCheckedState(RowsCollection rows, bool check)
		{
			SetHeaderCheckedState(rows, check ? CheckState.Checked : CheckState.Unchecked);
		}

		public void SetHeaderCheckedState(RowsCollection rows, CheckState state)
		{
			SetHeaderCheckedStateInternal(rows, state, isCancelable: true);
		}

		internal void SetHeaderCheckedStateInternal(RowsCollection rows, CheckState state, bool isCancelable)
		{
			if (state == CheckState.Indeterminate && HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved != HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.None)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException("CheckState.Indeterminate is not supported for the SetHeaderCheckedState() method.");
			}
			switch (HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved)
			{
			case HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.Band:
				if (Band != null)
				{
					Band.SetCheckStateCache(this, state, isCancelable, synchronize: true);
					DirtyHeaderUIElements(null);
				}
				break;
			default:
				if (rows != null)
				{
					rows.SetCheckStateCache(this, state, isCancelable, synchronize: true);
					DirtyHeaderUIElements(rows);
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		internal void SetCellValuesBasedOnCheckState(RowsCollection rows, CheckState state)
		{
			object obj = state;
			IEnumerator enumerator = null;
			enumerator = ((rows != null) ? rows.GetEnumerator() : Band.GetRowEnumerator(GridRowType.DataRow).GetEnumerator());
			try
			{
				isProcessingHeaderCheckStateChange = true;
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (UltraGridRow)enumerator.Current;
					if (!ultraGridRow.IsDataRow)
					{
						continue;
					}
					EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = ultraGridRow.GetEditorResolved(this);
					if (editorResolved != null)
					{
						GridEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase gridEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase = ultraGridRow.GetEditorOwnerInfo(this);
						bool flag = false;
						object dataFilteredDestinationValue = editorResolved.GetDataFilteredDestinationValue(obj, (ConversionDirection)3, ref flag, (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)gridEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase, (object)this);
						if (flag)
						{
							ultraGridRow.SetCellValueConditionally(this, dataFilteredDestinationValue);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGridRow.SetCellValueConditionally(this, obj);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isProcessingHeaderCheckStateChange = false;
				GetGrid()?.OnHeaderCheckStateChangeComplete(state);
			}
		}

		internal CheckState GetHeaderCheckedStateBasedOnCellValues(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			if (!IsHeaderCheckBoxVisible)
			{
				return CheckState.Indeterminate;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = true;
			IEnumerator enumerator = null;
			enumerator = ((rows != null) ? rows.GetEnumerator() : Band.GetRowEnumerator(GridRowType.DataRow).GetEnumerator());
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (UltraGridRow)enumerator.Current;
				if (ultraGridRow.IsDataRow)
				{
					bool? flag3 = ConvertObjectToBoolean(ultraGridRow.GetCurrentDataFilteredCellValue(this));
					if (!flag3.HasValue || !flag3.HasValue)
					{
						return CheckState.Indeterminate;
					}
					if (flag3.Value)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else
					{
						flag2 = false;
					}
					if (!flag2 && !flag)
					{
						return CheckState.Indeterminate;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag2 && !flag)
			{
				return CheckState.Checked;
			}
			if (flag && !flag2)
			{
				return CheckState.Unchecked;
			}
			return CheckState.Indeterminate;
		}

		internal void DirtyHeaderUIElements(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			Header.DirtyHeaderUIElements(rows);
		}

		private bool? ConvertObjectToBoolean(object objValue)
		{
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0076: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0081: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0083: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (objValue is DBNull || objValue == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (objValue is bool || objValue is bool?)
			{
				return (bool?)objValue;
			}
			if (objValue is CheckState)
			{
				switch ((CheckState)objValue)
				{
				case CheckState.Checked:
					return true;
				case CheckState.Unchecked:
					return false;
				case CheckState.Indeterminate:
					return null;
				}
			}
			if (objValue is DefaultableBoolean val)
			{
				if ((int)val == 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if ((int)val == 2)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void UpdateHeaderCheckBox(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			if (IsHeaderCheckBoxVisible)
			{
				switch (HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved)
				{
				case HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.Band:
					Band.DirtyCheckStateCacheValidEntry(this);
					DirtyHeaderUIElements(null);
					break;
				case HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.RowsCollection:
					rows.DirtyCheckStateCacheValidEntry(this);
					DirtyHeaderUIElements(rows);
					break;
				case HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.None:
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		}

		internal object GetNullValue(out string message, ref bool canAcceptNull, Nullable nullable)
		{
			message = string.Empty;
			switch (nullable)
			{
			case Nullable.Disallow:
				message = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCellUpdateEmptyValueNotAllowed", Header.Caption);
				canAcceptNull = false;
				return null;
			case Nullable.EmptyString:
				canAcceptNull = true;
				return string.Empty;
			case Nullable.Nothing:
				canAcceptNull = true;
				return null;
			case Nullable.Null:
				canAcceptNull = true;
				return DBNull.Value;
			default:
			{
				PropertyDescriptor obj = PropertyDescriptor;
				IUltraDataColumn val = (IUltraDataColumn)(object)((obj is IUltraDataColumn) ? obj : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					canAcceptNull = val.AllowDBNull;
					return DBNull.Value;
				}
				DataColumn dataColumn = GetDataColumn();
				if (dataColumn != null)
				{
					canAcceptNull = dataColumn.AllowDBNull;
					if (!canAcceptNull && DataType == typeof(string))
					{
						canAcceptNull = true;
						return string.Empty;
					}
					return DBNull.Value;
				}
				if (propertyDescriptor != null && DataType == typeof(string))
				{
					canAcceptNull = true;
					return string.Empty;
				}
				if (Utilities.IsNullableType(DataType))
				{
					canAcceptNull = true;
					return null;
				}
				canAcceptNull = true;
				return DBNull.Value;
			}
			}
		}

		internal void SynchronizeRadioButtons(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if ((Style != ColumnStyle.RadioButtonByBand && style != ColumnStyle.RadioButtonByRowsCollection && !(row.GetEditorResolved(this) is RadioButtonEditor)) || !GetCellRadioButtonState(row, this, out var value) || !value)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			UltraGridCell lastCheckedRadioButtonCell = GetLastCheckedRadioButtonCell(row, this);
			if (lastCheckedRadioButtonCell != null)
			{
				bool cellRadioButtonState = GetCellRadioButtonState(lastCheckedRadioButtonCell.Row, lastCheckedRadioButtonCell.Column, out value);
				if (cellRadioButtonState && value)
				{
					flag = true;
					if (lastCheckedRadioButtonCell.Row != row)
					{
						lastCheckedRadioButtonCell.Value = false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridRow item in Style switch
				{
					ColumnStyle.RadioButtonByBand => row.Band.GetRowEnumerator(GridRowType.DataRow), 
					_ => row.ParentCollection, 
				})
				{
					if (row != item)
					{
						bool cellRadioButtonState = GetCellRadioButtonState(item, this, out value);
						if (cellRadioButtonState && value)
						{
							item.SetCellValue(this, false);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			lastCheckedRadioButtonCellRef = new WeakReference(row.Cells[this]);
		}

		private static bool GetCellRadioButtonState(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column, out bool value)
		{
			value = false;
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = row.GetEditorResolved(column);
			if (!(editorResolved is RadioButtonEditor))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridCell cellIfAllocated = row.GetCellIfAllocated(column);
			object obj = ((cellIfAllocated == null || !cellIfAllocated.IsInEditMode) ? row.GetCellValue(column) : editorResolved.Value);
			if (!(obj is bool))
			{
				return false;
			}
			value = (bool)obj;
			return true;
		}

		internal UltraGridCell GetLastCheckedRadioButtonCell()
		{
			if (lastCheckedRadioButtonCellRef == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GridUtils.GetWeakReferenceTarget(lastCheckedRadioButtonCellRef) as UltraGridCell;
		}

		internal UltraGridCell GetLastCheckedRadioButtonCell(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			return column.Style switch
			{
				ColumnStyle.RadioButtonByBand => GetLastCheckedRadioButtonCell(), 
				_ => row.ParentCollection.GetLastCheckedRadioButtonCell(), 
			};
		}

		private void VerifyCellAppearanceCacheVersion()
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if (ultraGridBand.CellAppearanceCacheVersion != lastVerifiedCellAppearanceCacheVersion)
			{
				cellAppearanceCache = null;
				selectedCellAppearanceCache = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class ColumnDataTypeUITypeEditor : DataTypeUITypeEditor
	{
		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (!(context.Instance is UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn))
			{
				return value;
			}
			if (ultraGridColumn.IsBound)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_102"));
			}
			return ((DataTypeUITypeEditor)this).EditValue(context, provider, value);
		}
	}
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, Name = "FullTrust")]
	[PermissionSet(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Name = "FullTrust")]
	public class ColumnUITypeEditor : UITypeEditor
	{
		public override UITypeEditorEditStyle GetEditStyle(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return UITypeEditorEditStyle.Modal;
		}

		public override object EditValue(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value)
		{
			if (context != null && context.Instance != null && provider != null)
			{
				IWindowsFormsEditorService windowsFormsEditorService = null;
				windowsFormsEditorService = (IWindowsFormsEditorService)provider.GetService(typeof(IWindowsFormsEditorService));
				if (windowsFormsEditorService != null && value is ColumnsCollection columns)
				{
					try
					{
						ColumnUITypeEditorInfoDNF columnUITypeEditorInfo = new ColumnUITypeEditorInfoDNF(columns);
						windowsFormsEditorService.ShowDialog(new ColumnEditorDialog(columnUITypeEditorInfo));
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
			}
			return value;
		}
	}

		}

		}

		internal class ListIndexComparer : IComparer<UltraGridRow>
		{
			private int AncestorRowIndexComparer(UltraGridRow row1, UltraGridRow row2)
			{
				UltraGridRow parentRow = row1.ParentRow;
				if (parentRow != null)
				{
					UltraGridRow parentRow2 = row2.ParentRow;
					if (parentRow2 != null)
					{
						int num = AncestorRowIndexComparer(parentRow, parentRow2);
						if (num != 0)
						{
							return num;
						}
					}
				}
				int listIndex = row1.ListIndex;
				int listIndex2 = row2.ListIndex;
				if (listIndex < listIndex2)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (listIndex > listIndex2)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return 0;
			}

			public int Compare(UltraGridRow row1, UltraGridRow row2)
			{
				if (row1 != null && row2 != null)
				{
					return AncestorRowIndexComparer(row1, row2);
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		public sealed class LayoutTypeConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{

					return true;
				}

				{
					UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = (UltraGridLayout)value;
					bool flag = ultraGridLayout.Key != null && ultraGridLayout.Key.Length > 0;
					ConstructorInfo constructorInfo = ((!flag) ? typeof(UltraGridLayout).GetConstructor(new Type[0]) : typeof(UltraGridLayout).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) }));
					if (constructorInfo != null)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new InstanceDescriptor(constructorInfo, new object[1] { ultraGridLayout.Key }, isComplete: false);
						}
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructorInfo, new object[0], isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		public sealed class DisplayLayoutTypeConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
				UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = value as UltraGridLayout;
				if (properties != null && ultraGridLayout != null && ultraGridLayout.grid is UltraDropDownBase)

					int num = 0;

					{

						{
							num++;
						}
					}
					PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[num];
					int num2 = 0;
					for (int j = 0; j < properties.Count; j++)
					{
						if (!FilterOutProperty(properties[j]))
						{
							array[num2] = properties[j];
							num2++;
						}
					}
					return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
				}
				return properties;
			}

			private static bool FilterOutProperty(PropertyDescriptor pd)
			{
				switch (pd.DisplayName)
				{
				case "AddNewBox":
				case "GroupByBox":
				case "InterBandSpacing":
				case "Key":
				case "MaxColScrollRegions":
				case "MaxRowScrollRegions":
				case "RowConnectorColor":
				case "RowConnectorStyle":
				case "TabNavigation":
				case "ValueLists":
				case "ViewStyle":
				case "ViewStyleBand":
					return true;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		private class RowComparerByRelation : IComparer<UltraGridRow>
		{
			internal RowComparerByRelation()
			{
			}

			private int CompareHelper(UltraGridRow x, UltraGridRow y, bool sameLevelRowsComparisonOnly)
			{
				UltraGridRow parentRow = x.ParentRow;
				int num;
				if (parentRow != null)
				{
					num = CompareHelper(parentRow, y, sameLevelRowsComparisonOnly: true);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						return num;
					}
				}
				UltraGridRow parentRow2 = y.ParentRow;
				if (parentRow2 != null)
				{
					num = CompareHelper(x, parentRow2, sameLevelRowsComparisonOnly: true);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						return num;
					}
				}
				num = x.OverallHierarchyLevel.CompareTo(y.OverallHierarchyLevel);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					if (!sameLevelRowsComparisonOnly)
					{
						return num;
					}
					return 0;
				}
				return x.Index.CompareTo(y.Index);
			}

			public int Compare(UltraGridRow x, UltraGridRow y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (x == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (y == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return CompareHelper(x, y, sameLevelRowsComparisonOnly: false);
			}
		}

			private int hierarchicalLevel = -1;

			public bool? Hidden
			{
				get

		internal int CachedCaptionHeight
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0149: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0095: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a9: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_009f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (cachedCaptionHeight == 0)
				{
					ResolveAppearanceContext context = new ResolveAppearanceContext(typeof(UltraGridLayout), (AppearancePropFlags)65028552);
					context.IsCaption = true;
					Size size = new Size(0, 0);
					string text = ((Control)(object)grid).Text;
					AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
					ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
					if (((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).Image != null)
					{
						Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).GetImage(Grid.ImageList);
						if (image != null)
						{
							size = image.Size;
							size.Height++;
						}
					}
					if (((int)((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageVAlign == 1 || (int)((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageVAlign == 3) && (int)((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageHAlign == 2)
					{
						cachedCaptionHeight = size.Height;
						if (text != null)
						{
							cachedCaptionHeight = CalculateFontSize(ref appData, text).Height;
							if (cachedCaptionHeight != 0)
							{
								cachedCaptionHeight += 4;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (text != null)
						{
							cachedCaptionHeight = CalculateFontSize(ref appData, text).Height;
							if (cachedCaptionHeight != 0)
							{
								cachedCaptionHeight += 4;
							}
						}
						if (size.Height > cachedCaptionHeight)
						{
							cachedCaptionHeight = size.Height;
						}
					}
				}
				if (cachedCaptionHeight != 0)
				{
					return cachedCaptionHeight + 2 * GetBorderThickness(BorderStyleCaption);
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal int AddNewBoxMaxHeight
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0122: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (AddNewBox.Hidden)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				int num = AddNewBox.PromptSize.Height;
				int num2 = 0;
				int num3 = addNewBox.ButtonHeight + 3 + 2 * GetButtonThickness(addNewBox.GetButtonStyleResolved(null));
				if (num3 > num)
				{
					num = num3;
				}
				if (SortedBands != null)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = null;
					if (addNewBox.Style != AddNewBoxStyle.Full)
					{
						num2 = Math.Max(2, num - num3) + 2;
						return Math.Max(num, num2) + 2 * GetBorderThickness(addNewBox.BorderStyle) + 4;
					}
					num2 = Math.Max(8, num - num3) + 8;
					for (int i = 0; i < SortedBands.Count; i++)
					{
						if (!sortedBands[i].Hidden)
						{
							int hierarchicalLevel = sortedBands[i].HierarchicalLevel;
							num2 = ((ultraGridBand == null) ? (num2 + num3) : ((hierarchicalLevel > ultraGridBand.HierarchicalLevel) ? (num2 + 8) : (num2 + (num3 + 6))));
							ultraGridBand = sortedBands[i];
						}
					}
				}
				return Math.Max(num, num2) + 2 * GetBorderThickness(addNewBox.BorderStyle);
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Content)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public BandsSerializer BandsSerializer
		{
			get
			{
				if (loadedBands == null)
				{
					loadedBands = new BandsSerializer(this);
				}
				if (!(typeof(UltraGridLayout) == GetType()) || sortedBands == null || loadedBands.Count > 0)
				{
					bool flag = grid != null && !grid.Initializing && grid.DesignMode && !grid.InternalInSet_ListManager && grid.IsSerializing;
					if (flag)
					{
						flag = Grid.BindingManager != null;
						if (!flag && loadedBands.Count <= 0)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							foreach (UltraGridBand loadedBand in loadedBands)
							{
								if (!Bands.Contains(loadedBand))
								{
									flag = true;
									break;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						InitializeBandsSerializeFromBandsHelper(Bands);
					}
				}
				return loadedBands;
			}
		}

		internal BandsSerializer LoadedBandsInternal => loadedBands;

				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		internal ViewStyleBase ViewStyleImpl
		{
			get
			{
				if (viewStyleImpl == null)
				{
					if (grid == null || grid is UltraGrid)
					{
						if (viewStyle == ViewStyle.MultiBand)
						{
							if (viewStyleBand == ViewStyleBand.Horizontal)
							{
								viewStyleImpl = new ViewStyleHorizontal(this);
							}
							else if (viewStyleBand == ViewStyleBand.Vertical)
							{
								viewStyleImpl = new ViewStyleVertical(this);
							}
							else
							{
								viewStyleImpl = new ViewStyleOutlookGroupBy(this);
							}
						}
						else if (ViewStyleBand.OutlookGroupBy == ViewStyleBand)
						{
							viewStyleImpl = new ViewStyleOutlookGroupBySingle(this);
						}
						else
						{
							viewStyleImpl = new ViewStyleSingle(this);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						viewStyleImpl = new ViewStyleSingle(this);
					}
				}
				return viewStyleImpl;
			}
		}

		internal Scrollbars ScrollbarsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0034: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (grid != null && !grid.DesignMode && scrollbars == Scrollbars.Automatic && grid is UltraDropDownBase ultraDropDownBase && (int)ultraDropDownBase.DropDownResizeHandleStyleResolved == 1)
				{
					if (ultraDropDownBase.IncludeHorizontalScrollbar)
					{
						if (ultraDropDownBase.IncludeVerticalScrollbar)
						{
							return Scrollbars.Both;
						}
						return Scrollbars.Horizontal;
					}
					if (ultraDropDownBase.IncludeVerticalScrollbar)
					{
						return Scrollbars.Vertical;
					}
					return Scrollbars.None;
				}
				return scrollbars;
			}
		}

		internal ScrollBounds ScrollBoundsResolved
		{
			get
			{
				ScrollBounds scrollBounds = ScrollBounds;
				if (scrollBounds == ScrollBounds.ScrollToFill && IsPrintLayout)
				{
					return ScrollBounds.ScrollToLastItem;
				}
				if (scrollBounds != ScrollBounds.ScrollToFill && rows != null && rows.HasFixedRows(top: false))
				{
					scrollBounds = ScrollBounds.ScrollToFill;
				}
				return scrollBounds;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridLayout_P_ViewStyle")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Display")]
		public ViewStyle ViewStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return viewStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value == viewStyle)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(ViewStyle), value))
				{
					throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_172"));
				}
				BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
				if (!(grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
				{
					viewStyle = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ViewStyle);
					return;
				}
				if (ultraGrid.EventManager.InProgress(GridEventIds.InitializeRow))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_173"));
				}
				if (value == ViewStyle.SingleBand && IsDisplayLayout)
				{
					UltraGridRow activeRow = ActiveRow;
					if (activeRow != null && activeRow.ParentRow != null)
					{
						UltraGridRow band_0_Row = ActiveRow.GetBand_0_Row();
						grid.ActiveRow = band_0_Row;
						if (band_0_Row != grid.ActiveRow && grid.ActiveRow != null)
						{
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				viewStyle = value;
				ClearViewStyle(groupByAffected: false);
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridLayout_P_ViewStyleBand")]

					{
						throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_173"));
					}
					bool groupByAffected = ViewStyleBand.OutlookGroupBy == value || ViewStyleBand.OutlookGroupBy == viewStyleBand;
					viewStyleBand = value;

					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ViewStyleBand);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		internal ColScrollRegion ActiveColScrollRegion
		{
			get
			{
				if (grid != null)
				{
					return grid.ActiveColScrollRegion;
				}
				ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegionsCollection = ColScrollRegions;
				if (colScrollRegionsCollection == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (colScrollRegionsCollection.Count < 1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return colScrollRegionsCollection.DefaultActiveRegion;
			}

		internal UltraGridBand BandZero
		{
			get
			{
				if (sortedBands == null || sortedBands.Count <= 0)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return sortedBands[0];
			}
		}

		internal int MinRowHeight
		{
			get
			{
				int num = 10;
				BandsCollection bandsCollection = sortedBands;
				if (bandsCollection.Count > 0)
				{
					int num2 = 0;
					num = bandsCollection[num2].GetMinRowHeight();
					for (num2++; num2 < bandsCollection.Count; num2++)
					{
						if (bandsCollection[num2].HiddenResolved)
						{
							num = Math.Min(num, bandsCollection[num2].GetMinRowHeight());
						}
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal int DefaultFontHeight
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (cachedFontHeight < 1)
				{
					AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
					AppearancePropFlags flags = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
					MergeLayoutAppearances(ref appData, ref flags, LayoutAppearanceIndex.Default, StyleUtils.GetControlAreaRole(this), (RoleState)1);
					cachedFontHeight = CalculateFontHeight(ref appData);
				}
				return cachedFontHeight;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_ListIndexComparer_P_ScrollBarLook")]
		public ScrollBarLook ScrollBarLook
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (scrollbarLook == null || ((DisposableObject)(object)scrollbarLook).Disposed)
				{
					scrollbarLook = new ScrollBarLook(Appearances);
					((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollbarLook).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					scrollbarLook.InitializeAppearances(Appearances);
					ReInitializeScrollBarLook();
				}
				return scrollbarLook;
			}
			set
			{
				if (scrollbarLook != value)
				{
					if (scrollbarLook != null)
					{
						((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollbarLook).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					scrollbarLook = value;
					ReInitializeScrollBarLook();
					if (scrollbarLook != null)
					{
						((SubObjectBase)(object)scrollbarLook).SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
						scrollbarLook.InitializeAppearances(Appearances);
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ScrollBarLook, null);
				}
			}
		}

				{
					InheritanceAttribute inheritanceAttribute = Utilities.GetInheritanceAttribute((Component)(object)Grid);
					if (inheritanceAttribute != null && inheritanceAttribute.InheritanceLevel == InheritanceLevel.Inherited)
					{
						return !ShouldSerialize();
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
			}
		}

		internal bool AlwaysSerializeBandsAndColumns
		{
			get
			{
				if (Grid != null && Grid.DataSource == null && sortedBands != null)
				{
					if (sortedBands.Count <= 1)
					{
						if (sortedBands.Count > 0 && sortedBands[0].Columns != null)
						{
							return sortedBands[0].Columns.Count > 0;
						}
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridLayout_P_SelectionOverlayColor")]
		public Color SelectionOverlayColor
		{
			get
			{
				return selectionOverlayColor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(selectionOverlayColor == value))
				{
					selectionOverlayColor = value;
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.SelectionOverlayColor);
				}
			}
		}

		internal Color SelectionOverlayColorResolved
		{
			get
			{
				Color color = SelectionOverlayColor;
				if (grid != null && grid.GetExternalSelectionOverlayColor(out var externalColor))
				{
					color = externalColor;
				}
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(this, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SelectionOverlayColor, out var val))
				{
					val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue(this, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SelectionOverlayColor, color, Color.Empty, Color.Empty);
				}
				Color color2 = (Color)val;
				if (color2 != Color.Empty && color2.A == byte.MaxValue)
				{
					color2 = Color.FromArgb(21, color2);
				}
				return color2;
			}
		}

				int num = SelectionOverlayBorderThickness;
				if (grid != null && grid.GetExternalSelectionOverlayBorderThickness(out var externalThickness))
				{
					num = externalThickness;
				}
				if (!StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(this, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SelectionOverlayBorderThickness, out var val))
				{
					val = StyleUtils.CachePropertyValue(this, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SelectionOverlayBorderThickness, num, -1, 3);
				}
				return (int)val;
			}
		}

		internal static void DisposeObjects(IDisposable[] objectsToDispose)
		{
			if (objectsToDispose == null || objectsToDispose.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < objectsToDispose.Length; i++)
			{
				if (objectsToDispose[i] != null)
				{
					objectsToDispose[i].Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsBackgroundScrollable(bool vertical)
		{
			if (vertical)
			{
				if (UseScrollWindow.Both != UseScrollWindow && UseScrollWindow.VerticalOnly != UseScrollWindow)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			else if (UseScrollWindow.Both != UseScrollWindow && UseScrollWindow.HorizontalOnly != UseScrollWindow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DataAreaElement != null && DataAreaElement.dontUseUseScrollWindow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (HasAppearance && !GridUtils.IsBackgroundScrollable(Appearance))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (HasEmptyRowSettings && EmptyRowSettings.ShowEmptyRows && EmptyRowSettings.HasEmptyAreaAppearance && !GridUtils.IsBackgroundScrollable(EmptyRowSettings.EmptyAreaAppearance))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeUseScrollWindow()
		{
			return UseScrollWindow.Both != useScrollWindow;
		}

		internal void ResetUseScrollWindow()
		{
			UseScrollWindow = UseScrollWindow.Both;
		}

		internal static Color DarkenColor(Color color, int byAmount)
		{
			return Color.FromArgb(color.A, Math.Min(255, Math.Max(0, color.R - byAmount)), Math.Min(255, Math.Max(0, color.G - byAmount)), Math.Min(255, Math.Max(0, color.B - byAmount)));
		}

		internal static Color GetColorShade(Color color, int byAmount)
		{
			if (byAmount + color.R > 255 || byAmount + color.B > 255 || byAmount + color.G > 255)
			{
				return DarkenColor(color, byAmount);
			}
			return LightenColor(color, byAmount);
		}

		internal static Color LightenColor(Color color, int byAmount)
		{
			return DarkenColor(color, -byAmount);
		}

		internal int GetOverallExtent(ColScrollRegion csr)
		{
			int num = BandsOverallExtent;
			if (csr.Extent > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < SortedBands.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = SortedBands[i];
					if (!ultraGridBand.CardView || ultraGridBand.HiddenResolved)
					{
						continue;
					}
					int num2 = ((ultraGridBand.CardSettings.MaxCardAreaCols <= 0) ? 3 : ultraGridBand.CardSettings.MaxCardAreaCols);
					int num3 = ultraGridBand.CalculateRequiredCardAreaWidth(num2);
					if (ultraGridBand.CardSettings.AutoFit)
					{
						num3 = Math.Min(num3, csr.Extent);
					}
					else
					{
						while (num3 > csr.Extent && num2 > 1)
						{
							num2--;
							num3 = ultraGridBand.CalculateRequiredCardAreaWidth(num2);
						}
					}
					num = Math.Max(num, num3 + ultraGridBand.GetOrigin(BandOrigin.PreRowArea));
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void ValidateSynchronizedColLists()
		{
			if (grid is UltraGrid)
			{
				if (!synchronizedColListsDirty || InProgress(GridEventIds.InitializeLayout))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (!synchronizedColListsDirty || InProgress(DropDownEventIds.InitializeLayout))
			{
				return;
			}
			synchronizedColListsDirty = false;
			if (sortedBands != null)
			{
				int num = ClearSynchronizedColLists();
				if (num > 0 && sortedBands.Count > 0 && sortedBands[0] != null)
				{
					sortedBands[0].BuildSynchronizedColLists(null);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int ClearSynchronizedColLists()
		{
			int num = 0;
			ViewStyleBase viewStyleBase = ViewStyleImpl;
			if (sortedBands != null && viewStyleBase != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < sortedBands.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = sortedBands[i];
					if (ultraGridBand.HiddenResolved)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (ultraGridBand.AllowColSizingResolved != AllowColSizing.Free)
					{
						num++;
					}
					if (ultraGridBand.Columns != null)
					{
						ColumnsCollection columns = ultraGridBand.Columns;
						int j = 0;
						for (int count = columns.Count; j < count; j++)
						{
							columns[j].RemoveFromSynchronizedColList();
						}
					}
					if (!viewStyleBase.IsMultiBandDisplay)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void ResetCachedScrollCounts(UltraGridRow ultraGridRow)
		{
			if (!IsCachingBandInfo)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<UltraGridRow, CachedRowInfo> dictionary = CachedRowData;
			Dictionary<ChildBandsCollection, CachedChildBandsInfo> dictionary2 = CachedChildBandsData;
			while (ultraGridRow != null)
			{
				if (dictionary.TryGetValue(ultraGridRow, out var value))
				{
					value.ScrollCount = -1;
				}
				UltraGridRow parentRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
				if (parentRow != null && parentRow.ChildBands != null && dictionary2.TryGetValue(parentRow.ChildBands, out var value2))
				{
					value2.ScrollCount = -1;
				}
				ultraGridRow = parentRow;
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureDataSourceAttached()
		{
			if (dataSourceAttachedAtLeastOnce || in_EnsureDataSourceAttached || Rows == null || Rows.Band == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			in_EnsureDataSourceAttached = true;
			try
			{
				dataSourceAttachedAtLeastOnce = bands != null && bands.Count > 0 && bands[0].BindingManager != null && Grid != null && ((Control)(object)Grid).BindingContext != null;
				if (!dataSourceAttachedAtLeastOnce && grid != null && !grid.Initializing && !base.Disposed && grid.DataSource != null && ((Control)(object)grid).BindingContext != null && 1 == Bands.Count && Bands[0].BindingManager == null && !grid.dontLoadDataSource)
				{
					grid.VerifyDataSourceAttached();
					dataSourceAttachedAtLeastOnce = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				in_EnsureDataSourceAttached = false;
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyLoadedBandsHelper()
		{
			if (sortedBands != null && sortedBands.Count > 0)
			{
				if (loadedBands != null && (loadedBands.Count <= 0 || loadedBands[0] != SortedBands[0]))
				{
					Bands.InitializeFrom(loadedBands, PropertyCategories.All);
				}
				SortedBands.InitAppearanceHolders();
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyLoadedBands()
		{
			isApplyingLayout = true;
			try
			{
				if (Grid == null || ((Control)(object)Grid).BindingContext == null || (Grid.DataSource == null && !Grid.DesignMode) || Grid is UltraGrid { Printing_DontInitializeRows: not false } || SortedBands.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				loadedBandsApplied = true;
				ApplyLoadedBandsHelper();
				loadedBands = null;
				if (SortedBands[0].Columns.Count > 0)
				{
					if (!grid.InitializeLayoutFired)
					{
						grid.FireInitializeLayout(new InitializeLayoutEventArgs(this));
					}
					if (rows != null)
					{
						rows.DirtyRows();
					}
				}
				SortedBands.DirtyOrigins();
				RowScrollRegions.DirtyAllVisibleRows();
				ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics(setScrollToBeginning: false);
				if (!IsDisplayLayout)
				{
					ColScrollRegions.InitializeMetrics();
				}
				if (rows != null)
				{
					rows.BumpRowFiltersVersion();
				}
				DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
			}
			finally
			{
				isApplyingLayout = false;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		protected bool ShouldSerializeBands()
		{
			if (bands != null)
			{
				if (bands.Count > 0 && AlwaysSerializeBandsAndColumns)
				{
					return true;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridBand band in bands)
				{
					if (band.ShouldSerialize())
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void InitializeBandsSerializeFromBandsHelper(BandsCollection bands)
		{
			if (loadedBands == null)
			{
				loadedBands = new BandsSerializer(this);
			}
			loadedBands.Clear();
			if (bands == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand band in bands)
			{
				loadedBands.Add(band);
				if (band != null)
				{
					band.addedInBandsSerializer = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ExtractDataStructure(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			try
			{
				extractDataStructureOnly = true;
				if (Grid == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				BindingManagerBase bindingManagerBase = ((Control)(object)Grid).BindingContext[dataSource, dataMember];
				if (bindingManagerBase != null)
				{
					ListManagerUpdated(bindingManagerBase);
					if (rows != null)
					{
						rows.InternalClearHelper();
						rows.UnBind();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				extractDataStructureOnly = false;
			}
		}

		internal void ListManagerUpdated()
		{
			if (Grid != null)
			{
				ListManagerUpdated(Grid.BindingManager);
			}
		}

		private void ListManagerUpdated(BindingManagerBase bindingManager)
		{
			if (grid == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SuspendCalcManagerNotifications();
			bool isUpdating = ((UltraControlBase)grid).IsUpdating;
			if (!isUpdating)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)grid).BeginUpdate();
			}
			try
			{
				maxBandDepthCurrentlyEnforced = MaxBandDepth;
				if (bindingManager == null)
				{
					if (grid != null)
					{
						grid.ClearActiveRow();
					}
					if (rows != null)
					{
						rows.InternalClearHelper();
						rows.UnBind();
						rows.Dispose();
						rows = null;
					}
					if (bands != null)
					{
						if (grid != null && (grid.DesignMode || grid.DataSource != null))
						{
							BandsSerializer bandsSerializer = BandsSerializer;
							if ((bandsSerializer == null || bandsSerializer.Count == 0) && bands.Count > 0)
							{
								InitializeBandsSerializeFromBandsHelper(bands);
							}
							bands.Clear();
						}
						else
						{
							bands.Dispose();
						}
						bands = null;
					}
					if (colScrollRegions != null)
					{
						synchronizedColListsDirty = true;
						ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics(setScrollToBeginning: true);
					}
					if (rowScrollRegions != null)
					{
						RowScrollRegions.DirtyAllVisibleRows(setScrollToBeginning: true);
					}
					BumpSortedBandsVersion();
					DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
					return;
				}
				UltraGridBand[] oldBands = null;
				if (Bands.Count < 1)
				{
					Bands.InternalAdd(null, null, null);
				}
				else if (Bands.Count > 1)
				{
					oldBands = Bands.ClearAllButBandZero();
				}
				string text = grid.DataMember;
				if (bindingManager != null)
				{
					PropertyDescriptorCollection itemProperties = bindingManager.GetItemProperties();
					bool flag = false;
					string text2 = null;
					foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in itemProperties)
					{
						if (typeof(IList).IsAssignableFrom(item.PropertyType) && !typeof(Array).IsAssignableFrom(item.PropertyType))
						{
							if (text2 == null)
							{
								text2 = item.Name;
							}
							continue;
						}
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (!flag && text2 != null)
					{
						text = ((text == null || text.Length == 0) ? text2 : (text + "." + text2));
						bindingManager = ((Control)(object)Grid).BindingContext[Grid.DataSource, text];
					}
				}
				bands[0].InitListManager(bindingManager, text, oldBands);
				if (!ExtractDataStructureOnly)
				{
					ApplyLoadedBands();
				}
				else
				{
					loadedBands = null;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				ResumeCalcManagerNotifications();
				if (!isUpdating)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)grid).EndUpdate();
				}
			}
			if (LoadedBandsApplied)
			{
				if (!grid.InitializeLayoutFired)
				{
					grid.FireInitializeLayout(new InitializeLayoutEventArgs(this));
				}
				if (grid is UltraCombo ultraCombo)
				{
					ultraCombo.InternalDataSourceInitialized();
				}
			}
		}

				if (grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
				{
					ultraGrid.EnsureTempActiveRowAssigned();
				}
			}
		}

		protected void ClearViewStyle(bool groupByAffected)
		{
			viewStyleImpl = null;
			if (groupByAffected && sortedBands != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < sortedBands.Count; i++)
				{
					if (sortedBands[i].HasSortedColumns && sortedBands[i].SortedColumns.Count > 0 && sortedBands[i].SortedColumns[0].InternalGetIsGroupByColumn())
					{
						sortedBands[i].BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
					}
				}
			}
			BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
			BumpScrollableRowCountVersion();
			BumpRowFiltersVersion();
			BumpFixedRowsCollectionsVersion();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ViewStyle);
		}

		public void ClearGroupByColumns()
		{

			{
				for (int i = 0; i < SortedBands.Count; i++)

					ultraGridBand.ClearGroupByColumns();
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		internal int GetCellSpacingDefault(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (HasOverride && overrideObj.ShouldSerializeCellSpacing())
			{
				return overrideObj.CellSpacing;
			}
			if (band == null || !band.CardView)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			return 1;
		}

		internal int GetRowSelectorWidthDefault(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (HasOverride && overrideObj.ShouldSerializeRowSelectorWidth())
			{
				return overrideObj.RowSelectorWidth;
			}
			int num = RowSelectorRowIconWidth;
			if (band.SupportsDataErrorInfoOnRowsResolved)
			{
				num += DATA_ERROR_ICON_DEFAULT_WIDTH;
			}
			if (FixedRowIndicator.Button == band.FixedRowIndicatorResolved)
			{
				int fixedRowIndicatorWidth = FixedRowIndicatorWidth;
				num += fixedRowIndicatorWidth + 2 * HEADER_BUTTON_PADDING;
			}
			num += band.GetRowSelectorNumberWidth();
			if ((band.RowEditTemplateUITypeResolved & RowEditTemplateUIType.RowSelectorImage) != RowEditTemplateUIType.None)
			{
				num += RowEditTemplateIndicatorWidth + 4;
			}
			return Math.Max(num, RowSelectorMinimumWidth);
		}

		internal void BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion()
		{
			cellChildElementsCacheVersion++;
			BumpRowChildElementsCacheVersion();
		}

		internal void BumpRowFiltersVersion()
		{
			rowFiltersVersionNumber++;
			BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
			BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
		}

		internal void BumpSummariesVersion()
		{
			BandsCollection bandsCollection = bands;
			if (bandsCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < bandsCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = bandsCollection[i];
				if (ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridBand.HasSummaries)
				{
					ultraGridBand.Summaries.BumpSummariesVersion();
				}
			}
		}
