		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			//IL_0337: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_033d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (propChange.Source == overrideObj)
			{
				OnOverrideChanged(propChange, null);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Override, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == addNewBox)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
				{
					switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId)
					{
					case PropertyIds.AddNewBoxStyle:
					case PropertyIds.Appearance:
					case PropertyIds.ButtonAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.Hidden:
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
					}
					else
					{
						UIElement uIElement = GetUIElement(verify: false);
						if (uIElement != null)
						{
							uIElement = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(AddNewBoxUIElement));
							if (uIElement != null)
							{
								uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
							}
						}
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AddNewBox, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == groupByBox)
			{
				bool flag2 = false;
				if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
				{
					switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId)
					{
					case PropertyIds.AddNewBoxStyle:
					case PropertyIds.Appearance:
					case PropertyIds.ButtonAppearance:
					case PropertyIds.Hidden:
					case PropertyIds.Prompt:
					case PropertyIds.ShowBandLabels:
					case PropertyIds.BandLabelBorderStyle:
					case PropertyIds.GroupByBoxStyle:
						flag2 = true;
						break;
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
					}
					else
					{
						UIElement uIElement2 = GetUIElement(verify: false);
						if (uIElement2 != null)
						{
							uIElement2 = uIElement2.GetDescendant(typeof(GroupByBoxUIElement));
							if (uIElement2 != null)
							{
								uIElement2.DirtyChildElements();
							}
						}
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupByBox, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == bands)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Bands, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == colScrollRegions)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ColScrollRegions, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == rowScrollRegions)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RowScrollRegions, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == valuelists)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ValueLists, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == appearances)
			{
				NotifyPropChange((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropIds)1000, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == scrollbarLook)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ScrollBarLook, propChange);
			}
			else if (filterOperatorValueListAll == propChange.Source)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.FilterOperatorsValueList, propChange);
			}
			else if (emptyRowSettings == propChange.Source)
			{
				BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
				BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
				DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.EmptyRowSettings, propChange);
			}
			else if (rowSelectorImages == propChange.Source)
			{
				DirtyGridElement();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RowSelectorImages, propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				if (appearanceHolders == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
				{
					if (appearanceHolders[i] == null || !appearanceHolders[i].HasAppearance || propChange.Source != appearanceHolders[i].RootAppearance)
					{
						continue;
					}
					bool flag3 = propChange.FindPropId((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropIds)4) != null;
					bool flag4 = propChange.FindPropId((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropIds)9) != null;
					bool flag5 = propChange.FindPropId((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropIds)7) != null || propChange.FindPropId((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropIds)8) != null;
					if (i == 0)
					{
						if ((int)(AppearancePropIds)(object)propChange.PropId == 1)
						{
							SynchGridBackColor();
						}
						OnBaseFontChanged();
						if (flag4)
						{
							BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
						}
					}
					if (flag3 || flag4 || flag5)
					{
						DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
					}
					cachedCaptionHeight = 0;
					NotifyPropChange(AppearancePropIds[i], propChange);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange != null && propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)

				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.BorderStyle:

					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
					break;
				case PropertyIds.AsyncExportCompleteImage:
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
					if (IsDisplayLayout && Grid is UltraGrid { HasAsyncExportStatusDisplay: not false } ultraGrid2)
					{
						ultraGrid2.AsyncExportStatusDisplay.AsyncExportCompleteImage = AsyncExportCompleteImage;
					}
					break;
				case PropertyIds.AllowCancelAsyncExport:
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);

				return new Size(20, 20);

			Graphics cachedGraphics = GetCachedGraphics();
			Size result = MeasureString(cachedGraphics, string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) ? "lWg" : text, font, maxWidth, null, textOrientation);
			ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);
			if (text == null && font == fontDefault)

				cachedBaseFontHeight = result.Height;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool PerformAction(UltraGridAction actionCode, bool shiftKeyDown, bool ctlKeyDown)
		{
			//IL_0467: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = Grid as UltraGrid;
			switch (actionCode)
			{
			case UltraGridAction.Copy:
				return PerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Copy);
			case UltraGridAction.Cut:
				return PerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Cut);
			case UltraGridAction.DeleteCells:
				return PerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Delete);
			case UltraGridAction.Paste:
				return PerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Paste);
			case UltraGridAction.Redo:
				return PerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Redo);
			case UltraGridAction.Undo:
				return PerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Undo);
			case UltraGridAction.ExpandRow:
				if (ActiveRow != null)
				{
					ActiveRow.Expanded = true;
				}
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.CollapseRow:
				if (ActiveRow != null)
				{
					ActiveRow.Expanded = false;
				}
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.DeleteRows:
				DeleteSelectedRows(checkAllowDeleteProp: true);
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.UndoCell:
				if (ActiveCell != null)
				{
					ActiveCell.CancelUpdate();
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case UltraGridAction.UndoRow:
				if (ActiveRow != null)
				{
					ActiveRow.CancelUpdate();
					return true;
				}
				break;
			case UltraGridAction.ToggleEditMode:
				if (ActiveCell != null)
				{
					ActiveCell.ToggleEditMode();
				}
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.EnterEditMode:
				if (ActiveCell != null)
				{
					ActiveCell.EnterEditMode(byMouse: false);
				}
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.ExitEditMode:
				ExitEditModeHelper();
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.EnterEditModeAndDropdown:
				if (ActiveCell != null && !ActiveCell.EnterEditMode(byMouse: false, showingDropDown: true))
				{
					ActiveCell.ShowDropDown();
				}
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.ToggleDropdown:
				if (ActiveCell != null)
				{
					ActiveCell.ToggleDropDown();
				}
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.CloseDropdown:
				if (ActiveCell != null)
				{
					ActiveCell.HideDropDown();
				}
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.NextRegion:
				ActivateNextRegion();
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.PrevRegion:
				ActivatePreviousRegion();
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.DeactivateCell:
				if (ultraGrid == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ultraGrid.ActiveCell = null;
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.ActivateCell:
				if (ultraGrid == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ActiveRow != null && !ActiveRow.IsGroupByRow)
				{
					UltraGridCell ultraGridCell2 = null;
					UltraGridColumn firstVisibleCol = ActiveRow.Band.GetFirstVisibleCol(grid.ActiveColScrollRegion, includeNonActivateable: false);
					if (firstVisibleCol != null)
					{
						ultraGridCell2 = ActiveRow.Cells[firstVisibleCol];
						while (ultraGridCell2 != null && ultraGridCell2.IsDisabled && ultraGridCell2 != ActiveCell)
						{
							ultraGridCell2 = GetNextCell(next: true, ActiveRow, ultraGridCell2, shiftKeyDown, ctlKeyDown, spanBands: false, spanRows: false, spanParents: false);
						}
					}
					if (ultraGridCell2 != null)
					{
						ultraGrid.ActiveCell = ultraGridCell2;
						if (ultraGridCell2 == ActiveCell)
						{
							((UltraControlBase)grid).Update();
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.ToggleCheckbox:
				if (ActiveCell != null && ActiveCell.CanBeModified)
				{
					ActiveCell.ToggleCheckBox();
				}
				return true;
			case UltraGridAction.CommitRow:
			{
				UltraGridRow activeRow = ActiveRow;
				if (activeRow is UltraGridFilterRow)
				{
					UltraGridFilterRow ultraGridFilterRow = (UltraGridFilterRow)activeRow;
					ultraGridFilterRow.ApplyFilters();
					return true;
				}
				if (activeRow != null && (activeRow != activeRow.ParentCollection.CurrentAddRow || activeRow.ParentCollection.CurrentAddRowModifiedByUser))
				{
					UltraGridCell activeCell = ActiveCell;
					if (activeCell != null && activeCell.IsInEditMode)
					{
						activeCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: false);
					}
					activeCell = ActiveCell;
					if (activeCell == null || !activeCell.IsInEditMode)
					{
						bool isAddRowFromTemplate = activeRow.IsAddRowFromTemplate;
						if (activeRow.Update())
						{
							activeCell = ActiveCell;
							if (isAddRowFromTemplate && activeRow == ActiveRow && activeRow.ParentCollection.TemplateRowLocationResolved != TemplateAddRowLocation.None && activeRow.AllAncestorsExpanded && (activeCell == null || !activeCell.IsInEditMode))
							{
								activeRow.ParentCollection.AddTemplateAddRowToDataList(activateFirstCellInNewRow: true);
							}
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			case UltraGridAction.CommitHeader:
			{
				HeaderBase activeHeader2 = ActiveHeader;
				if (activeHeader2 != null)
				{
					activeHeader2.ExitEditMode();
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			case UltraGridAction.CancelHeader:
			{
				HeaderBase activeHeader = ActiveHeader;
				if (activeHeader != null)
				{
					activeHeader.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: true);
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			default:
			{
				bool flag = false;
				bool flag2 = false;
				try
				{
					if (!((UltraControlBase)ultraGrid).IsUpdating && (actionCode == UltraGridAction.PageUpRow || actionCode == UltraGridAction.PageDownRow || actionCode == UltraGridAction.PageUpCell || actionCode == UltraGridAction.PageDownCell))
					{
						bool flag3 = false;
						if ((UltraGridAction.PageUpRow != actionCode && UltraGridAction.PageUpCell != actionCode) ? (!ActiveRowScrollRegion.IsLastScrollableRowVisible()) : (!ActiveRowScrollRegion.IsFirstScrollableRowVisible()))
						{
							flag = true;
							((UltraControlBase)ultraGrid).BeginUpdate();
						}
					}
					bool flag4 = ActiveCell != null && ActiveCell.IsInEditMode;
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = ((ActiveCell != null) ? ActiveCell.Band : null);
					GridItemBase selectableItem = GetSelectableItem(actionCode, ref shiftKeyDown, ctlKeyDown);
					if (selectableItem != null)
					{
						ISelectionStrategy selectionStrategy = ((ISelectionManager)Grid).GetSelectionStrategy((ISelectableItem)selectableItem);
						if (selectionStrategy != null)
						{
							bool flag5 = false;
							if (actionCode == UltraGridAction.ToggleCellSel || actionCode == UltraGridAction.ToggleRowSel)
							{
								flag5 = true;
							}
							dontUpdateWhenSelecting = true;
							bool flag6 = true;
							try
							{
								flag6 = selectionStrategy.ProcessKeyBoardItem((ISelectableItem)selectableItem, shiftKeyDown, ctlKeyDown, flag5);
							}
							finally
							{
								Snaking = false;
								dontUpdateWhenSelecting = false;
							}
							if (flag6)
							{
								flag2 = true;
							}
							if (!flag5 && flag6 && selectableItem is UltraGridCell && (UltraGridAction.NextCellByTab == actionCode || UltraGridAction.PrevCellByTab == actionCode))
							{
								UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = (UltraGridCell)selectableItem;
								if ((flag4 && ultraGridBand == ultraGridCell.Band) || ultraGridCell.CellClickActionResolved == CellClickAction.Edit || ultraGridCell.CellClickActionResolved == CellClickAction.EditAndSelectText)
								{
									ultraGridCell.SetFocusAndActivate(byMouse: false, enterEditMode: true, byTabKey: true);
								}
							}
							return flag6;
						}
					}
					else if (TabNavigation == TabNavigation.NextCell && (actionCode == UltraGridAction.NextCellByTab || actionCode == UltraGridAction.PrevCellByTab))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						((UltraControlBase)ultraGrid).EndUpdate();
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						((UltraControlBase)ultraGrid).Update();
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal GridItemBase GetSelectableItem(UltraGridAction actionCode, ref bool shiftKeyDown, bool ctlKeyDown)
		{
			//IL_0113: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		internal UltraGridRow GetRelatedVisibleRow(UltraGridRow row, NavigateType navType, bool spanBands, bool spanParents, bool includeNonActivateable)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			if (row.IsCard)
			{
				ultraGridRow = row.ParentCollection.GetRelatedVisibleCard(row, navType, includeNonActivateable);
				if (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					return ultraGridRow;
				}
				if (!spanParents && !spanBands)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			ViewStyleBase viewStyleBase = viewStyleImpl;
			if (viewStyleBase == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if ((navType == NavigateType.Above || navType == NavigateType.Below) && !viewStyleBase.HasMultiRowTiers)
			{
				navType = ((navType == NavigateType.Above) ? NavigateType.Prev : NavigateType.Next);
			}
			while (true)
			{
				switch (navType)
				{
				case NavigateType.Above:
				{
					bool flag = false;
					if (row.HasPrevSibling(spanBands, excludeHidden: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
					{
						ultraGridRow = row.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Previous, spanBands, excludeCardBands: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
					}
					else if (spanParents)
					{
						UltraGridRow ultraGridRow3 = null;
						ultraGridRow3 = row.GetVisibleCrossParentSibling(previous: true, spanBands);
						if (ultraGridRow3 != null)
						{
							ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow3;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case NavigateType.Below:
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					if (row.HasNextSibling(spanBands, excludeHidden: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
					{
						ultraGridRow = row.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Next, spanBands, excludeCardBands: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
					}
					else if (spanParents)
					{
						UltraGridRow ultraGridRow4 = null;
						ultraGridRow4 = row.GetVisibleCrossParentSibling(previous: false, spanBands);
						if (ultraGridRow4 != null)
						{
							ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow4;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case NavigateType.Next:
					if (spanParents)
					{
						if (spanBands)
						{
							ultraGridRow = row.GetNextVisibleRow();
							break;
						}
						int visibleIndexOffset = ((!row.HiddenResolved) ? 1 : 0);
						ultraGridRow = row.ParentCollection.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(row, visibleIndexOffset);
						if (ultraGridRow == null || ultraGridRow == row)
						{
							UltraGridRow ultraGridRow6 = null;
							ultraGridRow6 = row.GetVisibleCrossParentSibling(previous: false, spanBands);
							if (ultraGridRow6 != null)
							{
								ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow6;
							}
						}
					}
					else if (spanBands)
					{
						ultraGridRow = row.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Next, spanBands, excludeCardBands: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
					}
					else
					{
						int visibleIndexOffset2 = ((!row.HiddenResolved) ? 1 : 0);
						ultraGridRow = row.ParentCollection.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(row, visibleIndexOffset2);
						if (ultraGridRow == row)
						{
							ultraGridRow = null;
						}
					}
					break;
				case NavigateType.Prev:
					if (spanParents)
					{
						if (spanBands)
						{
							ultraGridRow = row.GetPrevVisibleRow();
							break;
						}
						ultraGridRow = row.ParentCollection.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(row, -1);
						if (ultraGridRow == null)
						{
							UltraGridRow ultraGridRow5 = null;
							ultraGridRow5 = row.GetVisibleCrossParentSibling(previous: true, spanBands);
							ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow5;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGridRow = ((!spanBands) ? row.ParentCollection.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(row, -1) : row.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Previous, spanBands, excludeCardBands: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows));
					}
					break;
				case NavigateType.First:
					ultraGridRow = grid.GetRow(ChildRow.First);
					break;
				case NavigateType.Last:
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = null;
					ultraGridRow2 = grid.GetRow(ChildRow.Last);
					if (ultraGridRow2 != null)
					{
						ultraGridRow = viewStyleBase.GetLastDescendantRow(ultraGridRow2);
						if (ultraGridRow == null)
						{
							ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow2;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				if (ultraGridRow == null || !ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
				{
					break;
				}
				row = ultraGridRow;
				ultraGridRow = null;
				if (navType == NavigateType.First)
				{
					navType = NavigateType.Next;
				}
				else if (NavigateType.Last == navType)
				{
					navType = NavigateType.Prev;
				}
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		internal void DeleteSelectedRows(bool checkAllowDeleteProp, bool displayPrompt)
		{
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (!(Grid is UltraGrid { Selected: var selected }))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_180"));
			}
			if (selected == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			SelectedRowsCollection selectedRowsCollection = selected.Rows;
			if (selectedRowsCollection == null || selectedRowsCollection.Count < 1 || selectedRowsCollection[0] is UltraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (checkAllowDeleteProp)
			{
				UltraGridBand band = selectedRowsCollection[0].Band;
				if (selectedRowsCollection[0] == null || (int)band.AllowDeleteResolved == 2)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!band.AllowDelete(out var canDelete))
				{
					foreach (UltraGridRow item in selectedRowsCollection)
					{
						if (!band.AllowDelete(item))
						{
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (!canDelete)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			InternalDeleteRowsHelper(selectedRowsCollection, displayPrompt);
		}

		internal void RaiseMinRowsViolatedError(UltraGridRow rowOptional, int minRowsForBand)
		{
			if (Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
			{
				string errorText = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_UltraGridLayout_MinRowsViolation", minRowsForBand);
				DataErrorInfo dataErrorInfo = new DataErrorInfo(null, null, rowOptional, null, DataErrorSource.RowDelete, errorText);
				ErrorEventArgs e = new ErrorEventArgs(dataErrorInfo);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.Error, e);
			}
		}

		internal void InternalDeleteRowsHelper(SelectedRowsCollection Rows, bool displayPrompt)
		{
			if (Rows.Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!(Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_180"));
			}
			UltraGridRow[] array = new UltraGridRow[Rows.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < Rows.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = Rows[i];
			}
			List<UltraGridRow> list = new List<UltraGridRow>(array.Length);
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				if (array[i] != null)
				{
					list.Add(array[i]);
				}
			}
			list.Sort(new ListIndexComparer());
			int minRowsForBand = GetMinRowsForBand(array);
			if (MinRowsConstraintWillBeViolatedIfTheseRowsAreDeleted(list, minRowsForBand))
			{
				RaiseMinRowsViolatedError(null, minRowsForBand);
				return;
			}
			if (!showDeleteRowsPrompt)
			{
				displayPrompt = showDeleteRowsPrompt;
			}
			BeforeRowsDeletedEventArgs e = new BeforeRowsDeletedEventArgs(array, displayPrompt);
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowsDeleted, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.DisplayPromptMsg)
			{
				string text;
				string text2;
				if (Rows.Count > 1)
				{
					text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DeleteMultipleRowsPrompt", Rows.Count);
					text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DeleteRowsMessageTitle");
				}
				else
				{
					text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DeleteSingleRowPrompt");
					text2 = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DeleteSingleRowMessageTitle");
				}
				DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(text, text2, MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question);
				if (dialogResult != DialogResult.Yes)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			Selected newSelections = new Selected();
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeSelectChange, new BeforeSelectChangeEventArgs(typeof(UltraGridRow), newSelections));
			for (int i = list.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = list[i];
				try
				{
					ultraGridRow.DeleteHelper();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					DataErrorInfo dataErrorInfo = new DataErrorInfo(ex, null, ultraGridRow, null, DataErrorSource.RowDelete, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorDeleteRowUnableToDelete", ex.Message));
					if (Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid2)
					{
						ultraGrid2.InternalHandleDataError(dataErrorInfo);
					}
				}
			}
			ultraGrid.ClearAllSelected();
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterSelectChange, new AfterSelectChangeEventArgs(typeof(UltraGridRow)));
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowsDeleted, null);
			RowScrollRegions.DirtyAllVisibleRows(setScrollToBeginning: false);
			DirtyGridElement();
		}

		internal static bool MinRowsConstraintWillBeViolatedIfTheseRowsAreDeleted(List<UltraGridRow> rowsToDelete, int minRowsForBand)
		{
			RowsCollection rowsCollection = null;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < rowsToDelete.Count; i++)
			{
				ultraGridRow = rowsToDelete[i];
				if (ultraGridRow == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (rowsCollection == null)
				{
					rowsCollection = ultraGridRow.ParentCollection.TopLevelRowsCollection;
					num2 = rowsCollection.UnSortedActualRows.Count;
				}
				if (rowsCollection == ultraGridRow.ParentCollection.TopLevelRowsCollection)
				{
					num++;
					int num3 = num2 - num;
					if (num3 < minRowsForBand)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					rowsCollection = null;
					num = 0;
					i--;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static int GetMinRowsForBand(UltraGridRow[] rowArray)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < rowArray.Length; i++)
			{
				if (rowArray[i] != null)
				{
					return rowArray[i].Band.MinRows;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		{
			Form form = null;
			try

				form = Grid.EditorContainerControl.FindForm();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}

		internal Rectangle GetExternalWindowRect(Control externalControl)
		{
			Rectangle empty = Rectangle.Empty;
			Rectangle empty2 = Rectangle.Empty;
			empty = grid.EditorContainerControl.RectangleToScreen(grid.GridClientAreaRectangle);
			if (externalControl == null)
			{
				return empty;
			}
			empty2 = externalControl.RectangleToScreen(externalControl.ClientRectangle);
			empty2.X -= empty.X;
			empty2.Y -= empty.Y;
			return empty2;
		}

		internal void ActivateNextRegion()
		{
			ColScrollRegion activeColScrollRegion = grid.ActiveColScrollRegion;
			RowScrollRegion activeRowScrollRegion = grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			if (activeColScrollRegion == null || activeRowScrollRegion == null || grid == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColScrollRegion nextVisibleRegion = colScrollRegions.GetNextVisibleRegion(activeColScrollRegion, wrap: false);
			if (nextVisibleRegion == null)
			{
				RowScrollRegion nextVisibleRegion2 = rowScrollRegions.GetNextVisibleRegion(activeRowScrollRegion, wrap: true);
				if (nextVisibleRegion2 != null && nextVisibleRegion2 != activeRowScrollRegion)
				{
					grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion = nextVisibleRegion2;
				}
				nextVisibleRegion = colScrollRegions.GetNextVisibleRegion(null, wrap: false);
			}
			if (nextVisibleRegion != null && nextVisibleRegion != activeColScrollRegion)
			{
				grid.ActiveColScrollRegion = nextVisibleRegion;
			}
		}

		internal void ActivatePreviousRegion()
		{
			ColScrollRegion activeColScrollRegion = grid.ActiveColScrollRegion;
			RowScrollRegion activeRowScrollRegion = grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			if (activeColScrollRegion == null || activeRowScrollRegion == null || grid == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColScrollRegion previousVisibleRegion = colScrollRegions.GetPreviousVisibleRegion(activeColScrollRegion, wrap: false);
			if (previousVisibleRegion == null)
			{
				RowScrollRegion previousVisibleRegion2 = rowScrollRegions.GetPreviousVisibleRegion(activeRowScrollRegion, wrap: true);
				if (previousVisibleRegion2 != null && previousVisibleRegion2 != activeRowScrollRegion)
				{
					grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion = previousVisibleRegion2;
				}
				previousVisibleRegion = colScrollRegions.GetPreviousVisibleRegion(null, wrap: false);
			}
			if (previousVisibleRegion != null && previousVisibleRegion != activeColScrollRegion)
			{
				grid.ActiveColScrollRegion = previousVisibleRegion;
			}
		}

		protected UltraGridLayout(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)

		public void Load(string filename)
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filename, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			try
			{
				Load(fileStream);
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream.Close();
			}
		}

		public void Load(Stream stream, PropertyCategories propertyCategories)
		{
			if (!stream.CanRead)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_181"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_334"));
			}
			BinaryFormatter binaryFormatter = new BinaryFormatter(null, new StreamingContext(StreamingContextStates.Persistence, propertyCategories));
			binaryFormatter.AssemblyFormat = FormatterAssemblyStyle.Simple;
			LoadHelper(stream, propertyCategories, binaryFormatter);
		}

		public void Load(string filename, PropertyCategories propertyCategories)
		{
			FileStream fileStream = new FileStream(filename, FileMode.Open, FileAccess.Read);
			try
			{
				Load(fileStream, propertyCategories);
			}
			finally
			{
				fileStream.Close();
			}
		}

		private void LoadHelper(Stream stream, PropertyCategories propertyCategories, IFormatter formatter)
		{
			formatter.Binder = (SerializationBinder)(object)new Infragistics.Win.UltraWinGrid.Serialization.Binder();
			AppDomain.CurrentDomain.AssemblyResolve += OnAppDomainAssemblyResolve;
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout;
			try
			{
				ultraGridLayout = formatter.Deserialize(stream) as UltraGridLayout;
			}
			finally
			{
				AppDomain.CurrentDomain.AssemblyResolve -= OnAppDomainAssemblyResolve;
			}
			ultraGridLayout.OnDeserializationComplete(calledFromEndInit: false);
			Load(ultraGridLayout, propertyCategories);
		}

		private Assembly OnAppDomainAssemblyResolve(object sender, ResolveEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Name != null && e.Name.StartsWith("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinGrid"))
			{
				return typeof(UltraGridLayout).Assembly;
			}
			if (e.Name != null && e.Name.StartsWith("Infragistics") && IsInfragisticsAssembly(e.Name, "Win"))
			{
				return typeof(UltraControlBase).Assembly;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsInfragisticsAssembly(string assemblyName, string assemblySuffix)
		{
			if (assemblyName != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < global::AssemblyRef.AllowedAssemblyPrefixes.Length; i++)
				{
					string arg = global::AssemblyRef.AllowedAssemblyPrefixes[i];
					if (assemblyName.StartsWith($"{arg}.{assemblySuffix}.v"))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InitAppearanceHolders()
		{
			if (valuelists != null)
			{
				valuelists.InitAppearanceHolders();
			}
			Bands.InitAppearanceHolders();
		}

		public void Load(UltraGridLayout newLayout, PropertyCategories propertyCategories)
		{
			isApplyingLayout = true;
			try
			{
				CopyFrom(newLayout, propertyCategories);
			}
			finally
			{
				isApplyingLayout = false;
			}
		}

			binaryFormatter.Serialize(stream, this);
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = (UltraGridLayout)MemberwiseClone();
			ultraGridLayout.InitializeFrom(this, PropertyCategories.All);
			return ultraGridLayout;
		}

		internal void HookIntoEditor(EmbeddableEditorBase editor)
		{
			if (lastHookedEditor != editor)
			{
				UnHookFromEditor();
				lastHookedEditor = editor;
				lastHookedEditor.BeforeEnterEditMode += EmbeddableEditor_BeforeEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.AfterEnterEditMode += EmbeddableEditor_AfterEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.BeforeExitEditMode += EmbeddableEditor_BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.AfterExitEditMode += EmbeddableEditor_AfterExitEditModeEventHandler;
				if (lastHookedEditor.SupportsDropDown)
				{
					lastHookedEditor.BeforeDropDown += EmbeddableEditor_BeforeDropDownEventHandler;
					lastHookedEditor.AfterCloseUp += EmbeddableEditor_AfterCloseupEventHandler;
					lastHookedEditor.SelectionChanged += EmbeddableEditor_SelectionChangedEventHandler;
				}
				lastHookedEditor.KeyDown += EmbeddableEditor_KeyDownEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.KeyUp += EmbeddableEditor_KeyUpEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.KeyPress += EmbeddableEditor_KeyPressEventHandler;
			}
		}

		internal void UnHookFromEditor()
		{
			if (lastHookedEditor != null)
			{
				lastHookedEditor.BeforeEnterEditMode -= EmbeddableEditor_BeforeEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.AfterEnterEditMode -= EmbeddableEditor_AfterEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.BeforeExitEditMode -= EmbeddableEditor_BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.AfterExitEditMode -= EmbeddableEditor_AfterExitEditModeEventHandler;
				if (lastHookedEditor.SupportsDropDown)
				{
					lastHookedEditor.BeforeDropDown -= EmbeddableEditor_BeforeDropDownEventHandler;
					lastHookedEditor.AfterCloseUp -= EmbeddableEditor_AfterCloseupEventHandler;
					lastHookedEditor.SelectionChanged -= EmbeddableEditor_SelectionChangedEventHandler;
				}
				lastHookedEditor.KeyDown -= EmbeddableEditor_KeyDownEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.KeyUp -= EmbeddableEditor_KeyUpEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.KeyPress -= EmbeddableEditor_KeyPressEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor = null;
			}
		}

								valueList.ValueListItems.Add(val);
							}
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			valueList.DisplayStyle = (ValueListDisplayStyle)4;
			valueList.ScaleItemImage = (ScaleImage)0;
			object[] array = filterRowCache;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i += 6)
			{
				FilterOperatorDropDownItems filterOperatorDropDownItems = (FilterOperatorDropDownItems)array[i];
				FilterComparisionOperator filterComparisionOperator = (FilterComparisionOperator)array[1 + i];
				if (filterOperatorDropDownItems == (filterOperatorDropDownItems & items))
				{
					string text = array[3 + i].ToString();
					string symbol = array[4 + i].ToString();
					Image image = (Image)array[5 + i];
					if (image == null)
					{
						image = (Image)(array[5 + i] = GetFilterComparisonOperatorSymbolHelper(filterComparisionOperator, symbol));
					}
					ValueListItem val2 = valueList.ValueListItems.Add((object)filterComparisionOperator, text);
					if (image != null)
					{
						val2.Appearance.Image = image;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal EmbeddableEditorBase GetFilterOperandEditor(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			//IL_00b4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00be: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0065: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			FilterOperandStyle filterOperandStyleResolved = column.FilterOperandStyleResolved;
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = null;
			switch (filterOperandStyleResolved)
			{
			case FilterOperandStyle.Combo:
			case FilterOperandStyle.DropDownList:
				if (filterRowComboEditor == null)
				{
					filterRowComboEditor = (EditorWithCombo)(object)new FilterOperandEditorWithCombo();
				}
				val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)filterRowComboEditor;
				break;
			case FilterOperandStyle.UseColumnEditor:
				val = column.Editor;
				if (val is RadioButtonEditor)
				{
					if (filterRowCheckEditor == null)
					{
						filterRowCheckEditor = new CheckEditor();
						((ToggleEditorBase)filterRowCheckEditor).CheckAlign = ContentAlignment.MiddleCenter;
					}
					val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)filterRowCheckEditor;
				}
				break;
			case FilterOperandStyle.Default:
			case FilterOperandStyle.FilterUIProvider:
				if (column.Band != null)
				{
					IFilterUIProvider filterUIProviderResolved = column.Band.FilterUIProviderResolved;
					if (filterUIProviderResolved != null)
					{
						EmbeddableEditorBase filterCellEditor = filterUIProviderResolved.GetFilterCellEditor(column);
						if (filterCellEditor != null)
						{
							val = filterCellEditor;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				goto default;
			default:
				if (filterRowTextEditor == null)
				{
					filterRowTextEditor = new EditorWithText();
				}
				val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)filterRowTextEditor;
				break;
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal bool ExitEditModeHelper(bool cell = true, bool header = true)
		{
			if (header && !ExitEditModeOnActiveHeaderIfNeeded())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (cell)
			{
				ActiveCell?.ExitEditMode();
				UltraGridCell activeCell = ActiveCell;
				if (activeCell != null)
				{
					return !activeCell.IsInEditMode;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void BumpVerifyEditorVersionNumber(UltraGridBand changedBand)
		{
			if (sortedBands == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in sortedBands)
			{
				if (sortedBand == null || !sortedBand.HasColumnsBeenAllocated)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in sortedBand.Columns)
				{
					if (changedBand == null || changedBand == sortedBand)
					{
						column.DirtyDefaultEditor();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RecreateCalcReference()
		{
			bool calcManagerNotificationsSuspended = CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended;
			if (!calcManagerNotificationsSuspended)
			{
				Grid.UnRegisterFromCalcManager();
			}
			calcReference = null;
			if (!calcManagerNotificationsSuspended)
			{
				ResumeCalcManagerNotifications();
			}
		}

		internal void SuspendCalcManagerNotifications()
		{
			bool calcManagerNotificationsSuspended = CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended;
			calcManagerNotificationsSuspended_Counter++;
			if (!calcManagerNotificationsSuspended && Grid != null)
			{
				Grid.UnRegisterFromCalcManager();
			}
		}

		internal void ResumeCalcManagerNotifications()
		{
			if (CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended)
			{
				calcManagerNotificationsSuspended_Counter--;
				if (!CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended && Grid != null)
				{
					Grid.RegisterWithCalcManager();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RehookWithCalcManager(IUltraCalcManager oldCalcManager)
		{
			BandsCollection bandsCollection = sortedBands;
			if (bandsCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand item in bandsCollection)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in item.Columns)
				{
					column?.FormulaHolder.ReaddReferenceToCalcNetwork(oldCalcManager);
				}
				foreach (SummarySettings item2 in (IEnumerable)item.Summaries)
				{
					item2?.FormulaHolder.ReaddReferenceToCalcNetwork(oldCalcManager);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddRecalcDeferredFormulasToRecalcChain_Helper(FormulaRefBase formulaRef)
		{
			if (formulaRef.RecalcDeferredBase && CalcManager != null && formulaRef.FormulaHolder.HasActiveFormula && formulaRef.HasFormula && !formulaRef.Formula.HasSyntaxError)
			{
				CalcManager.PerformAction(UltraCalcAction.AddReferenceToRecalcChain, formulaRef);
			}
		}

		internal void AddRecalcDeferredFormulasToRecalcChain()
		{
			BandsCollection bandsCollection = sortedBands;
			if (bandsCollection == null || CalcManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand item in bandsCollection)
			{
				if (item == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in item.Columns)
				{
					if (column.CalcReference != null)
					{
						AddRecalcDeferredFormulasToRecalcChain_Helper(column.CalcReference);
					}
				}
				foreach (SummarySettings item2 in (IEnumerable)item.Summaries)
				{
					if (item2.CalcReference != null)
					{
						AddRecalcDeferredFormulasToRecalcChain_Helper(item2.CalcReference);
					}
				}
				if (item.CalcReference.GroupLevelRelatedReferences == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference groupLevelRelatedReference in item.CalcReference.GroupLevelRelatedReferences)
				{
					if (groupLevelRelatedReference != null)
					{
						AddRecalcDeferredFormulasToRecalcChain_Helper(groupLevelRelatedReference);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal static ReferenceNode GetReferenceNode(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			List<ReferenceNode> list = new List<ReferenceNode>();
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in band.Columns)
			{
				if (!column.IsChaptered && column.CalcReference != null)
				{
					list.Add(new ReferenceNode(column.CalcReference, null, isDataReference: true));
				}
			}
			foreach (SummarySettings item in (IEnumerable)band.Summaries)
			{
				if (item.Key != null && item.Key.Length > 0 && item.CalcReference != null)
				{
					list.Add(new ReferenceNode(item.CalcReference, null, isDataReference: true));
				}
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in band.Layout.SortedBands)
			{
				if (sortedBand.ParentBand == band && sortedBand.Key != null && sortedBand.Key.Length > 0)
				{
					ReferenceNode referenceNode = GetReferenceNode(sortedBand);
					if (referenceNode != null)
					{
						list.Add(referenceNode);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new ReferenceNode(band.CalcReference, list.ToArray(), isDataReference: false);
		}

		internal ReferenceNode GetDesignerReferences()
		{
			if (SortedBands == null || SortedBands.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetReferenceNode(SortedBands[0]);
		}

		private void GetCardAreaRowsHelper(UIElement elem, List<UltraGridRow> list, Hashtable map)
		{
			UIElementsCollection val = ((elem != null && elem.HasChildElements) ? elem.ChildElements : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ArrayList)(object)val).Count; i++)
			{
				UIElement val2 = val[i];
				if (!(val2 is RowCellAreaUIElement { Row: var row }))
				{
					GetCardAreaRowsHelper(val2, list, map);
				}
				else if (row != null && !map.ContainsKey(row))
				{
					list.Add(row);
					map[row] = DBNull.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetCardAreaRows(UltraGridRow cardRow, List<UltraGridRow> list, Hashtable map)
		{
			UIElement val = UIElementInternal;
			if (val != null)
			{
				val = val.GetDescendant(typeof(CardAreaUIElement), (object)cardRow.ParentCollection);
			}
			if (val != null)
			{
				GetCardAreaRowsHelper(val, list, map);
			}
		}

		internal List<UltraGridRow> GetVisibleRowsFromAllScrollRegions(RowsCollection rows, bool excludeRowAncestors, bool excludeGroupByRows, bool forCalculations)
		{
			List<UltraGridRow> list = new List<UltraGridRow>();
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			if (RowScrollRegions != null)
			{
				foreach (RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion in RowScrollRegions)
				{
					VisibleRowsCollection visibleRowsCollection = rowScrollRegion?.VisibleRows;
					if (visibleRowsCollection == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (VisibleRow item in visibleRowsCollection)
					{
						UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = item.Row;
						while (ultraGridRow != null && !hashtable.ContainsKey(ultraGridRow))
						{
							if (!ultraGridRow.IsCard)
							{
								list.Add(ultraGridRow);
							}
							else
							{
								GetCardAreaRows(ultraGridRow, list, hashtable);
							}
							hashtable[ultraGridRow] = DBNull.Value;
							if (excludeRowAncestors || ultraGridRow == null || (ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow) == null)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			hashtable.Clear();
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = list.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = list[i];
				if ((rows != null && rows != ultraGridRow2.ParentCollection) || (excludeGroupByRows && ultraGridRow2.IsGroupByRow) || (forCalculations && !ultraGridRow2.IsDataRow && !ultraGridRow2.IsGroupByRow) || !ultraGridRow2.IsStillValid)
				{
					list[i] = null;
				}
			}
			GridUtils.RemoveAll(list, null);
			Utilities.SortMergeGeneric<UltraGridRow>(list, (IComparer<UltraGridRow>)new RowComparerByRelation());
			return list;
		}

		internal void StoreCellValues(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			ClearStoredCellValues();
			if (row == null || row.Band == null || !row.IsStillValid)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColumnsCollection columns = row.Band.Columns;
			storedCellValues = new Hashtable(1 + columns.Count);
			foreach (UltraGridColumn item in columns)
			{
				if (!item.IsChaptered)
				{
					object cellValue = row.GetCellValue(item);
					if (cellValue != null)
					{
						storedCellValues[item] = cellValue;
					}
				}
			}
			storedCellValuesRow = row;
		}

		internal void ClearStoredCellValues()
		{
			storedCellValuesRow = null;
			if (storedCellValues != null)
			{
				storedCellValues.Clear();
			}
			storedCellValues = null;
		}

		internal void NotifyCalcEngineOfChangedCellsInStoredRow()
		{
			if (storedCellValuesRow != null && storedCellValues != null && storedCellValuesRow.IsStillValid)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in storedCellValuesRow.Band.Columns)
				{
					if (!column.IsChaptered)
					{
						object obj = storedCellValues[column];
						if (obj == null || !object.Equals(obj, storedCellValuesRow.GetCellValue(column)))
						{
							storedCellValuesRow.ParentCollection.NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged(storedCellValuesRow, column);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			ClearStoredCellValues();
		}

		internal void EnsureAllFormulasCalculated()
		{
			IUltraCalcManager calcManager = CalcManager;
			if (calcManager != null)
			{
				GridReference gridReference = CalcReference;
				try
				{
					gridReference.recalcDeferredSuspended = true;
					AddRecalcDeferredFormulasToRecalcChain();
					calcManager.PerformAction(UltraCalcAction.Recalc, -1L);
				}
				finally
				{
					gridReference.recalcDeferredSuspended = false;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void DelegateSubObjPropChangeTo(object target, PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (target is UltraGridCell ultraGridCell)
			{
				ultraGridCell.InternalOnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
			else if (target is UltraGridRow ultraGridRow)
			{
				ultraGridRow.InternalOnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		private void OnMulticastAppearanceChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			object source = propChange.Source;
			AppearanceBase val = (AppearanceBase)((source is AppearanceBase) ? source : null);
			if (val == null || multiCastAppearances == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = multiCastAppearances[val];
			if (obj is Hashtable)
			{
				foreach (object key in ((Hashtable)obj).Keys)
				{
					DelegateSubObjPropChangeTo(key, propChange);
				}
				return;
			}
			DelegateSubObjPropChangeTo(obj, propChange);
		}

		internal static void AddMulticastObjectHelper(Hashtable table, object obj)
		{
			if (table.ContainsKey(obj))
			{
				int num = (int)table[obj];
				num++;
				table[obj] = num;
			}
			else
			{
				table[obj] = ONE;
			}
		}

		internal void SetMulticastAppearance(AppearanceBase appearance, object obj)
		{
			if (multiCastAppearances == null)
			{
				multiCastAppearances = new Hashtable(2, 0.95f);
				if (multicastAppearancePropChangeHandler == null)
				{
					multicastAppearancePropChangeHandler = OnMulticastAppearanceChanged;
				}
			}
			object obj2 = multiCastAppearances[appearance];
			if (obj2 is Hashtable)
			{
				AddMulticastObjectHelper((Hashtable)obj2, obj);
			}
			else if (obj2 != null)
			{
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable(2, 0.95f);
				multiCastAppearances[appearance] = hashtable;
				AddMulticastObjectHelper(hashtable, obj2);
				AddMulticastObjectHelper(hashtable, obj);
			}
			else
			{
				multiCastAppearances[appearance] = obj;
				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearance).SubObjectPropChanged += multicastAppearancePropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveMulticastAppearance(AppearanceBase appearance, object obj)
		{
			if (multiCastAppearances == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			object obj2 = multiCastAppearances[appearance];
			if (obj2 is Hashtable)
			{
				Hashtable hashtable = (Hashtable)obj2;
				if (hashtable.ContainsKey(obj))
				{
					int num = (int)hashtable[obj];
					num--;
					if (num > 0)
					{
						hashtable[obj] = num;
					}
					else
					{
						hashtable.Remove(obj);
					}
					if (hashtable.Count == 0)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (obj2 == obj)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				multiCastAppearances.Remove(appearance);
				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearance).SubObjectPropChanged -= multicastAppearancePropChangeHandler;
				if (multiCastAppearances.Count == 0)
				{
					multiCastAppearances.Clear();
					multiCastAppearances = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SynchGridBackColor()
		{
			//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!IsDisplayLayout || grid == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!grid.Initializing)
			{
				AppearanceData appearance = default(AppearanceData);
				AppearancePropFlags requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)1;
				ResolveLayoutAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, resolveDefaultColors: false);
				if ((requestedProps & 1) == 0)
				{
					((Control)(object)grid).BackColor = ((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((Control)(object)grid).BackColor = Color.Empty;
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridRow PerformPageUpDownHelper(UltraGridAction action, UltraGridRow startRow)
		{
			RowScrollRegion activeRowScrollRegion = grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			bool nonGroupByRowsOnly = UltraGridAction.PageUpCell == action || UltraGridAction.PageDownCell == action;
			if (startRow == null && SortedBands != null && SortedBands.Count > 0)
			{
				startRow = activeRowScrollRegion.GetFirstVisibleRow(SortedBands[0], nonGroupByRowsOnly, scrollableRowsOnly: false);
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			if (startRow != null && activeRowScrollRegion != null)
			{
				if (UltraGridAction.PageUpCell == action || UltraGridAction.PageUpRow == action)
				{
					bool flag = FixedRowStyle.Top == startRow.FixedResolvedLocation;
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = activeRowScrollRegion.GetFirstVisibleRow(startRow.Band, nonGroupByRowsOnly, !flag);
					if (UltraGridAction.PageUpCell == action && ultraGridRow2 != null && ultraGridRow2.IsSummaryRow)
					{
						ultraGridRow2 = null;
					}
					if ((!flag && startRow == ultraGridRow2 && !activeRowScrollRegion.IsFirstScrollableRowVisible()) || ultraGridRow2 == null)
					{
						activeRowScrollRegion.KybdScroll(ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement);
						ultraGridRow = activeRowScrollRegion.GetFirstVisibleRow(startRow.Band, nonGroupByRowsOnly, scrollableRowsOnly: true);
						if (ultraGridRow == null || ultraGridRow == startRow)
						{
							ultraGridRow = activeRowScrollRegion.GetFirstVisibleRow(startRow.Band, nonGroupByRowsOnly, scrollableRowsOnly: false);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow2;
					}
				}
				else if (UltraGridAction.PageDownCell == action || UltraGridAction.PageDownRow == action)
				{
					bool flag2 = FixedRowStyle.Bottom == startRow.FixedResolvedLocation;
					UltraGridRow lastVisibleRow = activeRowScrollRegion.GetLastVisibleRow(startRow.Band, nonGroupByRowsOnly, !flag2);
					if (lastVisibleRow != null && startRow == lastVisibleRow && ViewStyleImpl.IsLastRow(lastVisibleRow))
					{
						ultraGridRow = lastVisibleRow;
					}
					else if (!flag2 && (startRow == lastVisibleRow || lastVisibleRow == null))
					{
						activeRowScrollRegion.KybdScroll(ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement);
						ultraGridRow = activeRowScrollRegion.GetLastVisibleRow(startRow.Band, nonGroupByRowsOnly, scrollableRowsOnly: true);
						if (ultraGridRow == null || ultraGridRow == startRow)
						{
							ultraGridRow = activeRowScrollRegion.GetLastVisibleRow(startRow.Band, nonGroupByRowsOnly, scrollableRowsOnly: false);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGridRow = lastVisibleRow;
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		internal void BumpSortVersionNumber()
		{
			if (sortedBands == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in sortedBands)
			{
				if (sortedBand.HasSortedColumns)
				{
					sortedBand.SortedColumns.BumpSortVersion();
					sortedBand.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
				}
			}
			DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
		}

		internal bool SuspendInitializeRowFor(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (initializeRowSuspendedFor == null)
			{
				initializeRowSuspendedFor = row;
			}
			else
			{
				if (row == initializeRowSuspendedFor)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (initializeRowSuspendedFor_List == null)
				{
					initializeRowSuspendedFor_List = new List<UltraGridRow>();
				}
				else if (initializeRowSuspendedFor_List.Contains(row))
				{
					return true;
				}
				initializeRowSuspendedFor_List.Add(initializeRowSuspendedFor);
				initializeRowSuspendedFor = row;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsInitializeRowSuspendedFor(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (initializeRowSuspendedFor != row)
			{
				if (initializeRowSuspendedFor_List != null)
				{
					return initializeRowSuspendedFor_List.Contains(row);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void ResumeInitializeRowFor(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row == initializeRowSuspendedFor)
			{
				initializeRowSuspendedFor = null;
				if (initializeRowSuspendedFor_List != null)
				{
					int num = initializeRowSuspendedFor_List.Count - 1;
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						initializeRowSuspendedFor = initializeRowSuspendedFor_List[num];
						initializeRowSuspendedFor_List.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					if (num == 0)
					{
						initializeRowSuspendedFor_List = null;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (initializeRowSuspendedFor_List != null)
			{
				initializeRowSuspendedFor_List.Remove(row);
				if (initializeRowSuspendedFor_List.Count == 0)
				{
					initializeRowSuspendedFor_List = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool InvalidateHotTrackedElement(UIElement elem)
		{
			if (elem is HeaderUIElement)
			{
				HeaderUIElement headerUIElement = (HeaderUIElement)(object)elem;
				if (headerUIElement.InvalidateIfHotTracked())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (elem is RowUIElementBase)
			{
				RowUIElementBase rowUIElementBase = (RowUIElementBase)(object)elem;
				if (rowUIElementBase.InvalidateIfHotTracked())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (elem.HasChildElements)
			{
				UIElementEnumerator enumerator = elem.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
						if (InvalidateHotTrackedElement(current))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InvalidateHotTrackedElement()
		{
			if (HasUIElement)
			{
				InvalidateHotTrackedElement(UIElementInternal);
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyColSpan()
		{
			if (!needToVerifyColSpan)
			{
				return;
			}
			hasColSpan = false;
			needToVerifyColSpan = false;
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in SortedBands)
			{
				if (sortedBand.AllowColSizingResolved != AllowColSizing.Synchronized || sortedBand.HiddenResolved || sortedBand.UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in sortedBand.Columns)
				{
					if (!column.IsChaptered && !column.HiddenResolved && column.ColSpan != 1)
					{
						hasColSpan = true;
						return;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void BeginCaching()
		{
			cacheListenerCount++;
			if (bands != null && bands.Count > 0)
			{
				if (cachedBandData == null)
				{
					cachedBandData = new Dictionary<UltraGridBand, CachedBandInfo>(bands.Count);
				}
				if (cachedRowData == null)
				{
					cachedRowData = new Dictionary<UltraGridRow, CachedRowInfo>();
				}
				if (bands.Count > 1 && cachedChildBandsData == null)
				{
					cachedChildBandsData = new Dictionary<ChildBandsCollection, CachedChildBandsInfo>(bands.Count);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void EndCaching()
		{
			if (--cacheListenerCount == 0)
			{
				if (cachedBandData != null)
				{
					cachedBandData.Clear();
					cachedBandData = null;
				}
				if (cachedRowData != null)
				{
					cachedRowData.Clear();
					cachedRowData = null;
				}
				if (cachedChildBandsData != null)
				{
					cachedChildBandsData.Clear();
					cachedChildBandsData = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void BumpSortedBandsVersion()

			{
				sortedBandsVersion++;
			}
			else
			{
				sortedBandsVersion = int.MinValue;
			}
		}

		private void MergeExternalAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = Grid;
			if (ultraGridBase != null)
			{
				AppearanceBase appearance = null;
				bool flag = false;
				switch (index)
				{
				case UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Cell:
					flag = ultraGridBase.GetExternalOverrideCellAppearance(null, out appearance);
					break;
				case UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Header:
					flag = ultraGridBase.GetExternalOverrideHeaderAppearance(null, out appearance);
					break;
				case UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.Row:
					flag = ultraGridBase.GetExternalOverrideRowAppearance(null, out appearance);
					break;
				case UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.RowSelector:
					flag = ultraGridBase.GetExternalOverrideRowSelectorAppearance(null, out appearance);
					break;
				case UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.RowSelectorHeaderAppearance:
					flag = ultraGridBase.GetExternalOverrideRowSelectorHeaderAppearance(null, out appearance);
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void BumpHeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				if (bands == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridBand band2 in Bands)
				{
					band2.BumpHeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				band.BumpHeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion();
			}
			DirtyGridElement();
		}

		internal void DisposeUIAProviders(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (!HasUIElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			DataAreaUIElement dataAreaElement = DataAreaElement;
			if (dataAreaElement == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator = ((UIElement)dataAreaElement).ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					if (current is RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)
					{
						rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement.DisposeUIAProviders(row);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal int AdjustForTouchMode(int extent)
		{
			return AdjustForTouchMode(extent, 0);
		}

		internal int AdjustForTouchMode(int extent, int padding)
		{
			return AdjustForTouchMode(extent, adjustByWidth: true, padding);
		}

		internal int AdjustForTouchMode(int extent, bool adjustByWidth = true, int padding = 0)
		{
			UIElement uIElementInternal = UIElementInternal;
			if (uIElementInternal != null)
			{
				ControlUIElementBase controlElement = uIElementInternal.ControlElement;
				return controlElement.AdjustForTouchMode(extent, adjustByWidth, padding);
			}
			return extent + padding;
		}

		internal Size AdjustForTouchMode(Size size)
		{
			UIElement uIElementInternal = UIElementInternal;
			if (uIElementInternal != null)
			{
				ControlUIElementBase controlElement = uIElementInternal.ControlElement;
				return controlElement.AdjustForTouchMode(size);
			}
			return size;
		}

		internal Size GetIdealClearButtonSize()
		{
			int extent = Math.Max(VerticalScrollBarWidthResolved, 18);
			extent = AdjustForTouchMode(extent);
			return new Size(extent, extent);
		}

		internal Size GetIdealOperatorButtonSize()
		{
			int extent = Math.Max(ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)(object)Grid), 18);
			extent = AdjustForTouchMode(extent);
			return new Size(extent, extent);
		}

		private void DirtyHeaderCheckBoxHelper(UltraGridBand band)
		{

				foreach (UltraGridBand band2 in Bands)
				{
					band2.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
					band2.DirtyCachedContainsCheckboxOnTopOrBottom();
				}
				return;
			}
			band.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
			band.DirtyCachedContainsCheckboxOnTopOrBottom();
		}

		private int GetAbsoluteColumnX(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			int num = column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginXResolved;
			for (UltraGridGroup parentGroup = column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup; parentGroup != null; parentGroup = parentGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.ParentGroup)
			{
				num += parentGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.OriginXResolved;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private bool ExitEditModeOnActiveHeaderIfNeeded()
		{
			HeaderBase activeHeader = ActiveHeader;
			if (activeHeader != null && activeHeader.IsInEditMode)
			{
				activeHeader.ExitEditMode();
				activeHeader = ActiveHeader;
				if (activeHeader != null && activeHeader.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void HookIntoHeaderEditor(EmbeddableEditorBase editor)
		{
			if (lastHookedHeaderEditor != editor)
			{
				UnHookFromHeaderEditor();
				lastHookedHeaderEditor = editor;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.BeforeEnterEditMode += EmbeddableEditor_BeforeHeaderEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.AfterEnterEditMode += EmbeddableEditor_AfterHeaderEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.BeforeExitEditMode += EmbeddableEditor_BeforeHeaderExitEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.AfterExitEditMode += EmbeddableEditor_AfterHeaderExitEditModeEventHandler;
				if (lastHookedHeaderEditor.SupportsDropDown)
				{
					lastHookedHeaderEditor.BeforeDropDown += EmbeddableEditor_BeforeHeaderDropDownEventHandler;
					lastHookedHeaderEditor.AfterCloseUp += EmbeddableEditor_AfterHeaderCloseupEventHandler;
					lastHookedHeaderEditor.SelectionChanged += EmbeddableEditor_HeaderSelectionChangedEventHandler;
				}
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.KeyDown += EmbeddableEditor_KeyDownEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.KeyUp += EmbeddableEditor_KeyUpEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.KeyPress += EmbeddableEditor_KeyPressEventHandler;
			}
		}

		private void LastHookedHeaderEditor_AfterExitEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		private void LastHookedHeaderEditor_BeforeExitEditMode(object sender, BeforeExitEditModeEventArgs e)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		private void LastHookedHeaderEditor_AfterEnterEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		private void LastHookedHeaderEditor_BeforeEnterEditMode(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			throw new NotImplementedException();
		}

		internal void UnHookFromHeaderEditor()
		{
			if (lastHookedHeaderEditor != null)
			{
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.BeforeEnterEditMode -= EmbeddableEditor_BeforeHeaderEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.AfterEnterEditMode -= EmbeddableEditor_AfterHeaderEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.BeforeExitEditMode -= EmbeddableEditor_BeforeHeaderExitEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.AfterExitEditMode -= EmbeddableEditor_AfterHeaderExitEditModeEventHandler;
				if (lastHookedHeaderEditor.SupportsDropDown)
				{
					lastHookedHeaderEditor.BeforeDropDown -= EmbeddableEditor_BeforeHeaderDropDownEventHandler;
					lastHookedHeaderEditor.AfterCloseUp -= EmbeddableEditor_AfterHeaderCloseupEventHandler;
					lastHookedHeaderEditor.SelectionChanged -= EmbeddableEditor_HeaderSelectionChangedEventHandler;
				}
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.KeyDown -= EmbeddableEditor_KeyDownEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.KeyUp -= EmbeddableEditor_KeyUpEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor.KeyPress -= EmbeddableEditor_KeyPressEventHandler;
				lastHookedHeaderEditor = null;
			}
		}

		internal void OnEditorBeforeHeaderEnterEditMode(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			forceExitEditOperationFlag = false;
			cancellingEditOperationFlag = false;
			if (Grid is UltraGrid { ActiveHeader: { } } ultraGrid)
			{
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeHeaderEnterEditMode, e);
			}
		}

		internal void OnHeaderEditorBeforeEnterEditMode(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			forceExitEditOperationFlag = false;
			cancellingEditOperationFlag = false;
			if (Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
			{
				BeforeHeaderEnterEditModeEventArgs e2 = new BeforeHeaderEnterEditModeEventArgs(ActiveHeader);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeHeaderEnterEditMode, e2);
				e.Cancel = e2.Cancel;
			}
		}

		internal void OnHeaderEditorAfterEnterEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = Grid as UltraGrid;
			HeaderBase activeHeader = ActiveHeader;
			if (activeHeader != null)
			{
				activeHeader.OnAfterHeaderEnterEditMode();
				if (ultraGrid != null)
				{
					AfterHeaderEnterEditModeEventArgs e2 = new AfterHeaderEnterEditModeEventArgs(activeHeader);
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterHeaderEnterEditMode, e2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnHeaderEditorBeforeExitEditMode(object sender, BeforeExitEditModeEventArgs e)
		{
			if (Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid && HeaderInEditMode != null)
			{
				HeaderBase activeHeader = ActiveHeader;
				bool forceExit = ForceExitEditOperationFlag;
				bool cancelingEditOperation = CancellingEditOperationFlag;
				string newCaption = activeHeader.EditorResolved.Value.ToString();
				BeforeHeaderExitEditModeEventArgs e2 = new BeforeHeaderExitEditModeEventArgs(activeHeader, forceExit, cancelingEditOperation, newCaption);
				e2.Cancel = ((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel;
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeHeaderExitEditMode, e2);
				if (!ForceExitEditOperationFlag)
				{
					((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel = e2.Cancel;
				}
				string caption = activeHeader.Caption;
				newCaption = e2.NewCaption;
				activeHeader.EditorResolved.Value = newCaption;
				if (((CancelEventArgs)(object)e).Cancel && !ForceExitEditOperationFlag)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (!CancellingEditOperationFlag)
			{
				HeaderInEditMode?.CommitEditValue();
			}
		}

		internal void OnHeaderEditorAfterExitEditMode(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			HeaderBase activeHeader = ActiveHeader;
			activeHeader?.OnAfterHeaderExitEditMode();
			EmbeddableElementBeingEdited = null;
			forceExitEditOperationFlag = false;
			cancellingEditOperationFlag = false;
			lastAutoSizeEditEventArgs = null;
			if (Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
			{
				ultraGrid.editorWantedLastKeyDown = false;
				if (activeHeader != null)
				{
					AfterHeaderExitEditModeEventArgs e2 = new AfterHeaderExitEditModeEventArgs(activeHeader);
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterHeaderExitEditMode, e2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnEditorBeforeHeaderDropDown(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		internal void OnEditorHeaderSelectionChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		internal void OnEditorAfterHeaderCloseup(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
		}

		{
			grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeAutoSizeColumn, e);
		}

		internal void OnAfterAutoSizeColumn(object sender, AfterAutoSizeColumnEventArgs e)
		{
			grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.AfterAutoSizeColumn, e);
		}

		internal void NotifyDpiChanged()
		{
			OnBaseFontChanged();
			if (HasRowSelectorImages)
			{
				RowSelectorImages.ResetDefaultCachedImages();
			}
			StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(this);
			DisposeCardExpansionImages();
			DisposeDefaultDataErrorImage();
		}

		internal void DisposeCardExpansionImages()
		{
			if (cardExpansionImage != null)
			{
				cardExpansionImage.Dispose();
				cardExpansionImage = null;
			}
			if (cardExpansionImageInverse != null)
			{
				cardExpansionImageInverse.Dispose();
				cardExpansionImageInverse = null;
			}
		}

		internal void DisposeDefaultDataErrorImage()
		{
			if (defaultDataErrorImage != null)
			{
				defaultDataErrorImage.Dispose();
				defaultDataErrorImage = null;
			}
		}

		public sealed class UltraGridOverrideTypeConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
			{
				PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = base.GetProperties(context, value, attributes);
				UltraGridOverride ultraGridOverride = value as UltraGridOverride;
				if (properties != null && ultraGridOverride != null && ultraGridOverride.layout != null && ultraGridOverride.layout.Grid is UltraDropDownBase)
				{
					int num = 0;
					for (int i = 0; i < properties.Count; i++)
					{
						if (!FilterOutProperty(properties[i]))
						{
							num++;
						}
					}
					PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[num];
					int num2 = 0;
					for (int j = 0; j < properties.Count; j++)
					{
						if (!FilterOutProperty(properties[j]))
						{
							array[num2] = properties[j];
							num2++;
						}
					}
					return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
				}
				return properties;
			}

			{
				switch (pd.DisplayName)

				case "ActiveCardCaptionAppearance":

				case "CardCaptionAppearance":
				case "CellButtonAppearance":

				case "SelectedCellAppearance":
				case "AllowAddNew":
				case "AllowColMoving":
				case "AllowColSizing":
				case "AllowColSwapping":
				case "AllowDelete":
				case "AllowGroupBy":
				case "AllowGroupMoving":
				case "AllowGroupSwapping":
				case "AllowUpdate":
				case "BorderStyleCardArea":
				case "CardSpacing":
				case "CellClickAction":
				case "ExpansionIndicator":
				case "GroupByColumnsHidden":
				case "GroupByRowDescriptionMask":
				case "GroupByRowPadding":
				case "MaxSelectedCells":
				case "MaxSelectedRows":
				case "RowSizing":
				case "SelectTypeCell":
				case "SelectTypeCol":
				case "SelectTypeGroupByRow":
				case "SelectTypeRow":
				case "TipStyleRowConnector":
				case "FilterCellAppearance":
				case "FilterCellAppearanceActive":
				case "FilterClearButtonAppearance":
				case "FilterClearButtonLocation":
				case "FilterEvaluationTrigger":
				case "FilterOperandStyle":
				case "FilterOperatorAppearance":
				case "FilterOperatorDefaultValue":

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
				{
					if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
					{
						appearanceHolders[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
						appearanceHolders[i].Reset();
						appearanceHolders[i] = null;
					}
				}
			}
			if (HasDragDropIndicatorSettings)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)dragDropIndicatorSettings).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				dragDropIndicatorSettings.Reset();
				dragDropIndicatorSettings = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Key;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeAppearanceHolders()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
				{
					if (appearanceHolders[i] != null && appearanceHolders[i].ShouldSerialize())
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ResetAppearanceHolders()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
				{
					appearanceHolders[i].Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResetAppearances()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
				{
					ResetAppearance((OverrideAppearanceIndex)i);
				}
			}
		}

		private SelectionStrategyBase CreateSelectionStrategyHelper(SelectType selectType)
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003b: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0047: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Expected O, but got Unknown
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			SelectionStrategyBase result = null;
			if (ultraGrid != null)
			{
				switch (selectType)
				{
				case SelectType.None:
					result = (SelectionStrategyBase)new SelectionStrategyNone((ISelectionManager)(object)ultraGrid);
					break;
				case SelectType.Single:
					result = (SelectionStrategyBase)new SelectionStrategySingle((ISelectionManager)(object)ultraGrid);
					break;
				case SelectType.Extended:
					result = (SelectionStrategyBase)new SelectionStrategyExtended((ISelectionManager)(object)ultraGrid);
					break;
				case SelectType.SingleAutoDrag:
					result = (SelectionStrategyBase)new SelectionStrategySingleAutoDrag((ISelectionManager)(object)ultraGrid);
					break;
				case SelectType.ExtendedAutoDrag:
					result = (SelectionStrategyBase)new SelectionStrategyExtendedAutoDrag((ISelectionManager)(object)ultraGrid);
					break;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool HasAppearance(OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null && appearanceHolders[(int)index] != null)
			{
				return appearanceHolders[(int)index].HasAppearance;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeAppearance(OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			if (HasAppearance(index))
			{
				return GetAppearance(index).ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetAppearance(OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null && appearanceHolders[(int)index] != null)
			{
				appearanceHolders[(int)index].Reset();
				NotifyPropChange(AppearancePropIds[(int)index]);
			}
		}

		internal AppearanceBase GetAppearance(OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (AppearanceHolders[(int)index] == null)
			{
				AppearanceHolders[(int)index] = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolders[(int)index].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (layout != null)
			{
				appearanceHolders[(int)index].Collection = layout.Appearances;
			}
			return appearanceHolders[(int)index].Appearance;
		}

		internal AppearanceBase GetAppearanceIfAllocated(OverrideAppearanceIndex index)
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null)
			{
				AppearanceHolder val = appearanceHolders[(int)index];
				if (val != null && val.HasAppearance)
				{
					return val.Appearance;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SetAppearance(OverrideAppearanceIndex index, AppearanceBase appearance)
		{
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (AppearanceHolders[(int)index] == null || !AppearanceHolders[(int)index].HasAppearance || appearance != AppearanceHolders[(int)index].Appearance)
			{
				if (AppearanceHolders[(int)index] == null)
				{
					AppearanceHolders[(int)index] = new AppearanceHolder();
					appearanceHolders[(int)index].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (layout != null)
				{
					appearanceHolders[(int)index].Collection = layout.Appearances;
				}
				AppearanceHolders[(int)index].Appearance = appearance;
				NotifyPropChange(AppearancePropIds[(int)index], null);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
				{
					if (appearanceHolders[i] != null && appearanceHolders[i].HasAppearance && propChange.Source == appearanceHolders[i].RootAppearance)
					{
						NotifyPropChange(AppearancePropIds[i], propChange);
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			if (propChange.PropId is DragDropIndicatorSettingsPropIds && propChange.Source == dragDropIndicatorSettings)
			{
				if (layout != null)
				{
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(layout);
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DragDropIndicatorSettings, propChange);
			}
		}

		internal void InitLayout(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			this.layout = layout;
			InitAppearanceHolders();
		}

		internal void InitAppearanceHolders()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders == null || layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
				{
					appearanceHolders[i].Collection = layout.Appearances;
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeRowSelectorHeaderStyle()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)rowSelectorHeaderStyle > 0;
		}

		public void ResetRowSelectorHeaderStyle()
		{
			RowSelectorHeaderStyle = (RowSelectorHeaderStyle)0;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeRowSelectorWidth()
		{
			return rowSelectorWidth != 0;
		}

		public void ResetRowSelectorWidth()
		{
			RowSelectorWidth = 0;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeBorderStyleRowSelector()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4

		}

		public void ResetBorderStyleRowSelector()
		{
			BorderStyleRowSelector = (UIElementBorderStyle)0;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeAllowRowLayoutCellSizing()

	public class GroupExpansionIndicatorUIElement : ExpansionIndicatorUIElement
	{
		public override bool IsOpen => Group?.Expanded ?? true;

		public UltraGridGroup Group
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(((UIElement)this).Parent.GetContext(typeof(GroupHeader)) is GroupHeader groupHeader))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return groupHeader.Group;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole(Group.Band, StyleUtils.Role.GroupExpansionIndicator);

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle
		{
			get
			{

				//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				UltraGridBand band = Group.Band;
