				{
					val = StyleUtils.CacheBorderStylePropertyValue(band, StyleUtils.CachedProperty.BorderStyleGroupExpansionIndicator, StyleUtils.Role.GroupExpansionIndicator, (UIElementBorderStyle)0, ((ExpansionIndicatorUIElement)this).BorderStyle);
				}
				return (UIElementBorderStyle)val;
			}
		}

		public GroupExpansionIndicatorUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		protected override void Toggle()
		{
			UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = Group;
			UltraGridLayout layout = ultraGridGroup.Band.Layout;
			if (((UIElement)this).Enabled && layout.ExitEditModeHelper())
			{
				ultraGridGroup.Expanded = !ultraGridGroup.Expanded;
			}
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = Group;
			UltraGridBand band = ultraGridGroup.Band;
			UltraGridLayout layout = band.Layout;
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrder = StyleUtils.GetResolutionOrder(layout);
			UIRole uIRole = ((UIElement)this).UIRole;
			if ((((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore || ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter) && uIRole != null)
			{
				if (((ExpansionIndicatorUIElement)this).IsOpen)
				{
					uIRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4194304);
				}
				uIRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			bool canExpand = ((ExpansionIndicatorUIElement)this).CanExpand;
			if ((1uL & (ulong)requestedProps) != 0L)
			{

				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 1uL);
			}
			if ((2uL & (ulong)requestedProps) != 0L)
			{

				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 2uL);
			}
			RowConnectorStyle rowConnectorStyleResolved = layout.RowConnectorStyleResolved;
			if (rowConnectorStyleResolved == RowConnectorStyle.Inset || rowConnectorStyleResolved == RowConnectorStyle.Raised)
			{
				if ((4uL & (ulong)requestedProps) != 0L)
				{

			if ((((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleBefore || ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrder)).UseStyleAfter) && uIRole != null)
			{
				if (((ExpansionIndicatorUIElement)this).IsOpen)
				{
					uIRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4194304);
				}
				uIRole.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			bool canExpand = ((ExpansionIndicatorUIElement)this).CanExpand;
			if ((1uL & (ulong)requestedProps) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = (canExpand ? SystemColors.Window : SystemColors.Control);
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 1uL);
			}
			if ((2uL & (ulong)requestedProps) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = (canExpand ? SystemColors.WindowText : SystemColors.ControlDark);
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 2uL);
			}
			RowConnectorStyle rowConnectorStyleResolved = layout.RowConnectorStyleResolved;
			if (rowConnectorStyleResolved == RowConnectorStyle.Inset || rowConnectorStyleResolved == RowConnectorStyle.Raised)
			{
				if ((4uL & (ulong)requestedProps) != 0L)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = SystemColors.ControlDark;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 4uL);
				}
			}
			else if ((4uL & (ulong)requestedProps) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BorderColor = layout.RowConnectorColorResolved;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 4uL);
			}
		}

		public override bool Contains(Point point, bool ignoreClipping)
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).AreTouchMetricsEnabled && ignoreClipping)
			{
				Size touchElementSize = TouchUtilities.GetTouchElementSize(((UIElement)this).Control, (TouchElementSizes)0);
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
				return new Rectangle(rect.X - touchElementSize.Width / 2, rect.Y - touchElementSize.Height / 2, touchElementSize.Width, touchElementSize.Height).Contains(point);
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).Contains(point, ignoreClipping);
		}
	}
	public class ChildBandsCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase

		public UltraGridChildBand this[UltraGridBand band]
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeChildBands();
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (this[i].Band == band)
					{
						return this[i];
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

		internal int ScrollCount
		{
			get
			{
				Dictionary<ChildBandsCollection, UltraGridLayout.CachedChildBandsInfo> dictionary = null;
				UltraGridLayout.CachedChildBandsInfo value = null;
				if (ParentRow != null && ParentRow.Layout != null && ParentRow.Layout.IsCachingChildBandsInfo)
				{
					dictionary = ParentRow.Layout.CachedChildBandsData;
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(this, out value) && value.ScrollCount > -1)
					{
						return value.ScrollCount;
					}
				}
				int num = CalculateScrollCount();
				if (dictionary != null)
				{
					if (value != null)
					{
						value.ScrollCount = num;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(this, out value))
						{
							value = new UltraGridLayout.CachedChildBandsInfo();
							dictionary.Add(this, value);
						}
						value.ScrollCount = num;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridChildBand First

		internal ChildBandsCollection(UltraGridRow parentRow)

			this.parentRow = parentRow;

		private static UltraGridChildBand ExtractChildBand(ArrayList list, int endIndex, UltraGridBand band)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i <= endIndex; i++)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = (UltraGridChildBand)list[i];
				if (ultraGridChildBand != null && ultraGridChildBand.Band == band)
				{
					list[i] = null;
					return ultraGridChildBand;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SynchronizeChildBands()
		{
			if ((verifiedBandsVersion == parentRow.BandInternal.ColumnsVersion && verifiedSortedBandsVersion == parentRow.BandInternal.Layout.sortedBandsVersion) || parentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridBand bandInternal = parentRow.BandInternal;
			if (bandInternal.Layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			BandsCollection sortedBands = bandInternal.Layout.SortedBands;
			verifiedBandsVersion = bandInternal.ColumnsVersion;
			verifiedSortedBandsVersion = parentRow.BandInternal.Layout.sortedBandsVersion;
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			int num = arrayList.Count - 1;
			for (int i = 1; i < sortedBands.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = sortedBands[i];
				if (ultraGridBand.ParentBand == bandInternal)
				{
					UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = ExtractChildBand(arrayList, num, ultraGridBand);
					if (ultraGridChildBand == null)
					{
						ultraGridChildBand = new UltraGridChildBand(this, ultraGridBand);
					}
					arrayList.Add(ultraGridChildBand);
				}
			}
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i <= num; i++)
				{
					if (arrayList[i] != null)
					{
						((UltraGridChildBand)arrayList[i]).Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				arrayList.RemoveRange(0, 1 + num);
			}
		}

		internal bool HasChildRowsInternal(IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item.Rows.GetRowCount(includeRowTypes) > 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void Refresh(RefreshRow action, bool refreshDescendantRows)
		{
			foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				if (item.HaveRowsBeenInitialized)
				{
					item.Rows.Refresh(action, refreshDescendantRows);
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetFirstRow(bool excludeCardBands, IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (!excludeCardBands || !this[i].Band.CardView)
				{
					RowsCollection rows = this[i].Rows;
					UltraGridRow rowAtIndex = rows.GetRowAtIndex(0, includeRowTypes);
					if (rowAtIndex != null)
					{
						return rowAtIndex;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraGridChildBand GetNextChildBand(UltraGridChildBand band, bool excludeCardBands)
		{
			int i = IndexOf(band) + 1;
			if (i >= 0 && i < Count)
			{
				for (; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (!excludeCardBands || !this[i].Band.CardView)
					{
						return this[i];
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraGridChildBand GetPreviousChildBand(UltraGridChildBand band, bool excludeCardBands)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(band) - 1;
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				while (num >= 0)
				{
					if (!excludeCardBands || !this[num].Band.CardView)
					{
						return this[num];
					}
					num--;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetLastRow(bool excludeCardBands, IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (!excludeCardBands || !this[num].Band.CardView)
				{
					RowsCollection rows = this[num].Rows;
					int rowCount = rows.GetRowCount(includeRowTypes);
					if (rowCount > 0)
					{
						return rows.GetRowAtIndex(rowCount - 1, includeRowTypes);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(UltraGridChildBand ChildBand)
		{
			return InternalAdd((IKeyedSubObject)ChildBand);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetFirstVisibleRow()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = this[i];
				if (ultraGridChildBand != null && !ultraGridChildBand.Band.HiddenResolved)
				{
					UltraGridRow firstVisibleRow = ultraGridChildBand.Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow();
					if (firstVisibleRow != null)
					{
						return firstVisibleRow;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetLastVisibleRow()
		{
			for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = this[num];
				if (ultraGridChildBand != null && !ultraGridChildBand.Band.HiddenResolved)
				{
					UltraGridRow lastVisibleRow = ultraGridChildBand.Rows.GetLastVisibleRow();
					if (lastVisibleRow != null)
					{
						return lastVisibleRow;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
			{
				if (List[i] is UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand)
				{
					ultraGridChildBand.Dispose();
				}
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		private int CalculateScrollCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = this[i];
				if (!ultraGridChildBand.Band.HiddenResolved)
				{
					num += ultraGridChildBand.Rows.ScrollCount;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetItemAtScrollIndex(int scrollIndex)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = this[i];
				if (!ultraGridChildBand.Band.HiddenResolved)
				{
					int scrollCount = ultraGridChildBand.Rows.ScrollCount;
					if (scrollIndex < scrollCount)
					{
						return ultraGridChildBand.Rows.GetRowAtScrollIndex(scrollIndex);
					}
					scrollIndex -= scrollCount;
				}
			}
			if (ParentRow != null)
			{
				ParentRow.NotifyScrollCountChanged();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal AccessibleObject GetAccessibleChild(int index)
		{
			foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				AccessibleObject rowsCollectionAccessibilityObject = item.RowsCollectionAccessibilityObject;
				int childCount = rowsCollectionAccessibilityObject.GetChildCount();
				if (index >= 0 && index < childCount)
				{
					return rowsCollectionAccessibilityObject.GetChild(index);
				}
				index -= childCount;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int GetAccessibleChildCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				num += item.GetAccessibleChildCount();
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal bool Exists(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (band == this[i].Band)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ScrollHeaderIntoView(HeaderBase header, bool leftAlign)
		{

			}

					ScrollCardColIntoView(header);
				}

			}
			ColScrollRegion exclusiveColScrollRegion = header.ExclusiveColScrollRegion;
			if (exclusiveColScrollRegion != null && this != exclusiveColScrollRegion)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_50"));
			}
			if (header.Band.IsHeaderFixed(this, header) && (!header.Band.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers || header.Band.ParentBand == null))
			{
				return;

			int num = regionRect.Left + GetClientWidth(base.Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion);
			if (num < regionRect.Right)
			{
				regionRect.Width = num - regionRect.Left;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = regionRect;
			int num2 = 0;
			int width = 0;
			header.GetDimensions(PositionDimensions.InsidePreRowSelectors, DimOriginBase.Relative, ref num2, ref width, this);
			num2 += base.Origin;
			rectangle.X = num2;

				if (!rectangle2.IsEmpty && rectangle2.Equals(rectangle) && (!header.Band.UseFixedHeadersResolved(this) || !header.Band.IsHeaderScrolledUnderFixedHeaders(this, header)))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (header.Band.UseFixedHeadersResolved(this))
			{
				InternalScroll(ScrollEventType.EndScroll, 0, rectangle, leftAlign, takeIntoAccountFixedHeaders: true, header);
			}
			else

			}
		}

		public void ScrollRowIntoView(UltraGridRow row, RowScrollRegion rsr)
		{
			Rectangle rect = rsr.Rect;
			Rectangle rectangle = rect;
			HeaderBase headerBase = null;
			if (base.ExclusiveItems.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (HeaderBase exclusiveItem in base.ExclusiveItems)
				{
					if (!exclusiveItem.Hidden && exclusiveItem.Band == row.Band && exclusiveItem.GetFirstVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable: true) != null)
					{
						headerBase = exclusiveItem;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = row.Band.OrderedHeaders;
				if (orderedHeaders != null)
				{
					foreach (HeaderBase item in orderedHeaders)
					{
						if (!item.Hidden && item.ExclusiveColScrollRegion == null && item.GetFirstVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable: true) != null)
						{
							headerBase = item;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (headerBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridColumn firstVisibleCol = headerBase.GetFirstVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable: true);
			if (firstVisibleCol != null)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = firstVisibleCol.Band.Header.GetRelatedVisibleCol(firstVisibleCol, NavigateType.Last, includeNonActivateable: true);
				if (ultraGridColumn == null)
				{
					ultraGridColumn = firstVisibleCol;
				}
				rectangle.X = firstVisibleCol.Header.OverallOrigin - Position;
				rectangle.Width = ultraGridColumn.Header.OverallOrigin + ultraGridColumn.Extent - Position - rectangle.X;
				Rectangle rectangle2 = Rectangle.Intersect(rectangle, rect);
				if (!rectangle2.IsEmpty || !object.Equals(rectangle2, rectangle))
				{
					InternalScroll(ScrollEventType.EndScroll, 0, rectangle);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool InternalScroll(ScrollEventType scrollType, int lineDelta, Rectangle scrollIntoViewRect, bool leftAlign, bool takeIntoAccountFixedHeaders, HeaderBase headerBeingScrolled)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = base.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			if (ultraGrid != null && ultraGrid.EventManager != null && ultraGrid.EventManager.InProgress(GridEventIds.BeforeColRegionScroll))
			{
				dirtyGridElement = true;
			}
			int num = Position;
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = Clone();
			if (colScrollRegion == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				regeneratedDuringScrolling = false;
				scrolling = true;
				bool flag = base.Layout != null && base.Layout.Grid != null && ((UltraControlBase)base.Layout.Grid).IsUpdating;
				Control control = ((base.Layout != null && base.Layout.Grid != null) ? base.Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay : null);
				bool flag2 = !flag && control != null && control.Created;
				if (flag2)
				{
					control.Update();
				}
				colScrollRegion.ScrollHeaders(scrollType, lineDelta, scrollIntoViewRect, leftAlign, takeIntoAccountFixedHeaders, headerBeingScrolled);
				scrolling = false;
				regeneratedDuringScrolling = false;
				if (num == Position)
				{
					lastScrollType = scrollType;
					return false;
				}
				ResetScrollInfo();
				Rectangle region = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
				GetRegionRect(ref region, null, clipToParent: false, clipToDataArea: true);
				if (flag2)
				{
					int drawSequence = base.Layout.DrawSequence;
					control.Update();
					if (drawSequence != base.Layout.DrawSequence)
					{
						Rectangle lastPaintRect = base.Layout.lastPaintRect;
						if (lastPaintRect.Width >= region.Width && lastPaintRect.Height >= region.Height)
						{
							flag2 = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (control != null && control.Created)
				{
					Control controlForGridDisplay = base.Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay;
					ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegions = base.Layout.ColScrollRegions;
					RowScrollRegionsCollection rowScrollRegions = base.Layout.RowScrollRegions;
					RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement uIElement = GetUIElement(null);
					bool flag3 = uIElement != null && ((UIElement)uIElement).RightToLeftResolved;
					if (colScrollRegions != null && rowScrollRegions != null && base.IsLastVisibleRegion)
					{
						Rectangle rc = region;
						rc.X = region.Right - VerticalScrollBarWidth;
						foreach (RowScrollRegion item in rowScrollRegions)
						{
							if (item.WillScrollbarBeShown())
							{
								region.Width = rc.Left - region.Left;
								continue;
							}
							rc.Y = item.ZoomedOrigin;
							rc.Height = item.ZoomedExtent;
							if (!flag)
							{
								controlForGridDisplay.Invalidate(rc, invalidateChildren: false);
							}
						}
					}
					short num2 = 0;
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						region = ((UIElement)uIElement).AdjustRectForRightToLeft(region);
						region = ((UIElement)uIElement).AdjustRectForZooming(region);
					}
					Rectangle a = region;
					int num3 = num - Position;
					if (flag3)
					{
						num3 = -num3;
					}
					UltraControlBase val = (UltraControlBase)(object)((controlForGridDisplay is UltraControlBase) ? controlForGridDisplay : null);
					float num4 = ((val != null) ? val.ZoomFactor : 1f);
					num3 = Utilities.GetZoomedValue(num3, num4, false);
					if (num3 < 0)
					{
						a.X -= num3;
						a.Width += num3;
					}
					else
					{
						a.Width -= num3;
					}
					a = Rectangle.Intersect(a, region);
					if (flag2 && !base.Layout.UseFixedHeaders && base.Layout.IsBackgroundScrollable(vertical: false) && !a.IsEmpty && !base.Layout.RowScrollRegions.AreCardsInView && num4 % 1f == 0f)
					{
						Rectangle a2 = a;
						Rectangle a3 = a;
						a2.Offset(num3, 0);
						if (num3 < 0)
						{
							int x = a3.X;
							a3.X = a2.Right;
							a3.Width -= a3.X - x;
						}
						else
						{
							a3.Width = a2.Left - a3.Left;
						}
						a2 = Rectangle.Intersect(a2, region);
						if (!a2.IsEmpty)
						{
							a3 = Rectangle.Intersect(a3, region);
							cachedScrollOriginValue -= num3;
							Rectangle updateRect = Rectangle.Empty;

								}
								else

								}
								if (base.Layout != null)
								{
									base.Layout.IsScrolling = false;
								}
								controlForGridDisplay.Invalidate(a3, invalidateChildren: false);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							cachedScrollOriginValue = 1073741824;
							if (!flag)
							{
								controlForGridDisplay.Invalidate(region, invalidateChildren: false);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						cachedScrollOriginValue = 1073741824;
						if (!flag)
						{
							controlForGridDisplay.Invalidate(region, invalidateChildren: false);
						}
					}

					if (descendant != null)

					}

		internal void ScrollHeaders(ScrollEventType scrollType, int lineDelta, Rectangle scrollIntoViewRect, bool leftAlign, bool takeIntoAccountFixedHeaders, HeaderBase headerBeingScrolled)
		{
			if (ClonedFrom == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!scrollIntoViewRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				Rectangle region = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
				int num = 0;
				GetRegionRect(ref region, base.Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion, !scrollIntoViewRect.IsEmpty, clipToDataArea: false);
				if (takeIntoAccountFixedHeaders && headerBeingScrolled != null && headerBeingScrolled.Band.UseFixedHeadersResolved(this))
				{
					int num2 = 0;
					if (headerBeingScrolled.Band.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers)
					{
						if (!headerBeingScrolled.Band.IsHeaderFixed(this, headerBeingScrolled))
						{
							for (UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = headerBeingScrolled.Band; ultraGridBand != null; ultraGridBand = ultraGridBand.ParentBand)
							{
								num2 += ultraGridBand.PreRowAreaExtent + ultraGridBand.RowSelectorExtent + ultraGridBand.GetFixedHeadersExtent(this);
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = headerBeingScrolled.Band.GetOrigin(BandOrigin.RowCellArea) + headerBeingScrolled.Band.GetFixedHeadersExtent(this, getRightExtent: false);
					}
					region.X += num2;
					region.Width -= num2;
					region.Width -= headerBeingScrolled.Band.GetFixedHeadersExtent(this, getRightExtent: true);
				}
				int num3 = region.Left + GetClientWidth(base.Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion);
				if (num3 < region.Right)
				{
					region.Width = num3 - region.Left;
				}
				if (leftAlign)
				{
					num = scrollIntoViewRect.Left - region.Left;
				}
				else
				{
					if (scrollIntoViewRect.Right > region.Right)
					{
						num = scrollIntoViewRect.Right - region.Right;
					}
					if (scrollIntoViewRect.Left < region.Left + num)
					{
						num = scrollIntoViewRect.Left - region.Left;
					}
				}
				Position = Math.Max(0, Position + num);
				int range = Range;
				Position = Math.Min(Position, range);
			}
			else
			{
				int val = 1 + base.ScrollBarInfo.Maximum - base.ScrollBarInfo.LargeChange;
				switch (scrollType)
				{
				case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
					Position = Math.Max(0, Position - base.ScrollBarInfo.SmallChange);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
					Position = Math.Min(val, Position + base.ScrollBarInfo.SmallChange);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement:
					Position = Math.Max(0, Position - base.ScrollBarInfo.LargeChange);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement:
					Position = Math.Min(val, Position + base.ScrollBarInfo.LargeChange);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.First:
					Position = 0;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.Last:
					Position = val;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.ThumbPosition:
				case ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack:
					Position = base.ScrollBarInfo.Value;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.EndScroll:
					return;
				}
			}
			ResetScrollInfo();
			if (ClonedFrom.Position == Position)
			{
				ClonedFrom.lastScrollType = scrollType;
			}
			destroyVisibleHeaders = true;
			RegenerateVisibleHeaders();
			UltraGridBase grid = base.Layout.Grid;
			if (grid != null)
			{
				int num4 = Position;
				BeforeColRegionScrollEventArgs e = new BeforeColRegionScrollEventArgs(this, ClonedFrom);
				grid.FireBeforeColRegionScroll(e);
				bool cancel = e.Cancel;
				if (ClonedFrom.dirtyGridElement)
				{
					base.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
					dirtyGridElement = false;
				}
				if (cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ClonedFrom.regeneratedDuringScrolling)
				{
					SetDestroyVisibleHeaders(destroy: true);
					RegenerateVisibleHeaders();
				}
				else if (num4 != Position)
				{
					RegenerateVisibleHeaders();
				}
			}
			ClonedFrom.position = Position;
			ClonedFrom.overallWidth = overallWidth;
			ClonedFrom.visibleHeaders = visibleHeaders;
		}

		private void GetRegionRect(ref Rectangle region, RowScrollRegion rowRegion, bool clipToParent, bool clipToDataArea)
		{
			Rectangle b = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			UIElement val = null;
			UIElement uIElementInternal = base.Layout.UIElementInternal;
			if (uIElementInternal != null)
			{
				val = uIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(DataAreaUIElement));
				if (val != null)
				{
					b = val.RectInsideBorders;
				}
			}
			if (rowRegion != null)
			{
				region.Y = rowRegion.Origin;
				region.Height = rowRegion.Extent;
			}
			else if (val != null)
			{
				region = val.Rect;
			}
			else
			{
				region.Y = base.Layout.RowScrollRegions.GetNextVisibleRegion(null, wrap: false).Origin;
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = (RowScrollRegion)base.Layout.RowScrollRegions.LastVisibleRegion;
				region.Height = rowScrollRegion.Origin + rowScrollRegion.Extent - region.Y;
			}
			region.X = base.Origin;
			region.Width = base.Extent;
			if (clipToDataArea && val != null)
			{
				region = Rectangle.Intersect(region, b);
			}
			if (rowRegion != null && rowRegion.WillScrollbarBeShown())
			{
				region.Width -= VerticalScrollBarWidth;
			}
			if (WillScrollbarBeShown())
			{
				region.Height -= HorizontalScrollBarHeight;
			}
			if (clipToParent)
			{
				base.Layout.ClipToParent(ref region, clientCoords: true);
			}
		}

		internal override void CheckIfSizeChanged()
		{
			if (!(base.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ultraGrid.IsEventInProgress(GridEventIds.AfterColRegionSize))
			{
				eventInterrupted = true;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!((Control)(object)ultraGrid).Visible || base.Hidden || ultraGrid.FirstDraw)
				{
					return;
				}
				int clippedExtent = ClippedExtent;
				if (clippedExtent != extentLastResize)
				{
					extentLastResize = clippedExtent;
					ColScrollRegionEventArgs e = new ColScrollRegionEventArgs(this);
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterColRegionSize, e);
					if (eventInterrupted)
					{
						base.Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, fInvalidate: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal int GetBandOrigin(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (!base.HasExclusiveItems)
			{
				return band.GetOrigin();
			}
			ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = base.Layout.ViewStyleImpl;
			if (!viewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers)
			{
				return band.GetOrigin();
			}
			if (lastBand != band)
			{
				GetBandExtent(band);
			}
			if (originCached)
			{
				return lastBandOrigin;
			}
			if (band.ParentBand != null)
			{
				return GetBandOrigin(band.ParentBand) + GetBandExtent(band.ParentBand);
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal int GetBandExtent(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (!base.HasExclusiveItems || band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				return band.GetExtent();
			}
			if (lastBand == band)
			{
				return lastBandExtent;
			}
			lastBand = band;
			lastBandExtent = band.PreRowAreaExtent + band.RowSelectorExtent;
			lastBandOrigin = 0;
			originCached = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.ExclusiveItems.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = base.ExclusiveItems[i];
				if (!headerBase.Hidden && headerBase.Band == band)
				{
					if (!originCached)
					{
						originCached = true;
						lastBandOrigin = headerBase.OverallOrigin - headerBase.Band.PreRowAreaExtent;
					}
					lastBandExtent += headerBase.Extent - headerBase.RowSelectorExtent;
				}
			}
			return lastBandExtent;
		}

		public ColScrollRegion Split(int extent)
		{
			if (!(base.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_51"));
			}
			if (base.SizingMode == SizingMode.Fixed)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_52"));
			}
			if (ClonedFrom != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_53"));
			}
			if (extent < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_54"));
			}
			if (base.Layout.MaxColScrollRegions > 0 && base.Layout.ColScrollRegions.Count >= base.Layout.MaxColScrollRegions)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_55"));
			}
			base.Layout.GetUIElement(verify: true, forceInitializeRect: true);
			int clippedExtent = ClippedExtent;
			int num = extent;
			int colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved = base.Layout.ColScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved;
			if (extent > 0 && clippedExtent < num + colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_56"));
			}
			if (num <= 0 || clippedExtent - num <= colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved)
			{
				int num2 = clippedExtent;
				clippedExtent = (clippedExtent - colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved) / 2;
				num = num2 - (clippedExtent + colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved);
			}
			else
			{
				if (num >= clippedExtent)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_56"));
				}
				clippedExtent -= num + colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved;
			}
			if (clippedExtent <= 0 || num <= 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_57"));
			}
			int index = Index;
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = new ColScrollRegion((ColScrollRegionsCollection)collectionValue);
			colScrollRegion.SetOriginAndExtent(base.Origin, num);
			if (base.Layout.Grid != null)
			{
				BeforeColRegionSplitEventArgs e = new BeforeColRegionSplitEventArgs(this, colScrollRegion);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeColRegionSplit, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			SetOriginAndExtent(base.Origin + num + colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved, clippedExtent);
			base.Layout.ColScrollRegions.InternalInsert(colScrollRegion, index);
			base.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Width);
			return colScrollRegion;
		}

		internal override bool WillScrollbarBeShown(ScrollbarVisibility assumeRowScrollbarsVisible)
		{
			if (base.Layout.SortedBands.Count < 1 || base.Layout.SortedBands[0].CardView)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (base.ScrollbarResolved)
			{
			case Scrollbar.Show:
				return true;
			case Scrollbar.ShowIfNeeded:
			{
				int verticalScrollBarWidth = VerticalScrollBarWidth;
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = ((base.ExclusiveItems.Count >= 1) ? OverallWidth : base.Layout.GetOverallExtent(this));
				if (num2 <= base.Extent && num2 > base.Extent - verticalScrollBarWidth && base.IsLastVisibleRegion && (ScrollbarVisibility.Visible == assumeRowScrollbarsVisible || (assumeRowScrollbarsVisible == ScrollbarVisibility.Check && base.Layout.RowScrollRegions.AreScrollbarsVisible(ScrollbarVisibility.Hidden))))
				{
					num = verticalScrollBarWidth;
				}
				return num2 > base.Extent - num;
			}
			case Scrollbar.Hide:
				return false;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal override void PositionScrollbar(bool resetScrollInfo)
		{
			if ((scrollBarInfoValue == null || !scrollBarInfoValue.IsThumbInDrag) && scrollbarRectSet)
			{
				if (base.IsClone)
				{
					ClonedFrom.PositionScrollbar(resetScrollInfo);
					return;
				}
				scrollbarPositionDirty = false;
				bool show = !base.Hidden && WillScrollbarBeShown(ScrollbarVisibility.Check);
				ShowScrollbar(show, resetScrollInfo);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsPivotItemFixedHeaderItem()
		{
			if (lastPivotItem is HeaderBase || lastPivotItem is UltraGridCell)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = lastPivotItem as HeaderBase;
				if (headerBase == null)
				{
					headerBase = ((UltraGridCell)lastPivotItem).Column.Header;
				}
				if (headerBase.Band.UseFixedHeadersResolved(this))
				{
					return headerBase.Band.IsHeaderFixed(this, headerBase);

			}

		}

		internal bool FixedHeaders_DragSelectScrollHelper(Point mouseLoc, out bool doesNeedScroll, ref int timerInterval, bool performScroll)

			Rectangle regionRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);

					bool flag2 = headerBase.Band.AreNonFixedHeadersScrolledUnderneathFixedHeadersLeft(this);
					bool flag3 = headerBase.Band.AreNonFixedHeadersScrolledUnderneathFixedHeadersRight(this);

					bool flag6 = flag4 && headerBase.FixOnRightResolved;
					int num3 = base.Origin + headerBase.Band.GetRightFixedHeadersAreaLeft(this);
					if (flag5)

						{
							if (mouseLoc.X <= regionRect.Right && flag2)
							{
								if (!fixedToNonFixedAreaBoundaryCrossed)
								{
									num = -25;
									flag = true;
								}
							}
							else if (mouseLoc.X > regionRect.Right && num2 > regionRect.Right)
							{
								num = mouseLoc.X - regionRect.Right;
							}
							if (performScroll)
							{
								fixedToNonFixedAreaBoundaryCrossed = true;
							}
						}
					}
					else if (flag6)
					{
						if (mouseLoc.X < num3 - regionRect.Left)
						{
							if (mouseLoc.X >= regionRect.Left && flag3)
							{
								if (!fixedToNonFixedAreaBoundaryCrossed)
								{
									num = 25;
									flag = true;
								}
							}
							else if (mouseLoc.X < regionRect.Left && flag3)
							{
								num = mouseLoc.X + regionRect.Left;
							}
							if (performScroll)
							{
								fixedToNonFixedAreaBoundaryCrossed = true;
							}
						}
						else if (fixedToNonFixedAreaBoundaryCrossed && flag2 && mouseLoc.X < regionRect.X + leftFixedHeadersAreaRight)
						{
							num = mouseLoc.X - (regionRect.X + leftFixedHeadersAreaRight);
						}
					}
					else if (mouseLoc.X > regionRect.Right && num2 > regionRect.Right)
					{
						num = mouseLoc.X - regionRect.Right;
					}
					else if (flag2 && mouseLoc.X < regionRect.X + leftFixedHeadersAreaRight)
					{
						num = mouseLoc.X - (regionRect.X + leftFixedHeadersAreaRight);
					}
					else if (flag3 && mouseLoc.X > num3 - regionRect.X)
					{
						num = mouseLoc.X - (num3 - regionRect.X);
					}
					if (num != 0)
					{
						doesNeedScroll = true;
						int num4 = Math.Abs(num);
						if (flag)
						{
							timerInterval = 1;
						}
						else if (num4 > 100)
						{
							timerInterval = 40;
						}
						else if (num4 > 80)
						{
							timerInterval = 65;
						}
						else if (num4 > 60)
						{
							timerInterval = 80;
						}
						else if (num4 > 50)
						{
							timerInterval = 100;
						}
						else if (num4 > 40)
						{
							timerInterval = 150;
						}
						else if (num4 > 20)
						{
							timerInterval = 200;
						}
						else if (num4 > 10)
						{
							timerInterval = 300;
						}
						else if (num4 > 6)
						{
							timerInterval = 400;
						}
						else
						{
							timerInterval = 500;
						}
						if (performScroll)
						{
							int value = base.ScrollBarInfo.Value;
							int num5 = value;
							if (flag)

								value += num8 * num9;

		internal bool DoesDragNeedScroll(Point mouseLoc, ref int timerInterval)
		{
			UltraGridBase grid = base.Layout.Grid;
			if (grid != null && !grid.ShouldScrollGridOnDragMoveHelper(mouseLoc))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((!(base.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid { HasSelectedBeenAllocated: not false } ultraGrid) || !ultraGrid.Selected.HasRows) && FixedHeaders_DragSelectScrollHelper(mouseLoc, out var doesNeedScroll, ref timerInterval, performScroll: false))
			{
				return doesNeedScroll;
			}
			Rectangle regionRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			GetRegionRect(ref regionRect, base.Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion);
			int num = 0;
			if (mouseLoc.X >= regionRect.Left && mouseLoc.X <= regionRect.Right)
			{
				return false;
			}
			num = ((mouseLoc.X >= regionRect.Left) ? (mouseLoc.X - regionRect.Right) : (regionRect.Left - mouseLoc.X));
			if (num > 100)
			{
				timerInterval = 40;
			}
			else if (num > 80)
			{
				timerInterval = 65;
			}
			else if (num > 60)
			{
				timerInterval = 80;
			}
			else if (num > 50)
			{
				timerInterval = 100;
			}
			else if (num > 40)
			{
				timerInterval = 150;
			}
			else if (num > 20)
			{
				timerInterval = 200;
			}
			else if (num > 10)
			{
				timerInterval = 300;
			}
			else if (num > 6)
			{
				timerInterval = 400;
			}
			else
			{
				timerInterval = 500;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void DoDragScroll(Point mouseLoc, int timerInterval)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = base.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			if ((ultraGrid == null || !ultraGrid.HasSelectedBeenAllocated || !ultraGrid.Selected.HasRows) && FixedHeaders_DragSelectScrollHelper(mouseLoc, out var _, ref timerInterval, performScroll: true))
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle regionRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			GetRegionRect(ref regionRect, base.Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion);
			ScrollEventType scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
			if (mouseLoc.X < regionRect.Left)
			{
				scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
			}
			else
			{
				if (mouseLoc.X <= regionRect.Right)
				{
					return;
				}
				scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement;
			}
			if (ultraGrid != null && ((Control)(object)ultraGrid).RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes)
			{
				switch (scrollEventType)
				{
				case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
					scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
					scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
					break;
				}
			}
			int num = ((timerInterval > 400) ? 10 : ((timerInterval > 300) ? 30 : ((timerInterval <= 200) ? 80 : 50)));
			int value = base.ScrollBarInfo.Value;
			value += ((scrollEventType == ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement) ? num : (-num));
			base.ScrollBarInfo.Value = Math.Max(base.ScrollBarInfo.Minimum, Math.Min(base.ScrollBarInfo.Maximum - 1, (value >= 0) ? value : 0));
			InternalScroll(scrollEventType, num);
		}

		internal override void RaiseScrollPatternScrollPercentPropertyIdChanged()
		{
			double scrollPercent = base.ScrollBarInfo.GetScrollPercent();
			if (oldScrollPercent == scrollPercent)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion in base.Layout.RowScrollRegions)
			{
				RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement uIElement = GetUIElement(rowScrollRegion);
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.RaiseUIAutomationPropertyChangedEventInternal((AutomationPropertyIds)30053, oldScrollPercent, scrollPercent);
					uIElement.RaiseUIAutomationEventInternal((AutomationEventIds)20002);
				}
			}
			oldScrollPercent = scrollPercent;
		}
	}

		public void Clear()
		{

		}

		internal void OnSplitBoxDrop(Point point)
		{
			int colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved = base.Layout.ColScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved;
			ColScrollRegionEnumerator colScrollRegionEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (colScrollRegionEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ColScrollRegion current = colScrollRegionEnumerator.Current;
					if (point.X > current.Origin + colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved && point.X < current.Origin + current.Extent - colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved)
					{
						try
						{
							current.Split(point.X - current.Origin);
							break;
						}
						catch
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = colScrollRegionEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnResize(ColScrollRegion csr, int deltaX)
		{
			int colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved = base.Layout.ColScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved;
			int num = csr.Extent + deltaX;
			int num2 = csr.Origin + num;
			ColScrollRegion nextVisibleRegion = GetNextVisibleRegion(csr, wrap: false);
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = null;
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion2 = null;
			if (num < 2)
			{
				colScrollRegion = csr;
				colScrollRegion2 = nextVisibleRegion;
			}
			else if (nextVisibleRegion != null && num2 >= nextVisibleRegion.Origin + nextVisibleRegion.Extent - colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved)
			{
				if (SizingMode.Fixed == nextVisibleRegion.SizingMode)
				{
					colScrollRegion = csr;
				}
				else
				{
					colScrollRegion = nextVisibleRegion;
					colScrollRegion2 = csr;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				colScrollRegion2 = csr;
			}
			if (colScrollRegion != null)
			{
				int origin = colScrollRegion.Origin;
				if (colScrollRegion2 != null && colScrollRegion2.Origin < origin)
				{
					origin = colScrollRegion2.Origin;
				}
				if (colScrollRegion2 != null)
				{
					num = colScrollRegion2.Extent + colScrollRegion.Extent + colScrollRegionSplitterBarWidthResolved;
				}
				Remove(colScrollRegion);
				int num3 = IndexOf(colScrollRegion);
				if (num3 < 0)
				{
					colScrollRegion2?.SetOriginAndExtent(origin, num);
					base.Layout.UpdateUIElementRect();
				}
			}
			else if (colScrollRegion2 != null)
			{
				SetExtent(colScrollRegion2, num);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeMetricsHelper()
		{

		internal void SetExtent(ColScrollRegion csr, int newExtent)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = base.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			if (ultraGrid != null && (ultraGrid.EventManager.InProgress(GridEventIds.BeforeColRegionSize) || ultraGrid.EventManager.InProgress(GridEventIds.BeforeColRegionSplit)))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_256"));
			}
			ColScrollRegion nextVisibleRegion = GetNextVisibleRegion(csr, wrap: false);
			if (nextVisibleRegion == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_61"));
			}
			int origin = csr.Origin;
			int extent = csr.Extent;
			int origin2 = nextVisibleRegion.Origin;
			int extent2 = nextVisibleRegion.Extent;
			if (newExtent < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_62"));
			}
			int num = ((base.Layout != null) ? base.Layout.VerticalScrollBarWidthResolved : ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)(object)ultraGrid));
			int num2 = extent + extent2 - num;
			if (newExtent > num2 && num2 > 0)
			{
				newExtent = num2;
			}
			if (newExtent < 0)
			{
				newExtent = 0;
			}
			int num3 = newExtent - extent;
			csr.SetOriginAndExtent(origin, newExtent);
			nextVisibleRegion.SetOriginAndExtent(origin2 + num3, extent2 - num3);
			if (base.Layout.Grid != null)
			{
				BeforeColRegionSizeEventArgs e = new BeforeColRegionSizeEventArgs(csr, nextVisibleRegion);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeColRegionSize, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					csr.SetOriginAndExtent(origin, extent);
					nextVisibleRegion.SetOriginAndExtent(origin2, extent2);
				}
			}
			base.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
			csr.PositionScrollbar(resetScrollInfo: true);
			nextVisibleRegion.PositionScrollbar(resetScrollInfo: true);
			metricsDirty = true;
		}

		public void Remove(ColScrollRegion csr)
		{
			if (!(base.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_63"));
			}
			if (Count < 2)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_258"));
			}
			int num = IndexOf(csr);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				BeforeColRegionRemovedEventArgs e = new BeforeColRegionRemovedEventArgs(csr);
				if (base.Layout.Grid != null)
				{
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeColRegionRemoved, e);
				}
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				csr.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				csr.Dispose();
			}
			InternalRemove(csr);
			metricsDirty = true;
			if (base.Layout != null)
			{
				base.Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
				base.Layout.UIElementInternal.VerifyChildElements(true);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Remove);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			for (int num = List.Count - 1; num > 0; num--)
			{
				ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = (ColScrollRegion)List[num];
				colScrollRegion.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				colScrollRegion.Dispose();
				InternalRemove(colScrollRegion);
			}
			metricsDirty = true;
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Remove);
		}

		public new ColScrollRegionEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ColScrollRegionEnumerator(this);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			PropertyCategories propertyCategories = ((context.Context is PropertyCategories) ? ((PropertyCategories)context.Context) : PropertyCategories.All);
			if ((propertyCategories & PropertyCategories.ColScrollRegions) != 0)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
				}
				SerializeTag(info);
			}
		}

		private ColScrollRegionsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(null)
		{
			if ((((context.Context is PropertyCategories) ? ((PropertyCategories)context.Context) : PropertyCategories.All) & PropertyCategories.ColScrollRegions) == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(ColScrollRegion))
				{
					ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = (ColScrollRegion)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ColScrollRegion), null);
					if (colScrollRegion != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(colScrollRegion);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(ColScrollRegionsCollection source, PropertyCategories propertyCategories)
		{
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.Tag;
			}
			int num = Count - source.Count;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				for (int num2 = Count; num2 > source.Count; num2--)
				{
					this[num2 - 1].Dispose();
					InternalRemove(num2 - 1);
				}
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				for (int i = Count; i < source.Count; i++)
				{
					ColScrollRegion csr = new ColScrollRegion(this);
					AddScrollRegionHelper(csr);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Count; j++)
			{
				this[j].InitializeFrom(source[j]);
			}
		}

		public void CopyTo(ColScrollRegion[] array, int index)
		{
			base.CopyTo(array, index);
		}
	}
	public class ColSplitBoxUIElement : SplitterUIElement
	{
		private ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegions;

		public override Border3DSide BorderSides => Border3DSide.All;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				if (colScrollRegions == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(colScrollRegions.Layout, StyleUtils.Role.ColScrollRegionSplitBox);
			}
		}

		public ColSplitBoxUIElement(UIElement parent, ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegions)
			: base(parent, true)
		{
			this.colScrollRegions = colScrollRegions;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			((colScrollRegions != null) ? colScrollRegions.Layout : null)?.MergeLayoutAppearances(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, UltraGridLayout.LayoutAppearanceIndex.SplitterBarVerticalAppearance, StyleUtils.Role.ColScrollRegionSplitBox, (RoleState)1);
		}

		public override void ApplyAdjustment(Point delta)
		{
			if (delta.X > ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width)
			{
				delta.Offset(((UIElement)this).Rect.Left, ((UIElement)this).Rect.Top);
				colScrollRegions.OnSplitBoxDrop(delta);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			bool result = ((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
			if (colScrollRegions != null)
			{
				colScrollRegions.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper();
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class ColSplitterBarUIElement : SplitterUIElement
	{
		private ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion;

		public ColScrollRegion ColScrollRegion => colScrollRegion;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => colScrollRegion.Layout.BorderStyleSplitter;

		public override UIRole UIRole
		{
			get
			{
				if (colScrollRegion == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return StyleUtils.GetRole(colScrollRegion.Layout, StyleUtils.Role.ColScrollRegionSplitterBar);
			}
		}

		internal ColSplitterBarUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent, true)
		{
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			((ColScrollRegion != null) ? ColScrollRegion.Layout : null)?.MergeLayoutAppearances(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, UltraGridLayout.LayoutAppearanceIndex.SplitterBarVerticalAppearance, StyleUtils.Role.ColScrollRegionSplitterBar, (RoleState)1);
		}

		public ColSplitterBarUIElement(UIElement parent, ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion)
			: this(parent)
		{
			initialize(colScrollRegion);
		}

		internal void initialize(ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion)
		{
			this.colScrollRegion = colScrollRegion;
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = colScrollRegion;
		}

		public override bool SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			int count = ColScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions.Count;
			int index = ColScrollRegion.Index;
			if (ColScrollRegion.SizingMode == SizingMode.Fixed && ColScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions[index + 1].SizingMode == SizingMode.Fixed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = index + 1; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (ColScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions[i].SizingMode != SizingMode.Free)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int num = index; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (ColScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions[num].SizingMode == SizingMode.Free)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void ApplyAdjustment(Point delta)
		{
			if (delta.X == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (colScrollRegion.SizingMode == SizingMode.Fixed)
			{
				for (int num = colScrollRegion.Index; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (colScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions[num].SizingMode == SizingMode.Free)
					{
						colScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions.OnResize(colScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions[num], delta.X);
						break;
					}
					colScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions.OnResize(colScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions[num], delta.X);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				colScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions.OnResize(colScrollRegion, delta.X);
			}
			for (int i = colScrollRegion.Index + 1; i < colScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions.Count && colScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions[i].SizingMode != SizingMode.Free; i++)
			{
				colScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions.OnResize(colScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions[i], delta.X);
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			bool result = ((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
			if (ColScrollRegion != null)
			{
				ColScrollRegion.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper();
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		private void ColumnChooserDialog_VisibleChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			float zoomFactor = ((UltraControlBase)ultraGridColumnChooser.DisplayGrid).ZoomFactor;
			if (Math.Abs(LastZoomFactor - zoomFactor) >= 0.01f)
			{
				((Control)(object)ultraGridColumnChooser.DisplayGrid).Refresh();
				LastZoomFactor = zoomFactor;
			}
		}

		private void ColumnChooserDialog_Closing(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			//IL_002a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002f: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			if (inColumnChooserDialog_Closing)
			{
				return;
			}
			inColumnChooserDialog_Closing = true;
			try
			{
				if (1 == (int)DisposeOnClose)
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
					Dispose();
				}
				else if (2 == (int)DisposeOnClose)
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
					base.Visible = false;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inColumnChooserDialog_Closing = false;
			}
		}

		{
		}
	}

		private void ColumnEditorDialog_Paint(object sender, PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.WindowState != FormWindowState.Minimized && base.ClientSize.Width > 14)
			{
				int num = ColumnPropertyGrid.Bounds.Bottom + 7;
				Point pt = new Point(7, num);
				Point pt2 = new Point(base.ClientSize.Width - 7, num);
				e.Graphics.DrawLine(SystemPens.ControlDark, pt, pt2);
				pt.Y++;
				pt2.Y++;
				e.Graphics.DrawLine(SystemPens.ControlLightLight, pt, pt2);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveButton_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			while (ColumnListBox.SelectedItems.Count > 0)
			{
				object obj = ColumnListBox.SelectedItems[0];
				object columnFromWrapper = columnUITypeEditorInfo.GetColumnFromWrapper(obj);
				if (!columnUITypeEditorInfo.IsBound(columnFromWrapper))
				{
					columnUITypeEditorInfo.Remove(columnFromWrapper);
					ColumnListBox.Remove(obj);
				}
			}
		}

			ColumnListBox.ClearSelected();

			ColumnListBox.SelectedIndex = ColumnListBox.Add(columnWrapperForListBox);
		}

		private void UpdatePropertyGridCollection()
		{
			ColumnPropertyGrid.SelectedObject = null;
			if (ColumnListBox.SelectedItems.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			foreach (object selectedItem in ColumnListBox.SelectedItems)
			{
				object columnFromWrapper = columnUITypeEditorInfo.GetColumnFromWrapper(selectedItem);
				arrayList.Add(columnFromWrapper);
			}
			ColumnPropertyGrid.SelectedObjects = arrayList.ToArray();
		}

		private void VerifyRemoveEnabledState()
		{
			bool enabled = true;
			if (ColumnListBox.SelectedItems.Count == 0)
			{
				if (ColumnListBox.SelectedItem == null)
				{
					enabled = false;
				}
				else
				{
					object selectedItem = ColumnListBox.SelectedItem;
					if (selectedItem == null)
					{
						enabled = false;
					}
					else
					{
						object columnFromWrapper = columnUITypeEditorInfo.GetColumnFromWrapper(selectedItem);
						enabled = !columnUITypeEditorInfo.IsBound(columnFromWrapper);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (object selectedItem2 in ColumnListBox.SelectedItems)
				{
					object obj = selectedItem2;
					if (obj != null)
					{
						object columnFromWrapper2 = columnUITypeEditorInfo.GetColumnFromWrapper(obj);
						if (columnUITypeEditorInfo.IsBound(columnFromWrapper2))
						{
							enabled = false;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			RemoveButton.Enabled = enabled;
		}

		private static bool CanResetSelectedItems(PropertyGrid propGrid)
		{
			if (propGrid == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (propGrid.SelectedObjects == null || propGrid.SelectedObjects.Length == 0 || propGrid.SelectedGridItem == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object[] selectedObjects = propGrid.SelectedObjects;
			foreach (object component in selectedObjects)
			{
				try
				{
					GridItem selectedGridItem = propGrid.SelectedGridItem;
					if (!selectedGridItem.PropertyDescriptor.CanResetValue(component))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				catch (InvalidCastException)
				{
					return false;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void menuItemReset_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			ColumnPropertyGrid.ResetSelectedProperty();
		}

		private void BeginTransaction()
		{
			IComponent componentForPropertyGrid = columnUITypeEditorInfo.ComponentForPropertyGrid;
			if (componentForPropertyGrid != null)
			{
				IServiceProvider serviceProvider = componentForPropertyGrid.Site;
				if (serviceProvider != null)
				{
					componentService = serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) as IComponentChangeService;
					designerHostService = serviceProvider.GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) as IDesignerHost;
				}
				if (designerHostService != null)
				{
					transaction = designerHostService.CreateTransaction(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DesignerTransactionName"));
				}
				if (componentService != null)
				{
					componentService.OnComponentChanging(componentForPropertyGrid, null);
					componentService.OnComponentChanged(componentForPropertyGrid, null, null, null);
				}
				wasDesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = columnUITypeEditorInfo.DesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled;
				columnUITypeEditorInfo.DesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = true;
			}
		}

		private void CommitTransaction()
		{
			IComponent componentForPropertyGrid = columnUITypeEditorInfo.ComponentForPropertyGrid;
			if (!wasDesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled && componentForPropertyGrid != null)
			{
				columnUITypeEditorInfo.DesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = false;
			}
			if (transaction != null)
			{
				transaction.Commit();
			}
			transaction = null;
		}

		private void CancelTransaction()
		{
			try
			{
				IComponent componentForPropertyGrid = columnUITypeEditorInfo.ComponentForPropertyGrid;
				if (!wasDesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled && componentForPropertyGrid != null)
				{
					columnUITypeEditorInfo.DesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = false;
				}
				if (transaction != null)
				{
					transaction.Cancel();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				transaction = null;
			}
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	public class ColumnFilter : KeyedSubObjectBase, ISerializable
	{
		private UltraGridColumn column;

		private FilterConditionsCollection filterConditions;

		private FilterLogicalOperator logicalOperator;

		internal SerializedColumnID serializedColumnId;

		internal object filterRowOperandValue;

		internal object filterRowOperatorValue;

		internal object filterRowOperatorEditorContext;

		internal bool filterOperandModifiedSinceLastApply;

		internal bool filterOperatorModifiedSinceLastApply;

		internal string displayTextOverride;

		public UltraGridColumn Column => column;

		public FilterConditionsCollection FilterConditions
		{
			get
			{
				if (filterConditions == null)
				{
					filterConditions = new FilterConditionsCollection(this);
					filterConditions.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				return filterConditions;
			}
		}

		public FilterLogicalOperator LogicalOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return logicalOperator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != logicalOperator)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(FilterLogicalOperator), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_104"), (int)value, typeof(FilterLogicalOperator));
					}
					logicalOperator = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.LogicalOperator);
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool HasFilterConditions
		{
			get
			{
				if (filterConditions != null)
				{
					return filterConditions.Count > 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal ColumnFilter(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_149"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_103"));
			}
			this.column = column;
			logicalOperator = FilterLogicalOperator.And;
		}

		public ColumnFilter(UltraGridColumn column, FilterLogicalOperator logicalOperator)
			: this(column)
		{
			this.logicalOperator = logicalOperator;
		}

		protected ColumnFilter(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), Key);
					break;
				case "LogicalOperator":
					logicalOperator = (FilterLogicalOperator)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(FilterLogicalOperator), logicalOperator);
					break;
				case "Column":
					serializedColumnId = (SerializedColumnID)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(SerializedColumnID), null);
					break;
				case "FilterConditions":
					filterConditions = (FilterConditionsCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(FilterConditionsCollection), null);
					break;
				case "displayTextOverride":
					displayTextOverride = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), null);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearFilterConditions()
		{
			if (filterConditions != null)
			{
				filterConditions.Clear();
			}
			filterRowOperandValue = null;
			UltraGridFilterCell ultraGridFilterCell = ((Column != null && Column.Layout != null) ? (Column.Layout.ActiveCell as UltraGridFilterCell) : null);
			if (ultraGridFilterCell != null && ultraGridFilterCell.IsInEditMode && this == ultraGridFilterCell.ColumnFilter)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = ultraGridFilterCell.EditorResolved;
				if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.IsInEditMode)
				{
					editorResolved.Value = DBNull.Value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(ColumnFilter source)
		{
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.tagValue;
			}
			FilterConditions.InitializeFrom(source.FilterConditions);
			logicalOperator = source.logicalOperator;
			displayTextOverride = source.displayTextOverride;
		}

		internal bool CanInitializeFrom(ColumnFilter columnFilter)
		{
			UltraGridColumn matchingColumn = columnFilter.column;
			if (columnFilter.serializedColumnId != null && columnFilter.serializedColumnId.Key.Length > 0)
			{
				matchingColumn = Column.Band.GetMatchingColumn(columnFilter.serializedColumnId);
			}
			if (Column == matchingColumn)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (matchingColumn != null && Column != null && Column.Key != null && Column.Key.Equals(matchingColumn.Key))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool DoesRowPassFilters(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (!HasFilterConditions)
			{
				return true;
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Column;
			if (ultraGridColumn == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ultraGridColumn.Band != row.Band)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (LogicalOperator == FilterLogicalOperator.And)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < FilterConditions.Count; i++)
				{
					FilterCondition filterCondition = FilterConditions[i];
					bool flag2 = filterCondition.MeetsCriteria(row);
					flag = flag && flag2;
					if (!flag)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				return flag;
			}
			if (FilterLogicalOperator.Or == LogicalOperator)
			{
				bool flag3 = false;
				for (int j = 0; j < FilterConditions.Count; j++)
				{
					FilterCondition filterCondition2 = FilterConditions[j];
					bool flag4 = filterCondition2.MeetsCriteria(row);
					flag3 = flag3 || flag4;
					if (flag3)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				return flag3;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeLogicalOperator())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeFilterConditions();
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void Reset()
		{
			ResetLogicalOperator();
			ResetFilterConditions();
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeLogicalOperator()
		{
			return LogicalOperator != FilterLogicalOperator.And;
		}

		internal void ResetLogicalOperator()
		{
			LogicalOperator = FilterLogicalOperator.And;
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeFilterConditions()
		{
			if (filterConditions != null)
			{
				return filterConditions.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetFilterConditions()
		{
			if (filterConditions != null)
			{
				filterConditions.Clear();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public ColumnFilter Clone()
		{
			ColumnFilter columnFilter = new ColumnFilter(Column);
			columnFilter.InitializeFrom(this);
			return columnFilter;
		}

		internal bool InternalEquals(ColumnFilter cf)
		{
			if (LogicalOperator != cf.LogicalOperator)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = (HasFilterConditions ? FilterConditions.Count : 0);
			int num2 = (cf.HasFilterConditions ? cf.FilterConditions.Count : 0);
			if (num != num2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (!FilterConditions[i].InternalEquals(cf.FilterConditions[i]))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal string GetLogicalOperatorText()
		{
			return GetLogicalOperatorText(LogicalOperator);
		}

		internal static string GetLogicalOperatorText(FilterLogicalOperator logicalOperator)
		{
			string name = ((FilterLogicalOperator.Or == logicalOperator) ? "RowFilterLogicalOperator_Or" : "RowFilterLogicalOperator_And");
			return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(name);
		}

		internal void ClearEditModeInfo()
		{
			filterRowOperandValue = null;
			filterOperandModifiedSinceLastApply = false;
			filterOperatorModifiedSinceLastApply = false;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			displayTextOverride = null;
			if ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId == PropertyIds.Clear)
			{
				ClearEditModeInfo();
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ColumnFilter);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializeTag(info);
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			if (ShouldSerializeLogicalOperator())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "LogicalOperator", LogicalOperator);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayTextOverride))
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "displayTextOverride", displayTextOverride);
			}
			if (Column != null)
			{
				SerializedColumnID serializedColumnID = Column.Band.GetSerializedColumnId(Column);
				if (serializedColumnID != null)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Column", serializedColumnID);
				}
			}
			else if (serializedColumnId != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Column", serializedColumnId);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeFilterConditions())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "FilterConditions", FilterConditions);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayTextOverride))
			{
				return displayTextOverride;
			}
			FilterConditionsCollection filterConditionsCollection = FilterConditions;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < filterConditionsCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				FilterCondition filterCondition = filterConditionsCollection[i];
				if (filterCondition != null)
				{
					if (i > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(' ').Append(GetLogicalOperatorText()).Append(' ');
					}
					filterCondition.ToString(stringBuilder, includeColumnName: false);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public class ColumnFiltersCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, ISerializable
	{
		private int columnsCollectionVersion = -1;

		private UltraGridBand band;

		private bool inSynchronizeWithColumnsColection;

		private FilterLogicalOperator logicalOperator;

		protected override int InitialCapacity
		{
			get
			{
				if (Band != null && Band.Columns != null)
				{
					return Band.Columns.Count;
				}
				return 10;
			}
		}

		public override object[] All
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
				object[] array = new object[Count];
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					array[i] = GetItem(i);
				}
				return array;
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
		}

		public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

		private UltraGridBand Band => band;

		public override int Count
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
				return base.Count;
			}
		}

		public ColumnFilter this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
				return (ColumnFilter)GetItem(index);
			}
		}

		public ColumnFilter this[string columnKey]
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
				return (ColumnFilter)GetItem(columnKey);
			}
		}

		public ColumnFilter this[UltraGridColumn column]
		{
			get
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
				return (ColumnFilter)GetItem(column.Index);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsAnyColumnFilterActive
		{
			get
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
				{
					ColumnFilter columnFilter = (ColumnFilter)List[i];
					if (columnFilter != null && columnFilter.HasFilterConditions)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public FilterLogicalOperator LogicalOperator
		{
			get
			{
				return logicalOperator;
			}
			set
			{
				if (logicalOperator != value)
				{
					GridUtils.ValidateEnum("LogicalOperator", typeof(FilterLogicalOperator), value);
					logicalOperator = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.LogicalOperator);
				}
			}
		}

		internal ColumnFiltersCollection(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_104"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_319"));
			}
			this.band = band;
		}

		protected ColumnFiltersCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(ColumnFilter))
				{
					ColumnFilter columnFilter = (ColumnFilter)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(ColumnFilter), null);
					if (columnFilter != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(columnFilter);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string name = current.Name;
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void InternalClearHelper()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
			{
				if (List[i] is ColumnFilter columnFilter)
				{
					columnFilter.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
			List.Clear();
		}

		private void InternalRemoveHelper(int index)
		{
			if (List[index] is ColumnFilter columnFilter)
			{
				columnFilter.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			InternalRemove(index);
		}

		private void SynchronizeWithColumnsColection()
		{
			if (inSynchronizeWithColumnsColection)
			{
				return;
			}
			inSynchronizeWithColumnsColection = true;
			try
			{
				ColumnsCollection columns = Band.Columns;
				int count = columns.Count;
				if (count == List.Count && columnsCollectionVersion == Band.ColumnsVersion)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (count == 0)
				{
					InternalClearHelper();
					return;
				}
				List.Capacity = List.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
				{
					if (List[i] != null)
					{
						int index = ((ColumnFilter)List[i]).Column.Index;
						if (index < 0)
						{
							InternalRemoveHelper(i);
							i--;
						}
						else if (index < i)
						{
							InternalRemoveHelper(i - 1);
							i -= 2;
						}
						else if (index > i)
						{
							List.Insert(i, null);
						}
					}
				}
				if (count < List.Count)
				{
					for (int num = List.Count - 1; num >= count; num--)
					{
						if (List[num] is ColumnFilter columnFilter)
						{
							columnFilter.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
						}
					}
					List.RemoveRange(count, List.Count - count);
				}
				else
				{
					while (count > List.Count)
					{
						List.Add(null);
					}
				}
				columnsCollectionVersion = Band.ColumnsVersion;
			}
			finally
			{
				inSynchronizeWithColumnsColection = false;
			}
		}

		public override int IndexOf(string key)
		{
			if (Band != null)
			{
				return Band.Columns.IndexOf(key);
			}
			return base.IndexOf(key);
		}

		protected override IKeyedSubObject GetItem(string key)
		{
			SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
			int num = IndexOf(key);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_106"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_320"));
			}
			return (IKeyedSubObject)GetItem(num);
		}

		public override object GetItem(int index)
		{
			SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
			ColumnFilter columnFilter = (ColumnFilter)List[index];
			if (columnFilter == null)
			{
				columnFilter = new ColumnFilter(Band.Columns[index]);
				columnFilter.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				List[index] = columnFilter;
			}
			return columnFilter;
		}

		internal bool HasColumnFilter(int index)
		{
			SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
			return List[index] != null;
		}

		internal bool HasColumnFilter(string columnKey)
		{
			SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
			int num = IndexOf(columnKey);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return List[num] != null;
		}

		internal bool HasColumnFilter(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			int num = Band.Columns.IndexOf(column);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				return HasColumnFilter(num);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public void ClearAllFilters()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
			{
				if (List[i] is ColumnFilter columnFilter)
				{
					columnFilter.ClearFilterConditions();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ColumnFilters);
		}

		internal bool DoesRowPassFilters(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			return DoesRowPassFilters(row, null);
		}

		internal bool DoesRowPassFilters(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn ignoreFiltersForColumn)
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if (ultraGridBand == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (row.Band != ultraGridBand)
			{
				return true;
			}
			SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
			bool flag = true;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (!HasColumnFilter(i))
				{
					continue;
				}
				ColumnFilter columnFilter = this[i];
				if (columnFilter.Column != ignoreFiltersForColumn && columnFilter.HasFilterConditions)
				{
					flag = columnFilter.DoesRowPassFilters(row);
					if ((!flag && LogicalOperator == FilterLogicalOperator.And) || (flag && FilterLogicalOperator.Or == LogicalOperator))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			FilterCondition filterCondition = ((band != null) ? band.Layout : null)?.AutoCompleteFilterCondition;
			if (filterCondition != null)
			{
				flag = flag && filterCondition.MeetsCriteria(row);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (List.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
			{
				if (List[i] is ColumnFilter value)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), value);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(ColumnFiltersCollection source, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			if ((PropertyCategories.ColumnFilters & categories) == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.tagValue;
			}
			ClearAllFilters();
			Dictionary<string, ColumnFilter> dictionary = new Dictionary<string, ColumnFilter>(source.List.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < source.List.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(source.List[i] is ColumnFilter columnFilter))
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (columnFilter.serializedColumnId != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnFilter.serializedColumnId.Key))
				{
					dictionary[columnFilter.serializedColumnId.Key] = columnFilter;
					continue;
				}
				UltraGridColumn column = columnFilter.Column;
				if (column != null)
				{
					dictionary[column.Key] = columnFilter;
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Count; j++)
			{
				ColumnFilter columnFilter2 = this[j];
				if (columnFilter2.Column != null)
				{
					string key = columnFilter2.Column.Key;
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
					{
						columnFilter2.InitializeFrom(value);
						dictionary.Remove(key);
					}
				}
			}
			List<ColumnFilter> list = new List<ColumnFilter>(dictionary.Values);
			if (list.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < Count; k++)
				{
					ColumnFilter columnFilter3 = this[k];
					for (int l = 0; l < list.Count; l++)
					{
						ColumnFilter columnFilter4 = list[l];
						if (columnFilter4 != null && columnFilter3.CanInitializeFrom(columnFilter4))
						{
							columnFilter3.InitializeFrom(columnFilter4);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			logicalOperator = source.logicalOperator;
		}

		public void CopyFrom(ColumnFiltersCollection source)
		{
			InitializeFrom(source, PropertyCategories.All);
		}

		internal bool InternalShouldSerialize()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].ShouldSerialize())
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return ShouldSerializeLogicalOperator();
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeLogicalOperator()
		{
			return logicalOperator != FilterLogicalOperator.And;
		}

		public void ResetLogicalOperator()
		{
			LogicalOperator = FilterLogicalOperator.And;
		}
	}
