			internal RowFilterDropDownOwner(ColumnHeader columnHeader, ColumnFiltersCollection columnFilters, RowsCollection rows)
			{
				if (columnHeader == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_108"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_321"));
				}
				if (columnFilters == null)

			internal static bool ShowCustomFilterDialogHelper(ColumnFilter columnFilter, RowsCollection rows)
			{
				bool result = true;
				UltraGridColumn column = columnFilter.Column;
				UltraGridBase grid = column.Layout.Grid;
				CustomRowFiltersDialog customRowFiltersDialog = null;
				try
				{
					customRowFiltersDialog = new CustomRowFiltersDialog(grid);
					customRowFiltersDialog.InitializeDialog(column, columnFilter, rows);
					BeforeCustomRowFilterDialogEventArgs e = new BeforeCustomRowFilterDialogEventArgs(column, (rows != null && RowFilterMode.AllRowsInBand != rows.Band.RowFilterModeResolved) ? rows.TopLevelRowsCollection : null, customRowFiltersDialog);
					grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeCustomRowFilterDialog, e);
					if (!e.Cancel)
					{
						if (!((Control)(object)customRowFiltersDialog).Visible)
						{
							DialogResult dialogResult;
							if (grid is UltraGrid)
							{
								dialogResult = customRowFiltersDialog.InternalShowDialog();
							}
							else
							{
								try
								{
									DropDownManager.SuspendAutoCloseUp();
									dialogResult = customRowFiltersDialog.InternalShowDialog();
								}
								finally
								{
									DropDownManager.ResumeAutoCloseUp();
								}
							}
							if (DialogResult.OK != dialogResult)
							{
								result = false;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						result = false;
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((Component)(object)customRowFiltersDialog)?.Dispose();
					customRowFiltersDialog = null;
				}
				return result;
			}

			void IValueListOwner.OnSelectionChangeCommitted()
			{
				UltraGridBase grid = Grid;
				if (grid == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int selectedItemIndex = ((IValueList)grid.FilterDropDown).SelectedItemIndex;
				if (selectedItemIndex < 0 || selectedItemIndex >= ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)grid.FilterDropDown.ValueListItems).Count)
				{
					return;
				}
				ValueListItem val = grid.FilterDropDown.ValueListItems[selectedItemIndex];
				if (columnFilters != null)
				{
					string text = val.DisplayText;
					string text2 = val.DataValue as string;
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2) && (GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterAllText, text2) || GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterBlanks, text2) || GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterNonBlanks, text2) || GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterCustomText, text2)))
					{
						text = text2;
					}
					if (text == null)
					{
						text = "";
					}
					ColumnFilter origColumnFilter = columnFilters[ColumnHeader.Column];
					ProcessColumnFilterSelection(origColumnFilter, rows, text, (val is FilterValueListItem) ? UltraGridBase.StaticFilterDataObject : val.DataValue);
				}
				if (grid != null)
				{
					IValueList filterDropDown = (IValueList)(object)grid.FilterDropDown;
					if (filterDropDown != null && !filterDropDown.IsDroppedDown)
					{
						((IValueListOwner)this).OnCloseUp();
					}
				}
				if (ColumnHeader != null)
				{
					ColumnHeader.InvalidateItem();
				}
			}

			internal static void ProcessColumnFilterSelection(ColumnFilter origColumnFilter, RowsCollection rows, string text, object dataValue)
			{
				ColumnFilter columnFilter = origColumnFilter.Clone();
				bool flag = true;
				if (dataValue is FilterCondition)
				{
					columnFilter.ClearFilterConditions();
					columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add((FilterCondition)dataValue);
				}
				else if (dataValue is ColumnFilter)
				{
					columnFilter.InitializeFrom((ColumnFilter)dataValue);
				}
				else if (dataValue == UltraGridBase.StaticFilterDataObject)
				{
					if (GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterAllText, text))
					{
						columnFilter.ClearFilterConditions();
					}
					else if (GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterBlanks, text))
					{
						columnFilter.ClearFilterConditions();
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(FilterComparisionOperator.Equals, DBNull.Value);
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(FilterComparisionOperator.Equals, null);
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(FilterComparisionOperator.Equals, "");
						columnFilter.LogicalOperator = FilterLogicalOperator.Or;
					}
					else if (GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterNonBlanks, text))
					{
						columnFilter.ClearFilterConditions();
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals, DBNull.Value);
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals, null);
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals, "");
						columnFilter.LogicalOperator = FilterLogicalOperator.And;
					}
					else if (GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterCustomText, text))
					{
						flag = ShowCustomFilterDialogHelper(columnFilter, rows);
					}
					else if (string.Compare(text, UltraGridBand.FilterErrors, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
					{
						columnFilter.ClearFilterConditions();
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(new DataErrorFilterCondition(shouldMatchError: true));
						columnFilter.LogicalOperator = FilterLogicalOperator.Or;
					}
					else if (string.Compare(text, UltraGridBand.FilterNonErrors, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
					{
						columnFilter.ClearFilterConditions();
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(new DataErrorFilterCondition(shouldMatchError: false));
						columnFilter.LogicalOperator = FilterLogicalOperator.Or;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					columnFilter.ClearFilterConditions();
					columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(FilterComparisionOperator.Equals, dataValue);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					UltraGridBand band = origColumnFilter.Column.Band;
					if (!band.IsRootBand && band.RowFilterModeResolved == RowFilterMode.AllRowsInBand)
					{
						UltraGridFilterRow.ApplyNewFiltersHelper(origColumnFilter, columnFilter, rows?.FilterRow, null);
					}
					else
					{
						UltraGridFilterRow.ApplyNewFiltersHelper(origColumnFilter, columnFilter, rows?.FilterRow, rows);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public class ColumnHeaderAccessibleObject : HeaderAccessibleObjectBase
		{

					return null;

			private bool IsSortingAllowed
			{
				get
				{
					if (!Column.Header.Hidden && !Column.Header.IsDisabled && Column.Header.SortIndicator != SortIndicator.Disabled && (Column.Band.HeaderClickActionResolved == HeaderClickAction.SortSingle || Column.Band.HeaderClickActionResolved == HeaderClickAction.SortMulti))
					{
						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

				: base(columnHeader, parent)

			}

					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetMarshallingControl().Invalidate();
				}
			}

				return null;

				return null;

				return null;

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					return null;
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					return null;
				default:
				{
					NavigateType navigateType = NavigateType.Topmost;
					switch (navdir)
					{
					case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
					{
						int num4 = base.ParentInternal.Headers.IndexOf(base.Header);
						if (num4 < 0 || 1 + num4 >= base.ParentInternal.Headers.Count)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(base.ParentInternal.Headers[1 + num4]);
					}
					case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					{
						int num5 = base.ParentInternal.Headers.IndexOf(base.Header);
						if (num5 <= 0)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(base.ParentInternal.Headers[num5 - 1]);
					}
					case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					{
						HeaderBase headerBase = null;
						if (base.Header.Band.GroupsDisplayed && base.Header.Band.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout && Column.Group != null)
						{
							UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = Column.Group;
							int num = 0;
							int relativeOrigin = Column.RelativeOrigin;
							int val = relativeOrigin + Column.Group.OverallWidth;
							for (int j = 0; j < ultraGridGroup.Columns.Count; j++)
							{
								UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = ultraGridGroup.Columns[j];
								if ((AccessibleNavigation.Up == navdir && ultraGridColumn2.Level < Column.Level) || (AccessibleNavigation.Down == navdir && ultraGridColumn2.Level > Column.Level))
								{
									int relativeOrigin2 = ultraGridColumn2.RelativeOrigin;
									int val2 = relativeOrigin2 + ultraGridColumn2.Group.OverallWidth;
									int num2 = Math.Min(val2, val) - Math.Max(relativeOrigin2, relativeOrigin);
									if (num2 > num)
									{
										num = num2;
										headerBase = ultraGridColumn2.Header;
									}
								}
							}
							if (headerBase != null)
							{
								return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(headerBase);
							}
							if (AccessibleNavigation.Up == navdir && !Column.Group.Header.Hidden)
							{
								return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(Column.Group.Header);
							}
							return null;
						}
						if (Column.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
						{
							HeadersCollection layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical = Column.Band.LayoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical;
							int num3 = layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical?.IndexOf(Column.Header) ?? (-1);
							if (AccessibleNavigation.Up == navdir && num3 > 0)
							{
								headerBase = layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical[num3 - 1];
							}
							if (AccessibleNavigation.Down == navdir && num3 >= 0 && 1 + num3 < layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical.Count)
							{
								headerBase = layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical[1 + num3];
							}
							if (headerBase != null)
							{
								RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = Column.RowLayoutColumnInfo;
								RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo2 = headerBase.Column.RowLayoutColumnInfo;
								if (Math.Min(rowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginXResolved + rowLayoutColumnInfo.SpanXResolved, rowLayoutColumnInfo2.OriginXResolved + rowLayoutColumnInfo2.SpanXResolved) - Math.Max(rowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginXResolved, rowLayoutColumnInfo2.OriginXResolved) <= 0)
								{
									headerBase = null;
								}
							}
						}
						if (headerBase == null && AccessibleNavigation.Up == navdir && !Column.Band.Header.Hidden)
						{
							headerBase = Column.Band.Header;
						}
						if (headerBase == null)
						{
							return null;
						}
						return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(headerBase);
					}
					case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
						if (base.Header.Band.GroupsDisplayed && base.Header.Band.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout && Column.Group != null && Column.LastItemInLevel)
						{
							UltraGridGroup relatedVisibleGroup2 = Column.Group.GetRelatedVisibleGroup(VisibleRelation.Next);
							if (relatedVisibleGroup2 != null)
							{
								for (int k = 0; k < relatedVisibleGroup2.Columns.Count; k++)
								{
									UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn3 = relatedVisibleGroup2.Columns[k];
									if (!ultraGridColumn3.Header.Hidden && ultraGridColumn3.Level == Column.Level)
									{
										return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(ultraGridColumn3.Header);
									}
								}
							}
							return null;
						}
						navigateType = NavigateType.Next;
						break;
					case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
						if (base.Header.Band.GroupsDisplayed && base.Header.Band.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout && Column.Group != null && Column.FirstItemInLevel)
						{
							UltraGridGroup relatedVisibleGroup = Column.Group.GetRelatedVisibleGroup(VisibleRelation.Previous);
							if (relatedVisibleGroup != null)
							{
								for (int i = 0; i < relatedVisibleGroup.Columns.Count; i++)
								{
									UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = relatedVisibleGroup.Columns[i];
									if (!ultraGridColumn.Header.Hidden && ultraGridColumn.LastItemInLevel && ultraGridColumn.Level == Column.Level)
									{
										return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(ultraGridColumn.Header);
									}
								}
							}
							return null;
						}
						navigateType = NavigateType.Prev;
						break;
					}
					AccessibleObject accessibleObject = null;
					if (navigateType != NavigateType.Topmost)
					{
						UltraGridColumn relatedVisibleCol = Column.Band.GetRelatedVisibleCol(Column, navigateType, includeNonActivateable: true);
						if (relatedVisibleCol == Column)
						{
							accessibleObject = null;
						}
						accessibleObject = base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(relatedVisibleCol.Header);
						if (accessibleObject != null && !((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Bounds.IsEmpty && !accessibleObject.Bounds.IsEmpty)
						{
							if (navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Left && accessibleObject.Bounds.Right > ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Bounds.Left)
							{
								accessibleObject = null;
							}
							else if (navdir == AccessibleNavigation.Right && accessibleObject.Bounds.Left < ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Bounds.Right)
							{
								accessibleObject = null;
							}
						}
					}
					return accessibleObject;
				}
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool Draggable
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0028: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				//IL_00a0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00a5: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = base.Column;
				if (Band == null || ultraGridColumn == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					if (1 != (int)Band.AllowRowLayoutColMovingResolved)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				else if (AllowColMoving.NotAllowed != Band.AllowColMovingResolved)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (Band.Layout == null || Band.Layout.Grid == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Band.Layout.Grid.DesignMode)
				{
					return true;
				}
				UIElement val = ultraGridColumn.Layout.UIElementInternal;
				if (val != null)
				{
					val = val.GetDescendant(typeof(GroupByBoxUIElement));
				}
				if (val != null && 1 == (int)ultraGridColumn.AllowGroupByResolved)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

				if (actualColDisplayLevels > 1)
				{
					int num2 = num / actualColDisplayLevels;
					num = ((base.Column.LevelResolved < actualColDisplayLevels - 1) ? num2 : (num - num2 * (actualColDisplayLevels - 1)));
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public int VisiblePositionWithinBand
		{
			get
			{
				int num = -1;
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = base.Column;
				if (Band.GroupsDisplayed && Band.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout)
				{
					if (ultraGridColumn.Group != null)
					{
						num = ultraGridColumn.Group.Columns.IndexOf(ultraGridColumn);
						for (int i = 0; i < Band.OrderedGroupHeaders.Count; i++)
						{
							UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = Band.OrderedGroupHeaders[i].Group;
							if (ultraGridGroup == ultraGridColumn.Group)
							{
								break;
							}
							num += ultraGridGroup.Columns.Count;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num = Band.OrderedColumnHeaders.IndexOf(ultraGridColumn.Header);
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public HeaderCheckBoxAlignment CheckBoxAlignmentResolved
		{
			get
			{
				HeaderCheckBoxAlignment headerCheckBoxAlignment = HeaderCheckBoxAlignment.Default;
				if (ShouldSerializeCheckBoxAlignment())
				{
					if (checkBoxAlignment == HeaderCheckBoxAlignment.Center && base.Caption.Length > 0)
					{
						return DefaultHeaderCheckBoxAlignmentBasedOnTextOrientationResolved;
					}
					return checkBoxAlignment;
				}
				if (Band != null)
				{
					headerCheckBoxAlignment = Band.HeaderCheckBoxAlignmentResolved;
					if (headerCheckBoxAlignment == HeaderCheckBoxAlignment.Default)
					{
						headerCheckBoxAlignment = DefaultHeaderCheckBoxAlignmentBasedOnTextOrientationResolved;
					}
					if (headerCheckBoxAlignment == HeaderCheckBoxAlignment.Center && base.Caption.Length > 0)
					{
						headerCheckBoxAlignment = DefaultHeaderCheckBoxAlignmentBasedOnTextOrientationResolved;
					}
					return headerCheckBoxAlignment;
				}
				return DefaultHeaderCheckBoxAlignmentBasedOnTextOrientationResolved;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization CheckBoxSynchronizationResolved
		{
			get
			{
				HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization headerCheckBoxSynchronization = HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.Default;
				if (!IsHeaderCheckBoxVisible)
				{
					headerCheckBoxSynchronization = HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.None;
				}
				else if (ShouldSerializeCheckBoxSynchronization())
				{
					headerCheckBoxSynchronization = checkBoxSynchronization;
				}
				else if (Band != null)
				{
					headerCheckBoxSynchronization = Band.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved;
				}
				if (headerCheckBoxSynchronization == HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.Default)
				{
					headerCheckBoxSynchronization = ((column == null || !(column.Editor is CheckEditor)) ? HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.None : HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.RowsCollection);
				}
				if (headerCheckBoxSynchronization == HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.RowsCollection && Band.HeaderPlacementResolved == HeaderPlacement.FixedOnTop)
				{
					headerCheckBoxSynchronization = HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.Band;
				}
				return headerCheckBoxSynchronization;
			}
		}

		private HeaderCheckBoxAlignment DefaultHeaderCheckBoxAlignmentBasedOnTextOrientationResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (base.Caption.Length == 0)
				{
					return HeaderCheckBoxAlignment.Center;
				}
				if (base.TextOrientationResolved == null || (int)base.TextOrientationResolved.FlowDirection == 0)
				{
					return HeaderCheckBoxAlignment.Left;
				}
				return HeaderCheckBoxAlignment.Top;
			}
		}

		internal ColumnHeader(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			this.column = column;
			visiblePos = -1;
			if (this.column != null)
			{
				this.column.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		private ColumnHeader(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			visiblePos = -1;
			DeserializeHelper(info, context);
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "CheckBoxVisibility":
					checkBoxVisibility = (HeaderCheckBoxVisibility)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(HeaderCheckBoxVisibility), checkBoxVisibility);
					break;
				case "CheckBoxAlignment":
					checkBoxAlignment = (HeaderCheckBoxAlignment)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(HeaderCheckBoxAlignment), checkBoxAlignment);
					break;
				case "CheckBoxSynchronization":
					checkBoxSynchronization = (HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization), checkBoxSynchronization);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal override void AdjustForCellLevel(ref Rectangle rect, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			int bottom = rect.Bottom;
			int displayLevel = column.GetDisplayLevel();
			int levelOffset = row.GetLevelOffset(displayLevel, fromInsideTopBorder: true);
			rect.Y += levelOffset;
			rect.Height -= levelOffset;
			levelOffset = Math.Min(bottom, rect.Top + row.GetLevelHeight(displayLevel));
			rect.Height = levelOffset - rect.Top;
		}

		internal override bool AdjustForCellPicture(ref Rectangle rect, ref Rectangle pictureRect, ref AppearanceData resolvedCellAppearance)
		{
			//IL_0111: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0123: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0173: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0178: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_017a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_017d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018f: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			pictureRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			bool result = false;
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref resolvedCellAppearance)).Image == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref resolvedCellAppearance)).GetImage(Band.Layout.Grid.ImageList);
			Size size = new Size(0, 0);
			size = image?.Size ?? Band.Layout.SizeOfImages;
			if (size.Width < 1 || size.Height < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rect.Height > 2 && size.Height > rect.Height - 2)
			{
				result = true;
				size.Width = (int)((double)size.Width * ((double)(rect.Height - 2) / (double)size.Height));
				size.Height = rect.Height - 2;
			}
			if (rect.Width > 2 && size.Width > rect.Width - 2)
			{
				size.Width = rect.Width - 2;
			}
			pictureRect = rect;
			pictureRect.Width = size.Width;
			pictureRect.Height = size.Height;
			DrawUtility.AdjustHAlign(((AppearanceData)(ref resolvedCellAppearance)).ImageHAlign, ref pictureRect, rect);
			DrawUtility.AdjustVAlign(((AppearanceData)(ref resolvedCellAppearance)).ImageVAlign, ref pictureRect, rect);
			if (pictureRect.Top == rect.Top)
			{
				pictureRect.Y++;
			}
			else if (pictureRect.Bottom == rect.Bottom)
			{
				pictureRect.Y--;
			}
			HAlign imageHAlign = ((AppearanceData)(ref resolvedCellAppearance)).ImageHAlign;
			switch (imageHAlign - 1)
			{
			case 2:
				pictureRect.X--;
				rect.Width -= pictureRect.Width + 1;
				break;
			default:
				pictureRect.X++;
				rect.Width -= pictureRect.Width + 1;
				rect.X += pictureRect.Width + 1;
				break;
			case 1:
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool AreFiltersActive(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			RowFilterMode rowFilterModeResolved = Band.RowFilterModeResolved;
			return GetColumnFilter(rows)?.HasFilterConditions ?? false;
		}

		internal ColumnFilter GetColumnFilter(RowsCollection rows, bool allocateIfNecessary)
		{
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = base.Column;
			UltraGridBand band = Band;
			if (ultraGridColumn == null || band == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (rows != null && rows.Band != band)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColumnFilter result = null;
			if (rows == null || RowFilterMode.AllRowsInBand == band.RowFilterModeResolved)
			{
				if ((band.HasColumnFilters && band.ColumnFilters.HasColumnFilter(ultraGridColumn)) || allocateIfNecessary)
				{
					result = band.ColumnFilters[ultraGridColumn];
				}
			}
			else if (rows.HasColumnFilters || allocateIfNecessary)
			{
				result = rows.ColumnFilters[ultraGridColumn];
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal ColumnFilter GetColumnFilter(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			return GetColumnFilter(rows, allocateIfNecessary: false);
		}

		internal override void OnClickFilterDropDown(HeaderUIElement headerElem, bool shiftKeyDown)
		{
			if (headerElem == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridBase grid = Band.Layout.Grid;
			if (Band == null || grid == null || grid.DesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColumnFiltersCollection columnFiltersCollection = null;
			RowsCollection rowsCollection = null;
			if (RowFilterMode.AllRowsInBand == Band.RowFilterModeResolved)
			{
				columnFiltersCollection = Band.ColumnFilters;
				if (Band.IsRootBand)
				{
					rowsCollection = Band.Layout.Rows;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (RowFilterMode.SiblingRowsOnly != Band.RowFilterModeResolved)
				{
					return;
				}
				rowsCollection = ((RowsCollection)((UIElement)headerElem).GetContext(typeof(RowsCollection), true)).TopLevelRowsCollection;
				if (rowsCollection == null)
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (UltraGridRow)((UIElement)headerElem).GetContext(typeof(UltraGridRow), true);
					if (ultraGridRow != null)
					{
						rowsCollection = ultraGridRow.ParentCollection;
					}
				}
				if (rowsCollection == null && Band != null && Band.Index == 0)
				{
					rowsCollection = Band.Layout.Rows;
				}
				if (rowsCollection == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				columnFiltersCollection = rowsCollection.ColumnFilters;
			}
			ValueList filterDropDown = grid.FilterDropDown;
			IFilterUIProvider filterUIProvider = ((Band != null) ? Band.FilterUIProviderResolved : null);
			if (filterUIProvider == null)
			{
				((IValueList)filterDropDown).Activate((IValueListOwner)(object)new RowFilterDropDownOwner(this, columnFiltersCollection, rowsCollection));
			}
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.WaitCursor;
			try
			{
				bool flag = filterUIProvider != null;
				bool flag2 = shiftKeyDown;
				if (!flag2 && flag)
				{
					flag2 = !(filterUIProvider is IFilterUIProviderEx filterUIProviderEx) || filterUIProviderEx.OperandListFilterBehaviorResolved == OperandListFilterBehavior.ShowAllItems;
				}
				Band.LoadFilterValueList(filterDropDown, headerElem, flag2, flag ? FilterValueListOptions.FilterUIProvider : FilterValueListOptions.None);
				BeforeRowFilterDropDownEventArgs e = new BeforeRowFilterDropDownEventArgs(column, rowsCollection, filterDropDown);
				grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeRowFilterDropDown, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (filterUIProvider != null)
				{
					if (((UIElement)headerElem).GetDescendant(typeof(FilterDropDownButtonUIElement)) is FilterDropDownButtonUIElement filterDropDownButtonUIElement)
					{
						filterUIProvider.Show(columnFiltersCollection[column], rowsCollection, Band.Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)filterDropDownButtonUIElement).DrawingRect), filterDropDown);
					}
				}
				else
				{

		internal override bool IsValidDropArea(DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo, Point point)
		{
			UltraGridLayout layout = base.Column.Layout;
			ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegions = layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false);
			if (colScrollRegions != null)
			{
				ColScrollRegion exclusiveColScrollRegionResolved = base.ExclusiveColScrollRegionResolved;
				ColScrollRegion regionFromOrigin = colScrollRegions.GetRegionFromOrigin(point.X);
				if (regionFromOrigin == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (exclusiveColScrollRegionResolved != null)
				{
					if (!regionFromOrigin.IsExclusive || regionFromOrigin.SafeOrigin != exclusiveColScrollRegionResolved.SafeOrigin)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (regionFromOrigin.IsExclusive && !Band.CardView && !Band.Layout.AutoFitAllColumns)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			AllowColMoving allowColMovingResolved = Band.AllowColMovingResolved;
			bool flag = false;
			if (dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetColumn)
			{
				ColumnHeader columnHeader = dropLocationInfo.ColumnHeader;
				if (columnHeader != null)
				{
					UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = columnHeader.Group;
					bool flag2 = false;
					UltraGridBase grid = layout.Grid;
					if (grid != null)
					{
						flag2 = grid.DesignMode && allowColMovingResolved == AllowColMoving.NotAllowed;
					}
					if ((allowColMovingResolved == AllowColMoving.WithinGroup || flag2) && ultraGridGroup != null)
					{
						flag = ((ultraGridGroup == Group) ? true : false);
					}
					else if (((uint)(allowColMovingResolved switch
					{
						AllowColMoving.WithinGroup => (ultraGridGroup == null) ? 1 : 0, 
						AllowColMoving.WithinBand => 1, 
						_ => 0, 
					}) | (flag2 ? 1u : 0u)) != 0)
					{
						UltraGridBand band = dropLocationInfo.GridItem.Band;
						UltraGridBand band2 = Band;
						flag = band == band2;
						if (FixedHeaderIndicator.None == base.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved)
						{
							flag = flag && columnHeader != null && base.FixedResolved == columnHeader.FixedResolved;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else if (dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetGroup || dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetEmptyLevel)
			{
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup2 = dropLocationInfo.GroupHeader.Group;
				if (ultraGridGroup2 != null && ultraGridGroup2.Band != Band)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (allowColMovingResolved == AllowColMoving.WithinGroup && ultraGridGroup2 != null)
				{
					flag = ultraGridGroup2 == Group;
				}
				else if (allowColMovingResolved == AllowColMoving.WithinBand)
				{
					flag = true;
					if (FixedHeaderIndicator.None == base.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved)
					{
						flag = flag && ultraGridGroup2 != null && ultraGridGroup2.Header != null && base.FixedResolved == ultraGridGroup2.Header.FixedResolved;
					}
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal bool StartDragNoSelection(bool isGroupByButton)
		{
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = base.Column;
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = ultraGridColumn.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			UltraGridBand band = Band;
			if (ultraGrid == null || IsDisabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				ultraGrid.StartGridBagLayoutDrag(ultraGridColumn, isGroupByButton);
				if (band.Layout.GroupByBox.HiddenResolved)
				{
					ultraGrid.ColumnChooser_OnDragStart();
					return true;
				}
			}
			DragStrategyColumn dragStrategyColumn = new DragStrategyColumn(band, ultraGrid, isGroupByButton);
			if (dragStrategyColumn.BeginDrag(this))
			{
				DragEffect dragEffect = ultraGrid.DragEffect;
				if (dragEffect != null)
				{
					dragEffect.Setup(dragStrategyColumn);
					dragEffect.Display();
					ultraGrid.ColumnChooser_OnDragStart();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool StartDrag()
		{
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = base.Column;
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = ultraGridColumn.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			UltraGridBand band = Band;
			if (ultraGrid == null || IsDisabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Selected selected = ultraGrid.Selected;
			if (selected == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = Band != null && Band.SelectTypeColResolved != SelectType.None;
			if (Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					if (Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
					{
						if (selected.Columns.Count != 1)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					else if (selected.Cells.Count != 1)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				ultraGrid.StartGridBagLayoutDrag(ultraGridColumn, isGroupByButton: false);
				if (band.Layout.GroupByBox.HiddenResolved)
				{
					ultraGrid.ColumnChooser_OnDragStart();
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
				{
					if (selected.Columns == null || selected.Columns.Count == 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (selected.Cells == null || selected.Cells.Count == 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			DragStrategyColumn dragStrategyColumn = new DragStrategyColumn(band, ultraGrid);
			if (dragStrategyColumn.BeginDrag(this))
			{
				DragEffect dragEffect = ultraGrid.DragEffect;
				if (dragEffect != null)
				{
					dragEffect.Setup(dragStrategyColumn);
					dragEffect.Display();
					ultraGrid.ColumnChooser_OnDragStart();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void CalcSelectionRange(Selected newSelection, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select, Selected initialSelection)
		{
			GridItemBase pivotItem = Band.Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion.GetPivotItem();
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = base.Column;
			ColumnHeader columnHeader = pivotItem as ColumnHeader;
			if (pivotItem is GroupHeader)
			{
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = ((GroupHeader)pivotItem).Group;
				UltraGridGroup groupResolved = ultraGridColumn.GroupResolved;
				if (groupResolved != null && ultraGridGroup != groupResolved)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = ((ultraGridGroup.Header.VisiblePosition <= groupResolved.Header.VisiblePosition) ? ultraGridGroup.FirstSelectableColumn : ultraGridGroup.LastSelectableColumn);
					if (ultraGridColumn2 != null)
					{
						columnHeader = ultraGridColumn2.Header;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					UltraGridColumn firstSelectableColumn = ultraGridGroup.FirstSelectableColumn;
					if (firstSelectableColumn != null)
					{
						columnHeader = firstSelectableColumn.Header;
					}
				}
			}
			if (columnHeader == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				if (!clearExistingSelection)
				{
					Selected selected = ((Band.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid { HasSelectedBeenAllocated: not false } ultraGrid) ? ultraGrid.Selected : null);
					if (selected != null)
					{
						foreach (UltraGridRow row in selected.Rows)
						{
							newSelection.Rows.InternalAdd(row);
						}
						foreach (UltraGridCell cell in selected.Cells)
						{
							newSelection.Cells.InternalAdd(cell);
						}
					}
					foreach (ColumnHeader column in initialSelection.Columns)
					{
						newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(column);
					}
				}
				if (columnHeader == this)
				{
					if (!newSelection.Columns.Contains(this))
					{
						newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(this);
					}
					return;
				}
				UltraGridBand band = Band;
				ColumnHeader columnHeader2 = columnHeader;
				HeadersCollection layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders = band.LayoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders;
				if (layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders == null || !layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders.Contains(columnHeader2) || !layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders.Contains(this))
				{
					return;
				}
				Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Union(columnHeader2.Column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.CachedHeaderRect, Column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.CachedHeaderRect);
				for (int i = 0; i < layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders.Count; i++)
				{
					ColumnHeader columnHeader3 = (ColumnHeader)layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders[i];
					Rectangle cachedItemRectHeader = columnHeader3.Column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.CachedItemRectHeader;
					cachedItemRectHeader.Inflate(-1, -1);
					if (!columnHeader3.IsDisabled && rectangle.IntersectsWith(cachedItemRectHeader) && !newSelection.Columns.Contains(columnHeader3))
					{
						newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(columnHeader3);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			HeadersCollection headersForSelection = GetHeadersForSelection(select, columnHeader);
			for (int j = 0; j < headersForSelection.Count; j++)
			{
				newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd((ColumnHeader)headersForSelection[j]);
			}
			headersForSelection = null;
			if (clearExistingSelection)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = ultraGridColumn.InternalGetVisiblePosition();
			int visiblePosition = columnHeader.VisiblePosition;
			foreach (ColumnHeader column2 in initialSelection.Columns)
			{
				int visiblePosition2 = column2.VisiblePosition;
				if (num > visiblePosition)
				{
					if (visiblePosition2 < visiblePosition || visiblePosition2 > num)
					{
						newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(column2);
					}
				}
				else if (visiblePosition2 < num || visiblePosition2 > visiblePosition)
				{
					newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(column2);
				}
			}
			if (!(Band.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid2))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridRow row2 in ultraGrid2.Selected.Rows)
			{
				newSelection.Rows.InternalAdd(row2);
			}
			foreach (UltraGridCell cell2 in ultraGrid2.Selected.Cells)
			{
				newSelection.Cells.InternalAdd(cell2);
			}
		}

		internal override void InternalSelect(bool value)
		{
			if (selectedValue == value)
			{
				return;
			}
			selectedValue = value;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = base.Column;
			UltraGridGroup groupResolved = ultraGridColumn.GroupResolved;
			if (groupResolved != null)
			{
				if (!value)
				{
					groupResolved.Header.SetSelectedFlag(value);
				}
				else
				{
					bool flag = true;
					foreach (UltraGridColumn item in groupResolved.ColumnsResolved)
					{
						if (!item.Header.Selected)
						{
							flag = false;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						groupResolved.Header.SetSelectedFlag(value);
					}
				}
			}
			ultraGridColumn.NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Selected, null);
			ultraGridColumn.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
		}

		public void SetVisiblePosition(int visiblePosition, bool raiseColPosChangedNotifications)
		{
			if (column == null || column.Band == null)
			{
				visiblePos = visiblePosition;
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (raiseColPosChangedNotifications)
			{
				UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ((base.Layout != null) ? base.Layout.Grid : null);
				int num = column.InternalGetVisiblePosition();
				if (num != visiblePosition && ultraGridBase != null)
				{
					BeforeColPosChangedEventArgs e = new BeforeColPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.Moved, new ColumnHeader[1] { this }, PosChangedType.Moved);
					ultraGridBase.FireBeforeColPosChanged(e);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			column.InternalSetVisiblePosition(visiblePosition);
			base.VisiblePosition = column.InternalGetVisiblePosition();
			if (flag)
			{
				AfterColPosChangedEventArgs e2 = new AfterColPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.Moved, new ColumnHeader[1] { this }, PosChangedType.Moved);
				((base.Layout != null) ? base.Layout.Grid : null)?.FireAfterColPosChanged(e2);
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldSerializeVisiblePosition()
		{
			if (column != null && (column.Group != null || column.GroupId != 0))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int defaultVisiblePosition = DefaultVisiblePosition;
			if (defaultVisiblePosition < 0)
			{
				return base.SerializedVisiblePosition >= 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeCheckBoxAlignment() && !ShouldSerializeCheckBoxSynchronization())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeCheckBoxVisibility();
			}
			return true;
		}

			ResetCheckBoxVisibility();
		}

		internal List<HeaderUIElement> GetHeaderUIElements(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			List<HeaderUIElement> list = new List<HeaderUIElement>();
			if (base.Layout == null || base.Layout.UIElementInternal == null || column == null)
			{
				return list;
			}
			if (!(base.Layout.UIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(DataAreaUIElement)) is DataAreaUIElement dataAreaUIElement))
			{
				return list;
			}

					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!(current is RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement))

							{

											}

											{

												{
													UIElement current4 = enumerator4.Current;
													if (!(current4 is CardLabelAreaUIElement))
													{

													}
													UIElementEnumerator enumerator5 = current4.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();

													finally

															disposable.Dispose();

												}
											}
										}
									}
									finally
									{
										if (enumerator6 is IDisposable disposable5)

										}
									}
								}
							}
							else
							{
								if (!(current2 is BandHeadersUIElement bandHeadersUIElement) || (rows != null && ((UIElement)bandHeadersUIElement).GetContext(typeof(RowsCollection)) != rows))
								{
									continue;
								}

									}
								}
								finally
								{
									if (enumerator8 is IDisposable disposable6)

								}
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						if (enumerator2 is IDisposable disposable7)

			}
			finally

		}

		public ColumnsCollection(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			this.band = band;
			listInternal = List;

		protected ColumnsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			listInternal = List;
			band = null;
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(UltraGridColumn))
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = (UltraGridColumn)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraGridColumn), null);
					if (ultraGridColumn != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(ultraGridColumn);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			ColumnEnumerator columnEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (columnEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraGridColumn current = columnEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					current.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = columnEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
		}

		internal bool AreThereAnyOtherVisibleColumns(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = this[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn != column && !ultraGridColumn.HiddenResolved)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Columns, propChange);
		}

		public UltraGridColumn Add()
		{
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = new UltraGridColumn(band);
			ultraGridColumn.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalAdd(ultraGridColumn);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Add);
			return ultraGridColumn;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int Add(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_113"));
			}
			if (!(obj is UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_316", obj.GetType().Name));
			}
			if (ultraGridColumn.Band != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_115"));
			}
			return InternalAdd(ultraGridColumn);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddRange(object[] columns)
		{
			if (columns == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			foreach (object obj in columns)
			{
				Add(obj);
			}
		}

		public UltraGridColumn Add(string key)
		{
			return Add(key, null);
		}

		public UltraGridColumn Insert(int index, string key)
		{
			ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(key);
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
			ultraGridColumn = ((key != null) ? new UltraGridColumn(band, key) : new UltraGridColumn(band));
			InternalInsert(index, ultraGridColumn);
			return ultraGridColumn;
		}

		public UltraGridColumn Add(string key, string caption)
		{
			ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(key);
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = new UltraGridColumn(band, key);
			ultraGridColumn.Header.Caption = caption;
			InternalAdd(ultraGridColumn);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Add);
			return ultraGridColumn;
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			column.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			BumpColumnsVersion();
			int result = InternalAdd((IKeyedSubObject)column);
			AddRemoveColumnFromCalcManager(column, add: true);
			return result;
		}

		internal void InternalInsert(int index, UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			InternalInsert(index, (IKeyedSubObject)column);
			BumpColumnsVersion();
			column.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Add);
			AddRemoveColumnFromCalcManager(column, add: true);
		}

		public void Remove(int index)
		{
			Remove(this[index]);
		}

		public void Remove(string key)
		{
			Remove(this[key]);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index > Count || index < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_116"));
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = this[index];
			if (ultraGridColumn.IsBound)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_117"));
			}
			InternalRemoveAt(index);
			BumpColumnsVersion();
			if (ultraGridColumn != null)
			{
				ultraGridColumn.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Remove);
				AddRemoveColumnFromCalcManager(ultraGridColumn, add: false);
			}
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			ColumnEnumerator columnEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (columnEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraGridColumn current = columnEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					AddRemoveColumnFromCalcManager(current, add: false);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = columnEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			BumpColumnsVersion();
		}

		internal void BumpColumnsVersion()
		{
			if (Band != null)
			{
				Band.BumpColumnsVersion();
			}
		}

		public void ClearUnbound()
		{
			if (Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			for (int num = Count - 1; num > -1; num--)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = this[num];
				if (!ultraGridColumn.IsBound)
				{
					ultraGridColumn.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					Band.BumpColumnsVersion();
					InternalRemove(ultraGridColumn);
					flag = true;
					AddRemoveColumnFromCalcManager(ultraGridColumn, add: false);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ClearUnbound, null);
			}
		}

		public ColumnEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ColumnEnumerator(this);
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(ColumnsCollection source, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.Tag;
			}
			if (band.Layout.IsDisplayLayout || band.Layout.IsPrintLayout || band.Layout.IsExportLayout)
			{
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				for (int i = 0; i < source.Count; i++)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = source[i];
					for (int j = 0; j < Count; j++)
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = this[j];
						if (ultraGridColumn2.CanInitializeFrom(ultraGridColumn))
						{
							ultraGridColumn2.InitializeFrom(ultraGridColumn, categories);
							hashtable[ultraGridColumn2] = null;
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (!flag && !ultraGridColumn.IsBound)
					{
						CreateAndAppendColumn(ultraGridColumn, categories);
						if (Count > 0)
						{
							hashtable[this[Count - 1]] = null;
						}
					}
				}
				for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn3 = this[num];
					if (!hashtable.ContainsKey(ultraGridColumn3))
					{
						if (ultraGridColumn3.IsBound)
						{
							ultraGridColumn3.Reset();
							UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = ((Band != null) ? Band.Layout : null);
							if (ultraGridLayout != null && ultraGridLayout.IsApplyingLayout && NewColumnLoadStyle.Hide == ultraGridLayout.NewColumnLoadStyleInEffect)
							{
								ultraGridColumn3.Hidden = true;
							}
							if (ultraGridColumn3.IsHeaderAllocated)
							{
								ultraGridColumn3.Header.InternalResetVisiblePos();
							}
						}
						else
						{
							RemoveAt(num);
						}
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			Clear();
			if (source.Count >= 1)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < source.Count; k++)
				{
					CreateAndAppendColumn(source[k], categories);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CreateAndAppendColumn(UltraGridColumn source, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = new UltraGridColumn(band, source.Key);
			ultraGridColumn.InitializeFrom(source, categories);
			ultraGridColumn.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalAdd(ultraGridColumn);
		}

		internal void InternalRemoveColumn(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			InternalRemove(column);
			BumpColumnsVersion();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Remove);
			AddRemoveColumnFromCalcManager(column, add: false);
		}

		public void Remove(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_118"));
			}
			if (!(value is UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_339", value.GetType().Name));
			}
			if (ultraGridColumn.IsBound)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_117"));
			}
			ultraGridColumn.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemove(ultraGridColumn);
			BumpColumnsVersion();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Remove);
			AddRemoveColumnFromCalcManager(ultraGridColumn, add: false);
		}

		internal void InitBand(UltraGridBand band, bool calledFromEndInit)
		{
			this.band = band;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i].InitBand(this.band, calledFromEndInit);
			}
		}

		internal object Clone()
		{
			ColumnsCollection columnsCollection = new ColumnsCollection(band);
			columnsCollection.InitializeFrom(this, PropertyCategories.All);
			return columnsCollection;
		}

		internal void AddRemoveColumnFromCalcManager(UltraGridColumn column, bool add)
		{
			if (Band != null && this == Band.Columns)
			{
				if (add)
				{
					column.FormulaHolder.AddReferenceToCalcNetwork();
				}
				else
				{
					column.FormulaHolder.RemoveReferenceFromCalcNetwork();
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn FindColumn(PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = this[i];
				if (propertyDescriptor.Equals(ultraGridColumn.PropertyDescriptor))
				{
					return ultraGridColumn;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn GetFirstNonChapteredColumn()
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = this[i];
				if (!ultraGridColumn.IsChaptered)
				{
					return ultraGridColumn;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn FindMatchingColumn(PropertyDescriptor propDesc, bool tryMatchingByPropertyDescriptor)
		{
			string name = propDesc.Name;
			if (Exists(name))
			{
				return this[name];
			}
			if (tryMatchingByPropertyDescriptor)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = FindColumn(propDesc);
				if (ultraGridColumn != null)
				{
					OnListChanged();
				}
				return ultraGridColumn;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool TryGetItemInternal(string key, out UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			IKeyedSubObject item;
			bool result = base.TryGetItem(key, out item);
			column = (UltraGridColumn)item;
			return result;
		}

	internal class ComboBoxWithTouchMetrics : ComboBox
	{
		private bool areTouchMetricsEnabled;

		private int originalItemHeight;

		private DrawMode originalDrawmode;

		public bool AreTouchMetricsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return areTouchMetricsEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (areTouchMetricsEnabled != value)
				{
					areTouchMetricsEnabled = value;
					if (areTouchMetricsEnabled)
					{
						originalItemHeight = base.ItemHeight;
						originalDrawmode = base.DrawMode;
						base.ItemHeight = TouchUtilities.AdjustForTouchMode((Control)this, areTouchMetricsEnabled, base.ItemHeight, false, 0);
						base.DrawMode = DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed;
					}
					else
					{
						base.ItemHeight = originalItemHeight;
						base.DrawMode = originalDrawmode;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDrawItem(DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!areTouchMetricsEnabled)
			{
				base.OnDrawItem(e);
				return;
			}
			string itemText = GetItemText(e.Index);
			using (SolidBrush brush = new SolidBrush(e.BackColor))
			{
				e.Graphics.FillRectangle(brush, e.Bounds);
			}
			SizeF sizeF = DrawUtility.MeasureString(e.Graphics, itemText, e.Font);
			Point point = new Point(e.Bounds.X, e.Bounds.Location.Y + (int)((float)e.Bounds.Height - sizeF.Height) / 2);
			DrawUtility.DrawString(e.Graphics, itemText, e.Font, point, e.ForeColor);
		}

		public virtual string GetItemText(int index)
		{
			if (index == -1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			object obj = base.Items[index];
			if (obj is DataRowView dataRowView)
			{
				return dataRowView[base.DisplayMember].ToString();
			}
			return obj.ToString();
		}
	}

	internal static class GestureConsumer

		public static int ConvertItemsToScrollUnits(UIElement containerElement, Orientation orientation, int items)
		{
			if (containerElement == null)
			{
				return items;
			}
			int num = 4;
			return items / num;
		}

		public static int ConvertPixelsToScrollUnits(UltraGridLayout layout, UIElement containerElement, Orientation orientation, int pixels)
		{
			if (containerElement == null)
			{
				return pixels;
			}
			int num = 1;
			if (containerElement is CardAreaUIElement)
			{
				switch (orientation)
				{
				case Orientation.Horizontal:
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = containerElement.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridBand)) as UltraGridBand;
					int cardWidthResolved = ultraGridBand.CardWidthResolved;
					num = Math.Max(cardWidthResolved / 4, 1);
					return pixels / num;
				}
				case Orientation.Vertical:
					return pixels * 2;
				}
			}
			if (orientation == Orientation.Horizontal)
			{
				num = Math.Max(30, 1);
				return pixels / num;
			}
			int rowHeightResolved = layout.BandZero.RowHeightResolved;
			rowHeightResolved = Math.Max(rowHeightResolved, 1);
			return pixels / rowHeightResolved;
		}

		{

				return false;
			}

			SelectedRowsCollection rows = selected.Rows;
			if (!flag)

				selected.ClearAllSelected();

			else if (rows.Count > 0)

				}
			}
			return true;
		}

				result = ComboEventIds.RotateGesture;
				break;
			case 6:
				result = ComboEventIds.TwoFingerTapGesture;
				break;
			case 5:
				result = ComboEventIds.PressAndTapGesture;
				break;
			case 7:
				result = ComboEventIds.PressAndHoldGesture;
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static Enum ConvertGestureEventId(Enum value, Type destinationType)
		{
			if (!destinationType.IsEnum && Enum.IsDefined(destinationType, value))
			{
				string value2 = value.ToString();
				return (Enum)Enum.Parse(destinationType, value2);
			}
			return value;
		}

		{
			private UltraCombo control;

			internal UltraComboNativeWindow(UltraCombo control)
			{

				}

			private Message ForwardMessageToTextBox(Message msg)
			{
				EditorWithText internalEditor = (EditorWithText)(object)control.InternalEditor;
				TextBox textBox = (TextBox)(object)internalEditor.TextBox;
				msg.Result = NativeWindowMethods.SendMessageApi(textBox.Handle, msg.Msg, msg.WParam, msg.LParam);
				return msg;
			}

			private TextUIElement GetTextUIElement()
			{
				UIElement controlUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((UltraControlBase)control).ControlUIElement;
				EmbeddableUIElementBase val = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)((controlUIElement != null) ? /*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/: null);
				return (TextUIElement)((val != null) ? /*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/: null);
			}

			protected override void WndProc(ref Message msg)
			{
				if (Enum.IsDefined(typeof(NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages), msg.Msg))
				{
					NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages msg2 = (NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages)msg.Msg;
					if (control.IsInEditMode && msg2 != NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.WM_GETTEXT && msg2 != NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.WM_GETTEXTLENGTH)
					{
						msg = ForwardMessageToTextBox(msg);
						return;
					}
					switch (msg2)
					{
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.WM_CLEAR:
						control.SelectedText = null;
						return;
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_GETSEL:
					{
						int num5;
						int num6;
						if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)control.InternalEditor).SupportsSelectableText)
						{
							num5 = control.SelectionStart;
							num6 = num5 + control.SelectionLength;
						}
						else
						{
							num5 = 0;
							num6 = 0;
						}
						if (msg.WParam != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							Marshal.WriteInt32(msg.WParam, num5);
						}
						if (msg.LParam != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							Marshal.WriteInt32(msg.LParam, num6);
						}
						msg.Result = new IntPtr(num5 + (num6 << 16));
						return;
					}
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_SETSEL:
					{
						int num2 = 0;
						int num3 = 0;
						if (msg.WParam != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							num2 = (int)msg.WParam.ToInt64();
						}
						if (msg.LParam != IntPtr.Zero)
						{
							num3 = (int)msg.LParam.ToInt64();
						}
						if (num2 == 0 && num3 == -1)
						{
							control.SelectAll();
							return;
						}
						if (num2 == -1)
						{
							control.SelectionLength = 0;
							return;
						}
						if (num2 > num3)
						{
							int num4 = num2;
							num2 = num3;
							num3 = num4;
						}
						control.SelectionStart = num2;
						control.SelectionLength = num3 - num2;
						return;
					}
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_REPLACESEL:
					{
						EditorWithText internalEditor = (EditorWithText)(object)control.InternalEditor;
						if (((EmbeddableEditorBase)internalEditor).SupportsSelectableText)
						{
							IntPtr lParam = msg.LParam;
							string selectedText = Marshal.PtrToStringAuto(lParam);
							control.SelectedText = selectedText;
							return;
						}
						break;
					}
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_GETLINECOUNT:
					{
						TextUIElement textUIElement2 = GetTextUIElement();
						if (textUIElement2 != null)
						{
							msg.Result = new IntPtr(((TextUIElementBase)textUIElement2).GetLineCount());
							return;
						}
						break;
					}
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_LINEFROMCHAR:
					{
						TextUIElement textUIElement = GetTextUIElement();
						if (textUIElement != null)
						{
							int num7 = -1;
							if (msg.WParam != IntPtr.Zero)
							{
								num7 = (int)msg.WParam.ToInt64();
							}
							if (num7 == -1)
							{
								num7 = control.SelectionStart;
							}
							msg.Result = new IntPtr(((TextUIElementBase)textUIElement).GetLineNumber(num7));
							return;
						}
						break;
					}
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_LINEINDEX:
						msg.Result = IntPtr.Zero;
						break;
					case NativeWindowMethods.WindowMessages.EM_LINELENGTH:
					{
						int num = (int)msg.WParam.ToInt64();
						int length = ((Control)(object)control).Text.Length;
						if (num > length)
						{
							msg.Result = IntPtr.Zero;
						}
						else if (num == -1)
						{
							msg.Result = new IntPtr(length - control.SelectionLength);
						}
						else
						{
							msg.Result = new IntPtr(length);
						}
						return;
					}
					}
				}
				base.WndProc(ref msg);
			}

			private void control_HandleCreated(object sender, EventArgs e)
			{
				((Control)(object)control).HandleCreated -= control_HandleCreated;
				AssignHandle(((Control)(object)control).Handle);
			}

		private int IdealHeight
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_00ca: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00df: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Font font = ((Control)(object)this).Font;
				Font font2 = null;
				if (HasAppearance && Appearance.HasFontData)
				{
					font2 = Appearance.CreateFont(font);
					if (font2 != null)
					{
						font = font2;
					}
				}
				int val = 0;
				Image image = null;
				if (HasAppearance)
				{
					image = Appearance.GetImage(base.ImageList);
				}
				if (image != null)
				{
					val = image.Height + 2;
				}

				}

				height += ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val2)).Bottom + ((UIElementBorderWidths)(ref val2)).Top;
				font2?.Dispose();

				return Utilities.GetZoomedValue(height, (UltraControlBase)(object)this, false);
			}
		}

		CheckStyle ICheckedItemList.CheckBoxStyle
		{
			get

				if (ultraGridColumn != null)
				{
					ColumnStyle styleResolved = ultraGridColumn.GetStyleResolved(null);
					if (styleResolved == ColumnStyle.TriStateCheckBox)

		IList ICheckedItemList.Value
		{
			get
			{
				return CheckedRows.Values;
			}
			set
			{
				UltraGridBand bandZero = base.DisplayLayout.BandZero;
				string valueMemberResolved = base.ValueMemberResolved;
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ((bandZero != null && bandZero.Columns.Exists(valueMemberResolved)) ? bandZero.Columns[valueMemberResolved] : null);
				string checkStateMember = CheckedListSettings.CheckStateMember;
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = ((bandZero != null && bandZero.Columns.Exists(checkStateMember)) ? bandZero.Columns[checkStateMember] : null);
				if (ultraGridColumn2 == null || ultraGridColumn == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				CheckedRowsCollection checkedRowsCollection = CheckedRows;
				if (value == null)
				{
					value = new List<object>(0);
				}
				Dictionary<object, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, object>(value.Count);
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = value.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					object key = value[i];
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(key))
					{
						dictionary.Add(key, null);
					}
				}
				bool flag = value.Count != checkedRows.Count;
				foreach (UltraGridRow item in (IEnumerable<UltraGridRow>)checkedRows)
				{
					object cellValue = item.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn);
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(cellValue))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return;
				}
				List<UltraGridRow> list = new List<UltraGridRow>(checkedRows.Count);
				foreach (UltraGridRow item2 in (IEnumerable<UltraGridRow>)checkedRows)
				{
					object cellValue2 = item2.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn);
					if (!dictionary.ContainsKey(cellValue2))
					{
						list.Add(item2);
					}
				}
				RowsCollection rows = base.Rows;
				List<UltraGridRow> list2 = new List<UltraGridRow>(rows.Count);
				foreach (UltraGridRow item3 in rows)
				{
					object cellValue3 = item3.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn);
					if (!object.Equals(cellValue3, null) && dictionary.ContainsKey(cellValue3))
					{
						list2.Add(item3);
					}
					if (list2.Count == dictionary.Count)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				foreach (UltraGridRow item4 in list)
				{
					CheckedListSettings.SetCheckState(item4, ultraGridColumn2, CheckState.Unchecked, checkExistingValue: false, fireDataChanged: false);
				}
				foreach (UltraGridRow item5 in list2)
				{
					CheckedListSettings.SetCheckState(item5, ultraGridColumn2, CheckState.Checked, checkExistingValue: false, fireDataChanged: false);
				}
				base.Rows.RaiseDataChangedEvent(checkStateMember);
			}
		}

		internal void DropDownList()
		{

				Focus();
			}
			else if (!((EmbeddableEditorBase)InternalEditor).Focused && ((EmbeddableEditorBase)InternalEditor).CanFocus)

			}
		}

		public virtual bool PerformAction(UltraComboAction actionCode)

		public virtual bool PerformAction(UltraComboAction actionCode, bool shift, bool control)
		{

		}

		internal bool PerformAction(UltraComboAction actionCode, bool shift, bool control, bool checkIfActionIsAllowed)
		{
			bool flag = AutoCompleteInfo?.IsFilteredDropDownVisible ?? false;
			bool flag2 = base.SelectedRow != null;
			switch (actionCode)
			{
			case UltraComboAction.ToggleDropdown:
				ToggleDropdown();
				return true;
			case UltraComboAction.Dropdown:
				DropDownList();
				return true;
			case UltraComboAction.CloseDropdown:
				CloseUpList();
				return true;
			case UltraComboAction.CommitSelectionForSuggestMode:
				if (flag && flag2)
				{
					EditorWithCombo editorInEditMode = (EditorWithCombo)(object)EditorInEditMode;
					if (editorInEditMode != null)
					{
						SyncSelectedRow(((EmbeddableEditorBase)editorInEditMode).CurrentEditText);
					}
					IValueListOwner editorInEditMode2 = (IValueListOwner)(object)EditorInEditMode;
					if (editorInEditMode2 != null)
					{
						editorInEditMode2.OnSelectionChangeCommitted();
					}
				}
				return true;
			default:
			{
				bool flag3 = true;
				if ((!checkIfActionIsAllowed) ? ((KeyActionMappingsBase)AllActionsMappings).IsActionAllowed((Enum)actionCode, (long)CurrentState) : ((KeyActionMappingsBase)KeyActionMappings).IsActionAllowed((Enum)actionCode, (long)CurrentState))
				{
					GridItemBase selectableItem = base.DisplayLayout.GetSelectableItem(MapToGridAction(actionCode), ref shift, control);
					if (selectableItem != null)
					{
						ISelectionStrategy selectionStrategy = ((ISelectionManager)this).GetSelectionStrategy((ISelectableItem)selectableItem);
						if (selectionStrategy != null)
						{
							if (selectionStrategy.ProcessKeyBoardItem((ISelectableItem)selectableItem, shift, control))
							{
								if (base.IsDroppedDown)
								{
									base.DisplayLayout.RowScrollRegions[0].ScrollRowIntoView(selectableItem as UltraGridRow);
								}
								((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
							}
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			}
		}

		private static UltraGridAction MapToGridAction(UltraComboAction comboAction)
		{
			UltraGridAction ultraGridAction = UltraGridAction.NextRow;
			return comboAction switch
			{
				UltraComboAction.FirstRow => UltraGridAction.FirstRowInGrid, 
				UltraComboAction.LastRow => UltraGridAction.LastRowInGrid, 
				UltraComboAction.NextRow => UltraGridAction.NextRow, 
				UltraComboAction.PrevRow => UltraGridAction.PrevRow, 
				UltraComboAction.PageDown => UltraGridAction.PageDownRow, 
				UltraComboAction.PageUp => UltraGridAction.PageUpRow, 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_271"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_362")), 
			};
		}

			{
				switch (id)

		internal static bool IsOnUserControl(Control control)
		{
			if (control == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			try
			{
				UIPermission uIPermission = new UIPermission(UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					uIPermission.Assert();
				}
				for (Control parent = control.Parent; parent != null; parent = parent.Parent)
				{
					if (parent is UserControl)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref Size proposedSize)
		{
			Size minimumSize = ((Control)(object)this).MinimumSize;
			Size maximumSize = ((Control)(object)this).MaximumSize;
			if (maximumSize.Width == 0)
			{
				maximumSize.Width = int.MaxValue;
			}
			if (maximumSize.Height == 0)
			{
				maximumSize.Height = int.MaxValue;
			}
			proposedSize.Width = Math.Max(minimumSize.Width, Math.Min(proposedSize.Width, maximumSize.Width));
			proposedSize.Height = Math.Max(minimumSize.Height, Math.Min(proposedSize.Height, maximumSize.Height));
		}

		public override Size GetPreferredSize(Size proposedSize)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			bool flag2 = true;
			if (proposedSize.Width == 0 || proposedSize.Width == 1)
			{
				proposedSize.Width = 2000000000;
				flag = false;
			}
			if (proposedSize.Height == 0 || proposedSize.Height == 1)
			{
				proposedSize.Height = 2000000000;
				flag2 = false;
			}
			ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref proposedSize);
			Size proposedSize2 = proposedSize;
			Control parent = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)this);
			if (!flag || parent is ToolStrip || parent is ToolStripOverflow)
			{
				proposedSize2.Width = ((Control)(object)this).Width;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				proposedSize2.Width = ((Control)(object)this).Width;
			}
			if (((Control)(object)this).AutoSize)
			{
				proposedSize2.Height = Math.Min(proposedSize2.Height, IdealHeight);
			}
			else if (!flag2)
			{
				proposedSize2.Height = ((Control)(object)this).Height;
			}
			ApplyBoundsConstraints(ref proposedSize2);
			return proposedSize2;
		}

		private void SyncSelectedRow(string currentEditText)
		{
			int num = -1;
			((IValueList)this).GetValue(currentEditText, ref num);
			if (num < 0 || (selectedRow != null && selectedRow.Index == num))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			if (selectedRow != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(currentEditText))
			{
				string text = ((IValueList)this).GetText(selectedRow.Index);
				if (string.Equals(currentEditText, text, StringComparison.InvariantCultureIgnoreCase))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				SelectedItemChangeHelper(ComboSelectedItemChangeContext.SelectedIndex, num);
			}
		}
