	public class GroupByRowUIElement : UIElement
	{
		private MouseButtons lastMouseDownButton;

		internal Rectangle lastClipRect;

		internal int groupByRowSummaryFooter_ClipLeft = int.MinValue;

		internal bool isMouseOver;

		public override IRawElementProviderFragment UIAutomationProvider => ((UIElement)this).CreateUIAutomationProvider();

		public override bool IsUiaElement => true;

		public UltraGridGroupByRow GroupByRow => (UltraGridGroupByRow)((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => GroupByRow.BorderStyleResolved;

		public override Border3DSide BorderSides
		{
			get
			{
				if (GroupByRow.ParentRow == null)
				{
					return Border3DSide.Top;
				}
				return Border3DSide.Left | Border3DSide.Top;
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole(GroupByRow.BandInternal, StyleUtils.Role.GroupByRow);

		internal bool IsHotTracking => GridUtils.IsGroupByRowHotTracking((UIElement)(object)this);

		internal bool IsMouseOver
		{
			get
			{
				return isMouseOver;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isMouseOver != value)
				{
					isMouseOver = value;
					((UIElement)this).DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override IRawElementProviderFragment CreateUIAutomationProvider()
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)) is RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)
			{
				return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement.GetRowUiaProviderStub(GroupByRow)).Provider;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal GroupByRowUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		public GroupByRowUIElement(UIElement parent, UltraGridGroupByRow row)
			: this(parent)
		{
			InitializeRow(row);
		}

		internal void InitializeRow(UltraGridGroupByRow row)
		{
			((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext = row;
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags)
		{
			GroupByRow.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref flags, IsHotTracking);
		}

		protected override bool ContinueDescendantSearch(Type type, object[] contexts)
		{
			if (contexts != null)
			{
				UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow = GroupByRow;
				foreach (object obj in contexts)
				{
					if (obj != null)
					{
						if (obj is UltraGridCell)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (obj is UltraGridGroupByRow && groupByRow != obj)
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (obj is HeaderBase)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static void PositionChildElementsHelper(UltraGridGroupByRow row, Rectangle rectInsideBorders, UIElement elementContext, out Rectangle expansionIndicatorRect, out Rectangle groupByDescriptionRect, out Rectangle groupBySummariesRect, out bool summariesWrapped)
		{
			summariesWrapped = false;
			expansionIndicatorRect = (groupByDescriptionRect = (groupBySummariesRect = Rectangle.Empty));
			UltraGridBand bandInternal = row.BandInternal;
			UltraGridLayout layout = bandInternal.Layout;
			GroupByRowExpansionStyle groupByRowExpansionStyleResolved = bandInternal.GroupByRowExpansionStyleResolved;
			Rectangle rectangle;
			if (groupByRowExpansionStyleResolved == GroupByRowExpansionStyle.ExpansionIndicator || groupByRowExpansionStyleResolved == GroupByRowExpansionStyle.ExpansionIndicatorAndDoubleClick)
			{
				rectangle = rectInsideBorders;
				if (bandInternal.IndentationGroupByRow != 0)
				{
					rectangle.X += bandInternal.IndentationGroupByRowExpansionIndicatorResolved;
				}
				else
				{
					rectangle.X += bandInternal.IndentationGroupByRowExpansionIndicatorResolved * row.GroupByRowLevel;
				}
				if (rectangle.Height > layout.GroupByRowExpansionIndicatorWidth)
				{
					rectangle.Y += (rectangle.Height - layout.GroupByRowExpansionIndicatorWidth) / 2;
					rectangle.Height = layout.GroupByRowExpansionIndicatorWidth;
				}
				rectangle.Width = rectangle.Height;
				if (rectangle.Width >= layout.GroupByRowExpansionIndicatorWidth && ((UltraControlBase)layout.Grid).UseFlatModeResolved)
				{
					rectangle.Inflate(-1, -1);
				}
				expansionIndicatorRect = rectangle;
			}
			else
			{
				rectangle = new Rectangle(rectInsideBorders.Location, Size.Empty);
			}
			Rectangle rectangle2 = rectangle;
			rectangle = rectInsideBorders;
			int gROUPBYROW_EXPANSION_INDICATOR_SPACING = layout.GROUPBYROW_EXPANSION_INDICATOR_SPACING;
			rectangle.X = gROUPBYROW_EXPANSION_INDICATOR_SPACING + rectangle2.Right;
			rectangle.Width -= gROUPBYROW_EXPANSION_INDICATOR_SPACING + rectangle2.Width;
			int groupByRowPaddingResolved = bandInternal.GroupByRowPaddingResolved;
			rectangle.Inflate(-groupByRowPaddingResolved, -groupByRowPaddingResolved);
			groupByDescriptionRect = rectangle;
			GroupBySummaryDisplayStyle groupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved = bandInternal.GroupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved;
			if (!bandInternal.HasSummaries || (GroupBySummaryDisplayStyle.SummaryCells != groupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved && GroupBySummaryDisplayStyle.SummaryCellsAlwaysBelowDescription != groupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved))
			{
				return;
			}
			SummarySettingsCollection summaries = bandInternal.Summaries;
			SummaryValuesCollection summaryValues = row.Rows.SummaryValues;
			SummaryDisplayAreaContext inGroupByRowsSummariesContext = SummaryDisplayAreaContext.GetInGroupByRowsSummariesContext(row);
			int summaryFooterHeight = summaryValues.GetSummaryFooterHeight(inGroupByRowsSummariesContext);
			if (summaryFooterHeight > 0)
			{
				groupBySummariesRect = rectInsideBorders;
				groupBySummariesRect.Y += groupByRowPaddingResolved;
				groupBySummariesRect.Height = summaryFooterHeight;
				int num = bandInternal.CalcGroupBySummariesIndent(row);
				groupBySummariesRect.X += num;
				ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = ((elementContext != null) ? GridUtils.GetColScrollRegion(elementContext) : null);
				if (colScrollRegion != null && colScrollRegion.IsExclusive)
				{
					groupBySummariesRect.Width = colScrollRegion.GetBandExtent(bandInternal);
				}
				else
				{
					groupBySummariesRect.Width = bandInternal.GetExtent(BandOrigin.RowSelector);
				}
				if (colScrollRegion != null)
				{
					groupBySummariesRect.Width -= bandInternal.GetFixedHeaders_ExtentDelta(colScrollRegion);
				}
				if (row.ParentRow != null)
				{
					groupBySummariesRect.X--;
				}
				summariesWrapped = true;
				Size descriptionSize = row.GetDescriptionSize(GroupBySummaryDisplayStyle.SummaryCells == groupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved);
				groupByDescriptionRect.Height = descriptionSize.Height;
				if (GroupBySummaryDisplayStyle.SummaryCells == groupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved)
				{
					int leftOfLeftMostSummary = summaries.GetLeftOfLeftMostSummary(inGroupByRowsSummariesContext);
					leftOfLeftMostSummary += num;
					summariesWrapped = rectInsideBorders.X + leftOfLeftMostSummary < groupByDescriptionRect.X + descriptionSize.Width;
				}
				if (!summariesWrapped && summaries.Band.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.None && summaries.Band.RowLayoutLabelStyle == RowLayoutLabelStyle.WithCellData)
				{
					summariesWrapped = true;
				}
				if (summariesWrapped)
				{
					groupBySummariesRect.Y = groupByDescriptionRect.Bottom;
				}
				else
				{
					groupByDescriptionRect.Width = descriptionSize.Width;
				}
				groupBySummariesRect.Height = Math.Min(groupBySummariesRect.Height, rectInsideBorders.Bottom - groupBySummariesRect.Y);
			}
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow = GroupByRow;
			PositionChildElementsHelper(groupByRow, ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders, (UIElement)(object)this, out var expansionIndicatorRect, out var groupByDescriptionRect, out var groupBySummariesRect, out var summariesWrapped);
			GroupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement groupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement = null;
			GroupByRowDescriptionUIElement groupByRowDescriptionUIElement = null;
			SummaryFooterUIElement summaryFooterUIElement = null;
			if (!expansionIndicatorRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				groupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement = (GroupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)base.childElementsCollection, typeof(GroupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement), true);
				if (groupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement == null)
				{
					groupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement = new GroupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				((UIElement)groupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement).Rect = expansionIndicatorRect;
			}
			if (!groupByDescriptionRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				groupByRowDescriptionUIElement = (GroupByRowDescriptionUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)base.childElementsCollection, typeof(GroupByRowDescriptionUIElement), true);
				if (groupByRowDescriptionUIElement == null)
				{
					groupByRowDescriptionUIElement = new GroupByRowDescriptionUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				((UIElement)groupByRowDescriptionUIElement).Rect = groupByDescriptionRect;
			}
			groupByRowSummaryFooter_ClipLeft = int.MinValue;
			if (!groupBySummariesRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				summaryFooterUIElement = (SummaryFooterUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)base.childElementsCollection, typeof(SummaryFooterUIElement), true);
				SummaryDisplayAreaContext inGroupByRowsSummariesContext = SummaryDisplayAreaContext.GetInGroupByRowsSummariesContext(groupByRow);
				if (summaryFooterUIElement == null)
				{
					summaryFooterUIElement = new SummaryFooterUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, groupByRow.Rows, inGroupByRowsSummariesContext);
				}
				else
				{
					summaryFooterUIElement.Initialize(groupByRow.Rows, inGroupByRowsSummariesContext);
				}
				((UIElement)summaryFooterUIElement).Rect = groupBySummariesRect;
				if (!groupByDescriptionRect.IsEmpty && !summariesWrapped && groupBySummariesRect.X < groupByDescriptionRect.Right)
				{
					groupByRowSummaryFooter_ClipLeft = groupByDescriptionRect.Right;
				}
			}
			((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)this).ChildElements).Clear();
			if (groupByRowDescriptionUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)groupByRowDescriptionUIElement);
			}
			if (summaryFooterUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)summaryFooterUIElement);
			}
			if (groupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)groupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement);
			}
			GridUtils.SetupElementToolTip((UIElement)(object)this, groupByRow.ToolTipText, useTextElemText: false);
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			lastMouseDownButton = e.Button;
			if (MouseButtons.Right == e.Button)
			{
				GroupByRow.ClickRight();
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow = GroupByRow;
			if (lastMouseDownButton == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				if (groupByRow != null)
				{
					GroupByRowExpansionStyle groupByRowExpansionStyleResolved = groupByRow.BandInternal.GroupByRowExpansionStyleResolved;
					flag = groupByRow.IsExpandable && (groupByRowExpansionStyleResolved == GroupByRowExpansionStyle.DoubleClick || groupByRowExpansionStyleResolved == GroupByRowExpansionStyle.ExpansionIndicatorAndDoubleClick);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					if (!groupByRow.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper())
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						groupByRow.Expanded = !groupByRow.ShowAsExpanded;
					}
				}
			}
			if (groupByRow.BandInternal != null && groupByRow.BandInternal.Layout != null && groupByRow.BandInternal.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
			{
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.DoubleClickRow, new DoubleClickRowEventArgs(groupByRow, RowArea.GroupByRowArea));
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnDoubleClick(adjustableArea);
		}

		internal static void OnMouseEnterLeaveHelper(UIElement elem, bool enter)
		{
			GroupByRowUIElement groupByRowUIElement = ((elem != null) ? ((GroupByRowUIElement)(object)elem.GetAncestor(typeof(GroupByRowUIElement))) : null);
			if (groupByRowUIElement != null)
			{
				groupByRowUIElement.IsMouseOver = enter;
				((UIElement)groupByRowUIElement).Invalidate();
			}
		}

		private void OnMouseEnterLeave(bool enter)
		{
			OnMouseEnterLeaveHelper((UIElement)(object)this, enter);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			OnMouseEnterLeave(enter: true);
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			OnMouseEnterLeave(enter: false);
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
		}
	}
	public class HeaderUIElement : HeaderUIElementBase
	{
		internal bool sortClickPending;

		private Point lastClickedPoint = Point.Empty;

		protected bool dragging;

		protected bool startDragging;

		private System.Windows.Forms.Timer dragScrollTimer;

		private Rectangle clipSelfRect = Rectangle.Empty;

		internal UIElementBorderStyle borderStyle = (UIElementBorderStyle)1;

		public override bool IsUiaElement => true;

		protected override bool ClipSelf
		{
			get

				if (isRightFixedHeaderSeparator)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return !clipSelfRect.IsEmpty;
			}
		}

		public override Region Region
		{
			get
			{
				if (isRightFixedHeaderSeparator)
				{
					Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
					rect.X = rect.Right - 1;
					rect.Width = 1;
					return new Region(rect);
				}
				if (clipSelfRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					return ((UIElement)this).Region;
				}
				return new Region(clipSelfRect);
			}
		}

		public override bool Enabled
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Header.Enabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ((UIElement)this).Enabled;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsHotTracking => GridUtils.IsHotTracking((UIElement)(object)this, isHotTracking);

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => borderStyle;

		public override Border3DSide BorderSides
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0011: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_001f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				UltraGridBand band = Band;
				if (band != null && (int)band.RowSelectorHeaderStyleResolved == 3)
				{
					UltraGridLayout layout = band.Layout;
					if (layout != null && layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(((UIElement)this).BorderStyle) && Header.FirstItem)
					{
						return Border3DSide.Top | Border3DSide.Right | Border3DSide.Bottom | Border3DSide.Middle;
					}
				}
				return Border3DSide.All;
			}
		}

		public override bool Adjustable
		{
			get
			{
				if (Header != null)
				{
					UltraGridColumn column = Header.Column;
					if (column != null)
					{
						if (column.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
						{
							return RowLayoutSizing.None != column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.AllowLabelSizingResolved;
						}
						if (column.Band.CardView)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					else if (Header is GroupHeader)
					{
						UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = Header.Group;
						if (ultraGridGroup != null && ultraGridGroup.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
						{
							return RowLayoutSizing.None != ultraGridGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.AllowLabelSizingResolved;
						}
					}
					if (Header.AllowSizing)
					{
						if (column == null)
						{
							return true;
						}
						ColumnSizingArea columnSizingAreaResolved = Header.Band.ColumnSizingAreaResolved;
						if (ColumnSizingArea.HeadersOnly == columnSizingAreaResolved || ColumnSizingArea.EntireColumn == columnSizingAreaResolved)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private bool RowLayoutDesignerElement => ((DataAreaUIElement)(object)((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(DataAreaUIElement)))?.RowLayoutDesignerElement ?? false;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		protected override bool ShouldProcessMouseDown
		{
			get
			{
				if (forceMouseDownProcessing)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).ShouldProcessMouseDown;
			}
		}

		private bool SupportsAutoSizing
		{
			get
			{
				if (Header is ColumnHeader && ((UIElement)this).Adjustable && !Header.Band.CardView && !Header.Band.Layout.Grid.DesignMode)
				{
					return ColumnAutoSizeMode.None != Header.Column.AutoSizeModeResolved;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsColumnChooserHeader => false;

		internal virtual bool IsMultiSelectColumnChooserHeader => false;

		protected override bool RequiresSeparator
		{
			get
			{
				if (Header is BandHeader)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ActiveThemeMouseTracking => !(Header is BandHeader);

		protected override UIElementButtonState HeaderState
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				HeaderBase header = Header;
				if (header is BandHeader)
				{
					return (UIElementButtonState)0;
				}
				if ((header.Selected || ((UIElement)this).HasCapture) && !IsColumnChooserHeader)
				{
					return (UIElementButtonState)3;
				}
				return ((HeaderUIElementBase)this).HeaderState;
			}
		}

		public override ISelectableItem SelectableItem
		{
			get
			{

		public override Cursor GetAdjustableCursor(Point point)
		{
			if (GridUtils.IsControlKeyDown && SupportsSpanSizing)
			{
				if (SupportsLeftRightSpanSizingFromPoint(point))
				{
					wasShowingSpanCursor = true;
					return SpanResizeCursorHoriz;
				}
				if (SupportsUpDownSpanSizingFromPoint(point))
				{
					wasShowingSpanCursor = true;
					return SpanResizeCursorVert;
				}
			}
			wasShowingSpanCursor = false;
			if (((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(point) && !((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(point))
			{
				if (SupportsAutoSizing)
				{
					Cursor autoSizeCursor = Header.Band.Layout.AutoSizeCursor;
					if (autoSizeCursor != null)
					{
						return autoSizeCursor;
					}
				}
				return Cursors.SizeWE;
			}
			return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).GetAdjustableCursor(point);
		}

		public override void ApplyAdjustment(Point delta)
		{
			if (Header == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeaderBase header = Header;
			if (header.Column != null)
			{
				if (header.Column.HiddenResolved)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (header.Group != null && header.Group.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!header.IsGroup)
			{
				UltraGridColumn column = Header.Column;
				if (column.Group != null && column.LastItemInLevel && !column.ProportionalResize)
				{
					header = column.Group.Header;
				}
			}
			UltraGridLayout layout = Header.Band.Layout;
			layout.ExitEditModeHelper();
			int extent = header.Extent;
			extent += delta.X;
			UltraGridBand band = Header.Band;
			if (band != null && band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				if (Grid != null && Grid.gridBagLayoutDragStrategy != null)
				{
					Point pointInControlCoords = Grid.EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
					IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider = Header.RowLayoutColumnInfoProvider;
					ILayoutItem resizeLayoutItem = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.ResizeLayoutItem;
					Grid.DragSpanEnd(pointInControlCoords, (UIElement)(object)this, (ILayoutItem)(object)header, resizeLayoutItem);
					return;
				}
				Size layoutContainerSize = GetLayoutContainerSize();
				UIElement containerElement = GridBagLayoutDragManager.GetContainerElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				if (containerElement is BandHeadersUIElement || containerElement is CardLabelAreaUIElement)
				{
					Point delta2 = new Point(delta.X, 0);
					Point delta3 = new Point(0, delta.Y);
					if (!band.CardView)
					{
						IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider2 = Header.RowLayoutColumnInfoProvider;
						ILayoutItem resizeLayoutItem2 = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider2.ResizeLayoutItem;
						band.ResizeLayoutItem(resizeLayoutItem2, new Size(layoutContainerSize.Width, 0), delta2);
						if (delta.X != 0 && delta.Y != 0)
						{
							band.VerifyRowLayoutCache();
						}
						band.ResizeLayoutItem((ILayoutItem)(object)header, layoutContainerSize, delta3);
					}
					else
					{
						band.ResizeLayoutItem((ILayoutItem)(object)header, layoutContainerSize, delta2);
						if (delta.X != 0 && delta.Y != 0)
						{
							band.VerifyRowLayoutCache();
						}
						IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider3 = Header.RowLayoutColumnInfoProvider;
						ILayoutItem resizeLayoutItem3 = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider3.ResizeLayoutItem;
						band.ResizeLayoutItem(resizeLayoutItem3, new Size(0, layoutContainerSize.Height), delta3);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					band.ResizeLayoutItem((UIElement)(object)this, (ILayoutItem)(object)Header, layoutContainerSize, delta);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ApplyAdjustmentNonRowLayoutMode(header, extent);
			}
		}

		internal static void ApplyAdjustmentNonRowLayoutMode(HeaderBase header, int newWidth)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			header.proportionalResizeOverride = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			try
			{
				header.InternalSetWidth(newWidth, autofit: false);
				if (header.Band != null)
				{
					header.Band.Layout.ColScrollRegions.InitializeMetrics();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				header.proportionalResizeOverride = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
				if (header.Band != null)
				{
					header.Band.Layout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
				}
			}
		}

		{
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).GetAdjustmentRange(point, ref range);

			int maxWidth = 0;
			UltraGridBand band = Header.Band;
			if (band != null && band.UseRowLayoutResolved)

				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;

				UIElement ancestor2 = ((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(DataAreaUIElement));
				Rectangle rect2 = ((UIElement)((UIElement)this).ControlElement).Rect;
				Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Intersect(rect2, (ancestor2 != null) ? ancestor2.RectInsideBorders : rect2);
				Rectangle rectangle2 = ((ancestor != null) ? ancestor.Rect : Grid.GridClientAreaRectangle);

				r = ((UIElement)this).Control.RectangleToScreen(r);

				int minHeight = 0;
				int maxHeight = 0;
				int minHeight2 = 0;
				int maxHeight2 = 0;
				Size layoutContainerSize = GetLayoutContainerSize();
				if (((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(point))
				{
					if (band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea && !band.CardView)

						ILayoutItem headerLayoutItem = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.HeaderLayoutItem;
						band.GetLayoutItemResizeRange(headerLayoutItem, new Size(layoutContainerSize.Width, 0), ref minWidth, ref maxWidth, ref minHeight2, ref maxHeight2);
					}
					else

					}
					range.maxDeltaLeft = Math.Min(0, rect.Left + minWidth - rect.Right);
					Rectangle rectangle3 = ((UIElement)this).Control.RectangleToScreen(rect);
					if (maxWidth > 0)
					{
						range.maxDeltaRight = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(maxWidth - rect.Width, deskTopWorkArea.Right - rectangle3.Right));
					}
					else
					{
						range.maxDeltaRight = Math.Max(0, deskTopWorkArea.Right - rectangle3.Right);
					}
					range.leftRightAdjustmentBar.Y = rectangle.Top;
					range.leftRightAdjustmentBar.Height = rectangle.Bottom - rectangle.Top;

					}
					if (Grid.gridBagLayoutDragStrategy == null)
					{
						range.maxDeltaUp = Math.Min(0, rect.Top + minHeight - rect.Bottom);
					}
					if (maxHeight > 0)
					{
						range.maxDeltaDown = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(maxHeight - rect.Height, rectangle2.Bottom - rect.Bottom));
					}

				Rectangle rect4 = ((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)).Rect;

				range.leftRightAdjustmentBar.Height = rect3.Height;
			}
		}

		public override bool SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (!((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(point))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((UIElement)this).Adjustable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int minWidth = 0;
			int maxWidth = 0;
			HeaderBase header = Header;
			if (header != null)
			{
				IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider = header.RowLayoutColumnInfoProvider;
				if (rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider != null)
				{
					UltraGridBand band = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.Band;
					if (band != null && band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
					{
						if (RowLayoutDesignerElement && Keys.Control == Control.ModifierKeys)
						{
							return false;
						}
						RowLayoutSizing allowLabelSizingResolved = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.RowLayoutColumnInfo.AllowLabelSizingResolved;
						if (RowLayoutSizing.Horizontal != allowLabelSizingResolved && RowLayoutSizing.Both != allowLabelSizingResolved)
						{
							return false;
						}
						int minHeight = 0;
						int maxHeight = 0;
						Size layoutContainerSize = GetLayoutContainerSize();
						if (band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea && !band.CardView)
						{
							ILayoutItem resizeLayoutItem = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.ResizeLayoutItem;
							band.GetLayoutItemResizeRange(resizeLayoutItem, new Size(layoutContainerSize.Width, 0), ref minWidth, ref maxWidth, ref minHeight, ref maxHeight);
						}
						else
						{
							band.GetLayoutItemResizeRange((UIElement)(object)this, (ILayoutItem)(object)Header, layoutContainerSize, ref minWidth, ref maxWidth, ref minHeight, ref maxHeight);
						}
						if (maxWidth != 0 && maxWidth == minWidth)
						{
							return false;
						}
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			Header.GetResizeRange(ref minWidth, ref maxWidth);
			if (minWidth == maxWidth && ((UIElement)this).Rect.Width <= minWidth)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			UltraGridBand band = Header.Band;
			if (band == null || !band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(point))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!((UIElement)this).Adjustable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			rect.Y = rect.Bottom - 2;
			rect.Height = 4;
			if (!rect.Contains(point))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int minHeight = 0;
			int maxHeight = 0;
			RowLayoutSizing allowLabelSizingResolved = Header.RowLayoutColumnInfo.AllowLabelSizingResolved;
			if (RowLayoutSizing.Vertical != allowLabelSizingResolved && RowLayoutSizing.Both != allowLabelSizingResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (RowLayoutDesignerElement && Keys.Control == Control.ModifierKeys)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int minWidth = 0;
			int maxWidth = 0;
			Size layoutContainerSize = GetLayoutContainerSize();
			if (band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea && band.CardView)
			{
				ILayoutItem headerLayoutItem = Header.RowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.HeaderLayoutItem;
				band.GetLayoutItemResizeRange(headerLayoutItem, new Size(0, layoutContainerSize.Height), ref minWidth, ref maxWidth, ref minHeight, ref maxHeight);
			}
			else
			{
				band.GetLayoutItemResizeRange((UIElement)(object)this, (ILayoutItem)(object)Header, layoutContainerSize, ref minWidth, ref maxWidth, ref minHeight, ref maxHeight);
			}
			if (maxHeight != 0 && minHeight == maxHeight)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e, bool adjustableArea, ref UIElement captureMouseForElement)
		{
			if (RowLayoutDesignerElement)
			{
				bool flag = forceMouseDownProcessing;
				try
				{
					forceMouseDownProcessing = true;
					return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
				}
				finally
				{
					forceMouseDownProcessing = flag;
				}
			}
			if (Header is BandHeader)
			{
				Header.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper();
				return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
			}
			UltraGridLayout layout = Header.Band.Layout;
			if (!layout.ExitEditModeHelper())
			{
				return true;
			}
			lastClickedPoint = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
			startDragging = false;
			sortClickPending = false;
			bool flag2 = dragging;
			dragging = false;
			UltraGridBase grid = Header.Band.Layout.Grid;
			ISelectionManager val = (ISelectionManager)(object)((grid is ISelectionManager) ? grid : null);
			if (flag2 && val != null)
			{
				val.OnDragEnd(true);
				if (((UIElement)this).ControlElement != null)
				{
					((UIElement)this).ControlElement.TerminateCapture();
				}
				if (!((UIElement)this).IsDrawing)
				{
					((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (e.Button == MouseButtons.Left && !((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(new Point(e.X, e.Y)) && !((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsUpDownAdjustmentsFromPoint(new Point(e.X, e.Y)))
			{
				HeaderClickAction headerClickActionResolved = Header.Band.HeaderClickActionResolved;
				if (headerClickActionResolved == HeaderClickAction.SortMulti || headerClickActionResolved == HeaderClickAction.SortSingle || IsColumnChooserHeader)
				{
					if (Header is ColumnHeader)
					{
						sortClickPending = true;
					}
					captureMouseForElement = (UIElement)(object)this;
					startDragging = true;
					return true;
				}
			}
			return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnMouseDown(e, adjustableArea, ref captureMouseForElement);
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnDoubleClick(adjustableArea);
			if (adjustableArea && SupportsAutoSizing && ((UIElement)this).Control != null && ((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(((UIElement)this).Control.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition)))
			{
				if (Header != null && Header.Band != null && Header.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					RowsCollection rowsContext = (RowsCollection)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(RowsCollection));
					UltraGridBand band = Header.Band;
					band.AutoResizeLayoutItem((ILayoutItem)(object)Header, rowsContext, GetLayoutContainerSize(), (UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				else
				{
					AutoResizeNonRowLayoutMode((ColumnHeader)Header, (UIElement)(object)this);
				}
			}
			UltraGrid grid = Grid;
			if (grid != null && Header != null)
			{
				grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.DoubleClickHeader, new DoubleClickHeaderEventArgs(Header));
			}
		}

		internal static void AutoResizeNonRowLayoutMode(ColumnHeader header, UIElement element)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = header.Column;
			ColumnAutoSizeMode autoSizeModeResolved = column.AutoSizeModeResolved;
			if (ColumnAutoSizeMode.SiblingRowsOnly == autoSizeModeResolved && element.GetContext(typeof(RowsCollection)) != null)
			{
				column.PerformAutoResizeHelper((RowsCollection)element.GetContext(typeof(RowsCollection), true), 0);
			}
			else if (ColumnAutoSizeMode.AllRowsInBand == autoSizeModeResolved)
			{
				column.PerformAutoResizeHelper(null, 0);
			}
			else if (ColumnAutoSizeMode.None != autoSizeModeResolved)
			{
				column.PerformAutoResize();
			}
		}

		private void OnTimerTick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!dragging || Header == null || Header.Band == null || Header.Band.Layout == null || Header.Band.Layout.Grid == null)
			{
				if (dragScrollTimer != null)
				{
					dragScrollTimer.Enabled = false;
					dragScrollTimer.Dispose();
					dragScrollTimer = null;
				}
				return;
			}
			UltraGridBase grid = Header.Band.Layout.Grid;
			ISelectionManager val = (ISelectionManager)(object)((grid is ISelectionManager) ? grid : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (val.DoesDragNeedScrollHorizontal(grid.ControlForGridDisplay.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition), ref num))
				{
					val.DoDragScrollHorizontal(num);
				}
				if (Header.Band.CardView && val.DoesDragNeedScrollVertical(grid.ControlForGridDisplay.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition), ref num))
				{
					val.DoDragScrollVertical(num);
				}
				if (dragScrollTimer != null && num > 0)
				{
					dragScrollTimer.Interval = num;
				}
			}
		}

		private Point ToGridFromControlCoordinates(Point p)
		{
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ((Band != null) ? Band.Layout.Grid : null);
			Control control = ((UIElement)this).Control;
			if ((object)ultraGridBase != control && control != null && ultraGridBase != null)
			{
				p = control.PointToScreen(p);
				p = ultraGridBase.EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(p);
			}
			return p;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseMove(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Point p = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = null;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = null;
			if (Header != null)
			{
				ultraGridBand = Header.Band;
				if (ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridBand.Layout != null)
				{
					ultraGrid = Header.Band.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
				}
			}
			p = ToGridFromControlCoordinates(p);
			if (ultraGrid != null && dragging)
			{
				ISelectionManager val = (ISelectionManager)(object)ultraGrid;
				if (val != null)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					int num = 200;
					if ((ultraGridBand == null || !ultraGridBand.CardView) && val.DoesDragNeedScrollHorizontal(p, ref num))
					{
						val.DoDragScrollHorizontal(num);
						flag = true;
					}
					if ((ultraGridBand == null || ultraGridBand.CardView) && val.DoesDragNeedScrollVertical(p, ref num))
					{
						val.DoDragScrollVertical(num);
						flag = true;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						if (dragScrollTimer == null)
						{
							dragScrollTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
							dragScrollTimer.Tick += OnTimerTick;
							dragScrollTimer.Interval = Math.Max(500, num);
							dragScrollTimer.Enabled = true;
						}
						else
						{
							dragScrollTimer.Interval = num;
							dragScrollTimer.Enabled = true;
						}
					}
					else if (dragScrollTimer != null)
					{
						dragScrollTimer.Enabled = false;
					}
				}
				ultraGrid.DragMoveHelper(p, IsMultiSelectColumnChooserHeader);
				return;
			}
			if (startDragging)
			{
				int num2 = e.X - lastClickedPoint.X;
				int num3 = e.Y - lastClickedPoint.Y;
				if (Math.Sqrt(num2 * num2 + num3 * num3) > 4.0)
				{
					HeaderClickAction headerClickActionResolved = ultraGridBand.HeaderClickActionResolved;
					if (ultraGrid != null && Header.Draggable && (headerClickActionResolved == HeaderClickAction.SortMulti || headerClickActionResolved == HeaderClickAction.SortSingle || IsColumnChooserHeader))
					{
						sortClickPending = false;
						bool flag2 = false;
						if (Header is ColumnHeader)
						{
							if (IsMultiSelectColumnChooserHeader)
							{
								flag2 = true;
							}
							else
							{
								ColumnHeader columnHeader = (ColumnHeader)Header;
								flag2 = columnHeader.StartDragNoSelection();
							}
						}
						else if (Header is GroupHeader)
						{
							GroupHeader groupHeader = (GroupHeader)Header;
							flag2 = groupHeader.StartDragNoSelection();
						}
						if (flag2)
						{
							ultraGrid.ActiveColScrollRegion.InternalSetLastPivotItem(Header);
							ultraGrid.DragMoveHelper(p);
							startDragging = false;
							dragging = true;
							if (!((UIElement)this).IsDrawing)
							{
								((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
							}
							return;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnMouseMove(e);
		}

		protected override void OnCaptureAborted()
		{
			if (dragScrollTimer != null)
			{
				dragScrollTimer.Stop();
				dragScrollTimer.Dispose();
				dragScrollTimer = null;
			}
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = null;
			if (Header != null && Header.Band.Layout != null)
			{
				ultraGrid = Header.Band.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			}
			if (ultraGrid != null && ultraGrid.ActiveColScrollRegion != null)
			{
				ultraGrid.ActiveColScrollRegion.InternalSetLastPivotItem(null);
			}
			startDragging = false;
			if (dragging && ultraGrid != null)
			{
				dragging = false;
				sortClickPending = false;
				((ISelectionManager)ultraGrid).OnDragEnd(true);
				if (!((UIElement)this).IsDrawing)
				{
					((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnCaptureAborted();
			}
		}

		protected override bool OnMouseUp(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (EndDragHelper(cancelled: false))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnMouseUp(e);
		}

		internal virtual bool EndDragHelper(bool cancelled)
		{
			if (dragScrollTimer != null)
			{
				dragScrollTimer.Stop();
				dragScrollTimer.Dispose();
				dragScrollTimer = null;
			}
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = null;
			if (Header != null && Header.Band.Layout != null)
			{
				ultraGrid = Header.Band.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			}
			if (ultraGrid != null && ultraGrid.ActiveColScrollRegion != null)
			{
				ultraGrid.ActiveColScrollRegion.InternalSetLastPivotItem(null);
			}
			startDragging = false;
			if (dragging && ultraGrid != null)
			{
				dragging = false;
				sortClickPending = false;
				((ISelectionManager)ultraGrid).OnDragEnd(cancelled);
				if (!((UIElement)this).IsDrawing)
				{
					((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (sortClickPending)
			{
				sortClickPending = false;
				if (Header is ColumnHeader columnHeader)
				{
					columnHeader.Column.ClickSortIndicator();
					((UIElement)this).Invalidate();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void AdjustForFirstItem(ref Rectangle rect)
		{
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ((Header is ColumnHeader) ? Header.Column : null);
			if (ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea && !ultraGridColumn.Band.CardView)
			{
				int num = ultraGridColumn.RowLayoutColumnInfo.CachedItemRectCell.Left - ultraGridColumn.RowLayoutColumnInfo.CachedItemRectHeader.Left;
				rect.X += num;
				rect.Width -= num;
			}
		}

		private Size GetLayoutContainerSize()
		{
			UltraGridBand band = Band;
			if (band != null && band.RowLayoutStyle == RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout && ((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(UltraGridColumn)) is UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn && ultraGridColumn.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup != null)
			{
				return ultraGridColumn.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.CachedItemRectCell.Size;
			}
			BandHeadersUIElement bandHeadersUIElement = (BandHeadersUIElement)(object)((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(BandHeadersUIElement));
			if (bandHeadersUIElement != null)
			{
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)bandHeadersUIElement).Rect;
				int rowSelectorExtent = bandHeadersUIElement.Band.RowSelectorExtent;
				int num = ((bandHeadersUIElement.Band != null) ? bandHeadersUIElement.Band.Header.GetBandHeaderHeight() : 0);
				if (RowLayoutDesignerElement)
				{
					num = 0;
				}
				rect.Y += num;
				rect.Height -= num;
				rect.X += rowSelectorExtent;
				rect.Width -= rowSelectorExtent;
				if (bandHeadersUIElement.usingFixedHeaders)
				{
					ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = (ColScrollRegion)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(ColScrollRegion), true);
					if (colScrollRegion != null && bandHeadersUIElement != null && bandHeadersUIElement.Band != null)
					{
						int fixedHeaders_OriginDelta = bandHeadersUIElement.Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(colScrollRegion);
						rect.X -= fixedHeaders_OriginDelta;
						rect.Width += fixedHeaders_OriginDelta;
					}
				}
				return rect.Size;
			}
			((RowCellAreaUIElement)(object)((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(RowCellAreaUIElement)))?.GetLayoutContainerSize();
			return Size.Empty;
		}

		internal bool SupportsLeftRightSpanSizingFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			//IL_0051: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0056: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0059: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_005d: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			if (!((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(point))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!IsColumnHeader)
			{
				if (!IsGroupHeader)
				{
					return false;
				}
				LabelPosition labelPositionResolved = Header.Group.RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelPositionResolved;
				if (labelPositionResolved != LabelPosition.Left && labelPositionResolved != LabelPosition.Right && labelPositionResolved != LabelPosition.LabelOnly)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (Band == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			GridBagLayoutAllowSpanSizing allowRowLayoutLabelSpanSizingResolved = Band.AllowRowLayoutLabelSpanSizingResolved;
			if (2 != (int)allowRowLayoutLabelSpanSizingResolved)
			{
				return 3 == (int)allowRowLayoutLabelSpanSizingResolved;
			}
			return true;
		}

			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

		internal void OnKeyToggled()
		{
			if (Grid != null && Band != null && Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				if (!((Control)(object)Grid).IsHandleCreated)
				{
					return;
				}
				Point point = Grid.EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
				if (wasShowingSpanCursor == WillShowSpanCursor(point))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			GridUtils.SetCursorPosition(Cursor.Position);
		}

		private bool WillShowSpanCursor(Point point)
		{
			if (GridUtils.IsControlKeyDown && SupportsSpanSizing && (SupportsLeftRightSpanSizingFromPoint(point) || SupportsUpDownSpanSizingFromPoint(point)))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CanStartAdjustment(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Point point = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
			if (Grid != null && SupportsSpanSizing && (SupportsLeftRightSpanSizingFromPoint(point) || SupportsUpDownSpanSizingFromPoint(point)))
			{
				if (!IsColumnHeader && !IsGroupHeader)
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool isDragSpanHorizontal = ((AdjustableUIElement)this).SupportsLeftRightAdjustmentsFromPoint(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
				bool isHeaderBeingDragged = true;
				return Grid.StartRowLayoutSpanResizeDrag(Header.RowLayoutColumnInfoProvider, isDragSpanHorizontal, isHeaderBeingDragged);
			}
			return ((AdjustableUIElement)this).CanStartAdjustment(e);
		}

				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool WantsInputNotification(UIElementInputType inputType, Point point)
		{
			//IL_005c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (isRightFixedHeaderSeparator)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Band.UseFixedHeaders && !IsRightFixedHeader)
			{
				ColScrollRegion csr = (ColScrollRegion)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(ColScrollRegion), true);
				HeaderBase firstRightFixedHeader = Band.GetFirstRightFixedHeader(csr);
				if (firstRightFixedHeader != null)
				{
					int onScreenOrigin = firstRightFixedHeader.GetOnScreenOrigin(csr, includeRowSelectors: false);
					if (onScreenOrigin < point.X)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return ((UIElement)this).WantsInputNotification(inputType, point);
		}

		private void EnsureEditControlFocused()
		{
			HeaderBase header = Header;
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = (header?.Layout)?.Grid;
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = ultraGridBase as UltraGrid;
			HeaderBase headerBase = ultraGrid?.ActiveHeader;
			if (headerBase == null || headerBase != header || !header.IsInEditMode || !((Control)(object)ultraGrid).Focused)
			{
				return;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = header.EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.CanFocus && editorResolved.IsInEditMode)
			{
				try
				{
					editorResolved.Focus();
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
		}

		internal static EmbeddableUIElementBase FindEmbeddableUIElement(UIElementsCollection childElementsCollection, bool extract)
		{
			if (childElementsCollection != null)
			{
				int count = ((ArrayList)(object)childElementsCollection).Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					UIElement obj = childElementsCollection[i];
					EmbeddableUIElementBase val = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((obj is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? obj : null);
					if (val == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (extract)
					{
						if (1 == count)
						{
							((ArrayList)(object)childElementsCollection).Clear();
						}
						else
						{
							childElementsCollection[i] = null;
						}
					}
					return val;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void OnEmbeddableElementMouseDown(object sender, EmbeddableMouseDownEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0075: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			//IL_00b2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b7: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			if (RowLayoutDesignerElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeaderBase header = Header;
			if (header == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (((EmbeddableMouseEventArgs)e).MouseArgs.Button == MouseButtons.Left)
			{
				Keys modifierKeys = Control.ModifierKeys;
				if ((modifierKeys & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control || (modifierKeys & Keys.Shift) == Keys.Shift)
				{
					if (2 == (int)((EmbeddableClickEventArgs)e).ElementType && (header == null || !header.IsInEditMode))
					{
						e.EatMessage = false;
					}
					return;
				}
				EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = header.EditorResolved;
				if (2 != (int)((EmbeddableClickEventArgs)e).ElementType && AllowHeaderEditing.OnDoubleClick != header.AllowEditingResolved)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!header.IsInEditMode)
				{
					if (CanEnterEditMode)
					{
						header.SetFocusAndActivate(byMouse: true, enterEditMode: true, byTabKey: false, (UIElement)(object)this);
						EnsureEditControlFocused();
						e.EatMessage = true;
					}
					else if (2 == (int)((EmbeddableClickEventArgs)e).ElementType)
					{
						bool eatMessage = false;
						if (header.ActivationResolvedInternal != Activation.Disabled && Grid != null)
						{
							((header.Layout == null) ? null : (header.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid))?.ClearAllSelected();
							header.SetFocusAndActivate(byMouse: true, enterEditMode: false);
							if (header.IsActiveHeader)
							{
								eatMessage = true;
							}
							e.NotifyParentElement = false;
						}
						else
						{
							e.NotifyParentElement = true;
						}
						e.EatMessage = eatMessage;
					}
					if (e.EatMessage && !e.NotifyParentElement)
					{
						((UIElement)this).OnClick();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					e.EatMessage = true;
				}
				return;
			}
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = header.Band?.Layout;
			HeaderBase activeHeader = ultraGridLayout.ActiveHeader;
			if (activeHeader == header && header.IsInEditMode)
			{
				EnsureEditControlFocused();
				e.EatMessage = true;
				return;
			}
			activeHeader?.ExitEditMode();
			if (activeHeader == null || !activeHeader.IsInEditMode)
			{
				e.NotifyParentElement = true;
			}
		}

		internal void OnEmbeddableElementDoubleClick(GridHeaderEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase gridHeaderEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase, EmbeddableClickEventArgs e)
		{
			if (RowLayoutDesignerElement)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeaderBase header = Header;
			if (header == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = header.EditorResolved;
			if (AllowHeaderEditing.OnDoubleClick == header.AllowEditingResolved)
			{
				EmbeddableUIElementBase val = FindEmbeddableUIElement(extract: false);
				if (header.IsInEditMode && !val.IsInEditMode)
				{
					Band.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper(cell: false);
				}
				if (!header.IsInEditMode && header.CanEnterEditMode)
				{
					header.SetFocusAndActivate(byMouse: true, enterEditMode: true, byTabKey: false, (UIElement)(object)this);
					EnsureEditControlFocused();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void EnterEditMode()
		{
			HeaderBase header = Header;
			if (!header.IsInEditMode)
			{
				if (!header.CanEnterEditMode)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("LE_InvalidOperationException_HeaderCannotEnterEditMode");
				}
				header.SetFocusAndActivate(byMouse: true, enterEditMode: true);
				EnsureEditControlFocused();
			}
		}
	}

		private bool MergeRowSelectorTop
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0033: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

				UltraGridRow row = Row;
				bool result = true;
				UltraGridRow parentRow = row.ParentRow;
				VisibleRow visibleRow = VisibleRow;
				if (visibleRow != null && visibleRow.HasHeader)

					UltraGridBand band = row.Band;
					if (band != null)
					{
						RowSelectorHeaderStyle rowSelectorHeaderStyleResolved = band.RowSelectorHeaderStyleResolved;

							result = false;

						default:
							result = false;

						case 2:
						case 3:
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (parentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow)
				{
					if (visibleRow != null)
					{
						VisibleRow parentVisibleRow = visibleRow.ParentVisibleRow;
						if (parentVisibleRow != null)
						{
							result = false;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = (RowScrollRegion)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(RowScrollRegion), true);
					if (rowScrollRegion != null)
					{
						VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = rowScrollRegion.VisibleRows;
						VisibleRow visibleRow2 = null;
						for (int i = 0; i < visibleRows.Count; i++)
						{
							if (visibleRows[i].Row == row)
							{
								if (row.RowSpacingBeforeResolved > 0 || (visibleRow2 != null && visibleRow2.Row.RowSpacingAfterResolved > 0))
								{
									result = false;
								}
								else if (visibleRow2 != null && visibleRow2.Band != row.Band && visibleRows[i].Tier > 0 && !visibleRows[i].HasHeader && row.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers)
								{
									result = false;
								}
								break;
							}
							visibleRow2 = visibleRows[i];
						}
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		private bool GetRowAreaUnderCursor(out RowArea rowArea, UltraGrid grid)
		{
			Point point = grid.EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
			UIElement val = ((UIElement)this).ElementFromPoint(point);
			bool flag = val != null && val.GetAncestor(typeof(PreRowAreaUIElement)) == null;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (val.GetAncestor(typeof(RowSelectorUIElementBase)) != null)
				{
					rowArea = RowArea.RowSelectorArea;
				}
				else if (val.GetAncestor(typeof(RowAutoPreviewUIElement)) != null)
				{
					rowArea = RowArea.RowPreviewArea;
				}
				else if (val.GetAncestor(typeof(CellUIElementBase)) != null)
				{
					rowArea = RowArea.Cell;
				}
				else
				{
					rowArea = RowArea.CellArea;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				rowArea = RowArea.GroupByRowArea;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal ISelectableItem GetItemNearestPoint(Point point, ISelectableItem lastItem)
		{
			if (lastItem is UltraGridRow)
			{
				return Row;
			}
			if (!(lastItem is UltraGridCell))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!(((UIElement)this).GetDescendant(typeof(RowCellAreaUIElement)) is RowCellAreaUIElement rowCellAreaUIElement))
			{
				return null;
			}
			CellUIElementBase cellUIElementBase = null;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ArrayList)(object)((UIElement)rowCellAreaUIElement).ChildElements).Count; i++)
			{
				if (((UIElement)rowCellAreaUIElement).ChildElements[i] is CellUIElementBase cellUIElementBase2)
				{
					Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)cellUIElementBase2).Rect;
					if (rect.Contains(point))
					{
						return cellUIElementBase2.Cell;
					}
					num2 = 0;
					if (point.X < rect.Left)
					{
						num2 += rect.Left - point.X;
					}
					else if (point.X > rect.Right)
					{
						num2 += point.X - rect.Right;
					}
					if (point.Y < rect.Top)
					{
						num2 += rect.Top - point.Y;
					}
					else if (point.Y > rect.Bottom)
					{
						num2 += point.Y - rect.Bottom;
					}
					if (cellUIElementBase == null || num2 < num)
					{
						cellUIElementBase = cellUIElementBase2;
						num = num2;
					}
				}
			}
			return cellUIElementBase?.Cell;
		}

		internal bool InvalidateIfHotTracked()
		{
			if (isMouseOverSelectorOrCellArea)
			{
				RowCellAreaUIElementBase.OnMouseEnterLeaveHelper((UIElement)(object)this, isMouseOverSelectorOrCellArea);
				UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)this).GetDescendant(typeof(RowCellAreaUIElementBase));
				if (descendant != null && descendant.HasChildElements)
				{
					UIElementEnumerator enumerator = descendant.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (enumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
							if (current is CellUIElementBase cellUIElementBase && cellUIElementBase.InvalidateIfHotTracked())
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal Rectangle GetResolvedClipSelfRect()
		{
			Rectangle rectangle = ((UIElement)this).DrawingClipRect;
			Rectangle drawingClipSelfRect = DrawingClipSelfRect;
			if (!drawingClipSelfRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				rectangle = Rectangle.Intersect(rectangle, drawingClipSelfRect);
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

		protected override bool ContinueDescendantSearch(Type type, object[] contexts)
		{
			if (contexts != null)
			{
				UltraGridRow row = Row;
				foreach (object obj in contexts)
				{
					if (obj != null)
					{
						if (obj is UltraGridRow)
						{
							return obj == row;
						}
						if (obj is UltraGridCell ultraGridCell)
						{
							return ultraGridCell.Row == row;
						}
						if (obj is HeaderBase && !(obj is GroupHeader) && row != null && (!row.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved || row.Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea))
						{
							return false;
						}
						if (obj is MergedCell)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElements()
		{
			//IL_00ec: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0174: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridRow row = Row;
			UltraGridBand bandInternal = row.BandInternal;
			InitCachedInfo(row);
			if (row.IsCard)
			{
				PositionChildElementsForCardArea();
			}
			else
			{
				int preRowAreaExtentResolved = row.PreRowAreaExtentResolved;
				int rowSelectorExtentResolved = row.RowSelectorExtentResolved;
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
				UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
				((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;
				Rectangle rectangle = default(Rectangle);
				if (!RowLayoutDesignerElement && preRowAreaExtentResolved > 0)
				{
					rectangle = rect;
					rectangle.Width = preRowAreaExtentResolved;
					rect.Width -= preRowAreaExtentResolved;
					rect.Offset(preRowAreaExtentResolved, 0);
					if (rectangle.IntersectsWith(((UIElement)this).Parent.Rect))
					{
						PreRowAreaUIElement preRowAreaUIElement = CreatePreRowAreaUIElement(childElements);
						((UIElement)preRowAreaUIElement).Rect = rectangle;
						((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)preRowAreaUIElement);
					}
				}
				if (rowSelectorExtentResolved > 0)
				{
					Rectangle rect2 = rect;
					rect2.Width = rowSelectorExtentResolved;
					rect.Width -= rowSelectorExtentResolved;
					rect.Offset(rowSelectorExtentResolved, 0);
					if (bandInternal.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(rowBorderStyle))
					{
						rect.X--;
						rect.Width++;
					}
					if (overlapTopBorder)
					{
						rect2.Y++;
						rect2.Height--;
					}
					if (rect2.IntersectsWith(((UIElement)this).Parent.Rect))
					{
						RowSelectorUIElementBase rowSelectorUIElementBase = CreateRowSelectorUIElement(childElements);
						if (bandInternal.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(bandInternal.BorderStyleRowSelectorResolved))
						{
							if (bandInternal.GetOrigin(BandOrigin.RowSelector) == 0 && bandInternal.Layout.IsDisplayLayout)
							{
								rect2.X--;
								rect2.Width++;
							}
							if (MergeRowSelectorTop)
							{
								rect2.Y--;
								rect2.Height++;
							}
						}
						((UIElement)rowSelectorUIElementBase).Rect = rect2;
						((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)rowSelectorUIElementBase);
					}
				}
				if (rect.IntersectsWith(((UIElement)this).Parent.Rect))
				{
					RowCellAreaUIElementBase rowCellAreaUIElementBase = CreateRowCellAreaUIElement(childElements);
					((UIElement)rowCellAreaUIElementBase).Rect = rect;
					((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)rowCellAreaUIElementBase);
				}
				if (childElements != null)
				{
					childElements.DisposeElements();
				}
			}
			GridUtils.SetupElementToolTip((UIElement)(object)this, row.ToolTipText, useTextElemText: false);
		}

		private void PositionChildElementsForCardArea()
		{
			//IL_0067: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0154: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015a: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			UltraGridRow row = Row;
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			((UIElement)this).childElementsCollection = null;

				rectInsideBorders.Height = row.Band.CardCaptionHeight;

				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)cardCaptionUIElement);
				num = rectInsideBorders.Height;
			}
			if (!row.IsCardCompressed)
			{
				bool flag = !row.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved && row.Band.CardSettings.StyleResolved != CardStyle.MergedLabels;
				int num2 = (flag ? row.Band.CardLabelWidthResolved : (-1));
				Rectangle rectInsideBorders;
				if (flag && num2 > 0)

					CardLabelAreaUIElement cardLabelAreaUIElement = (CardLabelAreaUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)childElements, typeof(CardLabelAreaUIElement), true);
					if (cardLabelAreaUIElement == null)

					}
					cardLabelAreaUIElement.InFirstCardAreaRow = InFirstCardAreaRow;
					rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
					rectInsideBorders.Y += num;

		protected override Rectangle IntersectInvalidRect(Rectangle invalidRect, int rightToLeftOffset, float zoomFactor)
		{
			if (clipSelfRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				return ((UIElement)this).IntersectInvalidRect(invalidRect, rightToLeftOffset, zoomFactor);
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = clipSelfRect;
			if (((UIElement)this).RightToLeftResolved)
			{
				UIElementDrawParams.MirrorRect(((UIElement)this).rectValue, ref rectangle, false);

		}

				}

			}
		}

		{

			{

					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.DoubleClickRow, new DoubleClickRowEventArgs(Row, rowArea));
				}
				RowEditTemplateUIType rowEditTemplateUITypeResolved = Row.Band.RowEditTemplateUITypeResolved;

				{
					Row.ShowEditTemplate(preventForHiddenOrDisabledRow: true, TemplateDisplaySource.OnRowDoubleClick);
				}
			}
			((AdjustableUIElement)this).OnDoubleClick(adjustableArea);
		}

			internal static bool HasBandHeader(RowsCollection rows)
			{
				UltraGridBand band = rows.Band;
				if (!band.HeadersAreaVisible)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (band.HeaderPlacementResolved)
				{
				case HeaderPlacement.FixedOnTop:
					return rows.IsTopLevel;
				case HeaderPlacement.RepeatOnBreak:
				case HeaderPlacement.OncePerRowIsland:
					return !rows.IsGroupByRows;
				case HeaderPlacement.OncePerGroupedRowIsland:
					return rows.IsTopLevel;
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}

						}
						return null;

					{

					ultraGridCell = base.Row.Cells[column];
				}
				if (ultraGridCell == null && layoutItem is RowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder.CellLayoutItem cellLayoutItem)
				{
					ultraGridCell = cellLayoutItem.Row.Cells[cellLayoutItem.Column];

				if (ultraGridCell != null)

		internal class BandHeadersUiaProviderStub : GridItemUiaProviderBase<RowsCollection>, IScrollItemProvider

			private Dictionary<HeaderBase, HeaderUiaProviderStub> headerUiaProviders;

			private List<HeaderBase> headers;

			private int columnsVersion = -1;

			private UltraGridBand Band => Rows.Band;

			internal List<HeaderBase> Headers
			{
				get
				{
					UltraGridBand band = Band;
					if (headers != null && columnsVersion == band.ColumnsVersion)
					{
						return headers;
					}
					columnsVersion = band.ColumnsVersion;
					if (headers != null)
					{
						headers.Clear();
					}
					else
					{
						headers = new List<HeaderBase>();
					}
					if (band.HeaderVisible)
					{
						headers.Add(band.Header);
					}
					if (!band.CardView)
					{
						if (band.GroupsDisplayed && band.GroupHeadersVisible)
						{
							GroupsCollection groups = band.Groups;
							for (int i = 0; i < groups.Count; i++)
							{
								UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = groups[i];
								if (!ultraGridGroup.HiddenResolved)
								{
									headers.Add(groups[i].Header);
								}
							}
						}
						if (band.ColHeadersVisible)
						{
							ColumnsCollection columns = band.Columns;
							for (int j = 0; j < columns.Count; j++)
							{
								UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = columns[j];
								if (!ultraGridColumn.HiddenResolved && !ultraGridColumn.IsChaptered)
								{
									headers.Add(columns[j].Header);
								}
							}
						}
					}
					return headers;
				}
			}

			private Dictionary<HeaderBase, HeaderUiaProviderStub> HeaderUiaProviders
			{
				get
				{
					if (headerUiaProviders == null)
					{
						headerUiaProviders = new Dictionary<HeaderBase, HeaderUiaProviderStub>();
					}
					return headerUiaProviders;
				}
			}

				{

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				DataAreaUIElement dataAreaElement = DataAreaElement;
				if (dataAreaElement == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				UltraGridBase grid = Grid;
				if (grid == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = rowColElement.RowScrollRegion;
				ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = rowColElement.ColScrollRegion;
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					if (grid.ActiveColScrollRegion == colScrollRegion && grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion == rowScrollRegion)
					{
						if (grid.Rows.TemplateRowLocationDefault == TemplateAddRowLocation.Top)
						{
							return grid.Rows.TemplateAddRow.AccessibilityObject;
						}
						if (grid.Rows.Count > 0)
						{
							return grid.Rows[0].AccessibilityObject;
						}
						if (grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].CardScrollbarAccessibilityObject != null)
						{
							return grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].CardScrollbarAccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
					return null;
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					if (grid.ActiveColScrollRegion == colScrollRegion && grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion == rowScrollRegion)
					{
						if (grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].CardScrollbarAccessibilityObject != null)
						{
							return grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].CardScrollbarAccessibilityObject;
						}
						if (grid.Rows.TemplateRowLocationDefault == TemplateAddRowLocation.Bottom)
						{
							return grid.Rows.TemplateAddRow.AccessibilityObject;
						}
						if (grid.Rows.Count > 0)
						{
							return grid.Rows[grid.Rows.Count - 1].AccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
					return null;
				default:
					return ((UIElementAccessibleObject)this).Navigate(navdir);
				}
			}

		}

		private static bool AddColumnForMerging(List<UltraGridColumn>[] mergedCols, UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column.MergedCellEnabledResolved)
			{
				int index = column.Band.Index;
				if (index >= 0 && index < mergedCols.Length)
				{
					if (mergedCols[index] == null)
					{
						mergedCols[index] = new List<UltraGridColumn>();
					}
					mergedCols[index].Add(column);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void PositionMergedCellElements(UIElementsCollection oldMergedCellElems)
		{
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = ColScrollRegion;
			UltraGridLayout layout = colScrollRegion.Layout;
			List<UltraGridColumn>[] array = new List<UltraGridColumn>[layout.SortedBands.Count];
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (VisibleHeader visibleHeader in colScrollRegion.VisibleHeaders)
			{
				HeaderBase header = visibleHeader.Header;
				UltraGridColumn column = header.Column;
				if (column != null)
				{
					flag = AddColumnForMerging(array, column) || flag;
					continue;
				}
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = header.Group;
				if (ultraGridGroup == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridColumn item in ultraGridGroup.ColumnsResolved)
				{
					flag = AddColumnForMerging(array, item) || flag;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
			UIElementsCollection childElements = ((UIElement)this).ChildElements;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = ((ArrayList)(object)childElements).Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				RowUIElement rowUIElement = childElements[i] as RowUIElement;
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = rowUIElement?.Row;
				if (ultraGridRow == null || ultraGridRow.BandInternal == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				rowUIElement.hasMergedCells = false;
				int index = ultraGridRow.BandInternal.Index;
				List<UltraGridColumn> list = ((index >= 0 && index < array.Length) ? array[index] : null);
				if (list == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int j = 0;
				for (int count2 = list.Count; j < count2; j++)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = list[j];
					MergedCell mergedCell = ultraGridColumn.GetMergedCell(ultraGridRow);
					if (mergedCell == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					rowUIElement.hasMergedCells = true;
					MergedCellUIElement mergedCellUIElement = (MergedCellUIElement)hashtable[mergedCell];
					if (mergedCellUIElement != null)
					{
						mergedCellUIElement.RowElements.Add(rowUIElement);
						continue;
					}
					int topRelativeTo = mergedCell.GetTopRelativeTo(ultraGridRow);
					int height = mergedCell.Height;
					if (height > 0 && -topRelativeTo < height)
					{
						int mergedCellTop = ((UIElement)rowUIElement).Rect.Y + topRelativeTo;
						mergedCellUIElement = AddMergedCellElement(mergedCell, mergedCellTop, height, oldMergedCellElems);
						if (mergedCellUIElement != null)
						{
							mergedCellUIElement.RowElements.Add(rowUIElement);
							hashtable.Add(mergedCell, mergedCellUIElement);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMousePanVertical(int delta)
		{
			UltraGridBase grid = Grid;
			if (grid == null || !grid.ExternalOnMousePanVertical(delta))
			{
				int num = Math.Abs(delta);
				int num2 = 1;
				if (num >= 200)
				{
					num2 = num / 100;
				}
				RowScrollAction action = RowScrollAction.LineDown;
				if (delta < 0)
				{
					action = RowScrollAction.LineUp;
				}
				for (int i = 1; i <= num2; i++)
				{
					rsr.Scroll(action);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMousePanHorizontal(int delta)

			}

			{

			}
			for (int i = 1; i <= num2; i++)

			}
		}
