		private void DrawSelectionOverlay(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, UltraGridBand band, bool isRowSelection, Color selectionColor, Color borderColor)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
			((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).AdjustForDrawing(ref rect);
			DrawSelectionOverlay(rect, ref drawParams, band, isRowSelection, selectionColor, borderColor, FixedState.Left);
			DrawSelectionOverlay(rect, ref drawParams, band, isRowSelection, selectionColor, borderColor, FixedState.Right);
			DrawSelectionOverlay(rect, ref drawParams, band, isRowSelection, selectionColor, borderColor, FixedState.None);
		}

		private SelectionOverlayRegionInfo CalculateSelectionOverlayRegionInfo(Rectangle regionRect, ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, UltraGridBand band, bool isRowSelection, Color selectionColor, Color borderColor, FixedState fixedState)
		{
			SelectionOverlayRegionInfo selectionOverlayRegionInfo = new SelectionOverlayRegionInfo(regionRect);
			Region cellRegion = selectionOverlayRegionInfo.CellRegion;
			Region borderRegion = selectionOverlayRegionInfo.BorderRegion;
			Region clippingRegion = selectionOverlayRegionInfo.ClippingRegion;
			Border3DSide borders = Border3DSide.All;
			bool hasFoundSelection = false;
			int selectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved = band.Layout.SelectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved;
			CalculateSelectionOverlayRegionsHelper((UIElement)(object)this, cellRegion, borderRegion, selectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved, isRowSelection, ref borders, ref hasFoundSelection, clippingRegion, (borders & Border3DSide.Right) != 0, fixedState);
			return selectionOverlayRegionInfo;
		}

		private void DrawSelectionOverlay(Rectangle regionRect, ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams, UltraGridBand band, bool isRowSelection, Color selectionColor, Color borderColor, FixedState fixedState)
		{
			SelectionOverlayRegionInfo selectionOverlayRegionInfo = CalculateSelectionOverlayRegionInfo(regionRect, ref drawParams, band, isRowSelection, selectionColor, borderColor, fixedState);
			try
			{
				Region cellRegion = selectionOverlayRegionInfo.CellRegion;
				Region borderRegion = selectionOverlayRegionInfo.BorderRegion;
				Region clippingRegion = selectionOverlayRegionInfo.ClippingRegion;
				Border3DSide border3DSide = Border3DSide.All;
				int selectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved = band.Layout.SelectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved;
				Region clip = ((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.Clip;
				if (selectionColor != Color.Empty && selectionColor.A > 0)
				{
					SolidBrush brush = GetCachedSelectionOverlayBrush(selectionColor);
					try
					{
						((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.Clip = clippingRegion;
						((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.FillRegion(brush, cellRegion);
					}
					finally
					{
						((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.Clip = clip;
					}
				}
				if (borderColor == Color.Empty || borderColor.A == 0 || selectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				RectangleF[] regionScans = borderRegion.GetRegionScans(new Matrix());
				if (regionScans == null || regionScans.Length != 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				Pen pen = GetCachedSelectionBorderPen(selectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved, borderColor);
				Rectangle rect = Rectangle.Truncate(regionScans[0]);
				if (!isRowSelection)
				{
					int cellSpacingResolved = band.CellSpacingResolved;
					rect.Inflate(-cellSpacingResolved, -cellSpacingResolved);
				}
				((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.Clip = clippingRegion;
				try
				{
					if (border3DSide == Border3DSide.All)
					{
						((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawRectangle(pen, rect);
						return;
					}
					Point pt = new Point(rect.X, rect.Bottom);
					Point pt2 = new Point(pt.X + rect.Width, pt.Y);
					Point pt3 = new Point(rect.Right, rect.Top);
					if ((border3DSide & Border3DSide.Left) != 0)
					{
						((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(pen, new Point(rect.Location.X, rect.Location.Y - selectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved / 2), new Point(pt.X, pt.Y + selectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved / 2));
					}
					if ((border3DSide & Border3DSide.Bottom) != 0)
					{
						((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(pen, pt, pt2);
					}
					if ((border3DSide & Border3DSide.Right) != 0)
					{
						((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(pen, new Point(pt2.X, pt2.Y + selectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved / 2), new Point(pt3.X, pt3.Y - selectionOverlayBorderThicknessResolved / 2));
					}
					if ((border3DSide & Border3DSide.Top) != 0)
					{
						((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.DrawLine(pen, pt3, rect.Location);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					((UIElementDrawParams)(ref drawParams)).Graphics.Clip = clip;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				selectionOverlayRegionInfo?.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void CalculateSelectionOverlayRegionsHelper(UIElement parent, Region cellRegion, Region borderRegion, int borderThickness, bool isRowSelection, ref Border3DSide borders, ref bool hasFoundSelection, Region clippingRegion, bool hadInitialRightBorder, FixedState fixedState)
		{
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator = parent.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					if (!(current is RowCellAreaUIElement rowCellAreaUIElement))
					{
						if (current.HasChildElements)
						{
							CalculateSelectionOverlayRegionsHelper(current, cellRegion, borderRegion, borderThickness, isRowSelection, ref borders, ref hasFoundSelection, clippingRegion, hadInitialRightBorder, fixedState);
						}
						continue;
					}
					Rectangle drawingRect = ((UIElement)this).DrawingRect;
					if (isRowSelection)
					{
						UltraGridRow row = rowCellAreaUIElement.Row;
						if (!row.Selected)
						{
							continue;
						}
						Rectangle drawingRect2 = ((UIElement)rowCellAreaUIElement).DrawingRect;
						cellRegion.Union(drawingRect2);
						int num = borderThickness / 2;
						if (borderThickness % 2 == 0)
						{
							num--;
						}
						drawingRect2.Inflate(num, num);
						if (borderThickness % 2 != 0)
						{
							drawingRect2.Width--;
							drawingRect2.Height--;
						}
						borderRegion.Union(drawingRect2);
						if (((UIElement)rowCellAreaUIElement).GetAncestor(typeof(RowUIElementBase)) is RowUIElementBase rowUIElementBase)
						{
							Rectangle resolvedClipSelfRect = rowUIElementBase.GetResolvedClipSelfRect();
							if (resolvedClipSelfRect.Bottom != ((UIElement)rowUIElementBase).DrawingRect.Bottom)
							{
								Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(drawingRect.X, resolvedClipSelfRect.Bottom, drawingRect.Width, drawingRect.Height);
								clippingRegion.Exclude(rect);
							}
							if (resolvedClipSelfRect.Top != ((UIElement)rowUIElementBase).DrawingRect.Top)
							{
								Rectangle rect2 = new Rectangle(drawingRect.X, drawingRect.Y, drawingRect.Width, resolvedClipSelfRect.Top - drawingRect.Top);
								clippingRegion.Exclude(rect2);
							}
						}
						if (!hasFoundSelection && (borders & Border3DSide.Top) != 0)
						{
							UltraGridRow prevVisibleRow = row.GetPrevVisibleRow();
							if (prevVisibleRow != null && prevVisibleRow.ParentCollection == row.ParentCollection && prevVisibleRow.Selected && (prevVisibleRow.VisibleIndex == -1 || !hasFoundSelection))
							{
								borders ^= Border3DSide.Top;
							}
						}
						hasFoundSelection = true;
						continue;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					CellUIElement cellUIElement = null;
					Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
					List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>((IEnumerable<UIElement>)((UIElement)rowCellAreaUIElement).ChildElements);
					list.Sort(UIElementLocationComparison);
					foreach (UIElement item in list)
					{
						if (!(item is CellUIElement cellUIElement2) || (!cellUIElement2.Cell.Selected && !cellUIElement2.Column.Header.Selected))
						{
							continue;
						}
						ColumnHeader header = cellUIElement2.Column.Header;
						if (header.FixedState != fixedState)
						{
							continue;
						}
						Rectangle rect3 = UltraGridCell.CalculateCellOverlayRect((UIElement)(object)cellUIElement2, 0, calculateInvalidRect: false);
						cellRegion.Union(rect3);
						Rectangle drawingRect3 = ((UIElement)cellUIElement2).DrawingRect;
						if (((((UIElement)cellUIElement2).Parent != null) ? ((UIElement)cellUIElement2).Parent.DrawingRect : drawingRect3).Top - 1 == drawingRect3.Top)
						{
							drawingRect3.Y++;
							drawingRect3.Height--;
						}
						Rectangle resolvedClipSelfRect2 = cellUIElement2.GetResolvedClipSelfRect();
						if (!resolvedClipSelfRect2.IsEmpty)
						{
							if (resolvedClipSelfRect2.Left != drawingRect3.Left)
							{
								int num2 = (cellUIElement2.CanMergeBorderSide(Border3DSide.Left) ? 1 : 0);
								Rectangle rect4 = new Rectangle(drawingRect.X, drawingRect.Y, resolvedClipSelfRect2.Left - num2, drawingRect.Height);
								clippingRegion.Exclude(rect4);
							}
							if (resolvedClipSelfRect2.Top != drawingRect3.Top)
							{
								Rectangle rect5 = new Rectangle(drawingRect.X, drawingRect.Y, drawingRect.Width, resolvedClipSelfRect2.Top - drawingRect.Top);
								clippingRegion.Exclude(rect5);
							}
							if (resolvedClipSelfRect2.Right != drawingRect3.Right)
							{
								Rectangle rect6 = new Rectangle(resolvedClipSelfRect2.Right, drawingRect.Top, drawingRect.Width, drawingRect.Height);
								clippingRegion.Exclude(rect6);
							}
							if (resolvedClipSelfRect2.Bottom != drawingRect3.Bottom)
							{
								Rectangle rect7 = new Rectangle(drawingRect.X, resolvedClipSelfRect2.Bottom, drawingRect.Width, drawingRect.Height);
								clippingRegion.Exclude(rect7);
							}
						}
						rect3 = UltraGridCell.CalculateCellOverlayRect((UIElement)(object)cellUIElement2, borderThickness, calculateInvalidRect: false);
						if (!flag)
						{
							flag = true;
							if ((borders & Border3DSide.Left) != 0)
							{
								UltraGridCell[] allCellsFromPosition = cellUIElement2.GetAllCellsFromPosition(right: false);
								if (allCellsFromPosition.Length == 1)
								{
									if (((UIElement)cellUIElement2).ClipRect.X > drawingRect3.X)
									{
										borders ^= Border3DSide.Left;
									}
								}
								else
								{
									for (int num3 = allCellsFromPosition.Length - 2; num3 >= 0; num3--)
									{
										if (allCellsFromPosition[num3].Selected)
										{
											borders ^= Border3DSide.Left;
											break;
										}
									}
								}
							}
						}
						rect3.Inflate(cellUIElement2.Cell.Band.CellSpacingResolved, cellUIElement2.Cell.Band.CellSpacingResolved);
						if (rectangle != Rectangle.Empty)
						{
							borderRegion.Union(rectangle);
						}
						rectangle = rect3;
						if (!hasFoundSelection && (borders & Border3DSide.Top) != 0)
						{
							UltraGridRow prevVisibleRow2 = cellUIElement2.Row.GetPrevVisibleRow();
							if (prevVisibleRow2 != null && prevVisibleRow2.ParentCollection == cellUIElement2.Row.ParentCollection && (cellUIElement2.Column.Header.Selected || prevVisibleRow2.Cells[cellUIElement2.Cell.Column].Selected) && (prevVisibleRow2.VisibleIndex == -1 || !hasFoundSelection))
							{
								borders ^= Border3DSide.Top;
							}
						}
						hasFoundSelection = true;
						cellUIElement = cellUIElement2;
					}
					if (!(rectangle != Rectangle.Empty))
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (cellUIElement != null && hadInitialRightBorder)
					{
						UltraGridCell[] allCellsFromPosition2 = cellUIElement.GetAllCellsFromPosition(right: true);
						for (int i = 1; i < allCellsFromPosition2.Length; i++)
						{
							UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = allCellsFromPosition2[i];
							if (ultraGridCell.Selected && ultraGridCell.Column.Header.FixedState == fixedState)
							{
								borders ^= Border3DSide.Right;
								if (((UIElement)this).Rect.Right > rectangle.Right)
								{
									rectangle.Width += ((UIElement)this).Rect.Right - rectangle.Right;
								}
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					borderRegion.Union(rectangle);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private SolidBrush GetCachedSelectionOverlayBrush(Color color)
		{
			if (cachedSelectionOverlayBrush != null && cachedSelectionOverlayBrush.Color == color)
			{
				return cachedSelectionOverlayBrush;
			}
			if (cachedSelectionOverlayBrush != null)
			{
				cachedSelectionOverlayBrush.Dispose();
			}
			cachedSelectionOverlayBrush = new SolidBrush(color);
			return cachedSelectionOverlayBrush;
		}

		private Pen GetCachedSelectionBorderPen(int borderThickeness, Color color)
		{
			if (cachedSelectionBorderPen != null && (int)cachedSelectionBorderPen.Width == borderThickeness && cachedSelectionBorderPen.Color == color)
			{
				return cachedSelectionBorderPen;
			}
			if (cachedSelectionBorderPen != null)
			{
				cachedSelectionBorderPen.Dispose();
			}
			cachedSelectionBorderPen = new Pen(color, borderThickeness);
			return cachedSelectionBorderPen;
		}

		private int UIElementLocationComparison(UIElement elementX, UIElement elementY)
		{
			int num = elementX.Rect.Left.CompareTo(elementY.Rect.Left);
			if (num != 0)
			{
				return num;
			}
			return elementX.Rect.Top.CompareTo(elementY.Rect.Top);
		}

		private ChildBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement AddChildBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement(UIElementsCollection oldElements, ViewStyleBase viewStyle, UltraGridBand band, VisibleRow vr, BandHeadersUIElement bandHeadersElement)
		{
			if (bandHeadersElement != null && vr.Row.ParentChildBand != null && vr.Row.ParentChildBand.Band.Index != 0 && !vr.Row.ParentRow.ParentCollection.IsGroupByRows && viewStyle.CanCollapseChildBands())
			{
				ChildBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement childBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement = (ChildBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElements, typeof(ChildBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement), true);
				if (childBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement == null)
				{
					childBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement = new ChildBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement((UIElement)(object)this);
				}
				childBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement.Initialize(vr.Row.ParentChildBand);
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)bandHeadersElement).Rect;
				int num = band.RowConnectorLineOffset * 2;
				rect.X -= num;
				rect.Width = num;
				((UIElement)childBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)childBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement);
				return childBandExpansionIndicatorHeaderUIElement;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class SummaryFooterUIElement : UIElement
	{
		internal bool usingFixedHeaders;

		private SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext;

		private Rectangle clipSelfRect = Rectangle.Empty;

		internal Rectangle lastClipRect = Rectangle.Empty;

		public override IRawElementProviderFragment UIAutomationProvider => ((UIElement)this).CreateUIAutomationProvider();

		public override bool IsUiaElement => true;

		public RowsCollection Rows => (RowsCollection)((UIElement)this).PrimaryContext;

		internal SummaryValuesCollection SummaryValues => Rows?.SummaryValues;

		internal SummaryDisplayAreaContext SummaryDisplayAreaContext => summaryDisplayAreaContext;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => Rows.Band.GetBorderStyleSummaryFooterResolved(SummaryDisplayAreaContext);

		protected override bool ClipChildren
		{
			get
			{
				if (usingFixedHeaders)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return ((UIElement)this).ClipChildren;
			}
		}

		protected override bool ClipSelf => !clipSelfRect.IsEmpty;

		public override Region Region
		{
			get
			{
				if (clipSelfRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					return ((UIElement)this).Region;
				}
				return new Region(clipSelfRect);
			}
		}

		public override UIRole UIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole(Rows.Band, StyleUtils.Role.SummaryFooter);

		internal Rectangle DrawingClipSelfRect => GridUtils.CalculateDrawingClipSelfRect((UIElement)(object)this, clipSelfRect);

		protected override IRawElementProviderFragment CreateUIAutomationProvider()
		{
			if (((UIElement)this).GetAncestor(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)) is RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)
			{
				UltraGridSummaryRow summaryRow = GetSummaryRow();
				RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement.RowUiaProviderStubBase rowUiaProviderStub = rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement.GetRowUiaProviderStub(summaryRow);
				if (rowUiaProviderStub != null)
				{
					return ((FragmentUIAProviderStub)rowUiaProviderStub).Provider;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public SummaryFooterUIElement(UIElement parent, RowsCollection rows)
			: this(parent, rows, SummaryDisplayAreas.Top | SummaryDisplayAreas.TopFixed | SummaryDisplayAreas.Bottom | SummaryDisplayAreas.BottomFixed)
		{
		}

		internal SummaryFooterUIElement(UIElement parent, RowsCollection rows, SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext)
			: base(parent)
		{

				{
					AccessibleObject focused = ((AccessibleObject)(object)this).GetFocused();
					if (index == 0)
					{
						uIElementInternal.VerifyChildElements();
						return focused;
					}
					index--;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < ((ArrayList)(object)uIElementInternal.ChildElements).Count; i++)
				{
					UIElement val = uIElementInternal.ChildElements[i];
					if (val.IsAccessibleElement)
					{
						if (index == 0)
						{
							return val.AccessibilityInstance;
						}
						index--;
					}
				}
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return Grid.CreateAccessibilityInstance(Grid.Rows);
				}
				index--;
				return ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChild(index);
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 0;
				UIElement uIElementInternal = grid.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal;
				if (uIElementInternal == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (((Control.ControlAccessibleObject)this).Owner.Focused)
				{
					num++;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < ((ArrayList)(object)uIElementInternal.ChildElements).Count; i++)
				{
					UIElement val = uIElementInternal.ChildElements[i];
					if (val.IsAccessibleElement)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				num++;
				return num + ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetChildCount();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				if (((Control)(object)grid).Focused)
				{
					if (grid.ActiveRow != null)
					{
						if (grid is UltraGrid)
						{
							UltraGridCell activeCell = ((UltraGrid)grid).ActiveCell;
							if (activeCell != null)
							{
								return activeCell.AccessibilityObject.GetFocused();
							}
						}
						return grid.ActiveRow.AccessibilityObject;
					}
					return (AccessibleObject)(object)this;
				}
				return ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).GetFocusedChildControl();
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				if (((Control)(object)grid).Focused && grid.ActiveRow != null && grid is UltraGrid)
				{
					UltraGridCell activeCell = ((UltraGrid)grid).ActiveCell;
					if (activeCell != null)
					{
						return activeCell.AccessibilityObject.GetSelected();
					}
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				AccessibleObject accessibleObject = ((UltraControlAccessibleObject)this).HitTest(x, y);
				if ((object)accessibleObject != this)
				{
					return accessibleObject;
				}
				UIElement uIElementInternal = grid.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal;
				if (uIElementInternal == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return uIElementInternal.HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				UIElement uIElementInternal = grid.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal;
				if (uIElementInternal == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return uIElementInternal.Navigate(navdir);
			}
		}

		private class CommitRowCallback : IRowCallback
		{
			internal CommitRowCallback()
			{
			}

			public bool ProcessRow(UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (row != null && (row.DataChanged || row.dataChangedViaCalcManager) && !row.IsUnModifiedAddRowFromTemplate)
				{
					row.Update();
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public ColScrollRegion ActiveColScrollRegion
		{
			get
			{
				if (activeColScrollRegion == null || activeColScrollRegion.Disposed)
				{
					if (DisplayLayout != null && DisplayLayout.ColScrollRegions != null)
					{
						activeColScrollRegion = (ColScrollRegion)DisplayLayout.ColScrollRegions.FirstVisibleRegion;
					}
					else
					{
						activeColScrollRegion = null;
					}
				}
				return activeColScrollRegion;
			}
			set
			{
				if (activeColScrollRegion != value)
				{
					if (value.Layout != DisplayLayout)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_293"));
					}
					activeColScrollRegion = value;
					if (currentActiveRow != null && ((Control)this).ContainsFocus && ActiveRow != null)
					{
						ActiveRow.InvalidateItemAllRegions();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue("")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		[Editor("System.Windows.Forms.Design.DataMemberListEditor, System.Design", "System.Drawing.Design.UITypeEditor, System.Drawing")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridBase_P_DataMember")]
		public string DataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return dataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataMember == null || !dataMember.Equals(value))
				{
					dataMember = ((value == null) ? string.Empty : value);
					ResetInitializeLayoutFiredFlag();
					Set_ListManager(dataSource, dataMember);
					((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.DataMember);
				}
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridBase_P_DataSource")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Data")]
		[RefreshProperties(RefreshProperties.All)]
		[AttributeProvider(typeof(IListSource))]
		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return dataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (dataSource != null && dataSource.Equals(value))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value is UltraGridRowEditTemplate ultraGridRowEditTemplate && DisplayLayout != null && DisplayLayout.BandsInternal != null)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridBand item in DisplayLayout.BandsInternal)
					{
						if (item.RowEditTemplate == ultraGridRowEditTemplate)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Invalid_DataSource_RowEditTemplate"));
						}
					}
				}
				UnhookDataSourceDisposed();
				dataSource = value;
				HookDataSourceDisposed();
				ResetInitializeLayoutFiredFlag();
				if (Utilities.IsDataMemberChangeRequired((Control)(object)this, dataSource, dataMember))
				{
					dataMember = string.Empty;
				}
				Set_ListManager(dataSource, dataMember);
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.DataSource);
			}
		}

		private void BindingListChanged(object sender, ListChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (BindingManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			_ = UltraGridBand.binding_debug;
			try
			{
				switch (e.ListChangedType)
				{
				case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorAdded:
				case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorDeleted:
				case ListChangedType.PropertyDescriptorChanged:
					if (DisplayLayout != null && DisplayLayout.SortedBands.Count > 0 && BindingManager == DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].BindingManager)
					{
						ColumnsCollection columns = DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].Columns;
						int num = columns.BoundColumnsCount - columns.ChapteredColumnsCount;
						if (num > 0)
						{
							break;
						}
						Set_ListManager(DataSource, DataMember);
					}
					ResetInitializeLayoutFiredFlag();
					goto case ListChangedType.Reset;
				case ListChangedType.Reset:
					if (DisplayLayout == null || DisplayLayout.SortedBands.Count <= 0 || BindingManager != DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].BindingManager)
					{
						Set_ListManager(DataSource, DataMember);
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		}

		internal void PaintTimer_Tick(object source, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (DisplayLayout != null && !DisplayLayout.Disposed)
			{
				if (paintTimer != null)
				{
					paintTimer.Enabled = false;
				}
				if (this is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
				{
					ultraGrid.EnsureTempActiveRowAssigned();
				}
				else if (TempActiveRow != null && ActiveRow != TempActiveRow)
				{
					ActiveRow = TempActiveRow;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetTempActiveRow(UltraGridRow tempActiveRow, bool scrollIntoView)
		{
			tempActiveRow_ScrollIntoView = tempActiveRow != null && scrollIntoView;
			if (this.tempActiveRow == tempActiveRow)
			{
				return;
			}
			this.tempActiveRow = tempActiveRow;
			if (RowSynchronizationSuspended)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (paintTimer == null && this.tempActiveRow != null)
			{
				paintTimer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
				paintTimer.Tick += PaintTimer_Tick;
			}
			if (paintTimer != null)
			{
				paintTimer.Stop();
				if (this.tempActiveRow != null)
				{
					paintTimer.Interval = 1000;
					paintTimer.Start();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ActiveRowInvalidHelper()
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = TempActiveRow;
			bool flag = ultraGridRow?.IsStillValid ?? false;
			if (flag)
			{
				tempActiveRow = null;
			}
			if (currentActiveRow != null)
			{
				foreach (RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion in DisplayLayout.RowScrollRegions)
				{
					rowScrollRegion.VerifyPivotItem();
				}
			}
			ClearActiveRow();
			if (flag)
			{
				tempActiveRow = ultraGridRow;
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyActiveRowValid()
		{
			if (currentActiveRow == null || in_getActiveRow || currentActiveRow.IsStillValid)
			{
				return;
			}
			in_getActiveRow = true;
			try
			{
				if (this is UltraGrid { ActiveCell: { IsInEditMode: not false } activeCell })
				{
					activeCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: true, forceExit: true);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			ActiveRowInvalidHelper();
			in_getActiveRow = false;
		}

		internal void SetActiveRow(UltraGridRow row, bool scrollIntoView)
		{
			if (row != null && !row.IsStillValid)
			{
				row = null;
			}
			if (row != null && row.IsTemplateAddRow && Activation.Disabled == row.ActivationResolvedInternal)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridRowEditTemplate ultraGridRowEditTemplate = null;
			if (ActiveRow != null)
			{
				ultraGridRowEditTemplate = ActiveRow.RowEditTemplateResolved;
				try
				{
					if (ultraGridRowEditTemplate != null && ultraGridRowEditTemplate.IsShown && (row == null || row.RowEditTemplateResolved != ultraGridRowEditTemplate || row.IsDisabled || row.HiddenResolved || row.Band.RowEditTemplateUITypeResolved == RowEditTemplateUIType.None))
					{
						bool forceTemplateCloseOnActionRowChanged = ActiveRow.forceTemplateCloseOnActionRowChanged;
						if (!ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Close(commitChanges: true, forceTemplateCloseOnActionRowChanged))
						{
							return;
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					ActiveRow.forceTemplateCloseOnActionRowChanged = false;
				}
			}
			TempActiveRow = null;
			if (!OnActiveRowCleared(update: true))
			{
				return;
			}
			TempActiveRow = null;
			OnActiveRowChange(row, scrollIntoView);
			if (ActiveRow != row)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ultraGridRowEditTemplate != null && ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Row != null && !ultraGridRowEditTemplate.IsShown)
			{
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = row.RowEditTemplateResolved;
				if (rowEditTemplateResolved == null || rowEditTemplateResolved != ultraGridRowEditTemplate)
				{
					ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Row = null;
				}
				else
				{
					ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Row = row;
				}
			}
			if (((Control)this).ContainsFocus)
			{
				AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.Focus, 0);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (preventPropChangeNotification)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is UltraControlPropIds && (int)(UltraControlPropIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId == 9)
			{
				UltraGridLayout displayLayout = DisplayLayout;
				if (displayLayout != null)
				{
					displayLayout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true, fInvalidate: true, dirtyColMetrics: true);
					displayLayout.ClearBandRowHeightMetrics();
					displayLayout.ClearCachedCaptionHeight();
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected virtual void OnBasePropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = DisplayLayout;
			if (displayLayout != null && propChange.Source == displayLayout)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
				{
					PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
					if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.BorderStyle || propertyIds == PropertyIds.BorderStyleCaption)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(displayLayout);
					}
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.DisplayLayout, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == layouts)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Layouts, propChange);
			}
		}

		public void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			OnBasePropChanged(propChange);
		}

		protected override void OnFontChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			DisplayLayout.ClearCachedCaptionHeight();
			DisplayLayout.OnBaseFontChanged();
			DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement();
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnFontChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnCreateControl()
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnCreateControl();
			VerifyDataSourceAttached();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && paintTimer != null)
			{
				paintTimer.Enabled = false;
				paintTimer.Tick -= PaintTimer_Tick;
				paintTimer.Dispose();
				paintTimer = null;
			}
			CalcManager = null;
			if (disposing && layout != null)
			{
				layout.SubObjectPropChanged -= OnSubObjectPropChanged;
				layout.Dispose();
				layout = null;
			}
			if (disposing)
			{
				activeColScrollRegion = null;
				activeRowScrollRegion = null;
				currentActiveRow = null;
				tempActiveRow = null;
				try
				{
					if (dataSource is IComponent)
					{
						((IComponent)dataSource).Disposed -= DataSource_Disposed;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				dataSource = null;
				dataMember = null;
				try
				{
					UnhookFromBindingManager(bindingManager);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				bindingManager = null;
				try
				{
					if (layouts != null)
					{
						layouts.SubObjectPropChanged -= SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					layouts = null;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				if (cachedColumnChooserDialog != null && !cachedColumnChooserDialog.IsDisposed)
				{
					cachedColumnChooserDialog.Dispose();
					cachedColumnChooserDialog = null;
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			initializing = true;
			if (endInitDuringDesignModeRecieved && DisplayLayout != null)
			{
				endInitDuringDesignModeRecieved = false;
				bool flag = preventPropChangeNotification;
				preventPropChangeNotification = true;
				try
				{
					DisplayLayout.InternalClearLoadedBands();
					DisplayLayout.Reset();
					UnRegisterFromCalcManager();
					DisplayLayout.dataSourceAttachedAtLeastOnce = false;
				}
				finally
				{
					preventPropChangeNotification = flag;
				}
			}
			OnBeginInit();
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			endInitDuringDesignModeRecieved = DesignMode;
			DisplayLayout.OnDeserializationComplete();
			if (layouts != null)
			{
				layouts.InitGrid(this);
				for (int i = 0; i < layouts.Count; i++)
				{
					BandsSerializer loadedBandsInternal = layouts[i].LoadedBandsInternal;
					if (loadedBandsInternal != null && loadedBandsInternal.Count > 0)
					{
						layouts[i].Bands.InternalCopyFromBandsSerializer(loadedBandsInternal, clearSource: true, calledFromEndInit: true);
					}
				}
			}
			if (DesignMode && DisplayLayout != null && DisplayLayout.Bands.Count > 0 && DisplayLayout.LoadedBandsInternal != null && DisplayLayout.LoadedBandsInternal.Count > 0)
			{
				DisplayLayout.ApplyLoadedBandsHelper();
			}
			HookDesignerHostLoaded();
			initializing = false;
			DisplayLayout.SynchGridBackColor();
			OnEndInit();
		}

		private void HookDesignerHostLoaded()
		{
			if (DesignMode && ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost designerHost)
			{
				if (designerHost.InTransaction)
				{
					designerHost.TransactionClosing += OnDesignerTransactionClosing;
					delayDesignTimeDataSourceInitialization = true;
				}
				else if (designerHost.Loading)
				{
					designerHost.LoadComplete += OnDesignerHostLoadComplete;
					delayDesignTimeDataSourceInitialization = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnDesignerTransactionClosing(object sender, DesignerTransactionCloseEventArgs e)
		{
			delayDesignTimeDataSourceInitialization = false;
			DesignTimeDataSourceInitialization();
			if (((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost designerHost)
			{
				designerHost.TransactionClosing -= OnDesignerTransactionClosing;
			}
		}

		private void DesignTimeDataSourceInitialization()
		{
			preventPropChangeNotification = true;
			try
			{
				_ = deserializedColumnsToActualColumnsMap;
				deserializedColumnsToActualColumnsMap = new Dictionary<UltraGridColumn, UltraGridColumn>();
				VerifyDataSourceAttached();
				if (((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost designerHost && designerHost.GetDesigner((IComponent)this) is IUltraGridDesigner ultraGridDesigner)
				{
					ultraGridDesigner.FixUpCachhedSubObjects(deserializedColumnsToActualColumnsMap);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				deserializedColumnsToActualColumnsMap = null;
				preventPropChangeNotification = false;
			}
		}

		private void OnDesignerHostLoadComplete(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			delayDesignTimeDataSourceInitialization = false;
			DesignTimeDataSourceInitialization();
			if (((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IDesignerHost)) is IDesignerHost designerHost)
			{
				designerHost.LoadComplete -= OnDesignerHostLoadComplete;
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyDataSourceAttached()
		{
			if (((Control)(object)this).BindingContext == null || dontLoadDataSource || delayDesignTimeDataSourceInitialization || in_VerifyDataSourceAttached)
			{
				return;
			}
			in_VerifyDataSourceAttached = true;
			try
			{
				if (inSet_ListManager)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (DisplayLayout.Bands.Count < 1 || DisplayLayout.Bands[0].BindingManager == null)
				{
					if (dataSource != null)
					{
						Set_ListManager(dataSource, dataMember);
					}
					else if (DisplayLayout != null && DisplayLayout.LoadedBandsInternal != null && DisplayLayout.LoadedBandsInternal.Count > 0)
					{
						DisplayLayout.Bands.InternalCopyFromBandsSerializer(DisplayLayout.LoadedBandsInternal, clearSource: false);
						DisplayLayout.DisposeRows();
						BandsCollection.InitializeParentBandPointers(DisplayLayout.Bands);
						foreach (UltraGridBand band in DisplayLayout.Bands)
						{
							if (band != null && band.ParentColumn != null)
							{
								band.ParentColumn.InternalSetCachedIsChaptered(val: true);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				DisplayLayout.ApplyLoadedBands();
				if (DisplayLayout.Bands.Layout == null)
				{
					DisplayLayout.Bands.InitLayout(DisplayLayout);
				}
				RegisterWithCalcManager();
			}
			finally
			{
				in_VerifyDataSourceAttached = false;
			}
		}

			return GetBandString(bandsColl, band) + "/" + column.Key;
		}

		private static string GetBandString(BandsCollection bandsColl, UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (bandsColl.Count <= 0 || band != bandsColl[0])
			{
				return band.Key;
			}
			return "/";
		}

		public void SetDataBinding(object dataSource, string dataMember, bool hideNewColumns)
		{
			SetDataBinding(dataSource, dataMember, hideNewColumns, NewBandLoadStyle.Hide == DisplayLayout.NewBandLoadStyle);
		}

		public void SetDataBinding(object dataSource, string dataMember, bool hideNewColumns, bool hideNewBands)
		{
			DisplayLayout.newColumnLoadStyleOverride = NewColumnLoadStyle.Show;
			DisplayLayout.newBandLoadStyleOverride = NewBandLoadStyle.Show;
			try
			{
				SetDataBindingHelper(dataSource, dataMember, hideNewColumns, hideNewBands);
			}
			finally
			{
				DisplayLayout.newColumnLoadStyleOverride = null;
				DisplayLayout.newBandLoadStyleOverride = null;
			}
		}

		private void SetDataBindingHelper(object dataSource, string dataMember, bool hideNewColumns, bool hideNewBands)
		{
			Hashtable hashtable = null;
			Hashtable hashtable2 = null;
			if ((hideNewColumns || hideNewBands) && DisplayLayout != null)
			{
				BandsCollection bandsCollection = DisplayLayout.SortedBands;
				if (bandsCollection == null || bandsCollection.Count <= 0 || bandsCollection[0].Columns.Count <= 0)
				{
					bandsCollection = DisplayLayout.LoadedBandsInternal;
				}
				if (bandsCollection != null)
				{
					hashtable = new Hashtable();
					hashtable2 = new Hashtable();
					foreach (UltraGridBand item in bandsCollection)
					{
						hashtable2[GetBandString(bandsCollection, item)] = item;
						if (item.Columns == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (UltraGridColumn column in item.Columns)
						{
							if (column.Key.Length > 0)
							{
								hashtable[GetBandColumnString(bandsCollection, item, column)] = new object();
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			UnhookDataSourceDisposed();
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
			this.dataMember = dataMember;
			HookDataSourceDisposed();
			ResetInitializeLayoutFiredFlag();
			Set_ListManager(this.dataSource, this.dataMember);
			if ((hideNewColumns || hideNewBands) && hashtable != null && DisplayLayout != null && DisplayLayout.SortedBands != null)
			{
				BandsCollection sortedBands = DisplayLayout.SortedBands;
				foreach (UltraGridBand item2 in sortedBands)
				{
					if (item2.Columns == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					bool flag = false;
					foreach (UltraGridColumn column2 in item2.Columns)
					{
						flag = hashtable.ContainsKey(GetBandColumnString(sortedBands, item2, column2));
						if (flag)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
					if (flag || NewColumnLoadStyle.Hide == DisplayLayout.NewColumnLoadStyle)
					{
						foreach (UltraGridColumn column3 in item2.Columns)
						{
							if (hideNewColumns && !hashtable.ContainsKey(GetBandColumnString(sortedBands, item2, column3)))
							{
								column3.Hidden = true;
							}
						}
					}
					if (hideNewBands && hashtable2 != null && !hashtable2.ContainsKey(GetBandString(sortedBands, item2)))
					{
						item2.Hidden = true;
					}
				}
			}
			RefreshColumnChoosers();
		}

		private void UnhookFromBindingManager(BindingManagerBase bindingManager)
		{
			if (bindingManager is CurrencyManager currencyManager && currencyManager.List is IBindingList)
			{
				IBindingList bindingList = (IBindingList)currencyManager.List;
				if (bindingList != null)
				{
					bindingList.ListChanged -= BindingListChanged;
				}
			}
		}

		private void Set_ListManager(object newDataSource, string newDataMember)
		{
			if (Initializing || dontLoadDataSource || inSet_ListManager)
			{
				return;
			}
			inSet_ListManager = true;
			try
			{
				if (this is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
				{
					ultraGrid.Selected.Rows.Clear();
					ultraGrid.Selected.Cells.Clear();
					ultraGrid.Selected.Columns.Clear();
				}
				UpdateListManager();
				bool flag = bindingManager != null;
				UnhookFromBindingManager(bindingManager);
				if (DataSource != null && ((Control)(object)this).BindingContext != null)
				{
					bindingManager = ((Control)(object)this).BindingContext[DataSource, DataMember];
				}
				else
				{
					bindingManager = null;
					DisplayLayout.dataSourceAttachedAtLeastOnce = false;
				}
				if (bindingManager is CurrencyManager currencyManager && currencyManager.List is IBindingList)
				{
					IBindingList bindingList = (IBindingList)currencyManager.List;
					if (bindingList != null)
					{
						bindingList.ListChanged += BindingListChanged;
					}
				}
				if (DisplayLayout != null)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						DisplayLayout.ClearMainUIElement();
					}
					DisplayLayout.ListManagerUpdated();
					DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal.DirtyChildElements();
					DisplayLayout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
					DisplayLayout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
					DisplayLayout.BumpSummariesVersion();
					if (DisplayLayout.BandsInternal != null)
					{
						DisplayLayout.BandsInternal.DirtyCachedContainsCheckboxOnTopOrBottom();
					}
					DisplayLayout.BumpHeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion(null);
					OnListManagerSet();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inSet_ListManager = false;
				if (newDataSource == null && layout != null)
				{
					layout.DisposeRows();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void OnListManagerSet()
		{
		}

		private void UpdateListManager()
		{
			try
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ((DisplayLayout != null) ? DisplayLayout.ActiveCell : null);
				if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					ultraGridCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: true);
				}
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = ((DisplayLayout != null) ? DisplayLayout.ActiveRow : null);
				if (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.IsUnModifiedAddRowFromTemplate)
				{
					ultraGridRow.CancelUpdate();
				}
				if (bindingManager != null)
				{
					bindingManager.EndCurrentEdit();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetFirstLastRowHelper(bool first)
		{
			if (Rows.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (first)
			{
				return Rows[0];
			}
			return Rows[Rows.Count - 1];
		}

		public UltraGridRow GetRow(ChildRow child)
		{
			return child switch
			{
				ChildRow.First => GetFirstLastRowHelper(first: true), 
				ChildRow.Last => GetFirstLastRowHelper(first: false), 
				_ => throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_294")), 
			};
		}

		public ColScrollRegion GetActiveColScrollRegion(bool initializeMetrics)
		{
			if (activeColScrollRegion != null)
			{
				if (initializeMetrics)
				{
					DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics);
				}
				return activeColScrollRegion;
			}
			if (DisplayLayout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegions = DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics);
			if (colScrollRegions == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (colScrollRegions.Count < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			activeColScrollRegion = colScrollRegions.DefaultActiveRegion;
			return activeColScrollRegion;
		}

		internal void OnKeyDownForwarded(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DisplayLayout == null)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).OnKeyDown(e);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = this as UltraGrid;
			if ((Keys.Tab == e.KeyData || (Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift) == e.KeyData) && ultraGrid != null && DisplayLayout.TabNavigation == TabNavigation.NextControlOnLastCell)
			{
				flag = ((e.Modifiers != Keys.Shift) ? ultraGrid.IsActiveCellLastVisibleCell() : ultraGrid.IsActiveCellFirstVisibleCell());
			}
			if (flag || ((Keys.Tab == e.KeyData || (Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift) == e.KeyData) && (DisplayLayout.TabNavigation == TabNavigation.NextControl || this is UltraCombo)))
			{
				if (!DisplayLayout.ExitEditModeHelper())
				{
					return;
				}
				try
				{
					Control parent = ((Control)this).Parent;
					while (parent != null && !(parent is UserControl))
					{
						parent = parent.Parent;
					}
					if ((Keys.Tab == e.KeyData || (Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift) == e.KeyData) && this is UltraCombo && parent is UserControl)
					{
						UltraCombo ultraCombo = (UltraCombo)this;
						bool dontGiveFocusToTextBox = ultraCombo.dontGiveFocusToTextBox;
						ultraCombo.dontGiveFocusToTextBox = true;
						try
						{
							ultraCombo.Focus();
						}
						finally
						{
							ultraCombo.dontGiveFocusToTextBox = dontGiveFocusToTextBox;
						}
						((Control)(object)this).ProcessDialogKey(e.KeyData);
						OnSelectingNextControl();
					}
					else
					{
						OnSelectingNextControl();
						if (((UltraControlBase)this).SetFocusToNextControl(!e.Shift))
						{
							e.Handled = true;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			EditorContainerControlOnKeyDown(e);
		}

		}

		internal void OnKeyUpForwarded(KeyEventArgs e)

			((Control)(object)this).OnKeyUp(e);
		}

		internal void OnMouseWheelInternal(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			HandledMouseEventArgs e2 = e as HandledMouseEventArgs;
			if (e2 != null && e2.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool handled = false;
			try
			{
				Control controlForGridDisplay = ControlForGridDisplay;
				Point point = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
				if ((object)controlForGridDisplay != this && controlForGridDisplay != null && !controlForGridDisplay.IsDisposed && !((Control)this).IsDisposed)
				{
					point = EditorContainerControl.PointToScreen(point);
					point = controlForGridDisplay.PointToClient(point);
				}
				UIElement val = DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal.ElementFromPoint(point);
				UltraGridCell activeCell = DisplayLayout.ActiveCell;
				IValueList val2 = activeCell?.ValueListResolved;
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					EmbeddableEditorBase val3 = (EmbeddableEditorBase)((activeCell != null) ? /*isinst with value type is only supported in some contexts*/: null);
					if (val3 != null && val3.IsInEditMode && val3.SupportsDropDown && val3.IsDroppedDown)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				if (activeCell is UltraGridFilterCell && activeCell.IsInEditMode && (val2 == null || !val2.IsDroppedDown) && FilterOperatorLocation.Hidden != activeCell.Column.FilterOperatorLocationResolved)
				{
					IValueList valueList = ((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)activeCell.Column.FilterOperatorEditorOwnerInfo).GetValueList((object)activeCell);
					if (valueList != null && valueList.IsDroppedDown)
					{
						val2 = valueList;
					}
				}
				if (val2 != null && val2.IsDroppedDown)
				{
					if (val2 is UltraDropDownBase ultraDropDownBase && ultraDropDownBase.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollBarInfo.Visible && ultraDropDownBase.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollBarInfo.EnabledResolved)
					{
						if (e.Delta < 0)
						{
							ultraDropDownBase.ActiveRowScrollRegion.Scroll(RowScrollAction.LineDown);
						}
						else
						{
							ultraDropDownBase.ActiveRowScrollRegion.Scroll(RowScrollAction.LineUp);
						}
						handled = true;
					}
					return;
				}
				if (DisplayLayout.Grid is UltraGrid)
				{
					UltraGrid ultraGrid = DisplayLayout.Grid as UltraGrid;
					if (ultraGrid.HasSwapDropDown && ((IValueList)ultraGrid.SwapDropDown).IsDroppedDown)
					{
						ultraGrid.SwapDropDown.ProcessOnMouseWheel(e);
						handled = true;
						return;
					}
					if (ultraGrid.HasFilterDropDown && ((IValueList)ultraGrid.FilterDropDown).IsDroppedDown)
					{
						ultraGrid.FilterDropDown.ProcessOnMouseWheel(e);
						handled = true;
						return;
					}
				}
				if (val != null && val.GetAncestor(typeof(CardAreaUIElement)) is CardAreaUIElement cardAreaUIElement && ((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).Rect.Contains(point) && cardAreaUIElement.OnMouseWheel(e))
				{
					handled = true;
					return;
				}
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = null;
				if (val != null)
				{
					rowScrollRegion = val.GetContext(typeof(RowScrollRegion)) as RowScrollRegion;
				}
				if (rowScrollRegion == null)
				{
					rowScrollRegion = ActiveRowScrollRegion;
				}
				if (rowScrollRegion == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (rowScrollRegion.ScrollBarInfo.Visible && rowScrollRegion.ScrollBarInfo.EnabledResolved && (rowScrollRegion.Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay == null || rowScrollRegion.Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.Visible))
				{
					int num = Math.Max(1, SystemInformation.MouseWheelScrollLines);
					bool dontUpdateInOnScroll = rowScrollRegion.dontUpdateInOnScroll;
					if (num > 1)
					{
						rowScrollRegion.dontUpdateInOnScroll = true;
					}
					try
					{
						int num2 = Math.Max(1, Math.Abs(e.Delta) / SystemInformation.MouseWheelScrollDelta);
						num *= num2;
						if (e.Delta < 0)
						{
							rowScrollRegion.ScrollLines(num);
						}
						else
						{
							rowScrollRegion.ScrollLines(-num);
						}
						handled = true;
					}
					finally
					{
						rowScrollRegion.dontUpdateInOnScroll = dontUpdateInOnScroll;
					}
				}
				if (!(this is UltraDropDownBase ultraDropDownBase2))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ultraDropDownBase2.IsDroppedDown)
				{
					handled = true;
				}
				else if (ultraDropDownBase2 is UltraCombo { DropDownStyle: UltraComboStyle.DropDownList } ultraCombo && e.Delta != 0)
				{
					bool flag = e.Delta > 0;
					IValueList val4 = (IValueList)(object)ultraCombo;
					if (val4 != null)
					{
						val4.MoveNextItemPreviousItem(flag);
					}
					handled = true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (e2 != null)
				{
					e2.Handled = handled;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool IsPointDesignTimeActive(Point pt)
		{
			UIElement val = DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal.ElementFromPoint(pt);
			if (val != null && (val.GetAncestor(typeof(BandHeadersUIElement)) != null || val.GetAncestor(typeof(HeaderUIElement)) != null || val is ColSplitBoxUIElement || val is ColSplitterBarUIElement || val is ExpansionIndicatorUIElement || val.GetAncestor(typeof(GroupByButtonUIElement)) != null || val is GroupByRowExpansionIndicatorUIElement || val is RowSplitBoxUIElement || val is RowSplitterBarUIElement || val is SplitterIntersectionUIElement || val is SwapButtonUIElement))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return ((UltraControlBase)this).IsPointDesignTimeActive(pt);
		}

		protected internal virtual AccessibleObject CreateAccessibilityInstance(object relatedObject)
		{
			//IL_0144: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0189: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AccessibleObject result = null;
			if (relatedObject is UltraGridCell)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new UltraGridCell.CellAccessibleObject(relatedObject as UltraGridCell)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is UltraGridRow)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new UltraGridRow.RowAccessibleObject(relatedObject as UltraGridRow)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement.RowColRegionAccessibleObject(relatedObject as RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is ColumnHeader.ColumnHeaderAccessibleObject)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)(relatedObject as ColumnHeader.ColumnHeaderAccessibleObject)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is GroupHeader.GroupHeaderAccessibleObject)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)(relatedObject as GroupHeader.GroupHeaderAccessibleObject)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is BandHeader.BandHeaderAccessibleObject)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)(relatedObject as BandHeader.BandHeaderAccessibleObject)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is HeadersCollection.HeadersAccessibleObject)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)(relatedObject as HeadersCollection.HeadersAccessibleObject)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject == this)
			{
				result = (AccessibleObject)(object)new UltraGridBaseAccessibleObject(this);
			}
			else if (relatedObject is CaptionAreaUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new CaptionAreaUIElement.CaptionAreaAccessibleObject(relatedObject as CaptionAreaUIElement)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is DataAreaUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new DataAreaUIElement.DataAreaAccessibleObject(relatedObject as DataAreaUIElement)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is AddNewRowButtonUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new AddNewRowButtonUIElement.AddNewButtonAccessibleObject(relatedObject as AddNewRowButtonUIElement)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is AddNewBoxUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new UIElementAccessibleObject((UIElement)((relatedObject is UIElement) ? relatedObject : null), AccessibleRole.Grouping, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_AddNewBoxArea"))).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is GroupByButtonUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new GroupByButtonUIElement.GroupByButtonAccessibleObject(relatedObject as GroupByButtonUIElement)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is GroupByBoxUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new UIElementAccessibleObject((UIElement)(object)(relatedObject as GroupByBoxUIElement), AccessibleRole.Grouping, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_GroupByBox"))).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is GroupByBandLabelUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new GroupByBandLabelUIElement.GroupByBandlLabelAccessibleObject(relatedObject as GroupByBandLabelUIElement)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is GroupByBoxPromptUIElement)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new GroupByBoxPromptUIElement.GroupByPromptAccessibleObject(relatedObject as GroupByBoxPromptUIElement)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			else if (relatedObject is RowsCollection)
			{
				result = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)new RowsCollectionAccessibleObject(relatedObject as RowsCollection)).AccessibleObject;
			}
			return result;
		}

			{
				((Control)this).AccessibilityNotifyClients(accEvent, childID);
			}
		}

		string[] ISupportPresets.GetPresetProperties(PresetType presetType)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0066: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0068: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			list.Add("DisplayLayout");
			if ((presetType & 1) == 1)
			{
				list.Add("BackColor");
				list.Add("BackgroundImage");
				list.Add("ForeColor");
				list.Add("FlatMode");
				list.Add("Font");
				list.Add("SupportThemes");
				list.Add("Text");
			}
			if ((presetType & 2) == 2)
			{
				list.Add("UpdateMode");
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		}

		internal void OnCalcReferenceDirtied(object sender, UltraCalcReferenceEventArgs e)
		{
			IUltraCalcReference underlyingReference = RefUtils.GetUnderlyingReference(e.Reference);
			if (!(underlyingReference is UltraGridRefBase ultraGridRefBase) || this != ultraGridRefBase.Grid)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (underlyingReference is FormulaRefBase formulaRefBase)
			{
				formulaRefBase.valueDirtyCounter++;
				formulaRefBase.visibleCounter++;
				formulaRefBase.InvalidateUIElement();
				return;
			}
			if (underlyingReference is FormulaTargetRefBase { ContainingFormulaRef: var containingFormulaRef } formulaTargetRefBase)
			{
				if (containingFormulaRef != null)
				{
					formulaTargetRefBase.verifiedValueDirtyCounter = containingFormulaRef.valueDirtyCounter - 1;
					formulaTargetRefBase.verifiedRecalcVisibleVersion = containingFormulaRef.visibleCounter - 1;
				}
				formulaTargetRefBase.InvalidateUIElement();
				return;
			}
			if (underlyingReference is NestedColumnReference nestedColumnReference)
			{
				nestedColumnReference.Column.CalcReference.visibleCounter++;
				if (nestedColumnReference.Rows.ParentRow == null)
				{
					nestedColumnReference.Column.CalcReference.valueDirtyCounter++;
				}
				nestedColumnReference.InvalidateUIElement();
			}
			if (underlyingReference is NestedSummarySettingsReference nestedSummarySettingsReference)
			{
				nestedSummarySettingsReference.SummaryReference.visibleCounter++;
				nestedSummarySettingsReference.InvalidateUIElement();
			}
		}

		internal void RegisterWithCalcManager()
		{
			if (DisplayLayout == null || DisplayLayout.CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended || lastCalcManagerGridRegisteredTo == calcManager)
			{
				return;
			}
			UnRegisterFromCalcManager();
			if (calcManager != null)
			{
				string name = ((Control)this).Name;
				if (name == null || name.Length == 0)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("CalcManager requires that a unique name be given to every control participating with the calc manager.");
				}
			}
			try
			{
				if (calcManager != null)
				{
					calcManager.CalcEngineDirtyValue += OnCalcReferenceDirtied;
					calcManager.AddParticipant(this);
					IUltraCalcReference rootReference = ((IUltraCalcParticipant)this).RootReference;
					if (rootReference != null)
					{
						calcManager.AddReference(rootReference);
					}
				}
				if (DisplayLayout != null && !DisplayLayout.Disposed)
				{
					DisplayLayout.RehookWithCalcManager(lastCalcManagerGridRegisteredTo);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				lastCalcManagerGridRegisteredTo = calcManager;
			}
		}

		internal void UnRegisterFromCalcManager()
		{
			if (lastCalcManagerGridRegisteredTo == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IUltraCalcReference rootReference = ((IUltraCalcParticipant)this).RootReference;
			try
			{
				calcManager.CalcEngineDirtyValue -= OnCalcReferenceDirtied;
				if (rootReference != null)
				{
					lastCalcManagerGridRegisteredTo.RemoveReference(rootReference);
				}
				lastCalcManagerGridRegisteredTo.RemoveParticipant(this);
			}
			finally
			{
				lastCalcManagerGridRegisteredTo = null;
			}
		}

		ReferenceNode IUltraCalcParticipant.GetDesignerReferences(IFormulaProvider formulaProvider)
		{
			ReferenceNode referenceNode = ((DisplayLayout != null) ? DisplayLayout.GetDesignerReferences() : null);
			if (referenceNode != null && DisplayLayout.CalcReference != null)
			{
				referenceNode = new ReferenceNode(DisplayLayout.CalcReference, new ReferenceNode[1] { referenceNode }, isDataReference: false);
			}
			return referenceNode;
		}

		void IUltraCalcParticipant.RecreateReference()
		{
			if (DisplayLayout != null && !DisplayLayout.Disposed && !((Control)this).Disposing && !((Control)this).IsDisposed)
			{
				DisplayLayout.RecreateCalcReference();
			}
		}

		public override void EndUpdate(bool invalidate)
		{
			if (invalidate && DisplayLayout != null)
			{
				DisplayLayout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).EndUpdate(invalidate);
		}

		public override void Refresh()
		{
			if (DisplayLayout != null && !DisplayLayout.Disposed && DisplayLayout.HasUIElement)
			{
				DisplayLayout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
				DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, fInvalidate: false);
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).Refresh();
		}

		{
			if (DisplayLayout != null)
			{
				BandsCollection sortedBands = DisplayLayout.SortedBands;
				if (sortedBands != null)
				{
					Rows.InternalTraverseRowsHelper(new CommitRowCallback(), recursive: true, onlyAllocatedRows: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ShowColumnChooser(UltraGridBand band, bool allowBandSelection, string dialogCaption, bool disposeOnClose, Rectangle dialogRect)
		{
			//IL_01cf: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d4: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			if (!DisplayLayout.ExitEditModeHelper(cell: false))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (dialogCaption == null)
			{
				dialogCaption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ColumnChooserDialogCaption");
			}
			if (dialogCaption == null)
			{
				dialogCaption = string.Empty;
			}
			if (cachedColumnChooserDialog == null || cachedColumnChooserDialog.IsDisposed)
			{
				cachedColumnChooserDialog = new ColumnChooserDialog(((UltraControlBase)this).ZoomFactor);
			}
			ZoomManager.SyncZoomLevels((UltraControlBase)(object)cachedColumnChooserDialog.ColumnChooserControl.DisplayGrid, (UltraControlBase)(object)this);
			ColumnChooserDialog columnChooserDialog = cachedColumnChooserDialog;
			columnChooserDialog.DisposeOnClose = (DefaultableBoolean)(disposeOnClose ? 1 : 2);
			columnChooserDialog.Text = dialogCaption;
			Form form = DisplayLayout.Form;
			if (form != null)
			{
				columnChooserDialog.Owner = null;
				columnChooserDialog.Owner = form;
			}
			columnChooserDialog.RightToLeft = ((Control)(object)this).RightToLeft;
			columnChooserDialog.ColumnChooserControl.SourceGrid = this;
			columnChooserDialog.ColumnChooserControl.CurrentBand = band;
			Rectangle desktopBounds = columnChooserDialog.DesktopBounds;
			if (-1 != dialogRect.Left)
			{
				desktopBounds.X = dialogRect.Left;
			}
			if (-1 != dialogRect.Top)
			{
				desktopBounds.Y = dialogRect.Top;
			}
			if (dialogRect.Width != 0)
			{
				desktopBounds.Width = dialogRect.Width;
			}
			if (dialogRect.Height != 0)
			{
				desktopBounds.Height = dialogRect.Height;
			}
			if (-1 != dialogRect.Left || -1 != dialogRect.Top)
			{
				columnChooserDialog.StartPosition = FormStartPosition.Manual;
			}
			columnChooserDialog.DesktopBounds = desktopBounds;
			columnChooserDialog.ColumnChooserControl.MultipleBandSupport = ((!allowBandSelection) ? ((band == null) ? MultipleBandSupport.DisplayColumnsFromAllBands : MultipleBandSupport.SingleBandOnly) : MultipleBandSupport.ShowBandSelectionUI);
			string styleSetName = ((UltraControlBase)this).StyleSetName;
			if (styleSetName != null && styleSetName.Length > 0)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)columnChooserDialog.ColumnChooserControl.DisplayGrid).StyleSetName = styleSetName;
			}
			((UltraControlBase)columnChooserDialog.ColumnChooserControl.DisplayGrid).StyleLibraryName = ((UltraControlBase)this).StyleLibraryName;
			((UltraControlBase)columnChooserDialog.ColumnChooserControl.DisplayGrid).UseAppStyling = ((UltraControlBase)this).UseAppStyling;
			BeforeColumnChooserDisplayedEventArgs e = new BeforeColumnChooserDisplayedEventArgs(columnChooserDialog);
			FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeColumnChooserDisplayed, e);
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				if (2 != (int)columnChooserDialog.DisposeOnClose)
				{
					cachedColumnChooserDialog = null;
				}
				columnChooserDialog.Show();
			}
			else if (disposeOnClose && cachedColumnChooserDialog != null)
			{
				if (!cachedColumnChooserDialog.IsDisposed)
				{
					cachedColumnChooserDialog.Dispose();
				}
				cachedColumnChooserDialog = null;
			}
		}

		internal void RegisterColumnChooser(UltraGridColumnChooser cc)
		{
			if (registeredColumnChoosers == null)
			{
				registeredColumnChoosers = new List<UltraGridColumnChooser>();
			}
			columnChooserHasBeenDispalyedAtLeastOnce = true;
			if (!registeredColumnChoosers.Contains(cc))
			{
				registeredColumnChoosers.Add(cc);
			}
		}

		internal void UnRegisterColumnChooser(UltraGridColumnChooser cc)
		{
			if (registeredColumnChoosers != null)
			{
				registeredColumnChoosers.Remove(cc);
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridColumnChooser[] GetRegisteredColumnChoosers(bool visibleOnly)
		{
			if (registeredColumnChoosers != null)
			{
				for (int num = registeredColumnChoosers.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					UltraGridColumnChooser ultraGridColumnChooser = registeredColumnChoosers[num];
					if (ultraGridColumnChooser == null || ultraGridColumnChooser.IsDisposed)
					{
						registeredColumnChoosers.RemoveAt(num);
					}
				}
				if (registeredColumnChoosers.Count == 0)
				{
					registeredColumnChoosers = null;
				}
			}
			List<UltraGridColumnChooser> list = registeredColumnChoosers;
			if (visibleOnly)
			{
				list = new List<UltraGridColumnChooser>();
				if (registeredColumnChoosers != null)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridColumnChooser registeredColumnChooser in registeredColumnChoosers)
					{
						if (registeredColumnChooser.Visible)
						{
							list.Add(registeredColumnChooser);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (list == null)
			{
				return new UltraGridColumnChooser[0];
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal bool IsOverColumnChooser()
		{
			return IsOverColumnChooser(Control.MousePosition, mousePosInScreenCoordinate: true);
		}

		internal bool IsOverColumnChooser(Point mousePos, bool mousePosInScreenCoordinate)
		{
			return GetColumnChooserUnder(mousePos, mousePosInScreenCoordinate) != null;
		}

		internal bool ShouldScrollGridOnDragMoveHelper(Point mouseLocInClient)
		{
			if (IsOverColumnChooser(mouseLocInClient, mousePosInScreenCoordinate: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridColumnChooser draggingColumnChooser = GetDraggingColumnChooser();
			if (draggingColumnChooser != null)
			{
				if (cachedColumnChooserDragInfo != null)
				{
					return cachedColumnChooserDragInfo.mouseHasBeenInGridWhileDragging;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal UltraGridColumnChooser GetColumnChooserUnder(Point mousePos, bool mousePosInScreenCoordinate)
		{
			Point p = (mousePosInScreenCoordinate ? mousePos : EditorContainerControl.PointToScreen(mousePos));
			UltraGridColumnChooser[] array = GetRegisteredColumnChoosers(visibleOnly: true);
			foreach (UltraGridColumnChooser ultraGridColumnChooser in array)
			{
				Point pt = ultraGridColumnChooser.PointToClient(p);
				if (ultraGridColumnChooser.ClientRectangle.Contains(pt))
				{
					return ultraGridColumnChooser;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal virtual UltraGridColumn[] GetItemsBeingDragged(out bool isDraggingGroupByButton)
		{
			isDraggingGroupByButton = false;
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraGridColumnChooser GetDraggingColumnChooser()
		{
			if (cachedColumnChooserDragInfo != null && cachedColumnChooserDragInfo.draggingColumnChooser != null)
			{
				return cachedColumnChooserDragInfo.draggingColumnChooser;
			}
			UltraGridColumnChooser[] array = GetRegisteredColumnChoosers(visibleOnly: true);
			foreach (UltraGridColumnChooser ultraGridColumnChooser in array)
			{
				if (ultraGridColumnChooser.IsDraggingFromThisColumnChooser)
				{
					return ultraGridColumnChooser;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void ColumnChooser_OnDragStart()
		{
			cachedColumnChooserDragInfo = null;
			bool isDraggingGroupByButton;
			UltraGridColumn[] itemsBeingDragged = GetItemsBeingDragged(out isDraggingGroupByButton);
			if (itemsBeingDragged == null || itemsBeingDragged.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridColumn[] array = itemsBeingDragged;
			foreach (UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn in array)
			{
				if (ExcludeFromColumnChooser.True == ultraGridColumn.ExcludeFromColumnChooserResolved)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			cachedColumnChooserDragInfo = new ColumnChooserCache();
			cachedColumnChooserDragInfo.dragColumns = itemsBeingDragged;
			cachedColumnChooserDragInfo.draggingColumnChooser = GetDraggingColumnChooser();
			cachedColumnChooserDragInfo.isDraggingGroupByButton = isDraggingGroupByButton;
		}

		internal bool ColumnChooser_OnDragMove(Point mouseLocInClient, out CurrentCursor cursorToDisplay)
		{
			bool result = false;
			cursorToDisplay = CurrentCursor.Default;
			if (cachedColumnChooserDragInfo != null)
			{
				if (!cachedColumnChooserDragInfo.mouseHasBeenInGridWhileDragging)
				{
					UIElement val = DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal.ElementFromPoint(mouseLocInClient);
					if (val != null)
					{
						val = val.GetAncestor(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement));
					}
					if (val != null && val.Rect.Contains(mouseLocInClient))
					{
						cachedColumnChooserDragInfo.mouseHasBeenInGridWhileDragging = true;
					}
				}
				Point mouseLocInScreen = EditorContainerControl.PointToScreen(mouseLocInClient);
				UltraGridColumnChooser[] array = GetRegisteredColumnChoosers(visibleOnly: true);
				foreach (UltraGridColumnChooser ultraGridColumnChooser in array)
				{
					ultraGridColumnChooser.OnDragMove(mouseLocInScreen);
				}
				result = ColumnChooser_DragDropHelper(mouseLocInClient, performDrop: false, out cursorToDisplay);
			}
			return result;
		}

			ColumnChooser_SetHidden(column, hidden, null);
		}

		internal void ColumnChooser_SetHidden(UltraGridColumn column, bool hidden, ILayoutGroup newParentGroup)
		{
			ColumnChooser_SetHidden(column, hidden, newParentGroup, firePosChangedNotifications: true);
		}

		internal void ColumnChooser_SetHidden(UltraGridColumn column, bool hidden, ILayoutGroup newParentGroup, bool firePosChangedNotifications)
		{
			firePosChangedNotifications = firePosChangedNotifications && column.Hidden != hidden;
			if (firePosChangedNotifications)
			{
				BeforeColPosChangedEventArgs e = new BeforeColPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.HiddenStateChanged, new ColumnHeader[1] { column.Header }, PosChangedType.HiddenStateChanged);
				FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeColPosChanged, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			column.Hidden = hidden;
			if (!hidden && column.IsGroupByColumn)
			{
				column.HiddenWhenGroupByOverride = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			}
			if (!column.HiddenResolved && column.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				EnsureItemDoesntOverlap(column, spanXChanged: true, newParentGroup);
			}
			if (hidden)
			{

		public static Rectangle GetLayoutGroupRect(UltraGridGroup group, UIElement containingElement)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("group");
			}
			if (containingElement == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("containingElement");
			}
			UltraGridBand band = group.Band;
			if (band == null)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			if (band.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("This method is only valid for groups whose Band's RowLayoutStyle is to set to GroupLayout.");
			}
			if (containingElement is RowUIElement)
			{
				containingElement = containingElement.GetDescendant(typeof(RowCellAreaUIElement));
			}
			if (!(containingElement is BandHeadersUIElement) && !(containingElement is CardLabelAreaUIElement) && !(containingElement is RowCellAreaUIElement))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("containingElement must be a BandHeadersUIElement, RowUIElement, RowCellAreaUIElement, or CardLabelAreaUIElement.");
			}
			List<IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo> groupsAndColumns = UltraGridBand.GetGroupsAndColumns(band);
			List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>();
			foreach (IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo item in groupsAndColumns)
			{
				if (!UltraGridGroup.IsDescendantOfGroup(group, item))
				{
					continue;
				}
				UIElementEnumerator enumerator2 = containingElement.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					while (enumerator2.MoveNext())
					{
						UIElement current2 = enumerator2.Current;
						if (current2.HasContext((object)item.Header) || current2.HasContext((object)item))
						{
							list.Add(current2);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (enumerator2 is IDisposable disposable)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count == 0)
			{
				return Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			Rectangle rectangle = list[0].Rect;
			for (int i = 1; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				rectangle = Rectangle.Union(rectangle, list[i].Rect);
			}
			return rectangle;
		}

			while (!flag && ultraGridGroup != null)
			{
				flag = (object)ultraGridGroup == group;
				ultraGridGroup = ultraGridGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.ParentGroup;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		protected override void OnTouchProviderRegistrationChanged(ITouchProvider touchProvider, int touchProviderListVersion)
		{
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = DisplayLayout;
			displayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics();
			displayLayout.ClearBandRowHeightMetrics(null);
			DirtyChildElementRecursive((UIElement)(object)displayLayout.UIElement);
			foreach (UltraGridBand band in displayLayout.Bands)
			{
				band.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnTouchProviderRegistrationChanged(touchProvider, touchProviderListVersion);
		}

		protected override void OnTouchProviderStateChange(bool invalidate)
		{
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = DisplayLayout;
			displayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics();
			displayLayout.ClearBandRowHeightMetrics(null);
			foreach (UltraGridBand band in displayLayout.Bands)
			{
				band.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
			}
			DirtyChildElementRecursive((UIElement)(object)displayLayout.UIElement);
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnTouchProviderStateChange(invalidate);
		}

		private void DirtyChildElementRecursive(UIElement element)
		{
			element.DirtyChildElements();
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator = element.ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					DirtyChildElementRecursive(current);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnVisibleChanged(EventArgs e)

			if (!base.DesignMode && base.Visible)

					addConditionButton.Image = ImageAddButton;

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			bool result = base.ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
			if ((Keys.Tab == keyData || (Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift) == keyData) && ((Control)(object)grid).ContainsFocus && grid != null && !((Control)(object)grid).IsDisposed && grid.Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				RowsCollection rowsCollection = grid.Rows;
				UltraGridCell activeCell = ((Keys.Shift != (Keys.Shift & keyData)) ? rowsCollection[0].Cells["Operator"] : rowsCollection[rowsCollection.Count - 1].Cells["Operand"]);
				grid.ActiveCell = activeCell;
				EnterEditMode();
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal virtual void ArrangeControls()
		{
			int num = 12;
			int num2 = 4;
			if (AddButton != null)
