				Size preferredSize = AddButton.GetPreferredSize(new Size(int.MaxValue, 0));
				Size preferredSize2 = DeleteButton.GetPreferredSize(new Size(int.MaxValue, 0));
				int num3 = Math.Max(preferredSize.Width, preferredSize2.Width);
				AddButton.Width = num3 + num2;
				DeleteButton.Width = num3 + num2;
				gridPanel.SetBounds(DeleteButton.Bounds.Right + num, gridPanel.Bounds.Y, base.Width - (DeleteButton.Bounds.Right + num * 2), gridPanel.Bounds.Height);
			}
			if (OKButton != null)
			{
				Size preferredSize3 = OKButton.GetPreferredSize(new Size(int.MaxValue, 0));
				Size preferredSize4 = CancelButton.GetPreferredSize(new Size(int.MaxValue, 0));
				int num4 = Math.Max(preferredSize3.Width, preferredSize4.Width);
				num4 = (int)((double)num4 * 1.5);
				OKButton.Width = num4 + num2;
				CancelButton.Width = num4 + num2;
				CancelButton.SetBounds(base.Width - (CancelButton.Width + num), CancelButton.Bounds.Y, num4 + num2, CancelButton.Height);
				OKButton.SetBounds(CancelButton.Left - (num4 + num), OKButton.Bounds.Y, num4 + num2, OKButton.Height);
			}
		}

		internal void GetColumnFilters()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = Grid.DataSource as ArrayList;
			columnFilter.ClearFilterConditions();
			if (arrayList != null && arrayList.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
				{
					FilterConditionRow filterConditionRow = (FilterConditionRow)arrayList[i];
					object obj = filterConditionRow.Operator;
					if (!(obj is FilterComparisionOperator) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(FilterComparisionOperator), obj))
					{
						continue;
					}
					FilterComparisionOperator filterComparisionOperator = (FilterComparisionOperator)obj;
					object obj2 = filterConditionRow.Operand;
					if (obj2 is BlanksClass)
					{
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(filterComparisionOperator, FilterCondition.BlankCellValue);
						continue;
					}
					if (obj2 is NonBlanksClass)
					{
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(filterComparisionOperator, FilterCondition.NonBlankCellValue);
						continue;
					}
					if (obj2 is SpecialOperandClass)
					{
						SpecialOperandClass specialOperandClass = (SpecialOperandClass)obj2;
						if (specialOperandClass.OperandType == SpecialOperandClass.SpecialOperandType.Regex)
						{
							columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(filterComparisionOperator, specialOperandClass.ToString());
						}
						else if (SpecialOperandClass.SpecialOperandType.Wildcard == specialOperandClass.OperandType)
						{
							columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(filterComparisionOperator, specialOperandClass.ToString());
						}
						continue;
					}
					if (obj2 is ErrorsClass)
					{
						columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(new DataErrorFilterCondition(filterComparisionOperator == FilterComparisionOperator.Equals));
						continue;
					}
					if (obj2 is EmptyStringClass)
					{
						obj2 = "";
					}
					else if (obj2 is DBNullClass)
					{
						obj2 = DBNull.Value;
					}
					else if (obj2 is ColumnValueListDataValue)
					{
						obj2 = ((ColumnValueListDataValue)obj2).column;
					}
					columnFilter.FilterConditions.Add(filterComparisionOperator, obj2);
				}
			}
			columnFilter.LogicalOperator = (FilterLogicalOperator)logicalOperatorCombo.SelectedValue;
		}

		internal bool InitializeDialog(UltraGridColumn column, ColumnFilter columnFilter, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			//IL_028d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0294: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_02a9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02b3: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_02ae: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02b8: Expected O, but got Unknown
			cachedAllCellValues = (cachedFilteredInCellValues = null);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (column.Band == null || !column.Band.Columns.Contains(column))
			{
				return false;
			}
			internalColumn = column;
			this.rows = rows;
			string captionAsSingleLine = ColumnValueListDataValue.GetCaptionAsSingleLine(column);
			Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RowFilterDialogTitlePrefix") + " " + captionAsSingleLine;
			ArrayList arrayList = new ArrayList();
			arrayList.Add(new FilterConditionRow());
			Grid.DataSource = arrayList;
			PopulateGrid(columnFilter);
			OKButton.Enabled = false;
			((Control)(object)Grid).Text = string.Empty;
			Grid.UpdateMode = UpdateMode.OnCellChangeOrLostFocus;
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = grid.DisplayLayout;
			displayLayout.Override.AllowColSizing = AllowColSizing.None;
			displayLayout.Override.RowSpacingAfter = 2;
			displayLayout.MaxColScrollRegions = 1;
			displayLayout.MaxRowScrollRegions = 1;
			displayLayout.Bands[0].ColHeadersVisible = false;
			displayLayout.ScrollBounds = ScrollBounds.ScrollToFill;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = displayLayout.SortedBands[0].Columns.Add("FilterColumn", captionAsSingleLine);
			ultraGridColumn.Header.Caption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RowFilterDialogFilterColumnCaptionText");
			ultraGridColumn.NullText = captionAsSingleLine;
			ultraGridColumn.CellActivation = Activation.NoEdit;
			ultraGridColumn.CellClickAction = CellClickAction.RowSelect;
			ultraGridColumn.Header.VisiblePosition = 0;
			ultraGridColumn.CellAppearance.TextHAlign = (HAlign)2;
			ultraGridColumn.CellAppearance.TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
			ultraGridColumn.CellAppearance.TextTrimming = (TextTrimming)3;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = displayLayout.SortedBands[0].Columns["Operator"];
			ultraGridColumn2.Header.Caption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RowFilterDialogOperatorColumnCaptionText");
			ultraGridColumn2.ValueList = (IValueList)(object)GetOperatorsValueList();
			ultraGridColumn2.Style = ColumnStyle.DropDownList;
			ultraGridColumn2.ButtonDisplayStyle = ButtonDisplayStyle.Always;
			ultraGridColumn2.CellAppearance.TextVAlign = (VAlign)2;
			ultraGridColumn2.CellAppearance.TextTrimming = (TextTrimming)3;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn3 = displayLayout.SortedBands[0].Columns["Operand"];
			ultraGridColumn3.Header.Caption = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RowFilterDialogOperandColumnCaptionText");
			ultraGridColumn3.ValueList = (IValueList)(object)GetOperandsValueLists();
			EmbeddableEditorBase val = (columnFilter?.Column)?.Editor;
			if (val != null && val.DataFilter != null)
			{
				PopulateOperandsValueList(hasBlanksItem: false, hasEmptyTextItem: false, hasDBNullItem: false, hasColumns: false, hasRegExExamples: false, hasCellValues: true, hasErrors: false);
			}
			else if (Grid.Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				PopulateOperandsCellHelper(Grid.Rows[0].Cells[ultraGridColumn3]);
			}
			DefaultEditorOwnerSettings val2 = new DefaultEditorOwnerSettings();
			val2.DataType = typeof(object);
			ultraGridColumn3.Editor = (EmbeddableEditorBase)new EditorWithCombo((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)new DefaultEditorOwner(val2));
			ultraGridColumn3.ButtonDisplayStyle = ButtonDisplayStyle.Always;
			ultraGridColumn3.NullText = string.Format("({0})", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RowFilterDialogDBNullItem"));

		internal void PopulateGrid(ColumnFilter columnFilter)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = Grid.DataSource as ArrayList;
			if (arrayList == null)
			{
				arrayList = new ArrayList();
			}
			arrayList.Clear();
			logicalOperatorCombo.SelectedValue = columnFilter.LogicalOperator;
			int[] array = new int[3] { -1, -1, -1 };
			for (int i = 0; i < columnFilter.FilterConditions.Count; i++)
			{
				FilterCondition filterCondition = columnFilter.FilterConditions[i];
				if (columnFilter.LogicalOperator == FilterLogicalOperator.And)
				{
					if (FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals == filterCondition.ComparisionOperator)
					{
						if (filterCondition.CompareValue == null)
						{
							array[0] = i;
						}
						else if (filterCondition.CompareValue is DBNull)
						{
							array[1] = i;
						}
						else if (filterCondition.CompareValue.ToString().Length <= 0)
						{
							array[2] = i;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (filterCondition.ComparisionOperator == FilterComparisionOperator.Equals)
				{
					if (filterCondition.CompareValue == null)
					{
						array[0] = i;
					}
					else if (filterCondition.CompareValue is DBNull)
					{
						array[1] = i;
					}
					else if (filterCondition.CompareValue.ToString().Length <= 0)
					{
						array[2] = i;
					}
				}
			}
			if (array[0] >= 0 && array[1] >= 0 && array[2] >= 0)
			{
				FilterConditionRow filterConditionRow = new FilterConditionRow();
				filterConditionRow.Operator = ((FilterLogicalOperator.Or != columnFilter.LogicalOperator) ? FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals : FilterComparisionOperator.Equals);
				filterConditionRow.Operand = new BlanksClass();
				arrayList.Add(filterConditionRow);
			}
			else
			{
				array[0] = (array[1] = (array[2] = -1));
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < columnFilter.FilterConditions.Count; j++)
			{
				if (Array.IndexOf(array, j) < 0)
				{
					FilterCondition filterCondition2 = columnFilter.FilterConditions[j];
					FilterConditionRow filterConditionRow2 = new FilterConditionRow();
					filterConditionRow2.Operator = filterCondition2.ComparisionOperator;
					object obj = filterCondition2.CompareValue;
					if (obj != null && obj is string && ((string)obj).Length == 0)
					{
						obj = new EmptyStringClass();
					}
					else if (obj != null && obj is DBNull)
					{
						obj = new DBNullClass();
					}
					else if (obj is SpecialFilterOperand)
					{
						arrayList.Clear();
						break;
					}
					filterConditionRow2.Operand = obj;
					arrayList.Add(filterConditionRow2);
				}
			}
			if (arrayList.Count <= 0)
			{
				arrayList.Add(new FilterConditionRow());
			}
			Grid.DataSource = arrayList;
			if (Grid.Rows != null)
			{
				Grid.Rows.Refresh(RefreshRow.RefreshDisplay, recursive: false);
			}
		}

		internal void UpdateConditionLabelText()
		{
			bool enabled = false;
			if (internalColumn != null && Grid.Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Grid.Rows.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = Grid.Rows[i];
					object cellValue = GetCellValue(ultraGridRow.Cells["Operator"]);
					if (cellValue != null && !(cellValue is DBNull) && (!(cellValue is string) || ((string)cellValue).Length != 0))
					{
						enabled = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			OKButton.Enabled = enabled;
			if (Grid.Rows.Count <= 0)
			{
				OKButton.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogOkButtonNoFiltersText");
				OKButton.Enabled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				OKButton.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogOkButtonText");
			}
			if (Grid.Rows.Count <= 1)
			{
				AddButton.Enabled = true;
				if (1 == Grid.Rows.Count)
				{
					UltraGridColumn column = Grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].Columns["Operand"];
					UltraGridColumn column2 = Grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].Columns["Operator"];
					object cellValue2 = GetCellValue(Grid.Rows[0].Cells[column2]);
					object cellValue3 = GetCellValue(Grid.Rows[0].Cells[column]);
					if (cellValue2 is FilterComparisionOperator && Enum.IsDefined(typeof(FilterComparisionOperator), cellValue2))
					{
						FilterComparisionOperator filterComparisionOperator = (FilterComparisionOperator)cellValue2;
						if (cellValue3 is BlanksClass || cellValue3 is NonBlanksClass)
						{
							if (filterComparisionOperator != FilterComparisionOperator.Equals && FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals != filterComparisionOperator)
							{
								Grid.Rows[0].Cells[column].Value = new DBNullClass();
							}
							else
							{
								AddButton.Enabled = true;
								if (filterComparisionOperator == FilterComparisionOperator.Equals)
								{
									logicalOperatorCombo.SelectedValue = FilterLogicalOperator.Or;
								}
								else if (FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals == filterComparisionOperator)
								{
									logicalOperatorCombo.SelectedValue = FilterLogicalOperator.And;
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				AddButton.Enabled = true;
				for (int j = 0; j < Grid.Rows.Count; j++)
				{
					object value = Grid.Rows[j].Cells["Operand"].Value;
					if (!(value is BlanksClass) && !(value is NonBlanksClass))
					{
						continue;
					}
					object obj = (FilterComparisionOperator)Grid.Rows[j].Cells["Operator"].Value;
					if (obj is FilterComparisionOperator)
					{
						if ((FilterComparisionOperator)obj == FilterComparisionOperator.Equals)
						{
							logicalOperatorCombo.SelectedValue = FilterLogicalOperator.Or;
						}
						else if (FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals == (FilterComparisionOperator)obj)
						{
							logicalOperatorCombo.SelectedValue = FilterLogicalOperator.And;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			RefreshDeleteButtonEnabled();
		}

		}

		protected virtual void AssignUseAppStyling(bool useAppStyling)
		{
			if (useAppStyling)
			{
				inboxControlStyler1.ApplyAppStyling = (ApplyAppStyling)2;
			}
			else
			{
				inboxControlStyler1.ApplyAppStyling = (ApplyAppStyling)3;
			}
		}

		protected static ValueListItem FindValueListItem(ValueList valueList, object dataValue)
		{
			if (valueList == null || valueList.ValueListItems == null || ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)valueList.ValueListItems).Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)valueList.ValueListItems).Count; i++)
			{
				if (dataValue == valueList.ValueListItems[i].DataValue)
				{
					return valueList.ValueListItems[i];
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void InitializeDialogStrings()
		{
			addConditionButton.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogConditionAddButtonText");
			cancelButton.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogCancelButtonText");
			okButton.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogOkButtonText");
			deleteButton.Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogConditionDeleteButtonText");
			string text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogApplyLabelText");
			string[] array = text.Split(new string[1] { "{0}" }, StringSplitOptions.None);
			int num = array.Length;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				applyLabel1.Text = array[0];
			}
			if (num > 1)
			{
				applyLabel2.Text = array[1];
			}
			base.AccessibleName = Text;
			addConditionButton.AccessibleName = addConditionButton.Text;
			cancelButton.AccessibleName = cancelButton.Text;
			okButton.AccessibleName = okButton.Text;
			deleteButton.AccessibleName = deleteButton.Text;
			deleteButton.AccessibleDescription = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogDeleteButton_AccessibleDescription");
			applyLabel1.AccessibleName = applyLabel1.Text;
			applyLabel2.AccessibleName = applyLabel2.Text;
		}

		protected virtual void RefreshDeleteButtonEnabled()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (Grid != null)
			{
				int num = 0;
				while (!flag && num < Grid.Selected.Rows.Count)
				{
					flag = Grid.Selected.Rows[num].IsStillValid;
					num++;
				}
			}
			DeleteButton.Enabled = flag;
		}

		private void AddColumnOperands(ValueList valueList)
		{
			if (internalColumn == null || internalColumn.Band == null || internalColumn.Band.Columns == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < internalColumn.Band.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = internalColumn.Band.Columns[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn != internalColumn && !ultraGridColumn.HiddenResolved && FindValueListItem(valueList, new ColumnValueListDataValue(ultraGridColumn)) == null)
				{
					valueList.ValueListItems.Add((object)new ColumnValueListDataValue(ultraGridColumn));
					valueList.BumpContentsVersion();
				}
			}
		}

		private void AddRegexExamples(ValueList valueList)
		{
			if (regexExamples == null)
			{
				regexExamples = new ArrayList();
				string[] array = new string[7] { "^[A-Z]", "^[a-z]", "^[0-9]", "^[A-Za-z]", "^[^A-Za-z]", "^[^0-9]+$", "^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_]*$" };
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					regexExamples.Add(new SpecialOperandClass(SpecialOperandClass.SpecialOperandType.Regex, array[i]));
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < regexExamples.Count; j++)
			{
				if (FindValueListItem(valueList, regexExamples[j]) == null)
				{
					valueList.ValueListItems.Add(regexExamples[j], regexExamples[j].ToString());
					valueList.BumpContentsVersion();
				}
			}
		}

		private void DelayedEnterEditMode()
		{
			if (!base.IsDisposed && grid != null && !((Control)(object)grid).IsDisposed)
			{
				BeginInvoke(new MethodInvoker(EnterEditMode));
			}
		}

		private void EnterEditMode()
		{
			if (grid == null || ((Control)(object)grid).IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			Grid.EnsureTempActiveRowAssigned();
			UltraGridCell activeCell = grid.ActiveCell;
			if (activeCell == null)
			{
				UltraGridRow activeRow = Grid.ActiveRow;
				if (activeRow != null && activeRow.Band.Columns.Exists("Operator"))
				{
					activeRow.Cells["Operator"].Activate();
					activeCell = grid.ActiveCell;
				}
			}
			if (activeCell != null && !activeCell.IsInEditMode)
			{
				grid.PerformAction(UltraGridAction.EnterEditMode);
			}
		}

		private object GetCellValue(UltraGridCell cell)
		{
			object obj = cell.Value;
			if (cell == Grid.ActiveCell && cell.IsInEditMode && cell.DataChanged)
			{
				try
				{
					object value = cell.Column.Editor.Value;
					obj = value;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			if (obj is string)
			{
				IValueList valueList = cell.Column.ValueList;
				if (valueList != null)
				{
					int num = -1;
					object value2 = valueList.GetValue((string)obj, ref num);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						valueList.GetText(obj, ref num);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							value2 = valueList.GetValue(num);
						}
					}
					if (value2 != null)
					{
						obj = value2;
					}
				}
			}
			return obj;
		}

		private void PopulateOperandsCellHelper(UltraGridCell operandsCell)
		{
			if (operandsCell == null || !"Operand".Equals(operandsCell.Column.Key))
			{
				return;
			}
			object cellValue = GetCellValue(operandsCell.Row.Cells["Operator"]);
			IValueList valueList = operandsCell.Column.ValueList;
			ValueList val = (ValueList)(object)((valueList is ValueList) ? valueList : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool hasColumns = false;
			bool hasRegExExamples = false;
			bool flag = false;
			bool hasEmptyTextItem = false;
			bool hasDBNullItem = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool hasErrors = false;
			FilterOperandDropDownItems filterOperandDropDownItems = ((columnFilter != null && columnFilter.Column != null) ? columnFilter.Column.FilterOperandDropDownItemsResolved : (FilterOperandDropDownItems.Blanks | FilterOperandDropDownItems.NonBlanks | FilterOperandDropDownItems.Custom | FilterOperandDropDownItems.CellValues | FilterOperandDropDownItems.All));
			if (cellValue is FilterComparisionOperator && Enum.IsDefined(typeof(FilterComparisionOperator), cellValue))
			{
				switch ((FilterComparisionOperator)cellValue)
				{
				case FilterComparisionOperator.Match:
				case FilterComparisionOperator.DoesNotMatch:
					hasRegExExamples = true;
					break;
				case FilterComparisionOperator.Equals:
					flag = true;
					hasEmptyTextItem = true;
					hasDBNullItem = true;
					hasColumns = true;
					flag2 = true;
					hasErrors = (filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.Errors) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.Errors;
					break;
				case FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals:
					flag = true;
					hasEmptyTextItem = true;
					hasDBNullItem = true;
					hasColumns = true;
					flag2 = true;
					hasErrors = (filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.Errors) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.Errors;
					break;
				case FilterComparisionOperator.LessThan:
				case FilterComparisionOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo:
					hasColumns = true;
					flag2 = true;
					break;
				case FilterComparisionOperator.GreaterThan:
					flag = true;
					hasDBNullItem = true;
					hasEmptyTextItem = true;
					hasColumns = true;
					flag2 = true;
					break;
				case FilterComparisionOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo:
					hasEmptyTextItem = true;
					hasColumns = true;
					flag2 = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			flag = flag && (filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.Blanks) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.Blanks;
			flag2 = flag2 && (filterOperandDropDownItems & FilterOperandDropDownItems.CellValues) == FilterOperandDropDownItems.CellValues;
			if (flag)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Grid.Rows.Count; i++)
				{
					if (operandsCell.Row != Grid.Rows[i] && Grid.Rows[i].Cells["Operand"].Value is BlanksClass)
					{
						flag = false;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			PopulateOperandsValueList(flag, hasEmptyTextItem, hasDBNullItem, hasColumns, hasRegExExamples, flag2, hasErrors);
		}

		private void PopulateOperandsValueList(bool hasBlanksItem, bool hasEmptyTextItem, bool hasDBNullItem, bool hasColumns, bool hasRegExExamples, bool hasCellValues, bool hasErrors)
		{
			//IL_0125: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012c: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ValueList operandsValueLists = GetOperandsValueLists();
			if (hasErrors)
			{
				operandsValueLists.ValueListItems.Insert(0, (object)ErrorsClass.Value, ErrorsClass.Value.ToString());
			}
			if (hasEmptyTextItem)
			{
				operandsValueLists.ValueListItems.Insert(0, (object)EmptyStringClass.Value, EmptyStringClass.Value.ToString());
			}
			if (hasDBNullItem)
			{
				operandsValueLists.ValueListItems.Insert(0, (object)DBNullClass.Value, DBNullClass.Value.ToString());
			}
			if (hasBlanksItem)
			{
				operandsValueLists.ValueListItems.Insert(0, (object)BlanksClass.Value, BlanksClass.Value.ToString());
			}
			if (hasColumns)
			{
				AddColumnOperands(operandsValueLists);
			}
			if (hasRegExExamples)
			{
				AddRegexExamples(operandsValueLists);
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = internalColumn;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = ultraGridColumn?.Band;
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = (ultraGridBand?.Layout)?.Grid;
			if (ultraGridBase != null)
			{
				BeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulateEventArgs e = new BeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulateEventArgs(ultraGridColumn, rows, operandsValueLists);
				if (ultraGridBand.RowFilterActionResolved == RowFilterAction.None)
				{
					e.Handled = true;
				}
				ultraGridBase.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulate, e);
				if (e.Handled)
				{
					hasCellValues = false;
				}
			}
			if (hasCellValues && (cachedAllCellValues == null || cachedFilteredInCellValues == null) && ultraGridBand != null)
			{
				ValueList val = new ValueList();
				try
				{
					ultraGridBand.LoadFilterValueListHelper(val, (RowFilterMode.AllRowsInBand == ultraGridBand.RowFilterModeResolved) ? null : rows, internalColumn, includeFilteredOutRows: true, FilterValueListOptions.CellValuesOnly, fireRowFilterDropDownPopulateEvents: false);
					ValueListItemsCollection valueListItems = val.ValueListItems;
					cachedAllCellValues = (ValueListItem[])(object)new ValueListItem[((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)valueListItems).Count];
					for (int i = 0; i < ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)valueListItems).Count; i++)
					{
						cachedAllCellValues[i] = valueListItems[i];
					}
					val.ValueListItems.Clear();
					ultraGridBand.LoadFilterValueListHelper(val, (RowFilterMode.AllRowsInBand == ultraGridBand.RowFilterModeResolved) ? null : rows, internalColumn, includeFilteredOutRows: false, FilterValueListOptions.CellValuesOnly, fireRowFilterDropDownPopulateEvents: false);
					valueListItems = val.ValueListItems;
					cachedFilteredInCellValues = (ValueListItem[])(object)new ValueListItem[((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)valueListItems).Count];
					for (int j = 0; j < ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)valueListItems).Count; j++)
					{
						cachedFilteredInCellValues[j] = valueListItems[j];
					}
					val.ValueListItems.Clear();
				}
				finally
				{
					((IDisposable)val)?.Dispose();
				}
			}
			if (hasCellValues)
			{
				ValueListItemsCollection valueListItems2 = operandsValueLists.ValueListItems;
				object[] array = ((Keys.Shift == Control.ModifierKeys) ? cachedAllCellValues : cachedFilteredInCellValues);
				if (array != null)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
					{
						valueListItems2.Add(array[k]);
					}
				}
			}
			if (ultraGridBase != null)
			{
				AfterRowFilterDropDownPopulateEventArgs e2 = new AfterRowFilterDropDownPopulateEventArgs(ultraGridColumn, rows, operandsValueLists);
				ultraGridBase.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.AfterRowFilterDropDownPopulate, e2);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeCombo()
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable();
			dataTable.Columns.Add("DisplayText");
			dataTable.Columns.Add("Value", typeof(FilterLogicalOperator));
			dataTable.Rows.Add(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogAllComboItem"), FilterLogicalOperator.And);
			dataTable.Rows.Add(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogAnyComboItem"), FilterLogicalOperator.Or);
			logicalOperatorCombo.DisplayMember = "DisplayText";
			logicalOperatorCombo.ValueMember = "Value";
			logicalOperatorCombo.DataSource = dataTable;
			Padding padding = applyLabel1.Padding;
			int num = (logicalOperatorCombo.Height - applyLabel1.Height - padding.Vertical) / 2 + 2;
			Padding padding2 = new Padding(0, num, 0, num);
			applyLabel1.Padding = padding2;
			applyLabel2.Padding = padding2;
		}

		private void AdjustForTouchMode()
		{
			if (!TouchProviderManager.AreTouchMetricsEnabled((Control)(object)owningGrid))
			{
				return;
			}
			logicalOperatorCombo.AreTouchMetricsEnabled = true;
			int num = flowLayoutPanel1.Height;
			flowLayoutPanel1.Height = logicalOperatorCombo.ItemHeight + 4;
			int num2 = flowLayoutPanel1.Height - num;
			foreach (Control control in controlsPanel.Controls)
			{
				if ((control.Anchor & AnchorStyles.Top) == AnchorStyles.Top && control.Top > flowLayoutPanel1.Top)
				{
					control.Top += num2;
					if ((control.Anchor & AnchorStyles.Bottom) == AnchorStyles.Bottom)
					{
						control.Height -= num2;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected void addConditionButton_Click(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Grid.DataSource is ArrayList arrayList)
			{
				arrayList.Add(new FilterConditionRow());
				Grid.Rows.Refresh(RefreshRow.RefreshDisplay, recursive: false);
				Grid.PerformAction(UltraGridAction.LastRowInGrid);
			}
			else
			{
				ArrayList arrayList2 = new ArrayList();
				arrayList2.Add(new FilterConditionRow());
				Grid.DataSource = arrayList2;
				Grid.PerformAction(UltraGridAction.LastRowInGrid);
			}
			UpdateConditionLabelText();
		}

		private void OnGrid_CellChange(object sender, CellEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Cell != null && "Operand".Equals(e.Cell.Column.Key) && e.Cell.IsInEditMode && e.Cell.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = e.Cell.Column.Editor;
				if (editor != null && editor.IsInEditMode)
				{
					string text = null;
					try
					{
						text = editor.CurrentEditText;
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
					if (text != null && text.Length > 0 && BlanksClass.Value.ToString() != text && !AddButton.Enabled)
					{
						AddButton.Enabled = true;
					}
				}
			}
			UpdateConditionLabelText();
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			if (grid != null)
			{
				grid.AfterRowInsert -= OnGrid_AfterRowInsert;
				grid.AfterRowsDeleted -= OnGrid_AfterRowsDeleted;
				grid.BeforeSelectChange -= OnGrid_BeforeSelectChange;
				grid.BeforeRowsDeleted -= OnGrid_BeforeRowsDeleted;
				grid.CellListSelect -= OnGrid_CellListSelect;
				grid.AfterRowUpdate -= OnGrid_AfterRowUpdate;
				grid.CellChange -= OnGrid_CellChange;
				((Component)(object)grid).Dispose();
				grid = null;
				if (rowSelectorImage != null)
				{
					rowSelectorImage.Dispose();
					rowSelectorImage = null;
				}
			}
			if (operandsValueList != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)operandsValueList).Dispose();
			}
			if (operatorsValueList != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)operatorsValueList).Dispose();
			}
			if (addConditionButton != null)
			{
				addConditionButton.Image = null;
			}
			if (deleteButton != null)
			{
				deleteButton.Image = null;
			}
			internalColumn = null;
			if (dialogSettings != null)
			{
				dialogSettings.Dispose();
				dialogSettings = null;
			}
			owningGrid = null;
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

		{

				(Control)(object)cancelUltraButton,
				(Control)(object)addUltraButton,
				(Control)(object)deleteUltraButton

			((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel).Dock = backgroundPanel.Dock;
			((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel).Bounds = backgroundPanel.Bounds;
			((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel).Name = "ultraBackgroundPanel";

			base.Controls.Remove(okButton);

			base.Controls.Remove(addConditionButton);

			ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
		}

	public class CustomRowFiltersDialog : AppStyledDialogBase
	{
		private IContainer components;

		private CustomRowFiltersControl customRowFiltersControl;

		private IWin32Window ownerWindow;

		private static bool UseInbox;

		public UltraGrid Grid => customRowFiltersControl.Grid;

		public Image ImageAddButton

		}

				return customRowFiltersControl.ImageDeleteButton;
			}
			set

				customRowFiltersControl.ImageDeleteButton = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsUsingInfragisticsControls => !UseInbox;

		public CustomRowFiltersDialog(UltraGridBase ownerGrid)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			((Control)this).AccessibleName = ((Control)(object)this).Text;
			if (UseInbox)
			{
				customRowFiltersControl = new CustomRowFiltersControl(ownerGrid);
			}
			else
			{
				string typeName = "Infragistics.Win.Misc.UltraButton, Infragistics4.Win.Misc.v21.1, Version=21.1.20211.24, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb";
				Type type = Type.GetType(typeName, throwOnError: false);
				if (type != null)
				{
					customRowFiltersControl = new CustomRowFiltersControlUltra(ownerGrid);
				}
				else
				{
					UseInbox = true;
					customRowFiltersControl = new CustomRowFiltersControl(ownerGrid);
				}
			}
			customRowFiltersControl.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
			((Form)this).AcceptButton = customRowFiltersControl.OKButton as IButtonControl;
			((Form)this).CancelButton = customRowFiltersControl.CancelButton as IButtonControl;

			{
				((Control)this).Height += TouchUtilities.GetTouchElementSize((Control)(object)this, (TouchElementSizes)0).Height * 2;
			}

			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				((Control)this).Hide();
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)

		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			components = new Container();
			((Control)this).SuspendLayout();
			((ContainerControl)this).AutoScaleDimensions = new SizeF(96f, 96f);
			((ContainerControl)this).AutoScaleMode = AutoScaleMode.Dpi;
			((Form)this).ClientSize = new Size(572, 169);
			((Form)this).MaximizeBox = false;
			((Form)this).MinimizeBox = false;
			((Control)(object)this).MinimumSize = new Size(372, 205);
			((Control)this).Name = "CustomRowFiltersDialog";
			((Form)this).StartPosition = FormStartPosition.CenterParent;
			((Form)this).Closing += CustomRowFiltersDialog_Closing;
			((Control)this).ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
		}

		internal bool InitializeDialog(UltraGridColumn column, ColumnFilter columnFilter, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (column.Band == null || !column.Band.Columns.Contains(column))
			{
				return false;
			}
			((Control)(object)this).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("FilterDialogTitle");
			UltraGridBase grid = column.Layout.Grid;
			if (grid != null)
			{
				try
				{
					Control editorContainerControl = grid.EditorContainerControl;
					if (editorContainerControl is UltraGridBase ultraGridBase)
					{
						ownerWindow = ultraGridBase.ControlForGridDisplay.FindForm();
					}
					else
					{
						ownerWindow = editorContainerControl.FindForm();
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			customRowFiltersControl.InitializeDialog(column, columnFilter, rows);
			((Form)this).Icon = customRowFiltersControl.IconDialog;
			return true;
		}

		internal DialogResult InternalShowDialog()
		{
			try
			{
				customRowFiltersControl.UpdateConditionLabelText();
				DialogResult dialogResult = ((ownerWindow == null) ? ((Form)this).ShowDialog() : ((Form)this).ShowDialog(ownerWindow));
				if (DialogResult.OK == dialogResult)
				{
					try
					{
						if (Grid != null)
						{
							UltraGridCell activeCell = Grid.ActiveCell;
							if (activeCell != null && activeCell.IsInEditMode)
							{
								activeCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: false);
							}
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
					customRowFiltersControl.GetColumnFilters();
				}
				return dialogResult;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			return DialogResult.None;
		}

		public DialogResult ShowDialog(ColumnFilter columnFilter, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			InitializeDialog(columnFilter.Column, columnFilter, rows);
			return InternalShowDialog();
		}

		private bool ValidateInput()
		{
			Grid.PerformAction(UltraGridAction.ExitEditMode, shift: false, control: false);
			ArrayList arrayList = Grid.DataSource as ArrayList;
			int num = 0;
			while (arrayList != null && num < arrayList.Count)
			{
				if (arrayList[num] is FilterConditionRow filterConditionRow && filterConditionRow.Operator is FilterComparisionOperator)
				{
					FilterComparisionOperator filterComparisionOperator = (FilterComparisionOperator)filterConditionRow.Operator;
					if (FilterComparisionOperator.Match == filterComparisionOperator)
					{
						string text = ((filterConditionRow.Operand != null) ? filterConditionRow.Operand.ToString() : "");
						try
						{
							new Regex(filterConditionRow.Operand.ToString(), RegexOptions.ExplicitCapture);
						}
						catch (Exception ex)
						{
							Grid.ClearSelectedCells();
							Grid.Rows[num].Cells["Operand"].Selected = true;
							UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RowFilterRegexError", text) + "\n" + ex.Message, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RowFilterRegexErrorCaption"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
							return false;
						}
					}
					if (FilterComparisionOperator.Like == filterComparisionOperator)
					{
						string text2 = ((filterConditionRow.Operand != null) ? filterConditionRow.Operand.ToString() : "");
						try
						{
							Utilities.StrLike("testString", filterConditionRow.Operand.ToString(), true);
						}
						catch (Exception ex2)
						{
							Grid.ClearSelectedCells();
							Grid.Rows[num].Cells["Operand"].Selected = true;
							UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)this, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RowFilterPatternError", text2) + "\n" + ex2.Message, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("RowFilterPatternCaption"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				num++;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void CustomRowFiltersDialog_Closing(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!customRowFiltersControl.CancellingDialog && !ValidateInput())
			{
				customRowFiltersControl.CancellingDialog = true;
				e.Cancel = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnStyleLibraryNameChanged(string styleLibraryName)
		{
			customRowFiltersControl.StyleLibraryName = styleLibraryName;
		}

		protected override void OnStyleSetNameChanged(string styleSetName)
		{
			customRowFiltersControl.StyleSetName = styleSetName;
		}

		protected override void OnUseAppStylingChanged(bool useAppStyling)
		{
			customRowFiltersControl.UseAppStyling = useAppStyling;
		}
	}

	public class DataErrorIconUIElement : UIElement
	{
		private AppearanceData imageAppData;

		private bool hasShownTooltipSinceLastMouseEnter;

		private bool showingTooltip;

		public UltraGridRow Row => (UltraGridRow)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(UltraGridRow));

		public UltraGridColumn Column => (UltraGridColumn)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(UltraGridColumn));

		private bool IsOverCell => Column != null;

		private bool IsOverRowSelector => !IsOverCell;

		protected override bool WantsMouseHoverNotification => true;

		public DataErrorIconUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags)
		{
			AppearanceData.Merge(ref appData, ref imageAppData, ref flags);
			((UIElement)this).InitAppearance(ref appData, ref flags);
		}

		internal void InitImageAppData(ref AppearanceData imageAppData)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.imageAppData = imageAppData;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			hasShownTooltipSinceLastMouseEnter = false;
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{
			UltraGridRow row = Row;
			if (hasShownTooltipSinceLastMouseEnter || row == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridColumn column = Column;
			string text = row.GetDataError(column);
			bool flag = false;
			UltraGridBase grid = row.Layout.Grid;
			if (grid is UltraGrid)
			{
				BeforeDisplayDataErrorTooltipEventArgs e = new BeforeDisplayDataErrorTooltipEventArgs(row, column, row.GetDataErrorInfo(), text);
				((UltraGrid)grid).FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeDisplayDataErrorTooltip, e);
				text = e.TooltipText;
				flag = e.Cancel;
			}
			if (!flag && text != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				ToolTip val = grid?.TooltipTool;
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.ToolTipText = text;
					val.Show();
					showingTooltip = true;
					hasShownTooltipSinceLastMouseEnter = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			if (showingTooltip)
			{
				ToolTip val = Row.Layout.Grid?.TooltipTool;
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.Hide();
				}

	[ToolboxItem(false)]
	internal class IndexListBox : ListBox
	{
		private const int ActionFailed = -1;

		private const int BorderWidth = 2;

		private new const int Padding = 2;

		private Size lastSize = new Size(0, 0);

		private Size indexAreaSize = new Size(0, 0);

		public IndexListBox()
		{
			base.IntegralHeight = false;
			DrawMode = DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed;
			SelectionMode = SelectionMode.MultiExtended;
		}

		public int Add(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return InternalInsertItem(base.Items.Count, obj);
		}

		public void Remove(object obj)
		{
			base.Items.Remove(obj);
			RefreshSizeCalculations();
		}

		private int InternalInsertItem(int index, object obj)
		{
			int result = index;
			if (index >= base.Items.Count)
			{
				result = base.Items.Add(obj);
			}
			else
			{
				base.Items.Insert(index, obj);
			}
			RefreshSizeCalculations();
			return result;
		}

		private static Size GetItemSize(string text, int index, Graphics g, Font f, out Size indexAreaSize)
		{
			if (g == null || f == null)
			{
				indexAreaSize = new Size(0, 0);
				return new Size(0, 0);
			}
			Size size = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, index.ToString(), f));
			size.Height += 4;
			size.Width += 4;
			indexAreaSize = size;
			Size size2 = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(g, text, f));
			return new Size(size2.Width + size.Width, Math.Max(size.Height, size2.Height));
		}

		private void RefreshSizeCalculations()
		{
			if (base.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Graphics cachedGraphics = DrawUtility.GetCachedGraphics((Control)this);
			int val = 0;
			int num = 0;
			indexAreaSize = new Size(0, 0);
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Items.Count; i++)
				{
					Size size;
					Size itemSize = GetItemSize(base.Items[i].ToString(), i, cachedGraphics, Font, out size);
					indexAreaSize = new Size(Math.Max(size.Width, indexAreaSize.Width), Math.Max(size.Height, indexAreaSize.Height));
					val = Math.Max(val, itemSize.Height);
					num = Math.Max(num, itemSize.Width);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DrawUtility.ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);
			}
			ItemHeight = Math.Max(val, 1);
			base.HorizontalExtent = num + 2;
		}

		private void InternalDrawItem(DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Items.Count == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle bounds = e.Bounds;
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(bounds.Location, indexAreaSize);
			e.Graphics.FillRectangle(SystemBrushes.Control, rectangle);
			ControlPaint.DrawBorder3D(e.Graphics, rectangle, Border3DStyle.Raised);
			rectangle.X += 2;
			rectangle.Y += 2;
			rectangle.Width -= 4;
			rectangle.Height -= 4;
			StringFormat stringFormat = new StringFormat(StringFormatFlags.FitBlackBox | StringFormatFlags.NoWrap | StringFormatFlags.NoClip);
			stringFormat.Alignment = StringAlignment.Center;
			using (SolidBrush solidBrush = new SolidBrush(SystemColors.ControlText))
			{
				DrawUtility.DrawString(e.Graphics, e.Index.ToString(), e.Font, solidBrush, (RectangleF)rectangle, stringFormat);
			}
			bounds.Width -= indexAreaSize.Width;
			bounds.X += indexAreaSize.Width;
			Rectangle rectangle2 = bounds;
			rectangle2.Width -= 2;
			rectangle2.X += 2;
			string text = base.Items[e.Index].ToString();
			Size size = Size.Ceiling(DrawUtility.MeasureString(e.Graphics, text, e.Font, text.Length, stringFormat));
			rectangle2.Y += (rectangle2.Height - size.Height) / 2;
			if (text != null && text.Length != 0)
			{
				SolidBrush solidBrush2 = Utilities.CreateSolidBrush(e.ForeColor);
				SolidBrush solidBrush3 = Utilities.CreateSolidBrush(e.BackColor);
				e.Graphics.FillRectangle(solidBrush3, bounds);
				stringFormat.Alignment = StringAlignment.Near;
				stringFormat.Trimming = StringTrimming.None;
				DrawUtility.DrawString(e.Graphics, text, e.Font, solidBrush2, (RectangleF)rectangle2, stringFormat);
				solidBrush2.Dispose();
				solidBrush3.Dispose();
				if ((e.State & DrawItemState.Focus) == DrawItemState.Focus)
				{
					ControlPaint.DrawFocusRectangle(e.Graphics, bounds, e.ForeColor, e.BackColor);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDrawItem(DrawItemEventArgs e)
		{
			if (DrawMode == DrawMode.OwnerDrawFixed)
			{
				InternalDrawItem(e);
			}
			base.OnDrawItem(e);
		}

		protected override void OnFontChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			RefreshSizeCalculations();
			base.OnFontChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Width < lastSize.Width)
			{
				RefreshSizeCalculations();
			}
			lastSize = base.Size;
			base.OnResize(e);
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
	public class InOperand : ISerializable
	{
		private class CaseInsensitiveStringEqualityComparer : IEqualityComparer<object>
		{
			public new bool Equals(object x, object y)
			{
				bool flag = x == null;
				bool flag2 = y == null;
				if (flag != flag2)
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool flag3 = x is DBNull;
				bool flag4 = y is DBNull;
				if (flag3 != flag4)
				{
					return false;
				}
				string x2 = x.ToString();
				string y2 = y.ToString();
				return StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase.Compare(x2, y2) == 0;
			}

			public int GetHashCode(object obj)
			{
				return obj?.ToString().ToLower().GetHashCode() ?? 0;
			}
		}

		private IEnumerable items;

		private string displayText;

		private HashSet<object> cachedValues;

		public InOperand(IEnumerable items)
		{
			IEnumerable enumerable2;
			if (items == null)
			{
				IEnumerable enumerable = new object[0];
				enumerable2 = enumerable;
			}
			else
			{
				enumerable2 = items;
			}
			this.items = enumerable2;
		}

		protected InOperand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string name = current.Name;
				if (name.StartsWith("Value_"))
				{
					object item = Utils.DeserializeObjectProperty(current);
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			items = ((list.Count > 0) ? list.ToArray() : new object[0]);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (displayText == null)
			{
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				foreach (object item in items)
				{
					if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(", ");
					}
					stringBuilder.Append(item.ToString());
				}
				displayText = stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return displayText;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return (items != null) ? items.GetHashCode() : 0;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object o)
		{
			if (o is InOperand inOperand && base.Equals(inOperand))
			{
				return inOperand.items == items;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void VerifyCachedValues(FilterCondition filterCondition)
		{
			if (cachedValues != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridColumn column = filterCondition.Column;
			Type type = Utilities.GetUnderlyingType(column.DataType);
			if (GridUtils.DisplaysTextValues(column))
			{
				type = typeof(string);
			}
			bool flag = type == typeof(string);
			bool isCaseInsensitive = filterCondition.IsCaseInsensitive;
			if (flag && isCaseInsensitive)
			{
				cachedValues = new HashSet<object>(new CaseInsensitiveStringEqualityComparer());
			}
			else
			{
				cachedValues = new HashSet<object>();
			}
			foreach (object item2 in items)
			{
				object item;
				if (flag || item2.GetType() == type)
				{
					item = item2;
				}
				else
				{
					bool forceGetDisplayValue = false;
					item = column.ConvertValueToDataType(item2);
					item = UltraGridBand.GetValueForFilterComparisionHelper(item, null, column, ref forceGetDisplayValue);
				}
				cachedValues.Add(item);
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable GetValues(FilterCondition filterCondition)
		{
			VerifyCachedValues(filterCondition);
			return new List<object>(cachedValues);
		}

		internal bool IsMatch(object value, FilterCondition filterCondition)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = filterCondition.Column;
			Type type = Utilities.GetUnderlyingType(column.DataType);
			if (GridUtils.DisplaysTextValues(column))
			{
				type = typeof(string);
			}
			bool isCaseInsensitive = filterCondition.IsCaseInsensitive;
			bool flag = type == typeof(string);
			VerifyCachedValues(filterCondition);
			bool flag2 = cachedValues.Contains(value);
			switch (filterCondition.ComparisionOperator)
			{
			case FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals:
			case FilterComparisionOperator.NotIn:
				flag2 = !flag2;
				break;
			}
			return flag2;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (cachedValues == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object cachedValue in cachedValues)
			{
				string name = $"Value_{num.ToString()}";
				Utils.SerializeObjectProperty(info, name, cachedValue);
				num++;
			}
		}

		public static IEnumerable GetInOperandValues(FilterCondition filterCondition)
		{
			InOperand inOperand = filterCondition.CompareValue as InOperand;
			if (inOperand == null)
			{
				InOperatorCache inOperatorCache = filterCondition.InOperatorCache;
				if (inOperatorCache == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				inOperand = inOperatorCache.CachedInOperand;
			}
			return inOperand?.GetValues(filterCondition);
		}
	}

	internal class DragEffect
	{
		private DragStrategy dragStrategy;

		private DragDropIndicatorManager dragDropIndicatorManager;

		private UltraGrid grid;

		private CurrentCursor currentCursor;

		private Rectangle activeItemRect = Rectangle.Empty;

		private int lastColScrollRegionPosition = -1;

		internal DragStrategy DragStrategy => dragStrategy;

		internal DragDropIndicatorManager DragDropIndicatorManager
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0023: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (dragDropIndicatorManager == null)
				{
					dragDropIndicatorManager = new DragDropIndicatorManager(Orientation.Horizontal, (Control)(object)grid, 0.6);
					dragDropIndicatorManager.DropIndicatorArrowSize = (ArrowSize)1;
				}
				return dragDropIndicatorManager;
			}
		}

		internal CurrentCursor CurrentCursor
		{
			get
			{
				return currentCursor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (currentCursor != value)
				{
					currentCursor = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal DragEffect(UltraGrid grid)
		{
			this.grid = grid;
			dragStrategy = null;
			currentCursor = CurrentCursor.None;
			activeItemRect = Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		internal bool Setup(DragStrategy strategy)
		{
			dragStrategy = strategy;
			if (dragDropIndicatorManager != null)
			{
				dragDropIndicatorManager.InitializeDragIndicator((Image)null);
			}
			if (dragStrategy != null)
			{
				HeaderBase dragBitmapItem = dragStrategy.GetDragBitmapItem();
				if (dragBitmapItem != null)
				{
					dragBitmapItem.SetDragBitmap(this, dragStrategy.IsMultiItemDrag());
					UltraGridBand band = dragBitmapItem.Band;
					if (band != null && dragDropIndicatorManager != null)
					{
						DragDropIndicatorSettings dragDropIndicatorSettingsResolved = band.DragDropIndicatorSettingsResolved;
						if (dragDropIndicatorSettingsResolved.ShouldSerialize())
						{
							dragDropIndicatorManager.InitializeDropIndicator(dragDropIndicatorSettingsResolved);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void SetBitmap(Bitmap newBitmap, Region windowRegion, Point dragWindowOffset)
		{
			DragDropIndicatorManager.DragIndicatorOffset = dragWindowOffset;
			DragDropIndicatorManager.InitializeDragIndicator((Image)newBitmap, windowRegion);
		}

		internal void Display()
		{
			if (DragDropIndicatorManager != null)
			{
				DragDropIndicatorManager.ShowDragIndicator();
			}
			CurrentCursor = CurrentCursor.Valid;
		}

		internal void MoveDragIndicator(Point mouseLoc)
		{
			if (dragDropIndicatorManager != null && DragDropIndicatorManager.IsDragIndicatorVisible)
			{
				DragDropIndicatorManager.ShowDragIndicator(mouseLoc);
			}
		}

		internal void HideDragIndicator()
		{
			if (dragDropIndicatorManager != null)
			{
				DragDropIndicatorManager.HideDragIndicator();
			}
		}

		internal void OnDragMove(Point mouseLoc, bool isMultiSelectColumnChooser = false)
		{
			bool flag = true;
			if (grid != null && grid.ActiveColScrollRegion != null)
			{
				int position = grid.ActiveColScrollRegion.Position;
				if (lastColScrollRegionPosition != position)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				lastColScrollRegionPosition = position;
			}
			if (flag && !activeItemRect.IsEmpty && activeItemRect.Contains(mouseLoc))
			{
				if (grid != null)
				{
					mouseLoc = grid.EditorContainerControl.PointToScreen(mouseLoc);
				}
				MoveDragIndicator(mouseLoc);
				if (grid != null)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)grid).Update();
				}
				return;
			}
			bool flag2 = false;
			DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo = new DropLocationInfo();
			Rectangle itemBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
			if (dragStrategy == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point point = mouseLoc;
			if (!IsLocationValid(ref mouseLoc, dropLocationInfo, ref itemBounds))
			{
				CurrentCursor = CurrentCursor.Invalid;
				HideDropGuides();
			}
			else
			{
				CurrentCursor = CurrentCursor.Valid;
				if (dragStrategy.IsDropValid(mouseLoc, dropLocationInfo, itemBounds, isMultiSelectColumnChooser))
				{
					dropLocationInfo.SetDropTargetItemBounds(itemBounds);
					bool flag3 = true;
					dragStrategy.GetDropLocation(dropLocationInfo, mouseLoc, itemBounds);
					Point pt = CalcDropGuideDisplayPoint(itemBounds, dropLocationInfo);
					if (grid.DisplayLayout != null && grid.DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false) != null && grid.DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).GetRegionFromOrigin(pt.X) == null && grid.DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).GetRegionFromOrigin(pt.X - 2) == null && grid.DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).GetRegionFromOrigin(pt.X + 2) == null)
					{
						flag3 = false;
					}
					if (dropLocationInfo.GridItem != null)
					{
						UIElement uIElement = grid.DisplayLayout.GetUIElement(verify: false);
						UIElement val = null;
						if (uIElement != null)
						{
							val = uIElement.ElementFromPoint(mouseLoc);
							if (val == null)
							{
								return;
							}
							UIElement val2 = null;
							val2 = ((!(val is HeaderUIElement)) ? val.GetAncestor(typeof(HeaderUIElement)) : val);
							if (val2 == null)
							{
								val2 = val.GetAncestor(typeof(GroupByBoxUIElement));
								if (val2 != null)
								{
									UIElement val3 = null;
									if (dropLocationInfo.GridItem != null)
									{
										val3 = val2.GetDescendant(typeof(GroupByButtonUIElement), (object)dropLocationInfo.GridItem);
									}
									else if (dropLocationInfo.GroupByBand != null)
									{
										val3 = val2.GetDescendant(typeof(GroupByBandLabelUIElement), (object)dropLocationInfo.GroupByBand);
									}
									if (val3 != null)
									{
										val2 = val3;
									}
								}
							}
							val = val2;
						}
						if (val != null)
						{
							if (val.IsFullyVisible && flag3)
							{
								ShowDropGuides(dropLocationInfo, mouseLoc, itemBounds);
							}
							else
							{
								Rectangle clipRect = val.ClipRect;
								Rectangle b = new Rectangle(pt.X, pt.Y, 1, 1);
								b.Inflate(4, 4);
								if ((clipRect.Contains(pt) || clipRect.Contains(new Point(pt.X - 1, pt.Y)) || !Rectangle.Intersect(clipRect, b).IsEmpty) && flag3)
								{
									ShowDropGuides(dropLocationInfo, mouseLoc, itemBounds);
								}
								else
								{
									HideDropGuides();
								}
							}
						}
					}
					else if (flag3)
					{
						if (!itemBounds.IsEmpty)
						{
							ShowDropGuides(dropLocationInfo, mouseLoc, itemBounds);
						}
						else
						{
							HideDropGuides();
						}
					}
					else if (itemBounds.IsEmpty)
					{
						HideDropGuides();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					HideDropGuides();
				}
			}
			if (grid != null)
			{
				point = grid.EditorContainerControl.PointToScreen(point);
			}
			MoveDragIndicator(point);
			if (grid != null)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)grid).Update();
			}
		}

		internal void OnLeftButtonUp(Point mouseLoc)
		{
			if (dragStrategy != null && CurrentCursor.Valid == CurrentCursor)
			{
				DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo = new DropLocationInfo();
				Rectangle itemBounds = Rectangle.Empty;
				if (IsLocationValid(ref mouseLoc, dropLocationInfo, ref itemBounds))
				{
					ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = ((grid != null) ? grid.ActiveColScrollRegion : null);
					HeaderBase headerBase = null;
					if (dropLocationInfo != null)
					{
						headerBase = (dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetColumn ? ((HeaderBase)dropLocationInfo.ColumnHeader) : ((HeaderBase)dropLocationInfo.GroupHeader));
					}
					bool flag = headerBase != null && colScrollRegion != null && headerBase.Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, headerBase);
					bool flag2 = true;
					if (colScrollRegion != null && dragStrategy != null && dropLocationInfo != null && dragStrategy.DragItems != null && dragStrategy.DragItems.Count > 0)
					{
						int num = 0;
						while (flag2 && num < dragStrategy.DragItems.Count)
						{
							HeaderBase headerBase2 = dragStrategy.DragItems[0];
							if (headerBase2 != null && headerBase2.Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, headerBase2))
							{
								flag2 = false;
							}
							num++;
						}
					}
					dragStrategy.Drop(mouseLoc, dropLocationInfo, itemBounds);
					if (colScrollRegion != null && dragStrategy != null && dropLocationInfo != null && dragStrategy.DragItems != null && dragStrategy.DragItems.Count > 0 && headerBase != null && flag && flag2)
					{
						HeaderBase firstNonFixedHeader = headerBase.Band.GetFirstNonFixedHeader(colScrollRegion);
						if (firstNonFixedHeader != null)
						{
							colScrollRegion.ScrollHeaderIntoView(firstNonFixedHeader, leftAlign: false);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			TerminateMove();
		}

		internal void OnCancelMode()
		{
			TerminateMove();
		}

		private bool TerminateMove()
		{
			DragDropIndicatorManager.HideDragIndicator();
			DragDropIndicatorManager.HideDropIndicator();
			if (dragDropIndicatorManager != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)dragDropIndicatorManager).Dispose();
				dragDropIndicatorManager = null;
			}
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.Default;
			dragStrategy = null;
			return true;
		}

		internal bool ShowDropGuides(DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo, Point point, Rectangle itemBounds)
		{
			if (itemBounds.IsEmpty)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (DragDropIndicatorManager == null || grid == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (grid.IsOverColumnChooser(point, mousePosInScreenCoordinate: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			DropLocation dropLocation = dropLocationInfo.DropLocation;
			if (((Control)(object)grid).RightToLeft == RightToLeft.Yes)
			{
				switch (dropLocation)
				{
				case DropLocation.After:
					dropLocation = DropLocation.Before;
					break;
				case DropLocation.Before:
					dropLocation = DropLocation.After;
					break;
				}
			}
			DragDropIndicatorManager.ShowDropIndicator(grid.EditorContainerControl.RectangleToScreen(itemBounds), (IndicatorAlignment)((dropLocation != DropLocation.Before) ? 1 : 0), (!dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetCardLabel) ? Orientation.Vertical : Orientation.Horizontal);
			return true;
		}

		internal bool HideDropGuides()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (DragDropIndicatorManager != null)
			{
				DragDropIndicatorManager.HideDropIndicator();
				result = true;
			}
			activeItemRect = Rectangle.Empty;
			return result;
		}

		internal bool IsLocationValid(ref Point point, DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo, ref Rectangle itemBounds)
		{
			if (dragStrategy == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			int num = 0;
			if (DragDropIndicatorManager != null)
			{
				num = DragDropIndicatorManager.DragIndicatorRectangle.Height;
			}
			Point point2 = point;
			point2 = point;
			if (dragStrategy.IsLocationValid(point2, dropLocationInfo, ref itemBounds))
			{
				point = point2;
				return true;
			}
			if (dragStrategy is DragStrategyColumn)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = grid.DisplayLayout.GetUIElement(verify: false);
				uIElement = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(GroupByBoxUIElement));
				if (uIElement != null && uIElement.DrawingRect.Contains(point))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (grid.gridBagLayoutDragStrategy == null)
			{
				point2.Y -= num / 2;
			}
			flag = dragStrategy.IsLocationValid(point2, dropLocationInfo, ref itemBounds);
			if (flag)
			{
				point = point2;
				return true;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal static Point CalcDropGuideDisplayPoint(Rectangle itemBounds, DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo)
		{
			DropLocation dropLocation = dropLocationInfo.DropLocation;
			Point empty = Point.Empty;
			if (dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetCardLabel)
			{
				empty.X = itemBounds.X;
				if (dropLocation == DropLocation.Before)
				{
					empty.Y = itemBounds.Top;
				}
				else
				{
					empty.Y = itemBounds.Bottom;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				empty.Y = itemBounds.Top;
				if (dropLocation == DropLocation.Before)
				{
					empty.X = itemBounds.Left;
				}
				else if (DropLocation.After == dropLocation)
				{
					empty.X = itemBounds.Right;
				}
			}
			return empty;
		}
	}
	internal enum DropLocation
	{
		Before,
		After
	}
	internal class DropLocationInfo
	{
		protected GridItemBase gridItem;

		protected GroupHeader groupHeader;

		protected int level;

		protected DropLocation dropLocation;

		protected UltraGridBand groupByBand;

		protected int groupBySortedColsInsertIndex = -1;

		private Rectangle dropTargetItemBounds = Rectangle.Empty;

		internal GridItemBase GridItem
		{
			get
			{
				return gridItem;
			}
			set
			{
				gridItem = value;
			}
		}

		internal int Level
		{
			get
			{
				return level;
			}
			set
			{
				level = value;
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridBand GroupByBand
		{
			get
			{
				return groupByBand;
			}
			set
			{
				groupByBand = value;
			}
		}

		internal int GroupBySortedColsInsertIndex
		{
			get
			{
				return groupBySortedColsInsertIndex;
			}
			set
			{
				groupBySortedColsInsertIndex = value;
			}
		}

		internal ColumnHeader ColumnHeader
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsDropTargetColumn)
				{
					return (ColumnHeader)gridItem;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal GroupHeader GroupHeader
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsDropTargetGroup)
				{
					return (GroupHeader)gridItem;
				}
				if (groupHeader != null)
				{
					return groupHeader;
				}
				if (IsDropTargetColumn)
				{
					UltraGridGroup groupResolved = ColumnHeader.Column.GroupResolved;
					if (groupResolved != null)
					{
						return groupResolved.Header;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				groupHeader = value;
			}
		}

		internal HeaderBase Header => (HeaderBase)(((object)ColumnHeader) ?? ((object)GroupHeader));

		internal DropLocation DropLocation
		{
			get
			{
				return dropLocation;
			}
			set
			{
				dropLocation = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDropTargetCardLabel
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsDropTargetColumn || ColumnHeader == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraGridColumn column = ColumnHeader.Column;
				if (column.Band.CardView)
				{
					GroupByBox groupByBox = (column.Band.Layout.HasGroupByBox ? column.Band.Layout.GroupByBox : null);
					if (groupByBox != null)
					{
						UIElement uIElement = groupByBox.UIElement;
						if (uIElement != null && uIElement.Rect.IntersectsWith(dropTargetItemBounds))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDropTargetColumn
		{
			get
			{
				if (gridItem != null && gridItem.SelectChangeType == SelectChange.Col)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDropTargetGroup
		{
			get
			{
				if (gridItem != null && SelectChange.Group == gridItem.SelectChangeType)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDropTargetEmptyLevel => gridItem == null;

		internal DropLocationInfo()
		{
			gridItem = null;
			groupHeader = null;
			level = -1;
			groupByBand = null;
		}

		internal void SetDropTargetItemBounds(Rectangle rect)
		{
			dropTargetItemBounds = rect;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class DragStrategy
	{
		internal const int INVALID_DROP_POS = -1;

		protected UltraGrid grid;

		protected UltraGridBand band;

		protected ColScrollRegion csr;

		protected bool sameCSR;

		protected List<HeaderBase> dragItems;

		internal List<HeaderBase> DragItems => dragItems;

		internal DragStrategy(UltraGridBand band, UltraGrid grid)
		{
			this.band = band;
			this.grid = grid;
			dragItems = new List<HeaderBase>();
		}

		internal static HeaderBase[] ToHeaderArray(SelectedColsCollection headers)
		{
			List<HeaderBase> list = new List<HeaderBase>(headers.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < headers.Count; i++)
			{
				if (headers[i] != null)
				{
					list.Add(headers[i]);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal static HeaderBase[] ToHeaderArray(GroupsCollection groups)
		{
			List<HeaderBase> list = new List<HeaderBase>(groups.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < groups.Count; i++)
			{
				if (groups[i] != null && groups[i].Header != null)
				{
					list.Add(groups[i].Header);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal static GroupHeader[] ToGroupHeaderArray(UltraGridGroup[] array)
		{
			GroupHeader[] array2 = new GroupHeader[array.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array2[i] = array[i].Header;
			}
			return array2;
		}

		internal static ColumnHeader[] ToColumnHeaderArray(object[] array)
		{
			ColumnHeader[] array2 = new ColumnHeader[array.Length];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				ColumnHeader columnHeader = array[i] as ColumnHeader;
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = array[i] as UltraGridColumn;
				if (columnHeader != null)
				{
					array2[num++] = columnHeader;
				}
				else if (ultraGridColumn != null)
				{
					array2[num++] = ultraGridColumn.Header;
				}
			}
			return array2;
		}

		internal static GroupHeader[] ToGroupHeaderArray(object[] array)
		{
			GroupHeader[] array2 = new GroupHeader[array.Length];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				GroupHeader groupHeader = array[i] as GroupHeader;
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = array[i] as UltraGridGroup;
				if (groupHeader != null)
				{
					array2[num++] = groupHeader;
				}
				else if (ultraGridGroup != null)
				{
					array2[num++] = ultraGridGroup.Header;
				}
			}
			return array2;
		}

		internal abstract bool BeginDrag(HeaderBase headerItem);

		internal virtual bool IsLocationValid(Point point, DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo, ref Rectangle itemBounds)
		{
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = null;
			ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegionsCollection = null;
			colScrollRegionsCollection = grid.DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false);
			colScrollRegion = colScrollRegionsCollection.GetRegionFromOrigin(point.X);
			sameCSR = colScrollRegion == csr || colScrollRegion == null || csr == null;
			bool flag = false;
			GridItemBase gridItemBase = GetGridItem(point, ref itemBounds) as GridItemBase;
			if (gridItemBase == null && !IsExtendedLocationValid(point, dropLocationInfo, ref itemBounds))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (gridItemBase != null)
			{
				if (!IsGridItemValid(gridItemBase))
				{
					return flag;
				}
				dropLocationInfo.GridItem = gridItemBase;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < dragItems.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = dragItems[i];
				if (headerBase != null)
				{
					flag = headerBase.IsValidDropArea(dropLocationInfo, point);
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				dropLocationInfo.GridItem = null;
			}
			if (!sameCSR)
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal virtual bool IsExtendedLocationValid(Point point, DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo, ref Rectangle itemBounds)
		{
			return false;
		}

		internal abstract bool IsDropValid(Point mouseLoc, DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo, Rectangle itemBounds, bool isMultiSelectColumnChooser = false);

		internal abstract bool Drop(Point point, DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo, Rectangle itemBounds);

		internal abstract bool CreateDragItemsList(HeaderBase headerItem);

		internal virtual void GetDropLocation(DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo, Point point, Rectangle itemBounds)
		{
			int num = itemBounds.Left + itemBounds.Width / 2;
			if (point.X < num)
			{
				dropLocationInfo.DropLocation = DropLocation.Before;
			}
			else
			{
				dropLocationInfo.DropLocation = DropLocation.After;
			}
			if (!dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetColumn && !dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetGroup)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeaderBase headerBase = (dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetColumn ? ((HeaderBase)dropLocationInfo.ColumnHeader) : ((HeaderBase)dropLocationInfo.GroupHeader));
			if (headerBase != null)
			{
				ColScrollRegion activeColScrollRegion = headerBase.Band.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion;
				if (headerBase.Band.IsHeaderScrolledUnderFixedHeadersLeft(activeColScrollRegion, headerBase))
				{
					dropLocationInfo.DropLocation = DropLocation.After;
				}
				else if (headerBase.Band.IsHeaderScrolledUnderFixedHeadersRight(activeColScrollRegion, headerBase))
				{
					dropLocationInfo.DropLocation = DropLocation.Before;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool IsMultiItemDrag()
		{
			return GetItemCount() > 1;
		}

		internal virtual HeaderBase GetDragBitmapItem()
		{
			HeaderBase result = null;
			if (dragItems != null && dragItems.Count > 0)
			{
				result = dragItems[0];
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected virtual object GetGridItem(Point point, ref Rectangle bounds)
		{
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = grid.DisplayLayout;
			if (displayLayout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement uIElement = displayLayout.GetUIElement(verify: true);
			if (uIElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			uIElement = uIElement.ElementFromPoint(point);
			object obj = null;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				obj = uIElement.SelectableItem as GridItemBase;
			}
			if (!(obj is HeaderBase) || obj is BandHeader)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			if (obj != null)
			{
				UIElement ancestor = uIElement.GetAncestor(typeof(HeaderUIElement));
				if (ancestor != null)
				{
					uIElement = ancestor;
				}
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					bounds = uIElement.DrawingRect;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bounds = Rectangle.Empty;
			}
			return obj;
		}

		protected abstract bool IsGridItemValid(GridItemBase gridItem);

		internal static int GetNewVisiblePos(HeaderBase headerItem, List<HeaderBase> orderedHeaders)
		{
			if (headerItem == null || orderedHeaders == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int result = -1;
			int num2 = 0;
			while (num2 < orderedHeaders.Count)
			{
				if (orderedHeaders[num2] == headerItem)
				{
					result = num;
					break;
				}
				num2++;
				num++;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static bool CompareVisiblePositions(List<HeaderBase> newHeaderList, List<HeaderBase> existingHeaderList)
		{
			if (newHeaderList == null || existingHeaderList == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < existingHeaderList.Count; i++)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = existingHeaderList[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < newHeaderList.Count; j++)
				{
					HeaderBase headerBase2 = newHeaderList[j];
					if (headerBase2 != null && headerBase2 == headerBase)
					{
						int newVisiblePos = GetNewVisiblePos(headerBase, newHeaderList);
						int visiblePosition = headerBase.VisiblePosition;
						if (newVisiblePos == visiblePosition)
						{
							break;
						}
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal int GetItemCount()
		{
			return dragItems.Count;
		}
	}
	internal class DragStrategyColumn : DragStrategy
	{
		private bool isDraggingGroupByButton;

		internal bool IsDraggingGroupByButton => isDraggingGroupByButton;

		internal DragStrategyColumn(UltraGridBand band, UltraGrid grid, bool isDraggingGroupByButton)
			: base(band, grid)
		{
			this.isDraggingGroupByButton = isDraggingGroupByButton;
		}

		internal DragStrategyColumn(UltraGridBand band, UltraGrid grid)
			: base(band, grid)
		{
		}

		internal override bool BeginDrag(HeaderBase header)
