		}

		internal void ApplyFilters(bool commitEditValues)
		{
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in Band.Columns)
			{
				ApplyFilters(column, commitEditValues);
			}
		}

		internal void ApplyFilters(UltraGridColumn column, bool commitEditValues)
		{
			if (commitEditValues)
			{
				UltraGridCell activeCell = column.Layout.ActiveCell;
				if (activeCell != null && activeCell.IsInEditMode && activeCell.Row == this && activeCell.Column == column)
				{
					bool stayInEdit = true;
					activeCell.CommitEditValue(ref stayInEdit, fireDataError: true);
				}
			}
			ColumnFiltersCollection columnFilters = ColumnFilters;
			ColumnFilter columnFilter = (columnFilters.HasColumnFilter(column) ? columnFilters[column] : null);
			if (columnFilter == null || (!columnFilter.filterOperandModifiedSinceLastApply && !columnFilter.filterOperatorModifiedSinceLastApply))
			{
				return;
			}
			object operatorValue = GetOperatorValue(column);
			object obj = GetCellValue(column);
			if (FilterOperandStyle.UseColumnEditor == column.FilterOperandStyleResolved)
			{
				obj = UltraGridBand.GetValueForFilterComparision(this, column);
			}
			ColumnFilter columnFilter2 = columnFilter.Clone();
			columnFilter2.FilterConditions.Clear();
			columnFilter2.displayTextOverride = null;
			if (obj != null && DBNull.Value != obj)
			{
				FilterComparisionOperator filterComparisionOperator = GetComparisionOperatorFromOperatorValue(column, operatorValue);
				string text = obj.ToString();
				if (GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterBlanks, text) || GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterNonBlanks, text))
				{
					obj = (GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterBlanks, text) ? FilterCondition.BlankCellValue : FilterCondition.NonBlankCellValue);
					if (filterComparisionOperator != FilterComparisionOperator.Equals && FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals != filterComparisionOperator)
					{
						filterComparisionOperator = FilterComparisionOperator.Equals;
						SetOperatorValue(column, filterComparisionOperator);
					}
				}
				else if (UltraGridBand.FilterErrors == text || UltraGridBand.FilterNonErrors == text)
				{
					obj = new DataErrorFilterCondition(UltraGridBand.FilterErrors == text);
					if (filterComparisionOperator != FilterComparisionOperator.Equals && FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals != filterComparisionOperator)
					{
						filterComparisionOperator = FilterComparisionOperator.Equals;
						SetOperatorValue(column, filterComparisionOperator);
					}
				}
				try
				{
					if (obj is FilterCondition)
					{
						columnFilter2.FilterConditions.Add((FilterCondition)obj);
					}
					else if (obj is ColumnFilter)
					{
						ColumnFilter source = obj as ColumnFilter;
						columnFilter2.InitializeFrom(source);
					}
					else
					{
						columnFilter2.FilterConditions.Add(filterComparisionOperator, obj);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			RowsCollection rowsCollection = GetRowsCollection();
			if (ApplyNewFiltersHelper(columnFilter, columnFilter2, this, rowsCollection))
			{
				if (obj is FilterCondition || obj is ColumnFilter)
				{
					columnFilter.displayTextOverride = GetCellText(column);
				}
				else
				{
					columnFilter.displayTextOverride = null;
				}
				columnFilter.ClearEditModeInfo();
				UpdateRowDataChangedHelper();
			}
		}

		public static bool ApplyNewFiltersHelper(ColumnFilter origColumnFilter, ColumnFilter newColumnFilter, UltraGridFilterRow filterRow)
		{
			return ApplyNewFiltersHelper(origColumnFilter, newColumnFilter, filterRow, fireFilterCellValueChangedEvent: false);
		}

		public static bool ApplyNewFiltersHelper(ColumnFilter origColumnFilter, ColumnFilter newColumnFilter, UltraGridFilterRow filterRow, bool fireFilterCellValueChangedEvent)
		{
			return ApplyNewFiltersHelper(origColumnFilter, newColumnFilter, filterRow, fireFilterCellValueChangedEvent, null);
		}

		public static bool ApplyNewFiltersHelper(ColumnFilter origColumnFilter, ColumnFilter newColumnFilter, UltraGridFilterRow filterRow, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			return ApplyNewFiltersHelper(origColumnFilter, newColumnFilter, filterRow, fireFilterCellValueChangedEvent: false, rows);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static bool ApplyNewFiltersHelper(ColumnFilter origColumnFilter, ColumnFilter newColumnFilter, UltraGridFilterRow filterRow, bool fireFilterCellValueChangedEvent, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = origColumnFilter.Column;
			if (filterRow != null && fireFilterCellValueChangedEvent && !filterRow.FireFilterCellValueChangedHelper(column, applyNewFilters: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = column.Band?.Layout;
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ultraGridLayout?.Grid;
			if (origColumnFilter.InternalEquals(newColumnFilter))
			{
				return false;
			}
			BeforeRowFilterChangedEventArgs e = new BeforeRowFilterChangedEventArgs(newColumnFilter, rows);
			ultraGridBase?.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeRowFilterChanged, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			origColumnFilter.InitializeFrom(newColumnFilter);
			if (ultraGridBase != null)
			{
				ultraGridBase.Rows.EnsureSortedAndFilteredHelper(e.ProcessMode, column.Band);
				ultraGridBase.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.AfterRowFilterChanged, new AfterRowFilterChangedEventArgs(column, origColumnFilter, rows));
				RowScrollRegion activeRowScrollRegion = ultraGridLayout.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
				if (activeRowScrollRegion != null && ultraGridLayout.Rows.VisibleRowCount > 0 && ultraGridLayout.ScrollBounds != ScrollBounds.ScrollToFill)
				{
					UltraGridRow firstRow = activeRowScrollRegion.FirstRow;
					activeRowScrollRegion.SetDestroyVisibleRows();
					activeRowScrollRegion.RegenerateVisibleRows();
					if (activeRowScrollRegion.IsLastScrollableRowVisible() && !activeRowScrollRegion.IsFirstScrollableRowVisible())
					{
						activeRowScrollRegion.FirstRow = ultraGridLayout.Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow();
						activeRowScrollRegion.SetDestroyVisibleRows();
						activeRowScrollRegion.RegenerateVisibleRows(resetScrollInfo: false);
						if (!activeRowScrollRegion.IsLastScrollableRowVisible())
						{
							activeRowScrollRegion.FirstRow = firstRow;
							activeRowScrollRegion.SetDestroyVisibleRows();
						}
					}
				}
				if (filterRow != null && ((activeRowScrollRegion != null) & filterRow.IsActiveRow))
				{
					activeRowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(filterRow, exitEditMode: false, dontUpdateGridControl: true);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void UpdateRowDataChangedHelper()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in Band.Columns)
			{
				ColumnFilter columnFilterIfAllocated = GetColumnFilterIfAllocated(column);
				if (columnFilterIfAllocated != null && (columnFilterIfAllocated.filterOperandModifiedSinceLastApply || columnFilterIfAllocated.filterOperatorModifiedSinceLastApply))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					GetCellIfAllocated(column)?.SetDataChanged(newValue: false);
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				SetDataChanged(newValue: false);
			}
		}

		internal static FilterComparisionOperator GetComparisionOperatorFromOperatorValue(UltraGridColumn column, object operatorValue)
		{
			FilterComparisionOperator filterComparisionOperator = FilterCondition.GetFilterComparisonOperator(operatorValue);
			if (FilterComparisionOperator.Custom == filterComparisionOperator)
			{
				filterComparisionOperator = column.Layout.GetAssociatedFilterComparisionOperator(column.FilterOperatorDefaultValueResolved);
			}
			return filterComparisionOperator;
		}

		internal FilterComparisionOperator GetOperatorValueAsEnum(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			return GetComparisionOperatorFromOperatorValue(column, GetOperatorValue(column));
		}

		internal ColumnFilter GetColumnFilter(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			return ColumnFilters[column];
		}

		internal ColumnFilter GetColumnFilterIfAllocated(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			ColumnFiltersCollection columnFilters = ColumnFilters;
			if (!columnFilters.HasColumnFilter(column))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return columnFilters[column];
		}

		internal static bool IsOperandEditable(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			FilterOperandStyle filterOperandStyleResolved = column.FilterOperandStyleResolved;
			if (FilterOperandStyle.Disabled != filterOperandStyleResolved)
			{
				return FilterOperandStyle.None != filterOperandStyleResolved;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal ValueListItem GetOperatorValueListItem(FilterComparisionOperator filterComparisonOperator)
		{
			int num = -1;
			ValueList filterOperatorValueListAll = base.Layout.FilterOperatorValueListAll;
			((IValueList)filterOperatorValueListAll).GetText((object)filterComparisonOperator, ref num);
			return (num >= 0 && num < ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)filterOperatorValueListAll.ValueListItems).Count) ? filterOperatorValueListAll.ValueListItems[num] : null;
		}

		internal object GetCurrentOperatorImage(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			object operatorValue = GetOperatorValue(column);
			object result = null;
			if (operatorValue is FilterComparisionOperator filterComparisonOperator)
			{
				ValueListItem operatorValueListItem = GetOperatorValueListItem(filterComparisonOperator);
				if (operatorValueListItem != null)
				{
					result = operatorValueListItem.Appearance.Image;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal object GetOperatorValue(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			ColumnFilter columnFilterIfAllocated = GetColumnFilterIfAllocated(column);
			object obj = columnFilterIfAllocated?.filterRowOperatorValue;
			if (columnFilterIfAllocated == null || !columnFilterIfAllocated.filterOperatorModifiedSinceLastApply)
			{
				FilterConditionsCollection filterConditionsCollection = columnFilterIfAllocated?.FilterConditions;
				obj = ((filterConditionsCollection == null || filterConditionsCollection.Count == 0) ? ((obj is FilterComparisionOperator && FilterComparisionOperator.Custom != (FilterComparisionOperator)obj) ? obj : ((object)column.Layout.GetAssociatedFilterComparisionOperator(column.FilterOperatorDefaultValueResolved))) : ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnFilterIfAllocated.displayTextOverride)) ? ((object)FilterComparisionOperator.Custom) : ((1 != filterConditionsCollection.Count) ? ((object)FilterComparisionOperator.Custom) : ((object)filterConditionsCollection[0].ComparisionOperator))));
			}
			return obj;
		}

		internal void SetOperatorValue(UltraGridColumn column, object val)
		{
			ColumnFilter columnFilter = GetColumnFilter(column);
			columnFilter.filterRowOperatorValue = val;
			columnFilter.filterOperatorModifiedSinceLastApply = true;
			Cells[column].SetDataChanged(newValue: true);
			InvalidateCellAllRegions(column, invalidate: true, dirtyChildElems: true);
			UltraGridCell cellIfAllocated = GetCellIfAllocated(column);
			if (cellIfAllocated != null && cellIfAllocated.IsInEditMode && column.FilterOperatorEditor.IsInEditMode)
			{
				column.FilterOperatorEditor.Value = val;
			}
		}

		internal int GetIdealOpearatorCellHeight(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			int bLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight = base.BandInternal.GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.FilterOperatorAppearance, StyleUtils.Role.FilterOperator, (RoleState)1);
			int val = base.Layout?.GetIdealOperatorButtonSize().Height ?? 18;
			return Math.Max(val, bLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight + 2 * base.BandInternal.CellPaddingResolved);
		}

		internal int GetIdealOperandCellHeight(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			int num = Math.Max(base.BandInternal.GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.FilterRowAppearance, StyleUtils.Role.Row, (RoleState)512), base.BandInternal.GetBLOverrideAppearanceFontHeight(UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.FilterRowAppearanceActive, StyleUtils.Role.Row, (RoleState)4096));
			return num + 2 * base.BandInternal.CellPaddingResolved;
		}

		internal int GetIdealFilterCellHeight(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			//IL_00a3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00c6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridBand bandInternal = base.BandInternal;
			int num = GetIdealOperandCellHeight(column);
			UltraGridLayout layout = bandInternal.Layout;
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = layout?.Grid;
			if (column.FilterClearButtonVisibleResolved)
			{
				int val = layout?.GetIdealClearButtonSize().Height ?? ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)(object)ultraGridBase);
				num = Math.Max(num, val);
			}
			FilterOperatorLocation filterOperatorLocationResolved = column.FilterOperatorLocationResolved;
			if (FilterOperatorLocation.AboveOperand == filterOperatorLocationResolved)
			{
				num += GetIdealOpearatorCellHeight(column);
			}
			else if (FilterOperatorLocation.WithOperand == filterOperatorLocationResolved)
			{
				int val2 = layout?.GetIdealOperatorButtonSize().Height ?? ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)(object)ultraGridBase);
				num = Math.Max(num, val2);
			}
			int cellSpacingResolved = bandInternal.CellSpacingResolved;
			num += 2 * cellSpacingResolved;
			UIElementBorderStyle borderStyleCellResolved = BorderStyleCellResolved;
			if (cellSpacingResolved > 0 || !bandInternal.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(borderStyleCellResolved))
			{
				num += 2 * bandInternal.Layout.GetBorderThickness(borderStyleCellResolved);
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal bool FireFilterCellValueChangedHelper(UltraGridColumn column, bool applyNewFilters)
		{
			UltraGridBase grid = base.Layout.Grid;
			if (grid != null)
			{
				FilterCellValueChangedEventArgs e = new FilterCellValueChangedEventArgs((UltraGridFilterCell)Cells[column], applyNewFilters);
				grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.FilterCellValueChanged, e, checkInProgress: true);
				applyNewFilters = e.ApplyNewFilter;
			}
			return applyNewFilters;
		}

		internal void ClearFilterButtonClickedHelper(UltraGridColumn column, bool applyNewFilters)
		{
			object cellValue = GetCellValue(column);
			bool flag = GetCellIfAllocated(column)?.IsInEditMode ?? false;
			SetCellValue(column, null);
			ColumnFiltersCollection columnFilters = base.ParentCollection.ColumnFilters;
			bool flag2 = columnFilters.HasColumnFilter(column) && columnFilters[column].FilterConditions.Count > 0;
			if (!flag && flag2)
			{
				applyNewFilters = FireFilterCellValueChangedHelper(column, applyNewFilters);
				if (applyNewFilters)
				{
					ApplyFilters(column, commitEditValues: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnFilterClearButtonClicked(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column != null)
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = Cells[column];
				bool flag = ultraGridCell?.IsInEditMode ?? false;
				if (!flag && !base.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper())
				{
					return;
				}
				FilterEvaluationTrigger filterEvaluationTriggerResolved = column.FilterEvaluationTriggerResolved;
				bool applyNewFilters = FilterEvaluationTrigger.OnCellValueChange == filterEvaluationTriggerResolved || FilterEvaluationTrigger.OnEnterKeyOrLeaveCell == filterEvaluationTriggerResolved;
				ClearFilterButtonClickedHelper(column, applyNewFilters);
				if (!flag && ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.CanEnterEditMode && ultraGridCell.CanBeModified)
				{
					ultraGridCell.Activate();
					if (ultraGridCell.IsActiveCell)
					{
						ultraGridCell.EnterEditMode();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!base.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper())
				{
					return;
				}
				ColumnFiltersCollection columnFilters = ColumnFilters;
				bool flag2 = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < columnFilters.Count; i++)
				{
					ColumnFilter columnFilter = (columnFilters.HasColumnFilter(i) ? columnFilters[i] : null);
					if (columnFilter != null)
					{
						ClearFilterButtonClickedHelper(columnFilter.Column, applyNewFilters: false);
						if (columnFilter.HasFilterConditions)
						{
							flag2 = true;
						}
					}
				}
				UltraGrid ultraGrid = base.Layout?.Grid as UltraGrid;
				RowsCollection rowsCollection = GetRowsCollection();
				if (ultraGrid != null && flag2)
				{
					ClearAllFilterButtonClickedEventArgs e = new ClearAllFilterButtonClickedEventArgs(rowsCollection);
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeClearAllFilterButtonClicked, e);
				}
				ApplyFilters();
				if (ultraGrid != null && flag2)
				{
					ClearAllFilterButtonClickedEventArgs e2 = new ClearAllFilterButtonClickedEventArgs(rowsCollection);
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterClearAllFilterButtonClicked, e2);
				}
			}
		}

		internal string GetCellTooltip(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			object cellValue = GetCellValue(column);
			if (cellValue is ColumnFilter)
			{
				ColumnFilter columnFilter = cellValue as ColumnFilter;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnFilter.displayTextOverride))
				{
					return columnFilter.displayTextOverride;
				}
			}
			if (cellValue != null && DBNull.Value != cellValue)
			{
				if (cellValue != null && GridUtils.IsSameString(UltraGridBand.FilterCustomText, cellValue.ToString()))
				{
					return GetColumnFilter(column).ToString();
				}
				FilterComparisionOperator comparisionOperatorFromOperatorValue = GetComparisionOperatorFromOperatorValue(column, GetOperatorValue(column));
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
				FilterCondition.ToString(column, stringBuilder, includeColumnName: false, comparisionOperatorFromOperatorValue, cellValue);
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool HasActiveFilters(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			return GetColumnFilterIfAllocated(column)?.HasFilterConditions ?? false;
		}

		internal bool IsFilterCellInputValid(UltraGridColumn column, object operandVal, out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			if (GetOperatorValue(column) is FilterComparisionOperator comparisonOperator)
			{
				try
				{
					FilterCondition.ValidateSearchPattern(comparisonOperator, operandVal);
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					errorMessage = ex.Message;
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private RowsCollection GetRowsCollection()
		{
			if (!base.ParentCollection.IsRootRowsCollection && Band.RowFilterModeResolved != RowFilterMode.SiblingRowsOnly)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return base.ParentCollection;
		}

		internal override Activation GetResolvedCellActivation(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (!IsOperandEditable(column))
			{
				return Activation.Disabled;
			}
			return Activation.AllowEdit;
		}

		public override object GetCellValue(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			ColumnFilter columnFilterIfAllocated = GetColumnFilterIfAllocated(column);
			object obj = columnFilterIfAllocated?.filterRowOperandValue;
			if (obj == null && (columnFilterIfAllocated == null || !columnFilterIfAllocated.filterOperandModifiedSinceLastApply))
			{
				FilterConditionsCollection filterConditionsCollection = columnFilterIfAllocated?.FilterConditions;
				obj = ((filterConditionsCollection == null || filterConditionsCollection.Count == 0) ? DBNull.Value : ((!string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnFilterIfAllocated.displayTextOverride)) ? columnFilterIfAllocated : ((1 != filterConditionsCollection.Count) ? UltraGridBand.FilterCustomText : filterConditionsCollection[0].CompareValue)));
			}
			return obj;
		}

		internal override bool SetCellValue(UltraGridColumn column, object val, bool suppressErrorMessagePrompt, bool throwExceptionOnError)
		{
			ColumnFilter columnFilter = GetColumnFilter(column);
			columnFilter.filterRowOperandValue = val;
			columnFilter.filterOperandModifiedSinceLastApply = true;
			Cells[column].SetDataChanged(newValue: true);
			InvalidateCellAllRegions(column, invalidate: true, dirtyChildElems: true);
			UltraGridCell cellIfAllocated = GetCellIfAllocated(column);
			if (cellIfAllocated != null && !cellIfAllocated.InCommitEditValue && cellIfAllocated.IsInEditMode && column.FilterOperandEditor.IsInEditMode)
			{
				column.FilterOperandEditor.Value = val;
			}
			return true;
		}

		{
			if (elem is FilterRowUIElement filterRowUIElement)
			{
				return this == filterRowUIElement.contextRow;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void AdjustUIElementRect(ref Rectangle elemRect)
		{
			if (base.ParentCollection.IsGroupByRows && !base.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay)
			{
				int num = base.BandInternal.CalcGroupByRowIndent(base.ParentCollection);
				elemRect.X += num;
				elemRect.Width -= num;
			}
		}

		}

	public class FixedRowsCollection : SubObjectsCollectionBase
	{

		internal bool HasFixedResolvedRows
		{

				{

					if (!ultraGridRow.FixedResolved)

		public void Insert(int index, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			ValidateRow(row);
			if (Contains(row))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("Row already exists in the collection.");
			}
			InternalInsert(index, row);
			RowAddOrder.Add(row);
			BumpFixedRowsCollectionVersion();
			row.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true, dirtyMergedCell: true);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Add);
		}

		public void Remove(UltraGridRow row)
		{

			{
				RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this[index];
			InternalRemove(index);
			RowAddOrder.Remove(ultraGridRow);
			if (ultraGridRow.ParentCollection == ParentRows)
			{
				ParentRows.MoveRowToCorrectSortOrder(ultraGridRow);
			}
			BumpFixedRowsCollectionVersion();
			ultraGridRow.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true, dirtyMergedCell: true);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Remove);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			InternalClear();
			try
			{
				foreach (UltraGridRow item in RowAddOrder)
				{
					if (item.ParentCollection == ParentRows)
					{
						ParentRows.MoveRowToCorrectSortOrder(item);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				RowAddOrder.Clear();
				BumpFixedRowsCollectionVersion();
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Clear);
		}

		public void RefreshSort()
		{
			verifiedSortVersion = Band.SortedColumns.SortVersion;
			if (Band.HasSortedColumns && Count > 1)
			{
				UltraGridRow[] array = (UltraGridRow[])All;
				IComparer comparer2;
				if (array[0].IsGroupByRow)
				{
					IComparer comparer = new RowsCollection.GroupByRowsSortComparer(ParentRows);
					comparer2 = comparer;
				}
				else
				{
					IComparer comparer = new RowsCollection.RowsSortComparer(ParentRows);
					comparer2 = comparer;
				}
				IComparer comparer3 = comparer2;
				Utilities.SortMerge((object[])array, comparer3);
				ArrayList arrayList = List;
				arrayList.Clear();
				UltraGridRow[] array2 = array;
				foreach (UltraGridRow value in array2)
				{
					arrayList.Add(value);
				}
				BumpFixedRowsCollectionVersion();
			}
		}

		public override int IndexOf(object obj)

		}

		private void ValidateRow(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (!ParentRows.Contains(row))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Row must be from the associated RowsCollection.", "row");
			}
			if (!row.IsDataRow && !row.IsGroupByRow)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("Only data rows and group-by rows can be added to the fixed rows collection.", "row");
			}
		}

		internal void BumpFixedRowsCollectionVersion()
		{
			fixedRowsCollectionVersion++;
			Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
			Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
		}

		internal void VerifyFixedRows()
		{
			VerifyFixedRows(verifyScrollCount: true);
		}

		internal void VerifyFixedRows(bool verifyScrollCount)
		{
			if (verifiedGrandVersion == Layout.GrandVerifyVersion || inVerifyFixedRows)
			{
				return;
			}
			inVerifyFixedRows = true;
			DirtySortedByListIndexList();
			try
			{
				if (verifyScrollCount && parentRowCollection != null)
				{
					parentRowCollection.SparseArray.VerifyScrollCount();
				}
				RowsCollection parentRows = ParentRows;
				UltraGridBand band = Band;
				UltraGridLayout layout = band.Layout;
				ArrayList arrayList = List;
				List<UltraGridRow> list = RowAddOrder;
				bool flag = false;
				int num = parentRows.VerifyVersion + parentRows.verifiedGroupByHierarchyBandsVersion + parentRows.removedRowsVersion;
				if (verifiedRowCollectionVersion != num)
				{
					verifiedRowCollectionVersion = num;
					for (int num2 = rowAddOrder.Count - 1; num2 >= 0; num2--)
					{
						UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = rowAddOrder[num2];
						if (!ultraGridRow.IsStillValid || ultraGridRow.ParentCollection != ParentRows)
						{
							Remove(ultraGridRow);
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
				int fixedRowsLimitResolved = band.FixedRowsLimitResolved;
				while (fixedRowsLimitResolved > 0 && rowAddOrder.Count > fixedRowsLimitResolved)
				{
					Remove(rowAddOrder[0]);
					flag = true;
				}
				SortedColumnsCollection internalSortedColumns = band.InternalSortedColumns;
				if (internalSortedColumns != null && verifiedSortVersion != internalSortedColumns.SortVersion && FixedRowSortOrder.Sorted == band.FixedRowSortOrderResolved)
				{
					RefreshSort();
					flag = true;
				}
				int num3 = fixedRowsCollectionVersion + layout.FixedRowsCollectionsVersion;
				if (num3 != verifiedFixedRowsCollectionVersion)
				{
					verifiedFixedRowsCollectionVersion = num3;
					flag = true;
					ParentRows.MoveFixedRowsToProperLocation();
					if (TopFixed)
					{
						fixedResolvedBreakIndex = -1;
						for (int i = 0; i < arrayList.Count; i++)
						{
							UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = (UltraGridRow)arrayList[i];
							int scrollCountInternal = ultraGridRow2.ScrollCountInternal;
							fixedResolvedBreakIndex++;
							if (scrollCountInternal > 1)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						fixedResolvedBreakIndex = arrayList.Count;
						for (int num4 = arrayList.Count - 1; num4 >= 0; num4--)
						{
							UltraGridRow ultraGridRow3 = (UltraGridRow)arrayList[num4];
							int scrollCountInternal2 = ultraGridRow3.ScrollCountInternal;
							if (scrollCountInternal2 > 1)
							{
								break;
							}
							fixedResolvedBreakIndex--;
						}
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					ParentRows.verifiedSpecialRowsCacheVersion--;
					Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
				}
				verifiedGrandVersion = layout.GrandVerifyVersion;
			}
			finally
			{
				inVerifyFixedRows = false;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsFixedResolved(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (ParentRows.SupportsFixedRows)
			{
				VerifyFixedRows();
				int num = IndexOf(row);
				if (num >= 0 && (TopFixed ? (num <= fixedResolvedBreakIndex) : (num >= fixedResolvedBreakIndex)))
				{
					return !row.HiddenInternal;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void Move(UltraGridRow row, int newIndex)
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			int num = arrayList.IndexOf(row);
			if (num >= 0 && newIndex >= 0 && newIndex < arrayList.Count)
			{
				arrayList.RemoveAt(num);
				arrayList.Insert(newIndex, row);
			}
		}

		internal void DirtySortedByListIndexList()
		{
			sortedByListIndexList = null;
		}
	}

				return item != null;

		internal class MeetsCriteriaEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private IEnumerator enumerator;

			private IMeetsCriteria meetsCriteriaCallback;

			private object currentItem;

			public object Current => currentItem;

			internal MeetsCriteriaEnumerator(IEnumerator enumerator, IMeetsCriteria meetsCriteriaCallback)
			{
				ValidateNull(enumerator);
				ValidateNull(meetsCriteriaCallback);
				this.enumerator = enumerator;
				this.meetsCriteriaCallback = meetsCriteriaCallback;
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				enumerator.Reset();
				currentItem = null;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				do
				{
					if (!enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						return false;
					}
					currentItem = enumerator.Current;
				}
				while (!meetsCriteriaCallback.MeetsCriteria(currentItem));
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class MeetsCriteriaEnumerable : IEnumerable
		{
			private IEnumerable e;

			private IMeetsCriteria i;

			internal MeetsCriteriaEnumerable(IEnumerable e, IMeetsCriteria i)
			{
				ValidateNull(e);
				ValidateNull(i);
				this.e = e;
				this.i = i;
			}

			public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
			{
				return new MeetsCriteriaEnumerator(e.GetEnumerator(), i);
			}
		}

		internal class AlphabeticalComparer : IComparer
		{
			private bool useColumnChooserCaption;

			internal AlphabeticalComparer()
				: this(useColumnChooserCaption: false)
			{
			}

			internal AlphabeticalComparer(bool useColumnChooserCaption)
			{
				this.useColumnChooserCaption = useColumnChooserCaption;
			}

			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				string strA = null;
				string strB = null;
				bool ignoreCase = true;
				if (x is UltraGridColumn && y is UltraGridColumn)
				{
					if (useColumnChooserCaption)
					{
						strA = ((UltraGridColumn)x).ColumnChooserCaptionResolved;
						strB = ((UltraGridColumn)y).ColumnChooserCaptionResolved;
					}
					else
					{
						strA = ((UltraGridColumn)x).Header.Caption;
						strB = ((UltraGridColumn)y).Header.Caption;
					}
				}
				return string.Compare(strA, strB, ignoreCase);
			}
		}

		private static bool IsEnumFlags(Type enumType)
		{
			object[] customAttributes = enumType.GetCustomAttributes(typeof(FlagsAttribute), inherit: true);
			if (customAttributes != null)
			{
				return customAttributes.Length != 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void ValidateEnum(Type enumType, object enumVal)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(enumType, enumVal) && !IsEnumFlags(enumType))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(enumType.Name, (int)enumVal, enumType);
			}
		}

		internal static void ValidateEnum(string argumentName, Type enumType, object enumVal)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(enumType, enumVal) && !IsEnumFlags(enumType))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(argumentName, (int)enumVal, enumType);
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsPointInGroupByBox(UltraGridBase grid, Point pointInControlCoords)
		{
			if (grid.DisplayLayout.GroupByBox.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement val = grid.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal.ElementFromPoint(pointInControlCoords);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			val = val.GetAncestor(typeof(GroupByBoxUIElement));
			return val != null;
		}

		internal static CharacterCasing CaseToCharacterCasing(Case textCase)
		{
			return textCase switch
			{
				Case.Upper => CharacterCasing.Upper, 
				Case.Lower => CharacterCasing.Lower, 
				_ => CharacterCasing.Normal, 
			};
		}

		internal static Case CharacterCasingToCase(CharacterCasing characterCasing)
		{
			return characterCasing switch
			{
				CharacterCasing.Upper => Case.Upper, 
				CharacterCasing.Lower => Case.Lower, 
				_ => Case.Unchanged, 
			};
		}

		internal static UltraGridRow GetNearestDataRow(UltraGridRow row, bool prev)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridLayout layout = row.Layout;
			int num = row.ScrollPosition;
			if (num < 0 || layout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRow rowAtScrollPos;
			do
			{
				num += ((!prev) ? 1 : (-1));
				rowAtScrollPos = layout.GetRowAtScrollPos(num);
			}
			while (rowAtScrollPos != null && !rowAtScrollPos.IsDataRow);
			return rowAtScrollPos;
		}

		internal static void Swap(object[] arr, int i, int j)

			object obj = arr[i];
			arr[i] = arr[j];
			arr[j] = obj;
		}

			arr[i] = arr[j];
			arr[j] = num;
		}

		internal static bool IsObjectOfType(object obj, Type type)
		{
			if (obj != null)
			{
				return IsObjectOfType(obj.GetType(), type);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static bool IsObjectOfType(Type objectType, Type typeToCheck)
		{
			if (!(objectType == typeToCheck))
			{
				return typeToCheck.IsAssignableFrom(objectType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static UIElementToolTipItem CreateToolTipItem(string toolTipText, IToolTipItem existingToolTipItem)
		{
			UIElementToolTipItem uIElementToolTipItem = null;
			if (toolTipText != null && toolTipText.Length > 0)
			{
				uIElementToolTipItem = existingToolTipItem as UIElementToolTipItem;
				if (uIElementToolTipItem == null)
				{
					uIElementToolTipItem = new UIElementToolTipItem(toolTipText);
				}
				else
				{
					uIElementToolTipItem.Initialize(toolTipText);
				}
			}
			return uIElementToolTipItem;
		}

		internal static bool SetupElementToolTip(UIElement element, string toolTipText, bool useTextElemText)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
			UIElementToolTipItemBase uIElementToolTipItemBase = null;
			if (toolTipText == null || toolTipText.Length == 0)
			{
				if (useTextElemText)
				{
					TextUIElementBase val = (TextUIElementBase)GetChild(element, typeof(TextUIElementBase));
					if (val != null)
					{
						val.TrackCharactersRendered = true;
						val.TrackTextArea = true;
						uIElementToolTipItemBase = TextUIElementToolTipItem.Value;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				uIElementToolTipItemBase = CreateToolTipItem(toolTipText, element.ToolTipItem);
			}
			element.ToolTipItem = (IToolTipItem)(object)uIElementToolTipItemBase;
			return uIElementToolTipItemBase != null;
		}

		internal static string ToSingleLine(string text)
		{
			string newLine = Environment.NewLine;
			return text.Replace(newLine, " ");
		}

		internal static bool IsEmpty(string str)
		{
			if (str != null)
			{
				return str.Length == 0;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static string ApplyDelimiters(string text, string delim)
		{
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
			if (delim != null && delim.Length > 0)
			{
				text = delim + text + delim;
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal static Bitmap AddPadding(Bitmap image, Insets padding, Color paddingColor)
		{
			Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(image, image.Width + padding.Left + padding.Right, image.Height + padding.Top + padding.Bottom);
			int width = bitmap.Width;
			int height = bitmap.Height;
			for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
				{
					if (j < padding.Left || i < padding.Right || j >= padding.Left + image.Width || i >= padding.Top + image.Height)
					{
						bitmap.SetPixel(j, i, paddingColor);
					}
					else
					{
						bitmap.SetPixel(j, i, image.GetPixel(j - padding.Left, i - padding.Top));
					}
				}
			}
			return bitmap;
		}

		internal static UIElement GetChild(UIElement parent, Type type)
		{
			if (parent.HasChildElements)
			{
				UIElementsCollection childElements = parent.ChildElements;
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = ((ArrayList)(object)childElements).Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					UIElement val = childElements[i];
					if (IsObjectOfType(val, type))
					{
						return val;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static Activation MaxActivation(Activation a1, Activation a2)
		{
			if (activationLogicalOrder[(int)a1] <= activationLogicalOrder[(int)a2])
			{
				return a2;
			}
			return a1;
		}

		internal static UltraGridBand GetBandAssociatedWithChapteredColumn(UltraGridColumn chapteredColumn)
		{
			BandsCollection bandsCollection = ((chapteredColumn.Band != null) ? chapteredColumn.Band.Layout : null)?.SortedBands;
			if (bandsCollection != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = bandsCollection.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = bandsCollection[i];
					if (ultraGridBand.ParentColumn == chapteredColumn)
					{
						return ultraGridBand;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static void RemoveAll<T>(List<T> list, T itemToRemove) where T : class
		{
			int num = 0;
			int count = list.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (itemToRemove == list[i])
				{
					num++;
				}
				else if (num != 0)
				{
					list[i - num] = list[i];
				}
			}
			list.RemoveRange(count - num, num);
		}

		internal static Point GetDragIndicatorOffset(UIElement[] dragElements)
		{
			Rectangle a = dragElements[0].Rect;
			for (int i = 1; i < dragElements.Length; i++)
			{
				a = Rectangle.Union(a, dragElements[i].Rect);
			}
			Point result = new Point(-a.Width / 2, -a.Height);
			UIElement val = dragElements[0];
			if (val.Control != null)
			{
				Point pt = val.Control.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
				if (a.Contains(pt))
				{
					result = new Point(a.X - pt.X, a.Y - pt.Y);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static UltraGridColumn GetColumnFromLayoutItem(ILayoutItem item)
		{
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = item as UltraGridColumn;
			if (ultraGridColumn == null)
			{
				if (item is ColumnHeader)
				{
					ultraGridColumn = ((ColumnHeader)(object)item).Column;
				}
				else if (item is RowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder.CellLayoutItem)
				{
					ultraGridColumn = ((RowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder.CellLayoutItem)(object)item).Column;
				}
				else if (item is SummaryLayoutItem)
				{
					ultraGridColumn = ((SummaryLayoutItem)(object)item).Column;
				}
			}
			return ultraGridColumn;
		}

		internal static void SetCursorToCurrent(UltraGridBase grid, CurrentCursor currentCursor)
		{
			Cursor cursor = null;
			cursor = currentCursor switch
			{
				CurrentCursor.Valid => Cursors.Arrow, 
				CurrentCursor.Invalid => Cursors.No, 
				CurrentCursor.HideColumnCursor => (grid != null) ? grid.HideColumnCursor : Cursors.No, 
				_ => Cursors.Default, 
			};
			if (null != cursor)
			{
				Cursor.Current = cursor;
			}
		}

		internal static bool IsHotTracking(UIElement elem, bool isHotTracking)
		{
			if (!isHotTracking || elem == null || !elem.Enabled)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = (UltraGridLayout)elem.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridLayout));
			if (ultraGridLayout == null || ultraGridLayout.CellInEditMode != null || ultraGridLayout.CellGoingIntoEditMode != null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ControlUIElementBase controlElement = elem.ControlElement;
			if (controlElement == null || controlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture != null)
			{
				UIElement elementWithMouseCapture = controlElement.ElementWithMouseCapture;
				if (!elementWithMouseCapture.IsDescendantOf(elem))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool IsRowHotTracking(UIElement rowDescendantElem)
		{
			RowUIElementBase rowUIElementBase = ((rowDescendantElem != null) ? ((RowUIElementBase)(object)rowDescendantElem.GetAncestor(typeof(RowUIElementBase))) : null);
			if (rowUIElementBase != null)
			{
				return IsHotTracking((UIElement)(object)rowUIElementBase, rowUIElementBase.isMouseOverSelectorOrCellArea);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static int GetElemCount(object[] arr, object elem)
		{
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < arr.Length; i++)
			{
				if (elem == arr[i])
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static T GetFirstItem<T>(List<T> list)
		{
			if (list == null || list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			return list[0];
		}

		internal static T GetLastItem<T>(List<T> list)
		{
			if (list == null || list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return default(T);
			}
			return list[list.Count - 1];
		}

		internal static bool IsBackgroundOpaque(ref AppearanceData appData)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001a: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			if (3 == (int)((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BackColorAlpha)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BackColorAlpha == 0 || 1 == (int)((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BackColorAlpha)
			{
				int alphaLevel = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).AlphaLevel;
				if (alphaLevel != 0 && alphaLevel < 255)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static Stack<UltraGridRow> BuildParentChainStack(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			Stack<UltraGridRow> stack = new Stack<UltraGridRow>();
			for (UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = row; ultraGridRow != null; ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow)
			{
				stack.Push(ultraGridRow);
			}
			return stack;
		}

		internal AppearanceBase GetAppearance(int index)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown

			{
				AppearanceHolders[index] = new AppearanceHolder();

			}
			AppearanceHolders[index].Collection = Appearances;
			return AppearanceHolders[index].Appearance;
		}

		internal void SetAppearance(int index, AppearanceBase appearance)
		{
			//IL_0011: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Expected O, but got Unknown

			{
				AppearanceHolders[index] = new AppearanceHolder();
				appearanceHolders[index].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			if (appearance != AppearanceHolders[index].Appearance)
			{
				AppearanceHolders[index].Collection = Appearances;
				AppearanceHolders[index].Appearance = appearance;
				NotifyPropChange(appearancePropIds[index], null);
			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerializeAppearances()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < maxAppearanceCount; i++)
			{
				if (ShouldSerializeAppearance(i))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void ResetAppearances()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < maxAppearanceCount; i++)
			{
				ResetAppearance(i);
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(AppearanceManager source)
		{
			int num = Math.Min(source.maxAppearanceCount, maxAppearanceCount);
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				if (source.appearanceHolders != null && source.appearanceHolders[i] != null)
				{
					GetAppearance(i);
					AppearanceHolders[i].InitializeFrom(source.appearanceHolders[i]);
				}
				else if (appearanceHolders != null && appearanceHolders[i] != null)
				{
					appearanceHolders[i].Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializeTag(info, "Tag");
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "maxAppearanceCount", maxAppearanceCount);
			if (appearanceHolders == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (appearanceHolders[i] != null && appearanceHolders[i].ShouldSerialize())
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), appearanceHolders[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetAppearances();
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return ShouldSerializeAppearances();
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearance(int index, ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags)
		{
			AppearanceBase appearanceIfAllocated = GetAppearanceIfAllocated(index);
			if (appearanceIfAllocated != null)
			{
				appearanceIfAllocated.MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (appearanceHolders != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < appearanceHolders.Length; i++)
				{
					if (appearanceHolders[i] != null)
					{
						appearanceHolders[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
						appearanceHolders[i].Reset();
						appearanceHolders[i] = null;
					}
				}
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			base.OnSubObjectPropChanged(propChange);
			int num = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < AppearanceHolders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (HasAppearance(i) && GetAppearance(i) == propChange.Source)
				{
					num = i;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (num >= 0 && appearancePropIds != null)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(appearancePropIds[num], propChange);
			}
			else
			{
				NotifyPropChange(propChange);
			}
		}
	}

	internal class CellContextProvider : IConditionContextProvider
	{
		private WeakReference baseRowRef;

		private WeakReference baseColumnRef;

		public object Context
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = GridUtils.GetWeakReferenceTarget(baseRowRef) as UltraGridRow;
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = GridUtils.GetWeakReferenceTarget(baseColumnRef) as UltraGridColumn;
				if (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridColumn != null)
				{
					return ultraGridRow.Cells[ultraGridColumn];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public CellContextProvider(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (row == null || column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			baseRowRef = new WeakReference(row);
			baseColumnRef = new WeakReference(column);
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(UltraGridGroupTypeConverter))]
	public class UltraGridGroup : KeyedSubObjectBase, ISerializable, IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo, ILayoutGroup
	{
		public sealed class UltraGridGroupTypeConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_20"));
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is UltraGridGroup)
				{
					UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = (UltraGridGroup)value;
					string key = ultraGridGroup.Key;
					bool flag = key != null && key.Length > 0;
					ConstructorInfo constructorInfo = ((!flag) ? typeof(UltraGridGroup).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(int) }) : typeof(UltraGridGroup).GetConstructor(new Type[2]
					{
						typeof(string),
						typeof(int)
					}));
					if (constructorInfo != null)
					{
						if (flag)
						{
							return new InstanceDescriptor(constructorInfo, new object[2] { key, ultraGridGroup.InternalID }, isComplete: false);
						}
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructorInfo, new object[1] { ultraGridGroup.InternalID }, isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		private class GroupLayoutColumnsEnumerable : IEnumerable<UltraGridColumn>, IEnumerable
		{
			private UltraGridGroup parentGroup;

			public GroupLayoutColumnsEnumerable(UltraGridGroup parentGroup)
			{
				this.parentGroup = parentGroup;
			}

			IEnumerator<UltraGridColumn> IEnumerable<UltraGridColumn>.GetEnumerator()
			{
				if (parentGroup.Band == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				foreach (HeaderBase orderedColumnHeader in parentGroup.Band.OrderedColumnHeaders)
				{
					UltraGridColumn column = orderedColumnHeader.Column;
					if (column != null && column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup == parentGroup)
					{
						yield return column;
					}
				}
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				foreach (UltraGridColumn item in (IEnumerable<UltraGridColumn>)this)
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		private class GroupLayoutChildGroupsEnumerable : IEnumerable<UltraGridGroup>, IEnumerable
		{
			private UltraGridGroup parentGroup;

			public GroupLayoutChildGroupsEnumerable(UltraGridGroup parentGroup)
			{
				this.parentGroup = parentGroup;
			}

			IEnumerator<UltraGridGroup> IEnumerable<UltraGridGroup>.GetEnumerator()
			{
				if (parentGroup.Band == null)
				{
					yield break;
				}
				foreach (HeaderBase orderedGroupHeader in parentGroup.Band.OrderedGroupHeaders)
				{
					UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = orderedGroupHeader.Group;
					if (ultraGridGroup != null && ultraGridGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.ParentGroup == parentGroup)
					{
						yield return ultraGridGroup;
					}
				}
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				foreach (UltraGridGroup item in (IEnumerable<UltraGridGroup>)this)
				{
					yield return item;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Hidden
		{
			get
			{
				return hidden;
			}
			set
			{
				if (hidden != value)
				{
					hidden = value;
					if (Band != null && Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
					{
						Band.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
					}
					if (Band != null)
					{
						Band.BumpFixedHeadersVerifyVersion();
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Hidden, null);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool HiddenResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (band == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (band.RowLayoutStyle == RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout)
				{
					UltraGridGroup parentGroup = RowLayoutGroupInfo.ParentGroup;
					if (parentGroup != null)
					{
						if (parentGroup.HiddenResolved)
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (!Hidden && !parentGroup.Expanded)
						{
							return HiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed;
						}
					}
				}
				return Hidden;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		[MergableProperty(false)]
		public int Index
		{
			get
			{
				try
				{
					if (this == band.Groups[index])
					{
						return index;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				index = band.Groups.IndexOf(this);
				return index;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Visible)]
		public AppearanceBase CellAppearance
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0013: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (cellAppearanceHolder == null)
				{
					cellAppearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
					cellAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
				if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null)
				{
					cellAppearanceHolder.Collection = Band.Layout.Appearances;
				}
				return cellAppearanceHolder.Appearance;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0036: Expected O, but got Unknown
				if (cellAppearanceHolder == null || !cellAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance || value != cellAppearanceHolder.Appearance)
				{
					if (cellAppearanceHolder == null)
					{
						cellAppearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
						cellAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					}
					if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null)
					{
						cellAppearanceHolder.Collection = Band.Layout.Appearances;
					}
					cellAppearanceHolder.Appearance = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CellAppearance);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public GroupColumnsCollection Columns
		{
			get
			{
				if (groupColumnsCollection == null)
				{
					AllocateGroupColumnsCollection();
				}
				else if (Band != null && Band.ColumnsVersion != orderedColumnsVersion)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < groupColumnsCollection.Count; i++)
					{
						if (!Band.Columns.Contains(groupColumnsCollection[i]))
						{
							groupColumnsCollection.RemoveAt(i);
							i--;
						}
					}
					orderedColumnsVersion = Band.ColumnsVersion;
				}
				return groupColumnsCollection;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		internal bool AllowSizing
		{
			get
			{
				int minWidth = 0;
				int maxWidth = 0;
				if (!Header.Enabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (groupColumnsCollection == null || groupColumnsCollection.Count < 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				GetResizeRange(ref minWidth, ref maxWidth);
				return minWidth != maxWidth;
			}
		}

		internal bool ProportionalResizeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				if (header != null && (int)header.proportionalResizeOverride != 0)
				{
					return 1 == (int)header.proportionalResizeOverride;
				}
				if (Band.Layout.AutoFitAllColumns)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridColumn item in ColumnsResolved)
					{
						if (!item.HiddenResolved && item.ProportionalResize)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					if (Band != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < Band.Columns.Count; i++)
						{
							UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Band.Columns[i];
							if (!ultraGridColumn.HiddenResolved && ultraGridColumn.ProportionalResize)
							{
								return false;
							}
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		Size IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo.PreferredHeaderSize
		{
			get
			{
				Size preferredLabelSize = RowLayoutGroupInfo.PreferredLabelSize;
				LabelPosition labelPositionResolved = RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelPositionResolved;
				if (preferredLabelSize.Width == 0 && (labelPositionResolved == LabelPosition.Top || labelPositionResolved == LabelPosition.Bottom))
				{
					preferredLabelSize.Width = PreferredHeaderLayoutSize.Width;
				}
				if (preferredLabelSize.Height == 0 && (labelPositionResolved == LabelPosition.Left || labelPositionResolved == LabelPosition.Right))
				{
					preferredLabelSize.Height = PreferredHeaderLayoutSize.Height;
				}
				if (preferredLabelSize.Width <= 0)
				{
					preferredLabelSize.Width = CalculatePreferredGroupHeaderSize().Width;
				}
				if (preferredLabelSize.Height <= 0)
				{
					preferredLabelSize.Height = Header.Height;
					if (Band.CardView && Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
					{
						preferredLabelSize.Height = Math.Max(preferredLabelSize.Height, Header.Height);
					}
				}
				Size minimumLabelSize = RowLayoutGroupInfo.MinimumLabelSize;
				preferredLabelSize.Width = Math.Max(preferredLabelSize.Width, minimumLabelSize.Width);
				preferredLabelSize.Height = Math.Max(preferredLabelSize.Height, minimumLabelSize.Height);
				return preferredLabelSize;
			}
		}

		public bool Expanded
		{
			get
			{
				return expanded;
			}
			set
			{
				UltraGrid ultraGrid = GetGrid() as UltraGrid;
				if (expanded == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (ultraGrid != null)
				{
					CancelableGroupEventArgs e = new CancelableGroupEventArgs(this);
					if (value)
					{
						ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeGroupExpanded, e);
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeGroupCollapsed, e);
					}
					if (e.Cancel)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				expanded = value;
				groupWidthNeedsAdjusting = true;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupExpanded, null);
				if (ultraGrid != null)
				{
					GroupEventArgs e2 = new GroupEventArgs(this);
					if (value)
					{
						ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterGroupExpanded, e2);
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterGroupCollapsed, e2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridGroup(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			this.band = band;
			groupsCollection = this.band.Groups;
			Reset();
			if (this.band != null && internalID == 0)
			{
				internalID = this.band.Groups.GetUniqueID();
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridGroup(UltraGridBand band, string key)
			: base(key)
		{
			this.band = band;
			groupsCollection = this.band.Groups;
			Reset();
			if (this.band != null && internalID == 0)
			{
				internalID = this.band.Groups.GetUniqueID();
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridGroup(UltraGridGroup group, bool byMouse)
		{
			band = group.Band;
			groupsCollection = band.Groups;
			cloneData = new GroupCloneData();
			Key = group.Key;
			if (group.header != null)
			{
				header = group.header.Clone();
				header.InitGroup(this);
			}
			if (cloneData != null)
			{
				cloneData.clonedFromGroup = group;
				cloneData.width = group.Width;
				cloneData.visiblePosition = group.Header.VisiblePosition;
				group.GetGroupWidthRange(byMouse, groupResize: true, ref cloneData.minWidth, ref cloneData.maxWidth);
			}
			if (group.groupColumnsCollection != null)
			{
				groupColumnsCollection = group.groupColumnsCollection.Clone();
			}
			else
			{
				groupColumnsCollection = null;
			}
			if (group.rowLayoutGroupInfo != null && group.ShouldSerializeRowLayoutGroupInfo())
			{
				RowLayoutGroupInfo.InitializeFrom(group.RowLayoutGroupInfo);
			}
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeCellAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeHidden() && !ShouldSerializeKey() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeWidth() && !ShouldSerializeHiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed() && !ShouldSerializeAllowGroupCollapsing())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeExpanded();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetHidden();
			ResetCellAppearance();
			if (groupColumnsCollection != null)
			{
				groupColumnsCollection.Clear();
			}
			ResetHiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed();
			ResetAllowGroupCollapsing();
			ResetExpanded();
			ResetRowLayoutGroupInfo();
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (header != null)
			{
				header.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				header.Dispose();
				header = null;
			}
			if (cellAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				cellAppearanceHolder.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				cellAppearanceHolder.Reset();
				cellAppearanceHolder = null;
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			if (Key == null || Key.Length == 0)
			{
				if (band == null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("Group");
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append("Group#");
					stringBuilder.Append(Index);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(Key);
			}
			if (Header.Hidden)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append(" [hidden]");
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		public UltraGridGroup GetRelatedVisibleGroup(VisibleRelation relation)
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			HeadersCollection orderedGroupHeaders = band.OrderedGroupHeaders;
			if (orderedGroupHeaders != null && orderedGroupHeaders.Count > 0)
			{
				switch (relation)
				{
				case VisibleRelation.First:
					return orderedGroupHeaders[0].Group;
				case VisibleRelation.Last:
					return orderedGroupHeaders[orderedGroupHeaders.Count - 1].Group;
				case VisibleRelation.Next:
					if (orderedGroupHeaders.Contains(Header))
					{
						int num2 = orderedGroupHeaders.IndexOf(Header);
						if (num2 >= 0 && num2 < orderedGroupHeaders.Count - 1)
						{
							return orderedGroupHeaders[num2 + 1].Group;
						}
					}
					break;
				case VisibleRelation.Previous:
					if (orderedGroupHeaders.Contains(Header))
					{
						int num = orderedGroupHeaders.IndexOf(Header);
						if (num > 0)
						{
							return orderedGroupHeaders[num - 1].Group;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source == Header)
			{
				if (propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.CellAppearance) != null)
				{
					Band.ClearCachedHeaderFontHeights();
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Header, propChange);
			}
			else if (propChange.Source == groupColumnsCollection)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Columns, propChange);
				if (propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Hidden) != null)
				{
					groupWidthNeedsAdjusting = true;
					OnColumnsChanged();
				}
				else if (propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.IsGroupByColumn) != null)
				{
					groupWidthNeedsAdjusting = true;
					OnColumnsChanged();
				}
				else if (propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Level) != null)
				{
					OnColumnsChanged();
				}
				else if (propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.VisiblePosition) != null)
				{
					OnColumnsChanged();
				}
				else if (propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Width) != null || propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Caption) != null)
				{
					groupWidthNeedsAdjusting = true;
					OnColumnsChanged();
				}
			}
			else if (HasCellAppearance && propChange.Source == cellAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance)
			{
				Band.ClearCachedHeaderFontHeights();
				if (groupColumnsCollection != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < groupColumnsCollection.Count; i++)
					{
						groupColumnsCollection[i].ClearFontCache();
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CellAppearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasRowLayoutGroupInfo && propChange.Source == RowLayoutGroupInfo)
			{
				if (Band != null)
				{
					Band.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RowLayoutColumnInfo, propChange);
			}
		}

		internal void OnColumnsChanged()
		{
			band.Layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = false;
			band.Layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics();
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref ResolveAppearanceContext context)
		{
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00e6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (context.ObjectType == typeof(HeaderBase))
			{
				if (Header != null && Header.HasAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref context.ResolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					Header.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref context.UnresolvedProps);
				}
			}
			else if (HasCellAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref context.ResolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				cellAppearanceHolder.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref context.UnresolvedProps);
			}
			if ((int)context.UnresolvedProps != 0)
			{
				if (context.ObjectType == typeof(HeaderBase))
				{
					Band.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
					Band.Layout.ResolveColors(ref appData, ref context, SystemColors.Control, SystemColors.WindowFrame, SystemColors.WindowText, selectedPass: false);
				}
				else if (context.ObjectType == typeof(UltraGridCell) && (int)context.UnresolvedProps != 0 && context.IsCellOnly)
				{
					Band.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
				}
			}
		}

		public int GetIndex()
		{
			if (groupsCollection == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return groupsCollection.IndexOf(this);
		}

		internal bool CanInitializeFrom(UltraGridGroup source)
		{
			if (string.Compare(Key, source.Key, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			if (groupColumnsCollection == null)
			{
				return null;

		}

		internal void SetColumnPosition(UltraGridColumn column, short position)
		{
			if (column.Band != band)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_System.ArgumentException_134"));
			}
			UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = column.Group;
			if (this != ultraGridGroup)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_System.ArgumentException_135"));
			}
			ultraGridGroup.RemoveColumn(column);
			groupColumnsCollection.InternalInsert(position, column);
		}

		public int GetIndex(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			int result = -1;
			if (groupColumnsCollection != null)
			{
				result = (short)groupColumnsCollection.IndexOf(column);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void RemoveColumn(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column.Band != band)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_System.ArgumentException_136"));
			}
			UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = column.Group;
			if (ultraGridGroup != null)
			{
				if (this != ultraGridGroup)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_System.ArgumentException_137"));
				}
				groupColumnsCollection.Remove(column);
				groupWidthNeedsAdjusting = true;
			}
		}

		internal void AllocateGroupColumnsCollection()
		{
			if (groupColumnsCollection == null)

				groupColumnsCollection = new GroupColumnsCollection(this);
				if (groupColumnsCollection != null)
				{
					groupColumnsCollection.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				}
			}
		}

		private void AdjustGroupWidth(bool byMouse, bool groupResize, bool duringDrag)
		{
			if (groupColumnsCollection != null)
			{
				groupColumnsCollection.AdjustGroupWidth(byMouse, groupResize, duringDrag);

		internal UltraGridColumn GetColumnAtOffset(UltraGridRow row, int offsetX, int offsetY, bool daggingRight, bool daggingDown)
		{
			if (groupColumnsCollection == null || groupColumnsCollection.Count < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			short num = 0;
			short num2 = (short)band.LevelCount;
			int num3 = row?.BaseHeight ?? band.RowHeightResolved;
			int num4 = num3 / num2;
			offsetX = Math.Max(offsetX, 0);
			offsetX = Math.Min(offsetX, GetActualWidth(ignoreDraggingWidth: false));
			offsetY = Math.Max(offsetY, 1);
			offsetY = Math.Min(offsetY, num3);
			if (num2 > 0 && offsetY > num4)
			{
				num = (short)Math.Min(num2 - 1, offsetY / num4);
			}
			UltraGridColumn result;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = (result = null);
			for (int i = 0; i < groupColumnsCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = groupColumnsCollection[i];
				if (!ultraGridColumn2.HiddenResolved)
				{

					{
						ultraGridColumn = ultraGridColumn2;
					}
					result = ultraGridColumn2;
					if (ultraGridColumn2.Level == num && ultraGridColumn2.RelativeOrigin <= offsetX && ultraGridColumn2.RelativeOrigin + ultraGridColumn2.OverallWidth >= offsetX)
					{
						return ultraGridColumn2;
					}
				}
			}

			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void SetWidth(int newWidth, bool byMouse, bool fireEvents, bool fAdjustAllColsInGroup, bool fNotify)
		{
			int minWidth = 0;
			int maxWidth = 0;
			GetGroupWidthRange(byMouse, groupResize: true, ref minWidth, ref maxWidth);
			newWidth = Math.Max(newWidth, minWidth);
			if (maxWidth > minWidth)
			{
				newWidth = Math.Min(newWidth, maxWidth);
			}
			widthDuringDrag = 0;
			if (newWidth == width)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridBase grid = band.Layout.Grid;
			if (fireEvents && grid != null)
			{
				GroupsCollection groupsCollection = new GroupsCollection(band);
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = null;
				ultraGridGroup = Clone(byMouse);
				ultraGridGroup.cloneData.width = newWidth;
				groupsCollection.AddClonedGroup(ultraGridGroup.Key);
				hasBeforePosChanged = true;
				BeforeGroupPosChangedEventArgs e = new BeforeGroupPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.Sized, DragStrategy.ToGroupHeaderArray(groupsCollection.All), PosChangedType.Sized);
				grid.FireBeforeGroupPosChanged(e);
				hasBeforePosChanged = false;
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					ultraGridGroup.OnDispose();
					return;
				}
				width = ultraGridGroup.cloneData.width;
				if (fAdjustAllColsInGroup)
				{

				}
				if (fNotify)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Width, null);
				}
				groupsCollection.ClearClonedGroups();
				groupsCollection.AddClonedGroup(Key);
				AfterGroupPosChangedEventArgs e2 = new AfterGroupPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.Sized, DragStrategy.ToGroupHeaderArray(new UltraGridGroup[1] { this }), PosChangedType.Sized);
				grid.FireAfterGroupPosChanged(e2);
				ultraGridGroup.OnDispose();
				groupsCollection.ClearClonedGroups();
			}
			else
			{
				width = newWidth;
				if (fAdjustAllColsInGroup)
				{
					AdjustAllColumnWidths(byMouse: true, groupResize: true, duringDrag: false, fireGroupResizeEvent: false, columnAdded: false, null);
				}

		internal bool SetOrderedCols(OrderedDropColumns orderedDropCols)
		{
			if (this.groupColumnsCollection == null || orderedDropCols == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			GroupColumnsCollection groupColumnsCollection = this.groupColumnsCollection.Clone();
			if (groupColumnsCollection != null)
			{
				this.groupColumnsCollection.Clear();
				int num = 0;
				List<HeaderBase> headerList = orderedDropCols.GetHeaderList();
				if (headerList == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < headerList.Count; i++)
				{
					HeaderBase headerBase = headerList[i];
					ColumnHeader columnHeader = (ColumnHeader)headerBase;
					if (columnHeader == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					PositionInfo positionInfo = new PositionInfo();
					positionInfo = orderedDropCols.GetPositionInfo(columnHeader);
					UltraGridColumn column = columnHeader.Column;
					if (columnHeader.Group != this)
					{
						column.Group = null;
						column.InternalSetLevel(positionInfo.Level, notify: false);
						this.groupColumnsCollection.InternalAdd(column);
						column.InternalSetGroup(this);
						num++;
						continue;
					}
					for (int j = 0; j < groupColumnsCollection.Count; j++)
					{
						if (column == groupColumnsCollection[j])
						{
							column.InternalSetLevel(positionInfo.Level, notify: false);
							this.groupColumnsCollection.InternalInsert(num, column);
							num++;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (headerList != null)
				{
					headerList.Clear();
					headerList = null;
				}
				groupWidthNeedsAdjusting = true;
				for (int k = 0; k < this.groupColumnsCollection.Count; k++)
				{
					this.groupColumnsCollection[k].NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.VisiblePosition);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void Swap(UltraGridGroup swapGroup)
		{
			if (!(Band.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_138"));
			}
			if (band != swapGroup.band)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_139"));
			}
			if (swapGroup == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridGroup[] array = new UltraGridGroup[2];
			UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = Clone(byMouse: false);
			UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup2 = swapGroup.Clone(byMouse: false);
			if (ultraGridGroup == null || ultraGridGroup2 == null || ultraGridGroup.cloneData == null || ultraGridGroup2.cloneData == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int visiblePosition = Header.VisiblePosition;
			int visiblePosition2 = swapGroup.Header.VisiblePosition;
			bool flag = false;
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = ((Band != null && Band.Layout != null) ? Band.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion : null);
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (colScrollRegion != null && Band.AreFixedHeadersAllowed(colScrollRegion))
			{
				flag2 = Header.FixedResolved;
				flag3 = swapGroup.Header.FixedResolved;
				if (flag2 != flag3)
				{
					ultraGridGroup.Header.InternalSetFixed(flag3);
					ultraGridGroup2.Header.InternalSetFixed(flag2);
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			ultraGridGroup.cloneData.visiblePosition = visiblePosition2;
			ultraGridGroup2.cloneData.visiblePosition = visiblePosition;
			array[0] = ultraGridGroup;
			array[1] = ultraGridGroup2;
			if (Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				ultraGridGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.InitializeFrom(ultraGridGroup2.RowLayoutGroupInfo);
				ultraGridGroup2.RowLayoutGroupInfo.InitializeFrom(RowLayoutGroupInfo);
				ultraGridGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelSpan = RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelSpan;
				ultraGridGroup2.RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelSpan = swapGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelSpan;
			}
			hasBeforePosChanged = true;
			swapGroup.HasBeforePosChanged = true;
			BeforeGroupPosChangedEventArgs e = new BeforeGroupPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.Swapped, DragStrategy.ToGroupHeaderArray(array), PosChangedType.Swapped);
			ultraGrid.FireBeforeGroupPosChanged(e);
			hasBeforePosChanged = false;
			swapGroup.HasBeforePosChanged = false;
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				if (Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					RowLayoutGroupInfo.InitializeFrom(ultraGridGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo);
					swapGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.InitializeFrom(ultraGridGroup2.RowLayoutGroupInfo);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					Header.InternalSetFixed(flag3);
					swapGroup.Header.InternalSetFixed(flag2);
					Header.InternalSetVisiblePosValue(visiblePosition2);
					swapGroup.Header.InternalSetVisiblePosValue(visiblePosition);
					Band.BumpFixedHeadersVerifyVersion(dirtyOrderedHeaders: true);
					swapGroup.Header.NotifyFixedChanged();
					Header.NotifyFixedChanged();
				}
				else
				{
					Band.OrderedGroupHeaders.Swap(Header, swapGroup.Header);
				}
				Band.Layout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
				Band.Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false);
				if (Band.Layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false) != null)
				{
					Band.Layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics();
				}
				array[0] = this;
				array[1] = swapGroup;
				AfterGroupPosChangedEventArgs e2 = new AfterGroupPosChangedEventArgs(PosChanged.Swapped, DragStrategy.ToGroupHeaderArray(array), PosChangedType.Swapped);
				ultraGrid.FireAfterGroupPosChanged(e2);
			}
		}

		internal void CreateSwapList(ValueList swapDropDown)
		{
			GroupsCollection groups = Band.Groups;
			if (groups == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = ((Band != null && Band.Layout != null) ? Band.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion : null);
			Band.AddSwapDropdownFixUnfixItem(swapDropDown, Header);
			for (int i = 0; i < groups.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = groups[i];
				if (this != ultraGridGroup && !ultraGridGroup.HiddenResolved && (colScrollRegion == null || !Band.AreFixedHeadersAllowed(colScrollRegion) || Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, Header) == Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, ultraGridGroup.Header) || (FixedHeaderIndicator.None != Header.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved && FixedHeaderIndicator.None != ultraGridGroup.Header.FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved)) && (Band.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout || (!IsDescendantOfGroup(this, ultraGridGroup) && !IsDescendantOfGroup(ultraGridGroup, this) && ultraGridGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.SpanXResolved == RowLayoutGroupInfo.SpanXResolved && ultraGridGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.SpanYResolved == RowLayoutGroupInfo.SpanYResolved)))
				{
					swapDropDown.ValueListItems.Add((object)ultraGridGroup, ultraGridGroup.Header.Caption);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_012d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			PropertyCategories propertyCategories = ((context.Context is PropertyCategories) ? ((PropertyCategories)context.Context) : PropertyCategories.All);
			if ((propertyCategories & PropertyCategories.Groups) != 0)
			{
				if (ShouldSerializeCellAppearance())
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CellAppearanceHolder", cellAppearanceHolder);
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeWidth())
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Width", width);
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeHidden())

					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Hidden", hidden);
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeKey())
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
				}
				SerializeTag(info);
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Columns", Columns);
				if (Header.ShouldSerialize())
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Header", Header);
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeRowLayoutGroupInfo())
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RowLayoutGroupInfo", rowLayoutGroupInfo);
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeExpanded())
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Expanded", expanded);
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeHiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed())
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "HiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed", HiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed);
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeAllowGroupCollapsing())
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AllowGroupCollapsing", AllowGroupCollapsing);

			}
		}

		protected UltraGridGroup(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_0258: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0262: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if ((((context.Context is PropertyCategories) ? ((PropertyCategories)context.Context) : PropertyCategories.All) & PropertyCategories.Groups) == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Reset();
			band = null;
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)

				case "CellAppearanceHolder":

					break;
				case "Width":

					break;
				case "Hidden":
					hidden = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), hidden);
					break;
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), Key);

				case "Tag":

					break;
				case "Columns":

					break;

					break;
				case "RowLayoutGroupInfo":
					rowLayoutGroupInfo = (RowLayoutColumnInfo)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RowLayoutColumnInfo), null);
					break;
				case "Expanded":
					Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, ref expanded);
					break;
				case "HiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed":
					Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, ref hiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed);
					break;
