		}

		private void InitGroupColumnsOnDeserialization()
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			if (band.Columns != null)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in band.Columns)
				{
					if (column.GroupId == internalID)
					{
						num++;
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, column.IndexInGroup);
					}
				}
			}
			if (num < 1 || num2 != num - 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridColumn[] array = new UltraGridColumn[num];
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column2 in band.Columns)
			{
				if (column2.GroupId == internalID)
				{
					if (array[column2.IndexInGroup] != null)
					{
						return;
					}
					array[column2.IndexInGroup] = column2;
				}
			}
			if (groupColumnsCollection == null)
			{
				groupColumnsCollection = new GroupColumnsCollection(this);
			}
			groupColumnsCollection.InitDuringDeserialization(array);
		}

		internal void InitBand(UltraGridBand band, bool calledFromEndInit)
		{
			this.band = band;
			if (calledFromEndInit)
			{
				InitGroupColumnsOnDeserialization();
				return;
			}
			if (header != null)
			{
				header.InitGroup(this);
			}
			if (this.band != null && cellAppearanceHolder != null)
			{
				cellAppearanceHolder.Collection = this.band.Layout.Appearances;
			}
			if (this.band != null && internalID == 0)
			{
				internalID = this.band.Groups.GetUniqueID();
			}
			if (groupColumnsCollection != null)
			{
				groupColumnsCollection.InitBand(band, this);
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(UltraGridGroup source, PropertyCategories propCat)
		{
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006e: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_010a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_010f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((propCat & PropertyCategories.Groups) == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Key = source.Key;
			width = source.width;
			hidden = source.hidden;
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.Tag;
			}
			if (internalID == 0)
			{
				internalID = source.InternalID;
			}
			if (source.HasCellAppearance)
			{
				if (!HasCellAppearance)
				{
					cellAppearanceHolder = new AppearanceHolder();
				}
				cellAppearanceHolder.InitializeFrom(source.cellAppearanceHolder);
			}
			Header.InitializeFrom(source.Header, propCat);
			if (source.Columns != null)
			{
				if (groupColumnsCollection == null)
				{
					AllocateGroupColumnsCollection();
				}
				groupColumnsCollection.InitializeFrom(source.Columns, propCat);
			}
			else if (groupColumnsCollection != null)
			{
				groupColumnsCollection.Clear();
			}
			if (source.rowLayoutGroupInfo != null)
			{
				RowLayoutGroupInfo.InitializeFrom(source.rowLayoutGroupInfo);
			}
			else if (rowLayoutGroupInfo != null)
			{
				rowLayoutGroupInfo.Reset();
			}
			hiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed = source.hiddenWhenParentGroupCollapsed;
			allowGroupCollapsing = source.allowGroupCollapsing;
			expanded = source.expanded;
		}

		private Size CalculatePreferredGroupHeaderSize()
		{
			//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (band == null)
			{
				return Size.Empty;
			}
			Size result = new Size(0, 0);
			if (Header != null)
			{
				string caption = Header.Caption;
				int length = caption.Length;
				if (length > 0)
				{
					AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
					Header.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, (AppearancePropFlags)65011720);
					result = band.Layout.CalculateFontSize(ref appData, caption);
				}
			}
			if (AllowSwapping)
			{
				result.Width += 10;
			}
			if (AllowGroupCollapsingResolved)
			{
				int num = band.ExpansionIndicatorWidth + band.Layout.GROUP_EXPANSIONINDICATOR_PADDING;
				result.Width += num;
			}
			result.Width += 14;
			return result;
		}

		private void CalcLayoutHelper(int bandExtent)
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if (ultraGridBand == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			layoutItemDimensionsCellArea = null;
			layoutItemDimensionsHeaderArea = null;
			if (!ultraGridBand.CardView)
			{
				if (bandExtent < 0)
				{
					bandExtent = ultraGridBand.GetExtentLayout();
				}
				if (ultraGridBand.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
				{
					LayoutContainerCalcSize cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize = GetCachedLayoutContainerCalcSize();
					cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize.Initialize(PreferredHeaderLayoutSize);
					HeaderLayoutManager.LayoutContainer((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize, (object)null);
					layoutItemDimensionsHeaderArea = gridBagHeaderLayoutManager.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize, (object)null);
				}
				LayoutContainerCalcSize cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize2 = GetCachedLayoutContainerCalcSize();
				cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize2.Initialize(PreferredRowLayoutSize);
				RowLayoutManager.LayoutContainer((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize2, (object)null);
				layoutItemDimensionsCellArea = gridBagRowLayoutManager.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize2, (object)null);
			}
			else
			{
				if (ultraGridBand.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
				{
					LayoutContainerCalcSize cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize3 = GetCachedLayoutContainerCalcSize();
					cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize3.Initialize();
					HeaderLayoutManager.LayoutContainer((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize3, (object)null);
					layoutItemDimensionsHeaderArea = gridBagHeaderLayoutManager.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize3, (object)null);
				}
				Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(0, 0, Band.CardWidthResolved, PreferredRowLayoutSize.Height);
				LayoutContainerCalcSize cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize4 = GetCachedLayoutContainerCalcSize();
				cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize4.Initialize(rect);
				RowLayoutManager.LayoutContainer((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize4, (object)null);
				layoutItemDimensionsCellArea = gridBagRowLayoutManager.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)cachedLayoutContainerCalcSize4, (object)null);
			}
			UltraGridColumn[] layoutVisibleColumns = GetLayoutVisibleColumns();
			for (int i = 0; i < layoutVisibleColumns.Length; i++)
			{
				Size cardLabelSize = layoutVisibleColumns[i].CardLabelSize;
			}
			ultraGridBand.BumpMajorRowHeightVersion();
		}

		internal void GetDescendantColumnsHelper(bool recursive, List<UltraGridColumn> columnsList)
		{

			}

				return;
			}
			IEnumerable<UltraGridGroup> childGroupsResolved = ChildGroupsResolved;
			if (childGroupsResolved == null)
			{
				return;

		}

		internal UltraGridColumn[] GetLayoutVisibleColumns()
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if (ultraGridBand == null)
			{
				return new UltraGridColumn[0];
			}
			ColumnsCollection columns = ultraGridBand.Columns;
			List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>(columns.Count);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = columns.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = columns[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.IsVisibleInLayout && ShouldIncludeInGroupLayout(ultraGridColumn))
				{
					list.Add(ultraGridColumn);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal UltraGridGroup[] GetLayoutVisibleGroups()
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if (ultraGridBand == null || ultraGridBand.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout)
			{
				return new UltraGridGroup[0];
			}
			GroupsCollection groups = ultraGridBand.Groups;
			List<UltraGridGroup> list = new List<UltraGridGroup>(groups.Count);
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = groups.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = groups[i];
				if (ultraGridGroup != null && ultraGridGroup.IsVisibleInLayout && ShouldIncludeInGroupLayout(ultraGridGroup))
				{
					list.Add(ultraGridGroup);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal static ILayoutGroup GetLayoutGroup(UltraGridBand band, ILayoutChildItem layoutItem)
		{
			switch (band.RowLayoutStyle)
			{
			case RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout:
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = UltraGridBand.GetRowLayoutColumnInfo((ILayoutItem)(object)layoutItem);
				if (rowLayoutColumnInfo == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				UltraGridGroup parentGroup = rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup;
				if (parentGroup == null)
				{
					return (ILayoutGroup)(object)band;
				}
				return (ILayoutGroup)(object)parentGroup;
			}
			case RowLayoutStyle.ColumnLayout:
				return (ILayoutGroup)(object)band;
			case RowLayoutStyle.None:
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn GetRightMostColumn()
		{
			GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection val = LayoutItemDimensions;
			UltraGridColumn rightMostItem = GetRightMostItem(GetLayoutVisibleColumns(), val);
			UltraGridGroup rightMostItem2 = GetRightMostItem(GetLayoutVisibleGroups(), val);
			if (rightMostItem2 == null)
			{
				return rightMostItem;
			}
			if (rightMostItem != null)
			{
				int originX = val[(ILayoutItem)(object)rightMostItem2.RowLayoutGroupInfo].OriginX;
				int originX2 = val[(ILayoutItem)(object)rightMostItem.RowLayoutColumnInfo].OriginX;
				if (originX <= originX2)
				{
					return rightMostItem;
				}
			}
			return rightMostItem2.GetRightMostColumn() ?? rightMostItem;
		}

		private static T GetRightMostItem<T>(T[] items, GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection layoutItemDimensions) where T : IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo
		{
			T val = default(T);
			for (int i = 0; i < items.Length; i++)
			{
				T val2 = items[i];
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = val2.RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				if (layoutItemDimensions.Exists((ILayoutItem)(object)rowLayoutColumnInfo) && (val == null || layoutItemDimensions[(ILayoutItem)(object)rowLayoutColumnInfo].OriginX > layoutItemDimensions[(ILayoutItem)(object)val.RowLayoutColumnInfo].OriginX))
				{
					val = val2;
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal static bool IsDescendantOfGroup(UltraGridGroup group, IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo)
		{
			bool flag = iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo == group;
			UltraGridGroup parentGroup = iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup;
			while (parentGroup != null && !flag)
			{
				if (parentGroup == group)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				parentGroup = parentGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo.ParentGroup;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool ShouldIncludeInGroupLayout(IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo)
		{
			return band.RowLayoutStyle switch
			{
				RowLayoutStyle.None => false, 
				RowLayoutStyle.ColumnLayout => false, 
				RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout => iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup == this, 
				_ => true, 
			};
		}

		private void SetCachedLayoutItemDimensions(UltraGridGroup[] groupsArr)
		{
			SetCachedSpans();
			foreach (UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup in groupsArr)
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = ultraGridGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo;
				rowLayoutColumnInfo.cachedOriginXResolved = layoutItemDimensions[(ILayoutItem)(object)rowLayoutColumnInfo].OriginX;
				rowLayoutColumnInfo.cachedOriginYResolved = layoutItemDimensions[(ILayoutItem)(object)rowLayoutColumnInfo].OriginY;
			}
			RowLayoutGroupInfo.shouldPositionCellElement = LabelPosition.LabelOnly != RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelPositionResolved;
			RowLayoutGroupInfo.shouldPositionLabelElement = LabelPosition.None != RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelPositionResolved;
		}

		private void SetCachedSpans()
		{
			RowLayoutGroupInfo.cachedSpanXResolved = gridBagLayoutManagerHelper.ColumnWidths.Length;
			RowLayoutGroupInfo.cachedSpanYResolved = gridBagLayoutManagerHelper.RowHeights.Length;
			switch (RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
			{
			case LabelPosition.Top:
			case LabelPosition.Bottom:
				RowLayoutGroupInfo.cachedSpanYResolved += RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelSpan;
				break;
			case LabelPosition.Left:
			case LabelPosition.Right:
				RowLayoutGroupInfo.cachedSpanXResolved += RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelSpan;
				break;

				{
					rect.Y--;
				}
				HAlign imageHAlign = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageHAlign;
				switch (imageHAlign - 1)
				{
				case 2:
					rect.X--;
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= rect.Width + 1;
					break;
				default:
					rect.X++;
					rectInsideBorders.Width -= rect.Width + 1;
					rectInsideBorders.X += rect.Width + 1;
					break;
				case 1:
					break;
				}
				((UIElement)val2).Rect = rect;
				((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)val2);
			}
			if (val == null)
			{
				val = new TextUIElement((UIElement)(object)this, buttonDef.Caption);
			}
			((TextUIElementBase)val).Text = buttonDef.Caption;
			((UIElement)val).Rect = rectInsideBorders;
			((UIElement)this).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)val);
		}
	}

		internal override void InitializeFrom(SpecialBoxBase source, PropertyCategories propertyCategories)
		{
			//IL_0070: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			base.InitializeFrom(source, propertyCategories);
			if ((propertyCategories & PropertyCategories.General) != 0 && source is GroupByBox groupByBox)
			{
				if (groupByBox.bandLabelAppearanceHolder != null && groupByBox.bandLabelAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
				{
					AppearanceBase bandLabelAppearance = BandLabelAppearance;
					bandLabelAppearanceHolder.InitializeFrom(groupByBox.bandLabelAppearanceHolder);
				}
				else if (bandLabelAppearanceHolder != null && bandLabelAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
				{
					bandLabelAppearanceHolder.Reset();
				}
				BandLabelBorderStyle = groupByBox.BandLabelBorderStyle;
				ShowBandLabels = groupByBox.ShowBandLabels;
				ButtonBorderStyle = groupByBox.buttonBorderStyle;
				style = groupByBox.style;
				if (groupByBox.promptAppearanceHolder != null && groupByBox.promptAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
				{
					AppearanceBase promptAppearance = PromptAppearance;
					promptAppearanceHolder.InitializeFrom(groupByBox.promptAppearanceHolder);
				}
				else if (promptAppearanceHolder != null && promptAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
				{
					promptAppearanceHolder.Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!base.ShouldSerialize() && !ShouldSerializeBandLabelAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeBandLabelBorderStyle() && !ShouldSerializeShowBandLabels() && !ShouldSerializeButtonBorderStyle() && !ShouldSerializePromptAppearance())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeStyle();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			ResetBandLabelAppearance();
			ResetBandLabelBorderStyle();
			ResetShowBandLabels();
			ResetButtonBorderStyle();
			ResetPromptAppearance();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (!OnSubObjectPropChangedHelper(propChange))
			{
				if (HasBandLabelAppearance && bandLabelAppearanceHolder.RootAppearance == propChange.Source)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.BandLabelAppearance, propChange);
				}
				else
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupByBox, propChange);
				}
			}
		}

		internal ButtonDefinition[] GetButtons(ShowBandLabels bandLablesToShow)
		{
			List<ButtonDefinition> list = new List<ButtonDefinition>();
			BandsCollection sortedBands = base.Layout.SortedBands;
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedBands.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = sortedBands[i];
				if (ultraGridBand.HiddenResolved)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (ultraGridBand.HasGroupBySortColumns)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < ultraGridBand.SortedColumns.Count; j++)
					{
						if (ultraGridBand.SortedColumns[j].IsGroupByColumn)
						{
							string text = ultraGridBand.SortedColumns[j].Header.Caption;
							if (text.IndexOf('\r') >= 0 || text.IndexOf('\n') >= 0)
							{
								text = text.Replace("\r\n", " ");
								text = text.Replace('\n', ' ');
								text = text.Replace('\r', ' ');
							}
							list.Add(new ButtonDefinition(null, ultraGridBand.SortedColumns[j], text));
						}
					}
				}
				bool flag = false;
				switch (bandLablesToShow)
				{
				case ShowBandLabels.All:
					flag = true;
					break;
				case ShowBandLabels.AllWithGroupByColumnsOnly:
					flag = FirstBandWithGroupByColumns != null;
					break;
				case ShowBandLabels.IntermediateBandsOnly:
				{
					UltraGridBand lastBandWithGroupByColumns = LastBandWithGroupByColumns;
					if (lastBandWithGroupByColumns != null && ultraGridBand.Index < lastBandWithGroupByColumns.Index)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					break;
				}
				case ShowBandLabels.None:
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					list.Add(new ButtonDefinition(ultraGridBand, null, ultraGridBand.AddButtonCaptionResolved));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal ButtonDefinition[] GetButtons()
		{
			return GetButtons(ShowBandLabelsResolved);
		}

		internal Size CalcRequiredSize(ShowBandLabels showBandLabels)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Size promptSize = base.PromptSize;
			UIElement uIElement = base.Layout.GetUIElement(verify: false);
			int borderThickness = base.Layout.GetBorderThickness(uIElement.BorderStyle);
			Rectangle rectangle = new Rectangle(0, 0, uIElement.Rect.Width - 2 * borderThickness, ((Control)(object)base.Layout.Grid).Height - 2 * borderThickness);
			ButtonDefinition[] buttons = GetButtons(showBandLabels);
			if (buttons == null || buttons.Length == 0)
			{
				return new Size(rectangle.Width, MIN_HEIGHT);
			}
			Rectangle rectangle2 = new Rectangle(rectangle.Left + BTN_BAND_HEIGHT_OFFSET, rectangle.Top + BTN_BAND_HEIGHT_OFFSET, 2 + promptSize.Width, 2 + promptSize.Height);
			rectangle2.Width = 0;
			if (Style == GroupByBoxStyle.Full)
			{
				rectangle2.Y -= rectangle2.Height / 2;
			}
			if (buttons != null && buttons.Length != 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < buttons.Length; i++)
				{
					if (buttons[i].Caption != null)
					{
						Size buttonSize = GetButtonSize(buttons[i]);
						Rectangle rectangle3 = new Rectangle(rectangle2.Right + BTN_MIN_SPACING_HORZ, rectangle2.Top + ((Style == GroupByBoxStyle.Full) ? (rectangle2.Height / 2) : 0), buttonSize.Width, buttonSize.Height);
						rectangle2 = rectangle3;
					}
				}
			}
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			empty.Width = rectangle2.Right - rectangle.Left + BTN_BAND_HEIGHT_OFFSET;
			empty.Height = rectangle2.Bottom - rectangle.Top + BTN_BAND_HEIGHT_OFFSET;
			return empty;
		}

		}

		internal Size GetButtonSize(ButtonDefinition buttonDef)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0064: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d6: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			Size empty = Size.Empty;
			AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
			ResolveGroupByButtonAppearance(ref appData, (AppearancePropFlags)137438953471L, buttonDef);
			string caption = buttonDef.Caption;
			empty = ((caption.Length <= 0) ? base.Layout.CalculateFontSize(ref appData, "WWWWy") : base.Layout.CalculateFontSize(ref appData, caption));
			int borderThickness = base.Layout.GetBorderThickness((buttonDef.column != null) ? ButtonBorderStyleResolved : BandLabelBorderStyleResolved);
			empty.Height = 2 + empty.Height + 2 * borderThickness;
			Image image = null;
			Size size = Size.Empty;
			CalcDisplayedImageSize(appData, empty.Height - 2 * borderThickness, out image, out size);
			if (buttonDef.column != null)
			{
				if (caption.Length <= 0 && size.Width > 0)
				{
					empty.Width = 0;
				}
				if (2 != (int)((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ImageHAlign || empty.Width == 0)
				{
					empty.Width += 2 + size.Width;
				}
				empty.Width += base.Layout.SORT_INDICATOR_ELEMENT_WIDTH + 2 * borderThickness;
			}
			else
			{
				empty.Width = Math.Max(35, 2 + 2 * borderThickness + empty.Width);
			}
			return base.Layout.AdjustForTouchMode(empty);
		}

		internal void CalcDisplayedImageSize(AppearanceData appData, int maxHeight, out Image image, out Size size)
		{
			image = null;
			size = Size.Empty;
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).Image == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).GetImage(base.Layout.Grid.ImageList);
			if (image != null)
			{
				size = image.Size;
				if (maxHeight > 2 && size.Height > maxHeight - 2)
				{
					size.Width = (int)((double)size.Width * ((double)(maxHeight - 2) / (double)size.Height));
					size.Height = maxHeight - 2;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResolveGroupByButtonAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, ButtonDefinition buttonDef)

		}

		internal void ResolveGroupByButtonAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, ButtonDefinition buttonDef, bool resolveDefaultColors)
		{
			if (buttonDef.column != null)
			{
				buttonDef.column.Header.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref requestedProps, resolveDefaultColors, hotTrackingHeader: false, isGroupByBoxButton: true);
			}
			else
			{
				ResolveBandLabelAppearance(ref appData, requestedProps);

	internal class GroupByEvaluatorFactory
	{
		private class CellTextEvaluator : IGroupByEvaluator
		{
			private readonly bool isCaseInsensitive;

			internal CellTextEvaluator(SortComparisonType sortComparisonType)
			{
				isCaseInsensitive = sortComparisonType == SortComparisonType.CaseInsensitive;
			}

			object IGroupByEvaluator.GetGroupByValue(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				string cellText = row.GetCellText(groupByRow.Column);
				if (cellText != null)
				{
					return cellText;
				}
				return "";
			}

			bool IGroupByEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRow(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				string cellText = row.GetCellText(groupByRow.Column);
				cellText = ((cellText == null) ? "" : cellText);
				return string.Compare(groupByRow.Value.ToString(), cellText, isCaseInsensitive) == 0;
			}
		}

		private class DateEvaluator : IGroupByEvaluator
		{
			object IGroupByEvaluator.GetGroupByValue(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				return GetGroupByValueHelper(groupByRow, row);
			}

			internal static DateTime GetGroupByValueHelper(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (!(groupByRow.Value is DateTime))
				{
					return DateTime.MinValue;
				}
				return (DateTime)groupByRow.Value;
			}

			bool IGroupByEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRow(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (DoesGroupContainRowHelper(groupByRow, row, out var dateInGroup, out var dateInCell))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return dateInCell.Date == dateInGroup.Date;
			}

			internal static bool DoesGroupContainRowHelper(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row, out DateTime dateInGroup, out DateTime dateInCell)
			{
				object obj = row.GetCellValue(groupByRow.Column);
				dateInGroup = (DateTime)groupByRow.Value;
				if (!(obj is DateTime))
				{
					obj = DateTime.MinValue;
				}
				dateInCell = (DateTime)obj;
				return false;
			}
		}

		private abstract class DateGroupByComparerBase : IComparer, IComparer<UltraGridCell>
		{
			public virtual int Compare(UltraGridCell xxCell, UltraGridCell yyCell)
			{
				return CompareHelper(xxCell.Value, yyCell.Value);
			}

			public virtual int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = x as UltraGridCell;
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell2 = y as UltraGridCell;
				object value = ultraGridCell.Value;
				object value2 = ultraGridCell2.Value;
				return CompareHelper(value, value2);
			}

			private int CompareHelper(object xxValue, object yyValue)
			{
				if (xxValue is DateTime)
				{
					if (yyValue is DateTime)
					{
						int num = ((IComparable)xxValue).CompareTo(yyValue);
						if (num == 0 || AreInSameGroupBy((DateTime)xxValue, (DateTime)yyValue))
						{
							return 0;
						}
						return num;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				if (yyValue is DateTime)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 0;
			}

			protected abstract bool AreInSameGroupBy(DateTime x, DateTime y);
		}

		private class FirstCharactersEvaluator : IGroupByEvaluatorEx, IGroupByEvaluator
		{
			private readonly int numChars;

			private readonly bool isCaseInsensitive;

			internal FirstCharactersEvaluator(int numChars, SortComparisonType sortComparisonType)
			{
				this.numChars = numChars;
				isCaseInsensitive = sortComparisonType == SortComparisonType.CaseInsensitive;
			}

			object IGroupByEvaluator.GetGroupByValue(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				return GetFirstCharactersOfCellText(groupByRow, row);
			}

			bool IGroupByEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRow(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				string strA = ((groupByRow.Value == null) ? "" : groupByRow.Value.ToString());
				string firstCharactersOfCellText = GetFirstCharactersOfCellText(groupByRow, row);
				return string.Compare(strA, firstCharactersOfCellText, isCaseInsensitive) == 0;
			}

			private string GetFirstCharactersOfCellText(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				return GetFirstCharactersOfText(row.GetCellText(groupByRow.Column));
			}

			private string GetFirstCharactersOfText(string text)
			{
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = string.Empty;
				}
				else if (numChars < text.Length)
				{
					text = text.Substring(0, numChars);
				}
				return text;
			}

			int IGroupByEvaluatorEx.Compare(UltraGridCell xxCell, UltraGridCell yyCell)
			{
				string firstCharactersOfText = GetFirstCharactersOfText(xxCell.Text);
				string firstCharactersOfText2 = GetFirstCharactersOfText(yyCell.Text);
				return string.Compare(firstCharactersOfText, firstCharactersOfText2, isCaseInsensitive);
			}
		}

		private class HourEvaluator : IGroupByEvaluatorEx, IGroupByEvaluator
		{
			private class Comparer : DateGroupByComparerBase
			{
				protected override bool AreInSameGroupBy(DateTime x, DateTime y)
				{
					if (x.Date == y.Date)
					{
						return x.Hour == y.Hour;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			private Comparer sortComparer;

			private IComparer SortComparer
			{
				get
				{
					if (sortComparer == null)
					{
						sortComparer = new Comparer();
					}
					return sortComparer;
				}
			}

			object IGroupByEvaluator.GetGroupByValue(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				DateTime groupByValueHelper = DateEvaluator.GetGroupByValueHelper(groupByRow, row);
				return new DateTime(groupByValueHelper.Year, groupByValueHelper.Month, groupByValueHelper.Day, groupByValueHelper.Hour, 0, 0);
			}

			bool IGroupByEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRow(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (DateEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRowHelper(groupByRow, row, out var dateInGroup, out var dateInCell))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (dateInCell.Date == dateInGroup.Date)
				{
					return dateInCell.Hour == dateInGroup.Hour;
				}
				return false;
			}

			int IGroupByEvaluatorEx.Compare(UltraGridCell xxCell, UltraGridCell yyCell)
			{
				return SortComparer.Compare(xxCell, yyCell);
			}
		}

		private class MinuteEvaluator : IGroupByEvaluatorEx, IGroupByEvaluator
		{
			private class Comparer : DateGroupByComparerBase
			{
				protected override bool AreInSameGroupBy(DateTime x, DateTime y)
				{
					if (x.Date == y.Date && x.Hour == y.Hour)
					{
						return x.Minute == y.Minute;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			private Comparer sortComparer;

			private IComparer SortComparer
			{
				get
				{
					if (sortComparer == null)
					{
						sortComparer = new Comparer();
					}
					return sortComparer;
				}
			}

			object IGroupByEvaluator.GetGroupByValue(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				DateTime groupByValueHelper = DateEvaluator.GetGroupByValueHelper(groupByRow, row);
				return new DateTime(groupByValueHelper.Year, groupByValueHelper.Month, groupByValueHelper.Day, groupByValueHelper.Hour, groupByValueHelper.Minute, 0);
			}

			bool IGroupByEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRow(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (DateEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRowHelper(groupByRow, row, out var dateInGroup, out var dateInCell))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (dateInCell.Date == dateInGroup.Date && dateInCell.Hour == dateInGroup.Hour)
				{
					return dateInCell.Minute == dateInGroup.Minute;
				}
				return false;
			}

			int IGroupByEvaluatorEx.Compare(UltraGridCell xxCell, UltraGridCell yyCell)
			{
				return SortComparer.Compare(xxCell, yyCell);
			}
		}

		private class MonthEvaluator : IGroupByEvaluatorEx, IGroupByEvaluator
		{
			private class Comparer : DateGroupByComparerBase
			{
				protected override bool AreInSameGroupBy(DateTime x, DateTime y)
				{
					if (x.Year == y.Year)
					{
						return x.Month == y.Month;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			private Comparer sortComparer;

			private IComparer SortComparer
			{
				get
				{
					if (sortComparer == null)
					{
						sortComparer = new Comparer();
					}
					return sortComparer;
				}
			}

			object IGroupByEvaluator.GetGroupByValue(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				DateTime groupByValueHelper = DateEvaluator.GetGroupByValueHelper(groupByRow, row);
				return new DateTime(groupByValueHelper.Year, groupByValueHelper.Month, 1);
			}

			bool IGroupByEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRow(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (DateEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRowHelper(groupByRow, row, out var dateInGroup, out var dateInCell))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (dateInCell.Year == dateInGroup.Year)
				{
					return dateInCell.Month == dateInGroup.Month;
				}
				return false;
			}

			int IGroupByEvaluatorEx.Compare(UltraGridCell xxCell, UltraGridCell yyCell)
			{
				return SortComparer.Compare(xxCell, yyCell);
			}
		}

		private class OutlookDateEvaluator : IGroupByEvaluatorEx, IGroupByEvaluator
		{
			private class DateInfo
			{
				private readonly DateTime beginDate;

				private readonly DateTime endDate;

				private readonly string dateLabel;

				internal string DateLabel => dateLabel;

				internal DateInfo(DateTime begin, DateTime end, string label)
				{
					beginDate = begin;
					endDate = end;
					dateLabel = label;
				}

				internal bool Contains(DateTime date)
				{
					if (beginDate.Date <= date.Date)
					{
						return date.Date <= endDate.Date;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			private class Comparer : DateGroupByComparerBase
			{
				private OutlookDateEvaluator evaluator;

				internal Comparer(OutlookDateEvaluator evaluator)
				{
					this.evaluator = evaluator;
				}

				protected override bool AreInSameGroupBy(DateTime x, DateTime y)
				{
					string dateLabel = evaluator.GetDateLabel(x);
					string dateLabel2 = evaluator.GetDateLabel(y);
					return string.Compare(dateLabel, dateLabel2) == 0;
				}
			}

			private readonly string BEYOND_NEXT_MONTH;

			private readonly string NEXT_MONTH;

			private readonly string LATER_THIS_MONTH;

			private readonly string THREE_WEEKS_AWAY;

			private readonly string TWO_WEEKS_AWAY;

			private readonly string NEXT_WEEK;

			private readonly string TODAY;

			private readonly string YESTERDAY;

			private readonly string SUNDAY;

			private readonly string MONDAY;

			private readonly string TUESDAY;

			private readonly string WEDNESDAY;

			private readonly string THURSDAY;

			private readonly string FRIDAY;

			private readonly string SATURDAY;

			private readonly string LAST_WEEK;

			private readonly string TWO_WEEKS_AGO;

			private readonly string THREE_WEEKS_AGO;

			private readonly string EARLIER_THIS_MONTH;

			private readonly string LAST_MONTH;

			private readonly string OLDER;

			private readonly string NONE;

			private List<DateInfo> dateInfos;

			private DateTime lastUpdated;

			private Hashtable dayMap;

			private IComparer sortComparer;

			private Hashtable DayMap
			{
				get
				{
					if (dayMap == null)
					{
						dayMap = new Hashtable(7);
						dayMap.Add(DayOfWeek.Sunday, SUNDAY);
						dayMap.Add(DayOfWeek.Monday, MONDAY);
						dayMap.Add(DayOfWeek.Tuesday, TUESDAY);
						dayMap.Add(DayOfWeek.Wednesday, WEDNESDAY);
						dayMap.Add(DayOfWeek.Thursday, THURSDAY);
						dayMap.Add(DayOfWeek.Friday, FRIDAY);
						dayMap.Add(DayOfWeek.Saturday, SATURDAY);
					}
					return dayMap;
				}
			}

			private IComparer SortComparer
			{
				get
				{
					if (sortComparer == null)
					{
						sortComparer = new Comparer(this);
					}
					return sortComparer;
				}
			}

			internal OutlookDateEvaluator()
			{
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.Today;
				while (dateTime.DayOfWeek != DayOfWeek.Sunday)
				{
					dateTime = dateTime.AddDays(1.0);
				}
				SUNDAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_DayOfWeekFormatString", dateTime);
				MONDAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_DayOfWeekFormatString", dateTime.AddDays(1.0));
				TUESDAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_DayOfWeekFormatString", dateTime.AddDays(2.0));
				WEDNESDAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_DayOfWeekFormatString", dateTime.AddDays(3.0));
				THURSDAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_DayOfWeekFormatString", dateTime.AddDays(4.0));
				FRIDAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_DayOfWeekFormatString", dateTime.AddDays(5.0));
				SATURDAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_DayOfWeekFormatString", dateTime.AddDays(6.0));
				BEYOND_NEXT_MONTH = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_BeyondNextMonth");
				NEXT_MONTH = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_NextMonth");
				LATER_THIS_MONTH = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_LaterThisMonth");
				THREE_WEEKS_AWAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_ThreeWeeksAway");
				TWO_WEEKS_AWAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_TwoWeeksAway");
				NEXT_WEEK = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_NextWeek");
				TODAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_Today");
				YESTERDAY = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_Yesterday");
				LAST_WEEK = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_LastWeek");
				TWO_WEEKS_AGO = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_TwoWeeksAgo");
				THREE_WEEKS_AGO = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_ThreeWeeksAgo");
				EARLIER_THIS_MONTH = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_EarlierThisMonth");
				LAST_MONTH = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_LastMonth");
				OLDER = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_Older");
				NONE = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Outlook_GroupByMode_Description_None");
			}

			object IGroupByEvaluator.GetGroupByValue(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				object cellValue = row.GetCellValue(groupByRow.Column);
				string description = string.Empty;
				DateTime dateTime = DateTime.MinValue;
				if (cellValue == null || cellValue is DBNull)
				{
					description = NONE;
				}
				else if (cellValue is DateTime)
				{
					dateTime = (DateTime)cellValue;
					description = GetDateLabel(dateTime);
				}
				groupByRow.Description = description;
				return dateTime;
			}

			bool IGroupByEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRow(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				object cellValue = row.GetCellValue(groupByRow.Column);
				string description = groupByRow.Description;
				if (cellValue == null || cellValue is DBNull)
				{
					return description == NONE;
				}
				if (!(cellValue is DateTime))
				{
					return true;
				}
				string dateLabel = GetDateLabel((DateTime)cellValue);
				return dateLabel == description;
			}

			private string GetDateLabel(DateTime targetDate)
			{
				if (lastUpdated.Date < DateTime.Today)
				{
					InitDateInfos();
				}
				foreach (DateInfo dateInfo in dateInfos)
				{
					if (dateInfo.Contains(targetDate))
					{
						return dateInfo.DateLabel;
					}
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}

			private void InitDateInfos()
			{
				DayOfWeek firstDayOfWeek = Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture.DateTimeFormat.FirstDayOfWeek;
				DateTime today = DateTime.Today;
				DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(today.Year, today.Month, 1);
				DateTime dateTime2 = today;
				while (dateTime2.DayOfWeek != firstDayOfWeek)
				{
					dateTime2 = dateTime2.AddDays(-1.0);
				}
				dateInfos = new List<DateInfo>();
				DateTime dateTime3 = dateTime2;
				for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++)
				{
					bool flag = dateTime3.DayOfWeek == today.DayOfWeek;
					TimeSpan timeSpan = today - dateTime3;
					bool flag2 = timeSpan <= TimeSpan.FromDays(1.0) && timeSpan > TimeSpan.FromDays(0.0);
					string label = (flag ? TODAY : ((!flag2) ? (DayMap[dateTime3.DayOfWeek] as string) : YESTERDAY));
					dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(dateTime3, dateTime3, label));
					dateTime3 = dateTime3.AddDays(1.0);
					if (dateTime3.DayOfWeek == firstDayOfWeek)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				DateTime minValue = DateTime.MinValue;
				DateTime end = dateTime.AddMonths(-1).AddDays(-1.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, OLDER));
				minValue = dateTime2.AddDays(-21.0);
				end = minValue.AddDays(6.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, THREE_WEEKS_AGO));
				minValue = dateTime2.AddDays(-14.0);
				end = minValue.AddDays(6.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, TWO_WEEKS_AGO));
				minValue = dateTime2.AddDays(-7.0);
				end = minValue.AddDays(6.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, LAST_WEEK));
				minValue = dateTime;
				end = dateTime2.AddDays(-1.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, EARLIER_THIS_MONTH));
				minValue = dateTime.AddMonths(-1);
				end = dateTime.AddDays(-1.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, LAST_MONTH));
				minValue = dateTime2.AddDays(7.0);
				end = minValue.AddDays(6.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, NEXT_WEEK));
				minValue = dateTime2.AddDays(14.0);
				end = minValue.AddDays(6.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, TWO_WEEKS_AWAY));
				minValue = dateTime2.AddDays(21.0);
				end = minValue.AddDays(6.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, THREE_WEEKS_AWAY));
				minValue = dateTime;
				end = dateTime.AddMonths(1).AddDays(-1.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, LATER_THIS_MONTH));
				minValue = dateTime.AddMonths(1);
				end = dateTime.AddMonths(2).AddDays(-1.0);
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, NEXT_MONTH));
				minValue = dateTime.AddMonths(2);
				end = DateTime.MaxValue;
				dateInfos.Add(new DateInfo(minValue, end, BEYOND_NEXT_MONTH));
				lastUpdated = today;
			}

			int IGroupByEvaluatorEx.Compare(UltraGridCell xxCell, UltraGridCell yyCell)
			{
				return SortComparer.Compare(xxCell, yyCell);
			}
		}

		private class QuarterEvaluator : IGroupByEvaluatorEx, IGroupByEvaluator
		{
			private class Comparer : DateGroupByComparerBase
			{
				protected override bool AreInSameGroupBy(DateTime x, DateTime y)
				{
					if (x.Year == y.Year)
					{
						return GetQuarterMonth(x) == GetQuarterMonth(y);
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			private Comparer sortComparer;

			private IComparer SortComparer
			{
				get
				{
					if (sortComparer == null)
					{
						sortComparer = new Comparer();
					}
					return sortComparer;
				}
			}

			private static int GetQuarterMonth(DateTime dt)
			{
				return dt.Month - (dt.Month - 1) % 3;
			}

			object IGroupByEvaluator.GetGroupByValue(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				DateTime groupByValueHelper = DateEvaluator.GetGroupByValueHelper(groupByRow, row);
				if (groupByValueHelper == DateTime.MinValue)
				{
					return groupByValueHelper;
				}
				int quarterMonth = GetQuarterMonth(groupByValueHelper);
				return new DateTime(groupByValueHelper.Year, quarterMonth, 1);
			}

			bool IGroupByEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRow(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (DateEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRowHelper(groupByRow, row, out var dateInGroup, out var dateInCell))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (dateInCell.Year == dateInGroup.Year)
				{
					return GetQuarterMonth(dateInCell) == dateInGroup.Month;
				}
				return false;
			}

			int IGroupByEvaluatorEx.Compare(UltraGridCell xxCell, UltraGridCell yyCell)
			{
				return SortComparer.Compare(xxCell, yyCell);
			}
		}

		private class SecondEvaluator : IGroupByEvaluatorEx, IGroupByEvaluator
		{
			private class Comparer : DateGroupByComparerBase
			{
				protected override bool AreInSameGroupBy(DateTime x, DateTime y)
				{
					if (x.Date == y.Date && x.Hour == y.Hour && x.Minute == y.Minute)
					{
						return x.Second == y.Second;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			private Comparer sortComparer;

			private IComparer SortComparer
			{
				get
				{
					if (sortComparer == null)
					{
						sortComparer = new Comparer();
					}
					return sortComparer;
				}
			}

			object IGroupByEvaluator.GetGroupByValue(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				DateTime groupByValueHelper = DateEvaluator.GetGroupByValueHelper(groupByRow, row);
				return new DateTime(groupByValueHelper.Year, groupByValueHelper.Month, groupByValueHelper.Day, groupByValueHelper.Hour, groupByValueHelper.Minute, groupByValueHelper.Second);
			}

			bool IGroupByEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRow(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (DateEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRowHelper(groupByRow, row, out var dateInGroup, out var dateInCell))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (dateInCell.Date == dateInGroup.Date && dateInCell.Hour == dateInGroup.Hour && dateInCell.Minute == dateInGroup.Minute)
				{
					return dateInCell.Second == dateInGroup.Second;
				}
				return false;
			}

			int IGroupByEvaluatorEx.Compare(UltraGridCell xxCell, UltraGridCell yyCell)
			{
				return SortComparer.Compare(xxCell, yyCell);
			}
		}

		private class YearEvaluator : IGroupByEvaluatorEx, IGroupByEvaluator
		{
			private class Comparer : DateGroupByComparerBase
			{
				protected override bool AreInSameGroupBy(DateTime x, DateTime y)
				{
					return x.Year == y.Year;
				}
			}

			private Comparer sortComparer;

			private IComparer SortComparer
			{
				get
				{
					if (sortComparer == null)
					{
						sortComparer = new Comparer();
					}
					return sortComparer;
				}
			}

			object IGroupByEvaluator.GetGroupByValue(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				return new DateTime(DateEvaluator.GetGroupByValueHelper(groupByRow, row).Year, 1, 1);
			}

			bool IGroupByEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRow(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow, UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (DateEvaluator.DoesGroupContainRowHelper(groupByRow, row, out var dateInGroup, out var dateInCell))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return dateInCell.Year == dateInGroup.Year;
			}

			int IGroupByEvaluatorEx.Compare(UltraGridCell xxCell, UltraGridCell yyCell)
			{
				return SortComparer.Compare(xxCell, yyCell);
			}
		}

		internal static IGroupByEvaluator CreateEvaluator(UltraGridColumn columnBeingGrouped)
		{
			if (columnBeingGrouped == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return columnBeingGrouped.GroupByModeResolved switch
			{
				GroupByMode.Value => null, 
				GroupByMode.Date => new DateEvaluator(), 
				GroupByMode.FirstCharacter => new FirstCharactersEvaluator(1, columnBeingGrouped.SortComparisonTypeResolved), 
				GroupByMode.First2Characters => new FirstCharactersEvaluator(2, columnBeingGrouped.SortComparisonTypeResolved), 
				GroupByMode.First3Characters => new FirstCharactersEvaluator(3, columnBeingGrouped.SortComparisonTypeResolved), 
				GroupByMode.First4Characters => new FirstCharactersEvaluator(4, columnBeingGrouped.SortComparisonTypeResolved), 
				GroupByMode.Hour => new HourEvaluator(), 
				GroupByMode.Minute => new MinuteEvaluator(), 
				GroupByMode.Month => new MonthEvaluator(), 
				GroupByMode.OutlookDate => new OutlookDateEvaluator(), 
				GroupByMode.Quarter => new QuarterEvaluator(), 
				GroupByMode.Second => new SecondEvaluator(), 
				GroupByMode.Text => new CellTextEvaluator(columnBeingGrouped.SortComparisonTypeResolved), 
				GroupByMode.Year => new YearEvaluator(), 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}
	}
	public sealed class UltraGridGroupByRow : UltraGridSpecialRowBase
	{

		}

		private string groupByDescription;

		private object editorContext;

		private int minGroupByRowHeight;

		private AppearanceHolder rowConnectorAppearanceHolder;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public override ChildBandsCollection ChildBands
		{
			get
			{
				if (childBands == null)
				{
					childBands = new ChildBandsCollection(this);
					childBands.InternalAdd(new UltraGridChildBand(childBands, Band));
				}
				return childBands;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsGroupByRow => true;

		internal int GroupByRowLevel => base.ParentCollection.GroupByRowLevel;

		public override bool IsStillValid
		{
			get
			{
				try
				{
					if (!Column.IsGroupByColumn || !base.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.SupportsGroupByRows)
					{
						return false;
					}
					return base.IsStillValid;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool IsCard => false;

		public override bool HasExpansionIndicator => Rows.Count > 0;

		public object Value => commonValue;

		public string ValueAsDisplayText => GetDisplayText();

		internal object EditorContext

			get
			{
				return editorContext;
			}
			set
			{
				editorContext = value;
			}
		}

		public override string Description
		{
			get
			{
				if (groupByDescription != null && groupByDescription.Length > 0)
				{
					return groupByDescription;
				}
				return GetDescription(Band.GroupByRowDescriptionMaskResolved);
			}
			set
			{
				if (groupByDescription != value)
				{
					groupByDescription = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Description);
				}
			}
		}

		public string DescriptionWithSummaries
		{
			get
			{
				if (HiddenResolved)
				{
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AllRowsFilteredOut");
				}
				string text = Description;
				if (!Rows.HasSummaryValues)
				{
					return text;
				}
				if (GroupBySummaryDisplayStyle.Text != base.BandInternal.GroupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved)
				{
					return text;
				}
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = null;
				SummaryValuesCollection summaryValues = Rows.SummaryValues;
				SummaryDisplayAreaContext inGroupByRowsSummariesContext = SummaryDisplayAreaContext.GetInGroupByRowsSummariesContext(this);
				for (int i = 0; i < summaryValues.Count; i++)
				{
					SummaryValue summaryValue = summaryValues[i];
					if (!inGroupByRowsSummariesContext.DoesSummaryMatch(summaryValue))
					{
						continue;
					}
					string summaryText = summaryValue.SummaryText;
					if (summaryText != null && summaryText.Length > 0)
					{
						if (stringBuilder == null)
						{
							stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(5 + text.Length + summaryText.Length);
						}
						if (stringBuilder.Length > 0)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(", ");
						}
						string text2 = null;
						if (summaryValue.SummarySettings.SourceColumn != null)
						{
							text2 = summaryValue.SummarySettings.SourceColumn.Header.Caption;
						}
						if (text2 != null)
						{
							stringBuilder.Append(text2);
							stringBuilder.Append(" ");
						}
						stringBuilder.Append(summaryText);
					}
				}
				if (stringBuilder == null || stringBuilder.Length <= 0)
				{
					return text;
				}
				if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
				{
					stringBuilder.Insert(0, text);
					stringBuilder.Insert(text.Length, " ");
				}
				stringBuilder.Replace("\r\n", " ");
				stringBuilder.Replace('\n', ' ');
				stringBuilder.Replace('\r', ' ');
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		public override bool IsExpandable
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.BandInternal != null)
				{
					switch (base.BandInternal.GroupByRowExpansionStyleResolved)
					{
					case GroupByRowExpansionStyle.Disabled:
						return false;
					case GroupByRowExpansionStyle.ExpansionIndicatorAndDoubleClick:
					case GroupByRowExpansionStyle.ExpansionIndicator:
					case GroupByRowExpansionStyle.DoubleClick:
						return true;
					default:
						return false;
					}
				}
				return Rows.Count > 0;
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]

		internal override int MinRowHeight
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_005f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				UltraGridBand bandInternal = base.BandInternal;
				Size descriptionSize = GetDescriptionSize(calcWidth: false);
				int num = descriptionSize.Height;

			}
		}

		private static string[] MyStringSplit(string str, char splitChar)
		{
			List<string> list = new List<string>(4);
			int num = -1;
			int i;
			for (i = 0; i < str.Length; i++)
			{
				if (splitChar == str[i])
				{
					list.Add(str.Substring(1 + num, i - num - 1));
					num = i;
				}
			}
			if (str.Length > 0)
			{
				list.Add(str.Substring(1 + num, i - num - 1));
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private string GetAtomValue(string atom)
		{
			int visibleRowCount = Rows.GetVisibleRowCount(includeSpecialRows: false);
			if (string.Compare(atom, "[caption]", ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
			{
				return Column.Header.Caption;
			}
			if (string.Compare(atom, "[value]", ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
			{
				return GetDisplayText();
			}
			if (string.Compare(atom, "[count]", ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
			{
				return visibleRowCount.ToString();
			}
			if (!atom.StartsWith("[count") || !atom.EndsWith("]"))
			{
				return null;
			}
			string value = "[count,";
			string text = atom.ToLower(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			if (text.StartsWith(value))
			{
				string[] array = MyStringSplit(atom.Substring(1, atom.Length - 2), ',');
				if (4 != array.Length)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (visibleRowCount == 0)
				{
					return array[1];
				}
				if (1 == visibleRowCount)
				{
					return array[2];
				}
				return array[3];
			}
			return null;
		}

		private string GetDescription(string descriptionMask)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			for (int i = 0; i < descriptionMask.Length; i++)
			{
				string text = null;
				int num = -1;
				if ('[' == descriptionMask[i])
				{
					num = descriptionMask.IndexOf("]", 1 + i);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						string atom = descriptionMask.Substring(i, 1 + num - i);
						text = GetAtomValue(atom);
					}
				}
				if (text != null)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(text);
					i = num;
				}
				else
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(descriptionMask[i]);
				}
			}
			stringBuilder.Replace("\r\n", " ");
			stringBuilder.Replace('\n', ' ');
			stringBuilder.Replace('\r', ' ');
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal string GetDisplayText()
		{
			object value = Value;
			return Column.GetCellText(this, value);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow FindFirstRegularRow()
		{
			if (Rows.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = Rows[0];
			if (ultraGridRow is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				return ultraGridGroupByRow.FindFirstRegularRow();
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		private bool DoesRowMatchGroupHelper(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Column;
			IGroupByEvaluator groupByEvaluatorResolved = ultraGridColumn.GroupByEvaluatorResolved;
			if (groupByEvaluatorResolved != null)
			{
				return groupByEvaluatorResolved.DoesGroupContainRow(this, row);
			}
			IComparer sortComparer = ultraGridColumn.SortComparer;
			if (sortComparer != null)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = FindFirstRegularRow();
				if (ultraGridRow == row && ultraGridRow.HasNextSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: false, IncludeRowTypes.DataRowsOnly))
				{
					ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Next);
				}
				if (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					return sortComparer.Compare(ultraGridRow.Cells[ultraGridColumn], row.Cells[ultraGridColumn]) == 0;
				}
			}
			object value = Value;
			object cellValue = row.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn);
			if (value == null)
			{
				return cellValue == null;
			}
			if (cellValue == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return RowsCollection.RowsSortComparer.DefaultCompare(value, cellValue, duringSort: false, ultraGridColumn) == 0;
		}

		internal bool DoesRowMatchGroup(UltraGridRow row, bool recursive)
		{
			if (!DoesRowMatchGroupHelper(row))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (recursive && base.ParentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				return ultraGridGroupByRow.DoesRowMatchGroup(row);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool DoesRowMatchGroup(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			return DoesRowMatchGroup(row, recursive: true);
		}

		IEnumerator<UltraGridColumn> IEnumerable<UltraGridColumn>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			GroupColumnEnumerator groupColumnEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (groupColumnEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return groupColumnEnumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = groupColumnEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}

		{
			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.Grouping;

			public UltraGridGroup Group => ((GroupHeader)base.Header).Group;

			public GroupHeaderAccessibleObject(GroupHeader groupHeader, HeadersCollection.HeadersAccessibleObject parent)
				: base(groupHeader, parent)
			{
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				return null;
			}

			{
				return 0;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{

			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return null;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
					return null;
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					return null;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
				{
					UltraGridColumn firstVisibleCol = base.Header.GetFirstVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable: true);
					if (firstVisibleCol == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(firstVisibleCol.Header);
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					if (!base.Header.Band.Header.Hidden)
					{
						return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(base.Header.Band.Header);
					}
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				{
					int num = base.ParentInternal.Headers.IndexOf(base.Header);
					if (num < 0 || 1 + num >= base.ParentInternal.Headers.Count)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(base.ParentInternal.Headers[1 + num]);
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
				{
					int num2 = base.ParentInternal.Headers.IndexOf(base.Header);
					if (num2 <= 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(base.ParentInternal.Headers[num2 - 1]);
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Right:
				{
					UltraGridGroup relatedVisibleGroup2 = Group.GetRelatedVisibleGroup(VisibleRelation.Next);
					if (relatedVisibleGroup2 == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(relatedVisibleGroup2.Header);
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Left:
				{
					UltraGridGroup relatedVisibleGroup = Group.GetRelatedVisibleGroup(VisibleRelation.Previous);
					if (relatedVisibleGroup == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return base.ParentInternal.GetAccessibleObjectFor(relatedVisibleGroup.Header);
				}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal override void CalcSelectionRange(Selected newSelection, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select, Selected initialSelection)
		{
			GridItemBase pivotItem = Band.Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion.GetPivotItem();
			GroupHeader groupHeader = pivotItem as GroupHeader;
			if (Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				if (!clearExistingSelection)
				{
					Selected selected = ((Band.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid { HasSelectedBeenAllocated: not false } ultraGrid) ? ultraGrid.Selected : null);
					if (selected != null)
					{
						foreach (UltraGridRow row in selected.Rows)
						{
							newSelection.Rows.InternalAdd(row);
						}
						foreach (UltraGridCell cell in selected.Cells)
						{
							newSelection.Cells.InternalAdd(cell);
						}
					}
					foreach (ColumnHeader column2 in initialSelection.Columns)
					{
						newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(column2);
					}
				}
				if (groupHeader == this)
				{
					List<UltraGridColumn> descendantColumns = Group.GetDescendantColumns(recursive: true);
					{
						foreach (UltraGridColumn item in descendantColumns)
						{
							if (!newSelection.Columns.Contains(item.Header))
							{
								newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(item.Header);
							}
						}
						return;
					}
				}
				UltraGridBand band = Band;
				GroupHeader groupHeader2 = groupHeader;
				HeadersCollection layoutOrderedVisibleGroupHeaders = band.LayoutOrderedVisibleGroupHeaders;
				if (layoutOrderedVisibleGroupHeaders == null || !layoutOrderedVisibleGroupHeaders.Contains(groupHeader2) || !layoutOrderedVisibleGroupHeaders.Contains(this))
				{
					return;
				}
				Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Union(groupHeader2.Group.RowLayoutGroupInfo.CachedHeaderRect, Group.RowLayoutGroupInfo.CachedHeaderRect);
				for (int i = 0; i < layoutOrderedVisibleGroupHeaders.Count; i++)
				{
					GroupHeader groupHeader3 = (GroupHeader)layoutOrderedVisibleGroupHeaders[i];
					Rectangle cachedItemRectHeader = groupHeader3.Group.RowLayoutGroupInfo.CachedItemRectHeader;
					cachedItemRectHeader.Inflate(-1, -1);
					List<UltraGridColumn> descendantColumns2 = groupHeader3.group.GetDescendantColumns(recursive: true);
					foreach (UltraGridColumn item2 in descendantColumns2)
					{
						if (!item2.Header.IsDisabled && rectangle.IntersectsWith(cachedItemRectHeader) && !newSelection.Columns.Contains(item2.Header))
						{
							newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(item2.Header);
						}
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			if (pivotItem is ColumnHeader)
			{
				UltraGridColumn column = ((ColumnHeader)pivotItem).Column;
				UltraGridGroup groupResolved = column.GroupResolved;
				if (groupResolved != null)
				{
					groupHeader = groupResolved.Header;
				}
			}
			HeadersCollection headersForSelection = GetHeadersForSelection(select, groupHeader);
			for (int j = 0; j < headersForSelection.Count; j++)
			{
				headersForSelection[j].AddToCollection(newSelection);
			}
			headersForSelection = null;
			if (clearExistingSelection)
			{
				return;
			}
			int visiblePosition = VisiblePosition;
			int visiblePosition2 = groupHeader.VisiblePosition;
			foreach (ColumnHeader column3 in initialSelection.Columns)
			{
				int visiblePosition3 = column3.VisiblePosition;
				if (visiblePosition > visiblePosition2)
				{
					if (visiblePosition3 < visiblePosition2 || visiblePosition3 > visiblePosition)
					{
						newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(column3);
					}
				}
				else if (visiblePosition3 < visiblePosition || visiblePosition3 > visiblePosition2)
				{
					newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(column3);
				}
			}
		}

		ILayoutGroup ILayoutChildItem.GetDropGroup(DropLocation dropLocation)
		{
			//IL_0042: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0058: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0039: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			switch (Group.RowLayoutGroupInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
			{
			case LabelPosition.Bottom:
				if ((int)dropLocation == 1)
				{
					return ((ILayoutChildItem)this).AssociatedGroup;
				}
				break;
			case LabelPosition.Left:
				if ((int)dropLocation == 2)
				{
					return ((ILayoutChildItem)this).AssociatedGroup;
				}
				break;
			case LabelPosition.Top:
				if ((int)dropLocation == 3)
				{
					return ((ILayoutChildItem)this).AssociatedGroup;
				}
				break;
			case LabelPosition.Right:
				if ((int)dropLocation == 0)
				{
					return ((ILayoutChildItem)this).AssociatedGroup;
				}
				break;
			}
			return ((ILayoutChildItem)this).ParentGroup;
		}
	}

		private UltraGridGroup VerifyAddGroupParameter(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_158"));
			}
			if (!(value is UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_341", value.GetType().Name));
			}
			if (band != null && band.Layout != null)
			{
				if (ultraGridGroup.Band == null)
				{
					ultraGridGroup.InitBand(Band, calledFromEndInit: false);
				}
				else if (ultraGridGroup.Band != Band)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_159"));
				}
				ultraGridGroup.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				if (Count == 0)
				{
					band.Layout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics(setScrollToBeginning: false);
				}
			}
			return ultraGridGroup;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		protected GroupsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			band = null;
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(UltraGridGroup))
				{
					UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = (UltraGridGroup)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraGridGroup), null);
					if (ultraGridGroup != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(ultraGridGroup);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitBand(UltraGridBand band, bool calledFromEndInit)
		{
			this.band = band;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i].InitBand(band, calledFromEndInit);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (band == null || band.Layout == null || band.Layout.Grid == null || !band.Layout.Grid.DesignMode)
			{
				return base.ToString();
			}
			return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_Groups_AddViaCustomProps");
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(GroupsCollection source, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.Tag;
			}
			Clear();
			if (source.Count >= 1)
			{
				initialzingFrom = true;
				for (int i = 0; i < source.Count; i++)
				{
					string key = source[i].Key;
					UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = AddGroup(key, cloned: false);
					ultraGridGroup.InitializeFrom(source[i], categories);
				}
				initialzingFrom = false;
			}
		}

		internal void BumpGroupsVersion()
		{
			if (Band != null)
			{
				Band.BumpGroupsVersion();
			}
		}

		private void ClearGroupFromRowLayoutColumnInfos(UltraGridGroup groupBeingRemoved)
		{
			List<IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo> groupsAndColumns = UltraGridBand.GetGroupsAndColumns(Band);
			foreach (IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo item in groupsAndColumns)
			{
				if (item != groupBeingRemoved && groupBeingRemoved == item.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup)
				{
					UltraGridGroup parentGroup = groupBeingRemoved.RowLayoutGroupInfo.ParentGroup;
					if (parentGroup != null)
					{
						item.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup = parentGroup;
					}
					else
					{
						item.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ResetParentGroup();
					}
					item.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ResetOriginX();
					item.RowLayoutColumnInfo.ResetOriginY();
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class GroupsCollectionConverter : TypeConverter
	{
		public override bool GetPropertiesSupported(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public override PropertyDescriptorCollection GetProperties(ITypeDescriptorContext context, object value, Attribute[] attributes)
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection result = null;
			if (value is GroupsCollection { Count: >0 } groupsCollection)
			{
				PropertyDescriptor[] array = new PropertyDescriptor[groupsCollection.Count];
				int num = 0;
				foreach (UltraGridGroup item in groupsCollection)
				{
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(3);
					stringBuilder.Append(num);
					string key = item.Key;
					if (key != null && key.Length > 0)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(" - ");
						stringBuilder.Append(key);
					}
					array[num] = new GroupPropertyDescriptor(item, stringBuilder.ToString());
					num++;
				}
				result = new PropertyDescriptorCollection(array);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

				}

					}

					{
						return AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.ReadOnly;
					if (header.Selectable)
					{
						accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.Selectable;
						if (header.Selected)

							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Selected;

						return true;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			internal HeadersCollection.HeadersAccessibleObject ParentInternal => parent;

			public HeaderAccessibleObjectBase(HeaderBase header, HeadersCollection.HeadersAccessibleObject parent)

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
				//IL_0060: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!(Header is ColumnHeader) && !(Header is GroupHeader))
				{
					return;
				}
				HeaderBase headerBase = Header;
				UltraGridBase grid = Header.Band.Layout.Grid;
				ISelectionManager val = (ISelectionManager)(object)((grid is ISelectionManager) ? grid : null);
				ISelectionStrategy val2 = ((val != null) ? val.GetSelectionStrategy((ISelectableItem)headerBase) : null);
				if (val == null || val2 == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool clearExistingSelection = val2 is SelectionStrategyExtended && !((SelectionStrategyExtended)val2).IsDiscontiguousAllowed;
				if (grid is UltraGrid)
				{
					UltraGrid ultraGrid = (UltraGrid)grid;
					if ((AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection == (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection & flags) || AccessibleSelection.AddSelection == (AccessibleSelection.AddSelection & flags)) && headerBase.Selectable)
					{
						if (val2.IsSingleSelect)
						{
							ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(headerBase, clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
						}
						else if (val.IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection((ISelectableItem)headerBase) && !val.IsMaxSelectedItemsExceeded((ISelectableItem)headerBase))
						{
							if (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection == (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection & flags))
							{
								ultraGrid.InternalSelectRange(headerBase, clearExistingSelection: false, select: true);
							}
							else
							{
								ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(headerBase, clearExistingSelection, select: true);
							}
						}
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus == (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus & flags))
					{
						val.SetPivotItem((ISelectableItem)headerBase, false);
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection == (AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection & flags))
					{
						ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(headerBase, clearExistingSelection, select: false);
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection == (AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection & flags) && headerBase.Selectable)
					{
						ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(headerBase, clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					_ = grid is UltraDropDownBase;
				}
			}
		}

						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_160"));
					}
					exclusiveColScrollRegion = value;
					if (Band != null)
					{
						Band.BumpFixedHeadersVerifyVersion(dirtyOrderedHeaders: true);
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ExclusiveColScrollRegion, null);
				}

		internal Size MinimumSize
		{
			get
			{
				IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider = RowLayoutColumnInfoProvider;
				Size minimumLabelSize = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.RowLayoutColumnInfo.MinimumLabelSize;
				if (Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
				{
					if (Band.CardView)
					{
						if (minimumLabelSize.Width <= 0)
						{
							minimumLabelSize.Width = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.MinWidth;
						}
						if (LabelPosition.LabelOnly != rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
						{
							minimumLabelSize.Height = Math.Max(minimumLabelSize.Height, rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.MinimumSize.Height);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (LabelPosition.LabelOnly != rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
						{
							minimumLabelSize.Width = Math.Max(minimumLabelSize.Width, rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.MinimumSize.Width);
						}
						if (minimumLabelSize.Height <= 0)
						{
							minimumLabelSize.Height = Height;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Size minimumHeaderSize = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.MinimumHeaderSize;
					int cellSpacingResolved = Band.CellSpacingResolved;
					if (Band.CardView)
					{
						if (minimumLabelSize.Height <= 0)
						{
							minimumLabelSize.Height = 2 * cellSpacingResolved + minimumHeaderSize.Height;
						}
						if (minimumLabelSize.Width <= 0)
						{
							minimumLabelSize.Width = 2 * cellSpacingResolved + rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.MinimumSize.Width;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (minimumLabelSize.Height <= 0)
						{
							minimumLabelSize.Height = 2 * cellSpacingResolved + minimumHeaderSize.Height;
						}
						if (minimumLabelSize.Width <= 0)
						{
							minimumLabelSize.Width = 2 * cellSpacingResolved + rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.MinimumSize.Width;
						}
					}
				}
				return minimumLabelSize;
			}
		}

		internal Size MaximumSize
		{
			get
			{
				Size result = new Size(0, 0);
				UltraGridColumn column = Column;
				if (Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
				{
					if (!Band.CardView)
					{
						result.Width = column.MaxWidthActual;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					LabelPosition labelPosition = column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPosition;
					if (LabelPosition.Left == labelPosition || LabelPosition.Right == labelPosition)
					{
						result.Width = column.MaxWidthActual;
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal virtual Size PreferredSize
		{
			get
			{
				IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider = RowLayoutColumnInfoProvider;
				Size preferredLabelSize = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.RowLayoutColumnInfo.PreferredLabelSize;
				if (Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
				{
					if (Band.CardView)
					{
						if (preferredLabelSize.Width <= 0)
						{
							preferredLabelSize.Width = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.PreferredHeaderSize.Width;
						}
						if (LabelPosition.LabelOnly != rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
						{
							preferredLabelSize.Height = Math.Max(preferredLabelSize.Height, rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.PreferredHeaderSize.Height);
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (LabelPosition.LabelOnly != rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
						{
							preferredLabelSize.Width = Math.Max(preferredLabelSize.Width, rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.PreferredSize.Width);
						}
						if (preferredLabelSize.Height <= 0)
						{
							preferredLabelSize.Height = Height;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Size preferredHeaderSize = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.PreferredHeaderSize;
					int cellSpacingResolved = Band.CellSpacingResolved;
					if (Band.CardView)
					{
						if (preferredLabelSize.Width <= 0)
						{
							preferredLabelSize.Width = 2 * cellSpacingResolved + preferredHeaderSize.Width;
						}
						if (preferredLabelSize.Height <= 0)
						{
							preferredLabelSize.Height = 2 * cellSpacingResolved + preferredHeaderSize.Height;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (preferredLabelSize.Width <= 0)
						{
							preferredLabelSize.Width = 2 * cellSpacingResolved + preferredHeaderSize.Width;
						}
						if (preferredLabelSize.Height <= 0)
						{
							preferredLabelSize.Height = 2 * cellSpacingResolved + Height;
						}
					}
				}
				Size minimumLabelSize = rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.RowLayoutColumnInfo.MinimumLabelSize;
				preferredLabelSize.Width = Math.Max(preferredLabelSize.Width, minimumLabelSize.Width);
				preferredLabelSize.Height = Math.Max(preferredLabelSize.Height, minimumLabelSize.Height);
				return preferredLabelSize;
			}
		}

		Size ILayoutItem.MinimumSize
		{
			get
			{
				IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider = RowLayoutColumnInfoProvider;
				if (LabelPosition.None == rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
				{
					return LayoutUtility.AccountForLabelPosition(Band, rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.ContentLayoutItem.MinimumSize);
				}
				return MinimumSize;
			}
		}

		int IGridBagConstraint.OriginX
		{
			get
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				if ((!Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea || this is GroupHeader) && LabelPosition.Right == rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
				{
					return rowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginXResolved + rowLayoutColumnInfo.SpanXResolved - rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelSpanResolved;
				}
				return rowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginXResolved;
			}
		}

		int IGridBagConstraint.OriginY
		{
			get
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				if ((!Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea || this is GroupHeader) && LabelPosition.Bottom == rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
				{
					return rowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginYResolved + rowLayoutColumnInfo.SpanYResolved - rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelSpanResolved;
				}
				return rowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginYResolved;
			}
		}

		int IGridBagConstraint.SpanX
		{
			get
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				if (!Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea || this is GroupHeader)
				{
					LabelPosition labelPositionResolved = rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved;
					if (LabelPosition.Left == labelPositionResolved || LabelPosition.Right == labelPositionResolved)
					{
						return rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelSpanResolved;
					}
				}
				return rowLayoutColumnInfo.SpanXResolved;
			}
		}

		int IGridBagConstraint.SpanY
		{
			get
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				if (!Band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea || this is GroupHeader)
				{
					LabelPosition labelPositionResolved = rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved;
					if (LabelPosition.Top == labelPositionResolved || LabelPosition.Bottom == labelPositionResolved)
					{
						return rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelSpanResolved;
					}
				}
				return rowLayoutColumnInfo.SpanYResolved;
			}
		}

			}
