		internal FixedHeaderIndicator FixedHeaderIndicatorResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (this is BandHeader)
				{
					return FixedHeaderIndicator.None;
				}
				if (this is ColumnHeader && Column.GroupResolved != null)
				{
					return FixedHeaderIndicator.None;
				}
				if (Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					return FixedHeaderIndicator.None;
				}
				if (ExclusiveColScrollRegionResolved != null)
				{
					return FixedHeaderIndicator.None;
				}
				if (FixedHeaderIndicator != FixedHeaderIndicator.Default)
				{
					return FixedHeaderIndicator;
				}
				UltraGridOverride ultraGridOverride = (Band.HasOverride ? Band.Override : null);
				if (ultraGridOverride != null && ultraGridOverride.ShouldSerializeFixedHeaderIndicator())
				{
					return ultraGridOverride.FixedHeaderIndicator;
				}
				ultraGridOverride = (Band.Layout.HasOverride ? Band.Layout.Override : null);
				if (ultraGridOverride != null && ultraGridOverride.ShouldSerializeFixedHeaderIndicator())
				{
					return ultraGridOverride.FixedHeaderIndicator;
				}
				return FixedHeaderIndicator.Button;
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{

					UltraGridColumn column = Column;
					if (column.GroupResolved != null)
					{
						return column.GroupResolved.Header.FixedResolved;
					}
				}
				if (!Fixed || this is BandHeader || Band == null || !Band.UseFixedHeaders || Band.UseRowLayoutResolved || ExclusiveColScrollRegionResolved != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public DefaultableBoolean FixOnRight
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return fixOnRight;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0014: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0038: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0039: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0026: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0036: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				if (fixOnRight != value)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DefaultableBoolean), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", (int)value, typeof(DefaultableBoolean));
					}
					fixOnRight = value;
					if (Band != null)
					{
						Band.BumpFixedHeadersVerifyVersion(dirtyOrderedHeaders: true);
					}
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.FixOnRight);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public bool FixOnRightResolved
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_000f: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_0037: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_003d: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0070: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
				if (ShouldSerializeFixOnRight())
				{
					return (int)FixOnRight == 1;
				}
				UltraGridBand band = Band;
				if (band != null)
				{
					if (band.HasOverride && band.Override.ShouldSerializeFixHeadersOnRight())
					{
						return (int)band.Override.FixHeadersOnRight == 1;
					}
					if (band.Layout.HasOverride && band.Layout.Override.ShouldSerializeFixHeadersOnRight())
					{
						return (int)band.Layout.Override.FixHeadersOnRight == 1;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_HeaderBase_P_AllowEditing")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		public AllowHeaderEditing AllowEditing
		{
			get
			{
				return allowEditing;
			}
			set
			{
				if (allowEditing != value)
				{
					if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(AllowHeaderEditing), value))
					{
						throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("AllowEditing", (int)value, typeof(AllowHeaderEditing));
					}
					allowEditing = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.AllowEditing);
				}
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		internal AllowHeaderEditing AllowEditingResolved
		{
			get
			{
				TextOrientationInfo textOrientationResolved = TextOrientationResolved;
				if (textOrientationResolved != null && !object.Equals(textOrientationResolved, TextOrientationInfo.Horizontal))
				{
					return AllowHeaderEditing.None;
				}
				if (!Enabled)
				{
					return AllowHeaderEditing.None;
				}
				if (ShouldSerializeAllowEditing())
				{
					return AllowEditing;
				}
				UltraGridBand band = Band;
				if (band != null)
				{
					AllowHeaderEditing allowHeaderEditing = AllowHeaderEditing.Default;
					if (band.HasOverride)
					{
						if (this is ColumnHeader)
						{
							allowHeaderEditing = band.Override.AllowEditingColumnHeaders;
						}
						else if (this is GroupHeader)
						{
							allowHeaderEditing = band.Override.AllowEditingGroupHeaders;
						}
						else if (this is BandHeader)
						{
							allowHeaderEditing = band.Override.AllowEditingBandHeaders;
						}
					}
					if (allowHeaderEditing != AllowHeaderEditing.Default)
					{
						return allowHeaderEditing;
					}
					UltraGridLayout layout = band.Layout;
					AllowHeaderEditing allowHeaderEditing2 = AllowHeaderEditing.Default;
					if (layout.HasOverride)
					{
						if (this is ColumnHeader)
						{
							allowHeaderEditing2 = layout.Override.AllowEditingColumnHeaders;
						}
						else if (this is GroupHeader)
						{
							allowHeaderEditing2 = layout.Override.AllowEditingGroupHeaders;
						}
						else if (this is BandHeader)
						{
							allowHeaderEditing2 = layout.Override.AllowEditingBandHeaders;
						}
					}
					if (allowHeaderEditing2 != AllowHeaderEditing.Default)
					{
						return allowHeaderEditing2;
					}
				}
				return AllowHeaderEditing.None;
			}
		}

		internal bool CanEnterEditMode
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
				if (layout != null)
				{
					EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
					Type dataType = layout.HeaderEditorOwner.GetDataType((object)this);
					if (editorResolved != null && !editorResolved.CanEditType(dataType))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				return ShouldUseEditor;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsActiveHeader => Layout.ActiveHeader == this;

		internal bool IsInEditMode
		{
			get
			{
				return isInEditMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isInEditMode != value)
				{
					isInEditMode = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public EmbeddableEditorBase Editor
		{
			get
			{
				return editor;
			}
			set
			{
				if (editor != value)
				{
					if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null && value != null && !UltraGridColumn.IsEditorAppropriate(value, typeof(string)))
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_336", ((object)value).GetType().Name), "Editor");
					}
					if (IsInEditMode)
					{
						ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: true);
					}
					editor = value;
					DirtyCachedEditor();
					InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public EmbeddableEditorBase EditorResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (lastEmbeddableEditor != null && IsInEditMode)
				{
					return lastEmbeddableEditor;
				}
				EmbeddableEditorBase val = editor;
				UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
				if (val == null)
				{
					val = (EmbeddableEditorBase)(object)((Layout != null) ? layout.HeaderEditor : null);
				}
				return lastEmbeddableEditor = val;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldUseEditor
		{
			get
			{
				if (editor != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				switch (AllowEditingResolved)
				{
				default:
					return false;
				case AllowHeaderEditing.OnDoubleClick:
				case AllowHeaderEditing.Manual:
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool HasDropDown
		{
			get
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
				if (editorResolved != null)
				{
					return editorResolved.SupportsDropDown;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal FixedState FixedState
		{
			get
			{
				FixedState result = FixedState.None;
				if (FixedResolved)
				{
					result = (FixOnRightResolved ? FixedState.Right : FixedState.Left);
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeAppearance() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeCaption() && !ShouldSerializeEnabled() && !ShouldSerializeVisiblePosition() && !ShouldSerializeExclusiveColScrollRegion() && !ShouldSerializeFixed() && !ShouldSerializeFixedHeaderIndicator() && !ShouldSerializeToolTipText() && !ShouldSerializeTextOrientation() && !ShouldSerializeFixOnRight())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeAllowEditing();
			}
			return true;
		}

		{
			ResetAppearance();
			ResetCaption();
			ResetEnabled();
			ResetExclusiveColScrollRegion();
			ResetFixed();
			ResetFixedHeaderIndicator();
			ResetToolTipText();
			ResetTextOrientation();
			ResetFixOnRight();
			ResetAllowEditing();
		}

		internal virtual void InitializeFrom(HeaderBase source, PropertyCategories propertyCategories)
		{
			//IL_0136: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = (propertyCategories & PropertyCategories.Bands) != 0;
			if (flag && IsGroup)
			{
				flag = PropertyCategories.Groups == (propertyCategories & PropertyCategories.Groups);
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			enabled = source.enabled;
			if (source.appearanceHolder != null && source.appearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
			{
				AppearanceBase appearance = Appearance;
				appearanceHolder.InitializeFrom(source.appearanceHolder);
			}
			else if (appearanceHolder != null && appearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
			{
				appearanceHolder.Reset();
			}
			Caption = source.caption;
			if (source.exclusiveColScrollRegion != null && Band.Layout.ColScrollRegions != null)
			{
				int index = source.exclusiveColScrollRegion.Index;
				if (index >= 0 && index < Band.Layout.ColScrollRegions.Count)
				{
					exclusiveColScrollRegion = Band.Layout.ColScrollRegions[index];
				}
			}
			visiblePos = source.visiblePos;
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.Tag;
			}
			isHeaderFixed = source.isHeaderFixed;
			fixedHeaderIndicator = source.fixedHeaderIndicator;
			toolTipText = source.toolTipText;
			textOrientation = source.textOrientation;
			fixOnRight = source.fixOnRight;
			allowEditing = source.allowEditing;
			editor = source.editor;
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, bool resolveDefaultColors, bool hotTrackingHeader, bool isGroupByBoxButton)
		{
			//IL_01dc: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e2: Expected I8, but got Unknown
			//IL_0118: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01b0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridBand band = Band;
			ResolveAppearanceContext context = new ResolveAppearanceContext(typeof(HeaderBase), requestedProps);
			StyleUtils.Role headerRole = StyleUtils.GetHeaderRole(this, isGroupByBoxButton);
			context.Role = ((band != null) ? StyleUtils.GetRole(band, headerRole, out context.ResolutionOrder) : null);
			context.ResolveDefaultColors = resolveDefaultColors;
			if (hotTrackingHeader)
			{
				band?.MergeBLOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.HotTrackHeaderAppearance, (RoleState)4);
			}
			if (!(this is BandHeader) && band != null && band.CardView)
			{
				context.IsCard = true;
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref context.ResolutionOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				if (this is ColumnHeader columnHeader)
				{
					UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
					if (ultraGridBase != null)
					{
						AppearanceBase appearance = null;
						if (ultraGridBase.GetExternalColumnHeaderAppearance(columnHeader.Column, out appearance))
						{
							appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref context.UnresolvedProps);
						}
					}
				}
				if (HasAppearance)
				{
					appearanceHolder.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref context.UnresolvedProps);
				}
			}
			if (band != null)
			{
				if (FixedResolved)
				{
					context.IsFixedHeader = true;
					band.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
					context.IsFixedHeader = false;
					if ((int)context.UnresolvedProps == 0)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				UltraGridColumn column = Column;
				if (column != null && column.IsGroupByColumn && ViewStyleBand.OutlookGroupBy == band.Layout.ViewStyleBand)
				{
					context.IsGroupByColumnHeader = true;
					band.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
					context.IsGroupByColumnHeader = false;
					if ((int)context.UnresolvedProps == 0)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				if (column != null && !column.IsGroupByColumn && Layout != null && Layout.ActiveCellInternal != null && Layout.ActiveCellInternal.Column == column)
				{
					band.MergeBLOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref context, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.ActiveCellColumnHeaderAppearance, (RoleState)549755813888L);
					if ((int)context.UnresolvedProps == 0)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				if (band.CardView)
				{
					StyleUtils.ResolveAppearance((RoleState)34359738368L, ref appData, ref context);
				}
				band.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
			}
			requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)(long)context.UnresolvedProps;
		}

		internal virtual UltraGridColumn GetRelatedVisibleCol(UltraGridColumn column, NavigateType navType, bool includeNonActivateable)
		{
			UltraGridColumn result = null;
			switch (navType)
			{
			case NavigateType.First:
				result = GetFirstVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable);
				break;
			case NavigateType.Last:
				result = GetLastVisibleCol(includeNonActivateable);
				break;
			case NavigateType.Next:
				result = GetNextVisibleCol(column, includeNonActivateable);
				break;
			case NavigateType.Prev:
				result = GetPrevVisibleCol(column, includeNonActivateable);
				break;
			case NavigateType.Above:
				result = GetVisibleColAbove(column, topMost: false, includeNonActivateable);
				break;
			case NavigateType.Below:
				result = GetVisibleColBelow(column, bottomMost: false, includeNonActivateable);
				break;
			case NavigateType.Topmost:
				result = GetVisibleColAbove(column, topMost: true, includeNonActivateable);
				break;
			case NavigateType.Bottommost:
				result = GetVisibleColBelow(column, bottomMost: true, includeNonActivateable);
				break;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void AdjustDimensions(PositionDimensions enumDimFrom, PositionDimensions enumDimto, ref Rectangle rect, UltraGridRow row, ref AppearanceData resolvedCellAppearance, ref Rectangle pictureRect)
		{
			if (enumDimto < PositionDimensions.InsidePreRowSelectors)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (enumDimFrom < PositionDimensions.InsidePreRowSelectors)
			{
				AdjustForPreRowSelectorArea(ref rect);
			}
			if (enumDimto < PositionDimensions.InsideRowSelectors)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (enumDimFrom < PositionDimensions.InsideRowSelectors)
			{
				AdjustForRowSelector(ref rect);
			}
			if (enumDimto < PositionDimensions.InsideRowBorders)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (enumDimFrom < PositionDimensions.InsideRowBorders)
			{
				Column.AdjustForRowBorders(ref rect);
			}
			if (enumDimto < PositionDimensions.InsideCellSpacing || IsGroup || enumDimto < PositionDimensions.InsideCellSpacing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (enumDimFrom < PositionDimensions.InsideCellSpacing)
			{
				AdjustForCellSpacing(ref rect);
			}
			if (enumDimto < PositionDimensions.InsideCellBorders)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (enumDimFrom < PositionDimensions.InsideCellBorders)
			{
				AdjustForCellBorders(ref rect);
			}
			if (enumDimto >= PositionDimensions.InsideCellPadding)
			{
				if (enumDimFrom < PositionDimensions.InsideCellPadding)
				{
					AdjustForCellPadding(ref rect);
				}
				if (enumDimto >= PositionDimensions.CellTextAndPicture && enumDimFrom < PositionDimensions.CellTextAndPicture && !pictureRect.IsEmpty)
				{
					AdjustForCellPicture(ref rect, ref pictureRect, ref resolvedCellAppearance);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void GetDimensions(PositionDimensions enumDimensions, DimOriginBase enumOriginBase, ref int origin, ref int extent)
		{

		}

		internal void GetDimensions(PositionDimensions enumDimensions, DimOriginBase enumOriginBase, ref int origin, ref int extent, ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion)
		{
			origin = 0;
			extent = 0;
			int extent2 = Extent;
			if (extent2 < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			switch (enumOriginBase)
			{
			case DimOriginBase.Normalized:
				rect.X = 0;
				break;
			case DimOriginBase.OnScreen:
				if (colScrollRegion != null)
				{
					rect.X = GetOnScreenOrigin(colScrollRegion, includeRowSelectors: true);
				}
				break;
			case DimOriginBase.Absolute:
				rect.X = OverallOrigin;
				break;
			case DimOriginBase.Relative:
				if (colScrollRegion != null)
				{
					rect.X = OverallOrigin - colScrollRegion.Position;
					if (Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, this))
					{
						rect.X += Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(colScrollRegion);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			rect.Width = extent2;
			rect.Y = 0;
			rect.Height = 1000 - rect.Y;
			if (FirstItem)
			{
				int preRowAreaExtent = Band.PreRowAreaExtent;
				rect.X -= preRowAreaExtent;
				rect.Width += preRowAreaExtent;
			}
			AdjustDimensions(PositionDimensions.Outside, enumDimensions, ref rect);
			origin = rect.Left;
			extent = rect.Width;
		}

		internal void GetDimensions(VisibleRow visibleRow, PositionDimensions dimensions, DimOriginBase originBase, out Rectangle rect, ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion, ref AppearanceData resolvedCellAppearance, ref Rectangle pictureRect)
		{
			rect = Rectangle.Empty;
			int overallExtent = OverallExtent;
			if (overallExtent < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (originBase)
			{
			case DimOriginBase.Normalized:
				rect.X = 0;
				rect.Y = 0;
				break;
			case DimOriginBase.OnScreen:
				if (colScrollRegion != null)
				{
					rect.X = GetOnScreenOrigin(colScrollRegion, includeRowSelectors: true);
				}
				rect.Y = visibleRow.GetTopOfRowInClient();
				break;
			case DimOriginBase.Absolute:
				rect.X = OverallOrigin;
				rect.Y = visibleRow.GetTopOfRow();
				break;
			case DimOriginBase.Relative:
				if (colScrollRegion != null)
				{
					rect.X = OverallOrigin - colScrollRegion.Position;
					if (Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, this))
					{
						rect.X += Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(colScrollRegion);
					}
				}
				rect.Y = visibleRow.GetTopOfRow();
				break;
			}
			rect.Width = overallExtent;
			rect.Height = visibleRow.Row.BaseHeight;
			AdjustDimensions(PositionDimensions.Outside, dimensions, ref rect, visibleRow.Row, ref resolvedCellAppearance, ref pictureRect);
		}

		internal int GetOnScreenOrigin(ColScrollRegion csr, bool includeRowSelectors)
		{
			if (Hidden)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			ColScrollRegion exclusiveColScrollRegionResolved = ExclusiveColScrollRegionResolved;
			bool flag = this is BandHeader;
			if (exclusiveColScrollRegionResolved != null)
			{
				if (exclusiveColScrollRegionResolved != csr)
				{
					return -100000;
				}
			}
			else if (csr.IsExclusive && !flag)
			{
				return -100000;
			}
			int num = csr.HorizontalAdjustment;
			if (!csr.IsExclusive)
			{
				num += Band.GetOrigin(BandOrigin.RowSelector);
			}
			if (!includeRowSelectors)
			{
				num += RowSelectorExtent;
			}
			if (Band.IsHeaderFixed(csr, this))
			{
				if (FixOnRightResolved)
				{
					return GetRightFixedOnScreenOrigin(csr, num);
				}
				num += Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(csr);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				if (csr.IsExclusive)
				{
					num += csr.GetBandOrigin(Band) + Band.PreRowAreaExtent;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num += origin;
			}
			return num;
		}

		private int GetRightFixedOnScreenOrigin(ColScrollRegion csr, int onScreenVirtualBandOrigin)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = onScreenVirtualBandOrigin + Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(csr);
			int num3 = num2;
			HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = Band.OrderedHeaders;
			for (int num4 = orderedHeaders.Count - 1; num4 >= 0; num4--)
			{
				HeaderBase headerBase = orderedHeaders[num4];
				if (!headerBase.Hidden && headerBase == this)
				{
					for (num4--; num4 >= 0; num4--)
					{
						headerBase = orderedHeaders[num4];
						if (!headerBase.Hidden)
						{
							if (!Band.IsHeaderFixed(csr, headerBase) || !headerBase.FixOnRightResolved)
							{
								num3 += Band.RowSelectorExtent;
								break;
							}
							num += headerBase.Extent;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			HeaderBase lastLeftFixedHeader = Band.GetLastLeftFixedHeader(csr);
			if (lastLeftFixedHeader != null)
			{
				num3 = lastLeftFixedHeader.GetOnScreenOrigin(csr, includeRowSelectors: true) + lastLeftFixedHeader.Extent;
			}
			int num5 = csr.Origin + csr.Extent;
			if (csr == csr.Collection.LastVisibleRegion)
			{
				foreach (RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion in csr.Layout.RowScrollRegions)
				{
					if (!rowScrollRegion.Hidden && rowScrollRegion.WillScrollbarBeShown())
					{
						num5 -= ((Layout != null) ? Layout.VerticalScrollBarWidthResolved : ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)null));
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			HeaderBase lastVisibleHeader = orderedHeaders.LastVisibleHeader;
			if (lastVisibleHeader == null)
			{
				return num3;
			}
			int num6 = lastVisibleHeader.origin + lastVisibleHeader.Extent;
			int num7 = num6 - origin;
			int num8 = Math.Min(num5, onScreenVirtualBandOrigin + num6);
			return Math.Max(num8 - num7, num3 + num);
		}

		internal virtual void AdjustForCellSpacing(ref Rectangle rect)
		{
			//IL_0022: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int cellSpacingResolved = Band.CellSpacingResolved;
			if (cellSpacingResolved >= 1)
			{
				int borderThickness = Band.Layout.GetBorderThickness(Band.BorderStyleCellResolved);
				int val = rect.Width / 2 - (1 + borderThickness);
				int val2 = rect.Height / 2 - (1 + borderThickness);
				int num = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(cellSpacingResolved, val2));
				int num2 = Math.Max(0, Math.Min(cellSpacingResolved, val));
				rect.Inflate(-num2, -num);
			}
		}

		internal virtual void AdjustForCellBorders(ref Rectangle rect)

		}

		void IValueListOwner.OnSelectionChangeCommitted()
		{
			if (!(((IValueListOwner)this).Control is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return;
			}
			int selectedItemIndex = ((IValueList)ultraGrid.SwapDropDown).SelectedItemIndex;
			object value = ((IValueList)ultraGrid.SwapDropDown).GetValue(selectedItemIndex);
			if (value != null)
			{
				ColScrollRegion activeColScrollRegion = Band.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion;
				if (UltraGridBand.SWAP_DROPDOWN_ITEM_FIX_HEADER == value)
				{
					if (!FixedResolved)
					{
						OnFixedHeaderIndicatorClicked(activeColScrollRegion);
					}
					return;
				}
				if (UltraGridBand.SWAP_DROPDOWN_ITEM_UNFIX_HEADER == value)
				{
					if (FixedResolved)
					{
						OnFixedHeaderIndicatorClicked(activeColScrollRegion);
					}
					activeColScrollRegion?.ScrollHeaderIntoView(this, leftAlign: false);
					return;
				}
				if (UltraGridBand.SWAP_DROPDOWN_ITEM_UNFIX_ALL_HEADERS == value && Band != null)
				{
					Band.UnfixAllHeaders();
				}
				if (IsGroup)
				{
					if (value is UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup)
					{
						Swap(ultraGridGroup.Header);
					}
				}
				else if (value is UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn)
				{
					Swap(ultraGridColumn.Header);
				}
			}
			((IValueList)ultraGrid.SwapDropDown).DeActivate((IValueListOwner)(object)this);
		}

				int visiblePosition = ((!FixOnRightResolved) ? ((lastLeftFixedHeader != null) ? (1 + lastLeftFixedHeader.VisiblePosition) : 0) : ((firstRightFixedHeader != null) ? (firstRightFixedHeader.VisiblePosition - 1) : Band.OrderedHeaders.LastVisibleHeader.VisiblePosition));

					}
				}
				else
				{
					try
					{
						if (Layout != null && Layout.Grid != null && ((Control)(object)Layout.Grid).CanFocus)
						{
							((Control)(object)Layout.Grid).Focus();
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
			IsInEditMode = false;
			if (!ultraGrid.inOnLeave && focused)
			{
				try
				{
					GridUtils.FocusControlWithoutScrollingIntoView((Control)(object)Layout.Grid);
				}
				catch
				{
				}
			}
			InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
			return false;
		}

		internal void HookValueChangedIntoEditor(EmbeddableEditorBase editor)
		{
			UnhookValueChangedFromEditor();
			lastHookedEditor = editor;
			lastHookedEditor.ValueChanged += LastHookedEditor_ValueChanged;
		}

		internal void UnhookValueChangedFromEditor()
		{
			if (lastHookedEditor != null)
			{
				lastHookedEditor.ValueChanged -= LastHookedEditor_ValueChanged;
				lastHookedEditor = null;
			}
		}

		internal virtual void OnAfterHeaderEnterEditMode()
		{
			isInEditMode = true;
			if (Layout.ActiveProxy == null)
			{
				EmbeddableUIElementBase embeddableElementBeingEdited = ((HeaderUIElement)(object)GetUIElement(Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion, Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion, verifyElements: false))?.FindEmbeddableUIElement(extract: false);
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited = embeddableElementBeingEdited;
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited_ColScrollRegion = Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion;
				Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited_RowScrollRegion = Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			}
			editValueChanged = false;
			HookValueChangedIntoEditor(EditorResolved);
			if (Layout.ActiveProxy == null)
			{
				Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion.ScrollHeaderIntoView(this, leftAlign: false);
			}
			bool flag = !Layout.goingIntoEditModeByMouse;
			if (Layout.goingIntoEditModeByMouse && Layout.HasOverride && CanEnterEditMode)
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag && IsInEditMode)
			{
				SelectAll();
			}
			Layout.InvalidateHotTrackedElement();
		}

		internal virtual void OnAfterHeaderExitEditMode()
		{
			IsInEditMode = false;
			Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited = null;
			editValueChanged = false;
			Layout.UnHookFromHeaderEditor();
			UnhookValueChangedFromEditor();
			InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
			Layout.InvalidateHotTrackedElement();
		}

		public void SelectAll()
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.SupportsSelectableText)
			{
				if (editorResolved is EditorWithMask)
				{
					((EmbeddableEditorBase)(EditorWithMask)editorResolved).SelectAll();
					return;
				}
				editorResolved.SelectionStart = 0;
				editorResolved.SelectionLength = editorResolved.TextLength;
			}
		}

		internal void ToggleEditMode()
		{
			if (Layout.Grid is UltraGrid)
			{
				if (isInEditMode)
				{
					ExitEditMode();
				}
				else
				{
					EnterEditMode(byMouse: false);
				}
				InvalidateItem();
			}
		}

		private void LastHookedEditor_ValueChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!editValueChanged)
			{
				editValueChanged = true;
			}
		}

		private void DirtyCachedEditor()
		{
			verifiedCachedEditorVersion--;
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			layout.DirtyGridElement();
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public string GetExportText()
		{
			return GetExportText(Caption);
		}

		private string GetExportText(string headerCaption)
		{
			if (!ShouldUseEditor)
			{
				return headerCaption;
			}
			EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase headerEditorOwner = Layout.HeaderEditorOwner;
			string text = null;
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = EditorResolved;
			if (editorResolved != null)
			{
				object dataFilteredDestinationValue = editorResolved.GetDataFilteredDestinationValue((object)headerCaption, (ConversionDirection)2, headerEditorOwner, (object)this);
				if (editorResolved.DataFilter != null)
				{
					bool flag = default(bool);
					string text2 = default(string);
					bool flag2 = default(bool);
					object dataFilteredDestinationValue2 = editorResolved.GetDataFilteredDestinationValue(dataFilteredDestinationValue, (ConversionDirection)1, ref flag, headerEditorOwner, (object)this, ref text2, false, false, ref flag2);
					if (flag && flag2 && dataFilteredDestinationValue2 is string result)
					{
						return result;
					}
				}
				text = editorResolved.DataValueToText(dataFilteredDestinationValue, headerEditorOwner, (object)this);
				if (!EditorWithText.ApplyPasswordChar(headerEditorOwner, (object)this, ref text))
				{
					EditorWithText.ApplyCharacterCasing(headerEditorOwner, (object)this, ref text);
				}
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = headerCaption;
			}
			return text;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldSerializeEditor()
		{
			return editor != null;
		}

		{
			Editor = null;
		}

	public class HeaderCheckBoxUIElement : CheckBoxUIElement

		public UltraGridColumn Column => (UltraGridColumn)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(UltraGridColumn));

		public RowsCollection Rows => (RowsCollection)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(RowsCollection));

		public ColumnHeader Header => (ColumnHeader)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(ColumnHeader));

		public UltraGridBase Grid => (UltraGridBase)((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(UltraGridBase));

		public HeaderCheckBoxUIElement(UIElement parent)
			: base(parent)
		{
		}

		protected override void DrawBackColor(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			if (!((UIElement)this).AreTouchMetricsEnabled)
			{
				((CheckBoxUIElement)this).DrawBackColor(ref drawParams);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnClick()
		{
			if (((ButtonUIElementBase)this).leftButtonDown)
			{
				DoClick();
			}
			((ButtonUIElementBase)this).leftButtonDown = false;
		}

		private void DoClick()
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = Column;
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = column?.GetGrid();
			if (ultraGridBase == null || ultraGridBase.DesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			RowsCollection rows = Rows;
			((CheckBoxUIElement)this).OnClick();
			if (column == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (column.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved)
			{
			case HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.Band:
				column.SetHeaderCheckedState(null, ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).CheckState);
				return;
			}
			if (rows != null)
			{
				column.SetHeaderCheckedState(rows, ((ButtonUIElementBase)this).CheckState);
			}
		}
	}

		public class HeadersAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private UltraGridRow row;

			private UltraGridBand band;

			private UltraGridChildBand childBand;

			private AccessibleObject[] headerAccessibleObjects;

			private List<HeaderBase> headersArray;

			private int columnsVersion = -1;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = UIElement;
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return uIElement.Control?.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.ClipRect) ?? Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction => null;

			public override string Description => null;

			public override string Help => null;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_ColumnHeaders");
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent
			{
				get
				{
					if (row == null)
					{
						return ((Control)(object)band.Layout.Grid).AccessibilityObject;
					}
					return row.AccessibilityObject;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.Grouping;

			public override AccessibleStates State => AccessibleStates.ReadOnly;

			public override string Value
			{
				get
				{
					return null;
				}
				set
				{
				}
			}

			public UltraGridBand Band => band;

			public UltraGridChildBand ChildBand => childBand;

			public UltraGridRow Row => row;

			public UIElement UIElement
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement descendant = band.Layout.UIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement), new object[2]
					{
						band.Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion,
						band.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion
					});
					if (descendant == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					if (band.CardView)
					{
						CardLabelAreaUIElement cardLabelAreaUIElement = null;
						if (childBand != null)
						{
							return (UIElement)(object)(descendant.GetDescendant(typeof(CardLabelAreaUIElement), (object)childBand.Rows) as CardLabelAreaUIElement);
						}
						if (row != null)
						{
							return (UIElement)(object)(descendant.GetDescendant(typeof(CardLabelAreaUIElement), (object)row.ParentCollection) as CardLabelAreaUIElement);
						}
						return (UIElement)(object)(descendant.GetDescendant(typeof(CardLabelAreaUIElement), (object)band.Layout.Rows) as CardLabelAreaUIElement);
					}
					BandHeadersUIElement bandHeadersUIElement = null;
					if (row != null)
					{
						return (UIElement)(object)(descendant.GetDescendant(typeof(BandHeadersUIElement), (object)row) as BandHeadersUIElement);
					}
					return (UIElement)(object)(descendant.GetDescendant(typeof(BandHeadersUIElement), (object)band.Header) as BandHeadersUIElement);
				}
			}

			internal List<HeaderBase> Headers
			{
				get
				{
					if (headersArray != null && columnsVersion == Band.ColumnsVersion)
					{
						return headersArray;
					}
					columnsVersion = Band.ColumnsVersion;
					Hashtable hashtable = null;
					if (headersArray != null && headerAccessibleObjects != null)
					{
						hashtable = new Hashtable(headersArray.Count);
						for (int i = 0; i < headerAccessibleObjects.Length && i < headersArray.Count; i++)
						{
							if (headerAccessibleObjects[i] != null)
							{
								hashtable[headersArray[i]] = headerAccessibleObjects[i];
							}
						}
					}
					if (headersArray != null)
					{
						headersArray.Clear();
					}
					else
					{
						headersArray = new List<HeaderBase>();
					}
					headersArray.Add(Band.Header);
					if (Band.GroupsDisplayed)
					{
						GroupsCollection groups = Band.Groups;
						for (int i = 0; i < groups.Count; i++)
						{
							headersArray.Add(groups[i].Header);
						}
					}
					ColumnsCollection columns = Band.Columns;
					for (int i = 0; i < columns.Count; i++)
					{
						headersArray.Add(columns[i].Header);
					}
					headerAccessibleObjects = new AccessibleObject[headersArray.Count];
					for (int i = 0; i < headersArray.Count; i++)
					{
						headerAccessibleObjects[i] = ((hashtable != null && hashtable.ContainsKey(headersArray[i])) ? (hashtable[headersArray[i]] as AccessibleObject) : null);
					}
					return headersArray;
				}
			}

			public HeadersAccessibleObject(UltraGridBand band)

			public HeadersAccessibleObject(UltraGridRow row)

				row = this.childBand.ParentRow;
				band = this.childBand.Band;
			}

			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (index >= 0 && index < Headers.Count)
				{
					return GetAccessibleObjectFor(Headers[index]);
				}
				return null;
			}

			{

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return (Control)(object)band.Layout.Grid;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return null;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Navigate(navdir);
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
				{
					if (row != null)
					{
						ultraGridRow = row.GetNextVisibleRelative(spanBands: false, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
						break;
					}
					for (int j = band.Index + 1; j < band.Layout.SortedBands.Count; j++)
					{
						if (band.Layout.SortedBands[j].ParentBand == band.ParentBand && band.Layout.SortedBands[j].ColHeadersAccessibilityObject != null)
						{
							return band.Layout.SortedBands[j].ColHeadersAccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
					ultraGridRow = band.Layout.GetFirstOrLastRowInGrid(first: true);
					break;
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
				{
					if (row != null)
					{
						ultraGridRow = row.GetPrevVisibleRelative(spanBands: false, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
						break;
					}
					for (int num2 = band.Layout.SortedBands.Count - 1; num2 > band.Index; num2--)
					{
						if (band.Layout.SortedBands[num2].ParentBand == band.ParentBand && band.Layout.SortedBands[num2].ColHeadersAccessibilityObject != null)
						{
							return band.Layout.SortedBands[num2].ColHeadersAccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
					break;
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
				{
					if (row != null)
					{
						ultraGridRow = row.GetNextVisibleRelative(spanBands: false, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
						break;
					}
					for (int i = band.Index + 1; i < band.Layout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
					{
						if (band.Layout.SortedBands[i].ColHeadersAccessibilityObject != null)
						{
							return band.Layout.SortedBands[i].ColHeadersAccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
					ultraGridRow = band.Layout.GetFirstOrLastRowInGrid(first: true);
					break;
				}
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
				{
					if (row != null)
					{
						ultraGridRow = row.GetPrevVisibleRelative(spanBands: false, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
						break;
					}
					for (int num = band.Layout.SortedBands.Count - 1; num > band.Index; num--)
					{
						if (band.Layout.SortedBands[num].ColHeadersAccessibilityObject != null)
						{
							return band.Layout.SortedBands[num].ColHeadersAccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
					ultraGridRow = band.Layout.GetFirstOrLastRowInGrid(first: true);
					if (ultraGridRow != null)
					{
						ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Last, spanBands: false);
					}
					break;
				}
				}
				return ultraGridRow?.AccessibilityObject;
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
			}

			internal AccessibleObject GetAccessibleObjectFor(HeaderBase header)
			{
				int num = Headers.IndexOf(header);
				if (num >= 0 && num < headerAccessibleObjects.Length)
				{
					AccessibleObject accessibleObject = headerAccessibleObjects[num];
					if (accessibleObject != null)
					{
						return accessibleObject;
					}
					if (header is ColumnHeader)
					{
						accessibleObject = band.Layout.Grid.CreateAccessibilityInstance(new ColumnHeader.ColumnHeaderAccessibleObject((ColumnHeader)header, this));
					}
					else if (header is GroupHeader)
					{
						accessibleObject = band.Layout.Grid.CreateAccessibilityInstance(new GroupHeader.GroupHeaderAccessibleObject((GroupHeader)header, this));
					}
					else if (header is BandHeader)
					{
						accessibleObject = band.Layout.Grid.CreateAccessibilityInstance(new BandHeader.BandHeaderAccessibleObject((BandHeader)header, this));
					}
					return headerAccessibleObjects[num] = accessibleObject;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

	public interface ICustomSummaryCalculator
	{
		void BeginCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows);

		void AggregateCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, UltraGridRow row);

		object EndCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows);
	}
	internal class AverageSummaryCalculator : ICustomSummaryCalculator
	{
		private decimal sum;

		private int numberOfItems;

		internal AverageSummaryCalculator()
		{
		}

		public void BeginCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			sum = default(decimal);
			numberOfItems = 0;
		}

		public void AggregateCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row == null || summarySettings == null || summarySettings.SourceColumn == null || row.Band != summarySettings.SourceColumn.Band)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = row.GetCellValue(summarySettings.SourceColumn);
			if (obj == null || obj is DBNull)
			{
				if (!summarySettings.IgnoreNulls)
				{
					numberOfItems++;
				}
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (!(obj is double) || !double.IsNaN((double)obj))
				{
					obj = Convert.ToDecimal(obj, summarySettings.SourceColumn.FormatInfo);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			if (obj is decimal)
			{
				sum += (decimal)obj;
				numberOfItems++;
			}
		}

		public object EndCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			if (numberOfItems <= 0)
			{
				return 0m;
			}
			decimal num = sum / (decimal)numberOfItems;
			return num;
		}
	}
	internal class SumSummaryCalculator : ICustomSummaryCalculator
	{
		private decimal sum;

		internal SumSummaryCalculator()
		{
		}

		public void BeginCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			sum = default(decimal);
		}

		public void AggregateCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row == null || summarySettings == null || summarySettings.SourceColumn == null || row.Band != summarySettings.SourceColumn.Band)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = row.GetCellValue(summarySettings.SourceColumn);
			if (obj == null || obj is DBNull)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (!(obj is double) || !double.IsNaN((double)obj))
				{
					obj = Convert.ToDecimal(obj, summarySettings.SourceColumn.FormatInfo);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			if (obj is decimal)
			{
				sum += (decimal)obj;
			}
		}

		public object EndCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			return sum;
		}
	}
	internal class MinimumSummaryCalculator : ICustomSummaryCalculator
	{
		private object min;

		private bool firstTime = true;

		internal MinimumSummaryCalculator()
		{
		}

		public void BeginCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			min = null;
			firstTime = true;
		}

		public void AggregateCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row == null || summarySettings == null || summarySettings.SourceColumn == null || row.Band != summarySettings.SourceColumn.Band)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = row.GetCellValue(summarySettings.SourceColumn);
			if ((obj == null || obj is DBNull || (obj is string && ((string)obj).Length <= 0)) && summarySettings.IgnoreNulls)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (firstTime)
			{
				min = obj;
				firstTime = false;
			}
			else
			{
				if (min == null || min is DBNull)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (obj == null || obj is DBNull)
				{
					min = obj;
					return;
				}
				Type underlyingType = Utilities.GetUnderlyingType(summarySettings.SourceColumn.DataType);
				if (obj.GetType() != underlyingType)
				{
					try
					{
						obj = Convert.ChangeType(obj, underlyingType, summarySettings.SourceColumn.FormatInfo);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (obj is IComparable && obj.GetType() == min.GetType())
				{
					if (((IComparable)obj).CompareTo(min) < 0)
					{
						min = obj;
					}
					return;
				}
				string strB = min.ToString();
				string strA = obj.ToString();
				if (string.Compare(strA, strB, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) < 0)
				{
					min = obj;
				}
			}
		}

		public object EndCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			return min;
		}
	}
	internal class MaximumSummaryCalculator : ICustomSummaryCalculator
	{
		private object max;

		internal MaximumSummaryCalculator()
		{
		}

		public void BeginCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			max = null;
		}

		public void AggregateCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row == null || summarySettings == null || summarySettings.SourceColumn == null || row.Band != summarySettings.SourceColumn.Band)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = row.GetCellValue(summarySettings.SourceColumn);
			if (max == null || max is DBNull)
			{
				max = obj;
			}
			else
			{
				if (obj == null || obj is DBNull)
				{
					return;
				}
				Type underlyingType = Utilities.GetUnderlyingType(summarySettings.SourceColumn.DataType);
				if (obj.GetType() != underlyingType)
				{
					try
					{
						obj = Convert.ChangeType(obj, underlyingType, summarySettings.SourceColumn.FormatInfo);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (obj is IComparable && obj.GetType() == max.GetType())
				{
					if (((IComparable)obj).CompareTo(max) > 0)
					{
						max = obj;
					}
					return;
				}
				string strB = max.ToString();
				string strA = obj.ToString();
				if (string.Compare(strA, strB, ignoreCase: false, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) > 0)
				{
					max = obj;
				}
			}
		}

		public object EndCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			return max;
		}
	}
	internal class CountSummaryCalculator : ICustomSummaryCalculator
	{
		private int count;

		internal CountSummaryCalculator()
		{
		}

		public void BeginCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			count = 0;
		}

		public void AggregateCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row == null || summarySettings == null || summarySettings.SourceColumn == null || row.Band != summarySettings.SourceColumn.Band)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (summarySettings.IgnoreNulls)
			{
				object cellValue = row.GetCellValue(summarySettings.SourceColumn);
				if (cellValue == null || cellValue is DBNull)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			count++;
		}

		public object EndCustomSummary(SummarySettings summarySettings, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			return count;
		}
	}

	[Serializable]
	[ListBindable(false)]
	public class LayoutsCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, IList, ICollection, IEnumerable, ICloneable, ISerializable
	{
		private int initialCapacity = 5;

		private UltraGridBase grid;

		public UltraGridBase Grid => grid;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get
			{
				return base.GetItem(index);
			}
			set
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_186"));
			}
		}

		public UltraGridLayout this[int index] => (UltraGridLayout)base.GetItem(index);

		public UltraGridLayout this[string key] => (UltraGridLayout)base.GetItem(key);

		public bool IsFixedSize => false;

		public LayoutsCollection()
		{
		}

		internal void InitGrid(UltraGridBase grid)
		{
			this.grid = grid;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i]?.InitGrid(grid);
			}
		}

		internal int AddLayoutHelper(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			layout.InitGrid(Grid);
			layout.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			int result = InternalAdd(layout);
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Add);
			return result;
		}

		object ICloneable.Clone()
		{
			LayoutsCollection layoutsCollection = new LayoutsCollection();
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = new UltraGridLayout();
				ultraGridLayout.InitializeFrom(this[i], PropertyCategories.All);
				layoutsCollection.AddLayoutHelper(ultraGridLayout);
			}
			return layoutsCollection;
		}

		public UltraGridLayout Add()
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = new UltraGridLayout();
			AddLayoutHelper(ultraGridLayout);
			return ultraGridLayout;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = new UltraGridLayout();
				ultraGridLayout = this[i];
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), ultraGridLayout);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		protected LayoutsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(UltraGridLayout))
				{
					UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = (UltraGridLayout)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(UltraGridLayout), null);
					if (ultraGridLayout != null)
					{
						AddLayoutHelper(ultraGridLayout);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		public void Add(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			if (layout != null && layout.IsDisplayLayout)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_187"));
			}
			((IList)this).Add((object)layout);
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_188"));
			}
			if (!(value is UltraGridLayout layout))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_320", value.GetType().Name));
			}
			return AddLayoutHelper(layout);
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_188"));
			}
			if (!(value is UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_320", value.GetType().Name));
			}
			ultraGridLayout.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalInsert(index, ultraGridLayout);
		}

		public void Insert(int index, UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			((IList)this).Insert(index, (object)layout);
		}

		public void Remove(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			Remove((object)layout);
		}

		public void Remove(object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_189"));
			}
			if (!(value is UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_321", value.GetType().Name));
			}
			ultraGridLayout.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemove(ultraGridLayout);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			if (index > Count || index < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_116"));
			}
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = this[index];
			InternalRemoveAt(index);
			if (ultraGridLayout != null)
			{
				ultraGridLayout.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		public UltraGridLayout Add(string key)
		{
			ValidateKeyDoesNotExist(key);
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = new UltraGridLayout(key);
			AddLayoutHelper(ultraGridLayout);
			return ultraGridLayout;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i].SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			InternalClear();
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Layouts, propChange);
		}

		public LayoutEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new LayoutEnumerator(this);
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}

		public class CellsCollection : ICollection, IEnumerable
		{
			private UltraGridLayout layout;

			private UltraGridCell[] table;

			private int rowCount;

			private int columnCount;

			private int nonNullCount;

			internal UltraGridLayout Layout => layout;

			public UltraGridCell this[int row, int column] => table[row * ColumnCount + column];

			public int RowCount => rowCount;

			public int ColumnCount => columnCount;

			int ICollection.Count => nonNullCount;

			bool ICollection.IsSynchronized => table.IsSynchronized;

			object ICollection.SyncRoot => table;

			internal UltraGridCell LastCell
			{
				get
				{
					UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = null;
					int num = table.Length - 1;
					while (ultraGridCell == null && num >= 0)
					{
						ultraGridCell = table[num];
						num--;
					}
					return ultraGridCell;
				}
			}

			internal CellsCollection(UltraGridLayout layout, UltraGridCell[] table, int rowCount, int columnCount)
			{
				this.layout = layout;
				this.table = table;
				this.rowCount = rowCount;
				this.columnCount = columnCount;
				nonNullCount = this.table.Length - GridUtils.GetElemCount(this.table, null);
			}

			void ICollection.CopyTo(Array array, int index)
			{
				table.CopyTo(array, index);
			}

			IEnumerator IEnumerable.GetEnumerator()
			{
				return new GridUtils.MeetsCriteriaEnumerator(table.GetEnumerator(), new GridUtils.NonNullCriteria());
			}
		}

		public class CellValuesCollection
		{
			private Hashtable table;

			private CellsCollection cells;

			public CellValueHolder this[UltraGridCell cell]
			{
				get
				{
					ValidateCell(cell);
					return (CellValueHolder)table[cell];
				}
			}

			internal CellsCollection Cells => cells;

			internal CellValuesCollection(CellsCollection cells)
			{
				this.cells = cells;
				table = CreateTable(cells);
			}

			internal void SetValues(ClipboardData values)
			{
				int rowCount = values.RowCount;
				int columnCount = values.ColumnCount;
				int rowCount2 = cells.RowCount;
				int columnCount2 = cells.ColumnCount;
				int num = Math.Min(rowCount2, rowCount);
				int num2 = Math.Min(columnCount2, columnCount);
				if (num > 0 && num2 > 0)
				{
					if (rowCount2 >= rowCount && rowCount2 % rowCount == 0 && columnCount2 >= columnCount && columnCount2 % columnCount == 0)
					{
						num = rowCount2;
						num2 = columnCount2;
					}
					else if (rowCount2 == 1 && columnCount2 >= columnCount && columnCount2 % columnCount == 0)
					{
						num2 = columnCount2;
					}
					else if (columnCount2 == 1 && rowCount2 >= rowCount && rowCount2 % rowCount == 0)
					{
						num = rowCount2;
					}
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < num2; j++)
					{
						UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = cells[i, j];
						if (ultraGridCell == null)
						{
							continue;
						}
						object obj = null;
						bool isDisplayText = false;
						int row = i % rowCount;
						int column = j % columnCount;
						bool flag = false;
						if (values.HasCellValues && values.HasCellTexts)
						{
							obj = values.GetCellValue(row, column);
							object cellText = values.GetCellText(row, column);
							if (cellText is string)
							{
								string strA = (string)cellText;
								string strB = ultraGridCell.Column.GetCellText(ultraGridCell.Row, obj);
								if (ultraGridCell.StyleResolved == ColumnStyle.DropDownList)
								{
									IValueList valueListResolved = ultraGridCell.ValueListResolved;
									if (valueListResolved != null)
									{
										strB = null;
									}
								}
								if (string.Compare(strA, strB, ignoreCase: false) == 0)
								{
									flag = true;
									isDisplayText = false;
								}
							}
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							if (values.HasCellTexts)
							{
								obj = values.GetCellText(row, column);
								isDisplayText = true;
							}
							else if (values.HasCellValues)
							{
								obj = values.GetCellValue(row, column);
								isDisplayText = false;
							}
						}
						this[ultraGridCell].Initialize(obj, isDisplayText);
					}
				}
			}

			private static Hashtable CreateTable(CellsCollection cells)
			{
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				foreach (UltraGridCell item in (IEnumerable)cells)
				{
					hashtable.Add(item, new CellValueHolder(null, isValueDisplayText: false));
				}
				return hashtable;
			}

			public bool Exists(UltraGridCell cell)
			{
				return table.ContainsKey(cell);
			}

			private void ValidateCell(UltraGridCell cell)
			{
				if (!Exists(cell))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Invalid cell. Cell does not exist in the collection.", "cell");
				}
			}

			internal static object GetColumnDefaultValue(UltraGridCell cell)
			{
				return cell.Column.DefaultCellValue ?? cell.GetNullValueForMultiCellOperation();
			}

			internal bool ConvertToDataValue(MultiCellOperationContext context, out UltraGridCell stopCellExclusive, bool checkForReadOnlyCells)
			{
				stopCellExclusive = null;
				UltraGrid ultraGrid = Cells.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				UltraGridCell lastCell = Cells.LastCell;
				foreach (UltraGridCell item in (IEnumerable)Cells)
				{
					CellValueHolder cellValueHolder = this[item];
					if (cellValueHolder.Ignore)
					{
						continue;
					}
					MultiCellOperationErrorInfo errorInfo = null;
					bool flag = true;
					bool flag2 = item != lastCell;
					if (checkForReadOnlyCells && (!item.CanBeModified || item.EditorResolved is EmbeddableImageRenderer))
					{
						string message = (cellValueHolder.ConversionError = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("Error_Cell_ReadOnly", GridUtils.ToSingleLine(item.Column.Header.Caption)));
						if (item.Column.IsReadOnly)
						{
							if (hashtable.ContainsKey(item.Column))
							{
								flag = false;
							}
							else
							{
								hashtable[item.Column] = null;
							}
							flag2 = flag2 && Cells.ColumnCount >= 2;
						}
						errorInfo = new MultiCellOperationErrorInfo(context.operationBeingPerformed, item, new InvalidOperationException(message), null, flag2);
						errorInfo.Action = MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Continue;
					}
					if (errorInfo == null && cellValueHolder.IsValueDisplayText && cellValueHolder.Value is string)
					{
						string text2 = (string)cellValueHolder.Value;
						string error = null;
						object obj;
						if (text2.Length == 0 && item.Column.IsNullable)
						{
							obj = item.GetNullValueForMultiCellOperation();
						}
						else
						{
							obj = item.Column.ConvertDisplayTextToDataValue(item.Row, text2, out error);
							if (obj == null && error == null && text2.Length > 0)
							{
								error = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCellUpdateInvalidDataValue");
							}
						}
						if (error != null)
						{
							object value = item.Value;
							if (object.Equals(text2, value) || (text2.Length == 0 && (DBNull.Value == value || value == null)))
							{
								error = null;
								cellValueHolder.HasSameValue = true;
								obj = value;
							}
							else
							{
								error = (cellValueHolder.ConversionError = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MultiCellOperation_Error_ConversionError", text2, error));
								errorInfo = new MultiCellOperationErrorInfo(context.operationBeingPerformed, item, new InvalidOperationException(error), null, flag2);
							}
						}
						if (error == null)
						{
							cellValueHolder.Value = obj;
						}
					}
					if (errorInfo == null && !cellValueHolder.IsValueDisplayText && item.StyleResolved == ColumnStyle.DropDownList)
					{
						VerifyDataValueInList(context.operationBeingPerformed, item, cellValueHolder, cellValueHolder.Value, flag2, ref errorInfo, out var _);
					}
					if (errorInfo != null)
					{
						if (!item.Column.IsNullable && MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.ClearCellAndContinue == errorInfo.Action)
						{
							errorInfo.Action = MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Continue;
						}
						ultraGrid?.InternalHandleMultiCellOperationError(errorInfo, !flag);
						switch (errorInfo.Action)
						{
						case MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.ClearCellAndContinue:
							cellValueHolder.ConversionError = null;
							cellValueHolder.Value = GetColumnDefaultValue(item);
							break;
						case MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Revert:
							return false;
						case MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Stop:
							stopCellExclusive = item;
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}

			private static bool IsDisplayTextInList(IValueList valueList, string text)
			{
				int num = -1;
				valueList.GetValue(text, ref num);
				return num != -1;
			}

			internal static bool IsDataValueInList(IValueList valueList, object value)
			{
				int num = -1;
				valueList.GetText(value, ref num);
				return num != -1;
			}

			private static void VerifyDisplayTextInList(MultiCellOperation operation, UltraGridCell cell, CellValueHolder cvh, string text, bool displayContinueQuestion, ref MultiCellOperationErrorInfo errorInfo, out string error)
			{
				error = null;
				IValueList valueListResolved = cell.ValueListResolved;
				if (valueListResolved != null && !IsDisplayTextInList(valueListResolved, text))
				{
					error = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCellUpdateInvalidDataValue");
					cvh.ConversionError = error;
					errorInfo = new MultiCellOperationErrorInfo(operation, cell, new InvalidOperationException(error), null, displayContinueQuestion);
				}
			}

			private static void VerifyDataValueInList(MultiCellOperation operation, UltraGridCell cell, CellValueHolder cvh, object value, bool displayContinueQuestion, ref MultiCellOperationErrorInfo errorInfo, out string error)
			{
				error = null;
				IValueList valueListResolved = cell.ValueListResolved;
				if (valueListResolved != null && !IsDataValueInList(valueListResolved, value))
				{
					error = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCellUpdateInvalidDataValue");
					cvh.ConversionError = error;
					errorInfo = new MultiCellOperationErrorInfo(operation, cell, new InvalidOperationException(error), null, displayContinueQuestion);
				}
			}

			internal void ConvertToDisplayText(MultiCellOperationContext context)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridCell item in (IEnumerable)Cells)
				{
					CellValueHolder cellValueHolder = this[item];
					if (cellValueHolder != null && !cellValueHolder.IsValueDisplayText)
					{
						string cellText = item.Column.GetCellText(item.Row, cellValueHolder.Value);
						cellValueHolder.Value = cellText;
						cellValueHolder.IsValueDisplayText = true;
					}
				}
			}

			internal bool ResetCellValues(MultiCellOperationContext context)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridCell item in (IEnumerable)Cells)
				{
					this[item].Initialize(GetColumnDefaultValue(item), isDisplayText: false);
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal class CellComparer : IComparer
		{
			private Hashtable columnAbsoluteLocations;

			private UltraGridBand lastBand;

			private UltraGridColumn[] lastOrderedColumns;

			private UltraGridColumn[] GetOrderedVisibleColumns(UltraGridBand band)
			{
				if (lastBand == band && lastOrderedColumns != null)
				{
					return lastOrderedColumns;
				}
				List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>();
				for (UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = band.GetFirstVisibleCol(band.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion, includeNonActivateable: true, useTabOrderedColumns: true); ultraGridColumn != null; ultraGridColumn = band.GetRelatedVisibleCol(ultraGridColumn, NavigateType.Next, includeNonActivateable: true, byTabKey: true))
				{
					list.Add(ultraGridColumn);
				}
				lastOrderedColumns = list.ToArray();
				lastBand = band;
				return lastOrderedColumns;
			}

			internal UltraGridColumn GetColumnAt(UltraGridBand band, int location)
			{
				UltraGridColumn[] orderedVisibleColumns = GetOrderedVisibleColumns(band);
				if (location >= orderedVisibleColumns.Length)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return orderedVisibleColumns[location];
			}

			internal int GetAbsoluteLocation(UltraGridColumn column)
			{
				if (columnAbsoluteLocations != null)
				{
					object obj = columnAbsoluteLocations[column];
					if (obj != null)
					{
						return (int)obj;
					}
				}
				UltraGridColumn[] orderedVisibleColumns = GetOrderedVisibleColumns(column.Band);
				int num = Array.IndexOf(orderedVisibleColumns, column);
				if (columnAbsoluteLocations == null)
				{
					columnAbsoluteLocations = new Hashtable();
				}
				columnAbsoluteLocations[column] = num;
				return num;
			}

			internal int CompareHorizLocation(UltraGridCell x, UltraGridCell y)
			{
				int absoluteLocation = GetAbsoluteLocation(x.Column);
				int absoluteLocation2 = GetAbsoluteLocation(y.Column);
				return absoluteLocation.CompareTo(absoluteLocation2);
			}

			internal static int CompareVertLocation(UltraGridCell x, UltraGridCell y)
			{
				return Selected.SelectionPositionSortComparer.CompareRow(x.Row, y.Row);
			}

			internal int Compare(UltraGridCell xx, UltraGridCell yy)
			{
				int num = CompareVertLocation(xx, yy);
				if (num != 0)
				{
					return num;
				}
				return CompareHorizLocation(xx, yy);
			}

			int IComparer.Compare(object xObj, object yObj)
			{
				UltraGridCell xx = (UltraGridCell)xObj;
				UltraGridCell yy = (UltraGridCell)yObj;
				return Compare(xx, yy);
			}
		}
