		internal class ParserTSV
		{
			private ClipboardData data;

			private string text;

			private string cellSeparator;

			private string rowSeparator;

			private string cellDelimiter;

			private ParserTSV(string text, string cellSeparator, string rowSeparator, string cellDelimiter)
			{
				this.text = text;
				this.cellSeparator = cellSeparator;
				this.rowSeparator = rowSeparator;
				this.cellDelimiter = cellDelimiter;
			}

			internal string RemoveDelimiters(string text)
			{
				if (text != null)
				{
					string text2 = cellDelimiter;
					if (text.Length >= 2 * text2.Length && text.StartsWith(text2) && text.EndsWith(text2))
					{
						text = text.Substring(text2.Length, text.Length - 2 * text2.Length);
					}
				}
				return text;
			}

			private static string[] Split(string text, string separator)
			{
				if (text == null || separator == null || separator.Length == 0)
				{
					if (text == null || text.Length <= 0)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return new string[1] { text };
				}
				if (1 == separator.Length)
				{
					return text.Split(separator[0]);
				}
				separator = Regex.Escape(separator);
				string[] array = Regex.Split(text, separator, RegexOptions.ExplicitCapture | RegexOptions.Singleline);
				int num = array.Length - 1;
				while (num >= 0 && (array[num] == null || array[num].Length == 0))
				{
					num--;
				}
				if (num < 0)
				{
					array = null;
				}
				else if (num != array.Length - 1)
				{
					string[] array2 = new string[1 + num];
					Array.Copy(array, 0, array2, 0, array2.Length);
					array = array2;
				}
				return array;
			}

			private void Parse()
			{
				data = null;
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				string[] array = Split(text, rowSeparator);
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = 0;
				if (array != null)
				{
					num2 = array.Length;
					for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
					{
						string[] array2 = ((array[i] != null) ? Split(array[i], cellSeparator) : null);
						if (array2 != null)
						{
							num = Math.Max(num, array2.Length);
							for (int j = 0; j < array2.Length; j++)
							{
								hashtable[new Point(j, i)] = RemoveDelimiters(array2[j]);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				if (num2 * num <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				object[] array3 = new object[num2 * num];
				for (int k = 0; k < num2; k++)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < num; l++)
					{
						array3[k * num + l] = hashtable[new Point(l, k)];
					}
				}
				data = new ClipboardData(null, null, array3, num2, num);
			}

			internal static ClipboardData Parse(string text, UltraGridLayout layout)
			{
				ParserTSV parserTSV = new ParserTSV(text, layout.ClipboardCellSeparatorResolved, layout.ClipboardRowSeparatorResolved, layout.ClipboardCellDelimiterResolved);
				parserTSV.Parse();
				return parserTSV.data;
			}
		}

		private UltraGridLayout layout;

		internal UltraGridLayout Layout => layout;

		internal bool HasGroupByRowSelection
		{
			get
			{
				Selected selectedHelper = GetSelectedHelper();
				if (selectedHelper != null)
				{
					if (selectedHelper.HasGroupByRows)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (selectedHelper.HasCells || selectedHelper.HasRows)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (Layout.ActiveCell != null)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (Layout.ActiveRow != null)
					{
						return Layout.ActiveRow.IsGroupByRow;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool ClipboardHasSuitableData
		{
			get
			{
				ClipboardData data;
				Exception error;
				return GetDataFromClipboardHelper(justCheckForExistence: true, out data, out error);
			}
		}

		internal MultiCellOperationInfo(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			this.layout = layout;
		}

		private static bool CellQualifies(UltraGridCell cell)
		{
			if (!cell.Row.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return !cell.Column.HiddenResolved;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static UltraGridCell[] ConvertToSparseTable(UltraGridCell[] sortedCells, out int rowCount, out int columnCount, out Exception error)
		{
			rowCount = 0;
			columnCount = 0;
			error = null;
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable(sortedCells.Length);
			CellComparer cellComparer = new CellComparer();
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			foreach (UltraGridCell ultraGridCell in sortedCells)
			{
				if (ultraGridCell.Row != ultraGridRow)
				{
					rowCount++;
					ultraGridRow = ultraGridCell.Row;
				}
				int y = rowCount - 1;
				int absoluteLocation = cellComparer.GetAbsoluteLocation(ultraGridCell.Column);
				hashtable[new Point(absoluteLocation, y)] = ultraGridCell;
			}
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (Point key in hashtable.Keys)
			{
				num = Math.Min(num, key.X);
				num2 = Math.Max(num2, key.X);
			}
			int[] array = new int[1 + num2 - num];
			GridUtils.InitializeArray(array, -1);
			foreach (Point key2 in hashtable.Keys)
			{
				array[key2.X - num] = 1;
			}
			columnCount = 0;
			for (int j = 0; j < array.Length; j++)
			{
				if (array[j] > 0)
				{
					array[j] = columnCount;
					columnCount++;
				}
			}
			if (columnCount * rowCount == sortedCells.Length)
			{
				return sortedCells;
			}
			if (columnCount <= 0 || rowCount <= 0)
			{
				error = new Exception("Invalid selection.");
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridCell[] array2 = new UltraGridCell[columnCount * rowCount];
			foreach (DictionaryEntry item in hashtable)
			{
				Point point2 = (Point)item.Key;
				array2[point2.Y * columnCount + array[point2.X - num]] = (UltraGridCell)item.Value;
			}
			return array2;
		}

		private static void AddCellsHelper(List<UltraGridCell> list, UltraGridCell cell)
		{
			if (CellQualifies(cell))
			{
				list.Add(cell);
			}
		}

		private static void AddCellsHelper(List<UltraGridCell> list, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (!row.SupportsCells)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridCell cell in row.Cells)
			{
				AddCellsHelper(list, cell);
			}
		}

		private UltraGridCell[] GetCellsForMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperationContext context, Selected selection)
		{
			List<UltraGridCell> list = new List<UltraGridCell>();
			if (selection.Cells.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridCell cell in selection.Cells)
				{
					AddCellsHelper(list, cell);
				}
			}
			else if (selection.Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridRow row in selection.Rows)
				{
					AddCellsHelper(list, row);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				UltraGridRow activeRow = Layout.ActiveRow;
				UltraGridCell activeCell = Layout.ActiveCell;
				if (activeCell != null && CellQualifies(activeCell))
				{
					AddCellsHelper(list, activeCell);
				}
				else if (activeRow != null)
				{
					AddCellsHelper(list, activeRow);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal UltraGridBand HasSelectionHelper()
		{
			Selected selectedHelper = GetSelectedHelper();
			if (selectedHelper != null)
			{
				if (selectedHelper.HasCells)
				{
					return selectedHelper.Cells[0].Band;
				}
				if (selectedHelper.HasRows)
				{
					return selectedHelper.Rows[0].Band;
				}
				if (Layout.ActiveCell != null)
				{
					return Layout.ActiveCell.Band;
				}
				if (Layout.ActiveRow != null)
				{
					return Layout.ActiveRow.Band;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal Selected GetSelectedHelper()
		{
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid { HasSelectedBeenAllocated: not false } ultraGrid))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return ultraGrid.Selected;
		}

		internal void ScrollAndSelect(IList<UltraGridCell> cells, bool scrollIntoView, bool activateFirstCell)
		{
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return;
			}
			List<UltraGridCell> list = new List<UltraGridCell>();
			foreach (UltraGridCell cell in cells)
			{
				if (!cell.Disposed)
				{
					list.Add(cell);
				}
			}
			cells = list;
			if (!ultraGrid.SelectNewSelection(cells) && cells.Count > 0)
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = cells[0];
				if (activateFirstCell)
				{
					ultraGridCell?.Activate();
				}
				if (scrollIntoView)
				{
					ultraGrid.ScrollActiveItemIntoView();
				}
			}
		}

		internal CellsCollection GetCurrentSelection(MultiCellOperationContext context, out Exception error)
		{
			error = null;
			Selected selectedHelper = GetSelectedHelper();
			if (selectedHelper == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GetCellsCollection(context, selectedHelper, out error);
		}

		internal CellsCollection GetCellsCollection(MultiCellOperationContext context, Selected selection, out Exception error)
		{
			UltraGridCell[] cellsForMultiCellOperation = GetCellsForMultiCellOperation(context, selection);
			return GetCellsCollection(context, cellsForMultiCellOperation, out error);
		}

		internal CellsCollection GetCellsCollection(MultiCellOperationContext context, UltraGridCell[] cells, out Exception error)
		{
			if (cells == null || cells.Length == 0)
			{
				error = new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MultiCellOperation_Error_NoCellsSelected"));
				return null;
			}
			if (!GridUtils.IsFromSameRowsCollection(cells))
			{
				error = new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MultiCellOperation_Error_CrossParentSelection"));
				return null;
			}
			Utilities.SortMerge((object[])cells, (IComparer)new CellComparer());
			int rowCount;
			int columnCount;
			UltraGridCell[] array = ConvertToSparseTable(cells, out rowCount, out columnCount, out error);
			if (error != null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (MultiCellOperation.Delete != context.operationBeingPerformed && Array.IndexOf(array, null) >= 0)
			{
				error = new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MultiCellOperation_Error_NonRectangularSelection"));
				return null;
			}
			return new CellsCollection(Layout, array, rowCount, columnCount);
		}

		internal CellsCollection GetRectangularSelection(UltraGridCell anchorCell, int rowCount, int columnCount, int dataRowCount, int dataColumnCount, out Exception error)
		{
			error = null;
			UltraGridBand band = anchorCell.Band;
			CellComparer cellComparer = new CellComparer();
			int absoluteLocation = cellComparer.GetAbsoluteLocation(anchorCell.Column);
			if (absoluteLocation < 0)
			{
				error = new Exception("Invalid current selection.");
				return null;
			}
			List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>();
			for (int i = 0; i < columnCount; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn columnAt = cellComparer.GetColumnAt(band, absoluteLocation + i);
				if (columnAt == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				list.Add(columnAt);
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = anchorCell.Row;
			RowsCollection parentCollection = ultraGridRow.ParentCollection;
			List<UltraGridRow> list2 = new List<UltraGridRow>(rowCount);
			if (ultraGridRow.IsAddRowFromTemplate && rowCount > 1 && (!parentCollection.CurrentAddRowModifiedByUser || ultraGridRow.IsFixedTop || ultraGridRow.IsFixedBottom))
			{
				bool flag;
				switch (band.AllowAddNewResolved)
				{
				case AllowAddNew.TemplateOnTop:
				case AllowAddNew.TemplateOnTopWithTabRepeat:
				case AllowAddNew.FixedAddRowOnTop:
					flag = true;
					break;
				case AllowAddNew.TemplateOnBottom:
				case AllowAddNew.FixedAddRowOnBottom:
					flag = false;
					break;
				case AllowAddNew.Yes:
				case AllowAddNew.No:
				case AllowAddNew.TabRepeat:
					flag = false;
					break;
				default:
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
				UltraGrid ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
				bool flag2 = false;
				ultraGridRow.Activated = false;
				try
				{
					if (!((UltraControlBase)ultraGrid).IsUpdating)
					{
						((UltraControlBase)ultraGrid).BeginUpdate();
						flag2 = true;
					}
					int num = (flag ? rowCount : (rowCount + 1));
					for (int j = 0; j < num; j++)
					{
						if (!parentCollection.AddTemplateAddRowToDataListHelper(activateFirstCellInNewRow: false, out var addedRow))
						{
							break;
						}
						if (flag)
						{
							list2.Insert(0, addedRow);
						}
						else if (j < num - 1)
						{
							list2.Add(addedRow);
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					if (flag2)
					{
						((UltraControlBase)ultraGrid).EndUpdate();
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				list2.Add(ultraGridRow);
			}
			while (list2.Count < rowCount && ultraGridRow != null)
			{
				ultraGridRow = parentCollection.GetNextVisibleRow(ultraGridRow, IncludeRowTypes.DataRowsOnly);
				if (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					list2.Add(ultraGridRow);
				}
			}
			int count = list2.Count;
			if (count < rowCount)
			{
				if (count < dataRowCount)
				{
					error = new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MultiCell_Paste_Error_TooManyRows", rowCount, count));
					return null;
				}
				list2.RemoveRange(dataRowCount, count - dataRowCount);
			}
			int count2 = list.Count;
			if (count2 < columnCount)
			{
				if (count2 < dataColumnCount)
				{
					error = new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("MultiCell_Paste_Error_TooManyColumns", columnCount, list.Count));
					return null;
				}
				list.RemoveRange(dataColumnCount, count2 - dataColumnCount);
			}
			UltraGridCell[] array = new UltraGridCell[list2.Count * list.Count];
			int num2 = 0;
			foreach (UltraGridRow item in list2)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridColumn item2 in list)
				{
					array[num2++] = item.Cells[item2];
				}
			}
			return new CellsCollection(Layout, array, list2.Count, list.Count);
		}

		private bool GetDataFromClipboardHelper(bool justCheckForExistence, out ClipboardData data, out Exception error)
		{
			data = null;
			error = null;
			try
			{
				IDataObject dataObject = Clipboard.GetDataObject();
				if (dataObject == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (dataObject.GetDataPresent(typeof(ClipboardData)))
				{
					if (justCheckForExistence)
					{
						return true;
					}
					data = dataObject.GetData(typeof(ClipboardData)) as ClipboardData;
					if (data != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				if (dataObject.GetDataPresent(typeof(string)))
				{
					if (justCheckForExistence)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (dataObject.GetData(typeof(string)) is string { Length: >0 } text)
					{
						data = ParserTSV.Parse(text, layout);
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			catch (ExternalException)
			{
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal ClipboardData GetDataFromClipboard(out Exception error)
		{
			GetDataFromClipboardHelper(justCheckForExistence: false, out var data, out error);
			return data;
		}

		private IDataObject GetClipboardDataObject(CellValuesCollection cellValues, bool fireBeforeMultiCellOperationEvent)
		{
			DataObject dataObject = new DataObject();
			MultiCellOperationContext multiCellOperationContext = new MultiCellOperationContext(MultiCellOperation.Copy);
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			if (fireBeforeMultiCellOperationEvent && ultraGrid != null)
			{
				BeforeMultiCellOperationEventArgs e = new BeforeMultiCellOperationEventArgs(multiCellOperationContext.operationBeingPerformed, cellValues);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeMultiCellOperation, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return null;
				}
			}
			cellValues.ConvertToDisplayText(multiCellOperationContext);
			dataObject.SetData(typeof(ClipboardData), CreateUltraGridClipboardData(cellValues));
			dataObject.SetData(GetTabSeparatedText(cellValues));
			dataObject.SetData(DataFormats.Html, GetHtmlText(cellValues));
			return dataObject;
		}

		internal static bool IncludeColumnHeaders(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			return (AllowMultiCellOperation.CopyWithHeaders & band.AllowMultiCellOperationsResolved) != 0;
		}

		internal static ClipboardData CreateUltraGridClipboardData(CellValuesCollection cellValues)
		{
			CellsCollection cells = cellValues.Cells;
			string[] array = new string[cells.ColumnCount];
			object[] array2 = new object[cells.RowCount * cells.ColumnCount];
			object[] array3 = new object[cells.RowCount * cells.ColumnCount];
			for (int i = 0; i < cells.ColumnCount; i++)
			{
				array[i] = cells[0, i].Column.Key;
			}
			int num = 0;
			foreach (UltraGridCell item in (IEnumerable)cells)
			{
				array2[num] = item.Value;
				array3[num] = cellValues[item].Value;
				num++;
			}
			return new ClipboardData(array, array2, array3, cells.RowCount, cells.ColumnCount);
		}

		internal static CellValuesCollection GetCellValues(CellsCollection cells)
		{
			CellValuesCollection cellValuesCollection = new CellValuesCollection(cells);
			foreach (UltraGridCell item in (IEnumerable)cellValuesCollection.Cells)
			{
				cellValuesCollection[item].Initialize(item.Value, isDisplayText: false);
			}
			return cellValuesCollection;
		}

		internal static string GetCellTextHelper(CellValueHolder cvh, string delim)
		{
			string text = cvh.Value?.ToString();
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
			return GridUtils.ApplyDelimiters(text, delim);
		}

		internal static string GetColumnHeaderText(UltraGridCell cell, string delim)
		{
			string text = ((cell != null) ? GridUtils.ToSingleLine(cell.Column.Header.Caption) : string.Empty);
			return GridUtils.ApplyDelimiters(text, delim);
		}

		internal object GetTabSeparatedText(CellValuesCollection cellValues)
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			CellsCollection cells = cellValues.Cells;
			string clipboardRowSeparatorResolved = Layout.ClipboardRowSeparatorResolved;
			string clipboardCellSeparatorResolved = Layout.ClipboardCellSeparatorResolved;
			string clipboardCellDelimiterResolved = Layout.ClipboardCellDelimiterResolved;
			if (IncludeColumnHeaders(cells[0, 0].Band))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < cells.ColumnCount; i++)
				{
					string columnHeaderText = GetColumnHeaderText(cells[0, i], clipboardCellDelimiterResolved);
					stringBuilder.Append(columnHeaderText);
					if (1 + i < cells.ColumnCount)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(clipboardCellSeparatorResolved);
					}
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(clipboardRowSeparatorResolved);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < cells.RowCount; j++)
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < cells.ColumnCount; k++)
				{
					string cellTextHelper = GetCellTextHelper(cellValues[cells[j, k]], clipboardCellDelimiterResolved);
					stringBuilder.Append(cellTextHelper);
					if (1 + k < cells.ColumnCount)
					{
						stringBuilder.Append(layout.ClipboardCellSeparatorResolved);
					}
				}
				if (1 + j < cells.RowCount)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(layout.ClipboardRowSeparatorResolved);
				}
			}
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}

		internal static object GetHtmlText(CellValuesCollection cellValues)
		{
			Encoding uTF = Encoding.UTF8;
			CellsCollection cells = cellValues.Cells;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
			string format = "Version:1.0\r\nStartHTML:{0:0000000000}\r\nEndHTML:{1:0000000000}\r\nStartFragment:{2:0000000000}\r\nEndFragment:{3:0000000000}\r\n";
			string text = string.Format(format, 0, 0, 0, 0);
			stringBuilder.Append(text);
			int byteCount = uTF.GetByteCount(stringBuilder.ToString());
			stringBuilder.AppendFormat("<html><head><meta http-equiv=\"Content-Type\" content=\"text/html;charset={0}\" ></head>\r\n", uTF.WebName);
			stringBuilder.Append("<body>\r\n");
			int byteCount2 = uTF.GetByteCount(stringBuilder.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append("<!--StartFragment-->\r\n");
			stringBuilder.Append("<table>");
			if (IncludeColumnHeaders(cells[0, 0].Band))
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("<tr>");
				for (int i = 0; i < cells.ColumnCount; i++)
				{
					string columnHeaderText = GetColumnHeaderText(cells[0, i], null);
					columnHeaderText = GridUtils.HtmlEncode(columnHeaderText);
					stringBuilder.Append("<th>").Append(columnHeaderText).Append("</th>");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("</tr>");
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < cells.RowCount; j++)
			{
				stringBuilder.Append("<tr>");
				for (int k = 0; k < cells.ColumnCount; k++)
				{
					string cellTextHelper = GetCellTextHelper(cellValues[cells[j, k]], null);
					cellTextHelper = GridUtils.HtmlEncode(cellTextHelper);
					stringBuilder.Append("<td>").Append(cellTextHelper).Append("</td>");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append("</tr>");
			}
			stringBuilder.Append("</table>");
			stringBuilder.Append("\r\n<!--EndFragment-->");
			int byteCount3 = uTF.GetByteCount(stringBuilder.ToString());
			stringBuilder.Append("\r\n</body></html>");
			int byteCount4 = uTF.GetByteCount(stringBuilder.ToString());
			string newValue = string.Format(format, byteCount, byteCount4, byteCount2, byteCount3);
			stringBuilder.Replace(text, newValue, 0, text.Length);
			return new MemoryStream(uTF.GetBytes(stringBuilder.ToString()));
		}

		internal UltraGridState GetMultiCellOperationRelatedState()
		{
			UltraGridState ultraGridState = (UltraGridState)0;
			if (CanPerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Copy))
			{
				ultraGridState |= UltraGridState.CanCopy;
			}
			if (CanPerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Cut))
			{
				ultraGridState |= UltraGridState.CanCut;
			}
			if (CanPerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Delete))
			{
				ultraGridState |= UltraGridState.CanDeleteCells;
			}
			if (CanPerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Paste))
			{
				ultraGridState |= UltraGridState.CanPaste;
			}
			if (CanPerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Redo))
			{
				ultraGridState |= UltraGridState.CanRedo;
			}
			if (CanPerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation.Undo))
			{
				ultraGridState |= UltraGridState.CanUndo;
			}
			return ultraGridState;
		}

		internal bool CanPerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation operation)
		{
			switch (operation)
			{
			case MultiCellOperation.Copy:
			case MultiCellOperation.Cut:
			case MultiCellOperation.Delete:
			case MultiCellOperation.Paste:
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = HasSelectionHelper();
				if (ultraGridBand == null || !ultraGridBand.IsMultiCellOperationAllowed(operation))
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			switch (operation)
			{
			case MultiCellOperation.Copy:
			case MultiCellOperation.Cut:
				if (HasGroupByRowSelection)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case MultiCellOperation.Delete:
			{
				Selected selectedHelper = GetSelectedHelper();
				if (selectedHelper == null || selectedHelper.HasRows || !selectedHelper.HasCells)
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			}
			case MultiCellOperation.Paste:
				if (HasGroupByRowSelection)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return ClipboardHasSuitableData;
			case MultiCellOperation.Redo:
				if (!Layout.ActionHistory.CanRedo())
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			case MultiCellOperation.Undo:
				if (!Layout.ActionHistory.CanUndo())
				{
					return false;
				}
				break;
			default:
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool PerformMultiCellOperation(MultiCellOperation operation)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			Selected selected = ultraGrid?.Selected;
			if (selected == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			MultiCellOperationContext context = new MultiCellOperationContext(operation);
			Exception error = null;
			bool flag = false;
			switch (operation)
			{
			case MultiCellOperation.Copy:
			case MultiCellOperation.Cut:
			case MultiCellOperation.Delete:
			{
				CellsCollection currentSelection2 = GetCurrentSelection(context, out error);
				CellValuesCollection cellValuesCollection = ((currentSelection2 != null) ? GetCellValues(currentSelection2) : null);
				if (error != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				IDataObject dataObject = ((MultiCellOperation.Delete != operation) ? GetClipboardDataObject(cellValuesCollection, fireBeforeMultiCellOperationEvent: true) : null);
				if (dataObject != null)
				{
					try
					{
						Utilities.CopyToClipboard((object)dataObject, true);
						flag = true;
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						error = ex;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (((flag && dataObject != null && MultiCellOperation.Cut == operation) || MultiCellOperation.Delete == operation) && cellValuesCollection.ResetCellValues(new MultiCellOperationContext(MultiCellOperation.Delete)))
				{
					flag = PerformMultiCellValueActionHelper(context, cellValuesCollection);
				}
				break;
			}
			case MultiCellOperation.Paste:
			{
				ClipboardData dataFromClipboard = GetDataFromClipboard(out error);
				if (dataFromClipboard == null || error != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				CellsCollection currentSelection = GetCurrentSelection(context, out error);
				if (error != null || currentSelection.RowCount <= 0 || currentSelection.ColumnCount <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				UltraGridCell anchorCell = currentSelection[0, 0];
				int num = dataFromClipboard.RowCount;
				int num2 = dataFromClipboard.ColumnCount;
				int rowCount = currentSelection.RowCount;
				int columnCount = currentSelection.ColumnCount;
				if (rowCount >= num && rowCount % num == 0 && columnCount >= num2 && columnCount % num2 == 0)
				{
					num = rowCount;
					num2 = columnCount;
				}
				else if (rowCount == 1 && columnCount >= num2 && columnCount % num2 == 0)
				{
					num2 = columnCount;
				}
				else if (columnCount == 1 && rowCount >= num && rowCount % num == 0)
				{
					num = rowCount;
				}
				currentSelection = GetRectangularSelection(anchorCell, num, num2, dataFromClipboard.RowCount, dataFromClipboard.ColumnCount, out error);
				if (currentSelection == null || error != null)
				{
					break;
				}
				CellValuesCollection cellValues = GetCellValues(currentSelection);
				if (cellValues != null)
				{
					ValueListItemMatchingMode? itemMatchingModeOverride = ValueList.ItemMatchingModeOverride;
					ValueList.ItemMatchingModeOverride = (ValueListItemMatchingMode)1;
					try
					{
						cellValues.SetValues(dataFromClipboard);
						flag = PerformMultiCellValueActionHelper(context, cellValues);
					}
					finally
					{
						ValueList.ItemMatchingModeOverride = itemMatchingModeOverride;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case MultiCellOperation.Redo:
				flag = Layout.ActionHistory.Redo();
				break;
			case MultiCellOperation.Undo:
				flag = Layout.ActionHistory.Undo();
				break;
			default:
				return false;
			}
			if (error != null)
			{
				MultiCellOperationErrorInfo errorInfo = new MultiCellOperationErrorInfo(operation, null, error, null, canContinueWithRemainingCells: false);
				ultraGrid.InternalHandleMultiCellOperationError(errorInfo, defaultCancelValue: false);
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private bool PerformMultiCellValueActionHelper(MultiCellOperationContext context, CellValuesCollection newCellValues)
		{
			ActionHistory actionHistory = Layout.ActionHistory;
			ActionFactory.MultiCellValuesAction action = new ActionFactory.MultiCellValuesAction(actionHistory, newCellValues);
			return actionHistory.PerformAction(context, action);
		}
	}

	internal class OrderedGroupColLevels
	{
		private List<List<ColumnHeader>> levels;

		private int levelCount = -1;

		internal List<List<ColumnHeader>> Levels
		{
			get
			{
				if (levels == null)
				{
					levels = new List<List<ColumnHeader>>();
				}
				return levels;
			}
		}

		internal int LevelCount => levelCount;

		internal OrderedGroupColLevels(List<ColumnHeader> colHeaderList, int levelCount)
		{
			this.levelCount = levelCount;
			CreateColLevels(colHeaderList);
		}

		internal void Dispose()
		{
			if (levels != null)
			{
				Levels.Clear();
			}
		}

		internal List<ColumnHeader> GetLevelColHeaderList(int level)
		{
			if (level < 0 || level >= Levels.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return Levels[level];
		}

		internal List<HeaderBase> GetHeaderList()
		{
			List<HeaderBase> list = new List<HeaderBase>();
			for (int i = 0; i < LevelCount; i++)
			{
				List<ColumnHeader> levelColHeaderList = GetLevelColHeaderList(i);
				if (levelColHeaderList == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < levelColHeaderList.Count; j++)
				{
					try
					{
						list.Add(levelColHeaderList[j]);
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						list.Clear();
						list = null;
						return null;
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		internal bool ClearLevels()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Levels.Count; i++)
			{
				List<ColumnHeader> list = Levels[i];
				if (list != null)
				{
					ClearLevel(list);
					list.Clear();
					list = null;
				}
			}
			Levels.Clear();
			return true;
		}

		internal static bool ClearLevel(List<ColumnHeader> columnHeaderList)
		{
			if (columnHeaderList == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			columnHeaderList.Clear();
			return true;
		}

		internal bool CreateColLevels(List<ColumnHeader> colHeaderList)
		{
			ClearLevels();
			CreateLevel(colHeaderList, 0, 0);
			return true;
		}

		internal bool CreateLevel(List<ColumnHeader> colHeaderList, int startCol, int lastLevel)
		{
			int num = lastLevel;
			bool result = true;
			List<ColumnHeader> list = new List<ColumnHeader>();
			if (colHeaderList != null && colHeaderList.Count == 0)
			{
				try
				{
					Levels.Add(list);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					result = false;
				}
				if (num < LevelCount - 1)
				{
					CreateLevel(colHeaderList, 0, ++num);
					return true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					Levels.Add(list);
					int i;
					for (i = startCol; i < colHeaderList.Count; i++)
					{
						ColumnHeader columnHeader = colHeaderList[i];
						if (columnHeader != null)
						{
							if (num != columnHeader.Column.LevelResolved)
							{
								CreateLevel(colHeaderList, i, ++num);
								return true;
							}
							list.Add(columnHeader);
						}
					}
					if (i >= colHeaderList.Count && num < LevelCount - 1)
					{
						CreateLevel(colHeaderList, i, ++num);
						return true;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					result = false;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal class OrderedDropColumns
	{
		private bool valid;

		private GroupHeader dropGroupHeader;

		private DropLocation dropLocation;

		private List<HeaderBase> dragItems;

		private OrderedGroupColLevels groupColLevels;

		internal bool Valid
		{
			get
			{
				return valid;
			}
			set
			{
				valid = value;
			}
		}

		internal OrderedDropColumns(DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo, List<HeaderBase> dragItems)
		{
			dropLocation = dropLocationInfo.DropLocation;
			this.dragItems = dragItems;
			dropGroupHeader = dropLocationInfo.GroupHeader;
			groupColLevels = null;
			Valid = true;
			CreateDropColumnsList(dropLocationInfo);
		}

		internal void Dispose()
		{
			if (groupColLevels != null)
			{
				groupColLevels.Dispose();
				groupColLevels = null;
			}
		}

		internal List<HeaderBase> GetHeaderList()
		{
			if (groupColLevels != null)
			{
				return groupColLevels.GetHeaderList();
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal PositionInfo GetPositionInfo(ColumnHeader columnHeader)
		{
			PositionInfo positionInfo = new PositionInfo();
			if (groupColLevels == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			positionInfo.Level = -1;
			positionInfo.VisiblePos = -1;
			positionInfo.Group = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < groupColLevels.LevelCount; i++)
			{
				List<ColumnHeader> levelColHeaderList = groupColLevels.GetLevelColHeaderList(i);
				if (levelColHeaderList == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j < levelColHeaderList.Count; j++)
				{
					if (columnHeader == levelColHeaderList[j])
					{
						positionInfo.Level = (short)i;
						positionInfo.VisiblePos = (short)num;
						positionInfo.Group = dropGroupHeader.Group;
						return positionInfo;
					}
					num++;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool CreateDropColumnsList(DropLocationInfo dropLocationInfo)
		{
			GroupHeader groupHeader = dropLocationInfo.GroupHeader;
			ColumnHeader columnHeader = dropLocationInfo.ColumnHeader;
			bool flag = false;
			if (groupColLevels != null)
			{
				groupColLevels.ClearLevels();
				groupColLevels = null;
			}
			if (dragItems == null || groupHeader == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			IEnumerable<UltraGridColumn> columnsResolved = groupHeader.Group.ColumnsResolved;
			List<ColumnHeader> list = new List<ColumnHeader>();
			foreach (UltraGridColumn item in columnsResolved)
			{
				list.Add(item.Header);
			}
			if (columnsResolved == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			groupColLevels = new OrderedGroupColLevels(list, groupHeader.Band.LevelCountResolved);
			for (int i = 0; i < dragItems.Count; i++)
			{
				if (dragItems[i] is ColumnHeader columnHeader2)
				{
					Remove(columnHeader2);
				}
			}
			PositionInfo positionInfo = new PositionInfo();
			if (columnHeader != null)
			{
				positionInfo = GetPositionInfo(columnHeader);
				flag = positionInfo != null;
			}
			else if (groupHeader != null)
			{
				positionInfo.Group = groupHeader.Group;
				positionInfo.VisiblePos = 0;
				if (dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetGroup)
				{
					positionInfo.Level = 0;
				}
				else if (dropLocationInfo.IsDropTargetEmptyLevel)
				{
					positionInfo.Level = (short)dropLocationInfo.Level;
				}
				flag = true;
			}
			else
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				Valid = false;
				return false;
			}
			if (DropLocation.After == dropLocation)
			{
				positionInfo.VisiblePos++;
			}
			for (int num = dragItems.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (dragItems[num] is ColumnHeader columnHeader3)
				{
					Insert(columnHeader3, positionInfo);
				}
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal bool Insert(ColumnHeader columnHeader, PositionInfo newPosInfo)
		{
			if (groupColLevels == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			List<ColumnHeader> levelColHeaderList = groupColLevels.GetLevelColHeaderList(newPosInfo.Level);
			try
			{
				if (levelColHeaderList != null)
				{
					levelColHeaderList.Insert(Math.Min(newPosInfo.VisiblePos, levelColHeaderList.Count), columnHeader);
					result = true;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool Remove(ColumnHeader columnHeader)
		{
			if (groupColLevels == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = columnHeader.Group;
			if (ultraGridGroup == null || ultraGridGroup.Header != dropGroupHeader)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool result = false;
			List<ColumnHeader> levelColHeaderList = groupColLevels.GetLevelColHeaderList(columnHeader.Column.LevelResolved);
			if (levelColHeaderList != null)
			{
				try
				{
					if (levelColHeaderList.IndexOf(columnHeader) >= 0)
					{
						levelColHeaderList.Remove(columnHeader);
					}
					result = true;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					result = false;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}
	}

		private class Range : IComparable
		{
			internal int start;

			internal int end;

			internal Range(int start, int end)
			{
				this.start = start;
				this.end = end;
			}

			public int CompareTo(object x)
			{
				if (x == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				int num = start.CompareTo(((Range)x).start);
				if (num == 0)
				{
					num = end.CompareTo(((Range)x).end);
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		private void CalculateFirstRows()
		{
			//IL_00db: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00fe: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0132: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsPrintingCards)
			{
				CalculateFirstCards();
				return;
			}
			if (grid.PrintLayout.Rows.VisibleRowCount <= 0)
			{
				AddLogicalPrintPage(null);
				return;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = grid.PrintLayout.Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow();
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = grid.PrintLayout.RowScrollRegions[0];
			bool flag = true;
			flag = AddLogicalPrintPage(ultraGridRow);
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			ClipRowBehavior clipRowBehaviorResolved = ClipRowBehaviorResolved;
			do
			{
				double num2 = ((LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageFooterHeight != -1) ? ((double)LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageFooterHeight) : 0.0);
				double num3 = ((LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageHeaderHeight != -1) ? ((double)LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageHeaderHeight) : 0.0);
				num3 += (double)(2 * grid.PrintLayout.GetBorderThickness(LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageHeaderBorderStyle));
				num2 += (double)(2 * grid.PrintLayout.GetBorderThickness(LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageFooterBorderStyle));
				double num4 = PhysicalPageMarginBoundsSize.Height;
				UltraGridLayout printLayout = grid.PrintLayout;
				num4 += (double)(printLayout.GetBorderThickness(printLayout.BorderStyle) * 2);
				num4 /= scaleFactor;
				num4 -= num2 + num3;
				num4 -= (double)(printLayout.GetBorderThickness(printLayout.BorderStyle) * 2);
				rowScrollRegion.Origin = (int)num3;
				rowScrollRegion.Height = (int)num4;
				rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(ultraGridRow);
				rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset = num;
				rowScrollRegion.SetDestroyVisibleRows();
				rowScrollRegion.RegenerateVisibleRows();
				VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = rowScrollRegion.VisibleRows;
				if (visibleRows.Count == 0)
				{
					AddLogicalPrintPage(null);
					break;
				}
				int num5 = 0;
				int top = visibleRows[0].Top;
				for (int i = 0; i < visibleRows.Count; i++)
				{
					num5++;
					VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRows[i];
					ultraGridRow = visibleRow.Row;
					int top2 = visibleRow.Top;
					int totalHeight = visibleRow.GetTotalHeight();
					int extent = rowScrollRegion.Extent;
					if (top2 > extent && i == 0)
					{
						ErrorEventArgs e = new ErrorEventArgs(ErrorType.Printing, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("HeadersAreTooTallToPrint_Text"));
						grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.Error, e);
						if (!e.Cancel)
						{
							Form form = grid.PrintLayout.Form;
							MessageBoxButtons messageBoxButtons = MessageBoxButtons.OK;
							DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)form, e.ErrorText, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("PrintingError_Dialog_Title"), messageBoxButtons, MessageBoxIcon.Hand);
						}
						return;
					}
					if (num5 > 1 && ultraGridRow.StartsNewPrintedPage && visibleRow.Top != top)
					{
						num = 0;
						rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(ultraGridRow);
						rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset = num;
						rowScrollRegion.RegenerateVisibleRows();
						logicalPageList[logicalPageDimensions.Height - 1].UnusedDataHeight = extent - top2;
						flag = AddLogicalPrintPage(ultraGridRow, num);
						break;
					}
					if (top2 + totalHeight > extent)
					{
						if (1 == num5)
						{
							num = top2 - extent;
							if (ClipRowBehavior.CellBased == clipRowBehaviorResolved)
							{
								int num6 = AdjustScrollOffsetForWholeCells(visibleRow, num);
								if (num6 < extent)
								{
									num += num6;
								}
							}
						}
						else
						{
							num = 0;
						}
						rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(ultraGridRow);
						rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset = num;
						rowScrollRegion.RegenerateVisibleRows();
						flag = AddLogicalPrintPage(ultraGridRow, num);
						break;
					}
					flag = false;
				}
			}
			while (flag);
		}

		private void CalculateHorizontalOrigins()
		{
			if (!IsPrintingCards)
			{
				GetBandsOverallWidth(addPageHOrgin: true);
			}

				CalculateCardViewHorizontalOrigins();
			}
		}

		private void SetScaleFactor()
		{
			physicalPaperSizeDirtyFlag = true;
			int fitWidthToPages = logicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.FitWidthToPages;
			scaleFactor = 1.0;
			if (fitWidthToPages <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num = grid.PrintLayout.BandsOverallExtent;
			double num2 = PhysicalPageMarginBoundsSize.Width * fitWidthToPages;
			if (GetBandsOverallWidth(addPageHOrgin: false) > num2)
			{
				scaleFactor = num2 / num;
				for (num = GetBandsOverallWidth(addPageHOrgin: false); num > num2; num = GetBandsOverallWidth(addPageHOrgin: false))
				{
					scaleFactor -= 0.001;
				}
			}
		}

		private void CalculatePageDimensions()
		{
			Cursor current = Cursor.Current;
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.WaitCursor;
			ResetLayoutInfoHolder();
			SetScaleFactor();
			CalculateHorizontalOrigins();
			CalculateFirstRows();
			hasCalculatedPageDimensions = true;
			Cursor.Current = current;
		}

		private bool AddLogicalPrintPage(UltraGridRow row, int scrollOffset)
		{
			ResetLayoutInfoHolder();
			CancelableLogicalPrintPageEventArgs e = new CancelableLogicalPrintPageEventArgs(printDocument, logicalPageLayoutInfoHolder, logicalPageDimensions.Height + 1);
			grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.InitializeLogicalPrintPage, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			CalculateHeaderFooterHeights();
			logicalPageList[logicalPageDimensions.Height] = new LogicalPageInfo(row, logicalPageLayoutInfoHolder, scrollOffset);
			ref Size reference = ref logicalPageDimensions;
			int height = reference.Height + 1;
			reference.Height = height;
			if (PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.PrintRange == PrintRange.AllPages)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return logicalPageDimensions.Height * logicalPageDimensions.Width <= printDocument.PrinterSettings.ToPage;
		}

		private void SetStartPage()
		{
			if (PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.PrintRange == PrintRange.AllPages)
			{
				CurrentPrintingPage.Reset();
			}
			else
			{
				ConvertPhysicalToLogicalPage(CurrentPrintingPage, PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.FromPage);
			}
		}

		private void ConvertPhysicalToLogicalPage(Page LogicalPage, int PhysicalPage)
		{
			if (PhysicalPage == 1)
			{
				LogicalPage.x = 0;
				LogicalPage.y = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				PhysicalPage--;
				LogicalPage.x = PhysicalPage % logicalPageDimensions.Width;
				LogicalPage.y = PhysicalPage / logicalPageDimensions.Width;
			}
		}

		private double GetBandsOverallWidth(bool addPageHOrgin)
		{
			if (grid.PrintLayout != null)
			{
				grid.PrintLayout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = null;
				UltraGridBand band = null;
				double num = 0.0;
				double num2 = 0.0;
				double num3 = 0.0;
				int count = grid.PrintLayout.SortedBands.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					ultraGridBand = (UltraGridBand)grid.PrintLayout.SortedBands.GetItem(i);
					num2 = 0.0;
					num3 = 0.0;
					GetBandOverallWidth(ref num2, ref num3, ultraGridBand, addPageHOrigin: false);
					if (num3 > num)
					{
						num = num3;
						band = ultraGridBand;
					}
				}
				logicalPageDimensions.Width = 1;
				logicalPageDimensions.Height = 0;
				num2 = 0.0;
				num3 = 0.0;
				GetBandOverallWidth(ref num2, ref num3, band, addPageHOrgin);
				return num;
			}
			return 0.0;
		}

		private void GetBandOverallWidth(ref double pageExtent, ref double totalExtent, UltraGridBand band, bool addPageHOrigin)
		{
			if (band == null || band.Columns == null || grid.PrintLayout == null || grid.PrintLayout.SortedBands == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Size size = PhysicalPageMarginBoundsSize;
			if (band.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeadersCollection orderedHeaders = band.OrderedHeaders;
			ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegions = grid.PrintLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false);
			colScrollRegions.InitializeMetrics();
			if (orderedHeaders == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<Range> list = new List<Range>();
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < band.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = band.Columns[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn != null && !ultraGridColumn.HiddenResolved)
				{
					int overallOrigin = ultraGridColumn.Header.OverallOrigin;
					int num2 = ultraGridColumn.Header.Extent;
					if (band.GroupsDisplayed && band.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout && ultraGridColumn.Group != null && ultraGridColumn.LastItemInLevel)
					{
						Rectangle headerRect = Rectangle.Empty;
						Rectangle fixedHeaderRect = Rectangle.Empty;
						ultraGridColumn.Group.CalculateHeaderRect(ref headerRect, ref fixedHeaderRect);
						num2 = headerRect.Width - ultraGridColumn.RelativeOrigin;
					}
					num = Math.Max(num, overallOrigin + num2);
					list.Add(new Range(overallOrigin, overallOrigin + num2));
				}
			}
			list.Sort();
			list.Add(new Range(num, num));
			double num3 = pageExtent;
			ColumnClipMode columnClipMode = ((LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder != null) ? LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.ColumnClipMode : ColumnClipMode.Default);
			if (columnClipMode == ColumnClipMode.Default)
			{
				columnClipMode = ((!band.GroupsDisplayed && !band.UseRowLayoutResolved) ? ColumnClipMode.RepeatClippedColumns : ColumnClipMode.SplitClippedColumns);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				Range range = list[i];
				while (scaleFactor * ((double)range.start - num3) > (double)size.Width)
				{
					num3 += (double)(size.Width - 2) / scaleFactor;
					StartNewPage(ref pageExtent, ref totalExtent, (long)num3, 0.0, addPageHOrigin);
				}
				if (ColumnClipMode.RepeatClippedColumns == columnClipMode && scaleFactor * ((double)range.end - num3) > (double)size.Width)
				{
					bool flag = scaleFactor * (double)(range.end - range.start) > (double)size.Width;
					if (!flag && Math.Abs(band.GetOrigin(BandOrigin.RowSelector) - range.start) <= 2 && (band.Index == 0 || !band.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						StartNewPage(ref pageExtent, ref totalExtent, range.start, range.end - range.start, addPageHOrigin);
						num3 = range.start;
					}
				}
				if (list.Count - 1 == i)
				{
					double num4 = scaleFactor * ((double)range.end - num3) - pageExtent;
					if (num4 > 0.0)
					{
						pageExtent += num4;
						totalExtent += num4;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void StartNewPage(ref double pageExtent, ref double totalExtent, long origin, double colWidth, bool addPageHOrigin)
		{
			totalExtent += (double)PhysicalPageMarginBoundsSize.Width - pageExtent;
			pageExtent += (double)PhysicalPageMarginBoundsSize.Width - pageExtent;
			colWidth *= scaleFactor;
			pageExtent += colWidth;
			totalExtent += colWidth;
			if (addPageHOrigin)
			{
				SetPageHOrigin(logicalPageDimensions.Width, origin);
				ref Size reference = ref logicalPageDimensions;
				int width = reference.Width + 1;
				reference.Width = width;
			}
			pageExtent = colWidth;
		}

		{

			if (IsPrintingCards)
			{

				printLayout.Rows.FirstVisibleCardRow = logicalPageInfo.FirstRow;

				{

					printLayout.UIElementInternal.DirtyChildElements(true);
					printLayout.UIElementInternal.VerifyChildElements(true);
					if (((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement)) is CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement)
					{
						AdjustCardElementHorizontalPositions(cardAreaUIElement, (int)(-num));
						ClipRowBehavior clipRowBehaviorResolved = ClipRowBehaviorResolved;
						if (clipRowBehaviorResolved == ClipRowBehavior.CellBased)
						{
							int borderThickness = printLayout.GetBorderThickness(printLayout.BorderStyleResolved);
							if (IsAnyCardClipped(cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement, ((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).Rect.Bottom, vertical: true))
							{
								int maxExtent = (int)GetAvailablePageHeight(borderThickness);
								GetPartiallyClippedElements((UIElement)(object)cardAreaUIElement, ((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).Rect.Bottom, maxExtent, vertical: true, ClippedElementAction.Replace, typesToExcludeFromClippingInCardViewPrinting);
							}
							if (IsAnyCardClipped(cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement, ((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).Rect.Right, vertical: false))
							{
								int maxExtent2 = (int)GetAvailablePageWidth(borderThickness);
								GetPartiallyClippedElements((UIElement)(object)cardAreaUIElement, ((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).Rect.Right, maxExtent2, vertical: false, ClippedElementAction.Replace, typesToExcludeFromClippingInCardViewPrinting);
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				grid.PrintLayout.RowScrollRegions[0].scrollOffset = logicalPageInfo.ScrollOffset;
				grid.PrintLayout.RowScrollRegions[0].SetFirstRow(logicalPageInfo.FirstRow);
				grid.PrintLayout.RowScrollRegions[0].SetDestroyVisibleRows();
				grid.PrintLayout.ColScrollRegions[0].Position = (int)num;
				grid.PrintLayout.ColScrollRegions[0].SetDestroyVisibleHeaders();
			}
			grid.PrintLayout.UIElementInternal.Print(graphics, textNeedsClipping);
			grid.IsPrinting = false;
			ev.HasMorePages = NextPageHelper();
			if (!ev.HasMorePages)
			{
				textNeedsClipping = false;
			}
		}

		private bool NextPageHelper()
		{
			bool result = false;
			CurrentPrintingPage.x++;
			if (CurrentPrintingPage.x >= logicalPageDimensions.Width)
			{
				CurrentPrintingPage.x = 0;
				CurrentPrintingPage.y++;
				if (CurrentPrintingPage.y < logicalPageDimensions.Height)
				{
					result = MorePages();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				result = MorePages();
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void BeginPrint(object sender, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			if (calledFromPrint)
			{
				SaveToCache();
				CancelablePrintEventArgs e2 = new CancelablePrintEventArgs(PrintDocument, DefaultLayoutInfo, grid.PrintLayout);
				grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforePrint, e2);
				if (e2.Cancel)
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
					return;
				}
				if (hasCalculatedPageDimensions && HaveCacheValuesChanged())
				{
					hasCalculatedPageDimensions = false;
				}
				textNeedsClipping = ShouldClipText();
			}
			if (!HasCalculatedPageDimensions)
			{
				CalculatePageDimensions();
				calledFromPrint = true;
			}
			if (PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.PrintRange != PrintRange.AllPages && PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.FromPage <= 0)
			{
				PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.FromPage = 1;
			}
			if ((PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.PrintRange != PrintRange.AllPages && PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.FromPage > TotalNumberOfPages) || logicalPageList == null || logicalPageList[0] == null)
			{
				e.Cancel = true;
			}
			else
			{
				SetStartPage();
			}
		}

		internal void EndPrint(object sender, PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			DisposePrinterMetricsGraphicsHelper();
		}

		internal void DisposePrinterMetricsGraphicsHelper()
		{
			if (printerMetricsGraphics != null)
			{
				printerMetricsGraphics.Dispose();
				printerMetricsGraphics = null;
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldClipText()
		{
			bool result = false;
			if (defaultLayoutInfo.ClippingOverride == ClippingOverride.Auto)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < printerClipError.Length; i++)
				{
					string text = printDocument.PrinterSettings.PrinterName.ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
					string value = printerClipError[i].ToUpper(CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
					if (text.IndexOf(value) != -1)
					{
						result = true;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (defaultLayoutInfo.ClippingOverride == ClippingOverride.Yes)
			{
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void SaveToCache()
		{
			//IL_0054: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo = new LogicalPageLayoutInfo(grid);
			cachedPrintDocument = new PrintDocument();
			cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.FitWidthToPages = defaultLayoutInfo.FitWidthToPages;
			cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageFooter = defaultLayoutInfo.PageFooter;
			cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageFooterBorderStyle = defaultLayoutInfo.PageFooterBorderStyle;
			cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageFooterHeight = defaultLayoutInfo.PageFooterHeight;
			cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageHeader = defaultLayoutInfo.PageHeader;
			cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageFooterBorderStyle = defaultLayoutInfo.PageHeaderBorderStyle;
			cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageHeaderHeight = defaultLayoutInfo.PageHeaderHeight;
			cachedPrintDocument.DefaultPageSettings = (PageSettings)PrintDocument.DefaultPageSettings.Clone();
		}

		private bool HaveCacheValuesChanged()
		{
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0097: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.FitWidthToPages == defaultLayoutInfo.FitWidthToPages && !(cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageFooter != defaultLayoutInfo.PageFooter) && cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageFooterBorderStyle == defaultLayoutInfo.PageFooterBorderStyle && cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageFooterHeight == defaultLayoutInfo.PageFooterHeight && !(cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageHeader != defaultLayoutInfo.PageHeader) && cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageFooterBorderStyle == defaultLayoutInfo.PageHeaderBorderStyle && cachedLogicalPageLayoutInfo.PageHeaderHeight == defaultLayoutInfo.PageHeaderHeight && !defaultLayoutInfo.HasAppearanceChanged && !(cachedPrintDocument.DefaultPageSettings.Bounds != PrintDocument.DefaultPageSettings.Bounds) && cachedPrintDocument.DefaultPageSettings.Landscape == PrintDocument.DefaultPageSettings.Landscape && cachedPrintDocument.DefaultPageSettings.Margins.Equals(PrintDocument.DefaultPageSettings.Margins))
			{
				return cachedPrintDocument.DefaultPageSettings.PaperSize != PrintDocument.DefaultPageSettings.PaperSize;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool MorePages()
		{
			if (PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.PrintRange != PrintRange.AllPages)
			{
				return CurrentPrintingPageNumber <= PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.ToPage;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static void AdjustCardElementHorizontalPositions(CardAreaUIElement cardAreaUIElement, int hScrollOffset)
		{
			if (!(((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement)) is CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement) || hScrollOffset == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator = ((UIElement)cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement).ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					current.Offset(hScrollOffset, 0);
					current.DirtyChildElements(true);
					current.VerifyChildElements(true);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private static int AdjustOffsetForCellBasedCutOffPoint(CardAreaUIElement cardAreaUIElement, int limit, int maxExtent, bool vertical, int scrollOffset)
		{
			UIElement[] partiallyClippedElements = GetPartiallyClippedElements((UIElement)(object)cardAreaUIElement, limit, maxExtent, vertical, ClippedElementAction.None, typesToExcludeFromClippingInCardViewPrinting);
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			UIElement[] array = partiallyClippedElements;
			foreach (UIElement val in array)
			{
				int val2 = (vertical ? val.Rect.Top : val.Rect.Left);
				num = Math.Min(val2, num);
			}
			if (num != int.MaxValue)
			{
				int num2 = maxExtent - num;
				if (num2 > 0 && num2 < maxExtent)
				{
					scrollOffset -= num2;
				}
			}
			return scrollOffset;
		}

		private void CalculateCardViewHorizontalOrigins()
		{
			UltraGridLayout printLayout = grid.PrintLayout;
			if (printLayout.Rows.VisibleRowCount <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Size availablePageSize = GetAvailablePageSize(printLayout);
			UltraGridRow firstVisibleRow = printLayout.Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow();
			CardAreaUIElement temporaryCardAreaUIElement = GetTemporaryCardAreaUIElement(printLayout, availablePageSize, firstVisibleRow);
			UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)temporaryCardAreaUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(RowUIElement));
			if (descendant == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int right = descendant.Rect.Right;
			logicalPageDimensions.Width = 0;
			logicalPageDimensions.Height = 0;
			if (right <= availablePageSize.Width)
			{
				return;
			}
			ClipRowBehavior clipRowBehaviorResolved = ClipRowBehaviorResolved;
			int num = 0;
			SetPageHOrigin(logicalPageDimensions.Width, num);
			ref Size reference = ref logicalPageDimensions;
			int width = reference.Width + 1;
			reference.Width = width;
			for (num = availablePageSize.Width; num < right; num += availablePageSize.Width)
			{
				if (clipRowBehaviorResolved == ClipRowBehavior.CellBased)
				{
					num = AdjustOffsetForCellBasedCutOffPoint(temporaryCardAreaUIElement, availablePageSize.Width, availablePageSize.Width, vertical: false, num);
				}
				SetPageHOrigin(logicalPageDimensions.Width, num);
				ref Size reference2 = ref logicalPageDimensions;
				width = reference2.Width + 1;
				reference2.Width = width;
				AdjustCardElementHorizontalPositions(temporaryCardAreaUIElement, -num);
			}
		}

		private void CalculateFirstCards()
		{
			UltraGridLayout printLayout = grid.PrintLayout;
			if (printLayout.Rows.VisibleRowCount <= 0)
			{
				AddLogicalPrintPage(null);
				return;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = printLayout.Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow();
			bool flag = true;
			int visibleIndex = ultraGridRow.VisibleIndex;
			if (!AddLogicalPrintPage(ultraGridRow))
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			ClipRowBehavior clipRowBehaviorResolved = ClipRowBehaviorResolved;
			CardAreaUIElement cardAreaUIElement = null;
			UIElement descendant = printLayout.UIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement));
			do
			{
				Size availablePageSize = GetAvailablePageSize(printLayout);
				ultraGridRow.ParentCollection.FirstVisibleCard = ultraGridRow;
				if (cardAreaUIElement == null)
				{
					cardAreaUIElement = GetTemporaryCardAreaUIElement(printLayout, availablePageSize, ultraGridRow);
				}
				int totalVisibleCards = cardAreaUIElement.TotalVisibleCards;
				int heightAvailableForCards = cardAreaUIElement.HeightAvailableForCards;
				int height = ((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).Rect.Height;
				num = height;
				if (((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement)) is CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement)
				{
					bool flag2 = IsAnyCardClipped(cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement, num, vertical: true);
					while (flag2)
					{
						if (clipRowBehaviorResolved == ClipRowBehavior.CellBased)
						{
							num = AdjustOffsetForCellBasedCutOffPoint(cardAreaUIElement, num, num, vertical: true, num);
						}
						flag = AddLogicalPrintPage(ultraGridRow, num);
						num += height;
						flag2 = IsAnyCardClipped(cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement, num, vertical: true);
					}
				}
				ultraGridRow = printLayout.Rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(ultraGridRow, totalVisibleCards);
			}
			while (ultraGridRow != null && AddLogicalPrintPage(ultraGridRow));
		}

		private Size GetAvailablePageSize()
		{
			UltraGridLayout printLayout = grid.PrintLayout;
			return GetAvailablePageSize(printLayout);
		}

		private Size GetAvailablePageSize(UltraGridLayout printLayout)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int borderThickness = printLayout.GetBorderThickness(printLayout.BorderStyleResolved);
			int width = (int)GetAvailablePageWidth(borderThickness);
			int height = (int)GetAvailablePageHeight(borderThickness);
			return new Size(width, height);
		}

		private double GetAvailablePageHeight(int borderThickness)
		{
			//IL_0061: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			double num = ((LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageFooterHeight != -1) ? ((double)LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageFooterHeight) : 0.0);
			double num2 = ((LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageHeaderHeight != -1) ? ((double)LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageHeaderHeight) : 0.0);
			num2 += (double)(2 * grid.PrintLayout.GetBorderThickness(LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageHeaderBorderStyle));
			num += (double)(2 * grid.PrintLayout.GetBorderThickness(LogicalPageLayoutInfoHolder.PageFooterBorderStyle));
			double num3 = PhysicalPageMarginBoundsSize.Height;
			num3 /= scaleFactor;
			num3 -= num + num2;
			return num3 - (double)(borderThickness * 2);
		}

		private double GetAvailablePageWidth(int borderThickness)
		{
			double num = PhysicalPageMarginBoundsSize.Width;
			num /= scaleFactor;
			return num - (double)(borderThickness * 2);
		}

		private static UIElement[] GetPartiallyClippedElements(UIElement containingElement, int limit, int maxExtent, bool vertical, ClippedElementAction action, Type[] excludedTypes)
		{
			List<UIElement> list = new List<UIElement>();
			GetPartiallyClippedElementsHelper(containingElement, limit, maxExtent, vertical, action, list, excludedTypes);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private static void GetPartiallyClippedElementsHelper(UIElement containingElement, int limit, int maxExtent, bool vertical, ClippedElementAction action, List<UIElement> clippedElementsList, Type[] excludedTypes)
		{
			UIElement[] array = ((ArrayList)(object)containingElement.ChildElements).ToArray(typeof(UIElement)) as UIElement[];
			UIElement[] array2 = array;
			foreach (UIElement val in array2)
			{
				if (val is CellUIElement)
				{
					UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = val.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridCell)) as UltraGridCell;
				}
				if (!IsObjectOfType(val, excludedTypes) && IsElementClipped(val, limit, maxExtent, vertical))
				{
					clippedElementsList.Add(val);
					switch (action)
					{
					case ClippedElementAction.Remove:
						containingElement.ChildElements.Remove(val);
						break;
					case ClippedElementAction.Replace:
					{
						containingElement.ChildElements.Remove(val);
						BlankUIElement blankUIElement = new BlankUIElement(containingElement);
						((UIElement)blankUIElement).Rect = val.Rect;
						containingElement.ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)blankUIElement);
						break;
					}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					GetPartiallyClippedElementsHelper(val, limit, maxExtent, vertical, action, clippedElementsList, excludedTypes);
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool IsCardElementClipped(UIElement element, int limit, bool vertical)
		{
			int num = (vertical ? element.Rect.Bottom : element.Rect.Right);
			return num > limit;
		}

		private static bool IsElementClipped(UIElement element, int limit, int maxExtent, bool vertical)
		{
			int num = (vertical ? element.Rect.Height : element.Rect.Width);
			if (num > maxExtent)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num2 = (vertical ? element.Rect.Top : element.Rect.Left);
			if (num2 < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num3 = (vertical ? element.Rect.Bottom : element.Rect.Right);
			if (num2 < limit)
			{
				return num3 > limit;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsAnyCardClipped(CardAreaScrollRegionUIElement cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement, int limit, bool vertical)
		{
			UIElementEnumerator enumerator = ((UIElement)cardAreaScrollRegionUIElement).ChildElements.GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UIElement current = enumerator.Current;
					if (IsCardElementClipped(current, limit, vertical))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (enumerator is IDisposable disposable)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static CardAreaUIElement GetTemporaryCardAreaUIElement(UltraGridLayout printLayout, Size size, UltraGridRow firstRow)
		{
			UIElement descendant = printLayout.UIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement));
			CardAreaUIElement cardAreaUIElement = new CardAreaUIElement(descendant, firstRow);
			((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).Rect = new Rectangle(0, 0, size.Width, size.Height);
			((UIElement)cardAreaUIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
			return cardAreaUIElement;
		}

		private static bool IsObjectOfType(object o, Type[] types)
		{
			foreach (Type c in types)
			{
				if (o.GetType().IsAssignableFrom(c))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		{
			this.x = x;
			this.y = y;
		}

		internal void Reset()
		{
			x = 0;
			y = 0;
		}
	}

	internal struct ResolveAppearanceContext
	{
		public AppearancePropFlags UnresolvedProps;

		private Type objectType;

		public bool IsAlternate;

		public bool IsSelected;

		public bool IsActiveRow;

		public bool IsActiveCell;

		public bool IsCaption;

		public bool IsCard;

		public bool IsInEdit;

		public bool IsRowSelector;

		public bool IsCellOnly;

		public bool IsRowPreview;

		public bool IsGroupByColumn;

		public bool IsGroupByColumnHeader;

		public bool IsFixedHeader;

		public bool IsFixedColumn;

		public bool IsFormulaError;

		public bool IsNoDataSourceMessageText;

		public bool IsNoRowsInDataSourceMessageText;

		public bool IsNoVisibleRowsMessageText;

		public bool ResolveDefaultColors;

		public UIRole Role;

		public ResolutionOrderInfo ResolutionOrder;

		public Type ObjectType => objectType;

		public ResolveAppearanceContext(Type objectType, AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0008: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			this.objectType = objectType;
			UnresolvedProps = requestedProps;
			IsAlternate = false;
			IsSelected = false;
			IsActiveRow = false;
			IsActiveCell = false;
			IsCaption = false;
			IsCard = false;
			IsInEdit = false;
			IsRowSelector = false;
			IsCellOnly = false;
			IsRowPreview = false;
			IsGroupByColumn = false;
			IsGroupByColumnHeader = false;
			IsFixedColumn = false;
			IsFixedHeader = false;
			IsFormulaError = false;
			IsNoDataSourceMessageText = false;
			IsNoRowsInDataSourceMessageText = false;
			IsNoVisibleRowsMessageText = false;
			ResolveDefaultColors = true;
			Role = null;
			ResolutionOrder = new ResolutionOrderInfo((ResolutionOrder)0);
		}
	}
