	[StrongNameIdentityPermission(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, PublicKey = "")]
	public class UltraGridRow : ActivateableGridItemBase, IUIElementTextProvider, IUIElementProvider, ISparseArrayMultiItem, ISparseArrayItem
	{
		public class RowAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper
		{
			private UltraGridRow row;

			public override Rectangle Bounds
			{
				get
				{
					UIElement uIElement = row.GetUIElement(row.Band.Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion, row.Band.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion, verifyElements: true);
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					return uIElement.Control?.RectangleToScreen(uIElement.ClipRect) ?? Rectangle.Empty;
				}
			}

			public override string DefaultAction
			{
				get
				{
					if (row.HasExpansionIndicator)
					{
						if (row.Expanded)
						{
							return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Collapse");
						}
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Expand");
					}
					if (row.IsCard && row.IsCardStyleCompressed)
					{
						if (row.IsCardCompressed)
						{
							return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Expand");
						}
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Collapse");
					}
					if (!row.IsDisabled && (!row.IsActiveRow || row.Layout.ActiveCell != null))
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DefaultAction_Row");
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public override string Description => null;

			public override string Help => null;

			public override string Name
			{
				get
				{
					string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
					if (name != null && name.Length > 0)
					{
						return name;
					}
					if (row.IsTemplateAddRow)
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_TemplateAddRow");
					}
					if (row.IsAddRow)
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_AddRow");
					}
					if (row.IsFilterRow)
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_FilterRow");
					}
					string text = row.band.Header.Caption;
					if (text == null)
					{
						text = string.Empty;
					}
					name = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("AccessibleName_Row");
					try
					{
						return string.Format(name, text, row.Index + 1).Trim();
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						return name;
					}
				}
				set
				{
					((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Parent
			{
				get
				{
					UltraGridChildBand parentChildBand = row.ParentChildBand;
					if (parentChildBand == null)
					{
						return row.Layout.Grid.Rows.RowsAccessibleObject;
					}
					return parentChildBand.RowsCollectionAccessibilityObject;
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.Row;

			public override AccessibleStates State
			{
				get
				{
					if (row.HiddenResolved)
					{
						return AccessibleStates.Invisible;
					}
					if (row.ActivationResolvedInternal == Activation.Disabled)
					{
						return AccessibleStates.Unavailable;
					}
					AccessibleStates accessibleStates = AccessibleStates.ReadOnly;
					if (row.Selectable)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Selectable;
					}
					if (row.Selected)
					{
						accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Selected;
					}
					if (row.IsActiveRow)
					{
						UltraGridCell activeCell = row.band.Layout.ActiveCell;
						if (activeCell == null && ((Control)(object)row.band.Layout.Grid).Focused)
						{
							accessibleStates |= AccessibleStates.Focused;
						}
					}
					if (row.HasExpansionIndicator)
					{
						accessibleStates = ((!row.Expanded) ? (accessibleStates | AccessibleStates.Collapsed) : (accessibleStates | AccessibleStates.Expanded));
					}
					if (row.IsCard && row.IsCardStyleCompressed)
					{
						accessibleStates = ((!row.IsCardCompressed) ? (accessibleStates | AccessibleStates.Expanded) : (accessibleStates | AccessibleStates.Collapsed));
					}
					return accessibleStates;
				}
			}

			public override string Value
			{
				get
				{
					string description = row.Description;
					if (description != null && description.Length > 0)
					{
						return description;
					}
					return null;
				}
				set
				{
				}
			}

			public UltraGridRow Row => row;

			public RowAccessibleObject(UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (row == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("row");
				}
				this.row = row;
			}

			public override void DoDefaultAction()
			{
				if (row.HasExpansionIndicator)
				{
					row.Expanded = !row.Expanded;
				}
				else if (row.IsCard && row.IsCardStyleCompressed)
				{
					row.IsCardCompressed = !row.IsCardCompressed;
				}
				else if ((!row.IsActiveRow || row.Layout.ActiveCell != null) && !row.IsDisabled)
				{
					row.Layout.Grid.ActiveRow = row;
					if (row.Layout.ActiveRow == row && row.Layout.ActiveCell != null && row.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid)
					{
						((UltraGrid)row.Layout.Grid).ActiveCell = null;
					}
				}
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
			{
				if (row is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow)
				{
					if (row.Expanded && index >= 0 && index < ultraGridGroupByRow.Rows.Count)
					{
						return ultraGridGroupByRow.Rows[index].AccessibilityObject;
					}
					return null;
				}
				HeadersCollection headersCollection = ((!row.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved) ? row.Band.OrderedColumnHeaders : row.Band.LayoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders);
				if (index >= 0 && index < headersCollection.Count)
				{
					UltraGridColumn column = ((ColumnHeader)headersCollection[index]).Column;
					if (column != null)
					{
						return row.Cells[column].AccessibilityObject;
					}
				}
				index -= headersCollection.Count;
				if (!row.band.CardView && index >= 0 && row.Expanded && index < row.ChildBands.Count && row.HasChildRowsInternal(IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
				{
					return row.childBands[index].Rows.RowsAccessibleObject;
				}
				return null;
			}

			public override int GetChildCount()
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (row is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow)
				{
					if (row.Expanded)
					{
						num = ultraGridGroupByRow.Rows.Count;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num = ((!row.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved) ? row.Band.OrderedColumnHeaders.Count : row.Band.LayoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeaders.Count);
					if (!row.band.CardView && row.Expanded && !row.band.CardView && row.HasChildRowsInternal(IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
					{
						num += row.ChildBands.Count;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetFocused()
			{
				return null;
			}

			protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
			{
				return (Control)(object)row.Layout.Grid;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject GetSelected()
			{
				return null;
			}

			public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
			{
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).HitTest(x, y);
			}

			public override AccessibleObject Navigate(AccessibleNavigation navdir)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
				switch (navdir)
				{
				case AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild:
				case AccessibleNavigation.LastChild:
					if (!(row is UltraGridGroupByRow))
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ((navdir != AccessibleNavigation.FirstChild) ? row.Band.GetLastVisibleCol(row.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion, includeNonActivateable: true) : row.Band.GetFirstVisibleCol(row.Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion, includeNonActivateable: true));
						if (ultraGridColumn != null)
						{
							return row.Cells[ultraGridColumn].AccessibilityObject;
						}
					}
					return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Navigate(navdir);
				case AccessibleNavigation.Down:
					ultraGridRow = row.GetNextVisibleRelative(spanBands: false, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Up:
					ultraGridRow = row.GetPrevVisibleRelative(spanBands: false, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Next:
					ultraGridRow = row.GetNextVisibleRelative(spanBands: false, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
					break;
				case AccessibleNavigation.Previous:
					ultraGridRow = row.GetPrevVisibleRelative(spanBands: false, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
					break;
				}
				return ultraGridRow?.AccessibilityObject;
			}

			public override void Select(AccessibleSelection flags)
			{
				//IL_003b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = row;
				UltraGridBase grid = ultraGridRow.Layout.Grid;
				ISelectionManager val = (ISelectionManager)(object)((grid is ISelectionManager) ? grid : null);
				ISelectionStrategy val2 = ((val != null) ? val.GetSelectionStrategy((ISelectableItem)ultraGridRow) : null);
				if (val == null || val2 == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool clearExistingSelection = val2 is SelectionStrategyExtended && !((SelectionStrategyExtended)val2).IsDiscontiguousAllowed;
				if (grid is UltraGrid)
				{
					UltraGrid ultraGrid = (UltraGrid)grid;
					if ((AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection == (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection & flags) || AccessibleSelection.AddSelection == (AccessibleSelection.AddSelection & flags)) && ultraGridRow.Selectable)
					{
						if (val2.IsSingleSelect)
						{
							ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(ultraGridRow, clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
						}
						else if (val.IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection((ISelectableItem)ultraGridRow) && !val.IsMaxSelectedItemsExceeded((ISelectableItem)ultraGridRow))
						{
							if (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection == (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection & flags))
							{
								ultraGrid.InternalSelectRange(ultraGridRow, clearExistingSelection: false, select: true);
							}
							else
							{
								ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(ultraGridRow, clearExistingSelection, select: true);
							}
						}
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus == (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus & flags))
					{
						ultraGridRow.Activate();
						if (ultraGridRow.IsActiveRow)
						{
							val.SetPivotItem((ISelectableItem)ultraGridRow, false);
						}
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection == (AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection & flags))
					{
						ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(ultraGridRow, clearExistingSelection, select: false);
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection == (AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection & flags) && ultraGridRow.Selectable)
					{
						ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(ultraGridRow, clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
					}
				}
				else if (grid is UltraDropDownBase)
				{
					if (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection == (AccessibleSelection.ExtendSelection & flags) || AccessibleSelection.AddSelection == (AccessibleSelection.AddSelection & flags) || AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection == (AccessibleSelection.TakeSelection & flags) || AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus == (AccessibleSelection.TakeFocus & flags))
					{
						((UltraDropDownBase)grid).SelectedRow = ultraGridRow;
					}
					if (AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection == (AccessibleSelection.RemoveSelection & flags))
					{
						((UltraDropDownBase)grid).SelectedRow = null;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public class UltraGridRowDataErrorInfo : SubObjectBase, IDataErrorInfo
		{
			private UltraGridRow row;

			private string rowError = string.Empty;

			private Dictionary<UltraGridColumn, string> columnErrors;

			private int columnsCollectionVersion;

			private Dictionary<UltraGridColumn, string> ColumnErrors
			{
				get
				{
					if (columnErrors == null)
					{
						columnErrors = new Dictionary<UltraGridColumn, string>();
					}
					return columnErrors;
				}
			}

			private bool HasErrors
			{
				get
				{
					if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(RowError))
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (columnErrors == null || columnErrors.Count == 0)
					{
						return false;
					}
					SynchronizeWithColumnsCollection();
					foreach (UltraGridColumn key in columnErrors.Keys)
					{
						string value = ColumnErrors[key];
						if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			public string RowError
			{
				get
				{
					return rowError;
				}
				set
				{
					if (string.Compare(rowError, value, ignoreCase: false) != 0)
					{
						rowError = value;
						NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DataErrorInfoRowError);
					}
				}
			}

			string IDataErrorInfo.Error => RowError;

			string IDataErrorInfo.this[string columnKey] => GetColumnError(columnKey);

			internal UltraGridRowDataErrorInfo(UltraGridRow row)
			{
				this.row = row;
			}

			public void ResetRowError()
			{
				RowError = string.Empty;
			}

			private void SynchronizeWithColumnsCollection()
			{
				if (row.BandInternal.ColumnsVersion == columnsCollectionVersion)
				{
					return;
				}
				UltraGridBand bandInternal = row.BandInternal;
				if (columnErrors == null || columnErrors.Count == 0)
				{
					columnsCollectionVersion = bandInternal.ColumnsVersion;
					return;
				}
				ColumnsCollection columns = bandInternal.Columns;
				if (columns.Count == 0)
				{
					columnsCollectionVersion = bandInternal.ColumnsVersion;
					columnErrors.Clear();
					return;
				}
				UltraGridColumn[] array = new UltraGridColumn[ColumnErrors.Keys.Count];
				ColumnErrors.Keys.CopyTo(array, 0);
				UltraGridColumn[] array2 = array;
				foreach (UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn in array2)
				{
					if (!columns.Contains(ultraGridColumn))
					{
						columnErrors.Remove(ultraGridColumn);
					}
				}
				columnsCollectionVersion = bandInternal.ColumnsVersion;
			}

			private void VerifyColumnIsValid(UltraGridColumn column)
			{
				if (!row.Band.Columns.Contains(column))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_DataErrorInfo_ColumnNotInBand", column.Key));
				}
			}

			public void ClearErrors()
			{
				ResetRowError();
				ColumnErrors.Clear();
			}

			public string GetColumnError(int columnIndex)
			{
				UltraGridColumn column = row.Band.columns[columnIndex];
				return GetColumnError(column);
			}

			public string GetColumnError(string columnKey)
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsCollection();
				UltraGridColumn column = row.Band.columns[columnKey];
				return GetColumnError(column);
			}

			public string GetColumnError(UltraGridColumn column)
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsCollection();
				VerifyColumnIsValid(column);
				if (ColumnErrors.TryGetValue(column, out var value))
				{
					return value;
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}

			private UltraGridColumn[] GetColumnsInError()
			{
				List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>();
				SynchronizeWithColumnsCollection();
				if (columnErrors != null)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridColumn column in row.Band.Columns)
					{
						if (!column.IsChaptered)
						{
							string columnError = GetColumnError(column);
							if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(columnError))
							{
								list.Add(column);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}

			public void SetColumnError(int columnIndex, string error)
			{
				UltraGridColumn column = row.Band.Columns[columnIndex];
				SetColumnError(column, error);
			}

			public void SetColumnError(string columnKey, string error)
			{
				UltraGridColumn column = row.Band.columns[columnKey];
				SetColumnError(column, error);
			}

			public void SetColumnError(UltraGridColumn column, string error)
			{
				SynchronizeWithColumnsCollection();
				VerifyColumnIsValid(column);
				ColumnErrors[column] = error;
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DataErrorInfoColumnError);
			}
		}

		public virtual int RowSpacingBeforeResolved
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridLayout.CachedRowInfo value = null;
				Dictionary<UltraGridRow, UltraGridLayout.CachedRowInfo> dictionary = null;
				if (Layout != null && Layout.IsCachingBandInfo)
				{
					dictionary = Layout.CachedRowData;
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(this, out value) && value.RowSpacingBefore > -1)
					{
						return value.RowSpacingBefore;
					}
				}
				int num = RowSpacingBeforeResolvedBase;
				if (HasSpecialRowSeparatorBefore)
				{
					num += BandInternal.SpecialRowSeparatorHeightResolved;
				}
				UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
				if (parentRow != null)
				{
					ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = band.Layout.ViewStyleImpl;
					if (viewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers && !HasPrevSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) && !HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, parentRow.RowSpacingBeforeResolved);
					}
				}
				if (dictionary != null)
				{
					if (value != null)
					{
						value.RowSpacingBefore = num;
					}
					else
					{
						value = new UltraGridLayout.CachedRowInfo();
						value.RowSpacingBefore = num;
						dictionary[this] = value;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		public virtual int RowSpacingAfterResolved
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridLayout.CachedRowInfo value = null;
				Dictionary<UltraGridRow, UltraGridLayout.CachedRowInfo> dictionary = null;
				if (Layout != null && Layout.IsCachingBandInfo)
				{
					dictionary = Layout.CachedRowData;
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(this, out value) && value.RowSpacingAfter > -1)
					{
						return value.RowSpacingAfter;
					}
				}
				int num = RowSpacingAfterResolvedBase;
				if (HasSpecialRowSeparatorAfter)
				{
					num += BandInternal.SpecialRowSeparatorHeightResolved;
				}
				UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
				if (parentRow != null)
				{
					ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = band.Layout.ViewStyleImpl;
					if (viewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers && !HasPrevSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) && !HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, parentRow.RowSpacingAfterResolved);
					}
				}
				if (dictionary != null)
				{
					if (value != null)
					{
						value.RowSpacingAfter = num;
					}
					else
					{
						value = new UltraGridLayout.CachedRowInfo();
						value.RowSpacingAfter = num;
						dictionary[this] = value;
					}
				}
				return num;

		}

		{

				return cachedIsFilteredOut == 0;

			}

		public bool IsFilteredOut
		{
			get
			{
				if (parentCollection != null)
				{
					parentCollection.EnsureFiltersEvaluated();
					if (-1 == cachedIsFilteredOut)
					{
						ApplyFilters(parentCollection.ActiveColumnFilters);
						if (InternalIsFilteredOut)
						{
							HiddenStateChanged();
						}
					}
				}
				return cachedIsFilteredOut == 0;
			}
		}

		internal bool HiddenInternal
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridChildBand parentChildBand = ParentChildBand;
				if (parentChildBand != null && parentChildBand.CollapsedResolved && !IsPlaceHolderRow)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (!Hidden && (!IsFilteredOut || RowFilterAction.HideFilteredOutRows != BandInternal.RowFilterActionResolved))
				{
					if (IsTemplateAddRow)
					{
						return !ParentCollection.IsTemplateAddRowVisible;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public virtual string CardCaption
		{
			get
			{
				if (cardCaption != null && cardCaption.Length > 0)
				{
					return cardCaption;
				}
				string captionField = band.CardSettings.CaptionField;
				if (captionField != null && captionField.Length > 0)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
					try
					{
						if (band.Columns.Exists(captionField))
						{
							ultraGridColumn = band.Columns[captionField];
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_315", captionField));
					}
					if (ultraGridColumn != null)
					{
						return GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (cardCaption != value)
				{
					cardCaption = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.CardCaption);
				}
			}
		}

		internal int CardHeight
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_014f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				switch (band.CardSettings.StyleResolved)
				{
				case CardStyle.MergedLabels:
				case CardStyle.StandardLabels:
					return band.CardHeight;
				case CardStyle.Compressed:
					if (!IsCardCompressed)
					{
						return Band.CardHeight;
					}
					return Band.CardHeightCompressed;
				default:
					if (cachedCardHeight < 1 || drawSequence != Layout.DrawSequence)
					{
						int num = 0;
						for (int i = 0; i < band.OrderedHeaders.Count; i++)
						{
							HeaderBase headerBase = band.OrderedHeaders[i];
							if (headerBase.Hidden)
							{
								continue;
							}
							if (headerBase is GroupHeader { Group: var ultraGridGroup })
							{
								foreach (UltraGridColumn item in ultraGridGroup.ColumnsResolved)
								{
									if (!item.HiddenResolved && item.ShouldCellValueBeDisplayedInCard(this))
									{
										num += item.CardCellHeight;
									}
								}
							}
							else if (headerBase is ColumnHeader { Column: var column } && column.ShouldCellValueBeDisplayedInCard(this))
							{
								num += column.CardCellHeight;
							}
						}
						int borderThickness = Layout.GetBorderThickness(band.BorderStyleRowResolved);
						cachedCardHeight = num + band.CardCaptionHeight + 2 * borderThickness;
					}
					drawSequence = Layout.DrawSequence;
					return cachedCardHeight;
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual string Description
		{
			get
			{
				if (description != null && description.Length > 0)
				{
					return description;
				}
				string autoPreviewField = band.AutoPreviewField;
				if (autoPreviewField != null && autoPreviewField.Length > 0)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
					try
					{
						if (band.Columns.Exists(autoPreviewField))
						{
							ultraGridColumn = band.Columns[autoPreviewField];
						}
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_315", autoPreviewField));
					}
					if (ultraGridColumn != null)
					{
						return GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(description != value))
				{
					return;
				}
				description = value;
				if (Layout != null)

					UIElement uIElementInternal = Layout.UIElementInternal;
					if (uIElementInternal != null)
					{
						UIElement descendant = uIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(RowUIElementBase), (object)this);
						if (descendant != null)
						{
							Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
						}
					}
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Description);
			}
		}

		public bool Expanded
		{
			get
			{
				return expanded;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(Band.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_230"));
				}
				if (expanded == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				CancelableRowEventArgs e = new CancelableRowEventArgs(this);
				if (value)
				{
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowExpanded, e);
				}
				else
				{
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowCollapsed, e);
				}
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					expanded = value;
					NotifyScrollCountChanged();
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Expanded, null);
					RowEventArgs e2 = new RowEventArgs(this);
					if (value)
					{
						ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowExpanded, e2);
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowCollapsed, e2);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public virtual bool IsExpandable
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Band.Expandable || IsCard || !Band.HasChildBands(visibleBandsOnly: true))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (Band.ExpansionIndicatorResolved == ShowExpansionIndicator.CheckOnExpand)
				{
					if (childBands == null)
					{
						return true;
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < childBands.Count; i++)
					{
						if (!childBands[i].HaveRowsBeenInitialized && !childBands[i].Band.HiddenResolved)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				if (HasChild(excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return AreFiltersActiveOnChildRowsAndHasChildRows();
			}
		}

		public virtual bool HasExpansionIndicator
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsTemplateAddRow || IsUnModifiedAddRowFromTemplate || (IsAddRowFromTemplate && FixedResolved) || IsFilterRow || IsSummaryRow || IsEmptyMessageRow)
				{
					return false;
				}
				ShowExpansionIndicator showExpansionIndicator = ((expansionIndicator != ShowExpansionIndicator.Default) ? expansionIndicator : Band.ExpansionIndicatorResolved);
				if (showExpansionIndicator == ShowExpansionIndicator.Default)
				{
					if (!Layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay)
					{
						return false;
					}
					showExpansionIndicator = ShowExpansionIndicator.CheckOnExpand;
				}
				switch (showExpansionIndicator)
				{
				case ShowExpansionIndicator.Never:
					return false;
				case ShowExpansionIndicator.Always:
					return true;
				case ShowExpansionIndicator.CheckOnExpand:
					if (band.GetChildBandCount(excludeHidden: true) < 1)
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!expanded)
					{
						return true;
					}
					break;
				}
				if (HasChild(excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return AreFiltersActiveOnChildRowsAndHasChildRows();
			}
		}

		public bool IsExpanded => expanded;

		public override bool Activated
		{
			get

				return this == band.Layout.ActiveRow;

			{
				if (!Layout.IsDisplayLayout)

				}
				if (IsDisabled)
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_233"));
				}
				if (value)
				{
					band.Layout.Grid.ActiveRow = this;
				}
				else if (Activated)
				{
					band.Layout.Grid.ActiveRow = null;
				}
			}
		}

		public override bool Selected
		{
			get
			{
				return selectedValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (selectedValue == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
				{
					bool clearExistingSelection = true;
					SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategyRow = ((ISelectionStrategyProvider)Band).SelectionStrategyRow;
					if (selectionStrategyRow != null)
					{
						clearExistingSelection = selectionStrategyRow.IsSingleSelect;
					}
					if (!ultraGrid.ClearSelectedCells())
					{
						ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(this, clearExistingSelection, value);
					}
				}
				else if (Layout.Grid is UltraDropDownBase ultraDropDownBase && ultraDropDownBase.SelectedRow != this)
				{
					ultraDropDownBase.SelectedRow = this;
				}
				else
				{
					selectedValue = value;
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Selected, null);
				}
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool Selectable
		{
			get

				if (!IsDataRow && !IsGroupByRow)

					return false;
				}
				ISelectionStrategy selectionStrategyDefault = SelectionStrategyDefault;
				if (selectionStrategyDefault == null || selectionStrategyDefault is SelectionStrategyNone)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsDisabled)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return base.Selectable;
			}
		}

		internal int ScrollPosition
		{
			get
			{
				int num = ParentCollection.GetScrollIndex(this);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
				if (parentRow != null)
				{
					ChildBandsCollection childBandsCollection = parentRow.ChildBands;
					if (childBandsCollection != null)
					{
						UltraGridChildBand parentChildBand = ParentChildBand;
						for (int i = 0; i < childBandsCollection.Count; i++)
						{
							UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = childBandsCollection[i];
							if (ultraGridChildBand == parentChildBand)
							{
								break;
							}
							if (ultraGridChildBand != null && !ultraGridChildBand.Band.HiddenResolved)
							{
								num += ultraGridChildBand.Rows.ScrollCount;
							}
						}
					}
					num++;
					int scrollPosition = parentRow.ScrollPosition;
					num = ((scrollPosition < 0) ? (-1) : (num + scrollPosition));
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		protected bool IsRowHeightDirty
		{
			get
			{
				if (band.MajorRowHeightVersion > synchronizedRowHeightVersion)
				{
					return true;
				}
				RowSizing rowSizingResolved = band.RowSizingResolved;
				if (rowSizingResolved == RowSizing.Sychronized && band.SynchronizedRowHeightVersion != synchronizedRowHeightVersion)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (band.IsRowHeightDirty && rowSizingResolved == RowSizing.Sychronized)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal RowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder RowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder
		{
			get
			{
				if (rowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder == null)

		internal int HeightIncludingPadding
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (IsRowHeightDirty)
				{
					InitRootHeight();
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag || !isAutoSized)
				{
					RowSizing rowSizingResolved = band.RowSizingResolved;
					if (rowSizingResolved == RowSizing.AutoFree || rowSizingResolved == RowSizing.AutoFixed)
					{
						int num = CalculateAutoHeight();
						if (num > 0)
						{
							rootHeight = Math.Max(rootHeight, num);
						}
						isAutoSized = true;
					}
					else if (RowSizing.Sychronized == rowSizingResolved && rowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder != null && !IsFilterRow)
					{
						rowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder = null;
					}
				}
				int num2 = rootHeight;
				if (AutoPreviewEnabled)
				{
					num2 += AutoPreviewHeight;
				}
				return num2;
			}
		}

		internal virtual int MinRowHeight
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				int overrideMinRowHeight = BandInternal.OverrideMinRowHeight;
				if (overrideMinRowHeight > 0)

				RowSizing rowSizingResolved = BandInternal.RowSizingResolved;
				int num = 0;
				switch (rowSizingResolved)
				{
				case RowSizing.Free:
				case RowSizing.AutoFixed:
				case RowSizing.AutoFree:

		public virtual int AutoPreviewHeight
		{
			get
			{

				//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0085: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_008f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (!AutoPreviewEnabled)

					return 0;
				}
				string text = Description;
				if (text != null && text.Length > 0)
				{

					ResolveAppearance(ref appData, (AppearancePropFlags)65011720, previewArea: true);
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = band;

					{
						font2 = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).CreateFont(font);
						if (font2 != null)
						{
							font = font2;
						}
					}
					Graphics cachedGraphics = layout.GetCachedGraphics();
					UIElementBorderStyle borderStyleResolved = BorderStyleResolved;

					extent -= 2 * borderThickness;
					if (flag && ultraGridBand.RowSelectorExtent > 0)
					{
						extent++;
					}
					extent -= ultraGridBand.AutoPreviewIndentation;
					Size size = layout.MeasureString(cachedGraphics, text, font, extent);
					Size size2 = layout.MeasureString(cachedGraphics, "lg", font);
					int val = size2.Height * ultraGridBand.AutoPreviewMaxLines;
					layout.ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);
					font2?.Dispose();
					int val2 = Math.Max(size2.Height, size.Height);
					val2 = Math.Min(val, val2);
					return val2 + (2 + 2 * borderThickness);
				}
				return 0;
			}
		}

		internal virtual int BaseHeight
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridLayout.CachedRowInfo value = null;
				Dictionary<UltraGridRow, UltraGridLayout.CachedRowInfo> dictionary = null;
				if (Layout != null && Layout.IsCachingBandInfo)
				{
					dictionary = Layout.CachedRowData;
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(this, out value) && value.BaseHeight > -1)
					{
						return value.BaseHeight;
					}
				}
				int heightIncludingPadding = HeightIncludingPadding;
				int minRowHeight = MinRowHeight;
				int num = Math.Max(heightIncludingPadding, minRowHeight);
				UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
				if (parentRow != null)
				{
					ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = band.Layout.ViewStyleImpl;
					if (viewStyleImpl != null && viewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers && !HasPrevSibling(spanBands: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) && !band.UseRowLayoutResolved && !band.GroupsDisplayed && !parentRow.band.UseRowLayoutResolved && !parentRow.band.GroupsDisplayed)
					{
						num = Math.Max(num, parentRow.BaseHeight);
					}
				}
				if (dictionary != null)
				{
					if (value != null)
					{
						value.BaseHeight = num;
					}
					else
					{
						value = new UltraGridLayout.CachedRowInfo();
						value.BaseHeight = num;
						dictionary[this] = value;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal void ToggleCardCompressedState(bool selectCard)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = ((Band.Layout != null) ? (Band.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid) : null);
			CardCompressedState newCompressedState = ((!IsCardCompressed) ? CardCompressedState.Compressed : CardCompressedState.Expanded);
			if (ultraGrid != null)
			{
				BeforeCardCompressedStateChangedEventArgs e = new BeforeCardCompressedStateChangedEventArgs(this, newCompressedState);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeCardCompressedStateChanged, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			IsCardCompressed = !IsCardCompressed;
			Band.Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion?.ScrollRowIntoView(this);
			if (selectCard)
			{
				ISelectionStrategyProvider selectionStrategyProvider = Band;
				SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategyRow = selectionStrategyProvider.SelectionStrategyRow;
				if (ultraGrid != null && selectionStrategyProvider != null && selectionStrategyRow != null && (selectionStrategyRow.IsSingleSelect || selectionStrategyRow.IsMultiSelect))
				{
					ultraGrid.InternalSelectItem(this, clearExistingSelection: true, select: true);
				}
			}
			ultraGrid?.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterCardCompressedStateChanged, new AfterCardCompressedStateChangedEventArgs(this, newCompressedState));
		}

		internal void CancelEditHelper_ActivateNearestRow()
		{
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			UltraGridRow nearestDataRow = GridUtils.GetNearestDataRow(this, prev: false);
			if (nearestDataRow == null)
			{
				nearestDataRow = GridUtils.GetNearestDataRow(this, prev: true);
			}
			CancelEdit();
			if (nearestDataRow != null && nearestDataRow.IsStillValid && !IsStillValid && layout != null && (layout.ActiveRowInternal == null || this == layout.ActiveRowInternal))
			{
				nearestDataRow.Activate();
			}
		}

		private bool CancelEditOnIEditableObject(IEditableObject editableObject)
		{
			if (editableObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = GetGrid() as UltraGrid;
			bool isSelected = ultraGrid != null && FireBeforeSelectionChangeForRowAboutToBeDeleted(ultraGrid);
			editableObject.CancelEdit();
			RowEditTemplateResolved?.OnRowCancelEdit();
			SetDataChanged(newValue: false);
			ParentCollection.NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged(this);
			ParentCollection.DataChanged_DirtySummaries();
			FireAfterSelectionChangeForRowThatWasDeleted(ultraGrid, isSelected);
			return true;
		}

		private bool CancelEditOnICancelAddNew(ICancelAddNew cancelAddNew, IList dataList)
		{
			if (!endEditCalled && IsAddRow)
			{
				int listIndex = ListIndex;
				if (cancelAddNew != null && listIndex >= 0 && listIndex < dataList.Count)
				{
					cancelAddNew.CancelNew(listIndex);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CancelEditDefault()
		{
			if (!endEditCalled && IsAddRow)
			{
				DeleteHelper();
			}
		}

		internal void CancelEdit()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			IList data_List = ParentCollection.Data_List;
			IEditableObject editableObject = ListObject as IEditableObject;
			ICancelAddNew cancelAddNew = data_List as ICancelAddNew;
			switch (Band.EndEditNotificationInterfacesResolved)
			{
			case AddRowEditNotificationInterface.ICancelAddNewAndIEditableObject:
				flag = !CancelEditOnICancelAddNew(cancelAddNew, data_List);
				if (flag | !CancelEditOnIEditableObject(editableObject))
				{
					CancelEditDefault();
				}
				break;
			case AddRowEditNotificationInterface.ICancelAddNewOrIEditableObject:
				if (!CancelEditOnICancelAddNew(cancelAddNew, data_List) && !CancelEditOnIEditableObject(editableObject))
				{
					CancelEditDefault();
				}
				break;
			case AddRowEditNotificationInterface.IEditableObjectAndICancelAddNew:
				flag = !CancelEditOnIEditableObject(editableObject);
				if (flag | !CancelEditOnICancelAddNew(cancelAddNew, data_List))
				{
					CancelEditDefault();
				}
				break;
			case AddRowEditNotificationInterface.IEditableObjectOrICancelAddNew:
				if (!CancelEditOnIEditableObject(editableObject) && !CancelEditOnICancelAddNew(cancelAddNew, data_List))
				{
					CancelEditDefault();
				}
				break;
			}
		}

		private bool EndEditOnICancelAddNew(ICancelAddNew cancelAddNew, IList dataList)
		{
			if (!IsAddRow || cancelAddNew == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			int listIndex = ListIndex;
			if (listIndex >= 0 && listIndex < dataList.Count)
			{
				cancelAddNew.EndNew(listIndex);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool EndEditOnIEditableObject(IEditableObject editableObject)
		{
			if (editableObject == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RowEditTemplateResolved?.OnRowEndEdit();
			editableObject.EndEdit();
			return true;
		}

		internal void EndEdit()
		{
			IList data_List = ParentCollection.Data_List;
			IEditableObject editableObject = ListObject as IEditableObject;
			ICancelAddNew cancelAddNew = data_List as ICancelAddNew;
			switch (Band.EndEditNotificationInterfacesResolved)
			{
			case AddRowEditNotificationInterface.ICancelAddNewAndIEditableObject:
				EndEditOnICancelAddNew(cancelAddNew, data_List);
				EndEditOnIEditableObject(editableObject);
				break;
			case AddRowEditNotificationInterface.ICancelAddNewOrIEditableObject:
				if (!EndEditOnICancelAddNew(cancelAddNew, data_List))
				{
					EndEditOnIEditableObject(editableObject);
				}
				break;
			case AddRowEditNotificationInterface.IEditableObjectAndICancelAddNew:
				EndEditOnIEditableObject(editableObject);
				EndEditOnICancelAddNew(cancelAddNew, data_List);
				break;
			case AddRowEditNotificationInterface.IEditableObjectOrICancelAddNew:
				if (!EndEditOnIEditableObject(editableObject))
				{
					EndEditOnICancelAddNew(cancelAddNew, data_List);
				}
				break;
			}
			endEditCalled = true;
			if (ParentCollection.CurrentAddRow == this)
			{
				ParentCollection.CurrentAddRow = null;
			}
			SetDataChanged(newValue: false);
		}

		internal virtual void FireInitializeRow()
		{
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			if (layout.SuspendInitializeRowFor(this))
			{
				return;
			}
			inInitializeRowEvent = true;
			try
			{
				layout.Grid.FireInitializeRow(new InitializeRowEventArgs(this, initializeRowEventFired));
			}
			finally
			{
				initializeRowEventFired = true;
				inInitializeRowEvent = false;
				layout.ResumeInitializeRowFor(this);
			}
		}

		internal void BumpChildRowsVerifyVersion()
		{
			if (childBands == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < childBands.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = childBands[i];
				if (ultraGridChildBand != null && ultraGridChildBand.HaveRowsBeenInitialized)
				{
					ultraGridChildBand.Rows.BumpVerifyVersion();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool HaveChildRowsBeenCreated(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (childBands != null)
			{
				int count = childBands.Count;
				for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = childBands[i];
					if (band == ultraGridChildBand.Band)
					{
						return ultraGridChildBand.HaveRowsBeenInitialized;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool HasChildRowsInternal(IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			if (childBands == null && band.GetChildBandCount() == 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ChildBands != null)
			{
				return ChildBands.HasChildRowsInternal(includeRowTypes);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void GetCellRect(UltraGridColumn column, ref Rectangle rect, ref AppearanceData appData)
		{
			RowScrollRegion activeRowScrollRegion = Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			ColScrollRegion activeColScrollRegion = Layout.GetActiveColScrollRegion(initializeMetrics: false);
			GetCellRect(column, ref rect, ref appData, activeRowScrollRegion, activeColScrollRegion);
		}

		internal void GetCellRect(UltraGridColumn column, ref Rectangle rect, ref AppearanceData appData, RowScrollRegion rsr, ColScrollRegion csr)
		{
			if (rsr == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_226"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_339"));
			}
			if (csr == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_228"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_340"));
			}
			VisibleRow visibleRow = null;
			if (rsr != null)
			{
				visibleRow = rsr.GetVisibleRow(this);
			}
			if (visibleRow == null || csr == null || rsr == null)
			{
				rect = Rectangle.Empty;
				return;
			}
			ResolveCellAppearance(column, ref appData, (AppearancePropFlags)137438953471L);
			Rectangle pictureRect = Rectangle.Empty;
			column.Header.GetDimensions(visibleRow, PositionDimensions.CellTextAndPicture, DimOriginBase.OnScreen, out rect, csr, ref appData, ref pictureRect);
			int levelCountResolved = Band.LevelCountResolved;
			if (levelCountResolved > 1)
			{
				int left = rect.Left;
				int right = rect.Right;
				int displayLevel = column.GetDisplayLevel();
				int levelOffset = GetLevelOffset(displayLevel, fromInsideTopBorder: true);
				rect.Y += levelOffset;
				int num = rect.Bottom - rect.Top;
				int num2 = (num + levelCountResolved / 2) / levelCountResolved;
				rect.Height = rect.Bottom - rect.Y + rect.Top + num2 - 1;
				column.AdjustForRowBorders(ref rect);
				column.Header.AdjustForCellPadding(ref rect);
				rect.X = left;
				rect.Width = rect.Right - rect.X + right;
			}
		}

		public virtual object GetCellValue(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (IsTemplateAddRow)
			{
				return parentCollection.GetTemplateAddRowValue(column);
			}
			if (!column.IsBound)
			{
				return Cells[column].Value;
			}
			if (listObject == null && !Layout.ShouldDisplayDataFromDataSource)
			{
				return GetSampleDataForType(column.DataType);
			}
			if (deleted)
			{
				return null;
			}
			try
			{
				return column.PropertyDescriptor.GetValue(ListObject);
			}
			catch (Exception exception)
			{
				Layout?.Grid.InternalHandleDataError(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataError_CellValueRetrieval"), exception, defaultCancelValue: true);
			}
			return null;
		}

		{

		}

		internal bool SetCellValue(UltraGridColumn column, object val, bool suppressErrorMessagePrompt, bool throwExceptionOnError, bool fireDataChanged)
		{
			bool fireCellUpdateEvents = false;
			return SetCellValue(column, val, suppressErrorMessagePrompt, throwExceptionOnError, fireDataChanged, fireCellUpdateEvents);
		}

		internal bool SetCellValue(UltraGridColumn column, object val, bool suppressErrorMessagePrompt, bool throwExceptionOnError, bool fireDataChanged, bool fireCellUpdateEvents)
		{
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			try
			{
				if (layout != null)
				{
					layout.IsInSetCellValue = true;
				}
				if (deleted)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (column == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (IsTemplateAddRow)
				{
					parentCollection.SetTemplateAddRowValue(column, val);
					return true;
				}
				BeginEdit();
				object convertedValue = null;
				bool flag = false;
				if (val != null || Nullable.Nothing != column.Nullable)
				{
					flag = column.ConvertValueToDataType(val, out convertedValue);
				}
				if (!flag && convertedValue == null && (val != null || Nullable.Nothing != column.Nullable))
				{
					if (((HasCell(column) ? Cells[column] : null)?.InCommitEditValue ?? false) || throwExceptionOnError)
					{
						throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCellUpdateUnableToConvert", (val != null) ? val.GetType().ToString() : "null", column.PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType));
					}
					if (Layout.Grid is UltraGrid)
					{
						DataErrorInfo dataErrorInfo = new DataErrorInfo(null, val, this, Cells[column], DataErrorSource.CellUpdate, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCellUpdateUnableToConvert", (val == null) ? ((object)"(null)") : ((object)val.GetType()), column.PropertyDescriptor.PropertyType));
						((UltraGrid)Layout.Grid).InternalHandleDataError(dataErrorInfo, suppressErrorMessagePrompt);
					}
					return false;
				}
				if (column.PropertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					UltraGrid ultraGrid = ((layout != null) ? (Layout.Grid as UltraGrid) : null);
					if (fireCellUpdateEvents && ultraGrid != null)
					{
						BeforeCellUpdateEventArgs e = new BeforeCellUpdateEventArgs(this, column, convertedValue);
						ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeCellUpdate, e);
						if (e.Cancel)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					if (column.PropertyDescriptor is ValuePropertyDescriptor)
					{
						column.PropertyDescriptor.SetValue(this, convertedValue);
					}
					else
					{
						column.PropertyDescriptor.SetValue(ListObject, convertedValue);
						SetDataChanged(newValue: true);
					}
					if (ParentCollection != null)
					{
						ParentCollection.DataChanged_DirtySummaries();
						if (fireDataChanged)
						{
							RowsCollection rowsCollection = ParentCollection;
							string columnKey = ((column != null) ? column.Key : string.Empty);
							CheckedListSettings.DataChangedEventArgs args = new CheckedListSettings.DataChangedEventArgs(this, columnKey, null);
							rowsCollection.FireDataChanged(args);
						}
					}
					if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null && Band.AutoPreviewEnabled && Band.AutoPreviewField != null && column.Key != null && string.Compare(Band.AutoPreviewField, column.Key, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0)
					{
						Band.Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true, fInvalidate: true);
						Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
					}
					if (fireCellUpdateEvents && ultraGrid != null)
					{
						CellEventArgs e2 = new CellEventArgs(this, column);
						ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterCellUpdate, e2);
					}
					ParentCollection.NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged(this, column);
				}
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (layout != null)
				{
					layout.IsInSetCellValue = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool SetCellValueConditionally(UltraGridColumn column, object val)
		{
			object cellValue = GetCellValue(column);
			cellValue = ResolveEnumValue(column, cellValue);
			if (cellValue != null && cellValue.Equals(val))
			{
				return false;
			}
			InvalidateCellAllRegions(column, invalidate: true, dirtyChildElems: false);
			bool flag = Layout.IsInitializeRowSuspendedFor(this);
			Layout.SuspendInitializeRowFor(this);
			try
			{
				if (column.PropertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					return SetCellValue(column, val, suppressErrorMessagePrompt: false, throwExceptionOnError: false, fireDataChanged: true, fireCellUpdateEvents: true);
				}
				return Cells[column].SetValueInternal(val);
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!flag)
				{
					Layout.ResumeInitializeRowFor(this);
				}
				FireInitializeRow();
			}
		}

		private static object ResolveEnumValue(UltraGridColumn column, object currentValue)
		{
			if (column.DataType != null && column.DataType.IsEnum)
			{
				try
				{
					return Enum.ToObject(column.DataType, currentValue);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			return currentValue;
		}

		public UltraGridRow GetSibling(SiblingRow sibling, bool spanBands, bool excludeCardBands, bool includeSpecialRows)
		{
			return GetSibling(sibling, spanBands, excludeCardBands, includeSpecialRows ? IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows : IncludeRowTypes.DataRowsOnly);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetSibling(SiblingRow sibling, bool spanBands, bool excludeCardBands, IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
			switch (sibling)
			{
			case SiblingRow.First:
				ultraGridRow = ((!spanBands || parentRow == null) ? parentCollection.GetFirstRow(includeRowTypes) : parentRow.ChildBands.GetFirstRow(excludeCardBands, includeRowTypes));
				break;
			case SiblingRow.Next:
			{
				ultraGridRow = parentCollection.GetRowAtIndexOffset(this, 1, includeRowTypes);
				if (!(ultraGridRow == null && spanBands) || parentRow == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = ParentChildBand;
				do
				{
					ultraGridChildBand = parentRow.ChildBands.GetNextChildBand(ultraGridChildBand, excludeCardBands);
					if (ultraGridChildBand != null)
					{
						ultraGridRow = ultraGridChildBand.Rows.GetFirstRow(includeRowTypes);
					}
				}
				while (ultraGridRow == null && ultraGridChildBand != null);
				break;
			}
			case SiblingRow.Previous:
			{
				ultraGridRow = parentCollection.GetRowAtIndexOffset(this, -1, includeRowTypes);
				if (!(ultraGridRow == null && spanBands) || parentRow == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand2 = ParentChildBand;
				do
				{
					ultraGridChildBand2 = parentRow.ChildBands.GetPreviousChildBand(ultraGridChildBand2, excludeCardBands);
					if (ultraGridChildBand2 != null)
					{
						ultraGridRow = ultraGridChildBand2.Rows.GetLastRow(includeRowTypes);
					}
				}
				while (ultraGridRow == null && ultraGridChildBand2 != null);
				break;
			}
			case SiblingRow.Last:
				ultraGridRow = ((!spanBands || parentRow == null) ? parentCollection.GetLastRow(includeRowTypes) : parentRow.ChildBands.GetLastRow(excludeCardBands, includeRowTypes));
				break;
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		internal bool IsDescendantOf(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row != null)
			{
				UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
				if (parentRow == row)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (parentRow != null)
				{
					return parentRow.IsDescendantOf(row);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsTrivialDescendantOf(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (this != row)
			{
				return IsDescendantOf(row);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsDescendantOf(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this;
			while (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.ParentCollection != rows)
			{
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
			}
			return ultraGridRow != null;
		}

		internal void HiddenStateChanged(bool dirtySummaries)
		{
			if (HiddenInternal)
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ((band != null && band.Layout != null) ? band.Layout.ActiveCellInternal : null);
				if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.IsInEditMode && this == ultraGridCell.Row)
				{
					ultraGridCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: true);
				}
			}
			NotifyScrollCountChanged();
			ParentCollection.NotifyCalcManager_HiddenStateChanged(this);
			if (parentCollection != null && dirtySummaries)
			{
				parentCollection.DataChanged_DirtySummaries();
			}
			parentCollection.MaintainScrollPositionHelper();
		}

		private bool AreFiltersActiveOnChildRowsAndHasChildRows()
		{
			ChildBandsCollection childBandsCollection = ChildBands;
			if (childBandsCollection != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < childBandsCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = childBandsCollection[i];
					if (ultraGridChildBand.Rows.Count <= 0)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (ultraGridChildBand.HaveRowsBeenInitialized)
					{
						if (ultraGridChildBand.Rows.AreAnyFiltersActive)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
					else if (ultraGridChildBand.Band.AreAnyBandFiltersActive)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (ultraGridChildBand != null && ultraGridChildBand.CollapsedResolved)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal virtual void ApplyFilters(ColumnFiltersCollection columnFilters)
		{
			if (band.RowFilterActionResolved == RowFilterAction.None || IsAddRow)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsDataRow)
			{
				InternalIsFilteredOut = false;
				return;
			}
			InternalIsFilteredOut = columnFilters != null && !columnFilters.DoesRowPassFilters(this);
			UltraGridBase grid = Layout.Grid;
			if (grid != null)
			{
				FilterRowEventArgs e = new FilterRowEventArgs(this, InternalIsFilteredOut);
				grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.FilterRow, e);
				InternalIsFilteredOut = e.RowFilteredOut;
			}
		}

		private void ValidateNotGroupByRow()
		{
			if (this is UltraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_NotSupportedException_347"));
			}
		}

		public bool MeetsCriteria(FilterCondition filterCondition)
		{
			ValidateNotGroupByRow();
			if (filterCondition == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("filterCondition");
			}
			if (filterCondition.Column.Band != Band)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_11"), "filterCondition");
			}
			return filterCondition.MeetsCriteria(this);
		}

		public bool MeetsCriteria(FilterCondition[] filterConditions, FilterLogicalOperator logicalOperator)
		{
			ValidateNotGroupByRow();
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(FilterLogicalOperator), logicalOperator))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("logicalOperator", (int)logicalOperator, typeof(FilterComparisionOperator));
			}
			if (filterConditions == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("filterConditions");
			}
			if (filterConditions.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_12"), "filterConditions");
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < filterConditions.Length; i++)
			{
				if (logicalOperator == FilterLogicalOperator.And)
				{
					if (!MeetsCriteria(filterConditions[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (FilterLogicalOperator.Or == logicalOperator && MeetsCriteria(filterConditions[i]))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (logicalOperator == FilterLogicalOperator.And)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool MeetsCriteria(ColumnFilter columnFilter)
		{
			ValidateNotGroupByRow();
			if (columnFilter == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("columnFilter");
			}
			if (columnFilter.Column.Band != Band)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_13"), "columnFilter");
			}
			if (columnFilter.FilterConditions.Count <= 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_14"), "columnFilter");
			}
			FilterCondition[] array = new FilterCondition[columnFilter.FilterConditions.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < columnFilter.FilterConditions.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = columnFilter.FilterConditions[i];
			}
			return MeetsCriteria(array, columnFilter.LogicalOperator);
		}

		public bool MeetsCriteria(ColumnFilter[] columnFilters, FilterLogicalOperator logicalOperator)
		{
			ValidateNotGroupByRow();
			if (columnFilters == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("columnFilters");
			}
			if (columnFilters.Length == 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("ColumnFilters must contain at least one value ColumnFilter.", "columnFilters");
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(FilterLogicalOperator), logicalOperator))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("logicalOperator", (int)logicalOperator, typeof(FilterComparisionOperator));
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < columnFilters.Length; i++)
			{
				if (logicalOperator == FilterLogicalOperator.And)
				{
					if (!MeetsCriteria(columnFilters[i]))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (FilterLogicalOperator.Or == logicalOperator && MeetsCriteria(columnFilters[i]))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			if (logicalOperator == FilterLogicalOperator.And)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void InternalSelect(bool value)
		{
			if (selectedValue != value)
			{
				selectedValue = value;
				RowsCollection.MergedCell_RowStateChanged(this, MergedCell.State.Selection);
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Selected, null);
			}
		}

		public void CollapseAll()
		{
			if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null && !Band.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper())
			{
				return;
			}
			if (HasChildRows)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)ChildBands)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridRow row in item.Rows)
					{
						row.CollapseAll();
					}
				}
			}
			Expanded = false;
		}

		public void ExpandAll()
		{
			if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null && !Band.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper())
			{
				return;
			}
			Expanded = true;
			if (!HasChildRows)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)ChildBands)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridRow row in item.Rows)
				{
					row.ExpandAll();
				}
			}
		}

		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetChild(ChildRow child, UltraGridBand band, IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			if (!HasChildRowsInternal(IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRow result = null;
			switch (child)
			{
			case ChildRow.First:
			{
				if (band == null)
				{
					result = ChildBands.GetFirstRow(excludeCardBands: false, includeRowTypes);
					break;
				}
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = ChildBands[band];
				if (ultraGridChildBand != null)
				{
					result = ultraGridChildBand.Rows.GetFirstRow(includeRowTypes);
				}
				break;
			}
			case ChildRow.Last:
			{
				if (band == null)
				{
					result = ChildBands.GetLastRow(excludeCardBands: false, includeRowTypes);
					break;
				}
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = ChildBands[band];
				if (ultraGridChildBand != null)
				{
					result = ultraGridChildBand.Rows.GetLastRow(includeRowTypes);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool HasChild(UltraGridBand band, bool excludeHidden, IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			if (ChildBands == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < ChildBands.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = ChildBands[i];
				if ((band == null || band == ultraGridChildBand.Band) && (!excludeHidden || !ultraGridChildBand.Band.HiddenResolved))
				{
					if (!excludeHidden && ultraGridChildBand.Rows.Count > 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (ultraGridChildBand.Rows.GetVisibleRowCount(includeRowTypes) > 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool HasParent(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
			if (parentRow != null)
			{
				if (band != null)
				{
					if (band == parentRow.Band)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return parentRow.HasParent(band);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool HasNextSibling(bool spanBands, bool excludeHidden, IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			if (excludeHidden)
			{
				return GetVisibleSiblingRow(next: true, spanBands, includeRowTypes) != null;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this;
			do
			{
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Next, spanBands, excludeCardBands: false, includeRowTypes);
			}
			while (excludeHidden && ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved);
			return ultraGridRow != null;
		}

			}

			return ultraGridRow != null;

		public void Refresh()
		{
			Refresh(RefreshRow.RefreshDisplay);
		}

		public void Refresh(RefreshRow action)
		{
			Refresh(action, refreshDescendantRows: false);
		}

		public void Refresh(RefreshRow action, bool refreshDescendantRows)
		{
			switch (action)
			{
			case RefreshRow.RefreshDisplay:
				InvalidateItemAllRegions();
				break;
			case RefreshRow.FireInitializeRow:
				InvalidateItemAllRegions();
				if (Layout.Grid != null)
				{
					if (!IsTemplateAddRow)
					{
						FireInitializeRow(saveOriginalValForUnboundCells: true);
					}
					else
					{
						ParentCollection.FireInitializeTemplateAddRow();
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			if (refreshDescendantRows && childBands != null)
			{
				childBands.Refresh(action, refreshDescendantRows: true);
			}
		}

		public virtual void RefreshSortPosition()
		{
			if (IsStillValid && ParentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow && !ultraGridGroupByRow.DoesRowMatchGroup(this, recursive: true))
			{
				ultraGridGroupByRow.Rows.SyncRows_Remove(this, setDeletedFlag: false);
				ultraGridGroupByRow.Rows.TopLevelRowsCollection.SyncRows_Add(this);
			}
			ParentCollection.EnsureCorrectSortPosition(this);
			Layout.RowScrollRegions.DirtyAllVisibleRows();
			Layout.DirtyGridElement();
		}

		public void RefreshFilters()
		{
			sbyte b = cachedIsFilteredOut;
			cachedIsFilteredOut = -1;
			RowsCollection rowsCollection = ParentCollection;
			if (rowsCollection != null && !rowsCollection.FiltersNeedToBeEvaluated)
			{
				ApplyFilters(rowsCollection.ActiveColumnFilters);
				if (b != cachedIsFilteredOut)
				{
					HiddenStateChanged();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void FireInitializeRow(bool saveOriginalValForUnboundCells)
		{
			FireInitializeRow();
			if (saveOriginalValForUnboundCells)
			{
				SaveOriginalValForUnboundCells();
			}
		}

		internal void InternalPositionToRow()
		{
			InternalPositionToRow(null);
		}

		internal virtual void InternalPositionToRow(Stack oldPositions)
		{
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (oldPositions != null && band.BindingManager != null)
			{
				oldPositions.Push(band.BindingManager.Position);
			}
			UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
			if (parentRow != null)
			{
				bool ignoreDataSourePositionChange = Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange;
				Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange = true;
				try
				{
					parentRow.InternalPositionToRow(oldPositions);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					if (!ignoreDataSourePositionChange)
					{
						Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange = false;
					}
					throw;
				}
				if (!ignoreDataSourePositionChange)
				{
					Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange = false;
				}
			}
			if (!ultraGrid.SyncWithCurrencyManager || band.BindingManager == null || band.BindingManager.Position == ListIndex)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool ignoreDataSourePositionChange2 = Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange;
			try
			{
				if (!ignoreDataSourePositionChange2)
				{
					Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange = true;
				}
				band.BindingManager.Position = ListIndex;
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!ignoreDataSourePositionChange2)
				{
					Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange = false;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void restoreOldPositions(Stack oldPositions)
		{
			ParentRow?.restoreOldPositions(oldPositions);
			int num = (int)oldPositions.Pop();
			if (band.BindingManager != null && band.BindingManager.Position != num)
			{
				band.BindingManager.Position = num;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool Update()
		{
			DataErrorInfo error;
			bool result = Update(out error);
			if (error != null && Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
			{
				ultraGrid.InternalHandleDataError(error);
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal bool Update(out DataErrorInfo error)
		{
			error = null;
			if (!(Band.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_234"));
			}
			if (!DataChanged && !dataChangedViaCalcManager)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (ultraGrid != null && !Layout.IsPrintLayout && !Layout.IsExportLayout)
			{
				CancelableRowEventArgs e = new CancelableRowEventArgs(this);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowUpdate, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					if (ultraGrid.RowUpdateCancelAction == RowUpdateCancelAction.CancelUpdate)
					{
						CancelEdit();
					}
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (Layout != null && Layout.ActiveCell != null && this == Layout.ActiveCell.Row && Layout.ActiveCell.IsInEditMode && !Layout.ActiveCell.InCommitEditValue)
			{
				bool stayInEdit = true;
				Layout.ActiveCell.CommitEditValue(ref stayInEdit, fireDataError: false);
			}
			try
			{
				EndEdit();
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				error = new DataErrorInfo(ex, null, this, null, DataErrorSource.RowUpdate, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorRowUpdateUnableToUpdateRow", ex.Message));
				return false;
			}
			if (ultraGrid != null && !Layout.IsPrintLayout && !Layout.IsExportLayout)
			{
				RowEventArgs e2 = new RowEventArgs(this);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowUpdate, e2);
			}
			UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = RowEditTemplateResolved;
			if (rowEditTemplateResolved != null && rowEditTemplateResolved.IsShown)
			{
				BeginEdit();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void CancelUpdate()
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			if (!DataChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ultraGrid != null)
			{
				CancelableRowEventArgs e = new CancelableRowEventArgs(this);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowCancelUpdate, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			CancelEdit();
			SetDataChanged(newValue: false);
			ultraGrid?.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowCancelUpdate, new RowEventArgs(this));
			InvalidateItemAllRegions();
			UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = RowEditTemplateResolved;
			if (rowEditTemplateResolved != null && rowEditTemplateResolved.IsShown)
			{
				BeginEdit();
			}
		}

		internal static bool EnsureAllAncestorsCurrentRow(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			UltraGridRow findActualAncestorRow = row.FindActualAncestorRow;
			if (findActualAncestorRow != null && !EnsureAllAncestorsCurrentRow(findActualAncestorRow))
			{
				return false;
			}
			BindingManagerBase bindingManager = row.Band.BindingManager;
			if (bindingManager == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row.ListIndex < 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (bindingManager.Position != row.ListIndex)
			{
				bindingManager.Position = row.ListIndex;
				return bindingManager.Position == row.ListIndex;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void DeleteHelper()
		{
			BindingManagerBase bindingManager = band.BindingManager;
			bool ignoreDataSourePositionChange = Band.Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange;
			UltraGridCell activeCell = Layout.ActiveCell;
			if (activeCell != null && this == activeCell.Row && activeCell.IsInEditMode)
			{
				activeCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: true, forceExit: true);
			}
			UltraGridCellProxy activeProxy = Layout.ActiveProxy;
			if (activeProxy != null && ((UltraEditorProxyBase)activeProxy).Editor.IsInEditMode)
			{
				((UltraEditorProxyBase)activeProxy).Editor.ExitEditMode(true, true);
			}
			try
			{
				if (ParentCollection.TopLevelRowsCollection != null)
				{
					Band.Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange = true;
				}
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = RowEditTemplateResolved;
				if (rowEditTemplateResolved != null && rowEditTemplateResolved.IsShown)
				{
					rowEditTemplateResolved.Close(commitChanges: false, forceClose: true);
				}
				try
				{
					bindingManager?.EndCurrentEdit();
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				try
				{
					if (!Band.IsBoundToIBindingList && bindingManager != null && bindingManager.Position >= bindingManager.Count - 1 && bindingManager.Count - 2 >= 0)
					{
						bindingManager.Position = bindingManager.Count - 2;
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				int listIndex = ListIndex;
				UltraGridRow findActualAncestorRow = FindActualAncestorRow;
				if (bindingManager != null && (findActualAncestorRow == null || findActualAncestorRow.AreAllAncestorsCurrentRows || ParentCollection.BindingList == null))
				{
					if (bindingManager != null)
					{
						bindingManager.RemoveAt(listIndex);
						UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
						if (layout != null && layout.Grid is UltraGrid { SyncWithCurrencyManagerAfterRowDeletionResolved: not false, ActiveRow: null })
						{
							UltraGridRow rowWithListIndex = ParentCollection.GetRowWithListIndex(bindingManager.Position);
							if (rowWithListIndex != null)
							{
								Layout.Grid.SetTempActiveRow(rowWithListIndex, scrollIntoView: false);
							}
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ParentCollection.BindingList.RemoveAt(listIndex);
				}
				if (!ignoreDataSourePositionChange)
				{
					Band.Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange = false;
				}
				if (!Band.HookIntoList)
				{
					ParentCollection.TopLevelRowsCollection?.SyncRows();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (!ignoreDataSourePositionChange)
				{
					Band.Layout.IgnoreDataSourePositionChange = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Delete()
		{
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			if (layout != null)
			{
				return Delete(layout.ShowDeleteRowsPrompt);
			}
			return Delete(displayPrompt: true);
		}

		public bool Delete(bool displayPrompt)
		{
			if (!(Band.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_235"));
			}
			if (!parentCollection.Contains(this))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Band.MinRows > 0 && ParentCollection.TopLevelRowsCollection.UnSortedActualRows.Count <= Band.MinRows)
			{
				Layout.RaiseMinRowsViolatedError(this, Band.MinRows);
				return false;
			}
			BeforeRowsDeletedEventArgs e = new BeforeRowsDeletedEventArgs(new UltraGridRow[1] { this }, displayPromptMsg: true);
			e.DisplayPromptMsg = displayPrompt;
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowsDeleted, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (e.DisplayPromptMsg)
			{
				DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DeleteSingleRowPrompt"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DeleteRowsMessageTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.YesNo, MessageBoxIcon.Question);
				if (dialogResult != DialogResult.Yes)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				bool isSelected = FireBeforeSelectionChangeForRowAboutToBeDeleted(ultraGrid);
				DeleteHelper();
				FireAfterSelectionChangeForRowThatWasDeleted(ultraGrid, isSelected);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				DataErrorInfo dataErrorInfo = new DataErrorInfo(ex, null, this, null, DataErrorSource.RowDelete, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorDeleteRowUnableToDelete", ex.Message));
				ultraGrid.InternalHandleDataError(dataErrorInfo);
				return false;
			}
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowsDeleted, null);
			Layout.RowScrollRegions.DirtyAllVisibleRows(setScrollToBeginning: false);
			Layout.DirtyGridElement();
			return true;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetBand_0_Row()
		{
			UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
			if (parentRow == null)
			{
				return this;
			}
			return parentRow.GetBand_0_Row();
		}

		public void PerformAutoSize()
		{
			if (RowSizing.Sychronized == Band.RowSizingResolved)

				RowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder.VerifyCachedLayoutManager();
			}
			if (rowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder != null)
			{
				rowAutoSizeLayoutManagerHolder.PrepareForExplicitPerformAutoSize();
			}
			Height = CalculateAutoHeight();
			heightSetManually = false;
		}

		internal void SynchSameTierParentRows(int newHeight)
		{
			ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = band.Layout.ViewStyleImpl;
			if (!viewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!synchronizing && HeightIncludingPadding != newHeight)
			{
				synchronizing = true;
				try
				{
					band.ResizeRow(this, newHeight, fireEvents: false);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					throw;
				}
				synchronizing = false;
			}
			UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
			if (parentRow != null && !HasPrevSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) && !HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))
			{
				parentRow.SynchSameTierParentRows(newHeight);
			}
		}

		internal void SynchSameTierChildRows(int newHeight)
		{
			ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = band.Layout.ViewStyleImpl;
			if (!viewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers)
			{
				return;
			}

			{
				synchronizing = true;

				{

				}

			}
		}

		public bool ExpandAncestors()
		{
			UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
			if (parentRow == null)
			{
				return true;

			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!parentRow.IsExpanded)
			{
				parentRow.Expanded = true;
			}
			return parentRow.IsExpanded;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetCommonParent(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			for (UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this; ultraGridRow != null; ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow)
			{
				for (UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = row; ultraGridRow2 != null; ultraGridRow2 = ultraGridRow2.ParentRow)
				{
					if (ultraGridRow2 == ultraGridRow)
					{
						return ultraGridRow;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void SetHeight(int newHeight)

		}

		internal void SetHeight(int newHeight, bool notify)
		{
			if (resizing)
			{
				return;
			}
			resizing = true;
			if (Band.RowSizingResolved != RowSizing.Sychronized)
			{
				heightSetManually = true;
			}
			int heightIncludingPadding = HeightIncludingPadding;
			if (newHeight != heightIncludingPadding)
			{
				int minRowHeight = MinRowHeight;
				if (newHeight < minRowHeight)
				{
					newHeight = minRowHeight;
				}
				if (newHeight != heightIncludingPadding)
				{
					rootHeight = newHeight;
					if (AutoPreviewEnabled)
					{
						rootHeight -= AutoPreviewHeight;
					}
					if (Layout != null)
					{
						Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
					}
					if (ParentCollection != null)
					{
						ParentCollection.BumpRowHeightVersion();
					}
					if (notify)
					{
						NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Height);
					}
				}
			}
			if (ParentRow != null)
			{
				SynchSameTierParentRows(HeightIncludingPadding);
			}
			SynchSameTierChildRows(HeightIncludingPadding);
			resizing = false;
		}
