				if (ultraGridRow.ParentRow != null && ultraGridRow.ParentRow.ChildBands != null && ultraGridRow.ParentChildBand != null)
				{
					for (UltraGridChildBand nextChildBand = ultraGridRow.ParentRow.ChildBands.GetNextChildBand(ultraGridRow.ParentChildBand, excludeCardBands); nextChildBand != null; nextChildBand = nextChildBand.ParentRow.ChildBands.GetNextChildBand(nextChildBand, excludeCardBands))
					{
						rowAtVisibleIndexOffset = nextChildBand.Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow();
						if (rowAtVisibleIndexOffset != null && !rowAtVisibleIndexOffset.HiddenResolved)
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			do
			{
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Next, spanBands: true, excludeCardBands, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
			}
			while (excludeHidden && ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved);
			return ultraGridRow != null;
		}

		internal bool HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(bool excludeHidden)
		{
			return HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(excludeHidden, excludeCardBands: false);
		}

		internal bool HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(bool excludeHidden, bool excludeCardBands)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this;
			do
			{
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Previous, spanBands: true, excludeCardBands, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
			}
			while (excludeHidden && ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved);
			return ultraGridRow != null;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetPrevVisibleRelative()
		{
			return GetPrevVisibleRelative(spanBands: true, skipThisRow: false, spanParents: true);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetNextVisibleRelative(bool spanBands, bool skipThisRow, bool spanParents)
		{
			bool hiddenResolved = HiddenResolved;
			if (hiddenResolved && (ParentCollection == null || ParentCollection.VisibleRowCount <= 0))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!skipThisRow && !hiddenResolved)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (!band.HiddenResolved && (ParentRow == null || !ParentRow.HiddenResolved))
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this;
				bool spanBands2 = ParentRow != null && spanBands;
				while (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Next, spanBands2, excludeCardBands: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
					if (ultraGridRow != null && !ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
					{
						return ultraGridRow;
					}
				}
			}
			if (spanBands && spanParents)
			{
				UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
				if (parentRow != null && !parentRow.Band.HiddenResolved)
				{
					return parentRow.GetNextVisibleRelative(spanBands, skipThisRow: false, spanParents);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool IsAbsoluteFirstRow()
		{
			if (ParentRow != null || HasPrevSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetVisibleSiblingRow(bool next, bool acrossSiblingBands, IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			if (ParentCollection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (next ? ParentCollection.GetNextVisibleRow(this, includeRowTypes) : ParentCollection.GetPrevVisibleRow(this, includeRowTypes));
			if (ultraGridRow == null && acrossSiblingBands && ParentRow != null && ParentRow.ChildBands != null && ParentChildBand != null)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = ParentChildBand;
				while (ultraGridRow == null && ultraGridChildBand != null)
				{
					ultraGridChildBand = (next ? ultraGridChildBand.ParentRow.ChildBands.GetNextChildBand(ultraGridChildBand, excludeCardBands: false) : ultraGridChildBand.ParentRow.ChildBands.GetPreviousChildBand(ultraGridChildBand, excludeCardBands: false));
					if (ultraGridChildBand != null && !ultraGridChildBand.Band.HiddenResolved)
					{
						ultraGridRow = (next ? ultraGridChildBand.Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow(includeRowTypes) : ultraGridChildBand.Rows.GetLastVisibleRow(includeRowTypes));
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetNextVisibleRow()
		{
			return GetNextVisibleRow(skipThisRowDescendants: false);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetNextVisibleRow(bool skipThisRowDescendants)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			if (!skipThisRowDescendants && Expanded && !HiddenResolved && ChildBands != null)
			{
				ultraGridRow = ChildBands.GetItemAtScrollIndex(0);
			}
			if (ultraGridRow == null || ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
			{
				ultraGridRow = GetVisibleSiblingRow(next: true, acrossSiblingBands: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
			}
			if (ultraGridRow == null || ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
			{
				UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
				while (parentRow != null && ultraGridRow == null)
				{
					ultraGridRow = parentRow.GetVisibleSiblingRow(next: true, acrossSiblingBands: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
					if (ultraGridRow == null)
					{
						parentRow = parentRow.ParentRow;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null && !ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return ultraGridRow;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private UltraGridRow GetVisibleDescendant(bool last, bool includeThisRow)
		{
			if (!HiddenResolved)
			{
				if (Expanded)
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = GetChild(last ? ChildRow.Last : ChildRow.First, null, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
					while (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
					{
						ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetSibling((!last) ? SiblingRow.Next : SiblingRow.Previous, spanBands: true, excludeCardBands: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
					}
					if (ultraGridRow != null && !ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
					{
						ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetVisibleDescendant(last, includeThisRow: true);
						if (ultraGridRow != null && !ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
						{
							return ultraGridRow;
						}
					}
				}
				if (includeThisRow)
				{
					return this;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetPrevVisibleRow()
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			ultraGridRow = GetSibling(SiblingRow.Previous, spanBands: true, excludeCardBands: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
			while (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
			{
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Previous, spanBands: true, excludeCardBands: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null && !ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return ultraGridRow.GetVisibleDescendant(last: true, includeThisRow: true);
			}
			ultraGridRow = ParentRow;
			if (ultraGridRow != null && !ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return ultraGridRow;
			}
			while (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
			{
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Previous, spanBands: true, excludeCardBands: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null && !ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return ultraGridRow.GetVisibleDescendant(last: true, includeThisRow: true);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal bool IsAbsoluteLastRow(bool expandedOnly)
		{
			if (HasNextSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) || HasSiblingInNextSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow; parentRow != null; parentRow = parentRow.ParentRow)
			{
				if (parentRow.HasNextSibling(spanBands: true, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (!Band.HasChildBands())
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!expandedOnly || Expanded)
			{
				return !HasChild(excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetPrevVisibleRelative(bool spanBands, bool skipThisRow, bool spanParents)
		{
			bool hiddenResolved = HiddenResolved;
			if (hiddenResolved && (ParentCollection == null || ParentCollection.VisibleRowCount <= 0))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!skipThisRow && !hiddenResolved)
			{
				return this;
			}
			if (!band.HiddenResolved && (ParentRow == null || !ParentRow.HiddenResolved))
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this;
				bool spanBands2 = ParentRow != null && spanBands;
				while (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetSibling(SiblingRow.Previous, spanBands2, excludeCardBands: false, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
					if (ultraGridRow != null && !ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
					{
						return ultraGridRow;
					}
				}
			}
			if (spanBands && spanParents)

				}
			}

		}

		internal virtual Activation GetResolvedCellActivation(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (IsFilteredOut && RowFilterAction.DisableFilteredOutRows == BandInternal.RowFilterActionResolved)
			{
				return Activation.Disabled;
			}
			Activation activationResolved = column.ActivationResolved;
			return GridUtils.MaxActivation(ActivationResolvedInternal, activationResolved);
		}

		public Activation GetCellActivationResolved(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			UltraGridBase grid = GetGrid();
			if (grid != null)
			{
				Activation? cellActivationResolved = grid.GetCellActivationResolved(this, column);
				if (cellActivationResolved.HasValue)
				{
					return cellActivationResolved.Value;
				}
			}
			return GetCellIfAllocated(column)?.ActivationResolvedInternal ?? GetResolvedCellActivation(column);
		}

		internal string GetScrollTip(ref int lineCount, bool forRowConnectorTooltip)
		{
			string text = null;
			UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
			if (parentRow != null)
			{
				text = parentRow.GetScrollTip(ref lineCount, forRowConnectorTooltip);
			}
			if (TipStyle.Hide == Band.TipStyleScrollResolved(forRowConnectorTooltip))
			{
				return text;
			}
			UltraGridColumn scrollTipCol = Band.ScrollTipCol;
			if (scrollTipCol == null)
			{
				return text;
			}
			string text2 = string.Empty;
			for (int i = 0; i < lineCount; i++)
			{
				text2 += "    ";
			}
			string rowScrollTip = RowScrollTip;
			if (rowScrollTip != null)
			{
				text2 += RowScrollTip;
			}
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = string.Empty;
			}
			if (parentRow != null && text.Length > 0)
			{
				text += "\r\n";
			}
			text += text2;
			lineCount++;
			return text;
		}

		public bool Activate()
		{
			if (!Layout.IsDisplayLayout)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Layout.ActiveRow == this)
			{
				UltraGrid ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
				if (Layout.Grid != null)
				{
					Layout.Grid.SetTempActiveRow(null, scrollIntoView: false);
				}
				if (ultraGrid != null)
				{
					ultraGrid.ActiveCell = null;
					if (ultraGrid.ActiveCell != null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			Layout.Grid.ActiveRow = this;
			if (Layout.ActiveRow != this)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(this);
			return false;
		}

		internal void SetDataChanged(bool newValue)
		{
			if (IsCardStyleVariableHeight)
			{
				cachedCardHeight = -1;
			}
			if (newValue != dataChanged)
			{
				if (newValue && HasCalcReference && ((RowReference)CalcReference).inCellReferenceValueSet)
				{
					return;
				}
				dataChanged = newValue;
				if (!base.Disposed)
				{
					NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.DataChanged);
				}
			}
			if (newValue)
			{
				return;
			}
			dataChangedViaCalcManager = false;
			CellsCollection cellsCollection = Cells;
			if (cellsCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < cellsCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				if (cellsCollection.HasCell(i))
				{
					cellsCollection[i].SetDataChanged(newValue);
				}
			}
		}

		string IUIElementTextProvider.GetText(DependentTextUIElement element)
		{
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = (UltraGridColumn)((UIElement)element).GetContext(typeof(UltraGridColumn), true);
			string text = null;
			if (ultraGridColumn != null)
			{
				text = GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
				if (text != null && ultraGridColumn != null)
				{
					text = ultraGridColumn.FormatWithMaskMode(text, ultraGridColumn.MaskDisplayMode);
				}
				if (text == null)
				{
					text = string.Empty;
				}
				return text;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetVisibleCrossParentSibling(bool previous, bool spanBands)
		{
			UltraGridRow parentRow = ParentRow;
			if (parentRow == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = parentRow;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = null;
			while (ultraGridRow != null)
			{
				ultraGridRow2 = ultraGridRow.GetVisibleSiblingWithVisibleChildrenInBand(spanBands ? null : band, previous);
				if (ultraGridRow2 != null)
				{
					ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow2;
					break;
				}
				ultraGridRow2 = ultraGridRow.GetVisibleCrossParentSibling(previous, spanBands);
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow2;
				if (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					bool flag = false;
					if (ultraGridRow.HasChild(spanBands ? null : band, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraGridRow?.GetChild(previous ? ChildRow.Last : ChildRow.First, spanBands ? null : band, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetVisibleSiblingWithVisibleChildrenInBand(UltraGridBand childBand, bool previous)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this;
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			if (layout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			NavigateType navType = (previous ? NavigateType.Prev : NavigateType.Next);
			int num = ((childBand.ParentBand != null) ? childBand.ParentColumn.Index : (-1));
			bool flag = false;
			while (!flag)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = null;
				bool spanBands = num < 0;
				ultraGridRow2 = layout.GetRelatedVisibleRow(ultraGridRow, navType, spanBands, spanParents: false, includeNonActivateable: false);
				if (ultraGridRow2 == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow2;
				flag = ((num >= 0) ? ultraGridRow.HasChild(childBand, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) : ultraGridRow.HasChild(excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows));
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		internal void RestoreAllUnboundCells()
		{
			if (cells == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < cells.Count; i++)
			{
				if (cells[i] != null)
				{
					cells[i].RestoreUnboundData();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SaveOriginalValForUnboundCells()
		{
			if (cells == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < cells.Count; i++)
			{
				if (cells.HasCell(i))
				{
					cells[i].SaveOriginalVal();
				}
			}
		}

		internal SelectedRowsCollection GetRowsForSelection(bool select)
		{
			return GetRowsForSelection(select, null);
		}

		internal SelectedRowsCollection GetRowsForSelection(bool select, ISelectableItem selectableItem)
		{
			SelectedRowsCollection selectedRowsCollection = new SelectedRowsCollection();
			GridItemBase pivotItem = Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion.GetPivotItem();
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = pivotItem as UltraGridRow;
			if (ultraGridRow == null && pivotItem is UltraGridCell)
			{
				ultraGridRow = ((UltraGridCell)pivotItem).Row;
			}
			if (ultraGridRow == null)
			{
				return selectedRowsCollection;
			}
			long overallSelectionPosition = OverallSelectionPosition;
			long overallSelectionPosition2 = ultraGridRow.OverallSelectionPosition;
			if (overallSelectionPosition != overallSelectionPosition2 && select)
			{
				NavigateType navType = ((overallSelectionPosition <= overallSelectionPosition2) ? NavigateType.Prev : NavigateType.Next);
				for (UltraGridRow relatedVisibleRow = Layout.GetRelatedVisibleRow(ultraGridRow, navType, spanBands: false, spanParents: true, includeNonActivateable: true); relatedVisibleRow != null; relatedVisibleRow = Layout.GetRelatedVisibleRow(relatedVisibleRow, navType, spanBands: false, spanParents: true, includeNonActivateable: true))
				{
					if (relatedVisibleRow.CanSelectItem(selectableItem))
					{
						selectedRowsCollection.InternalAdd(relatedVisibleRow);
					}
					if (relatedVisibleRow == this)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (select)
			{
				selectedRowsCollection.InternalInsert(0, ultraGridRow);
			}
			return selectedRowsCollection;
		}

		internal bool CanSelectItem(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			return item?.IsSelectable ?? Selectable;
		}

		internal override void CalcSelectionRange(Selected newSelection, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select, Selected initialSelection)
		{
			GridItemBase pivotItem = Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion.GetPivotItem();
			if (pivotItem == null || pivotItem is UltraGridCell)
			{
				Layout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion.SetPivotItem(this);
				CalcSelectionRange(newSelection, clearExistingSelection, select, initialSelection);
				return;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = pivotItem as UltraGridRow;
			SelectedRowsCollection rowsForSelection = GetRowsForSelection(select);
			foreach (UltraGridRow item in rowsForSelection)
			{
				newSelection.Rows.InternalAdd(item, validateAlreadyExists: false);
			}
			rowsForSelection = null;
			if (clearExistingSelection)
			{
				return;
			}
			long overallSelectionPosition = OverallSelectionPosition;
			long overallSelectionPosition2 = ultraGridRow.OverallSelectionPosition;
			foreach (UltraGridRow row in initialSelection.Rows)
			{
				long overallSelectionPosition3 = row.OverallSelectionPosition;
				if (overallSelectionPosition > overallSelectionPosition2)
				{
					if (overallSelectionPosition3 < overallSelectionPosition2 || overallSelectionPosition3 > overallSelectionPosition)
					{
						newSelection.Rows.InternalAdd(row);
					}
				}
				else if (overallSelectionPosition3 < overallSelectionPosition || overallSelectionPosition3 > overallSelectionPosition2)
				{
					newSelection.Rows.InternalAdd(row);
				}
			}
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ColumnHeader column in ultraGrid.Selected.Columns)
			{
				newSelection.Columns.InternalAdd(column);
			}
		}

		internal override void SetInitialSelection(Selected currentSelection, Selected initialSelection)
		{
			if (currentSelection.Rows == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridRow row in currentSelection.Rows)
			{
				initialSelection.Rows.InternalAdd(row);
			}
		}

		{
			if (context == ParentCollection.SparseArray)
			{
				return sortedRows_SparseArrayOwnerData;
			}
			return unsortedRows_SparseArrayOwnerData;
		}

		{
			if (context == ParentCollection.SparseArray)
			{
				sortedRows_SparseArrayOwnerData = ownerData;
			}
			else
			{
				unsortedRows_SparseArrayOwnerData = ownerData;
			}
		}

		private int CalculateScrollCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (!HiddenInternal)
			{
				if (parentCollection.IsFixedAddRow(this))
				{
					return num;
				}
				num++;
				if (Expanded)
				{
					ChildBandsCollection childBandsCollection = ChildBands;
					if (childBandsCollection != null)
					{
						num += childBandsCollection.ScrollCount;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal static void CopyPrintRelatedSettings(RowsCollection source, RowsCollection dest)

		private static void CopyRowOrder(RowsCollection source, RowsCollection dest)
		{
			if (!source.hasMovedRows)
			{
				return;
			}
			dest.EnsureNotDirty();
			SparseArray unSortedActualRows = dest.UnSortedActualRows;
			bool flag = false;
			UltraGridRow[] array = dest.SparseArray.ToArray(typeof(UltraGridRow)) as UltraGridRow[];
			Dictionary<UltraGridRow, UltraGridRow> dictionary = null;
			bool isGroupByRows = source.IsGroupByRows;
			if (isGroupByRows)
			{
				dictionary = new Dictionary<UltraGridRow, UltraGridRow>(source.Count);
				List<UltraGridRow> list = new List<UltraGridRow>(array);
				foreach (UltraGridRow item in source)
				{
					bool flag2 = false;
					object value = ((UltraGridGroupByRow)item).Value;
					foreach (UltraGridRow item2 in list)
					{
						object value2 = ((UltraGridGroupByRow)item2).Value;
						if (object.Equals(value, value2))
						{
							dictionary[item] = item2;
							list.Remove(item2);
							flag2 = true;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (!flag2)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			dest.SparseArray.Clear();
			foreach (UltraGridRow item3 in source)
			{
				if (!isGroupByRows)
				{
					int listIndex = item3.ListIndex;
					if (listIndex < 0 || listIndex >= unSortedActualRows.Count)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					dest.SparseArray.Add(unSortedActualRows[listIndex]);
				}
				else
				{
					if (!dictionary.TryGetValue(item3, out var _))
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
					dest.SparseArray.Add(dictionary[item3]);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				dest.SparseArray.Clear();
				dest.SparseArray.AddRange(array);
			}
		}

		internal static void CopyFixedRows(RowsCollection source, RowsCollection dest)
		{
			if (dest.HasFixedRowsBeenAllocated)
			{
				dest.FixedRows.Clear();
			}
			if (!source.HasFixedRowsBeenAllocated)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridRow item in (IEnumerable)source.FixedRows)
			{
				UltraGridRow rowFromPrintRow = dest.GetRowFromPrintRow(item);
				if (rowFromPrintRow != null)
				{
					dest.FixedRows.Add(rowFromPrintRow);
				}
			}
		}

		}

		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			if (selectedValue)
			{
				UltraGrid ultraGrid = layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
				if (!layout.Disposed)
				{
					ultraGrid?.Selected.Rows.Remove(this);
				}
			}
			if (appearance != null)
			{
				layout?.RemoveMulticastAppearance((AppearanceBase)(object)appearance, this);
				((SubObjectBase)(object)appearance).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				appearance = null;
			}
			if (cellAppearance != null)
			{
				layout?.RemoveMulticastAppearance((AppearanceBase)(object)cellAppearance, this);
				((SubObjectBase)(object)cellAppearance).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				cellAppearance = null;
			}
			if (rowSelectorAppearance != null)
			{
				layout?.RemoveMulticastAppearance((AppearanceBase)(object)rowSelectorAppearance, this);
				((SubObjectBase)(object)rowSelectorAppearance).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				rowSelectorAppearance = null;
			}
			if (previewAppearance != null)
			{
				layout?.RemoveMulticastAppearance((AppearanceBase)(object)previewAppearance, this);
				((SubObjectBase)(object)previewAppearance).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				previewAppearance = null;
			}
			if (dataErrorInfo != null)
			{
				dataErrorInfo.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				dataErrorInfo = null;
			}
			if (resolvedUltraGridRowDataErrorInfo != null)
			{
				resolvedUltraGridRowDataErrorInfo = null;
			}
			if (cells != null)
			{
				cells.Dispose();
			}
			cells = null;
			if (childBands != null)
			{
				childBands.Dispose();
			}
			listObject = null;
			listObject_ForComparison = null;
			layout?.DisposeUIAProviders(this);
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal void InvalidateCellAllRegions(UltraGridColumn column, bool invalidate, bool dirtyChildElems, bool includeRowSelector, bool includeRowAutoPreview)
		{
			if (!IsPotentiallyVisibleOnScreen || Layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RowScrollRegionsCollection rowScrollRegions = Layout.RowScrollRegions;
			ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegions = Layout.ColScrollRegions;
			for (int i = 0; i < colScrollRegions.Count; i++)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < rowScrollRegions.Count; j++)
				{
					UIElement uIElement = GetUIElement(rowScrollRegions[j], colScrollRegions[i], verifyElements: false);
					if (uIElement == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (includeRowAutoPreview)
					{
						Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true, fInvalidate: true);
						Layout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion();
					}
					UIElement descendant = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(CellUIElementBase), (object)column);
					UIElement val = (includeRowSelector ? uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(RowSelectorUIElementBase)) : null);
					if (dirtyChildElems)
					{
						if (descendant != null)
						{
							descendant.DirtyChildElements(invalidate);
						}
						if (val != null)
						{
							val.DirtyChildElements(invalidate);
						}
					}
					else if (invalidate)
					{
						if (descendant != null)
						{
							descendant.Invalidate();
						}
						if (val != null)
						{
							val.Invalidate();
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DeallocateCellsHelper(UltraGridCell activeCell, bool retainUnboundData, bool recursive)
		{
			if (cells != null && cells.DeallocateCellsHelper(activeCell, retainUnboundData))
			{
				cells.Dispose();
				cells = null;
			}
			if (!(childBands != null && recursive))
			{
				return;
			}
			ChildBandsCollection childBandsCollection = childBands;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = childBandsCollection.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = childBandsCollection[i];
				if (ultraGridChildBand.HasRowsBeenAllocated)
				{
					ultraGridChildBand.Rows.DeallocateCellsHelper(activeCell, retainUnboundData, recursive);
				}
			}
		}

		{

		}

		internal bool ShowEditTemplate(bool preventForHiddenOrDisabledRow, TemplateDisplaySource source)
		{
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = RowEditTemplateResolved;
			if (rowEditTemplateResolved == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rowEditTemplateResolved.IsShown)
			{
				if (source == TemplateDisplaySource.OnEnterEditMode && rowEditTemplateResolved.DisplayMode == RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Popup && ((Control)(object)ultraGrid).Focused && !((Control)(object)rowEditTemplateResolved).ContainsFocus)
				{
					rowEditTemplateResolved.FocusActiveProxy(ultraGrid.ActiveCell);
					if (!((Control)(object)rowEditTemplateResolved).ContainsFocus)
					{
						((Control)(object)rowEditTemplateResolved).Focus();
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (preventForHiddenOrDisabledRow && (HiddenResolved || IsDisabled))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ultraGrid.ActiveCell != null && ultraGrid.ActiveCell.IsInEditMode && ultraGrid.ActiveCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridRow activeRow = ultraGrid.ActiveRow;
			if (!IsActiveRow && Activate())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (activeRow != null)
			{
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved2 = activeRow.RowEditTemplateResolved;
				if (rowEditTemplateResolved2 != null && rowEditTemplateResolved2.Row != null)
				{
					if (rowEditTemplateResolved2 == rowEditTemplateResolved)
					{
						rowEditTemplateResolved2.Row = this;
					}
					else
					{
						rowEditTemplateResolved2.Row = null;
					}
				}
			}
			if (rowEditTemplateResolved.Band == null)
			{
				rowEditTemplateResolved.Initialize(Band);
			}
			rowEditTemplateResolved.Row = this;
			RowEditTemplateRequestedEventArgs e = new RowEditTemplateRequestedEventArgs(rowEditTemplateResolved);
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.RowEditTemplateRequested, e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool flag = rowEditTemplateResolved.Display(ultraGrid.ActiveCell, source);
			if (!flag)
			{
				rowEditTemplateResolved.Row = null;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		}

		public Size GetCellSizeResolved(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			Size cellSizeResolved = column.CellSizeResolved;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if (ultraGridBand.UseRowLayout)
			{
				GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection layoutItemDimensions = GetLayoutItemDimensions();
				int[] rowDims = layoutItemDimensions.RowDims;
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = column.RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				int originY = rowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginY;
				int num = rowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginY + rowLayoutColumnInfo.SpanY;
				cellSizeResolved.Height = rowDims[num] - rowDims[originY];
			}
			else if (ultraGridBand.Groups.Count > 0)
			{
				cellSizeResolved.Height = Height / ultraGridBand.LevelCount;
			}
			else
			{
				cellSizeResolved.Height = Height;
			}
			return cellSizeResolved;
		}

		private GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection GetLayoutItemDimensions()
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			int extent = ultraGridBand.GetExtent(BandOrigin.RowCellArea);
			int height = Height;
			Size size = new Size(extent, height);
			LayoutManagerBase layoutManager = LayoutManager;
			GridBagLayoutManager val = (GridBagLayoutManager)(object)((layoutManager is GridBagLayoutManager) ? layoutManager : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.GetLayoutItemDimensions((ILayoutContainer)(object)new LayoutContainerCalcSize(size), (object)null);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool FireBeforeSelectionChangeForRowAboutToBeDeleted(UltraGrid grid)
		{
			bool flag = grid != null && grid.HasSelectedBeenAllocated && grid.Selected.Rows != null && grid.Selected.Rows.Contains(this);
			if (flag)
			{
				SelectionStrategyBase selectionStrategyRow = ((ISelectionStrategyProvider)Band).SelectionStrategyRow;
				bool clearExistingSelection = true;
				if (selectionStrategyRow != null)
				{
					clearExistingSelection = selectionStrategyRow.IsSingleSelect;
				}
				Selected newSelections = grid.CalcNewSelection(this, clearExistingSelection, select: false);
				grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeSelectChange, new BeforeSelectChangeEventArgs(typeof(UltraGridRow), newSelections));
			}
			return flag;
		}

		private void FireAfterSelectionChangeForRowThatWasDeleted(UltraGrid grid, bool isSelected)
		{
			if (isSelected)
			{
				grid.Selected.Rows.Remove(this);
				grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterSelectChange, new AfterSelectChangeEventArgs(typeof(UltraGridRow)));
			}
		}

			if (ShouldDrawBackColor(ref drawParams.AppearanceData) || GridUtils.ShouldDrawBackColor(Layout, StyleUtils.Role.SplitterBarIntersection))
			{
				((SplitterIntersectionUIElement)this).DrawBorders(ref drawParams);
			}
		}
	}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)

					throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is RowLayout)
				{
					RowLayout rowLayout = (RowLayout)value;
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(RowLayout).GetConstructor(new Type[1] { typeof(string) });
					if (null != constructor)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[1] { rowLayout.Key }, isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		internal RowLayout(RowLayoutsCollection parentCollection, string key)
			: base(key)
		{
			if (parentCollection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("parentCollection");
			}
			this.parentCollection = parentCollection;
			Reset();
		}

		protected RowLayout(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Reset();
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Key":
					Key = (string)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), Key);
					break;
				case "ColumnInfos":
					columnInfos = (RowLayoutColumnInfosCollection)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RowLayoutColumnInfosCollection), null);
					break;
				case "RowLayoutLabelPosition":
					rowLayoutLabelPosition = (LabelPosition)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(LabelPosition), rowLayoutLabelPosition);
					break;
				case "RowLayoutLabelStyle":
					rowLayoutLabelStyle = (RowLayoutLabelStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RowLayoutLabelStyle), rowLayoutLabelStyle);
					break;
				case "CardView":
					cardView = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), cardView);
					break;
				case "CardViewStyle":
					cardViewStyle = (CardStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(CardStyle), cardViewStyle);
					break;
				case "RowLayoutStyle":
					rowLayoutStyle = (RowLayoutStyle)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RowLayoutStyle), rowLayoutStyle);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(RowLayout source)
		{
			rowLayoutLabelPosition = source.rowLayoutLabelPosition;
			rowLayoutLabelStyle = source.rowLayoutLabelStyle;
			cardView = source.cardView;
			cardViewStyle = source.cardViewStyle;
			rowLayoutStyle = source.rowLayoutStyle;
			if (source.columnInfos != null)
			{
				ColumnInfos.InitializeFrom(source.columnInfos);
			}
			else if (columnInfos != null)
			{
				columnInfos.Reset();
			}
		}

		private void CopyCurrent()
		{
			//IL_004b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ac: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Reset();
			for (int i = 0; i < Band.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Band.Columns[i];
				ColumnInfos[ultraGridColumn].InitializeFrom(ultraGridColumn.RowLayoutColumnInfo);
				ColumnInfos[ultraGridColumn].columnHidden = (DefaultableBoolean)(ultraGridColumn.Hidden ? 1 : 2);
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Band.Groups.Count; j++)
			{
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = Band.Groups[j];
				ColumnInfos[ultraGridGroup].InitializeFrom(ultraGridGroup.RowLayoutGroupInfo);
				ColumnInfos[ultraGridGroup].columnHidden = (DefaultableBoolean)(ultraGridGroup.Hidden ? 1 : 2);
			}
			RowLayoutLabelPosition = Band.RowLayoutLabelPosition;
			RowLayoutLabelStyle = Band.RowLayoutLabelStyle;
			CardView = Band.CardView;
			CardViewStyle = Band.CardSettings.Style;
			RowLayoutStyle = Band.RowLayoutStyle;
		}

		public void Apply()
		{
			//IL_00e5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ee: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f3: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			for (int i = 0; i < ColumnInfos.Count; i++)
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = ColumnInfos[i];
				ColumnsCollection columns = Band.Columns;
				GroupsCollection groups = Band.Groups;
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo2 = null;
				if (i < columns.Count && columns[i].RowLayoutColumnInfo.CanInitializeFrom(rowLayoutColumnInfo))
				{
					rowLayoutColumnInfo2 = columns[i].RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				}
				if (rowLayoutColumnInfo2 == null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < columns.Count; j++)
					{
						if (columns[j].RowLayoutColumnInfo.CanInitializeFrom(rowLayoutColumnInfo))
						{
							rowLayoutColumnInfo2 = columns[j].RowLayoutColumnInfo;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (rowLayoutColumnInfo2 == null)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < groups.Count; k++)
					{
						if (groups[k].RowLayoutGroupInfo.CanInitializeFrom(rowLayoutColumnInfo))
						{
							rowLayoutColumnInfo2 = groups[k].RowLayoutGroupInfo;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if (rowLayoutColumnInfo2 == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				rowLayoutColumnInfo2.InitializeFrom(rowLayoutColumnInfo);
				if ((int)rowLayoutColumnInfo.columnHidden != 0)
				{
					bool hidden = 1 == (int)rowLayoutColumnInfo.columnHidden;
					if (rowLayoutColumnInfo2.Column != null)
					{
						rowLayoutColumnInfo2.Column.Hidden = hidden;
					}
					else if (rowLayoutColumnInfo2.Group != null)
					{
						rowLayoutColumnInfo2.Group.Hidden = hidden;
					}
				}
			}
			Band.RowLayoutLabelPosition = RowLayoutLabelPosition;
			Band.RowLayoutLabelStyle = RowLayoutLabelStyle;
			Band.CardView = CardView;
			Band.CardSettings.Style = CardViewStyle;
			if (RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.None)
			{
				Band.RowLayoutStyle = RowLayoutStyle;
			}
			Band.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
			Band.NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RowLayout);
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			ResetColumnInfos();
			ResetRowLayoutLabelPosition();
			ResetRowLayoutLabelStyle();
			ResetCardView();
			ResetCardViewStyle();
		}

		public void Reset(bool fromBand)
		{
			if (!fromBand)
			{
				Reset();
			}
			else
			{
				CopyCurrent();
			}
		}

		public bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeKey() && !ShouldSerializeTag() && !ShouldSerializeCardView() && !ShouldSerializeCardViewStyle() && !ShouldSerializeRowLayoutLabelPosition() && !ShouldSerializeRowLayoutLabelStyle())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeColumnInfos();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public void ResetRowLayoutLabelStyle()
		{
			RowLayoutLabelStyle = RowLayoutLabelStyle.Separate;
		}

		public void ResetColumnInfos()
		{
			if (columnInfos != null)
			{
				columnInfos.Reset();
			}
		}

		public void ResetRowLayoutLabelPosition()
		{
			RowLayoutLabelPosition = LabelPosition.Default;
		}

		public void ResetCardView()
		{
			CardView = false;
		}

		public void ResetCardViewStyle()
		{
			CardViewStyle = CardStyle.MergedLabels;
		}

		public void ResetRowLayoutStyle()
		{
			RowLayoutStyle = RowLayoutStyle.None;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeColumnInfos()
		{
			if (columnInfos != null)
			{
				return columnInfos.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeRowLayoutLabelPosition()
		{
			return rowLayoutLabelPosition != LabelPosition.Default;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeCardView()
		{
			return cardView;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeCardViewStyle()
		{
			return cardViewStyle != CardStyle.MergedLabels;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeRowLayoutLabelStyle()
		{
			return rowLayoutLabelStyle != RowLayoutLabelStyle.Separate;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeRowLayoutStyle()
		{
			return rowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.None;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (ShouldSerializeKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			}
			if (columnInfos != null && columnInfos.ShouldSerialize())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ColumnInfos", columnInfos);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRowLayoutLabelPosition())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RowLayoutLabelPosition", rowLayoutLabelPosition);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRowLayoutLabelStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RowLayoutLabelStyle", rowLayoutLabelStyle);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCardView())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CardView", cardView);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCardViewStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CardViewStyle", cardViewStyle);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeRowLayoutStyle())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "RowLayoutStyle", rowLayoutStyle);
			}
		}
	}

		public sealed class RowLayoutColumnInfoTypeConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				//IL_00fa: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is RowLayoutColumnInfo)
				{
					RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = (RowLayoutColumnInfo)value;
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(RowLayoutColumnInfo).GetConstructor(new Type[4]
					{
						typeof(RowLayoutColumnInfoContext),
						typeof(string),
						typeof(int),
						typeof(DefaultableBoolean)
					});
					int num = -1;
					if (rowLayoutColumnInfo.ContextType == RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Column)
					{
						UltraGridColumn column = rowLayoutColumnInfo.Column;
						if (column != null && column.Band != null && column.Band.Columns != null && !column.IsBound)
						{
							num = column.Index - column.Band.Columns.BoundColumnsCount;
						}
					}
					return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[4] { rowLayoutColumnInfo.ContextType, rowLayoutColumnInfo.Key, num, rowLayoutColumnInfo.columnHidden }, isComplete: false);
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		{
			get
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfoContext rowLayoutColumnInfoContext = ContextType;
				if (rowLayoutColumnInfoContext != RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Column && rowLayoutColumnInfoContext == RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Group)
				{
					if (Group != null)
					{
						return Group.Key;
					}
				}
				else if (Column != null)
				{
					return Column.Key;
				}
				return base.Key;
			}

				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_NotSupportedException_346"));
			}
		}

				{
					if (cachedItemRectHeader.Width != value.Width && Column != null)
					{
						Column.ClearFontCache(dirtyColMetrics: false);
					}
					cachedItemRectHeader = value;
				}

		{
			get
			{
				if (GetBand().AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
				{
					return CachedItemRectHeader;
				}
				if (!CachedItemRectCell.IsEmpty)
				{
					return Rectangle.Union(CachedItemRectCell, CachedItemRectHeader);
				}
				return CachedItemRectHeader;
			}
		}

		internal Rectangle CachedOverallCellRect
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsHeaderVisibleWithCell)
				{
					return Rectangle.FromLTRB(Math.Min(cachedItemRectCell.Left, cachedItemRectHeader.Left), Math.Min(cachedItemRectCell.Top, cachedItemRectHeader.Top), Math.Max(cachedItemRectCell.Right, cachedItemRectHeader.Right), Math.Max(cachedItemRectCell.Bottom, cachedItemRectHeader.Bottom));
				}
				return cachedItemRectCell;
			}
			set
			{
				cachedItemRectCell = value;
			}
		}

		internal RowLayoutSizing AllowCellSizingResolved
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridBase grid = Column.Band.Layout.Grid;
				if (grid != null && grid.DesignMode)
				{
					return RowLayoutSizing.Both;
				}
				if (!(grid is UltraGrid))
				{
					return RowLayoutSizing.None;
				}
				if (allowCellSizing != RowLayoutSizing.Default)
				{
					return allowCellSizing;
				}
				return Column.Band.AllowRowLayoutCellSizingResolved;
			}
		}

		internal RowLayoutSizing AllowLabelSizingResolved
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridBand band = GetBand();
				UltraGridBase grid = band.Layout.Grid;
				if (grid != null && grid.DesignMode)
				{
					return RowLayoutSizing.Both;
				}
				if (!(grid is UltraGrid))
				{
					return RowLayoutSizing.None;
				}
				if (allowLabelSizing != RowLayoutSizing.Default)
				{
					return allowLabelSizing;
				}
				return band.AllowRowLayoutLabelSizingResolved;
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public int LabelSpanResolved
		{
			get
			{
				LabelPosition labelPositionResolved = LabelPositionResolved;
				int num = 0;
				if (LabelPosition.Left == labelPositionResolved || LabelPosition.Right == labelPositionResolved)
				{
					num = SpanX;
				}
				else if (LabelPosition.Top == labelPositionResolved || LabelPosition.Bottom == labelPositionResolved)
				{
					num = SpanY;
				}
				if (num <= 0)
				{
					return LabelSpan;
				}
				return Math.Min(num, LabelSpan);
			}
		}

		{

			{

				{
					return LabelPosition.None != LabelPositionResolved;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public UltraGridGroup ParentGroup
		{
			get
			{
				return parentGroup;
			}
			set
			{
				if (parentGroup == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (contextType == RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Group && Group == value)
				{
					UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = Group;
					for (UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup2 = value; ultraGridGroup2 != null; ultraGridGroup2 = ultraGridGroup2.RowLayoutGroupInfo.ParentGroup)
					{
						if (ultraGridGroup2 == ultraGridGroup)
						{
							throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_RowLayoutColumnInfo_GroupParentedToSelf"));
						}
					}
				}
				parentGroup = value;
				if (parentGroup == null)
				{
					parentGroupKey = null;
					parentGroupIndex = -1;
				}
				else
				{
					parentGroupKey = parentGroup.Key;
					parentGroupIndex = parentGroup.Index;
				}
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.ParentGroup);
			}
		}

		private int DefaultLabelSpan
		{
			get
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfoContext rowLayoutColumnInfoContext = ContextType;
				if (rowLayoutColumnInfoContext != RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Column && rowLayoutColumnInfoContext == RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Group)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		private int DefaultLabelSpanResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (ContextType == RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Group)
				{
					UltraGridBand band = GetBand();
					if (band != null)
					{
						if (!band.AreColumnHeadersInSeparateLayoutArea)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						return 2;
					}
				}
				return 1;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (cellInsets != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)cellInsets).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			cellInsets = null;
			if (labelInsets != null)
			{
				((SubObjectBase)(object)labelInsets).SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
			labelInsets = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		private Size MergeAutoFitOverrideSize(Size size, Size overrideSize)
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = ((Column != null) ? Column.Layout : null);
			if (ultraGridLayout != null && ultraGridLayout.AutoFitAllColumns)
			{
				if (overrideSize.Width > 0)
				{
					size.Width = overrideSize.Width;
				}
				if (overrideSize.Height > 0)
				{
					size.Height = overrideSize.Height;
				}
			}
			return size;
		}

		internal void InitColumn(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("column");
			}
			contextType = RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Column;
			base.Key = column.Key;
			context = column;
		}

		internal void InitGroup(UltraGridGroup group)
		{
			if (group == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("group");
			}
			contextType = RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Group;
			base.Key = group.Key;
			context = group;
		}

		internal static Rectangle ApplyInsets(Rectangle rect, Insets insets)
		{
			if (insets != null)
			{
				rect.X += insets.Left;
				rect.Y += insets.Top;
				rect.Width -= insets.Left + insets.Right;
				rect.Height -= insets.Top + insets.Bottom;
			}
			return rect;
		}

		internal static Insets GetItemInsetsHelper(ILayoutItem item)
		{
			IGridBagConstraint associatedGridBagConstraint = LayoutUtility.GetAssociatedGridBagConstraint(item);
			Insets val = ((associatedGridBagConstraint != null) ? associatedGridBagConstraint.Insets : null);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return emptyInsets;
			}
			return val;
		}

		internal void VerifyLayoutItemDimensions(bool forceVerification = false)
		{
			if (!forceVerification && isVerifyingLayoutItemDimensions)
			{
				return;
			}
			isVerifyingLayoutItemDimensions = true;
			try
			{
				if (Column == null || Column.Band == null)
				{
					GetBand()?.VerifyRowLayoutCache();
					return;
				}
				GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection val = ((Column.Band.RowLayoutStyle != RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout || ParentGroup == null) ? Column.Band.LayoutItemDimensions : ParentGroup.LayoutItemDimensions);
				if (verifiedLayoutDimensionsVersion == Column.Band.RowLayoutCacheVersionForLayoutItems)
				{
					return;
				}
				verifiedLayoutDimensionsVersion = Column.Band.RowLayoutCacheVersionForLayoutItems;
				if (val != null && val.Exists((ILayoutItem)(object)this))
				{
					GridBagLayoutItemDimensions val2 = val[(ILayoutItem)(object)this];
					cachedOriginXResolved = val2.OriginX;
					cachedOriginYResolved = val2.OriginY;
					cachedSpanXResolved = val2.SpanX;
					cachedSpanYResolved = val2.SpanY;
					if (SpanX == 0 || -1 == SpanX)
					{
						cachedSpanXResolved++;
					}
					if (SpanY == 0 || -1 == SpanY)
					{
						cachedSpanYResolved++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					cachedOriginXResolved = originX;
					cachedOriginYResolved = originY;
					cachedSpanXResolved = spanX;
					cachedSpanYResolved = spanY;
					if (cachedSpanXResolved < 0)
					{
						cachedSpanXResolved = 2;
					}
					if (cachedSpanYResolved < 0)
					{
						cachedSpanYResolved = 2;
					}
				}
				shouldPositionCellElement = LabelPosition.LabelOnly != LabelPositionResolved;
				shouldPositionLabelElement = LabelPosition.None != LabelPositionResolved;
			}
			finally
			{
				isVerifyingLayoutItemDimensions = false;
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(RowLayoutColumnInfo source)
		{
			//IL_0110: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0115: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (source == null)
			{
				Reset();
				return;
			}
			labelPosition = source.labelPosition;
			labelSpan = source.labelSpan;
			minimumCellSize = source.minimumCellSize;
			minimumLabelSize = source.minimumLabelSize;
			preferredCellSize = source.preferredCellSize;
			preferredLabelSize = source.preferredLabelSize;
			originX = source.originX;
			originY = source.originY;
			spanX = source.spanX;
			spanY = source.spanY;
			weightX = source.weightX;
			weightY = source.weightY;
			allowCellSizing = source.allowCellSizing;
			allowLabelSizing = source.allowLabelSizing;
			if (source.ShouldSerializeCellInsets())
			{
				CellInsets.CopyFrom(source.cellInsets);
			}
			else if (cellInsets != null)
			{
				cellInsets.Reset();
			}
			if (source.ShouldSerializeLabelInsets())
			{
				LabelInsets.CopyFrom(source.labelInsets);
			}
			else if (labelInsets != null)
			{
				labelInsets.Reset();
			}
			columnHidden = source.columnHidden;
			contextType = source.contextType;
			parentGroupKey = source.parentGroupKey;
			parentGroupIndex = source.parentGroupIndex;
			UltraGridBand band = GetBand();
			if (band != null)
			{
				UltraGridBand.InitRowLayoutColumnInfo(this, band);
			}
			else
			{
				parentGroup = null;
			}
			verifiedLayoutDimensionsVersion--;
		}

		internal bool CanInitializeFrom(RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo)
		{
			object obj = rowLayoutColumnInfo.Context;
			object obj2 = Context;
			UltraGridBand band = rowLayoutColumnInfo.GetBand();
			UltraGridBand band2 = GetBand();
			if (obj == null && obj2 != null && band2 != null)
			{
				if (rowLayoutColumnInfo.serializedColumnId != null)
				{
					RowLayoutColumnInfoContext rowLayoutColumnInfoContext = rowLayoutColumnInfo.ContextType;
					obj = ((rowLayoutColumnInfoContext == RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Column || rowLayoutColumnInfoContext != RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Group) ? ((object)band2.GetMatchingColumn(rowLayoutColumnInfo.serializedColumnId)) : ((object)band2.GetMatchingGroup(rowLayoutColumnInfo.serializedGroupId)));
				}
				else if (rowLayoutColumnInfo.Key != null && rowLayoutColumnInfo.Key.Length > 0)
				{
					RowLayoutColumnInfoContext rowLayoutColumnInfoContext = rowLayoutColumnInfo.ContextType;
					if (rowLayoutColumnInfoContext != RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Column && rowLayoutColumnInfoContext == RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Group)
					{
						if (band2.Groups.Exists(rowLayoutColumnInfo.Key))
						{
							obj = band2.Groups[rowLayoutColumnInfo.Key];
						}
					}
					else if (band2.Columns.Exists(rowLayoutColumnInfo.Key))
					{
						obj = band2.Columns[rowLayoutColumnInfo.Key];
					}
				}
				else if (rowLayoutColumnInfo.serializedUnboundColumnIndex >= 0)
				{
					int num = rowLayoutColumnInfo.serializedUnboundColumnIndex + band2.Columns.BoundColumnsCount;
					if (num >= 0 && num < band2.Columns.Count)
					{
						obj = band2.Columns[num];
					}
				}
			}
			if (obj2 == obj)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (obj != null && obj2 != null && rowLayoutColumnInfo.Key != null && rowLayoutColumnInfo.Key.Equals(Key))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

				for (int j = 0; j < ciColl.List.Count; j++)
				{
					if (ciColl.List[j] is RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo3 && rowLayoutColumnInfo.CanInitializeFrom(rowLayoutColumnInfo3))
					{
						rowLayoutColumnInfo.InitializeFrom(rowLayoutColumnInfo3);
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void SynchronizeWithColumnsColection()
		{
			if (inSynchronizeWithColumnsColection)
			{
				return;
			}
			inSynchronizeWithColumnsColection = true;
			try
			{
				UltraGridBand band = Band;
				if (band == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				ColumnsCollection columns = band.Columns;
				GroupsCollection groups = band.Groups;
				if (columns == null && groups == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num = columns?.Count ?? 0;
				int num2 = groups?.Count ?? 0;
				int num3 = band.ColumnsVersion + band.GroupsVersion;
				int num4 = num + num2;
				if (columnsAndGroupsCollectionVersion == num3 && num4 == List.Count)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (num == 0 && num2 == 0)
				{
					InternalClear();
					return;
				}
				Dictionary<UltraGridColumn, RowLayoutColumnInfo> dictionary = new Dictionary<UltraGridColumn, RowLayoutColumnInfo>();
				Dictionary<UltraGridGroup, RowLayoutColumnInfo> dictionary2 = new Dictionary<UltraGridGroup, RowLayoutColumnInfo>();
				for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
				{
					RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = (RowLayoutColumnInfo)List[i];
					if (rowLayoutColumnInfo != null)
					{
						switch (rowLayoutColumnInfo.ContextType)
						{
						case RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Column:
							dictionary[rowLayoutColumnInfo.Column] = rowLayoutColumnInfo;
							break;
						case RowLayoutColumnInfoContext.Group:
							dictionary2[rowLayoutColumnInfo.Group] = rowLayoutColumnInfo;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				List.Clear();
				List.Capacity = num4;
				for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = columns[i];
					RowLayoutColumnInfo value = null;
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(ultraGridColumn, out value))
					{
						value.InitColumn(ultraGridColumn);
					}
					List.Add(value);
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = groups[i];
					RowLayoutColumnInfo value2 = null;
					if (dictionary2.TryGetValue(ultraGridGroup, out value2))
					{
						value2.InitGroup(ultraGridGroup);
					}
					List.Add(value2);
				}
				columnsAndGroupsCollectionVersion = num3;
			}
			finally
			{
				inSynchronizeWithColumnsColection = false;
			}
		}

		internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			return List.Count > 0;
		}

		public override int IndexOf(string key)
		{
			if (Band != null)
			{
				return Band.Columns.IndexOf(key);
			}
			return base.IndexOf(key);
		}

		protected override IKeyedSubObject GetItem(string key)
		{
			SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
			int num = IndexOf(key);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_106"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_320"));
			}
			return (IKeyedSubObject)GetItem(num);
		}

		public override object GetItem(int index)
		{
			SynchronizeWithColumnsColection();
			RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = (RowLayoutColumnInfo)List[index];
			if (rowLayoutColumnInfo == null && Band != null)
			{
				ColumnsCollection columns = Band.Columns;
				int num = columns?.Count ?? 0;
				rowLayoutColumnInfo = ((index >= num) ? new RowLayoutColumnInfo(Band.Groups[index - num]) : new RowLayoutColumnInfo(columns[index]));
				List[index] = rowLayoutColumnInfo;
			}
			return rowLayoutColumnInfo;
		}

		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RowLayoutColumnInfo, propChange);
		}

		{
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
			{
				if (List[i] is RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo)
				{
					rowLayoutColumnInfo.Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddRange(RowLayoutColumnInfo[] ciArr)
		{
			if (Band != null && Band.Layout != null && Band.Layout.Grid != null && !Band.Layout.Grid.DesignMode && !Band.Layout.Grid.Initializing)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("AddRange is not supported during runtime.");
			}
			int num = 0;
			while (ciArr != null && num < ciArr.Length)
			{
				if (ciArr[num] is ColumnLayoutInfo || ciArr[num] is UltraGridGroup.GroupLayoutInfo)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException("Only RowLayoutColumnInfo objects can be added and not ColumnLayoutInfo or GroupLayoutInfo.");
				}
				if (ciArr[num] != null)
				{
					InternalAdd(ciArr[num]);
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

	internal class LayoutUtility
	{
		private interface IUIElementCallback
		{
			bool ProcessElement(UIElement element);
		}

		private class NearesetColumnHeaderCallback : IUIElementCallback
		{
			internal ColumnHeader nearestColumnHeader;

			private UltraGridBand band;

			private int minDistance;

			private Point point = Point.Empty;

			internal NearesetColumnHeaderCallback(UltraGridBand band, Point point)
			{
				this.point = point;
				this.band = band;
			}

			bool IUIElementCallback.ProcessElement(UIElement element)
			{
				if (element is HeaderUIElement headerUIElement && headerUIElement.Header is ColumnHeader && (band == null || band == headerUIElement.Header.Band))
				{
					int num = DistanceSquared(((UIElement)headerUIElement).Rect, point);
					if (num <= minDistance || nearestColumnHeader == null)
					{
						nearestColumnHeader = (ColumnHeader)headerUIElement.Header;
						minDistance = num;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private class NearesetGroupHeaderCallback : IUIElementCallback
		{
			internal GroupHeader nearestGroupHeader;

			private UltraGridBand band;

			private int minDistance;

			private Point point = Point.Empty;

			internal NearesetGroupHeaderCallback(UltraGridBand band, Point point)
			{
				this.point = point;
				this.band = band;
			}

			bool IUIElementCallback.ProcessElement(UIElement element)
			{
				if (element is HeaderUIElement headerUIElement && headerUIElement.Header is GroupHeader && (band == null || band == headerUIElement.Header.Band))
				{
					int num = DistanceSquared(((UIElement)headerUIElement).Rect, point);
					if (num <= minDistance || nearestGroupHeader == null)
					{
						nearestGroupHeader = (GroupHeader)headerUIElement.Header;
						minDistance = num;
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private class NearesetCellCallback : IUIElementCallback
		{
			internal UltraGridCell nearestCell;

			private UltraGridBand band;

			private int minDistance;

			private Point point = Point.Empty;

			internal NearesetCellCallback(UltraGridBand band, Point point)
			{
				this.point = point;
				this.band = band;
			}

			bool IUIElementCallback.ProcessElement(UIElement element)
			{
				if (!(element is CellUIElement) && !(element is HeaderUIElement))
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (element.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridRow)) is UltraGridRow ultraGridRow && (band == null || band == ultraGridRow.Band) && ultraGridRow.Selectable)
				{
					if (!element.Contains(point) && element.Parent != null && !element.Parent.Contains(point))
					{
						return true;
					}
					int num = DistanceSquared(element.Rect, point);
					if (num <= minDistance || nearestCell == null)
					{
						UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = element.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridCell)) as UltraGridCell;
						if (ultraGridCell == null && element.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridColumn)) is UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn)
						{
							ultraGridCell = ultraGridRow.Cells[ultraGridColumn.Key];
						}
						if (ultraGridCell != null)
						{
							nearestCell = ultraGridCell;
							minDistance = num;
						}
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		private static int DistanceSquared(Rectangle rect, Point p)
		{
			rect.Offset(-p.X, -p.Y);
			if (rect.X < 0 && rect.Right > 0)
			{
				if (rect.Y < 0 && rect.Bottom > 0)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return Math.Min(rect.Y * rect.Y, rect.Bottom * rect.Bottom);
			}
			if (rect.Y < 0 && rect.Bottom > 0)
			{
				return Math.Min(rect.X * rect.X, rect.Right * rect.Right);
			}
			return Math.Min(rect.X * rect.X + rect.Y * rect.Y, Math.Min(rect.Right * rect.Right + rect.Y * rect.Y, Math.Min(rect.X * rect.X + rect.Bottom * rect.Bottom, rect.Right * rect.Right + rect.Bottom * rect.Bottom)));
		}

		private static bool TraverseDescendants(UIElement parentElement, IUIElementCallback callback)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ArrayList)(object)parentElement.ChildElements).Count; i++)
			{
				UIElement val = parentElement.ChildElements[i];
				if (val != null)
				{
					if (!callback.ProcessElement(val))
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (!TraverseDescendants(val, callback))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static ColumnHeader FindNearesetColumnHeader(UIElement parentElem, UltraGridBand band, Point p)
		{
			NearesetColumnHeaderCallback nearesetColumnHeaderCallback = new NearesetColumnHeaderCallback(band, p);
			TraverseDescendants(parentElem, nearesetColumnHeaderCallback);
			return nearesetColumnHeaderCallback.nearestColumnHeader;
		}

		internal static GroupHeader FindNearesetGroupHeader(UIElement parentElem, UltraGridBand band, Point p)
		{
			NearesetGroupHeaderCallback nearesetGroupHeaderCallback = new NearesetGroupHeaderCallback(band, p);
			TraverseDescendants(parentElem, nearesetGroupHeaderCallback);
			return nearesetGroupHeaderCallback.nearestGroupHeader;
		}

		internal static UltraGridCell FindNearesetCell(UIElement parentElem, UltraGridBand band, Point p)
		{
			NearesetCellCallback nearesetCellCallback = new NearesetCellCallback(band, p);
			TraverseDescendants(parentElem, nearesetCellCallback);
			return nearesetCellCallback.nearestCell;
		}

		internal static void ItemMergeBorderHelper(ref Rectangle rect, ILayoutItem item, Rectangle containerRect, bool rightToLeft)
		{
			Insets itemInsetsHelper = RowLayoutColumnInfo.GetItemInsetsHelper(item);
			if (itemInsetsHelper.Left == 0 && rect.X > containerRect.X)
			{
				if (!rightToLeft)
				{
					rect.X--;
				}
				rect.Width++;
			}
			if (itemInsetsHelper.Top == 0 && rect.Y > containerRect.Y)
			{
				rect.Y--;
				rect.Height++;
			}
		}

		}

		internal static Size AccountForLabelPosition(UltraGridBand band, Size defaultSize)

		internal static bool Intersects(int xx1, int ww1, int xx2, int ww2)
		{

		}

		internal static Rectangle GetLogicalGridBagLayoutRect(GridBagLayoutItemDimensionsCollection dims)
		{
			//IL_0020: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Expected O, but got Unknown
			int num2;
			int num = (num2 = int.MaxValue);
			int num4;
			int num3 = (num4 = 0);
			foreach (ILayoutItem item in (IEnumerable)dims)
			{
				ILayoutItem val = item;
				bool flag = val.IsVisible;
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = UltraGridBand.GetRowLayoutColumnInfo(val);
				if (rowLayoutColumnInfo == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					switch (rowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved)
					{
					case LabelPosition.LabelOnly:
						if (val is UltraGridColumn || val is GroupLayoutItemBase)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					case LabelPosition.None:
						if (val is HeaderBase)
						{
							flag = false;
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					GridBagLayoutItemDimensions val2 = dims[val];
					num = Math.Min(num, val2.OriginX);
					num2 = Math.Min(num2, val2.OriginY);
					num3 = Math.Max(num3, val2.OriginX + val2.SpanX);
					num4 = Math.Max(num4, val2.OriginY + val2.SpanY);
				}
			}
			return (num < num3 && num2 < num4) ? new Rectangle(num, num2, num3 - num, num4 - num2) : Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		internal static UIElement ExtractUIElement(UIElementsCollection oldElements, Type elementType)
		{
			if (oldElements != null)
			{
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = ((ArrayList)(object)oldElements).Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					UIElement val = oldElements[i];
					if (val != null && ((object)val).GetType() == elementType)
					{

		internal static Rectangle GetContainerRectHelper(UltraGridBand band, Rectangle rect, UIElementBorderStyle containerBorderStyle, UIElementBorderStyle itemBorderStyle, bool adjustForRowSelectors)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ab: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0099: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_009a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Rectangle result = rect;
			bool flag = band.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(band.BorderStyleRowResolved);
			bool flag2 = band.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(band.BorderStyleCellResolved);
			int cellSpacingResolved = band.CellSpacingResolved;
			if (adjustForRowSelectors)
			{
				int num = band.RowSelectorExtent;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						num--;
					}
					result.X += num;
					result.Width -= num;
				}
			}
			if (!flag2 || !flag || cellSpacingResolved > 0)
			{
				int borderThickness = band.Layout.GetBorderThickness(band.BorderStyleRowResolved);
				result.Inflate(-borderThickness, 0);
			}
			if (cellSpacingResolved > 0 || !band.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(containerBorderStyle, itemBorderStyle))
			{
				result.Inflate(0, -band.Layout.GetBorderThickness(containerBorderStyle));
			}
			return result;
		}

	internal class SummaryLayoutItem : ILayoutItem
	{
		private UltraGridColumn column;

		private SummarySettings[] summaries;

		private int[] summaryHeights;

		private SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext;

		internal UltraGridColumn Column => column;

		internal SummarySettings[] Summaries => summaries;

		internal int[] SummaryHeights => summaryHeights;

		Size ILayoutItem.PreferredSize
		{
			get
			{
				int num = UltraGridBand.ArrSum(summaryHeights);
				Size preferredSize = ((ILayoutItem)column).PreferredSize;
				if (preferredSize.Height < num || (summaryDisplayAreaContext != null && summaryDisplayAreaContext.IsGroupByRowSummaries))
				{
					preferredSize.Height = num;
				}
				return preferredSize;
			}
		}

		Size ILayoutItem.MinimumSize
		{
			get
			{
				Size minimumSize = ((ILayoutItem)column).MinimumSize;
				if (summaryDisplayAreaContext != null && summaryDisplayAreaContext.IsGroupByRowSummaries)
				{
					minimumSize.Height = 0;
				}
				return minimumSize;
			}
		}

		bool ILayoutItem.IsVisible => true;

		internal SummaryLayoutItem(UltraGridColumn column)
			: this(column, SummaryDisplayAreaContext.AllExceptGroupbySummaries)
		{
		}

		internal SummaryLayoutItem(UltraGridColumn column, SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("column");
			}
			this.column = column;
			GridUtils.ValidateNull(summaryDisplayAreaContext);
			this.summaryDisplayAreaContext = summaryDisplayAreaContext;
			summaries = this.column.Band.Summaries.GetFixedSummariesForDisplayColumn(summaryDisplayAreaContext, column);
			if (summaries == null)
			{
				summaries = new SummarySettings[0];
			}
			CalcSummaryHeights();
		}

		private void CalcSummaryHeights()
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_008d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags propFlags = (AppearancePropFlags)65011720;
			SummaryValuesCollection.ResolveSummaryValueAppearanceHelper(column.Band, ref appData, ref propFlags, summaryDisplayAreaContext);
			int num = column.Band.Layout.CalculateFontHeight(ref appData);
			summaryHeights = new int[summaries.Length];
			for (int i = 0; i < summaries.Length; i++)
			{
				int num2 = num * Math.Max(1, summaries[i].Lines);
				num2 += 2 * column.Band.Layout.GetBorderThickness(column.Band.BorderStyleSummaryValueResolved);
				num2 += 2 * column.Band.CellPaddingResolved;
				summaryHeights[i] = num2;
			}
		}
	}

		private void AdjustForMergedBorders(ref Rectangle rect, ILayoutItem item)
		{
			if (summaryBordersMergeable)
			{
				if (rect.X > containerRect.X)
				{
					rect.X--;
					rect.Width++;
				}
				if (rect.Y > containerRect.Y)
				{
					rect.Y--;
					rect.Height++;
				}
			}
			if (rect.Left == containerRect.Left)
			{
				rect.X = summaryAreaRect.Left;
				rect.Width += containerRect.Left - summaryAreaRect.Left;

				rect.Width = summaryAreaRect.Right - rect.X;
			}

		void ILayoutContainer.PositionItem(ILayoutItem item, Rectangle rect, object containerContext)
		{
			AdjustForMergedBorders(ref rect, item);
			if (!clipRect.IntersectsWith(rect))

				return;
			}

							continue;

						{

						}

							num3 += num2 * (float)summaryLayoutItem.SummaryHeights[i] - (float)num4;
							if (num3 > 1f)
							{
								num3 -= 1f;
								num4++;
							}
						}
						((UIElement)summaryValueUIElement).Rect = new Rectangle(rect.X, num, rect.Width, num4 + ((summaryBordersMergeable && !flag) ? 1 : 0));
						((UIElement)containerElem).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)summaryValueUIElement);
						val = (UIElement)(object)summaryValueUIElement;
						num += num4;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (item is HeaderBase)
			{
				HeaderBase header = (HeaderBase)(object)item;
				HeaderUIElement headerUIElement = (HeaderUIElement)(object)LayoutContainerHelper.ExtractUIElement(oldElements, typeof(HeaderUIElement));
				if (headerUIElement == null)

				((UIElement)containerElem).ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)headerUIElement);
				val = (UIElement)(object)headerUIElement;
			}

			}
			if (rect.X < clipLeft && rect.Right > clipLeft && val != null)
			{
				RowCellAreaUIElementBase.AddFixedCellSeparatorUIElement((UIElement)(object)containerElem, band, oldElements, clipLeft);

				lastCellAppearance = default(AppearanceData);

			internal Size GetIdealCellSize(UltraGridColumn column)
			{
				//IL_007c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0088: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0093: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00b3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00b5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				Size result = Size.Empty;
				if (column.IsChaptered)
				{
					return result;
				}
				int num = Math.Max(column.MinWidth, column.CellSizeResolved.Width - 2 * cellBorderThickness);
				if (column.IsColumnBorderMerged)
				{
					num += cellBorderThickness;
				}

		ILayoutItem[] IGridBagLayoutDragManager.GetVisibleLayoutItems()
		{
			List<ILayoutItem> list = new List<ILayoutItem>(Band.Columns.Count);
			if (Band.RowLayoutStyle == RowLayoutStyle.GroupLayout)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Band.Groups.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = Band.Groups[i];
					if (ultraGridGroup == itemBeingDragged || ultraGridGroup.IsVisibleInLayout)
					{
						list.Add(GetLayoutItem(ultraGridGroup));
					}
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Band.Columns.Count; j++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Band.Columns[j];
				if (ultraGridColumn == itemBeingDragged || ultraGridColumn.IsVisibleInLayout)
				{
					list.Add(GetLayoutItem(ultraGridColumn));
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		Size IGridBagLayoutDragManager.GetPreferredSize(ILayoutItem layoutItem)
		{
			Size preferredSize = layoutItem.PreferredSize;
			if (!AreColumnHeadersInSeparateArea)
			{
				IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo provideRowLayoutColumnInfo = layoutItem as IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo;
				LabelPosition labelPositionResolved = provideRowLayoutColumnInfo.RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved;
				Size size = ((layoutItem is UltraGridColumn || layoutItem is GroupLayoutItemBase) ? provideRowLayoutColumnInfo.PreferredHeaderSize : provideRowLayoutColumnInfo.PreferredSize);
				if (LabelPosition.Left == labelPositionResolved || LabelPosition.Right == labelPositionResolved)
				{
					preferredSize.Width += size.Width;
					preferredSize.Height = Math.Max(preferredSize.Height, size.Height);
				}
				else if (LabelPosition.Top == labelPositionResolved || LabelPosition.Bottom == labelPositionResolved)
				{
					preferredSize.Height += size.Height;
					preferredSize.Width = Math.Max(preferredSize.Width, size.Width);
				}
			}
			return preferredSize;
		}

		protected virtual bool ShouldAllowParentGroupChange(ILayoutChildItem item)
		{
			UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = null;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
			if (item is HeaderBase headerBase)
			{
				ultraGridGroup = headerBase.Group;
				ultraGridColumn = headerBase.Column;
			}
			else if (item is GroupLayoutItemBase groupLayoutItemBase)
			{
				ultraGridGroup = groupLayoutItemBase.Group;
			}
			else
			{
				ultraGridColumn = item as UltraGridColumn;
			}
			if (ultraGridColumn != null)
			{
				switch (ultraGridColumn.Band.AllowColMovingResolved)
				{
				case AllowColMoving.WithinBand:
					return true;
				case AllowColMoving.NotAllowed:
				case AllowColMoving.WithinGroup:
					return false;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
			return ultraGridGroup?.AllowParentGroupChangeResolved ?? false;
		}

		internal bool IsPointInValidLayoutArea(Point pointInControlCoords)
		{
			if (Band == null || Band.Layout == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(Band.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement val = UIElement.ElementFromPoint(pointInControlCoords);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Type containerElementType = ((IGridBagLayoutDragManager)this).GetContainerElementType();
			val = val.GetAncestor(containerElementType);
			if (val == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			object containerElementContext = ((IGridBagLayoutDragManager)this).GetContainerElementContext();
			if (val.HasContext(containerElementContext, true))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CacheRowLayoutInfo()
		{
			cachedRowLayoutInfo = new Hashtable();
			foreach (UltraGridGroup group in Band.Groups)
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = new RowLayoutColumnInfo(group);
				rowLayoutColumnInfo.InitializeFrom(group.RowLayoutGroupInfo);
				cachedRowLayoutInfo[group] = rowLayoutColumnInfo;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in Band.columns)
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo2 = new RowLayoutColumnInfo(column);
				rowLayoutColumnInfo2.InitializeFrom(column.RowLayoutColumnInfo);
				cachedRowLayoutInfo[column] = rowLayoutColumnInfo2;
			}
		}

		private void RestoreRowLayoutInfo()
		{
			foreach (UltraGridGroup group in Band.Groups)
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo source = cachedRowLayoutInfo[group] as RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				group.RowLayoutGroupInfo.InitializeFrom(source);
			}
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in Band.columns)
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo source2 = cachedRowLayoutInfo[column] as RowLayoutColumnInfo;
				column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.InitializeFrom(source2);
			}
		}

		private void SetResolvedGCsInternal(Hashtable hash, UltraGridGroup newGroup, bool setGroup)
		{
			//IL_001c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0022: Expected O, but got Unknown
			foreach (object key in hash.Keys)
			{
				GridBagConstraint val = (GridBagConstraint)hash[key];
				RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo = GetRowLayoutColumnInfo((ILayoutItem)((key is ILayoutItem) ? key : null));
				rowLayoutColumnInfo.Initialize(val.OriginX, val.OriginY, val.SpanX, val.SpanY);
				if (setGroup && itemBeingDragged.RowLayoutColumnInfo == rowLayoutColumnInfo)
				{
					rowLayoutColumnInfo.ParentGroup = newGroup;
				}
			}
			Band.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
		}
