		internal static UIElement GetContainerElement(UIElement element)
		{
			UIElement val = (UIElement)(object)(element.GetAncestor(typeof(BandHeadersUIElement)) as BandHeadersUIElement);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			val = (UIElement)(object)(element.GetAncestor(typeof(CardLabelAreaUIElement)) as CardLabelAreaUIElement);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			val = (UIElement)(object)(element.GetAncestor(typeof(RowCellAreaUIElement)) as RowCellAreaUIElement);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			val = (UIElement)(object)(element as BandHeadersUIElement);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			val = (UIElement)(object)(element as CardLabelAreaUIElement);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			val = (UIElement)(object)(element as RowCellAreaUIElement);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static Type GetContainerElementType(IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo, GridBagLayoutDragType dragType)
		{
			bool flag = dragType == GridBagLayoutDragType.CellSpanResize;
			if (GetAreColumnHeadersInSeparateArea(iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo))
			{
				if (iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo.Band != null && iProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo.Band.CardView)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						return typeof(CardLabelAreaUIElement);
					}
					return typeof(RowCellAreaUIElement);
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					return typeof(BandHeadersUIElement);
				}
				return typeof(RowCellAreaUIElement);
			}
			return typeof(RowCellAreaUIElement);
		}

		{
			List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>(Band.Columns.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Band.Columns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Band.Columns[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn.IsVisibleInLayout)
				{
					list.Add(ultraGridColumn);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal static RowLayoutColumnInfo GetRowLayoutColumnInfo(ILayoutItem layoutItem)
		{
			return UltraGridBand.GetRowLayoutColumnInfo(layoutItem);
		}

		protected internal RowLayoutColumnInfo GetDragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo()
		{
			return GetRowLayoutColumnInfo(((IGridBagLayoutDragManager)this).ItemBeingDragged);
		}

		protected internal virtual ILayoutItem GetLayoutItem(IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider)
		{
			return GetLayoutItem(rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider, dragType);
		}

		internal static ILayoutItem GetLayoutItem(IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider, GridBagLayoutDragType dragType)
		{
			if (dragType == GridBagLayoutDragType.CellSpanResize)
			{
				return rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.ContentLayoutItem;
			}
			return rowLayoutColumnInfoProvider.HeaderLayoutItem;
		}

		private static UltraGridColumn GetColumn(ILayoutItem layoutItem)
		{
			if (layoutItem is UltraGridColumn result)
			{
				return result;
			}
			if (layoutItem is ColumnHeader columnHeader)
			{
				return columnHeader.Column;
			}
			if (layoutItem is RowLayoutColumnInfo rowLayoutColumnInfo)
			{
				return rowLayoutColumnInfo.Column;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static UIElement[] GetDragElements(UltraGridGroup group, UIElement containerElement, bool areColumnHeadersInSeparateArea, List<UIElement> dragElements)
		{
			if (dragElements == null)
			{
				dragElements = new List<UIElement>();
			}
			UIElement descendant = containerElement.GetDescendant(typeof(HeaderUIElement), (object)group.Header);
			if (descendant != null && !dragElements.Contains(descendant))
			{
				dragElements.Add(descendant);
			}
			UltraGridColumn[] layoutVisibleColumns = group.GetLayoutVisibleColumns();
			UltraGridColumn[] array = layoutVisibleColumns;
			foreach (UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn in array)
			{
				descendant = containerElement.GetDescendant(typeof(HeaderUIElement), (object)ultraGridColumn.Header);
				if (descendant != null && !dragElements.Contains(descendant))
				{
					dragElements.Add(descendant);
				}
				if (!areColumnHeadersInSeparateArea)
				{
					descendant = containerElement.GetDescendant(typeof(CellUIElementBase), (object)ultraGridColumn);
					if (descendant != null && !dragElements.Contains(descendant))
					{
						dragElements.Add(descendant);
					}
				}
			}
			UltraGridGroup[] layoutVisibleGroups = group.GetLayoutVisibleGroups();
			UltraGridGroup[] array2 = layoutVisibleGroups;
			foreach (UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup in array2)
			{
				if (!areColumnHeadersInSeparateArea)
				{
					descendant = containerElement.GetDescendant(typeof(HeaderUIElement), (object)ultraGridGroup.Header);
					if (descendant != null && !dragElements.Contains(descendant))
					{
						dragElements.Add(descendant);
					}
				}
				GetDragElements(ultraGridGroup, containerElement, areColumnHeadersInSeparateArea, dragElements);
			}
			return dragElements.ToArray();
		}

		private UltraGridGroup[] GetVisibleGroups()
		{
			List<UltraGridGroup> list = new List<UltraGridGroup>(Band.Groups.Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Band.Groups.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridGroup ultraGridGroup = Band.Groups[i];
				if (ultraGridGroup.IsVisibleInLayout)
				{
					list.Add(ultraGridGroup);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}

	internal class ScrollCountManagerSparseArray : SparseArray, ICreateItemCallback
	{
		private int verifiedScrollCountVersion = -1;

		private RowsCollection ownerRowsCollection;

		internal int VisibleCount
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyAgainstScrollVersion();
				return GetVisibleCount();
			}
		}

		internal int ScrollCount
		{
			get
			{
				VerifyAgainstScrollVersion();
				return GetScrollCount();
			}
		}

		internal ScrollCountManagerSparseArray(RowsCollection ownerRowsCollection)
			: base(manageScrollCounts: true, 40, 0.2f)
		{
			if (ownerRowsCollection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("ownerRowsCollection");
			}
			this.ownerRowsCollection = ownerRowsCollection;
			if (this.ownerRowsCollection.Layout != null)
			{
				verifiedScrollCountVersion = this.ownerRowsCollection.Layout.ScrollableRowCountVersion;
			}
		}

		internal void DirtyScrollCount()
		{
			verifiedScrollCountVersion--;
			ownerRowsCollection.DirtyParentRowScrollCount();
		}

		private void VerifyAgainstScrollVersion()
		{
			RowsCollectionReference rowsCollectionReference = null;
			int num = 0;
			if (verifiedScrollCountVersion < 0)
			{
				rowsCollectionReference = ownerRowsCollection.CalcReference;
				if (rowsCollectionReference != null)
				{
					rowsCollectionReference.resyncEventSuspended++;
					num = rowsCollectionReference.resyncEventCounter;
				}
			}
			try
			{
				ownerRowsCollection.EnsureFiltersEvaluated();
				ownerRowsCollection.EnsureNotDirty();
				UltraGridLayout layout = ownerRowsCollection.Layout;
				if (layout != null && layout.ScrollableRowCountVersion != verifiedScrollCountVersion)
				{
					DirtyScrollCountInfo();
					verifiedScrollCountVersion = layout.ScrollableRowCountVersion;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				if (rowsCollectionReference != null)
				{
					rowsCollectionReference.resyncEventSuspended--;
					if (num > 0 && num < rowsCollectionReference.resyncEventCounter)
					{
						ownerRowsCollection.NotifyCalcManager_RowsCollectionResynced();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override object GetOwnerData(object item)
		{
			return ((UltraGridRow)item).sortedRows_SparseArrayOwnerData;
		}

		protected override void SetOwnerData(object item, object ownerData)
		{
			((UltraGridRow)item).sortedRows_SparseArrayOwnerData = ownerData;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetItem(int index, bool create)
		{
			return (UltraGridRow)GetItem(index, create ? this : null);
		}

		internal int VisibleIndexOf(ISparseArrayMultiItem immediateChild)
		{
			VerifyAgainstScrollVersion();
			return GetVisibleIndexOf(immediateChild);
		}

		internal int ScrollIndexOf(ISparseArrayMultiItem immediateChild)
		{
			VerifyAgainstScrollVersion();
			return GetScrollIndexOf(immediateChild);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetItemAtVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex)
		{
			VerifyAgainstScrollVersion();
			return (UltraGridRow)GetItemAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndex, this);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetItemAtVisibleIndexOffset(UltraGridRow startRow, int offset)
		{
			VerifyAgainstScrollVersion();
			return (UltraGridRow)GetItemAtVisibleIndexOffset(startRow, offset, this);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetItemAtScrollIndex(int scrollIndex, bool allocate)
		{
			VerifyAgainstScrollVersion();
			return (UltraGridRow)GetItemAtScrollIndex(scrollIndex, allocate ? this : null);
		}

		internal new void NotifyItemScrollCountChanged(ISparseArrayMultiItem item)
		{
			base.NotifyItemScrollCountChanged(item);
		}

		protected override void OnScrollCountChanged()
		{
			ownerRowsCollection.DirtyParentRowScrollCount();
		}

		object ICreateItemCallback.CreateItem(SparseArray array, int relativeIndex)
		{
			FixedRowsCollection fixedRows = ownerRowsCollection.FixedRows;
			List<UltraGridRow> sortedByListIndexList = fixedRows.SortedByListIndexList;
			bool topFixed = fixedRows.TopFixed;
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedByListIndexList.Count; i++)
			{
				if (topFixed)
				{
					if (sortedByListIndexList[i].ListIndex >= relativeIndex)
					{
						relativeIndex--;
					}
				}
				else if (sortedByListIndexList[i].ListIndex <= relativeIndex)
				{
					relativeIndex++;
				}
			}
			bool newRowCreated;
			UltraGridRow item = ownerRowsCollection.UnSortedActualRows.GetItem(relativeIndex, create: true, calledFromScrollCountManagerSparseArray: true, out newRowCreated);
			if (newRowCreated)
			{
				item?.FireInitializeRow();
			}
			return item;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow[] ToArray(bool create)
		{
			if (!create)
			{
				return (UltraGridRow[])ToArray(typeof(UltraGridRow));
			}
			UltraGridRow[] array = new UltraGridRow[base.Count];
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Count; i++)
			{
				array[i] = GetItem(i, create: true);
			}
			return array;
		}

		internal void VerifyScrollCount()
		{
			GetScrollCount();
		}

	public class RowsCollection : SubObjectsCollectionBase, IComparer, IEnumerable<UltraGridRow>, IEnumerable
	{
		private class ListObjectHolder
		{
			internal int listIndex = -1;

			internal object listObject;

			internal object comparisionListObject;

			internal ListObjectHolder(UltraGridRow row, object listObject, object comparisionListObject, int listIndex)
				: this(listObject, comparisionListObject, listIndex)

			}

			internal ListObjectHolder(object listObject, object comparisionListObject, int listIndex)
			{
				this.listIndex = listIndex;
				this.listObject = listObject;
				this.comparisionListObject = comparisionListObject;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				return comparisionListObject.GetHashCode();
			}

			public override bool Equals(object o)
			{
				if (o is ListObjectHolder listObjectHolder)
				{
					return listObjectHolder.comparisionListObject == comparisionListObject;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal class RowsSortComparer : RowsSortComparerBase, IComparer<UltraGridRow>
		{
			private class CellComparisonValue
			{
				private UltraGridRow row;

				internal object value;

				internal object text;

				internal bool comparesByValue;

				private int cachedListIndex = -1;

				internal int ListIndex
				{
					get
					{
						if (cachedListIndex < 0)
						{
							cachedListIndex = row.ListIndex;
						}
						return cachedListIndex;
					}
				}

				internal CellComparisonValue(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column)
				{
					this.row = row;
					value = row.GetCellValue(column);
					EmbeddableEditorBase editor = column.GetEditor(row);
					comparesByValue = editor == null || editor.ComparesByValue((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)column.EditorOwnerInfo, (object)row);
				}
			}

			private UltraGridRow currentAddRow;

			private Hashtable[] cellComparisonValues;

			internal RowsSortComparer(RowsCollection rows)
				: this(rows, groupingRows: false)
			{
			}

			internal RowsSortComparer(RowsCollection rows, bool groupingRows, int capacity = -1)
				: base(rows, groupingRows)
			{
				currentAddRow = base.rows.CurrentAddRow;
				if (capacity == -1)
				{
					capacity = base.rows.Count;
				}
				cellComparisonValues = new Hashtable[sortColumns.Length];
				for (int i = 0; i < sortColumns.Length; i++)
				{
					cellComparisonValues[i] = new Hashtable(capacity);
				}
			}

			internal static int DefaultCompare(object x, object y, UltraGridColumn column)
			{
				return DefaultCompare(x, y, duringSort: true, column);
			}

			internal static int DefaultCompare(object x, object y, bool duringSort, UltraGridColumn column)
			{
				return DefaultCompare(x, y, duringSort, column != null && SortComparisonType.CaseInsensitive == column.SortComparisonTypeResolved);
			}

			internal static int DefaultCompare(object x, object y, bool duringSort, bool caseInSensitive)
			{
				return Utilities.DefaultCompare(x, y, duringSort, caseInSensitive);
			}

			protected override int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				UltraGridRow rowX = x as UltraGridRow;
				UltraGridRow rowY = y as UltraGridRow;
				return CompareHelper(rowX, rowY);
			}

			private int CompareHelper(UltraGridRow rowX, UltraGridRow rowY)
			{
				if (rowX == rowY)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (rowX == null)
				{
					if (sortColumns.Length != 0 && SortIndicator.Descending == sortColumns[0].SortIndicator)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				if (rowY == null)
				{
					if (sortColumns.Length != 0 && SortIndicator.Descending == sortColumns[0].SortIndicator)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				if (currentAddRow != null && (rowX == currentAddRow || rowY == currentAddRow))
				{
					TemplateAddRowLocation templateRowLocationDefault = rows.TemplateRowLocationDefault;
					if (TemplateAddRowLocation.Top == templateRowLocationDefault)
					{
						if (rowX != currentAddRow)
						{
							return 1;
						}
						return -1;
					}
					if (TemplateAddRowLocation.Bottom == templateRowLocationDefault)
					{
						if (rowX != currentAddRow)
						{
							return -1;
						}
						return 1;
					}
				}
				int num = 0;
				CellComparisonValue cellComparisonValue = null;
				CellComparisonValue cellComparisonValue2 = null;
				int num2 = (groupingRows ? 1 : 2);
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < sortColumns.Length; j++)
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = sortColumns[j];
						if (num2 == 2)
						{
							switch (i)
							{
							case 0:
								if (ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn)
								{
									continue;
								}
								break;
							case 1:
								if (!ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn)
								{
									continue;
								}
								break;
							}
						}
						if (groupingRows && ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn && groupByEvaluators[j] is IGroupByEvaluatorEx)
						{
							IGroupByEvaluatorEx groupByEvaluatorEx = (IGroupByEvaluatorEx)groupByEvaluators[j];
							num = groupByEvaluatorEx.Compare(rowX.Cells[ultraGridColumn], rowY.Cells[ultraGridColumn]);
							groupByEvaluatorExUsed = true;
						}
						else if (ultraGridColumn.SortComparer != null)
						{
							num = ultraGridColumn.SortComparer.Compare(rowX.Cells[ultraGridColumn], rowY.Cells[ultraGridColumn]);
						}
						else
						{
							Hashtable hashtable = cellComparisonValues[j];
							cellComparisonValue = hashtable[rowX] as CellComparisonValue;
							cellComparisonValue2 = hashtable[rowY] as CellComparisonValue;
							if (cellComparisonValue == null)
							{
								cellComparisonValue = (CellComparisonValue)(hashtable[rowX] = new CellComparisonValue(rowX, ultraGridColumn));
							}
							if (cellComparisonValue2 == null)
							{
								cellComparisonValue2 = (CellComparisonValue)(hashtable[rowY] = new CellComparisonValue(rowY, ultraGridColumn));
							}
							object x;
							object y;
							if (cellComparisonValue.comparesByValue && cellComparisonValue2.comparesByValue)
							{
								x = cellComparisonValue.value;
								y = cellComparisonValue2.value;
							}
							else
							{
								if (cellComparisonValue.text == null)
								{
									cellComparisonValue.text = rowX.GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
								}
								if (cellComparisonValue2.text == null)
								{
									cellComparisonValue2.text = rowY.GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
								}
								x = cellComparisonValue.text;
								y = cellComparisonValue2.text;
							}
							num = DefaultCompare(x, y, ultraGridColumn);
						}
						if (num != 0)
						{
							if (ultraGridColumn.SortIndicator == SortIndicator.Descending)
							{
								num *= -1;
							}
							return num;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num == 0)
				{
					int num3 = cellComparisonValue?.ListIndex ?? rowX.ListIndex;
					int num4 = cellComparisonValue2?.ListIndex ?? rowY.ListIndex;
					num = ((num3 >= num4) ? 1 : (-1));
				}
				return num;
			}

			int IComparer<UltraGridRow>.Compare(UltraGridRow rowX, UltraGridRow rowY)
			{
				return CompareHelper(rowX, rowY);
			}
		}

		internal class ListIndexComparer : IComparer
		{
			public int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (UltraGridRow)x;
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = (UltraGridRow)y;
				int num = ultraGridRow?.ListIndex ?? (-1);
				int num2 = ultraGridRow2?.ListIndex ?? (-1);
				if (num >= num2)
				{
					if (num <= num2)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		internal class GroupByRowsSortComparer : RowsSortComparerBase, IComparer<UltraGridGroupByRow>
		{
			internal GroupByRowsSortComparer(RowsCollection rows)
				: this(rows, groupingRows: false)
			{
			}

			internal GroupByRowsSortComparer(RowsCollection rows, bool groupingRows)
				: base(rows, groupingRows)
			{
			}

			protected override int Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				UltraGridGroupByRow rowX = x as UltraGridGroupByRow;
				UltraGridGroupByRow rowY = y as UltraGridGroupByRow;
				return CompareHelper(rowX, rowY);
			}

			private int CompareHelper(UltraGridGroupByRow rowX, UltraGridGroupByRow rowY)
			{
				if (rowX == rowY)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (rowX == null)
				{
					if (sortColumns.Length != 0 && SortIndicator.Descending == sortColumns[0].SortIndicator)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				if (rowY == null)
				{
					if (sortColumns.Length != 0 && SortIndicator.Descending == sortColumns[0].SortIndicator)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					return 1;
				}
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = (groupingRows ? 1 : 2);
				for (int i = 0; i < num2; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < sortColumns.Length; j++)
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = sortColumns[j];
						if (ultraGridColumn != rowX.Column)
						{
							continue;
						}
						if (num2 == 2)
						{
							switch (i)
							{
							case 0:
								if (ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn)
								{
									continue;
								}
								break;
							case 1:
								if (!ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn)
								{
									continue;
								}
								break;
							}
						}
						if (!groupingRows || !ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn || !(groupByEvaluators[j] is IGroupByEvaluatorEx))
						{
							num = ((ultraGridColumn.SortComparer == null) ? RowsSortComparer.DefaultCompare(rowX.Value, rowY.Value, ultraGridColumn) : ultraGridColumn.SortComparer.Compare(rowX.Value, rowY.Value));
						}
						else
						{
							IGroupByEvaluatorEx groupByEvaluatorEx = (IGroupByEvaluatorEx)groupByEvaluators[j];
							num = groupByEvaluatorEx.Compare(rowX.Cells[ultraGridColumn], rowY.Cells[ultraGridColumn]);
							groupByEvaluatorExUsed = true;
						}
						if (num != 0)
						{
							if (ultraGridColumn.SortIndicator == SortIndicator.Descending)
							{
								num *= -1;
							}
							return num;
						}
					}
				}
				if (num == 0)
				{
					num = ((rowX.ListIndex >= rowY.ListIndex) ? 1 : (-1));
				}
				return num;
			}

			int IComparer<UltraGridGroupByRow>.Compare(UltraGridGroupByRow rowX, UltraGridGroupByRow rowY)
			{
				return CompareHelper(rowX, rowY);
			}
		}

		internal abstract class RowsSortComparerBase : IComparer
		{
			protected RowsCollection rows;

			protected UltraGridBand band;

			protected UltraGridColumn[] sortColumns;

			protected bool groupingRows;

			protected IGroupByEvaluator[] groupByEvaluators;

			internal bool groupByEvaluatorExUsed;

			internal RowsSortComparerBase(RowsCollection rows)
				: this(rows, groupingRows: false)
			{
			}

			internal RowsSortComparerBase(RowsCollection rows, bool groupingRows)
			{
				this.groupingRows = groupingRows;
				this.rows = rows;
				band = rows.band;
				HeaderClickAction headerClickActionResolved = band.GetHeaderClickActionResolved(changeExternalSortTypesToRegular: false);
				if (band.HasSortedColumns && HeaderClickAction.ExternalSortSingle != headerClickActionResolved && HeaderClickAction.ExternalSortMulti != headerClickActionResolved)
				{
					SortedColumnsCollection sortedColumns = band.SortedColumns;
					List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>();
					for (int i = 0; i < sortedColumns.Count; i++)
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = sortedColumns[i];
						if (ultraGridColumn.Index >= 0)
						{
							list.Add(ultraGridColumn);
						}
					}
					sortColumns = list.ToArray();
				}
				else
				{
					sortColumns = new UltraGridColumn[0];
				}
				groupByEvaluators = new IGroupByEvaluator[sortColumns.Length];
				for (int j = 0; j < groupByEvaluators.Length; j++)
				{
					groupByEvaluators[j] = sortColumns[j].GroupByEvaluatorResolved;
				}
			}

			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				return Compare(x, y);
			}

			protected abstract int Compare(object x, object y);
		}

						if (!dontFireInitializeRowOnNewRows)

							ultraGridRow.FireInitializeRow();
						}
					}
				}

		internal class MeetsCriteriaGridRowType : IMeetsCriteria
		{
			private GridRowType rowTypes;

			private UltraGridBand bandToMatch;

			internal MeetsCriteriaGridRowType(GridRowType rowTypes, UltraGridBand bandToMatch)
			{
				this.rowTypes = rowTypes;
				this.bandToMatch = bandToMatch;
			}

			private bool DoesRowMatchRowType(UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if ((GridRowType.DataRow & rowTypes) != 0 && row.IsDataRow)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if ((GridRowType.GroupByRow & rowTypes) != 0 && row.IsGroupByRow)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}

			public bool MeetsCriteria(object item)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (UltraGridRow)item;
				if (bandToMatch != null && bandToMatch != ultraGridRow.BandInternal)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!DoesRowMatchRowType(ultraGridRow))
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

							ultraGridRow = firstVisibleCard.GetPrevVisibleRelative(spanBands: false, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
						}
						firstVisibleCard = ultraGridRow;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					firstVisibleCard = GetFirstVisibleRow();
				}
				return firstVisibleCard;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null && !ValidateCard(value))
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_245"));
				}
				firstVisibleCard = value;
			}
		}

		internal TemplateAddRowLocation TemplateRowLocationDefault
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Band.HasGroupBySortColumns)
				{
					AllowAddNew allowAddNewResolved = Band.AllowAddNewResolved;
					if (AllowAddNew.TemplateOnBottom == allowAddNewResolved || AllowAddNew.FixedAddRowOnBottom == allowAddNewResolved)
					{
						if (Band.Layout.IsDisplayLayout)
						{
							return TemplateAddRowLocation.Bottom;
						}
					}
					else if ((AllowAddNew.TemplateOnTop == allowAddNewResolved || AllowAddNew.TemplateOnTopWithTabRepeat == allowAddNewResolved || AllowAddNew.FixedAddRowOnTop == allowAddNewResolved) && Band.Layout.IsDisplayLayout)
					{
						return TemplateAddRowLocation.Top;
					}
				}
				return TemplateAddRowLocation.None;
			}
		}

		internal TemplateAddRowLocation TemplateRowLocationResolved
		{
			get
			{
				TemplateAddRowLocation templateAddRowLocation = TemplateRowLocationDefault;
				if (templateAddRowLocation != TemplateAddRowLocation.None)
				{
					if ((currentAddRow != null && (!currentAddRowModifiedByUserFlag || currentAddRow.fixedResolvedLocationOverride != FixedRowStyle.Default || IsAllowAddNewFixed(Band.AllowAddNewResolved))) || (templateAddRow != null && templateAddRow.Hidden))
					{
						templateAddRowLocation = TemplateAddRowLocation.None;
					}
					else
					{
						UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = TopLevelRowsCollection.ParentRow;
						if (ultraGridRow != null && (ultraGridRow.IsTemplateAddRow || ultraGridRow.IsUnModifiedAddRowFromTemplate))
						{
							templateAddRowLocation = TemplateAddRowLocation.None;
						}
					}
				}
				if (templateAddRowLocation != TemplateAddRowLocation.None && !ContainsLessThanMaxRows)
				{
					return TemplateAddRowLocation.None;
				}
				return templateAddRowLocation;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsTemplateAddRowVisible => TemplateRowLocationResolved != TemplateAddRowLocation.None;

		internal UltraGridRow CurrentAddRow
		{
			get
			{
				return currentAddRow;
			}
			set
			{
				if (currentAddRow != value)
				{
					bool isTemplateAddRowVisible = IsTemplateAddRowVisible;
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = currentAddRow;
					bool flag = ultraGridRow?.FixedResolved ?? false;
					if (flag)
					{
						currentAddRow = value;
						ultraGridRow.InternalSetFixedResolvedOverride(FixedRowStyle.Default);
						ultraGridRow.NotifyScrollCountChanged();
						NotifyCalcManager_HiddenStateChanged(ultraGridRow);
					}
					currentAddRow = value;
					currentAddRowModifiedByUserFlag = false;
					if (currentAddRow != null)
					{
						currentAddRow.InternalSetIsAddRow(val: true);
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						OnTemplateAddRowVisibleStateChanged(ultraGridRow);
					}
					if (IsTemplateAddRowVisible != isTemplateAddRowVisible)
					{
						OnTemplateAddRowVisibleStateChanged();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool CurrentAddRowModifiedByUser
		{
			get
			{
				return currentAddRowModifiedByUserFlag;
			}
			set
			{
				if (currentAddRowModifiedByUserFlag == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool isTemplateAddRowVisible = IsTemplateAddRowVisible;
				currentAddRowModifiedByUserFlag = value;
				if (IsTemplateAddRowVisible != isTemplateAddRowVisible)
				{
					OnTemplateAddRowVisibleStateChanged();
					return;
				}
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = currentAddRow;
				if (ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridRow != null && (ultraGridBand.TemplateAddRowSpacingAfterDefault != ultraGridRow.RowSpacingAfterResolved || ultraGridBand.TemplateAddRowSpacingBeforeDefault != ultraGridRow.RowSpacingBeforeResolved))
				{
					Layout?.DirtyGridElement();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (columnFilters != null && propChange.Source == columnFilters && RowFilterMode.SiblingRowsOnly == Band.RowFilterModeResolved)
			{
				BumpRowFiltersVersion();
				SparseArray.DirtyScrollCount();
			}
			if (fixedRowCollection != null && propChange.Source == fixedRowCollection)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.FixedRows);
			}
		}

		{
			ClearMergedCellCache();
			UnBind();

			cachedList = null;
			lastParentListObject = null;
			oldBoundList = null;
			unsortedActualRows = null;
			if (sparseArray != null)
			{
				sparseArray.Clear();
			}
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		internal int GetVisibleRowCount(bool includeSpecialRows)
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;

			{
				ultraGridBand.CalcReference.VerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas();
			}
			int num = SparseArray.VisibleCount;
			if (includeSpecialRows)

		public void Refresh(RefreshRow action)
		{
			Refresh(action, recursive: false);
		}

		public void Refresh(RefreshRow action, bool recursive)
		{
			Refresh(action, recursive, initializeTemplateAddRow: false);
		}

		public void Refresh(RefreshRow action, bool recursive, bool initializeTemplateAddRow)
		{
			BumpVerifyVersion();
			if (!IsBoundToBindingList)
			{
				IList data_List = Data_List;
				if (data_List != null && data_List.Count != Count)
				{
					SyncRows();
				}
			}
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.Grid : null);
			if (ultraGridBase == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control controlForGridDisplay = ultraGridBase.ControlForGridDisplay;
			if (controlForGridDisplay == null || !controlForGridDisplay.Created)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (action)
			{
			case RefreshRow.FireInitializeRow:
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < Count; j++)
				{
					this[j].Refresh(action, recursive);
				}
				break;
			}
			case RefreshRow.ReloadData:
				if (IsTopLevel)
				{
					if (Band.BindingManager is CurrencyManager)
					{
						CurrencyManager currencyManager = (CurrencyManager)Band.BindingManager;
						currencyManager.Refresh();
					}
					Band.ResetCachedList();
					DirtyRows();
					if (recursive)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
						{
							this[i].Refresh(action, recursive);
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					NotifyCalcManager_RowsCollectionResynced();
				}
				break;
			}
			if (initializeTemplateAddRow)
			{
				if (templateAddRow != null)
				{
					FireInitializeTemplateAddRow();
				}
				else
				{
					_ = TemplateAddRow;
				}
			}
			if (Layout != null)
			{
				Layout.DirtyGridElement();
				Layout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
			}
			if (ultraGridBase == null || !((UltraControlBase)ultraGridBase).IsUpdating)
			{
				controlForGridDisplay.Invalidate();
			}
			ClearMergedCellCache();
		}

		public void ExpandAll(bool recursive)
		{
			if ((Layout != null && !Layout.ExitEditModeHelper()) || (Band != null && !Band.HasChildBands(visibleBandsOnly: false) && !IsGroupByRows))
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this[i];
				ultraGridRow.Expanded = true;
				if (!recursive)
				{
					continue;
				}
				ChildBandsCollection childBands = ultraGridRow.ChildBands;
				if (childBands != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < childBands.Count; j++)
					{
						childBands[j].Rows.ExpandAll(recursive);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void CollapseAll(bool recursive)
		{
			if (Layout != null && !Layout.ExitEditModeHelper())
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (recursive && this[i].HasChildRows)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)this[i].ChildBands)
					{
						item.Rows.CollapseAll(recursive);
					}
				}
				this[i].Expanded = false;
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetRelatedVisibleCard(UltraGridRow row, NavigateType navType, bool includeNonActivateable)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_241"));
			}
			if (!row.IsCard)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_242"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_241"));
			}
			if (row.ParentCollection != this)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_245"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_241"));
			}
			CardAreaUIElement cardAreaElement = GetCardAreaElement(null, null, scrollIntoView: false, exitEditMode: false);
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			if (cardAreaElement != null)
			{
				ultraGridRow = cardAreaElement.GetRelatedVisibleCard(row, navType, includeNonActivateable);
			}
			if (ultraGridRow == null)
			{
				cardAreaElement = GetCardAreaElement(null, null, scrollIntoView: false, exitEditMode: false);
				if (cardAreaElement != null)
				{
					ultraGridRow = cardAreaElement.GetRelatedVisibleCard(row, navType, includeNonActivateable);
				}
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		public void ScrollCardIntoView(UltraGridRow row, RowScrollRegion rsr, ColScrollRegion csr, bool exitEditMode)
		{
			if (row == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_241"));
			}
			if (!row.IsCard)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_242"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_241"));
			}
			if (row.ParentCollection != this)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_245"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_241"));
			}
			CardAreaUIElement cardAreaElement = GetCardAreaElement(rsr, csr, scrollIntoView: true, row, exitEditMode);
			if (cardAreaElement != null)
			{
				cardAreaElement.ScrollCardIntoView(row, exitEditMode);
				((UIElement)cardAreaElement).Parent.VerifyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		public bool IsCardVisible(UltraGridRow row, RowScrollRegion rsr, ColScrollRegion csr)
		{
			if (!row.IsCard)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_242"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_241"));
			}
			if (row.ParentCollection != this)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_245"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_241"));
			}
			if (!(Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (rsr == null)
			{
				rsr = ultraGrid.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			}
			if (csr == null)
			{
				csr = ultraGrid.ActiveColScrollRegion;
			}
			UIElement descendant = Layout.UIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(RowUIElementBase), new object[3] { rsr, csr, row });
			return descendant != null;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetRowAtVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex, IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			return GetRowAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndex, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows == includeRowTypes);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetRowAtVisibleIndex(int visibleIndex, bool includeSpecialRows)
		{
			if (visibleIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			if (includeSpecialRows)
			{
				ultraGridRow = GetSpecialRowAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndex, top: true);
				if (ultraGridRow == null)
				{
					visibleIndex -= GetSpecialRowsVisibleCount(top: true);
					ultraGridRow = SparseArray.GetItemAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndex);
					if (ultraGridRow == null)
					{
						visibleIndex -= SparseArray.VisibleCount;
						ultraGridRow = GetSpecialRowAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndex, top: false);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ultraGridRow = SparseArray.GetItemAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndex);
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		public UltraGridRow GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(UltraGridRow startAtRow, int visibleIndexOffset)
		{
			return GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(startAtRow, visibleIndexOffset, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(UltraGridRow startAtRow, int visibleIndexOffset, IncludeRowTypes includeRowTypes)
		{
			if (startAtRow != null && startAtRow.Index < 0 && startAtRow.IsDataRow)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (includeRowTypes == IncludeRowTypes.DataRowsOnly)
			{
				return SparseArray.GetItemAtVisibleIndexOffset(startAtRow, visibleIndexOffset);
			}
			if (startAtRow == null)
			{
				return GetRowAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndexOffset);
			}
			if (startAtRow.IsFixedTop && startAtRow.IsAddRow && visibleIndexOffset == 1)
			{
				visibleIndexOffset = 0;
			}
			UltraGridRow itemAtVisibleIndexOffset = SparseArray.GetItemAtVisibleIndexOffset(startAtRow, visibleIndexOffset);
			if (itemAtVisibleIndexOffset != null)
			{
				return itemAtVisibleIndexOffset;
			}
			int visibleIndex = GetVisibleIndex(startAtRow, includeSpecialRows: true);
			if (visibleIndex >= 0)
			{
				return GetRowAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndex + visibleIndexOffset);
			}
			if (visibleIndexOffset >= 0)
			{
				int countIncludingSpecialRows = CountIncludingSpecialRows;
				bool flag = false;
				int num = -1;
				for (int i = 0; i < countIncludingSpecialRows; i++)
				{
					itemAtVisibleIndexOffset = GetRowAtIndex(i, includeSpecialRows: true);
					if (itemAtVisibleIndexOffset == startAtRow)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (flag && !itemAtVisibleIndexOffset.HiddenInternal)
					{
						num++;
						if (num == visibleIndexOffset)
						{
							return itemAtVisibleIndexOffset;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				int countIncludingSpecialRows2 = CountIncludingSpecialRows;
				bool flag2 = false;
				int num2 = 1;
				for (int num3 = countIncludingSpecialRows2 - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					itemAtVisibleIndexOffset = GetRowAtIndex(num3, includeSpecialRows: true);
					if (itemAtVisibleIndexOffset == startAtRow)
					{
						flag2 = true;
					}
					if (flag2 && !itemAtVisibleIndexOffset.HiddenInternal)
					{
						num2--;
						if (num2 == visibleIndexOffset)
						{
							return itemAtVisibleIndexOffset;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void EnsureSortedAndFilteredHelper(ProcessMode processMode, UltraGridBand lowestLevelBand)
		{
			if (ProcessMode.Synchronous == processMode || ProcessMode.SynchronousExpanded == processMode)
			{
				EnsureSortedAndFiltered((ProcessMode.Synchronous != processMode) ? RecursionType.Expanded : RecursionType.All, lowestLevelBand);
			}
		}

		public void EnsureSortedAndFiltered()
		{
			EnsureSortedAndFiltered(RecursionType.None);
		}

		public void EnsureSortedAndFiltered(RecursionType recursion)
		{
			EnsureSortedAndFiltered(recursion, null);
		}

		public void EnsureSortedAndFiltered(RecursionType recursion, UltraGridBand lowestLevelBand)
		{
			if (Band == null || Band.Layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			EnsureNotDirty();
			EnsureFiltersEvaluated();
			if (recursion == RecursionType.None || (!IsGroupByRows && (Band == lowestLevelBand || !Band.HasChildBands(visibleBandsOnly: false))))
			{
				return;
			}
			RowEnumerator rowEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (rowEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraGridRow current = rowEnumerator.Current;
					if (current.ChildBands == null || (recursion == RecursionType.Expanded && !current.Expanded))
					{
						continue;
					}
					foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)current.ChildBands)
					{
						if (lowestLevelBand == null || lowestLevelBand.IsTrivialDescendantOf(item.Band))
						{
							item.Rows.EnsureSortedAndFiltered(recursion, lowestLevelBand);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = rowEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

			}
		}

		internal void EnsureNotDirty()
		{
			if (!IsTopLevel)
			{
				TopLevelRowsCollection.EnsureNotDirty();
			}
			if (rowsDirty)

			}
			VerifyGroupByVersion();

			}
		}

		internal bool InternalTraverseRowsHelper(IUltraGridExporter exporter)
		{
			if (Band.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int countIncludingSpecialRows = CountIncludingSpecialRows; i < countIncludingSpecialRows; i++)
			{
				UltraGridRow rowAtIndex = GetRowAtIndex(i, includeSpecialRows: true);
				if (rowAtIndex == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				ProcessRowParams processRowParams = new ProcessRowParams();
				exporter.ProcessRow(rowAtIndex, processRowParams);
				if (processRowParams.TerminateExport)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!processRowParams.SkipDescendants && rowAtIndex.ChildBands != null)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < rowAtIndex.ChildBands.Count; j++)
					{
						UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = rowAtIndex.ChildBands[j];
						if (!ultraGridChildBand.Band.HiddenResolved && !ultraGridChildBand.Rows.InternalTraverseRowsHelper(exporter))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
				}
				if (processRowParams.SkipSiblings)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool InternalTraverseRowsHelper(IRowCallback rowCallback, bool recursive, bool onlyAllocatedRows)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this[i];
				if (!rowCallback.ProcessRow(ultraGridRow))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!recursive || (onlyAllocatedRows && ultraGridRow.childBands == null) || ultraGridRow.ChildBands == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < ultraGridRow.ChildBands.Count; j++)
				{
					UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = ultraGridRow.ChildBands[j];
					if ((!onlyAllocatedRows || ultraGridChildBand.HaveRowsBeenInitialized) && ultraGridChildBand.Rows != null && !ultraGridChildBand.Rows.InternalTraverseRowsHelper(rowCallback, recursive, onlyAllocatedRows))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

			return data_List[listIndex];
		}

		private void BindToList(IBindingList list)
		{
			if (band == null || !Band.HookIntoList || !IsTopLevel)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (list == null)
			{
				band.HookIntoList = false;
			}
			if (list != oldBoundList && (Layout == null || !Layout.ExtractDataStructureOnly))
			{
				if (oldBoundList != null)
				{
					oldBoundList.ListChanged -= ListChangedHandler;
					_ = UltraGridBand.binding_debug;
				}
				oldBoundList = null;
				if (list != null)
				{
					list.ListChanged += ListChangedHandler;
					oldBoundList = list;
					_ = UltraGridBand.binding_debug;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			MergedCell_RowStateChanged(row, MergedCell.State.Value);
			if (ShouldByPassCalcManagerNotifications() || row == Layout.StoredCellValuesRow)
			{
				return;

			try
			{
				IUltraCalcManager calcManger = CalcManger;
				if (!(row.CalcReference is RowReference rowReference) || (rowReference.inCellReferenceValueSet && !row.InInitializeRowEvent))
				{
					return;
				}
				CellsCollection cellsCollection = (row.HasCells ? row.Cells : null);
				if (cellsCollection == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < cellsCollection.Count; i++)
				{
					if (cellsCollection.HasCell(i))
					{
						UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = cellsCollection[i];
						if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.HasCalcReference && !ultraGridCell.CalcReference.HasFormula)
						{
							calcManger.NotifyValueChanged(ultraGridCell.CalcReference);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			catch
			{
			}
		}

		internal void OnListChangedHelper(ListChangedEventArgs e, bool calledFromBandListChanged)
		{
			UltraGridBase grid = Layout.Grid;
			if (grid != null && grid.RowSynchronizationSuspended)
			{
				DirtyRows();
				return;
			}
			if ((ParentRow != null && !ParentRow.IsStillValid) || (ParentRow == null && this != Layout.Rows))
			{
				UnBind();
				return;
			}
			if (UltraGridBand.binding_debug)
			{
				_ = ParentRow;
			}
			BumpVerifyVersion();
			RowsSparseArray unSortedActualRows = UnSortedActualRows;
			if (!(ResolvedDataList is IBindingList bindingList) || IsRowsDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.ListChangedType)
			{
			case ListChangedType.ItemChanged:
			{
				int newIndex2 = e.NewIndex;
				if (newIndex2 >= 0 && newIndex2 < unSortedActualRows.Count)
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = (UltraGridRow)unSortedActualRows[newIndex2];
					if (ultraGridRow2 == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					ultraGridRow2.BumpChildRowsVerifyVersion();
					if (ultraGridRow2.IsPotentiallyVisibleOnScreen)
					{
						PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = null;
						propertyDescriptor = e.PropertyDescriptor;
						UltraDataSourceListChangedEventArgs e2 = (UltraDataSourceListChangedEventArgs)(object)((e is UltraDataSourceListChangedEventArgs) ? e : null);
						if (e2 != null)
						{
							propertyDescriptor = ((ListChangedEventArgs)(object)e2).PropertyDescriptor;
						}
						if (propertyDescriptor != null)
						{
							UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = band.Columns.FindColumn(propertyDescriptor);
							if (ultraGridColumn != null)
							{
								UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
								bool includeRowSelector = ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridBand.SupportsDataErrorInfoOnRowsResolved && ultraGridBand.RowSelectorExtent > 0;
								string key = ultraGridColumn.Key;
								string text = ((ultraGridBand != null) ? ultraGridBand.AutoPreviewField : string.Empty);
								bool includeRowAutoPreview = ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridBand.Layout != null && ultraGridBand.AutoPreviewEnabled && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(key) && string.Compare(text, key, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0;
								ultraGridRow2.InvalidateCellAllRegions(ultraGridColumn, invalidate: true, dirtyChildElems: true, includeRowSelector, includeRowAutoPreview);
							}
						}
						else
						{
							ultraGridRow2.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
						}
					}
					if (parentRow != null && !ultraGridRow2.AreAllAncestorsCurrentRows)
					{
						ultraGridRow2.FireInitializeRow();
					}
					ultraGridRow2.ParentCollection.NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged(ultraGridRow2);
					UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = ultraGridRow2.RowEditTemplateResolved;
					if (rowEditTemplateResolved != null && (rowEditTemplateResolved.IsShown || rowEditTemplateResolved.Row != null))
					{
						rowEditTemplateResolved.DirtyAllProxies();
						rowEditTemplateResolved.RefreshBindings(Band);
					}
				}
				else if (newIndex2 < 0)
				{
					DirtyRows();
				}
				break;
			}
			case ListChangedType.Reset:
				DirtyRows();
				break;
			case ListChangedType.ItemDeleted:
			{
				if (unSortedActualRows.Count <= bindingList.Count)
				{
					return;
				}
				int newIndex4 = e.NewIndex;
				if (newIndex4 < 0 || newIndex4 >= unSortedActualRows.Count)
				{
					break;
				}
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow5 = (UltraGridRow)unSortedActualRows[newIndex4];
				bool flag3 = ultraGridRow5?.IsActiveRowInternal ?? false;
				unSortedActualRows.RemoveAt(newIndex4);
				if (ultraGridRow5 == null)
				{
					SparseArray.RemoveAt(newIndex4);
				}
				else
				{
					SyncRows_Remove(ultraGridRow5);
					ultraGridRow5.OnDeleted();
					RowDeleted(ultraGridRow5);
				}
				if (!flag3 || grid.ActiveRow != null || !(grid is UltraGrid { SyncWithCurrencyManagerAfterRowDeletionResolved: not false }))
				{
					break;
				}
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand2 = Band;
				if (ultraGridBand2 == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				BindingManagerBase bindingManager = band.BindingManager;
				if (bindingManager != null)
				{
					UltraGridRow rowWithListIndex = GetRowWithListIndex(bindingManager.Position);
					if (rowWithListIndex != null)
					{
						Layout.Grid.SetTempActiveRow(rowWithListIndex, scrollIntoView: false);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case ListChangedType.ItemAdded:
			{
				if (unSortedActualRows.Count >= bindingList.Count)
				{
					if (calledFromBandListChanged)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (e.NewIndex >= 0 && e.NewIndex < unSortedActualRows.Count)
					{
						if (bindingList is DataView && listChanged_LastItemAddedNotification != null && listChanged_LastItemAddedNotification.newIndex != e.NewIndex)
						{
							listChanged_LastItemAddedNotification.fireInitializeRowInItemMoved = true;
							listChanged_LastItemAddedNotification.newIndex = e.NewIndex;
							return;
						}
						listChanged_LastItemAddedNotification = null;
						if (unSortedActualRows[e.NewIndex] is UltraGridRow ultraGridRow3)
						{
							ultraGridRow3.FireInitializeRow();
						}
					}
					else
					{
						if (band.ParentBand == null || e.NewIndex != unSortedActualRows.Count)
						{
							return;
						}
						if (unSortedActualRows.Count == 0)
						{
							DirtyRows();
							return;
						}
						DirtyDataList();
						if (parentRow != null)
						{
							parentRow.InternalDecrementVerifiedVersion();
						}
						InvalidateRowCollection(dirtyGridElem: true);
					}
					return;
				}
				int newIndex3 = e.NewIndex;
				if (newIndex3 < 0 || newIndex3 > unSortedActualRows.Count)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (Band.HookIntoList)
				{
					rowsDirty = false;
				}
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow4 = (inAddingTemplateAddRow ? SyncRows_GetTemplateAddRow() : AllocateNewRow());
				unSortedActualRows.Insert(newIndex3, ultraGridRow4);
				ultraGridRow4.InternalCachedListObject = bindingList[newIndex3];
				if (inAddingTemplateAddRow || band.inAddNew)
				{
					CopyDefaultValuesToAddRow(ultraGridRow4);
				}
				if (verifiedGroupByHierarchyBandsVersion == band.GroupByHierarchyVersion)
				{
					HeaderClickAction headerClickAction = ((Band != null) ? Band.GetHeaderClickActionResolved(changeExternalSortTypesToRegular: false) : HeaderClickAction.Default);
					if (Band != null && (!Band.HasSortedColumns || headerClickAction == HeaderClickAction.ExternalSortMulti || headerClickAction == HeaderClickAction.ExternalSortSingle))
					{
						SyncRows_Add(ultraGridRow4, newIndex3);
					}
					else
					{
						SyncRows_Add(ultraGridRow4);
					}
				}
				if (Band.inAddNew || inAddingTemplateAddRow)
				{
					ultraGridRow4.InternalSetIsAddRow(val: true);
				}
				if (Band.inAddNew)
				{
					Band.addedRow = ultraGridRow4;
				}
				listChanged_LastItemAddedNotification = new LastListChangedEventInfo(e);
				ActivateAddRow(ultraGridRow4);
				ultraGridRow4.FireInitializeRow();
				break;
			}
			case ListChangedType.ItemMoved:
			{
				int oldIndex = e.OldIndex;
				int newIndex = e.NewIndex;
				if (oldIndex >= 0 && oldIndex < unSortedActualRows.Count && newIndex >= 0 && newIndex < unSortedActualRows.Count)
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (UltraGridRow)unSortedActualRows[oldIndex];
					if (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.ListIndex != oldIndex)
					{
						break;
					}
					unSortedActualRows.RemoveAt(oldIndex);
					unSortedActualRows.Insert(newIndex, ultraGridRow);
					if (Layout == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					RowScrollRegion activeRowScrollRegion = Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
					bool flag = true;
					if (activeRowScrollRegion != null && !IsRowsDirty)
					{
						flag = activeRowScrollRegion.WillScrollbarBeShown();
					}
					if (!Band.HasSortedColumns && oldIndex < SparseArray.Count && newIndex < SparseArray.Count)
					{
						int num = SparseArray.IndexOf(ultraGridRow);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							SparseArray.RemoveAt(num);
							SparseArray.Insert(newIndex, ultraGridRow);
						}
					}
					if (listChanged_LastItemAddedNotification != null)
					{
						bool flag2 = listChanged_LastItemAddedNotification.fireInitializeRowInItemMoved && listChanged_LastItemAddedNotification.newIndex == newIndex;
						listChanged_LastItemAddedNotification = null;
						if (flag2)
						{
							ultraGridRow?.FireInitializeRow();
						}
					}
					if (grid is UltraGrid && ((UltraGrid)grid).SyncWithCurrencyManager)
					{
						UltraGridRow activeRow = Layout.ActiveRow;
						if (activeRow != null && activeRow.Band == Band && !IsRowsDirty)
						{
							UltraGridRow currentRow = Band.GetCurrentRow(ensureExpanded: false, dontSyncRows: true);
							if (currentRow != null)
							{
								Layout.Grid.TempActiveRow = currentRow;
							}
						}
					}
					if (!flag && activeRowScrollRegion != null)
					{
						activeRowScrollRegion.FirstRow = null;
					}
				}
				else if (unSortedActualRows != null && bindingList != null && unSortedActualRows.Count != bindingList.Count)
				{
					DirtyRows();
				}
				break;
			}
			}
			if (Layout != null && Layout.Grid is UltraDropDownBase)
			{
				UltraDropDownBase ultraDropDownBase = (UltraDropDownBase)Layout.Grid;
				ultraDropDownBase.FireListChanged();
			}
			DirtyCheckStateCacheValidEntry(null);
			if (Band != null)
			{
				Band.DirtyCheckStateCacheValidEntry(null);
			}
		}

			string columnKey = ((propertyDescriptor != null) ? propertyDescriptor.Name : string.Empty);

			FireDataChanged(args);
		}

		internal bool InternalTraverseRowsHelper(UltraGridBand band, IRowCallback rowCallback, bool recursive, bool includeTemplateAddRows)

			return InternalTraverseRowsHelper(band, rowCallback, null, recursive, includeTemplateAddRows);
		}

		internal bool InternalTraverseRowsHelper(UltraGridBand band, IRowCallback rowCallback, IRowsCollectionCallback rowsCollectionCallback, bool recursive, bool includeTemplateAddRows)
		{
			if (rowsCollectionCallback != null && !rowsCollectionCallback.ProcessRowsCollection(this))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = this[i];
				if (ultraGridRow.Band == band && !rowCallback.ProcessRow(ultraGridRow))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!recursive || (!band.IsDescendantOfBand(ultraGridRow.Band) && (!(ultraGridRow is UltraGridGroupByRow) || band != ultraGridRow.Band)) || ultraGridRow.ChildBands == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < ultraGridRow.ChildBands.Count; j++)
				{
					UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = ultraGridRow.ChildBands[j];
					if (band == ultraGridChildBand.Band || band.IsDescendantOfBand(ultraGridChildBand.Band))
					{
						if (ultraGridChildBand.Rows.InternalTraverseRowsHelper(band, rowCallback, rowsCollectionCallback, recursive, includeTemplateAddRows))
						{
							break;
						}
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			if (includeTemplateAddRows && IsTemplateAddRowVisible && TemplateAddRow != null)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = TemplateAddRow;
				if (ultraGridRow2.Band == band && !rowCallback.ProcessRow(ultraGridRow2))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool InternalTraverseRowsHelper(UltraGridBand band, IRowCallback rowCallback, bool recursive)
		{
			return InternalTraverseRowsHelper(band, rowCallback, recursive, includeTemplateAddRows: false);
		}

		}

				}

		}

		private void SortGroupByRowsHelper()
		{
			if (SparseArray.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridColumn groupByColumn = GroupByColumn;
			if (groupByColumn == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (SortIndicator.Ascending == groupByColumn.SortIndicator)
			{
				if (!verifiedGroupBySortDirectionAscending)
				{
					verifiedGroupBySortDirectionAscending = true;
					if (groupByColumn.GroupByComparer != null)
					{
						SparseArray.Sort(groupByColumn.GroupByComparer);
					}
					else
					{
						SparseArray.Reverse();
					}
				}
			}
			else if (verifiedGroupBySortDirectionAscending)
			{
				verifiedGroupBySortDirectionAscending = false;
				if (groupByColumn.GroupByComparer != null)
				{
					SparseArray.Sort(groupByColumn.GroupByComparer);
				}
				SparseArray.Reverse();
			}
		}

		private void AfterUngroupRows_EnsureActiveRow()
		{
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			if (ParentRow != null || layout == null || !layout.IsDisplayLayout || IsGroupByRows || !(layout.Grid is UltraGrid))
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = layout.Grid.TempActiveRow;
			if (ultraGridRow == null)
			{
				ultraGridRow = layout.ActiveRow;
			}
			if (ultraGridRow == null && layout.Grid is UltraGrid { SyncWithCurrencyManager: not false })
			{
				UltraGridRow currentRow = band.GetCurrentRow(ensureExpanded: false, dontSyncRows: true);
				if (currentRow != null)
				{
					layout.Grid.SetTempActiveRow(currentRow, scrollIntoView: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyGroupByVersion()
		{
			if (band.Layout.GrandVerifyVersion == verifiedGrandVersion_VerifyGroupByVersion || InSyncRows || inInitGroupByRows || inInitNonGroupByRows)
			{
				return;
			}
			RowsCollection topLevelRowsCollection = TopLevelRowsCollection;
			if (topLevelRowsCollection.inInitGroupByRows || topLevelRowsCollection.inInitNonGroupByRows)
			{
				return;
			}
			SortedColumnsCollection internalSortedColumns = Band.InternalSortedColumns;
			bool flag = internalSortedColumns != null;
			if (internalSortedColumns != null && internalSortedColumns.inProcessingNewSortedColumns)
			{
				return;
			}
			verifiedGrandVersion_VerifyGroupByVersion = Band.Layout.GrandVerifyVersion;
			BandReference bandReference = (Band.HasCalcReference ? Band.CalcReference : null);
			bandReference?.SuspendVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas();
			try
			{
				if (verifiedGroupByHierarchyBandsVersion != band.GroupByHierarchyVersion && !(ParentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow))
				{
					if (ViewStyleBand.OutlookGroupBy == band.Layout.ViewStyleBand && band.HasGroupBySortColumns)
					{
						InitGroupByRows();
					}
					else
					{
						InitNonGroupByRows();
					}
					verifiedGroupByHierarchyBandsVersion = band.GroupByHierarchyVersion;
					if (GroupByColumn != null)
					{
						verifiedGroupByHierarchyVersion = GroupByColumn.GroupByHierarchyVersion;
						verifiedGroupBySortDirectionAscending = SortIndicator.Ascending == GroupByColumn.SortIndicator;
					}
					UnSelectRowsNotInCollection();
					AfterUngroupRows_EnsureActiveRow();
					FireInitializeRowsCollection();
				}
				if (!flag || ViewStyleBand.OutlookGroupBy != band.Layout.ViewStyleBand)
				{
					return;
				}
				UltraGridColumn groupByColumn = GroupByColumn;
				if (groupByColumn == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (verifiedGroupByHierarchyVersion != groupByColumn.GroupByHierarchyVersion)
				{
					if (!IsStillValid)
					{
						return;
					}
					InitGroupByRows();
					verifiedGroupBySortDirectionAscending = SortIndicator.Ascending == GroupByColumn.SortIndicator;
					verifiedGroupByHierarchyVersion = GroupByColumn.GroupByHierarchyVersion;
					verifiedGroupByHierarchyBandsVersion = band.GroupByHierarchyVersion;
					Band.Layout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics(setScrollToBeginning: false);
					UnSelectRowsNotInCollection();
					AfterUngroupRows_EnsureActiveRow();
					FireInitializeRowsCollection();
				}
				if (verifiedGroupBySortDirectionAscending != (SortIndicator.Ascending == groupByColumn.SortIndicator))
				{
					SortGroupByRowsHelper();
					verifiedGroupBySortDirectionAscending = SortIndicator.Ascending == groupByColumn.SortIndicator;
					if (calcReference != null && CalcManger != null)
					{
						topLevelRowsCollection.VerifyGroupByVersion_EnsureNotDirtyRecursiveHelper();
					}
				}
				else if (sortVersion != Band.SortedColumns.SortVersion && groupByColumn.GroupByComparer != null)
				{
					sortVersion = Band.SortedColumns.SortVersion;
					SparseArray.Sort(groupByColumn.GroupByComparer);
					if (!verifiedGroupBySortDirectionAscending)
					{
						SparseArray.Reverse();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				bandReference?.ResumeVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas(verifyOnResume: true);
			}
		}

		private void VerifyGroupByVersion_EnsureNotDirtyRecursiveHelper()
		{
			if (IsGroupByRows)
			{
				{
					RowEnumerator rowEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (rowEnumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = (UltraGridGroupByRow)rowEnumerator.Current;
							RowsCollection rows = ultraGridGroupByRow.Rows;
							if (rows != null)
							{
								rows.EnsureNotDirty();
								rows.VerifyGroupByVersion_EnsureNotDirtyRecursiveHelper();
							}
						}
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = rowEnumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (IsTopLevel)
			{
				NotifyCalcManager_RowsCollectionResynced();
			}
		}

		internal void MaintainScrollPositionHelper()
		{
			MaintainScrollPositionHelper(0);
		}

		internal void MaintainScrollPositionHelper(int deltaScrollPos)
		{
			RowScrollRegionsCollection rowScrollRegionsCollection = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.RowScrollRegions : null);
			if (rowScrollRegionsCollection == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < rowScrollRegionsCollection.Count; i++)
			{
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = rowScrollRegionsCollection[i];
				UltraGridRow internalFirstRow = rowScrollRegion.InternalFirstRow;
				if (internalFirstRow != null && internalFirstRow.IsDescendantOf(this))
				{
					int num = (rowScrollRegion.HasScrollBarInfo ? rowScrollRegion.ScrollBarInfo.Value : 0);
					num = Math.Max(0, num + deltaScrollPos);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						rowScrollRegion.AfterSortScrollPositionToMaintain = num;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!IsCardRows || !IsPotentiallyVisibleOnScreen)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (CardStyle.VariableHeight != Band.CardSettings.StyleResolved && CardStyle.Compressed != Band.CardSettings.StyleResolved)
			{
				ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegions = Layout.ColScrollRegions;
				for (int j = 0; j < rowScrollRegionsCollection.Count; j++)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < colScrollRegions.Count; k++)
					{
						CardAreaUIElement cardAreaElement = GetCardAreaElement(rowScrollRegionsCollection[j], colScrollRegions[k], verifyElements: false);
						if (cardAreaElement != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)cardAreaElement).Disposed)
						{
							cardAreaElement.MaintainScrollPositionHelper();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			firstVisibleCard = null;
		}

		private void EnsureSortOrder()
		{
			bool flag = inEnsureSortOrder;
			inEnsureSortOrder = true;
			try
			{
				if (Band.Layout.GrandVerifyVersion == verifiedGrandVersion_EnsureSortOrder)
				{
					return;
				}
				SortedColumnsCollection internalSortedColumns = Band.InternalSortedColumns;
				if ((internalSortedColumns != null && internalSortedColumns.inProcessingNewSortedColumns) || InSyncRows)
				{
					return;
				}
				verifiedGrandVersion_EnsureSortOrder = Band.Layout.GrandVerifyVersion;
				if (internalSortedColumns == null || internalSortedColumns.SortVersion == sortVersion || internalSortedColumns.Count < 1 || GroupByColumn != null || base.Disposed || (SparseArray.Count > 0 && SparseArray[0] != null && this != ((UltraGridRow)SparseArray[0]).ParentCollection))
				{
					return;
				}
				sortVersion = band.SortedColumns.SortVersion;
				ClearMergedCellCache();
				HeaderClickAction headerClickActionResolved = band.GetHeaderClickActionResolved(changeExternalSortTypesToRegular: false);
				if (HeaderClickAction.ExternalSortSingle == headerClickActionResolved || HeaderClickAction.ExternalSortMulti == headerClickActionResolved)
				{
					if (parentRow != null && parentRow.IsGroupByRow)
					{
						SparseArray.Sort(new ListIndexComparer());
						MoveFixedRowsToProperLocation();
						MaintainScrollPositionHelper();
					}
				}
				else if (SparseArray.Count > 1)
				{
					UltraGridRow[] array = SparseArray.ToArray(create: true);
					if (array[0] == null || !array[0].IsGroupByRow)
					{
						Utilities.SortMergeGeneric<UltraGridRow>(array, (IComparer<UltraGridRow>)new RowsSortComparer(this));
						SparseArray.Clear();
						SparseArray.AddRange(array);
						hasMovedRows = false;
						MoveFixedRowsToProperLocation();
						MaintainScrollPositionHelper();
						NotifyCalcManager_RowsCollectionSorted();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inEnsureSortOrder = flag;
			}
		}

		int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (x == null)
			{
				if (y == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (band.HasSortedColumns && band.SortedColumns[0].SortIndicator == SortIndicator.Descending)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				return -1;
			}
			if (y == null)
			{
				if (band.HasSortedColumns && band.SortedColumns[0].SortIndicator == SortIndicator.Descending)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 1;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = x as UltraGridRow;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = y as UltraGridRow;
			IComparer comparer = null;
			if (ultraGridRow == ultraGridRow2)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (CurrentAddRow != null && (ultraGridRow == CurrentAddRow || ultraGridRow2 == CurrentAddRow))
			{
				TemplateAddRowLocation templateRowLocationDefault = TemplateRowLocationDefault;
				if (TemplateAddRowLocation.Top == templateRowLocationDefault)
				{
					if (ultraGridRow != CurrentAddRow)
					{
						return 1;
					}
					return -1;
				}
				if (TemplateAddRowLocation.Bottom == templateRowLocationDefault)
				{
					if (ultraGridRow != CurrentAddRow)
					{
						return -1;
					}
					return 1;
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < band.SortedColumns.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = band.SortedColumns[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn.Index < 0)
				{
					continue;
				}
				comparer = ultraGridColumn.SortComparer;
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = null;
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell2 = null;
				object obj = null;
				object obj2 = null;
				if (comparer != null)
				{
					ultraGridCell = ultraGridRow.Cells[ultraGridColumn];
					ultraGridCell2 = ultraGridRow2.Cells[ultraGridColumn];
					num = comparer.Compare(ultraGridCell, ultraGridCell2);
				}
				else
				{
					if (ultraGridColumn.IsBound)
					{
						obj = ultraGridRow.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn);
						obj2 = ultraGridRow2.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn);
					}
					else
					{
						obj = ultraGridRow.Cells[ultraGridColumn].Value;
						obj2 = ultraGridRow2.Cells[ultraGridColumn].Value;
					}
					EmbeddableEditorBase editor = ultraGridColumn.GetEditor(ultraGridRow);
					EmbeddableEditorBase editor2 = ultraGridColumn.GetEditor(ultraGridRow2);
					bool flag = true;
					if (editor == editor2)
					{
						if (editor != null && !editor.ComparesByValue((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)ultraGridColumn.EditorOwnerInfo, (object)ultraGridRow))
						{
							flag = false;
						}
					}
					else if (editor != null && !editor.ComparesByValue((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)ultraGridColumn.EditorOwnerInfo, (object)ultraGridRow))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					else if (editor2 != null && !editor2.ComparesByValue((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)ultraGridColumn.EditorOwnerInfo, (object)ultraGridRow2))
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						obj = ultraGridRow.GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
						obj2 = ultraGridRow2.GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
					}
					num = RowsSortComparer.DefaultCompare(obj, obj2, ultraGridColumn);
				}
				if (num != 0)
				{
					if (band.SortedColumns[i].SortIndicator == SortIndicator.Descending)
					{
						num *= -1;
					}
					return num;
				}
			}
			if (num == 0 && ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow2 != null && ultraGridRow != ultraGridRow2)
			{
				num = ((ultraGridRow.ListIndex >= ultraGridRow2.ListIndex) ? 1 : (-1));
			}
			return num;
		}

		private void CreateGroupByRowRows(UltraGridRow[] rows, ref int startIndex, bool rowsAlreadySorted)
		{
			SparseArray.Clear();
			UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = ParentRow as UltraGridGroupByRow;
			while (startIndex < rows.Length)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = rows[startIndex];
				if (ultraGridGroupByRow != null && SparseArray.Count > 0 && !ultraGridGroupByRow.DoesRowMatchGroup(ultraGridRow, recursive: true))
				{
					break;
				}
				SparseArray.Add(ultraGridRow);
				ultraGridRow.InitRowsCollection(this);
				startIndex++;
			}
			rowsDirty = false;
			if (rowsAlreadySorted)
			{
				sortVersion = band.SortedColumns.SortVersion;
			}
		}

		private void CreateGroupByRowsHelper(UltraGridRow[] rows, ref int startIndex, bool rowsAlreadySorted)
		{
			UltraGridColumn groupByColumn = GroupByColumn;
			ScrollCountManagerSparseArray scrollCountManagerSparseArray = SparseArray;
			scrollCountManagerSparseArray.Clear();
			hasMovedRows = false;
			UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = ParentRow as UltraGridGroupByRow;
			UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow2 = null;
			while (startIndex < rows.Length)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = rows[startIndex];
				if (ultraGridGroupByRow != null && scrollCountManagerSparseArray.Count > 0 && !ultraGridGroupByRow.DoesRowMatchGroup(ultraGridRow, recursive: true))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (ultraGridGroupByRow2 == null || !ultraGridGroupByRow2.DoesRowMatchGroup(ultraGridRow, recursive: false))
				{
					ultraGridGroupByRow2 = new UltraGridGroupByRow(band, this, groupByColumn, ultraGridRow);
					scrollCountManagerSparseArray.Add(ultraGridGroupByRow2);

		internal int CalculateCardAreaScrollRange(int heightAvailableForCards, int firstVisibleCardIndex, out int scrollBarValue)
		{
			scrollBarValue = 0;
			int cardSpacingVertical = Band.CardSpacingVertical;
			int num = heightAvailableForCards;
			int num2 = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < VisibleRowCount; i++)
			{
				UltraGridRow rowAtVisibleIndex = GetRowAtVisibleIndex(i);
				if (rowAtVisibleIndex == null || rowAtVisibleIndex.HiddenInternal)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int cardHeight = rowAtVisibleIndex.CardHeight;
				if (num < cardHeight)
				{
					num = heightAvailableForCards - cardHeight - cardSpacingVertical;
					num2++;
				}
				else
				{
					num -= cardHeight + cardSpacingVertical;
					if (num2 == 0)
					{
						num2 = 1;
					}
				}
				if (scrollBarValue == 0 && firstVisibleCardIndex <= i)
				{
					scrollBarValue = num2 - 1;
				}
			}
			if (scrollBarValue == 0)
			{
				scrollBarValue = num2;
			}
			return num2 - 1;
		}

					}

		internal int GetScrollIndex(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			int num = SparseArray.ScrollIndexOf(row);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				num += GetSpecialRowsScrollCount(top: true);
			}
			else
			{
				num = GetSpecialRowScrollIndex(row, top: true);
				if (num < 0)
				{
					num = GetSpecialRowScrollIndex(row, top: false);
					if (num >= 0)
					{
						num += GetSpecialRowsScrollCount(top: true) + SparseArray.ScrollCount;
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

					num = GetSpecialRowVisibleIndex(row, top: true);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						num = GetSpecialRowVisibleIndex(row, top: false);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							num += GetSpecialRowsVisibleCount(top: true) + SparseArray.VisibleCount;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		private UltraGridRow GetRowAtScrollIndex(int scrollIndex, bool allocate)
		{
			if (IsCardRows)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
				if (scrollIndex == 0)
				{
					ultraGridRow = GetFirstVisibleRow();

					{
						ultraGridRow = this[0];
					}
				}
				return ultraGridRow;
			}
			if (scrollIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = GetSpecialRowAtScrollIndex(scrollIndex, top: true);
			if (ultraGridRow2 == null)
			{
				scrollIndex -= GetSpecialRowsScrollCount(top: true);
				ultraGridRow2 = SparseArray.GetItemAtScrollIndex(scrollIndex, allocate);
				if (ultraGridRow2 == null)
				{
					scrollIndex -= SparseArray.ScrollCount;
					ultraGridRow2 = GetSpecialRowAtScrollIndex(scrollIndex, top: false);
				}
			}
			return ultraGridRow2;
		}

		internal void EnsureFiltersEvaluated()
		{
			if (ensureFiltersEvaluated_verifiedFiltersGrandVersion == band.Layout.GrandVerifyVersion)
			{
				return;
			}
			SortedColumnsCollection internalSortedColumns = band.InternalSortedColumns;
			if (InSyncRows || (internalSortedColumns != null && internalSortedColumns.inProcessingNewSortedColumns) || inInitGroupByRows || TopLevelRowsCollection.inInitGroupByRows)
			{
				return;
			}
			ensureFiltersEvaluated_verifiedFiltersGrandVersion = band.Layout.GrandVerifyVersion;
			if (RowFiltersVersion == ensureFiltersEvaluated_verifiedFiltersVersion || inEnsureFiltersEvaluated)
			{
				return;
			}
			inEnsureFiltersEvaluated = true;
			try
			{
				EnsureNotDirty();
				VerifyFilterInfo();
				ensureFiltersEvaluated_verifiedFiltersVersion = RowFiltersVersion;
				if (base.Disposed)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (sparseArray != null)
				{
					sparseArray.DirtyScrollCount();
				}
				ClearMergedCellCache();
				bool flag = true;
				if (IsGroupByRows)
				{
					if (verifiedGroupByHierarchyBandsVersion != band.GroupByHierarchyVersion)
					{
						return;
					}
					foreach (UltraGridGroupByRow item in SparseArray)
					{
						item.Rows.EnsureFiltersEvaluated();
						flag = flag && item.InternalIsFilteredOut;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ColumnFiltersCollection activeColumnFilters = ActiveColumnFilters;
					cachedAreAnyFiltersActive = activeColumnFilters?.IsAnyColumnFilterActive ?? false;
					UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
					IUltraCalcManager ultraCalcManager = (layout?.Grid)?.CalcManager;
					if (ultraCalcManager != null && cachedAreAnyFiltersActive)
					{
						List<ColumnReference> list = new List<ColumnReference>();
						for (int i = 0; i < activeColumnFilters.Count; i++)
						{
							ColumnFilter columnFilter = (activeColumnFilters.HasColumnFilter(i) ? activeColumnFilters[i] : null);
							if (columnFilter != null && columnFilter.HasFilterConditions)
							{
								UltraGridColumn column = columnFilter.Column;
								if (column != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(column.Formula))
								{
									list.Add(column.CalcReference);
								}
							}
						}
						if (list.Count > 0)
						{
							ultraCalcManager.ProcessEventQueue();
							try
							{
								foreach (ColumnReference item2 in list)
								{
									item2.disableRecalcDeferredOverride = true;
								}
								foreach (ColumnReference item3 in list)
								{
									layout.AddRecalcDeferredFormulasToRecalcChain_Helper(item3);
									ultraCalcManager.EnsureCalculated(item3, wait: true);
								}
							}
							finally
							{
								foreach (ColumnReference item4 in list)
								{
									item4.disableRecalcDeferredOverride = false;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					foreach (UltraGridRow nonNullItem in SparseArray.NonNullItems)
					{
						nonNullItem.ApplyFilters(activeColumnFilters);
						flag = flag && nonNullItem.InternalIsFilteredOut;
						SparseArray.NotifyItemScrollCountChanged(nonNullItem);
					}
					UltraGridCell activeCell = Layout.ActiveCell;
					if (activeCell != null && activeCell.IsInEditMode && activeCell.Row.IsDescendantOf(this) && activeCell.Row.HiddenResolved)
					{
						activeCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: true);
					}
				}
				if (parentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow2)
				{
					ultraGridGroupByRow2.InternalIsFilteredOut = flag;
				}
				if (Layout != null && Layout.CachedRowData != null)
				{
					Layout.CachedRowData.Clear();
				}
				DataChanged_DirtySummaries();
				if (FormulaRowIndexSource.VisibleIndex == Band.FormulaRowIndexSourceResolved)
				{
					NotifyCalcManager_RowsCollectionResynced();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inEnsureFiltersEvaluated = false;
			}
		}

		{

		internal void MoveRowToCorrectSortOrder(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			ScrollCountManagerSparseArray scrollCountManagerSparseArray = SparseArray;
			int num = scrollCountManagerSparseArray.IndexOf(row);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			IComparer comparer2;
			if (row.IsGroupByRow)
			{
				IComparer comparer = new GroupByRowsSortComparer(this);
				comparer2 = comparer;
			}
			else
			{
				IComparer comparer = new RowsSortComparer(this);
				comparer2 = comparer;
			}
			IComparer comparer3 = comparer2;
			FixedRowsCollection fixedRows = FixedRows;
			bool flag = row.Fixed;
			int num2;
			int num3;
			if (flag)
			{
				if (fixedRows.TopFixed)
				{
					num2 = 0;
					num3 = fixedRows.Count - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = scrollCountManagerSparseArray.Count - fixedRows.Count;
					num3 = scrollCountManagerSparseArray.Count - 1;
				}
			}
			else if (fixedRows.TopFixed)
			{
				num2 = fixedRows.Count;
				num3 = scrollCountManagerSparseArray.Count - 1;
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = 0;
				num3 = scrollCountManagerSparseArray.Count - 1 - fixedRows.Count;
			}
			while (num2 <= num3)
			{
				int num4 = (num2 + num3) / 2;
				UltraGridRow item = scrollCountManagerSparseArray.GetItem(num4, create: true);
				if (row == item)
				{
					if (num2 == num3)
					{
						break;
					}
					item = scrollCountManagerSparseArray.GetItem(++num4, create: true);
				}
				int num5 = comparer3.Compare(row, item);
				if (num5 < 0)
				{
					num3 = num4 - 1;
				}
				else if (num5 > 0)
				{
					num2 = num4 + 1;
				}
				else if (num < num4)
				{
					num3 = num4 - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					num2 = num4 + 1;
				}
			}
			if (num != num2)
			{
				int newIndex = ((num < num2) ? (num2 - 1) : num2);
				Move(row, newIndex, forceDirtyPrimaryMetrics: true);
				if (flag)
				{
					fixedRows.Move(row, newIndex);
				}
				MaintainScrollPositionHelper();
			}
		}
