		private void GetSpecialRowsHelper(Type rowType, List<UltraGridRow> list, bool top, UltraGridRow[] rowsToRecycle)
		{
			bool flag = ParentChildBand?.CollapsedResolved ?? false;
			if (typeof(UltraGridRow) == rowType && !flag)
			{
				TemplateAddRowLocation templateAddRowLocation = (top ? TemplateAddRowLocation.Top : TemplateAddRowLocation.Bottom);
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
				if (templateAddRowLocation == TemplateRowLocationResolved)
				{
					ultraGridRow = TemplateAddRow;
				}
				else if (currentAddRow != null && templateAddRowLocation == TemplateRowLocationDefault)
				{
					ultraGridRow = currentAddRow;
				}
				if (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					list.Add(ultraGridRow);
				}
			}
			if (top && typeof(UltraGridFilterRow) == rowType && !flag && IsFilterRowVisibleHelper)
			{
				list.Add(FilterRow);
			}
			if (typeof(UltraGridSummaryRow) == rowType && !flag && Band.HasSummaries)
			{
				Band.Summaries.GetSummaryRows(list, top, this, rowsToRecycle);
			}
			if (top && typeof(UltraGridEmptyMessageRow) == rowType && !flag && band.Layout.Grid.DataSource != null)
			{
				UltraGridEmptyMessageRow ultraGridEmptyMessageRow = null;
				bool noRowsInDataSourceMessageEnabledResolved = band.NoRowsInDataSourceMessageEnabledResolved;
				bool noVisibleRowsMessageEnabledResolved = band.NoVisibleRowsMessageEnabledResolved;
				if (band.RowFilterActionResolved == RowFilterAction.None)
				{
					if (Count == 0)
					{
						bool isAnyColumnFilterActive = band.ColumnFilters.IsAnyColumnFilterActive;
						if (isAnyColumnFilterActive && noVisibleRowsMessageEnabledResolved)
						{
							ultraGridEmptyMessageRow = CreateEmptyMessageRow(rowsToRecycle, EmptyMessageUIElement.EmptyMessageType.NoVisibleRows);
						}
						else if (!isAnyColumnFilterActive && noRowsInDataSourceMessageEnabledResolved)
						{
							ultraGridEmptyMessageRow = CreateEmptyMessageRow(rowsToRecycle, EmptyMessageUIElement.EmptyMessageType.NoRows);
						}
					}
				}
				else if (Count == 0 && noRowsInDataSourceMessageEnabledResolved)
				{
					ultraGridEmptyMessageRow = CreateEmptyMessageRow(rowsToRecycle, EmptyMessageUIElement.EmptyMessageType.NoRows);
				}
				else if (noVisibleRowsMessageEnabledResolved && Count > 0 && GetVisibleRowCount(includeSpecialRows: false) == 0)
				{
					ultraGridEmptyMessageRow = CreateEmptyMessageRow(rowsToRecycle, EmptyMessageUIElement.EmptyMessageType.NoVisibleRows);
				}
				if (ultraGridEmptyMessageRow != null)
				{
					list.Add(ultraGridEmptyMessageRow);
				}
			}
			if (top && typeof(UltraGridPlaceholderRow) == rowType && ShouldAddPlaceholderChildRow)
			{
				list.Add(PlaceHolderRow);
			}
		}

		private void GetSpecialRowsHelper(List<UltraGridRow> list, bool top, UltraGridRow[] rowsToRecycle)
		{

			}
			if (!flag2 && !flag3)

			}
			Type[] array;
			if (!flag2 && flag3)
			{
				array = new Type[1] { typeof(UltraGridEmptyMessageRow) };
			}
			else
			{
				long[] array2 = new long[5]
				{
					ultraGridBand.GetSequenceSummaryRowResolved(top),
					ultraGridBand.GetSequenceFilterRowResolved(top),
					ultraGridBand.GetSequenceEmptyMessageRowResolved(top),
					ultraGridBand.GetSequenceFixedAddRowResolved(top),
					ultraGridBand.GetSequencePlaceholderRowResolved(top)
				};
				array = new Type[5]
				{
					typeof(UltraGridSummaryRow),
					typeof(UltraGridFilterRow),
					typeof(UltraGridEmptyMessageRow),
					typeof(UltraGridRow),
					typeof(UltraGridPlaceholderRow)
				};
				for (int i = 0; i < array2.Length; i++)
				{
					for (int j = 1 + i; j < array2.Length; j++)
					{
						if (array2[i] > array2[j])
						{
							GridUtils.Swap(array2, i, j);
							GridUtils.Swap(array, i, j);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
			{
				GetSpecialRowsHelper(array[k], list, top, rowsToRecycle);
			}
			if (!flag || !layout.ViewStyleImpl.Using_CreateRowsList_FixedRowsFeature)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag4 = false;
			switch (ultraGridBand.HeaderPlacementResolved)
			{
			case HeaderPlacement.RepeatOnBreak:
			case HeaderPlacement.OncePerRowIsland:
				flag4 = true;
				break;
			case HeaderPlacement.OncePerGroupedRowIsland:
				if (IsTopLevel)
				{
					flag4 = true;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (flag4)
			{
				list.Add(CreateHeadersRow(rowsToRecycle));
			}
		}

		private HeadersRow CreateHeadersRow(UltraGridRow[] rowsToRecycle)
		{
			if (rowsToRecycle != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < rowsToRecycle.Length; i++)
				{
					if (rowsToRecycle[i] is HeadersRow result)
					{
						rowsToRecycle[i] = null;
						return result;
					}
				}
			}
			return new HeadersRow(this, isAttachedHeader: false);
		}

		private UltraGridEmptyMessageRow CreateEmptyMessageRow(UltraGridRow[] rowsToRecycle, EmptyMessageUIElement.EmptyMessageType emptyMessageType)
		{
			if (rowsToRecycle != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < rowsToRecycle.Length; i++)
				{
					if (rowsToRecycle[i] is UltraGridEmptyMessageRow ultraGridEmptyMessageRow && ultraGridEmptyMessageRow.ParentCollection == this)
					{
						if (ultraGridEmptyMessageRow.EmptyMessageType != emptyMessageType)
						{
							ChangeEmptyMessageType(ultraGridEmptyMessageRow, emptyMessageType);
						}
						rowsToRecycle[i] = null;
						return ultraGridEmptyMessageRow;
					}
				}
			}
			return new UltraGridEmptyMessageRow(band, this, emptyMessageType);
		}

		internal void ChangeEmptyMessageType(UltraGridEmptyMessageRow emptyMessageRow, EmptyMessageUIElement.EmptyMessageType emptyMessageType)
		{
			emptyMessageRow.EmptyMessageType = emptyMessageType;
		}

		}

		private void CalcSpecialAndFixedRowsHelper(out List<UltraGridRow> outSpecialRows, out List<UltraGridRow> outFixedRows, bool top, UltraGridRow[] rowsToRecycle)
		{
			outSpecialRows = null;
			outFixedRows = null;
			bool supportsFixedRows = SupportsFixedRows;
			List<UltraGridRow> list = new List<UltraGridRow>(10);
			List<UltraGridRow> list2 = new List<UltraGridRow>(5);
			GetSpecialRowsHelper(list2, top, rowsToRecycle);
			if (!top)
			{
				AddFixedRows(list, top);
			}
			if (list2 != null && list2.Count > 0)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (list2.Contains(templateAddRow) ? templateAddRow : ((!list2.Contains(currentAddRow)) ? null : currentAddRow));
				if (supportsFixedRows && ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					if (AllowAddNew.FixedAddRowOnTop == Band.AllowAddNewResolved)
					{
						ultraGridRow.InternalSetFixedResolvedOverride(FixedRowStyle.Top);
					}
					else if (AllowAddNew.FixedAddRowOnBottom == Band.AllowAddNewResolved)
					{
						ultraGridRow.InternalSetFixedResolvedOverride(FixedRowStyle.Bottom);
					}
					else
					{
						ultraGridRow.InternalSetFixedResolvedOverride(FixedRowStyle.Default);
					}
				}
				int num = -1;
				int num2 = -1;
				if (top ? HasFixedDataRowsVisibleOnTop : HasFixedDataRowsVisibleOnBottom)
				{
					num2 = 0;
					num = list2.Count - 1;
				}
				else
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
					{
						UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = list2[i];
						if (ultraGridRow2.FixedResolved)
						{
							if (num2 < 0)
							{
								num2 = i;
							}
							num = i;
						}
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < list2.Count; j++)
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow3 = list2[j];
					bool num3;
					if (!top)
					{
						if (num2 >= 0)
						{
							num3 = j >= num2;
							goto IL_0144;
						}
					}
					else if (num >= 0)
					{
						num3 = j <= num;
						goto IL_0144;
					}
					goto IL_015e;
					IL_0144:
					if (num3)
					{
						ultraGridRow3.InternalSetFixedResolvedOverride(top ? FixedRowStyle.Top : FixedRowStyle.Bottom);
						list.Add(ultraGridRow3);
						continue;
					}
					goto IL_015e;
					IL_015e:
					if (ultraGridRow3 == currentAddRow)
					{
						list2.RemoveAt(j);
						if (num2 > j)
						{
							num2--;
						}
						if (num > j)
						{
							num--;
						}
						j--;
					}
				}
			}
			if (top)
			{
				AddFixedRows(list, top);
			}
			outSpecialRows = list2;
			outFixedRows = list;
		}

		internal void EnsureSpecialAndFixedRowsCacheCalculated()
		{
			if (verifiedSpecialRowsCacheVersion != Layout.GrandVerifyVersion)
			{
				verifiedSpecialRowsCacheVersion = Layout.GrandVerifyVersion;
				CalcSpecialAndFixedRowsHelper(out var outSpecialRows, out var outFixedRows, top: true, cachedSpecialRowsTop);
				bool flag = outFixedRows.Count != ((cachedFixedRowsTop != null) ? cachedFixedRowsTop.Length : 0) || outSpecialRows.Count != ((cachedSpecialRowsTop != null) ? cachedSpecialRowsTop.Length : 0);
				cachedSpecialRowsTop = ToRowArrayHelper(outSpecialRows);
				cachedFixedRowsTop = ToRowArrayHelper(outFixedRows);
				CalcSpecialAndFixedRowsHelper(out outSpecialRows, out outFixedRows, top: false, cachedSpecialRowsBottom);
				flag = flag || outFixedRows.Count != ((cachedFixedRowsBottom != null) ? cachedFixedRowsBottom.Length : 0) || outSpecialRows.Count != ((cachedSpecialRowsBottom != null) ? cachedSpecialRowsBottom.Length : 0);
				cachedSpecialRowsBottom = ToRowArrayHelper(outSpecialRows);
				cachedFixedRowsBottom = ToRowArrayHelper(outFixedRows);
				if (flag)
				{
					DirtyParentRowScrollCount(dirtyFixedRowsCollection: false);
				}
			}
		}

		private int FixedAddRow_TranslateIndex(int index, bool toExternalIndexSpace)
		{
			if (currentAddRow == null)
			{
				return index;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = currentAddRow;
			int specialRowIndex = GetSpecialRowIndex(ultraGridRow, top: true);
			int specialRowIndex2 = GetSpecialRowIndex(ultraGridRow, top: false);
			if (specialRowIndex >= 0 || specialRowIndex2 >= 0)
			{
				int num = SparseArray.IndexOf(ultraGridRow);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					num += GetSpecialRowsCount(top: true);
					if (index >= num)
					{
						index += ((!toExternalIndexSpace) ? 1 : (-1));
					}
				}
			}
			return index;
		}

		}

		internal int GetRowIndex(UltraGridRow row, bool includeSpecialRows)
		{
			EnsureNotDirty();
			int num = SparseArray.IndexOf(row);
			if (includeSpecialRows)
			{
				if (row == currentAddRow && (GetSpecialRowIndex(row, top: true) >= 0 || GetSpecialRowIndex(row, top: false) >= 0))
				{
					num = -1;
				}
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					num += GetSpecialRowsCount(top: true);
				}
				else
				{
					num = GetSpecialRowIndex(row, top: true);
					if (num < 0)
					{
						num = GetSpecialRowIndex(row, top: false);
						if (num >= 0)
						{
							num += GetSpecialRowsCount(top: true) + SparseArray.Count;
						}
					}
				}
				num = FixedAddRow_TranslateIndex(num, toExternalIndexSpace: true);
			}
			return num;
		}

				num = FixedAddRow_TranslateIndex(num, toExternalIndexSpace: true);
			}

		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetRowAtIndex(int index, bool includeSpecialRows)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				if (includeSpecialRows)
				{
					index = FixedAddRow_TranslateIndex(index, toExternalIndexSpace: false);
					UltraGridRow specialRowAtIndex = GetSpecialRowAtIndex(index, top: true);
					if (specialRowAtIndex != null)
					{
						return specialRowAtIndex;
					}
					index -= GetSpecialRowsCount(top: true);
				}
				int count = Count;
				if (index >= 0 && index < count)
				{
					return this[index];
				}
				index -= count;
				if (includeSpecialRows)
				{
					return GetSpecialRowAtIndex(index, top: false);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetFirstScrollableRow()
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			int i = 0;
			for (int scrollCount = ScrollCount; i < scrollCount; i++)
			{
				ultraGridRow = GetRowAtScrollIndex(i);
				if (ultraGridRow == null || !ultraGridRow.FixedResolved)
				{
					break;
				}
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetLastScrollableRow()
		{
			for (int num = ScrollCount - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				UltraGridRow rowAtScrollIndex = GetRowAtScrollIndex(num);
				if (rowAtScrollIndex == null || !rowAtScrollIndex.FixedResolved)
				{
					return rowAtScrollIndex;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool CanNavigateToViaSelectionStrategy(UltraGridRow row, bool shiftKeyDown, bool ctrlKeyDown)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridBase ultraGridBase = Layout?.Grid;
			ISelectionStrategy val = ((ultraGridBase != null) ? ((ISelectionManager)ultraGridBase).GetSelectionStrategy((ISelectableItem)row) : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return val.CanItemBeNavigatedTo((ISelectableItem)row, shiftKeyDown, ctrlKeyDown);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetFirstLastActivatableRow(bool first, bool checkForSelectionStrategyNavigation, bool shiftKeyDown, bool ctrlKeyDown)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (first ? GetFirstVisibleRow() : GetLastVisibleRow());
			while (ultraGridRow != null && (Activation.Disabled == ultraGridRow.ActivationResolvedInternal || (checkForSelectionStrategyNavigation && !CanNavigateToViaSelectionStrategy(ultraGridRow, shiftKeyDown, ctrlKeyDown))))
			{
				ultraGridRow = GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(ultraGridRow, first ? 1 : (-1));
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		public void ExpandAllCards()
		{
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if ((ultraGridBand == null || (ultraGridBand.CardView && ultraGridBand.CardSettings.Style == CardStyle.Compressed)) && (layout == null || layout.ExitEditModeHelper()))
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					this[i].IsCardCompressed = false;
				}
			}
		}

		public void CollapseAllCards()
		{
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if ((ultraGridBand == null || (ultraGridBand.CardView && ultraGridBand.CardSettings.Style == CardStyle.Compressed)) && (layout == null || layout.ExitEditModeHelper()))

				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					this[i].IsCardCompressed = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal CheckState GetHeaderCheckState(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (band == null || !band.Columns.Contains(column))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_RowsCollection_ColumnNotInBand"));
			}
			if (!IsCachedCheckStateValid(column))
			{
				CheckState state = ((column.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved != HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.None) ? column.GetHeaderCheckedStateBasedOnCellValues(this) : CheckState.Unchecked);
				SetCheckStateCache(column, state, isCancelable: false, synchronize: false);
			}
			return checkStateCache[column];
		}

		private bool IsCachedCheckStateValid(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column.Band != null && column.Band.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion != currentHeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion && column.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved != HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.None)
			{
				currentHeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion = column.Band.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationVersion;
				DirtyCheckStateCacheValidEntry(null);
				return false;
			}
			if (!checkStateCacheValidHashTable.ContainsKey(column))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return checkStateCacheValidHashTable[column];
		}

		internal void DirtyCheckStateCacheValidEntry(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				if (Band == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (UltraGridColumn column2 in Band.Columns)
					{
						if (column2.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved != HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.None)
						{
							checkStateCacheValidHashTable[column2] = false;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			checkStateCacheValidHashTable[column] = false;
		}

		internal void SetCheckStateCache(UltraGridColumn column, CheckState state, bool isCancelable, bool synchronize)
		{
			if (synchronize && Layout.Grid is UltraGrid { ActiveCell: not null } ultraGrid && ultraGrid.ActiveCell.IsInEditMode && ultraGrid.ActiveCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: false))
			{
				return;
			}
			CheckState checkState = state;
			bool flag = checkStateCache.ContainsKey(column);
			if (!flag || checkStateCache[column] != checkState)
			{
				UltraGridBase grid = Layout.Grid;
				BeforeHeaderCheckStateChangedEventArgs e = new BeforeHeaderCheckStateChangedEventArgs(column, this, state, flag ? checkStateCache[column] : CheckState.Indeterminate, isCancelable);
				grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeHeaderCheckStateChanged, e);
				if (e.Cancel && isCancelable)
				{
					return;
				}
				checkState = e.NewCheckState;
				checkStateCache[column] = checkState;
				column.DirtyHeaderUIElements(this);
				if (synchronize && column.HeaderCheckBoxSynchronizationResolved == HeaderCheckBoxSynchronization.RowsCollection && checkState != CheckState.Indeterminate)
				{
					column.SetCellValuesBasedOnCheckState(this, checkState);
				}
				grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.AfterHeaderCheckStateChanged, new AfterHeaderCheckStateChangedEventArgs(column, this));
			}
			checkStateCacheValidHashTable[column] = true;
		}

		internal void FireDataChanged(CheckedListSettings.DataChangedEventArgs args)
		{
			if (this.DataChanged != null)
			{
				this.DataChanged(this, args);
			}
		}

		internal void RaiseDataChangedEvent(string columnKey)
		{
			CheckedListSettings.DataChangedEventArgs args = new CheckedListSettings.DataChangedEventArgs(null, columnKey, null);
			FireDataChanged(args);
		}

		IEnumerator<UltraGridRow> IEnumerable<UltraGridRow>.GetEnumerator()
		{
			RowEnumerator rowEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (rowEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					yield return rowEnumerator.Current;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = rowEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		private bool ShouldByPassCalcManagerNotifications()
		{
			if (CalcManger != null && !Layout.CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended && !TopLevelRowsCollection.inSyncRows)
			{
				return TopLevelRowsCollection.inInitGroupByRows;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void BumpRemovedRowsVersion()
		{
			if (removedRowsVersion < int.MaxValue)
			{
				removedRowsVersion++;
			}
			else
			{
				removedRowsVersion = int.MinValue;
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridCell GetLastCheckedRadioButtonCell()
		{
			if (lastCheckedRadioButtonCellRef == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return GridUtils.GetWeakReferenceTarget(lastCheckedRadioButtonCellRef) as UltraGridCell;
		}

	public class RowEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		private IEnumerator enumerator;

		object IEnumerator.Current => enumerator.Current;

		public UltraGridRow Current => (UltraGridRow)enumerator.Current;

		public RowEnumerator(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			enumerator = rows.SparseArray.GetEnumerator(rows.SparseArray);
		}

		public RowEnumerator(SelectedRowsCollection rows)
		{
			enumerator = ((IEnumerable)rows).GetEnumerator();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			enumerator.Reset();
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			return enumerator.MoveNext();
		}
	}
	public class RowsCollectionAccessibleObject : AccessibleObjectWrapper

		private RowsCollection rowsCollection;

		public override Rectangle Bounds
		{
			get
			{
				if (rowsCollection != null && rowsCollection.Band != null)
				{
					if (!(rowsCollection.Band.Layout.UIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(DataAreaUIElement)) is DataAreaUIElement dataAreaUIElement))
					{
						return Rectangle.Empty;
					}
					Control control = ((UIElement)dataAreaUIElement).Control;
					if (IsRootRowsCollection && control != null)
					{
						return control.RectangleToScreen(((UIElement)dataAreaUIElement).ClipRect);
					}
					if (!IsRootRowsCollection)
					{
						Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
						if (rowsCollection.Band.HeadersAreaVisible)
						{
							UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)dataAreaUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(HeaderUIElement), (object)rowsCollection);
							if (descendant != null)
							{
								rectangle = descendant.ClipRect;
							}
						}
						if (rowsCollection.Count > 0)
						{
							if (rectangle == Rectangle.Empty)
							{
								UIElement uIElement = rowsCollection[0].GetUIElement();
								if (uIElement != null)
								{
									rectangle = uIElement.ClipRect;
								}
							}
							foreach (UltraGridRow item in rowsCollection)
							{
								UIElement uIElement2 = item.GetUIElement();
								if (uIElement2 != null)
								{
									rectangle = Rectangle.Union(rectangle, uIElement2.ClipRect);
								}
							}
						}
						return control?.RectangleToScreen(rectangle) ?? rectangle;
					}
				}
				return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Bounds;
			}
		}

		public override string Name
		{
			get
			{
				string name = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name;
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
				{
					return name;
				}
				name = rowsCollection.Band.Key;
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(name))
				{
					return ((Control)(object)Grid).AccessibleName;
				}
				return name;
			}
			set

				((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).Name = value;
			}
		}

				}
				return ((Control)(object)Grid).AccessibilityObject;
			}
		}

		public override AccessibleRole Role => AccessibleRole.Table;

		{

		public RowsCollectionAccessibleObject(RowsCollection rowsCollection)
		{

		public override AccessibleObject GetChild(int index)
		{
			if (rowsCollection.Band.HeadersAreaVisible)
			{
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return rowsCollection.Band.ColHeadersAccessibilityObject;
				}
				index--;
			}
			TemplateAddRowLocation templateRowLocationDefault = rowsCollection.TemplateRowLocationDefault;
			if (templateRowLocationDefault == TemplateAddRowLocation.Top)
			{
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return rowsCollection.TemplateAddRow.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				index--;
			}
			int count = rowsCollection.Count;
			if (index >= 0 && index < count)
			{
				return rowsCollection[index].AccessibilityObject;
			}
			index -= count;
			if (templateRowLocationDefault == TemplateAddRowLocation.Bottom)
			{
				if (index == 0)
				{
					return rowsCollection.TemplateAddRow.AccessibilityObject;
				}
				index--;
			}
			int count2 = rowsCollection.Layout.SortedBands.Count;
			if (count2 > 0 && index >= 0 && index < count2)
			{
				AccessibleObject cardScrollbarAccessibilityObject = rowsCollection.Layout.SortedBands[index].CardScrollbarAccessibilityObject;
				if (cardScrollbarAccessibilityObject != null)
				{
					if (index == 0)
					{
						return cardScrollbarAccessibilityObject;
					}
					index--;
				}
			}
			if (IsRootRowsCollection)
			{
				ColScrollRegion activeColScrollRegion = Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion;
				if (activeColScrollRegion != null)
				{
					UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)Grid.DisplayLayout.UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(DataAreaUIElement));
					if (descendant != null)
					{
						UIElement descendant2 = descendant.GetDescendant(typeof(ColScrollbarUIElement), (object)activeColScrollRegion);
						if (descendant2 != null)
						{
							if (index == 0)
							{
								return descendant2.AccessibilityInstanceResolved;
							}
							index--;
						}
						RowScrollRegion activeRowScrollRegion = Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
						if (activeRowScrollRegion != null)
						{
							UIElement descendant3 = descendant.GetDescendant(typeof(RowScrollbarUIElement), (object)activeRowScrollRegion);
							if (descendant3 != null)
							{
								if (index == 0)
								{
									return descendant3.AccessibilityInstanceResolved;
								}
								index--;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(index);
		}

		public override int GetChildCount()
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (rowsCollection.Band.HeadersAreaVisible)
			{
				num++;
			}
			num += rowsCollection.Count;
			if (rowsCollection.TemplateRowLocationDefault != TemplateAddRowLocation.None)
			{
				num++;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in rowsCollection.Layout.SortedBands)
			{
				if (sortedBand.CardScrollbarAccessibilityObject != null)
				{
					num++;
				}
			}
			if (IsRootRowsCollection)
			{
				ColScrollRegion activeColScrollRegion = Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion;
				if (activeColScrollRegion != null)
				{
					UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)Grid.DisplayLayout.UIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(DataAreaUIElement));
					if (descendant != null)
					{
						UIElement descendant2 = descendant.GetDescendant(typeof(ColScrollbarUIElement), (object)activeColScrollRegion);
						if (descendant2 != null)
						{
							num++;
						}
						RowScrollRegion activeRowScrollRegion = Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
						if (activeRowScrollRegion != null)
						{
							UIElement descendant3 = descendant.GetDescendant(typeof(RowScrollbarUIElement), (object)activeRowScrollRegion);
							if (descendant3 != null)
							{
								num++;
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected override Control GetMarshallingControl()
		{
			if (rowsCollection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return (Control)(object)rowsCollection.Layout.Grid;
		}

		public override AccessibleObject HitTest(int x, int y)
		{
			int childCount = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChildCount();
			for (int i = 0; i < childCount; i++)
			{
				AccessibleObject child = ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).GetChild(i);
				if (child != null && child.Bounds.Contains(x, y))
				{
					return child;
				}
				UltraGridRow.RowAccessibleObject rowAccessibleObject = AccessibleObjectWrapper.FromAccessibleObject(child) as UltraGridRow.RowAccessibleObject;
				if (child == null || rowAccessibleObject == null || !rowAccessibleObject.Row.IsExpanded)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)rowAccessibleObject.Row.ChildBands)
				{
					if (item.RowsCollectionAccessibilityObject.Bounds.Contains(x, y))
					{
						return item.RowsCollectionAccessibilityObject;
					}
				}
			}
			return ((AccessibleObjectWrapper)this).HitTest(x, y);
		}
	}

		public UltraGridRow FirstRow
		{
			get
			{
				if (AfterSortScrollPositionToMaintain >= 0 && base.Layout != null && !inGetMaxScrollPosition)
				{
					int maxScrollPosition = GetMaxScrollPosition();
					int pos = Math.Min(maxScrollPosition, AfterSortScrollPositionToMaintain);
					UltraGridRow rowAtScrollPos = base.Layout.GetRowAtScrollPos(pos);
					if (rowAtScrollPos != null)
					{
						firstRow = rowAtScrollPos;
					}
					afterSortScrollPositionToMaintain = -1;
				}
				while (firstRow != null)
				{
					bool flag = firstRow.HiddenResolved;
					if (firstRow == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					if (flag && base.Layout.ViewStyleImpl != null)
					{
						bool recreateRowList = false;
						flag = base.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.VerifyShouldRemoveHiddenRow(this, firstRow, out recreateRowList);
					}
					if (firstRow == null || (firstRow.AllAncestorsExpanded && firstRow != null && firstRow.IsStillValid && !flag) || firstRow == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					firstRow = firstRow.ParentRow;
				}
				if (firstRow == null)
				{
					firstRow = base.Layout.Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow();
				}
				if (firstRow == null)
				{
					UltraGridLayout layout = base.Layout;
					if (layout != null && layout.SortedBands != null && layout.SortedBands.Count > 0 && layout.Rows != null && layout.Rows.Count > 0)
					{
						UltraGridRow row = layout.Rows[0];
						bool recreateRowList2 = false;
						if (!base.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.VerifyShouldRemoveHiddenRow(this, row, out recreateRowList2))
						{
							firstRow = row;
						}
					}
				}
				return firstRow;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != firstRow)
				{
					if (value != null && value.Band.Layout != base.Layout)
					{
						throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_247"));
					}
					if (base.Layout != null && base.Layout.Grid != null && base.Layout.IsDisplayLayout && base.Layout.Grid.TempActiveRow != null && base.Layout.Grid.ActiveRow != base.Layout.Grid.TempActiveRow)
					{
						base.Layout.Grid.PaintTimer_Tick(null, null);
					}
					firstRow = value;
					if (firstRow != null)
					{
						firstRow.ExpandAncestors();
					}
					if (firstRow != null && firstRow.ScrollPosition > cachedMaxScrollPosition)
					{
						verifiedMaxScrollPositionVersion--;
					}
					SetDestroyVisibleRows();
					VisibleRows.Dirty = true;
					Invalidate();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnRowPropChange(VisibleRow vr, PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			UltraGridRow row = vr.Row;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = true;
			bool flag4 = false;
			bool flag5 = false;
			bool recalcRects = false;
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = null;
			bool flag6 = false;
			if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.Expanded:
					flag = true;
					flag2 = true;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Delete:
					flag = true;
					flag4 = true;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.AutoPreviewHidden:
				case PropertyIds.Description:
				case PropertyIds.Height:
				case PropertyIds.Hidden:
				case PropertyIds.RowSpacingAfter:
				case PropertyIds.RowSpacingBefore:
				case PropertyIds.Width:
					flag2 = true;
					flag5 = true;
					verifiedMaxScrollPositionVersion--;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Activation:
				case PropertyIds.Selected:
					row.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
					UltraGrid.VerifyRowEditTemplateProxyEnabledStates(row);
					flag3 = false;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.DataChanged:
				case PropertyIds.AllowFixing:
				case PropertyIds.ToolTipText:
					recalcRects = true;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Cells:
				{
					PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo = propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Cell);
					if (propChangeInfo == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					ultraGridCell = (UltraGridCell)propChangeInfo.FindSource(typeof(UltraGridCell));
					if (ultraGridCell == null)
					{
						ultraGridCell = (UltraGridCell)propChangeInfo.FindSource(typeof(UltraGridFilterCell));
					}
					if (ultraGridCell == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (propChangeInfo.PropId is PropertyIds)
					{
						switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo.PropId)
						{
						case PropertyIds.TabStop:
							ultraGridCell = null;
							flag3 = false;
							break;
						case PropertyIds.Cell:
						{
							PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo2 = propChangeInfo.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Activation);
							if (propChangeInfo2 != null)
							{
								UltraGrid.VerifyRowEditTemplateProxyEnabledStates(row);
							}
							break;
						}
						}
					}
					PropChangeInfo propChangeInfo3 = propChangeInfo.FindTrigger(null);
					if (propChangeInfo3.PropId is PropertyIds)
					{
						flag6 = flag6 || (PropertyIds)(object)propChangeInfo3.PropId == PropertyIds.Appearance;
					}
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			if (flag5 && base.Layout != null)
			{
				base.Layout.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				SetDestroyVisibleRows(Set: true);
			}
			if (flag2)
			{
				base.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
				SetDestroyVisibleRows(Set: true);
			}
			else if (flag4)
			{
				Rectangle regionRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
				GetRegionRect(ref regionRect);
				regionRect.X += vr.OrigTop;
				regionRect.Height -= vr.OrigTop;
				Invalidate(regionRect);
				base.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
				SetDestroyVisibleRows(Set: true);
			}
			else if (flag3)
			{
				if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell != null)
				{
					ultraGridCell.InvalidateItem(this, flag6);
				}
				else
				{
					row.InvalidateItem(this, recalcRects);
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool WillScrollbarBeShown(ScrollbarVisibility assumeColScrollbarsVisible)
		{
			if (base.Layout.SortedBands.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = base.Layout.SortedBands[0];
			if (ultraGridBand.CardView && (!ultraGridBand.HasGroupBySortColumns || !ultraGridBand.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.SupportsGroupByRows))
			{
				return false;
			}
			Scrollbar scrollbarResolved = base.ScrollbarResolved;
			switch (scrollbarResolved)
			{
			case Scrollbar.Show:
			case Scrollbar.ShowIfNeeded:
				if (DestroyVisibleRows)
				{
					RegenerateVisibleRows();
				}
				if (Scrollbar.Show == scrollbarResolved)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (VisibleRows.Count < 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return !IsFirstScrollableRowVisible(assumeColScrollbarsVisible) || !IsLastScrollableRowVisible(assumeColScrollbarsVisible);
			case Scrollbar.Hide:
				return false;
			default:
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal void ScrollToEnd()
		{
			bool flag = forceScroll;
			forceScroll = true;
			try
			{
				OnScroll(base.ScrollBarInfo, ScrollEventType.Last);
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			forceScroll = flag;
		}

		internal void RegenerateVisibleRows()
		{
			RegenerateVisibleRows(resetScrollInfo: true);
		}

		internal void RegenerateVisibleRows(bool resetScrollInfo)
		{
			if (regeneratingRows || !destroyVisibleRows)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (resetScrollInfo)
			{
				base.Layout.ColScrollRegions.InitializeMetrics();
			}
			destroyVisibleRows = false;
			regeneratingRows = true;
			try
			{
				base.Layout.BeginCaching();
				EnsureScrollRegionFilled(calledFromRegenerateVisibleRows: true);
				base.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.RecreateRowList(this);
				if (scrollbarPositionDirty)
				{
					PositionScrollbar(resetScrollInfo: true);
				}
				if (resetScrollInfo)
				{
					ResetScrollInfo();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.Layout.EndCaching();
				regeneratingRows = false;
			}
		}

		internal void AdjustFirstRow(UltraGridRow rowBeingDeleted)
		{
			if (rowBeingDeleted != null && rowBeingDeleted.ParentCollection.ParentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = (UltraGridGroupByRow)rowBeingDeleted.ParentCollection.ParentRow;
				if (1 == ultraGridGroupByRow.Rows.Count && ultraGridGroupByRow.Rows[0] == rowBeingDeleted)
				{
					UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow2 = ultraGridGroupByRow.ParentRow as UltraGridGroupByRow;
					while (ultraGridGroupByRow2 != null && ultraGridGroupByRow2.Rows.Count == 1)
					{
						ultraGridGroupByRow = ultraGridGroupByRow2;
						ultraGridGroupByRow2 = ultraGridGroupByRow.ParentRow as UltraGridGroupByRow;
					}
					rowBeingDeleted = ultraGridGroupByRow;
				}
			}
			if (firstRow == null || (rowBeingDeleted != firstRow && !firstRow.IsDescendantOf(rowBeingDeleted)))
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			if (firstRow.ParentCollection != null && firstRow.ParentCollection.TemplateRowLocationDefault != TemplateAddRowLocation.None && firstRow == firstRow.ParentCollection.CurrentAddRow)
			{
				ultraGridRow = firstRow.ParentCollection.TemplateAddRow;
			}
			if (ultraGridRow == null)
			{
				ultraGridRow = firstRow.GetNextVisibleRow(skipThisRowDescendants: true);
				if (ultraGridRow == null)
				{
					ultraGridRow = firstRow.GetPrevVisibleRow();
				}
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null)
			{
				firstRow = ultraGridRow;
			}
		}

		internal int GetClippedExtent()
		{
			int num = base.Extent;
			if (num > 0 && (base.Layout.IsDisplayLayout || base.Layout.IsPrintLayout || base.Layout.IsExportLayout))
			{
				UIElement uIElement = base.Layout.GetUIElement(verify: false);
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(DataAreaUIElement));
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						Rectangle rectInsideBorders = uIElement.RectInsideBorders;
						if (num > rectInsideBorders.Bottom - base.Origin)
						{
							num = rectInsideBorders.Bottom - base.Origin;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					num = 0;
				}
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = 0;
			}
			return num;
		}

			ScrollEventType scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
			OnScroll(scrollType: action switch
			{
				RowScrollAction.LineUp => ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement, 
				RowScrollAction.LineDown => ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement, 
				RowScrollAction.PageUp => ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement, 
				RowScrollAction.PageDown => ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement, 
				RowScrollAction.Top => ScrollEventType.First, 
				RowScrollAction.Bottom => ScrollEventType.Last, 
				_ => throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(), 
			}, scrollBar: base.ScrollBarInfo);
			lastScrollType = ScrollEventType.EndScroll;
		}

		public RowScrollRegion Split(int extent)
		{
			if (!(base.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_51"));
			}
			if (base.SizingMode == SizingMode.Fixed)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_52"));
			}
			if (ClonedFrom != null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_249"));
			}
			if (extent < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_250"));
			}
			if (base.Layout.MaxRowScrollRegions > 0 && base.Layout.RowScrollRegions.Count >= base.Layout.MaxRowScrollRegions)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_251"));
			}
			base.Layout.GetUIElement(verify: true, forceInitializeRect: true);
			int clippedExtent = ClippedExtent;
			int num = extent;
			int rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved = base.Layout.RowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved;
			if (extent > 0 && clippedExtent < num + rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_56"));
			}
			if (num <= 0 || clippedExtent - num <= rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved)
			{
				int num2 = clippedExtent;
				clippedExtent = (clippedExtent - rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved) / 2;
				num = num2 - (clippedExtent + rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved);
			}
			else
			{
				if (num >= clippedExtent)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_56"));
				}
				clippedExtent -= num + rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved;
			}
			if (clippedExtent <= 0 || num <= 0)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_57"));
			}
			int index = Index;
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = new RowScrollRegion((RowScrollRegionsCollection)collectionValue);
			rowScrollRegion.SetOriginAndExtent(base.Origin, num);
			BeforeRowRegionSplitEventArgs e = new BeforeRowRegionSplitEventArgs(this, rowScrollRegion);
			ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowRegionSplit, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return null;
			}
			SetOriginAndExtent(base.Origin + num + rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved, clippedExtent);
			base.Layout.RowScrollRegions.InternalInsert(rowScrollRegion, index);
			base.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Width);
			return rowScrollRegion;
		}

			return (RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)(object)uIElement;
		}

		internal void ScrollRowIntoView(UltraGridRow row, bool exitEditMode, bool dontUpdateGridControl, bool maintainClosestScrollPosition)
		{
			if (inScrollRowIntoView)
			{
				return;
			}
			inScrollRowIntoView = true;
			UltraGridBase grid = base.Layout.Grid;
			grid.tempActiveRow_ScrollIntoView = false;
			try
			{
				bool selfUsedFlag = false;
				ScrollRowIntoViewHelper(row, exitEditMode, dontUpdateGridControl, maintainClosestScrollPosition, ref selfUsedFlag);
			}
			finally

			}
		}

		private void ScrollRowIntoViewHelper(UltraGridRow row, bool exitEditMode, bool dontUpdateGridControl, bool maintainClosestScrollPosition, ref bool selfUsedFlag)
		{
			RegenerateVisibleRows();
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = FirstRow;
			if (row.Layout != base.Layout)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_253"));
			}
			if (row.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (row.IsCard)
			{
				row.ParentCollection.ScrollCardIntoView(row, this);
				return;
			}
			ColScrollRegion activeColScrollRegion = base.Layout.GetActiveColScrollRegion(initializeMetrics: false);
			if (GetClientHeight(activeColScrollRegion) == 0)
			{
				SetFirstRow(row, invalidate: false);
				SetDestroyVisibleRows(Set: true);
				return;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				int clientHeight = GetClientHeight(activeColScrollRegion);
				base.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.VerifyRowList(this, syncWithCalcManager: false);
				VisibleRowsCollection visibleRowsCollection = VisibleRows;
				int count = visibleRowsCollection.Count;
				int num = 0;
				while (true)
				{
					if (num < count)
					{
						VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRowsCollection[num];
						if (visibleRow.Row != row)
						{
							num++;
							continue;
						}
						if (visibleRowsCollection[0] == visibleRow || visibleRowsCollection.GetFirstScrollableRow() == visibleRow || row.FixedResolved || IsRowFullyVisible(visibleRow))
						{
							return;
						}
						bool flag = dontUpdateInOnScroll;
						try
						{
							if (inGetMaxScrollPosition || dontUpdateGridControl)
							{
								dontUpdateInOnScroll = true;
							}
							UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = firstRow;
							if (!OnScroll(base.ScrollBarInfo, ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement, exitEditMode, invalidateRegion: false))
							{
								return;
							}
							if (ultraGridRow2 != firstRow)
							{
								lastScrollType = ScrollEventType.EndScroll;
								break;
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							dontUpdateInOnScroll = flag;
						}
					}
					ViewStyleBase.OnAfterRowListCreated(this);
					SetFirstRow(row, invalidate: false, fireScrollEvents: true);
					if (firstRow != row)
					{
						return;
					}
					SetDestroyVisibleRows();
					RegenerateVisibleRows(resetScrollInfo: false);
					if (maintainClosestScrollPosition && ultraGridRow != null && row != null)
					{
						int scrollPosition = ultraGridRow.ScrollPosition;
						int scrollPosition2 = row.ScrollPosition;
						if (scrollPosition >= 0 && scrollPosition < scrollPosition2)
						{
							Rectangle regionRect = Rectangle.Empty;
							GetRegionRect(ref regionRect, null, clipToParent: false, clipToDataArea: true);
							ScrollRowsContext scrollContext = new ScrollRowsContext(ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement, this, base.ScrollBarInfo.Value, base.ScrollBarInfo.Minimum, base.ScrollBarInfo.Maximum, regionRect);
							scrollContext.findScrollableArea = false;
							base.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.ScrollRows(ref scrollContext);
							selfUsedFlag = false;
							ScrollRowIntoViewHelper(row, exitEditMode, dontUpdateGridControl: true, maintainClosestScrollPosition: false, ref selfUsedFlag);
							if (selfUsedFlag)
							{
								return;
							}
						}
					}
					if ((ScrollBounds.ScrollToLastItem != base.Layout.ScrollBoundsResolved || !(base.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid)) && IsLastScrollableRowVisible(assumeColScrollbarsVisible: true))
					{
						bool flag2 = dontUpdateInOnScroll;
						dontUpdateInOnScroll = true;
						try
						{
							UltraGridRow ultraGridRow3 = null;
							do
							{
								ultraGridRow3 = FirstRow;
								OnScroll(base.ScrollBarInfo, ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement, exitEditMode, invalidateRegion: false);
							}
							while (ultraGridRow3 != FirstRow && IsLastScrollableRowVisible(assumeColScrollbarsVisible: false));
							if (ultraGridRow3 != null)
							{
								row = ultraGridRow3;
								SetFirstRow(row, invalidate: false, fireScrollEvents: true);
								SetDestroyVisibleRows();
								RegenerateVisibleRows(resetScrollInfo: false);
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							dontUpdateInOnScroll = flag2;
						}
					}
					int num2 = 1;
					for (int i = 0; i < visibleRowsCollection.Count && visibleRowsCollection[i].Row.FixedResolved; i++)
					{
						num2++;
					}
					if (visibleRowsCollection.Count > num2 && ultraGridRow == visibleRowsCollection[num2].Row)
					{
						SetFirstRow(ultraGridRow, invalidate: false);
						SetDestroyVisibleRows();
						RegenerateVisibleRows(resetScrollInfo: false);
						OnScroll(base.ScrollBarInfo, ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement, exitEditMode, invalidateRegion: false);
					}
					else
					{
						Invalidate();
						ResetScrollInfo();
						selfUsedFlag = true;
					}
					return;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureRowIsFullyInView(UltraGridRow row, bool exitEditMode)

		internal void EnsureRowIsFullyInView(UltraGridRow row, bool exitEditMode, bool scrollWholeCardArea)
		{
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRowsCollection = VisibleRows;
			int count = visibleRowsCollection.Count;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			int clientHeight = GetClientHeight(base.Layout.GetActiveColScrollRegion(initializeMetrics: false));
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRowsCollection[i];
				if (row.IsCard)
				{
					if (row.ParentCollection == visibleRow.Row.ParentCollection)
					{
						flag = true;
						num = (scrollWholeCardArea ? visibleRow.Band.CalculateRequiredCardAreaHeight(1) : row.CardHeight);
					}
				}
				else if (visibleRow.Row == row)
				{
					flag = true;
					num = row.TotalHeight;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (i == 0 || visibleRow.Tier == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				int num3 = clientHeight - visibleRow.GetTopOfRow(adjustForOverlappedBorders: true);
				if (num3 < num)
				{
					num2 = num - num3;
				}
				break;
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (exitEditMode)
				{
					base.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper();
				}
				SetFirstRow(row, invalidate: true);
				SetDestroyVisibleRows();
			}
			else
			{
				if (num2 < 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (exitEditMode)
				{
					base.Layout.ExitEditModeHelper();
				}
				int num4 = visibleRowsCollection.GetFirstScrollableRow()?.GetTop() ?? base.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.GetFixedHeaderHeight();
				flag = false;
				for (int j = 1; j < count; j++)
				{
					VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRowsCollection[j];
					if (row.IsCard)
					{
						if (row.ParentCollection == visibleRow.Row.ParentCollection)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else if (visibleRow.Row == row)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (!flag && visibleRow.GetTop() < num2 + num4)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (visibleRow.Tier < 2)
					{
						if (OnScroll(base.ScrollBarInfo, ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement, exitEditMode, invalidateRegion: false))
						{
							lastScrollType = ScrollEventType.EndScroll;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						SetFirstRow(visibleRow.Row, invalidate: true);
						SetDestroyVisibleRows();
					}
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void GetRegionRect(ref Rectangle regionRect, ColScrollRegion colRegion, bool clipToParent, bool clipToDataArea)
		{
			if (ClonedFrom != null)
			{
				ClonedFrom.GetRegionRect(ref regionRect);
				return;
			}
			Rectangle b = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			UIElement val = null;
			UIElement uIElement = base.Layout.GetUIElement(verify: false);
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				val = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(DataAreaUIElement));
				if (val != null)
				{
					b = val.DrawingRectInsideBorders;
				}
			}
			if (colRegion != null)
			{
				regionRect.X = colRegion.ZoomedOrigin;
				regionRect.Width = colRegion.ZoomedExtent;
			}
			else if (val != null)
			{
				regionRect = val.DrawingRect;
			}
			else
			{
				regionRect.X = base.Layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).GetNextVisibleRegion(null, wrap: false).ZoomedOrigin;
				ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = (ColScrollRegion)base.Layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).LastVisibleRegion;
				regionRect.Width = colScrollRegion.ZoomedOrigin + colScrollRegion.ZoomedExtent - regionRect.X;
			}
			regionRect.Y = base.ZoomedOrigin;
			regionRect.Height = base.ZoomedExtent;
			UltraGridBase grid = base.Layout.Grid;
			if (clipToDataArea && val != null)
			{
				regionRect = Rectangle.Intersect(regionRect, b);
			}
			if (colRegion != null && colRegion.WillScrollbarBeShown())
			{
				int horizontalScrollBarHeight = HorizontalScrollBarHeight;
				regionRect.Height -= Utilities.GetZoomedValue(horizontalScrollBarHeight, (UltraControlBase)(object)grid, false);
			}
			if (WillScrollbarBeShown())
			{
				int zoomedValue = Utilities.GetZoomedValue(VerticalScrollBarWidth, (UltraControlBase)(object)grid, false);
				if (uIElement == null || !uIElement.RightToLeftResolved)
				{
					regionRect.Width -= zoomedValue;
				}
				else
				{
					regionRect.X += zoomedValue;
				}
			}
			if (clipToParent)
			{
				base.Layout.ClipToParent(ref regionRect, clientCoords: true);
			}
		}

		internal bool ScrollRows(ScrollEventType scrollType, ref ScrollRowsContext src)
		{
			if (!base.IsClone)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridLayout layout = base.Layout;
			ViewStyleBase viewStyleImpl = layout.ViewStyleImpl;
			if (viewStyleImpl == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			switch (scrollType)
			{
			case ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack:
			{
				int num3 = layout.RowScrollRange - 1;
				int num2 = src.scrollTrackPos * scrollbarFactor;
				if (num2 > num3)
				{
					num2 = num3;

		internal RowScrollRegion Clone()
		{
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = (RowScrollRegion)MemberwiseClone();
			if (rowScrollRegion == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			rowScrollRegion.clonedFromRegion = this;
			rowScrollRegion.visibleRows = null;
			if (rowScrollRegion.VisibleRows == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			rowScrollRegion.extentLastResize = extentLastResize;
			rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset = ScrollOffset;
			rowScrollRegion.lastScrollDelta = lastScrollDelta;
			rowScrollRegion.lastScrollType = lastScrollType;
			rowScrollRegion.tagValue = Tag;
			CopyState(rowScrollRegion, this);
			rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(firstRow);
			return rowScrollRegion;
		}

				else if (ScrollbarVisibility.Hidden == colScrollbarVisibility)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else
				{
					ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegions = base.Layout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false);
					flag = colScrollRegions.AreScrollbarsVisible(ScrollbarVisibility.Check);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					num -= HorizontalScrollBarHeight;
					if (num < num2)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private bool InternalScrollToNewFirstRow(bool invalidate)
		{
			if (!base.IsClone)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (ClonedFrom.firstRow != firstRow)
			{
				flag = true;
				UltraGridBase grid = base.Layout.Grid;
				if (grid != null)
				{
					BeforeRowRegionScrollEventArgs e = new BeforeRowRegionScrollEventArgs(this, ClonedFrom);
					grid.FireBeforeRowRegionScroll(e);
					if (e.Cancel)
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
			}
			ClonedFrom.scrollOffset = scrollOffset;
			ClonedFrom.lastScrollDelta = lastScrollDelta;
			ClonedFrom.lastScrollType = lastScrollType;
			if (visibleRows != null)
			{
				ClonedFrom.VisibleRows.CopyRowsFromHelper(VisibleRows);
			}
			else
			{
				ClonedFrom.VisibleRows.InternalClear();
			}
			ClonedFrom.SetFirstRow(firstRow, invalidate);
			if (flag)
			{
				ClonedFrom.SetDestroyVisibleRows(Set: true);
			}
			else if (lastScrollDelta != 0 && base.Layout != null)
			{
				base.Layout.DirtyDataAreaElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, invalidate: false);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void SetFirstRow(UltraGridRow newFirstRow)
		{
			SetFirstRow(newFirstRow, invalidate: true);
		}

		internal void SetFirstRow(UltraGridRow newFirstRow, bool invalidate)
		{
			SetFirstRow(newFirstRow, invalidate, fireScrollEvents: false);
		}

		internal void SetFirstRow(UltraGridRow newFirstRow, bool invalidate, bool fireScrollEvents)
		{
			if (firstRow == newFirstRow)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (fireScrollEvents)
			{
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = (base.IsClone ? this : Clone());
				if (rowScrollRegion != null)
				{
					rowScrollRegion.firstRow = newFirstRow;
					if (rowScrollRegion.InternalScrollToNewFirstRow(invalidate))
					{
						base.Layout.Grid?.FireAfterRowRegionScroll(new RowScrollRegionEventArgs(this));
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			if (invalidate && !base.IsClone)
			{
				base.Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false);
			}
			firstRow = newFirstRow;
		}

		internal void ClearVisibleRows()
		{
			visibleRows.InternalClear();
		}

		internal void PopFrontVisibleRow()
		{
			VisibleRow visibleRow = VisibleRows[0];
			if (visibleRow != null)

				VisibleRows.InternalRemove(visibleRow);
			}
		}

		internal override void CheckIfSizeChanged()
		{
			if (!(base.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ultraGrid.IsEventInProgress(GridEventIds.AfterColRegionSize))
			{
				eventInterrupted = true;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!((Control)(object)ultraGrid).Visible || base.Hidden || ultraGrid.FirstDraw)
				{
					return;
				}
				int clippedExtent = ClippedExtent;
				if (clippedExtent != extentLastResize)
				{
					extentLastResize = clippedExtent;
					RowScrollRegionEventArgs e = new RowScrollRegionEventArgs(this);
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowRegionSize, e);
					if (eventInterrupted)
					{
						base.Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, fInvalidate: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void RemoveVisibleRow(VisibleRow visibleRow)

			visibleRows.InternalRemove(visibleRow);
		}

		internal void PopBackVisibleRow()

			if (lastRow != null)
