				visibleRows.InternalRemove(lastRow);
			}
		}

		internal override void PositionScrollbar(bool resetScrollInfo)
		{
			if (scrollBarInfoValue != null && scrollBarInfoValue.IsThumbInDrag)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!scrollbarRectSet)
			{
				scrollbarPositionDirty = true;
				return;
			}
			if (base.IsClone)
			{
				clonedFromRegion.PositionScrollbar(resetScrollInfo);
				return;
			}
			scrollbarPositionDirty = false;
			bool flag = WillScrollbarBeShown() && !base.Hidden;
			if (flag != !base.ScrollbarRect.IsEmpty)
			{
				scrollbarRectSet = false;
				scrollbarPositionDirty = true;
				base.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
				flag = !flag;
			}
			else if (resetScrollInfo)
			{
				ResetScrollInfo();
			}
			ShowScrollbar(flag, resetScrollInfo);
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetLastVisibleRow(UltraGridBand band, bool nonGroupByRowsOnly, bool scrollableRowsOnly)
		{
			if (visibleRows == null || visibleRows.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			int clientHeight = GetClientHeight(base.Layout.GetActiveColScrollRegion(initializeMetrics: false));
			for (int num = visibleRows.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRows[num];
				UltraGridRow row = visibleRow.Row;
				if (IsRowFullyVisible(visibleRow) && visibleRow.Bottom <= clientHeight && row.Band == band && (!nonGroupByRowsOnly || !(row is UltraGridGroupByRow)) && (!scrollableRowsOnly || row == null || !row.FixedResolved) && !row.IsSummaryRow)
				{
					return row;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal VisibleRow GetVisibleRow(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (VisibleRows == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < VisibleRows.Count; i++)
			{
				VisibleRow visibleRow = VisibleRows[i];
				if (row == visibleRow.Row)
				{
					return visibleRow;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetFirstVisibleRow(UltraGridBand band, bool nonGroupByRowsOnly, bool scrollableRowsOnly)
		{
			if (visibleRows == null || visibleRows.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rectangle regionRect = default(Rectangle);
			GetRegionRect(ref regionRect, base.Layout.GetActiveColScrollRegion(initializeMetrics: false));
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleRows.Count; i++)
			{
				VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRows[i];
				int num = visibleRow.GetTopOfRow() + base.Origin;
				if (!regionRect.IsEmpty && num >= regionRect.Bottom)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (IsRowFullyVisible(visibleRow))
				{
					UltraGridRow row = visibleRows[i].Row;
					if (num >= regionRect.Top && row.Band == band && (!nonGroupByRowsOnly || !(row is UltraGridGroupByRow)) && (!scrollableRowsOnly || row == null || !row.FixedResolved))
					{
						return row;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void KybdScroll(ScrollEventType scrollType)
		{
			Scrollbars scrollbars = base.Layout.Scrollbars;
			if (Scrollbars.Horizontal == scrollbars || scrollbars == Scrollbars.None || WillScrollbarBeShown())
			{
				OnScroll(base.ScrollBarInfo, scrollType);
				lastScrollType = ScrollEventType.EndScroll;
			}
		}

		internal static bool AreRowsSelectionCompatible(UltraGridRow row1, UltraGridRow row2, bool isCellSelection)
		{
			if (row1.Band != row2.Band)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row1 is UltraGridGroupByRow && !(row2 is UltraGridGroupByRow))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row2 is UltraGridGroupByRow && !(row1 is UltraGridGroupByRow))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row1 is UltraGridGroupByRow && row2 is UltraGridGroupByRow && ((UltraGridGroupByRow)row1).Column != ((UltraGridGroupByRow)row2).Column)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((!isCellSelection && (!row1.Selectable || !row2.Selectable)) || row1.IsUnModifiedAddRowFromTemplate || row2.IsUnModifiedAddRowFromTemplate)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool AreCardsInView(bool nonScrollableCardsOnly)
		{
			if (base.Hidden)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (visibleRows != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < visibleRows.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!visibleRows[i].IsCardArea)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (nonScrollableCardsOnly)
					{
						if (visibleRows[i].Row != null && visibleRows[i].Row.Band.CardView && visibleRows[i].Row.Band.HasCardSettings && CardStyle.Compressed == visibleRows[i].Row.Band.CardSettings.StyleResolved)
						{
							return true;
						}
						int num = base.Extent;
						if (!base.Layout.AutoFitAllColumns && base.IsLastVisibleRegion)
						{
							num -= HorizontalScrollBarHeight;
						}
						if (VisibleRows[i].Band.CalculateRequiredCardAreaHeight(1) < VisibleRows[i].GetTotalHeight())
						{
							return true;
						}
						if (visibleRows[i].Bottom < num)
						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal VisibleRow GetNearestSameBandRow(Point point, GridItemBase LastGridItem)
		{
			if (VisibleRows.Count < 1 || LastGridItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Rectangle regionRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			GetRegionRect(ref regionRect, base.Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion);
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			UltraGridRow row = LastGridItem.GetRow();
			bool isCellSelection = LastGridItem is UltraGridCell;
			if (pivotItem != null && pivotItem.GetType() == LastGridItem.GetType())
			{
				ultraGridRow = pivotItem.GetRow();
				if (ultraGridRow != null && !AreRowsSelectionCompatible(ultraGridRow, row, isCellSelection))
				{
					ultraGridRow = null;
				}
			}
			VisibleRow visibleRow = null;
			VisibleRow result = null;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = 0;
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleRows.Count; i++)
			{
				VisibleRow visibleRow2 = visibleRows[i];
				if (visibleRow2.Row == null || visibleRow2.Row.HiddenResolved)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					if (visibleRow2.Row == ultraGridRow)
					{
						num = base.Origin + visibleRow2.GetTopOfRow();
						num2 = num + visibleRow2.Row.TotalHeight;
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (row == visibleRow2.Row)
				{
					result = visibleRow2;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				if (rowsScrolledDuringDrag > 0)
				{
					num = regionRect.Top;
					num2 = regionRect.Top;
				}
				if (rowsScrolledDuringDrag < 0)
				{
					num = regionRect.Bottom;
					num2 = regionRect.Bottom;
				}
			}
			if (point.Y < regionRect.Top && AreRowsSelectionCompatible(row, visibleRows[0].Row, isCellSelection))
			{
				return visibleRows[0];
			}
			if (point.Y > regionRect.Bottom)
			{
				for (int num3 = visibleRows.Count - 1; num3 >= 0; num3--)
				{
					VisibleRow visibleRow3 = visibleRows[num3];
					if (visibleRow3.Bottom <= regionRect.Bottom)
					{
						if (!AreRowsSelectionCompatible(row, visibleRow3.Row, isCellSelection) || visibleRow3.Row.HiddenResolved)
						{
							break;
						}
						return visibleRow3;
					}
				}
			}
			bool flag2 = point.Y <= num || ultraGridRow == null;
			for (int j = ((!flag2) ? (visibleRows.Count - 1) : 0); j >= 0 && j < visibleRows.Count; j += (flag2 ? 1 : (-1)))
			{
				VisibleRow visibleRow2 = visibleRows[j];
				UltraGridRow row2 = visibleRow2.Row;
				if (row2.HiddenResolved || !AreRowsSelectionCompatible(visibleRow2.Row, row, isCellSelection))
				{
					continue;
				}
				int num4 = base.Origin + visibleRow2.GetTopOfRow();
				int num5 = num4 + row2.TotalHeight;
				if (num4 >= regionRect.Bottom || num5 < regionRect.Top)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (point.Y >= num4)
				{
					if (point.Y <= num5)
					{
						visibleRow = visibleRow2;
						break;
					}
					if (ultraGridRow != null && !flag2 && num4 >= num2)
					{
						visibleRow = visibleRow2;
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (ultraGridRow != null && flag2 && num4 <= num)
				{
					visibleRow = visibleRow2;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (visibleRow == null)
			{
				return result;
			}
			return visibleRow;
		}

		internal bool DoesDragNeedScroll(Point mouseLoc, ref int timerInterval)
		{
			Rectangle regionRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			GetRegionRect(ref regionRect, base.Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion);
			if (mouseLoc.Y >= regionRect.Top && mouseLoc.Y <= regionRect.Bottom)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridBase grid = base.Layout.Grid;
			if (grid != null && !grid.ShouldScrollGridOnDragMoveHelper(mouseLoc))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = 0;
			if (mouseLoc.Y < regionRect.Top)
			{
				num = regionRect.Top - mouseLoc.Y;
			}
			else if (regionRect.Bottom < mouseLoc.Y)
			{
				num = mouseLoc.Y - regionRect.Bottom;
			}
			if (num > 120)
			{
				timerInterval = 1;
			}
			else if (num > 100)
			{
				timerInterval = 40;
			}
			else if (num > 80)
			{
				timerInterval = 65;
			}
			else if (num > 60)
			{
				timerInterval = 80;
			}
			else if (num > 50)
			{
				timerInterval = 100;
			}
			else if (num > 40)
			{
				timerInterval = 150;
			}
			else if (num > 20)
			{
				timerInterval = 200;
			}
			else if (num > 10)
			{
				timerInterval = 300;
			}
			else if (num > 6)
			{
				timerInterval = 400;
			}
			else
			{
				timerInterval = 500;
			}
			Control controlForGridDisplay = base.Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay;
			if (controlForGridDisplay != null)
			{
				Rectangle rectangle = controlForGridDisplay.RectangleToScreen(regionRect);
				Rectangle bounds = Utilities.ScreenFromRectangle(rectangle).Bounds;
				Point point = controlForGridDisplay.PointToScreen(mouseLoc);
				if (point.Y + 1 >= bounds.Bottom || point.Y <= bounds.Y)
				{
					timerInterval = 1;
				}
				else
				{
					int num2 = ((point.Y <= rectangle.Y) ? (rectangle.Y - bounds.Y) : (bounds.Bottom - rectangle.Bottom));
					if (num2 > 0 && num2 < 120)
					{
						timerInterval = Math.Max(1, (int)((double)(timerInterval * num2) / 120.0));
					}
				}
			}
			if (mouseLoc.Y > regionRect.Bottom && IsLastScrollableRowVisible())
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (mouseLoc.Y < regionRect.Top && IsFirstScrollableRowVisible())
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal void DoDragScroll(Point mouseLoc, int timerInterval)
		{
			Rectangle regionRect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			GetRegionRect(ref regionRect, base.Layout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion);
			ScrollEventType scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
			if (mouseLoc.Y < regionRect.Top)
			{
				scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
			}
			else
			{
				if (mouseLoc.Y <= regionRect.Bottom)
				{
					return;
				}
				scrollEventType = ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement;
			}
			bool flag = OnScroll(base.ScrollBarInfo, scrollEventType);
			LastScrollType = ScrollEventType.EndScroll;
			if (flag)
			{
				switch (scrollEventType)
				{
				case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
					rowsScrolledDuringDrag--;
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
					rowsScrolledDuringDrag++;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			base.OnDispose();
			if (visibleRows != null)
			{
				visibleRows.InternalClear();
			}
		}

		internal override void RaiseScrollPatternScrollPercentPropertyIdChanged()
		{
			double scrollPercent = base.ScrollBarInfo.GetScrollPercent();
			if (oldScrollPercent == scrollPercent)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion in base.Layout.ColScrollRegions)
			{
				GetUIElement(colScrollRegion)?.RaiseUIAutomationPropertyChangedEventInternal((AutomationPropertyIds)30055, oldScrollPercent, scrollPercent);
			}
			oldScrollPercent = scrollPercent;
		}

		internal void ScrollLines(int linesToScroll)
		{
			int val = ScrollPosition + linesToScroll;
			val = Math.Min(val, GetMaxScrollPosition());
			ScrollPosition = val;
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public sealed class RowScrollRegionsCollection : ScrollRegionsCollectionBase, ISerializable
	{
		public class RowScrollRegionEnumerator : DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase
		{
			public RowScrollRegion Current => (RowScrollRegion)((IEnumerator)this).Current;

			public RowScrollRegionEnumerator(RowScrollRegionsCollection rowScrollRegions)
				: base(rowScrollRegions)
			{
			}
		}

		private bool metricsDirty;

		private bool initializingMetrics;

		private int initialCapacity;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

		public RowScrollRegion this[int index] => (RowScrollRegion)List[index];

		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		internal bool AreCardsInView
		{
			get
			{
				bool flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < base.Layout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
				{
					if (!base.Layout.SortedBands[i].HiddenResolved && base.Layout.SortedBands[i].CardView)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < Count; j++)
					{
						if (this[j].AreCardsInView(nonScrollableCardsOnly: false))
						{
							return true;
						}
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public bool IsSplitBoxVisible => Count < base.Layout.MaxRowScrollRegions;

		internal bool MetricsDirty => metricsDirty;

		internal bool InitializingMetrics => initializingMetrics;

		internal RowScrollRegion DefaultActiveRegion
		{
			get
			{
				if (Count < 1)
				{
					return null;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = this[i];
					if (!rowScrollRegion.Hidden)
					{
						return rowScrollRegion;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public RowScrollRegionsCollection(UltraGridLayout layout)
			: base(layout)
		{
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public int Add(object obj)
		{
			if (obj == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (!(obj is RowScrollRegion))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_254"));
			}
			if (((RowScrollRegion)obj).Collection != null)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}
			((RowScrollRegion)obj).InitCollection(this);
			return AddScrollRegionHelper((RowScrollRegion)obj);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), this[i]);
			}
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(RowScrollRegionsCollection source, PropertyCategories propertyCategories)
		{
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.Tag;
			}
			int num = Count - source.Count;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				for (int num2 = Count; num2 > source.Count; num2--)
				{
					this[num2 - 1].Dispose();
					InternalRemove(num2 - 1);
				}
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				for (int i = Count; i < source.Count; i++)
				{
					RowScrollRegion rsr = new RowScrollRegion(this);
					AddScrollRegionHelper(rsr);
				}
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < Count; j++)
			{
				this[j].InitializeFrom(source[j]);
			}
		}

		internal RowScrollRegionsCollection Clone()
		{
			RowScrollRegionsCollection rowScrollRegionsCollection = new RowScrollRegionsCollection(base.Layout);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = new RowScrollRegion(this);
				rowScrollRegion.InitializeFrom(this[i]);
				rowScrollRegionsCollection.AddScrollRegionHelper(rowScrollRegion);
			}
			return rowScrollRegionsCollection;
		}

		private int AddScrollRegionHelper(RowScrollRegion rsr)
		{
			rsr.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			return InternalAdd(rsr);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			RowScrollRegionEnumerator rowScrollRegionEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (rowScrollRegionEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					RowScrollRegion current = rowScrollRegionEnumerator.Current;
					current.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					current.Dispose();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = rowScrollRegionEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			metricsDirty = true;
		}

		private RowScrollRegionsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(RowScrollRegion))
				{
					RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = (RowScrollRegion)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RowScrollRegion), null);
					if (rowScrollRegion != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(rowScrollRegion);
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), initialCapacity));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitLayout(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			base.Layout = layout;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i].InitCollection(this);
				this[i].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		internal override bool AreScrollbarsVisible(ScrollbarVisibility assumeColScrollbarsVisible)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = this[i];
				if (rowScrollRegion != null && rowScrollRegion.WillScrollbarBeShown(assumeColScrollbarsVisible))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnSplitBoxDrop(Point point)
		{
			int rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved = base.Layout.RowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved;
			RowScrollRegionEnumerator rowScrollRegionEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (rowScrollRegionEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					RowScrollRegion current = rowScrollRegionEnumerator.Current;
					if (point.Y > current.Origin + rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved && point.Y < current.Origin + current.Extent - rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved)
					{
						try
						{
							current.Split(point.Y - current.Origin);
							break;
						}
						catch
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = rowScrollRegionEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnResize(RowScrollRegion rsr, int deltaY)
		{
			int rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved = base.Layout.RowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved;
			int num = rsr.Extent + deltaY;
			int num2 = rsr.Origin + num;
			RowScrollRegion nextVisibleRegion = GetNextVisibleRegion(rsr, wrap: false);
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = null;
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion2 = null;
			if (num < 2)
			{
				rowScrollRegion = rsr;
				rowScrollRegion2 = nextVisibleRegion;
			}
			else if (nextVisibleRegion != null && num2 >= nextVisibleRegion.Origin + nextVisibleRegion.Extent - rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved)
			{
				if (SizingMode.Fixed == nextVisibleRegion.SizingMode)
				{
					rowScrollRegion = rsr;
				}
				else
				{
					rowScrollRegion = nextVisibleRegion;
					rowScrollRegion2 = rsr;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				rowScrollRegion2 = rsr;
			}
			if (rowScrollRegion != null)
			{
				int origin = rowScrollRegion.Origin;
				if (rowScrollRegion2 != null && rowScrollRegion2.Origin < origin)
				{
					origin = rowScrollRegion2.Origin;
				}
				if (rowScrollRegion2 != null)
				{
					num = rowScrollRegion2.Extent + rowScrollRegion.Extent + rowScrollRegionSplitterBarHeightResolved;
				}
				Remove(rowScrollRegion);
				int num3 = IndexOf(rowScrollRegion);
				if (num3 < 0)
				{
					rowScrollRegion2?.SetOriginAndExtent(origin, num);
					base.Layout.UpdateUIElementRect();
				}
			}
			else if (rowScrollRegion2 != null)
			{
				SetExtent(rowScrollRegion2, num);
			}
		}

		internal void InitializeMetrics()
		{
			if (!metricsDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			metricsDirty = false;
			initializingMetrics = true;
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					this[i].RegenerateVisibleRows();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				initializingMetrics = false;
			}
			if (base.Layout.ActiveCell == null || !base.Layout.ActiveCell.IsInEditMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (base.Layout.ActiveCell != null)
				{
					base.Layout.ActiveCell.RepositionTextBoxCtl();
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		internal override void CheckIfSizeChanged()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i].CheckIfSizeChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.RowScrollRegion, propChange);
			if (propChange.PropId is PropertyIds)
			{
				PropertyIds propertyIds = (PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
				if (propertyIds == PropertyIds.Hidden || propertyIds == PropertyIds.Remove || propertyIds == PropertyIds.Scrollbar)
				{
					base.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void InitFirstRegion()
		{
			if (Count < 1)
			{
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = new RowScrollRegion(this);
				List.Add(rowScrollRegion);
				rowScrollRegion.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		internal void InternalInsert(RowScrollRegion rsr, int insertAt)
		{
			InternalInsert(insertAt, rsr);
			rsr.SubObjectPropChanged += OnSubObjectPropChanged;
			metricsDirty = true;
		}

		internal RowScrollRegion GetNextVisibleRegion(RowScrollRegion startRegion, bool wrap)
		{
			if (Count < 1)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = null;
			for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (startRegion == this[num] && (rowScrollRegion != null || !wrap))
				{
					return rowScrollRegion;
				}
				if (!this[num].Hidden)
				{
					rowScrollRegion = this[num];
				}
			}
			return rowScrollRegion;
		}

		internal RowScrollRegion GetPreviousVisibleRegion(RowScrollRegion startRegion, bool wrap)
		{
			if (Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (startRegion == this[i] && (rowScrollRegion != null || !wrap))
				{
					return rowScrollRegion;
				}
				if (!this[i].Hidden)
				{
					rowScrollRegion = this[i];
				}
			}
			return rowScrollRegion;
		}

		internal void SetExtent(RowScrollRegion rsr, int newExtent)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = base.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			if (ultraGrid != null && (ultraGrid.EventManager.InProgress(GridEventIds.BeforeRowRegionSize) || ultraGrid.EventManager.InProgress(GridEventIds.BeforeRowRegionSplit)))
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_256"));
			}
			RowScrollRegion nextVisibleRegion = GetNextVisibleRegion(rsr, wrap: false);
			if (nextVisibleRegion == null)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_61"));
			}
			int origin = rsr.Origin;
			int extent = rsr.Extent;
			int origin2 = nextVisibleRegion.Origin;
			int extent2 = nextVisibleRegion.Extent;
			if (newExtent < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_256"));
			}
			int num = base.Layout?.HorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved ?? ScaledSystemInformation.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeight((Control)null);
			int num2 = extent + extent2 - num;
			if (newExtent > num2 && num2 > 0)
			{
				newExtent = num2;
			}
			if (newExtent < 0)
			{
				newExtent = 0;
			}
			int num3 = newExtent - extent;
			rsr.SetOriginAndExtent(origin, newExtent);
			nextVisibleRegion.SetOriginAndExtent(origin2 + num3, extent2 - num3);
			if (ultraGrid != null)
			{
				BeforeRowRegionSizeEventArgs e = new BeforeRowRegionSizeEventArgs(rsr, nextVisibleRegion);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowRegionSize, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					rsr.SetOriginAndExtent(origin, extent);
					nextVisibleRegion.SetOriginAndExtent(origin2, extent2);
				}
			}
			base.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
			rsr.PositionScrollbar(resetScrollInfo: true);
			nextVisibleRegion.PositionScrollbar(resetScrollInfo: true);
			metricsDirty = true;
		}

		public void Remove(RowScrollRegion rsr)
		{
			if (!(base.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_257"));
			}
			if (Count < 2)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_258"));
			}
			int num = IndexOf(rsr);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				BeforeRowRegionRemovedEventArgs e = new BeforeRowRegionRemovedEventArgs(rsr);
				ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowRegionRemoved, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				rsr.SubObjectPropChanged -= OnSubObjectPropChanged;
				rsr.Dispose();
			}
			InternalRemove(rsr);
			metricsDirty = true;
			if (base.Layout != null)
			{
				base.Layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
				base.Layout.UIElementInternal.VerifyChildElements(true);
			}
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Remove);
		}

		public override void Reset()
		{
			base.Reset();
			for (int num = List.Count - 1; num > 0; num--)
			{
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = (RowScrollRegion)List[num];
				rowScrollRegion.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				rowScrollRegion.Dispose();
				InternalRemove(rowScrollRegion);
			}
			metricsDirty = true;
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Remove);
		}

		internal void OnRowDeleted(UltraGridRow deletedRow)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (this[i].FirstRow == deletedRow)
				{
					this[i].SetDestroyVisibleRows(Set: true, setScrollToBeginning: true);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ResetFirstRowIfDescendantOf(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = this[i];
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = rowScrollRegion.FirstRow;
				if (ultraGridRow == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				while (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					if (ultraGridRow.ParentCollection == rows)
					{
						rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(rows.GetFirstVisibleRow());
						break;
					}
					ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void DirtyAllVisibleRows()
		{
			DirtyAllVisibleRows(setScrollToBeginning: false);
		}

		internal void DirtyAllVisibleRows(bool setScrollToBeginning)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i].SetDestroyVisibleRows(Set: true, setScrollToBeginning);
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyAllScrollbarPositions()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i].PositionScrollbar(resetScrollInfo: true);
			}
		}

		public new RowScrollRegionEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new RowScrollRegionEnumerator(this);
		}

		public void CopyTo(RowScrollRegion[] array, int index)
		{
			base.CopyTo(array, index);
		}
	}

		protected RowSelectorImageInfo(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Reset();
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "AddNewRowImage":
					addNewRowImage = (Image)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Image), addNewRowImage);
					break;
				case "ActiveAndDataChangedImage":
					activeDataChangedImage = (Image)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Image), activeDataChangedImage);
					break;
				case "ActiveAndAddNewRowImage":
					activeAddNewRowImage = (Image)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Image), activeAddNewRowImage);
					break;
				case "ActiveRowImage":
					activeRowImage = (Image)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Image), activeRowImage);
					break;
				case "DataChangedImage":
					dataChangedImage = (Image)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Image), dataChangedImage);
					break;
				case "UseDefaultActiveAndAddNewRowImage":
					useDefaultActiveAndAddNewRowImage = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), useDefaultActiveAndAddNewRowImage);
					break;
				case "UseDefaultActiveAndDataChangedImage":
					useDefaultActiveAndDataChangedImage = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), useDefaultActiveAndDataChangedImage);
					break;
				case "UseDefaultActiveRowImage":
					useDefaultActiveRowImage = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), useDefaultActiveRowImage);
					break;

			{
				if (scrollbarRectSet && ScrollbarRect.Equals(value))
				{

				}
				scrollbarRectValue = value;
				scrollbarRectSet = true;
				if (scrollbarRectValue.IsEmpty)
				{
					if (scrollBarInfoValue != null && scrollBarInfoValue.Visible)

			}
			set
			{
				if (value == hidden)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value && !AreAnyOtherScrollRegionsVisible())
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_258"));
				}
				if (value && !base.Disposed && Layout != null && !Layout.Disposed && Layout.Grid != null && !((Control)(object)Layout.Grid).IsDisposed)
				{
					if (this == Layout.ActiveColScrollRegion)
					{
						Layout.Grid.InternalResetActiveColScrollRegion();
					}
					else if (this == Layout.ActiveRowScrollRegion)
					{
						Layout.Grid.InternalResetActiveRowScrollRegion();
					}
				}
				hidden = value;
				if (Layout != null)
				{
					Layout.DirtyGridElement();
				}
			}
		}

		protected Scrollbar ScrollbarResolved
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsClone)
				{
					return ClonedFrom.ScrollbarResolved;
				}
				if (Scrollbar == Scrollbar.Default)
				{
					switch (Layout.ScrollbarsResolved)
					{
					case Scrollbars.None:
						return Scrollbar.Hide;
					case Scrollbars.Vertical:
						if (IsVerticalScrollbar)
						{
							return Scrollbar.Show;
						}
						return Scrollbar.Hide;
					case Scrollbars.Horizontal:
						if (IsVerticalScrollbar)
						{
							return Scrollbar.Hide;
						}
						return Scrollbar.Show;
					case Scrollbars.Both:
						return Scrollbar.Show;
					case Scrollbars.Automatic:
						return Scrollbar.ShowIfNeeded;
					default:
						return Scrollbar.Show;
					}
				}
				return Scrollbar;
			}
		}

		{
			return OnScroll(scrollBar, scrollType, exitEditMode: true, invalidateRegion: false);
		}

		internal abstract bool OnScroll(ScrollBarInfo scrollBar, ScrollEventType scrollType, bool exitEditMode, bool invalidateRegion);

		internal void OnScroll(object sender, ScrollEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_0059: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0069: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!Layout.ExitEditModeHelper())
			{
				if (sender is ScrollBarInfo)
				{
					e.NewValue = ((ScrollBarInfo)sender).Value;
					((ScrollBarInfo)sender).CancelScroll(true);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				oldScrollPercent = ScrollBarInfo.GetScrollPercent();
				scrollBarInfoValue.Value = e.NewValue;
				OnScroll((ScrollBarInfo)sender, e.Type);
				e.NewValue = scrollBarInfoValue.Value;
				RaiseScrollPatternScrollPercentPropertyIdChanged();
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			if (scrollBarInfoValue != null)
			{
				scrollBarInfoValue.Scroll -= OnScroll;
				((DisposableObject)(object)scrollBarInfoValue).Dispose();
				scrollBarInfoValue = null;
			}
		}

		internal void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (ShouldSerializeHidden())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Hidden", hidden);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeScrollbar())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Scrollbar", Scrollbar);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSizingMode())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SizingMode", SizingMode);
			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Extent", extent);
			SerializeTag(info);
		}

		protected ScrollRegionBase(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Reset();
			scrollbarRectValue = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			cachedScrollOriginValue = 1073741824;
			InitCollection(null);
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				switch (current.Name)
				{
				case "Hidden":
					Hidden = (bool)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(bool), hidden);
					break;
				case "Scrollbar":
					Scrollbar = (Scrollbar)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(Scrollbar), scrollbar);
					break;
				case "SizingMode":
					SizingMode = (SizingMode)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(SizingMode), sizingMode);
					break;
				case "Tag":
					DeserializeTag(current);
					break;
				case "Extent":
					Extent = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), extent);
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InitCollection(ScrollRegionsCollectionBase collection)
		{
			collectionValue = collection;
		}

		internal virtual void SetOriginAndExtent(int origin, int extent)
		{
			if (this.origin == origin && this.extent == extent)
			{
				PositionScrollbar(resetScrollInfo: false);
				return;
			}
			this.origin = origin;
			this.extent = extent;
			PositionScrollbar(resetScrollInfo: true);
		}

		private bool AreAnyOtherScrollRegionsVisible()
		{
			if (clonedFromRegion != null)
			{
				return clonedFromRegion.AreAnyOtherScrollRegionsVisible();
			}
			ScrollRegionsCollectionBase collection = Collection;
			if (collection != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < collection.Count; i++)
				{
					if (collection.GetItem(i) is ScrollRegionBase scrollRegionBase && scrollRegionBase != this && !scrollRegionBase.Hidden)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeHidden()
		{
			return hidden;
		}

		public void ResetHidden()
		{
			Hidden = false;
		}

		internal void Invalidate(Rectangle intersectRect)
		{
			if (Layout.IsDisplayLayout && intersectRect.IntersectsWith(Rect))
			{
				intersectRect.Intersect(Rect);
				Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.Invalidate(intersectRect);
			}
		}

		internal void Invalidate()
		{
			if (Layout.IsDisplayLayout)
			{
				Layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.Invalidate(Rect);
			}
		}

		public virtual bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (!ShouldSerializeHidden() && !ShouldSerializeScrollbar() && !ShouldSerializeSizingMode())
			{
				return ShouldSerializeTag();
			}
			return true;
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ResetHidden();
			ResetScrollbar();
			ResetSizingMode();
			ResetTag();
		}

		}

		public void ResetScrollbar()
		{

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSizingMode()

		public void ResetSizingMode()
		{
			SizingMode = SizingMode.Free;
		}

		protected abstract void ResetScrollInfo();

		protected void ShowScrollbar(bool show, bool resetScrollInfo)
		{
			if (show)
			{
				ScrollBarInfo.Show();
			}
			else
			{
				ScrollBarInfo.Hide();
			}
			if (resetScrollInfo)
			{
				ResetScrollInfo();
			}
		}

		internal abstract void CheckIfSizeChanged();

		internal bool WillScrollbarBeShown()
		{
			return WillScrollbarBeShown(ScrollbarVisibility.Check);
		}

	[StrongNameIdentityPermission(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, PublicKey = "")]
	public abstract class ScrollRegionsCollectionBase : SubObjectsCollectionBase
	{
		public class ScrollRegionBaseEnumerator : DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase
		{
			public ScrollRegionBase Current => (ScrollRegionBase)((IEnumerator)this).Current;

			public ScrollRegionBaseEnumerator(ScrollRegionsCollectionBase rowScrollRegions)
				: base(rowScrollRegions)
			{
			}
		}

		private UltraGridLayout layout;

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public UltraGridLayout Layout
		{
			get
			{
				return layout;
			}
			set
			{
				layout = value;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		protected override int InitialCapacity => 3;

		internal ScrollRegionBase FirstVisibleRegion
		{
			get
			{
				InitFirstRegion();
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (!((ScrollRegionBase)GetItem(i)).Hidden)
					{
						return (ScrollRegionBase)GetItem(i);
					}
				}
				return (ScrollRegionBase)GetItem(0);
			}
		}

		internal ScrollRegionBase LastVisibleRegion
		{
			get
			{
				if (this is ColScrollRegionsCollection && layout.AutoFitAllColumns)
				{
					return FirstVisibleRegion;
				}
				InitFirstRegion();
				for (int num = Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
				{
					if (!((ScrollRegionBase)GetItem(num)).Hidden)
					{
						return (ScrollRegionBase)GetItem(num);
					}
				}
				return (ScrollRegionBase)GetItem(0);
			}
		}

		internal ScrollRegionsCollectionBase(UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			this.layout = layout;
		}

		internal ScrollRegionsCollectionBase()
		{
		}

		internal abstract void CheckIfSizeChanged();

		internal abstract void InitFirstRegion();

		protected internal bool ShouldSerialize()
		{
			if (Count > 1)
			{
				return true;
			}
			ScrollRegionBaseEnumerator scrollRegionBaseEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (scrollRegionBaseEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ScrollRegionBase current = scrollRegionBaseEnumerator.Current;
					if (current.ShouldSerialize())
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = scrollRegionBaseEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public virtual void Reset()
		{
			ScrollRegionBaseEnumerator scrollRegionBaseEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (scrollRegionBaseEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					ScrollRegionBase current = scrollRegionBaseEnumerator.Current;
					current.Reset();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = scrollRegionBaseEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal abstract bool AreScrollbarsVisible(ScrollbarVisibility assumeColScrollbarsVisible);

		public ScrollRegionBaseEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new ScrollRegionBaseEnumerator(this);
		}
	}
	public class Selected
	{
		internal class SelectionPositionSortComparer : IComparer
		{
			internal SelectionPositionSortComparer()
			{
			}

			internal static int CompareRow(UltraGridRow rowX, UltraGridRow rowY)
			{
				UltraGridRow parentRow = rowX.ParentRow;
				UltraGridRow parentRow2 = rowY.ParentRow;
				if (parentRow != null)
				{
					int num = CompareRow(parentRow, parentRow2);
					if (num != 0)
					{
						return num;
					}
				}
				return rowX.Index.CompareTo(rowY.Index);
			}

			int IComparer.Compare(object x, object y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				if (x == null)
				{
					return 1;
				}
				if (y == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				if (x is UltraGridRow && y is UltraGridRow)
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (UltraGridRow)x;
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = (UltraGridRow)y;
					if (ultraGridRow.Band == ultraGridRow2.Band)
					{
						return CompareRow(ultraGridRow, ultraGridRow2);
					}
					return ultraGridRow.OverallSelectionPosition.CompareTo(ultraGridRow2.OverallSelectionPosition);
				}
				if (x is UltraGridCell && y is UltraGridCell)
				{
					UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = (UltraGridCell)x;
					UltraGridCell ultraGridCell2 = (UltraGridCell)y;
					int num = ((IComparer)this).Compare((object)ultraGridCell.Row, (object)ultraGridCell2.Row);
					if (num == 0)
					{
						return ultraGridCell.Column.Header.VisiblePosition.CompareTo(ultraGridCell2.Column.Header.VisiblePosition);
					}
					return num;
				}
				if (x is HeaderBase && y is HeaderBase)
				{
					HeaderBase headerBase = (HeaderBase)x;
					HeaderBase headerBase2 = (HeaderBase)y;
					return headerBase.VisiblePosition.CompareTo(headerBase2.VisiblePosition);
				}
				throw new ArgumentException("Passed in objects must be cells or rows.");
			}
		}

		private SelectedCellsCollection cells;

		private SelectedRowsCollection rows;

		private SelectedColsCollection columns;

		private UltraGrid grid;

		}

		internal void SetRows(SelectedRowsCollection newRows)
		{
			rows = newRows;
			if (rows != null && rows.Selected == null)
			{
				rows.Initialize(this);
			}
		}

		internal bool IsItemInCollection(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (item == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			if (rows != null && Rows.Contains(item))
			{
				result = true;
			}
			else if (columns != null && Columns.Contains(item))
			{
				result = true;
			}
			else if (cells != null && Cells.Contains(item))
			{
				result = true;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void RemoveItemFromCollection(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (item is UltraGridRow)
			{
				if (rows != null)
				{
					rows.Remove((UltraGridRow)item);
				}
			}
			else if (item is UltraGridCell)
			{
				if (cells != null)
				{
					cells.Remove((UltraGridCell)item);
				}
			}
			else if (item is ColumnHeader && columns != null)
			{
				columns.Remove((ColumnHeader)item);
			}
		}

		private static UltraGridBand GetBandFromItem(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			UltraGridBand result = null;
			if (item is UltraGridRow)
			{
				result = ((UltraGridRow)item).BandInternal;
			}
			else if (item is UltraGridCell)
			{
				result = ((UltraGridCell)item).Band;
			}
			else if (item is ColumnHeader)
			{
				result = ((ColumnHeader)item).Band;
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal static void RemoveItemFromCollectionHelper(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			UltraGridBand bandFromItem = GetBandFromItem(item);
			if (bandFromItem != null)
			{
				UltraGridLayout layout = bandFromItem.Layout;
				if (layout != null && !layout.Disposed && layout.Grid is UltraGrid { HasSelectedBeenAllocated: not false, Selected: var selected })
				{
					selected.RemoveItemFromCollection(item);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ClearAllSelected()
		{
			if (rows != null)
			{
				ClearSelectedFlags(rows);
				rows.InternalClear();
			}
			if (columns != null)
			{
				ClearSelectedFlags(columns);
				columns.InternalClear();
			}
			if (cells != null)
			{
				ClearSelectedFlags(cells);
				cells.InternalClear();
			}
		}

		private static void ClearSelectedFlags(IEnumerable gridItems)
		{
			foreach (GridItemBase gridItem in gridItems)
			{
				gridItem.InternalSelect(value: false, raiseNotification: false);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearItemsOfType(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (item is UltraGridRow)
			{
				if (HasRows)
				{
					Rows.Clear();
				}
			}
			else if (item is UltraGridCell)
			{
				if (HasCells)
				{
					Cells.Clear();
				}
			}
			else if (item is HeaderBase && HasColumns)
			{
				Columns.Clear();
			}
		}

		private static bool CompareCollections(ICollection coll1, ICollection coll2)
		{
			if (coll1 == coll2)
			{
				return true;
			}
			int num = coll1?.Count ?? 0;
			int num2 = coll2?.Count ?? 0;
			if (num <= 0 && num2 <= 0)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (num != num2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = true;
			IEnumerator enumerator = coll2.GetEnumerator();
			enumerator.Reset();
			foreach (object item in coll1)
			{
				if (!enumerator.MoveNext() || item != enumerator.Current)
				{
					flag = false;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable(coll1.Count);
			Hashtable hashtable2 = new Hashtable(coll2.Count);
			object value = new object();
			foreach (object item2 in coll1)
			{
				hashtable[item2] = value;
			}
			foreach (object item3 in coll2)
			{
				hashtable2[item3] = value;
			}
			if (hashtable.Count != hashtable2.Count)
			{
				return false;
			}
			foreach (object key in hashtable.Keys)
			{
				if (!hashtable2.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			foreach (object key2 in hashtable2.Keys)
			{
				if (!hashtable.ContainsKey(key2))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal bool IsSelectionSameForItemType(Type itemType, Selected selectionToCompareTo)
		{
			if (typeof(UltraGridRow) == itemType || typeof(UltraGridRow).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))
			{
				return CompareCollections(rows, selectionToCompareTo.rows);
			}
			if (typeof(UltraGridCell) == itemType || typeof(UltraGridCell).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))
			{
				return CompareCollections(cells, selectionToCompareTo.cells);
			}
			if (typeof(HeaderBase) == itemType || typeof(HeaderBase).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))
			{
				return CompareCollections(columns, selectionToCompareTo.columns);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void RemoveDuplicateObjects(ArrayList list)
		{
			int num = 0;
			int i = 0;
			int count;
			for (count = list.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				for (; i + 1 < count && list[i] == list[i + 1]; i++)
				{
				}
				if (i >= count)
				{
					break;
				}
				list[num] = list[i];
				num++;
			}
			if (num < count)
			{
				list.RemoveRange(num, count - num);
			}
		}

		internal bool VerifyRowsNotDirty()
		{
			if (!needsToVerifyRowCollections)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = grid;
			if (inVerifyRowsNotDirty || ultraGrid == null || this != ultraGrid.SelectedIfAllocated)
			{
				return false;
			}
			needsToVerifyRowCollections = false;
			inVerifyRowsNotDirty = true;
			try
			{
				RowsCollection rowsCollection = (ultraGrid?.DisplayLayout)?.RowsIfAllocated;
				if (rowsCollection != null && rowsCollection.IsRowsDirty)
				{
					rowsCollection.SyncRows();
					return true;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inVerifyRowsNotDirty = false;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

					throw new NotSupportedException();

				Clear();
				if (value.Length != 0)
				{
					UltraGridCell[] array = new UltraGridCell[value.Length];
					for (int i = 0; i < value.Length; i++)
					{
						array[i] = (UltraGridCell)value[i];
					}
					AddRange(array);
				}
			}
		}

		internal Selected Selected => selected;

		internal UltraGrid Grid
		{
			get

			{
				int num = IndexOf(selectedCell);
				if (num >= 0)
				{
					return num;
				}

		internal int InternalAdd(object[] selectedCells)
		{
			int result = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < selectedCells.Length; i++)
			{
				if (selectedCells[i] is UltraGridCell)
				{
					result = InternalAdd((object)(selectedCells[i] as UltraGridCell));
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		{
			base.InternalClear();
		}

		{
			return new CellEnumerator(this);
		}

		{
			InternalClear();
			InternalAddRange(cells);
		}

		internal void Initialize(Selected selected)
		{
			this.selected = selected;
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			UltraGrid grid = Grid;
			if (IsReadOnly)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_NotSupportedException_346"));
			}
			grid.ClearSelectedCells();
		}

		public void AddRange(UltraGridCell[] cells)
		{
			if (cells.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGrid grid = Grid;
			UltraGridBand band = cells[0].Band;
			for (int i = 1; i < cells.Length; i++)
			{
				if (cells[i].Band != band)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_4"), "cells");
				}
			}
			if (band == null || band.Layout != grid.DisplayLayout)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArguementException_5"), "cells");
			}
			SelectType selectTypeCellResolved = band.SelectTypeCellResolved;
			if (SelectType.None == selectTypeCellResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_InvalidOperationException1"));
			}
			if (SelectType.Single == selectTypeCellResolved || SelectType.SingleAutoDrag == selectTypeCellResolved)
			{
				if (cells.Length + Count > 1)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_InvalidOperationException2"));
				}
			}
			else if (SelectType.Extended != selectTypeCellResolved && SelectType.ExtendedAutoDrag != selectTypeCellResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_InvalidOperationException3"));
			}
			if (!grid.ClearSelectedRows())
			{
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				object value = new object();
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					hashtable[this[i]] = value;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < cells.Length; i++)
				{
					hashtable[cells[i]] = value;
				}
				object[] array = new object[hashtable.Count];
				hashtable.Keys.CopyTo(array, 0);
				hashtable = null;
				Utilities.SortMerge(array, (IComparer)new Selected.SelectionPositionSortComparer());
				Selected selected = new Selected();
				selected.Cells.InternalAddRange(array);
				selected.Columns.InternalSetList(grid.Selected.Columns);
				grid.SelectNewSelection(typeof(UltraGridCell), selected);
			}
		}

		public void Add(UltraGridCell cell)
		{
			AddRange(new UltraGridCell[1] { cell });
		}

		public void CopyTo(UltraGridCell[] array, int index)
		{
			base.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			Sort(new Selected.SelectionPositionSortComparer());
		}
	}

		{
			UltraGrid grid = Grid;
			if (IsReadOnly)
			{
				throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_NotSupportedException_346"));
			}
			grid.ClearSelectedColumns();
		}

		public void AddRange(ColumnHeader[] columnHeaders)
		{
			if (columnHeaders.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGrid grid = Grid;
			UltraGridBand band = columnHeaders[0].Band;
			for (int i = 1; i < columnHeaders.Length; i++)
			{
				if (columnHeaders[i].Band != band)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_6"), "columnHeaders");
				}
			}
			if (band == null || band.Layout != grid.DisplayLayout)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_7"), "columnHeaders");
			}
			SelectType selectTypeColResolved = band.SelectTypeColResolved;
			if (SelectType.None == selectTypeColResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_InvalidOperationException4"));
			}
			if (SelectType.Single == selectTypeColResolved || SelectType.SingleAutoDrag == selectTypeColResolved)
			{
				if (columnHeaders.Length + Count > 1)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_InvalidOperationException5"));
				}
			}
			else if (SelectType.Extended != selectTypeColResolved && SelectType.ExtendedAutoDrag != selectTypeColResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException("LER_InvalidOperationException6");
			}
			Selected selected = new Selected();
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				selected.Columns.List.Add(this[i]);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < columnHeaders.Length; i++)
			{
				selected.Columns.List.Add(columnHeaders[i]);
			}
			selected.Columns.List.Sort(new Selected.SelectionPositionSortComparer());
			Selected.RemoveDuplicateObjects(selected.Columns.List);
			selected.Rows.InternalSetList(grid.Selected.Rows);
			selected.Cells.InternalSetList(grid.Selected.Cells);
			grid.SelectNewSelection(typeof(ColumnHeader), selected);
		}

		public void Add(ColumnHeader columnHeader)
		{
			AddRange(new ColumnHeader[1] { columnHeader });
		}

		public void CopyTo(ColumnHeader[] array, int index)
		{
			base.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			object[] all = All;
			Array.Sort(all, new Selected.SelectionPositionSortComparer());
			base.InternalClear();
			object[] array = all;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				SubObjectBase obj = (SubObjectBase)array[i];
				InternalAdd(obj);
			}
		}
	}

		public void AddRange(UltraGridRow[] rows)
		{
			AddRange(rows, ensureRowsOrdered: true, fireSlectionChangeEvent: true);
		}

		public void AddRange(UltraGridRow[] rows, bool ensureRowsOrdered, bool fireSlectionChangeEvent)
		{
			if (rows.Length == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGrid grid = Grid;
			UltraGridBand band = rows[0].Band;
			for (int i = 1; i < rows.Length; i++)
			{
				if (rows[i].BandInternal != band)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_8"), "rows");
				}
			}
			if (band == null || band.Layout != grid.DisplayLayout)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ArgumentException_9"), "rows");
			}
			SelectType selectTypeRowResolved = band.SelectTypeRowResolved;
			if (SelectType.None == selectTypeRowResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_InvalidOperationException7"));
			}
			if (SelectType.Single == selectTypeRowResolved || SelectType.SingleAutoDrag == selectTypeRowResolved)
			{
				if (rows.Length + Count > 1)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_InvalidOperationException8"));
				}
			}
			else if (SelectType.Extended != selectTypeRowResolved && SelectType.ExtendedAutoDrag != selectTypeRowResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_InvalidOperationException9"));
			}
			if (grid.ClearSelectedCells())
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = ensureRowsOrdered || Count != 0;
			if (flag && Count == 0)
			{
				flag = false;
				int i = 1;
				while (!flag && i < rows.Length)
				{
					flag = 0 < Selected.SelectionPositionSortComparer.CompareRow(rows[i - 1], rows[i]);
					i++;
				}
			}
			object[] array;
			if (flag)
			{
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				object value = new object();
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					hashtable[this[i]] = value;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < rows.Length; i++)
				{
					hashtable[rows[i]] = value;
				}
				array = new object[hashtable.Count];
				hashtable.Keys.CopyTo(array, 0);
				hashtable = null;
				Utilities.SortMerge(array, (IComparer)new Selected.SelectionPositionSortComparer());
			}
			else
			{
				array = rows;
			}
			if (!fireSlectionChangeEvent)
			{
				InternalClear();
				InternalAddRange(array);
				{
					RowEnumerator rowEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
					try
					{
						while (rowEnumerator.MoveNext())
						{
							GridItemBase current = rowEnumerator.Current;
							current.InternalSelect(value: true);
						}
						return;
					}
					finally
					{
						IDisposable disposable = rowEnumerator as IDisposable;
						if (disposable != null)
						{
							disposable.Dispose();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			Selected selected = new Selected();
			selected.Rows.InternalAddRange(array);
			selected.Columns.InternalSetList(grid.Selected.Columns);
			grid.SelectNewSelection(typeof(UltraGridRow), selected);
		}

		public void Add(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			AddRange(new UltraGridRow[1] { row });
		}

		public void CopyTo(UltraGridRow[] array, int index)
		{
			base.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		public void Sort()
		{
			Sort(new Selected.SelectionPositionSortComparer());
		}
	}

		protected override void OnMouseHover()
		{

			if (!(ultraGridLayout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return;

			Point point = ultraGrid.EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
			UltraGridRow tooltipRow = GetTooltipRow();
			if (tooltipRow == null || !((Control)(object)ultraGridLayout.Grid).IsHandleCreated)

			ToolTip tooltipTool = ultraGrid.TooltipTool;
			if (tooltipTool != null)

				p = ultraGridLayout.Grid.EditorContainerControl.PointToScreen(p);

					Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
					rect.Inflate(6, 0);

		internal void OnKeyToggled()
		{
			if (!(lastLineCursor == null))
			{
				Cursor lineCursor = LineCursor;
				if (!(lineCursor == null) && !(lastLineCursor == lineCursor))
				{
					GridUtils.SetCursorPosition(Cursor.Position);
					((UIElement)this).OnMouseHover();
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetTooltipRow()
		{
			if (parentRow == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) != Keys.None && rowAboveTipEnabled && TipStyle.Hide != parentRow.Band.TipStyleRowConnectorResolved)
			{
				return parentRow;
			}
			if (!rowBelowTipEnabled)
			{
				if (rowAboveTipEnabled && TipStyle.Hide != parentRow.Band.TipStyleRowConnectorResolved)
				{
					return parentRow;
				}
				return null;
			}
			if (rowBelow != null)
			{
				if (TipStyle.Hide == rowBelow.Band.TipStyleRowConnectorResolved)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return rowBelow;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			if (firstChildConnector)
			{
				ultraGridRow = parentRow.GetChild(ChildRow.First, null);
				if (ultraGridRow == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
				{
					ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetNextVisibleRelative(spanBands: true, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ultraGridRow = parentRow.GetNextVisibleRelative(spanBands: true, skipThisRow: true, spanParents: false);
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null)
			{
				rowBelow = ultraGridRow;
			}
			if (rowBelow != null)
			{
				if (TipStyle.Hide == rowBelow.Band.TipStyleRowConnectorResolved)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return rowBelow;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = (UltraGridLayout)((UIElement)this).Parent.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridLayout), true);
			if (ultraGridLayout.Grid is UltraGrid { HasTooltipTool: not false } ultraGrid)
			{
				ultraGrid.TooltipTool.Hide();
			}
			((UIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
		}

		protected override void OnDoubleClick(bool adjustableArea)
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = (UltraGridLayout)((UIElement)this).Parent.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridLayout), true);
			if (ultraGridLayout.Grid is UltraGrid { HasTooltipTool: not false } ultraGrid)
			{
				ultraGrid.TooltipTool.Hide();
			}
			if (ultraGridLayout == null || ultraGridLayout.Grid == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridRow tooltipRow = GetTooltipRow();
			if (tooltipRow != null)
			{
				if (tooltipRow == ultraGridLayout.ActiveRow)
				{
					ultraGridLayout.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(tooltipRow);
				}
				else
				{
					ultraGridLayout.Grid.ActiveRow = tooltipRow;
				}
			}
		}
	}

					break;

	[Serializable]
	public class SortedColumnsCollection : KeyedSubObjectsCollectionBase, ISerializable
	{
		private UltraGridBand band;

		private bool firingBeforeSortChange;

		private bool isClone;

		private int sortVersion;

		private SerializedColumnID[] serializedColumnIDs;

		internal bool inProcessingNewSortedColumns;

		private int initialCapacity = 5;

		public UltraGridBand Band => band;

		internal UltraGridLayout Layout => band.Layout;

		internal int SortVersion => sortVersion;

		internal bool HasSerializedColumnIDs
		{
			get
			{
				if (serializedColumnIDs != null)
				{
					return serializedColumnIDs.Length != 0;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		protected override int InitialCapacity => initialCapacity;

		public UltraGridColumn this[int index] => (UltraGridColumn)base.GetItem(index);

		public UltraGridColumn this[string key] => (UltraGridColumn)base.GetItem(key);

		public bool IsFixedSize => false;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => false;

		internal int LastGroupByColIndex
		{
			get
			{
				int i;
				for (i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					if (!this[i].IsGroupByColumn)
					{
						return i - 1;
					}
				}
				if (i - 1 >= 0 && this[i - 1].IsGroupByColumn)
				{
					return i - 1;
				}
				return -1;
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn LastGroupByColumn
		{
			get
			{
				int lastGroupByColIndex = LastGroupByColIndex;
				if (lastGroupByColIndex >= 0)
				{
					return this[lastGroupByColIndex];
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasGroupByColumns
		{
			get
			{
				if (Count > 0)
				{
					return this[0].IsGroupByColumn;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal int GroupBySortColumnsCount
		{
			get
			{
				int i;
				for (i = 0; i < Count && this[i].IsGroupByColumn; i++)
				{
				}
				return i;
			}
		}

		public SortedColumnsCollection(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			this.band = band;
		}

		internal void VerifyColumns()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				if (band.Columns.IndexOf(this[i]) < 0)
				{
					RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
		}

		internal int AddSortedColHelper(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			column.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			return InternalAdd(column);
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (HasSerializedColumnIDs && Count == 0)
			{
				int num = 0;
				for (int i = 0; i < serializedColumnIDs.Length; i++)
				{
					SerializedColumnID serializedColumnID = serializedColumnIDs[i];
					if (serializedColumnID != null)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", num);
				for (int j = 0; j < serializedColumnIDs.Length; j++)
				{
					SerializedColumnID serializedColumnID2 = serializedColumnIDs[j];
					if (serializedColumnID2 != null)
					{
						Utils.SerializeProperty(info, j.ToString(), serializedColumnID2);
					}
				}
				return;
			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Count", Count);
			for (int k = 0; k < Count; k++)
			{
				int num2 = this[k].Index;
				if (!this[k].IsBound)
				{
					num2 -= Band.Columns.BoundColumnsCount;
				}
				SerializedColumnID value = new SerializedColumnID(num2, this[k].IsBound, this[k].SortIndicator, this[k].IsGroupByColumn, this[k].Key);
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, k.ToString(), value);
			}
		}

		protected SortedColumnsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(SerializedColumnID))
				{
					int num = int.Parse(current.Name);
					SerializedColumnID serializedColumnID = (SerializedColumnID)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(SerializedColumnID), null);
					if (serializedColumnID != null && num >= 0 && num < serializedColumnIDs.Length)
					{
						serializedColumnIDs[num] = serializedColumnID;
					}
					continue;
				}
				string name = current.Name;
				if (!(name == "Count"))
				{
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					int num2 = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(int), 0);
					initialCapacity = Math.Max(initialCapacity, num2);
					serializedColumnIDs = new SerializedColumnID[num2];
				}
			}
		}

		public void Remove(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (isClone)
			{
				InternalRemove(column);
			}
			else
			{
				SetSortedColumn(column, SortIndicator.None, column.IsGroupByColumn, clearExistingNonGroupByColumns: false, fireEvents: true);
			}
		}

		public void Insert(int insertIndex, UltraGridColumn column, bool groupBy)
		{
			//IL_006a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006f: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			if (insertIndex > 1 + LastGroupByColIndex)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_334"));
			}
			if (SortIndicator.Disabled == column.SortIndicator)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_335"));
			}
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_268"));
			}
			if (column.Band != band)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_262"));
			}
			if (groupBy && 2 == (int)column.AllowGroupByResolved)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_InvalidOperationException_263"));
			}
			if (firingBeforeSortChange)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_264"));
			}
			if (column.SortIndicator == SortIndicator.Disabled)
			{
				return;
			}
			SortIndicator sortIndicator = ((column.SortIndicator == SortIndicator.None) ? SortIndicator.Ascending : column.SortIndicator);
			if (isClone)
			{
				column.TempSortIndicator = sortIndicator;
				column.TempIsGroupByColumn = groupBy;
				if (Contains(column))
				{
					InternalRemove(column);
				}
				if (groupBy)
				{
					int index = Math.Min(insertIndex, 1 + LastGroupByColIndex);
					InternalInsert(index, column);
				}
				else
				{
					InternalInsert(insertIndex, column);
				}
				return;
			}
			SortedColumnsCollection sortedColumnsCollection = Clone();
			foreach (UltraGridColumn item in (IEnumerable)sortedColumnsCollection)
			{
				item.isCloneForEvents = true;
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = column.Clone();
			ultraGridColumn2.isCloneForEvents = true;
			column.TempSortIndicator = sortIndicator;
			if (groupBy && sortedColumnsCollection.GetColumnIndex(column) >= 0)
			{
				int columnIndex = sortedColumnsCollection.GetColumnIndex(column);
				if (columnIndex - 1 >= 0)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn3 = this[columnIndex - 1];
					ultraGridColumn3.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
					if (ultraGridColumn3.ClonedFromColumn != null)
					{
						ultraGridColumn3.ClonedFromColumn.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Band.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
				}
			}
			try
			{
				if (sortedColumnsCollection.GetColumnIndex(column) >= 0)
				{
					int columnIndex2 = sortedColumnsCollection.GetColumnIndex(column);
					if (columnIndex2 < insertIndex)
					{
						insertIndex--;
					}
					if (columnIndex2 >= 0)
					{
						sortedColumnsCollection.Remove(columnIndex2);
					}
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			if (sortIndicator != SortIndicator.None && sortIndicator != SortIndicator.Disabled && ultraGridColumn2 != null)
			{
				ultraGridColumn2.InitSortIndicator(sortIndicator);
				ultraGridColumn2.TempSortIndicator = sortIndicator;
				ultraGridColumn2.TempIsGroupByColumn = groupBy;
				if (groupBy)
				{
					sortedColumnsCollection.InternalInsert(insertIndex, ultraGridColumn2);
					if (insertIndex - 1 >= 0)
					{
						sortedColumnsCollection[insertIndex - 1].BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
					}
					else
					{
						Band.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					sortedColumnsCollection.InternalAdd(ultraGridColumn2);
				}
			}
			ProcessNewSortedColumnsHelper(sortedColumnsCollection, fireEvents: true, groupBy);
		}

		internal int GetColumnIndex(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			int num = IndexOf(column.Key);
			if (num < 0)
			{
				num = IndexOf(column);
			}
			if (num < 0 && column.ClonedFromColumn != null)
			{
				num = IndexOf(column.ClonedFromColumn);
			}
			if (num < 0)
			{
				int index = column.Index;
				if (index < 0 && column.ClonedFromColumn != null)
				{
					index = column.ClonedFromColumn.Index;
				}
				if (index >= 0)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = this[i];
						if (column.Band == ultraGridColumn.Band && (ultraGridColumn.Index == index || (ultraGridColumn.ClonedFromColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.ClonedFromColumn.Index == index)))
						{
							num = i;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		public void Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_265"));
			}
			if (!(value is UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Exception_323", value.GetType().Name));
			}
			ultraGridColumn.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			if (index <= LastGroupByColIndex)
			{
				ultraGridColumn.SetGroupByColumnStatus(groupedBy: true);
				try
				{
					int columnIndex = GetColumnIndex(ultraGridColumn);
					if (columnIndex >= 0)
					{
						Remove(columnIndex);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				InternalInsert(index, ultraGridColumn);
			}
			else
			{
				InternalInsert(index, ultraGridColumn);
			}
		}

		internal void ClearGroupByColumns()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = this[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn)
				{
					ultraGridColumn.InternalSetIsGroupByColumn(val: false);
					RemoveAt(i);
					i--;
				}
			}
			Band.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
		}

		public int Add(UltraGridColumn column, bool descending, bool groupBy)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_266"));
			}
			if (column.Band != band)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_267"));
			}
			SortIndicator sortIndicator = ((!descending) ? SortIndicator.Ascending : SortIndicator.Descending);
			if (isClone)
			{
				column.TempSortIndicator = sortIndicator;
				column.TempIsGroupByColumn = groupBy;
				if (Contains(column))
				{
					InternalRemove(column);
				}
				if (groupBy)
				{
					int num = 1 + LastGroupByColIndex;
					InternalInsert(num, column);
					return num;
				}
				return InternalAdd(column);
			}
			SetSortedColumn(column, sortIndicator, groupBy, clearExistingNonGroupByColumns: false, fireEvents: true);
			if (Contains(column))
			{
				return IndexOf(column);
			}
			return -1;
		}
