		internal void InitBand(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			this.band = band;
			ProcessSerializedColumnIDs(serializedColumnIDs);
			serializedColumnIDs = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				this[i].InitBand(this.band, calledFromEndInit: false);
				this[i].SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		private void ProcessSerializedColumnIDs(SerializedColumnID[] colids)
		{
			if (colids == null && band != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < colids.Length; i++)
			{
				ultraGridColumn = null;
				try
				{
					if (colids[i].Key.Length > 0)
					{
						ultraGridColumn = band.Columns[colids[i].Key];
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
				if (ultraGridColumn == null)
				{
					int num = colids[i].RelativeIndex;
					if (!colids[i].Bound)
					{
						num += Band.Columns.BoundColumnsCount;
					}
					try
					{
						ultraGridColumn = band.Columns[num];
					}
					catch (Exception)
					{
					}
				}
				if (ultraGridColumn != null)
				{
					ultraGridColumn.InternalSetIsGroupByColumn(colids[i].IsGroupByColumn);
					ultraGridColumn.InitSortIndicator(colids[i].SortIndicator);
					InternalAdd(ultraGridColumn);
				}
			}
			Band.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
		}

		internal void InitDuringDeserialization(UltraGridColumn[] sortedColumns)
		{
			base.InternalClear();
			for (int i = 0; i < sortedColumns.Length; i++)
			{
				if (sortedColumns[i] != null)
				{
					InternalAdd(sortedColumns[i]);
				}
			}
		}

		internal new void InternalClear()
		{
			bool hasGroupByColumns = HasGroupByColumns;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = this[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn != null && (!isClone || ultraGridColumn.ClonedFromColumn != null))
				{
					ultraGridColumn.InternalSetIsGroupByColumn(val: false);
					ultraGridColumn.InternalSetSortIndicator(SortIndicator.None);
				}
			}
			if (hasGroupByColumns && !isClone && !inProcessingNewSortedColumns && Band != null)
			{
				Band.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
			}
			base.InternalClear();
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			if (isClone)
			{
				InternalClear();
			}
			else
			{
				if (Count == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (firingBeforeSortChange)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_264"));
				}
				bool flag = Count > 0 && this[0].IsGroupByColumn;
				try
				{
					SortedColumnsCollection sortedColumnsCollection = Clone();
					foreach (UltraGridColumn item in (IEnumerable)sortedColumnsCollection)
					{
						item.isCloneForEvents = true;
					}
					sortedColumnsCollection.Clear();
					ProcessNewSortedColumnsHelper(sortedColumnsCollection, fireEvents: true, groupBy: false);
				}
				finally
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						Band.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void SetSortedColumn(UltraGridColumn column, SortIndicator sortIndicator, bool groupBy, bool clearExistingNonGroupByColumns, bool fireEvents)
		{
			if (column == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_268"));
			}
			if (column.Band != band)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_262"));
			}
			if (firingBeforeSortChange)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_264"));
			}
			SortedColumnsCollection sortedColumnsCollection = Clone();
			if (fireEvents)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridColumn item in (IEnumerable)sortedColumnsCollection)
				{
					item.isCloneForEvents = true;
				}
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = column.Clone();
			if (fireEvents)
			{
				ultraGridColumn2.isCloneForEvents = true;
			}
			if ((groupBy || column.IsGroupByColumn) && sortedColumnsCollection.GetColumnIndex(column) >= 0)
			{
				int columnIndex = sortedColumnsCollection.GetColumnIndex(column);
				if (columnIndex - 1 >= 0)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn3 = this[columnIndex - 1];
					ultraGridColumn3.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
					if (ultraGridColumn3.ClonedFromColumn != null)
					{
						ultraGridColumn3.ClonedFromColumn.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					Band.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
				}
				sortedColumnsCollection.Remove(columnIndex);
			}
			if (clearExistingNonGroupByColumns)
			{
				if (LastGroupByColIndex >= 0)
				{
					int num = 1 + LastGroupByColIndex;
					while (num < sortedColumnsCollection.Count)
					{
						sortedColumnsCollection.RemoveAt(num);
					}
					for (int num2 = Count - 1; num2 > num; num2--)
					{
						RemoveAt(num2);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					sortedColumnsCollection.Clear();
				}
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					int columnIndex2 = sortedColumnsCollection.GetColumnIndex(column);
					if (columnIndex2 >= 0)
					{
						sortedColumnsCollection.Remove(columnIndex2);
					}
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
				}
			}
			if (sortIndicator != SortIndicator.None && sortIndicator != SortIndicator.Disabled && ultraGridColumn2 != null)
			{
				ultraGridColumn2.InitSortIndicator(sortIndicator);
				ultraGridColumn2.TempSortIndicator = sortIndicator;
				ultraGridColumn2.TempIsGroupByColumn = groupBy;
				if (groupBy)
				{
					if (sortedColumnsCollection.Contains(ultraGridColumn2))
					{
						sortedColumnsCollection.Remove(ultraGridColumn2);
					}
					int lastGroupByColIndex = sortedColumnsCollection.LastGroupByColIndex;
					if (lastGroupByColIndex >= 0)
					{
						this[lastGroupByColIndex].BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
					}
					else
					{
						Band.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
					}
					sortedColumnsCollection.InternalInsert(1 + lastGroupByColIndex, ultraGridColumn2);
				}
				else
				{
					if (sortedColumnsCollection.Contains(ultraGridColumn2))
					{
						sortedColumnsCollection.Remove(ultraGridColumn2);
					}
					sortedColumnsCollection.InternalAdd(ultraGridColumn2);
				}
			}
			if (!ProcessNewSortedColumnsHelper(sortedColumnsCollection, fireEvents, groupBy) && ((!Contains(column) && sortIndicator == SortIndicator.None) || sortIndicator == SortIndicator.Disabled))
			{
				column.InitSortIndicator(sortIndicator);
				column.TempSortIndicator = sortIndicator;
			}
		}

		private bool ProcessNewSortedColumnsHelper(SortedColumnsCollection newSortedColumns, bool fireEvents, bool groupBy)
		{
			inProcessingNewSortedColumns = true;
			bool flag = false;
			ProcessMode processMode = ProcessMode.Lazy;
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < newSortedColumns.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = newSortedColumns[i];
					ultraGridColumn.InternalSetIsGroupByColumn(ultraGridColumn.TempIsGroupByColumn);
				}
				UltraGridBase grid = band.Layout.Grid;
				if (fireEvents)
				{
					if (grid == null)
					{
						fireEvents = false;
					}
					else if (grid is UltraGrid)
					{
						fireEvents = !((UltraGrid)grid).EventManager.InProgress(GridEventIds.InitializeLayout);
					}
					else if (grid is UltraCombo)
					{
						fireEvents = !((UltraCombo)grid).EventManager.InProgress(ComboEventIds.InitializeLayout);
					}
					else if (grid is UltraDropDown)
					{
						fireEvents = !((UltraDropDown)grid).EventManager.InProgress(DropDownEventIds.InitializeLayout);
					}
				}
				if (fireEvents)
				{
					firingBeforeSortChange = true;
					BeforeSortChangeEventArgs e = new BeforeSortChangeEventArgs(band, newSortedColumns);
					fireEvents = grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.BeforeSortChange, e, checkInProgress: true);
					if (e.Cancel)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					processMode = e.ProcessMode;
					firingBeforeSortChange = false;
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					IUltraCalcManager calcManager = Layout.CalcManager;
					if (calcManager != null)
					{
						List<UltraGridRefBase> list = new List<UltraGridRefBase>();
						try
						{
							bool flag2 = false;
							foreach (UltraGridColumn item in (IEnumerable)newSortedColumns)
							{
								UltraGridColumn clonedFromColumn = item.ClonedFromColumn;
								if (clonedFromColumn != null && clonedFromColumn.HasActiveFormula)
								{
									flag2 = true;
									ColumnReference calcReference = clonedFromColumn.CalcReference;
									if (calcReference != null && calcReference.RecalcDeferredBase)
									{
										RefUtils.RemoveFormulaHelper(calcManager, calcReference.Formula);
										calcReference.disableRecalcDeferredOverride = true;
										list.Add(calcReference);
										RefUtils.AddFormulaHelper(calcManager, calcReference.Formula);
									}
								}
							}
							if (flag2)
							{
								calcManager.PerformAction(UltraCalcAction.Recalc, -1L);
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							foreach (UltraGridRefBase item2 in list)
							{
								item2.disableRecalcDeferredOverride = false;
							}
						}
					}
					BandReference bandReference = (Band.HasCalcReference ? Band.CalcReference : null);
					try
					{
						bandReference?.SuspendVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas();
						ApplyNewSortedColumns(newSortedColumns, groupBy);
					}
					finally
					{
						bandReference?.ResumeVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas(verifyOnResume: false);
					}
					inProcessingNewSortedColumns = false;
					if (fireEvents)
					{
						grid.Rows.EnsureSortedAndFilteredHelper(processMode, Band);
						BandEventArgs e2 = new BandEventArgs(band);
						grid.FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds.AfterSortChange, e2);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inProcessingNewSortedColumns = false;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal void ApplyNewSortedColumns(SortedColumnsCollection newSortedColumns, bool groupBy)
		{
			InternalClear();
			if (newSortedColumns.Count > 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < newSortedColumns.Count; i++)
				{
					if (newSortedColumns[i] != null)
					{
						UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = newSortedColumns[i].ClonedFromColumn;
						if (ultraGridColumn == null)
						{
							ultraGridColumn = newSortedColumns[i];
						}
						List.Add(ultraGridColumn);
						ultraGridColumn.InternalSetIsGroupByColumn(newSortedColumns[i].TempIsGroupByColumn);
						ultraGridColumn.InternalSetSortIndicator(newSortedColumns[i].TempSortIndicator);
						int num = Math.Max(ultraGridColumn.GroupByHierarchyVersion, newSortedColumns[i].GroupByHierarchyVersion);
						if (num != ultraGridColumn.GroupByHierarchyVersion)
						{
							ultraGridColumn.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
						}
					}
				}
				newSortedColumns.Clear();
			}
			if (!groupBy)
			{
				BumpSortVersion();
				OnSortChanged();
			}
			else
			{
				OnSortChanged();
			}
		}

		internal void OnSortChanged()
		{
			OnSortChanged(null);
		}

		internal void OnSortChanged(UltraGridRow firstRow)
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
			if (ultraGridBand == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridLayout layout = ultraGridBand.Layout;
			if (layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RowScrollRegionsCollection rowScrollRegions = layout.RowScrollRegions;
			if (rowScrollRegions == null || rowScrollRegions.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridBase grid = layout.Grid;
			if (grid == null || grid.InInitializeLayout || layout.isInInitializeFrom || layout.ScrollBoundsResolved == ScrollBounds.ScrollToFill)
			{
				layout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: true);
				return;
			}
			bool flag = inProcessingNewSortedColumns;
			try
			{
				if (Band.Layout.Grid != null && !Band.Layout.Grid.InInitializeLayout)
				{
					bool[] array = new bool[rowScrollRegions.Count];
					for (int i = 0; i < rowScrollRegions.Count; i++)
					{
						RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = rowScrollRegions[i];
						if (rowScrollRegion.InternalFirstRow == null)
						{
							array[i] = false;
							continue;
						}
						inProcessingNewSortedColumns = true;
						array[i] = rowScrollRegion.IsFirstScrollableRowVisible() && rowScrollRegion.IsLastScrollableRowVisible();
						if (!array[i])
						{
							UltraGridRow firstRow2 = rowScrollRegion.FirstRow;
							if (firstRow != null)
							{
								rowScrollRegion.FirstRow = firstRow;
							}
							else
							{
								rowScrollRegion.FirstRow = Band.Layout.Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow();
							}
							rowScrollRegion.SetDestroyVisibleRows(Set: true);
							rowScrollRegion.RegenerateVisibleRows(resetScrollInfo: false);
							array[i] = rowScrollRegion.IsFirstScrollableRowVisible() && rowScrollRegion.IsLastScrollableRowVisible();
							if (!array[i])
							{
								rowScrollRegion.FirstRow = firstRow2;
							}
						}
					}
					for (int i = 0; i < rowScrollRegions.Count; i++)
					{
						RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion2 = rowScrollRegions[i];
						bool flag2 = array[i];
						rowScrollRegion2.SetDestroyVisibleRows(Set: true, flag2);
						if (flag2)
						{
							inProcessingNewSortedColumns = false;
							rowScrollRegion2.FirstRow = ((firstRow != null) ? firstRow : Band.Layout.Rows.GetFirstScrollableRow());
						}
					}
				}
				Band.Layout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			finally
			{
				inProcessingNewSortedColumns = flag;
			}
		}

		internal void BumpSortVersion()
		{
			sortVersion++;
			if (Band != null)
			{
				Band.BumpFixedHeadersVerifyVersion();
			}
			if (Band != null)
			{
				Band.DirtyRowLayoutCachedInfo();
			}
		}

		public void RefreshSort(bool regroupBy)
		{
			if (regroupBy && Band != null)
			{
				Band.BumpGroupByHierarchyVersion();
			}
			BumpSortVersion();
			OnSortChanged();
		}

		internal SortedColumnsCollection Clone()
		{
			SortedColumnsCollection sortedColumnsCollection = new SortedColumnsCollection(band);
			if (sortedColumnsCollection == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			sortedColumnsCollection.isClone = true;
			try
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
				{
					object obj = this[i].Clone();
					sortedColumnsCollection.List.Add(obj);
					this[i].TempSortIndicator = this[i].SortIndicator;
					((UltraGridColumn)obj).TempSortIndicator = this[i].SortIndicator;
					this[i].TempIsGroupByColumn = this[i].IsGroupByColumn;
					((UltraGridColumn)obj).TempIsGroupByColumn = this[i].IsGroupByColumn;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				sortedColumnsCollection = null;
			}
			return sortedColumnsCollection;
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(SortedColumnsCollection source, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			if ((categories & PropertyCategories.SortedColumns) != PropertyCategories.SortedColumns)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.Tag;
			}
			List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>(Math.Min(5, source.Count));
			for (int i = 0; i < source.Count; i++)
			{
				if (source[i].IsGroupByColumn)
				{
					list.Add(source[i]);
				}
			}
			Clear();
			for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
			{
				list[j].InternalSetIsGroupByColumn(val: true);
			}
			if (source.serializedColumnIDs != null)
			{
				ProcessSerializedColumnIDs(source.serializedColumnIDs);
			}
			else
			{
				if (source.Count < 1)
				{
					return;
				}
				ColumnsCollection columns = band.Columns;
				if (columns == null)
				{
					return;
				}
				for (int k = 0; k < source.Count; k++)
				{
					for (int l = 0; l < columns.Count; l++)
					{
						if (columns[l].CanInitializeFrom(source[k]))
						{
							SetSortedColumn(columns[l], source[k].SortIndicator, source[k].IsGroupByColumn, clearExistingNonGroupByColumns: false, Layout.IsDisplayLayout);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public void CopyFrom(SortedColumnsCollection source)
		{
			InitializeFrom(source, PropertyCategories.All);
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(Dictionary<string, SortIndicator> sortedCols)
		{
			if (band == null || sortedCols == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List.Clear();
			ColumnsCollection columns = band.Columns;
			foreach (UltraGridColumn item in columns)
			{
				SortIndicator value = SortIndicator.None;
				if (sortedCols.TryGetValue(item.Key, out value))
				{
					InternalAdd(item);
					item.InternalSetSortIndicator(value);
				}
				else
				{
					item.InternalSetSortIndicator(SortIndicator.None);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		protected override void DrawImage(ref UIElementDrawParams drawParams)
		{
			Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref drawParams.AppearanceData)).Image as Image;
			Rectangle rectInsideBorders = ((UIElement)this).RectInsideBorders;
			if (image != null)
			{
				int num = image.Width;
				int num2 = image.Height;
				if (num > rectInsideBorders.Width || num2 > rectInsideBorders.Height)
				{
					double num3 = Math.Min((double)rectInsideBorders.Width / (double)num, (double)rectInsideBorders.Height / (double)num2);
					num = (int)(num3 * (double)num);

		}

	[Serializable]
	public abstract class SpecialFilterOperand : ISerializable
	{
		private string name;

		private string displayText;

		public string Name => name;

		public string DisplayText
		{
			get
			{
				return displayText ?? name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(displayText == value))
				{
					displayText = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public SpecialFilterOperand(string name)
			: this(name, null)
		{
		}

		public SpecialFilterOperand(string name, string displayText)
		{
			this.name = name;
			this.displayText = displayText;
		}

		protected SpecialFilterOperand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string text = current.Name;
				if (!(text == "name"))
				{
					if (text == "displayText")
					{
						displayText = Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), string.Empty).ToString();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					name = Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(string), string.Empty).ToString();
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		protected virtual void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
		}

		public virtual bool Match(FilterComparisionOperator comparisonOperator, object value)
		{
			if (!SupportsOperator(comparisonOperator) || (value != null && !SupportsDataType(value.GetType())))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public abstract bool SupportsDataType(Type dataType);

		public abstract bool SupportsOperator(FilterComparisionOperator comparisonOperator);

		public override string ToString()
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
			{
				return Name;
			}
			return base.ToString();
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(Name))
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "name", Name);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(displayText))
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "displayText", displayText);
			}
			GetObjectData(info, context);
		}
	}
	internal class DateOperand : SpecialFilterOperand
	{
		public DateOperand(string name, string displayName)
			: base(name, displayName)
		{
		}

		protected DateOperand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
		}

		public override bool Match(FilterComparisionOperator comparisonOperator, object value)
		{
			if (!base.Match(comparisonOperator, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (value == null || value == DBNull.Value || Utilities.GetUnderlyingType(value.GetType()) != typeof(DateTime))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool SupportsDataType(Type dataType)
		{
			return Utilities.GetUnderlyingType(dataType) == typeof(DateTime);
		}

		public override bool SupportsOperator(FilterComparisionOperator comparisonOperator)
		{
			switch (comparisonOperator)
			{
			case FilterComparisionOperator.Equals:
			case FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals:
			case FilterComparisionOperator.LessThan:
			case FilterComparisionOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo:
			case FilterComparisionOperator.GreaterThan:
			case FilterComparisionOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo:
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}

		private DateTime cachedThisYearEnd;

		private DateTime cachedNextWeekStart;

		private DateTime cachedNextWeekEnd;

		private DateTime cachedNextMonthStart;

		private DateTime cachedNextMonthEnd;

		private DateTime cachedNextQuarterStart;

		private DateTime cachedNextQuarterEnd;

		private DateTime cachedNextYearStart;

		private DateTime cachedNextYearEnd;

		private DateTime cachedYearToDateStart;

		public RelativeDateOperand(string name, string displayText, RelativeDate relativeDate)
			: base(name, displayText)
		{
			this.relativeDate = relativeDate;
		}

		protected RelativeDateOperand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string text = current.Name;
				if (text == "relativateDate")
				{
					relativeDate = (RelativeDate)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(RelativeDate), RelativeDate.Today);
				}
			}
		}

		private static void CalculateQuarterRange(DateTime dateInQuarter, ref DateTime cachedStart, ref DateTime cachedEnd)
		{
			if (dateInQuarter.Month < 4)
			{
				cachedStart = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 1, 1);
				cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 3, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateInQuarter.Year, 3));
			}
			else if (dateInQuarter.Month < 7)
			{
				cachedStart = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 4, 1);
				cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 6, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateInQuarter.Year, 6));
			}
			else if (dateInQuarter.Month < 10)
			{
				cachedStart = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 7, 1);
				cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 9, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateInQuarter.Year, 9));
			}
			else
			{
				cachedStart = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 10, 1);
				cachedEnd = new DateTime(dateInQuarter.Year, 12, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateInQuarter.Year, 12));
			}
		}

		private static bool MatchHelper(FilterComparisionOperator comparisonOperator, DateTime rangeStart, DateTime rangeEnd, DateTime comparisonValue)
		{
			if (rangeStart > rangeEnd)
			{
				DateTime dateTime = rangeEnd;
				rangeEnd = rangeStart;
				rangeStart = dateTime;
			}
			switch (comparisonOperator)
			{
			case FilterComparisionOperator.Equals:
				if (rangeStart <= comparisonValue)
				{
					return rangeEnd >= comparisonValue;
				}
				return false;
			case FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals:
				return !MatchHelper(FilterComparisionOperator.Equals, rangeStart, rangeEnd, comparisonValue);
			case FilterComparisionOperator.LessThan:
				return comparisonValue < rangeStart;
			case FilterComparisionOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo:
				if (!(comparisonValue < rangeStart))
				{
					return MatchHelper(FilterComparisionOperator.Equals, rangeStart, rangeEnd, comparisonValue);
				}
				return true;
			case FilterComparisionOperator.GreaterThan:
				return comparisonValue > rangeEnd;
			case FilterComparisionOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo:
				if (!(comparisonValue > rangeEnd))
				{
					return MatchHelper(FilterComparisionOperator.Equals, rangeStart, rangeEnd, comparisonValue);
				}
				return true;
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}

		private void ResetCurrentDate()
		{
			useCustomCurrentDate = false;
			cachedCurrentDate = DateTime.MinValue;
		}

		internal void SetCurrentDate(DateTime currentDate)
		{
			useCustomCurrentDate = true;
			customCurrentDate = currentDate;
		}

		private void VerifyCache()
		{
			if ((useCustomCurrentDate && cachedCurrentDate == customCurrentDate) || (!useCustomCurrentDate && cachedCurrentDate == DateTime.Today))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (useCustomCurrentDate)
			{
				cachedCurrentDate = customCurrentDate;
			}
			else
			{
				cachedCurrentDate = DateTime.Today;
			}
			int length = Enum.GetValues(typeof(DayOfWeek)).Length;
			switch (relativeDate)
			{
			case RelativeDate.LastWeek:
			{
				DateTime dateTime7 = cachedCurrentDate.AddDays(-1 * length);
				if (dateTime7.DayOfWeek > DayOfWeek.Sunday)
				{
					dateTime7 = dateTime7.AddDays(-1 * Convert.ToInt32(dateTime7.DayOfWeek));
				}
				cachedLastWeekStart = dateTime7;
				cachedLastWeekEnd = dateTime7.AddDays(length - 1);
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDate.ThisWeek:
			{
				DateTime dateTime8 = cachedCurrentDate;
				if (dateTime8.DayOfWeek > DayOfWeek.Sunday)
				{
					dateTime8 = dateTime8.AddDays(-1 * Convert.ToInt32(dateTime8.DayOfWeek));
				}
				cachedThisWeekStart = dateTime8;
				cachedThisWeekEnd = dateTime8.AddDays(length - 1);
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDate.NextWeek:
			{
				DateTime dateTime6 = cachedCurrentDate.AddDays(length);
				if (dateTime6.DayOfWeek > DayOfWeek.Sunday)
				{
					dateTime6 = dateTime6.AddDays(-1 * Convert.ToInt32(dateTime6.DayOfWeek));
				}
				cachedNextWeekStart = dateTime6;
				cachedNextWeekEnd = dateTime6.AddDays(length - 1);
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDate.LastMonth:
			{
				DateTime dateTime5 = cachedCurrentDate.AddMonths(-1);
				cachedLastMonthStart = new DateTime(dateTime5.Year, dateTime5.Month, 1);
				cachedLastMonthEnd = new DateTime(dateTime5.Year, dateTime5.Month, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime5.Year, dateTime5.Month));
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDate.ThisMonth:
			{
				DateTime dateTime4 = cachedCurrentDate;
				cachedThisMonthStart = new DateTime(dateTime4.Year, dateTime4.Month, 1);
				cachedThisMonthEnd = new DateTime(dateTime4.Year, dateTime4.Month, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime4.Year, dateTime4.Month));
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDate.NextMonth:
			{
				DateTime dateTime3 = cachedCurrentDate.AddMonths(1);
				cachedNextMonthStart = new DateTime(dateTime3.Year, dateTime3.Month, 1);
				cachedNextMonthEnd = new DateTime(dateTime3.Year, dateTime3.Month, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime3.Year, dateTime3.Month));
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDate.LastQuarter:
			{
				DateTime dateInQuarter2 = cachedCurrentDate.AddMonths(-3);
				CalculateQuarterRange(dateInQuarter2, ref cachedLastQuarterStart, ref cachedLastQuarterEnd);
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDate.ThisQuarter:
				CalculateQuarterRange(cachedCurrentDate, ref cachedThisQuarterStart, ref cachedThisQuarterEnd);
				break;
			case RelativeDate.NextQuarter:
			{
				DateTime dateInQuarter = cachedCurrentDate.AddMonths(3);
				CalculateQuarterRange(dateInQuarter, ref cachedNextQuarterStart, ref cachedNextQuarterEnd);
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDate.LastYear:
			{
				DateTime dateTime2 = cachedCurrentDate.AddYears(-1);
				cachedLastYearStart = new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, 1, 1);
				cachedLastYearEnd = new DateTime(dateTime2.Year, 12, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime2.Year, 12));
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDate.ThisYear:
				cachedThisYearStart = new DateTime(cachedCurrentDate.Year, 1, 1);
				cachedThisYearEnd = new DateTime(cachedCurrentDate.Year, 12, DateTime.DaysInMonth(cachedCurrentDate.Year, 12));
				break;
			case RelativeDate.NextYear:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = cachedCurrentDate.AddYears(1);
				cachedNextYearStart = new DateTime(dateTime.Year, 1, 1);
				cachedNextYearEnd = new DateTime(dateTime.Year, 12, DateTime.DaysInMonth(dateTime.Year, 12));
				break;
			}
			case RelativeDate.YearToDate:
				cachedYearToDateStart = new DateTime(cachedCurrentDate.Year, 1, 1);
				break;
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "relativeDate", relativeDate);
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		public override bool Match(FilterComparisionOperator comparisonOperator, object value)
		{
			if (!base.Match(comparisonOperator, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			VerifyCache();
			DateTime date = ((DateTime)value).Date;
			switch (relativeDate)
			{
			case RelativeDate.Yesterday:
			{
				DateTime dateTime2 = cachedCurrentDate.AddDays(-1.0);
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, dateTime2, dateTime2, date.Date);
			}
			case RelativeDate.Today:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedCurrentDate, cachedCurrentDate, date.Date);
			case RelativeDate.Tomorrow:
			{
				DateTime dateTime = cachedCurrentDate.AddDays(1.0);
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, dateTime, dateTime, date.Date);
			}
			case RelativeDate.LastWeek:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedLastWeekStart, cachedLastWeekEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.ThisWeek:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedThisWeekStart, cachedThisWeekEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.NextWeek:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedNextWeekStart, cachedNextWeekEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.LastMonth:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedLastMonthStart, cachedLastMonthEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.ThisMonth:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedThisMonthStart, cachedThisMonthEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.NextMonth:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedNextMonthStart, cachedNextMonthEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.LastQuarter:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedLastQuarterStart, cachedLastQuarterEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.ThisQuarter:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedThisQuarterStart, cachedThisQuarterEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.NextQuarter:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedNextQuarterStart, cachedNextQuarterEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.LastYear:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedLastYearStart, cachedLastYearEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.ThisYear:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedThisYearStart, cachedThisYearEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.NextYear:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedNextYearStart, cachedNextYearEnd, date);
			case RelativeDate.YearToDate:
				return MatchHelper(comparisonOperator, cachedYearToDateStart, cachedCurrentDate, date);
			default:
				return false;
			}
		}
	}
	internal class MonthOperand : DateOperand
	{
		internal short month;

		public MonthOperand(string name, string displayText, short month)
			: base(name, displayText)
		{
			if (month < 1 || month > 12)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			this.month = month;
		}

		protected MonthOperand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string text = current.Name;
				if (text == "month")
				{
					month = (short)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(short), 1);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "month", month);
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		public override bool Match(FilterComparisionOperator comparisonOperator, object value)
		{
			if (!base.Match(comparisonOperator, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = ((DateTime)value).Month;
			return comparisonOperator switch
			{
				FilterComparisionOperator.Equals => month == num, 
				FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals => month != num, 
				FilterComparisionOperator.LessThan => num < month, 
				FilterComparisionOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo => num <= month, 
				FilterComparisionOperator.GreaterThan => num > month, 
				FilterComparisionOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo => num >= month, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}
	}
	internal class QuarterOperand : DateOperand
	{
		private short quarter;

		public QuarterOperand(string name, string displayName, short quarter)
			: base(name, displayName)
		{
			if (quarter < 1 || quarter > 4)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException();
			}
			this.quarter = quarter;
		}

		protected QuarterOperand(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
			: base(info, context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				string text = current.Name;
				if (text == "quarter")
				{
					quarter = (short)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(short), 1);
				}
			}
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, SerializationFormatter = true)]
		protected override void GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "quarter", quarter);
			base.GetObjectData(info, context);
		}

		public override bool Match(FilterComparisionOperator comparisonOperator, object value)
		{
			if (!base.Match(comparisonOperator, value))
			{
				return false;
			}
			int num = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)((DateTime)value).Month / 3.0);
			return comparisonOperator switch
			{
				FilterComparisionOperator.Equals => num == quarter, 
				FilterComparisionOperator.NotEquals => num != quarter, 
				FilterComparisionOperator.LessThan => num < quarter, 
				FilterComparisionOperator.LessThanOrEqualTo => num <= quarter, 
				FilterComparisionOperator.GreaterThan => num > quarter, 
				FilterComparisionOperator.GreaterThanOrEqualTo => num >= quarter, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}
	}

				}
				return september;
			}
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperand October
		{
			get
			{
				if (october == null)
				{
					october = new MonthOperand("October", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SpecialFilterOperand_October"), 10);
				}
				return october;
			}
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperand November
		{
			get
			{
				if (november == null)
				{
					november = new MonthOperand("November", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SpecialFilterOperand_November"), 11);
				}
				return november;
			}
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperand December
		{
			get
			{
				if (december == null)
				{
					december = new MonthOperand("December", Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SpecialFilterOperand_December"), 12);
				}
				return december;
			}
		}

		private static void VerifyDefaultOperandsRegistered()
		{
			if (!hasRegisteredDefaultOperands)
			{
				RegisteredOperands.Clear();
				RegisteredOperands.Add(Yesterday.Name, Yesterday);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(Today.Name, Today);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(Tomorrow.Name, Tomorrow);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(LastWeek.Name, LastWeek);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(ThisWeek.Name, ThisWeek);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(NextWeek.Name, NextWeek);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(LastMonth.Name, LastMonth);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(ThisMonth.Name, ThisMonth);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(NextMonth.Name, NextMonth);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(LastQuarter.Name, LastQuarter);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(ThisQuarter.Name, ThisQuarter);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(NextQuarter.Name, NextQuarter);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(LastYear.Name, LastYear);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(ThisYear.Name, ThisYear);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(NextYear.Name, NextYear);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(YearToDate.Name, YearToDate);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(Quarter1.Name, Quarter1);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(Quarter2.Name, Quarter2);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(Quarter3.Name, Quarter3);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(Quarter4.Name, Quarter4);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(January.Name, January);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(February.Name, February);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(March.Name, March);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(April.Name, April);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(May.Name, May);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(June.Name, June);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(July.Name, July);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(August.Name, August);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(September.Name, September);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(October.Name, October);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(November.Name, November);
				RegisteredOperands.Add(December.Name, December);
				hasRegisteredDefaultOperands = true;
			}
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperand GetRegisteredOperand(string operandName)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(operandName))
			{
				return null;
			}
			VerifyDefaultOperandsRegistered();
			if (RegisteredOperands.ContainsKey(operandName))
			{
				return RegisteredOperands[operandName];
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperand[] GetRegisteredOperands()
		{
			return GetRegisteredOperands(null);
		}

		public static SpecialFilterOperand[] GetRegisteredOperands(Type dataType)
		{
			VerifyDefaultOperandsRegistered();
			List<SpecialFilterOperand> list = new List<SpecialFilterOperand>();
			foreach (SpecialFilterOperand value in RegisteredOperands.Values)
			{
				if (dataType == null || value.SupportsDataType(dataType))
				{
					list.Add(value);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static void Register(SpecialFilterOperand operand)
		{
			if (operand != null)
			{
				VerifyDefaultOperandsRegistered();
				if (!RegisteredOperands.ContainsKey(operand.Name))
				{
					RegisteredOperands.Add(operand.Name, operand);
				}
			}
		}

		public static void Reset()
		{
			Reset(regenerateDefaults: true);
		}

		public static void Reset(bool regenerateDefaults)
		{
			hasRegisteredDefaultOperands = false;
			if (regenerateDefaults)
			{
				tomorrow = null;
				today = null;
				yesterday = null;
				nextWeek = null;
				thisWeek = null;
				lastWeek = null;
				nextMonth = null;
				thisMonth = null;
				lastMonth = null;
				nextQuarter = null;
				thisQuarter = null;
				lastQuarter = null;
				nextYear = null;
				thisYear = null;
				lastYear = null;
				yearToDate = null;
				quarter1 = null;
				quarter2 = null;
				quarter3 = null;
				quarter4 = null;
				january = null;
				february = null;
				march = null;
				april = null;
				may = null;
				june = null;
				july = null;
				august = null;
				september = null;
				october = null;
				november = null;
				december = null;
			}
		}

		public static void Unregister(SpecialFilterOperand operand)
		{
			if (operand != null)
			{
				VerifyDefaultOperandsRegistered();
				if (RegisteredOperands.ContainsKey(operand.Name))
				{
					RegisteredOperands.Remove(operand.Name);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		private bool SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(bool checkBoxChecked, SummaryType summaryType)
		{
			SummarySettingsCollection summaries = Column.Band.Summaries;
			SummarySettings summarySettings = summaries.FindSummary(Column, summaryType, onlyFixed: true);
			if (checkBoxChecked)
			{
				if (summarySettings == null)
				{
					summaries.Add(summaryType, null, Column, SummaryPosition.UseSummaryPositionColumn, Column);
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (summarySettings != null)
			{
				summaries.Remove(summarySettings);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool SynchronizeSummaries()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			if (Column.SingleSummariesOnly)
			{
				flag = SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(averageRadio.Checked, SummaryType.Average) || flag;
				flag = SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(sumRadio.Checked, SummaryType.Sum) || flag;
				flag = SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(minimumRadio.Checked, SummaryType.Minimum) || flag;
				flag = SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(maximumRadio.Checked, SummaryType.Maximum) || flag;
				return SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(countRadio.Checked, SummaryType.Count) || flag;
			}
			flag = SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(averageCheckBox.Checked, SummaryType.Average) || flag;
			flag = SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(sumCheckBox.Checked, SummaryType.Sum) || flag;
			flag = SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(minimumCheckBox.Checked, SummaryType.Minimum) || flag;
			flag = SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(maximumCheckBox.Checked, SummaryType.Maximum) || flag;
			return SyncSummaryWithCheckBox(countCheckBox.Checked, SummaryType.Count) || flag;
		}

		private void SummaryControl_VisibleChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.DesignMode || !base.Visible)
			{
				return;
			}
			CheckBox checkBox = averageCheckBox;
			Image image = (averageRadio.Image = ImageAverage);
			checkBox.Image = image;
			CheckBox checkBox2 = countCheckBox;
			image = (countRadio.Image = ImageCount);
			checkBox2.Image = image;
			CheckBox checkBox3 = maximumCheckBox;
			image = (maximumRadio.Image = ImageMaximum);
			checkBox3.Image = image;
			CheckBox checkBox4 = minimumCheckBox;
			image = (minimumRadio.Image = ImageMinimum);
			checkBox4.Image = image;
			noneRadio.Image = ImageNone;
			CheckBox checkBox5 = sumCheckBox;
			image = (sumRadio.Image = ImageSum);
			checkBox5.Image = image;
			bool singleSummariesOnly = Column.SingleSummariesOnly;
			panelCheckboxes.Visible = !singleSummariesOnly;
			panelRadios.Visible = singleSummariesOnly;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Column;
			Type type = ultraGridColumn?.DataType;
			if (ultraGridColumn == null || !(null != type))
			{
				return;
			}
			averageCheckBox.Enabled = false;
			countCheckBox.Enabled = false;
			minimumCheckBox.Enabled = false;
			maximumCheckBox.Enabled = false;
			sumCheckBox.Enabled = false;
			averageRadio.Enabled = false;
			countRadio.Enabled = false;
			minimumRadio.Enabled = false;
			maximumRadio.Enabled = false;
			sumRadio.Enabled = false;
			SummarySettingsCollection summaries = Column.Band.Summaries;
			if (summaries != null)
			{
				if (singleSummariesOnly)
				{
					averageRadio.Checked = summaries.FindSummary(Column, SummaryType.Average, onlyFixed: true) != null;
					countRadio.Checked = summaries.FindSummary(Column, SummaryType.Count, onlyFixed: true) != null;
					minimumRadio.Checked = summaries.FindSummary(Column, SummaryType.Minimum, onlyFixed: true) != null;
					maximumRadio.Checked = summaries.FindSummary(Column, SummaryType.Maximum, onlyFixed: true) != null;
					sumRadio.Checked = summaries.FindSummary(Column, SummaryType.Sum, onlyFixed: true) != null;
					noneRadio.Checked = !averageRadio.Checked && !countRadio.Checked && !maximumRadio.Checked && !minimumRadio.Checked && !sumRadio.Checked;
				}
				else
				{
					averageCheckBox.Checked = summaries.FindSummary(Column, SummaryType.Average, onlyFixed: true) != null;
					countCheckBox.Checked = summaries.FindSummary(Column, SummaryType.Count, onlyFixed: true) != null;
					minimumCheckBox.Checked = summaries.FindSummary(Column, SummaryType.Minimum, onlyFixed: true) != null;
					maximumCheckBox.Checked = summaries.FindSummary(Column, SummaryType.Maximum, onlyFixed: true) != null;
					sumCheckBox.Checked = summaries.FindSummary(Column, SummaryType.Sum, onlyFixed: true) != null;
				}
			}
			if (ultraGridColumn.IsColumnNumeric)
			{
				if (singleSummariesOnly)
				{
					averageRadio.Enabled = true;
					countRadio.Enabled = true;
					minimumRadio.Enabled = true;
					maximumRadio.Enabled = true;
					sumRadio.Enabled = true;
				}
				else
				{
					averageCheckBox.Enabled = true;
					countCheckBox.Enabled = true;
					minimumCheckBox.Enabled = true;
					maximumCheckBox.Enabled = true;
					sumCheckBox.Enabled = true;
				}
			}
			else if (typeof(DateTime) == type)
			{
				if (singleSummariesOnly)
				{
					countRadio.Enabled = true;
					minimumRadio.Enabled = true;
					maximumRadio.Enabled = true;
				}
				else
				{
					countCheckBox.Enabled = true;
					minimumCheckBox.Enabled = true;
					maximumCheckBox.Enabled = true;
				}
			}
			else if (typeof(IComparable).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				if (singleSummariesOnly)
				{
					countRadio.Enabled = true;
					minimumRadio.Enabled = true;
					maximumRadio.Enabled = true;
				}
				else
				{
					countCheckBox.Enabled = true;
					minimumCheckBox.Enabled = true;
					maximumCheckBox.Enabled = true;
				}
			}
			else if (singleSummariesOnly)
			{
				countRadio.Enabled = true;
			}
			else
			{
				countCheckBox.Enabled = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && components != null)
			{
				components.Dispose();
			}
			if (dialogSettings != null)
			{
				dialogSettings.Dispose();
				dialogSettings = null;
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
		}

	internal class SummaryControlUltra : SummaryControl
	{
		private UltraButton okUltraButton;

		private UltraButton cancelUltraButton;

		private UltraGroupBox ultraBackgroundPanel;

		internal override IButtonControl CancelButton => cancelUltraButton;

		internal override IButtonControl OKButton => okUltraButton;

		public SummaryControlUltra(UltraGridColumn column)
			: base(column)
		{
			ReplaceInboxControls();
		}

		protected override void AssignStyleLibraryName(string libraryName)
		{
			UltraButton ultraButton = okUltraButton;
			UltraButton ultraButton2 = cancelUltraButton;
			string text = (((UltraControlBase)ultraBackgroundPanel).StyleLibraryName = libraryName);
			string text3 = (((UltraControlBase)ultraButton2).StyleLibraryName = text);
			((UltraControlBase)ultraButton).StyleLibraryName = text3;
			base.AssignStyleLibraryName(libraryName);
		}

		protected override void AssignStyleSetName(string styleSetName)
		{
			UltraButton ultraButton = okUltraButton;
			UltraButton ultraButton2 = cancelUltraButton;
			string text = (((UltraControlBase)ultraBackgroundPanel).StyleSetName = styleSetName);
			string text3 = (((UltraControlBase)ultraButton2).StyleSetName = text);
			((UltraControlBase)ultraButton).StyleSetName = text3;
			base.AssignStyleSetName(styleSetName);
		}

		protected override void AssignUseAppStyling(bool useAppStyling)
		{
			UltraButton ultraButton = okUltraButton;
			UltraButton ultraButton2 = cancelUltraButton;
			bool flag = (((UltraControlBase)ultraBackgroundPanel).UseAppStyling = useAppStyling);
			bool flag3 = (((UltraControlBase)ultraButton2).UseAppStyling = flag);
			((UltraControlBase)ultraButton).UseAppStyling = flag3;
			base.AssignUseAppStyling(useAppStyling);
		}

		private UltraButton CopyButton(Button inboxButton)
		{
			UltraButton ultraButton = new UltraButton();
			((Control)(object)ultraButton).Bounds = inboxButton.Bounds;
			((Control)(object)ultraButton).TabIndex = inboxButton.TabIndex;
			((Control)(object)ultraButton).Text = inboxButton.Text;
			((Control)(object)ultraButton).AccessibleName = inboxButton.AccessibleName;
			ultraButton.DialogResult = inboxButton.DialogResult;
			return ultraButton;
		}

		private void ReplaceInboxControls()
		{
			ultraBackgroundPanel = new UltraGroupBox();
			((ISupportInitialize)ultraBackgroundPanel).BeginInit();
			((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel).SuspendLayout();
			panelRadios.Parent = (Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel;
			panelCheckboxes.Parent = (Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel;
			okUltraButton = CopyButton(okButton);
			((Control)(object)okUltraButton).Name = "okUltraButton";
			cancelUltraButton = CopyButton(cancelButton);
			((Control)(object)cancelUltraButton).Name = "cancelUltraButton";
			ultraBackgroundPanel.BorderStyle = GroupBoxBorderStyle.None;
			((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel).Controls.Add((Control)(object)cancelUltraButton);
			((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel).Controls.Add((Control)(object)okUltraButton);
			((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel).Dock = backgroundPanel.Dock;
			((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel).Bounds = backgroundPanel.Bounds;
			((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel).Name = "ultraBackgroundPanel";
			base.Controls.Remove(backgroundPanel);
			base.Controls.Remove(okButton);
			base.Controls.Remove(cancelButton);
			backgroundPanel.Dispose();
			okButton.Dispose();
			cancelButton.Dispose();
			backgroundPanel = null;
			okButton = null;
			cancelButton = null;
			base.Controls.Add((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel);
			((ISupportInitialize)ultraBackgroundPanel).EndInit();
			((Control)(object)ultraBackgroundPanel).ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
			ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
		}
	}
	public class SummaryDialog : AppStyledDialogBase
	{
		private UltraGridColumn column;

		private SummaryControl summaryControl;

		private Icon defaultIcon;

		private static bool UseInbox;

		public Image ImageAverage
		{
			get
			{
				return summaryControl.ImageAverage;
			}
			set
			{
				summaryControl.ImageAverage = value;
			}
		}

		public Image ImageCount
		{
			get
			{
				return summaryControl.ImageCount;
			}
			set
			{
				summaryControl.ImageCount = value;
			}
		}

		public Image ImageMaximum
		{
			get
			{
				return summaryControl.ImageMaximum;
			}
			set
			{
				summaryControl.ImageMaximum = value;
			}
		}

		public Image ImageMinimum
		{
			get
			{
				return summaryControl.ImageMinimum;
			}
			set
			{
				summaryControl.ImageMinimum = value;
			}
		}

		public Image ImageNone
		{
			get
			{
				return summaryControl.ImageNone;
			}
			set
			{
				summaryControl.ImageNone = value;
			}
		}

		public Image ImageSum
		{
			get
			{
				return summaryControl.ImageSum;
			}
			set
			{
				summaryControl.ImageSum = value;
			}
		}

		public bool IsUsingInfragisticsControls => !UseInbox;

		internal SummaryDialog(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			InitializeDialogStrings();
			if (UseInbox)
			{
				summaryControl = new SummaryControl(column);
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					summaryControl = new SummaryControlUltra(column);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					UseInbox = true;
					summaryControl = new SummaryControl(column);
				}
			}
			summaryControl.Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
			this.column = column;
			((Form)this).AcceptButton = summaryControl.OKButton;
			((Form)this).CancelButton = summaryControl.CancelButton;
			((Control)this).Controls.Add(summaryControl);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				((Form)this).Icon = null;
				if (defaultIcon != null)
				{
					((Form)this).Icon = null;
					defaultIcon.Dispose();
					defaultIcon = null;
				}
			}
			((AppStyledDialogBase)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		private void InitializeComponent()
		{
			ComponentResourceManager componentResourceManager = new ComponentResourceManager(typeof(SummaryDialog));
			((Control)this).SuspendLayout();
			componentResourceManager.ApplyResources(this, "$this");
			((Form)this).FormBorderStyle = FormBorderStyle.FixedDialog;
			((Form)this).MaximizeBox = false;
			((Form)this).MinimizeBox = false;
			((Control)this).Name = "SummaryDialog";
			((Form)this).ShowInTaskbar = false;
			((Control)this).ResumeLayout(performLayout: false);
		}

		private void InitializeDialogStrings()
		{
			((Control)(object)this).Text = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_SelectSummaries");
			((Control)this).AccessibleName = ((Control)(object)this).Text;
			((Control)this).AccessibleDescription = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LDR_SelectSummaries_AccessibleDescription");
		}

		internal bool ShowSummaryDialog()
		{
			return Show(column);
		}

		internal bool Show(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null || column.Band == null || null == column.DataType)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_149"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_103"));
			}
			summaryControl.Column = column;
			IWin32Window owner = null;
			try
			{
				owner = column.Layout.Grid.EditorContainerControl.FindForm();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
			((Form)this).Icon = summaryControl.IconDialog;
			DialogResult dialogResult = ((Form)this).ShowDialog(owner);
			bool result = false;
			if (DialogResult.OK == dialogResult)
			{
				result = summaryControl.SynchronizeSummaries();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void OnStyleLibraryNameChanged(string styleLibraryName)
		{
			summaryControl.StyleLibraryName = styleLibraryName;
		}

		protected override void OnStyleSetNameChanged(string styleSetName)
		{
			summaryControl.StyleSetName = styleSetName;
		}

		protected override void OnUseAppStylingChanged(bool useAppStyling)
		{
			summaryControl.UseAppStyling = useAppStyling;
		}
	}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			object val = null;
			if (imageAverageFromResource != null)
			{
				if (StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(layout, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SummaryDialogImageAverage, out val) && !object.Equals(val, imageAverageFromResource))
				{
					imageAverageFromResource.Dispose();
				}
				imageAverageFromResource = null;
			}
			if (imageCountFromResource != null)
			{
				if (StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(layout, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SummaryDialogImageCount, out val) && !object.Equals(val, imageCountFromResource))
				{
					imageCountFromResource.Dispose();
				}
				imageCountFromResource = null;
			}
			if (imageMaximumFromResource != null)
			{
				if (StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(layout, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SummaryDialogImageMaximum, out val) && !object.Equals(val, imageMaximumFromResource))
				{
					imageMaximumFromResource.Dispose();
				}
				imageMaximumFromResource = null;
			}
			if (imageMinimumFromResource != null)
			{
				if (StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(layout, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SummaryDialogImageMinimum, out val) && !object.Equals(val, imageMinimumFromResource))
				{
					imageMinimumFromResource.Dispose();
				}
				imageMinimumFromResource = null;
			}
			if (imageNoneFromResource != null)
			{
				if (StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(layout, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SummaryDialogImageNone, out val) && !object.Equals(val, imageNoneFromResource))
				{
					imageNoneFromResource.Dispose();
				}
				imageNoneFromResource = null;
			}
			if (imageSumFromResource != null)
			{
				if (StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(layout, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SummaryDialogImageSum, out val) && !object.Equals(val, imageSumFromResource))
				{
					imageSumFromResource.Dispose();
				}
				imageSumFromResource = null;
			}
			if (iconDefault != null)
			{
				if (StyleUtils.GetCachedPropertyVal(layout, StyleUtils.CustomProperty.SummaryDialogIcon, out val) && !object.Equals(val, iconDefault))
				{
					iconDefault.Dispose();
				}
				iconDefault = null;
			}
			iconDialog = null;
			imageUsedToCreateDefaultIcon = null;
			imageAverage = null;
			imageCount = null;
			imageMaximum = null;
			imageMinimum = null;
			imageNone = null;
			imageSum = null;
			layout = null;
			base.OnDispose();
		}

	public class SummaryDisplayAreaContext
	{
		public class EqualityComparerWithoutGroupByRowContext : IEqualityComparer<SummaryDisplayAreaContext>
		{
			bool IEqualityComparer<SummaryDisplayAreaContext>.Equals(SummaryDisplayAreaContext x, SummaryDisplayAreaContext y)
			{
				if (x == null && y != null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x != null && y == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (x.displayArea == y.displayArea && x.matchAll == y.matchAll && x.matchAny == y.matchAny)
				{
					return x.matchNone == y.matchNone;
				}
				return false;
			}

			int IEqualityComparer<SummaryDisplayAreaContext>.GetHashCode(SummaryDisplayAreaContext obj)
			{
				return obj.displayArea.GetHashCode() ^ obj.matchAll.GetHashCode() ^ obj.matchAny.GetHashCode() ^ obj.matchNone.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		internal const SummaryDisplayAreas ALL_EXCEPT_GROUPBY_SUMMARIES = SummaryDisplayAreas.Top | SummaryDisplayAreas.TopFixed | SummaryDisplayAreas.Bottom | SummaryDisplayAreas.BottomFixed;

		private SummaryDisplayAreas matchAny;

		private SummaryDisplayAreas matchAll;

		private SummaryDisplayAreas matchNone;

		private SummaryDisplayAreas displayArea;

		private UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRowContext;

		internal bool IsGroupByRowSummaries => SummaryDisplayAreas.InGroupByRows == matchAny;

		internal bool IsGroupByRowsCollectionSummaryFooter => (SummaryDisplayAreas.GroupByRowsFooter & matchAny) != 0;

		internal SummaryDisplayAreas DisplayArea => displayArea;

		internal bool IsDisplayAreaTop
		{
			get
			{
				if (SummaryDisplayAreas.Top != DisplayArea)
				{
					return SummaryDisplayAreas.TopFixed == DisplayArea;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsDisplayAreaBottom
		{
			get
			{
				if (SummaryDisplayAreas.Bottom != DisplayArea)
				{
					return SummaryDisplayAreas.BottomFixed == DisplayArea;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal static SummaryDisplayAreaContext AllExceptGroupbySummaries => new SummaryDisplayAreaContext(SummaryDisplayAreas.Top | SummaryDisplayAreas.TopFixed | SummaryDisplayAreas.Bottom | SummaryDisplayAreas.BottomFixed);

		internal static SummaryDisplayAreaContext BottomScrollingSummariesContext => new SummaryDisplayAreaContext(SummaryDisplayAreas.Bottom);

		internal static SummaryDisplayAreaContext NoneSummariesContext => new SummaryDisplayAreaContext(SummaryDisplayAreas.None);

		internal static SummaryDisplayAreaContext InGroupByRowsSummariesContext => new SummaryDisplayAreaContext(SummaryDisplayAreas.InGroupByRows);

		internal UltraGridGroupByRow GroupByRowContext => groupByRowContext;

		internal SummaryDisplayAreaContext(SummaryDisplayAreas matchAny)
			: this(matchAny, SummaryDisplayAreas.None, SummaryDisplayAreas.None, matchAny)
		{
		}

		internal SummaryDisplayAreaContext(SummaryDisplayAreas matchAny, SummaryDisplayAreas matchAll, SummaryDisplayAreas matchNone, SummaryDisplayAreas displayArea)
		{
			this.matchAny = matchAny;
			this.matchAll = matchAll;
			this.matchNone = matchNone;
			this.displayArea = displayArea;
		}

		internal bool DoesSummaryMatch(SummarySettings summary)
		{
			SummaryDisplayAreas summaryDisplayAreaResolved = summary.SummaryDisplayAreaResolved;
			if ((matchAny == SummaryDisplayAreas.None || (matchAny & summaryDisplayAreaResolved) != SummaryDisplayAreas.None) && matchAll == (matchAll & summaryDisplayAreaResolved) && (matchNone & summaryDisplayAreaResolved) == 0)
			{
				return !summary.HiddenResolvedHelper;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool DoesSummaryMatch(SummaryValue summaryValue)
		{
			return DoesSummaryMatch(summaryValue.SummarySettings);
		}

		internal static SummaryDisplayAreaContext GetInGroupByRowsSummariesContext(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRowContext)
		{
			SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext = new SummaryDisplayAreaContext(SummaryDisplayAreas.InGroupByRows);
			summaryDisplayAreaContext.groupByRowContext = groupByRowContext;
			return summaryDisplayAreaContext;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (!(obj is SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (displayArea == summaryDisplayAreaContext.displayArea && matchAll == summaryDisplayAreaContext.matchAll && matchAny == summaryDisplayAreaContext.matchAny && matchNone == summaryDisplayAreaContext.matchNone)
			{
				return groupByRowContext == summaryDisplayAreaContext.groupByRowContext;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = displayArea.GetHashCode() ^ matchAll.GetHashCode() ^ matchAny.GetHashCode() ^ matchNone.GetHashCode();
			if (groupByRowContext != null)
			{
				num ^= groupByRowContext.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}
	}
	public class UltraGridSummaryRow : UltraGridSpecialRowBase
	{
		private SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext;

		public SummaryDisplayAreaContext SummaryDisplayAreaContext => summaryDisplayAreaContext;

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public bool ShouldDisplaySummaryFooterCaption
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ParentCollection != null && base.ParentCollection.SummaryValues.SummaryFooterCaptionVisibleResolved)
				{
					return !SummaryDisplayAreaContext.IsGroupByRowSummaries;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsSummaryRow => true;

		internal override Activation ActivationResolvedInternal => Activation.Disabled;

		internal override DefaultableBoolean HasHeadersOverride
		{
			get
			{
				if (SummaryDisplayAreaContext.IsGroupByRowsCollectionSummaryFooter && !base.ParentCollection.IsTopLevel)
				{
					return (DefaultableBoolean)2;
				}
				UltraGridRow prevVisibleRow = base.ParentCollection.GetPrevVisibleRow(this);
				if (prevVisibleRow == null)
				{
					return (DefaultableBoolean)0;
				}
				return (DefaultableBoolean)2;
			}
		}

		internal override int RowSpacingBeforeResolvedBase
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridBand bandInternal = base.BandInternal;
				int num = base.RowSpacingBefore;
				if (num < 0 && bandInternal.HasOverride)
				{
					num = bandInternal.Override.SummaryFooterSpacingBefore;
				}
				if (num < 0 && bandInternal.Layout.HasOverride)
				{
					num = bandInternal.Layout.Override.SummaryFooterSpacingBefore;
				}
				if (num < 0 && !HasSpecialRowSeparatorBefore)
				{
					UltraGridRow prevVisibleRow = base.ParentCollection.GetPrevVisibleRow(this);
					if (prevVisibleRow != null && 1 == prevVisibleRow.ScrollCountInternal)
					{
						num = 1;
					}
				}
				return Math.Max(0, num);
			}
		}

		internal override int RowSpacingAfterResolvedBase
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridBand bandInternal = base.BandInternal;
				int summaryFooterSpacingAfter = base.RowSpacingAfter;
				if (summaryFooterSpacingAfter < 0 && bandInternal.HasOverride)
				{
					summaryFooterSpacingAfter = bandInternal.Override.SummaryFooterSpacingAfter;
				}
				if (summaryFooterSpacingAfter < 0 && bandInternal.Layout.HasOverride)
				{
					summaryFooterSpacingAfter = bandInternal.Layout.Override.SummaryFooterSpacingAfter;
				}
				return Math.Max(0, summaryFooterSpacingAfter);
			}
		}

		internal override FixedRowStyle FixedResolvedLocation
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.ParentCollection.SupportsFixedRows)
				{
					if (fixedResolvedLocationOverride != FixedRowStyle.Default)
					{
						return fixedResolvedLocationOverride;
					}
					SummaryDisplayAreas displayArea = SummaryDisplayAreaContext.DisplayArea;
					if (SummaryDisplayAreas.TopFixed == displayArea)
					{
						return FixedRowStyle.Top;
					}
					if (SummaryDisplayAreas.BottomFixed == displayArea)
					{
						return FixedRowStyle.Bottom;
					}
				}
				return FixedRowStyle.Default;
			}
		}

		internal override bool HasSpecialRowSeparatorBefore
		{
			get
			{
				if ((SpecialRowSeparator.SummaryRow & base.BandInternal.GetSpecialRowSeparatorResolved(this)) != SpecialRowSeparator.None)
				{
					return SummaryDisplayAreaContext.IsDisplayAreaBottom;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal override bool HasSpecialRowSeparatorAfter
		{
			get
			{
				if ((SpecialRowSeparator.SummaryRow & base.BandInternal.GetSpecialRowSeparatorResolved(this)) != SpecialRowSeparator.None)
				{
					return SummaryDisplayAreaContext.IsDisplayAreaTop;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal override int BaseHeight => base.ParentCollection.SummaryValues.GetSummaryFooterHeight(SummaryDisplayAreaContext);

		internal override LayoutManagerBase LayoutManager => base.BandInternal.GetSummaryLayoutManager(SummaryDisplayAreaContext);

		internal UltraGridSummaryRow(RowsCollection parentCollection, SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext)
			: base(parentCollection)
		{
			GridUtils.ValidateNull(summaryDisplayAreaContext);
			Initialize(summaryDisplayAreaContext);
		}

		internal void Initialize(SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext)
		{
			this.summaryDisplayAreaContext = summaryDisplayAreaContext;
			fixedResolvedLocationOverride = FixedRowStyle.Default;
		}

		public bool IsSummaryVisible(SummarySettings summary)
		{
			return SummaryDisplayAreaContext.DoesSummaryMatch(summary);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public static UltraGridSummaryRow GetInGroupByRowSummaryContext(UltraGridGroupByRow groupByRow)
		{
			if (groupByRow != null)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = groupByRow.Band;
				GroupBySummaryDisplayStyle groupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved = ultraGridBand.GroupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved;
				if (ultraGridBand.HasSummaries && (GroupBySummaryDisplayStyle.SummaryCells == groupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved || GroupBySummaryDisplayStyle.SummaryCellsAlwaysBelowDescription == groupBySummaryDisplayStyleResolved))
				{
					SummaryDisplayAreaContext inGroupByRowsSummariesContext = SummaryDisplayAreaContext.GetInGroupByRowsSummariesContext(groupByRow);
					if (inGroupByRowsSummariesContext != null)
					{
						return new UltraGridSummaryRow(groupByRow.Rows, inGroupByRowsSummariesContext);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal override bool IsUIElementCompatible(UIElement parent, UIElement elem)
		{
			return elem is SummaryFooterUIElement;
		}

		internal override bool HasSameContext(UIElement parent, UIElement elem)
		{
			if (elem is SummaryFooterUIElement summaryFooterUIElement)
			{
				return base.ParentCollection == summaryFooterUIElement.Rows;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override UIElement CreateRowUIElement(UIElement parent)
		{
			return (UIElement)(object)new SummaryFooterUIElement(parent, base.ParentCollection);
		}

		internal override void InitializeUIElement(UIElement elem)
		{
			SummaryFooterUIElement summaryFooterUIElement = (SummaryFooterUIElement)(object)elem;
			summaryFooterUIElement.Initialize(base.ParentCollection, SummaryDisplayAreaContext);
		}

		internal static bool ShouldLeftAlignGroupByRowsFooter(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context, RowsCollection rows)
		{
			if (context.IsGroupByRowsCollectionSummaryFooter)
			{
				if (!context.IsDisplayAreaBottom && rows.IsTopLevel)
				{
					return !rows.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ShouldLeftAlignGroupByRowsFooter()
		{
			return ShouldLeftAlignGroupByRowsFooter(SummaryDisplayAreaContext, base.ParentCollection);
		}

		internal override void AdjustUIElementRect(ref Rectangle elemRect)
		{
			if (ShouldLeftAlignGroupByRowsFooter())
			{
				int num = base.BandInternal.CalcGroupByRowIndent(base.ParentCollection);
				elemRect.X += num;
				elemRect.Width -= num;
			}
			else
			{
				int preRowAreaExtent = base.BandInternal.PreRowAreaExtent;
				elemRect.X += preRowAreaExtent;
				elemRect.Width -= preRowAreaExtent;
			}
		}

		internal override void SetElementClipSelfRect(UIElement elem, Rectangle clipRect)
		{
			if (elem is SummaryFooterUIElement summaryFooterUIElement)
			{
				summaryFooterUIElement.InternalSetClipSelfRegion(clipRect);
			}
		}

		internal override Rectangle GetElementLastClipRect(UIElement elem)
		{
			if (elem is SummaryFooterUIElement summaryFooterUIElement)
			{
				return summaryFooterUIElement.lastClipRect;
			}
			return Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		internal override void SetElementLastClipRect(UIElement elem, Rectangle clipRect)
		{
			if (elem is SummaryFooterUIElement summaryFooterUIElement)
			{
				summaryFooterUIElement.lastClipRect = clipRect;
			}
		}

		internal override void AfterElementAdded(UIElement addedRowElem, UIElementsCollection oldElems, ref Rectangle actualRectOccupiedByRowRelatedElements)
		{
			if (!IsFromGroupByRowsParentCollection)
			{
				int preRowAreaExtent = base.BandInternal.PreRowAreaExtent;
				if (preRowAreaExtent > 0)
				{
					PreRowAreaUIElement preRowAreaUIElement = (PreRowAreaUIElement)GridUtils.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldElems, typeof(PreRowAreaUIElement), removeExtractedElement: true);
					if (preRowAreaUIElement == null)
					{
						preRowAreaUIElement = new PreRowAreaUIElement(addedRowElem.Parent);
					}
					preRowAreaUIElement.Initialize(this);
					Rectangle rect = addedRowElem.Rect;
					rect.Width = preRowAreaExtent;
					rect.X -= preRowAreaExtent;
					actualRectOccupiedByRowRelatedElements = Rectangle.Union(actualRectOccupiedByRowRelatedElements, rect);
					((UIElement)preRowAreaUIElement).Rect = rect;
					addedRowElem.Parent.ChildElements.Add((UIElement)(object)preRowAreaUIElement);
				}
			}
			base.AfterElementAdded(addedRowElem, oldElems, ref actualRectOccupiedByRowRelatedElements);
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	[TypeConverter(typeof(SummarySettingsConverter))]
	public class SummarySettings : KeyedSubObjectBase, ISerializable, IFormulaProvider
	{
		public sealed class SummarySettingsConverter : ExpandableObjectConverter
		{
			public override bool CanConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor))
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.CanConvertTo(context, destinationType);
			}

			private static int GetColumnRelativeIndex(UltraGridColumn column)
			{
				if (!column.IsBound)
				{
					return column.UnboundRelativePosition;
				}
				return column.Index;
			}

			public override object ConvertTo(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value, Type destinationType)
			{
				if (destinationType == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("destinationType");
				}
				if (destinationType == typeof(InstanceDescriptor) && value is SummarySettings)
				{
					SummarySettings summarySettings = (SummarySettings)value;
					ConstructorInfo constructor = typeof(SummarySettings).GetConstructor(new Type[12]
					{
						typeof(string),
						typeof(SummaryType),
						typeof(string),
						typeof(string),
						typeof(int),
						typeof(bool),
						typeof(string),
						typeof(int),
						typeof(SummaryPosition),
						typeof(string),
						typeof(int),
						typeof(bool)
					});
					if (null != constructor)
					{
						return new InstanceDescriptor(constructor, new object[12]
						{
							summarySettings.Key,
							summarySettings.summaryType,
							summarySettings.Formula,
							(summarySettings.sourceColumn != null) ? summarySettings.sourceColumn.Key : ((summarySettings.serializedSourceColumnId != null) ? summarySettings.serializedSourceColumnId.Key : null),
							(summarySettings.sourceColumn != null) ? GetColumnRelativeIndex(summarySettings.sourceColumn) : ((summarySettings.serializedSourceColumnId != null) ? summarySettings.serializedSourceColumnId.RelativeIndex : (-1)),
							(summarySettings.sourceColumn != null) ? summarySettings.sourceColumn.IsBound : (summarySettings.serializedSourceColumnId != null && summarySettings.serializedSourceColumnId.Bound),
							(summarySettings.sourceColumn != null) ? summarySettings.sourceColumn.Band.Key : summarySettings.serializedSourceColumnBandKey,
							(summarySettings.sourceColumn != null) ? summarySettings.sourceColumn.Band.Index : summarySettings.serializedSourceColumnBandIndex,
							summarySettings.summaryPosition,
							(summarySettings.summaryPositionColumn != null) ? summarySettings.summaryPositionColumn.Key : ((summarySettings.serializedSummaryPositionColumnId != null) ? summarySettings.serializedSummaryPositionColumnId.Key : null),
							(summarySettings.summaryPositionColumn != null) ? GetColumnRelativeIndex(summarySettings.summaryPositionColumn) : ((summarySettings.serializedSummaryPositionColumnId != null) ? summarySettings.serializedSummaryPositionColumnId.RelativeIndex : (-1)),
							(summarySettings.summaryPositionColumn != null) ? summarySettings.summaryPositionColumn.IsBound : (summarySettings.serializedSummaryPositionColumnId != null && summarySettings.serializedSummaryPositionColumnId.Bound)
						}, isComplete: false);
					}
				}
				return base.ConvertTo(context, culture, value, destinationType);
			}
		}

		[ComVisible(false)]
		public class ColumnsListUITypeEditor : UITypeEditorListBase
		{
			private class BooleanIndicator
			{
				internal bool val;
			}

			private class ColumnItem
			{
				internal UltraGridColumn column;

				private BooleanIndicator includeBandKeysInNames;

				internal ColumnItem(UltraGridColumn column, BooleanIndicator includeBandKeysInNames)
				{
					this.column = column;
					this.includeBandKeysInNames = includeBandKeysInNames;
				}

				public override string ToString()
				{
					if (column == null)
					{
						return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ColumnsUITypeEditorList_None_Entry");
					}
					string text = column.Key;
					if (text == null || text.Length == 0)
					{
						text = $"Column# [{column.Index}]";
					}
					if (includeBandKeysInNames.val)
					{
						text = $"{column.Band.Key} - {text}";
					}
					return text;
				}

				public override int GetHashCode()
				{
					if (column == null)
					{
						return 0;
					}
					return column.GetHashCode();
				}

				public override bool Equals(object value)
				{
					if (value is ColumnItem)
					{
						return column == ((ColumnItem)value).column;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			protected override object[] GetListItems(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value, ref object currentEntry)
			{
				List<ColumnItem> list = new List<ColumnItem>();
				if (context.Instance is SummarySettings { Band: not null } summarySettings && context.PropertyDescriptor != null)
				{
					Queue queue = new Queue();
					queue.Enqueue(summarySettings.Band);
					bool flag = "SourceColumn" == context.PropertyDescriptor.Name;
					BooleanIndicator booleanIndicator = new BooleanIndicator();
					int num = 0;
					while (queue.Count > 0)
					{
						UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = (UltraGridBand)queue.Dequeue();
						int count = list.Count;
						foreach (UltraGridColumn column in ultraGridBand.Columns)
						{
							if (!column.IsChaptered)
							{
								ColumnItem columnItem = new ColumnItem(column, booleanIndicator);
								list.Add(columnItem);
								if (column == value || columnItem.Equals(value))
								{
									currentEntry = columnItem;
								}
							}
						}
						if (count != list.Count)
						{
							num++;
						}
						if (!flag)
						{
							continue;
						}
						foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in ultraGridBand.Layout.SortedBands)
						{
							if (ultraGridBand != sortedBand && sortedBand.IsDescendantOfBand(ultraGridBand))
							{
								queue.Enqueue(sortedBand);
							}
						}
					}
					booleanIndicator.val = num > 1;
					if (list.Count > 0)
					{
						list.Insert(0, new ColumnItem(null, booleanIndicator));
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}

			protected override object ValidateEditItem(ITypeDescriptorContext context, IServiceProvider provider, object value, object selectedEntry)
			{
				if (selectedEntry is ColumnItem)
				{
					return ((ColumnItem)selectedEntry).column;
				}
				return selectedEntry;
			}
		}

		protected SummarySettings(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_03ec: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

					break;

					serializedSourceColumnId = (SerializedColumnID)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(SerializedColumnID), null);
