		internal void Initialize(SummarySettingsCollection parentCollection)
		{
			this.parentCollection = parentCollection;
		}

		internal void Initialize(SummarySettingsCollection parentCollection, SummaryType summaryType, ICustomSummaryCalculator customSummaryCalculator, UltraGridColumn sourceColumn, SummaryPosition summaryPosition, UltraGridColumn summaryPositionColumn, string formula)
		{
			if (parentCollection == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_43"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_347"));
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SummaryType), summaryType))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_348"), (int)summaryType, typeof(SummaryType));
			}
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(typeof(SummaryPosition), summaryPosition))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_349"), (int)summaryPosition, typeof(SummaryPosition));
			}
			if (SummaryType.Custom == summaryType && customSummaryCalculator == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_350"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_351"));
			}
			if (sourceColumn == null && SummaryType.Formula != summaryType)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_352"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_103"));
			}
			if (sourceColumn != null && parentCollection.Band != null && sourceColumn.Band != parentCollection.Band && !sourceColumn.Band.IsDescendantOfBand(parentCollection.Band))
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_352"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_353"));
			}
			this.parentCollection = parentCollection;
			this.summaryType = summaryType;
			this.customSummaryCalculator = customSummaryCalculator;
			this.sourceColumn = sourceColumn;
			this.summaryPosition = summaryPosition;
			this.summaryPositionColumn = summaryPositionColumn;
			Formula = formula;
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			//IL_00b6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			SerializeTag(info);
			if (ShouldSerializeKey())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Key", Key);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeDisplayFormat())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "DisplayFormat", DisplayFormat);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeLines())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Lines", Lines);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSummaryPosition())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SummaryPosition", SummaryPosition);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "AppearanceHolder", appearanceHolder);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeFormula())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "Formula", Formula);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeShowCalculatingText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ShowCalculatingText", ShowCalculatingText);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeSummaryDisplayArea())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SummaryDisplayArea", SummaryDisplayArea);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeToolTipText())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "ToolTipText", toolTipText);
			}
			Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SummaryType", SummaryType);
			bool flag = false;
			if (serializedSourceColumnId != null && serializedSourceColumnBandKey != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SourceColumn", serializedSourceColumnId);
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SourceColumnBandKey", serializedSourceColumnBandKey);
				flag = true;
			}
			if (SourceColumn != null && SourceColumn.Band != null && SourceColumn.Band.Key != null)
			{
				SerializedColumnID serializedColumnId = SourceColumn.Band.GetSerializedColumnId(SourceColumn);
				if (serializedColumnId != null)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SourceColumn", serializedColumnId);
						Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SourceColumnBandKey", SourceColumn.Band.Key);
					}
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SourceColumnBandIndex", SourceColumn.Band.Index);
				}
			}
			if (serializedSummaryPositionColumnId != null)
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SummaryPositionColumn", serializedSummaryPositionColumnId);
			}
			else if (ShouldSerializeSummaryPositionColumn() && SummaryPositionColumn.Band == Band && Band != null)
			{
				SerializedColumnID serializedColumnId2 = Band.GetSerializedColumnId(SummaryPositionColumn);
				if (serializedColumnId2 != null)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "SummaryPositionColumn", serializedColumnId2);
				}
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeCustomSummaryCalculator())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "CustomSummaryCalculator", CustomSummaryCalculator);
			}
			if (ShouldSerializeGroupBySummaryValueAppearance())
			{
				Utils.SerializeProperty(info, "GroupBySummaryValueAppearanceHolder", groupBySummaryValueAppearanceHolder);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		public void ResetDisplayInGroupBy()
		{
			DisplayInGroupByNoWarns = true;
		}

		public void ResetHidden()
		{
			HiddenNoWarns = false;
		}

		public void ResetAppearance()
		{
			if (HasAppearance)
			{
				appearanceHolder.Reset();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Appearance);
			}
		}

		public void ResetGroupBySummaryValueAppearance()
		{
			if (HasGroupBySummaryValueAppearance)
			{
				groupBySummaryValueAppearanceHolder.Reset();
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupBySummaryValueAppearance);
			}
		}

		public void ResetSummaryPositionColumn()
		{
			SummaryPositionColumn = null;
		}

		public void ResetSummaryPosition()
		{
			SummaryPosition = SummaryPosition.UseSummaryPositionColumn;
		}

		public void ResetDisplayFormat()
		{
			DisplayFormat = null;
		}

		public void ResetLines()
		{
			Lines = 1;
		}

		public void ResetFormula()
		{
			Formula = null;
		}

		public void ResetShowCalculatingText()
		{
			ShowCalculatingText = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
		}

		public void ResetSummaryDisplayArea()
		{
			SummaryDisplayArea = SummaryDisplayAreas.Default;
		}

		public void Refresh()
		{
			BumpSummaryCalculationsVersion();
			if (Band.Layout != null)
			{
				Band.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
			}
		}

		public void ResetToolTipText()
		{
			ToolTipText = null;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeDisplayFormat()
		{
			if (displayFormat != null)
			{
				return displayFormat.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeLines()
		{
			return 1 != lines;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeHidden()
		{
			return false;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeAppearance()
		{
			if (HasAppearance)
			{
				return Appearance.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeSummaryPositionColumn()
		{
			return SummaryPositionColumn != null;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeSummaryPosition()
		{
			return SummaryPosition.UseSummaryPositionColumn != SummaryPosition;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeDisplayInGroupBy()
		{
			return false;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeFormula()
		{
			if (Formula != null)
			{
				return Formula.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeShowCalculatingText()
		{
			//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			return (int)showCalculatingText > 0;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeSummaryDisplayArea()
		{
			return SummaryDisplayAreas.Default != summaryDisplayArea;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (HasAppearance && propChange.Source == Appearance)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Appearance, propChange);
			}
			else if (HasGroupBySummaryValueAppearance && propChange.Source == GroupBySummaryValueAppearance)
			{
				NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.GroupBySummaryValueAppearance, propChange);
			}
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeToolTipText()
		{
			if (toolTipText != null)
			{
				return toolTipText.Length > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected internal bool ShouldSerializeCustomSummaryCalculator()
		{
			if (customSummaryCalculator == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Utils.IsSafelyInfragisticsSerializable(customSummaryCalculator.GetType()))
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool ShouldSerializeGroupBySummaryValueAppearance()
		{
			if (HasGroupBySummaryValueAppearance)
			{
				return GroupBySummaryValueAppearance.ShouldSerialize();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static bool IsColumnDisplayed(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column == null || column.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private string GetSummaryTypeString(SummaryType summaryType)
		{
			return SummaryType switch
			{
				SummaryType.Average => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryTypeAverage"), 
				SummaryType.Count => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryTypeCount"), 
				SummaryType.Custom => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryTypeCustom"), 
				SummaryType.Maximum => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryTypeMaximum"), 
				SummaryType.Minimum => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryTypeMinimum"), 
				SummaryType.Sum => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryTypeSum"), 
				SummaryType.External => Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryTypeExternal"), 
				_ => "", 
			};
		}

		internal void BumpSummaryCalculationsVersion()
		{
			summaryCalculationsVersion++;
			NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged();
			Layout?.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
		}

		internal void InternalInitializeFrom(SummarySettings source)
		{
			//IL_007d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0082: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridBand band = Band;
			if (band != null)
			{
				UltraGridLayout layout = band.Layout;
				if (layout != null && (layout.IsExportLayout || layout.IsPrintLayout))
				{
					sourceSummarySettings = source;
				}
			}
			if (source.ShouldSerializeTag())
			{
				tagValue = source.tagValue;
			}
			displayFormat = source.displayFormat;
			lines = source.lines;
			summaryType = source.summaryType;
			summaryPosition = source.summaryPosition;
			summaryDisplayArea = source.summaryDisplayArea;
			showCalculatingText = source.showCalculatingText;
			toolTipText = source.toolTipText;
			displayFormatProvider = source.displayFormatProvider;
			if (source.appearanceHolder != null && source.appearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
			{
				AppearanceBase appearance = Appearance;
				appearanceHolder.InitializeFrom(source.appearanceHolder);
			}
			else if (appearanceHolder != null && appearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
			{
				appearanceHolder.Reset();
			}
			if (source.groupBySummaryValueAppearanceHolder != null && source.groupBySummaryValueAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
			{
				AppearanceBase groupBySummaryValueAppearance = GroupBySummaryValueAppearance;
				groupBySummaryValueAppearanceHolder.InitializeFrom(source.groupBySummaryValueAppearanceHolder);
			}
			else if (groupBySummaryValueAppearanceHolder != null && groupBySummaryValueAppearanceHolder.HasAppearance)
			{
				groupBySummaryValueAppearanceHolder.Reset();
			}
		}

		internal void OnDeserializationComplete(SummarySettingsCollection parentCollection)
		{
			Initialize(parentCollection);
			UltraGridLayout layout = Layout;
			if (layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (serializedSourceColumnBandKey != null && serializedSourceColumnId != null)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = (layout.Bands.Exists(serializedSourceColumnBandKey) ? layout.Bands[serializedSourceColumnBandKey] : null);
				if (ultraGridBand == null && serializedSourceColumnBandIndex >= 0 && serializedSourceColumnBandIndex < layout.Bands.Count)
				{
					ultraGridBand = layout.Bands[serializedSourceColumnBandIndex];
				}
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ultraGridBand?.GetMatchingColumn(serializedSourceColumnId);
				if (ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.Band != null && ultraGridColumn.Band.IsTrivialDescendantOf(Band))
				{
					sourceColumn = ultraGridColumn;
					BumpSummaryCalculationsVersion();
				}
			}
			if (serializedSummaryPositionColumnId != null)
			{
				UltraGridColumn matchingColumn = Band.GetMatchingColumn(serializedSummaryPositionColumnId);
				if (matchingColumn != null)
				{
					summaryPositionColumn = matchingColumn;
					BumpSummaryCalculationsVersion();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged()
		{
			if (HasCalcReference)
			{
				RowsCollection.NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged(CalcReference);
			}
		}
	}

		public UltraGridBand Band => band;

		internal UltraGridLayout Layout
		{
			get
			{
				if (Band == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Band.Layout;
			}
		}

		internal int SummariesVersion => summariesVersion;

		object IList.this[int index]
		{
			get

				return this[index];

				throw new NotSupportedException();
			}

		bool IList.IsReadOnly => false;

		internal SummarySettingsCollection(UltraGridBand band)

			Initialize(band);
		}

		private SummarySettingsCollection(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializationInfoEnumerator enumerator = info.GetEnumerator();
			while (enumerator.MoveNext())
			{
				SerializationEntry current = enumerator.Current;
				if (current.ObjectType == typeof(SummarySettings))
				{
					SummarySettings summarySettings = (SummarySettings)Utils.DeserializeProperty(current, typeof(SummarySettings), null);
					if (summarySettings != null)
					{
						InternalAdd(summarySettings);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					string name = current.Name;
					if (name == "Tag")
					{
						DeserializeTag(current);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Summaries, propChange);
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			Clear();
			base.OnDispose();
		}

		[SecurityPermission(SecurityAction.Demand, Flags = SecurityPermissionFlag.SerializationFormatter)]
		void ISerializable.GetObjectData(SerializationInfo info, StreamingContext context)
		{
			SerializeTag(info);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = this[i];
				if (summarySettings != null && summarySettings.CanSerialize)
				{
					Utils.SerializeProperty(info, i.ToString(), summarySettings);
				}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return string.Empty;
		}

		internal SummarySettings AddHelper(string key, SummaryType summaryType, ICustomSummaryCalculator customSummaryCalculator, UltraGridColumn sourceColumn, SummaryPosition summaryPosition, UltraGridColumn summaryPositionColumn, string formula)
		{
			SummarySettings summarySettings = new SummarySettings(key, this, summaryType, customSummaryCalculator, sourceColumn, summaryPosition, summaryPositionColumn, formula);
			AddHelper(-1, summarySettings);
			return summarySettings;
		}

		internal void AddHelper(int index, SummarySettings summarySettings)
		{
			if (index >= 0)
			{
				InternalInsert(index, summarySettings);
			}
			else
			{
				InternalAdd(summarySettings);
			}
			summarySettings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			BumpSummariesVersion();
			summarySettings.FormulaHolder.AddReferenceToCalcNetwork();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Add);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void AddRange(SummarySettings[] summaries)
		{
			foreach (SummarySettings summarySettings in summaries)
			{
				if (summarySettings != null)
				{
					summarySettings.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					InternalAdd(summarySettings);
				}
			}
			BumpSummariesVersion();
		}

		public void Remove(SummarySettings summarySettings)
		{
			summarySettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			InternalRemove(summarySettings);
			summarySettings.FormulaHolder.RemoveReferenceFromCalcNetwork();
			BumpSummariesVersion();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Remove);
		}

		public void RemoveAt(int index)
		{
			SummarySettings summarySettings = this[index];
			Remove(summarySettings);
		}

		public void Clear()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = this[i];
				if (summarySettings != null)
				{
					summarySettings.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					summarySettings.FormulaHolder.RemoveReferenceFromCalcNetwork();
				}
			}
			InternalClear();
			BumpSummariesVersion();
			NotifyPropChange(PropertyIds.Clear);
		}

		internal void GetFixedSummariesForLevel(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context, int level, List<SummarySettings> list)
		{
			list.Clear();
			if (!HasFixedSummaries(context))
			{
				return;
			}
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable(Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = this[i];
				if (!context.DoesSummaryMatch(summarySettings))
				{
					continue;
				}
				UltraGridColumn summaryPositionColumnResolved = summarySettings.SummaryPositionColumnResolved;
				if (summaryPositionColumnResolved != null && summarySettings.IsFixedSummary)
				{
					if (!hashtable.Contains(summaryPositionColumnResolved))
					{
						hashtable[summaryPositionColumnResolved] = 1;
					}
					else
					{
						hashtable[summaryPositionColumnResolved] = 1 + (int)hashtable[summaryPositionColumnResolved];
					}
					if (level == (int)hashtable[summaryPositionColumnResolved] - 1)
					{
						list.Add(summarySettings);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void GetFreeFormSummariesForLevel(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context, int level, List<SummarySettings> list)
		{
			list.Clear();
			if (!HasFreeFormSummaries(context))
			{
				return;
			}
			Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable(Count);
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = this[i];
				if (context.DoesSummaryMatch(summarySettings) && summarySettings.IsFreeFormSummary)
				{
					if (!hashtable.Contains(summarySettings.SummaryPosition))
					{
						hashtable[summarySettings.SummaryPosition] = 1;
					}
					else
					{
						hashtable[summarySettings.SummaryPosition] = 1 + (int)hashtable[summarySettings.SummaryPosition];
					}
					if (level == (int)hashtable[summarySettings.SummaryPosition] - 1)
					{
						list.Add(summarySettings);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool HasFixedSummaries(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = this[i];
				if (context.DoesSummaryMatch(summarySettings) && SummaryPosition.UseSummaryPositionColumn == summarySettings.SummaryPosition && summarySettings.SummaryPositionColumnResolved != null)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool HasFreeFormSummaries(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = this[i];
				if (context.DoesSummaryMatch(summarySettings) && SummaryPosition.UseSummaryPositionColumn != summarySettings.SummaryPosition)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool HasSummaryVisibleInFooter(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context)
		{
			if (!HasFixedSummaries(context))
			{
				return HasFreeFormSummaries(context);
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal SummarySettings[] GetFixedSummariesForDisplayColumn(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context, UltraGridColumn displayColumn)
		{
			List<SummarySettings> list = new List<SummarySettings>();
			List<SummarySettings> list2 = new List<SummarySettings>();
			int num = 0;
			bool flag;
			do
			{
				list2.Clear();
				GetFixedSummariesForLevel(context, num++, list2);
				flag = false;
				for (int i = 0; i < list2.Count; i++)
				{
					SummarySettings summarySettings = list2[i];
					if (summarySettings.SummaryPositionColumnResolved == displayColumn)
					{
						list.Add(summarySettings);
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			while (flag);
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal SummarySettings FindSummary(UltraGridColumn sourceColumn, SummaryType summaryType, bool onlyFixed)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = this[i];
				if ((!onlyFixed || SummaryPosition.UseSummaryPositionColumn == summarySettings.SummaryPosition) && sourceColumn == summarySettings.SourceColumn && summaryType == summarySettings.SummaryType)
				{
					return summarySettings;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal SummarySettings FindSummary(UltraGridColumn sourceColumn)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = this[i];
				if (sourceColumn == summarySettings.SourceColumn)
				{
					return summarySettings;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void BumpSummariesVersion()
		{
			summariesVersion++;
			Layout?.BumpCellChildElementsCacheVersion();
		}

		internal void BumpSummaryCalculationsVersion()
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				this[i]?.BumpSummaryCalculationsVersion();
			}
		}

		internal bool DirtySummarySettings(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			bool result = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = this[i];
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = ((summarySettings.SourceColumn != null) ? summarySettings.SourceColumn.Band : null);
				if (ultraGridBand == band || ultraGridBand.IsDescendantOfBand(band))
				{
					summarySettings.BumpSummaryCalculationsVersion();
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		internal void InitializeFrom(SummarySettingsCollection summarySettings, PropertyCategories categories)
		{
			if ((PropertyCategories.Summaries & categories) == 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			Clear();
			if (Band == null || Band.Layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < summarySettings.Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings2 = summarySettings[i];
				bool flag = false;
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = summarySettings2.SourceColumn;
				string text = ultraGridColumn?.Key;
				string text2 = ((ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.Band != null) ? ultraGridColumn.Band.Key : null);
				int num = ((ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.Band != null) ? ultraGridColumn.Band.Index : (-1));
				if (text2 == null && summarySettings2.InternalSerializedSourceColumnID != null && summarySettings2.InternalSerializedSourceColumnBandKey != null)
				{
					text2 = summarySettings2.InternalSerializedSourceColumnBandKey;
					text = summarySettings2.InternalSerializedSourceColumnID.Key;
				}
				if (text2 != null && text != null)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = null;
					if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(text2))
					{
						ultraGridBand = Band.Layout.Bands[0];
					}
					else
					{
						foreach (UltraGridBand band in Band.Layout.Bands)
						{
							if (band.Key == text2 && band.Index == num)
							{
								ultraGridBand = band;
								break;
							}
						}
						if (ultraGridBand == null && Band.Layout.Bands.Exists(text2))
						{
							ultraGridBand = Band.Layout.Bands[text2];
						}
					}
					if (ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridBand.Columns.Exists(text) && (summarySettings2.InternalSerializedSourceColumnBandIndex < 0 || ultraGridBand.Index == summarySettings2.InternalSerializedSourceColumnBandIndex))
					{
						ultraGridColumn = ultraGridBand.Columns[text];
						if (ultraGridColumn.Band != null && (ultraGridColumn.Band == Band || ultraGridColumn.Band.IsDescendantOfBand(Band)))
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (SummaryType.Formula == summarySettings2.SummaryType)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = summarySettings2.SummaryPositionColumn;
				if (ultraGridColumn2 == null && summarySettings2.InternalSerializedSummaryPositionColumnId != null)
				{
					ultraGridColumn2 = Band.GetMatchingColumn(summarySettings2.InternalSerializedSummaryPositionColumnId);
				}
				if (flag && ultraGridColumn2 != null)
				{
					if (Band.Columns.Exists(ultraGridColumn2.Key))
					{
						ultraGridColumn2 = Band.Columns[ultraGridColumn2.Key];
					}
					else
					{
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					SummarySettings summarySettings3 = AddHelper(summarySettings2.Key, summarySettings2.SummaryType, summarySettings2.CustomSummaryCalculator, ultraGridColumn, summarySettings2.SummaryPosition, ultraGridColumn2, summarySettings2.Formula);
					summarySettings3.InternalInitializeFrom(summarySettings2);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Initialize(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_104"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentNullException_319"));
			}
			this.band = band;
		}

		internal void OnDeserializationComplete(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			Initialize(band);
			foreach (SummarySettings item in (IEnumerable)this)
			{
				item.OnDeserializationComplete(this);
			}
		}

		private static UltraGridSummaryRow CreateSummaryRow(RowsCollection parentRows, SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext, UltraGridRow[] rowsToRecycle)
		{
			if (rowsToRecycle != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < rowsToRecycle.Length; i++)
				{
					if (rowsToRecycle[i] is UltraGridSummaryRow ultraGridSummaryRow && ultraGridSummaryRow.ParentCollection == parentRows)
					{
						ultraGridSummaryRow.Initialize(summaryDisplayAreaContext);
						rowsToRecycle[i] = null;
						return ultraGridSummaryRow;
					}
				}
			}
			return new UltraGridSummaryRow(parentRows, summaryDisplayAreaContext);
		}

		private void GetSummaryRow(List<UltraGridRow> list, bool top, bool isFixed, RowsCollection parentRows, UltraGridRow[] rowsToRecycle)
		{
			bool isGroupByRows = parentRows.IsGroupByRows;
			SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext = null;
			if ((isGroupByRows || !parentRows.IsCardRows) && (!isGroupByRows || !Band.CardView))
			{
				SummaryDisplayAreas summaryDisplayAreas = ((!top) ? (isFixed ? SummaryDisplayAreas.BottomFixed : SummaryDisplayAreas.Bottom) : (isFixed ? SummaryDisplayAreas.TopFixed : SummaryDisplayAreas.Top));
				SummaryDisplayAreas summaryDisplayAreas2 = SummaryDisplayAreas.None;
				SummaryDisplayAreas summaryDisplayAreas3 = SummaryDisplayAreas.None;
				bool isTopLevel = parentRows.IsTopLevel;
				if (!isTopLevel)
				{
					summaryDisplayAreas3 |= SummaryDisplayAreas.RootRowsFootersOnly;
				}
				if (isGroupByRows)
				{
					summaryDisplayAreas2 |= SummaryDisplayAreas.GroupByRowsFooter;
				}
				else
				{
					summaryDisplayAreas3 |= SummaryDisplayAreas.HideDataRowFooters;
				}
				if (isTopLevel && summaryDisplayAreas2 != SummaryDisplayAreas.None)
				{
					summaryDisplayAreas2 |= SummaryDisplayAreas.RootRowsFootersOnly;
				}
				SummaryDisplayAreas displayArea = summaryDisplayAreas;
				summaryDisplayAreaContext = new SummaryDisplayAreaContext(summaryDisplayAreas2, summaryDisplayAreas, summaryDisplayAreas3, displayArea);
				if (HasSummaryVisibleInFooter(summaryDisplayAreaContext))
				{
					list.Add(CreateSummaryRow(parentRows, summaryDisplayAreaContext, rowsToRecycle));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void GetSummaryRows(List<UltraGridRow> list, bool top, RowsCollection parentRows, UltraGridRow[] rowsToRecycle)
		{
			GetSummaryRow(list, top, top, parentRows, rowsToRecycle);
			GetSummaryRow(list, top, !top, parentRows, rowsToRecycle);
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public int GetLeftOfLeftMostSummary(UltraGridSummaryRow summaryRowContext)
		{
			SummaryDisplayAreaContext context = ((summaryRowContext != null) ? summaryRowContext.SummaryDisplayAreaContext : new SummaryDisplayAreaContext(SummaryDisplayAreas.Bottom));
			return GetLeftOfLeftMostSummary(context);
		}

		internal int GetLeftOfLeftMostSummary(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context)
		{
			int num = int.MaxValue;
			int origin = Band.GetOrigin(BandOrigin.RowSelector);
			int num2 = 0;
			int count = Count;
			while (num > origin && num2 < count)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = this[num2];
				if (context.DoesSummaryMatch(summarySettings))
				{
					if (summarySettings.IsFreeFormSummary)
					{
						int extent = summarySettings.Band.GetExtent(BandOrigin.RowSelector);
						switch (summarySettings.SummaryPosition)
						{
						case SummaryPosition.Left:
							num = Math.Min(num, origin);
							break;
						case SummaryPosition.Center:
							num = Math.Min(num, origin + extent / 3);
							break;
						case SummaryPosition.Right:
							num = Math.Min(num, origin + 2 * extent / 3);
							break;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						UltraGridColumn summaryPositionColumnResolved = summarySettings.SummaryPositionColumnResolved;
						if (summaryPositionColumnResolved != null)
						{
							int num3 = summaryPositionColumnResolved.Header.Origin;
							if (summaryPositionColumnResolved.GroupResolved != null && summaryPositionColumnResolved.Band.GroupsDisplayed)
							{
								num3 += summaryPositionColumnResolved.GroupResolved.Header.Origin;
							}
							num = Math.Min(num, num3);
						}
					}
				}
				num2++;
			}
			return num;
		}

		void IList.Insert(int index, object value)
		{
			if (index < 0 || index > Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("index");
			}
			SummarySettings summarySettings = (SummarySettings)value;
			if (summarySettings.ParentCollection != null && this != summarySettings.ParentCollection)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("You can't add a summary from a different collection.", "value");
			}
			summarySettings.Initialize(this);
			if (!Contains(summarySettings))
			{
				AddHelper(index, summarySettings);
			}
		}

		void IList.Remove(object value)
		{
			Remove((SummarySettings)value);
		}

		int IList.Add(object value)
		{
			int count = Count;
			((IList)this).Insert(count, value);
			return count;
		}

		bool IList.Contains(object value)
		{
			return Contains(value);
		}
	}

		private class RowCallback : IRowCallback
		{
			private SummarySettings summarySettings;

			private ICustomSummaryCalculator summaryCalculator;

			internal RowCallback(ICustomSummaryCalculator summaryCalculator, SummarySettings summarySettings)
			{
				this.summarySettings = summarySettings;
				this.summaryCalculator = summaryCalculator;
			}

			bool IRowCallback.ProcessRow(UltraGridRow row)
			{
				if (typeof(UltraGridRow) == row.GetType())
				{
					bool flag = row.HiddenInternal;
					UltraGridRow parentRow = row.ParentRow;
					while (parentRow != null && (parentRow.Band == summarySettings.Band || parentRow.Band.IsDescendantOfBand(summarySettings.Band)))
					{
						if (parentRow.HiddenInternal)
						{
							flag = true;
							break;
						}
						parentRow = parentRow.ParentRow;
					}
					if (!flag)
					{
						summaryCalculator.AggregateCustomSummary(summarySettings, row);
					}
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public string SummaryText
		{
			get
			{

				{
					bool isError;
					object formulaCalcValue = RefUtils.GetFormulaCalcValue(CalcReference, out isError, FormatProviderResolved);
					if (isError)
					{
						return formulaCalcValue.ToString();
					}
				}
				object obj = Value;
				if ((obj == null || obj is DBNull) && SummarySettings.SourceColumn != null)
				{
					obj = SummarySettings.SourceColumn.NullTextResolved;
				}
				IFormatProvider formatProviderResolved = FormatProviderResolved;
				string formatResolved = FormatResolved;
				if (formatResolved == null || formatResolved.Length == 0)
				{
					if (obj is IFormattable formattable)
					{
						return formattable.ToString(null, formatProviderResolved);
					}
					return obj.ToString();
				}
				try
				{
					return string.Format(formatProviderResolved, formatResolved, new object[1] { obj });
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryValueInvalidDisplayFormat", formatResolved, ex.Message);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void OnExternalSummaryValueRequested()
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = null;
			if (Layout != null)
			{
				ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			}
			ultraGrid?.FireEvent(GridEventIds.ExternalSummaryValueRequested, new ExternalSummaryValueEventArgs(this));
		}

		internal void OnSummaryValueChanged(object oldSummaryValue, object newSummaryValue)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = null;
			if (Layout != null)
			{
				Layout.BumpRowChildElementsCacheVersion();
				ultraGrid = Layout.Grid as UltraGrid;
			}
			if (ultraGrid != null)
			{
				bool flag = true;
				if (oldSummaryValue == newSummaryValue)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				else if (oldSummaryValue != null && newSummaryValue != null && oldSummaryValue.GetType() == newSummaryValue.GetType() && oldSummaryValue.Equals(newSummaryValue))
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged();
					ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.SummaryValueChanged, new SummaryValueChangedEventArgs(this));
				}
			}
		}

		internal void CalculateSummaryValue()
		{
			RowsCollection parentRows = ParentRows;
			if (parentRows == null || (SummarySettings.SummaryCalculationsVersion == verifiedSummaryCalculationsVersion && parentRows.DataChangedVersion == verifiedDataChangedVersion) || inCalculateSummary)
			{
				return;
			}
			inCalculateSummary = true;
			try
			{
				verifiedSummaryCalculationsVersion = SummarySettings.SummaryCalculationsVersion;
				verifiedDataChangedVersion = parentRows.DataChangedVersion;
				object oldSummaryValue = calculatedSummaryValue;
				if (summarySettings != null && summarySettings.IsExternal)
				{
					OnExternalSummaryValueRequested();
					return;
				}
				calculatedSummaryValue = CalculateSummaryValue(parentRows, SummarySettings);
				OnSummaryValueChanged(oldSummaryValue, calculatedSummaryValue);
			}
			finally
			{
				inCalculateSummary = false;
			}
		}

		private static object CalculateSummaryValue(RowsCollection rows, SummarySettings summarySettings)
		{
			if (SummaryType.Custom == summarySettings.SummaryType && summarySettings.CustomSummaryCalculator == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ICustomSummaryCalculator customSummaryCalculator = null;
			switch (summarySettings.SummaryType)
			{
			case SummaryType.Average:
				customSummaryCalculator = new AverageSummaryCalculator();
				break;
			case SummaryType.Count:
				customSummaryCalculator = new CountSummaryCalculator();
				break;
			case SummaryType.Maximum:
				customSummaryCalculator = new MaximumSummaryCalculator();
				break;
			case SummaryType.Minimum:
				customSummaryCalculator = new MinimumSummaryCalculator();
				break;
			case SummaryType.Sum:
				customSummaryCalculator = new SumSummaryCalculator();
				break;
			case SummaryType.Custom:
				customSummaryCalculator = summarySettings.CustomSummaryCalculator;
				break;
			case SummaryType.Formula:
				return null;
			case SummaryType.External:
				return null;
			default:
				return null;
			}
			if (summarySettings.SourceColumn == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (summarySettings.SourceColumn.Band != summarySettings.ParentCollection.Band && !summarySettings.SourceColumn.Band.IsDescendantOfBand(summarySettings.ParentCollection.Band))
			{
				return null;
			}
			customSummaryCalculator.BeginCustomSummary(summarySettings, rows);
			rows.InternalTraverseRowsHelper(summarySettings.SourceColumn.Band, new RowCallback(customSummaryCalculator, summarySettings), recursive: true);
			return customSummaryCalculator.EndCustomSummary(summarySettings, rows);
		}

		internal void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags propFlags, SummaryDisplayAreaContext summaryDisplayAreaContext)
		{
			//IL_0074: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007a: Expected I8, but got Unknown
			//IL_0106: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0166: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0120: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridBand band = Band;
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(band, StyleUtils.Role.SummaryValue, out resOrder);
			if (summaryDisplayAreaContext != null && summaryDisplayAreaContext.IsGroupByRowSummaries)
			{
				if (summaryDisplayAreaContext.GroupByRowContext != null && summaryDisplayAreaContext.GroupByRowContext.Selected)
				{
					ResolveAppearanceContext context = new ResolveAppearanceContext(typeof(UltraGridGroupByRow), propFlags);
					context.Role = StyleUtils.GetRole(band, StyleUtils.Role.GroupByRow, out context.ResolutionOrder);
					context.IsSelected = true;
					band.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
					propFlags = (AppearancePropFlags)(long)context.UnresolvedProps;
					if ((4uL & (ulong)propFlags) != 0L)
					{
						propFlags = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)propFlags ^ 4uL);
						((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).BorderColor = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).ForeColor;
					}
				}
				if (HasGroupBySummaryValueAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					GroupBySummaryValueAppearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref propFlags);
				}
			}
			if (HasAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				((AppearanceBase)Appearance).MergeData(ref appData, ref propFlags);
			}
			SummarySettings summarySettings = SummarySettings;
			if (summaryDisplayAreaContext != null && summaryDisplayAreaContext.IsGroupByRowSummaries)
			{
				if (summarySettings.HasGroupBySummaryValueAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					summarySettings.GroupBySummaryValueAppearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref propFlags);
				}
				band.MergeBLOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref propFlags, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.GroupBySummaryValueAppearance, role, resOrder, (RoleState)2097152);
				if (HasFormulaCalcError)
				{
					band.MergeBLOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref propFlags, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.FormulaErrorAppearance, role, resOrder, (RoleState)128);
				}
				GridUtils.ResolveBackColorsToTransparent(ref appData, ref propFlags);
			}
			else
			{
				if (summarySettings.HasAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
				{
					summarySettings.Appearance.MergeData(ref appData, ref propFlags);
				}
				if ((long)propFlags == 0L)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (HasFormulaCalcError)
				{
					band.MergeBLOverrideAppearances(ref appData, ref propFlags, UltraGridOverride.OverrideAppearanceIndex.FormulaErrorAppearance, role, resOrder, (RoleState)128);
					if ((long)propFlags == 0L)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ParentCollection != null)
			{
				ParentCollection.ResolveSummaryValueAppearance(summaryDisplayAreaContext, ref appData, ref propFlags);
			}
		}

		internal bool GetFormulaCalcError(out string errorInfoText)
		{
			errorInfoText = null;
			if (SummarySettings.HasActiveFormula)
			{
				RefUtils.GetFormulaCalcValue(CalcReference, out var isError, out errorInfoText, FormatProviderResolved);
				return isError;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void InvalidateItemAllRegions()

		}

		internal static void InvalidateItemAllRegions(SummaryValue[] summaryValues, UltraGridBand band, RowsCollection parentRows)
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridLayout layout = band.Layout;
			if (layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = parentRows?.TopLevelRowsCollection.IsPotentiallyVisibleOnScreen ?? false;
			if (!flag)
			{
				return;
			}
			Dictionary<SummaryValue, object> dictionary = new Dictionary<SummaryValue, object>();
			bool hasGroupBySortColumns = band.HasGroupBySortColumns;
			foreach (SummaryValue summaryValue in summaryValues)
			{
				dictionary[summaryValue] = null;
				if (hasGroupBySortColumns && flag && summaryValue.SummarySettings != null && SummaryDisplayAreaContext.InGroupByRowsSummariesContext.DoesSummaryMatch(summaryValue.SummarySettings))
				{
					layout.DirtyDataAreaElement();
					layout.BumpRowChildElementsCacheVersion();
					return;
				}
			}
			InvalidateAllSummaryElements(layout.UIElementInternal, dictionary);
		}

		private static void InvalidateAllSummaryElements(UIElement element, Dictionary<SummaryValue, object> summaryValues)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < ((ArrayList)(object)element.ChildElements).Count; i++)
			{
				UIElement val = element.ChildElements[i];
				if (val is SummaryValueUIElement)
				{
					SummaryValue summaryValue = (SummaryValue)val.GetContext(typeof(SummaryValue));
					if (summaryValue != null && summaryValues.ContainsKey(summaryValue))
					{
						val.DirtyChildElements();
					}
				}
				else
				{
					InvalidateAllSummaryElements(val, summaryValues);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void NotifyCalcManager_ValueChanged()
		{
			if (HasCalcReference && !Layout.CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended && (!CalcReference.HasFormula || CalcReference.ContainingFormulaRef.dummyFormula))
			{
				CalcReference.NotifyCalcEngineValueChanged();
			}
		}

		private bool IsVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulasSuspended()
		{
			return (Band?.CalcReference)?.IsVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulasSuspended ?? false;
		}

		private SummaryValue GetSummaryValueFromPosition(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context, SummaryPosition summaryPosition, UltraGridColumn positionColumn, int level)
		{
			List<SummarySettings> list = new List<SummarySettings>();
			if (SummaryPosition.UseSummaryPositionColumn == summaryPosition)
			{
				if (positionColumn == null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentNullException("positionColumn", "You must specify a valid positionColumn if summaryPosition is UseSummaryPositionColumn.");
				}
				Band.Summaries.GetFixedSummariesForLevel(context, level, list);
			}
			else
			{
				Band.Summaries.GetFreeFormSummariesForLevel(context, level, list);
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < list.Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = list[i];
				if (SummaryPosition.UseSummaryPositionColumn == summaryPosition)
				{
					if (summarySettings != null && summarySettings.SummaryPositionColumnResolved == positionColumn)
					{
						return GetSummaryValueFor(summarySettings);
					}
				}
				else if (summarySettings != null && summaryPosition == summarySettings.SummaryPosition)
				{
					return GetSummaryValueFor(summarySettings);
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void InternalClearHelper()
		{
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			int count = arrayList.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{

			InternalClear();
		}

		private void InternalAddSummaryValueFor(int index, SummarySettings summarySettings)
		{
			if (summarySettings != null)
			{
				SummaryValue summaryValue = new SummaryValue(this, summarySettings);
				summaryValue.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				InternalInsert(index, summaryValue);
			}
		}

		internal SummaryValue GetSummaryValueFor(SummarySettings summarySettings)
		{
			VerifySummariesVersion();
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			int count = arrayList.Count;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (arrayList[i] is SummaryValue)
				{
					SummaryValue summaryValue = (SummaryValue)arrayList[i];
					if (summaryValue != null && summaryValue.SummarySettings == summarySettings)
					{
						return summaryValue;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static bool DoesSummarySettingsExistFor(SummaryValue summaryValue, SummarySettingsCollection summaries)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < summaries.Count; i++)
			{
				if (summaryValue.SummarySettings == summaries[i])
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void VerifySummariesVersion()
		{
			if (Band.Summaries.SummariesVersion == verifiedSummariesVersion)
			{
				return;
			}
			verifiedSummariesVersion = Band.Summaries.SummariesVersion;
			if (!Band.HasSummaries)
			{
				InternalClearHelper();
				return;
			}
			SummarySettingsCollection summaries = Band.Summaries;
			ArrayList arrayList = List;
			for (int num = arrayList.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				if (arrayList[num] is SummaryValue)
				{
					SummaryValue summaryValue = (SummaryValue)arrayList[num];
					if (!DoesSummarySettingsExistFor(summaryValue, summaries))
					{
						InternalRemoveHelper(summaryValue);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					InternalRemoveHelper(num);
				}
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < summaries.Count; i++)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = summaries[i];
				SummaryValue summaryValueFor = GetSummaryValueFor(summarySettings);
				if (summaryValueFor == null)
				{
					InternalAddSummaryValueFor(i, summarySettings);
				}
			}
		}

			UltraGridBand band = Band;

			{

			}

			UIElementBorderStyle borderStyleSummaryFooterCaptionResolved = band.BorderStyleSummaryFooterCaptionResolved;

		{

				font = font2;
			}

			int result = ((cachedGraphics != null) ? Band.Layout.MeasureString(cachedGraphics, "ghW", font).Height : font.Height);
			font2?.Dispose();
			font2 = null;
			if (cachedGraphics != null)

				Band.Layout.ReleaseCachedGraphics(cachedGraphics);

		private int GetSummaryLineHeightHelper(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context, List<SummarySettings> list)
		{
			//IL_0068: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

					num = Math.Max(num, summarySettings.Lines);
				}

		}

		{

		}

		internal bool DirtySummaryValues(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			bool result = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < List.Count; i++)
			{
				SummaryValue summaryValue = List[i] as SummaryValue;
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = ((summaryValue != null && summaryValue.SummarySettings != null && summaryValue.SummarySettings.SourceColumn != null) ? summaryValue.SummarySettings.SourceColumn.Band : null);
				if (ultraGridBand != null && (ultraGridBand == band || ultraGridBand.IsDescendantOfBand(band)))
				{
					summaryValue.DirtySummaryValue();
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

			}
			if ((long)propFlags != 0L && (summaryDisplayAreaContext == null || !summaryDisplayAreaContext.IsGroupByRowSummaries))
			{
				context.UnresolvedProps = propFlags;
				band.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
				propFlags = (AppearancePropFlags)(long)context.UnresolvedProps;
				if ((long)propFlags != 0L)
				{
					context = new ResolveAppearanceContext(typeof(SummaryFooterUIElement), propFlags);
					band.ResolveAppearance(ref appData, ref context);
					propFlags = (AppearancePropFlags)(long)context.UnresolvedProps;
				}
			}
		}

		internal string ReplaceSummaryFooterCaptionToken(string token)
		{
			UltraGridBand band = Band;
			if ("GROUPBYROWVALUE".Equals(token))
			{
				if (!(Rows.ParentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return ultraGridGroupByRow.GetDisplayText();
			}
			if (token.Equals("BANDHEADER"))
			{
				string text = ((band.Header.Caption != null) ? band.Header.Caption : band.Key);
				if (text == null)
				{
					return "";
				}
				return text;
			}
			UltraGridBand parentBand = band.ParentBand;
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
			if (token.Equals("SCROLLTIPFIELD"))
			{
				ultraGridColumn = parentBand?.ScrollTipCol;
			}
			else if (parentBand != null && parentBand.Columns != null && parentBand.Columns.Exists(token))
			{
				ultraGridColumn = parentBand.Columns[token];
			}
			if (ultraGridColumn != null && Rows != null)
			{
				string cellText = Rows.TopLevelRowsCollection.ParentRow.GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
				if (cellText == null)
				{
					return ultraGridColumn.NullTextResolved;
				}
				return cellText;
			}
			return token;
		}

		internal string GetSummaryFooterCaption()
		{
			string text = ((SummaryFooterCaption != null) ? SummaryFooterCaption : Band.SummaryFooterCaptionInternal);
			if (text == null)
			{
				text = (Rows.IsRootRowsCollection ? Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryFooterCaption_RootRows") : ((!Rows.ParentRow.IsGroupByRow) ? Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryFooterCaption_ChildBandNonGroupByRows") : Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("SummaryFooterCaption_GroupByChildRows")));
			}
			int num = 0;
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(10 + text.Length);
			while (num < text.Length)
			{
				string text2 = null;
				int num2 = text.IndexOf('[', num);
				int num3 = -1;
				if (num2 >= 0)
				{
					num3 = text.IndexOf(']', 1 + num2);
					if (num3 > 0)
					{
						text2 = ReplaceSummaryFooterCaptionToken(text.Substring(1 + num2, num3 - num2 - 1));
					}
				}
				if (text2 == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				if (stringBuilder == null)
				{
					stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(text.Length + text2.Length);
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(text, num, num2 - num);
				stringBuilder.Append(text2);
				num = 1 + num3;
			}
			if (stringBuilder != null)
			{
				if (num < text.Length)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(text, num, text.Length - num);
				}
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
			return text;
		}

		internal SummaryValue GetFormulaSummaryFromPrintFormulaSummary(SummaryValue printFormulaSummary)
		{
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				SummaryValue summaryValue = this[i];
				string formula = summaryValue.SummarySettings.Formula;
				if (formula == printFormulaSummary.SummarySettings.Formula)
				{
					return summaryValue;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal int GetSummaryValueAppearanceImageHeight(SummaryDisplayAreaContext context)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			AppearanceData appData = default(AppearanceData);
			AppearancePropFlags propFlags = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
			ResolveSummaryValueAppearance(context, ref appData, ref propFlags);
			if (((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).Image != null && Band != null && Band.Layout != null && Band.Layout.Grid != null)
			{
				Image image = ((AppearanceData)(ref appData)).GetImage(Band.Layout.Grid.ImageList);
				if (image != null)
				{
					return image.Height;
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}

		internal static int ResolveSummaryRowHeight(int calculatedHeight, UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				return calculatedHeight;
			}
			int defaultSummaryRowHeightResolved = band.DefaultSummaryRowHeightResolved;
			int minRowSummaryHeightResolved = band.MinRowSummaryHeightResolved;
			minRowSummaryHeightResolved = ((minRowSummaryHeightResolved == -1) ? calculatedHeight : minRowSummaryHeightResolved);
			if (defaultSummaryRowHeightResolved <= 0)
			{
				if (calculatedHeight <= minRowSummaryHeightResolved)
				{
					return minRowSummaryHeightResolved;
				}
				return calculatedHeight;
			}
			if (defaultSummaryRowHeightResolved <= minRowSummaryHeightResolved)
			{
				return minRowSummaryHeightResolved;
			}
			return defaultSummaryRowHeightResolved;
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			if (propChange.Source is SummaryValue)
			{
				SummaryValue summaryValue = (SummaryValue)propChange.Source;
				summaryValue.InvalidateItemAllRegions();
			}
		}

	internal class FormulaHolder
	{
		private FormulaRefBase calcReference;

		private string formula;

		private object clientObject;

		private IFormulaValueConverter formulaValueConverter;

		private string referenceName;

		private string normalizedReferenceName;

		private int clientObjectIndex = -1;

		internal string Formula
		{
			get
			{
				return formula;
			}
			set
			{
				if (formula != value)
				{
					formula = value;
					ReaddFormulaToCalcNetwork();
				}
			}
		}

		internal IFormulaValueConverter FormulaValueConverter
		{
			get
			{
				return formulaValueConverter;
			}
			set
			{
				formulaValueConverter = value;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasActiveFormula
		{
			get
			{
				if (formula != null && formula.Length > 0 && CalcManager != null)
				{
					string elementName = CalcReference.ElementName;
					if (elementName != null)
					{
						return elementName.Length > 0;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private UltraGridLayout Layout
		{
			get
			{
				if (clientObject is SummarySettings)
				{
					return ((SummarySettings)clientObject).Layout;
				}
				if (clientObject is UltraGridColumn)
				{
					return ((UltraGridColumn)clientObject).Layout;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal string ReferenceName
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureReferenceNameInitialized();
				return referenceName;
			}
		}

		internal string NormalizedCalcReferenceName
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureReferenceNameInitialized();
				return normalizedReferenceName;
			}
		}

		internal IUltraCalcManager CalcManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (Layout == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Layout.CalcManager;
			}
		}

		internal FormulaRefBase CalcReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (calcReference == null && Layout != null)
				{
					if (clientObject is UltraGridColumn)
					{
						calcReference = new ColumnReference((UltraGridColumn)clientObject);
					}
					else if (clientObject is SummarySettings)
					{
						calcReference = new SummarySettingsReference((SummarySettings)clientObject);
					}
				}
				return calcReference;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasValidReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (CalcReference != null)
				{
					string elementName = CalcReference.ElementName;
					if (elementName != null && elementName.Length > 0)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal bool CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended
		{
			get
			{
				if (Layout != null)
				{
					return Layout.CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal bool HasCalcReference => calcReference != null;

		internal FormulaHolder(object clientObject)
		{
			if (clientObject == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("clientObject");
			}
			if (!(clientObject is SummarySettings) && !(clientObject is UltraGridColumn))
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			this.clientObject = clientObject;
		}

		private void DirtyCachedReferenceName()
		{
			referenceName = null;
		}

		private void EnsureReferenceNameInitialized()
		{
			if (referenceName != null && referenceName.Length > 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (clientObject is SummarySettings)
			{
				SummarySettings summarySettings = (SummarySettings)clientObject;
				referenceName = summarySettings.Key;
				if (referenceName == null || referenceName.Length == 0)
				{
					if (clientObjectIndex == -1)
					{
						clientObjectIndex = summarySettings.Band.GetNextInternalSummaryFormulaNameIndex();
					}
					referenceName = "_Summary_" + clientObjectIndex;
				}
			}
			else if (clientObject is UltraGridColumn)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = (UltraGridColumn)clientObject;
				referenceName = ultraGridColumn.Key;
				if (referenceName == null || referenceName.Length == 0)
				{
					if (clientObjectIndex == -1)
					{
						clientObjectIndex = ultraGridColumn.Band.GetNextInternalColumnFormulaNameIndex();
					}
					referenceName = "_Summary_" + clientObjectIndex;
				}
			}
			referenceName = RefParser.EscapeString(referenceName, withinQuotes: false);
			normalizedReferenceName = referenceName.ToLower(RefUtils.UltraCalcCulture);
		}

		internal void AddReferenceToCalcNetwork()
		{
			ReaddReferenceToCalcNetwork(null);
		}

		internal void RemoveReferenceFromCalcNetwork()
		{
			IUltraCalcManager calcManager = CalcManager;
			if (calcManager != null && HasValidReference && !CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended)
			{
				calcManager.RemoveReference(CalcReference);
				DirtyCachedReferenceName();
			}
		}

		internal void ReaddReferenceToCalcNetwork(IUltraCalcManager oldCalcManager)
		{
			if (HasValidReference && !CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended)
			{
				IUltraCalcManager calcManager = CalcManager;
				if (oldCalcManager != null && CalcReference != null)
				{
					oldCalcManager.RemoveReference(CalcReference);
				}
				DirtyCachedReferenceName();
				if (calcManager != null && CalcReference != null)
				{
					calcManager.AddReference(CalcReference);
					ReaddFormulaToCalcNetwork();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ReaddFormulaToCalcNetwork()
		{
			if (CalcManager != null && HasValidReference && !CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended)
			{
				CalcReference.RegisterFormula(formula);
			}
		}
	}

		protected virtual bool ContainsReferenceHelper(IUltraCalcReference inReference, bool isProperSubset)
		{
			RefBase refBase = inReference as RefBase;
			UltraGridRefBase ultraGridRefBase = RefUtils.GetUnderlyingReference(refBase) as UltraGridRefBase;
			bool flag = ultraGridRefBase != null;
			if (refBase != null && flag)
			{
				if (refBase is CellReference && this is ColumnReference)
				{
					return ((CellReference)refBase).Cell.Column == ((ColumnReference)this).Column;
				}
				if (this is SummarySettingsReference && refBase is SummarySettingsReference)
				{
					return string.Equals(NormalizedAbsoluteName, refBase.NormalizedAbsoluteName);
				}
				RefParser parsedReference = ParsedReference;
				RefParser parsedReference2 = refBase.ParsedReference;
				if ((!parsedReference.IsFullyQualified && !parsedReference.IsRoot) || (!parsedReference2.IsFullyQualified && !parsedReference2.IsRoot) || parsedReference.TupleCount <= 0 || parsedReference2.TupleCount <= 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!(isProperSubset ? parsedReference[0].IsSubset(parsedReference2[0]) : parsedReference[0].Contains(parsedReference2[0])))
				{
					return false;
				}
				List<RefTuple> list = RefUtils.InsertGroupByColumnTuples(Layout, parsedReference);
				List<RefTuple> list2 = RefUtils.InsertGroupByColumnTuples(Layout, parsedReference2);
				if (list != null && list2 != null && list.Count <= list2.Count)
				{
					bool flag2 = true;
					int num = 0;
					while (flag2 && num < list.Count)
					{
						flag2 = (isProperSubset ? list[num].IsSubset(list2[num]) : list[num].Contains(list2[num]));
						num++;
					}
					return flag2;
				}
			}
			return base.ContainsReference(inReference);
		}

		public override bool ContainsReference(IUltraCalcReference inReference)
		{
			return ContainsReferenceHelper(inReference, isProperSubset: false);
		}

		public override bool IsSubsetReference(IUltraCalcReference inReference)
		{
			return ContainsReferenceHelper(inReference, isProperSubset: true);
		}

		internal static IUltraCalcReference FilterReference(IUltraCalcReference result)
		{
			NestedReference nestedReference = RefUtils.GetUnderlyingReference(result) as NestedReference;
			RefBase refBase = null;
			if (nestedReference != null && nestedReference.Rows.IsRootRowsCollection)
			{
				if (nestedReference is NestedColumnReference)
				{
					refBase = RefUtils.GetColumnReference(((NestedColumnReference)nestedReference).Column);
				}
				else if (nestedReference is NestedBandReference)
				{
					refBase = RefUtils.GetBandReference(((NestedBandReference)nestedReference).Band);
				}
				else if (nestedReference is NestedSummarySettingsReference)
				{
					refBase = ((NestedSummarySettingsReference)nestedReference).SummaryReference;
				}
			}
			else if (RefUtils.GetUnderlyingReference(result) is SummaryValueReference summaryValueReference && summaryValueReference.SummaryValue.ParentRows.IsRootRowsCollection)
			{
				refBase = RefUtils.GetSummarySettingsReference(summaryValueReference.SummaryValue.SummarySettings);
			}
			if (refBase != null && refBase != nestedReference)
			{
				if (result is RefUnAnchored)
				{
					RefUnAnchored refUnAnchored = new RefUnAnchored(refBase);
					refUnAnchored.RelativeReference = ((RefUnAnchored)result).RelativeReference;
					refBase = refUnAnchored;
				}
				return refBase;
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference CreateReference(string referenceName)
		{
			return FilterReference(base.CreateReference(referenceName));
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference ResolveReference(IUltraCalcReference inReference, ResolveReferenceType referenceType)
		{
			if (inReference is SummarySettingsReference || inReference is NestedSummarySettingsReference)
			{
				if (this is ColumnReference || this is BandReference || this is SummarySettingsReference)
				{
					return inReference;
				}
				if (this is NestedReference && inReference is SummarySettingsReference)
				{
					RowsCollection rows = ((NestedReference)this).Rows;
					UltraGridBand band = rows.Band;
					SummarySettingsReference summarySettingsReference = (SummarySettingsReference)inReference;
					UltraGridBand band2 = summarySettingsReference.Summary.Band;
					if (band.Layout == band2.Layout && !band.IsDescendantOfBand(band2))
					{
						return RefUtils.GetNestedSummarySettingsReference(rows, summarySettingsReference);
					}
					return inReference;
				}
			}
			return FilterReference(base.ResolveReference(inReference, referenceType));
		}

		private RefTuple GetLastRangeRefTuple(RefParser rp, out string errorMessage)
		{
			errorMessage = null;
			RefTuple refTuple = new RefTuple(rp.LastTuple);
			RefTuple refTuple2 = rp[rp.TupleCount - 2];
			if (refTuple.Scope == RefTuple.RefScope.Any)
			{
				refTuple.Scope = refTuple2.Scope;
				refTuple.ScopeIndex = refTuple2.ScopeIndex;
			}
			if (refTuple.Scope == RefTuple.RefScope.Any || RefTuple.RefScope.All == refTuple.Scope || RefTuple.RefScope.Index == refTuple.Scope || (RefTuple.RefScope.RelativeIndex == refTuple.Scope && this is ColumnReference))
			{
				return refTuple;
			}
			errorMessage = "Invalid scope.";
			return null;
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference CreateRange(string fromReferenceName, string toReferenceName)
		{
			IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = CreateReference(fromReferenceName);
			if (ultraCalcReference is UltraCalcReferenceError)
			{
				return ultraCalcReference;
			}
			IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference2 = CreateReference(toReferenceName);
			if (ultraCalcReference2 is UltraCalcReferenceError)
			{
				return ultraCalcReference2;
			}
			UltraGridRefBase ultraGridRefBase = RefUtils.GetUnderlyingReference(ultraCalcReference) as UltraGridRefBase;
			RefParser refParser = ((ultraCalcReference is RefUnAnchored) ? ((RefUnAnchored)ultraCalcReference).ParsedReference : ultraGridRefBase.ParsedReference);
			UltraGridRefBase ultraGridRefBase2 = RefUtils.GetUnderlyingReference(ultraCalcReference2) as UltraGridRefBase;
			RefParser refParser2 = ((ultraCalcReference2 is RefUnAnchored) ? ((RefUnAnchored)ultraCalcReference2).ParsedReference : ultraGridRefBase2.ParsedReference);
			if (ultraGridRefBase == null || ultraGridRefBase2 == null || refParser == null || refParser2 == null || refParser.TupleCount < 2 || refParser2.TupleCount < 2)
			{
				return base.CreateRange(fromReferenceName, toReferenceName);
			}
			string errorMessage = null;
			if (ultraGridRefBase.ColumnContext == null || ultraGridRefBase2.ColumnContext == null)
			{
				errorMessage = "From or to reference does not specify a column.";
			}
			else if (ultraGridRefBase.ColumnContext != ultraGridRefBase2.ColumnContext)
			{
				errorMessage = "From and to references in the range reference are not the same columns.";
			}
			RefTuple refTuple = null;
			RefTuple refTuple2 = null;
			if (errorMessage == null)
			{
				refTuple = GetLastRangeRefTuple(refParser, out errorMessage);
			}
			if (errorMessage == null)
			{
				refTuple2 = GetLastRangeRefTuple(refParser2, out errorMessage);
			}
			string reference = fromReferenceName + ":" + toReferenceName;
			if (errorMessage != null || refTuple == null || refTuple2 == null)
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(reference, errorMessage);
			}
			return new RangeReference(ultraGridRefBase.ColumnContext, refParser, refParser2, refTuple, refTuple2);
		}

		public override bool IsSiblingReference(IUltraCalcReference reference)
		{
			UltraGridRefBase ultraGridRefBase = RefUtils.GetUnderlyingReference(reference) as UltraGridRefBase;
			UltraGridRefBase ultraGridRefBase2 = this;
			if (ultraGridRefBase is NestedColumnReference && ((NestedColumnReference)ultraGridRefBase).Rows.IsRootRowsCollection)
			{
				ultraGridRefBase = ((NestedColumnReference)ultraGridRefBase).Column.CalcReference;
			}
			if (ultraGridRefBase2 is NestedColumnReference && ((NestedColumnReference)ultraGridRefBase2).Rows.IsRootRowsCollection)
			{
				ultraGridRefBase2 = ((NestedColumnReference)ultraGridRefBase2).Column.CalcReference;
			}
			if (ultraGridRefBase is ColumnReference && ultraGridRefBase2 is ColumnReference)
			{
				return ((ColumnReference)ultraGridRefBase).BandContext == ((ColumnReference)ultraGridRefBase2).BandContext;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class GridReference : UltraGridRefBase
	{
		private string gridName;

		internal bool recalcDeferredSuspended;

		public override string ElementName => gridName;

		public override RefBase BaseParent => null;

		public override bool IsDisposedReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Layout != null)
				{
					return base.Layout.Disposed;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override string AbsoluteName => "//" + ElementName;

		internal GridReference(UltraGridLayout layout)
			: base(layout, layout.Grid)
		{
			ISite site = ((Component)(object)layout.Grid).Site;
			if (site != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(site.Name))
			{
				gridName = site.Name;
			}
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(gridName))
			{
				gridName = ((Control)(object)layout.Grid).Name;
			}
			if (gridName == null)
			{
				gridName = "";
			}
			string.IsNullOrEmpty(gridName);
			gridName = RefParser.EscapeString(gridName, withinQuotes: false);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name)
		{

		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindSummaryItem(string name)

		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, string index)

			if (!(bandReference is BandReference))
			{
				return bandReference;
			}

		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, int index, bool isRelative)
		{

			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_RelativeIndexInvalid"));
			}
