		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindAll(string name)
		{
			return FindItem(name);
		}

		private IUltraCalcReference BuildReferenceHelper(RefParser newRef, bool forceDataRef, out bool returnedRefFromThisGrid)
		{
			returnedRefFromThisGrid = false;
			IEnumerator enumerator = newRef.GetEnumerator();
			if (newRef.IsFullyQualified)
			{
				if (!enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					return new UltraCalcReferenceError(newRef.ToString(), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_InvalidReference", newRef.ToString()));
				}
				RefTuple refTuple = (RefTuple)enumerator.Current;
				if (refTuple.Type != RefTuple.RefType.Identifier)
				{
					return new UltraCalcReferenceError(newRef.ToString(), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_InvalidReference", newRef.ToString()));
				}
				if (refTuple.Scope != RefTuple.RefScope.Any)
				{
					return new UltraCalcReferenceError(newRef.ToString(), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_InvalidReference", newRef.ToString()));
				}
				if (string.Compare(ElementName, refTuple.Name, ignoreCase: true) != 0)
				{
					return (RefBase)base.CalcManager.GetReference(newRef.ToString());
				}
			}
			returnedRefFromThisGrid = true;
			return RefLoop(this, enumerator, forceDataRef);
		}

		protected override IUltraCalcReference BuildReference(RefParser newRef, bool forceDataRef)
		{
			bool returnedRefFromThisGrid;
			return BuildReferenceHelper(newRef, forceDataRef, out returnedRefFromThisGrid);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference CreateReference(string reference)
		{
			try
			{
				RefParser refParser = new RefParser(reference);
				if (refParser.TupleCount == 0)
				{
					return new UltraCalcReferenceError(reference, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_InvalidReference", reference));
				}
				bool returnedRefFromThisGrid;
				IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = BuildReferenceHelper(refParser, forceDataRef: false, out returnedRefFromThisGrid);
				if (!returnedRefFromThisGrid || ultraCalcReference is UltraCalcReferenceError || !(ultraCalcReference is RefBase))
				{
					return ultraCalcReference;
				}
				RefBase refBase = (RefBase)ultraCalcReference;
				if (refBase.IsAnchored)
				{
					refBase = new RefUnAnchored(refBase);
				}
				refBase.RelativeReference = refParser;
				return UltraGridRefBase.FilterReference(refBase);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(reference, ex.Message);
			}
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference[] GetChildReferences(ChildReferenceType referenceType)
		{
			List<IUltraCalcReference> list = new List<IUltraCalcReference>();
			if (base.Layout != null && !IsDisposedReference && base.Layout.SortedBands != null)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in base.Layout.SortedBands)
				{
					if (!sortedBand.Disposed && sortedBand.CalcReference != null)
					{
						list.Add(sortedBand.CalcReference);
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}
	}
	internal class BandReference : UltraGridRefBase
	{
		private UltraGridBand band;

		private Hashtable columnsByNormalizedCalcReferenceName;

		private int verifiedColumnsVersion = -1;

		internal int verifiedSummariesVersion = -1;

		private int verifiedGroupByHierarchyVersion = -1;

		private List<GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference> groupLevelRelatedReferences;

		private int suspendVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas_Counter;

		internal UltraGridBand Band => band;

		private Hashtable ColumnsByNormalizedCalcReferenceName
		{
			get
			{
				if (columnsByNormalizedCalcReferenceName == null || verifiedColumnsVersion != band.ColumnsVersion)
				{
					columnsByNormalizedCalcReferenceName = new Hashtable();
					foreach (UltraGridColumn column in band.Columns)
					{
						string normalizedCalcReferenceName = column.FormulaHolder.NormalizedCalcReferenceName;
						columnsByNormalizedCalcReferenceName[normalizedCalcReferenceName] = column;
						verifiedColumnsVersion = band.ColumnsVersion;
					}
				}
				return columnsByNormalizedCalcReferenceName;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulasSuspended => suspendVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas_Counter > 0;

		public override string ElementName => Band.CalcReferenceName;

		public override RefBase BaseParent
		{
			get
			{
				if (Band.ParentBand == null)
				{
					return base.Layout.CalcReference;
				}
				return Band.ParentBand.CalcReference;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsDisposedReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (band != null)
				{
					return !band.IsStillValid;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal List<GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference> GroupLevelRelatedReferences => groupLevelRelatedReferences;

		internal BandReference(UltraGridBand band)
			: base(band.Layout, band)
		{
			this.band = band;
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn GetColumnFromNormalizedCalcReferenceName(string normalizedCalcReferenceName)
		{
			return ColumnsByNormalizedCalcReferenceName[normalizedCalcReferenceName] as UltraGridColumn;
		}

		internal void SuspendVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas()
		{
			suspendVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas_Counter++;
		}

		internal void ResumeVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas(bool verifyOnResume)
		{
			if (IsVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulasSuspended)
			{
				suspendVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas_Counter--;
				if (!IsVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulasSuspended && verifyOnResume)
				{
					VerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas()
		{
			int groupByHierarchyVersion = Band.GroupByHierarchyVersion;
			int num = (Band.HasSummaries ? Band.Summaries.SummariesVersion : 0);
			if ((verifiedGroupByHierarchyVersion == groupByHierarchyVersion && verifiedSummariesVersion == num) || IsVerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulasSuspended)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = verifiedGroupByHierarchyVersion == groupByHierarchyVersion;
			verifiedGroupByHierarchyVersion = groupByHierarchyVersion;
			verifiedSummariesVersion = num;
			IUltraCalcManager calcManager = base.CalcManager;
			bool flag2 = calcManager == null || base.Layout.CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended;
			List<GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference> list = new List<GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference>();
			if (groupLevelRelatedReferences != null)
			{
				List<GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference> list2 = groupLevelRelatedReferences;
				groupLevelRelatedReferences = null;
				foreach (GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference item in list2)
				{
					if (item != null)
					{
						if (flag && Band.Summaries.Contains(item.Summary))
						{
							string text = ((item.Formula != null) ? item.Formula.FormulaString : string.Empty);
							string text2 = ((item.Summary.Formula != null) ? item.Summary.Formula : string.Empty);
							if (text == text2)
							{
								list.Add(item);
								continue;
							}
						}
						if (item.Formula != null && !flag2)
						{
							RefUtils.RemoveFormulaHelper(calcManager, item.Formula);
						}
						item.InternalSetIsDisposed(disposed: true);
					}
					if (!flag2)
					{
						calcManager.RemoveReference(item);
					}
				}
			}
			if (!band.HasGroupBySortColumns)
			{
				return;
			}
			groupLevelRelatedReferences = new List<GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference>();
			foreach (SummarySettings item2 in (IEnumerable)band.Summaries)
			{
				UltraGridRefBase ultraGridRefBase = this;
				for (int i = 0; i < band.SortedColumns.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = band.SortedColumns[i];
					if (!ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn)
					{
						break;
					}
					GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference groupLevelSummarySettingsReference = null;
					if (flag && list != null)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
						{
							GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference groupLevelSummarySettingsReference2 = list[j];
							if (groupLevelSummarySettingsReference2 != null && groupLevelSummarySettingsReference2.Summary == item2 && groupLevelSummarySettingsReference2.GroupByColumn == ultraGridColumn)
							{
								list[j] = null;
								groupLevelSummarySettingsReference = groupLevelSummarySettingsReference2;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (groupLevelSummarySettingsReference == null)
					{
						ultraGridRefBase = new GroupLevelReference(ultraGridRefBase, ultraGridColumn);
						groupLevelSummarySettingsReference = new GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference((GroupLevelReference)ultraGridRefBase, item2);
					}
					groupLevelRelatedReferences.Add(groupLevelSummarySettingsReference);
				}
			}
			if (!flag2)
			{
				foreach (GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference groupLevelRelatedReference in groupLevelRelatedReferences)
				{
					if (groupLevelRelatedReference is GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference groupLevelSummarySettingsReference3)
					{
						calcManager.AddReference(groupLevelSummarySettingsReference3);
						groupLevelSummarySettingsReference3.EnsureFormulaRegistered(groupLevelSummarySettingsReference3.Summary.Formula);
					}
				}
			}
			if (groupLevelRelatedReferences.Count <= 0)
			{
				groupLevelRelatedReferences = null;
			}
		}

		internal SummarySettingsReference GetSummarySettingsReference(SummaryValue summaryValue)
		{
			UltraGridColumn groupByColumn = ((summaryValue.ParentRows.ParentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow) ? ultraGridGroupByRow.Column : null);
			return GetSummarySettingsReference(summaryValue.SummarySettings, groupByColumn);
		}

		internal SummarySettingsReference GetSummarySettingsReference(SummarySettings summary, UltraGridColumn groupByColumn)
		{
			VerifyGroupLevelSummaryFormulas();
			if (groupLevelRelatedReferences != null)
			{
				foreach (GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference groupLevelRelatedReference in groupLevelRelatedReferences)
				{
					if (groupLevelRelatedReference.Summary == summary && groupByColumn == groupLevelRelatedReference.GroupByColumn)
					{
						return groupLevelRelatedReference;
					}
				}
			}
			if (groupByColumn == null)
			{
				return RefUtils.GetSummarySettingsReference(summary);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = RefUtils.GetColumn(Band, name, raiseException: false);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return RefUtils.CreateMissingColumnReference(Band, name);
			}
			if (column.IsChaptered)
			{
				return RefUtils.GetBandReference(base.Layout, name);
			}
			return RefUtils.GetColumnReference(column);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindSummaryItem(string name)
		{
			return RefUtils.GetSummarySettingsReference(Band, name);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, string index)
		{
			return FindItem(name);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, int index, bool isRelative)
		{
			return FindItem(name);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindAll(string name)
		{
			return FindItem(name);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference[] GetChildReferences(ChildReferenceType referenceType)
		{
			List<IUltraCalcReference> list = new List<IUltraCalcReference>();
			if (base.Layout != null && Band != null && !IsDisposedReference)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in Band.Columns)
				{
					if (!column.Disposed && column.CalcReference != null)
					{
						list.Add(column.CalcReference);
					}
				}
				if (Band.HasSummaries)
				{
					foreach (SummarySettings item in (IEnumerable)Band.Summaries)
					{
						if (!item.Disposed && item.CalcReference != null)
						{
							list.Add(item.CalcReference);
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (list.Count <= 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return band.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RefUnAnchored || obj is NestedBandReference)
			{
				return obj.Equals(this);
			}
			if (obj is BandReference bandReference)
			{
				return band == bandReference.band;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}
	internal class RowsCollectionReference : UltraGridRefBase
	{

		internal int resyncEventSuspended;

		internal override int ParserInstanceVersion
		{
			get
			{
				int num = parserInstanceVersion;
				RowsCollection parentCollection = Rows;
				while (parentCollection.ParentRow != null)
				{
					parentCollection = parentCollection.ParentRow.ParentCollection;
					num += parentCollection.CalcReference.parserInstanceVersion;
				}
				return num;
			}
		}

		internal RowsCollection Rows => rows;

		internal UltraGridBand Band => Rows.Band;

		internal override UltraGridBand BandContext => Rows.Band;

		public override string ElementName => Band.CalcReferenceName;

		private string GroupByColumnReferenceName => Rows.GroupByColumn?.FormulaHolder.NormalizedCalcReferenceName;

		{

					return Band.Layout.CalcReference;

			}
		}

		public override bool IsDisposedReference

			}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name)

			return FindItem(name);

		private static IUltraCalcReference ResolveReferenceHelperHelper(RefTuple referenceTuple, UltraGridRefBase reference, ResolveReferenceType resolveReferenceType, RowsCollection rows, UltraGridRow rowContext)
		{
			bool flag = referenceTuple.Marked;
			if (!flag)
			{
				foreach (RefTuple item in reference.ParsedReference)
				{
					if (item.Marked)
					{
						flag = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (flag && !referenceTuple.Marked && resolveReferenceType == ResolveReferenceType.LeftHandSide)
			{
				return reference;
			}
			if (reference is ColumnReference)
			{
				UltraGridColumn column = ((ColumnReference)reference).Column;
				IUltraCalcReference result = null;
				switch ((resolveReferenceType == ResolveReferenceType.LeftHandSide && flag) ? RefTuple.RefScope.All : referenceTuple.Scope)
				{
				case RefTuple.RefScope.Any:
					result = ((rowContext != null && rowContext.Band == column.Band) ? RefUtils.GetCellReference(rowContext, column) : RefUtils.GetNestedColumnReference(rows, column));
					break;
				case RefTuple.RefScope.All:
					result = RefUtils.GetNestedColumnReference(rows, column);
					break;
				case RefTuple.RefScope.RelativeIndex:
				{
					IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference2 = ((rowContext != null && rowContext.Band == column.Band) ? RefUtils.GetRowRelativeReference(rowContext, referenceTuple.ScopeIndex, null) : RefUtils.GetNestedColumnReference(rows, column));
					if (!(ultraCalcReference2 is RowReferenceBase))
					{
						return ultraCalcReference2;
					}
					result = RefUtils.GetCellReference(((RowReferenceBase)ultraCalcReference2).Row, column);
					break;
				}
				case RefTuple.RefScope.Index:
				{
					RefBase refBase = (RefBase)RefUtils.GetNestedColumnReference(rows, column);
					int num = 0;
					foreach (IUltraCalcReference reference2 in refBase.References)
					{
						if (num == referenceTuple.ScopeIndex)
						{
							return reference2;
						}
						num++;
					}
					break;
				}
				case RefTuple.RefScope.Identifier:
				{
					IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = RefUtils.FindRowReference(rows, rowContext.Band, referenceTuple.ScopeID, null);
					if (!(ultraCalcReference is RowReferenceBase))
					{
						return ultraCalcReference;
					}
					result = RefUtils.GetCellReference(((RowReferenceBase)ultraCalcReference).Row, column);
					break;
				}
				}
				return result;
			}
			SummarySettingsReference summarySettingsReference = (SummarySettingsReference)reference;
			if (resolveReferenceType == ResolveReferenceType.LeftHandSide)
			{
				return RefUtils.GetNestedSummarySettingsReference(rows.TopLevelRowsCollection, summarySettingsReference);
			}
			if (rows.Band != summarySettingsReference.Summary.Band)
			{
				return RefUtils.GetNestedSummarySettingsReference(rows, summarySettingsReference);
			}
			return RefUtils.GetSummaryValueReference(rows, summarySettingsReference.Summary);
		}

		internal IUltraCalcReference ResolveReferenceHelper(IUltraCalcReference inReference, ResolveReferenceType referenceType, UltraGridRow rowContext)
		{
			RefUnAnchored refUnAnchored = inReference as RefUnAnchored;
			UltraGridRefBase ultraGridRefBase = ((refUnAnchored != null) ? (refUnAnchored.WrappedReference as UltraGridRefBase) : (inReference as UltraGridRefBase));
			if (ultraGridRefBase is RangeReference)
			{
				RangeReference rangeReference = (RangeReference)ultraGridRefBase;
				return rangeReference.GetResolvedRangeReference(rows, rowContext);
			}
			RefParser refParser = ((refUnAnchored != null) ? refUnAnchored.RelativeReference : ultraGridRefBase?.ParsedReference);
			bool flag = rowContext == null;
			RefTuple refTuple = refParser?.LastTuple;
			try
			{
				if (refTuple != null && (ultraGridRefBase is ColumnReference || ultraGridRefBase is SummarySettingsReference))
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = ((ultraGridRefBase is ColumnReference) ? ((ColumnReference)ultraGridRefBase).Column.Band : ((SummarySettingsReference)ultraGridRefBase).Summary.Band);
					if (ultraGridBand != Band)
					{
						if (Band.IsDescendantOfBand(ultraGridBand))
						{
							UltraGridRow parentRow = rows.ParentRow;
							while (parentRow != null && ultraGridBand != parentRow.Band)
							{
								parentRow = parentRow.ParentRow;
							}
							IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = ResolveReferenceHelperHelper(refTuple, ultraGridRefBase, referenceType, parentRow.ParentCollection, parentRow);
							if (ultraCalcReference is UltraCalcReferenceError)
							{
								return new UltraCalcReferenceError(refParser.ToString(), ((UltraCalcReferenceError)ultraCalcReference).Message);
							}
							return ultraCalcReference;
						}
						RowsCollection rowsCollection = null;
						if (ultraGridBand.IsDescendantOfBand(Band))
						{
							if (rowContext != null)
							{
								UltraGridBand ultraGridBand2 = ultraGridBand;
								while (Band != ultraGridBand2.ParentBand)
								{
									ultraGridBand2 = ultraGridBand2.ParentBand;
								}
								rowsCollection = rowContext.ChildBands[ultraGridBand2].Rows;
							}
							else
							{
								rowsCollection = Rows;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							if (ultraGridBand.Layout != base.Layout)
							{
								return null;
							}
							UltraGridBand ultraGridBand3 = ultraGridBand;
							while (Band.ParentBand != ultraGridBand3.ParentBand)
							{
								ultraGridBand3 = ultraGridBand3.ParentBand;
							}
							rowsCollection = Rows.TopLevelRowsCollection.ParentRow.ChildBands[ultraGridBand3].Rows;
						}
						IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference2 = ResolveReferenceHelperHelper(refTuple, ultraGridRefBase, referenceType, rowsCollection, null);
						if (ultraCalcReference2 is UltraCalcReferenceError)
						{
							return new UltraCalcReferenceError(refParser.ToString(), ((UltraCalcReferenceError)ultraCalcReference2).Message);
						}
						return ultraCalcReference2;
					}
					RowsCollection rowsCollection2 = Rows;
					if ((ultraGridRefBase is ColumnReference && (RefTuple.RefScope.All == refTuple.Scope || (flag && refTuple.Scope == RefTuple.RefScope.Any))) || ultraGridRefBase is SummarySettingsReference)
					{
						if (refParser != null && refParser.IsRelative)
						{
							bool flag2 = false;
							foreach (RefTuple item in refParser)
							{
								if (item.Type != RefTuple.RefType.Parent)
								{
									break;
								}
								if (!flag2)
								{
									flag2 = true;
									continue;
								}
								if (rowsCollection2.ParentRow == null)
								{
									return new UltraCalcReferenceError(inReference.AbsoluteName, "Invalid reference.");
								}
								rowsCollection2 = rowsCollection2.ParentRow.ParentCollection;
							}
							if (rowsCollection2.Band != Band)
							{
								return new UltraCalcReferenceError(refParser.ToString(), "Invalid reference.");
							}
						}
						else if (ultraGridRefBase is GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference)
						{
							GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference groupLevelSummarySettingsReference = (GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference)ultraGridRefBase;
							RowsCollection rowsCollection3 = rowsCollection2;
							while (rowsCollection3.ParentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow && groupLevelSummarySettingsReference.ParentReference.GroupByColumn != ((UltraGridGroupByRow)rowsCollection3.ParentRow).Column)
							{
								rowsCollection3 = rowsCollection3.ParentRow.ParentCollection;
							}
							if (rowsCollection3.ParentRow == null || !rowsCollection3.ParentRow.IsGroupByRow)
							{
								return RefUtils.GetNestedSummarySettingsReference(rowsCollection2, (GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference)ultraGridRefBase);
							}
							rowsCollection2 = rowsCollection3;
						}
						else
						{
							rowsCollection2 = rowsCollection2.TopLevelRowsCollection;
						}
					}
					IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference3 = ResolveReferenceHelperHelper(refTuple, ultraGridRefBase, referenceType, rowsCollection2, rowContext);
					if (ultraCalcReference3 is UltraCalcReferenceError)
					{
						return new UltraCalcReferenceError(refParser.ToString(), ((UltraCalcReferenceError)ultraCalcReference3).Message);
					}
					return ultraCalcReference3;
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(refParser.ToString(), "Invalid reference.");
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference ResolveReference(IUltraCalcReference reference, ResolveReferenceType referenceType)
		{
			IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = ResolveReferenceHelper(reference, referenceType, null);
			if (ultraCalcReference != null)
			{
				return ultraCalcReference;
			}
			return base.ResolveReference(reference, referenceType);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return rows.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RefUnAnchored)
			{
				return obj.Equals(this);
			}
			if (obj is RowsCollectionReference rowsCollectionReference)
			{
				return rows == rowsCollectionReference.rows;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool ContainsReferenceHelper(IUltraCalcReference inReference, bool isProperSubset)
		{
			RefBase refBase = inReference as RefBase;
			UltraGridRefBase ultraGridRefBase = RefUtils.GetUnderlyingReference(refBase) as UltraGridRefBase;
			if (isProperSubset && (refBase is ColumnReference || refBase is BandReference))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!isProperSubset && (ultraGridRefBase is ColumnReference || ultraGridRefBase is BandReference))
			{
				UltraGridBand band = Band;
				UltraGridBand bandContext = ultraGridRefBase.BandContext;
				if (bandContext != null && band != null)
				{
					return bandContext.IsTrivialDescendantOf(band);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (ultraGridRefBase is NestedSummarySettingsReference)
			{
				return ((NestedSummarySettingsReference)ultraGridRefBase).Rows.IsTrivialDescendantOf(Rows);
			}
			return base.ContainsReferenceHelper(inReference, isProperSubset);
		}
	}
	internal abstract class NestedReference : UltraGridRefBase
	{
		private RowsCollection rows;

		private UltraGridRefBase nestingReference;

		internal RowsCollection Rows => rows;

		public override bool RecalcDeferred => nestingReference.RecalcDeferred;

		internal NestedReference(RowsCollection rows, UltraGridRefBase nestingReference, object context)
			: base(rows.Layout, context)
		{
			if (rows == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("rows");
			}
			if (nestingReference == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("nestingReference");
			}
			this.nestingReference = nestingReference;
			this.rows = rows;
		}

		internal override void InvalidateUIElement()
		{
			if (Rows != null && base.Layout != null && Rows.IsPotentiallyVisibleOnScreen)
			{
				base.Layout.DirtyGridElement();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class NestedBandReference : NestedReference
	{
		private UltraGridBand band;

		internal UltraGridBand Band => band;

		public override string ElementName => Band.CalcReferenceName;

		public override RefBase BaseParent
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Rows.Band == band.ParentBand || base.Rows.Band == band)
				{
					return RefUtils.GetRowsReference(base.Rows);
				}
				return RefUtils.GetNestedBandReference(base.Rows, band.ParentBand);
			}
		}

		public override bool IsDisposedReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (band != null && band.IsStillValid && base.Rows != null && base.Rows.IsStillValid)
				{
					if (base.Rows.ParentRow != null)
					{
						return base.Rows.ParentRow.CalcReference.IsDisposedReference;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal NestedBandReference(RowsCollection rows, UltraGridBand band)
			: base(rows, band.CalcReference, band)
		{
			this.band = band;
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = RefUtils.GetColumn(Band, name, raiseException: false);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return RefUtils.CreateMissingColumnReference(Band, name);
			}
			if (column.IsChaptered)
			{
				return RefUtils.GetNestedBandReference(base.Rows, name);
			}
			return RefUtils.GetNestedColumnReference(base.Rows, column);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindSummaryItem(string name)
		{
			IUltraCalcReference summarySettingsReference = RefUtils.GetSummarySettingsReference(Band, name);
			if (summarySettingsReference is UltraCalcReferenceError)
			{
				return summarySettingsReference;
			}
			SummarySettingsReference summaryReference = (SummarySettingsReference)summarySettingsReference;
			return RefUtils.GetNestedSummarySettingsReference(base.Rows, summaryReference);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, string index)
		{
			IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = FindItem(name);
			if (ultraCalcReference is RefBase)
			{
				return new RefUnAnchored(ultraCalcReference as RefBase);
			}
			return ultraCalcReference;
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, int index, bool isRelative)
		{
			return FindItem(name);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindAll(string name)
		{
			return FindItem(name);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			int num = band.GetHashCode();
			if (!base.Rows.IsRootRowsCollection)
			{
				num ^= base.Rows.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RefUnAnchored)
			{
				return obj.Equals(this);
			}
			if (obj is NestedBandReference nestedBandReference)
			{
				if (band == nestedBandReference.band)
				{
					return base.Rows == nestedBandReference.Rows;
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (obj is BandReference bandReference && base.Rows.IsRootRowsCollection)
			{
				return band == bandReference.Band;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

			if (!base.Rows.IsRootRowsCollection)
			{
				num ^= base.Rows.GetHashCode();
			}
			return num;
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)

			{
				return column == columnReference.Column;
			}
			return false;
		}

				return true;

		public override bool IsEnumerable => true;

	internal abstract class RowReferenceBase : UltraGridRefBase
	{
		private UltraGridRow row;

		protected int lastValidIndex = -1;

		internal override int ParserInstanceVersion => Row.ParentCollection?.CalcReference.ParserInstanceVersion ?? 0;

		internal UltraGridRow Row => row;

		internal override UltraGridBand BandContext => Row.Band;

		public override bool IsDataReference => false;

		public override bool IsDisposedReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (row != null && row.IsStillValid && row.Band != null && row.Band.IsStillValid && RefUtils.GetRowCalcIndex(row) >= 0)
				{
					if (row.ParentRow != null)
					{
						return row.ParentRow.CalcReference.IsDisposedReference;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		internal RowReferenceBase(UltraGridRow row)
			: base(row.Layout, row)
		{
			this.row = row;
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindSummaryItem(string name)
		{
			return RefUtils.GetSummaryValueReference(Row.ParentCollection, name);
		}

		public override bool ContainsReference(IUltraCalcReference inReference)
		{
			IUltraCalcReference underlyingReference = RefUtils.GetUnderlyingReference(inReference);
			if (underlyingReference is SummarySettingsReference || (underlyingReference is SummaryValueReference && ((SummaryValueReference)underlyingReference).SummaryValue.Band == Row.BandInternal))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.ContainsReference(inReference);
		}

		internal IUltraCalcReference ResolveReferenceHelper(IUltraCalcReference inReference, ResolveReferenceType referenceType, UltraGridCell cellContext)
		{
			RefBase refBase = inReference as RefBase;
			if (refBase != null && !refBase.IsRange)
			{
				try
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
					RefUnAnchored refUnAnchored = refBase as RefUnAnchored;
					if (refUnAnchored != null)
					{
						refBase = refUnAnchored.WrappedReference;
					}
					if (refBase is ColumnReference)
					{
						ultraGridColumn = ((ColumnReference)refBase).Column;
					}
					else if (refBase is NestedColumnReference)
					{
						ultraGridColumn = ((NestedColumnReference)refBase).Column;
					}
					if (ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.Band == Row.BandInternal && !Row.IsGroupByRow)
					{
						RefParser refParser = ((refUnAnchored != null) ? refUnAnchored.ParsedReference : refBase.ParsedReference);
						if (refParser == null || refParser.TupleCount <= 0 || (!refParser.HasRelativeIndex && !refParser.HasAbsoluteIndex && !refParser.LastTuple.Marked && RefTuple.RefScope.All != refParser.LastTuple.Scope))
						{
							return RefUtils.GetCellReference(Row.Cells[ultraGridColumn]);
						}
					}
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					return new UltraCalcReferenceError(refBase.AbsoluteName, ex.Message);
				}
				return Row.ParentCollection.CalcReference.ResolveReferenceHelper(inReference, referenceType, Row);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference ResolveReference(IUltraCalcReference reference, ResolveReferenceType referenceType)
		{
			IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = ResolveReferenceHelper(reference, referenceType, null);
			if (ultraCalcReference != null)
			{
				return ultraCalcReference;
			}
			return base.ResolveReference(reference, referenceType);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return row.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RefUnAnchored)
			{
				return obj.Equals(this);
			}
			if (obj is RowReferenceBase rowReferenceBase)
			{
				return row == rowReferenceBase.row;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool ContainsReferenceHelper(IUltraCalcReference inReference, bool isSubset)
		{
			UltraGridRefBase ultraGridRefBase = RefUtils.GetUnderlyingReference(inReference) as UltraGridRefBase;
			if (ultraGridRefBase is CellReference)
			{
				return ((CellReference)ultraGridRefBase).Cell.Row.IsTrivialDescendantOf(row);
			}
			if (ultraGridRefBase is ColumnReference)
			{
				if (!isSubset)
				{
					return ultraGridRefBase.BandContext.IsTrivialDescendantOf(BandContext);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return base.ContainsReferenceHelper(inReference, isSubset);
		}
	}
	internal class RowReference : RowReferenceBase
	{
		internal bool inCellReferenceValueSet;

		public override RefBase BaseParent
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridRow parentRow = RefUtils.GetParentRow(base.Row);
				if (parentRow == null)
				{
					return base.Layout.CalcReference;
				}
				return RefUtils.GetRowReference(parentRow);
			}
		}

		public override string ElementName
		{
			get
			{
				int rowCalcIndex = RefUtils.GetRowCalcIndex(base.Row);
				if (rowCalcIndex < 0 && lastValidIndex >= 0)
				{
					rowCalcIndex = lastValidIndex;
				}
				lastValidIndex = rowCalcIndex;
				string calcReferenceName = base.Row.Band.CalcReferenceName;
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(calcReferenceName.Length + 8);
				stringBuilder.Append(calcReferenceName).Append('(').Append(rowCalcIndex)
					.Append(')');
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		internal RowReference(UltraGridRow row)
			: base(row)
		{
		}

		private IUltraCalcReference FindItemHelper(string name, bool all)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = RefUtils.GetColumn(base.Row.Band, name, raiseException: false);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return RefUtils.CreateMissingColumnReference(base.Row.Band, name);
			}
			if (column.IsChaptered)
			{
				return RefUtils.GetChildBandRowsReference(base.Row, name);
			}
			if (all)
			{
				return RefUtils.GetNestedColumnReference(base.Row.ParentCollection, column);
			}
			return RefUtils.GetCellReference(base.Row.Cells[column]);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name)
		{
			return FindItemHelper(name, all: false);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindAll(string name)
		{
			return FindItemHelper(name, all: true);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, string index)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = RefUtils.GetColumn(base.Row.Band, name, raiseException: false);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return RefUtils.CreateMissingColumnReference(base.Row.Band, name);
			}
			if (column.IsChaptered)
			{
				return RefUtils.FindChildBandRowReference(base.Row, name, index);
			}
			IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = RefUtils.FindRowReference(base.Row.ParentCollection, base.Row.Band, index, name);
			if (!(ultraCalcReference is RowReferenceBase))
			{
				return ultraCalcReference;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = ((RowReferenceBase)ultraCalcReference).Row;
			UltraGridCell cell = ultraGridRow.Cells[column];
			return RefUtils.GetCellReference(cell);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, int index, bool isRelative)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = RefUtils.GetColumn(base.Row.Band, name, raiseException: false);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return RefUtils.CreateMissingColumnReference(base.Row.Band, name);
			}
			if (column.IsChaptered)
			{
				if (isRelative)
				{
					return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_RelativeIndexInvalid"));
				}
				return RefUtils.GetChildBandRowReference(base.Row, name, index);
			}
			IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = (isRelative ? RefUtils.GetRowRelativeReference(base.Row, index, name) : RefUtils.GetRowReference(base.Row.ParentCollection, index, name));
			if (!(ultraCalcReference is RowReferenceBase))
			{
				return ultraCalcReference;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = ((RowReferenceBase)ultraCalcReference).Row;
			UltraGridCell cell = ultraGridRow.Cells[column];
			return RefUtils.GetCellReference(cell);
		}
	}
	internal class GroupByRowReference : RowReferenceBase
	{
		internal UltraGridGroupByRow GroupByRow => (UltraGridGroupByRow)base.Row;

		public override RefBase BaseParent
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridRow parentRow = RefUtils.GetParentRow(base.Row);
				if (parentRow != null && parentRow.IsGroupByRow)
				{
					return RefUtils.GetRowReference(parentRow);
				}
				return RefUtils.GetRowsReference(base.Row.ParentCollection);
			}
		}

		public override string ElementName
		{
			get
			{
				int rowCalcIndex = RefUtils.GetRowCalcIndex(base.Row);
				if (rowCalcIndex < 0 && lastValidIndex >= 0)
				{
					rowCalcIndex = lastValidIndex;
				}
				lastValidIndex = rowCalcIndex;
				string elementName = GroupByRow.Column.CalcReference.ElementName;
				StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(elementName.Length + 8);
				stringBuilder.Append(elementName).Append('(').Append(rowCalcIndex)
					.Append(')');
				return stringBuilder.ToString();
			}
		}

		internal GroupByRowReference(UltraGridGroupByRow row)
			: base(row)
		{
		}

		private IUltraCalcReference FindItemHelper(string name, bool all)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = RefUtils.GetColumn(base.Row.Band, name, raiseException: false);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return RefUtils.CreateMissingColumnReference(base.Row.Band, name);
			}
			if (column.IsChaptered)
			{
				return RefUtils.GetChildBandRowsReference(base.Row, name);
			}
			if (!all)
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, "Column invalid on a group-by row.");
			}
			return RefUtils.GetNestedColumnReference(base.Row.ParentCollection, column);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name)
		{
			return FindItemHelper(name, all: false);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindAll(string name)
		{
			return FindItemHelper(name, all: true);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, string index)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = RefUtils.GetColumn(base.Row.Band, name, raiseException: false);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return RefUtils.CreateMissingColumnReference(base.Row.Band, name);
			}
			if (column.IsChaptered)
			{
				return RefUtils.FindChildBandRowReference(base.Row, name, index);
			}
			if (column == RefUtils.GetNextGroupByColumn(GroupByRow.Column))
			{
				UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = RefUtils.FindGroupByRow(GroupByRow.Rows, index);
				if (ultraGridGroupByRow == null)
				{
					return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, string.Format("GroupBy Row '{0)' not found.", index));
				}
				return RefUtils.GetRowReference(ultraGridGroupByRow);
			}
			return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, "Next group-by column name or child band name expected.");
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, int index, bool isRelative)
		{
			UltraGridColumn column = RefUtils.GetColumn(base.Row.Band, name, raiseException: false);
			if (column == null)
			{
				return RefUtils.CreateMissingColumnReference(base.Row.Band, name);
			}
			if (column.IsChaptered)
			{
				if (isRelative)
				{
					return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_RelativeIndexInvalid"));
				}
				return RefUtils.GetChildBandRowReference(base.Row, name, index);
			}
			if (column == RefUtils.GetNextGroupByColumn(GroupByRow.Column))
			{
				if (isRelative)
				{
					return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_RelativeIndexInvalid"));
				}
				return RefUtils.GetRowReference(GroupByRow.Rows, index, name);
			}
			return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, "Next group-by column name or child band name expected.");
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindSummaryItem(string name)
		{
			return RefUtils.GetSummaryValueReference(GroupByRow.Rows, name);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference ResolveReference(IUltraCalcReference reference, ResolveReferenceType referenceType)
		{
			IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = GroupByRow.Rows.CalcReference.ResolveReferenceHelper(reference, referenceType, null);
			if (ultraCalcReference != null && ultraCalcReference is NestedColumnReference)
			{
				return ultraCalcReference;
			}
			return base.ResolveReference(reference, referenceType);
		}
	}
	internal class SummarySettingsReference : FormulaRefBase
	{
		private SummarySettings summary;

		internal SummarySettings Summary => summary;

		public override string ElementName => Summary.FormulaHolder.ReferenceName + "()";

		public override RefBase BaseParent => BandReference;

		private BandReference BandReference => RefUtils.GetBandReference(Summary.Band);

		public override bool IsDisposedReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (summary != null)
				{
					return !summary.IsStillValid;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReferenceCollection References => ScopedReferences(ParsedReference);

		private bool IsRootSummary
		{
			get
			{
				if (!(this is GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference))
				{
					return Summary.Band.ParentBand == null;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override bool IsEnumerable => !IsRootSummary;

		public override UltraCalcValue Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsRootSummary)
				{
					SummaryValueReference summaryValueReference = (SummaryValueReference)RefUtils.GetSummaryValueReference(base.Layout.Rows, Summary);
					return summaryValueReference.Value;
				}
				return base.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (IsRootSummary)
				{
					SummaryValueReference summaryValueReference = (SummaryValueReference)RefUtils.GetSummaryValueReference(base.Layout.Rows, Summary);
					summaryValueReference.Value = value;
				}
				else
				{
					base.Value = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal SummarySettingsReference(SummarySettings summary)
			: base(summary.Layout, summary, summary.FormulaHolder)
		{
			this.summary = summary;
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name)
		{
			return BandReference.FindItem(name);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindSummaryItem(string name)
		{
			return BandReference.FindSummaryItem(name);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, string index)
		{
			return BandReference.FindItem(name, index);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindItem(string name, int index, bool isRelative)
		{
			return BandReference.FindItem(name, index, isRelative);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference FindAll(string name)
		{
			return FindItem(name);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReferenceCollection ScopedReferences(RefParser scopeRP)
		{
			return new RefSummaryValueCollection(this, Summary, scopeRP);
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference ResolveReference(IUltraCalcReference reference, ResolveReferenceType referenceType)
		{
			if (IsRootSummary)
			{
				IUltraCalcReference summaryValueReference = RefUtils.GetSummaryValueReference(base.Layout.Rows, Summary);
				return summaryValueReference.ResolveReference(reference, referenceType);
			}
			return base.ResolveReference(reference, referenceType);
		}

		public override int GetHashCode()
		{
			return summary.GetHashCode();
		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RefUnAnchored || obj is NestedSummarySettingsReference || obj is GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference)
			{
				return obj.Equals(this);
			}
			if (obj is SummarySettingsReference summarySettingsReference)
			{
				return summary == summarySettingsReference.summary;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		{
			return FindItem(name, index, isRelative);
		}

		{

		}

		public override bool Equals(object obj)
		{
			if (obj is RefUnAnchored)
			{
				return obj.Equals(this);
			}
			if (obj is GroupLevelReference groupLevelReference)
			{
				return groupByColumn == groupLevelReference.groupByColumn;
			}
			return false;

	internal abstract class FormulaRefBase : UltraGridRefBase
	{
		private IUltraCalcFormula formula;

		internal int valueDirtyCounter;

		internal int visibleCounter;

		private FormulaHolder formulaHolder;

		internal bool dummyFormula;

		internal FormulaHolder FormulaHolder => formulaHolder;

		internal bool HasFormulaSyntaxError
		{
			get
			{
				if (Formula != null)
				{
					return Formula.HasSyntaxError;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		internal string FormulaSyntaxError
		{
			get
			{
				if (!HasFormulaSyntaxError)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Formula.SyntaxError;
			}
		}

		public override IUltraCalcFormula Formula => formula;

		internal bool HasFormula => Formula != null;

		internal FormulaRefBase(UltraGridLayout layout, object context, FormulaHolder formulaHolder)
			: base(layout, context)
		{
			this.formulaHolder = formulaHolder;
		}

		internal void EnsureFormulaRegistered(string formulaString)
		{
			if (Formula == null || !(formulaString == Formula.FormulaString))
			{
				RegisterFormula(formulaString);
			}
		}

		internal void RegisterFormula(string newFormulaString)
		{
			IUltraCalcManager calcManager = base.CalcManager;
			if (calcManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (formula != null)
			{
				IUltraCalcFormula ultraCalcFormula = formula;
				formula = null;
				RefUtils.RemoveFormulaHelper(calcManager, ultraCalcFormula);
			}
			SummarySettingsReference summarySettingsReference = this as SummarySettingsReference;
			if (summarySettingsReference != null)
			{
				summarySettingsReference.dummyFormula = false;
				if (!summarySettingsReference.IsDisposedReference && (newFormulaString == null || newFormulaString.Length == 0))
				{
					string text = summarySettingsReference.Summary.SourceColumn?.FormulaHolder.ReferenceName;
					if (text != null && text.Length > 0 && !summarySettingsReference.Summary.IsExternal)
					{
						string text2 = "SUM( [" + text + "] )";
						summarySettingsReference.dummyFormula = true;
						newFormulaString = text2;
					}
				}
			}
			if (newFormulaString != null && newFormulaString.Length > 0 && (summarySettingsReference == null || summarySettingsReference.Summary == null || !summarySettingsReference.Summary.IsExternal))
			{
				formula = calcManager.CompileFormula(this, newFormulaString);
				if (!formula.HasSyntaxError)
				{
					RefUtils.AddFormulaHelper(calcManager, formula);
				}
			}
		}

		private RefBase CreateReferenceHelper(string referenceName)
		{
			UltraGridBand band = ((this is SummarySettingsReference) ? ((SummarySettingsReference)this).Summary.Band : ((ColumnReference)this).Column.Band);
			Match match = Regex.Match(referenceName, "^(\\.\\.\\/)*([^\\/\\(]+)(\\(\\s*(\\*?)\\s*\\))?$");
			if (match != null && match.Success)
			{
				string value = match.Groups[2].Value;
				bool flag = match.Groups[3].Value.Length != 0 && match.Groups[4].Value.Length == 0;
				bool flag2 = !flag && "*" == match.Groups[4].Value;
				if (flag)
				{
					SummarySettings summarySettings = RefUtils.GetSummarySettings(band, value);
					if (summarySettings != null)
					{
						if (!(this is GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference groupLevelSummarySettingsReference))
						{
							return RefUtils.GetSummarySettingsReference(summarySettings);
						}
						return summarySettings.Band.CalcReference.GetSummarySettingsReference(summarySettings, groupLevelSummarySettingsReference.GroupByColumn);
					}
				}
				else if (flag2)
				{
					UltraGridColumn column = RefUtils.GetColumn(band, value, raiseException: false);
					if (column != null)
					{
						return RefUtils.GetColumnReference(column);
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override IUltraCalcReference CreateReference(string referenceName)
		{
			IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = ((this is GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference) ? ((GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference)this).Summary.CalcReference.CreateReference(referenceName) : base.CreateReference(referenceName));
			if (ultraCalcReference == null || ultraCalcReference is UltraCalcReferenceError)
			{
				RefBase refBase = CreateReferenceHelper(referenceName);
				if (refBase != null)
				{
					RefUnAnchored refUnAnchored = new RefUnAnchored(refBase);
					refUnAnchored.RelativeReference = new RefParser(referenceName);
					ultraCalcReference = refUnAnchored;
				}
			}
			return ultraCalcReference;
		}
	}
	internal abstract class FormulaTargetRefBase : UltraGridRefBase
	{
		protected UltraCalcValue formulaEvaluationResult;

		internal int verifiedValueDirtyCounter = -1;

		private FormulaRefBase containingFormulaRef;

		internal string formulaCalculationErrorDisplayText;

		internal object formulaCalculatiorErrorStoreValue;

		internal int verifiedRecalcVisibleVersion = -1;

		internal FormulaRefBase ContainingFormulaRef => containingFormulaRef;

		internal UltraCalcValue FormulaEvaluationResult => formulaEvaluationResult;

		internal bool HasFormulaSyntaxError => containingFormulaRef.HasFormulaSyntaxError;

		internal string FormulaSyntaxError => containingFormulaRef.FormulaSyntaxError;

		public override IUltraCalcFormula Formula => containingFormulaRef.Formula;

		internal bool HasFormula => Formula != null;

		internal bool IsValueDirty
		{
			get
			{
				if (verifiedValueDirtyCounter < containingFormulaRef.valueDirtyCounter && HasFormula)
				{
					return base.Layout.IsDisplayLayout;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override UltraCalcValue Value
		{
			get
			{
				return formulaEvaluationResult;
			}
			set
			{
				formulaEvaluationResult = value;
				verifiedValueDirtyCounter = containingFormulaRef.valueDirtyCounter;
				formulaCalculationErrorDisplayText = null;
				formulaCalculatiorErrorStoreValue = null;
				if (value != null && value.IsError)
				{
					FormulaCalculationErrorEventArgs e = base.CalcManager.RaiseFormulaError(this, null, value.ToErrorValue(), null);
					if (e != null)
					{
						formulaCalculatiorErrorStoreValue = e.ErrorValue;
						formulaCalculationErrorDisplayText = e.ErrorDisplayText;
						if ("" == formulaCalculationErrorDisplayText)
						{
							formulaCalculationErrorDisplayText = null;
						}
					}
				}
				InvalidateUIElement();
			}
		}

		public override bool RecalcVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (verifiedRecalcVisibleVersion != containingFormulaRef.visibleCounter)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return base.RecalcVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				verifiedRecalcVisibleVersion = containingFormulaRef.visibleCounter;
				base.RecalcVisible = value;
			}
		}

		protected FormulaTargetRefBase(UltraGridLayout layout, FormulaRefBase containingFormulaRef, object context)
			: base(layout, context)
		{
			if (containingFormulaRef == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("containingFormulaRef");
			}
			this.containingFormulaRef = containingFormulaRef;
			RecalcVisible = true;
		}

		internal void InternalCopyValueFrom(FormulaTargetRefBase source)
		{
			formulaEvaluationResult = source.formulaEvaluationResult;
			formulaCalculationErrorDisplayText = source.formulaCalculationErrorDisplayText;
			formulaCalculatiorErrorStoreValue = source.formulaCalculatiorErrorStoreValue;
		}
	}
	internal class CellReference : FormulaTargetRefBase
	{
		private UltraGridCell cell;

		internal bool inValueSet;

		internal override int ParserInstanceVersion => Cell.Row.ParentCollection?.CalcReference.ParserInstanceVersion ?? 0;

		internal UltraGridCell Cell => cell;

		internal override UltraGridColumn ColumnContext => Cell.Column;

		public override bool IsDataReference => true;

		public override string ElementName => Cell.Column.FormulaHolder.ReferenceName;

		public override RefBase BaseParent => RefUtils.GetRowReference(Cell.Row);

		public override bool IsDisposedReference
		{
			get
			{
				if (cell != null && !cell.Disposed && cell.Row != null && cell.Column != null && cell.Column.IsStillValid && !cell.Row.Disposed)
				{
					return !cell.Row.IsStillValid;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public override UltraCalcValue Value
		{
			get
			{
				UltraCalcValue value = base.Value;
				if (value != null && base.HasFormula)
				{
					return value;
				}
				return RefUtils.GetCalcValue(Cell.Value, this);
			}
			set
			{
				UltraCalcValue value2 = base.Value;
				base.Value = value;
				if (Cell.Disposed)
				{
					return;
				}
				bool isErrorValue;
				object obj = RefUtils.GetValueFormCalcValue(value, Cell.Column.FormatInfo, out isErrorValue, this);
				bool flag = inValueSet;
				RowReference rowReference = (RowReference)Cell.Row.CalcReference;
				bool inCellReferenceValueSet = rowReference.inCellReferenceValueSet;
				inValueSet = true;
				rowReference.inCellReferenceValueSet = true;
				try
				{
					if (isErrorValue)
					{
						obj = ((formulaCalculatiorErrorStoreValue != null) ? formulaCalculatiorErrorStoreValue : Cell.Column.FormulaErrorValueResolved);
					}
					UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = Cell;
					UltraGridColumn column = ultraGridCell.Column;
					if (obj != null && DBNull.Value != obj && !GridUtils.IsObjectOfType(obj, column.DataType))
					{
						object obj2 = column.ConvertValueToDataType(obj);
						if (obj2 != null)
						{
							obj = obj2;
						}
					}
					try
					{
						ultraGridCell.SetValueInternal(obj, suppressErrorMessagePrompt: true, fireInitializeRow: true);
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						if (ultraGridCell.Layout.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid)
						{
							CellDataErrorEventArgs e = new CellDataErrorEventArgs(forceExit: true);
							ultraGrid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.CellDataError, e);
							if (e.RaiseErrorEvent)
							{
								DataErrorInfo dataErrorInfo = new DataErrorInfo(ex, obj, ultraGridCell.Row, ultraGridCell, DataErrorSource.CellUpdate, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCellUpdateUnableToUpdateValue", (ex != null) ? ex.Message : ""));
								ultraGrid.InternalHandleDataError(dataErrorInfo, defaultCancelValue: true);
							}
							base.Value = (e.RestoreOriginalValue ? value2 : new UltraCalcValue(new UltraCalcErrorValue(UltraCalcErrorCode.Value, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorCalculatedValueDoesntMatchDataType"))));
						}
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					inValueSet = flag;
					rowReference.inCellReferenceValueSet = inCellReferenceValueSet;
				}
			}
		}

	internal class RefCellCollection : IUltraCalcReferenceCollection, IEnumerable

	internal class RefRowIterator
	{
		private UltraGridBand band;

		private RefTuple tuple;

		private RefTuple childTuple;

		private RefRowIterator child;

		private RowsCollection rows;

		private UltraGridRow row;

		private bool recalcDeferredIterator;

		private bool usedInRangeRecalc;

		private FormulaRowIndexSource rowIndexType;

		private bool firstTime = true;

		private bool isCalcDeferredSummary;

		private List<UltraGridRow> recalcDeferredRowsList;

		private int rowIndexInRowsSortedByListIndex = -1;

		private UltraGridRow[] rowsSortedByListIndex;

		private UltraGridLayout Layout => band.Layout;

		public UltraGridRow Current
		{
			get
			{
				if (child == null)
				{
					return row;
				}
				return child.Current;
			}
		}

		public RowsCollection CurrentRowsCollection
		{
			get
			{
				if (child == null)
				{
					return rows;
				}
				return child.CurrentRowsCollection;
			}
		}

		internal bool IsCalcDeferredSummary => isCalcDeferredSummary;

		private RefRowIterator(UltraGridBand band, RefTuple tuple)
		{
			this.band = band;
			this.tuple = tuple;
			rowIndexType = this.band.FormulaRowIndexSourceResolved;
		}

		internal static RefRowIterator CreateRowIterator(UltraGridLayout layout, RefParser rp, UltraGridRefBase referenceBeingEnumerated)
		{
			UltraGridBand skipBand = null;
			if (referenceBeingEnumerated is SummarySettingsReference summarySettingsReference)
			{
				skipBand = summarySettingsReference.Summary.Band;
			}
			else if (referenceBeingEnumerated is NestedSummarySettingsReference nestedSummarySettingsReference)
			{
				skipBand = nestedSummarySettingsReference.Summary.Band;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (referenceBeingEnumerated is ColumnReference || referenceBeingEnumerated is NestedColumnReference)
			{
				UltraGridColumn columnContext = referenceBeingEnumerated.ColumnContext;
				if (columnContext != null && FormulaRowIndexSource.ListIndex == columnContext.Band.FormulaRowIndexSourceResolved)
				{
					RowsCollection rowsCollection = ((referenceBeingEnumerated is ColumnReference) ? layout.Rows : ((NestedColumnReference)referenceBeingEnumerated).Rows);
					if (rowsCollection != null && (rowsCollection.Band != columnContext.Band || rowsCollection.IsTopLevel))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
			}
			List<RefTuple> list = RefUtils.InsertGroupByColumnTuples(layout, rp, skipBand);
			if (list == null || list.Count == 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			bool flag2 = referenceBeingEnumerated.RecalcDeferred;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = null;
			RefTuple refTuple = null;
			RefRowIterator refRowIterator = null;
			RefRowIterator refRowIterator2 = null;
			bool flag3 = false;
			bool flag4 = false;
			foreach (RefTuple item in list)
			{
				bool flag5 = RefTuple.RefScope.SummaryValue == item.Scope;
				flag2 = flag2 && (item.Scope == RefTuple.RefScope.Any || RefTuple.RefScope.Index == item.Scope || flag5);
				flag4 = flag2 && flag5;
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ((ultraGridBand != null && RefTuple.RefScope.SummaryValue != item.Scope) ? RefUtils.GetColumn(ultraGridBand, item.Name, raiseException: false) : null);
				RefRowIterator refRowIterator3 = null;
				if (ultraGridBand == null || (ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.IsChaptered))
				{
					ultraGridBand = RefUtils.GetBand(layout, ultraGridBand, item.Name);
					refTuple = item;
					flag3 = false;
					if (!ultraGridBand.HasGroupBySortColumns)
					{
						refRowIterator3 = new RefRowIterator(ultraGridBand, item);
						flag3 = true;
					}
				}
				else if (!flag3)
				{
					if (RefTuple.RefScope.SummaryValue != item.Scope && ultraGridBand.NormalizedCalcReferenceName == item.Name)
					{
						flag3 = true;
						refRowIterator3 = new RefRowIterator(ultraGridBand, item);
					}
					else if (ultraGridColumn != null && ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn)
					{
						refRowIterator3 = new RefRowIterator(ultraGridBand, item);
					}
					else
					{
						flag3 = true;
						refRowIterator3 = new RefRowIterator(ultraGridBand, refTuple);
						refRowIterator3.childTuple = item;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					refRowIterator2.childTuple = item;
				}
				if (refRowIterator3 != null)
				{
					if (refRowIterator == null)
					{
						refRowIterator = refRowIterator3;
					}
					if (refRowIterator2 != null)
					{
						refRowIterator2.child = refRowIterator3;
						refRowIterator2.childTuple = refRowIterator3.tuple;
					}
					refRowIterator2 = refRowIterator3;
				}
			}
			for (refRowIterator2 = refRowIterator; refRowIterator2 != null; refRowIterator2 = refRowIterator2.child)
			{
				refRowIterator2.usedInRangeRecalc = flag;
				refRowIterator2.recalcDeferredIterator = flag2;
			}
			refRowIterator.rows = layout.Rows;
			refRowIterator.isCalcDeferredSummary = flag4;
			return refRowIterator;
		}

		private UltraGridRow GetFirstRow()
		{
			FormulaRowIndexSource formulaRowIndexSource = rowIndexType;
			if (FormulaRowIndexSource.ListIndex == formulaRowIndexSource)
			{
				if (child == null)
				{
					rowsSortedByListIndex = null;
					rowIndexInRowsSortedByListIndex = -1;
					if (usedInRangeRecalc)
					{
						UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = ((rows.UnSortedActualRows.Count > 0) ? rows.UnSortedActualRows.GetItem(0, create: true) : null);
						if (ultraGridRow == null || !ultraGridRow.IsDescendantOf(rows))
						{
							return null;
						}
						rowsSortedByListIndex = rows.UnSortedActualRows.ToArray(create: true, syncWithSortedSparseArray: true);
					}
					else if (!rows.IsGroupByRows)
					{
						rowsSortedByListIndex = (UltraGridRow[])rows.All;
						Utilities.SortMerge((object[])rowsSortedByListIndex, (IComparer)new RowsCollection.ListIndexComparer());
					}
					if (rowsSortedByListIndex != null)
					{
						if (rowsSortedByListIndex.Length != 0)
						{
							return rowsSortedByListIndex[rowIndexInRowsSortedByListIndex = 0];
						}
						rowsSortedByListIndex = null;
						return null;
					}
				}
				formulaRowIndexSource = FormulaRowIndexSource.RowIndex;
			}
			return RefUtils.GetRow(rows, 0, formulaRowIndexSource);
		}

		private UltraGridRow GetNextRow()
		{
			FormulaRowIndexSource formulaRowIndexSource = rowIndexType;
			if (FormulaRowIndexSource.ListIndex == formulaRowIndexSource)
			{
				if (child == null && !row.IsGroupByRow)
				{
					rowIndexInRowsSortedByListIndex++;
					if (rowsSortedByListIndex == null || rowIndexInRowsSortedByListIndex >= rowsSortedByListIndex.Length)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return rowsSortedByListIndex[rowIndexInRowsSortedByListIndex];
				}
				formulaRowIndexSource = FormulaRowIndexSource.RowIndex;
			}
			int rowCalcIndex = RefUtils.GetRowCalcIndex(row, formulaRowIndexSource);
			if (rowCalcIndex < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return RefUtils.GetRow(rows, ++rowCalcIndex, formulaRowIndexSource);
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			if (child != null && !firstTime && child.MoveNext())
			{
				return true;
			}
			do
			{
				bool flag = firstTime;
				firstTime = false;
				if (recalcDeferredIterator)
				{
					if (flag)
					{
						recalcDeferredRowsList = Layout.GetVisibleRowsFromAllScrollRegions(rows, excludeRowAncestors: false, excludeGroupByRows: false, forCalculations: true);
					}
					do
					{
						int num = ((row != null) ? (1 + recalcDeferredRowsList.IndexOf(row)) : 0);
						row = ((num >= 0 && num < recalcDeferredRowsList.Count) ? recalcDeferredRowsList[num] : null);
					}
					while (row != null && RefTuple.RefScope.Index == tuple.Scope && tuple.ScopeIndex != RefUtils.GetRowCalcIndex(row));
				}
				else
				{
					RefTuple.RefScope refScope = tuple.Scope;
					if (childTuple != null)
					{
						if (RefTuple.RefScope.All == childTuple.Scope)
						{
							refScope = RefTuple.RefScope.All;
						}
						else if (RefTuple.RefScope.SummaryValue == childTuple.Scope && !flag)
						{
							row = null;
							return false;
						}
					}
					switch (refScope)
					{
					case RefTuple.RefScope.Any:
					case RefTuple.RefScope.All:
						if (flag)
						{
							row = GetFirstRow();
							if (row == null && childTuple != null && RefTuple.RefScope.SummaryValue == childTuple.Scope)
							{
								return true;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							row = GetNextRow();
						}
						break;
					case RefTuple.RefScope.Identifier:
					{
						row = (flag ? GetFirstRow() : GetNextRow());
						RefParser.NameValuePair[] nameValuePairs = null;
						if (row != null)
						{
							if (row.IsGroupByRow)
							{
								nameValuePairs = new RefParser.NameValuePair[1]
								{
									new RefParser.NameValuePair(((UltraGridGroupByRow)row).Column.FormulaHolder.NormalizedCalcReferenceName, tuple.ScopeID)
								};
							}
							else
							{
								nameValuePairs = RefParser.ParseNameValuePairs(tuple.ScopeID, out var error);
								if (error != null)
								{
									throw new UltraCalcException(error);
								}
							}
						}
						while (row != null && !RefUtils.DoesRowMatchCriteria(row, nameValuePairs))
						{
							row = GetNextRow();
						}
						break;
					}
					case RefTuple.RefScope.Index:
						if (flag)
						{
							row = RefUtils.GetRow(rows, tuple.ScopeIndex);
							if (FormulaRowIndexSource.ListIndex == rowIndexType && row != null && rows != row.ParentCollection)
							{
								row = null;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							row = null;
						}
						break;
					default:
						throw new UltraCalcException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_InvalidReference_InvalidScope", tuple.ToString()));
					}
				}
				if (row != null && child != null)
				{
					child.InitRowsCollection(row.ChildBands[child.band].Rows);
				}
			}
			while (row != null && child != null && !child.MoveNext());
			return row != null;
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			row = null;
			firstTime = true;
		}

		private void InitRowsCollection(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			this.rows = rows;
			Reset();
		}

		private static SummarySettingsReference GetSummarySettingsReference(UltraGridRefBase subReference)
		{
			if (subReference is NestedSummarySettingsReference nestedSummarySettingsReference)
			{
				return nestedSummarySettingsReference.SummaryReference;
			}
			if (subReference is GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference groupLevelSummarySettingsReference)
			{
				return groupLevelSummarySettingsReference.Summary.CalcReference;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	internal class RefSummaryValueCollection : IUltraCalcReferenceCollection, IEnumerable
	{
		private class RefSummaryValueCollectionEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private RefSummaryValueCollection collection;

			private RefRowIterator rowIterator;

			private bool isCalcDeferredSummary;

			private int index = -1;

			private List<SummaryValue> summaryValues;

			public object Current
			{
				get
				{
					if (isCalcDeferredSummary)
					{
						return summaryValues[index].CalcReference;
					}
					return RefUtils.GetSummaryValueReference(rowIterator.CurrentRowsCollection, collection.summarySettings);
				}
			}

			internal RefSummaryValueCollectionEnumerator(RefSummaryValueCollection collection)
			{
				this.collection = collection;
				UltraGridLayout layout = collection.summarySettings.Layout;
				UltraGridRefBase referenceBeingEnumerated = collection.referenceBeingEnumerated;
				rowIterator = RefRowIterator.CreateRowIterator(layout, collection.scopeRP, referenceBeingEnumerated);
				isCalcDeferredSummary = collection.referenceBeingEnumerated != null && rowIterator.IsCalcDeferredSummary;
				if (isCalcDeferredSummary)
				{
					summaryValues = GetAllMatchingSummaryValues(layout.Grid, referenceBeingEnumerated);
				}
			}

			internal static List<SummaryValue> GetAllMatchingSummaryValues(UltraGridBase grid, UltraGridRefBase referenceBeingEnumerated)
			{
				HashSet<RowsCollection> hashSet = new HashSet<RowsCollection>();
				foreach (RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion in grid.DisplayLayout.RowScrollRegions)
				{
					foreach (VisibleRow visibleRow in rowScrollRegion.VisibleRows)
					{
						UltraGridRow row = visibleRow.Row;
						hashSet.Add(row.ParentCollection);
						if (row is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow)
						{
							hashSet.Add(ultraGridGroupByRow.Rows);
						}
					}
				}
				List<SummaryValue> list = new List<SummaryValue>();
				foreach (RowsCollection item in hashSet)
				{
					foreach (SummaryValue item2 in (IEnumerable)item.SummaryValues)
					{
						if (item2.CalcReference != null && referenceBeingEnumerated.ContainsReference(item2.CalcReference) && !list.Contains(item2))
						{
							list.Add(item2);
						}
					}
				}
				return list;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				if (isCalcDeferredSummary)
				{
					if (index == -1)
					{
						if (summaryValues.Count > 0)
						{
							index = 0;
							return true;
						}
						return false;
					}
					index++;
					return summaryValues.Count > index;
				}
				return rowIterator.MoveNext();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				if (isCalcDeferredSummary)
				{
					index = -1;
				}
				else
				{
					rowIterator.Reset();
				}
			}
		}

		private SummarySettings summarySettings;

		private RefParser scopeRP;

		private UltraGridRefBase referenceBeingEnumerated;

		public RefSummaryValueCollection(UltraGridRefBase referenceBeingEnumerated, SummarySettings summarySettings, RefParser scopeRP)
		{
			if (summarySettings == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("summarySettings");
			}
			this.summarySettings = summarySettings;
			this.referenceBeingEnumerated = referenceBeingEnumerated;
			this.scopeRP = scopeRP;
		}

		public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new RefSummaryValueCollectionEnumerator(this);
		}
	}
	internal class RefUtils
	{
		internal const string SUMMARY_REFERENCE_POSTFIX = "()";

		internal const string RANGE_REFERENCE_SEPARATOR = ":";

		internal static CultureInfo UltraCalcCulture => CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;

		private RefUtils()
		{
		}

		internal static object GetFormulaCalcValue(FormulaTargetRefBase formulaTargetRef, out bool isError, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			string errorInfoText;
			return GetFormulaCalcValue(formulaTargetRef, out isError, out errorInfoText, formatProvider);
		}

		internal static object GetFormulaCalcValue(FormulaTargetRefBase formulaTargetRef, out bool isError, out string errorInfoText, IFormatProvider formatProvider)
		{
			isError = false;
			errorInfoText = null;
			if (formulaTargetRef.Grid.DesignMode && formulaTargetRef.HasFormula)
			{
				return formulaTargetRef.Formula.FormulaString;
			}
			UltraCalcValue formulaEvaluationResult = formulaTargetRef.FormulaEvaluationResult;
			if (formulaTargetRef.HasFormulaSyntaxError)
			{
				isError = true;
				errorInfoText = formulaTargetRef.FormulaSyntaxError;
				return Utilities.GetLocalizedString("UltraCalc_ErrorCode_Syntax");
			}
			if (formulaTargetRef.IsValueDirty || formulaEvaluationResult == null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (formulaTargetRef is CellReference cellReference)
				{
					flag = cellReference.Cell.Column.ShowCalculatingTextResolved;
				}
				else if (formulaTargetRef is SummaryValueReference summaryValueReference)
				{
					flag = summaryValueReference.SummaryValue.SummarySettings.ShowCalculatingTextResolved;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					isError = true;
					errorInfoText = Utilities.GetLocalizedString("UltraCalc_Status_Calculating");
					return Utilities.GetLocalizedString("UltraCalc_StatusCode_Calculating");
				}
				if (formulaEvaluationResult == null)
				{
					return DBNull.Value;
				}
			}
			object valueFormCalcValue = GetValueFormCalcValue(formulaEvaluationResult, formatProvider, out isError, formulaTargetRef);
			if (isError)
			{
				errorInfoText = formulaTargetRef.formulaCalculationErrorDisplayText;
			}
			return valueFormCalcValue;
		}

		internal static IUltraCalcReference GetUnderlyingReference(IUltraCalcReference reference)
		{
			if (!(reference is RefUnAnchored refUnAnchored))
			{
				return reference;
			}
			return refUnAnchored.WrappedReference;
		}

		internal static object GetValueFormCalcValue(UltraCalcValue ultraCalcValue, IFormatProvider formatProvider, out bool isErrorValue, FormulaTargetRefBase formulaTargetRef)
		{
			isErrorValue = false;
			if (ultraCalcValue.IsError)
			{
				isErrorValue = true;
				return ultraCalcValue.ToString(formatProvider);
			}
			IFormulaValueConverter formulaValueConverter = formulaTargetRef.ContainingFormulaRef.FormulaHolder.FormulaValueConverter;
			if (formulaValueConverter != null)
			{
				return formulaValueConverter.ConvertFromUltraCalcValue(ultraCalcValue, formulaTargetRef.Context);
			}
			if (ultraCalcValue.IsNull)
			{
				return DBNull.Value;
			}
			while (ultraCalcValue.IsReference)
			{
				IUltraCalcReference ultraCalcReference = ultraCalcValue.ToReference();
				if (ultraCalcReference == null)
				{
					return ultraCalcValue.ToString(formatProvider);
				}
				ultraCalcValue = ultraCalcReference.Value;
			}
			object value = ultraCalcValue.Value;
			if (value != null && DataBindingUtils.IsKnownType(value.GetType()))
			{
				return value;
			}
			return ultraCalcValue.ToString(formatProvider);
		}

		internal static UltraCalcValue GetCalcValue(object val, FormulaTargetRefBase formulaTargetRef)
		{
			IFormulaValueConverter formulaValueConverter = formulaTargetRef.ContainingFormulaRef.FormulaHolder.FormulaValueConverter;
			if (formulaValueConverter != null)
			{
				return formulaValueConverter.ConvertToUltraCalcValue(val, formulaTargetRef.Context);
			}
			return new UltraCalcValue(val);
		}

		private static UltraGridChildBand GetChildBand(UltraGridRow row, string name)

					{
						return item;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static UltraGridColumn GetNextGroupByColumn(UltraGridColumn groupByColumn)
		{
			int num = groupByColumn.Band.SortedColumns.IndexOf(groupByColumn);
			if (num >= 0 && 1 + num < groupByColumn.Band.SortedColumns.Count)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = groupByColumn.Band.SortedColumns[1 + num];
				if (ultraGridColumn.IsGroupByColumn)
				{
					return ultraGridColumn;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private static UltraGridColumn GetNextGroupByColumn(UltraGridBand band, UltraGridColumn groupByColumn)
		{
			if (band.HasGroupBySortColumns)
			{
				if (groupByColumn == null)
				{
					return band.SortedColumns[0];
				}
				return GetNextGroupByColumn(groupByColumn);
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static List<RefTuple> InsertGroupByColumnTuples(UltraGridLayout layout, RefParser rp)
		{
			return InsertGroupByColumnTuples(layout, rp, null);
		}

		internal static List<RefTuple> InsertGroupByColumnTuples(UltraGridLayout layout, RefParser rp, UltraGridBand skipBand)
		{
			List<RefTuple> list = new List<RefTuple>();
			try
			{
				if (rp.TupleCount < 2)
				{
					return list;
				}
				UltraGridBand band = GetBand(layout, null, rp[1].Name);
				list.Add(rp[1]);
				int index = 0;
				bool flag = false;
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
				for (int i = 2; i < rp.TupleCount; i++)
				{
					RefTuple refTuple = rp[i];
					bool flag2 = i + 1 == rp.TupleCount;
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = ((RefTuple.RefScope.SummaryValue != refTuple.Scope) ? GetColumn(band, refTuple.Name, raiseException: false) : null);
					if (ultraGridColumn2 != null && ultraGridColumn2.IsGroupByColumn && !flag2)
					{
						ultraGridColumn = ultraGridColumn2;
					}
					else
					{
						if (!flag && band != skipBand)
						{
							while ((ultraGridColumn = GetNextGroupByColumn(band, ultraGridColumn)) != null)
							{
								list.Add(new RefTuple(ultraGridColumn.FormulaHolder.NormalizedCalcReferenceName));
							}
							if (band.HasGroupBySortColumns && band.NormalizedCalcReferenceName != refTuple.Name)
							{
								RefTuple item = list[index];
								list.Add(item);
								list[index] = new RefTuple(band.NormalizedCalcReferenceName);
							}
						}
						flag = true;
						ultraGridColumn = null;
						if (ultraGridColumn2 != null && ultraGridColumn2.IsChaptered)
						{
							band = GetBand(layout, band, refTuple.Name);
							flag = false;
							index = list.Count;
						}
					}
					list.Add(refTuple);
				}
				return list;
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		internal static bool DoesRowMatchCriteria(UltraGridRow row, RefParser.NameValuePair[] nameValuePairs)
		{
			foreach (RefParser.NameValuePair nameValuePair in nameValuePairs)
			{
				UltraGridColumn column = GetColumn(row.Band, nameValuePair.Name, raiseException: true);
				if (!EqualValue(row, column, nameValuePair.Value))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal static UltraGridGroupByRow FindGroupByRow(RowsCollection rows, string index)
		{
			if (!rows.IsGroupByRows)
			{
				throw new UltraCalcException("Specified rows collection does not contain group-by rows.");
			}
			foreach (UltraGridGroupByRow row in rows)
			{
				if (EqualValue(row, rows.GroupByColumn, index))
				{
					return row;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal static UltraGridRow FindRow(RowsCollection rows, UltraGridBand band, string index, out string exception)
		{
			exception = null;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			if (band != rows.Band && band.IsDescendantOfBand(rows.Band))
			{
				exception = $"{band} is not a descendant band of the {rows.Band} band.";
			}
			if (exception == null)
			{
				RefParser.NameValuePair[] nameValuePairs = RefParser.ParseNameValuePairs(index, out exception);
				if (exception == null)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridRow item in rows.GetRowEnumerator(GridRowType.DataRow, band, band))
					{
						if (DoesRowMatchCriteria(item, nameValuePairs))
						{
							ultraGridRow = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					if (ultraGridRow == null)
					{
						exception = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_IndexedRowNotFound", index);
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		internal static IUltraCalcReference FindRowReference(RowsCollection rows, UltraGridBand band, string index, string name)
		{
			string exception;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = FindRow(rows, band, index, out exception);
			if (ultraGridRow == null)
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, exception);
			}
			return GetRowReference(ultraGridRow);
		}

		}

		internal static IUltraCalcReference GetRowRelativeReference(UltraGridRow row, int offset, string name)
		{
			int num = GetRowCalcIndex(row);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				num += offset;
			}
			return GetRowReference(row.ParentCollection, num, name);
		}

		internal static UltraGridRow GetRow(RowsCollection rows, int calcIndex)
		{
			return GetRow(rows, calcIndex, rows.Band.FormulaRowIndexSourceResolved);
		}

		internal static UltraGridRow GetRow(RowsCollection rows, int calcIndex, FormulaRowIndexSource rowIndexType)
		{
			if (FormulaRowIndexSource.ListIndex == rowIndexType && !rows.IsGroupByRows)
			{
				return rows.TopLevelRowsCollection.GetRowWithListIndexHelper(calcIndex, dontSyncRows: false);
			}
			if (FormulaRowIndexSource.VisibleIndex == rowIndexType)
			{
				return rows.SparseArray.GetItemAtVisibleIndex(calcIndex);
			}
			if (calcIndex < 0 || calcIndex >= rows.Count)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return rows[calcIndex];
		}

		internal static int GetRowCalcIndex(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			return GetRowCalcIndex(row, row.Band.FormulaRowIndexSourceResolved);
		}

		internal static int GetRowCalcIndex(UltraGridRow row, FormulaRowIndexSource rowIndexType)
		{
			if (FormulaRowIndexSource.ListIndex == rowIndexType && !row.IsGroupByRow)
			{
				return row.ListIndex;
			}
			if (FormulaRowIndexSource.VisibleIndex == rowIndexType)
			{
				return row.ParentCollection.SparseArray.VisibleIndexOf(row);
			}
			return row.Index;
		}

		internal static int GetMaxCalcIndex(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			return GetMaxCalcIndex(rows, rows.Band.FormulaRowIndexSourceResolved);
		}

		internal static int GetMaxCalcIndex(RowsCollection rows, FormulaRowIndexSource rowIndexType)
		{
			if (FormulaRowIndexSource.ListIndex == rowIndexType && !rows.IsGroupByRows)
			{
				return rows.TopLevelRowsCollection.ActualRowsCount - 1;
			}
			if (FormulaRowIndexSource.VisibleIndex == rowIndexType)
			{
				return rows.SparseArray.VisibleCount - 1;
			}
			return rows.Count - 1;
		}
