		internal static void ThrowRootBandNameExpectedException(UltraGridLayout layout, string name)
		{
			throw new UltraCalcException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_RootBandNameExpected", layout.CalcReference.ElementName, name));
		}

		internal static UltraGridBand GetBand(UltraGridLayout layout, UltraGridBand ensureParentBand, string name)
		{
			UltraGridBand band = GetBand(layout, name, ensureParentBand, raiseException: true);
			if (ensureParentBand != band.ParentBand)
			{
				if (ensureParentBand != null)
				{
					throw new UltraCalcException($"{ensureParentBand.CalcReferenceName} is not a child band of {name}");
				}
				ThrowRootBandNameExpectedException(layout, name);
			}
			return band;
		}

		internal static UltraGridBand GetBand(UltraGridLayout layout, string name, UltraGridBand preferredParentBand, bool raiseException)
		{
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = null;
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in layout.SortedBands)
			{
				if (sortedBand.NormalizedCalcReferenceName == name)
				{
					ultraGridBand = sortedBand;
					if (preferredParentBand == null || preferredParentBand == sortedBand.ParentBand)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (ultraGridBand == null && raiseException)
			{
				throw new UltraCalcException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_BandNameExpected", name));
			}
			return ultraGridBand;
		}

		internal static IUltraCalcReference GetBandReference(UltraGridLayout layout, UltraGridBand ensureParentBand, string name)
		{
			UltraGridBand band = GetBand(layout, name, ensureParentBand, raiseException: false);
			if (band == null)
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_BandNameExpected", name));
			}
			if (ensureParentBand != band.ParentBand)
			{
				if (ensureParentBand == null)
				{
					return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_RootBandNameExpected", layout.CalcReference.ElementName, name));
				}
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, $"{ensureParentBand.CalcReferenceName} is not a child band of {name}");
			}
			return band.CalcReference;
		}

		internal static IUltraCalcReference GetBandReference(UltraGridLayout layout, string name)
		{
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in layout.SortedBands)
			{
				if (sortedBand.NormalizedCalcReferenceName == name)
				{
					return GetBandReference(sortedBand);
				}
			}
			return new UltraCalcReferenceError(name, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_Calc_BandNameExpected", name));
		}

			return cell.CalcReference;

		internal static IUltraCalcReference GetCellReference(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (row.BandInternal != column.Band)
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(column.CalcReference.ElementName, $"Invalid column {column.Key}. Row band does not match with the column band.");
			}
			if (row.IsGroupByRow)
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(row.CalcReference.ElementName, string.Format("Attempted to get a cell referenced from a GroupByRow; invalid.", column.Key));
			}
			return GetCellReference(row.Cells[column]);
		}

		internal static bool EqualValue(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column, string testVal)
		{
			if (row is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow && column == ultraGridGroupByRow.Column)
			{
				object value = ultraGridGroupByRow.Value;
				if (value != testVal)
				{
					if (value != null && testVal != null)
					{
						return value.Equals(testVal);
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			string cellText = column.GetCellText(row);
			return string.Compare(cellText, testVal, ignoreCase: true) == 0;
		}

		internal static bool AddFormulaHelper(IUltraCalcManager calcManager, IUltraCalcFormula formula)
		{
			if (!formula.HasSyntaxError)
			{
				calcManager.AddFormula(formula);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal static void RemoveFormulaHelper(IUltraCalcManager calcManager, IUltraCalcFormula formula)
		{
			if (!formula.HasSyntaxError)
			{
				calcManager.RemoveFormula(formula);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class RangeReference : UltraGridRefBase
	{
		private class RangeEnumerator : IEnumerator
		{
			private ResolvedRangeReference resolvedRange;

			private int index;

			private IUltraCalcReference currentCell;

			public object Current => currentCell;

			internal RangeEnumerator(ResolvedRangeReference resolvedRange)
			{
				this.resolvedRange = resolvedRange;
				Reset();
			}

			public void Reset()
			{
				currentCell = null;
				index = resolvedRange.from - 1;
			}

			public bool MoveNext()
			{
				index++;
				currentCell = null;
				if (index <= resolvedRange.to)
				{
					UltraGridRow row = RefUtils.GetRow(resolvedRange.rows, index);
					if (row != null)
					{
						currentCell = RefUtils.GetCellReference(row, resolvedRange.range.column);
					}
				}
				return currentCell != null;
			}
		}

		private class ResolvedRangeReference : UltraGridRefBase, IUltraCalcReferenceCollection, IEnumerable
		{
			internal RangeReference range;

			internal RowsCollection rows;

			internal int from;

			internal int to;

			private RefParser fromRP;

			private RefParser toRP;

			public override IUltraCalcReferenceCollection References => this;

			public override RefBase BaseParent => range;

			public override string ElementName => range.ElementName;

			public override string AbsoluteName
			{
				get
				{
					CreateParsedReference();
					return fromRP.ToString() + " : " + toRP.ToString();
				}
			}

			public override string NormalizedAbsoluteName => AbsoluteName;

			public override bool IsEnumerable => true;

			internal ResolvedRangeReference(RowsCollection rows, int from, int to, RangeReference range)
				: base(rows.Layout, range.column)
			{
				if (rows.Band != range.column.Band || rows.IsGroupByRows)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException("Invalid rows collection. Rows must be from the same band as the columns in the range reference.");
				}
				this.range = range;
				this.rows = rows;
				this.from = from;
				this.to = to;
			}

			public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
			{
				return new RangeEnumerator(this);
			}

			protected override RefParser CreateParsedReference()
			{
				if (fromRP == null)
				{
					RowsCollectionReference rowsReference = RefUtils.GetRowsReference(rows);
					string absoluteName = rowsReference.AbsoluteName;
					StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder(absoluteName);
					int length = stringBuilder.Length;
					stringBuilder.Append('(').Append(from).Append(')');
					fromRP = new RefParser(stringBuilder.ToString());
					stringBuilder.Remove(length, stringBuilder.Length - length);
					stringBuilder.Append('(').Append(to).Append(')');
					toRP = new RefParser(stringBuilder.ToString());
				}
				return fromRP;
			}
		}

		private UltraGridColumn column;

		private string referenceName;

		private RefParser fromRP;

		private RefParser toRP;

		private RefTuple fromTuple;

		private RefTuple toTuple;

		internal override UltraGridColumn ColumnContext => column;

		public override RefBase BaseParent => column.Band.CalcReference;

		public override string ElementName => fromTuple.ToString() + ":" + toTuple.ToString();

		public override string AbsoluteName => fromRP.ToString() + ":" + toRP.ToString();

		public override string NormalizedAbsoluteName => AbsoluteName;

		public override RefParser ParsedReference => fromRP;

		public override bool IsEnumerable => true;

		public override bool HasRelativeIndex => true;

		public override IUltraCalcFormula Formula => RefUtils.GetColumnReference(column)?.Formula;

		internal RangeReference(UltraGridColumn column, RefParser fromRP, RefParser toRP, RefTuple fromTuple, RefTuple toTuple)
			: base(column.Layout, column)
		{
			if (column == null || fromTuple == null || toTuple == null || fromRP == null || toRP == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.column = column;
			this.fromRP = fromRP;
			this.toRP = toRP;
			this.fromTuple = fromTuple;
			this.toTuple = toTuple;
			referenceName = this.fromRP.ToString() + ":" + this.toRP.ToString();
		}

		public override bool ContainsReference(IUltraCalcReference reference)
		{
			return column.CalcReference.ContainsReference(reference);
		}

		public override void MarkRelativeIndices(IUltraCalcReference formulaReference)
		{
			if (formulaReference is UltraGridRefBase)
			{
				RefParser refParser = ((column.CalcReference != null) ? column.CalcReference.ParsedReference : null);
				RefParser parsedReference = ((UltraGridRefBase)formulaReference).ParsedReference;
				if (refParser != null && parsedReference != null)
				{
					refParser.MarkRelativeIndices(parsedReference, forceLastTuple: true);
				}
			}
		}

		private int GetIndexFromTuple(RefTuple tuple, RowsCollection rows, UltraGridRow rowContext, out UltraCalcReferenceError error)
		{
			error = null;
			int num = 0;
			if (RefTuple.RefScope.RelativeIndex == tuple.Scope)
			{
				int num2 = ((rowContext != null) ? RefUtils.GetRowCalcIndex(rowContext) : (-1));
				num = ((num2 >= 0) ? (num2 + tuple.ScopeIndex) : (-1));
			}
			else if (RefTuple.RefScope.Index == tuple.Scope)
			{
				num = tuple.ScopeIndex;
			}
			else if (tuple.Scope == RefTuple.RefScope.Any)
			{
				num = ((rowContext != null) ? RefUtils.GetRowCalcIndex(rowContext) : (-1));
			}
			else if (RefTuple.RefScope.All == tuple.Scope)
			{
				num = ((tuple != fromTuple) ? RefUtils.GetMaxCalcIndex(rows) : 0);
			}
			if (num < 0 || num > RefUtils.GetMaxCalcIndex(rows))
			{
				error = new UltraCalcReferenceError(referenceName, "Invalid range for the cell.");
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal IUltraCalcReference GetResolvedRangeReference(RowsCollection rows, UltraGridRow rowContext)
		{
			if (rows.Band != BandContext || (rowContext != null && rowContext.Band != BandContext))
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(referenceName, "Formula not from the same band as the columns in the range reference.");
			}
			if (rowContext is UltraGridGroupByRow || rows.IsGroupByRows)
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(referenceName, "Invalid context of group-by row.");
			}
			if (rowContext == null && (RefTuple.RefScope.RelativeIndex == fromTuple.Scope || RefTuple.RefScope.RelativeIndex == toTuple.Scope))
			{
				return new UltraCalcReferenceError(referenceName, "Range refernece doesn't have any context of row.");
			}
			UltraCalcReferenceError error;
			int indexFromTuple = GetIndexFromTuple(fromTuple, rows, rowContext, out error);
			if (error != null)
			{
				return error;
			}
			int indexFromTuple2 = GetIndexFromTuple(toTuple, rows, rowContext, out error);
			if (error != null)
			{
				return error;
			}
			return new ResolvedRangeReference(rows, indexFromTuple, indexFromTuple2, this);
		}
	}
	internal class RowsEnumerator : IEnumerator
	{
		internal class Enumerable : IEnumerable
		{
			private RowsCollection rows;

			private UltraGridBand lowestLevelBand;

			internal Enumerable(RowsCollection rows, UltraGridBand lowestLevelBand)
			{
				this.rows = rows;
				this.lowestLevelBand = lowestLevelBand;
			}

			public IEnumerator GetEnumerator()
			{
				return new RowsEnumerator(rows, lowestLevelBand);
			}
		}

		private RowsCollection rows;

		private IEnumerator rowsEnumerator;

		private UltraGridRow rowsEnumerator_CurrentRow;

		private UltraGridBand lowestLevelBand;

		private RowsEnumerator child;

		private UltraGridRow currentRow;

		public UltraGridRow Current => currentRow;

		object IEnumerator.Current => Current;

		internal RowsEnumerator(RowsCollection rows, UltraGridBand lowestLevelBand)
		{
			this.rows = rows;
			this.lowestLevelBand = lowestLevelBand;
			Reset();
		}

		public void Reset()
		{
			rowsEnumerator = rows.GetEnumerator();
			child = null;
			currentRow = null;
		}

		private UltraGridChildBand GetNextChildBand(ChildBandsCollection childBands, UltraGridBand band)
		{
			bool flag = band == null;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = childBands.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridChildBand ultraGridChildBand = childBands[i];
				if (flag)
				{
					if (lowestLevelBand == null || lowestLevelBand.IsTrivialDescendantOf(ultraGridChildBand.Band))
					{
						return ultraGridChildBand;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					flag = ultraGridChildBand.Band == band;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public bool MoveNext()
		{
			do
			{
				if (child != null)
				{
					if (child.MoveNext())
					{
						currentRow = child.Current;
						return true;
					}
					currentRow = rowsEnumerator_CurrentRow;
				}
				ChildBandsCollection childBandsCollection = ((currentRow != null) ? currentRow.ChildBands : null);
				if (childBandsCollection != null && childBandsCollection.Count > 0)
				{
					UltraGridChildBand nextChildBand = GetNextChildBand(childBandsCollection, (child == null) ? null : child.rows.Band);
					if (nextChildBand != null)
					{
						child = new RowsEnumerator(nextChildBand.Rows, lowestLevelBand);
						currentRow = null;
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (rowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					currentRow = (rowsEnumerator_CurrentRow = (UltraGridRow)rowsEnumerator.Current);
					child = null;
					continue;
				}
				currentRow = (rowsEnumerator_CurrentRow = null);
				break;
			}
			while (currentRow == null);
			return currentRow != null;
		}
	}

		internal void FireEvent(DropDownEventIds id, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!EventManager.CanFireEvent(id) || !Enum.IsDefined(typeof(DropDownEventIds), id))
			{
				return;
			}
			EventManager.IncrementInProgress(id);
			try
			{
				switch (id)
				{
				case DropDownEventIds.BeforeDropDown:
					OnBeforeDropDown(e as CancelableDropDownEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.AfterDropDown:
					OnAfterDropDown(e as DropDownEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.AfterCloseUp:
					OnAfterCloseUp(e as DropDownEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.RowSelected:
					OnRowSelected(e as RowSelectedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.FilterRow:
					OnFilterRow(e as FilterRowEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.AfterSortChange:
					OnAfterSortChange(e as BandEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.BeforeSortChange:
					OnBeforeSortChange(e as BeforeSortChangeEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.AfterColPosChanged:
					OnAfterColPosChanged(e as AfterColPosChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.BeforeColPosChanged:
					OnBeforeColPosChanged(e as BeforeColPosChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.BeforeRowFilterDropDown:
					OnBeforeRowFilterDropDown(e as BeforeRowFilterDropDownEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.BeforeRowFilterChanged:
					OnBeforeRowFilterChanged(e as BeforeRowFilterChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.AfterRowFilterChanged:
					OnAfterRowFilterChanged(e as AfterRowFilterChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.BeforeCustomRowFilterDialog:
					OnBeforeCustomRowFilterDialog(e as BeforeCustomRowFilterDialogEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.BeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulate:
					OnBeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulate(e as BeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulateEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.FilterCellValueChanged:
					OnFilterCellValueChanged(e as FilterCellValueChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.InitializeRowsCollection:
					OnInitializeRowsCollection(e as InitializeRowsCollectionEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.BeforeColumnChooserDisplayed:
					OnBeforeColumnChooserDisplayed(e as BeforeColumnChooserDisplayedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.BeforeBandHiddenChanged:
					OnBeforeBandHiddenChanged(e as BeforeBandHiddenChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.AfterBandHiddenChanged:
					OnAfterBandHiddenChanged(e as AfterBandHiddenChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.AfterRowFilterDropDownPopulate:
					OnAfterRowFilterDropDownPopulate(e as AfterRowFilterDropDownPopulateEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.BeforeAutoSizeColumn:
					OnBeforeAutoSizeColumn(e as BeforeAutoSizeColumnEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.AfterAutoSizeColumn:
					OnAfterAutoSizeColumn(e as AfterAutoSizeColumnEventArgs);
					break;
				case DropDownEventIds.InitializeLayout:
				case DropDownEventIds.InitializeRow:
				case DropDownEventIds.TextChanged:
					break;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(id);
			}
		}

		internal override bool FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds id, EventArgs e, bool checkInProgress)
		{
			DropDownEventIds dropDownEventIds;
			switch (id)
			{
			case CommonEventIds.AfterSortChange:
				dropDownEventIds = DropDownEventIds.AfterSortChange;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeSortChange:
				dropDownEventIds = DropDownEventIds.BeforeSortChange;

		private class BinarySearchSortComparer : IComparer<UltraGridRow>
		{
			private bool useText = true;

			private UltraGridColumn column;

			public BinarySearchSortComparer(UltraDropDownBase ultraDropDownBase, bool useText)
			{
				column = (useText ? ultraDropDownBase.GetDisplayMemberColumnResolved() : ultraDropDownBase.GetValueMemberColumnResolved());
				this.useText = useText;
			}

			public int BinarySearchValues(List<UltraGridRow> rows, object value)
			{
				int num = 0;
				int num2 = rows.Count - 1;
				while (num <= num2)
				{
					int num3 = num + (num2 - num) / 2;
					int num4 = CompareHelper(GetValue(rows[num3]), value);
					if (num4 == 0)
					{
						return num3;
					}
					if (num4 < 0)
					{
						num = num3 + 1;
					}
					else
					{
						num2 = num3 - 1;
					}
				}
				return ~num;
			}

			private object GetValue(UltraGridRow x)
			{
				if (!useText)
				{
					return x.GetCellValue(column);
				}
				return x.GetCellText(column);
			}

			public int Compare(UltraGridRow x, UltraGridRow y)
			{
				if (x == y)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				object xObj = null;
				if (x != null)
				{
					xObj = GetValue(x);
				}
				object yObj = null;
				if (y != null)
				{
					yObj = GetValue(y);
				}
				return CompareHelper(xObj, yObj);
			}

			private int CompareHelper(object xObj, object yObj)
			{
				if (useText)
				{
					return string.Compare((string)xObj, (string)yObj, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
				}
				return CompareDataValue(xObj, yObj, (ValueListItemMatchingMode)0);
			}
		}

		internal bool DoesTextMatch(string partialText, string fullText, bool partial)
		{
			if (partialText == null || (partial && partialText.Length == 0))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!partial)
			{
				return string.Compare(partialText, fullText, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0;
			}
			int length = partialText.Length;
			int length2 = fullText.Length;
			if (length == length2)
			{
				return DoesTextMatch(partialText, fullText, partial: false);
			}
			if (length < length2)
			{
				return string.Compare(fullText, 0, partialText, 0, length, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture) == 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		void IValueList.ResolveItemAppearance(int itemIndex, ref AppearanceData appData, ref AppearancePropFlags flags, ComponentRole componentRole)
		{
			RowsCollection rows = base.DisplayLayout.Rows;
			if (itemIndex < 0 || itemIndex >= rows.Count)
			{
				throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_278"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentOutOfRangeException_364"));
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = base.DisplayLayout.Rows[itemIndex];
			UltraGridColumn displayMemberColumnResolved = GetDisplayMemberColumnResolved();
			Appearance appearance = null;
			if (displayMemberColumnResolved != null)
			{
				if (GetExternalCellAppearance(displayMemberColumnResolved, ultraGridRow, out appearance))
				{
					((AppearanceBase)appearance).MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
				}
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ultraGridRow.Cells[displayMemberColumnResolved];
				if (ultraGridCell.HasAppearance)
				{
					((AppearanceBase)ultraGridCell.Appearance).MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
				}
			}
			appearance = null;
			if (GetExternalRowAppearance(ultraGridRow, out appearance))
			{
				((AppearanceBase)appearance).MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
			}
			if (ultraGridRow.HasAppearance)
			{
				((AppearanceBase)ultraGridRow.Appearance).MergeData(ref appData, ref flags);
			}
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.ActivateItem(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (item is ColumnHeader)
			{
				clickedOnColumnHeader = true;
				return false;
			}
			if (IsReadOnly)
			{
				return true;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = item as UltraGridRow;
			try
			{
				isActivatingRowByMouse = true;
				if (ultraGridRow == null || ultraGridRow.IsDisabled)
				{
					clickedOnDisabledRow = true;
					return true;
				}
				base.ActiveRow = ultraGridRow;
				if (base.ActiveRow != ultraGridRow)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			finally
			{
				isActivatingRowByMouse = false;
			}
		}

		ISelectableItem ISelectionManager.ItemNearestPoint(Point point, ISelectableItem lastItem)
		{
			if (lastItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Type type = lastItem.GetType();
			VisibleRow visibleRow = new VisibleRow(base.ActiveRowScrollRegion);
			if (GridUtils.IsObjectOfType(type, typeof(UltraGridRow)) || GridUtils.IsObjectOfType(type, typeof(UltraGridCell)))
			{
				if (base.ActiveRowScrollRegion == null)
				{
					return lastItem;
				}
				visibleRow = base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.GetNearestSameBandRow(point, (GridItemBase)lastItem);
			}
			if (type == typeof(UltraGridRow) || typeof(UltraGridRow).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				if (visibleRow == null)
				{
					return lastItem;
				}
				return visibleRow.Row;
			}
			return lastItem;
		}

		internal void ReCalculateDropDownSize(bool resizeDropDownForm, bool dirtyMetrics)
		{
			if (!IsDroppedDown)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool isRecalcRequired = false;
			Size size = CalculateDropDownSize(lastEditAreaInScreenCoords, determineScrollBarVisibility: true, ref isRecalcRequired, dirtyMetrics);
			if (!resizeDropDownForm)
			{
				return;
			}
			Control control = ((owner != null) ? owner.Control : null);
			if (control != null)
			{
				Point point2;
				Point point;
				if (!isDropDownAlignedRight)
				{
					point = new Point(lastEditAreaInScreenCoords.Left, lastEditAreaInScreenCoords.Bottom);
					point2 = point;
				}
				else
				{
					point = new Point(lastEditAreaInScreenCoords.Right, lastEditAreaInScreenCoords.Bottom);
					point2 = point;
				}
				point = point2;
				Rectangle rectangle = lastRequestedRect;
				Rectangle rectangle2 = (lastRequestedRect = new Rectangle(point, size));
				if (rectangle2 != rectangle && !lastEditAreaInScreenCoords.IsEmpty)
				{
					DropDownManager.ResetDropDownPositionAndSize(control, rectangle2, lastEditAreaInScreenCoords);
				}
			}
		}

		private Size CalculateDropDownSize(Rectangle editAreaInScreenCoords, bool determineScrollBarVisibility, ref bool isRecalcRequired)
		{
			return CalculateDropDownSize(editAreaInScreenCoords, determineScrollBarVisibility, ref isRecalcRequired, dirtyMetrics: true);
		}

		private Size CalculateDropDownSize(Rectangle editAreaInScreenCoords, bool determineScrollBarVisibility, ref bool isRecalcRequired, bool dirtyMetrics)
		{
			//IL_0143: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0220: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0225: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_022d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0403: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_04d9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_03a2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (dirtyMetrics)
			{
				base.DisplayLayout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
			}
			Rectangle deskTopWorkArea = UIElement.GetDeskTopWorkArea(editAreaInScreenCoords);
			int num = Math.Max(deskTopWorkArea.Bottom - editAreaInScreenCoords.Bottom, editAreaInScreenCoords.Top - deskTopWorkArea.Top);
			Size dropDownSize = new Size(0, 0);
			if (determineScrollBarVisibility)
			{
				includeVerticalScrollbar = false;
				includeHorizontalScrollbar = false;
				Scrollbars scrollbars = base.DisplayLayout.Scrollbars;
				if (scrollbars == Scrollbars.Vertical || scrollbars == Scrollbars.Both)
				{
					includeVerticalScrollbar = true;
				}
				scrollbars = base.DisplayLayout.Scrollbars;
				if (scrollbars == Scrollbars.Horizontal || scrollbars == Scrollbars.Both)
				{
					includeHorizontalScrollbar = true;
				}
			}
			int itemCount = ((IValueList)this).ItemCount;
			UltraGridRow previousRow = null;
			int numNonFixedRows;
			List<UltraGridRow> specialRows = CalculateSpecialRowsInDropDown(ref previousRow, out numNonFixedRows);
			itemCount += numNonFixedRows;
			itemCount = Math.Min(itemCount, MaxDropDownItems);
			itemCount = Math.Max(itemCount, MinDropDownItems);
			if (((IValueList)this).ItemCount > itemCount && base.DisplayLayout.Scrollbars == Scrollbars.Automatic && determineScrollBarVisibility)
			{
				includeVerticalScrollbar = true;
			}
			base.DisplayLayout.ColScrollRegions.InitializeMetrics();
			int num2 = base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].Header.OverallExtent;
			if (includeVerticalScrollbar)
			{
				num2 += base.DisplayLayout.VerticalScrollBarWidthResolved;
			}
			num2 += 2 * base.DisplayLayout.GetBorderThickness(base.DisplayLayout.BorderStyleResolved);
			if (DropDownWidth > 0)
			{
				dropDownSize.Width = DropDownWidth;
			}
			else if (DropDownWidth == 0)
			{
				dropDownSize.Width = editAreaInScreenCoords.Width;
			}
			else
			{
				if (DropDownWidth == -2)
				{
					dropDownSize.Width = Math.Max(num2, editAreaInScreenCoords.Width);
				}
				else
				{
					dropDownSize.Width = num2;
				}
				if (num2 <= 4 && this is UltraCombo)
				{
					dropDownSize.Width = ((Control)(object)this).Width;
				}
			}
			if (dropDownSize.Width > deskTopWorkArea.Width)
			{
				dropDownSize.Width = deskTopWorkArea.Width;
			}
			if (determineScrollBarVisibility && base.DisplayLayout.Scrollbars == Scrollbars.Automatic && dropDownSize.Width < num2)
			{
				includeHorizontalScrollbar = true;
				isRecalcRequired = true;
			}
			int totalHeight = 0;
			bool flag = true;
			UIElementBorderStyle borderStyleRowResolved = base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].BorderStyleRowResolved;
			int borderThickness = base.DisplayLayout.GetBorderThickness(borderStyleRowResolved);
			int itemsCount = 0;
			int num3 = ((IValueList)this).SelectedItemIndex;
			if (num3 < 0)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			else if (num3 >= base.Rows.Count)
			{
				num3 = Math.Max(0, base.Rows.Count - 1);
			}
			if (num3 >= 0 && num3 < base.Rows.Count)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = base.Rows[num3];
				int visibleIndex = ultraGridRow.VisibleIndex;
				if (visibleIndex < 0)
				{
					if (ultraGridRow.ParentCollection != null)
					{
						UltraGridRow rowAtVisibleIndexOffset = ultraGridRow.ParentCollection.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(ultraGridRow, 1);
						ultraGridRow = ((rowAtVisibleIndexOffset == null) ? ultraGridRow.ParentCollection.GetRowAtVisibleIndexOffset(ultraGridRow, -1) : rowAtVisibleIndexOffset);
					}
					if (ultraGridRow != null)
					{
						visibleIndex = ultraGridRow.VisibleIndex;
					}
				}
				if (base.Rows.VisibleRowCount - visibleIndex < itemCount)
				{
					num3 = base.Rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndex(Math.Max(0, base.Rows.VisibleRowCount - itemCount))?.Index ?? Math.Max(0, base.Rows.Count - itemCount);
				}
			}
			num3 = Math.Max(num3, 0);
			int count = base.Rows.Count;
			if (itemCount <= count)
			{
				num3 = 0;
			}
			for (int i = num3; i < count; i++)
			{
				if (itemsCount >= itemCount)
				{
					break;
				}
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = base.Rows[i];
				if (ultraGridRow2.HiddenResolved)
				{
					continue;
				}
				totalHeight += ultraGridRow2.TotalHeight;
				if (previousRow != null)
				{
					if (previousRow.RowSpacingAfterResolved <= 0 && ultraGridRow2.RowSpacingBeforeResolved <= 0 && base.DisplayLayout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(borderStyleRowResolved))
					{
						totalHeight -= borderThickness;
					}
				}
				else if (ultraGridRow2.RowSpacingBeforeResolved > 0)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				previousRow = ultraGridRow2;
				itemsCount++;
			}
			if (totalHeight <= 0)
			{
				itemCount = 1;
				totalHeight = itemCount * base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].RowHeightResolved;
				totalHeight = ((!base.DisplayLayout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(borderStyleRowResolved) || base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].RowSpacingBeforeDefault >= 1 || base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].RowSpacingAfterDefault >= 1) ? (totalHeight + 2 * borderThickness * itemCount) : (totalHeight + borderThickness * (1 + itemCount)));
			}
			if (base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].Columns != null && base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].Columns.Count > 0)
			{
				totalHeight += base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].GetTotalHeaderHeight(!flag);
			}
			bool flag2 = CalculateSpecialRowsSize(specialRows, itemCount, ref totalHeight, ref itemsCount);
			dropDownSize.Height = totalHeight;
			dropDownSize.Height += 2 * base.DisplayLayout.GetBorderThickness(base.DisplayLayout.BorderStyleResolved);
			if (includeHorizontalScrollbar)
			{
				dropDownSize.Height += base.DisplayLayout.HorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved;
			}
			if (dropDownSize.Height > num)
			{
				dropDownSize.Height = num;
				CalculateDropDownSizeAutoScrollbarHelper(determineScrollBarVisibility, deskTopWorkArea, ref dropDownSize, ref isRecalcRequired);
			}
			else if (flag2)
			{
				CalculateDropDownSizeAutoScrollbarHelper(determineScrollBarVisibility, deskTopWorkArea, ref dropDownSize, ref isRecalcRequired);
			}
			return dropDownSize;
		}

		private void CalculateDropDownSizeAutoScrollbarHelper(bool determineScrollBarVisibility, Rectangle monitorWorkArea, ref Size dropDownSize, ref bool isRecalcRequired)
		{
			if (base.DisplayLayout.Scrollbars == Scrollbars.Automatic && !includeVerticalScrollbar && determineScrollBarVisibility)
			{
				dropDownSize.Width += base.DisplayLayout.VerticalScrollBarWidthResolved;
				includeVerticalScrollbar = true;
				isRecalcRequired = true;
				if (dropDownSize.Width > monitorWorkArea.Width)
				{
					dropDownSize.Width = monitorWorkArea.Width;
					includeHorizontalScrollbar = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private bool CalculateSpecialRowsSize(List<UltraGridRow> specialRows, int itemsToDisplay, ref int totalHeight, ref int itemsCount)
		{
			if (specialRows == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool result = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < specialRows.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = specialRows[i];
				if (itemsCount < itemsToDisplay)
				{
					totalHeight += ultraGridRow.TotalHeight;
					itemsCount++;
				}
				else if (ultraGridRow.IsFixedBottom || ultraGridRow.IsFixedTop)
				{
					totalHeight += ultraGridRow.TotalHeight;
				}
				else
				{
					result = true;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private List<UltraGridRow> CalculateSpecialRowsInDropDown(ref UltraGridRow previousRow, out int numNonFixedRows)
		{
			numNonFixedRows = 0;
			List<UltraGridRow> rows = new List<UltraGridRow>();
			CalculateSpecialRowsInDropDownHelper(base.Rows.GetBottomSpecialRows(), setPreviousRow: false, ref numNonFixedRows, ref previousRow, ref rows);
			CalculateSpecialRowsInDropDownHelper(base.Rows.GetTopSpecialRows(), setPreviousRow: true, ref numNonFixedRows, ref previousRow, ref rows);
			return rows;
		}

		private static void CalculateSpecialRowsInDropDownHelper(UltraGridRow[] specialRows, bool setPreviousRow, ref int numNonFixedRows, ref UltraGridRow previousRow, ref List<UltraGridRow> rows)
		{
			if (specialRows == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridRow ultraGridRow in specialRows)
			{
				if (!ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
				{
					if (!ultraGridRow.IsFixedBottom && !ultraGridRow.IsFixedTop)
					{
						numNonFixedRows++;
					}
					if (setPreviousRow)
					{
						previousRow = ultraGridRow;
					}
					rows.Add(ultraGridRow);
				}
			}
		}

			return array[num];
		}

		private bool ContinueScrolling(ref Point mouseLoc)
		{
			MouseButtons mouseButtons = MouseButtons.Left;
			if ((Control.MouseButtons & mouseButtons) != mouseButtons)
			{
				return false;
			}
			mouseLoc = ControlForGridDisplay.PointToClient(Cursor.Position);
			return true;
		}

		internal void ScrollSelectedRowIntoView(bool force)
		{
			if (!(!IsDroppedDown || force))
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).BeginUpdate();
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = ((SelectedRow != null) ? SelectedRow : base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.FirstRow);
				if (base.ActiveRowScrollRegion != null && ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(ultraGridRow);
					if (base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.IsLastScrollableRowVisible(assumeColScrollbarsVisible: false))
					{
						base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.Scroll(RowScrollAction.Top);
						base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(ultraGridRow);
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal virtual void SelectedItemChangeHelper(ComboSelectedItemChangeContext context, object newData)
		{
			AutoCompleteInfo autoCompleteInfo = AutoCompleteInfo;
			if (autoCompleteInfo != null && autoCompleteInfo.IsFilteredDropDownVisible && autoCompleteInfo.IsProcessingTextChanged)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = -1;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			switch (context)
			{
			case ComboSelectedItemChangeContext.SelectedIndex:
				num = (int)newData;
				if (num == ((IValueList)this).SelectedItemIndex)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (num >= 0 && num < base.Rows.Count)
				{
					ultraGridRow = base.Rows[num];
				}
				break;
			case ComboSelectedItemChangeContext.SelectedRow:
				ultraGridRow = newData as UltraGridRow;
				if (ultraGridRow == selectedRow)
				{
					return;
				}
				num = ((ultraGridRow != null) ? base.Rows.IndexOf(ultraGridRow) : (-1));
				break;
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null && num < 0)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_287"), Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_367"));
			}
			if (selectedRow != null)
			{
				selectedRow.Selected = false;
			}
			selectedRow = ultraGridRow;
			base.ActiveRow = ultraGridRow;
			if (selectedRow != null)
			{
				selectedRow.Selected = true;
			}
			((IValueList)this).SelectedItemIndex = num;
			if (selectedRow != null && ((IValueList)this).IsDroppedDown)
			{
				base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(selectedRow);
			}
			if (owner != null)
			{
				owner.OnSelectedItemChanged();
			}
			RowSelectedEventArgs e = new RowSelectedEventArgs((Control)(object)this, selectedRow);
			FireRowSelected(e);
		}

		}

		private void BuildSortedDisplayMemberList()
		{
			sortedDisplayMemberList = new List<UltraGridRow>();
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Rows.Count; i++)
			{
				sortedDisplayMemberList.Add(base.Rows[i]);
			}
			Utilities.SortMergeGeneric<UltraGridRow>(sortedDisplayMemberList, (IComparer<UltraGridRow>)new BinarySearchSortComparer(this, useText: true));
			UpdateSortedDisplayMemberListVersion();
		}

		private void BuildSortedValueMemberList()
		{
			sortedValueMemberList = new List<UltraGridRow>();
			canDoBinarySearch = true;
			UltraGridColumn valueMemberColumnResolved = GetValueMemberColumnResolved();
			lastValueMemberListType = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Rows.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = base.Rows[i];
				sortedValueMemberList.Add(ultraGridRow);
				if (valueMemberColumnResolved == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				object cellValue = ultraGridRow.GetCellValue(valueMemberColumnResolved);
				if (cellValue != null && !(cellValue is DBNull))
				{
					if (!(cellValue is IComparable))
					{
						canDoBinarySearch = false;
						return;
					}
					Type type = cellValue.GetType();
					if (lastValueMemberListType == null)
					{
						lastValueMemberListType = type;
					}
					else if (lastValueMemberListType != type)
					{
						canDoBinarySearch = false;
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			Utilities.SortMergeGeneric<UltraGridRow>(sortedValueMemberList, (IComparer<UltraGridRow>)new BinarySearchSortComparer(this, useText: false));
			UpdateSortedValueMemberListVersion();
		}

		private static int CompareDataValue(object dataValue1, object dataValue2, ValueListItemMatchingMode itemMatchingMode)
		{
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (dataValue1 == dataValue2)
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (dataValue1 == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (dataValue2 == null)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (dataValue1 is DBNull)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (dataValue2 is DBNull)
			{
				return 1;
			}
			if (dataValue1.GetType() == dataValue2.GetType())
			{
				return RowsCollection.RowsSortComparer.DefaultCompare(dataValue1, dataValue2, duringSort: false, caseInSensitive: false);
			}
			if ((int)itemMatchingMode != 0)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			string strA = dataValue1.ToString();
			string strB = dataValue2.ToString();
			return string.Compare(strA, strB, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
		}

		internal UltraGridColumn GetDisplayMemberColumnResolved()
		{
			InitializeValueMemberIfToFirstColumn();
			UltraGridColumn result = null;
			ColumnsCollection columns = base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0].Columns;
			string displayMemberResolved = DisplayMemberResolved;
			if (columns.Exists(displayMemberResolved))
			{
				result = columns[displayMemberResolved];
			}
			return result;
		}

		private object PerformBinarySearch(object dataValue, ref int index, bool getValue)
		{
			//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridColumn column = (getValue ? GetDisplayMemberColumnResolved() : GetValueMemberColumnResolved());
			BinarySearchSortComparer binarySearchSortComparer = new BinarySearchSortComparer(this, getValue);
			int num = (getValue ? binarySearchSortComparer.BinarySearchValues(SortedDisplayMemberList, (string)dataValue) : binarySearchSortComparer.BinarySearchValues(SortedValueMemberList, dataValue));
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				int num2 = num - 1;
				while (num2 >= 0 && (getValue ? DoesTextMatch(SortedDisplayMemberList[num2].GetCellText(column), (string)dataValue, partial: false) : DoesDataValueMatch(SortedValueMemberList[num2].GetCellValue(column), dataValue, ItemMatchingMode)))
				{
					num = num2--;
				}
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = (getValue ? SortedDisplayMemberList[num] : SortedValueMemberList[num]);
				int num3 = (index = ultraGridRow.Index);
				if (!getValue)
				{
					return ((IValueList)this).GetText(num3);
				}
				return ((IValueList)this).GetValue(num3);
			}
			index = -1;
			return null;
		}

		private bool CanDoBinarySearchHelper(UltraGridColumn valueMemberColumnResolved)
		{

			{
				return false;
			}

			{
				BuildSortedValueMemberList();

			return canDoBinarySearch;
		}

		private void VerifyItemImageSize(ComponentRole componentRole, ImageList imageList)
		{
			//IL_0041: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (lastVerifiedItemImageSizeVersion == itemImageSizeVersion + listVersion)

			Image image = null;

			for (int i = 0; i < itemCount; i++)

				AppearancePropFlags val2 = (AppearancePropFlags)256;
				componentRole = null;

				image = ((AppearanceData)(ref val)).GetImage(imageList);

		void IDropDownResizeHandleOwner.ResolveDropDownResizeHandleAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearanceData, ref AppearancePropFlags appearancePropFlags)
		{
			ResolutionOrderInfo resOrder;
			UIRole role = StyleUtils.GetRole(base.DisplayLayout, StyleUtils.Role.DropDownDropDownResizeHandle, out resOrder);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleBefore && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref appearancePropFlags, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (HasDropdownResizeHandleAppearance && ((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				DropDownResizeHandleAppearance.MergeData(ref appearanceData, ref appearancePropFlags);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resOrder)).UseStyleAfter && role != null)
			{
				role.ResolveAppearance(ref appearanceData, ref appearancePropFlags, (RoleState)1);
			}
		}

		{

		}

		{
			private Image icon;

			private Bitmap bitmap;

			private Color lastForeColor;

			private Point[] transparentPixels;

			internal BitmapFromIconCache(object icon)
			{
				if (icon is Image)
				{
					this.icon = (Image)icon;
				}
				else if (icon is Icon)
				{
					this.icon = ((Icon)icon).ToBitmap();
				}
			}

			internal Bitmap GetBitmap(Color foreColor)
			{
				if (this.bitmap == null)
				{
					Bitmap bitmap = new Bitmap(icon);
					List<Point> list = new List<Point>();
					int width = bitmap.Width;
					int height = bitmap.Height;
					for (int i = 0; i < height; i++)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < width; j++)
						{
							Color pixel = bitmap.GetPixel(j, i);
							if (pixel.R == byte.MaxValue && pixel.G == 0 && pixel.B == 0)
							{
								list.Add(new Point(j, i));
							}
						}
					}
					transparentPixels = list.ToArray();
					this.bitmap = bitmap;
				}
				if (lastForeColor != foreColor)
				{
					Bitmap bitmap2 = this.bitmap;
					Point[] array = transparentPixels;
					for (int k = 0; k < array.Length; k++)
					{
						Point point = array[k];
						bitmap2.SetPixel(point.X, point.Y, foreColor);
					}
					lastForeColor = foreColor;
				}
				return this.bitmap;
			}
		}

		public UltraGridState CurrentState
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_00e3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_00e8: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
				int num = 0;
				if (swapDropDown != null && ((IValueList)swapDropDown).IsDroppedDown)
				{
					num |= 0x20000;
				}
				HeaderBase headerBase = ActiveHeader;
				bool flag = headerBase?.IsInEditMode ?? false;
				if (flag)
				{
					num |= 0x40000000;
					if (headerBase.HasDropDown)
					{
						num |= 8;
						EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = ActiveHeader.EditorResolved;
						if (editorResolved != null && editorResolved.SupportsDropDown && editorResolved.IsDroppedDown)
						{
							num |= 0x40;
						}
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ActiveCell;
					if (ultraGridCell != null)
					{
						num |= 1;
						UltraGridColumn relatedVisibleCol = ultraGridCell.Band.GetRelatedVisibleCol(activeCell.Column, NavigateType.Prev, includeNonActivateable: false);
						UltraGridColumn relatedVisibleCol2 = ultraGridCell.Band.GetRelatedVisibleCol(activeCell.Column, NavigateType.Next, includeNonActivateable: false);
						if (relatedVisibleCol == null)
						{
							num |= 2;
						}
						if (relatedVisibleCol2 == null)
						{
							num |= 4;
						}
						if (ultraGridCell.IsInEditMode)
						{
							num |= 0x10;
							if (1 == (int)ultraGridCell.Column.CellMultiLineResolved)
							{
								num |= 0x20000000;
							}
						}
						if (ultraGridCell.HasDropDown)
						{
							num |= 8;
							EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved2 = ultraGridCell.EditorResolved;
							if (editorResolved2 != null && editorResolved2.SupportsDropDown && editorResolved2.IsDroppedDown)
							{
								num |= 0x40;
							}
						}
						if (ultraGridCell.StyleResolved == ColumnStyle.CheckBox || ultraGridCell.StyleResolved == ColumnStyle.TriStateCheckBox)
						{
							num |= 0x20;
						}
					}
					if (base.ActiveRow != null)
					{
						num |= 0x80;
						if (!base.ActiveRow.HasPrevSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
						{
							num |= 0x1000;
							if (!base.ActiveRow.HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))
							{
								num |= 0x800;
								if (base.ActiveRow.IsAbsoluteFirstRow())
								{
									num |= 0x80000;
								}
							}
						}
						if (base.ActiveRow.Expanded)
						{
							num |= 0x400;
						}
						UltraGridRow nextRow = base.DisplayLayout.GetNextRow(NavigateType.Next, base.ActiveRow, shiftKeyDown: false, ctlKeyDown: false, spanBands: true, spanParents: true, select: false, setSnakingState: false);
						if (nextRow == null)
						{
							num |= 0x4000;
							num |= 0x2000;
							num |= 0x100000;
						}
						else if (nextRow.Band != base.ActiveRow.Band)
						{
							num |= 0x4000;
							if (nextRow.ParentRow != base.ActiveRow.ParentRow)
							{
								num |= 0x2000;
							}
						}
						if (!base.ActiveRow.IsGroupByRow)
						{
							if (base.ActiveRow.HasExpansionIndicator)
							{
								num |= 0x200;
							}
						}
						else if (base.ActiveRow.IsExpandable)
						{
							num |= 0x200;
						}
						if (base.ActiveRow.ParentRow != null)
						{
							num |= 0x100;
						}
						if (base.ActiveRow is UltraGridGroupByRow)
						{
							num |= 0x8000;
						}
						if (base.ActiveRow.DataChanged || base.ActiveRow.IsAddRow)
						{
							num |= 0x10000;
						}
						if (base.ActiveRow.IsFilterRow)
						{
							num |= 0x200000;
						}
						if (base.ActiveRow.IsAddRow)
						{
							num |= 0x400000;
						}
					}
				}
				if (base.DisplayLayout != null)
				{
					num |= (int)base.DisplayLayout.ActionHistory.MultiCellOperationInfo.GetMultiCellOperationRelatedState();
				}
				return (UltraGridState)num;
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public UltraGridCell ActiveCell
		{
			get
			{
				if (activeCell != null && !in_getActiveCell)
				{
					in_getActiveCell = true;
					UltraGridRow row = activeCell.Row;
					UltraGridColumn column = activeCell.Column;
					if ((row != null && !row.IsStillValid) || (column != null && !column.IsStillValid))
					{
						try
						{
							if (activeCell.IsInEditMode)
							{
								activeCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: true, forceExit: true);
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
						ActiveRowInvalidHelper();
					}
					in_getActiveCell = false;
				}
				return activeCell;
			}
			set
			{
				if (activeCell == value)
				{
					return;
				}
				ClearActiveCell(invalidate: true, shutdown: false);
				if (value == null && currentActiveRow != null)
				{
					currentActiveRow.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
				}
				if (value == null || activeCell != null)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (value != null)
				{
					base.ActiveRow = value.Row;
					if (base.ActiveRow != value.Row)
					{
						return;
					}
				}
				CancelableCellEventArgs e = new CancelableCellEventArgs(value);
				FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeCellActivate, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return;
				}
				activeCell = value;
				if (activeCell != null)
				{
					activeCell.OnActiveStateChanged(activated: true);
				}
				if (activeCell != null)
				{
					activeCell.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
					UltraGridBand band = activeCell.Band;
					if (band != null && band.HasActiveCellColumnHeaderAppearance())
					{
						activeCell.Column.Header.DirtyHeaderUIElements(null);
					}
					RowsCollection.MergedCell_CellStateChanged(activeCell, MergedCell.State.Activation);
					SynchImeMode();
				}
				FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterCellActivate, new CellEventArgs(activeCell));
				if (((Control)(object)this).ContainsFocus)
				{
					AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.Focus, 0);
				}
			}
		}

		internal UltraGridCell ActiveCellInternal => activeCell;

		[Browsable(false)]

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool IsExportAsyncInProgress
		{
			get
			{
				AsyncExportOperation asyncExportOperation = AsynchronousExportManager.FindExportOperation(this);
				if (asyncExportOperation == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (asyncExportOperation.CurrentAsyncExportPhase)
				{
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Pending:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Completed:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Cancelled:
					return false;
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.PrepareForExport:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.AutoSizeColumns:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.BeginExport:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.ProcessRows:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.EndExport:
					return true;
				default:
					return true;
				}
			}
		}

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		[Browsable(false)]
		public bool IsExportAsyncPending
		{
			get
			{
				AsyncExportOperation asyncExportOperation = AsynchronousExportManager.FindExportOperation(this);
				if (asyncExportOperation == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				switch (asyncExportOperation.CurrentAsyncExportPhase)
				{
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Pending:
					return true;
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.PrepareForExport:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.AutoSizeColumns:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.BeginExport:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.ProcessRows:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.EndExport:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Completed:
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Cancelled:
					return false;
				default:
					return false;
				}
			}
		}

		public UltraGrid()
		{
			try
			{
				license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(UltraGrid), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
			ResetUpdateMode();
			((Control)(object)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.AllPaintingInWmPaint, value: true);
			((Control)(object)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.ResizeRedraw, value: true);
			((Control)(object)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.Selectable, value: true);
			((Control)(object)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer, value: false);
			((Control)(object)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.StandardClick, value: true);
			((Control)(object)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.StandardDoubleClick, value: true);
			((Control)(object)this).SetStyle(ControlStyles.SupportsTransparentBackColor, value: true);
		}

		internal void FireEvent(GridEventIds id, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!EventManager.CanFireEvent(id))
			{
				return;
			}
			EventManager.IncrementInProgress(id);
			try
			{
				switch (id)
				{
				case GridEventIds.AfterCellActivate:
					OnAfterCellActivate();
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterCellCancelUpdate:
					OnAfterCellCancelUpdate(e as CellEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterCellListCloseUp:
					OnAfterCellListCloseUp(e as CellEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterCellUpdate:
					OnAfterCellUpdate(e as CellEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterColPosChanged:
					OnAfterColPosChanged(e as AfterColPosChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterColRegionScroll:
					OnAfterColRegionScroll(e as ColScrollRegionEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterColRegionSize:
					OnAfterColRegionSize(e as ColScrollRegionEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterEnterEditMode:
					OnAfterEnterEditMode();
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterExitEditMode:
					OnAfterExitEditMode();
					AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.Focus, 0);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterGroupPosChanged:
					OnAfterGroupPosChanged(e as AfterGroupPosChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterRowActivate:
					OnAfterRowActivate();
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterRowCancelUpdate:
					OnAfterRowCancelUpdate(e as RowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterRowCollapsed:
					OnAfterRowCollapsed(e as RowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterRowExpanded:
					OnAfterRowExpanded(e as RowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterRowInsert:
					OnAfterRowInsert(e as RowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterRowRegionScroll:
					OnAfterRowRegionScroll(e as RowScrollRegionEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterRowRegionSize:
					OnAfterRowRegionSize(e as RowScrollRegionEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterRowResize:
					OnAfterRowResize(e as RowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterRowsDeleted:
					OnAfterRowsDeleted();
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterRowUpdate:
					OnAfterRowUpdate(e as RowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterSelectChange:
					OnAfterSelectChange(e as AfterSelectChangeEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.AfterSortChange:
					OnAfterSortChange(e as BandEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeAutoSizeEdit:
					OnBeforeAutoSizeEdit(e as CancelableAutoSizeEditEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeCellActivate:
					OnBeforeCellActivate(e as CancelableCellEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeCellCancelUpdate:
					OnBeforeCellCancelUpdate(e as CancelableCellEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeCellDeactivate:
					OnBeforeCellDeactivate(e as CancelEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeCellListDropDown:
					OnBeforeCellListDropDown(e as CancelableCellEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeCellUpdate:
					OnBeforeCellUpdate(e as BeforeCellUpdateEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeColPosChanged:
					OnBeforeColPosChanged(e as BeforeColPosChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeColRegionRemoved:
					OnBeforeColRegionRemoved(e as BeforeColRegionRemovedEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeColRegionScroll:
					OnBeforeColRegionScroll(e as BeforeColRegionScrollEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeColRegionSize:
					OnBeforeColRegionSize(e as BeforeColRegionSizeEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeColRegionSplit:
					OnBeforeColRegionSplit(e as BeforeColRegionSplitEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeEnterEditMode:
					OnBeforeEnterEditMode(e as CancelEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeExitEditMode:
					OnBeforeExitEditMode(e as BeforeExitEditModeEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeGroupPosChanged:
					OnBeforeGroupPosChanged(e as BeforeGroupPosChangedEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforePrint:
					OnBeforePrint(e as CancelablePrintEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowActivate:
					OnBeforeRowActivate(e as RowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowCancelUpdate:
					OnBeforeRowCancelUpdate(e as CancelableRowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowCollapsed:
					OnBeforeRowCollapsed(e as CancelableRowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowDeactivate:
					OnBeforeRowDeactivate(e as CancelEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowExpanded:
					OnBeforeRowExpanded(e as CancelableRowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowInsert:
					OnBeforeRowInsert(e as BeforeRowInsertEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowRegionRemoved:
					OnBeforeRowRegionRemoved(e as BeforeRowRegionRemovedEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowRegionScroll:
					OnBeforeRowRegionScroll(e as BeforeRowRegionScrollEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowRegionSize:
					OnBeforeRowRegionSize(e as BeforeRowRegionSizeEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowRegionSplit:
					OnBeforeRowRegionSplit(e as BeforeRowRegionSplitEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowResize:
					OnBeforeRowResize(e as BeforeRowResizeEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowsDeleted:
					OnBeforeRowsDeleted(e as BeforeRowsDeletedEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeRowUpdate:
					OnBeforeRowUpdate(e as CancelableRowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeSelectChange:
					OnBeforeSelectChange(e as BeforeSelectChangeEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.BeforeSortChange:
					OnBeforeSortChange(e as BeforeSortChangeEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.CellChange:
					OnCellChange(e as CellEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.CellListSelect:
					OnCellListSelect(e as CellEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.ClickCellButton:
					OnClickCellButton(e as CellEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.Error:
					OnError(e as ErrorEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.CellDataError:
					OnCellDataError(e as CellDataErrorEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.InitializeGroupByRow:
					OnInitializeGroupByRow(e as InitializeGroupByRowEventArgs);
					break;
				case GridEventIds.InitializeLayout:

				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(id);
			}

		internal override bool FireCommonEvent(CommonEventIds id, EventArgs e, bool checkInProgress)
		{
			GridEventIds gridEventIds;
			switch (id)
			{
			case CommonEventIds.AfterSortChange:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.AfterSortChange;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeSortChange:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.BeforeSortChange;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.FilterRow:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.FilterRow;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeColPosChanged:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.BeforeColPosChanged;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.AfterColPosChanged:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.AfterColPosChanged;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeRowFilterDropDown:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.BeforeRowFilterDropDown;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.AfterRowFilterChanged:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.AfterRowFilterChanged;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeRowFilterChanged:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.BeforeRowFilterChanged;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeCustomRowFilterDialog:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.BeforeCustomRowFilterDialog;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulate:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.BeforeRowFilterDropDownPopulate;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.FilterCellValueChanged:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.FilterCellValueChanged;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.InitializeRowsCollection:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.InitializeRowsCollection;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeColumnChooserDisplayed:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.BeforeColumnChooserDisplayed;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeBandHiddenChanged:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.BeforeBandHiddenChanged;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.AfterBandHiddenChanged:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.AfterBandHiddenChanged;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeHeaderCheckStateChanged:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.BeforeHeaderCheckStateChanged;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.AfterHeaderCheckStateChanged:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.AfterHeaderCheckStateChanged;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.AfterRowFilterDropDownPopulate:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.AfterRowFilterDropDownPopulate;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.BeforeAutoSizeColumn:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.BeforeAutoSizeColumn;
				break;
			case CommonEventIds.AfterAutoSizeColumn:
				gridEventIds = GridEventIds.AfterAutoSizeColumn;
				break;
			default:
				return false;
			}
			if (checkInProgress && EventManager.InProgress(gridEventIds))
			{
				return false;
			}
			FireEvent(gridEventIds, e);
			return true;
		}

		protected internal override void FireInitializeRow(InitializeRowEventArgs e)
		{
			UltraGridRow row = e.Row;
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = row?.Layout;
			if (ultraGridLayout != null && (ultraGridLayout.IsPrintLayout || ultraGridLayout.IsExportLayout))
			{
				CopyPropertiesToPrintRow(row);
			}
			FireEvent(GridEventIds.InitializeRow, e);
		}

		internal void FireInitializeGroupRow(InitializeGroupByRowEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Row != null && e.Row.Layout != null && (e.Row.Layout.IsPrintLayout || e.Row.Layout.IsExportLayout))
			{
				CopyPropertiesToPrintRow(e.Row);
			}
			FireEvent(GridEventIds.InitializeGroupByRow, e);
		}

		protected internal override void FireInitializeLayout(InitializeLayoutEventArgs e)
		{
			base.FireInitializeLayout(e);
			FireEvent(GridEventIds.InitializeLayout, e);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnterElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			if (EventManager.CanFireEvent(GridEventIds.MouseEnterElement))
			{
				EventManager.IncrementInProgress(GridEventIds.MouseEnterElement);
				try
				{
					((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseEnterElement(e);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					EventManager.DecrementInProgress(GridEventIds.MouseEnterElement);
					throw;
				}
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(GridEventIds.MouseEnterElement);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeaveElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			if (EventManager.CanFireEvent(GridEventIds.MouseLeaveElement))
			{
				EventManager.IncrementInProgress(GridEventIds.MouseLeaveElement);
				try
				{
					((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseLeaveElement(e);
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					EventManager.DecrementInProgress(GridEventIds.MouseLeaveElement);
					throw;
				}
				EventManager.DecrementInProgress(GridEventIds.MouseLeaveElement);
			}
		}

		protected internal override bool OnActiveRowChange(UltraGridRow newActiveRow, bool scrollIntoView)
		{
			if (newActiveRow == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (newActiveRow.IsTemplateAddRow && newActiveRow.ParentCollection != null)
			{
				if (!newActiveRow.ParentCollection.AddTemplateAddRowToDataList(activateFirstCellInNewRow: false))
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (base.ActiveRow == newActiveRow)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			RowEventArgs e = new RowEventArgs(newActiveRow);
			FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowActivate, e);
			bool flag = !settingActiveRowToTempActiveRow || tempActiveRow_ScrollIntoView;
			if (base.FirstDraw && settingActiveRowToTempActiveRow)
			{
				flag = false;
				if (!newActiveRow.AllAncestorsExpanded)
				{
					scrollIntoView = false;
				}
			}
			if (flag && !newActiveRow.ExpandAncestors())
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = currentActiveRow;
			currentActiveRow = newActiveRow;
			if (base.ActiveRow != null)
			{
				try
				{
					base.ActiveRow.InternalPositionToRow();
				}
				catch (Exception ex)
				{
					currentActiveRow = ultraGridRow;
					DataErrorInfo dataErrorInfo = new DataErrorInfo(ex, null, currentActiveRow, null, DataErrorSource.RowUpdate, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorRowUpdateUnableToUpdateRow", ex.Message));
					InternalHandleDataError(dataErrorInfo);
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (currentActiveRow != null)
			{
				currentActiveRow.OnActiveStateChanged(activated: true);
			}
			if (base.ActiveRow != null)
			{
				base.ActiveRow.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
				UIElement uIElement = base.DisplayLayout.GetUIElement(verify: false);
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(AddNewBoxUIElement));
					if (uIElement != null)
					{
						uIElement.Invalidate();
					}
				}
				uIElement = base.DisplayLayout.ActiveRow.GetUIElement(base.DisplayLayout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion, base.DisplayLayout.Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion, verifyElements: false);
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
				}
				RowsCollection.MergedCell_RowStateChanged(currentActiveRow, MergedCell.State.Activation);
				if (scrollIntoView)
				{
					base.DisplayLayout.Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(base.DisplayLayout.ActiveRow);
				}
				if (Selected.Rows.Count == 0 || (1 == Selected.Rows.Count && Selected.Rows[0] == base.ActiveRow))
				{
					((ISelectionManager)this).SetPivotItem((ISelectableItem)base.ActiveRow, true);
				}
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = base.ActiveRow.RowEditTemplateResolved;
				if (rowEditTemplateResolved != null && rowEditTemplateResolved.IsShown)
				{
					rowEditTemplateResolved.Row = base.ActiveRow;
				}
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate ultraGridRowEditTemplate = ultraGridRow?.RowEditTemplateResolved;
				if (ultraGridRowEditTemplate != null && ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Row != null && !ultraGridRowEditTemplate.IsShown)
				{
					ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Row = base.ActiveRow;
				}
				FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowActivate, null);
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).OnLeave(e);
			InternalLostFocus(scrolling: false);
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeExitEditModeOnLeave()
		{
			return !exitEditModeOnLeave;
		}

		public void ResetExitEditModeOnLeave()
		{
			ExitEditModeOnLeave = true;
		}

		internal void InternalLostFocus(bool scrolling)
		{
			if (!scrolling && toolTip != null && toolTip.Control != null && toolTip.Control.ContainsFocus)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = inOnLeave;
			inOnLeave = true;
			try
			{
				if (!ExitEditModeOnLeave)
				{
					return;
				}
				HeaderBase headerBase = ActiveHeader;
				if (headerBase != null && headerBase.IsInEditMode)
				{
					headerBase.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: true);
				}
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ActiveCell;
				if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					hasBeforeRowUpdateEventFired = false;
					ultraGridCell.ExitEditMode();
					if (ultraGridCell.IsInEditMode || (UpdateMode.OnCellChangeOrLostFocus != UpdateMode && UpdateMode != UpdateMode.OnRowChangeOrLostFocus) || ultraGridCell.Row == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (ultraGridCell.Row.IsUnModifiedAddRowFromTemplate)
					{
						ultraGridCell.Row.CancelEditHelper_ActivateNearestRow();
					}
					else if (!hasBeforeRowUpdateEventFired)
					{
						UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = ultraGridCell.Row.RowEditTemplateResolved;
						if (rowEditTemplateResolved == null || !rowEditTemplateResolved.IsShown)
						{
							ultraGridCell.Row.Update();
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (UpdateMode.OnCellChangeOrLostFocus != UpdateMode && UpdateMode != UpdateMode.OnRowChangeOrLostFocus)
					{
						return;
					}
					UltraGridRow activeRow = base.ActiveRow;
					if (activeRow == null)
					{
						return;
					}
					if (activeRow.IsUnModifiedAddRowFromTemplate)
					{
						activeRow.CancelEditHelper_ActivateNearestRow();
					}
					else if (activeRow.DataChanged)
					{
						UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved2 = activeRow.RowEditTemplateResolved;
						if (rowEditTemplateResolved2 == null || !rowEditTemplateResolved2.IsShown)
						{
							activeRow.Update();
						}
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				inOnLeave = flag;
			}
		}

		protected internal override void ClearActiveRow()
		{
			activeCell = null;
			base.ClearActiveRow();
		}

		protected internal override bool OnActiveRowCleared(bool update)
		{
			bool invalidate = activeCell != null && activeCell.Band.ActiveCellBorderThicknessResolved > 0;
			if (ClearActiveCell(invalidate, shutdown: false))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (currentActiveRow != null)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = currentActiveRow;
				if (base.ActiveRow != null)
				{
					CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
					FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowDeactivate, e);
					if (e.Cancel)
					{
						return false;
					}
					UltraGridRow activeRow = base.ActiveRow;
					if (activeRow != null && activeRow.IsUnModifiedAddRowFromTemplate)
					{
						update = false;
						activeRow.CancelEdit();
					}
				}
				if (update && UpdateMode.OnUpdate != UpdateMode)
				{
					if (!ultraGridRow.Update())
					{
						return false;
					}
					if (ultraGridRow.IsCardStyleVariableHeight && ultraGridRow.IsPotentiallyVisibleOnScreen && base.DisplayLayout != null)
					{
						base.DisplayLayout.DirtyDataAreaElement();
					}
					if (currentActiveRow == null)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
				UIElement val = ((base.DisplayLayout != null) ? base.DisplayLayout.GetUIElement(verify: false) : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val = val.GetDescendant(typeof(AddNewBoxUIElement));
					if (val != null)
					{
						val.Invalidate();
					}
				}
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = currentActiveRow;
				currentActiveRow = null;
				ultraGridRow2?.OnActiveStateChanged(activated: false);
				if (ultraGridRow2 != null)
				{
					ultraGridRow2.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: true);
					RowsCollection.MergedCell_RowStateChanged(ultraGridRow2, MergedCell.State.Activation);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
