		protected override void OnResize(EventArgs eventArgs)
		{
			if (((Control)(object)this).IsDisposed || ((Control)(object)this).Disposing)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = base.DisplayLayout;
			if (displayLayout != null && !displayLayout.Disposed && displayLayout.HasUIElement)
			{
				displayLayout.InternalInitializeUltraGridUIElementRect(verify: false);
				if (displayLayout.RowScrollRegions != null)
				{
					foreach (RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion in displayLayout.RowScrollRegions)
					{
						rowScrollRegion.VerifyGridRectAndVisibleRows = true;
					}
				}
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnResize(eventArgs);
			if (displayLayout != null && displayLayout.RowScrollRegions != null)
			{
				foreach (RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion2 in displayLayout.RowScrollRegions)
				{
					rowScrollRegion2.VerifyGridRectAndVisibleRows = false;
				}
			}
			if (!base.FirstDraw && ((Control)(object)this).Created)
			{
				base.DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement();
				base.DisplayLayout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
				base.DisplayLayout.RowScrollRegions.DirtyAllVisibleRows();
			}
			base.DisplayLayout.ExitEditModeHelper();
			if (base.DisplayLayout != null && !base.DisplayLayout.Disposed && !base.FirstDraw && ((Control)(object)this).Created)
			{
				base.DisplayLayout.BumpGrandVerifyVersion(bumpScrollToFillVersion: true);
			}
		}

		internal void EnsureTempActiveRowAssigned()
		{
			UltraGridRow rowWithListIndexHelper = base.TempActiveRow;
			if (rowWithListIndexHelper == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.ActiveRow != rowWithListIndexHelper && rowWithListIndexHelper.Layout == base.DisplayLayout)
			{
				settingActiveRowToTempActiveRow = true;
				try
				{
					UltraGridBand band = rowWithListIndexHelper.Band;
					if (band.BindingManager != null && (!rowWithListIndexHelper.IsStillValid || band.BindingManager.Position != rowWithListIndexHelper.ListIndex))
					{
						RowsCollection currentParentRows = band.GetCurrentParentRows(initializeIfNeeded: false, dontSyncRows: false);
						if (currentParentRows != null)
						{
							rowWithListIndexHelper = currentParentRows.GetRowWithListIndexHelper(band.BindingManager.Position, dontSyncRows: false);
						}
					}
					if (rowWithListIndexHelper != null && rowWithListIndexHelper.IsStillValid && base.ActiveRow != rowWithListIndexHelper)
					{
						SetActiveRow(rowWithListIndexHelper, tempActiveRow_ScrollIntoView);
					}
				}
				finally
				{
					settingActiveRowToTempActiveRow = false;
				}
			}
			base.TempActiveRow = null;
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			if (base.FirstDraw)
			{
				base.DisplayLayout.GetUIElement(verify: true, forceInitializeRect: true);
			}
			EnsureTempActiveRowAssigned();
			if (base.DisplayLayout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = base.FirstDraw;
			if (flag)
			{
				ResetFirstDrawFlag();
				base.DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: true).DirtyMetrics();
			}
			drawingValue = true;
			base.DisplayLayout.InitializeDrawingFlag(newState: true);
			try
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).OnPaint(pe);
			}
			finally
			{
				drawingValue = false;
				base.DisplayLayout.InitializeDrawingFlag(newState: false);
				base.DisplayLayout.lastPaintRect = pe.ClipRectangle;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				base.DisplayLayout.RowScrollRegions.VerifyAllScrollbarPositions();
			}
			if (!base.DisplayLayout.TextControlPositionDirty)
			{
				return;
			}
			base.DisplayLayout.TextControlPositionDirty = false;
			try
			{
				ActiveCell?.RepositionTextBoxCtl();
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPropertyChanged(PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_001d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0023: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (e.ChangeInfo.PropId is UltraControlPropIds && (int)(UltraControlPropIds)(object)e.ChangeInfo.PropId == 5)
			{
				base.DisplayLayout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
				base.DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement();
				base.DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics(setScrollToBeginning: false);
			}
			base.OnPropertyChanged(e);
		}

		protected override void OnBasePropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			try
			{
				if (propChange.Source != base.DisplayLayout)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (propChange.FindPropId((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropIds)4) != null || propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.TextOrientation) != null)
				{
					base.DisplayLayout.ClearCachedCaptionHeight();
					base.DisplayLayout.OnBaseFontChanged();
					base.DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement();
					return;
				}
				switch ((PropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId)
				{
				case PropertyIds.ViewStyleBand:
					base.DisplayLayout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
					break;
				case PropertyIds.ViewStyle:
					ClearAllSelected();
					if (!base.DisplayLayout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay)
					{
						UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = base.ActiveRow;
						while (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.ParentRow != null)
						{
							ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
						}
						base.ActiveRow = ultraGridRow;
					}
					if (base.DisplayLayout.ViewStyleImpl != null && !base.DisplayLayout.ViewStyleImpl.SupportsGroupByRows && base.ActiveRow != null && base.ActiveRow is UltraGridGroupByRow)
					{
						int num = -1;
						UltraGridRow activeRow = null;
						try
						{
							UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0];
							if (ultraGridBand.BindingManager != null)
							{
								num = ultraGridBand.BindingManager.Position;
								activeRow = ultraGridBand.Layout.Rows[num];
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
						}
						base.ActiveRow = activeRow;
					}
					base.DisplayLayout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
					base.DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement();
					base.DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics(setScrollToBeginning: false);
					break;
				case PropertyIds.ScrollBarLook:
				case PropertyIds.AutoFitStyle:
					base.DisplayLayout.SynchronizedColListsDirty = true;
					base.DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement();
					base.DisplayLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics(setScrollToBeginning: false);
					base.DisplayLayout.ResetAutoFit_ColumnLastAdjustmentFullyAppliedToIndex();
					base.DisplayLayout.BumpRowLayoutVersion();
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Scrollbars:
					if (base.DisplayLayout != null)
					{
						base.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal.DirtyChildElements();
					}
					break;
				case PropertyIds.ColScrollRegions:
				case PropertyIds.RowScrollRegions:
					if (propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Hidden) != null || propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Scrollbar) != null || propChange.FindPropId(PropertyIds.Remove) != null)
					{
						base.DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement();
					}
					else
					{
						((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
					}
					break;
				case PropertyIds.Appearance:
				case PropertyIds.CaptionAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.SplitterBarHorizontalAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.SplitterBarVerticalAppearance:
				case PropertyIds.NoDataSourceMessageAppearance:
				{
					bool flag2 = true;
					if (propChange.Trigger == null)
					{
						base.DisplayLayout.ClearCachedCaptionHeight();
						if (base.DisplayLayout.Bands != null)
						{
							base.DisplayLayout.Bands.OnBaseFontChanged();
						}
					}
					if (propChange.FindPropId((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropIds)16) != null)
					{
						flag2 = false;
					}
					if (flag2)
					{
						base.DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false);
					}
					else
					{
						((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
					}
					break;
				}
				case PropertyIds.AlphaBlendEnabled:
				case PropertyIds.RowConnectorColor:
				case PropertyIds.RowConnectorStyle:
				{
					bool flag = true;
					if (propChange.FindPropId((Enum)(object)(AppearancePropIds)16) != null)
					{
						flag = false;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						base.DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false);
					}
					else
					{
						((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
					}
					StyleUtils.DirtyCachedPropertyVals(base.DisplayLayout);
					break;
				}
				case PropertyIds.BorderStyleCaption:
				case PropertyIds.Caption:
				case PropertyIds.MaxColScrollRegions:
				case PropertyIds.MaxRowScrollRegions:
				case PropertyIds.CaptionVisible:
				case PropertyIds.NoDataSourceMessageText:
					base.DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement();
					break;
				case PropertyIds.BorderStyle:
				case PropertyIds.InterBandSpacing:
					base.DisplayLayout.DirtyGridElement();
					base.DisplayLayout.ColScrollRegions.DirtyMetrics();
					break;
				case PropertyIds.SelectionOverlayColor:
				case PropertyIds.SelectionOverlayBorderColor:
				case PropertyIds.SelectionOverlayBorderThickness:
					((UltraControlBase)this).Invalidate();
					break;
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				base.OnBasePropChanged(propChange);
			}
		}

		internal Bitmap GetCachedBitmapFromIcon(object icon, Color foreColor)
		{
			if (cachedBitmapsFromIcons == null)
			{
				cachedBitmapsFromIcons = new Hashtable();
			}
			BitmapFromIconCache bitmapFromIconCache = (BitmapFromIconCache)cachedBitmapsFromIcons[icon];
			if (bitmapFromIconCache == null)
			{
				bitmapFromIconCache = (BitmapFromIconCache)(cachedBitmapsFromIcons[icon] = new BitmapFromIconCache(icon));
			}
			return bitmapFromIconCache.GetBitmap(foreColor);
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (license != null)
				{
					license.Dispose();
					license = null;
				}
				if (activeRowIcon != null)
				{
					activeRowIcon.Dispose();
					activeRowIcon = null;
				}
				if (activeRowAddedIcon != null)
				{
					activeRowAddedIcon.Dispose();
					activeRowAddedIcon = null;
				}
				if (activeRowModifiedIcon != null)
				{
					activeRowModifiedIcon.Dispose();
					activeRowModifiedIcon = null;
				}
				if (filterDropDown != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)filterDropDown).Dispose();
					filterDropDown = null;
				}
				if (rowAddedIcon != null)
				{
					rowAddedIcon.Dispose();
					rowAddedIcon = null;
				}
				if (rowModifiedIcon != null)
				{
					rowModifiedIcon.Dispose();
					rowModifiedIcon = null;
				}
				if (swapDropDown != null)
				{
					((DisposableObject)(object)swapDropDown).Dispose();
					swapDropDown = null;
				}
				if (defaultDropIndicatorDownArrowImage != null)
				{
					defaultDropIndicatorDownArrowImage.Dispose();
					defaultDropIndicatorDownArrowImage = null;
				}
				if (colorizableDropIndicatorDownArrowImage != null)
				{
					colorizableDropIndicatorDownArrowImage.Dispose();
					colorizableDropIndicatorDownArrowImage = null;
				}
				if (toolTip != null)
				{
					if (toolTip.Control != null)
					{
						toolTip.Control.MouseDown -= ToolTip_MouseDown;
						toolTip.Control.MouseUp -= ToolTip_MouseUp;
						toolTip.Control.Click -= ToolTip_Click;
					}
					((DisposableObject)(object)toolTip).Dispose();
					toolTip = null;
				}
				UnhookComponentChangeService();
				if (asyncExportStatusDisplay != null)
				{
					asyncExportStatusDisplay.StatusChanged -= asyncExportStatusDisplay_StatusChanged;
					asyncExportStatusDisplay.Dispose();
					asyncExportStatusDisplay = null;
				}
			}
			base.Dispose(disposing);
			if (disposing)
			{
				activeHeader = null;
				activeCell = null;
				eventManager = null;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool PerformAction(UltraGridAction actionCode, bool shift, bool control)
		{
			if (base.DisplayLayout != null)
			{
				base.DisplayLayout.EnsureRowsSyncedWithDataSource();
			}
			if (((KeyActionMappingsBase)KeyActionMappings).IsActionAllowed((Enum)actionCode, (long)CurrentState))
			{
				return base.DisplayLayout.PerformAction(actionCode, shift, control);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public bool PerformAction(UltraGridAction actionCode)
		{
			return PerformAction(actionCode, shift: false, control: false);
		}

		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.InheritanceDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		[UIPermission(SecurityAction.LinkDemand, Window = UIPermissionWindow.AllWindows)]
		protected override bool ProcessMnemonic(char charCode)
		{
			if (base.DesignMode)
			{
				return ((Control)(object)this).ProcessMnemonic(charCode);
			}
			if (base.DisplayLayout != null && base.DisplayLayout.HasAddNewBox && !base.DisplayLayout.AddNewBox.Hidden)
			{
				UIElement uIElementInternal = base.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal;
				AddNewBoxUIElement addNewBoxUIElement = ((uIElementInternal != null) ? ((AddNewBoxUIElement)(object)uIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(AddNewBoxUIElement))) : null);
				if (addNewBoxUIElement == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				for (int i = 0; i < base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[i];
					AddNewRowButtonUIElement addNewRowButtonUIElement = ((addNewBoxUIElement != null) ? ((AddNewRowButtonUIElement)(object)((UIElement)addNewBoxUIElement).GetDescendant(typeof(AddNewRowButtonUIElement), (object)ultraGridBand)) : null);
					if (addNewRowButtonUIElement == null || !((UIElement)addNewRowButtonUIElement).Enabled || ((ButtonWithTextUIElementBase)addNewRowButtonUIElement).Text == null || !Control.IsMnemonic(charCode, ((ButtonWithTextUIElementBase)addNewRowButtonUIElement).Text))
					{
						continue;
					}
					Control controlForGridDisplay = ControlForGridDisplay;
					if (!controlForGridDisplay.Focused)
					{
						try
						{
							if (DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(controlForGridDisplay.GetType()))
							{
								GridUtils.FocusControl(controlForGridDisplay);
							}
							else
							{
								controlForGridDisplay.Focus();
							}
						}
						catch (Exception)
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					ultraGridBand.InternalAddNew();
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		}

		internal bool ClearSelectedItemsOfType(GridItemBase item)
		{
			if (item is UltraGridRow)
			{
				return ClearSelectedRows();
			}
			if (item is UltraGridCell)
			{
				return ClearSelectedCells();
			}
			if (item is HeaderBase)
			{
				return ClearSelectedColumns();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ClearSelectedCells()
		{
			if (Selected.Cells != null && Selected.Cells.Count > 0)
			{
				Selected selected = new Selected();
				if (SelectNewSelection(typeof(UltraGridCell), selected))
				{
					return true;
				}
				base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.SetPivotItem(null);
				base.ActiveColScrollRegion.SetPivotCell(null);
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ClearSelectedRows()
		{
			if (Selected.Rows != null && Selected.Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				Selected selected = new Selected();
				if (SelectNewSelection(typeof(UltraGridRow), selected))
				{
					return true;
				}
				base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.SetPivotItem(null);
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ClearSelectedColumns()
		{
			if (Selected.Columns != null && Selected.Columns.Count > 0)
			{
				Selected selected = new Selected();
				if (SelectNewSelection(typeof(ColumnHeader), selected))
				{
					return true;
				}
				base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.SetPivotItem(null);
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ClearAllSelected()
		{
			return ClearAllSelected(dontClearPivotItems: false);
		}

		internal bool ClearAllSelected(bool dontClearPivotItems)
		{
			Type type = null;
			if (Selected.Cells != null && Selected.Cells.Count > 0)
			{
				type = Selected.Cells[0].GetType();
			}
			else if (Selected.Rows != null && Selected.Rows.Count > 0)
			{
				type = Selected.Rows[0].GetType();
			}
			else
			{
				if (Selected.Columns == null || Selected.Columns.Count <= 0)
				{
					return false;
				}
				type = Selected.Columns[0].GetType();
			}
			Selected selected = new Selected();
			if (SelectNewSelection(type, selected))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!dontClearPivotItems)
			{
				base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.SetPivotItem(null);
				base.ActiveColScrollRegion.SetPivotCell(null);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool ClearActiveCell()

			return ClearActiveCell(invalidate: true, shutdown: false);
		}

		internal bool ClearActiveCell(bool invalidate)
		{
			return ClearActiveCell(invalidate, shutdown: false);
		}

		internal bool ClearActiveCell(bool invalidate, bool shutdown)
		{
			if (activeCell == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!shutdown)
			{
				if (activeCell.ExitEditMode())
				{
					return true;
				}
				CancelableCellEventArgs e = new CancelableCellEventArgs(activeCell);
				FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeCellDeactivate, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (activeCell == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				UIElement uIElement = activeCell.GetUIElement(base.ActiveRowScrollRegion, base.ActiveColScrollRegion, verifyElements: false);
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					uIElement.DirtyChildElements();
				}
			}
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = activeCell;
			activeCell = null;
			ultraGridCell.OnActiveStateChanged(activated: false);
			if (invalidate)
			{
				ultraGridCell.InvalidateItemAllRegions(recalcRects: false);
				UltraGridBand band = ultraGridCell.Band;
				if (band != null && band.HasActiveCellColumnHeaderAppearance())
				{
					ultraGridCell.Column.Header.DirtyHeaderUIElements(null);
				}
			}
			RowsCollection.MergedCell_CellStateChanged(ultraGridCell, MergedCell.State.Activation);
			return false;
		}

		{
			if (toolTip != null)
			{
				Point p = toolTip.Control.PointToScreen(new Point(e.X, e.Y));
				Point pt = EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(p);
				if (((Control)(object)this).Bounds.Contains(pt))
				{
					toolTip.Hide();
					((Control)(object)this).OnMouseDown(new MouseEventArgs(e.Button, e.Clicks, pt.X, pt.Y, e.Delta));
				}
			}
		}

				Point pt = EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(p);
				if (((Control)(object)this).Bounds.Contains(pt))
				{
					toolTip.Hide();
					((Control)(object)this).OnMouseUp(new MouseEventArgs(e.Button, e.Clicks, pt.X, pt.Y, e.Delta));

		}

			}
		}

		internal bool IsActiveCellFirstVisibleCell()
		{
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ActiveCell;
			if (ultraGridCell == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridRow firstLastActivatableRow = base.Rows.GetFirstLastActivatableRow(first: true);
			if (firstLastActivatableRow != null)
			{
				while (firstLastActivatableRow is UltraGridGroupByRow)
				{
					firstLastActivatableRow = ((UltraGridGroupByRow)firstLastActivatableRow).Rows.GetFirstLastActivatableRow(first: true);
				}
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = firstLastActivatableRow.Band.GetFirstVisibleCol(null, includeNonActivateable: false, useTabOrderedColumns: true);
				while (ultraGridColumn != null && !UltraGridBase.CanBeActivatedAndIsTabStop(firstLastActivatableRow, ultraGridColumn))
				{
					ultraGridColumn = firstLastActivatableRow.Band.GetRelatedVisibleCol(ultraGridColumn, NavigateType.Next, includeNonActivateable: false, byTabKey: true);
				}
				if (ultraGridColumn == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (firstLastActivatableRow.Cells.HasCell(ultraGridColumn) && firstLastActivatableRow.Cells[ultraGridColumn] == ultraGridCell)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private UltraGridRow GetLastAbsoluteVisibleRow()
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = base.Rows.GetFirstLastActivatableRow(first: false);
			while (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.IsExpanded && ultraGridRow.HasChild(excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
			{
				UltraGridRow lastVisibleChildRow = ultraGridRow.GetLastVisibleChildRow();
				if (lastVisibleChildRow == null)
				{
					break;
				}
				ultraGridRow = lastVisibleChildRow;
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		internal bool IsActiveCellLastVisibleCell()
		{
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ActiveCell;
			if (ultraGridCell == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = GetLastAbsoluteVisibleRow();
			while (ultraGridRow is UltraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetPrevVisibleRow();
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = ultraGridRow.Band.GetLastVisibleCol(null, includeNonActivateable: false, useTabOrderedColumns: true);
				while (ultraGridColumn == null)
				{
					UltraGridRow parentRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
					if (parentRow == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					ultraGridRow = parentRow;
					ultraGridColumn = ultraGridRow.Band.GetLastVisibleCol(null, includeNonActivateable: false, useTabOrderedColumns: true);
					while (ultraGridColumn != null && !UltraGridBase.CanBeActivatedAndIsTabStop(ultraGridRow, ultraGridColumn))
					{
						ultraGridColumn = ultraGridRow.Band.GetRelatedVisibleCol(ultraGridColumn, NavigateType.Prev, includeNonActivateable: false, byTabKey: true);
					}
				}
				while (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridColumn != null)
				{
					UltraGridCell cellIfAllocated = ultraGridRow.GetCellIfAllocated(ultraGridColumn);
					if (cellIfAllocated == ultraGridCell)
					{
						return true;
					}
					if (UltraGridBase.CanBeActivatedAndIsTabStop(ultraGridRow, ultraGridColumn))
					{
						break;
					}
					ultraGridColumn = ultraGridRow.Band.GetRelatedVisibleCol(ultraGridColumn, NavigateType.Prev, includeNonActivateable: false, byTabKey: true);
					if (ultraGridColumn == null)
					{
						ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetPrevVisibleRow();
						if (ultraGridRow != null)
						{
							ultraGridColumn = ultraGridRow.Band.GetRelatedVisibleCol(null, NavigateType.Last, includeNonActivateable: false, byTabKey: true);
						}
					}
				}
				if (ultraGridColumn == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (ultraGridRow.Cells.HasCell(ultraGridColumn) && ultraGridRow.Cells[ultraGridColumn] == ultraGridCell)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool IsActiveRowFirstVisibleRow()
		{
			UltraGridRow activeRow = base.ActiveRow;
			if (activeRow == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridRow firstVisibleRow = base.Rows.GetFirstVisibleRow();
			return activeRow == firstVisibleRow;
		}

		internal bool IsActiveRowLastVisibleRow()
		{
			if (base.ActiveRow != null)
			{
				return GetLastAbsoluteVisibleRow() == base.ActiveRow;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool InternalIsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			return ((Control)(object)this).IsInputKey(keyData);
		}

		protected override bool IsInputKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = base.DisplayLayout;
			EmbeddableEditorBase editorInEditMode = displayLayout.EditorInEditMode;
			if (editorInEditMode != null && !editorInEditMode.CanFocus && !editorInEditMode.Focused && editorInEditMode.IsInputKey(keyData))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (!EditorContainerControl.ContainsFocus)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Keys keys = Keys.KeyCode & keyData;
			bool flag = Keys.Shift == (Keys.Shift & keyData);
			bool flag2 = Keys.Alt == (Keys.Alt & keyData);
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ActiveCell;
			if (Keys.Tab == keys)
			{
				if (TabNavigation.NextControlOnLastCell == base.DisplayLayout.TabNavigation)
				{
					if (Keys.Shift == (Keys.Shift & keyData))
					{
						if (IsActiveCellFirstVisibleCell() || (ultraGridCell == null && IsActiveRowFirstVisibleRow()))
						{
							return false;
						}
					}
					else if (IsActiveCellLastVisibleCell() || (ultraGridCell == null && IsActiveRowLastVisibleRow()))
					{
						return false;
					}
				}
				else if (TabNavigation.NextControl == base.DisplayLayout.TabNavigation)
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			ValueList val = swapDropDown;
			if (val != null && ((IValueList)val).IsDroppedDown)
			{
				bool result = false;
				if (Keys.Escape == keys)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				else if (Keys.Down == keys)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						result = true;
					}
				}
				else if (Keys.Right == keys)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				else if (Keys.Up == keys)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						result = true;
					}
				}
				else if (Keys.Left == keys)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				else if (Keys.Return == keys)
				{
					result = true;
				}
				return result;
			}
			if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.IsInEditMode && ultraGridCell.HasDropDown && ultraGridCell.HasValueList)
			{
				bool flag3 = false;
				if (Keys.Escape == keys)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else if (Keys.Down == keys)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
				}
				else if (Keys.Up == keys)
				{
					if (!flag2)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
				}
				else if (Keys.Return == keys)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else if (Keys.Right == keys)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				else if (Keys.Left == keys)
				{
					flag3 = true;
				}
				bool isDroppedDown = ultraGridCell.ValueListResolved.IsDroppedDown;
				if (isDroppedDown)
				{
					if (Keys.Home == keys && !flag)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
					else if (Keys.End == keys && !flag)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
					else if (Keys.Prior == keys)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
					else if (Keys.Next == keys)
					{
						flag3 = true;
					}
				}
				if (flag3 || isDroppedDown)
				{
					if (Keys.Tab == keys && ((KeyActionMappingsBase)KeyActionMappings).IsKeyMapped(keyData, (long)CurrentState))
					{
						return true;
					}
					return flag3;
				}
			}
			return ((KeyActionMappingsBase)KeyActionMappings).IsKeyMapped(keyData, (long)CurrentState);
		}

		private void OnKeyToggled()
		{
			if (base.DisplayLayout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (base.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal.ControlElement.LastElementEntered is SiblingRowConnectorUIElement)
			{
				((SiblingRowConnectorUIElement)(object)base.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal.ControlElement.LastElementEntered).OnKeyToggled();
			}
			if (!((Control)(object)this).IsHandleCreated)
			{
				return;
			}
			Point point = EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(Control.MousePosition);
			UIElement val = base.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal.AdjustableElementFromPoint(point);
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (val is CellUIElementBase cellUIElementBase)
				{
					cellUIElementBase.OnKeyToggled();
				}
				else if (val is HeaderUIElement headerUIElement)
				{
					headerUIElement.OnKeyToggled();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyPress(KeyPressEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.DisplayLayout == null)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).OnKeyPress(e);
				return;
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnKeyPress(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = null;
				EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase editorOwnerInfo = null;
				GetEditorForKeyMessageForwarding(out editor, out editorOwnerInfo);
				if (editor != null && editor.IsInEditMode && !editor.Focused && editorOwnerInfo != null)
				{
					editorOwnerInfo.RaiseKeyPress(e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnKeyUp(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.DisplayLayout == null)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).OnKeyUp(e);
				return;
			}
			((Control)(object)this).OnKeyUp(e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (editorWantedLastKeyDown)
			{
				editorWantedLastKeyDown = false;
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = null;
				EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase editorOwnerInfo = null;
				GetEditorForKeyMessageForwarding(out editor, out editorOwnerInfo);
				if (editor != null && editor.IsInEditMode && !editor.Focused && editor.IsInputKey(e.KeyData) && editorOwnerInfo != null)
				{
					editorOwnerInfo.RaiseKeyUp(e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			OnKeyToggled();
		}

		internal static void GetEditorForKeyMessageForwarding(UltraGridCell activeCell, out EmbeddableEditorBase editor, out EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase editorOwnerInfo)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase filterOperatorEditor = activeCell.Column.FilterOperatorEditor;
			if (activeCell.IsFilterRowCell && filterOperatorEditor.IsInEditMode && filterOperatorEditor.SupportsDropDown && filterOperatorEditor.IsDroppedDown)
			{
				editor = filterOperatorEditor;
				editorOwnerInfo = (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)activeCell.Column.FilterOperatorEditorOwnerInfo;
			}
			else
			{
				editor = activeCell.EditorResolved;
				editorOwnerInfo = (EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)(object)activeCell.EditorOwnerInfo;
			}
		}

		internal static void GetEditorForKeyMessageForwarding(HeaderBase activeHeader, out EmbeddableEditorBase editor, out EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase editorOwnerInfo)
		{
			editor = activeHeader.EditorResolved;
			editorOwnerInfo = activeHeader.Layout.HeaderEditorOwner;
		}

		internal void GetEditorForKeyMessageForwarding(out EmbeddableEditorBase editor, out EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase editorOwnerInfo)
		{
			editor = null;
			editorOwnerInfo = null;
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ActiveCell;
			if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.IsInEditMode)
			{
				GetEditorForKeyMessageForwarding(ultraGridCell, out editor, out editorOwnerInfo);
				return;
			}
			HeaderBase headerBase = ActiveHeader;
			if (headerBase != null && headerBase.IsInEditMode)
			{
				GetEditorForKeyMessageForwarding(headerBase, out editor, out editorOwnerInfo);
			}
		}

		internal void ForwardToValueListHelper(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			editorWantedLastKeyDown = false;
			ValueList val = swapDropDown;
			if (val == null || !((IValueList)val).IsDroppedDown)
			{
				val = filterDropDown;
			}
			if (val == null || !((IValueList)val).IsDroppedDown)
			{
				return;
			}
			IValueList val2 = (IValueList)(object)val;
			bool handled = false;
			if ((Keys.Escape & e.KeyData) == Keys.Escape)
			{
				handled = true;
				val2.CloseUp();
			}
			else if (e.KeyData == Keys.Down && (Keys.Alt & e.Modifiers) != Keys.Alt)
			{
				handled = true;
				val2.MoveNextItemPreviousItem(false);
			}
			else if (Keys.Right == e.KeyData)
			{
				handled = true;
				val2.MoveNextItemPreviousItem(false);
			}
			else if (e.KeyData == Keys.Up && (Keys.Alt & e.Modifiers) != Keys.Alt)
			{
				handled = true;
				if (val2.SelectedItemIndex > 0)
				{
					val2.MoveNextItemPreviousItem(true);
				}
			}
			else if (e.KeyData == Keys.Left)
			{
				handled = true;
				if (val2.SelectedItemIndex > 0)
				{
					val2.MoveNextItemPreviousItem(true);
				}
			}
			else if (e.KeyData == Keys.Return)
			{
				handled = true;
				int selectedItemIndex = val2.SelectedItemIndex;
				val2.CloseUp();
				val2.SelectedItemIndex = selectedItemIndex;
				if (val2.SelectedItemIndex >= 0)
				{
					IValueListOwner owner = val.Owner;
					if (owner != null)
					{
						EditorWithCombo val3 = (EditorWithCombo)(object)((owner is EditorWithCombo) ? owner : null);
						if (val3 != null)
						{
							val3.LastSelectionChangeCommittedTrigger = (SelectionChangeCommittedTrigger)1;
						}
						owner.OnSelectionChangeCommitted();
					}
				}
			}
			e.Handled = handled;
		}

		internal void ForwardKeyToEditorHelper(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			EmbeddableEditorBase editor = null;
			EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase editorOwnerInfo = null;
			GetEditorForKeyMessageForwarding(out editor, out editorOwnerInfo);
			if (editor != null && editor.IsInEditMode && !editor.Focused && editor.IsInputKey(e.KeyData))
			{
				editorWantedLastKeyDown = true;
				if (editorOwnerInfo != null)
				{
					editorOwnerInfo.RaiseKeyDown(e);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
			OnKeyToggled();
		}

		internal void InternalHandleDataError(DataErrorInfo dataErrorInfo)
		{
			InternalHandleDataError(dataErrorInfo, defaultCancelValue: false);
		}

		internal void InternalHandleDataError(DataErrorInfo dataErrorInfo, bool defaultCancelValue)
		{
			ErrorEventArgs e = new ErrorEventArgs(dataErrorInfo);
			GridEventManager gridEventManager = EventManager;
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = base.DisplayLayout;
			if (gridEventManager != null && displayLayout != null)
			{
				if ((e.ErrorText == null || e.ErrorText.Length == 0) && dataErrorInfo.Exception != null)
				{
					e.ErrorText = dataErrorInfo.Exception.Message;
				}
				e.Cancel = defaultCancelValue;
				OnError(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					UltraMessageBoxManager.Show(e.ErrorText, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("DataErrorMessageTitle"), MessageBoxButtons.OK, MessageBoxIcon.Asterisk);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalHandleMultiCellOperationError(MultiCellOperationErrorInfo errorInfo, bool defaultCancelValue)
		{
			GridEventManager gridEventManager = EventManager;
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = base.DisplayLayout;
			if (gridEventManager == null || displayLayout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			ErrorEventArgs e = new ErrorEventArgs(errorInfo);
			e.Cancel = defaultCancelValue;
			FireEvent(GridEventIds.Error, e);
			if (!e.Cancel && MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Stop != errorInfo.Action && MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Revert != errorInfo.Action && e.ErrorText != null && e.ErrorText.Length > 0)
			{
				Form form = displayLayout.Form;
				MessageBoxButtons messageBoxButtons = (errorInfo.CanContinueWithRemainingCells ? MessageBoxButtons.OKCancel : MessageBoxButtons.OK);
				DialogResult dialogResult = UltraMessageBoxManager.Show((IWin32Window)form, e.ErrorText, errorInfo.GetErrorMsgBoxTitle(), messageBoxButtons, MessageBoxIcon.Exclamation);
				if (DialogResult.Cancel == dialogResult)
				{
					errorInfo.Action = MultiCellOperationErrorInfo.ErrorAction.Stop;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			GridItemBase gridItemBase = item as GridItemBase;
			if (item is UltraGridRow)
			{
				if (selected == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (selected.Rows.Count < 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (selected.Rows[0].Band != gridItemBase.Band)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (item is UltraGridGroupByRow)
				{
					if (!(selected.Rows[0] is UltraGridGroupByRow))
					{
						return false;
					}
					return ((UltraGridGroupByRow)item).Column == ((UltraGridGroupByRow)selected.Rows[0]).Column;
				}
				if (selected.Rows[0] is UltraGridGroupByRow)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (item is UltraGridCell)
			{
				if (selected == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (selected.Cells.Count < 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return selected.Cells[0].Band == gridItemBase.Band;
			}
			if (item is HeaderBase)
			{
				if (selected == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (selected.Columns.Count < 1)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return selected.Columns[0].Band == gridItemBase.Band;
			}
			return true;
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (!(item is GridItemBase gridItemBase))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!gridItemBase.Selectable)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection(item);
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.OnDragStart(ISelectableItem item, Point mousePosition)
		{
			CancelEventArgs e = new CancelEventArgs();
			isDragging = false;
			FireEvent(GridEventIds.OnSelectionDrag, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return true;
			}
			bool result = false;
			cardAreaPivot = GetCardAreaFromItem(item);
			if (item is UltraGridCell ultraGridCell && ultraGridCell.Band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				item = ultraGridCell.Column.Header;
			}
			if (item is ColumnHeader && ((ColumnHeader)item).Draggable)
			{
				ColumnHeader columnHeader = (ColumnHeader)item;
				result = columnHeader.StartDrag();
			}
			else if (item is GroupHeader && ((GroupHeader)item).Draggable)
			{
				GroupHeader groupHeader = (GroupHeader)item;
				result = groupHeader.StartDrag();
			}
			isDragging = result;
			return result;
		}

		private CardAreaUIElement GetCardAreaFromItem(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			if (item is UltraGridRow)
			{
				ultraGridRow = item as UltraGridRow;
			}
			else if (item is UltraGridCell)
			{
				ultraGridRow = ((UltraGridCell)item).Row;
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.IsCard)
			{
				return base.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(CardAreaUIElement), new object[3] { ultraGridRow.ParentCollection, base.ActiveColScrollRegion, base.ActiveRowScrollRegion }) as CardAreaUIElement;
			}
			return null;
		}

		void ISelectionManager.OnDragMove(ref MouseMessageInfo msginfo)
		{
			Point pointInControlCoords = new Point(((MouseMessageInfo)(ref msginfo)).X, ((MouseMessageInfo)(ref msginfo)).Y);
			DragMoveHelper(pointInControlCoords);
		}

		void ISelectionManager.OnDragEnd(bool cancelled)
		{
			bool designerChangeNotificationsDisabled = base.DesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled;
			try
			{
				base.DesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = true;
				OnDragEndHelper(cancelled);
			}
			finally
			{
				base.DesignerChangeNotificationsDisabled = designerChangeNotificationsDisabled;
			}
		}

		private void OnDragEndHelper(bool cancelled)
		{
			//IL_00b7: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Point point = EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(Cursor.Position);
			bool flag = IsOverColumnChooser(point, mousePosInScreenCoordinate: false);
			GridBagLayoutDragStrategy val = gridBagLayoutDragStrategy;
			if (gridBagLayoutDragStrategy != null)
			{
				if (!flag && !cancelled)
				{
					GridBagLayoutDragManager gridBagLayoutDragManager = gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.GridBagLayoutDragManager as GridBagLayoutDragManager;
					if (gridBagLayoutDragManager.isGroupByButtonBeingDragged && !GridUtils.IsPointInGroupByBox(this, point))
					{
						bool flag2 = gridBagLayoutDragManager.IsPointInValidLayoutArea(point);
						RowLayoutColumnInfo dragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo = ((GridBagLayoutDragManager)(object)gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.GridBagLayoutDragManager).GetDragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo();
						if (dragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo != null && dragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo.Column != null)
						{
							dragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo.Column.SetGroupByColumnStatus(groupedBy: false);
						}
						if (!flag2)
						{
							ResetGridBagLayoutDragStrategy();
						}
						else
						{
							EndGridBagLayoutDrag(point);
							if (cachedColumnChooserDragInfo != null)
							{
								cachedColumnChooserDragInfo.groupByButtonDroppedOverColumnHeaders = (DefaultableBoolean)1;
							}
						}
					}
					else
					{
						EndGridBagLayoutDrag(point);
					}
				}
				else
				{
					ResetGridBagLayoutDragStrategy();
				}
			}
			if (dragEffect != null)
			{
				if (!flag && !cancelled)
				{
					try
					{
						gridBagLayoutDragStrategy = val;
						dragEffect.OnLeftButtonUp(point);
					}
					finally
					{
						gridBagLayoutDragStrategy = null;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dragEffect.OnCancelMode();
				}
				Cursor.Current = Cursors.Default;
			}
			isDragging = false;
			ColumnChooser_OnDragEnd(cancelled, point);
			if (base.DisplayLayout != null)
			{
				base.DisplayLayout.InvalidateHotTrackedElement();
			}
		}

		void ISelectionManager.EnterSnakingMode(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (!(item is UltraGridCell ultraGridCell))
			{
				return;
			}
			ISelectableItem pivotItem = ((ISelectionManager)this).GetPivotItem(item);
			if (pivotItem is UltraGridCell ultraGridCell2)
			{
				if (ultraGridCell2.Row == ultraGridCell.Row)
				{
					base.DisplayLayout.Snaking = false;
				}
				else
				{
					base.DisplayLayout.Snaking = true;
				}
			}
		}

		public void Print(UltraGridLayout layout, PrintDocument printDocument, RowPropertyCategories retainRowPropertyCategories)
		{
			PrintHelper(layout, printDocument, retainRowPropertyCategories);
			printManager.CalledFromPrint = true;
			try
			{
				if (printManager.PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.PrinterName == "<no default printer>")
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_291"));
				}
				CancelablePrintEventArgs e = new CancelablePrintEventArgs(printManager.PrintDocument, printManager.DefaultLayoutInfo, PrintLayout);
				FireEvent(GridEventIds.InitializePrint, e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					if (PrintLayout != null && e.DefaultLogicalPageLayoutInfo.FitWidthToPages != 0 && PrintLayout.AutoFitAllColumns)
					{
						PrintLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics(setScrollToBeginning: false);
					}
					FormatPrintLayout();
					printManager.PrintDocument.Print();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DisposePrintHelper();
			}
		}

		private void PrintHelper(UltraGridLayout layout, PrintDocument printDocument, RowPropertyCategories retainRowPropertyCategories)
		{
			printLayout = new UltraGridLayout();
			printLayout.RetainRowPropertyCategories = retainRowPropertyCategories;
			printManager = new PrintManager(this);
			if (printDocument is UltraGridPrintDocument ultraGridPrintDocument)
			{
				printManager.DefaultLayoutInfo.FitWidthToPages = ultraGridPrintDocument.FitWidthToPages;
				printManager.DefaultLayoutInfo.ColumnClipMode = ultraGridPrintDocument.ColumnClipMode;
			}
			printLayout.InitGrid(this);
			base.DisplayLayout.EnsureDataSourceAttached();
			try
			{
				printing_DontInitializeRows = true;
				if (layout != null)
				{
					printLayout.MaxBandDepth = layout.MaxBandDepth;
				}
				else if (base.DisplayLayout != null)
				{
					printLayout.MaxBandDepth = base.DisplayLayout.MaxBandDepth;
				}
				printLayout.ListManagerUpdated();
				isPrinting = true;
				if (layout != null)
				{
					printLayout.InitializeFrom(layout, PropertyCategories.All);
				}
				else
				{
					printLayout.InitializeFrom(base.DisplayLayout, PropertyCategories.All);
				}
				base.DisplayLayout.EnsureAllFormulasCalculated();
				isPrinting = false;
			}
			finally
			{
				printing_DontInitializeRows = false;
				printLayout.ApplyLoadedBands();
				foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands)
				{
					if (sortedBand.ParentBand == null)
					{
						UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = printLayout.SortedBands[0];
						ultraGridBand.CopyPrintRelatedProperties(sortedBand, printLayout.RetainRowPropertyCategories);
					}
					else if (printLayout.SortedBands.Exists(sortedBand.Key))
					{
						UltraGridBand ultraGridBand2 = printLayout.SortedBands[sortedBand.Key];
						ultraGridBand2.CopyPrintRelatedProperties(sortedBand, printLayout.RetainRowPropertyCategories);
					}
				}
				UltraGridRow.CopyPrintRelatedSettings(base.Rows, printLayout.Rows);
			}
			if (printDocument != null)
			{
				printManager.PrintDocument = printDocument;
			}
			printManager.PrintDocument.PrintPage += printManager.PrintPage;
			printManager.PrintDocument.BeginPrint += printManager.BeginPrint;
			printManager.PrintDocument.EndPrint += printManager.EndPrint;
		}

		private void FormatPrintLayout()
		{
			Cursor current = Cursor.Current;
			Cursor.Current = Cursors.WaitCursor;
			if (printLayout.ColScrollRegions.Count > 1)
			{
				printLayout.ColScrollRegions.Clear();
			}
			if (printLayout.RowScrollRegions.Count > 1)
			{
				printLayout.RowScrollRegions.Clear();
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in printLayout.SortedBands)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in sortedBand.Columns)
				{
					column.Header.ExclusiveColScrollRegion = null;
				}
			}
			if (RowPropertyCategories.Expanded != (RowPropertyCategories.Expanded & printLayout.RetainRowPropertyCategories))
			{
				printLayout.Rows.ExpandAll(recursive: true);
			}
			if (RowPropertyCategories.CompressedCardExpansionState != (RowPropertyCategories.CompressedCardExpansionState & printLayout.RetainRowPropertyCategories) && printLayout.AllowCardPrinting == AllowCardPrinting.RootBandOnly)
			{
				printLayout.Rows.ExpandAllCards();
			}
			Cursor.Current = current;
		}

		internal bool PrintDocumentHelper(UltraGridPrintDocument printDocument)
		{
			PrintHelper(null, (PrintDocument)(object)printDocument, printDocument.RowProperties);
			CancelablePrintEventArgs e = new CancelablePrintEventArgs(printManager.PrintDocument, printManager.DefaultLayoutInfo, PrintLayout);
			FireEvent(GridEventIds.InitializePrint, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (PrintLayout != null && printManager.DefaultLayoutInfo.FitWidthToPages != 0 && PrintLayout.AutoFitAllColumns)
			{
				PrintLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics(setScrollToBeginning: false);
			}
			FormatPrintLayout();
			return true;
		}

		public void PrintPreview(UltraGridLayout layout, PrintDocument printDocument, RowPropertyCategories retainRowPropertyCategories)
		{
			PrintHelper(layout, printDocument, retainRowPropertyCategories);
			PrintManager.CalledFromPrint = false;
			try
			{
				if (printManager.PrintDocument.PrinterSettings.PrinterName == "<no default printer>")
				{
					throw new NotSupportedException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_NotSupportedException_292"));
				}
				CancelablePrintPreviewEventArgs e = new CancelablePrintPreviewEventArgs(printManager.PrintDocument, printManager.DefaultLayoutInfo, printManager.PrintPreviewSettings, PrintLayout);
				FireEvent(GridEventIds.InitializePrintPreview, e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					if (PrintLayout != null && e.DefaultLogicalPageLayoutInfo.FitWidthToPages != 0 && PrintLayout.AutoFitAllColumns)
					{
						PrintLayout.GetColScrollRegions(initializeMetrics: false).DirtyMetrics(setScrollToBeginning: false);
					}
					FormatPrintLayout();
					printManager.ShowPrintPreviewDialog();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				DisposePrintHelper();
			}
		}

		internal void DisposePrintHelper()
		{
			if (printManager != null)
			{
				printManager.PrintDocument.PrintPage -= printManager.PrintPage;
				printManager.PrintDocument.BeginPrint -= printManager.BeginPrint;
				printManager.PrintDocument.EndPrint -= printManager.EndPrint;
				PrintManager.DisposePrinterMetricsGraphicsHelper();
			}
			if (printLayout != null)
			{
				printLayout.Dispose();
				printLayout = null;
			}
			printManager = null;
		}

			return (KeyActionMappingsBase)(object)KeyActionMappings;
		}

		protected internal override long GetCurrentState()
		{
			return (long)CurrentState;
		}

		protected internal override bool PerformKeyAction(Enum actionCode, bool shiftKeyDown, bool ctlKeyDown)
		{
			if (((KeyActionMappingsBase)KeyActionMappings).IsActionAllowed((Enum)(UltraGridAction)(object)actionCode, (long)CurrentState))
			{
				UltraGridAction ultraGridAction = (UltraGridAction)(object)actionCode;
				BeforeUltraGridPerformActionEventArgs e = new BeforeUltraGridPerformActionEventArgs(ultraGridAction);
				FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforePerformAction, e);
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					return false;
				}
				bool result = base.DisplayLayout.PerformAction(ultraGridAction, shiftKeyDown, ctlKeyDown);
				AfterUltraGridPerformActionEventArgs e2 = new AfterUltraGridPerformActionEventArgs(ultraGridAction);
				FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterPerformAction, e2);
				return result;
			}
			return false;
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.SelectItem(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection)
		{
			if (item is UltraGridCell { IsInEditMode: not false })
			{
				return false;
			}
			return InternalSelectItem(item, clearExistingSelection, select: true);
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.UnselectItem(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection)
		{
			return InternalSelectItem(item, clearExistingSelection, select: false);
		}

		internal bool InternalSelectItem(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			GridItemBase gridItemBase = item as GridItemBase;
			if (gridItemBase != null && !gridItemBase.Selectable)
			{
				if (clearExistingSelection)
				{
					ClearSelectedItemsOfType(gridItemBase);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if (!clearExistingSelection && select && item.IsSelected && this.selected != null && Selected.IsItemInCollection(item))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!clearExistingSelection && !IsItemSelectableWithCurrentSelection(item))
			{
				Selected.ClearItemsOfType(item);
			}
			Selected selected = CalcNewSelection(gridItemBase, clearExistingSelection, select);
			if (selected != null && this.selected != null && item != null && this.selected.IsSelectionSameForItemType(item.GetType(), selected))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (SelectNewSelection(item.GetType(), selected))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (base.DisplayLayout == null || !base.DisplayLayout.DontUpdateWhenSelecting)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool SelectNewSelection(Type type, Selected selected)
		{
			if (!base.DisplayLayout.ExitEditModeHelper())
			{
				return true;
			}
			BeforeSelectChangeEventArgs e = new BeforeSelectChangeEventArgs(type, selected);
			FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeSelectChange, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return true;
			}
			UpdateSelectedItems(selected);
			AfterSelectChangeEventArgs e2 = new AfterSelectChangeEventArgs(type);
			FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterSelectChange, e2);
			return false;
		}

		internal Selected CalcNewSelection(GridItemBase item, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			Selected selected = new Selected();
			if (!clearExistingSelection)
			{
				if (!(item is UltraGridRow) && Selected.Cells.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridCell cell in Selected.Cells)
					{
						selected.Cells.InternalAdd(cell);
					}
				}
				if (!(item is UltraGridCell) && Selected.Rows.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridRow row in Selected.Rows)
					{
						selected.Rows.InternalAdd(row);
					}
				}
				if (Selected.Columns.Count > 0)
				{
					foreach (ColumnHeader column in Selected.Columns)
					{
						selected.Columns.InternalAdd(column);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				bool flag = (Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Control) == Keys.Control;
				if (flag && (item is UltraGridCell || item is UltraGridRow) && Selected.Columns.Count > 0)
				{
					selected.SetColumns(Selected.Columns);
				}
				if (flag && (item.GetType() == typeof(ColumnHeader) || item.GetType() == typeof(GroupHeader)))
				{
					if (Selected.Cells.Count > 0)
					{
						selected.SetCells(Selected.Cells);
					}
					if (Selected.Rows.Count > 0)
					{
						selected.SetRows(Selected.Rows);
					}
				}
			}
			if (select)
			{
				item.AddToCollection(selected);
			}
			else
			{
				item.RemoveFromCollection(selected);
			}
			if (item != null && select)
			{
				EnsureItemsWithingMaxSelectedItemsBounds(item, selected);
			}
			return selected;
		}

		internal static void EnsureItemsWithingMaxSelectedItemsBounds(GridItemBase item, Selected newSelection)
		{
			if (item is UltraGridRow)
			{
				int maxSelectedRowsResolved = item.Band.MaxSelectedRowsResolved;
				if (maxSelectedRowsResolved > 0 && newSelection.Rows.Count > maxSelectedRowsResolved)
				{
					for (int num = newSelection.Rows.Count - 1; num >= maxSelectedRowsResolved; num--)
					{
						newSelection.Rows.Remove(newSelection.Rows[num]);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(item is UltraGridCell))
				{
					return;
				}
				int maxSelectedCellsResolved = item.Band.MaxSelectedCellsResolved;
				if (maxSelectedCellsResolved > 0 && newSelection.Cells.Count > maxSelectedCellsResolved)
				{
					for (int num2 = newSelection.Cells.Count - 1; num2 >= maxSelectedCellsResolved; num2--)
					{
						newSelection.Cells.Remove(newSelection.Cells[num2]);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal Selected CalcNewSelectionRange(GridItemBase item, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			Selected selected = new Selected();
			item.CalcSelectionRange(selected, clearExistingSelection, select, InitialSelection);
			EnsureItemsWithingMaxSelectedItemsBounds(item, selected);
			return selected;
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.ActivateItem(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			GridItemBase gridItemBase = item as GridItemBase;
			return gridItemBase.SetFocusAndActivate();
		}

		void ISelectionManager.SetPivotItem(ISelectableItem item, bool IsRangeSelect)
		{
			ISelectableItem selectableItem = ((UltraControlBase)this).GetSelectionManager().GetPivotItem(item);
			if (selectableItem is UltraGridRow { HiddenResolved: not false })
			{
				selectableItem = null;
			}
			if (IsRangeSelect && selectableItem != null)
			{
				return;
			}
			GridItemBase gridItemBase = item as GridItemBase;
			if (gridItemBase.PivotOnColScrollRegion)
			{
				base.ActiveColScrollRegion.SetPivotItem(gridItemBase);
			}
			else if (gridItemBase.PivotOnRowScrollRegion)
			{
				base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.SetPivotItem(gridItemBase);
				if (gridItemBase is UltraGridCell pivotCell)
				{
					base.ActiveColScrollRegion.SetPivotCell(pivotCell);
				}
			}
			cardAreaPivot = GetCardAreaFromItem(item);
		}

		ISelectableItem ISelectionManager.GetPivotItem(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			GridItemBase result = null;
			GridItemBase gridItemBase = item as GridItemBase;
			if (gridItemBase.PivotOnColScrollRegion)
			{
				result = GetActiveColScrollRegion(initializeMetrics: false).GetPivotItem();
			}
			else if (gridItemBase.PivotOnRowScrollRegion)
			{
				result = base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.GetPivotItem();
			}
			return result;
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.IsMaxSelectedItemsExceeded(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (item is UltraGridCell)
			{
				int num = ((base.DisplayLayout.ActiveCell != null) ? base.DisplayLayout.ActiveCell.Band.MaxSelectedCellsResolved : ((item != null) ? ((UltraGridCell)item).Band.MaxSelectedCellsResolved : 0));
				if (num > 0 && Selected.Cells.Count >= num)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else if (item is UltraGridRow)
			{
				int num2 = ((base.DisplayLayout.ActiveRow != null) ? base.DisplayLayout.ActiveRow.Band.MaxSelectedRowsResolved : ((item != null) ? ((UltraGridRow)item).Band.MaxSelectedRowsResolved : 0));
				if (num2 > 0 && Selected.Rows.Count >= num2)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		void ISelectionManager.SetInitialSelection(ISelectableItem item)
		{
			((GridItemBase)item).SetInitialSelection(Selected, InitialSelection);
		}

		void ISelectionManager.ClearInitialSelection()
		{
			InitialSelection.SetCells(null);
			InitialSelection.SetRows(null);
			InitialSelection.SetColumns(null);
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.SelectRange(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection)
		{
			return InternalSelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection, select: true);
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.UnselectRange(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection)
		{
			return InternalSelectRange(item, clearExistingSelection, select: false);
		}

		internal bool InternalSelectRange(ISelectableItem item, bool clearExistingSelection, bool select)
		{
			GridItemBase item2 = item as GridItemBase;
			Selected selected = CalcNewSelectionRange(item2, clearExistingSelection, select);
			if (SelectNewSelection(item.GetType(), selected))
			{
				return true;
			}
			((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
			return false;
		}

		internal void UpdateSelectedItems(Selected selected)
		{
			bool selectionOverlayBordersEnabled = base.DisplayLayout.SelectionOverlayBordersEnabled;
			List<GridItemBase> list = new List<GridItemBase>();
			if (Selected.HasCells)
			{
				SelectedCellsCollection cells = Selected.Cells;
				for (int i = 0; i < cells.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = cells[i];
					if (!selected.HasCells || !selected.Cells.Contains(ultraGridCell))
					{
						ultraGridCell.InternalSelect(value: false);
					}
					else if (selectionOverlayBordersEnabled)
					{
						list.Add(ultraGridCell);
					}
				}
			}
			if (selected.HasCells)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridCell cell in selected.Cells)
				{
					cell.InternalSelect(value: true);
				}
			}
			if (Selected.HasRows)
			{
				SelectedRowsCollection rows = Selected.Rows;
				for (int j = 0; j < rows.Count; j++)
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = Selected.Rows[j];
					if (!selected.HasRows || !selected.Rows.Contains(ultraGridRow))
					{
						ultraGridRow.InternalSelect(value: false);
					}
					else if (selectionOverlayBordersEnabled)
					{
						list.Add(ultraGridRow);
					}
				}
			}
			if (selected.HasRows)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridRow row in selected.Rows)
				{
					row.InternalSelect(value: true);
				}
			}
			if (Selected.HasColumns && !Selected.Columns.HasSameList(selected.Columns))
			{
				for (int k = 0; k < Selected.Columns.Count; k++)
				{
					GridItemBase gridItemBase = Selected.Columns[k];
					gridItemBase.InternalSelect(value: false);
				}
			}
			if (selected.HasColumns)
			{
				for (int l = 0; l < selected.Columns.Count; l++)
				{
					GridItemBase gridItemBase2 = selected.Columns[l];
					gridItemBase2.InternalSelect(value: true);
				}
			}
			this.selected.Rows.InternalSetList(selected.Rows);
			this.selected.Cells.InternalSetList(selected.Cells);
			this.selected.Columns.InternalSetList(selected.Columns);
			for (int m = 0; m < list.Count; m++)
			{
				list[m].InvalidateItemAllRegions();
			}
		}

		void ISelectionManager.TranslateItem(ref ISelectableItem item)
		{
			if (item is UltraGridCell && ((UltraGridCell)item).CellClickActionResolved == CellClickAction.RowSelect)
			{
				item = ((UltraGridCell)item).Row;
			}
		}

		ISelectableItem ISelectionManager.ItemNearestPoint(Point point, ISelectableItem lastItem)
		{
			if (lastItem == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			Control controlForGridDisplay = ControlForGridDisplay;
			UltraControlBase val = (UltraControlBase)(object)((controlForGridDisplay is UltraControlBase) ? controlForGridDisplay : null);
			point.X = Utilities.GetZoomedValue(point.X, val, true);
			point.Y = Utilities.GetZoomedValue(point.Y, val, true);
			bool flag = false;
			if (lastItem is ColumnHeader)
			{
				flag = ((ColumnHeader)lastItem).Band.UseRowLayoutResolved;
			}
			else if (lastItem is UltraGridCell)
			{
				flag = ((UltraGridCell)lastItem).Band.UseRowLayoutResolved;
			}
			else if (lastItem is GroupHeader)
			{
				flag = ((GroupHeader)lastItem).Band.UseRowLayoutResolved;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				UIElement uIElementInternal = base.DisplayLayout.UIElementInternal;
				RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement = ((uIElementInternal != null) ? ((RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)(object)uIElementInternal.GetDescendant(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement), new object[2] { base.ActiveColScrollRegion, base.ActiveRowScrollRegion })) : null);
				if (rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement != null)
				{
					if (lastItem is ColumnHeader)
					{
						return LayoutUtility.FindNearesetColumnHeader((UIElement)(object)rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement, ((ColumnHeader)lastItem).Band, point);
					}
					if (lastItem is UltraGridCell)
					{
						return LayoutUtility.FindNearesetCell((UIElement)(object)rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement, ((UltraGridCell)lastItem).Band, point);
					}
					if (lastItem is GroupHeader)
					{
						return LayoutUtility.FindNearesetGroupHeader((UIElement)(object)rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement, ((GroupHeader)lastItem).Band, point);
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			CardAreaUIElement cardAreaFromItem = GetCardAreaFromItem(lastItem);
			if (cardAreaFromItem != null)
			{
				return cardAreaFromItem.GetItemNearestPoint(point, lastItem);
			}
			Type type = lastItem.GetType();
			VisibleRow visibleRow = null;
			VisibleHeader visibleHeader = null;
			bool daggingRight = false;
			bool daggingDown = false;
			if (type == typeof(UltraGridRow) || typeof(UltraGridRow).IsAssignableFrom(type) || GridUtils.IsObjectOfType(type, typeof(UltraGridCell)))
			{
				if (base.ActiveRowScrollRegion == null)
				{
					return lastItem;
				}
				visibleRow = base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.GetNearestSameBandRow(point, (GridItemBase)lastItem);
			}
			if (type != typeof(UltraGridRow) && !typeof(UltraGridRow).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				if (base.ActiveColScrollRegion == null)
				{
					return lastItem;
				}
				visibleHeader = base.ActiveColScrollRegion.GetNearestSameBandHeader(point, (GridItemBase)lastItem);
			}
			if (type == typeof(UltraGridRow) || typeof(UltraGridRow).IsAssignableFrom(type))
			{
				if (visibleRow == null)
				{
					return lastItem;
				}
				return visibleRow.Row;
			}
			if (type == typeof(GroupHeader))
			{
				if (visibleHeader == null)
				{
					return lastItem;
				}
				return visibleHeader.Header;
			}
			if (type == typeof(ColumnHeader))
			{
				if (visibleHeader != null)
				{
					GridItemBase gridItemBase = HeaderItemFromPoint(point, base.ActiveRowScrollRegion, base.ActiveColScrollRegion);
					if (gridItemBase != null && gridItemBase.Band == ((GridItemBase)lastItem).Band && gridItemBase.GetType() == typeof(ColumnHeader))
					{
						ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = base.ActiveColScrollRegion;
						if ((!colScrollRegion.IsPivotItemFixedHeaderItem() || gridItemBase.Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, (HeaderBase)gridItemBase) || !gridItemBase.Band.AreNonFixedHeadersScrolledUnderneathFixedHeaders(colScrollRegion) || colScrollRegion.fixedToNonFixedAreaBoundaryCrossed) && (!gridItemBase.Band.IsHeaderFixed(colScrollRegion, (HeaderBase)gridItemBase) || colScrollRegion.IsPivotItemFixedHeaderItem() || !gridItemBase.Band.AreNonFixedHeadersScrolledUnderneathFixedHeaders(colScrollRegion)))
						{
							return (ColumnHeader)gridItemBase;
						}
					}
					HeaderBase header = visibleHeader.Header;
					int num = ((visibleHeader.Origin - visibleHeader.Header.Band.PreRowAreaExtent != 0) ? visibleHeader.Origin : 0);
					int num2 = point.X - (num - base.ActiveColScrollRegion.Position);
					if (visibleHeader.Header.Band.IsHeaderFixed(base.ActiveColScrollRegion, visibleHeader.Header))
					{
						num2 -= visibleHeader.Header.Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(base.ActiveColScrollRegion);
					}
					int offsetY = 1;
					if (((GridItemBase)lastItem).Band.LevelCountResolved > 1 && lastItem.GetType() != typeof(GroupHeader) && ((GridItemBase)lastItem).Band.GroupsDisplayed)
					{
						UIElement uIElement = base.DisplayLayout.GetUIElement(verify: false);
						if (uIElement != null)
						{
							uIElement = uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(HeaderUIElement), new object[3] { base.ActiveColScrollRegion, base.ActiveRowScrollRegion, lastItem });
							if (uIElement != null && uIElement.Parent != null)
							{
								uIElement = uIElement.Parent;
								offsetY = point.Y - (((GridItemBase)lastItem).Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight() + uIElement.Rect.Top);
							}
						}
					}
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = null;
					ultraGridColumn = ((!header.IsGroup) ? header.Column : header.Group.GetColumnAtOffset(null, num2, offsetY, daggingRight, daggingDown));
					if (ultraGridColumn != null)
					{
						return ultraGridColumn.Header;
					}
				}
			}
			else if (GridUtils.IsObjectOfType(type, typeof(UltraGridCell)) && visibleHeader != null && visibleRow != null)
			{
				UltraGridRow row = visibleRow.Row;
				HeaderBase header2 = visibleHeader.Header;
				int num3 = point.X - (visibleHeader.Origin + base.ActiveColScrollRegion.Origin - base.ActiveColScrollRegion.Position);
				if (visibleHeader.Header.Band.IsHeaderFixed(base.ActiveColScrollRegion, visibleHeader.Header))
				{
					num3 -= visibleHeader.Header.Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(base.ActiveColScrollRegion);
				}
				int offsetY2 = point.Y - visibleRow.GetTopOfRowInClient();
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = null;
				ultraGridColumn2 = ((!header2.IsGroup) ? header2.Column : header2.Group.GetColumnAtOffset(row, num3, offsetY2, daggingRight, daggingDown));
				if (ultraGridColumn2 != null)
				{
					UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = null;
					UltraGridRow row2 = visibleRow.Row;
					if (row2 != null && row2.SupportsCells)
					{
						ultraGridCell = row2.Cells[ultraGridColumn2];
					}
					if (ultraGridCell != null)
					{
						return ultraGridCell;
					}
				}
			}
			return lastItem;
		}

		private bool ContinueScrolling(ref Point mouseLoc)
		{
			MouseButtons mouseButtons = MouseButtons.Left;
			if ((Control.MouseButtons & mouseButtons) != mouseButtons)
			{
				return false;
			}
			mouseLoc = base.DisplayLayout.Grid.EditorContainerControl.PointToClient(Cursor.Position);
			return true;
		}

		void ISelectionManager.DoDragScrollVertical(int timerInterval)
		{
			Point mouseLoc = new Point(0, 0);
			if (ContinueScrolling(ref mouseLoc))
			{
				if (cardAreaPivot != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)cardAreaPivot).Disposed)
				{
					cardAreaPivot.ScrollCardVertically(mouseLoc);
				}
				else
				{
					base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.DoDragScroll(mouseLoc, timerInterval);
				}
			}
		}

		void ISelectionManager.DoDragScrollHorizontal(int timerInterval)
		{
			Point mouseLoc = new Point(0, 0);
			if (!ContinueScrolling(ref mouseLoc))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (cardAreaPivot != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)cardAreaPivot).Disposed)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
				if (mouseLoc.X > ((UIElement)cardAreaPivot).Rect.Left + ((UIElement)cardAreaPivot).Rect.Width / 2)
				{
					cardAreaPivot.ScrollCardArea(1);
				}
				else
				{
					cardAreaPivot.ScrollCardArea(-1);
				}
				((UltraControlBase)this).Update();
			}
			else
			{
				base.ActiveColScrollRegion.DoDragScroll(mouseLoc, timerInterval);
			}
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.DoesDragNeedScrollVertical(Point mouseLoc, ref int timerInterval)
		{
			if (cardAreaPivot != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)cardAreaPivot).Disposed)
			{
				return cardAreaPivot.DoesDragNeedScrollVertical(mouseLoc, ref timerInterval);
			}
			if (isDragging && dragEffect != null && dragEffect.DragStrategy != null && dragEffect.DragStrategy is DragStrategyColumn)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return base.ActiveRowScrollRegion.DoesDragNeedScroll(mouseLoc, ref timerInterval);
		}

		bool ISelectionManager.DoesDragNeedScrollHorizontal(Point mouseLoc, ref int timerInterval)
		{
			if (cardAreaPivot != null && !((DisposableObject)(object)cardAreaPivot).Disposed)
			{
				return cardAreaPivot.DoesDragNeedScrollHorizontal(mouseLoc, ref timerInterval);
			}
			return base.ActiveColScrollRegion.DoesDragNeedScroll(mouseLoc, ref timerInterval);
		}

		void ISelectionManager.OnMouseUp(ref MouseMessageInfo msginfo)
		{
		}

		private GridItemBase HeaderItemFromPoint(Point point, RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion, ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion)
		{
			GridItemBase result = null;
			UIElement uIElement = base.DisplayLayout.GetUIElement(verify: false);
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				UIElement val = uIElement.ElementFromPoint(point);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val = val.GetAncestor(typeof(HeaderUIElement));
				}
				if (val != null)
				{
					UIElement ancestor = val.GetAncestor(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement));
					RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement = (RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)(object)ancestor;
					if (rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement != null && (rowScrollRegion == null || rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement.RowScrollRegion == rowScrollRegion) && (colScrollRegion == null || rowColRegionIntersectionUIElement.ColScrollRegion == colScrollRegion))
					{
						result = ((HeaderUIElement)(object)val).Header;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected bool ShouldSerializeRowUpdateCancelAction()
		{
			return rowUpdateCancelAction != RowUpdateCancelAction.CancelUpdate;
		}

		public void ResetRowUpdateCancelAction()
		{
			RowUpdateCancelAction = RowUpdateCancelAction.CancelUpdate;
		}

		private void CopyPropertiesToPrintRow(UltraGridRow printRow)
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = printRow.Layout;
			if (ultraGridLayout != null && (ultraGridLayout.IsPrintLayout || ultraGridLayout.IsExportLayout))
			{
				UltraGridRow rowFromPrintRow = GetRowFromPrintRow(printRow, create: false);
				if (rowFromPrintRow != null)
				{
					printRow.CopyRowPropertiesFrom(rowFromPrintRow, ultraGridLayout.RetainRowPropertyCategories);
				}
			}
		}

		private static UltraGridRow FindAncestorGroupByRow(UltraGridColumn column, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			while (row != null)
			{
				if (row is UltraGridGroupByRow)
				{
					UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = (UltraGridGroupByRow)row;
					if (column.CanInitializeFrom(ultraGridGroupByRow.Column))
					{
						return ultraGridGroupByRow;
					}
				}
				row = row.ParentRow;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public UltraGridRow GetRowFromPrintRow(UltraGridRow printRow)
		{
			return GetRowFromPrintRow(printRow, create: true);
		}

		public UltraGridRow GetRowFromPrintRow(UltraGridRow printRow, bool create)
		{
			return GetCorrespondingRow(printRow, base.DisplayLayout, create);
		}

		public UltraGridRow GetPrintRowFromRow(UltraGridRow gridRow, UltraGridLayout layout, bool create)
		{
			return GetCorrespondingRow(gridRow, layout, create);
		}

		public RowsCollection GetRowsFromPrintRows(RowsCollection printRows, bool create)
		{
			return GetCorrespondingRows(printRows, base.DisplayLayout, create);
		}

		public RowsCollection GetPrintRowsFromRows(RowsCollection gridRows, UltraGridLayout layout, bool create)
		{
			return GetCorrespondingRows(gridRows, layout, create);
		}

		private UltraGridRow GetCorrespondingRow(UltraGridRow originalRow, UltraGridLayout layout, bool create)
		{
			if (originalRow == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (originalRow is UltraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow = (UltraGridGroupByRow)originalRow;
				UltraGridRow correspondingRow = GetCorrespondingRow(ultraGridGroupByRow.FindFirstRegularRow(), layout, create);
				return FindAncestorGroupByRow(ultraGridGroupByRow.Column, correspondingRow);
			}
			UltraGridBand band = originalRow.Band;
			if (band.ParentBand == null)
			{
				return layout.Rows.GetRowFromPrintRow(originalRow, create);
			}
			UltraGridRow correspondingRow2 = GetCorrespondingRow(originalRow.FindActualAncestorRow, layout, create: true);
			if (correspondingRow2 == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridBand bandFromPrintBand = GetBandFromPrintBand(originalRow.Band, layout);
			if (bandFromPrintBand != null && (create || correspondingRow2.HaveChildRowsBeenCreated(bandFromPrintBand)) && correspondingRow2.ChildBands != null)
			{
				if (!correspondingRow2.ChildBands.Exists(bandFromPrintBand))
				{
					return null;
				}
				return correspondingRow2.ChildBands[bandFromPrintBand].Rows.GetRowFromPrintRow(originalRow, create);
			}
			return null;
		}

		private RowsCollection GetCorrespondingRows(RowsCollection originalRows, UltraGridLayout layout, bool create)
		{
			if (originalRows == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridRow parentRow = originalRows.ParentRow;
			if (parentRow == null)
			{
				return layout.Rows;
			}
			UltraGridRow correspondingRow = GetCorrespondingRow(parentRow, layout, create);
			if (correspondingRow is UltraGridGroupByRow ultraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				return ultraGridGroupByRow.Rows;
			}
			return correspondingRow.ChildBands[originalRows.Band.Key].Rows;
		}

		private UltraGridBand GetBandFromPrintBand(UltraGridBand originalBand, UltraGridLayout layout)
		{
			if (originalBand == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in layout.SortedBands)
			{
				if (sortedBand.Key == originalBand.Key && sortedBand.HierarchicalLevel == originalBand.HierarchicalLevel)
				{
					return sortedBand;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void Export(IUltraGridExporter exporter)
		{
			if (exporter == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("exporter");
			}
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = new UltraGridLayout();
			try
			{
				VerifyExportInProgress(async: false);
				PrepareForExport(ultraGridLayout, async: false);
				exporter.BeginExport(ultraGridLayout, ultraGridLayout.Rows);
				bool canceled = false;
				try
				{
					canceled = !ultraGridLayout.Rows.InternalTraverseRowsHelper(exporter);
				}
				finally
				{
					exportInProgress = false;
				}
				exporter.EndExport(canceled);
			}
			finally
			{
				ultraGridLayout.Dispose();
			}
		}

		private void InvalidateActiveRowCell()
		{
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ActiveCell;
			UltraGridRow activeRow = base.ActiveRow;
			if (ultraGridCell != null)
			{
				ultraGridCell.InvalidateItem();
			}
			else
			{
				activeRow?.InvalidateItem();
			}
		}
