			AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(AccessibleEvents.Focus, 0);
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnGotFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnLostFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnLostFocus(e);
			InvalidateActiveRowCell();
		}

		private static void ApplyBandLevelXsdConstraints(XsdValueSetConstraint xsdValueSetConstraint, UltraGridBand band, XsdConstraintFlags constraintFlags)
		{
			if (band != null)
			{
				if (xsdValueSetConstraint.HasMaxOccurrences && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.MaxRows) != 0)
				{
					band.MaxRows = xsdValueSetConstraint.MaxOccurrences;
					band.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.MaxRows;
				}
				if (xsdValueSetConstraint.HasMinOccurrences && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.MinRows) != 0)
				{
					band.MinRows = xsdValueSetConstraint.MinOccurrences;
					band.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.MinRows;
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ApplyColumnLevelXsdConstraints(XsdValueConstraint xsdValueConstraint, UltraGridColumn column, XsdConstraintFlags constraintFlags)
		{
			//IL_01cb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d1: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (column == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (xsdValueConstraint.HasDefaultValue && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.DefaultValue) != 0)
			{
				object obj = ValueConstraint.ValueToDataValue(xsdValueConstraint.DefaultValue, column.DataType, (IFormatProvider)null, (string)null);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					column.DefaultCellValue = obj;
					column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.DefaultValue;
				}
			}
			ValueConstraint constraint = xsdValueConstraint.Constraint;
			if (constraint.HasEnumeration && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.Enumeration) != 0)
			{
				column.ValueList = constraint.Enumeration;
				column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.Enumeration;
			}
			if (constraint.HasFixedValue && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.FixedValue) != 0)
			{
				object obj2 = ValueConstraint.ValueToDataValue(constraint.FixedValue, column.DataType, (IFormatProvider)null, (string)null);
				if (obj2 != null)
				{
					column.DefaultCellValue = obj2;
					column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.FixedValue;
					column.Constraint.FixedValue = obj2;
				}
			}
			if (constraint.HasMaxExclusive && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.MaxExclusive) != 0)
			{
				column.MaxValueExclusive = constraint.MaxExclusive;
				column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.MaxExclusive;
			}
			if (constraint.HasMaxInclusive && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.MaxInclusive) != 0)
			{
				column.MaxValue = constraint.MaxInclusive;
				column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.MaxInclusive;
			}
			if (constraint.HasMaxLength && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.MaxLength) != 0)
			{
				column.MaxLength = constraint.MaxLength;
				column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.MaxLength;
			}
			if (constraint.HasMinExclusive && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.MinExclusive) != 0)
			{
				column.MinValueExclusive = constraint.MinExclusive;
				column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.MinExclusive;
			}
			if (constraint.HasMinInclusive && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.MinInclusive) != 0)
			{
				column.MinValue = constraint.MinInclusive;
				column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.MinInclusive;
			}
			if (constraint.HasMinLength && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.MinLength) != 0)
			{
				column.MinLength = constraint.MinLength;
				column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.MinLength;
			}
			if (constraint.HasNullable && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.Nullable) != 0)
			{
				column.Nullable = (((int)constraint.Nullable != 1) ? Nullable.Disallow : Nullable.Automatic);
				column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.Nullable;
			}
			if (constraint.HasRegexPattern && (constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.RegexPattern) != 0)
			{
				column.RegexPattern = constraint.RegexPattern;
				column.XsdSuppliedConstraints |= XsdConstraintFlags.RegexPattern;
			}
		}

		private static void ClearBandLevelXsdConstraints(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (band != null)
			{
				if ((band.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.MaxRows) != 0)
				{
					band.ResetMaxRows();
				}
				if ((band.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.MinRows) != 0)
				{
					band.ResetMinRows();
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ClearColumnLevelXsdConstraints(UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			if (column != null)
			{
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.DefaultValue) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetDefaultCellValue();
				}
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.Enumeration) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetValueList();
				}
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.FixedValue) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetDefaultCellValue();
				}
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.MaxExclusive) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetMaxValueExclusive();
				}
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.MaxInclusive) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetMaxValue();
				}
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.MaxLength) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetMaxLength();
				}
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.MinExclusive) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetMinValueExclusive();
				}
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.MinInclusive) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetMinValue();
				}
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.MinLength) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetMinLength();
				}
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.Nullable) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetNullable();
				}
				if ((column.XsdSuppliedConstraints & XsdConstraintFlags.RegexPattern) != 0)
				{
					column.ResetRegexPattern();
				}
			}
		}

		public void ClearXsdConstraints()
		{
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands)
			{
				ClearBandLevelXsdConstraints(sortedBand);
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in sortedBand.Columns)
				{
					ClearColumnLevelXsdConstraints(column);
				}
			}
			if (((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
			}
		}

		public void EnforceXsdConstraints(Stream stream)
		{
			EnforceXsdConstraints(stream, XsdConstraintFlags.All);
		}

		public void EnforceXsdConstraints(string filePath)
		{
			EnforceXsdConstraints(filePath, XsdConstraintFlags.All);
		}

		public void EnforceXsdConstraints(Stream stream, XsdConstraintFlags constraintFlags)
		{
			XPathDocument xpathDoc = new XPathDocument(stream);
			EnforceXsdConstraintsHelper(xpathDoc, constraintFlags);
		}

		public void EnforceXsdConstraints(string filePath, XsdConstraintFlags constraintFlags)
		{
			XPathDocument xpathDoc = new XPathDocument(filePath);
			EnforceXsdConstraintsHelper(xpathDoc, constraintFlags);
		}

		private void EnforceXsdConstraintsHelper(XPathDocument xpathDoc, XsdConstraintFlags constraintFlags)
		{
			//IL_003e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0044: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (base.DataSource == null)
			{
				throw new Exception(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_UltraGrid_XSD_MissingDataSource"));
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands)
			{
				string bandNameFromDataSource = GetBandNameFromDataSource(sortedBand);
				XsdValueSetConstraint val = new XsdValueSetConstraint(bandNameFromDataSource, xpathDoc);
				if (!val.FoundValueSet)
				{
					continue;
				}
				ApplyBandLevelXsdConstraints(val, sortedBand, constraintFlags);
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in sortedBand.Columns)
				{
					string key = column.Key;
					XsdValueConstraint constraintsOnXsdValue = val.GetConstraintsOnXsdValue(key);
					if (constraintsOnXsdValue != null && constraintsOnXsdValue.FoundValue)
					{
						if ((constraintFlags & XsdConstraintFlags.ImplicitXsdBaseTypeConstraints) == 0)
						{
							constraintsOnXsdValue.Constraint.ValidateAsType = (ValidateAsType)0;
						}
						ApplyColumnLevelXsdConstraints(constraintsOnXsdValue, column, constraintFlags);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static string GetBandNameFromDataSource(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			DataView dataView = band.List as DataView;
			if (dataView == null && band.List is DataRowView dataRowView)
			{
				dataView = dataRowView.DataView;
			}
			if (dataView != null && dataView.Table != null)
			{
				return dataView.Table.TableName;
			}
			return band.Key;
		}

		internal bool StartGridBagLayoutDrag(IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo itemBeingDragged, bool isGroupByButton)
		{
			ResetGridBagLayoutDragStrategy();
			if (!CreateLayoutDragStrategy(itemBeingDragged, GridBagLayoutDragManager.GridBagLayoutDragType.HeaderReposition))
			{
				return false;
			}
			GridBagLayoutDragManager gridBagLayoutDragManager = gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.GridBagLayoutDragManager as GridBagLayoutDragManager;
			gridBagLayoutDragManager.isGroupByButtonBeingDragged = isGroupByButton;
			UIElement[] dragElements = gridBagLayoutDragManager.GetDragElements(itemBeingDragged, isGroupByButton);
			if (dragElements != null)
			{
				Point mouseOffSet = GridBagLayoutDragManager.GetMouseOffSet(dragElements);
				DragDropIndicatorSettings val = ((itemBeingDragged.Band != null) ? itemBeingDragged.Band.DragDropIndicatorSettingsResolved : null);
				return gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.DragStart(dragElements, mouseOffSet, 0.6, val);
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void DragMoveHelper(Point pointInControlCoords, bool isMultiSelectColumnChooser = false)
		{
			CurrentCursor currentCursor = CurrentCursor.Default;
			bool flag = false;
			if (gridBagLayoutDragStrategy != null)
			{
				gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.DragMove(pointInControlCoords);
				DragEffect.HideDragIndicator();
				if (((GridBagLayoutDragManager)(object)gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.GridBagLayoutDragManager).IsPointInValidLayoutArea(pointInControlCoords))
				{
					DragEffect.HideDropGuides();
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag = true;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				DragEffect.OnDragMove(pointInControlCoords, isMultiSelectColumnChooser);
				currentCursor = DragEffect.CurrentCursor;
			}
			ColumnChooser_OnDragMove(pointInControlCoords, out var cursorToDisplay);
			if (CurrentCursor.Default != cursorToDisplay)
			{
				currentCursor = cursorToDisplay;
			}
			GridUtils.SetCursorToCurrent(this, currentCursor);
		}

		internal bool EndGridBagLayoutDrag(Point pointInGridCoords)
		{
			bool result = gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.DragEnd(pointInGridCoords);
			ResetGridBagLayoutDragStrategy();
			return result;
		}

		private static bool CreateLayoutDragStrategy(IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo itemBeingDragged, GridBagLayoutDragManager.GridBagLayoutDragType dragType)
		{
			//IL_000d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0013: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0016: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_003a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0040: Expected O, but got Unknown
			UltraGridBand band = itemBeingDragged.Band;
			if (band == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if ((int)band.AllowRowLayoutColMovingResolved == 1 && (int)band.AllowGroupByResolved == 2)
			{
				return false;
			}
			GridBagLayoutDragManager gridBagLayoutDragManager = new GridBagLayoutDragManager(itemBeingDragged, dragType);
			if (!(gridBagLayoutDragManager.Grid is UltraGrid ultraGrid))
			{
				return false;
			}
			GridBagLayoutDragStrategy val = new GridBagLayoutDragStrategy((IGridBagLayoutDragManager)(object)gridBagLayoutDragManager);
			ultraGrid.gridBagLayoutDragStrategy = val;
			return true;
		}

		internal void ResetGridBagLayoutDragStrategy()
		{
			if (gridBagLayoutDragStrategy != null)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)gridBagLayoutDragStrategy).Dispose();
				gridBagLayoutDragStrategy = null;
			}
		}

		internal bool StartRowLayoutSpanResizeDrag(IProvideRowLayoutColumnInfo itemBeingDragged, bool isDragSpanHorizontal, bool isHeaderBeingDragged)
		{
			ResetGridBagLayoutDragStrategy();
			GridBagLayoutDragManager.GridBagLayoutDragType dragType = (isHeaderBeingDragged ? GridBagLayoutDragManager.GridBagLayoutDragType.HeaderSpanResize : GridBagLayoutDragManager.GridBagLayoutDragType.CellSpanResize);
			CreateLayoutDragStrategy(itemBeingDragged, dragType);
			bool areColumnHeadersInSeparateArea = GridBagLayoutDragManager.GetAreColumnHeadersInSeparateArea(itemBeingDragged);
			bool cardView = itemBeingDragged.Band.CardView;
			LabelPosition labelPositionResolved = itemBeingDragged.RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPositionResolved;
			bool flag = labelPositionResolved == LabelPosition.Left || labelPositionResolved == LabelPosition.Right;
			return gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.DragSpanStart(isDragSpanHorizontal, areColumnHeadersInSeparateArea, isHeaderBeingDragged, cardView, flag, itemBeingDragged is UltraGridGroup, itemBeingDragged.Band.DragDropIndicatorBrushColorResolved);
		}

		internal void DragSpanMove(Point pointInControlCoords, UIElement dragElement, ILayoutItem headerDragItem, ILayoutItem columnDragItem)
		{
			if (gridBagLayoutDragStrategy != null)
			{
				gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.DragSpanMove(pointInControlCoords, dragElement, headerDragItem, columnDragItem);
			}
		}

		internal void DragSpanEnd(Point pointInControlCoords, UIElement dragElement, ILayoutItem headerDragItem, ILayoutItem columnDragItem)
		{
			if (gridBagLayoutDragStrategy != null)
			{
				gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.DragSpanEnd(pointInControlCoords, dragElement, headerDragItem, columnDragItem);
				ResetGridBagLayoutDragStrategy();
			}
		}

		internal override UltraGridColumn[] GetItemsBeingDragged(out bool isDraggingGroupByButton)
		{
			List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>();
			GridBagLayoutDragManager gridBagLayoutDragManager = ((gridBagLayoutDragStrategy == null) ? null : (gridBagLayoutDragStrategy.GridBagLayoutDragManager as GridBagLayoutDragManager));
			if (gridBagLayoutDragManager != null)
			{
				RowLayoutColumnInfo dragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo = gridBagLayoutDragManager.GetDragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo();
				if (dragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo != null && dragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo.Column != null)
				{
					list.Add(dragItemRowLayoutColumnInfo.Column);
				}
			}
			else if (DragEffect != null && DragEffect.DragStrategy != null && DragEffect.DragStrategy.DragItems != null)
			{
				foreach (HeaderBase dragItem in DragEffect.DragStrategy.DragItems)
				{
					if (dragItem is ColumnHeader)
					{
						list.Add(((ColumnHeader)dragItem).Column);
					}
				}
			}
			isDraggingGroupByButton = ((DragEffect != null) ? (DragEffect.DragStrategy as DragStrategyColumn) : null)?.IsDraggingGroupByButton ?? false;
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		internal void ScrollSelectionIntoView()
		{
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = base.DisplayLayout;
			Selected selected = Selected;
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = displayLayout?.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = displayLayout?.ActiveColScrollRegion;
			if (displayLayout != null && selected != null && !displayLayout.Disposed && rowScrollRegion != null && colScrollRegion != null)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (!((UltraControlBase)this).IsUpdating)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)this).BeginUpdate();
					flag = true;
				}
				if (selected.HasRows)
				{
					UltraGridRow row = selected.Rows[0];
					UltraGridRow row2 = selected.Rows[selected.Rows.Count - 1];
					rowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(row2);
					rowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(row);
				}
				else if (selected.HasCells)
				{
					UltraGridCell cell = selected.Cells[0];
					UltraGridCell cell2 = selected.Cells[selected.Cells.Count - 1];
					rowScrollRegion.ScrollCellIntoView(cell2, colScrollRegion);
					rowScrollRegion.ScrollCellIntoView(cell, colScrollRegion);
				}
				else if (selected.HasColumns)
				{
					ColumnHeader header = selected.Columns[0];
					ColumnHeader header2 = selected.Columns[selected.Columns.Count - 1];
					colScrollRegion.ScrollHeaderIntoView(header2, leftAlign: false);
					colScrollRegion.ScrollHeaderIntoView(header, leftAlign: false);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)this).EndUpdate();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void ScrollActiveItemIntoView()
		{
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = base.DisplayLayout;
			Selected selected = Selected;
			UltraGridRow activeRow = base.ActiveRow;
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ActiveCell;
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = displayLayout?.ActiveRowScrollRegion;
			ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = displayLayout?.ActiveColScrollRegion;
			if (displayLayout == null || displayLayout.Disposed || rowScrollRegion == null || colScrollRegion == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ultraGridCell != null)
			{
				UIElement uIElement = ultraGridCell.GetUIElement();
				if (uIElement != null && uIElement.ClipRect == uIElement.Rect)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			else if (activeRow != null)
			{
				UIElement uIElement2 = activeRow.GetUIElement();
				if (uIElement2 != null && uIElement2.ClipRect == uIElement2.Rect)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (!((UltraControlBase)this).IsUpdating)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).BeginUpdate();
				flag = true;
			}
			if (ultraGridCell != null)
			{
				colScrollRegion.ScrollCellIntoView(ultraGridCell, rowScrollRegion);
			}
			else if (activeRow != null)
			{
				rowScrollRegion.ScrollRowIntoView(activeRow);
			}
			else if (selected != null && selected.HasColumns)
			{
				ColumnHeader header = selected.Columns[0];
				ColumnHeader header2 = selected.Columns[selected.Columns.Count - 1];
				colScrollRegion.ScrollHeaderIntoView(header2, leftAlign: false);
				colScrollRegion.ScrollHeaderIntoView(header, leftAlign: false);
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)this).EndUpdate();
			}
		}

		internal bool SelectNewSelection(IEnumerable newCells)
		{
			Selected selected = new Selected();
			foreach (UltraGridCell newCell in newCells)
			{
				selected.Cells.InternalAdd(newCell, validateAlreadyExists: false);
			}
			return SelectNewSelection(typeof(UltraGridCell), selected);
		}

			{
				base.DisplayLayout.ClearUndoHistoryHelper(force: true);
			}
		}

		}

		private void HookComponentChangeService()
		{
			if (!hookedIntoComponentChangeService && ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) is IComponentChangeService componentChangeService)
			{
				hookedIntoComponentChangeService = true;
				componentChangeService.ComponentRemoving += OnComponentRemoving;
				componentChangeService.ComponentRename += OnComponentRename;
			}
		}

		private void UnhookComponentChangeService()
		{
			if (hookedIntoComponentChangeService && ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) is IComponentChangeService componentChangeService)
			{
				hookedIntoComponentChangeService = false;
				componentChangeService.ComponentRemoving -= OnComponentRemoving;
				componentChangeService.ComponentRename -= OnComponentRename;
			}
		}

		private void OnComponentRename(object sender, ComponentRenameEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Component is UltraGridRowEditTemplate)
			{
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate ultraGridRowEditTemplate = (UltraGridRowEditTemplate)e.Component;
				if (ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Grid == this && base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands.Contains(ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Band))
				{
					PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(UltraGridBand));
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = properties.Find("RowEditTemplate", ignoreCase: false);
					propertyDescriptor.SetValue(ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Band, e.Component);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnComponentRemoving(object sender, ComponentEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Component == this)
			{
				UnhookComponentChangeService();
			}
			else if (e.Component is UltraGridRowEditTemplate)
			{
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate ultraGridRowEditTemplate = (UltraGridRowEditTemplate)e.Component;
				if (ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Grid == this && base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands.Contains(ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Band))
				{
					PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(UltraGridBand));
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = properties.Find("RowEditTemplate", ignoreCase: false);
					propertyDescriptor.SetValue(ultraGridRowEditTemplate.Band, null);
				}
			}
		}

		public UltraGridColumn GetColumnFromPrintColumn(UltraGridColumn printColumn)
		{
			if (printColumn == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridBand band = printColumn.Band;
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = base.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[band.Index];
			if (band.Key != ultraGridBand.Key)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!ultraGridBand.Columns.Exists(printColumn.Key))
			{
				if (!printColumn.IsBound && string.IsNullOrEmpty(printColumn.Key))
				{
					foreach (UltraGridColumn column in ultraGridBand.Columns)
					{
						if (column.UnboundRelativePosition == printColumn.UnboundRelativePosition)
						{
							return column;
						}
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
			return ultraGridBand.Columns[printColumn.Key];
		}

		public SummarySettings GetSummarySettingsFromPrintSummarySettings(SummarySettings summarySettings)
		{
			UltraGridBand band = summarySettings.Band;
			if (band == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = band.Layout;
			if (ultraGridLayout == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (!ultraGridLayout.IsExportLayout && !ultraGridLayout.IsPrintLayout)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException("The specified SummarySettings object does not belong to a Print or Export layout");
			}
			return summarySettings.sourceSummarySettings;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			hasFiredCellClick = false;
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnMouseDown(e);
		}

		internal void PrepareForExport(UltraGridLayout exportLayout, bool async)
		{
			exportLayout.InternalSetIsExportLayout(isExportLayout: true);
			exportLayout.RetainRowPropertyCategories = RowPropertyCategories.All;
			exportLayout.InitGrid(this);
			base.DisplayLayout.EnsureDataSourceAttached();
			try
			{
				printing_DontInitializeRows = true;
				if (base.DisplayLayout != null)
				{
					exportLayout.MaxBandDepth = base.DisplayLayout.MaxBandDepth;
				}
				exportLayout.ListManagerUpdated();
				exportLayout.InitializeFrom(base.DisplayLayout, PropertyCategories.All);
				base.DisplayLayout.EnsureAllFormulasCalculated();
			}
			finally
			{
				printing_DontInitializeRows = false;
				exportLayout.ApplyLoadedBands();
				UltraGridRow.CopyPrintRelatedSettings(base.Rows, exportLayout.Rows);
			}
		}

		private void RemoveAsynchExportStatusDisplay()
		{
			if (((Control)(object)this).Controls.Contains(asyncExportStatusDisplay))
			{
				((Control)(object)this).Controls.Remove(asyncExportStatusDisplay);
				((ControlUIElementBase)base.DisplayLayout.UIElement).ResumeSyncMouseEnter();
				((Control)(object)this).TabStop = originalGridTabStop;
				asyncExportStatusDisplay.Status = null;
			}
		}

		private void VerifyExportInProgress(bool async)
		{
			if (exportInProgress || IsExportAsyncInProgress)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ExportAlreadyInProgress"));
			}
			if (IsExportAsyncPending)
			{
				throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ExportAlreadyInProgress"));
			}
			if (!async)
			{
				exportInProgress = true;
			}
		}

		public void CancelAsynchronousExport()
		{
			AsynchronousExportManager.FindExportOperation(this)?.Cancel();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseWheel(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!IsExportAsyncInProgress && !IsExportAsyncPending)
			{
				base.OnMouseWheel(e);
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		public void ExportAsync(IUltraGridExporterAsynch exporter)
		{
			if (exporter == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException("exporter");
			}
			VerifyExportInProgress(async: true);
			((ControlUIElementBase)base.DisplayLayout.UIElement).SuspendSyncMouseEnter();
			AsyncExportStatusDisplay.ExportDocumentType = exporter.ExportDocumentType;
			AsyncExportStatusDisplay.Size = ((Control)(object)this).Size;
			AsyncExportStatusDisplay.Visible = false;
			AsyncExportStatusDisplay.TabIndex = ((Control)(object)this).TabIndex;
			((Control)(object)this).Controls.Add(AsyncExportStatusDisplay);
			AsynchronousExportManager.AddExportOperation(this, exporter);
			AsyncExportStatusDisplay.Visible = true;
			if (((Control)(object)this).ContainsFocus)
			{
				AsyncExportStatusDisplay.Focus();
			}
			originalGridTabStop = ((Control)(object)this).TabStop;
			((Control)(object)this).TabStop = false;
		}

		private void asyncExportStatusDisplay_StatusChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			AsyncExportStatusDisplay asyncExportStatusDisplay = (AsyncExportStatusDisplay)sender;
			AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase? status = asyncExportStatusDisplay.Status;
			if (status.HasValue)
			{
				switch (status.GetValueOrDefault())
				{
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Completed:
				{
					System.Windows.Forms.Timer timer = Utilities.CreateTimer();
					timer.Interval = 2000;
					timer.Tick += asyncExportCompleteTimer_Tick;
					timer.Start();
					break;
				}
				case AsyncExportOperation.AsyncExportPhase.Cancelled:
					RemoveAsynchExportStatusDisplay();
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void asyncExportCompleteTimer_Tick(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			System.Windows.Forms.Timer timer = (System.Windows.Forms.Timer)sender;
			timer.Stop();
			timer.Tick -= asyncExportCompleteTimer_Tick;
			timer.Dispose();
			RemoveAsynchExportStatusDisplay();
		}

		internal static void VerifyRowEditTemplateProxyEnabledStates(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row != null)
			{
				UltraGridRowEditTemplate rowEditTemplateResolved = row.RowEditTemplateResolved;
				if (rowEditTemplateResolved != null && (rowEditTemplateResolved.IsShown || rowEditTemplateResolved.Row != null))
				{
					rowEditTemplateResolved.VerifyProxyEnabledStates();
				}
			}
		}

		bool IAutoEditMode.EnterEditMode(out EmbeddableEditorBase editor)
		{
			editor = null;
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ActiveCell;
			if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.Column.AutoEditModeResolved)
			{
				editor = ultraGridCell.EditorResolved;
				if (!editor.SupportsSelectableText)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if ((editor is EditorWithText || editor is ControlContainerEditor) && editor.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return true;
				}
				if (ultraGridCell.CanEnterEditMode)
				{
					return !ultraGridCell.EnterEditMode(byMouse: false, showingDropDown: false);
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void SynchImeMode(bool restoreOnly = false)
		{
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ActiveCell;
			if (!restoreOnly && ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.Column.AutoEditModeResolved)
			{
				lastGridImeMode = ((Control)(object)this).ImeMode;
				((Control)(object)this).ImeMode = activeCell.Column.ImeMode;
			}
			else if (lastGridImeMode.HasValue)
			{
				((Control)(object)this).ImeMode = lastGridImeMode.Value;
				lastGridImeMode = null;
			}
		}

		public bool EditHeader(HeaderBase header)
		{
			HeaderUIElement headerUIElement = header.GetUIElement() as HeaderUIElement;
			if (headerUIElement == null)
			{
				UltraGridLayout displayLayout = base.DisplayLayout;
				displayLayout.ActiveColScrollRegion.ScrollHeaderIntoView(header, leftAlign: false);
				headerUIElement = header.GetUIElement() as HeaderUIElement;
			}
			if (headerUIElement == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return EditHeader(headerUIElement);
		}

		public bool EditHeader(HeaderUIElement headerUIElement)
		{
			HeaderBase header = headerUIElement.Header;
			headerUIElement.EnterEditMode();
			return header.EditorResolved.IsInEditMode;
		}

		private void OnEditorKeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)(object)this).OnKeyDown(e);
			if (e.Handled)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (e.KeyData == Keys.Tab || e.KeyData == (Keys.Tab | Keys.Shift))
			{
				if (!((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor.IsInEditMode || ((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor.ExitEditMode(false, true))
				{
					bool focusToNextControl = true;
					if ((Control.ModifierKeys & Keys.Shift) == Keys.Shift)
					{
						focusToNextControl = false;
					}
					((UltraControlBase)this).SetFocusToNextControl(focusToNextControl);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editor = ((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor;
				IEmbeddableTextBoxListener val = (IEmbeddableTextBoxListener)(object)((editor is IEmbeddableTextBoxListener) ? editor : null);
				if (val != null)
				{
					val.OnKeyDown(e);
				}
			}
		}

		public void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			ResolveAppearance(((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).OwnerContext, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (EmbeddableEditorArea)0, IsHotTracking, string.Empty);

		internal bool ResolveAppearance(object ownerContext, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, EmbeddableEditorArea area, bool hotTracking, string customArea)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0003: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_004d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0052: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0144: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_012c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((int)area == 4)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = ((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor != null && ((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor.IsInEditMode && Row != null && Row.Layout.ActiveProxy == this;
			UIRole uIRoleResolved = ((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).UIRoleResolved;
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrderInfo = ComponentRole.GetResolutionOrderInfo(((UltraControlBase)this).ComponentRole);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrderInfo)).UseStyleBefore && uIRoleResolved != null)
			{
				if (hotTracking)
				{
					uIRoleResolved.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					uIRoleResolved.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)32);
				}
				uIRoleResolved.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrderInfo)).UseControlInfo)
			{
				if (hotTracking && HasHotTrackAppearance)
				{
					HotTrackAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (flag && HasEditAppearance)
				{
					EditAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				if (HasAppearance)
				{
					Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrderInfo)).UseStyleAfter && uIRoleResolved != null)
			{
				if (hotTracking)
				{
					uIRoleResolved.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)4);
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					uIRoleResolved.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)32);
				}
				uIRoleResolved.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (ownerContext != null && ((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).BaseOwner != null && UseGridAppearancesResolved)
			{
				if (((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).BaseOwner is GridEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase gridEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase)
				{
					gridEmbeddableEditorOwnerInfoBase.ResolveAppearance(ownerContext, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, area, hotTracking, customArea, isProxyResolution: true);
				}
				else
				{
					((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).BaseOwner.ResolveAppearance(ownerContext, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, area, hotTracking, customArea);
				}
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override void OnEnter(EventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_00ef: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f5: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (isInOnEnter || Row == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (!IsActiveProxy && Row.Layout.ActiveProxy != null)
			{
				if (!((Control)this).CausesValidation || !((Control)(object)Row.Layout.ActiveProxy).CausesValidation)
				{
					isSelecting = true;
					((Control)(object)Row.Layout.ActiveProxy).Select();
					isSelecting = false;
				}
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				isInOnEnter = true;
				if (RowEditTemplate != null)
				{
					if (!RowEditTemplate.OnProxyEnter(this))
					{
						didProxyEnterFail = true;
						return;
					}
					didProxyEnterFail = false;
				}
				if (!haveHookedEditor && ((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor != null)
				{
					((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor.KeyDown += EditorKeyDownHandler;
					((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor.KeyPress += EditorKeyPressHandler;
					((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor.KeyUp += EditorKeyUpHandler;
					haveHookedEditor = true;
				}
				if ((int)Column.CellMultiLineResolved == 1)
				{
					EmbeddableEditorBase editor = ((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor;
					EditorWithText val = (EditorWithText)(object)((editor is EditorWithText) ? editor : null);
					if (val != null)
					{
						val.AcceptsReturn = true;
					}
				}
				((UIElement)((UltraControlBase)this).ControlUIElement).DirtyChildElements();
				((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).OnEnter(e);
			}
			finally
			{
				isInOnEnter = false;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnGotFocus(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Row == null || (!IsActiveProxy && Row.Layout.ActiveProxy != null))
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridCell activeCell = RowEditTemplate.Grid.ActiveCell;
			if (activeCell != null && activeCell.IsInEditMode && activeCell.Layout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited != null)
			{
				activeCell.ExitEditMode();
				if (activeCell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			if (RowEditTemplate != null)
			{
				if (didProxyEnterFail)
				{
					didProxyEnterFail = false;
					return;
				}
				if (!RowEditTemplate.OnProxyEnter(this))
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).OnGotFocus(e);
		}

		protected override void OnLeave(EventArgs e)
		{
			if (isSelecting)
			{
				return;
			}
			((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).OnLeave(e);
			if (((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor == null || !((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor.IsInEditMode || !IsActiveProxy)
			{
				if (IsActiveProxy)
				{
					Row.Layout.ActiveProxy = null;
				}
				if (haveHookedEditor)
				{
					((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor.KeyDown -= EditorKeyDownHandler;
					((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor.KeyPress -= EditorKeyPressHandler;
					((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).Editor.KeyUp -= EditorKeyUpHandler;
					haveHookedEditor = false;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseWheel(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnMouseWheel(e);
			if (RowEditTemplate != null && RowEditTemplate.Grid != null)
			{
				RowEditTemplate.Grid.OnMouseWheelInternal(e);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs pe)
		{
			((UltraControlBase)this).OnPaint(pe);
			if (RowEditTemplate != null && RowEditTemplate.activeCellOnDisplay != null && RowEditTemplate.activeCellOnDisplay.Column.Key == ColumnKey)
			{
				if (((Control)this).Visible)
				{
					RowEditTemplate.FocusActiveProxy(RowEditTemplate.activeCellOnDisplay);
				}
				RowEditTemplate.activeCellOnDisplay = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnEnabledChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			SyncBackColor();
			((UltraEditorProxyBase)this).OnEnabledChanged(e);
		}
	}

	public class UltraGridCellProxyUIElement : UltraEditorProxyUIElement
	{
		private bool isMouseOverControl;

		public override UIElementBorderStyle BorderStyle => ((UltraGridCellProxy)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).BorderStyleResolved;

		public override UIRole UIRole => StyleUtils.GetRole((UltraGridCellProxy)(object)((UIElement)this).Control, StyleUtils.CellProxyRole.CellProxy);

		public UltraGridCellProxyUIElement(UltraGridCellProxy proxy)
			: base((UltraEditorProxyBase)(object)proxy)
		{
		}

		public override object GetContext(Type type, bool checkParentElementContexts)
		{
			UltraGridCellProxy ultraGridCellProxy = ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraGridCellProxy;
			if (type == typeof(UltraGridRow))
			{
				if (ultraGridCellProxy != null && ultraGridCellProxy.RowEditTemplate != null)
				{
					return ultraGridCellProxy.RowEditTemplate.Row;
				}
			}
			else if (type == typeof(UltraGridColumn))
			{
				return ultraGridCellProxy.Column;
			}
			return ((ControlUIElementBase)this).GetContext(type, checkParentElementContexts);
		}

		protected override void InitAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			((UltraGridCellProxy)(object)((UIElement)this).Control).ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			((ControlUIElementBase)this).InitAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter()
		{
			isMouseOverControl = true;
			((UltraEditorProxyUIElement)this).OnMouseEnter();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave()
		{
			isMouseOverControl = false;
			((UltraEditorProxyUIElement)this).OnMouseLeave();
		}

		protected override void PositionChildElementsHelper(UIElementsCollection oldChildElements)
		{
			UltraGridCellProxy ultraGridCellProxy = ((UIElement)this).Control as UltraGridCellProxy;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = ((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(UltraGridRow)) as UltraGridRow;
			UltraGridColumn column = ((UIElement)this).GetContext(typeof(UltraGridColumn)) as UltraGridColumn;
			if (base.lastElement != null && ultraGridCellProxy != null && ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.HasDataError(column))
			{
				ProxyDataErrorIconUIElement proxyDataErrorIconUIElement = (ProxyDataErrorIconUIElement)UIElement.ExtractExistingElement((ArrayList)(object)oldChildElements, typeof(ProxyDataErrorIconUIElement), true);
				if (proxyDataErrorIconUIElement == null)
				{
					proxyDataErrorIconUIElement = new ProxyDataErrorIconUIElement(this);
				}
				Rectangle textRect = ((UIElement)base.lastElement).Rect;
				CellUIElement.PositionDataErrorIcon(column, ultraGridRow, (UIElement)(object)this, ((UIElement)this).ChildElements, proxyDataErrorIconUIElement, ref textRect);
				((UIElement)base.lastElement).Rect = textRect;
			}
		}

		protected override void QueryEditElements(out bool includeEditElements, out bool reserveSpaceForEditElements)
		{
			if (!(((UIElement)this).Control is UltraGridCellProxy { Column: var column } ultraGridCellProxy))
			{
				((UltraEditorProxyUIElement)this).QueryEditElements(ref includeEditElements, ref reserveSpaceForEditElements);
				return;
			}
			switch ((column != null) ? ultraGridCellProxy.Column.ButtonDisplayStyle : ButtonDisplayStyle.OnMouseEnter)
			{
			default:
				includeEditElements = (reserveSpaceForEditElements = true);
				break;
			case ButtonDisplayStyle.OnCellActivate:
				includeEditElements = (reserveSpaceForEditElements = ultraGridCellProxy.IsActiveProxy);
				break;
			case ButtonDisplayStyle.OnMouseEnter:
				includeEditElements = (reserveSpaceForEditElements = isMouseOverControl || ultraGridCellProxy.IsActiveProxy);
				break;
			}
			reserveSpaceForEditElements = includeEditElements;
		}
	}
	public class UltraGridCellProxyOwnerInfo : UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase
	{
		private UltraGridCellProxy GridCellProxy => ((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).EditorProxy as UltraGridCellProxy;

		public UltraGridCellProxyOwnerInfo(UltraGridCellProxy editorProxy)
			: base((UltraEditorProxyBase)(object)editorProxy)
		{
		}

		internal void GetBaseButtonStyle(object ownerContext, out UIElementButtonStyle buttonStyle)
		{
			((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).GetButtonStyle(ownerContext, ref buttonStyle);
		}

		public override bool GetBorderStyle(object ownerContext, out UIElementBorderStyle borderStyle)
		{
			borderStyle = (UIElementBorderStyle)1;
			return true;
		}

		public override bool GetButtonStyle(object ownerContext, out UIElementButtonStyle buttonStyle)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Expected I4, but got Unknown
			buttonStyle = (UIElementButtonStyle)(int)GridCellProxy.ButtonStyleResolved;
			return true;
		}

		public override DefaultableBoolean DrawAsActive(object ownerContext)
		{
			//IL_000c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ControlUIElementBase proxyElement = ((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).ProxyElement;
			if (proxyElement == null)
			{
				return ((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).DrawAsActive(ownerContext);
			}
			UIElement descendant = ((UIElement)proxyElement).GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
			EmbeddableUIElementBase val = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant : null);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return ((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).DrawAsActive((object)val);
			}
			return ((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).DrawAsActive(ownerContext);
		}

		public override object GetValue(object ownerContext)
		{
			if (GridCellProxy.Band == null || !GridCellProxy.Band.Columns.Exists(GridCellProxy.ColumnKey))
			{
				if (((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)this).DesignMode)
				{
					return Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_UltraGridCellProxy_DesignTime_NoBandOrColumn");
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			if (((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)this).DesignMode)
			{
				return GridCellProxy.ColumnKey;
			}
			return ((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).GetValue(ownerContext);
		}

		public override bool IsEnabled(object ownerContext)
		{
			if (GridCellProxy == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (GridCellProxy.RowEditTemplate == null || GridCellProxy.RowEditTemplate.Row == null || GridCellProxy.Band == null || !GridCellProxy.Band.Columns.Exists(GridCellProxy.ColumnKey))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridColumn column = GridCellProxy.Band.Columns[GridCellProxy.ColumnKey];
			return GridCellProxy.RowEditTemplate.Row.GetCellActivationResolved(column) != Activation.Disabled;
		}

		public override bool IsKeyMapped(Keys keyData, EmbeddableUIElementBase element)
		{
			if (keyData == Keys.Escape)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).IsKeyMapped(keyData, element);
		}

		public override bool IsHotTrackingEnabled(object ownerContext)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override bool OnEditorBeforeEnterEditMode(EmbeddableEditorBase editor, EmbeddableUIElementBase element)
		{
			if (!(((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).EditorProxy is UltraGridCellProxy ultraGridCellProxy))
			{
				return ((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).OnEditorBeforeEnterEditMode(editor, element);
			}
			if (!ultraGridCellProxy.RowEditTemplate.Row.Cells.Exists(ultraGridCellProxy.ColumnKey))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ultraGridCellProxy.RowEditTemplate.Row.Cells[ultraGridCellProxy.ColumnKey];
			if (!ultraGridCell.Column.CanCellEnterEditMode(ultraGridCell.Row, isEnteringFromTemplate: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool ResolveAppearance(object ownerContext, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, EmbeddableEditorArea area, bool hotTracking, string customArea)
		{
			//IL_001a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!hotTracking)
			{
				hotTracking = GridCellProxy.IsHotTracking;
			}
			if (!GridCellProxy.ResolveAppearance(ownerContext, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, area, hotTracking, customArea))
			{
				return ((UltraEditorProxyOwnerBase)this).ResolveAppearance(ownerContext, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, area, hotTracking, customArea);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool SuppressEnterLeaveInvalidation(object ownerContext)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

		internal class ColumnBandHolder : IComparable
		{
			private object val;

			private string text;

			public object Value => val;

			internal ColumnBandHolder(object val)
				: this(val, null)
			{
			}

			internal ColumnBandHolder(object val, string text)
			{
				this.val = val;
				this.text = text;
			}

			internal static object GetWrappedValue(UltraGridCell cell)
			{
				object value = cell.Value;
				if (value is ColumnBandHolder)
				{
					value = ((ColumnBandHolder)value).Value;
				}
				return value;
			}

			public int CompareTo(object o)
			{
				return string.Compare(ToString(), (o != null) ? o.ToString() : string.Empty, ignoreCase: true, CultureInfo.CurrentCulture);
			}

			public override string ToString()
			{
				if (this.text != null)
				{
					return this.text;
				}
				if (val is UltraGridColumn)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = val as UltraGridColumn;
					return ultraGridColumn.ColumnChooserCaptionResolved;
				}
				if (val is UltraGridBand)
				{
					string text = ((UltraGridBand)val).Header.Caption;
					if (text == null)
					{
						text = string.Empty;
					}
					return text;
				}
				if (val != null)
				{
					return val.ToString();
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}

			public override bool Equals(object o)
			{
				if (val != o)
				{
					if (o is ColumnBandHolder)
					{
						return ((ColumnBandHolder)o).val == val;
					}
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}

			public override int GetHashCode()
			{
				if (val == null)
				{
					return 0;
				}
				return val.GetHashCode();
			}
		}

		public UltraGridColumnChooser()
		{
			try
			{
				license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(UltraGridColumnChooser), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}

		private void displayGrid_InitializeRow(object sender, InitializeRowEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Row.Cells.Exists("Visible"))
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = e.Row.Cells["Visible"];
				object wrappedValue = ColumnBandHolder.GetWrappedValue(e.Row.Cells["Value"]);
				if (wrappedValue is UltraGridColumn)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = (UltraGridColumn)wrappedValue;
					ultraGridCell.Value = !ultraGridColumn.Hidden;
					ultraGridCell.Row.Activation = (ultraGridColumn.Band.HiddenResolved ? Activation.Disabled : Activation.AllowEdit);
				}
				else if (wrappedValue is UltraGridBand)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = (UltraGridBand)wrappedValue;
					ultraGridCell.Value = !ultraGridBand.HiddenResolved;
					ultraGridCell.Hidden = ultraGridBand.IsRootBand || ColumnChooserStyle.AllColumnsAndChildBandsWithCheckBoxes != Style;
					ultraGridCell.Row.Activation = ((ultraGridBand.ParentBand != null && ultraGridBand.ParentBand.HiddenResolved) ? Activation.Disabled : Activation.AllowEdit);
					e.Row.Hidden = ultraGridCell.Hidden && CurrentBand != null && comboBoxBandSelector != null && comboBoxBandSelector.Visible;
				}
			}
		}

		}

		internal static void ToggleVisibleCellCheckState(UltraGridCell cell)
		{
			if ("Visible" == cell.Column.Key)
			{
				EmbeddableEditorBase editorResolved = cell.EditorResolved;
				object obj = ((editorResolved != null && editorResolved.IsInEditMode) ? editorResolved.Value : cell.Value);
				bool flag = obj is bool && (bool)obj;
				bool flag2 = !flag;
				object wrappedValue = ColumnBandHolder.GetWrappedValue(cell.Row.Cells["Value"]);
				if (wrappedValue is UltraGridColumn)
				{
					UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = (UltraGridColumn)wrappedValue;
					ultraGridColumn.Layout.Grid.ColumnChooser_SetHidden(ultraGridColumn, !flag2);
				}
				else if (wrappedValue is UltraGridBand)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = (UltraGridBand)wrappedValue;
					ultraGridBand.Layout.Grid.ColumnChooser_SetHidden(ultraGridBand, !flag2);
				}
				if (cell.IsInEditMode)
				{
					cell.ExitEditMode();
				}
				cell.Layout.Rows.Refresh(RefreshRow.FireInitializeRow, recursive: true);
			}
		}

		private void displayGrid_CellChange(object sender, CellEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Cell.Row.IsDataRow)
			{
				ToggleVisibleCellCheckState(e.Cell);
			}
		}

		private void displayGrid_KeyDown(object sender, KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			if (multiSelectEnabled || Keys.Space != e.KeyCode || e.Control || e.Alt || displayGrid == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			UltraGridRow activeRow = displayGrid.ActiveRow;
			UltraGridCell activeCell = displayGrid.ActiveCell;
			if (activeRow != null && (activeCell == null || !activeCell.IsInEditMode))
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = (activeRow.Cells.Exists("Visible") ? activeRow.Cells["Visible"] : null);
				if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.CanBeModified && !ultraGridCell.InternalHidden)
				{
					ToggleVisibleCellCheckState(ultraGridCell);
					e.Handled = true;
				}
			}
		}

		private static GridKeyActionMapping FindKeyActionMapping(GridKeyActionMappings mappings, UltraGridAction action, Keys key)
		{
			foreach (GridKeyActionMapping mapping in mappings)
			{
				if (action == mapping.ActionCode && key == ((KeyActionMappingBase)mapping).KeyCode)
				{
					return mapping;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void SetupKeyActionMappings()
		{
			if (DisplayGrid == null || ((Control)(object)DisplayGrid).IsDisposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			GridKeyActionMappings keyActionMappings = DisplayGrid.KeyActionMappings;
			((KeyActionMappingsBase)keyActionMappings).Reset();
			if (multiSelectEnabled)
			{
				SetupKeyActionMappingsMultiSelect(keyActionMappings);
				return;
			}
			UltraGridAction[] array = new UltraGridAction[4]
			{
				UltraGridAction.NextRowByTab,
				UltraGridAction.PrevRowByTab,
				UltraGridAction.FirstRowInGrid,
				UltraGridAction.LastRowInGrid
			};
			Keys[] array2 = new Keys[1] { Keys.Tab };
			GridKeyActionMapping gridKeyActionMapping;
			for (int num = ((DisposableObjectCollectionBase)(object)keyActionMappings).Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				gridKeyActionMapping = keyActionMappings[num];
				if (Array.IndexOf(array, gridKeyActionMapping.ActionCode) < 0 && Array.IndexOf(array2, ((KeyActionMappingBase)gridKeyActionMapping).KeyCode) < 0)
				{
					((KeyActionMappingsBase)keyActionMappings).Remove(num);
				}
			}
			gridKeyActionMapping = FindKeyActionMapping(keyActionMappings, UltraGridAction.PrevRowByTab, Keys.Tab);
			if (gridKeyActionMapping != null)
			{
				((KeyActionMappingsBase)keyActionMappings).Add((KeyActionMappingBase)(object)new GridKeyActionMapping(Keys.Up, gridKeyActionMapping.ActionCode, gridKeyActionMapping.StateDisallowed, gridKeyActionMapping.StateRequired, (SpecialKeys)7, (SpecialKeys)0));
			}
			gridKeyActionMapping = FindKeyActionMapping(keyActionMappings, UltraGridAction.NextRowByTab, Keys.Tab);
			if (gridKeyActionMapping != null)
			{
				((KeyActionMappingsBase)keyActionMappings).Add((KeyActionMappingBase)(object)new GridKeyActionMapping(Keys.Down, gridKeyActionMapping.ActionCode, gridKeyActionMapping.StateDisallowed, gridKeyActionMapping.StateRequired, (SpecialKeys)7, (SpecialKeys)0));
			}
		}

		private void SetupKeyActionMappingsMultiSelect(GridKeyActionMappings mappings)

					((KeyActionMappingsBase)mappings).Remove((KeyActionMappingBase)(object)gridKeyActionMapping);
				}
			}
			GridKeyActionMapping gridKeyActionMapping2 = new GridKeyActionMapping(Keys.Space, UltraGridAction.ToggleRowSel, (UltraGridState)0, UltraGridState.Row, (SpecialKeys)5, (SpecialKeys)2);
			((KeyActionMappingsBase)mappings).Add((KeyActionMappingBase)(object)gridKeyActionMapping2);
		}

		private void InitializeDisplayGridLayout()
		{
			//IL_00b6: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UltraGridLayout displayLayout = DisplayGrid.DisplayLayout;
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = ((SourceGrid != null) ? SourceGrid.DisplayLayout : null);
			if (displayLayout == null || ultraGridLayout == null || displayLayout.Disposed || ultraGridLayout.Disposed)
			{
				return;
			}
			InitializeAppearancesFromSourceGrid();
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in displayLayout.SortedBands)
			{
				sortedBand.HeaderVisible = false;
				sortedBand.RowLayoutStyle = RowLayoutStyle.ColumnLayout;
				sortedBand.RowLayoutLabelStyle = RowLayoutLabelStyle.WithCellData;
				if (sortedBand.IsRootBand)
				{
					sortedBand.Indentation = 0;
				}
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = (ultraGridLayout.SortedBands.Exists(sortedBand.Key) ? ultraGridLayout.SortedBands[sortedBand.Key] : null);
				if (ultraGridBand != null)
				{
					sortedBand.Override.HeaderStyle = ultraGridBand.Override.HeaderStyle;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridColumn column in sortedBand.Columns)
				{
					if ("Value" != column.Key && ((ColumnChooserStyle.AllColumnsWithCheckBoxes != Style && ColumnChooserStyle.AllColumnsAndChildBandsWithCheckBoxes != Style) || "Visible" != column.Key))
					{
						column.Hidden = true;
					}
					if ("Visible" == column.Key)
					{
						column.Header.VisiblePosition = 0;
						column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.LabelPosition = LabelPosition.None;
						column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginX = 0;
						column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.SpanX = 2;
					}
					else if ("Value" == column.Key)
					{
						if (ultraGridBand != null)
						{
							column.CellMultiLine = (DefaultableBoolean)((ultraGridBand.WrapHeaderTextResolved || ultraGridBand.ColHeaderLines > 1) ? 1 : 2);
						}
						sortedBand.RowLayoutLabelPosition = LabelPosition.None;
						column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.OriginX = 2;
						column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.SpanX = 0;
						column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.WeightX = 1f;
						column.TabStop = false;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool HasNonExcludedDescendantBand(UltraGridBand[] bands, UltraGridBand parentBand)
		{
			foreach (UltraGridBand ultraGridBand in bands)
			{
				if (ultraGridBand.IsDescendantOfBand(parentBand))
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static string GetUniqueTableName(DataSet ds, string baseName)
		{
			baseName = baseName.Replace('.', '_');
			if (!ds.Tables.Contains(baseName))
			{
				return baseName;
			}
			int i;
			for (i = 1; ds.Tables.Contains(baseName + i); i++)
			{
			}
			return baseName + i;
		}

		private static string GetUniqueRelationName(DataSet ds, string baseName)
		{
			if (!ds.Relations.Contains(baseName))
			{
				return baseName;
			}
			int i;
			for (i = 1; ds.Relations.Contains(baseName + i); i++)
			{
			}
			return baseName + i;
		}

		private void CreateColumnChooserGridDataStructureHelper(DataSet dataSet, DataTable parentTable, UltraGridBand band, bool recursive, int uniqueKeyValueCounter, UltraGridBand[] nonExcludedBands)
		{
			if (Array.IndexOf(nonExcludedBands, band) < 0 && !HasNonExcludedDescendantBand(nonExcludedBands, band))
			{
				return;
			}
			bool addBandRow = band.Layout.SortedBands.Count > 1 && (recursive || ColumnChooserStyle.AllColumnsAndChildBandsWithCheckBoxes == Style);
			string uniqueTableName = GetUniqueTableName(dataSet, band.Key);
			DataTable dataTable = CreateTableFromBand(uniqueTableName, band, ref uniqueKeyValueCounter, addBandRow, nonExcludedBands);
			dataSet.Tables.Add(dataTable);
			if (parentTable != null)
			{
				string uniqueRelationName = GetUniqueRelationName(dataSet, band.Key);
				dataSet.Relations.Add(uniqueRelationName, parentTable.Columns["key2"], dataTable.Columns["key1"], createConstraints: false);
			}
			if (!recursive)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in SourceGrid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands)
			{
				if (sortedBand.ParentBand == band)
				{
					CreateColumnChooserGridDataStructureHelper(dataSet, dataTable, sortedBand, recursive, uniqueKeyValueCounter, nonExcludedBands);
				}
			}
		}

		private DataTable CreateTableFromBand(string tableName, UltraGridBand band, ref int uniqueKeyValueCounter, bool addBandRow, UltraGridBand[] nonExcludedBands)
		{
			DataTable dataTable = new DataTable(tableName);
			dataTable.Columns.Add("key1", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("key2", typeof(string));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("Value", typeof(object));
			dataTable.Columns.Add("Visible", typeof(bool));
			int num = uniqueKeyValueCounter;
			if (addBandRow)
			{
				dataTable.Rows.Add(num, ++uniqueKeyValueCounter, new ColumnBandHolder(band));
			}
			if (Array.IndexOf(nonExcludedBands, band) >= 0)
			{
				UltraGridColumn[] nonExcludedColumns = GetNonExcludedColumns(band);
				SortColumnsByDisplayOrder(nonExcludedColumns);
				UltraGridColumn[] array = nonExcludedColumns;
				foreach (UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn in array)
				{
					if (!ultraGridColumn.IsChaptered && (ultraGridColumn.Hidden || ColumnChooserStyle.AllColumnsWithCheckBoxes == Style || ColumnChooserStyle.AllColumnsAndChildBandsWithCheckBoxes == Style))
					{
						dataTable.Rows.Add(num, ++uniqueKeyValueCounter, new ColumnBandHolder(ultraGridColumn));
					}
				}
			}
			return dataTable;
		}

		internal void CreateColumnChooserGridDataStructure()
		{
			DataSet dataSet = new DataSet();
			UltraGridBand[] nonExcludedBands = GetNonExcludedBands();
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = CurrentBand;
			CreateColumnChooserGridDataStructureHelper(dataSet, null, (ultraGridBand != null) ? ultraGridBand : SourceGrid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0], ultraGridBand == null, 1, nonExcludedBands);
			DisplayGrid.SetDataBinding(dataSet, null);
		}

		private void SortColumnsByDisplayOrder(UltraGridColumn[] columns)
		{
			IComparer comparer = null;
			ColumnDisplayOrder columnDisplayOrder = ColumnDisplayOrder;
			if (columnDisplayOrder == ColumnDisplayOrder.Alphabetical)
			{
				comparer = new GridUtils.AlphabeticalComparer(useColumnChooserCaption: true);
			}
			else if (ColumnDisplayOrder.SameAsGrid == columnDisplayOrder)
			{
				comparer = new UltraGridBand.ColumnVisiblePositionComparer();
			}
			if (comparer != null)
			{
				Array.Sort(columns, comparer);
			}
		}

		private void ReHookIntoSourceGrid()
		{
			//IL_0035: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_003f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (lastHookedIntoGrid != SourceGrid)
			{
				UnhookFromSourceGrid();
				lastHookedIntoGrid = SourceGrid;
				if (lastHookedIntoGrid != null)
				{
					((UltraControlBase)lastHookedIntoGrid).PropertyChanged += new PropertyChangedEventHandler(sourceGrid_PropertyChanged);
					((Component)(object)lastHookedIntoGrid).Disposed += sourceGrid_Disposed;
					lastHookedIntoGrid.RegisterColumnChooser(this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UnhookFromSourceGrid()
		{
			//IL_0015: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001f: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (lastHookedIntoGrid != null)
			{
				((UltraControlBase)lastHookedIntoGrid).PropertyChanged -= new PropertyChangedEventHandler(sourceGrid_PropertyChanged);
				((Component)(object)lastHookedIntoGrid).Disposed -= sourceGrid_Disposed;
				lastHookedIntoGrid.UnRegisterColumnChooser(this);
				lastHookedIntoGrid = null;
			}
		}

		internal void VerifyInitialized()
		{
			if (needsReinitialization)
			{
				needsReinitialization = false;
				if (SourceGrid != null && ((Control)(object)SourceGrid).IsDisposed)
				{
					SourceGrid = null;
				}
				Initialize();
			}
			if (needsToApplySourceGridAppearances)
			{
				InitializeAppearancesFromSourceGrid();
			}
		}

		private void ClearBandsCombobox()
		{
			if (comboBoxBandSelector != null)
			{
				comboBoxBandSelector.Items.Clear();
			}
		}

		private void LoadBandsCombobox(bool addAllEntry)
		{
			ClearBandsCombobox();
			if (SourceGrid == null || comboBoxBandSelector == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			object obj = null;
			if (addAllEntry)
			{
				obj = new ColumnBandHolder(SourceGrid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("ColumnChooserAllBandsItem"));
				comboBoxBandSelector.Items.Add(obj);
			}
			List<ColumnBandHolder> list = new List<ColumnBandHolder>();
			UltraGridBand[] nonExcludedBands = GetNonExcludedBands();
			foreach (UltraGridBand val in nonExcludedBands)
			{
				list.Add(new ColumnBandHolder(val));
			}
			list.Sort();
			comboBoxBandSelector.Items.AddRange(list.ToArray());
			object selectedItem = obj;
			if (CurrentBand != null)
			{
				ColumnBandHolder columnBandHolder = new ColumnBandHolder(CurrentBand);
				if (comboBoxBandSelector.Items.Contains(columnBandHolder))
				{
					selectedItem = columnBandHolder;
				}
			}
			comboBoxBandSelector.SelectedItem = selectedItem;
		}

		private static UltraGridColumn[] GetNonExcludedColumns(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			List<UltraGridColumn> list = new List<UltraGridColumn>();
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in band.Columns)
			{
				if (!column.IsChaptered && ExcludeFromColumnChooser.True != column.ExcludeFromColumnChooserResolved)
				{
					list.Add(column);
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private UltraGridBand[] GetNonExcludedBands()
		{
			List<UltraGridBand> list = new List<UltraGridBand>();
			if (SourceGrid != null && SourceGrid.DisplayLayout != null)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in SourceGrid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands)
				{
					UltraGridColumn[] nonExcludedColumns = GetNonExcludedColumns(sortedBand);
					if (nonExcludedColumns != null && nonExcludedColumns.Length != 0)
					{
						list.Add(sortedBand);
					}
				}
			}
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		private void Initialize()
		{
			if (isInitializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			isInitializing = true;
			try
			{
				ReHookIntoSourceGrid();
				DisplayGrid.SetDataBinding(null, null);
				if (SourceGrid != null)
				{
					LoadBandsCombobox(addAllEntry: true);
					UltraGridBand[] nonExcludedBands = GetNonExcludedBands();
					MultipleBandSupport multipleBandSupport = MultipleBandSupport;
					if (!SourceGrid.DisplayLayout.ViewStyleImpl.IsMultiBandDisplay || nonExcludedBands.Length <= 1)
					{
						multipleBandSupport = MultipleBandSupport.SingleBandOnly;
						CurrentBand = ((nonExcludedBands.Length != 0) ? nonExcludedBands[0] : null);
					}
					if (comboBoxBandSelector != null)
					{
						comboBoxBandSelector.Visible = multipleBandSupport == MultipleBandSupport.ShowBandSelectionUI;
					}
					if (TouchProviderManager.AreTouchMetricsEnabled((Control)(object)SourceGrid))
					{
						comboBoxBandSelector.AreTouchMetricsEnabled = true;
					}
					if (MultipleBandSupport.DisplayColumnsFromAllBands == multipleBandSupport && nonExcludedBands.Length > 1)
					{
						CurrentBand = null;
					}
					if (MultipleBandSupport.SingleBandOnly == multipleBandSupport && CurrentBand == null && nonExcludedBands.Length >= 1)
					{
						CurrentBand = nonExcludedBands[0];
					}
					CreateColumnChooserGridDataStructure();
					DisplayGrid.Rows.ExpandAll(recursive: true);
					if (Focused && !((Control)(object)DisplayGrid).ContainsFocus && DisplayGrid.Rows.Count > 0)
					{
						((Control)(object)DisplayGrid).Focus();
						DisplayGrid.Rows[0].Activate();
					}
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				isInitializing = false;
			}
		}

		public Size GetIdealSize(bool actualRequiredSize, float zoomFactor = 1f)
		{
			VerifyInitialized();
			Size size = new Size(160, 240);
			Size result = new Size(160, 240);
			if (SourceGrid != null)
			{
				zoomFactor = ((UltraControlBase)SourceGrid).ZoomFactor;
				UltraGridLayout displayLayout = DisplayGrid.DisplayLayout;
				UltraGridLayout source = displayLayout.Clone();
				displayLayout.AutoFitStyle = AutoFitStyle.None;
				int num = 0;
				foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in displayLayout.SortedBands)
				{
					foreach (UltraGridColumn column in sortedBand.Columns)
					{
						if (!column.IsChaptered)
						{
							column.PerformAutoResizeHelper(null, 0, applyWidth: true, includeHeader: false, includeCells: true);
						}
					}
				}
				displayLayout.ColScrollRegions.InitializeMetrics();
				foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand2 in displayLayout.SortedBands)
				{
					int val = sortedBand2.GetOrigin(BandOrigin.PreRowArea) + sortedBand2.GetExtent(BandOrigin.PreRowArea);
					num = Math.Max(num, val);
				}
				int num2 = 0;
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
				RowsEnumerator rowsEnumerator = new RowsEnumerator(displayLayout.Rows, null);
				while (rowsEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					UltraGridRow current4 = rowsEnumerator.Current;
					num2 += current4.TotalHeight;
					if (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.Band != current4.Band)
					{
						num2 += current4.Band.Layout.InterBandSpacing;
					}
					ultraGridRow = current4;
				}
				if (MultipleBandSupport == MultipleBandSupport.ShowBandSelectionUI)
				{
					num2 += comboBoxBandSelector.Height;
				}
				int num3 = 8;
				result.Height = num3 + num2;
				int num4 = displayLayout?.VerticalScrollBarWidthResolved ?? ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)this);
				result.Width = num3 + num + num4;
				if (!actualRequiredSize)
				{
					Rectangle r = new Rectangle(0, 0, 1, 1);
					r = UIElement.GetDeskTopWorkArea(SourceGrid.EditorContainerControl.RectangleToScreen(r));
					result.Width = Math.Min(Math.Max(size.Width, result.Width), r.Width);
					result.Height = Math.Min(Math.Max(size.Height, result.Height), r.Height);
					result.Height = Math.Min(result.Height, 3 * result.Width);
				}
				displayLayout.CopyFrom(source);
			}
			result.Width = Utilities.GetZoomedValue(result.Width, zoomFactor, false);
			result.Height = Utilities.GetZoomedValue(result.Width, zoomFactor, false);
			Size size2 = SystemInformation.WorkingArea.Size;
			result.Width = Math.Min(size2.Width, result.Width);
			result.Height = Math.Min(size2.Height, result.Height);
			return result;
		}

		public UIElement GetHeaderUIElement(UltraGridColumn column)
		{

			if (ultraGridCell != null)

				{
					val = val.GetDescendant(typeof(RowUIElementBase), (object)ultraGridCell.Row);
				}
				if (val != null)
				{
					val = val.GetDescendant(typeof(HeaderUIElement), (object)column);
				}
			}
			return val;
		}

		private UltraGridCell FindCellForColumn(RowsCollection rows, UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			UltraGridRow[] allNonGroupByRows = rows.GetAllNonGroupByRows();
			foreach (UltraGridRow ultraGridRow in allNonGroupByRows)
			{
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = ultraGridRow.Cells["Value"];
				if (column == ColumnBandHolder.GetWrappedValue(ultraGridCell))
				{
					return ultraGridCell;
				}
				if (ultraGridRow.ChildBands == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)ultraGridRow.ChildBands)
				{
					ultraGridCell = FindCellForColumn(item.Rows, column);
					if (ultraGridCell != null)
					{
						return ultraGridCell;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

		protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{

			}
			List<UltraGridRow> list = new List<UltraGridRow>();
			IEnumerable rowEnumerator = activeRow.Band.GetRowEnumerator(GridRowType.DataRow);

				list.Add(item);
			}

			base.Selected.Rows.AddRange(list.ToArray());
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		}

		internal void ToggleCheckState()
		{

			{
				return;
			}

			}
		}

		public override bool ResolveAppearance(object ownerContext, ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps, EmbeddableEditorArea area, bool hotTracking, string customArea)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0004: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0007: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0018: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0050: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_012a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00f7: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if ((int)area == 0 || (int)area == 1)
			{
				control.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				return true;
			}
			if ((int)area == 4)
			{
				if (control.HasButtonAppearance && StyleUtils.UseControlInfo(control.DisplayLayout))
				{
					control.ButtonAppearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
				}
				return true;
			}
			if ((int)area == 8 && customArea.Equals("SelectedText"))
			{
				bool flag = false;
				if (control.HasAppearance && StyleUtils.UseControlInfo(control.DisplayLayout))
				{
					control.Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (!((Control)(object)control).Focused || !((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)this).MustSelectFromList(ownerContext) || control.IsDroppedDown)
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (((Control)(object)control).Focused && control.DropDownStyle == UltraComboStyle.DropDownList && !control.IsDroppedDown && (int)control.DisplayStyleResolved != 7)
				{
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = SystemColors.Highlight;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFEuL);
					((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).ForeColor = SystemColors.HighlightText;
					requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFDuL);
					flag = true;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return ((EmbeddableEditorOwnerBase)this).ResolveAppearance(ownerContext, ref appearance, ref requestedProps, area, hotTracking, customArea);
		}

		public override EmbeddableUIElementBase GetEditorElement(object ownerContext)
		{
			UIElement mainUIElement = (UIElement)(object)((IUltraControlElement)control).MainUIElement;
			if (mainUIElement == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			UIElement descendant = mainUIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
			return (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((descendant is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? descendant : null);
		}

		public override void OnEditorMouseDown(EmbeddableUIElementBase embeddableElem, EmbeddableMouseDownEventArgs e)
		{
			UltraCombo ultraCombo = control;
			bool eatMessage = true;
			if (ultraCombo != null && ((Control)(object)ultraCombo).Enabled && embeddableElem != null && ((UIElement)embeddableElem).HasAncestor((UIElement)(object)ultraCombo.UIElement))
			{
				if (!((Control)(object)ultraCombo).ContainsFocus)
				{
					try
					{
						if (DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(((object)ultraCombo).GetType()))
						{
							GridUtils.FocusControl((Control)(object)ultraCombo);
						}
						else
						{
							ultraCombo.Focus();
						}
					}
					catch
					{
					}
				}
				eatMessage = !((Control)(object)ultraCombo).Enabled || !((Control)(object)ultraCombo).ContainsFocus;
			}
			e.EatMessage = eatMessage;
		}

		public override bool EnterEditModeOnClick(object ownerContext)
		{
			return ((Control)(object)control).ContainsFocus;
		}

		public override void AccessibilityNotifyClients(object ownerContext, AccessibleEvents eventId)
		{
			int childID = 0;
			switch (eventId)
			{
			case AccessibleEvents.ValueChange:
				childID = 1;
				break;
			case AccessibleEvents.Selection:
				childID = 1;
				break;
			}
			control.AccessibilityNotifyClientsInternal(eventId, childID);
		}

	[ToolboxBitmap(typeof(UltraGridBase), "ToolboxBitmaps.CLR2.UltraGridPrintDocument.png")]
	[Designer("Infragistics.Win.UltraWinGrid.Design.UltraGridPrintDocumentDesigner, Infragistics4.Win.v21.1.Design, Version=21.1.20211.24, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=7dd5c3163f2cd0cb")]
	[Infragistics.Shared.UltraLicense("UltraGridPrintDocument")]
	[LicenseProvider(typeof(UltraLicenseProvider))]
	[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridPrintDocument")]
	public class UltraGridPrintDocument : UltraPrintDocument, IUltraLicensedComponent
	{
		private UltraLicense license;

		private UltraGrid grid;

		private const RowPropertyCategories RowPropertyCategoriesDefault = RowPropertyCategories.All;

		private RowPropertyCategories retainRowPropertyCategories = RowPropertyCategories.All;

		private const int FitWidthToPagesDefault = 0;

		private int fitWidthToPages;

		private ColumnClipMode columnClipMode;

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridPrintDocument_P_Grid")]
		public UltraGrid Grid
		{
			get
			{
				return grid;
			}
			set
			{
				if (grid != value)
				{
					if (grid != null)
					{
						((Component)(object)grid).Disposed -= OnGridDisposed;
					}
					grid = value;
					if (grid != null)
					{
						((Component)(object)grid).Disposed += OnGridDisposed;
					}
					((UltraPrintDocument)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.Grid);
				}
			}
		}

		[Editor(typeof(FlagsEnumUITypeEditor), typeof(UITypeEditor))]
		[DefaultValue(RowPropertyCategories.All)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridPrintDocument_P_RowProperties")]
		public RowPropertyCategories RowProperties
		{
			get
			{
				return retainRowPropertyCategories;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != retainRowPropertyCategories)
				{
					retainRowPropertyCategories = value;
					((UltraPrintDocument)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.RowProperties);
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(ColumnClipMode.Default)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridPrintDocument_P_ColumnClipMode")]
		public ColumnClipMode ColumnClipMode
		{
			get
			{
				return columnClipMode;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != columnClipMode)
				{
					VerifyEnumPropertyIsValid(typeof(ColumnClipMode), (int)value);
					columnClipMode = value;
					((UltraPrintDocument)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.ColumnClipMode);
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(0)]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedCategory("LC_Behavior")]
		[Infragistics.Shared.LocalizedDescription("LD_UltraGridPrintDocument_P_FitWidthToPages")]
		public int FitWidthToPages
		{
			get
			{
				return fitWidthToPages;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != fitWidthToPages)
				{
					if (value < 0)
					{
						throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException("value", value, Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LER_ValueTooLow", "FitWidthToPages", 0));
					}
					fitWidthToPages = value;
					((UltraPrintDocument)this).NotifyPropChange((Enum)PropertyIds.FitWidthToPages);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool SupportsVariableSectionSize => false;

		protected override int? TotalNumberOfPages
		{
			get
			{
				if (Grid != null && Grid.PrintManager != null)
				{
					return Grid.PrintManager.TotalNumberOfPages;
				}
				return ((UltraPrintDocument)this).TotalNumberOfPages;
			}
