		public UltraGridPrintDocument()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public UltraGridPrintDocument(IContainer container)
			: base(container)
		{
			try
			{
				license = LicenseManager.Validate(typeof(UltraGridPrintDocument), this) as UltraLicense;
			}
			catch (FileNotFoundException)
			{
			}
		}

		private void OnGridDisposed(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			Grid = null;
		}

		private static void VerifyEnumPropertyIsValid(Type enumType, int value)
		{
			if (!Enum.IsDefined(enumType, value))
			{
				throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("value", value, enumType);
			}
		}

		protected override void DeserializeProperty(SerializationEntry entry)
		{
			switch (entry.Name)
			{
			case "FitWidthToPages":
				fitWidthToPages = (int)Utils.DeserializeProperty(entry, typeof(int), fitWidthToPages);
				break;
			case "ColumnClipMode":
				columnClipMode = (ColumnClipMode)Utils.DeserializeProperty(entry, typeof(ColumnClipMode), columnClipMode);
				break;
			case "RowProperties":
				retainRowPropertyCategories = (RowPropertyCategories)Utils.DeserializeProperty(entry, typeof(RowPropertyCategories), retainRowPropertyCategories);
				break;
			default:
				((UltraPrintDocument)this).DeserializeProperty(entry);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing && license != null)
			{
				license.Dispose();
				license = null;
			}
			((UltraPrintDocument)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void GetObjectData(ObjectStreamer streamer)
		{
			((UltraPrintDocument)this).GetObjectData(streamer);
			IDictionary dictionary = streamer.Dictionary;
			if (fitWidthToPages != 0)
			{
				dictionary.Add("FitWidthToPages", fitWidthToPages);
			}
			if (columnClipMode != ColumnClipMode.Default)
			{
				dictionary.Add("ColumnClipMode", columnClipMode);
			}
			if (retainRowPropertyCategories != RowPropertyCategories.All)
			{
				dictionary.Add("RowProperties", retainRowPropertyCategories);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnBeginPrint(PrintEventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraPrintDocument)this).OnBeginPrint(e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Grid == null || Grid.Rows.Count == 0)
			{
				e.Cancel = true;
			}
			else
			{
				if (Grid.PrintManager != null && (object)Grid.PrintManager.PrintDocument == this)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!Grid.PrintDocumentHelper(this))
				{
					e.Cancel = true;
				}
				else
				{
					PrintManager printManager = Grid.PrintManager;
					if (printManager == null)
					{
						e.Cancel = true;
					}
					else
					{
						printManager.BeginPrint(this, e);
					}
				}
				if (e.Cancel)
				{
					((UltraPrintDocument)this).OnPrintEnded();
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPagePrinted(PagePrintedEventArgs e)
		{
			((UltraPrintDocument)this).OnPagePrinted(e);
			if (!e.HasMorePages && Grid != null)
			{
				e.HasMorePages = Grid.PrintManager.HasMorePages;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPrintEnded()
		{
			((UltraPrintDocument)this).OnPrintEnded();
			if (grid != null)
			{
				grid.DisposePrintHelper();
			}
		}

		public override void Reset(bool deserializing)
		{
			((UltraPrintDocument)this).Reset(deserializing);
			if (!deserializing && grid != null)
			{
				grid = null;
			}
			columnClipMode = ColumnClipMode.Default;
			fitWidthToPages = 0;
			retainRowPropertyCategories = RowPropertyCategories.All;
		}
	}

		private sealed class ColumnPropertyDescriptor : PropertyDescriptor
		{
			private string columnKey;

			private Type columnType;

			private UltraGridRowEditTemplate template;

			private UltraGridBand band;

			private UltraGridColumn Column
			{
				get
				{
					if (band == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					return band.Columns[columnKey];
				}
			}

			private UltraGridRow Row
			{
				get
				{
					if (band == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = template.Row;
					while (ultraGridRow != null && ultraGridRow.Band != band)
					{
						ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
					}
					return ultraGridRow;
				}
			}

			public override Type ComponentType => columnType;

			public override bool IsReadOnly
			{
				get
				{
					if (Column != null && !Column.IsReadOnly && band != null)
					{
						return band != template.Band;
					}
					return true;
				}
			}

			public override Type PropertyType => columnType;

			internal ColumnPropertyDescriptor(UltraGridRowEditTemplate template, UltraGridBand band, string columnKey, Type columnType, Attribute[] attrs)
				: base(columnKey, attrs)
			{
				this.band = band;
				this.columnKey = columnKey;
				this.columnType = columnType;
				this.template = template;
			}

			internal ColumnPropertyDescriptor(UltraGridRowEditTemplate template, string columnKey, Type columnType, Attribute[] attrs)
				: this(template, null, columnKey, columnType, attrs)
			{
			}

			public override bool CanResetValue(object component)
			{
				return false;
			}

			public override object GetValue(object component)
			{
				if (Row == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return Row.GetCellValue(band.Columns[columnKey]);
			}

			public override void ResetValue(object component)
			{
			}

			public override void SetValue(object component, object value)
			{
				if (Row != null)
				{
					Row.Cells[columnKey].Value = value;
				}
			}

			public override bool ShouldSerializeValue(object component)
			{
				return false;
			}
		}

		private class TemplateBandPropertyCollection : BindingList<PropertyDescriptor>, ITypedList
		{
			private UltraGridRowEditTemplate template;

			private UltraGridBand band;

			private string bandKey;

			private int bandHierarchicalLevel;

			private int colDataIndex;

			internal UltraGridBand Band
			{
				get
				{
					if (band != null)
					{
						return band;
					}
					if (bandKey != null && bandHierarchicalLevel > -1 && template.Grid != null && !template.Grid.Initializing)
					{
						foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in template.Grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands)
						{
							if (sortedBand.Key == bandKey && sortedBand.HierarchicalLevel == bandHierarchicalLevel)
							{
								band = sortedBand;
								return band;
							}
						}
					}
					return null;
				}
			}

			public TemplateBandPropertyCollection(UltraGridRowEditTemplate template, UltraGridBand band)
			{
				this.band = band;
				this.template = template;
				ColumnPropertyDescriptor item = new ColumnPropertyDescriptor(template, "DummyRow", typeof(object), null);
				Add(item);
			}

			public TemplateBandPropertyCollection(UltraGridRowEditTemplate template, string bandKey, int bandHierarchicalLevel, int colDataIndex)
			{
				this.bandKey = bandKey;
				this.bandHierarchicalLevel = bandHierarchicalLevel;
				this.colDataIndex = colDataIndex;
				this.template = template;
				ColumnPropertyDescriptor item = new ColumnPropertyDescriptor(template, "DummyRow", typeof(object), null);
				Add(item);
			}

			PropertyDescriptorCollection ITypedList.GetItemProperties(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
			{
				bool flag = false;
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = null;
				if (Band != null)
				{
					ultraGridBand = ((template.ParentBands == null || template.ParentBands.Count == 0) ? band : template.ParentBands[0]);
				}
				string text = bandKey;
				int num = bandHierarchicalLevel;
				int num2 = colDataIndex;
				List<PropertyDescriptor> list = new List<PropertyDescriptor>();
				if (listAccessors != null && listAccessors.Length != 0 && listAccessors[listAccessors.Length - 1] is TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor templateBandPropertyDescriptor)
				{
					flag = true;
					ultraGridBand = templateBandPropertyDescriptor.Band;
					if (ultraGridBand == null)
					{
						text = templateBandPropertyDescriptor.BandKey;
						num = templateBandPropertyDescriptor.BandHierarchicalLevel;
						num2 = templateBandPropertyDescriptor.ColDataIndex;
					}
				}
				if (!flag)
				{
					if (band != null && template.Band != null)
					{
						for (int i = 0; i < template.Band.Columns.Count; i++)
						{
							UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = template.Band.Columns[i];
							if (!ultraGridColumn.IsChaptered)
							{
								ColumnPropertyDescriptor item = new ColumnPropertyDescriptor(template, template.Band, ultraGridColumn.Key, ultraGridColumn.DataType, null);
								list.Add(item);
							}
						}
						if (template.ParentBands.Count > 0)
						{
							TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor item2 = new TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor(template.ParentBands[0], template);
							list.Add(item2);
						}
					}
					else if (bandKey != null)
					{
						for (int j = 0; j < template.ColumnData.Count; j++)
						{
							ColumnDescriptorData columnDescriptorData = template.ColumnData[j];
							if (columnDescriptorData.BandHierarchicalLevel == template.BandHierarchyLevel && columnDescriptorData.BandKey == template.BandKey)
							{
								ColumnPropertyDescriptor item3 = new ColumnPropertyDescriptor(template, columnDescriptorData.Key, columnDescriptorData.Type, null);
								list.Add(item3);
								continue;
							}
							TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor item4 = new TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor(columnDescriptorData.BandKey, columnDescriptorData.BandHierarchicalLevel, j, template);
							list.Add(item4);
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (template.ColumnData.Count > 0)
					{
						ColumnDescriptorData columnDescriptorData2 = template.ColumnData[0];
						string text2 = columnDescriptorData2.BandKey;
						int num3 = columnDescriptorData2.BandHierarchicalLevel;
						for (int k = 0; k < template.ColumnData.Count; k++)
						{
							columnDescriptorData2 = template.ColumnData[k];
							if (columnDescriptorData2.BandKey == text2 && columnDescriptorData2.BandHierarchicalLevel == num3)
							{
								ReadOnlyAttribute readOnlyAttribute = new ReadOnlyAttribute(isReadOnly: true);
								ColumnPropertyDescriptor item5 = new ColumnPropertyDescriptor(template, columnDescriptorData2.Key, columnDescriptorData2.Type, new Attribute[1] { readOnlyAttribute });
								list.Add(item5);
								continue;
							}
							TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor item6 = new TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor(columnDescriptorData2.BandKey, columnDescriptorData2.BandHierarchicalLevel, k, template);
							list.Add(item6);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				else
				{
					if (ultraGridBand == null && template.parentBands != null)
					{
						foreach (UltraGridBand parentBand in template.parentBands)
						{
							if (parentBand.Key == text && parentBand.HierarchicalLevel == num)
							{
								ultraGridBand = parentBand;
								break;
							}
						}
					}
					if (ultraGridBand != null)
					{
						for (int l = 0; l < ultraGridBand.Columns.Count; l++)
						{
							UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn2 = ultraGridBand.Columns[l];
							if (!ultraGridColumn2.IsChaptered)
							{
								ReadOnlyAttribute readOnlyAttribute2 = new ReadOnlyAttribute(isReadOnly: true);
								ColumnPropertyDescriptor item7 = new ColumnPropertyDescriptor(template, ultraGridBand, ultraGridColumn2.Key, ultraGridColumn2.DataType, new Attribute[1] { readOnlyAttribute2 });
								list.Add(item7);
							}
						}
						int num4 = template.ParentBands.IndexOf(ultraGridBand);
						if (num4 > -1 && num4 < template.ParentBands.Count - 1)
						{
							TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor item8 = new TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor(template.ParentBands[num4 + 1], template);
							list.Add(item8);
						}
					}
					else if (text != null)
					{
						for (int m = num2; m < template.ColumnData.Count; m++)
						{
							ColumnDescriptorData columnDescriptorData3 = template.ColumnData[m];
							if (columnDescriptorData3.BandKey == text && columnDescriptorData3.BandHierarchicalLevel == num)
							{
								ReadOnlyAttribute readOnlyAttribute3 = new ReadOnlyAttribute(isReadOnly: true);
								ColumnPropertyDescriptor item9 = new ColumnPropertyDescriptor(template, columnDescriptorData3.Key, columnDescriptorData3.Type, new Attribute[1] { readOnlyAttribute3 });
								list.Add(item9);
								continue;
							}
							TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor item10 = new TemplateBandPropertyDescriptor(columnDescriptorData3.BandKey, columnDescriptorData3.BandHierarchicalLevel, m, template);
							list.Add(item10);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return new PropertyDescriptorCollection(list.ToArray());
			}

			string ITypedList.GetListName(PropertyDescriptor[] listAccessors)
			{
				if (bandKey != null)
				{
					return bandKey;
				}
				if (band == null || band.Key == null)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return band.Key;
			}
		}

		private class TemplateForm : Form
		{
			private UltraGridRowEditTemplate template;

			public TemplateForm(UltraGridRowEditTemplate template)
			{
				this.template = template;
			}

			protected override void OnFormClosed(FormClosedEventArgs e)
			{
				if (template.DisplayMode == RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Modeless)
				{
					template.ReparentTemplate();
				}
				base.OnFormClosed(e);
				template.OnFormClosed();
			}

			protected override void OnFormClosing(FormClosingEventArgs e)
			{
				base.OnFormClosing(e);
				if (!e.Cancel)
				{
					BeforeRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs e2 = new BeforeRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs(template, forceClosing: false);
					template.OnFormClosing(e2);
					if (e2.Cancel)
					{
						e.Cancel = true;
					}
					else if (template.DisplayMode == RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Modal)
					{
						template.isFormShown = false;
					}
				}
			}

			protected override void OnShown(EventArgs e)
			{
				if (template != null)
				{
					template.OnFormShown();
				}
				base.OnShown(e);
			}
		}

		private UltraGridRow DesignRow
		{
			get
			{
				if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
				{
					if (designRow == null && Band != null)
					{
						IEnumerator enumerator = Grid.Rows.GetRowEnumerator(GridRowType.DataRow, Band, null).GetEnumerator();
						if (enumerator != null)
						{
							enumerator.MoveNext();
							if (!(enumerator.Current is UltraGridRow ultraGridRow) || ultraGridRow.Cells.Count == 0)
							{
								return null;
							}
							designRow = ultraGridRow;
						}
					}
					return designRow;
				}
				return null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (((Component)this).DesignMode && designRow != value)
				{
					designRow = value;
				}
			}
		}

		private List<UltraGridBand> ParentBands
		{
			get
			{
				if (parentBands == null && Grid != null && !Grid.Initializing)
				{
					parentBands = new List<UltraGridBand>();
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Band;
					while (ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridBand.ParentBand != null)
					{
						ultraGridBand = ultraGridBand.ParentBand;
						parentBands.Insert(0, ultraGridBand);
					}
					InitializeColumnData();
				}
				return parentBands;
			}
		}

		private TemplateBandPropertyCollection TemplateDescriptorList
		{
			get
			{
				if (templateDescriptorList == null)
				{
					if (Band == null)
					{
						templateDescriptorList = new TemplateBandPropertyCollection(this, bandKey, bandHierarchicalLevel, 0);
					}
					else
					{
						templateDescriptorList = new TemplateBandPropertyCollection(this, Band);
					}
				}
				return templateDescriptorList;
			}
		}

		{
			get

				if (Row == null || Row.Layout == null || !IsShown)
				{
					return null;

		[Browsable(false)]
		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Never)]
		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		public UltraGridBand Band
		{
			get
			{
				if (cachedBand != null)
				{
					return cachedBand;
				}
				if (bandHierarchicalLevel == -1 || Grid == null || bandKey == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				if (bandHierarchicalLevel == 0 && !Grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands.Exists(bandKey))
				{
					if (Grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands.Count > 0)
					{
						return Grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands[0];
					}
					return null;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in Grid.DisplayLayout.SortedBands)
				{
					if (sortedBand.Key == bandKey && sortedBand.HierarchicalLevel == bandHierarchicalLevel)
					{
						if (!Grid.Initializing)
						{
							cachedBand = sortedBand;
						}
						return sortedBand;
					}
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		private Point CalculateTemplateDisplayLocation()
		{
			//IL_010f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			bool flag = false;
			UIElement uIElement = Row.GetUIElement();
			Rectangle rectangle = Rectangle.Empty;
			if (uIElement != null)
			{
				Rectangle r = ((!(uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(RowCellAreaUIElement)) is RowCellAreaUIElement rowCellAreaUIElement)) ? uIElement.DrawingRect : ((UIElement)rowCellAreaUIElement).DrawingRect);
				r.X = Math.Max(0, r.X);
				r.Y = Math.Max(0, r.Y);
				rectangle = Grid.EditorContainerControl.RectangleToScreen(r);
				flag = uIElement.RightToLeftResolved;
			}
			DropDownRepositionInfo val = default(DropDownRepositionInfo);
			((DropDownRepositionInfo)(ref val))..ctor((SplitMonitorAction)1);
			Rectangle rectangle2;
			switch (DisplayMode)
			{
			case RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Modal:
			case RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Modeless:
				Form.ClientSize = ((Control)this).Size;
				rectangle2 = new Rectangle(rectangle.Location, Form.Size);
				break;
			default:
				rectangle2 = new Rectangle(rectangle.Location, ((Control)this).Size);
				break;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				rectangle2.X = rectangle.Right - rectangle2.Width;
			}
			return DropDownManager.CalculateDropRect(rectangle, rectangle2, (Control)(object)Grid, false, (DropDownPosition)0, val).Location;
		}

		internal void DirtyAllProxies()
		{
			if (columnProxyMap != null)
			{
				Dictionary<string, UltraGridCellProxy>.Enumerator enumerator = columnProxyMap.GetEnumerator();
				while (enumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					enumerator.Current.Value.Dirty();
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool Display(UltraGridCell currentActiveCell, TemplateDisplaySource source)
		{
			//IL_018d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_020c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_021e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (Row == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			templateDisplaySource = source;
			Point location = CalculateTemplateDisplayLocation();
			BeforeRowEditTemplateDisplayedEventArgs e = new BeforeRowEditTemplateDisplayedEventArgs(this, location, source);
			Grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowEditTemplateDisplayed, e);
			if (e.Cancel)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Row.BeginEdit();
			if (currentActiveCell != null && columnProxyMap != null && columnProxyMap.ContainsKey(currentActiveCell.Column.Key))
			{
				activeCellOnDisplay = currentActiveCell;
			}
			switch (DisplayMode)
			{
			case RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Modal:
			{
				InitializeForm(e.Location);
				isDisplayingModalForm = true;
				Control owningControl = GetOwningControl();
				Form.RightToLeft = owningControl?.RightToLeft ?? ((Control)(object)this).RightToLeft;
				Form.ShowDialog(owningControl);
				ReparentTemplate();
				break;
			}
			case RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Modeless:
				InitializeForm(e.Location);
				Form.Show(GetOwningControl());
				Form.Activate();
				break;
			case RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Popup:
			{
				Rectangle exclusionArea = Rectangle.Empty;
				UIElement uIElement = Row.GetUIElement();
				if (uIElement != null)
				{
					Rectangle r = ((!(uIElement.GetDescendant(typeof(RowCellAreaUIElement)) is RowCellAreaUIElement rowCellAreaUIElement)) ? uIElement.Rect : ((UIElement)rowCellAreaUIElement).Rect);
					r.X = Math.Max(0, r.X);
					r.Y = Math.Max(0, r.Y);
					exclusionArea = Grid.EditorContainerControl.RectangleToScreen(r);
				}
				DropDownManagerParameters val = default(DropDownManagerParameters);
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).AutoCloseUp = true;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).BeforeCloseUpHandler = OnBeforeAutoCloseUp;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).CloseUpHandler = OnAutoCloseUp;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).DropDownControl = (Control)(object)this;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).DropDownSize = ((Control)this).Size;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).EatMouseMessageOnAutoCloseup = true;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).ExclusionArea = exclusionArea;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).IgnoreClicksInExclusionArea = true;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).Location = e.Location;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).Owner = (Control)(object)grid;
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).RepositionInfo = new DropDownRepositionInfo((SplitMonitorAction)2);
				((DropDownManagerParameters)(ref val)).UsePriorityMessageFilter = true;
				DropDownManager.DropDown(val);
				if (!IsShown)
				{
					Row.CancelEdit();
					return false;
				}
				((Control)this).Visible = true;
				((Control)this).Focus();
				if (activeCellOnDisplay != null && ColumnProxyMap.ContainsKey(activeCellOnDisplay.Column.Key) && ((Control)(object)columnProxyMap[currentActiveCell.Column.Key]).Visible)
				{
					if (((Control)(object)columnProxyMap[activeCellOnDisplay.Column.Key]).Visible)
					{
						((ScrollableControl)this).ScrollControlIntoView((Control)(object)ColumnProxyMap[activeCellOnDisplay.Column.Key]);
					}
					else
					{
						activeCellOnDisplay = null;
					}
				}
				AfterRowEditTemplateDisplayedEventArgs e2 = new AfterRowEditTemplateDisplayedEventArgs(this, source);
				Grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowEditTemplateDisplayed, e2);
				break;
			}
			}
			return true;
		}

		private static bool ExcludeProperty(PropertyDescriptor property, Attribute attribute)
		{
			if (attribute != null)
			{
				Attribute attribute2 = property.Attributes[attribute.GetType()];
				if (attribute2 != null)
				{
					return !attribute.Match(attribute2);
				}
				return !attribute.IsDefaultAttribute();
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void FocusActiveProxy(UltraGridCell activeCell)
		{
			if (activeCell == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string key = activeCell.Column.Key;
			if (ColumnProxyMap.ContainsKey(key))
			{
				UltraGridCellProxy ultraGridCellProxy = ColumnProxyMap[key];
				if (((Control)(object)ultraGridCellProxy).Visible && !((Control)(object)ultraGridCellProxy).ContainsFocus)
				{
					HookIntoEditorProxy(ultraGridCellProxy);
					GridUtils.FocusControl((Control)(object)ultraGridCellProxy);
				}
			}
		}

		private Control GetOwningControl()
		{
			try
			{
				if (Grid != null)
				{
					return Grid.EditorContainerControl.FindForm();
				}
			}
			catch (SecurityException)
			{
			}
			return (Control)(object)Grid;
		}

		private void HookComponentChangeService()
		{
			if (!hookedIntoComponentChangeService && ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) is IComponentChangeService componentChangeService)
			{
				hookedIntoComponentChangeService = true;
				componentChangeService.ComponentRemoved += OnComponentRemoved;
				componentChangeService.ComponentRename += OnComponentRename;
			}
		}

		private void HookControl(Control control)
		{
			if (isInitializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (control is UltraGridCellProxy ultraGridCellProxy)
			{
				ultraGridCellProxy.RowEditTemplate = this;
				if (ultraGridCellProxy.ColumnKey == null || ultraGridCellProxy.ColumnKey.Length == 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (!ColumnProxyMap.ContainsKey(ultraGridCellProxy.ColumnKey))
				{
					ColumnProxyMap.Add(ultraGridCellProxy.ColumnKey, ultraGridCellProxy);
					return;
				}
				if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
				{
					throw new InvalidOperationException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_UltraGridRowEditTemplate_MultipleProxiesOnColumn"));
				}
				ColumnProxyMap[ultraGridCellProxy.ColumnKey] = ultraGridCellProxy;
			}
			else
			{
				control.Enter += OnControlEnter;
				control.ControlAdded += OnChildControlAdded;
				control.ControlRemoved += OnChildControlRemoved;
			}
		}

		private void HookControls(Control parentControl)
		{
			foreach (Control control in parentControl.Controls)
			{
				HookControl(control);
				HookControls(control);
			}
		}

		private void HookIntoEditorProxy(UltraGridCellProxy proxy)
		{
			if (Row != null && lastHookedEditor != ((UltraEditorProxyBase)proxy).Editor)
			{
				UnHookFromEditorProxy();
				lastHookedEditor = ((UltraEditorProxyBase)proxy).Editor;
				UltraGridLayout layout = Row.Layout;
				lastHookedEditor.BeforeEnterEditMode += layout.EmbeddableEditor_BeforeEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.AfterEnterEditMode += layout.EmbeddableEditor_AfterEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.BeforeExitEditMode += layout.EmbeddableEditor_BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.AfterExitEditMode += layout.EmbeddableEditor_AfterExitEditModeEventHandler;
				if (lastHookedEditor.SupportsDropDown)
				{
					lastHookedEditor.BeforeDropDown += layout.EmbeddableEditor_BeforeDropDownEventHandler;
					lastHookedEditor.AfterCloseUp += layout.EmbeddableEditor_AfterCloseupEventHandler;
					lastHookedEditor.SelectionChanged += layout.EmbeddableEditor_SelectionChangedEventHandler;
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Initialize(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (Band != null && band != null && band.HierarchicalLevel == bandHierarchicalLevel && band.Key == bandKey)
			{
				return;
			}
			cachedBand = null;
			parentBands = null;
			templateDescriptorList = null;
			if (band == null)
			{
				bandKey = null;
				bandHierarchicalLevel = -1;
				SetGrid(null, null);
			}
			else
			{
				bandKey = band.Key;
				if (band.Layout != null)
				{
					SetGrid(band, band.Layout.Grid as UltraGrid);
				}
			}
			DesignRow = null;
			DirtyAllProxies();
			VerifyColumnData();
		}

		private void InitializeColumnData()
		{
			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode || Grid == null || Grid.Initializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			ColumnData.Clear();
			InitializeColumnData(Band);
			foreach (UltraGridBand parentBand in ParentBands)
			{
				InitializeColumnData(parentBand);
			}
		}

		private void InitializeColumnData(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (band == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in band.Columns)
			{
				if (!column.IsChaptered)
				{
					ColumnData.Add(new ColumnDescriptorData(column.Key, column.DataType, band.Key, band.HierarchicalLevel));
				}
			}
		}

		private void InitializeForm(Point startLocation)
		{
			if (Row != null)
			{
				Form.ClientSize = ((Control)this).Size;
				Form.Location = startLocation;
				originalParent = Utilities.GetParent((Control)(object)this);
				originalDockStyle = ((Control)(object)this).Dock;
				originalSize = ((Control)this).Size;
				((Control)(object)this).Dock = DockStyle.Fill;
				Form.Controls.Add((Control)(object)this);
				((Control)this).Visible = true;
				((Control)this).Location = new Point(0, 0);
			}
		}

		internal void OnAutoCloseUp(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!isInClose)
			{
				isClosing = true;
				if (Row != null && Row.Layout.ActiveProxy != null && ((UltraEditorProxyBase)Row.Layout.ActiveProxy).Editor != null)
				{
					((UltraEditorProxyBase)Row.Layout.ActiveProxy).Editor.ExitEditMode(true, true);
				}
				CommitChanges();
				Row = null;
				((Control)this).Visible = false;
				isClosing = false;
				Grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowEditTemplateClosed, new AfterRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs(this));
			}
		}

		internal void OnBandColumnsChanged()
		{
			templateDescriptorList = null;
			DesignRow = null;
			DirtyAllProxies();
		}

		internal void OnBeforeAutoCloseUp(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (!isInClose)
			{
				BeforeRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs e2 = new BeforeRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs(this, forceClosing: true);
				grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowEditTemplateClosed, e2);
				((Control)(object)this).BindingContext[this].EndCurrentEdit();
			}
		}

		private void OnBindingMangerBindingComplete(object sender, BindingCompleteEventArgs e)
		{
			if (isInCommitChanges)
			{
				hasBindingError = e.BindingCompleteState != BindingCompleteState.Success;
			}
		}

		private void OnChildControlAdded(object sender, ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			HookControl(e.Control);
		}

		private void OnChildControlRemoved(object sender, ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			UnhookControl(e.Control);
		}

		private void OnComponentRemoved(object sender, ComponentEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Component == this)
			{
				UnhookComponentChangeService();
			}
			else if (e.Component is IButtonControl)
			{
				IButtonControl buttonControl = (IButtonControl)e.Component;
				if (DialogSettings.AcceptButton == buttonControl || DialogSettings.CancelButton == buttonControl)
				{
					PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(RowEditTemplateDialogSettings));
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = ((DialogSettings.AcceptButton != buttonControl) ? properties.Find("CancelButton", ignoreCase: false) : properties.Find("AcceptButton", ignoreCase: false));
					propertyDescriptor.SetValue(DialogSettings, null);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnComponentRename(object sender, ComponentRenameEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.Component is IButtonControl)
			{
				IButtonControl buttonControl = (IButtonControl)e.Component;
				if (DialogSettings.AcceptButton == buttonControl || DialogSettings.CancelButton == buttonControl)
				{
					PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(typeof(RowEditTemplateDialogSettings));
					PropertyDescriptor propertyDescriptor = ((DialogSettings.AcceptButton != buttonControl) ? properties.Find("CancelButton", ignoreCase: false) : properties.Find("AcceptButton", ignoreCase: false));
					propertyDescriptor.SetValue(DialogSettings, e.Component);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnControlEnter(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (Row != null)
			{
				Row.Layout.ActiveProxy = null;
			}
		}

		private void OnFormClosed()
		{
			isFormShown = false;
			if (!isInClose && Row != null)
			{
				isClosing = true;
				if (Row != null && Row.Layout.ActiveProxy != null && ((UltraEditorProxyBase)Row.Layout.ActiveProxy).Editor != null)
				{
					((UltraEditorProxyBase)Row.Layout.ActiveProxy).Editor.ExitEditMode(true, true);
				}
				CommitChanges();
				Row = null;
				isClosing = false;
				AfterRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs e = new AfterRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs(this);
				Grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowEditTemplateClosed, e);
			}
		}

		private void OnFormClosing(BeforeRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!isInClose)
			{
				Grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowEditTemplateClosed, e);
			}
		}

		private void OnFormShown()
		{
			isFormShown = true;
			isDisplayingModalForm = false;
			((Control)this).Visible = true;
			if (activeCellOnDisplay != null && ColumnProxyMap.ContainsKey(activeCellOnDisplay.Column.Key))
			{
				if (((Control)(object)columnProxyMap[activeCellOnDisplay.Column.Key]).Visible)
				{
					((ScrollableControl)this).ScrollControlIntoView((Control)(object)ColumnProxyMap[activeCellOnDisplay.Column.Key]);
				}
				else
				{
					activeCellOnDisplay = null;
				}
			}
			VerifyProxyEnabledStates();
			AfterRowEditTemplateDisplayedEventArgs e = new AfterRowEditTemplateDisplayedEventArgs(this, templateDisplaySource);
			Grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowEditTemplateDisplayed, e);
		}

		internal bool OnProxyEnter(UltraGridCellProxy proxy)
		{
			if (isClosing)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Row != null && proxy.ColumnKey != null)
			{
				if (activeCellOnDisplay != null && activeCellOnDisplay != Row.Cells[proxy.ColumnKey])
				{
					return false;
				}
				if (!Row.Cells.Exists(proxy.ColumnKey))
				{
					return false;
				}
				UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = Row.Cells[proxy.ColumnKey];
				Grid.ActiveCell = ultraGridCell;
				if (Grid.ActiveCell != ultraGridCell)
				{
					if (Grid.ActiveCell != null && ColumnProxyMap.ContainsKey(Grid.ActiveCell.Column.Key))
					{
						GridUtils.FocusControl((Control)(object)ColumnProxyMap[Grid.ActiveCell.Column.Key]);
					}
					return false;
				}
				Row.Layout.ActiveProxy = proxy;
				HookIntoEditorProxy(proxy);
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void OnRowCancelEdit()
		{
			((Control)(object)this).BindingContext[this].CancelCurrentEdit();
		}

		internal void OnRowEndEdit()
		{
			((Control)(object)this).BindingContext[this].EndCurrentEdit();
		}

		protected virtual void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			//IL_01d3: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01d9: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01db: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01dd: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01df: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_01e1: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01e4: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			if (propChange.Source == dialogSettings && propChange.PropId is RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds)
			{
				if (form != null)
				{
					switch ((RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds)(object)propChange.PropId)
					{
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.AcceptButton:
						form.AcceptButton = dialogSettings.AcceptButton;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.AutoScaleMode:
						form.AutoScaleMode = dialogSettings.AutoScaleMode;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.CancelButton:
						form.CancelButton = dialogSettings.CancelButton;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.Caption:
						form.Text = dialogSettings.Caption;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.ControlBox:
						form.ControlBox = dialogSettings.ControlBox;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.FormBorderStyle:
						form.FormBorderStyle = dialogSettings.FormBorderStyle;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.Icon:
						form.Icon = dialogSettings.Icon;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.MaximizeBox:
						form.MaximizeBox = dialogSettings.MaximizeBox;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.MaximumSize:
						form.MaximumSize = dialogSettings.MaximumSize;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.MinimizeBox:
						form.MinimizeBox = dialogSettings.MinimizeBox;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.MinimumSize:
						form.MinimumSize = dialogSettings.MinimumSize;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.Opacity:
						form.Opacity = dialogSettings.Opacity;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.ShowIcon:
						form.ShowIcon = dialogSettings.ShowIcon;
						break;
					case RowEditTemplateDialogSettingsPropertyIds.AutoValidate:
						form.AutoValidate = dialogSettings.AutoValidate;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (!HasAppearance || Appearance != propChange.Source)
				{
					return;
				}
				AppearancePropIds val = (AppearancePropIds)(object)propChange.PropId;
				if ((int)val != 1)
				{
					if ((int)val != 2)
					{
						if ((int)val == 20)
						{
							((Control)this).Cursor = Appearance.Cursor;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						((Control)this).ForeColor = Appearance.ForeColor;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					SyncBackColor();
				}
				if (((Control)this).IsHandleCreated)
				{
					((Control)this).Invalidate(invalidateChildren: true);
				}
				NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfChange();
			}
		}

		internal void RefreshBindings(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			CurrencyManager currencyManager = null;
			if (Band.Key == band.Key && BandHierarchyLevel == band.HierarchicalLevel)
			{
				currencyManager = ((Control)(object)this).BindingContext[this] as CurrencyManager;
			}
			else if (((Control)(object)this).BindingContext.Contains(this, band.Key))
			{
				currencyManager = ((Control)(object)this).BindingContext[this, band.Key] as CurrencyManager;
			}
			currencyManager?.Refresh();
		}

		internal void ReparentTemplate()
		{
			((Control)this).Visible = false;
			((Control)(object)this).Dock = originalDockStyle;
			((Control)this).Size = originalSize;
			if (originalParent != null)
			{
				((Control)this).Parent = originalParent;
				originalParent = null;
			}
		}

		internal void SetGrid(UltraGridBand band, UltraGrid grid)
		{
			this.grid = grid;
			if (this.grid != null && !this.grid.Initializing)
			{
				bandHierarchicalLevel = band.HierarchicalLevel;
			}
			VerifyColumnData();
		}

		private void SyncBackColor()
		{
			//IL_000e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			((Control)this).BackColor = Utilities.ResolveControlBackColor(StyleUtils.GetRole(this, StyleUtils.TemplateRole.RowEditTemplatePanel), ComponentRole.GetResolutionOrderInfo(ComponentRole), HasAppearance ? Appearance : null, backColorInternal, ((Control)this).Enabled);
		}

		private void UnhookComponentChangeService()
		{
			if (hookedIntoComponentChangeService && ((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) is IComponentChangeService componentChangeService)
			{
				hookedIntoComponentChangeService = false;
				componentChangeService.ComponentRemoving -= OnComponentRemoved;
				componentChangeService.ComponentRename -= OnComponentRename;
			}
		}

		private void UnhookControl(Control control)
		{
			if (isInitializing)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (control is UltraGridCellProxy ultraGridCellProxy)
			{
				ultraGridCellProxy.RowEditTemplate = null;
				if (ultraGridCellProxy.ColumnKey != null)
				{
					ColumnProxyMap.Remove(ultraGridCellProxy.ColumnKey);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				control.Enter -= OnControlEnter;
				control.ControlAdded -= OnChildControlAdded;
				control.ControlRemoved -= OnChildControlRemoved;
			}
		}

		private void UnHookFromEditorProxy()
		{
			if (lastHookedEditor != null && Row != null)
			{
				UltraGridLayout layout = Row.Layout;
				lastHookedEditor.BeforeEnterEditMode -= layout.EmbeddableEditor_BeforeEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.AfterEnterEditMode -= layout.EmbeddableEditor_AfterEnterEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.BeforeExitEditMode -= layout.EmbeddableEditor_BeforeExitEditModeEventHandler;
				lastHookedEditor.AfterExitEditMode -= layout.EmbeddableEditor_AfterExitEditModeEventHandler;
				if (lastHookedEditor.SupportsDropDown)
				{
					lastHookedEditor.BeforeDropDown -= layout.EmbeddableEditor_BeforeDropDownEventHandler;
					lastHookedEditor.AfterCloseUp -= layout.EmbeddableEditor_AfterCloseupEventHandler;
					lastHookedEditor.SelectionChanged -= layout.EmbeddableEditor_SelectionChangedEventHandler;
				}
				lastHookedEditor = null;
			}
		}

		private bool VerifyColumnData()
		{
			return ParentBands != null;
		}

		internal void VerifyProxyEnabledStates()
		{
			if (isInClose || isClosing)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridCellProxy value in ColumnProxyMap.Values)
			{
				value.VerifyEnabledState();
			}
		}

		public bool Close()
		{
			return Close(commitChanges: true);
		}

		public bool Close(bool commitChanges)
		{
			return Close(commitChanges, forceClose: false);
		}

		internal bool Close(bool commitChanges, bool forceClose)
		{
			if (!IsShown || Grid == null || isInClose || isClosing)
			{
				return true;
			}
			try
			{
				isInClose = true;
				BeforeRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs e = new BeforeRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs(this, forceClose);
				grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.BeforeRowEditTemplateClosed, e);
				if (e.Cancel && !forceClose)
				{
					return false;
				}
				isClosing = true;
				if (Row.Layout.ActiveProxy != null && ((UltraEditorProxyBase)Row.Layout.ActiveProxy).Editor != null)
				{
					((UltraEditorProxyBase)Row.Layout.ActiveProxy).Editor.ExitEditMode(true, true);
				}
				if (commitChanges)
				{
					CommitChanges();
				}
				else
				{
					((Control)(object)this).BindingContext[this].CancelCurrentEdit();
					Row.CancelEdit();
				}
				switch (DisplayMode)
				{
				case RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Modal:
					Form.Close();
					break;
				case RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Modeless:
					Form.Close();
					break;
				case RowEditTemplateDisplayMode.Popup:
					DropDownManager.CloseDropDown((Control)(object)Grid);
					break;
				}
				if (IsShown && !forceClose)
				{
					return false;
				}
				Row = null;
				AfterRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs e2 = new AfterRowEditTemplateClosedEventArgs(this);
				Grid.FireEvent(GridEventIds.AfterRowEditTemplateClosed, e2);
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				isInClose = false;
				isClosing = false;
			}
		}

		public virtual bool CommitChanges()
		{
			bool flag = isInCommitChanges;
			try
			{
				isInCommitChanges = true;
				if (Row == null)
				{
					return false;
				}
				((Control)(object)this).BindingContext[this].EndCurrentEdit();
				if (hasBindingError)
				{
					hasBindingError = false;
					return false;
				}
				return Row.Update();
			}
			finally
			{
				isInCommitChanges = flag;
			}
		}

		protected void NotifyDesignEnvironmentOfChange()
		{
			if (!((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				if (((Component)(object)this).GetService(typeof(IComponentChangeService)) is IComponentChangeService componentChangeService)
				{
					componentChangeService.OnComponentChanging(this, null);
					componentChangeService.OnComponentChanged(this, null, null, null);
				}
			}
			catch (Exception)
			{
			}
		}

		protected internal virtual void OnAppStyleChanged()
		{
			SyncBackColor();
			UIElement controlUIElement = (UIElement)(object)ControlUIElement;
			if (controlUIElement != null)
			{
				controlUIElement.DirtyChildElements(true);
				((UIElement)ControlUIElement).VerifyChildElements(true);
			}
			((Control)this).Invalidate(invalidateChildren: true);
		}

		protected virtual void OnMouseEnterElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		protected virtual void OnMouseLeaveElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
		}

		public void ResolveAppearance(ref AppearanceData appearance, ref AppearancePropFlags requestedProps)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UIRole uIRoleResolved = ((UIElement)ControlUIElement).UIRoleResolved;
			ResolutionOrderInfo resolutionOrderInfo = ComponentRole.GetResolutionOrderInfo(ComponentRole);
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrderInfo)).UseStyleBefore && uIRoleResolved != null)
			{
				uIRoleResolved.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrderInfo)).UseControlInfo && HasAppearance)
			{
				Appearance.MergeData(ref appearance, ref requestedProps);
			}
			if (((ResolutionOrderInfo)(ref resolutionOrderInfo)).UseStyleAfter && uIRoleResolved != null)
			{
				uIRoleResolved.ResolveAppearance(ref appearance, ref requestedProps, (RoleState)1);
			}
			if (!((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).HasPropertyBeenSet((AppearancePropFlags)1) && ((ulong)requestedProps & 1uL) != 0L)
			{
				((AppearanceData)(ref appearance)).BackColor = ((Control)(object)this).BackColor;
				requestedProps = (AppearancePropFlags)((ulong)requestedProps ^ 1uL);
			}
		}

		protected override void Dispose(bool disposing)
		{
			if (disposing)
			{
				if (IsShown)
				{
					Close(commitChanges: true, forceClose: true);
				}
				Row = null;
				if (form != null)
				{
					form.Dispose();
					form = null;
				}
				if (dialogSettings != null)
				{
					dialogSettings.Dispose();
					dialogSettings = null;
				}
				UnhookComponentChangeService();
			}
			((IGPanel)this).Dispose(disposing);
		}

		protected override void OnControlAdded(ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnControlAdded(e);
			HookControl(e.Control);
		}

		protected override void OnControlRemoved(ControlEventArgs e)
		{
			((Control)this).OnControlRemoved(e);
			UnhookControl(e.Control);
		}

		protected override void OnCreateControl()
		{
			((IGPanel)this).OnCreateControl();
		}

		protected override void OnPaint(PaintEventArgs e)
		{
			if (ControlUIElement != null)
			{
				((UIElement)ControlUIElement).Draw(e.Graphics, e.ClipRectangle, !((Control)this).GetStyle(ControlStyles.OptimizedDoubleBuffer), (AlphaBlendMode)2);
			}
			((Control)this).OnPaint(e);
		}

		protected override bool ProcessDialogKey(Keys keyData)
		{
			if (ActiveProxy != null && ((UltraEditorProxyBase)ActiveProxy).Editor != null && ((UltraEditorProxyBase)ActiveProxy).Editor.IsInputKey(keyData))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return ((Control)this).ProcessDialogKey(keyData);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ((object)this).GetType().ToString();
		}

		IList IListSource.GetList()
		{
			return TemplateDescriptorList;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.BeginInit()
		{
			isInitializing = true;
		}

		void ISupportInitialize.EndInit()
		{
			isInitializing = false;
			HookControls((Control)(object)this);
			SyncBackColor();
			if (((Component)this).DesignMode)
			{
				HookComponentChangeService();
			}
		}

		void IUltraControl.FireMouseEnterElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseEnterElement(e);
		}

		void IUltraControl.FireMouseLeaveElement(UIElementEventArgs e)
		{
			OnMouseLeaveElement(e);
		}

		protected override void OnEnabledChanged(EventArgs e)
		{
			SyncBackColor();
			((Control)this).OnEnabledChanged(e);
		}
	}

		public override ColorRenderMode PrintColorMode
		{
			get

		private bool ShouldDisplayEmptyMessage(UltraGrid grid)
		{
			if (grid == null || grid.DesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (layout.NoDataSourceMessageEnabledResolved)
			{
				if (Grid.DataSource == null || layout.Bands.Count == 0 || layout.Bands[0].Columns.Count == 0)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal bool OnPreMouseDownInternal(ref MouseMessageInfo msgInfo, UIElement containingElement)
		{
			if (!(Grid is UltraGrid))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UIElement val = containingElement.ElementFromPoint(new Point(((MouseMessageInfo)(ref msgInfo)).X, ((MouseMessageInfo)(ref msgInfo)).Y));
			if (val != null)
			{
				if (val is RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement || val.GetAncestor(typeof(RowColRegionIntersectionUIElement)) != null)
				{
					RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = (RowScrollRegion)val.GetContext(typeof(RowScrollRegion));
					ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion = (ColScrollRegion)val.GetContext(typeof(ColScrollRegion));
					bool flag = true;
					UltraGrid ultraGrid = Grid as UltraGrid;
					if (colScrollRegion != null && rowScrollRegion != null && ultraGrid != null && (colScrollRegion != ultraGrid.DisplayLayout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited_ColScrollRegion || rowScrollRegion != ultraGrid.DisplayLayout.EmbeddableElementBeingEdited_RowScrollRegion))
					{
						UltraGridCell activeCell = ultraGrid.ActiveCell;
						if (activeCell != null && activeCell.IsInEditMode)
						{
							UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = (UltraGridCell)val.GetContext(typeof(UltraGridCell), true);
							if (ultraGridCell == activeCell)
							{
								activeCell.ExitEditMode(cancellingEditOperation: false, forceExit: false);
								if (activeCell.IsInEditMode)
								{
									flag = false;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						if (rowScrollRegion != null)
						{
							Grid.ActiveRowScrollRegion = rowScrollRegion;
						}
						if (colScrollRegion != null)
						{
							Grid.ActiveColScrollRegion = colScrollRegion;
						}
					}
				}
				Control controlForGridDisplay = Grid.ControlForGridDisplay;
				if (((MouseMessageInfo)(ref msgInfo)).Buttons != MouseButtons.Right && controlForGridDisplay.Enabled && !controlForGridDisplay.ContainsFocus)
				{
					bool flag2 = controlForGridDisplay.Site != null && controlForGridDisplay.Site.DesignMode;
					if (!flag2)
					{
						try
						{
							if (DisposableObject.HasSamePublicKey(controlForGridDisplay.GetType()))
							{
								GridUtils.FocusControl(controlForGridDisplay);
							}
							else
							{
								controlForGridDisplay.Focus();
							}
						}
						catch
						{
						}
					}
					if (!controlForGridDisplay.ContainsFocus && !flag2)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool CreateDesignerPromptArea()
		{
			if (!Grid.DesignMode)
			{
				return false;
			}
			RegistryKey registryKey = null;
			try
			{
				RegistryPermission registryPermission = new RegistryPermission(RegistryPermissionAccess.AllAccess, Registry.CurrentUser.Name);
				if (Utilities.CanAssert)
				{
					registryPermission.Assert();
				}
				registryKey = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey("Software\\Infragistics\\UltraWinGrid\\DesignerDialog");
				if (registryKey != null)
				{
					return Convert.ToBoolean(registryKey.GetValue("ShowStartButton", true));
				}
				return true;
			}
			catch
			{
				return true;
			}
			finally
			{
				registryKey?.Close();
			}
		}

		[EditorBrowsable(EditorBrowsableState.Advanced)]
		public override void ProcessKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
		{
			UltraGrid ultraGrid = Grid as UltraGrid;
			ultraGrid?.ForwardToValueListHelper(e);
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				((ControlUIElementBase)this).ProcessKeyDown(e);
			}
			if (!e.Handled)
			{
				ultraGrid?.ForwardKeyToEditorHelper(e);
			}
		}

		protected override bool ShouldDeferMouseDownForDoubleClick(UIElement element, MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			Point point = new Point(e.X, e.Y);
			UIElement val = ((UIElement)this).AdjustableElementFromPoint(point);
			if (val != null)
			{
				return ((ControlUIElementBase)this).ShouldDeferMouseDownForDoubleClick(element, e);
			}
			UIElement ancestor = element.GetAncestor(typeof(EmbeddableUIElementBase));
			EmbeddableUIElementBase val2 = (EmbeddableUIElementBase)(object)((ancestor is EmbeddableUIElementBase) ? ancestor : null);
			if (val2 == null)
			{
				return ((ControlUIElementBase)this).ShouldDeferMouseDownForDoubleClick(element, e);
			}
			if (val2.HasImmediateMouseActionAtPoint(e.Location))
			{
				return ((ControlUIElementBase)this).ShouldDeferMouseDownForDoubleClick(element, e);
			}
			if (!(((UIElement)val2).GetAncestor(typeof(HeaderUIElement)) is HeaderUIElement headerUIElement))
			{
				return ((ControlUIElementBase)this).ShouldDeferMouseDownForDoubleClick(element, e);
			}
			if (!headerUIElement.Header.CanEnterEditMode)
			{
				return ((ControlUIElementBase)this).ShouldDeferMouseDownForDoubleClick(element, e);
			}
			return AllowHeaderEditing.OnDoubleClick == headerUIElement.Header.AllowEditingResolved;
		}

	internal class UnBoundData
	{
		private object current;

		private object original;

		internal object Current
		{
			get
			{
				return current;
			}
			set
			{
				original = current;
				current = value;
			}
		}

		internal object Original
		{
			get
			{
				return original;
			}
			set
			{
				original = value;
			}
		}

		internal UnBoundData()
		{
			Clear();
		}

		internal void Clear()
		{
			current = null;
			original = null;
		}

		internal void RestoreOriginal()
		{
			object obj = Original;
			Current = obj;
		}

		internal void SaveOriginal()
		{
			if (current != null)
			{
				Original = current;
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ViewStyleBase
	{
		private class ScrollableAreaFinder
		{
			internal class VisibleRowInfo
			{
				internal const float ROUNDING_ERROR_MARGIN = 0.1f;

				internal UltraGridRow row;

				internal float top;

				internal float bottom;

				internal VisibleRowInfo(VisibleRow vr)
				{
					row = vr.Row;
					UltraGridBase grid = vr.Row.Band.Layout.Grid;
					top = (float)vr.Top * ((UltraControlBase)grid).ZoomFactor;
					bottom = (float)vr.Bottom * ((UltraControlBase)grid).ZoomFactor;
				}

				public override int GetHashCode()
				{
					return row.GetHashCode() ^ (int)Math.Round(bottom - top);
				}

				public override bool Equals(object o)
				{
					if (o is VisibleRowInfo visibleRowInfo && row == visibleRowInfo.row)
					{
						return Math.Abs(bottom - top - (visibleRowInfo.bottom - visibleRowInfo.top)) < 0.1f;
					}
					return false;
				}
			}

			private VisibleRowInfo[] oo;

			private VisibleRowInfo[] nn;

			private int rsrExtent;

			private ScrollableAreaFinder(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext, VisibleRowInfo[] oldVisibleRows, VisibleRowInfo[] newVisibleRows)
			{
				oo = oldVisibleRows;
				nn = newVisibleRows;
				rsrExtent = GetRsrExtent(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
			}

			private static int GetRsrExtent(RowScrollRegion rsr)
			{
				int num = rsr.ZoomedExtent;
				bool flag = rsr.IsLastVisibleRegion;
				UltraGridLayout layout = rsr.Layout;
				if (flag && layout != null && layout.DataAreaElement != null)
				{
					UIElement child = GridUtils.GetChild((UIElement)(object)layout.DataAreaElement, typeof(ColScrollbarUIElement));
					flag = child != null;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					int num2 = layout?.HorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved ?? ScaledSystemInformation.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeight((Control)null);
					num2 = Utilities.GetZoomedValue(num2, (UltraControlBase)(object)layout.Grid, false);
					num -= num2;
				}
				return num;
			}

			internal static VisibleRowInfo[] GetVisibleRowInfos(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext)
			{
				VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = scrollContext.VisibleRows;
				List<VisibleRowInfo> list = new List<VisibleRowInfo>(visibleRows.Count);
				int num = GetRsrExtent(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
				int i = 0;
				for (int count = visibleRows.Count; i < count; i++)
				{
					VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRows[i];
					VisibleRowInfo visibleRowInfo = new VisibleRowInfo(visibleRow);
					if (visibleRowInfo.top >= 0f && visibleRowInfo.bottom <= (float)num && !visibleRow.IsClipBottomToSet)
					{
						list.Add(visibleRowInfo);
					}
				}
				return list.ToArray();
			}

			internal static void FindAreasToScrollHelper(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext, VisibleRowInfo[] oldVisibleRows)
			{
				VisibleRowInfo[] visibleRowInfos = GetVisibleRowInfos(ref scrollContext);

				scrollableAreaFinder.FindAreasToScroll(ref scrollContext);
			}

			internal static bool Matches(VisibleRowInfo oldVr, VisibleRowInfo newVr, float ooDelta)
			{
				if (oldVr.row == newVr.row && Math.Abs(ooDelta + oldVr.top - newVr.top) <= 0.1f)
				{
					return Math.Abs(ooDelta + oldVr.bottom - newVr.bottom) <= 0.1f;
				}
				return false;
			}

			internal int GetMatchingRowsCount(int ooStart, int nnStart, bool forward, float ooDelta)
			{
				int num = 0;
				if (forward)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < Math.Min(oo.Length - ooStart, nn.Length - nnStart) && Matches(oo[ooStart + i], nn[nnStart + i], ooDelta); i++)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					for (int i = 0; i <= Math.Min(ooStart, nnStart) && Matches(oo[ooStart - i], nn[nnStart - i], ooDelta); i++)
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return num;
			}

			internal void FindAreasToScroll(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext)
			{
				int matchingRowsCount = GetMatchingRowsCount(0, 0, forward: true, 0f);
				int matchingRowsCount2 = GetMatchingRowsCount(oo.Length - 1, nn.Length - 1, forward: false, 0f);
				bool flag = true;
				if (matchingRowsCount + matchingRowsCount2 < nn.Length)
				{
					RectangleF empty = RectangleF.Empty;
					RectangleF rectangleF = RectangleF.Empty;
					RectangleF rectangleF2 = RectangleF.Empty;
					float num = 0f;
					int num2 = matchingRowsCount;
					int num3 = oo.Length - matchingRowsCount2 - 1;
					float y = ((matchingRowsCount > 0) ? nn[matchingRowsCount - 1].bottom : 0f);
					float num4 = ((matchingRowsCount2 > 0) ? nn[nn.Length - matchingRowsCount2].top : ((float)rsrExtent));
					if (num2 >= 0 && num3 >= 0)
					{
						int num5 = Array.IndexOf(nn, oo[num2]);
						if (num5 < 0 && nn.Length > 1 + num2 && oo.Length > 1 + num2)
						{
							num2++;
							num5 = Array.IndexOf(nn, oo[num2]);
							if (num5 < num2)
							{
								num5 = -1;
							}
						}
						if (num5 >= 0)
						{
							num = nn[num5].top - oo[num2].top;
							int matchingRowsCount3 = GetMatchingRowsCount(num2, num5, forward: true, num);
							if (matchingRowsCount3 > 0)
							{
								empty.Y = nn[num5].top - num;
								empty.Height = nn[num5 + matchingRowsCount3 - 1].bottom - nn[num5].top;
							}
						}
						else
						{
							num5 = Array.IndexOf(nn, oo[num3]);
							if (num5 >= 0)
							{
								num = nn[num5].bottom - oo[num3].bottom;
								int matchingRowsCount4 = GetMatchingRowsCount(num3, num5, forward: false, num);
								if (matchingRowsCount4 > 0)
								{
									empty.Y = nn[num5 - matchingRowsCount4 + 1].top - num;
									empty.Height = nn[num5].bottom - nn[num5 - matchingRowsCount4 + 1].top;
								}
							}
						}
					}
					if (!empty.IsEmpty)
					{
						scrollContext.scrollDelta = (int)Math.Round(num);
						rectangleF.Y = y;
						rectangleF.Height = empty.Y + num - rectangleF.Y;
						rectangleF2.Y = empty.Bottom + num;
						rectangleF2.Height = num4 - rectangleF2.Y;
						if (num > 0f)
						{
							RectangleF rectangleF3 = rectangleF;
							rectangleF = rectangleF2;
							rectangleF2 = rectangleF3;
						}
						int zoomedOrigin = scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.ZoomedOrigin;
						empty.Offset(0f, zoomedOrigin);
						rectangleF.Offset(0f, zoomedOrigin);
						rectangleF2.Offset(0f, zoomedOrigin);
						scrollContext.scrollRect = Rectangle.Round(empty);
						scrollContext.invalidRect = Rectangle.Round(rectangleF);
						scrollContext.invalidRect2 = Rectangle.Round(rectangleF2);
						scrollContext.invalidate = true;
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				else if (matchingRowsCount == matchingRowsCount2 && matchingRowsCount == nn.Length && nn.Length != 0 && nn[0].top == oo[0].top)
				{
					flag = false;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					scrollContext.scrollDelta = -1;
					scrollContext.invalidate = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void FitColumnsToWidth()
		{
			//IL_026a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if ((!layout.AutoFitAllColumns && !layout.AutoFitExtendLastColumn) || layout.Grid == null || (!((Control)(object)layout.Grid).Created && (layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay == null || !layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.Created)))

			Rectangle rectangle = ((ultraGridBase == null) ? Utilities.GetRectangleForZoomFactor(layout.Grid.ControlForGridDisplay.ClientRectangle, (UltraControlBase)(object)ultraGridBase, true) : Utilities.GetRectangleForZoomFactor(ultraGridBase.GridClientAreaRectangle, (UltraControlBase)(object)ultraGridBase, true));
			if (layout.IsPrintLayout && layout.Grid is UltraGrid)
			{
				PrintManager printManager = ((UltraGrid)layout.Grid).PrintManager;
				if (printManager != null)

						if (num <= (double)(int)num2)
						{
							rectangle.Width = (int)num2;
						}
						if (layout.AutoFitExtendLastColumn)
						{
							rectangle.Width = (int)num2;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			bool flag = false;
			if (!layout.IsPrintLayout)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < layout.RowScrollRegions.Count; i++)
				{
					RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = layout.RowScrollRegions[i];
					if (rowScrollRegion != null && rowScrollRegion.WillScrollbarBeShown(ScrollbarVisibility.Check))
					{
						flag = true;
					}
				}
				if (layout.IsDisplayLayout)
				{
					DataAreaUIElement dataAreaElement = layout.DataAreaElement;
					if (dataAreaElement != null)
					{
						dataAreaElement.haDDDDVerticalScrollbar = flag;
					}
				}
			}
			if (layout.Grid is UltraDropDownBase)

		internal virtual int GetFixedHeaderHeight(bool includeOverlappedBorders)
		{
			if (FixedHeaderHeightCachingEnabled && cachedFixedHeaderHeight != -1)
			{
				return cachedFixedHeaderHeight;
			}
			int num = 0;
			if (HasFixedHeaders)
			{
				BandsCollection sortedBands = layout.SortedBands;
				if (sortedBands != null)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < sortedBands.Count; i++)
					{
						UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = sortedBands[i];
						if (!ultraGridBand.Hidden && BandHasFixedHeaders(ultraGridBand))
						{
							int totalHeaderHeight = ultraGridBand.GetTotalHeaderHeight(includeOverlappedBorders);
							num = ((!HasMultiRowTiers) ? (num + totalHeaderHeight) : Math.Max(num, totalHeaderHeight));
						}
						if (!IsMultiBandDisplay)
						{
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (FixedHeaderHeightCachingEnabled)
			{
				cachedFixedHeaderHeight = num;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow GetLastDescendantRow(UltraGridRow parentRow)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			if (parentRow != null && parentRow.IsExpanded)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Layout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = Layout.SortedBands[i];
					if (ultraGridBand.Hidden)
					{
						continue;
					}
					bool flag = parentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow;
					if ((!flag || parentRow.Band != ultraGridBand) && (flag || parentRow.Band != ultraGridBand.ParentBand))
					{
						continue;
					}
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = null;
					ultraGridRow2 = parentRow.GetChild(ChildRow.Last, ultraGridBand, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);
					if (ultraGridRow2 == null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow3 = null;
					ultraGridRow3 = ultraGridRow2.GetPrevVisibleRelative(spanBands: false, skipThisRow: false, spanParents: true);
					if (ultraGridRow3 != null)
					{
						ultraGridRow = GetLastDescendantRow(ultraGridRow3);
						if (ultraGridRow == null)
						{
							ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow3;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return ultraGridRow;
		}

		internal static void OnAfterRowListCreated_ProcessBand(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			IUltraCalcManager ultraCalcManager = ((band.Layout != null) ? band.Layout.CalcManager : null);
			if (ultraCalcManager == null || band.Layout.CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridColumn column in band.Columns)
			{
				if (column != null && column.CalcReference != null && column.CalcReference.RecalcDeferred && column.CalcReference.HasFormula && !column.CalcReference.HasFormulaSyntaxError)
				{
					ultraCalcManager.RowsCollectionVisibilityChanged(column.CalcReference);
				}
			}
			foreach (SummarySettings item in (IEnumerable)band.Summaries)
			{
				if (item != null && item.CalcReference != null && item.CalcReference.RecalcDeferred && item.CalcReference.HasFormula && !item.CalcReference.HasFormulaSyntaxError)
				{
					ultraCalcManager.RowsCollectionVisibilityChanged(item.CalcReference);
				}
			}
			if (band.CalcReference.GroupLevelRelatedReferences == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GroupLevelSummarySettingsReference groupLevelRelatedReference in band.CalcReference.GroupLevelRelatedReferences)
			{
				if (groupLevelRelatedReference != null && groupLevelRelatedReference.RecalcDeferred && groupLevelRelatedReference.HasFormula && !groupLevelRelatedReference.HasFormulaSyntaxError)
				{
					ultraCalcManager.RowsCollectionVisibilityChanged(groupLevelRelatedReference);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static void OnAfterRowListCreated(RowScrollRegion rsr)
		{
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRowsCollection = rsr?.VisibleRows;
			if (visibleRowsCollection == null || rsr.Layout == null || rsr.inGetMaxScrollPosition || rsr.Layout.CalcManagerNotificationsSuspended)
			{
				return;
			}
			IUltraCalcManager calcManager = rsr.Layout.CalcManager;
			if (calcManager == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in rsr.Layout.SortedBands)
			{
				if (sortedBand.InternalSortedColumns != null && sortedBand.InternalSortedColumns.inProcessingNewSortedColumns)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			bool[] array = new bool[rsr.Layout.SortedBands.Count];
			foreach (VisibleRow item in visibleRowsCollection)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = item.Row?.Band;
				int num = ultraGridBand?.Index ?? (-1);
				if (num >= 0 && num < array.Length && !array[num] && ultraGridBand.Columns != null)
				{
					OnAfterRowListCreated_ProcessBand(ultraGridBand);
					array[num] = true;
				}
			}
		}

		internal abstract bool RecreateHeaderList(ColScrollRegion csr);

		internal virtual void RecreateRowList(RowScrollRegion rsr, bool syncWithCalcManager = true)
		{
			if (rsr.isInRecreateRowList)
			{
				return;
			}
			try
			{
				rsr.isInRecreateRowList = true;
				if (layout != null)
				{
					layout.BeginCaching();
				}
				rsr.VisibleRows.InternalClear();
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = rsr.FirstRow;
				while (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					UltraGridRow parentRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
					if (parentRow == null)
					{
						break;
					}
					bool hiddenResolved = ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved;
					if ((IsMultiBandDisplay && !hiddenResolved && ultraGridRow.AllAncestorsExpanded && (!HasMultiRowTiers || parentRow == null || ultraGridRow.HasPrevSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) || ultraGridRow.HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))) || parentRow is UltraGridGroupByRow)
					{
						break;
					}
					ultraGridRow = parentRow;
				}
				if (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					if (!ultraGridRow.HiddenResolved)
					{
						rsr.SetFirstRow(ultraGridRow);
					}
					VisibleRowFetchRowContext context = new VisibleRowFetchRowContext(rsr);
					context.beginAtRow = ultraGridRow;
					if (Using_CreateRowsList_FixedRowsFeature)
					{
						CreateRowsList_FixedRowsFeature(ref context, null, null);
					}
					else
					{
						AddSiblingRows(ref context, null, null);
					}
				}
				if (syncWithCalcManager)
				{
					OnAfterRowListCreated(rsr);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				rsr.isInRecreateRowList = false;
				if (layout != null)
				{
					layout.EndCaching();
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual void VerifyRowList(RowScrollRegion rsr, bool syncWithCalcManager = true)
		{
			if (SupportsFixedRows)
			{
				RecreateRowList(rsr, syncWithCalcManager);
				return;
			}
			VisibleRowFetchRowContext forwardContext = new VisibleRowFetchRowContext(rsr);
			if (VerifyExistingRows(ref forwardContext))
			{
				AdjustListToFillRegion(ref forwardContext);
			}
		}

		internal int CalcGroupByConnectorsExtent(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			int num = CalculateGroupByIndent(band);
			if (num > 0)
			{
				num += band.PreRowAreaExtent;
				if (band.ParentBand != null)
				{
					num -= band.ParentBand.PreRowAreaExtent;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal int CalculateGroupByIndent(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (band.HasGroupBySortColumns)
			{
				num = (1 + band.SortedColumns.LastGroupByColIndex) * band.IndentationGroupByRowResolved;
				if (band.PreRowAreaExtent > 0)
				{
					bool flag = true;
					switch (band.ExpansionIndicatorResolved)
					{
					case ShowExpansionIndicator.Never:
						flag = false;
						break;
					case ShowExpansionIndicator.Default:
						flag = IsMultiBandDisplay;
						break;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						num -= band.PreRowSelectorWidth / 2 - band.ExpansionIndicatorWidth / 2;
					}
				}
				if (band.ParentBand != null)
				{
					num += band.ParentBand.PreRowAreaExtent;
				}
			}
			return num;
		}

		protected bool AddBandHeaders(ColScrollRegion csr, UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (band.HiddenResolved)

			int position = csr.Position;

			{
				RowScrollRegionsCollection rowScrollRegionsCollection = ((Layout != null) ? Layout.RowScrollRegions : null);
				bool flag = rowScrollRegionsCollection != null && rowScrollRegionsCollection.Count > 0;
				int num3 = 0;
				while (flag && num3 < rowScrollRegionsCollection.Count)
				{
					flag = rowScrollRegionsCollection[num3].WillScrollbarBeShown();
					num3++;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					num -= num2;
				}
			}
			if (band.HiddenResolved)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag2 = band.UseFixedHeadersResolved(csr);
			int num4;
			if (!flag2 && !band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				num4 = ((!csr.IsExclusive) ? band.GetOrigin(BandOrigin.RowSelector) : csr.GetBandOrigin(band));
				foreach (HeaderBase orderedHeader in band.OrderedHeaders)
				{
					if (orderedHeader.Hidden)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (csr.IsExclusive)

						{
							continue;
						}
					}
					else if (orderedHeader.ExclusiveColScrollRegion != null)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (num4 > position + num)
					{
						break;
					}
					int headerExtent_AutoFitExtendLastColumn_NonRowLayout = GetHeaderExtent_AutoFitExtendLastColumn_NonRowLayout(orderedHeader);
					if (num4 + headerExtent_AutoFitExtendLastColumn_NonRowLayout >= position)
					{
						csr.VisibleHeaders.AddVisibleHeaderFromCache(orderedHeader, num4);
						result = true;
					}
					num4 += headerExtent_AutoFitExtendLastColumn_NonRowLayout;
				}
				return result;
			}
			bool hasMultiRowTiers = HasMultiRowTiers;
			if (hasMultiRowTiers && flag2)
			{
				int scrollDelta = position;
				UltraGridBand.GetBandOriginExtent_HorizontalViewStyle(band, csr, ref scrollDelta, out num4, out var _);
			}
			else
			{
				num4 = band.GetOrigin(BandOrigin.RowSelector);
			}
			int num5 = num4;
			bool flag3 = false;
			if (band.UseRowLayoutResolved)
			{
				HeadersCollection layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical = band.LayoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical;
				if (layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical != null)

					int num6 = num4 + fixedHeaders_OriginDelta - position;
					foreach (HeaderBase item in layoutOrderedVisibleColumnHeadersVertical)
					{
						int num7 = num6 + item.Origin;
						if (flag2 && !band.IsHeaderFixed(csr, item))
						{
							num7 -= position;
						}
						int num8 = num7 + item.Extent;
						if ((num8 > 0 && num8 > num6 && num7 < num) || band.Layout.AutoFitAllColumns)
						{

		private void CalcScrollUpAmount(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext, VisibleRow oldTopVisibleRow, int origTopOfRow, int origBottom, bool pixelScroll)
		{
			scrollContext.scrollDelta = oldTopVisibleRow.Bottom - origBottom;
			if (HasFixedHeaders)
			{
				if (HasMultiRowTiers)
				{

					scrollContext.invalidRect.Height = oldTopVisibleRow.GetTopOfRow(adjustForOverlappedBorders: false);
					scrollContext.invalidate = true;
				}
				else
				{
					scrollContext.scrollRect.Y += GetFixedHeaderHeight();
					scrollContext.scrollRect.Height -= GetFixedHeaderHeight();
				}
			}
			else if (!oldTopVisibleRow.HasHeader)
			{
				scrollContext.scrollRect.Y += origTopOfRow + 1;
				scrollContext.invalidRect.Height = scrollContext.scrollRect.Top - scrollContext.invalidRect.Top;
				scrollContext.invalidate = true;
			}
			scrollContext.scrollRect.Height -= scrollContext.scrollDelta;
		}

					}
					else if (flag2)
					{
						rowScrollRegion.PopFrontVisibleRow();
						flag = true;
						continue;
					}
				}
				if (visibleRows.Count <= 0)
				{
					break;
				}
				VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRows[0];
				int num = 0;
				while (true)
				{
					if (num < visibleRows.Count)
					{
						visibleRow = visibleRows[num];
						bool flag3 = false;
						UltraGridRow row = visibleRow.Row;
						UltraGridRow parentRow = row.ParentRow;
						if (row.HiddenResolved)
						{
							bool flag4 = VerifyShouldRemoveHiddenRow(rowScrollRegion, row, out recreateRowList);
							if (recreateRowList)
							{
								visibleRows.InternalClear();
								goto IL_011a;
							}
							if (flag4)
							{
								flag3 = true;
							}
						}
						if (!flag3 && parentRow != null && !parentRow.Expanded)
						{
							flag3 = true;
						}
						if (flag3)
						{
							break;
						}
						OrientVisibleRowForward(ref forwardContext, visibleRow);
						forwardContext.lastRowInserted = visibleRow;
						forwardContext.insertAfter = visibleRow;
						num++;
						continue;
					}
					goto IL_011a;
					IL_011a:
					if (recreateRowList)
					{
						RecreateRowList(rowScrollRegion);
						return false;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						ResetStartRow(rowScrollRegion);
					}
					return true;
				}
				rowScrollRegion.RemoveVisibleRow(visibleRow);
			}
			RecreateRowList(rowScrollRegion);
			return false;
		}

		private static void ResetStartRow(RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion)
		{
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = rowScrollRegion.VisibleRows;

		private void AdjustListToFillRegion(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext forwardContext)
		{
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = forwardContext.rowScrollRegion;
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = forwardContext.VisibleRows;
			if (forwardContext.lastRowInserted.OrigTop >= forwardContext.regionHeight)
			{
				while (visibleRows.Count > 1 && visibleRows.LastRow.OrigTop >= forwardContext.regionHeight + visibleRows.LastRow.GetTotalHeight())
				{
					rowScrollRegion.PopBackVisibleRow();
				}
				return;
			}
			VisibleRow lastRowInserted = forwardContext.lastRowInserted;
			rowScrollRegion.PopBackVisibleRow();
			forwardContext.beginAtRow = lastRowInserted.Row;
			forwardContext.beginAtVisibleRow = lastRowInserted;
			forwardContext.insertAfter = ((visibleRows.Count > 0) ? visibleRows.LastRow : null);
			forwardContext.lastRowInserted = forwardContext.insertAfter;
			if (lastRowInserted != null && lastRowInserted.HasHeader)
			{
				lastVisibleRowHadHeaders = lastRowInserted;
			}
			try
			{
				AddSiblingRows(ref forwardContext, null, null);
			}
			finally
			{
				lastVisibleRowHadHeaders = null;
			}
		}

		private void CalcScrollDownAmount(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext, VisibleRow newTopRow, int origBottom)

			CalcScrollDownAmount(ref scrollContext, newTopRow, origBottom, pixelScroll: false);
		}

		private void CalcScrollDownAmount(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext, VisibleRow newTopRow, int origBottom, bool pixelScroll)
		{
			scrollContext.scrollDelta = newTopRow.Bottom - origBottom;
			if (HasFixedHeaders)
			{
				scrollContext.scrollRect.Y += GetFixedHeaderHeight() - scrollContext.scrollDelta;
				scrollContext.invalidate = true;
				if (HasMultiRowTiers)
				{
					scrollContext.invalidRect.Height = 2 + Math.Max(GetFixedHeaderHeight(), newTopRow.GetTopOfRow());
					return;
				}
				if (pixelScroll)
				{
					scrollContext.invalidRect.Height = GetFixedHeaderHeight() + 2;
					return;
				}
				scrollContext.invalidRect.Y += GetFixedHeaderHeight();
				scrollContext.invalidRect.Height = 2;
			}
			else
			{
				if (newTopRow.GetTopOfRow() > 0)
				{
					scrollContext.invalidRect.Height = newTopRow.GetTopOfRow(adjustForOverlappedBorders: false) + 2;
					scrollContext.invalidate = true;
				}
				scrollContext.scrollRect.Y += newTopRow.GetTopOfRow() - scrollContext.scrollDelta;
			}
		}

				scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.lastScrollDelta = 0;

			}
			bool flag3;
			while (true)

							}
						}
						else

							scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset -= visibleRow2.Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight();
							if (visibleRow3 != null && visibleRow3.HasHeader)
							{
								scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset += visibleRow3.Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight();
							}
						}
						int scrollOffset = scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset;
					}
					int lastScrollDelta = scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.lastScrollDelta;
					int scrollDelta = scrollContext.scrollDelta;
				}
				else

					flag3 = true;
				}
				if (flag3)
