		private void OnScrollPageUp(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext)
		{
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = scrollContext.VisibleRows;
			VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRows[0];
			VisibleRow visibleRow2 = null;
			if (visibleRow.IsAbsoluteFirstRow)
			{
				return;
			}
			int top = visibleRow.GetTop();
			int topOfRow = visibleRow.GetTopOfRow();
			int tier = visibleRow.Tier;
			int bottom = visibleRow.Bottom;
			int num = Math.Max(visibleRow.Row.TotalHeight, scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.Extent - (top + visibleRow.GetTotalHeight()));
			int num2 = 0;
			int num3 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < visibleRows.Count; i++)
			{
				visibleRow2 = visibleRows[i];
				if (visibleRow2.Tier != num3)
				{
					num2++;
					num3 = visibleRow2.Tier;
				}
				visibleRow2.SetTop(visibleRow2.GetTop() + num);
				visibleRow2.Tier += 500;
			}
			scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.PopFrontVisibleRow();
			VisibleRowFetchRowContext context = new VisibleRowFetchRowContext(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion, fetchBackward: true);
			context.beginAtRow = visibleRow.Row;
			context.beginAtVisibleRow = visibleRow;
			context.insertBefore = ((visibleRows.Count > 0) ? visibleRows[0] : null);
			context.lastRowInserted = context.insertBefore;
			context.lastTierAdded = ((context.lastRowInserted != null) ? context.lastRowInserted.Tier : tier);
			AddSiblingRows(ref context, null, null);
			VerifyRowList(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
			if (visibleRow != null)
			{
				CalcScrollUpAmount(ref scrollContext, visibleRow, topOfRow, bottom);
			}
			scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(visibleRows[0].Row);
		}

		private void OnScrollPageDown(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext)
		{
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = scrollContext.VisibleRows;
			VisibleRowFetchRowContext forwardContext = new VisibleRowFetchRowContext(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
			forwardContext.regionHeight *= 2;
			if (!VerifyExistingRows(ref forwardContext))
			{
				scrollContext.invalidate = true;
				scrollContext.scrollDelta = 0;
				return;
			}
			AdjustListToFillRegion(ref forwardContext);
			VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRows[0];
			UltraGridBand oldTopHeaderBand = ((visibleRow != null && visibleRow.HasHeader) ? visibleRow.Band : null);
			bool flag = true;
			if (!scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.IsLastVisibleRegion || (scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions != null && scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions.LastVisibleRegion != null && !scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.Layout.ColScrollRegions.LastVisibleRegion.WillScrollbarBeShown(ScrollbarVisibility.Visible)))
			{
				flag = false;
			}
			int num = ((layout != null) ? layout.HorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved : ScaledSystemInformation.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeight((Control)null));
			int newTopRowCutoff = Math.Max(1, scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.Extent - (flag ? num : 0));
			if (CanScrollDownMore(ref scrollContext, oldTopHeaderBand, ref newTopRowCutoff))
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				while (visibleRows.Count > 1 && (num2 == 0 || visibleRows[0].OrigTop + visibleRows[0].GetTotalHeight() <= newTopRowCutoff) && CanScrollDownMore(ref scrollContext, oldTopHeaderBand))
				{
					scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.PopFrontVisibleRow();
					num2++;
				}
				VisibleRow visibleRow2 = visibleRows[0];
				scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(visibleRow2.Row);
				int bottom = visibleRow2.Bottom;
				VerifyRowList(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
				if (visibleRow2 != null)
				{
					CalcScrollDownAmount(ref scrollContext, visibleRow2, bottom);
				}
			}
		}

		private void OnEndScroll(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext)
		{
			if (scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset != 0)
			{
				Rectangle invalidRect = scrollContext.invalidRect;
				switch (scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.lastScrollType)
				{
				case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
					OnScrollUp(ref scrollContext);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
				{
					VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = scrollContext.VisibleRows;
					VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRows[0];
					while (visibleRow != null && visibleRow.GetTop() + visibleRow.GetTotalHeight() + visibleRow.PostRowSpacing < GetFixedHeaderHeight())
					{
						scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.PopFrontVisibleRow();
						VerifyRowList(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
						visibleRow = ((visibleRows.Count > 0) ? visibleRows[0] : null);
						scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset = 0;
						scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.lastScrollDelta = 0;
						scrollContext.scrollDelta = 0;
					}
					OnScrollDown(ref scrollContext);
					scrollContext.invalidate = true;
					scrollContext.invalidRect = invalidRect;
					break;
				}
				}
			}
			scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset = 0;
			scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.lastScrollDelta = 0;
		}

		internal UltraGridRow ScrollRows_PageUpHelper(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext, ScrollbarVisibility colScrollbarVisibility, int maxIteration, UltraGridRow targetLastRow, bool returnWhenTargetRowFullyVisible)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			while (maxIteration <= 0 || --maxIteration != 0)
			{
				ScrollRowsHelper(ref scrollContext);
				RecreateRowList(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
				if (returnWhenTargetRowFullyVisible && scrollContext.VisibleRows.IsFullyVisible(targetLastRow, colScrollbarVisibility))
				{
					return scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.InternalFirstRow;
				}
				VisibleRow firstLastScrollableRow = scrollContext.VisibleRows.GetFirstLastScrollableRow(first: false, fullyVisible: true, colScrollbarVisibility);
				if (firstLastScrollableRow == null || (!scrollContext.VisibleRows.HasAssociatedVisibleRow(targetLastRow) && ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement != scrollContext.scrollType))
				{
					break;
				}
				if (targetLastRow == firstLastScrollableRow.Row || ultraGridRow == scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.InternalFirstRow)
				{
					return scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.InternalFirstRow;
				}
				ultraGridRow = scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.InternalFirstRow;
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void ScrollRowsHelper(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext)
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = Layout;
			RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion = scrollContext.rowScrollRegion;
			int scrollTrackPos = scrollContext.scrollTrackPos;
			int maxScrollPosition = rowScrollRegion.GetMaxScrollPosition();
			ScrollbarVisibility scrollbarVisibility = ScrollbarVisibility.Check;
			UltraGridRow firstRow = rowScrollRegion.FirstRow;
			int val = -1;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = null;
			scrollContext.findScrollableArea = scrollContext.findScrollableArea && (scrollContext.scrollType == ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement || ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement == scrollContext.scrollType || ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack == scrollContext.scrollType);
			ScrollableAreaFinder.VisibleRowInfo[] oldVisibleRows = (scrollContext.findScrollableArea ? ScrollableAreaFinder.GetVisibleRowInfos(ref scrollContext) : null);
			switch (scrollContext.scrollType)
			{
			case ScrollEventType.First:
				val = 0;
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.Last:
				val = maxScrollPosition;
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
			case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = firstRow;
				if (ultraGridRow2 != null)
				{
					int scrollPosition2 = ultraGridRow2.ScrollPosition;
					int num2 = ((scrollContext.scrollType != ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement) ? 1 : (-1));
					int num3 = ((scrollContext.panDeltaAbsolute <= 0) ? 1 : scrollContext.panDeltaAbsolute);
					num3 *= num2;
					val = num3 + ((scrollPosition2 >= 0) ? scrollPosition2 : scrollTrackPos);
					val = Math.Max(0, val);
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement:
			case ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement:
			{
				if (scrollbarVisibility == ScrollbarVisibility.Check)
				{
					scrollbarVisibility = (ultraGridLayout.ColScrollRegions.AreScrollbarsVisible(ScrollbarVisibility.Visible) ? ScrollbarVisibility.Visible : ScrollbarVisibility.Hidden);
				}
				bool first = ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement == scrollContext.scrollType;
				VisibleRow firstLastScrollableRow = scrollContext.VisibleRows.GetFirstLastScrollableRow(first, fullyVisible: true, scrollbarVisibility);
				if (firstLastScrollableRow != null)
				{
					if (ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement == scrollContext.scrollType)
					{
						ultraGridRow = firstLastScrollableRow.Row;
					}
					else
					{
						try
						{
							int scrollPosition = firstLastScrollableRow.Row.ScrollPosition;
							int num = Math.Max(1, scrollContext.VisibleRows.Count - 1);
							UltraGridRow rowAtScrollPos = ultraGridLayout.GetRowAtScrollPos(scrollPosition - num);
							if (rowAtScrollPos != null)
							{
								rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(rowAtScrollPos, invalidate: false, fireScrollEvents: false);
								RecreateRowList(rowScrollRegion);
								VisibleRow firstLastScrollableRow2 = scrollContext.VisibleRows.GetFirstLastScrollableRow(first: false, fullyVisible: true, scrollbarVisibility);
								if (firstLastScrollableRow2 != null)
								{
									if (firstLastScrollableRow2.Row == firstLastScrollableRow.Row)
									{
										ultraGridRow = rowScrollRegion.InternalFirstRow;
									}
									else if (firstLastScrollableRow2.Row.ScrollPosition < scrollPosition)
									{
										scrollContext.scrollType = ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement;
										ultraGridRow = ScrollRows_PageUpHelper(ref scrollContext, scrollbarVisibility, num, firstLastScrollableRow.Row, returnWhenTargetRowFullyVisible: true);
									}
								}
							}
							if (ultraGridRow == null)
							{
								rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(firstLastScrollableRow.Row, invalidate: false, fireScrollEvents: false);
								RecreateRowList(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
								scrollContext.scrollType = ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement;
								ultraGridRow = ScrollRows_PageUpHelper(ref scrollContext, scrollbarVisibility, 0, firstLastScrollableRow.Row, returnWhenTargetRowFullyVisible: false);
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							scrollContext.scrollType = ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement;
						}
					}
				}
				if (firstLastScrollableRow == null || ultraGridRow == null || ultraGridRow == firstRow)
				{
					ultraGridRow = null;
					ScrollEventType scrollType = scrollContext.scrollType;
					scrollContext.scrollType = ((ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement != scrollType) ? ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement : ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement);
					try
					{
						ScrollRowsHelper(ref scrollContext);
					}
					finally
					{
						scrollContext.scrollType = scrollType;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case ScrollEventType.ThumbTrack:
				val = scrollContext.scrollTrackPos * scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.scrollbarFactor;
				break;
			case ScrollEventType.EndScroll:
				OnEndScroll(ref scrollContext);
				break;
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null)
			{
				val = ultraGridRow.ScrollPosition;
			}
			val = Math.Min(val, maxScrollPosition);
			if (val >= 0)
			{
				ultraGridRow = ultraGridLayout.GetRowAtScrollPos(val);
			}
			if (ultraGridRow != null)
			{
				rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(ultraGridRow, invalidate: false, fireScrollEvents: false);
			}
			RecreateRowList(rowScrollRegion);
			if (scrollContext.findScrollableArea)
			{
				try
				{
					ScrollableAreaFinder.FindAreasToScrollHelper(ref scrollContext, oldVisibleRows);
					return;
				}
				catch
				{
					scrollContext.invalidate = true;
					scrollContext.invalidRect = new Rectangle(0, rowScrollRegion.Origin, 0, rowScrollRegion.Extent);
					return;
				}
			}
			scrollContext.invalidate = true;
			scrollContext.scrollDelta = 0;
		}

		internal virtual void ScrollRows(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext)
		{
			VerifyRowList(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = scrollContext.VisibleRows;
			if (visibleRows.Count == 0)
			{
				RecreateRowList(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
				scrollContext.invalidate = true;
				scrollContext.scrollDelta = 0;
				return;
			}
			if (SupportsFixedRows)
			{
				ScrollRowsHelper(ref scrollContext);
			}
			else
			{
				switch (scrollContext.scrollType)
				{
				case ScrollEventType.First:
					OnScrollTop(ref scrollContext);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.Last:
					OnScrollBottom(ref scrollContext);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.SmallDecrement:
					OnScrollUp(ref scrollContext);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.SmallIncrement:
					OnScrollDown(ref scrollContext);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.LargeDecrement:
					OnScrollPageUp(ref scrollContext);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.LargeIncrement:
					OnScrollPageDown(ref scrollContext);
					break;
				case ScrollEventType.EndScroll:
					OnEndScroll(ref scrollContext);
					break;
				}
			}
			scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.LastScrollType = scrollContext.scrollType;
		}

		internal virtual void ScrollRowsCancelled(ref ScrollRowsContext scrollContext)
		{
			if (scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset != 0)
			{
				scrollContext.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset = 0;
				VerifyRowList(scrollContext.rowScrollRegion);
			}
		}

		protected bool CreateRowsList_FixedRowsFeature(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, VisibleRow parentVisibleRow, UltraGridRow firstSibling)
		{
			VisibleRowFetchRowContext context2 = context;
			context2.isBottomFixedRowsContext = true;
			AddBottomFixedRows(ref context2);
			if (context2.lastRowInserted != null)
			{
				context.regionHeight -= context2.lastRowInserted.BottomOverall;
			}
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = context.VisibleRows;
			int count = visibleRows.Count;
			AddTopFixedRows(ref context);
			try
			{
				BeginFixedHeaderHeightCaching();
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = context.beginAtRow;
				int num = ultraGridRow.ScrollPosition;
				Hashtable hashtable = new Hashtable();
				if (parentVisibleRow != null)
				{
					hashtable[parentVisibleRow.Row] = parentVisibleRow;
				}
				FixUpScrollCountsIfNeeded();
				do
				{
					if (!ultraGridRow.FixedResolved)
					{
						AddVisibleRow(ref context, ultraGridRow);
					}
					num++;
					ultraGridRow = context.rowScrollRegion.Layout.GetRowAtScrollPos(num);
				}
				while (ultraGridRow != null && !EndOfRegion(ref context));
				if (count > 0 && visibleRows.Count >= count)
				{
					visibleRows.InternalMoveRowsToEnd(0, count);
					OffsetRows(ref context, visibleRows.Count - count, count, context.regionHeight);
					VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRows[visibleRows.Count - count];
					bool flag = RemoveScrollableRowsBelowLocation(ref context, visibleRow.Top) || !context.rowScrollRegion.IsFirstScrollableRowVisible(ScrollbarVisibility.Hidden);
					if (Layout.ColScrollRegions.AreScrollbarsVisible(flag ? ScrollbarVisibility.Visible : ScrollbarVisibility.Hidden))
					{
						int num2 = ((layout != null) ? layout.HorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved : ScaledSystemInformation.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeight((Control)null));
						OffsetRows(ref context, visibleRows.Count - count, count, -num2);
						RemoveScrollableRowsBelowLocation(ref context, visibleRow.Top);
					}
					if (!visibleRow.HasHeader && visibleRows.Count > count && visibleRows[visibleRows.Count - count - 1].Row.ParentCollection != visibleRow.Row.ParentCollection && !visibleRow.Row.IsGroupByRow)
					{
						int bottomOverall = visibleRow.BottomOverall;
						SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, hasHeader: true);
						int bottomOverall2 = visibleRow.BottomOverall;
						OffsetRow(visibleRow, bottomOverall - bottomOverall2);
						RemoveScrollableRowsBelowLocation(ref context, visibleRow.Top);
					}
				}
				VisibleRow firstScrollableRow = context.VisibleRows.GetFirstScrollableRow();
				if (firstScrollableRow != null)
				{
					context.rowScrollRegion.SetFirstRow(firstScrollableRow.Row, invalidate: false, fireScrollEvents: false);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				EndFixedHeaderHeightCaching();
			}
			return true;
		}

		private void FixUpScrollCountsIfNeeded()
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = Layout;
			if (ultraGridLayout != null && ultraGridLayout.LoadStyle == LoadStyle.LoadOnDemand && ultraGridLayout.IsPrintLayout)
			{
				FixUpScrollCountsIfNeeded(ultraGridLayout.Rows);
			}
		}

		private void FixUpScrollCountsIfNeeded(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			foreach (UltraGridRow row in rows)
			{
				ISparseArrayMultiItem sparseArrayMultiItem = row;
				int scrollCount = sparseArrayMultiItem.ScrollCount;
				if (!row.Expanded || row.ChildBands == null)
				{
					continue;
				}
				foreach (UltraGridChildBand item in (IEnumerable)row.ChildBands)
				{
					FixUpScrollCountsIfNeeded(item.Rows);
				}
			}
		}

		internal static bool RemoveScrollableRowsBelowLocation(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, int location)
		{
			bool result = false;
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = context.VisibleRows;
			for (int num = visibleRows.Count - 1; num >= 0; num--)
			{
				VisibleRow visibleRow = visibleRows[num];
				if (!visibleRow.Row.FixedResolved)
				{
					if (visibleRow.Top > location)
					{
						result = true;
						context.VisibleRows.InternalRemoveAt(num);
					}
					else if (visibleRow.BottomOverall > location)
					{
						visibleRow.IsFullyVisibleOverride = (DefaultableBoolean)2;
						visibleRow.ClipBottomTo = location - visibleRow.Top;
						result = true;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private static void OffsetRow(VisibleRow vr, int amountToOffset)
		{
			vr.SetTop(vr.Top + amountToOffset);
		}

		private static void OffsetRows(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, int index, int count, int amountToOffset)
		{
			VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows = context.VisibleRows;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				OffsetRow(visibleRows[i + index], amountToOffset);
			}
		}

		private VisibleRow GetParentVisibleRowHelper(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, UltraGridRow childRow)
		{
			UltraGridRow parentRow = childRow.ParentRow;
			VisibleRow visibleRow = ((parentRow != null) ? ((VisibleRow)context.ParentVisibleRowMap[parentRow]) : null);
			if (parentRow != null && visibleRow == null)
			{
				visibleRow = context.VisibleRows.VisibleRowFromCache;
				visibleRow.Initialize(GetParentVisibleRowHelper(ref context, parentRow), parentRow);
				context.ParentVisibleRowMap[parentRow] = visibleRow;
			}
			return visibleRow;
		}

		private VisibleRow AddHeadersHelper(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row is HeadersRow)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (context.lastRowInserted == null || row.Band.IsTrivialDescendantOf(context.lastRowInserted.Band))
			{
				int num = ((context.lastRowInserted != null) ? (1 + context.lastRowInserted.Row.OverallHierarchyLevel) : 0);
				List<HeadersRow> list = new List<HeadersRow>();
				UltraGridRow parentRow = row.ParentRow;
				while (parentRow != null && parentRow.OverallHierarchyLevel >= num)
				{
					UltraGridBand band = parentRow.Band;
					HeaderPlacement headerPlacementResolved = band.HeaderPlacementResolved;
					bool flag = false;
					if (HeaderPlacement.OncePerRowIsland == headerPlacementResolved)
					{
						if (!parentRow.IsGroupByRow)
						{
							flag = true;
						}
					}
					else if (HeaderPlacement.OncePerGroupedRowIsland == headerPlacementResolved && parentRow.ParentCollection.IsTopLevel && !parentRow.Band.CardView)
					{
						flag = true;
					}
					if (flag)
					{
						HeadersRow item = new HeadersRow(parentRow.ParentCollection, isAttachedHeader: true);
						list.Add(item);
					}
					parentRow = parentRow.ParentRow;
				}
				list.Reverse();
				VisibleRow visibleRow = null;
				{
					foreach (HeadersRow item2 in list)
					{
						AddVisibleRow(ref context, item2);
						if (context.lastRowInserted != null)
						{
							context.lastRowInserted.AttachedHeadersRow = visibleRow;
						}
						visibleRow = context.lastRowInserted;
					}
					return visibleRow;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		internal void AddVisibleRow(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			VisibleRow attachedHeadersRow = AddHeadersHelper(ref context, row);
			VisibleRow parentVisibleRowHelper = GetParentVisibleRowHelper(ref context, row);
			VisibleRow visibleRowFromCache = context.VisibleRows.VisibleRowFromCache;
			visibleRowFromCache.Initialize(parentVisibleRowHelper, row);
			context.ParentVisibleRowMap[row] = visibleRowFromCache;
			HeadersRow headersRow = visibleRowFromCache.Row as HeadersRow;
			if (headersRow == null || !headersRow.IsAttachedHeader)
			{
				context.VisibleRows.InternalAdd(visibleRowFromCache);
			}
			if (context.fetchBackward)
			{
				OrientVisibleRowBackward(ref context, visibleRowFromCache);
			}
			else
			{
				OrientVisibleRowForward(ref context, visibleRowFromCache);
			}
			context.lastRowInserted = visibleRowFromCache;
			visibleRowFromCache.AttachedHeadersRow = attachedHeadersRow;
			bool flag = headersRow?.IsAttachedHeader ?? false;
		}

		internal void AddTopFixedRows(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context)
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = Layout;
			RowsCollection rows = ultraGridLayout.Rows;
			UltraGridRow[] fixedRows = rows.GetFixedRows(top: true);
			if (fixedRows != null && fixedRows.Length != 0)
			{
				foreach (UltraGridRow row in fixedRows)
				{
					AddVisibleRow(ref context, row);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void AddBottomFixedRows(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context)
		{
			UltraGridLayout ultraGridLayout = Layout;
			RowsCollection rows = ultraGridLayout.Rows;
			UltraGridRow[] fixedRows = rows.GetFixedRows(top: false);
			if (fixedRows == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < fixedRows.Length; i++)
			{
				UltraGridRow row = fixedRows[i];
				AddVisibleRow(ref context, row);
				if (i == 0 && context.lastRowInserted != null)
				{
					SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, context.lastRowInserted, hasHeader: false);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalOrientVisibleRowForward(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, VisibleRow visibleRow)
		{
			OrientVisibleRowForward(ref context, visibleRow);
		}

		internal void SetHasHeaderHelper(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, VisibleRow vr, bool hasHeader)
		{
			vr.HasHeader = hasHeader;
			if (HasMultiRowTiers)
			{
				return;
			}
			HeaderPlacement headerPlacementResolved = vr.Band.HeaderPlacementResolved;
			if (HeaderPlacement.OncePerRowIsland == headerPlacementResolved || HeaderPlacement.OncePerGroupedRowIsland == headerPlacementResolved)
			{
				vr.HasHeader = false;
				object key = ((HeaderPlacement.OncePerRowIsland != headerPlacementResolved) ? vr.Row.ParentCollection.TopLevelRowsCollection : vr.Row.ParentCollection);
				if (!context.CurrentHeaders.ContainsKey(key))
				{
					context.CurrentHeaders[key] = DBNull.Value;
					vr.HasHeader = hasHeader;
				}
			}
			else if (HeaderPlacement.FixedOnTop == headerPlacementResolved)
			{
				vr.HasHeader = false;
			}
		}

		private void BeginFixedHeaderHeightCaching()
		{
			fixedHeaderHeightCachingCounter++;
		}

		private void EndFixedHeaderHeightCaching()
		{
			if (fixedHeaderHeightCachingCounter != 0)
			{
				fixedHeaderHeightCachingCounter--;
				if (fixedHeaderHeightCachingCounter == 0)
				{
					cachedFixedHeaderHeight = -1;
					totalHeaderHeightCache = null;
				}
			}
		}

		internal virtual bool CanCollapseChildBands()
		{
			if (layout == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return layout.BandExpansionIndicators switch
			{
				BandExpansionIndicators.None => false, 
				BandExpansionIndicators.ShowOnChildBands => true, 
				_ => false, 
			};
		}
	}

		internal override void FitColumnsToWidth()
		{
			//IL_0084: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (!base.Layout.AutoFitAllColumns || base.Layout.Grid == null || !((Control)(object)base.Layout.Grid).Created)
			{
				return;
			}
			Rectangle gridClientAreaRectangle = base.Layout.Grid.GridClientAreaRectangle;
			if (gridClientAreaRectangle.IsEmpty)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = ((base.Layout != null) ? base.Layout.VerticalScrollBarWidthResolved : ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)null));
			int num2 = gridClientAreaRectangle.Right - num - 2 * base.Layout.GetBorderThickness(base.Layout.BorderStyleResolved);
			if (num2 <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			int[] array = new int[base.Layout.SortedBands.Count];
			int num3 = 0;
			int num4 = -1;
			int num5 = -1;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Layout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = base.Layout.SortedBands[i];
				if (!ultraGridBand.HiddenResolved)
				{
					int hierarchicalLevel = ultraGridBand.HierarchicalLevel;
					num4 = Math.Max(hierarchicalLevel, num4);
					if (!ultraGridBand.CardView)
					{
						num5 = Math.Max(hierarchicalLevel, num5);
						num3 = Math.Max(num3, ultraGridBand.GetOrigin(BandOrigin.PreRowArea) + ultraGridBand.GetExtent(BandOrigin.PreRowArea));
						array[hierarchicalLevel] = Math.Max(array[hierarchicalLevel], ultraGridBand.GetExtent(BandOrigin.PreRowArea));
					}
				}
			}
			if (num5 < 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (num4 > num5)
			{
				int num6 = 0;
				for (int j = 0; j <= num5; j++)
				{
					num6 += array[j];
				}
				int num7 = num6 / (num5 + 1);
				num3 += num7 * (num4 - num5);
			}
			if (num3 == num2)
			{
				return;
			}
			double num8 = (double)num2 / (double)num3;
			for (int k = 0; k < base.Layout.SortedBands.Count; k++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand2 = base.Layout.SortedBands[k];
				if (ultraGridBand2.HiddenResolved || ultraGridBand2.CardView)
				{
					continue;
				}
				int hierarchicalLevel2 = ultraGridBand2.HierarchicalLevel;
				int right;
				if (hierarchicalLevel2 == num4)
				{
					right = num2;
				}
				else
				{
					int num9 = 0;
					for (int l = 0; l <= hierarchicalLevel2; l++)
					{
						num9 += array[l];
					}
					right = (int)(num8 * (double)num9);
				}
				ultraGridBand2.FitColumnsToWidth(right);
				ultraGridBand2.ResetBandOrigins(adjustChildBandsAlso: true);
			}
		}

				}
			}
		}

		protected static void AlignTopsOfSameTierRows(VisibleRow visibleRow)
		{
			if (visibleRow.HasPrevSibling || visibleRow.Row.HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))
			{
				return;
			}
			int tier = visibleRow.Tier;
			int num = visibleRow.GetTopOfRow(adjustForOverlappedBorders: false);
			bool flag = false;
			VisibleRow parentVisibleRow = visibleRow.ParentVisibleRow;
			while (parentVisibleRow != null && parentVisibleRow.Tier == tier)
			{
				flag = true;
				num = Math.Max(num, parentVisibleRow.GetTopOfRow(adjustForOverlappedBorders: false));
				if (parentVisibleRow.Row.HasPrevSibling(spanBands: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) || parentVisibleRow.Row.HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))
				{
					break;
				}
				parentVisibleRow = parentVisibleRow.ParentVisibleRow;
			}
			visibleRow.SetTopOfRow(num, adjustForOverlappedBorders: false);
			parentVisibleRow = visibleRow.ParentVisibleRow;
			while (parentVisibleRow != null && parentVisibleRow.Tier == tier)
			{
				parentVisibleRow.SetTopOfRow(num, adjustForOverlappedBorders: false);
				if (parentVisibleRow.Row.HasPrevSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) || parentVisibleRow.Row.HasSiblingInPrevSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))
				{
					break;
				}
				parentVisibleRow = parentVisibleRow.ParentVisibleRow;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				visibleRow.Row.SetHeight(visibleRow.Row.BaseHeight, notify: false);
			}
		}

		protected override void OrientVisibleRowBackward(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, VisibleRow visibleRow)
		{
			SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, hasHeader: false);
			visibleRow.PostRowSpacing = 0;
			if (context.lastRowInserted == null)
			{
				visibleRow.Tier = 5000;
				visibleRow.SetTop(context.regionHeight - visibleRow.GetTotalHeight());
				if (GetFixedHeaderHeight(includeOverlappedBorders: false) >= visibleRow.OrigTop + context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset)
				{
					visibleRow.SetTop(GetFixedHeaderHeight() + context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset);
				}
				return;
			}
			int num = context.lastRowInserted.Tier;
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			bool flag3 = false;
			UltraGridRow row = visibleRow.Row;
			UltraGridRow row2 = context.lastRowInserted.Row;
			if (row.Band == row.Band)
			{
				flag = true;
				visibleRow.SetTop(context.lastRowInserted.GetTop() - visibleRow.GetTotalHeight());
				if (GetFixedHeaderHeight(includeOverlappedBorders: false) >= visibleRow.GetTop() + context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset)
				{
					visibleRow.SetTop(GetFixedHeaderHeight() + context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				flag3 = row2.Band.HasSiblingBands;
				if (context.lastRowInserted.ParentVisibleRow == visibleRow)
				{
					visibleRow.SetTop(context.lastRowInserted.GetTop());
				}
				else
				{
					flag = true;
					flag2 = true;
					visibleRow.SetTop(context.lastRowInserted.GetTop() - visibleRow.GetTotalHeight());
					if (GetFixedHeaderHeight(includeOverlappedBorders: false) >= visibleRow.GetTop() + context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset)
					{
						visibleRow.SetTop(GetFixedHeaderHeight() + context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset);
					}
					UltraGridRow commonParent = row2.GetCommonParent(row);
					int num2 = visibleRow.GetTop() + visibleRow.GetTotalHeight();
					VisibleRow parentVisibleRow = visibleRow.ParentVisibleRow;
					while (parentVisibleRow != null && commonParent != parentVisibleRow.Row)
					{
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, parentVisibleRow.GetTop() + parentVisibleRow.GetTotalHeight());
						parentVisibleRow = parentVisibleRow.ParentVisibleRow;
					}
					context.lastRowInserted.SetTop(num2 + base.Layout.InterBandSpacing);
				}
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				num--;
			}
			visibleRow.Tier = num;
			visibleRow.PostRowSpacing = (flag2 ? base.Layout.InterBandSpacing : 0);
			bool hasHeader = flag3 && context.lastRowInserted.GetTop() > GetFixedHeaderHeight(includeOverlappedBorders: false) + 1;
			SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, context.lastRowInserted, hasHeader);
			if (context.lastRowInserted != null)
			{
				AlignTopsOfSameTierRows(context.lastRowInserted);
			}
		}

		internal override void AdjustDescendantBandOrigins(UltraGridBand band, int adjustment)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < base.Layout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
			{
				if (base.Layout.SortedBands[i].HiddenResolved)
				{
					continue;
				}
				if (base.Layout.SortedBands[i] == band)
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				else
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						continue;
					}
					for (UltraGridBand parentBand = base.Layout.SortedBands[i].ParentBand; parentBand != null; parentBand = parentBand.ParentBand)
					{
						if (band == parentBand)
						{
							base.Layout.SortedBands[i].AdjustOrigin(adjustment);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal override void AdjustBandOrigin(UltraGridBand band, UltraGridBand priorBand, ref int origin)
		{
			origin = 0;
			while (priorBand != null)
			{
				if (priorBand == band.ParentBand)
				{
					origin = band.ParentBand.GetOrigin() + band.ParentBand.GetExtent();
					break;
				}
				priorBand = priorBand.ParentBand;
			}
		}

		internal override void AdjustExclusiveMetrics(ColScrollRegion csr, HeaderBase header, HeaderBase priorHeader)
		{
			int origin = ((priorHeader != null) ? ((header.Band == priorHeader.Band || header.Band.ParentBand == priorHeader.Band) ? (priorHeader.Origin + priorHeader.Extent) : (csr.GetBandOrigin(header.Band.ParentBand) + csr.GetBandExtent(header.Band.ParentBand))) : 0);
			SetExclusiveMetrics(header, origin);
		}

		internal override void GetFixedHeaderBands(VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows, UltraGridBand[] headerBands, ref int headerBandCount)
		{
			headerBandCount = 0;
			if (base.Layout.SortedBands.Count < 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = 0;
			VisibleRow visibleRow = ((visibleRows.Count > 0) ? visibleRows[0] : null);
			UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = null;
			if (visibleRow != null)
			{
				int tier = visibleRow.Tier;
				for (int i = 0; i < visibleRows.Count && !visibleRows[i].IsCardArea && visibleRows[i].Tier == tier; i++)
				{
					visibleRow = visibleRows[i];
				}
			}
			if (visibleRow != null)
			{
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = visibleRow.Row;
				ultraGridBand = ultraGridRow.Band;
				num = ultraGridRow.Band.HierarchicalLevel;
				headerBandCount = num + 1;
				while (ultraGridRow != null)
				{
					headerBands[num] = ultraGridRow.Band;
					num--;
					ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.ParentRow;
				}
			}
			if (headerBandCount < 1)
			{
				headerBandCount = 1;
				num = 0;
				headerBands[num] = base.Layout.SortedBands[0];
			}
			else
			{
				num = headerBandCount - 1;
			}
			int num2 = num;
			if (num2 + 1 < base.Layout.SortedBands.Count)
			{
				for (int j = 0; j < base.Layout.SortedBands.Count; j++)
				{
					UltraGridBand ultraGridBand2 = base.Layout.SortedBands[j];
					if (!ultraGridBand2.HiddenResolved && !ultraGridBand2.CardView)
					{
						int val;
						if (ultraGridBand2.ParentBand == headerBands[num])
						{
							num++;
							headerBands[num] = ultraGridBand2;
							headerBandCount++;
							val = num;
						}
						else
						{
							val = ultraGridBand2.HierarchicalLevel;
						}
						num2 = Math.Max(num2, val);
					}
				}
			}
			if (num2 < headerBandCount)
			{
				return;
			}
			for (int k = 0; k < base.Layout.SortedBands.Count; k++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand3 = base.Layout.SortedBands[k];
				if (!ultraGridBand3.HiddenResolved && (ultraGridBand == null || ultraGridBand3.IsDescendantOfBand(ultraGridBand)))
				{
					int val = ultraGridBand3.HierarchicalLevel;
					if ((val <= 0 || (headerBands[val - 1] != null && ultraGridBand3.IsDescendantOfBand(headerBands[val - 1]))) && headerBands[val] == null)
					{
						headerBands[val] = ultraGridBand3;
						headerBandCount++;
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	internal abstract class ViewStyleMultiBase : ViewStyleBase
	{
		internal override bool IsMultiBandDisplay => true;

		internal override UltraGridRow LastRow
		{
			get
			{
				UltraGridRow result = null;
				for (UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = base.LastRow; ultraGridRow != null; ultraGridRow = ultraGridRow.GetNextVisibleRow())
				{
					result = ultraGridRow;
				}
				return result;
			}
		}

		internal ViewStyleMultiBase(UltraGridLayout layout)
			: base(layout)
		{
		}

		internal override bool IsLastRow(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row.HasNextSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) || (row.Expanded && row.HasChild(excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows)) || row.HasSiblingInNextSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))
			{
				return false;
			}
			for (UltraGridRow parentRow = row.ParentRow; parentRow != null; parentRow = parentRow.ParentRow)
			{
				if (parentRow.HasNextSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows) || parentRow.HasSiblingInNextSiblingBand(excludeHidden: true))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
	internal class ViewStyleOutlookGroupBy : ViewStyleVertical
	{
		internal override bool IsOutlookGroupBy => true;

		internal override bool SupportsGroupByRows => true;

		internal ViewStyleOutlookGroupBy(UltraGridLayout layout)
			: base(layout)
		{
		}

		internal override void AdjustBandOrigin(UltraGridBand band, UltraGridBand priorBand, ref int origin)
		{
			if (band.ParentBand != null)
			{
				origin = band.ParentBand.GetOrigin() + band.ParentBand.PreRowAreaExtent;
			}
			else
			{
				origin = 0;
			}
			int num = 0;
			if (band.HasGroupBySortColumns)
			{
				num = CalculateGroupByIndent(band);
			}
			origin += num;
		}

		internal override void AdjustExclusiveMetrics(ColScrollRegion csr, HeaderBase header, HeaderBase priorHeader)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (header.FirstItem)
			{
				num = CalculateGroupByIndent(header.Band);
				if (header.Band.ParentBand != null)
				{
					num += header.Band.ParentBand.GetOrigin() + header.Band.ParentBand.PreRowAreaExtent;
				}
			}
			else if (priorHeader != null)
			{
				num += priorHeader.Extent + priorHeader.Origin;
			}
			SetExclusiveMetrics(header, num);
		}

		protected override void OrientVisibleRowForward(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, VisibleRow visibleRow)
		{
			HeaderPlacement headerPlacementResolved = visibleRow.Band.HeaderPlacementResolved;
			bool isGroupByRow = visibleRow.Row.IsGroupByRow;
			if (context.lastRowInserted == null)
			{
				visibleRow.Tier = 0;
				int num = ((!context.isBottomFixedRowsContext) ? GetFixedHeaderHeight() : 0);
				visibleRow.SetTop(num + context.rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset);
				SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, !isGroupByRow || HeaderPlacement.OncePerGroupedRowIsland == headerPlacementResolved);
				visibleRow.PostRowSpacing = 0;
				visibleRow.SpecialFlags = CalculateRowSpecialFlags(visibleRow, context.lastRowInserted);
				return;
			}
			visibleRow.Tier = context.lastRowInserted.Tier + 1;
			bool flag = visibleRow.Band == context.lastRowInserted.Band;
			bool flag2 = ((HeaderPlacement.OncePerGroupedRowIsland != headerPlacementResolved) ? (!isGroupByRow && (!flag || visibleRow.Row.ParentRow != context.lastRowInserted.Row.ParentRow)) : (!flag));
			SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, flag2);
			int postRowSpacing = 0;
			if (!flag || (!visibleRow.Row.IsEmptyRow && !visibleRow.Row.IsSummaryRow))
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					if (!(context.lastRowInserted.Row is UltraGridGroupByRow) || context.lastRowInserted.Row != visibleRow.Row.ParentRow)
					{
						postRowSpacing = base.Layout.InterBandSpacing;
					}
				}
				else if (!(context.lastRowInserted.Row is UltraGridGroupByRow) && visibleRow.Row.ParentRow == context.lastRowInserted.Row)
				{
					postRowSpacing = base.Layout.InterBandSpacing;
				}
			}
			context.lastRowInserted.PostRowSpacing = postRowSpacing;
			visibleRow.SetTop(context.lastRowInserted.GetTop() + context.lastRowInserted.GetTotalHeight() + context.lastRowInserted.PostRowSpacing);
			ViewStyleBase.SetNextCrossBandSibling(ref context, visibleRow);
			visibleRow.SpecialFlags = CalculateRowSpecialFlags(visibleRow, context.lastRowInserted);
		}

		protected override void OrientVisibleRowBackward(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, VisibleRow visibleRow)
		{
			HeaderPlacement headerPlacementResolved = visibleRow.Band.HeaderPlacementResolved;
			if (context.lastRowInserted == null)
			{
				visibleRow.Tier = 5000;
				visibleRow.SetTop(context.rowScrollRegion.Extent - visibleRow.GetTotalHeight());
				if (visibleRow.Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight() >= visibleRow.GetTop() + context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset)
				{
					visibleRow.SetTop(context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset);
				}
				SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, 0 >= visibleRow.GetTop());
				visibleRow.PostRowSpacing = 0;
				return;
			}
			visibleRow.Tier = context.lastRowInserted.Tier - 1;
			bool flag = visibleRow.Band == context.lastRowInserted.Band;
			bool flag2 = ((HeaderPlacement.OncePerGroupedRowIsland != headerPlacementResolved) ? (!context.lastRowInserted.Row.IsGroupByRow && (!flag || visibleRow.Row.ParentRow != context.lastRowInserted.Row.ParentRow)) : (!flag));
			SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, context.lastRowInserted, flag2);
			if (context.lastRowInserted.HasHeader)
			{
				context.lastRowInserted.SetTop(context.lastRowInserted.GetTop() - context.lastRowInserted.Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight());
			}
			int postRowSpacing = 0;
			if (!flag || (!visibleRow.Row.IsEmptyRow && !visibleRow.Row.IsSummaryRow))
			{
				if (flag2)
				{
					if (!(visibleRow.Row is UltraGridGroupByRow) || context.lastRowInserted.Row.ParentRow != visibleRow.Row)
					{
						postRowSpacing = base.Layout.InterBandSpacing;
					}
				}
				else if (!(context.lastRowInserted.Row is UltraGridGroupByRow) && visibleRow.Row.ParentRow == context.lastRowInserted.Row)
				{
					postRowSpacing = base.Layout.InterBandSpacing;
				}
			}
			visibleRow.PostRowSpacing = postRowSpacing;
			visibleRow.SetTop(context.lastRowInserted.GetTop() - (visibleRow.GetTotalHeight() + visibleRow.PostRowSpacing));
			if (0 >= visibleRow.GetTop() + context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset)
			{
				visibleRow.SetTop(context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset);
				SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, hasHeader: true);
			}
			else
			{
				SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, hasHeader: false);
			}
		}

		protected override ViewStyleSpecialFlags CalculateRowSpecialFlags(VisibleRow visibleRow, VisibleRow lastVisibleRow)
		{
			ViewStyleSpecialFlags viewStyleSpecialFlags = base.CalculateRowSpecialFlags(visibleRow, lastVisibleRow);
			viewStyleSpecialFlags &= ~ViewStyleSpecialFlags.SkipTopLevelHierarchyLines;
			return viewStyleSpecialFlags | ViewStyleSpecialFlags.DrawLongParentConnector;
		}
	}
	internal class ViewStyleOutlookGroupBySingle : ViewStyleSingle
	{
		internal override bool IsOutlookGroupBy => true;

		internal override bool SupportsGroupByRows => true;

		internal ViewStyleOutlookGroupBySingle(UltraGridLayout layout)
			: base(layout)
		{
		}

		internal override bool IsLastRow(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row.HasNextSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row.Expanded && row.HasChild(excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
			{
				return false;
			}
			while (row.ParentRow != null)
			{
				if (row.ParentRow.HasNextSibling(spanBands: false, excludeHidden: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows))
				{
					return false;
				}
				row = row.ParentRow;
			}
			return true;
		}

		internal override void AdjustExclusiveMetrics(ColScrollRegion csr, HeaderBase header, HeaderBase priorHeader)
		{
			int origin = ((priorHeader == null) ? CalculateGroupByIndent(header.Band) : (priorHeader.Extent + priorHeader.Origin));
			SetExclusiveMetrics(header, origin);
		}

		internal override void AdjustBandOrigin(UltraGridBand band, UltraGridBand priorBand, ref int origin)
		{
			origin = 0;
			int num = 0;
			if (band.HasGroupBySortColumns)
			{
				num = CalculateGroupByIndent(band);
			}
			origin += num;
		}
	}

			if (csr.Layout.SortedBands.Count < 1)

				return false;
			}
			for (int i = 0; i < csr.Layout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!csr.Layout.SortedBands[i].HiddenResolved)
				{
					AddBandHeaders(csr, csr.Layout.SortedBands[i]);
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

	internal class ViewStyleVertical : ViewStyleMultiBase
	{
		internal ViewStyleVertical(UltraGridLayout layout)
			: base(layout)
		{
		}

		internal override bool BandHasFixedHeaders(UltraGridBand band)
		{
			if (band != null)
			{
				if (HeaderPlacement.FixedOnTop == band.HeaderPlacementResolved && band.HeadersAreaVisible && !band.HiddenResolved)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in base.Layout.SortedBands)
				{
					if (BandHasFixedHeaders(sortedBand))
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal override void GetFixedHeaderBands(VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows, UltraGridBand[] headerBands, ref int headerBandCount)
		{
			headerBandCount = 0;
			foreach (UltraGridBand sortedBand in base.Layout.SortedBands)
			{
				if (BandHasFixedHeaders(sortedBand))
				{
					headerBands[headerBandCount++] = sortedBand;
				}
			}
		}

		internal override bool RecreateHeaderList(ColScrollRegion csr)
		{
			csr.VisibleHeaders.InternalClear();
			if (csr.Layout.SortedBands.Count < 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = false;
			int extent = csr.Extent;
			int position = csr.Position;
			for (int i = 0; i < csr.Layout.SortedBands.Count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = csr.Layout.SortedBands[i];
				int bandOrigin = csr.GetBandOrigin(ultraGridBand);
				int bandExtent = csr.GetBandExtent(ultraGridBand);
				if (!ultraGridBand.UseFixedHeaders)
				{
					if (ultraGridBand.HiddenResolved || bandOrigin + bandExtent < position)
					{
						continue;
					}
					if (bandOrigin > position + extent)
					{
						break;
					}
				}
				else if (ultraGridBand.HiddenResolved)
				{
					continue;
				}
				flag = AddBandHeaders(csr, ultraGridBand) || flag;
			}
			return flag;
		}

		internal override void AdjustBandOrigin(UltraGridBand band, UltraGridBand priorBand, ref int origin)
		{
			if (band.ParentBand != null)
			{
				origin = band.ParentBand.GetOrigin() + band.ParentBand.PreRowAreaExtent;
			}
			else
			{
				origin = 0;
			}
		}

		internal override void AdjustExclusiveMetrics(ColScrollRegion csr, HeaderBase header, HeaderBase priorHeader)
		{
			int num = 0;
			num = (header.FirstItem ? ((header.Band.ParentBand != null) ? (header.Band.ParentBand.GetOrigin() + header.Band.ParentBand.PreRowAreaExtent) : 0) : ((priorHeader != null) ? (priorHeader.Extent + priorHeader.Origin) : 0));
			SetExclusiveMetrics(header, num);
		}

		protected override void OrientVisibleRowForward(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, VisibleRow visibleRow)
		{
			if (context.lastRowInserted == null)
			{
				visibleRow.Tier = 0;
				int num = ((!context.isBottomFixedRowsContext) ? GetFixedHeaderHeight() : 0);
				visibleRow.SetTop(num + context.rowScrollRegion.scrollOffset);
				SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, hasHeader: true);
				visibleRow.PostRowSpacing = 0;
				visibleRow.SpecialFlags = CalculateRowSpecialFlags(visibleRow, context.lastRowInserted);
			}
			else
			{
				visibleRow.Tier = context.lastRowInserted.Tier + 1;
				bool flag = visibleRow.Band == context.lastRowInserted.Band;
				SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, !flag);
				context.lastRowInserted.PostRowSpacing = ((!flag) ? base.Layout.InterBandSpacing : 0);
				visibleRow.SetTop(context.lastRowInserted.GetTop() + context.lastRowInserted.GetTotalHeight() + context.lastRowInserted.PostRowSpacing);
				ViewStyleBase.SetNextCrossBandSibling(ref context, visibleRow);
				visibleRow.SpecialFlags = CalculateRowSpecialFlags(visibleRow, context.lastRowInserted);
			}
		}

		protected override void OrientVisibleRowBackward(ref VisibleRowFetchRowContext context, VisibleRow visibleRow)
		{
			if (context.lastRowInserted == null)
			{
				visibleRow.Tier = 5000;
				visibleRow.SetTop(context.rowScrollRegion.Extent - visibleRow.GetTotalHeight());
				if (visibleRow.Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight() >= visibleRow.GetTop() + context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset)
				{
					visibleRow.SetTop(context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset);
				}
				SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, 0 >= visibleRow.GetTop());
				visibleRow.PostRowSpacing = 0;
				return;
			}
			visibleRow.Tier = context.lastRowInserted.Tier - 1;
			bool flag = visibleRow.Band == context.lastRowInserted.Band;
			SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, context.lastRowInserted, !flag);
			if (context.lastRowInserted.HasHeader)
			{
				context.lastRowInserted.SetTop(context.lastRowInserted.GetTop() - context.lastRowInserted.Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight());
			}
			visibleRow.PostRowSpacing = ((!flag) ? base.Layout.InterBandSpacing : 0);
			visibleRow.SetTop(context.lastRowInserted.GetTop() - (visibleRow.GetTotalHeight() + visibleRow.PostRowSpacing));
			if (0 >= visibleRow.GetTop() + context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset)
			{
				visibleRow.SetTop(context.rowScrollRegion.ScrollOffset);
				SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, hasHeader: true);
			}
			else
			{
				SetHasHeaderHelper(ref context, visibleRow, hasHeader: false);
			}
		}

		protected override ViewStyleSpecialFlags CalculateRowSpecialFlags(VisibleRow visibleRow, VisibleRow lastVisibleRow)
		{
			ViewStyleSpecialFlags viewStyleSpecialFlags = base.CalculateRowSpecialFlags(visibleRow, lastVisibleRow);
			viewStyleSpecialFlags &= ~ViewStyleSpecialFlags.SkipTopLevelHierarchyLines;
			return viewStyleSpecialFlags | ViewStyleSpecialFlags.DrawLongParentConnector;
		}
	}
	[DebuggerDisplay("{Header.Caption}")]
	public sealed class VisibleHeader : SubObjectBase
	{
		private int origin;

			this.origin = origin;
			if (this.header != null)

				this.header.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)

		}

		internal void Unhook()

				header.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
			}
		}
	}
	public class VisibleHeadersCollection : SubObjectsCollectionBase
	{
		public class VisibleHeaderEnumerator : DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase
		{
			public VisibleHeader Current => (VisibleHeader)((IEnumerator)this).Current;

			public VisibleHeaderEnumerator(VisibleHeadersCollection visibleHeaders)
				: base(visibleHeaders)
			{
			}
		}

		private bool dirty = true;

		private ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion;

		private Stack visibleHeaderCache;

		public override bool IsReadOnly => true;

		public ColScrollRegion ColScrollRegion => colScrollRegion;

		public VisibleHeader this[int index] => (VisibleHeader)GetItem(index);

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		protected override int InitialCapacity => 30;

		public bool Dirty
		{
			get
			{
				return dirty;
			}
			set
			{
				dirty = value;
			}
		}

		protected Stack VisibleHeaderCache
		{
			get
			{
				if (visibleHeaderCache == null)
				{
					visibleHeaderCache = new Stack(100);
				}
				return visibleHeaderCache;
			}
		}

		public VisibleHeadersCollection(ColScrollRegion colScrollRegion)
		{
			this.colScrollRegion = colScrollRegion;
		}

		internal VisibleHeader GetVisibleHeaderFromCache()
		{
			if (VisibleHeaderCache.Count > 0)
			{
				return (VisibleHeader)VisibleHeaderCache.Pop();
			}
			return new VisibleHeader(ColScrollRegion);
		}

		internal VisibleHeader AddVisibleHeaderFromCache(HeaderBase header, int origin)
		{
			VisibleHeader visibleHeaderFromCache = GetVisibleHeaderFromCache();
			visibleHeaderFromCache.Initialize(header, origin);
			InternalAdd(visibleHeaderFromCache);
			return visibleHeaderFromCache;
		}

		internal int InternalAdd(VisibleHeader visibleHeader)
		{
			return List.Add(visibleHeader);
		}

		protected void CacheVisibleHeaderForRecycling(VisibleHeader visibleHeader)
		{
			VisibleHeaderCache.Push(visibleHeader);
			visibleHeader.Initialize(null, 0);
		}

		internal new void InternalClear()
		{
			VisibleHeaderEnumerator visibleHeaderEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (visibleHeaderEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					VisibleHeader current = visibleHeaderEnumerator.Current;
					CacheVisibleHeaderForRecycling(current);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = visibleHeaderEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			List.Clear();
		}

		public VisibleHeaderEnumerator GetEnumerator()
		{
			return new VisibleHeaderEnumerator(this);
		}

		public void CopyTo(VisibleHeader[] array, int index)
		{
			base.CopyTo(array, index);
		}

		internal VisibleHeadersCollection Clone(ColScrollRegion owningColScrollRegion)
		{
			VisibleHeadersCollection visibleHeadersCollection = new VisibleHeadersCollection(owningColScrollRegion);
			VisibleHeaderEnumerator visibleHeaderEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (visibleHeaderEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					VisibleHeader current = visibleHeaderEnumerator.Current;
					VisibleHeader visibleHeader = new VisibleHeader(owningColScrollRegion);
					visibleHeader.Initialize(current.Header, current.Origin);
					visibleHeadersCollection.List.Add(visibleHeader);
				}
				return visibleHeadersCollection;
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = visibleHeaderEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void Unhook()
		{
			VisibleHeaderEnumerator visibleHeaderEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (visibleHeaderEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					VisibleHeader current = visibleHeaderEnumerator.Current;
					current.Unhook();
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = visibleHeaderEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
		}
	}
	public class VisibleRow : SubObjectBase
	{
		private UltraGridRow row;

		private VisibleRow parentVisibleRow;

		private int tier;

		private int origTop;

		private int postRowSpacing;

		private ViewStyleSpecialFlags specialFlags;

		private int top;

		private bool hasHeader;

		private bool hookedIntoRowNotifications;

		private bool cardArea;

		private RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion;

		private DefaultableBoolean isFullyVisibleOverride;

		private int clipBottomTo = -1;

		private SubObjectDisposedEventHandler rowDisposedEventHandler;

		private VisibleRow attachedHeadersRow;

		public bool IsCardArea => cardArea;

		private SubObjectDisposedEventHandler RowDisposedEventHandler
		{
			get
			{
				if (rowDisposedEventHandler == null)
				{
					rowDisposedEventHandler = OnRowDisposed;
				}
				return rowDisposedEventHandler;
			}
		}

		public RowScrollRegion RowScrollRegion => rowScrollRegion;

		public VisibleRow ParentVisibleRow => parentVisibleRow;

		public UltraGridRow Row => row;

		public int Origin => Top;

		internal bool HasHeader
		{
			get
			{
				if (hasHeader && row.BandInternal.GetTotalHeaderHeight() < 1)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return hasHeader;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0023: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0036: Expected I4, but got Unknown
				if (IsCardArea)
				{
					hasHeader = true;
				}
				else if (row != null)
				{
					DefaultableBoolean hasHeadersOverride = row.HasHeadersOverride;
					switch ((int)hasHeadersOverride)
					{
					case 0:
						hasHeader = value;
						break;
					case 2:
						hasHeader = false;
						break;
					case 1:
						hasHeader = true;
						break;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					hasHeader = value;
				}
			}
		}

		internal bool IsAbsoluteFirstRow => row.IsAbsoluteFirstRow();

		internal UltraGridBand Band => row.BandInternal;

		internal int Bottom
		{
			get
			{
				if (IsCardArea)
				{
					return top + GetTotalHeight();
				}
				return GetTopOfRow() + row.BaseHeight;
			}
		}

		internal int BottomInClientOverall => GetTopInClient() + GetTotalHeight();

		internal int BottomOverall => GetTop() + GetTotalHeight();

		internal DefaultableBoolean IsFullyVisibleOverride
		{
			get
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				return isFullyVisibleOverride;
			}
			set
			{
				//IL_0001: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
				isFullyVisibleOverride = value;
			}
		}

		public int Top => top;

		internal int Tier
		{
			get
			{
				return tier;
			}
			set
			{
				tier = value;
			}
		}

		internal int PostRowSpacing
		{
			get
			{
				return postRowSpacing;
			}
			set
			{
				postRowSpacing = value;
			}
		}

		internal int OrigTop => origTop;

		internal bool HasPrevSibling => row.HasPrevSibling(spanBands: true, IncludeRowTypes.SpecialRows);

		internal ViewStyleSpecialFlags SpecialFlags

		}

		internal VisibleRow AttachedHeadersRow

		public VisibleRow(RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion)
		{
			this.rowScrollRegion = rowScrollRegion;
		}

		internal void UnhookFromRowNotifications()
		{
			if (hookedIntoRowNotifications)
			{
				if (row != null)
				{
					row.SubObjectPropChanged -= base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
					row.SubObjectDisposed -= RowDisposedEventHandler;
					row.DecrementVisibleRowCounter();
				}
				hookedIntoRowNotifications = false;
			}
		}

		internal void InternalSetRowScrollRegion(RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion)
		{
			this.rowScrollRegion = rowScrollRegion;
		}

		internal void Initialize(VisibleRow parentVisibleRow, UltraGridRow row)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			isFullyVisibleOverride = (DefaultableBoolean)0;
			if (parentVisibleRow == null)
			{
				if (row.BandInternal.ParentBand != null)
				{
					throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_303"));
				}
			}
			else if (!(parentVisibleRow.Row is UltraGridGroupByRow) && parentVisibleRow.Band != row.BandInternal.ParentBand)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException(Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString("LE_ArgumentException_304"));
			}
			UnhookFromRowNotifications();
			this.parentVisibleRow = parentVisibleRow;
			if (row != null && row.IsCard)
			{
				this.row = row.ParentCollection.GetFirstVisibleRow();
				if (this.row == null)
				{
					this.row = row;
				}
				cardArea = true;
				hasHeader = true;
			}
			else
			{
				this.row = row;
				cardArea = false;
			}
			top = 0;
			tier = 0;
			if (this.row != null && !row.IsCard)
			{
				this.row.SubObjectPropChanged += base.SubObjectPropChangeHandler;
				this.row.SubObjectDisposed += RowDisposedEventHandler;
				hookedIntoRowNotifications = true;
				this.row.IncrementVisibleRowCounter();
			}
			else
			{
				hookedIntoRowNotifications = false;
			}
			ResetClipBottomTo();
		}

		private void OnRowDisposed(SubObjectBase obj)
		{
			UnhookFromRowNotifications();
		}

		internal int GetTopOfRow()
		{
			return GetTopOfRow(adjustForOverlappedBorders: true);
		}

		internal int GetTopOfRow(bool adjustForOverlappedBorders)
		{
			int num = top;
			if (HasHeader)
			{
				UltraGridBand bandInternal = row.BandInternal;
				num += bandInternal.GetTotalHeaderHeight();
			}
			if (adjustForOverlappedBorders && SkipDblTopBorderDisplay())
			{
				num--;
			}
			return num;
		}

		internal void SetTopOfRow(int top, bool adjustForOverlappedBorders)
		{
			if (HasHeader)
			{
				this.top = top - Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight();
			}
			else
			{
				this.top = top;
			}
			if (adjustForOverlappedBorders && SkipDblTopBorderDisplay())
			{
				this.top++;
			}
		}

		internal bool SkipDblTopBorderDisplay()
		{
			//IL_006d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (row.RowSpacingBeforeResolved > 0)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (Row is UltraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			bool flag = HasHeader || (tier == 0 && Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight() > 0) || (ViewStyleSpecialFlags.SkipTopBorder & specialFlags) != 0;
			if (Row.IsCard)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					return Band.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(Band.BorderStyleCardAreaResolved);
				}
				return false;
			}
			if (flag)
			{
				return Band.ShareRowBorders;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal int GetTop()
		{
			return top;
		}

		internal int SetTop(int top)
		{
			int result = this.top;
			this.top = (origTop = top);
			return result;
		}

		internal int GetTotalHeight()
		{
			return GetTotalHeight(adjustForOverlappedBorders: true);
		}

		internal int GetTotalHeight(bool adjustForOverlappedBorders)
		{
			if (!IsCardArea && row != null && row.HiddenResolved)
			{
				int num = (HasHeader ? row.Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight() : 0);
				if (row is UltraGridGroupByRow)
				{
					num += row.TotalHeight;
				}
				return num;
			}
			int num2 = 0;
			if (IsCardArea)
			{
				int num3 = RowScrollRegion.Extent - row.Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight();
				num3 -= Top;
				if (RowScrollRegion.IsLastVisibleRegion && !Band.Layout.AutoFitAllColumns && (Band.Layout.Scrollbars == Scrollbars.Both || Band.Layout.Scrollbars == Scrollbars.Automatic || Band.Layout.Scrollbars == Scrollbars.Horizontal))
				{
					int num4 = Band.Layout?.HorizontalScrollBarHeightResolved ?? ScaledSystemInformation.GetHorizontalScrollBarHeight((Control)null);
					num3 -= num4;
				}
				if (row.Band.Index == 0 && (!row.Band.HasGroupBySortColumns || !row.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.SupportsGroupByRows))
				{
					num2 = num3;
					adjustForOverlappedBorders = false;
				}
				else
				{
					row.ParentCollection.ResetCardAreaHeightToExplicitlySetValue();
					num2 = row.ParentCollection.CardAreaHeight;
					int rowSpacingBeforeResolved = row.RowSpacingBeforeResolved;
					int rowSpacingAfterResolved = row.RowSpacingAfterResolved;
					num2 += rowSpacingBeforeResolved + rowSpacingAfterResolved;
					if (num2 - rowSpacingAfterResolved > num3)
					{
						if (row.Band.CardSettings.StyleResolved == CardStyle.VariableHeight || CardStyle.Compressed == row.Band.CardSettings.StyleResolved)
						{
							num2 = num3;
						}
						else
						{
							int totalActualRowsInCardArea = Row.ParentCollection.GetTotalActualRowsInCardArea(num3 - rowSpacingBeforeResolved);
							num2 = Band.CalculateRequiredCardAreaHeight(totalActualRowsInCardArea);
							Row.ParentCollection.InternalSetCardAreaHeight(num2);
							num2 += rowSpacingBeforeResolved + rowSpacingAfterResolved;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						Row.ParentCollection.InternalSetCardAreaHeight(0);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				num2 = row.TotalHeight;
			}
			if (HasHeader)
			{
				num2 += row.Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight();
			}
			if (adjustForOverlappedBorders && SkipDblTopBorderDisplay())
			{
				num2--;
			}
			return num2;
		}

		internal int GetTopInClient()
		{
			return GetTop() + RowScrollRegion.Origin;
		}

		internal int GetTopOfRowInClient()
		{
			return GetTopOfRow() + RowScrollRegion.Origin;
		}

		internal int GetRowBaseWidthHelper(ColScrollRegion csr, int rowLocationX)
		{
			if (Row is UltraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				if (csr.Extent > csr.OverallWidth && RowScrollRegion.WillScrollbarBeShown())
				{
					int num = Band.Layout?.VerticalScrollBarWidthResolved ?? ScaledSystemInformation.GetVerticalScrollBarWidth((Control)null);
					int val = csr.Extent - csr.GetBandOrigin(Band) - Band.GetFixedHeaders_ExtentDelta(csr) - num;
					int bandExtent = csr.GetBandExtent(Band);
					return Math.Max(val, bandExtent);
				}
				return Math.Max(csr.Extent, csr.OverallWidth) - csr.GetBandOrigin(Band) - Band.GetFixedHeaders_ExtentDelta(csr);
			}
			HeaderBase lastVisibleHeader = Band.OrderedHeaders.LastVisibleHeader;
			if (lastVisibleHeader != null && lastVisibleHeader.FixOnRightResolved && Band.IsHeaderFixed(csr, lastVisibleHeader))
			{
				return lastVisibleHeader.GetOnScreenOrigin(csr, Band.HasRowSelectors) + lastVisibleHeader.Extent - rowLocationX;
			}
			return csr.GetBandExtent(Band) - Band.GetFixedHeaders_ExtentDelta(csr);
		}

		internal Rectangle GetDimensions(ColScrollRegion csr, VisibleRowDimensions dimensions, DimOriginBase originBase)
		{
			int num = 0;
			if (Row is UltraGridGroupByRow)
			{
				num = Band.CalcGroupByRowIndent((UltraGridGroupByRow)Row);
			}
			Rectangle rect = new Rectangle(0, 0, 0, 0);
			if (dimensions == VisibleRowDimensions.HeaderArea)
			{
				if (!HasHeader)
				{
					return rect;
				}
				switch (originBase)
				{
				case DimOriginBase.Normalized:
					rect.X = 0;
					rect.Y = 0;
					break;
				case DimOriginBase.OnScreen:
					rect.X = csr.GetBandOrigin(Band) - csr.Position + Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(csr);
					rect.Y = GetTop() + RowScrollRegion.Origin;
					break;
				case DimOriginBase.Absolute:
					rect.X = csr.GetBandOrigin(Band);
					rect.Y = GetTop();
					break;
				case DimOriginBase.Relative:
					rect.X = csr.GetBandOrigin(Band) - csr.Position + Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(csr);
					rect.Y = GetTop();
					break;
				}
				rect.Width = GetRowBaseWidthHelper(csr, rect.X);
				AdjustForPreRowArea(ref rect);
				rect.Height = Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight();
				rect.X += num;
				rect.Width -= num;
				return rect;
			}
			int bandOrigin = csr.GetBandOrigin(Band);
			switch (originBase)
			{
			case DimOriginBase.Normalized:
				rect.X = 0;
				rect.Y = 0;
				break;
			case DimOriginBase.OnScreen:
				rect.X = bandOrigin + csr.Origin - csr.Position + Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(csr);
				rect.Y = GetTopOfRowInClient();
				break;
			case DimOriginBase.Absolute:
				rect.X = bandOrigin;
				rect.Y = GetTopOfRow();
				break;
			case DimOriginBase.Relative:
				rect.X = bandOrigin - csr.Position + Band.GetFixedHeaders_OriginDelta(csr);
				rect.Y = GetTopOfRow();
				break;
			}
			if (IsCardArea)
			{
				int preRowAreaExtent = Band.PreRowAreaExtent;
				rect.X += preRowAreaExtent;
				if (Band.ParentBand != null && Band.ParentBand.UseFixedHeaders)
				{
					if (Band.Layout.ViewStyleImpl.HasMultiRowTiers)
					{
						int scrollDelta = csr.Position;
						UltraGridBand.GetBandOriginExtent_HorizontalViewStyle(Band.ParentBand, csr, ref scrollDelta, out var _, out var _);
						rect.X += scrollDelta;
					}
					else
					{
						rect.X += csr.Position;
					}
				}
				else if (bandOrigin + preRowAreaExtent < csr.Position)
				{
					rect.X += csr.Position - bandOrigin - preRowAreaExtent;
				}
				rect.Width = 1;
			}
			else
			{
				rect.Width = GetRowBaseWidthHelper(csr, rect.X);
			}
			int rowSpacingBeforeResolved = row.RowSpacingBeforeResolved;
			rect.Y += rowSpacingBeforeResolved;
			if (IsCardArea)
			{
				rect.Height = GetTotalHeight() - row.Band.GetTotalHeaderHeight() + 1;
				int rowSpacingAfterResolved = row.RowSpacingAfterResolved;
				rect.Height -= rowSpacingBeforeResolved + rowSpacingAfterResolved;
			}
			else
			{
				rect.Height = row.BaseHeight;
				if (dimensions >= VisibleRowDimensions.InsideRowSelectors)
				{
					AdjustForPreRowArea(ref rect);
					AdjustForRowSelectorArea(ref rect);
					if (dimensions >= VisibleRowDimensions.InsideRowBorders)
					{
						AdjustForRowBorders(ref rect);
					}
				}
			}
			rect.X += num;
			rect.Width -= num;
			return rect;
		}

		internal void AdjustForPreRowArea(ref Rectangle rect)
		{
			int preRowAreaExtent = Band.PreRowAreaExtent;
			rect.X += preRowAreaExtent;
			rect.Width -= preRowAreaExtent;
		}

		internal void AdjustForRowSelectorArea(ref Rectangle rect)
		{
			int rowSelectorExtent = Band.RowSelectorExtent;
			rect.X += rowSelectorExtent;
			rect.Width -= rowSelectorExtent;
		}

		internal void AdjustForRowBorders(ref Rectangle rect)
		{
			//IL_0006: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			UIElementBorderStyle borderStyleRowResolved = Band.BorderStyleRowResolved;
			int borderThickness = Row.Layout.GetBorderThickness(borderStyleRowResolved);
			if (borderThickness >= 1)
			{
				rect.Y += borderThickness;
				rect.Height -= 2 * borderThickness;
				if (!Row.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(borderStyleRowResolved) || Band.RowSelectorExtent < 1)
				{
					rect.X += borderThickness;
					rect.Width -= 2 * borderThickness;
				}
				else
				{
					rect.Width -= borderThickness;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnSubObjectPropChanged(PropChangeInfo propChange)
		{
			RowScrollRegion.OnRowPropChange(this, propChange);
		}

		internal void ResetClipBottomTo()
		{
			clipBottomTo = -1;
		}

		protected override void OnDispose()
		{
			UnhookFromRowNotifications();
			base.OnDispose();
		}
	}
	public class VisibleRowsCollection : SubObjectsCollectionBase
	{
		public class VisibleRowEnumerator : DisposableObjectEnumeratorBase
		{
			public VisibleRow Current => (VisibleRow)((IEnumerator)this).Current;

			public VisibleRowEnumerator(VisibleRowsCollection visibleRows)
				: base(visibleRows)
			{
			}
		}

		private bool dirty = true;

		private bool internalCopyInProgress;

		private RowScrollRegion rowScrollRegion;

		private Queue cachedVisibleRows;

		public RowScrollRegion RowScrollRegion => rowScrollRegion;

		public override bool IsReadOnly
		{
			get
			{
				if (internalCopyInProgress)
				{
					return false;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public VisibleRow this[int index] => (VisibleRow)GetItem(index);

		[DesignerSerializationVisibility(DesignerSerializationVisibility.Hidden)]
		protected override int InitialCapacity => 30;

		public bool Dirty
		{
			get
			{
				return dirty;
			}
			set
			{
				dirty = value;
			}
		}

		internal VisibleRow LastRow

		protected void CacheVisibleRowForRecycling(VisibleRow visibleRow)
		{
			visibleRow.UnhookFromRowNotifications();
			for (VisibleRow parentVisibleRow = visibleRow.ParentVisibleRow; parentVisibleRow != null; parentVisibleRow = parentVisibleRow.ParentVisibleRow)
			{
				if (!Contains(parentVisibleRow))
				{
					parentVisibleRow.UnhookFromRowNotifications();
				}
			}
		}

		internal void InternalRemove(VisibleRow visibleRow)
		{
			CacheVisibleRowForRecycling(visibleRow);
			List.Remove(visibleRow);
		}

		internal void InternalRemoveAt(int index)
		{
			VisibleRow visibleRow = this[index];
			List.RemoveAt(index);
			CacheVisibleRowForRecycling(visibleRow);
		}

		internal new void InternalClear()
		{
			VisibleRowEnumerator visibleRowEnumerator = GetEnumerator();
			try
			{
				while (visibleRowEnumerator.MoveNext())
				{
					VisibleRow current = visibleRowEnumerator.Current;
					CacheVisibleRowForRecycling(current);
				}
			}
			finally
			{
				IDisposable disposable = visibleRowEnumerator as IDisposable;
				if (disposable != null)
				{
					disposable.Dispose();
				}
			}
			List.Clear();
		}

			}
			for (int i = num; first ? (i <= num2) : (i >= num2); i += num3)
			{
				VisibleRow visibleRow = this[i];
				if (!visibleRow.Row.FixedResolved && (!fullyVisible || IsFullyVisible(visibleRow, colScrollbarVisibility)))
