	internal class MergedCellCollection : SparseArray
	{
		private UltraGridColumn column;

		private MergedCellCache mergedCellCache;

		internal int likelyCellElementIndex = -1;

		private Hashtable nonMergedRows;

		internal MergedCellCache MergedCellCache => mergedCellCache;

		internal UltraGridColumn Column => column;

		internal RowsCollection Rows => mergedCellCache.Rows;

		internal MergedCellCollection(UltraGridColumn column, MergedCellCache mergedCellCache)
			: base(40, 0.25f, useOwnerData: false)
		{
			if (column == null || mergedCellCache == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			this.column = column;
			this.mergedCellCache = mergedCellCache;
		}

		internal MergedCell GetMergedCell(UltraGridRow row, bool allocate)
		{
			int index;
			return GetMergedCell(row, out index, allocate);
		}

		private MergedCell GetMergedCell(UltraGridRow row, out int index, bool allocate)
		{
			index = -1;
			if (nonMergedRows != null && nonMergedRows.ContainsKey(row))
			{
				return null;
			}
			MergedCell mergedCell = null;
			if (mergedCellCache.IsRowValid(row))
			{
				mergedCell = GetMergedCellHelper(row.Index, out index);
				if (mergedCell == null && allocate && index >= 0)
				{
					mergedCell = CreateMergedCell(row);
					if (mergedCell != null)
					{
						Insert(index, mergedCell);
					}
					else
					{
						if (nonMergedRows == null)
						{
							nonMergedRows = new Hashtable();
						}
						nonMergedRows.Add(row, null);
					}
				}
				if (mergedCell == null)
				{
					index = -1;
				}
			}
			return mergedCell;
		}

		private MergedCell GetMergedCellHelper(int rowIndex, out int index)
		{
			index = -1;
			int num = 0;
			int num2 = base.Count - 1;
			int num3 = 0;
			while (num <= num2)
			{
				num3 = (num + num2) / 2;
				MergedCell mergedCell = (MergedCell)base[num3];
				if (rowIndex < mergedCell.StartRow.Index)
				{
					num2 = num3 - 1;
					continue;
				}
				if (rowIndex > mergedCell.EndRow.Index)
				{
					num = num3 + 1;
					continue;
				}
				index = num3;
				return mergedCell;
			}
			index = ((num > num3) ? (1 + num3) : num3);
			return null;
		}

		private UltraGridColumn GetPrevSortColumn()
		{
			UltraGridColumn result = null;
			SortedColumnsCollection sortedColumns = Column.Band.SortedColumns;
			int i = 0;
			for (int count = sortedColumns.Count; i < count; i++)
			{
				UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = sortedColumns[i];
				if (ultraGridColumn == Column)
				{
					return result;
				}
				if (MergedCellStyle.OnlyWhenSorted == ultraGridColumn.MergedCellStyleResolved && ultraGridColumn.MergedCellEnabledResolved)
				{
					result = ultraGridColumn;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool CanCellsBeMerged(UltraGridRow row1, UltraGridRow row2)
		{
			if (!row1.IsDataRow || !row2.IsDataRow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridColumn ultraGridColumn = Column;
			bool flag;
			if (ultraGridColumn.MergedCellEvaluator != null)
			{
				flag = ultraGridColumn.MergedCellEvaluator.ShouldCellsBeMerged(row1, row2, ultraGridColumn);
			}
			else
			{
				MergedCellEvaluationType mergedCellEvaluationTypeResolved = ultraGridColumn.MergedCellEvaluationTypeResolved;
				if (MergedCellEvaluationType.MergeSameValue == mergedCellEvaluationTypeResolved)
				{
					object cellValue = row1.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn);
					object cellValue2 = row2.GetCellValue(ultraGridColumn);
					flag = RowsCollection.RowsSortComparer.DefaultCompare(cellValue, cellValue2, duringSort: false, ultraGridColumn) == 0;
				}
				else
				{
					string cellText = row1.GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
					string cellText2 = row2.GetCellText(ultraGridColumn);
					flag = cellText == cellText2;
				}
			}
			if (!flag)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (((ISparseArrayMultiItem)row1).ScrollCount > 1)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row1.AutoPreviewDisplayed)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (row1.Fixed != row2.Fixed || row1.IsFilterRow || row2.IsFilterRow || row1.IsAddRow || row2.IsAddRow)
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (ultraGridColumn.GetEditor(row1) != ultraGridColumn.GetEditor(row2))
			{
				return false;
			}
			UltraGridCell cellIfAllocated = row1.GetCellIfAllocated(ultraGridColumn);
			UltraGridCell cellIfAllocated2 = row2.GetCellIfAllocated(ultraGridColumn);
			if ((cellIfAllocated != null && cellIfAllocated.IsInEditMode && cellIfAllocated.EditValueChanged) || (cellIfAllocated2 != null && cellIfAllocated2.IsInEditMode && cellIfAllocated2.EditValueChanged))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (MergedCellStyle.OnlyWhenSorted == ultraGridColumn.MergedCellStyleResolved)
			{
				UltraGridColumn prevSortColumn = GetPrevSortColumn();
				if (prevSortColumn != null && !prevSortColumn.AreCellsMerged(row1, row2))
				{
					return false;
				}
			}
			if (row1.HasDataError(ultraGridColumn) || row2.HasDataError(ultraGridColumn))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		private UltraGridRow GetPrevVisibleRow(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			return Rows.GetPrevVisibleRow(row);
		}

		private UltraGridRow GetNextVisibleRow(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			return Rows.GetNextVisibleRow(row);
		}

		private MergedCell CreateMergedCell(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = row;
			UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = row;
			while (true)
			{
				UltraGridRow prevVisibleRow = GetPrevVisibleRow(ultraGridRow);
				if (prevVisibleRow == null || !CanCellsBeMerged(prevVisibleRow, ultraGridRow))
				{
					break;
				}
				ultraGridRow = prevVisibleRow;
			}
			while (true)
			{
				UltraGridRow nextVisibleRow = GetNextVisibleRow(ultraGridRow2);
				if (nextVisibleRow == null || !CanCellsBeMerged(ultraGridRow2, nextVisibleRow))
				{
					break;
				}
				ultraGridRow2 = nextVisibleRow;
			}
			if (ultraGridRow == ultraGridRow2)
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new MergedCell(ultraGridRow, ultraGridRow2, this);
		}

		internal void RemoveMergedCellFor(UltraGridRow row, bool removeNeighbors)
		{
			if (removeNeighbors)
			{
				UltraGridRow prevVisibleRow = GetPrevVisibleRow(row);
				UltraGridRow nextVisibleRow = GetNextVisibleRow(row);
				if (prevVisibleRow != null)
				{
					RemoveMergedCellFor(prevVisibleRow, removeNeighbors: false);
				}
				if (nextVisibleRow != null)
				{
					RemoveMergedCellFor(nextVisibleRow, removeNeighbors: false);
				}
			}
			if (nonMergedRows != null)
			{
				nonMergedRows.Remove(row);
			}
			int index;
			MergedCell mergedCell = GetMergedCell(row, out index, allocate: false);
			if (mergedCell != null && index >= 0)
			{
				RemoveAt(index);
				MergedCellCache.InvalidateItemAllRegions(mergedCell, dirtyDataAreaElem: true);
			}
			else
			{
				MergedCellCache.InvalidateItemAllRegions(row, Column, dirtyDataAreaElem: true);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class MergedCellCache
	{
		private RowsCollection rows;

		private int rowHeightVersion;

		private MergedCellCollection[] mergedCellCollArr;

		private int verifiedColumnsVersion = -1;

		internal int verifiedMergedCellVersion = -1;

		internal RowsCollection Rows => rows;

		internal UltraGridBand Band => rows.Band;

		internal int RowHeightVersion => rowHeightVersion + Band.MajorRowHeightVersion + Band.SynchronizedRowHeightVersion;

		internal MergedCellCache(RowsCollection rows)
		{
			this.rows = rows;
			verifiedMergedCellVersion = Band.MergedCellVersion;
		}

		internal bool IsRowValid(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			if (row.ParentCollection == rows)
			{
				return row.VisibleIndex >= 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void BumpRowHeightVersion()
		{
			rowHeightVersion++;
		}

		internal MergedCellCollection GetMergedCellCollection(UltraGridColumn column, bool allocate)
		{
			int index = column.Index;
			if (index < 0)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (verifiedColumnsVersion != Band.ColumnsVersion)
			{
				verifiedColumnsVersion = Band.ColumnsVersion;
				ColumnsCollection columns = Band.Columns;
				Hashtable hashtable = null;
				if (mergedCellCollArr != null)
				{
					hashtable = new Hashtable(columns.Count, 0.5f);
					MergedCellCollection[] array = mergedCellCollArr;
					foreach (MergedCellCollection mergedCellCollection in array)
					{
						if (mergedCellCollection != null)
						{
							hashtable[mergedCellCollection.Column] = mergedCellCollection;
						}
					}
				}
				else if (!allocate)
				{
					return null;
				}
				int count = columns.Count;
				mergedCellCollArr = new MergedCellCollection[count];
				for (int j = 0; j < count; j++)
				{
					UltraGridColumn key = columns[j];
					mergedCellCollArr[j] = ((hashtable != null) ? ((MergedCellCollection)hashtable[key]) : null);
				}
			}
			MergedCellCollection mergedCellCollection2 = mergedCellCollArr[index];
			if (mergedCellCollection2 == null && allocate)
			{
				mergedCellCollection2 = (mergedCellCollArr[index] = new MergedCellCollection(column, this));
			}
			return mergedCellCollection2;
		}

		internal MergedCell GetMergedCell(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column, bool allocate)
		{
			return GetMergedCellCollection(column, allocate)?.GetMergedCell(row, allocate);
		}

		internal void InvalidateMergedCellAllRegions(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column)
		{
			MergedCell mergedCell = GetMergedCell(row, column, allocate: false);
			if (mergedCell != null)
			{
				InvalidateItemAllRegionsHelper(mergedCell, column, dirtyDataAreaElem: false);
			}
		}

		internal void InvalidateItemAllRegions(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column, bool dirtyDataAreaElem)
		{
			InvalidateItemAllRegionsHelper(row, column, dirtyDataAreaElem);
		}

		internal void InvalidateItemAllRegions(MergedCell mergedCell, bool dirtyDataAreaElem)
		{
			InvalidateItemAllRegionsHelper(mergedCell, mergedCell.Column, dirtyDataAreaElem);
		}

		private void InvalidateItemAllRegionsHelper(object item, UltraGridColumn column, bool dirtyDataAreaElem)
		{
			UltraGridLayout layout = Rows.Layout;
			if (!Rows.IsPotentiallyVisibleOnScreen || layout == null || ((UltraControlBase)layout.Grid).IsUpdating)
			{
				return;
			}
			RowScrollRegionsCollection rowScrollRegions = layout.RowScrollRegions;
			ColScrollRegionsCollection colScrollRegions = layout.ColScrollRegions;
			for (int i = 0; i < rowScrollRegions.Count; i++)
			{
				RowScrollRegion rsr = rowScrollRegions[i];
				for (int j = 0; j < colScrollRegions.Count; j++)
				{
					ColScrollRegion csr = colScrollRegions[j];
					UIElement val = null;
					if (item is UltraGridRow)
					{
						val = ((UltraGridRow)item).GetUIElement(rsr, csr, verifyElements: false);
					}
					else if (item is MergedCell)
					{
						val = ((MergedCell)item).GetUIElement(rsr, csr);
					}
					if (val != null)
					{
						val.DirtyChildElements();
						if (dirtyDataAreaElem)
						{
							layout.DirtyDataAreaElement(primaryMetricsDirty: false, invalidate: false);
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private static bool ShouldBreakOnStateChange(MergedCell.State state)
		{
			if (state != MergedCell.State.Activation && MergedCell.State.Selection != state && MergedCell.State.EnterEditMode != state)
			{
				return MergedCell.State.Invalidate != state;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal void MergedCell_RowStateChanged(UltraGridRow row, MergedCell.State state)
		{
			if (mergedCellCollArr == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			bool flag = ShouldBreakOnStateChange(state);
			for (int i = 0; i < mergedCellCollArr.Length; i++)
			{
				MergedCellCollection mergedCellCollection = mergedCellCollArr[i];
				if (mergedCellCollection != null)
				{
					if (!flag)
					{
						InvalidateMergedCellAllRegions(row, mergedCellCollection.Column);
					}
					else
					{
						mergedCellCollection.RemoveMergedCellFor(row, removeNeighbors: true);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		internal void MergedCell_CellStateChanged(UltraGridCell cell, MergedCell.State state)
		{
			MergedCell_CellStateChanged(cell.Row, cell.Column, state);
		}

		internal void MergedCell_CellStateChanged(UltraGridRow row, UltraGridColumn column, MergedCell.State state)
		{
			if (!ShouldBreakOnStateChange(state))
			{
				InvalidateMergedCellAllRegions(row, column);
			}
			else if (MergedCellStyle.OnlyWhenSorted == column.MergedCellStyleResolved)
			{
				MergedCell_RowStateChanged(row, state);
			}
			else
			{
				GetMergedCellCollection(column, allocate: false)?.RemoveMergedCellFor(row, removeNeighbors: true);
			}
		}
	}
	internal class MergedCell
	{
		internal enum State
		{
			Activation,
			Deleted,
			EnterEditMode,
			ExitEditMode,
			Expanded,
			Hidden,
			Invalidate,
			Inserted,
			Selection,
			Value
		}

		private MergedCellCollection mergedCellColl;

		private UltraGridRow startRow;

		private UltraGridRow endRow;

		private int verifiedCachedHeightVersion = -1;

		private int[] heightMatrix;

		internal UltraGridColumn Column => mergedCellColl.Column;

		internal UltraGridBand Band => StartRow.BandInternal;

		internal UltraGridRow StartRow => startRow;

		internal MergedCellCollection ParentCollection => mergedCellColl;

		internal UltraGridRow EndRow => endRow;

		internal RowsCollection Rows => MergedCellCache.Rows;

		private MergedCellCache MergedCellCache => mergedCellColl.MergedCellCache;

		internal bool IsValid
		{
			get
			{
				int visibleIndex = StartRow.VisibleIndex;
				int visibleIndex2 = EndRow.VisibleIndex;
				if (visibleIndex >= 0)
				{
					return visibleIndex < visibleIndex2;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private int CellCount
		{
			get
			{
				if (!IsValid)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return 1 + EndRow.VisibleIndex - StartRow.VisibleIndex;
			}
		}

		internal int Height
		{
			get
			{
				EnsureHeightMatrixCalculated();
				if (heightMatrix == null)
				{
					return -1;
				}
				return heightMatrix[heightMatrix.Length - 1] - heightMatrix[0];
			}
		}

		internal MergedCell(UltraGridRow startRow, UltraGridRow endRow, MergedCellCollection mergedCellColl)
		{
			if (startRow == null || endRow == null || mergedCellColl == null)
			{
				throw new ArgumentNullException();
			}
			if (startRow.ParentCollection != endRow.ParentCollection)
			{
				throw new ArgumentException();
			}
			this.startRow = startRow;
			this.endRow = endRow;
			this.mergedCellColl = mergedCellColl;
		}

		internal bool ContainsCell(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			int visibleIndex = row.VisibleIndex;
			if (visibleIndex >= 0 && visibleIndex >= StartRow.VisibleIndex)
			{
				return visibleIndex <= EndRow.VisibleIndex;
			}
			return false;
		}

		internal UltraGridCell[] GetCells()
		{
			if (IsValid)
			{
				int visibleIndex = StartRow.VisibleIndex;
				int visibleIndex2 = EndRow.VisibleIndex;
				List<UltraGridCell> list = new List<UltraGridCell>();
				for (int i = visibleIndex; i <= visibleIndex2; i++)
				{
					UltraGridRow rowAtVisibleIndex = Rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndex(i);
					if (rowAtVisibleIndex == null)
					{
						return null;
					}
					list.Add(rowAtVisibleIndex.Cells[Column]);
				}
				UltraGridCell[] array = list.ToArray();
				if (array.Length >= 2)
				{
					return array;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void EnsureHeightMatrixCalculated()
		{
			//IL_0072: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0077: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ad: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01b8: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (IsValid)
			{
				if (heightMatrix != null && 1 + CellCount == heightMatrix.Length && verifiedCachedHeightVersion == MergedCellCache.RowHeightVersion)
				{
					return;
				}
				int visibleIndex = StartRow.VisibleIndex;
				int visibleIndex2 = EndRow.VisibleIndex;
				heightMatrix = new int[2 + visibleIndex2 - visibleIndex];
				RowsCollection rows = Rows;
				UltraGridBand band = rows.Band;
				UIElementBorderStyle borderStyleRowResolved = band.BorderStyleRowResolved;
				bool flag = band.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(borderStyleRowResolved);
				bool useRowLayoutResolved = band.UseRowLayoutResolved;
				int cellSpacingResolved = band.CellSpacingResolved;
				int num = cellSpacingResolved;
				if (!flag || cellSpacingResolved > 0)
				{
					num += band.Layout.GetBorderThickness(borderStyleRowResolved);
				}
				if (useRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					num += Column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.CellInsets.Top;
				}
				heightMatrix[0] = num;
				UltraGridRow ultraGridRow = rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndex(visibleIndex);
				int i = visibleIndex;
				int num2 = 0;
				for (; i <= visibleIndex2; i++)
				{
					UltraGridRow ultraGridRow2 = ultraGridRow;
					ultraGridRow = ((i < visibleIndex2) ? rows.GetRowAtVisibleIndex(1 + i) : null);
					if (ultraGridRow2 == null)
					{
						heightMatrix = null;
						return;
					}
					int rowSpacingAfterResolved = ultraGridRow2.RowSpacingAfterResolved;
					int num3 = ultraGridRow?.RowSpacingBeforeResolved ?? 0;
					int num4 = ((flag && ultraGridRow != null && rowSpacingAfterResolved <= 0 && num3 <= 0) ? 1 : 0);
					int num5 = ((ultraGridRow != null) ? (rowSpacingAfterResolved + num3) : 0);
					num2 += ultraGridRow2.Height - num4 + num5;
					heightMatrix[1 + i - visibleIndex] = num2;
				}
				int num6 = cellSpacingResolved;
				if (useRowLayoutResolved)
				{
					num6 += Column.RowLayoutColumnInfo.CellInsets.Bottom;
				}
				if (!flag || cellSpacingResolved > 0)
				{
					num6 += band.Layout.GetBorderThickness(borderStyleRowResolved);
				}
				heightMatrix[heightMatrix.Length - 1] -= num6;
				verifiedCachedHeightVersion = MergedCellCache.RowHeightVersion;
			}
			else
			{
				heightMatrix = null;
			}
		}

		internal int GetTopRelativeTo(UltraGridRow row)
		{
			EnsureHeightMatrixCalculated();
			if (heightMatrix != null)
			{
				int visibleIndex = StartRow.VisibleIndex;
				int visibleIndex2 = row.VisibleIndex;
				int num = visibleIndex2 - visibleIndex;
				if (num >= 0 && num < heightMatrix.Length - 1)
				{
					if (num == 0)
					{
						return heightMatrix[0];
					}
					return heightMatrix[0] - heightMatrix[num];
				}
			}
			return int.MinValue;
		}

		private static void ExcludeHorizBorders(ref Rectangle mergedCellClipRect, RowUIElementBase firstRowElem, RowUIElementBase lastRowElem)
		{
			if (firstRowElem != null && mergedCellClipRect.Y == ((UIElement)firstRowElem).Rect.Y)
			{
				mergedCellClipRect.Y++;
				mergedCellClipRect.Height--;
			}
			if (lastRowElem != null && mergedCellClipRect.Bottom == ((UIElement)lastRowElem).Rect.Bottom)
			{
				mergedCellClipRect.Height--;
			}
		}

			}
			return rect;
		}

		private bool PositionSelf()
		{
			//IL_0081: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0086: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0231: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0237: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02d0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02d5: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			//IL_02da: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02df: Invalid comparison between I4 and Unknown
			UltraGridColumn column = Column;
			UltraGridBand band = column.Band;
			RowUIElementBase rowUIElementBase = null;
			RowUIElementBase rowUIElementBase2 = null;
			CellUIElement cellUIElement = null;
			InitCellElemsList();
			if (RowElements.Count > 0)
			{
				rowUIElementBase = rowElements[0];
				rowUIElementBase2 = rowElements[rowElements.Count - 1];
			}
			if (CellElements.Count > 0)
			{
				cellUIElement = cellElements[0];
			}
			if (cellUIElement != null && rowUIElementBase != null && rowUIElementBase2 != null)
			{
				borderStyle = ((UIElement)cellUIElement).BorderStyle;
				Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)cellUIElement).Rect;
				rect.Y = elemTop;
				rect.Height = elemHeight;
				Rectangle rect2 = ((UIElement)this).Rect;
				if (rect2.Size == rect.Size && verifiedCellChildElementsCacheVersion == column.CellChildElementsCacheVersion && MergedCellContentArea.VisibleRect != column.MergedCellContentAreaResolved)
				{
					((UIElement)this).Offset(rect.X - rect2.X, rect.Y - rect2.Y, true);
					((UIElement)this).childElementsCollectionDirty = false;
				}
				else
				{
					verifiedCellChildElementsCacheVersion = column.CellChildElementsCacheVersion;
					((UIElement)this).Rect = rect;
				}
				Rectangle mergedCellClipRect = rect;
				Rectangle rowClipRect = GetRowClipRect(rowUIElementBase);
				int num = Math.Max(mergedCellClipRect.Y, rowClipRect.Y);
				mergedCellClipRect.Height += mergedCellClipRect.Y - num;
				mergedCellClipRect.Y = num;
				Rectangle rowClipRect2 = GetRowClipRect(rowUIElementBase2);
				mergedCellClipRect.Height = Math.Min(mergedCellClipRect.Height, rowClipRect2.Bottom - mergedCellClipRect.Y);
				Rectangle rectangle = cellUIElement.ClipSelfRect;
				if (!rectangle.IsEmpty)
				{
					mergedCellClipRect.X = rectangle.X;
					mergedCellClipRect.Width = rectangle.Width;
				}
				RowCellAreaUIElementBase rowCellAreaElement = cellUIElement.RowCellAreaElement;
				if (rowCellAreaElement.usingFixedHeaders)
				{
					int num2 = ((UIElement)rowCellAreaElement).RectInsideBorders.X - mergedCellClipRect.X;
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						mergedCellClipRect.X += num2;
						mergedCellClipRect.Width -= num2;
					}
				}
				borderSides = Border3DSide.All;
				if (rowCellAreaElement != null)
				{
					bool useRowLayoutResolved = band.UseRowLayoutResolved;
					if (band.Layout.CanMergeAdjacentBorders(((UIElement)rowCellAreaElement).BorderStyle, borderStyle))
					{
						if (!useRowLayoutResolved)
						{
							Rectangle rect3 = ((UIElement)rowCellAreaElement).Rect;
							if (rect.X == rect3.X + 1)
							{
								borderSides &= ~Border3DSide.Left;
							}
							if (mergedCellClipRect.Right + 1 == rect3.Right)
							{
								borderSides &= ~Border3DSide.Right;
							}
							ExcludeHorizBorders(ref mergedCellClipRect, rowUIElementBase, rowUIElementBase2);
						}
						else if (rowUIElementBase.topBorderOverlappedWithHeaders)
						{
							ExcludeHorizBorders(ref mergedCellClipRect, rowUIElementBase, null);
						}
					}
					else if (!useRowLayoutResolved && rowCellAreaElement.mergeableCellBordersBetweenRows)
					{
						borderSides &= ~Border3DSide.Top;
					}
					else if (1 == (int)borderStyle && 1 != (int)((UIElement)rowCellAreaElement).BorderStyle)
					{
						ExcludeHorizBorders(ref mergedCellClipRect, rowUIElementBase, rowUIElementBase2);
					}
				}
				clipSelfRect = ((rect != mergedCellClipRect) ? mergedCellClipRect : Rectangle.Empty);
				return true;
			}
			if (!((DisposableObject)this).Disposed)
			{
				((DisposableObject)(object)this).Dispose();
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static Rectangle GetCellRectHelper(CellUIElement cellElem, bool includeEntireRowHeight)
		{
			Rectangle rect = ((UIElement)cellElem).Rect;
			Rectangle rect2 = ((UIElement)cellElem.RowCellAreaElement).Rect;
			Border3DSide border3DSide = ((UIElement)cellElem).BorderSides;
			if (!includeEntireRowHeight)
			{
				if ((Border3DSide.Top & border3DSide) == 0 && rect.Y - 1 == rect2.Y)
				{
					rect.Y--;
					rect.Height++;
				}
				if ((Border3DSide.Bottom & border3DSide) == 0 && rect.Bottom + 1 == rect2.Bottom)
				{
					rect.Height++;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				rect.Y = rect2.Y;
				rect.Height = rect2.Height;
			}
			return rect;
		}

		private Region CreateRegion(bool forceCreation)
		{
			Region region = ((!clipSelfRect.IsEmpty) ? new Region(clipSelfRect) : ((UIElement)this).Region);
			if (IsActiveCellElemDrawn())
			{
				if (region == null)
				{
					region = new Region(((UIElement)this).ClipRect);
				}
				Rectangle cellRectHelper = GetCellRectHelper(activeCellElem, includeEntireRowHeight: false);
				region.Exclude(cellRectHelper);
			}
			else if (region == null && forceCreation)
			{
				region = new Region(((UIElement)this).ClipRect);
			}
			return region;
		}

		private bool IsActiveCellElemDrawn()

				{
					return IsCellStyleButton(activeCellElem);
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private Rectangle GetFocusRectHelper()
		{
			UIElement val = null;
			if (activeCellElem != null)
			{
				val = (UIElement)(object)((!isActiveCellElemInEditMode) ? activeCellElem : null);
			}

				UltraGridBand ultraGridBand = ((MergedCell != null) ? MergedCell.Band : null);
				if (ultraGridBand != null && ultraGridBand.Layout != null)
				{

				}
			}

			}
			return Rectangle.Empty;
		}

		private CellUIElement GetCellElemFromPoint(Point point)
		{
			if (cellElements != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < cellElements.Count; i++)
				{
					CellUIElement cellUIElement = cellElements[i];
					if (cellUIElement != null && ((UIElement)cellUIElement).Rect.Contains(point))
					{
						return cellUIElement;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool ShouldMannuallyEnterEditMode(Point point)
		{
			EmbeddableUIElementBase val = GetCellElemFromPoint(point)?.FindEmbeddableUIElement(extract: false);
			if (val != null && val.Editor is CheckEditor && val.Owner != null && !val.IsInEditMode && !val.Owner.IsReadOnly(val.OwnerContext))
			{
				return val.Owner.IsEnabled(val.OwnerContext);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void CalculateSpecialRegions(out Region selectedRegion, out CellUIElement activeCellElem, out CellUIElement hotTrackedCellElem)
		{
			selectedRegion = null;
			activeCellElem = null;
			hotTrackedCellElem = null;
			UltraGridColumn column = Column;
			for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
			{
				int j = 0;
				for (int count = cellElements.Count; j < count; j++)
				{
					CellUIElement cellUIElement = cellElements[j];
					UltraGridRow row = cellUIElement.Row;
					if (i == 0)
					{
						if (GridUtils.IsRowHotTracking((UIElement)(object)cellUIElement) && (row.HasRowHotTrackingAppearances || row.HasCellHotTrackingAppearances(column)))
						{
							hotTrackedCellElem = cellUIElement;
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (1 == i)
					{
						if (activeRowElem != null && row == activeRowElem.Row)
						{
							if (cellUIElement != hotTrackedCellElem)
							{
								activeCellElem = cellUIElement;
							}
							break;
						}
					}
					else if (cellUIElement != activeCellElem && cellUIElement != hotTrackedCellElem)
					{
						if (selectedRegion == null)
						{
							selectedRegion = new Region(Rectangle.Empty);
						}
						UltraGridCell ultraGridCell = row?.GetCellIfAllocated(column);
						if (ultraGridCell != null && ultraGridCell.Selected)
						{
							selectedRegion.Union(GetCellRectHelper(cellUIElement, includeEntireRowHeight: false));
						}
						else if (row != null && row.Selected)
						{
							selectedRegion.Union(GetCellRectHelper(cellUIElement, includeEntireRowHeight: true));
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

		}

		public override object GetContext(Type type, bool checkParentElementContexts)
		{
			if (typeof(UltraGridCell) == type)
			{
				return Cell;
			}

					displayName = Infragistics.Shared.SR.GetString(null, resourceName);
				}
				return displayName;
			}
		}

		public LocalizedDisplayNameAttribute(string resourceName)
		{
			this.resourceName = resourceName;
		}
	}
